rows.original:
As soon as you enter the Frost Hound's common room, Garth makes his way over to you with an awkwardly shaped package in his hands. The thing is tightly wrapped in paper, enough that you can tell the shape resembles a humanoid head. You [pc.dcb
        |set your jaw
        |straighten up
        |pout adorably
    ], readying yourself for bad news.
    
    "Champion," the old wolf says, holding up a hand. "This came for you in the night. There's no need to worry, I think. It feels much more heavy and solid than an actual head."
    
    You take the offered package, and sure enough there's a heft to it that banishes at least most of the worries you had. Still, what could this thing possibly be?
    
    Wandering up to your room with the package in hand, you take a seat on the edge of your bed. Warily, you begin peeling away the paper bit by bit. If the thing is going to explode, you want to be able to fling it away as easily as possible. Nothing like that happens, however, and you continue peeling until you've revealed an entire smooth marble bust. It's also not difficult to guess who sent the package, and you roll your eyes as you gaze into the petulant stone smirk of Tollus in statue form.
    
    Before you can prepare to toss the stupid thing out the window, however, you start with surprise as its mouth begins to move.
    
    "Ah! Champion! Nice of you to finally open my package," it says, in Tollus's voice. "I could prattle at length to irritate you, but the duration of this spell is limited and I wish to fill you in on as many of the juicy details as possible. I think your dear [flags.AHMRI_CAMP_SEX
        |lover
        |new friend
    ] from the centaur village is very much ready to return to you! The chieftain's daughter, was she? Shame about what happened to her father, but she came around just as easily when it came down to it. Be a good sport and come pick her up, will you? You can find us in these wonderful tunnels beneath the undermountain, in the... Ah, time's running down, I'm sure you'll find it."
    
    With that, the magic animating the bust is gone, and you're left with a furrowed brow and a new facet to your quest. You don't like that the cult leader is outright telling you where he took Ahmri, and it reeks of a trap. However, it's not like you've found any other leads after he stole her right out from under you. First things first, you take the statue head down and outside, where you give it a good smash with a sledgehammer from your pack. It doesn't actually help, but smashing the likeness of Tollus fills you with determination about doing the real thing.
    
    You'll find where he's hiding if you've gotta search the entirety of the abandoned villages in the undermountains.
rows.translation:
你刚走进寒霜猎犬的公共休息室，加斯便双手捧着一个形状古怪的包裹向你走来。那东西被纸张层层紧裹，依然能看出形似一颗类人头颅。你[pc.dcb
        |咬紧牙关
        |挺直身体
        |可爱地噘起嘴巴
    ]，准备听到坏消息。
    
    “勇者，”老狼举起一只手说道。“这是夜里送给你的。我想，不必担心。它摸起来比真正的头颅沉重结实得多。”
    
    你接过递来的包裹；果然，它颇有分量，至少打消了你的大部分忧虑。不过，这东西究竟会是什么？
    
    你手持包裹走上楼、回到房间，在床沿坐下。你保持警惕，一点点剥开纸张。如果这东西会爆炸，就得确保自己能尽快扔掉它。然而，什么也没发生；你继续拆开包装，直到一尊完整光滑的大理石半身像显露出来。送来包裹的人也不难猜，你看着化作雕像的托勒斯那副赌气般的石头坏笑，不禁翻了个白眼。
    
    然而，还没来得及把这蠢东西扔出窗外，它的嘴巴便动了起来，令你惊得浑身一颤。
    
    “啊！勇者！你终于愿意打开我的包裹，真是太好了，”它以托勒斯的声音说道。“我大可以长篇大论地惹你心烦，不过这个法术持续时间有限，我想尽可能多地告诉你那些香艳细节。你来自半人马村庄的亲爱[flags.AHMRI_CAMP_SEX
        |爱人
        |新朋友
    ]似乎已经非常期待回到你身边！她是酋长的女儿，对吧？她父亲的遭遇实在可惜，不过事到临头，她倒也同样轻易地回心转意。做个好人，来把她接走，行吗？你可以在山腹深域下方这些绝妙隧道中的……啊，时间所剩无几，我相信你能找到。”
    
    话音落下，驱动半身像的魔法就此消散，只留下眉头紧锁的你，以及任务中的一条新线索。邪教首领直接告诉你他把阿赫米带去了哪里，令你十分不安；这件事处处透着陷阱的气息。然而，他从你眼皮底下掳走阿赫米以后，你也没找到其他任何线索。首先，你把雕像脑袋搬到楼下室外，从背包取出大锤，将它狠狠砸碎。这并没有实际帮助，但将托勒斯的肖像砸烂，令你下定决心也要如此对付本人。
    
    哪怕必须搜遍山腹深域所有废弃村庄，你也会找到他的藏身之处。

rows.original:
"A friend of mine, the daughter of the centaur village's chief, was kidnapped by Tollus some time ago. He sent me a cryptic message about being 'ready to return her', but gave no indication of where beyond being somewhere in the undermountain tunnels. I assume he must be keeping her in one of the abandoned villages or buildings, but I have no idea where to start looking. Could you spare anyone to help?"

    "That bastard," Calise says, gripping the shaft of her stave. "Give me an hour or two to ask among my men. If they haven't personally seen anything, then I'm still sure we can find someone who has."
    
    "Thanks, Calise. She got kidnapped while I was fighting her corrupted father, so I'd like to get her back."
    
    "Worry not, champion. We'll find her. Maybe even catch this gods-forsaken imp-herald while we're at it."
rows.translation:
我的一个朋友，那个半人马村落落庄首领的女儿，不久前被托卢斯绑架了。他给我发了一条含义隐晦的信息，说‘已经准备好把她交回来’，但除了表示她被关在地下山洞的某个地方之外，没有提供任何其他线索。我猜他肯定把她关在某个废弃的村庄或建筑里，但我完全不知道该从哪里开始寻找。你们能派些人来帮忙吗？”

    “那个混蛋……”卡莉丝紧握着她的法杖说道，“给我一两个小时，让我去我的手下们中间打听一下。如果他们没有亲眼看到什么，那么我们肯定能找到有人知道内情。”
    
    “谢谢你，卡莉丝。她是在我和她那堕落的父亲交战的时候被绑架的，所以我一定要把她救回来。”
    
    “别担心，勇士。我们一定会找到她的。说不定还能顺便抓住那个该死的邪神使者呢。

rows.original:
"Champion! One of my men heard something," Calise says once you get close enough. "We were pushed away from an encounter near the abandoned crossroads in the western tunnels. We were able to get the jump on a large horde of imps, and they broke ranks when we ambushed them, but the sheer flood forced us to retreat before we could pursue any of the larger groups. However, before the ambush, one of my scouts says he heard them discussing a prisoner they'd recently moved to a nearby abandoned waystation. We assume they're talking about Waystation Stenn."
    
    "That's wonderful news! Thank you, Calise."
    
    "It's my pleasure, [pc.name]. I can have a handful of men meet you there. We're spread thin, so it won't be more than a few, but it should help you be able to focus on what's important if there are any stragglers left. I can't be sure it's her, but it's a start. Gods' speed, champion[silly
        |, and go get that pone
    ]."
    
    "Anything you can spare will be a great help, I'm sure."
rows.translation:
“冠军！我的一个手下听到了一些动静，”当你走近时，卡莉丝说道。“我们在西部隧道那处废弃的十字路口附近遭遇了一伙敌人，被迫后撤。我们本来偷袭了一大群小恶魔，设伏时它们阵脚大乱，但数量实在太多，我们还没来得及追击那些较大的群体就被迫撤退了。不过，在设伏之前，我的一名侦察兵说他听到它们在讨论一个最近被转移到附近一座废弃驿站的囚犯。我们猜它们说的是斯坦驿站。”
    
    “这真是个好消息！谢谢你，卡莉丝。”
    
    “这是我的荣幸，[pc.name]。我可以派几个人到那里与你会合。我们人手很紧，所以最多也就几个人，但如果还有落单的敌人，他们应该能帮你专心处理要紧的事。我不能确定那就是她，但总归是个开始。愿诸神保佑你，冠军[silly
        |，去把那个小妞带回来吧
    ]。”
    
    “你能匀出来的任何人手都会是极大的帮助，我相信。”

rows.original: As you approach the abandoned waystation, you see the chains on its door are looser than they looked on your brief inspection. Additionally, you can hear snickers and laughter from through the barred windows. As you approach, [party.som |four |three |two ] minoan legionnaires join you from small side tunnels, ready to aid in your assault. Without giving any advance warning to those inside, you quietly unlatch the door and then give it a strong kick. As it flies open, the flock of imps within turn and stare in bewilderment. One glances toward a door at the back, and you start for it, letting your allies sweep in to stop the paltry demonlets from following. You easily slip past them and into the dimly lit back room, drawing your weapon and preparing for anything. The first thing that draws your eyes is the tall, robed frame of Tollus, but something's off. His form flickers like the many candles lighting the room. He turns when he hears the commotion, and his smile makes you grit your teeth. "Ah! Here she is now! Weren't you just espousing your revenge, dear? Now's the best chance you'll ever get," he says, looking at you but not talking to you. Then, he simply waggles his fingers, and dissipates like as much smoke. It's doubtful he was there at all, more likely using illusion magic to set off an elaborate trap. On the same end of the room as he'd been occupying, Ahmri is knelt on the floor. Enchanted chains connect her wrists to the ground, and she looks quite disheveled. Still, her white coat looks surprisingly unspoilt, and there are plates of mostly eaten food on the ground around her. Perhaps it's not too late after all? That's your line of thought, at least, until she looks up at you. A haze of red light sparkles in the darkness around her amber eyes, painting them crimson, and her mouth is twisted in a grimace of loathing. "Ahmri? Whatever they did to you, we can-" "You b-bitch. You couldn't just leave my village alone?" she says, ignoring your words. With the way she's speaking, you can't be sure she heard them at all. "[pc.name] took it back, you know, and [pc.heShe]'ll thwart anything else you try and pull. If I stop you here, though, [pc.heShe] won't have to. I can't keep relying on other people to solve my problems, so I'll have to stop you myself!" The raw emotion in her shout staggers you, and you feel the shift of arcane energy in the room. There's a sensation of twisting in the fabric of the air, and you watch as Ahmri begins to change. Starting right at the center of her chest, a spreading stain of purest white creeps over every inch of her body. Wherever it touches, her sun-kissed skin is changed to the new porcelain complexion. When it touches more sensitive parts, and her humanoid hair, they instead take on a bright cyan color. Her eyes change as well, with the sclera matching her hair and the irises matching her new skin. The red haze still clings around those changed eyes, however, and you watch her pull herself to her feet as her transformation continues. The binding chains hold her for another moment, and she shows a frustrated grimace as she pulls at them. The air swells with magical power, and there's a groaning snap as they come apart like bread fresh from the oven. She cries out triumphantly, and the last connecting bits of shackle melt away inside a wreath of cerulean. Like a summer blaze in an over-dry forest, the coloration races over her fluffy coat, changing her pure-white equine body to the blue of the deep sea. Her tail twists and knits together, becoming more solid and draconic while gaining a spaded tip. She grits her teeth in discomfort, but then waves the newly shaped tail around behind her. The changes settle with her general shape still being mostly the same, and she regards herself with some measure of awe and disbelief. Showering motes of fire spark between her fingers as she channels the power in the air. Then, her eyes alight on you again, and now they're full of brash confidence and well-intentioned malice. She can't stop looking herself over, and a giggle escapes her as she twirls and shimmers with fire. Power rolls off her in waves alongside the heat, like she's become a living bonfire of magical force. "I did it! I'm... still me! This feels fantastic! All right, red witch, time to meet your maker!" she says, immediately lunging toward you with fists shrouded in flame. Ahmri's taken a step that probably can't be undone, and your words are failing to find her ears, but you might still be able to beat this enchanted madness out of her. rows.original:
"So how are you enjoying life at the Wayfort so far?"
    
    "Oh my gosh, it's so wonderful here! Sure I've gotta disguise my cool powers around most of the people, but once they find out I'm from the centaur village that got overtaken by evil forces, they treat me real nice!" Ahmri explains. "I could totally see why some princesses opt for the 'get rescued' thing rather than trying to do anything for themselves. I dunno if I'd ever have considered completely going that route, but it's nice to have people praising and pampering you without needing to be a conqueror or something."
    
    "Yeah, [pc.dcb
        |but conquering is also pretty fun,
        |and being nice in return is good too,
        |it's nice when people are nice,
    ]" you say. "Just don't milk it so much that it becomes awkward."
    
    "I know, I know. Other than that I've mostly been hanging out with [flags.ALRAUNE_KILLED|the people passing through|the nice plant lady]. Even the people who don't know or care who I am are so interesting. Makes me feel like when I was a kid reading stories from the travelers, except now I'm seeing the people from those stories myself. Gods, I wish I knew how the fuck to use any of this potential."
    
    "We can always work on it after I resolve the whole 'threat to the world' thing," you offer.
    
    "Well yeah, but then the threat will be gone and I'll just be part of the problem," she frowns.
    
    "Hey, don't ever start down that line of thinking. Besides, you think the world will just stop having problems when Kasyrra is dealt with? Ask the Belharan Empire if a wriggly red demoness had anything to do with their problems. I'm sure we can find something to train you up for and then sic you on like a demonic siege weapon."
    
    "Pfft. Yeah, right," she says, but her frown turns up. "I guess you will still need help afterwards, though."
    
    "Exactly. I'm not gonna be shipping you off to a vault somewhere. We can figure out exactly what you'll be doing when we get there, but for now I'm glad you're adapting to the change in scenery."
    
    "Definitely. I want to go on at least one adventure with you once this is all over. Don't skimp out on me."
    
    "I wouldn't dream of it."
    
    "Good. Is there anything else you wanted to hear about?"

“那么，目前为止，你觉得驿堡的生活怎么样？”
    
    “哦，我的天，这里太棒了！当然，在大多数人面前，我得把自己的酷炫力量藏起来；不过只要他们知道我来自被邪恶势力占领的半人马村庄，就会对我特别好！”阿赫米解释道。“我完全能理解为什么有些公主不打算依靠自己，而选择‘等待获救’。不知道自己会不会考虑彻底走上那条路，不过无需当什么征服者，也能受到赞美与宠爱，这感觉很不错。”
    
    “没错，[pc.dcb
        |不过征服也很有趣，
        |而且以善意回报别人也很好，
        |别人友善相待时，感觉很不错，
    ]”你说道。“只是别过分利用这点，免得事情变得尴尬。”
    
    “知道啦，知道啦。除此之外，我主要和[flags.ALRAUNE_KILLED|过往旅客|那位友善的植物女士]待在一起。就连不知道或不在意我是谁的人都这么有意思。这让我想起小时候阅读旅人讲述的故事，只是现在亲眼看见了故事里的那些人。诸神啊，真希望我他妈知道怎样使用这一身潜力。”
    
    “等我解决整个‘威胁世界’的问题后，我们随时可以一起训练，”你提议道。
    
    “嗯，没错，可那时威胁已经消失，我反而会变成问题的一部分，”她皱眉说道。
    
    “嘿，永远别开始这样思考。再说，你觉得解决卡希拉以后，世上的麻烦就会全部消失？不妨问问贝尔哈帝国，他们遇到的问题和某个浑身蠕动的红色女恶魔有没有关系。我敢肯定，我们能找到目标来训练你，之后再把你当作恶魔攻城武器一样放出去。”
    
    “噗。是啊，没错，”她说道，不过紧皱的眉头已经舒展开来。“但事情结束以后，我想你依然需要帮助。”
    
    “正是如此。我可不会把你送进某座金库封存起来。等事情发展到那一步，我们再弄清楚你究竟该做什么；不过现在，我很高兴你能适应环境变化。”
    
    “当然。等一切结束，我至少要和你一起冒险一次。你可不能在这件事上敷衍我。”
    
    “想都不会想。”
    
    “很好。还有什么想听的吗？”

"[pc.isDK
        |So how do you plan on dealing with the imps if you get knocked up?
        |If you get pregnant like this, what do you plan to do about the imps?
    ]" you ask.
    
    "Gods, no, I don't even plan to think about it. Those things are gross and I dont want a single one of them coming out of me or anything I fuck. I plan to keep taking herbs and just being able to fuck whenever we or I want," Ahmri replies, raising her head proudly.
    
    "And if imps weren't a problem?"
    
    "Like if I could have a normal baby? I... hmm..." She pauses for a long moment after that, rubbing her chin and then furrowing her brow. "I don't know how I feel about that. I mean, I feel like I should feel something, but thinking about it just makes me feel kinda grumpy. I think I should want to have a kid with you, cause sex is real fun and you tried to rescue me, but there's a kind of really obvious empty spot there that I'm... not gonna dwell on."
    
    "Sorry, I didn't mean to put you in an awkward situation," you say.
    
    "Don't worry! The best part about it being an empty spot is it means I don't really have to care about it. It just gets neatly tucked away, and then I don't think about it unless it's brought up. I have to fight to care in the first place, even while we're talking about it."
    
    "In that case... what do you think of pregnancy in general?"
    
    "Oh! It's super hot, I love the idea of it! I used to hang out with pregnant women in the village all the time, and would help them get situated and stuff like that. I always thought getting pampered like that would be pretty sweet. Sometimes if I was real lucky I could feel their babies kick. Centaur babies are born pretty big, and it was fun getting to play with the foals when they were learning to walk and stuff."
    
    "Learning tends to be the best part," you muse. Before you can change the subject, Ahmri grabs hold of your wrist gently.
    
    "Hey [pc.name]," she says, a look of minor frustration creasing her brow. "If you do find a way to ignore the whole imp thing, you should come ask me about this again. I wanna know how I'll feel."
    
    "Sure. Don't worry about it too much."
    
    "I won't. Can't, even," she says with a giggle, but there's a level of discomfort behind the words.

        |如果这样怀孕了，你打算怎么处理那些小家伙们呢？
    ]你问这个干嘛？
    
    “天啊，我才不想去想那种事情呢。那些东西太恶心了，我绝对不希望它们出现在我身上，或者出现在我与别人发生性关系的时候。我打算继续服用那些草药，这样就能在我们任何一方想要的时候进行性行为了。”阿赫米骄傲地抬起头说道。
    
    要是小妖精们不是个问题该多好？”
    
    “比如说，如果我能生一个正常的宝宝该多好？我……嗯……”她停顿了很久，揉着下巴，然后皱起了眉头。“我其实不太清楚自己该有什么感觉。我觉得自己应该有些反应才对，但一想到这个，我就觉得有点烦躁。我想，我应该是想和你生孩子的，因为和你做爱真的很开心，而且你也曾经救过我……不过，我心里确实有个很明显的空缺，只是……我不想去深想它罢了。
    
    对不起，我并不是故意让你陷入这种尴尬的境地的。”你说道。
    
    “别担心！这个空位存在的最大好处就是，我其实根本不需要去关心它。它就被整齐地收了起来，除非有人提起，否则我根本不会去想它。甚至在我们讨论这个话题的时候，我也得努力让自己去关心它才行。
    
    那样的话……你对于怀孕这件事总体来说是怎么看的呢？”
    
    “哦！那简直太棒了，我非常喜欢这个想法！我以前经常在村里和孕妇们一起待着，还会帮她们解决各种麻烦。我一直觉得，能够得到这样的照顾和关怀，真的是一件非常幸福的事情。有时候，如果我运气好的话，甚至还能感觉到她们肚子里的宝宝在踢动呢。半人马的宝宝出生时体型都比较大，所以当它们还在学习走路的时候，我和它们一起玩耍，真的觉得非常有趣。
    
    学习往往是最有趣的部分，”你想着。还没等你换话题，阿赫米就轻轻抓住了你的手腕。
    
    “嘿[pc.name]，嗯，”她说，眉头微微皱起，露出一丝沮丧的神情，“如果你真的找到了办法忽略掉那个‘小不点’的事情，那就再来问我吧。我想知道自己会有什么感觉。”
    
    “当然。别太担心这个。”
    
    “我不会的。真的没办法担心，”她笑着说，但话语中却隐含着一丝不安。

rows.translation: 哇，天啊，你们两个真是太性感了，”阿赫米说着，快步走过来，在你们的脸颊上各吻了一下。“谢谢你们帮助我们，尤比卡。” 说着，她又变回了正常的大小，帮助那匹驮马摆脱了束缚，同时还不断地在它那被汗水浸湿的上半身上亲吻着。她还会帮你下来马，当你重新站稳身体时，她又会继续给你一连串的亲吻。等她忙完这些后，还会帮你穿衣服。不过，她要花更长的时间才能缩回到自己的上衣里，而且即使穿上了，你也会觉得那件上衣在之后还会显得有些紧绷。 尤比卡仍然显得有些恍惚，呆呆地笑着，享受着那些种子落在她双腿间的美好感觉。她在阿赫米的耳边低语了些什么，同时还亲了亲他的脸颊，然后也俯下身来亲了你一下。她身上的装备痕迹还新鲜可见，而在你们俩离开之前，她甚至都懒得再穿上衣服。 你们一路回到了阿赫米的家，然后她突然扑上来，给了你一个拥抱。 啊，有你在身边真是太开心了！我们应该多这样做一些才对！还有其他人你想去拜访吗？或者还有其他什么你想做的吗？确实真的吗？你选择的每一样东西都那么有趣。
rows.raw: " "Wow. Gods you two are so hot like that," Ahmri says, trotting over and planting a big kiss on each of your cheeks. "Thanks for helping us out, Eubicha." As she speaks, she shrinks back down to her normal size, helping the pack-mare out of her bondage while peppering her sweat-drenched upper body with kisses. She also helps you dismount, giving you a similar storm of smooches while you get your balance back. When she's all through, she helps you get dressed as well. It takes her a little longer to finish shrinking enough to fit back into her top, and even then you swear it remains tight for a little longer after that. Eubicha still looks to be half in a stupor, smiling dumbly and basking in the afterglow of seed pouring between her legs. She whispers something in Ahmri's ear, accompanying it with a smooch on the cheek, and then leans down to give you a kiss as well. The marks from her gear are fresh on her skin, and she doesn't bother even putting clothes back on before the two of you leave. You make it all the way back to Ahmri's home before she tackles you in a hug. "Ahhh it's so much fun when you're around! We should do that more often! Is there anybody else you want to visit? Or anything else you wanna do, even? Everything you pick is fun." "

rows.original: "Hold your horses for a second, [pc.name], before we get up to anything..." [pc.dcb |"What's climbed up your ass?" |"Something wrong?" |"Aww, what's wrong cutie?" ] The dragon general gives you a flustered little noise, tail coiling around her leg. "Look, you're doing me a solid leaving me to my own devices here. You even told me to make myself at home, for what it's worth." "Riiiight?" Aileh frowns and rubs her arm, "I'm used to a certain amount of pleasures in life. I grew up in Mom's palace, surrounded by thick-as-dirt servants or snooty researchers, with nothing to do but [silly |get swole |exercise ], eat, and fool around." "Your point being?" "I want—" she cuts herself off and growls, struggling to muster up some humility. "I would like, a little assistance with some creature comforts." Aileh takes a deep breath and continues, tail uncoiling and instead flicking around. "Don't get me wrong, I prefer being here than surrounded by airheaded succubi who want my soul, or my kids... or both. But I do miss my bed, and my bath. Not to mention the fact that all of my belongings are just stored in random bags." "You want me to bring you a bed, a bath, and... a cabinet? Armoire?" Aileh snorts and shakes her head, "I mean, if you pay a carpenter and a tailor, I can pick up the goods and fly them up here... Unfortunately most of my money is worthless, but I'll at least save on delivery." She flexes to make a point, biceps bulging and whipcord tendons tightening before she relaxes. "The bath is the harder one; back home we had plumbing basically everywhere in the castle. With pipes, and metal that wasn't just bloody bronze, and we had hot water on demand." "We can do that with an enchanter, [wayfort.stateABC | |I think that's the plan for the Wayfort's water in the future? |that's how hot water's done in most of the rest of the Wayfort. ]" The muscular dragon shakes her hair out before giving you an actual smile, "I deeply miss a scalding hot bath, followed by a lovely hair-wash — oh, and a brushing. Even big girls love brushy-time." "What do you have?" Aileh ponders, looking towards a scattering of boxes. "Silver razor, shaving kit, mirror, four hair brushes, and some changes of clothing. Oh, and my baby; Spinehewer." She waves fondly at the weighty long-hafted battle-axe, as though its slate-gray metal might wave back. "Anyway, if you don't want to get the stuff, I get it, I'll figure it out myself. I don't exactly want to go flapping back to mommy."
rows.translation: “先等一下，[pc.name]，在我们做任何事之前……” [pc.dcb |“什么东西钻进你屁股了？” |“出什么事了吗？” |“啊，怎么了，小可爱？” ] 龙将军慌乱地发出一声轻响，尾巴卷住自己的腿。“听着，你让我在这里自行安排，对我帮助很大。严格来说，你甚至让我把这里当作自己家。” “没——错？” 艾莱赫皱眉揉着手臂。“我已经习惯生活中的一定享受。我在妈妈的宫殿长大，周围尽是蠢得要命的仆人或自命不凡的研究员，无事可做，只能[silly |练得壮硕 |锻炼 ]、吃饭，还有到处寻欢。” “所以你想说什么？” “我想要——”她突然住口，低声咆哮，努力挤出一丝谦逊。“我希望得到一点帮助，让生活更加舒适。”艾莱赫深吸一口气，继续说道；尾巴松开腿部，转而在身后甩动。“别误会，比起被那些觊觎我的灵魂、孩子……或者二者兼有的无脑魅魔包围，我更喜欢待在这里。不过，我的确想念自己的床铺和浴缸。更别说我所有的东西都随意收在袋子里。” “你想让我给你带一张床、一个浴缸，还有……橱柜？衣柜？” 艾莱赫哼了声，摇摇头。“我的意思是，要是你付钱雇个木匠和裁缝，我就能取走成品、亲自飞着运回来……可惜，我的大部分钱毫无价值，不过至少能省下运费。”她绷起肌肉强调自己的话，二头肌鼓胀，绳索般的肌腱紧绷，随后放松下来。“浴缸才是比较麻烦的那个；在故乡时，城堡几乎处处都有管道。那里有水管，还有不只是该死的青铜的金属，而且热水随时可用。” “附魔师能做到，[wayfort.stateABC | |我想，这也是未来为驿堡供水的计划？ |驿堡其他大部分地方的热水就是这样实现的。 ]” 肌肉发达的龙女甩开头发，终于向你露出真诚的微笑。“我深深怀念滚烫的热水澡，以及之后舒服的洗发——哦，还有梳毛。大姑娘也喜欢梳毛时间。” “你究竟拥有什么？” 艾莱赫望向散落各处的箱子，沉思起来。“银剃刀、剃须工具、镜子、四把发刷，还有几套换洗衣物。哦，还有我的宝贝——断脊者。”她亲昵地向那把沉重长柄战斧挥手，仿佛灰石色的金属也会挥手回应。 “总之，你要是不想去买那些东西，我也理解，自己会想办法。我可不想拍着翅膀跑回妈妈那里。”

rows.original:
"What? A carpenter? Gods and stones, you don't mess around when it comes to all of your little grand constructions, huh? I should just put you in direct contact with one of the men or women I go to."

    [pc.isCunning
        |"And rob you of a finder's fee?"
        |"I wouldn't want you to feel lonely."
    ]
    
    Garth snorts and looks half tempted whip a cleaning cloth at you before shrugging. "True. Yeah I'll shake them down later today, double-bed frame, cabinet, planks and base for a bath?"
    
    "That's right."
    
    You slide a neat stack of coin across a counter that has grown well-accustomed to the passage of hard currency, and Garth deposits it away with a smirk. "It'll probably take them a couple days, you let your friend know."
    
    "Don't panic, but she's kind of a muscular red-scaled winged woman."
    
    Garth narrows his eyes [jaelyn.isDemon
        |looking unsure, before puts his hands up disarmingly and settles back again. "I'm sure you know what you're doing."
        |and looks across the tavern at towering form of Jael'yn as she serves a handsome lupine man a drink. "I guess you know what your doing, godspeed."
    ]
rows.translation:
什么？一个木匠？天啊，你们在建造这些精巧的结构时可真是丝毫不马虎啊，是吧？我应该直接把你介绍给我经常合作的那些木匠当中去。

    [pc.isCunning
        |还要剥夺你应得的中介费吗？
        |我并不希望你感到孤独。
    ]
    
    加斯哼了一声，似乎真想用清洁布打你一下，但最终还是耸了耸肩。“好吧，今天晚些时候我会把它们清理干净的——双人床的框架、橱柜，还有浴缸的木板和底座，对吧？”
    
    “没错。”
    
    你把一叠整齐的硬币推到柜台上，而这个柜台早已习惯了收到这些硬通货。加斯笑着把硬币收了起来。他们可能需要几天时间，你告诉你的朋友吧。”
    
    “别慌，不过她是个肌肉发达、有着红色鳞片和翅膀的女性。”
    
    加斯眯起了眼睛。 [jaelyn.isDemon
        |他看起来有些不确定，但随后还是举手表示没有恶意，然后又坐了下来。“我相信你们自己知道自己在做什么。
        |她望着酒馆对面，看到贾埃尔林那高大的身影正在为一位英俊的狼人男子倒酒。“我想你心里很清楚自己在做什么，祝你好运吧。
    ]

rows.original:
[wayfort.hasMaids
        |"Again you come to me for some Wayfort stuff? I'm hardly surprised. What will it be this time? Ballgowns? Robes?"
        |"Oh? What do you need from me?"
    ]
    
    "Bedding, blankets, lots of soft stuff to fold into a mattress for a two-person bed."
    
    "You sure do like to keep yourself busy, dear." Nelia rubs her hands together, "is this for a bedroom then? I can throw in a few free extras if you'd like... I have spare curtains and a couple of rugs."
    
    "That would be [pc.dcb
        |decent, yes.
        |great, thanks!
        |super, yay!
    ]"
    
    Nelia smirks and accepts the fistful of coin, tucking it into her top. "Very well! I'll get to work on that in an hour or so, should I expect someone to pick it up?"
    
    "Yes, she'll be tall, muscular, and winged."
    
    "...Huhm, don't suppose I'll miss them, then. Well, off with you dear!"
rows.translation:
[wayfort.hasMaids
        |“又来找我置办驿堡用品了？一点也不意外。这次要什么？舞会礼服？长袍？”
        |“哦？你需要我做什么？”
    ]
    
    “寝具、毯子，还要许多能叠起来做双人床垫的柔软材料。”
    
    “你可真喜欢给自己找事做，亲爱的。”内莉娅搓了搓手。“这是要布置卧室吗？如果你愿意，我可以免费附赠几样东西……我还有备用的窗帘和几块地毯。”
    
    “那就[pc.dcb
        |还算不错，可以。
        |太好了，谢谢！
        |太棒了，耶！
    ]”
    
    内莉娅得意一笑，接过满满一把硬币，塞进自己的上衣。“很好！我大概一小时后开始动工，会有人来取货吗？”
    
    “会，她身材高大、肌肉发达，而且长着翅膀。”
    
    “……嗯，那我应该不会认不出来。好了，亲爱的，你去忙吧！”

rows.original:
"Oh? Just one little rune for heating? Not even a problem, my dear... I keep a handful of them for sale."
    
    "That was easy..."
    
    There's a mischievous twinkle in her eyes when she saunters over to a desk, pulling out a little electrum disc and looking it over. "Just hammer this into a surface until it stays there, stroke up to heat up, stroke down to turn off! If it wears out, let me know, but this should be good for months."
    
    With a shrug, you pay for the rune stamp, and pocket it while she gives you a wicked little smile. "Don't be a stranger..."
rows.translation:
“哦？只要一个用来加热的小符文？这根本不是问题，亲爱的……我手头正好存着几个要卖的。”
    
    “这么简单啊……”
    
    她眼里闪着狡黠的光，慢悠悠走到一张桌子前，取出一个小小的琥珀金圆盘端详起来。“把这个往某个表面上一敲，直到它固定住就行；向上抚摸可以加热，向下抚摸就能关掉！要是它用坏了就告诉我，不过这东西应该能撑上好几个月。”
    
    你耸耸肩，付钱买下这枚符文印章，把它揣进口袋，而她则朝你露出一个坏坏的小笑容。“别见外啊……”

"...How disappointingly mundane! Good for you that simple runes such as that are the kind some of my daughters produce for practice. For a nominal fee, of course."
    
    Her tail idly slaps at a chest of drawers, which makes the tray roll out to reveal a handful of electrum discs. "Just a nominal, easy fee..."
rows.translation:
“……真是平淡无奇到了极点！不过，像那样的简单符文，恰好也是我的一些女儿练手时会画出来的东西，对你来说算是好事。当然，只要付一点象征性的费用就行。”
    
    她的尾巴随意地拍打着五斗柜，这一动作使得托盘自动弹了出来，上面放着几枚琥珀金币。“只是一笔象征性的、微不足道的小费用……”

rows.original:
"Hot water? I suppose that's easy to produce just a one-off stamp for, I might even have one in a trunk somewhere..." The muscular mare lowers herself down carefully into a crouch and flips her tail from side-to-side, kicking up the scent of a horny breeder even while she's simply running inventory.
    
    "Any luck?" you gasp.
    
    She chuckles once upright again, tossing you an electrum stamp covered in runes, barely wider than a coin. "Will that do for you? It's easy to use."
    
    "Yeah, this is great, thanks." You pull out a fistful of electrum and hand it off, [pc.dcb
        |smirking when she shivers at your touch
        |grinning when she gives you a pleased little shiver at your touch
        |making a little 'honk!' noise when you make contact with her waiting grasp
    ].
rows.translation:
“热水？我想只是做一个一次性的印章应该很容易，说不定我哪个箱子里就有一个……”这只肌肉结实的母马小心翼翼地蹲下身去，左右甩动着尾巴，即使她只是在清点库存，也散发出一头发情种马的气味。
    
    “有进展吗？”你喘着气问道。
    
    她重新站直身子，轻笑一声，扔给你一枚刻满符文的琥珀金印章，只比硬币略宽一点。“这个合你用吗？用起来很简单。”
    
    “嗯，这太好了，谢谢。”你掏出一把琥珀金递过去，[pc.dcb
        |当你的触碰让她浑身一颤时，你露出坏笑
        |当她因为你的触碰而愉悦地轻轻一颤时，你咧嘴笑了
        |当你碰到她伸过来接钱的手时，她发出了一声短促的吭叽
    ]。

After giving it a quick wipe-down you slip the ring onto the chain dangling from your greatsword, relieved to see it melt onto the chain and fit securely. Now when you give the hilt a shake it jingles pleasantly. "Come back soon? Perhaps to try out some smooches?"

rows.raw: ' "Hey, I'm looking for something." "Is it a good time?" The alraune mother giggles and cups her chest. "Oh! Maybe a chaste kiss? We've been working on those! Gave one to a hornet a while back and, gods, the swooning she did. Such a pretty little peach, gave her all my pollen." Before her tangent can go any further — as entertaining a thought as it is — you put up your hands to stop her. "Have you seen a silver ring, with a silver bell on it buried around here anywhere?" "Oh... odd question. Maybe, though! Hold still just a moment [pc.mf |master |mistress ]." The verdant beauty closes her eyes and concentrates, vines and petals rustling as she reaches out with some unseen senses. "Ah! It seems to be at the bottom of one of my pitchers... that should be easy enough to get!" She gives you a sweet smile, gesturing with a slow lift of her hand. Additional petals and leaves rise up to her knees, unleashing a cloud of fuck-inducing sweetness that makes your mouth water, before she reaches down and deftly plucks out some goopey silver. After giving it a quick wipe-down you slip the ring onto the chain dangling from your greatsword, relieved to see it melt onto the chain and fit securely. rows.original: It's hard to imagine the curvaceous, slutty plant-mother to do anything subtle, but when you lean in for a kiss she gives you a coquettish giggle and meets you. A finger gently tickles your chin, and her lips press softly against yours. There's a tingling on your [pc.lips] when the Alraune parts again, and she gives you a demure smile with one hand resting on her chest. "See? Just a lil' chaste kiss. Well? Did it get your heart all a-flutter?" "...Little bit." She giggles again, [pc.hasHair |straightening your hair |adjusting your gear ] like an attentive wife, eventually nodding proudly. "Go get 'em, [pc.mf |master |mistress ]. I believe in you!" You're not sure who's teaching the Alraune these things, but it is sweet of her.
rows.translation: 很难想象这个身材丰满、淫荡的植物母亲会做出任何含蓄的举动，但当你凑近去亲吻她时，她娇媚地咯咯一笑，迎了上来。一根手指轻轻挠着你的下巴，她的嘴唇轻轻贴上你的。 当阿尔劳妮再次分开时，你的[pc.lips]上传来一阵刺痒，她一只手按在胸前，给了你一个端庄的微笑。“看到了吧？只是一个小小的、纯洁的吻而已。怎么样？是不是让你的心跳加速了呢？” “……有一点吧。” 她又咯咯笑了起来，[pc.hasHair |替你理了理头发 |替你整理好装备 ]，像个细心的妻子，最后骄傲地点了点头。“去拿下它们吧，[pc.mf |主人 |女主人 ]。我相信你！” 你不知道是谁在教阿尔劳妮这些东西，但她确实很贴心。

rows.original: Approaching the harpy, you find her slumped over the table, storm-gray hair and feathers spread out all over the wood in a chaotic mess. One of her hands clutches a half-empty — or half-full — earthenware jug of brazenberry ale for dear life, fingers tightened about the handle so hard as to turn her knuckles white. Every so often, she takes a sip of the cheap swill, the action carving a smile into her lips that stretches across her deep-flushed face. The bird would be pretty, perhaps, but the complete and utter drunkenness kind of ruins that. That, and the eyepatch over one eye, that is. Seemingly oblivious to your presence, the harpy takes not a sip, but a full draught from the jug, and her expression is consequently nourished into one of perfect serenity; harmony and acceptance of her place in the world pour off the inebriated harpy in palpable waves... or maybe it's just the reek of drink. Well, there's one conflict to break the tranquillity of the scene: the more cheap alcohol the harpy consumes, the harder it is for her to coordinate her hand with her lips to continue the process. She struggles with herself for a whole minute, a bedraggled mess of feathers and soundly ignoring you while she focuses on this immense task; it's only when she's drained the last drop that her attention is drawn away from her barren jug and one bleary eye focuses on you. "...Mmm." Mm? "Brazenberry ale. Cheap, yet exquisite. I could sit here and enjoy this exquisite swill all day long." All right, this one's clearly had too much to drink — anyone who would describe brazenberry ale as exquisite clearly isn't thinking straight. You wave over to Rumie and ask the beetender if she's going to do anything about the situation. "Oh, that's just Antonina," Rumie replies. "Just Nina," the harpy mumbles, slurring her words. For a moment, she looks like her face is going to be introduced to the tabletop, but she pulls back at the last moment to avoid the collision. "Fine, Nina. But yes, [pc.name] — could you please leave her alone? She's one of my best customers. Spends all day in here, ordering enough for four or five, and always pays up front. That's more than I can say for some of the people who come in here." She spends all day in Rumie's bar? "Yes." And always pays up front and in full? "Yep!" Then where does she get the money to buy all of that brazenberry ale? There were a half-dozen empty jugs on the floor by her bench. Rumie shrugs. "Don't know, and so long as she keeps paying me and brings no trouble... I'm too busy to look into it.[wayfort.hasDaliza | Besides, isn't that Daliza's job as bailiff? Put her on the case, if you're that interested. ] But really, it's not a big issue. Weird things happen to people who try to take advantage of her, you know." Now that's something interesting, and on your property no less. Weird things? "Well, weird might be putting it on too strongly — she's probably just drunk a lot, as is usual. But a lone harpy clearly smashed out of her mind, most people see that as an easy target, you know? It's happened a couple of times and I was going to put a stop to it, but every time those rough customers suddenly decided that messing with her wasn't the best of ideas and thought twice about bothering her." Is she absolutely sure this drunken harpy isn't any bother? Rumie shakes her head so vigorously, she's a blur. "Nope!" Well, if she's paying in full and up front and isn't causing a bother, there really isn't any reason for Rumie to do anything about the harpy, especially if she's such a good patron as Rumie implies. It's not as if the Wayfort bar ever closes up... or at least, as far as you know. Still, if the harpy piques your interest, it might be worth trying to talk to her. Sure, it might be hard to get anything coherent out of her through the drunken haze, but this is your property and if she's going to be a permanent fixture in the Wayfort then it probably isn't going to be wasted time. For now, though, a breather...
rows.translation: 当你走近那个女妖时，发现她瘫坐在桌边，风暴灰色的头发和羽毛散落在桌面上，一片狼藉。她的其中一只手紧紧抓着一只半空或半满的陶罐，里面装着铜莓啤酒——手指紧紧地握住罐柄，以至于指关节都变白了。她偶尔会喝上一口那种廉价的酒，这个动作让她的嘴唇上浮现出一丝微笑，而她那通红的脸庞也因为这个微笑而显得更加生动。那只鸟或许挺漂亮的，但她的酩酊大醉却完全破坏了这种美感。还有，那一只眼睛上戴的眼罩。 那只女妖似乎完全没注意到你的存在，她并没有小口啜饮，而是直接将整个水壶里的水都喝了个精光。她的表情也因此变得无比宁静与平和，那种对自身在世间地位的认同与接纳，仿佛以一种清晰可感的方式从她身上散发出来。……又或许只是酒精散发出的刺鼻气味吧。不过，有一个矛盾现象打破了这一宁静的场景：女妖喝的酒越便宜，她就越难以协调手部和嘴唇的动作来继续饮酒。它挣扎了好一会儿，浑身都是羽毛，发出各种声音，完全无视你的存在，一心专注于这项艰巨的任务；直到它把最后一滴东西都消耗殆尽，它的注意力才从那个空空如也的“容器”上移开，用那只昏昏沉沉的眼睛盯着你。 ……嗯。” “嗯？” “那种布拉赞莓啤酒啊。价格便宜，但味道却非常棒。我可以坐在这里，一整天都享受这种美味的啤酒。” 好吧，这家伙显然喝多了——谁会把布拉赞莓啤酒形容得这么好呢，显然他是神志不清了。你叫过露米，问那个服务员她是否打算采取什么措施来解决这个问题。 哦，那只是安东妮娜而已，”露米回答道。 “就叫妮娜吧，”那个女妖含糊地嘟囔着，说话时语无伦次。有那么一瞬间，她的脸似乎快要撞到桌面上去了，但她在最后一刻及时缩了回来，避免了一场碰撞。 “好吧，妮娜。不过[pc.name] — 请您别打扰她好吗？她是我最好的顾客之一。她每天都会来这里，每次都会订购四五份食物，而且总是提前付款。有些经常来这里的顾客，可就做不到这一点啦。 她整天都待在露米的酒吧里吗？ “是的。” 而且总是提前把钱付清吗？ “没错！” 那她究竟从哪里弄来这么多钱来购买那些布拉森贝里啤酒呢？她坐的凳子旁边，地上放着半打空酒壶。 龙美耸了耸肩：“不知道啊。只要她继续付我钱，也不惹麻烦……我实在太忙了，没时间去管这些事情。[wayfort.hasDaliza | 另外，这难道不是达莉莎的职责吗？如果你真的感兴趣的话，让她来处理这个案子吧。 ]但说真的，这并不是什么大问题。你知道，那些试图利用她的人，总会遇到一些奇怪的事情。 这可真是有趣啊，而且还是发生在你的地盘上。奇怪的事情？ “嗯，说‘奇怪’可能有点夸张了——她大概只是像往常一样喝多了酒而已。但是，显然有个“孤僻的恶女”从她的脑海中冒了出来——大多数人都会认为她是个容易攻击的目标，你懂我的意思吧？这种事情已经发生过几次了，我本来打算制止这种行为，但每次那些粗暴的人都会突然意识到，招惹她并不是个好主意，于是就会重新考虑是否要再去打扰她。她真的是这样吗？当然可以。这个醉醺醺的女妖难道不会惹麻烦吗？ 露米拼命地摇头，头发都快摇乱了：“不会的！” 既然她能一次性付清所有费用，也不会惹任何麻烦，那么露米确实没有理由去管这个女妖——尤其是当她像露米所说的那样，是个这么好的顾客的时候。荒废驿堡酒吧似乎从来都不会关门……至少，据你所知是这样。 不过，如果那个女妖引起了你的兴趣，试着和她聊聊或许也是值得的。当然，由于她喝得酩酊大醉，可能很难让她说出连贯的话来，但这是你的地盘，如果她打算长期留在荒废驿堡酒吧的话，那么花这个时间应该也不会白费。 不过，现在还是先休息一下吧……

rows.original: [flags.NINA_MET 2 |You take a seat across the table from Nina and the half-dozen empty jugs around her, then wait for the harpy to notice you. She does so with more alacrity than one would expect of someone completely and utterly drunk, although her movements are still sluggish and it takes several tries for her to focus her good eye on you. [rand |"W-well, if it isn't [pc.mf |mister |miss ] owner of the Wayfort [pc.himHer]self," Nina mumbles, then hiccups. "Come to share a drink?" Maybe. You'd have expected her to be a bit more reluctant to share her drink, though. "Oh no, there's plenty to go around. Not just from Rumie, but I have my ways, too. So... just have all you want, don't worry about it. More where that came from." You'll consider it, but for now, you have business with her. "Yeah, okay, sure. I don't mind. So, what's up?" |"Oh, it's you. Didn't see you coming there." Not in one of her visions? "They don't come all the time, I don't get to choose when they happen or what they're about, and they're not always about me or you," Nina mumbles in reply, rapping her jug on the tabletop. "I don't tell them what to show me, they just come and I follow if I can." Well, you're here. Does she mind if you have business with her? "Nah, I'm between bouts of exploring the different realities our world's made up of and chasing the cute critters back to where they belong." She takes a swig of brazenberry ale. "What's up?" |"How's it hanging?" [pc.isBimbo |You're doing, like, totally amazing. And her? "Never been better, [pc.mf |brother |sister ]." Nina takes a swig of brazenberry ale and smacks her lips. "I just like, figured out the solution to something that's been bugging me with some of my friends." Wow, that's amazing! Did she, like, go and visit them? "Yeah. Didn't even need to leave the bar, either." She taps her head. "It's all up in here." |How's what hanging? "It's an expression of... of... what's it, used by — you know what, forget it. It's just something a couple of my friends say, okay?" She has friends? Every time you're at the bar she never fails to be occupying her usual spot. "Yeah, well. Maybe I don't need to leave this place to visit these friends of mine." ] There's an awkward pause in the conversation, and you soldier on ahead anyway. So, if she doesn't mind, you have some business with her. "Sure. I'm between some verrrry important things at the moment, so you caught me at a good time. What can I do for you?" ] |Putting on your most approachable face, you sit down across the table from the bedraggled harpy and wait for her to notice you. When that fails to elicit a response, you gently tap her on the shoulder — it's only then that Nina stirs, shivers and pulls herself together barely enough to raise her head and regard you. "Oh," she mutters. "How's it going?" You're doing perfectly fine, thank you. But you were hoping that this conversation would be more about her instead — you understand from Rumie that she's one of the bar's more regular customers, moreso than most people passing through the Wayfort in order to use the bridge. And well, since you're [pc.isBaron |the baron[pc.mf | |ess ] of this wayfort |kind of the ruler here ], you'd like to get to know her better if she's going to be a permanent fixture on your property and in your home. It takes several moments for the inebriated harpy to pull herself together enough to reply. "Oh. Sounds fair." So, if she doesn't mind answering a few questions to make sure she's not just some kind of drunk waiting to explode into trouble for poor Rumie... you note that your beetender said she's here all day, drinking copious amounts of brazenberry ale and always paying in full up front. The money's got to come from somewhere, right? What does she do all day? "You answered your own question, [pc.title]. I mostly drink brazenberry ale." Nina hiccups and sprawls out on the table's surface, assuming what presumably is a more comfortable position. "But I guess I also have visions and communicate with higher beings. Ah, crap, this jug's empty. Ru-mie!" A beleaguered Rumie trundles over with a full jug of brazenberry ale, accepts Nina's payment, and watches with mild distaste as the harpy unstoppers the fresh jug and guzzles greedily, rivulets of cheap alcohol running down her cheeks. A whole third of the jug's gone down her gullet before she finally ceases and wipes her mouth with the back of a feathery forearm, her one good eye refocusing on you. Higher beings? Like the gods? Is she claiming to be an oracle or prophet? "N-no, not like the Seven. Higher beings." Her words are slurring even more now, and she giggles. "Not quite the level of the gods, but above you or me. Like... like the fey queen, for one. Or wyld trees. Or things that live deep under the sea.[silly | Down there it's better, down there it's wetter, take it from me. ] "See, it's not easy having these amazing powers. Nah... it's tough, knowing all this stuff got me kicked out from chilling with the other harpies. The immense knowledge makes my head hurt, makes me tired, and worst of all, leaves my mouth achingly dry. Can't have that." Maybe it's just the brazenberry ale? It takes another several moments for her to process that. "It-it's not the ale. Don't say I didn't tell you — it's the powers, my dear [pc.title]. I could tell you, like, so many things that aren't just beyond your imagination, but would utterly blow your mind." Things she sees in these visions, then? "Or get told when chatting with those higher being folks, yeah." You note that she never answered your question on where all the money comes from. Oh well, harpies were never the most serious of creatures, and this one's drunk; that's a lot of brazenberry ale she's been drinking. "Don't deny it. Rumie keeps on saying things like 'really, Nina, you've had enough!' and the only thing that comes to mind is... no. Just no. I can keep going all day if I want to, and mostly I do. Got not just one, but two bottomless pits on me here — " she taps her stomach, and then her temples — "and here." "Anyway..." Nina's about to launch into another inebriated train of thought when she freezes, then slumps even further onto the table and begins muttering incoherently. Her one good eye goes wide, its pupil dilating to unsettling proportions, and something wets her eyepatch from the other side; after a minute of her incomprehensible ramblings, she raises her head and greets you with a chipper smile as if nothing had happened, her words a little less slurred than they were minutes ago. "Hey, how's it going?" What just happened? [pc.isCunning |She didn't just have one of those visions she was talking about, was she? "Oh-h, you're a smart cookie, [pc.name]. Yeah, it was about you." | Nina shrugs. "Oh, it was just one of those visions again." Well, what was it she saw? "You, [pc.name]." ] Wait, you don't remember telling her your name. Did she see it in her vision? "Not this one." She's had other visions of you? "Yeah?" Nina takes another swig from her jug. "See plenty of people in them, takes all kinds to make a world. You turn up two or three times every year." ...You sincerely hope you were dressed in most of them.[pc.isBimbo | Not that you're afraid or ashamed of being nude, but like, consent and all. ] "Nah. You don't look half-bad under that [pc.armor], which must be why just about everyone wants to jump your bones first chance. Most other people at least want dinner first." ...Assuming she's not just crazy, how is all of this even possible? Nina shrugs. "Harpies don't know how they fly. They just do.[silly | According to all known laws of aviation, a harpy should not be able to get off the ground. Happily, most of my sisters aren't about to let the law tie them down. ]" She's drunk. "Not denying it." Presumably stopping or even consuming less drink is out of the question? She eyes you suspiciously, if blearily. "Now why would I do that? I told you, the weight of all this knowledge is absolutely crushing, by the gods. I'd die of thirst if I stopped. Not as if I'm causing any trouble for Rumie, and if she's doing good business, you're doing good business." ...That is true. You get up to leave the bedraggled but ultimately harmless harpy, but a thought comes to mind. Just what was in the vision? "What do you mean?" Focus, girl, focus. The vision she just had minutes ago — what did she see in it? Moments pass in silence, and then realization slowly dawns. "Oh. Yeah. It's kind of a long story, so if you want to talk about it you might as well sit down for a long listen. Just ask me anytime." Sure. "So." Nina takes another long pull from the jug of cheap ale. "Anything else you want to know?" ]

]荒废驿堡的拥有者[pc.himHer]自我，”妮娜喃喃道，然后打起了嗝。“过来一起喝点东西吧？” 也许吧。不过，你本以为她会更犹豫一些，才不会这么爽快地邀请你一起喝东西呢。 “哦，没关系，有的是喝的。不只是露米提供的，我自己也有办法弄到东西。所以……想喝多少就喝多少，别担心，还有很多呢。” 你会考虑这个邀请的，但现在，你还有事情要和她谈。 “嗯，好吧，没问题。我不介意。那么，有什么事吗？ |哦，原来是你。没注意到你朝那边走了。” 难道她的预知梦里没有出现过这一幕吗？ “这些预知梦并不经常发生，我无法选择它们何时会出现，也无法知道它们会预示什么。而且，这些梦并不总是关于我或你的。”尼娜边说边用罐子敲打着桌面。我不会告诉他们该给我展示什么，他们只是主动出现，而如果可以的话，我就会跟着他们去看。” 那么，你现在在这里了。她会不会介意你去找她谈事呢？ “不会的，我正在忙于探索我们这个世界由哪些不同的‘现实’构成的，同时也在把那些可爱的小生物赶回它们该去的地方。她喝了一口铜莓啤酒，问道：“怎么了？ |效果怎么样？ [pc.isBimbo |你做得真的太棒了。那她呢？ “从来没有比现在更好的了。 [pc.mf |兄弟 |姐姐 ]妮娜喝了一口铜莓啤酒，然后满意地咂了咂嘴，说道：‘我刚刚想出了一个办法，解决了之前一直困扰我的一些关于朋友们的问题。’” “哇，太厉害了！她是去他们那里请教了吗？” “是啊，甚至都不用离开酒吧呢。”她轻敲着自己的脑袋，“答案其实就在我脑子里。 |那句话是什么意思呢？” “嗯，就是一种表达方式……用来表达某种意思吧，不过具体是什么我就不记得了。只是我的几个朋友会这么说而已，好吧？” 她居然有朋友？每次你去酒吧的时候，她总是坐在她惯常的位置上。 “是啊，也许我并不需要离开这个地方就能去见我的那些朋友了。 ] 谈话中出现了一阵尴尬的沉默，但你还是继续说了下去。所以，如果她不介意的话，你有些事情想和她谈谈。 “当然。我现在有点非常目前有一些重要的事情需要处理，所以你找我的时机非常合适。我能为你做些什么呢？ ] |你露出最亲切的表情，坐在那个衣衫褴褛的女子对面，等待她注意到你。当这种方式没有引起她的反应时，你轻轻拍了拍她的肩膀——这时，尼娜才缓缓睁开眼睛，颤抖着勉强抬起头看着你。 “哦，”她低声说道，“最近怎么样？” “谢谢，一切都很好。”但你其实希望这次谈话能更多地围绕她相反，从露米那里你应该知道，她是那家酒吧的常客之一，比那些只是路过荒废驿堡桥才进去的人要常去得多。嗯，既然你也在那里[pc.isBaron |男爵[pc.mf | |ess ]通过这种方式 |可以算是这里的领导者吧 ]如果她打算长期留在你的住所里，你肯定想更深入地了解她。 那个喝得醉醺醺的哈皮花了好一会儿才恢复过来，终于能够回答问题了。哦，听起来挺合理的。” 那么，如果她不介意回答几个问题，以便确认她并不是那种会因为露米而惹上麻烦的醉汉的话……你需要注意，你的那位同事说她一整天都待在这里，喝大量的赤莓啤酒，而且总是提前付清所有的费用。这笔钱总得有来源吧？她一天到晚都在做些什么呢？ “你自己已经回答了自己的问题。 [pc.title]我主要喝铜莓啤酒。”妮娜打了个嗝，然后仰躺在桌子上，试图找到一个更舒服的姿势。“不过我想，我还能看到一些幻象，还能与高阶存在进行交流。啊，糟了，这个罐子空了。如梅被围困的露米拖着一大壶铜莓啤酒走了过来，收下了尼娜付的钱，然后带着一丝厌恶看着那个女妖打开新壶，贪婪地大口喝起酒来，廉价的酒精顺着她的脸颊流了下来。整整三分之一的酒已经流入了她的肚子里，直到最后她终于停了下来，用那只完好的眼睛重新注视着你，然后用她那羽毛般柔软的前臂背擦了擦嘴。 更高的存在？比如神明吗？她是在自称是先知或预言家吗？ 不……不是说像七位大君那样。是更高层次的存在。”她的话语现在变得更加含糊不清了，同时还不停地咯咯笑。“虽然达不到神明的境界，但肯定比你我高贵得多。比如……比如精灵女王，或者那些古老的巨树，还有生活在深海之中的生物。[silly | 在下面那里更好，也更潮湿，相信我吧。 ] 你看，拥有这些强大的能力其实并不容易……说实话，这真的太艰难了。因为这些知识，我甚至被其他女妖们排斥在外，无法和她们一起闲逛。这些庞大的知识让我头痛欲裂、疲惫不堪，最糟糕的是，还会让我的嘴巴干得难受极了。这种滋味可真是糟透了。” “也许只是因为喝了那种‘厚颜无耻莓’酿造的麦芽酒吧？” 过了好一会儿，她才反应过来：“不……不是麦芽酒的问题。我早就告诉过你啦，真正的问题在于这些能力本身，亲爱的。 [pc.title]我可以告诉你很多事情，这些事情不仅超出了你的想象范围，而且绝对会让你震惊不已。” 那么，她在这些幻象中看到了什么呢？ “或者是在与那些高阶存在交流时听到的信息，没错。你注意到，她始终没有回答你关于那些钱是从哪里来的这个问题。唉，反正女妖从来都不是什么严肃的生物，而这个女妖现在肯定喝醉了——她喝了那么多厚颜无耻莓酿啤酒，难怪会这样。 别否认，露米总是说些‘真的，Nina，你已经够了吧！’这样的话，而我唯一能想到的就是……不行。绝对不行。如果我想的话，我可以一整天都继续下去，而且大多数时候我确实会这么做。我拥有的可不止一个，而是很多两个我这里简直就是无底洞啊……”她敲了敲自己的肚子，又敲了敲太阳穴，“还有这里。” “不管怎样……” 尼娜正准备继续她那醉醺醺的思绪，突然停住了，整个人更加瘫软地靠在桌子上，开始含糊不清地嘟囔起来。她那唯一的一只眼睛瞪得大大的，瞳孔放大到令人不安的程度，而另一只眼睛的眼罩上则沾上了某种液体；在她絮絮叨叨地说了几分钟之后，她终于抬起头，带着一丝愉快的笑容向你打招呼，仿佛什么事情都没有发生一样。此时，她的话语已经没有几分钟前那么含糊不清了。 嘿，最近怎么样？” 刚才发生了什么？ [pc.isCunning |她应该不只是经历了那种她所说的幻觉吧？ “哦，你真是个聪明人啊[pc.name]是的，确实是关于你的。 | 尼娜耸了耸肩：“哦，只不过又是那种幻觉罢了。” 那么，她究竟看到了什么？ “是你，[pc.name]。" ] 等等，你难道不记得自己告诉过她自己的名字吗？她是通过某种预知能力看到这个名字的吗？ “不是这个名字。” 她已经知道其他关于你的幻象吗？” “嗯？”妮娜又喝了一大口水。“在那些幻象里，我看到各种各样的人——正是这些不同的人共同构成了这个世界。而你，每年都会出现在其中两三次。” ……你真心希望，在那些幻象里，自己总是穿着得体、打扮得漂亮。[pc.isBimbo | 并不是说你害怕或羞于裸体，而是关于同意的问题吧。 ] 不，你穿那身打扮其实还挺不错的。 [pc.armor]这大概就是为什么几乎所有人都想一有机会就和你亲热的原因吧。而其他人至少也会想先吃顿饭吧。 ……假设她并没有发疯的话，这一切究竟是怎么可能发生的呢？ 尼娜耸了耸肩：“鹰身女妖其实并不知道自己是怎么飞行的，它们只是会飞而已。[silly | 根据所有已知的航空法则，女妖根本不应该能够飞起来。不过幸运的是，我的大多数姐妹们可不会被这些法则所束缚。 ]她喝醉了。 “这一点我并不否认。” 那么，停止喝酒或者减少饮酒量显然是不可能的吧？ 她用怀疑的眼神看着你，眼神有些迷离：“我为什么要这么做呢？我早就告诉过你，这些知识带来的压力实在太大，大到让我喘不过气来。如果我停止喝酒，我肯定会渴死的。再说，我并没有给露米带来任何麻烦，如果她的生意做得不错的话你是生意做得很好。” ……确实如此。你摆脱了那个虽然衣衫褴褛但终究无害的“女妖”，但这时一个疑问突然出现在你的脑海中：那个幻象中究竟包含了什么信息呢？ “你是什么意思？ 集中注意力，姑娘，集中注意力。她几分钟前看到的那个幻象——里面到底有什么？ 片刻的沉默之后，恍然大悟的时刻终于到来了。“哦，对了。这个故事有点长，所以如果你想听的话，最好坐下来仔细听吧。随时都可以问我。” “好的。” “那么，”尼娜又从那罐便宜的麦芽酒中喝了一大口，“还有其他你想知道的事情吗？ ]

"I don't tell them what to show me, they just come and I follow if I can." Well, you're here. Does she mind if you have business with her? "Oh," she mutters. "How's it going?" You're doing perfectly fine, thank you. But you were hoping that this conversation would be more about her instead — you understand from Rumie that she's one of the bar's more regular customers, moreso than most people passing through the Wayfort in order to use the bridge. And well, since you're [pc.isBaron |the baron[pc.mf | |ess ] of this wayfort |kind of the ruler here ], you'd like to get to know her better if she's going to be a permanent fixture on your property and in your home. It takes several moments for the inebriated harpy to pull herself together enough to reply. "Oh. Sounds fair." So, if she doesn't mind answering a few questions to make sure she's not just some kind of drunk waiting to explode into trouble for poor Rumie... you note that your beetender said she's here all day, drinking copious amounts of brazenberry ale and always paying in full up front. The money's got to come from somewhere, right? What does she do all day? "You answered your own question, [pc.title]. I mostly drink brazenberry ale." Nina hiccups and sprawls out on the table's surface, assuming what presumably is a more comfortable position. "But I guess I also have visions and communicate with higher beings. Ah, crap, this jug's empty. Ru-mie!" A beleaguered Rumie trundles over with a full jug of brazenberry ale, accepts Nina's payment, and watches with mild distaste as the harpy unstoppers the fresh jug and guzzles greedily, rivulets of cheap alcohol running down her cheeks. A whole third of the jug's gone down her gullet before she finally ceases and wipes her mouth with the back of a feathery forearm, her one good eye refocusing on you. Higher beings? Like the gods? Is she claiming to be an oracle or prophet? "N-no, not like the Seven. Higher beings." Her words are slurring even more now, and she giggles. "Not quite the level of the gods, but above you or me. Like... like the fey queen, for one. Or wyld trees. I could tell you, like, so many things that aren't just beyond your imagination, but would utterly blow your mind." Things she sees in these visions, then? Oh well, harpies were never the most serious of creatures, and this one's drunk; that's a lot of brazenberry ale she's been drinking. "Don't deny it. rows.translation: 与妮娜讨论这些事情吧。

rows.original: Invite Nina back to your bedchambers for a romp in the hay.
rows.translation: 邀请妮娜回到你的卧室，一起在干草堆里尽情嬉戏吧。
rows.raw: "Invite Nina back to your bedchambers for a romp in the hay."

rows.original: Let Nina know what you found in the elven mine.
rows.translation: 告诉妮娜你在精灵矿井里发现了什么。
rows.raw: "Let Nina know what you found in the elven mine."

rows.original: You promised Nina you'd have that drink with her.
rows.translation: 你答应过妮娜会和她一起喝那杯酒的。
rows.raw: "You promised Nina you'd have that drink with her."

rows.original: You're ready. Whatever insanity that Nina has seen in her visions, you're well and truly prepared for it. Remember to bring along anything you might want to use on what might very well be a long adventure.
rows.translation: 你已经准备好了。无论妮娜在她的幻象中看到了什么疯狂的场景，你都已经做好了充分的准备。记得带上任何你可能会在这段漫长的冒险中用到的东西。
rows.raw: "You're ready. Whatever insanity that Nina has seen in her visions, you're well and truly prepared for it. Remember to bring along anything you might want to use on what might very well be a long adventure."

rows.original: Get some juice from Nina, maybe ask her about it.
rows.translation: 从妮娜那里拿些果汁，顺便问问她那是什么。
rows.raw: "Get some juice from Nina, maybe ask her about it."

rows.original: Nina gives you a little wave before turning back to her jug of cheap alcohol and taking a long swig. "Sleep tight. Don't let the void creatures bite."
rows.translation: 妮娜朝你挥了挥手，然后又转回去喝起她那罐廉价酒来，大口灌了一口。“睡个好觉吧，别让那些虚空生物咬到你。”
rows.raw: '\n        Nina gives you a little wave before turning back to her jug of cheap alcohol and taking a long swig. "Sleep tight. Don\'t let the void creatures bite."'

rows.original: That's enough crazy harpy for one day.
rows.translation: 今天就别再跟这个疯疯癫癫的鹰身女妖纠缠了。
rows.raw: "That's enough crazy harpy for one day."

rows.original:
Antonina, or simply Nina as she prefers to be called, is a petite harpy who spends much of her time in Rumie's completely smashed, which accounts for the faint scent of alcohol that perpetually hangs around her like an aura — or if one were less inclined to be charitable, a miasma. [nina.isPregnant
        |Being pregnant has dealt with that slenderness to some degree, but hasn't changed Nina's petite stature to any degree. If anything, her height just makes her egg-filled belly look even bigger on her than it would on her more well-built sisters.
