rows.translation: 你能去看看你的孩子们吗？一会儿就好。 “当然可以，我没意见。请稍等一会儿。” 你原本以为尼娜会带你去她平时居住的地方，或者至少去把你的女儿接过来，但实际情况是，她只是集中注意力，然后用空着的那只手朝空中一伸。就如同她在你的视觉探索之旅中引领你前往各种地方一样——虽然这一次时间并没有停止流动，但似乎没有人注意到任何异常。当尼娜将那只毛茸茸的小女妖拉过现实中的裂缝时，那只可怜的小生物甚至连所有的成年羽毛都还没有长全，全身覆盖着一层绒毛，在被拉到尼娜的怀中时，它还不满地吱吱叫着。 妈妈……” “嗯，对不起，宝贝。”妮娜放下手中的啤酒，把小女孩紧紧抱在怀里，然后在她的额头上亲了一下。“你知道，如果这不是件非常重要的事情，我是不会这样拉你出来的。毕竟即使拥有这座驿堡，你的[pc.mf |父亲 |母亲 ]也不是每天都能抽空来看你——不过拯救世界、消灭怪物这些事情总是让人忙得无暇他顾呢。” 那只长着白色羽毛的小鸟在妮娜和你之间转来转去，然后挺直身子，试图摆出一种庄严的样子。 [pc.bgMulti noblescion minstrel slumrat |看来有些事情就是不会改变，即使环境发生了巨大的变化。 |至少她知道，即使在这么年轻的时候，也要摆出适合舞台上的表情。 |真不知道她是从哪儿听来这个说法的——你简直就是[pc.bg]而尼娜的行为更是低劣到了极点。也许这一代人有什么问题吧，呵呵。 |由于她的身高实在太矮了，所以她其实并没有完全做到这一点，但结果就是，她看起来反而更加可爱了。而你，对此似乎并不介意。 ]鹰身女妖的幼崽长得真是快得吓人——似乎就在不久前，尼娜还把这只幼崽当作肚子里的蛋一样带着呢——不过话说回来，如果它们不是长得这么快，这些区域也不会被它们肆意侵扰了。 她叫什么名字？ “艾莉西亚。就是艾莉西亚。”你的女妖女儿在你怀里扭来扭去，尴尬之情几乎要从她身上消失殆尽。“那么，就是你把我放进了妈妈的身体里吧？” 原来是这样。…也可以这么说。更重要的是，你肯定想知道是谁教她这么做的。 “哦，是一些其他的女孩子。她们说妈妈在这一点上有点奇怪，但我觉得没什么问题，所以她们还是让我跟她们一起玩。 [wayfort.hasZhara |她是指荒废驿堡里的那些女孩吗？ “是的。” 你知道她的母亲是一名梦行者，这意味着她拥有一些特殊的能力，但另一方面，知道在发生什么事情的时候，她们并不会在地理上距离我们太远，这也让人感到安心。如果其他那些“女妖小姐妹”也能和艾莉西亚好好相处的话……嗯，那就没什么好抱怨的了。 尼娜轻笑了一声：“天啊，就算是没有预知能力的人，你也操心得太多了。哈比的小鸟们通常都各自安好，让这个女孩和同龄人一起玩耍也是件好事。 |等等。先不说尼娜，你应该不记得在荒废驿堡附近还有其他女妖吧。 尼娜轻笑道：“你以为我是从哪里把她找来的呢？ [pc.name]就像我一直跟你说的那样，我确实有自己的家。伙计，也许我要再重复十几遍，你才能终于明白我的意思。我可不会整天坐在这个酒吧里喝酒，就为了等着你出现，你懂的吧。 ] “别用那种瞪人的眼神看着我，伙计。游戏的意义就在于在安全的环境中从真正的危险中学习，如果我总是出手把她从各种危险中拯救出来，对她来说反而没有任何帮助。你必须允许孩子们犯错，同时也要让他们参与到自己感兴趣的事情中去。只有当有人真的会因此失去眼睛、肢体甚至生命的时候，我才会对艾莉西亚大声呵斥——你们应该都听到我告诉她的话了吧？除非真的有必要，否则我绝不会去强行拉她走那些艰难的道路。确实如此这是理所当然的，而判断什么真正危险、什么并不危险，正是我的职责所在。所以……放松点吧，伙计。我不是你平时遇到的那种妈妈，而艾莉西亚也不是你通常认为的那种恶毒女人，尽管她目前还没有表现出任何“梦行者”的迹象。就是她说的那样。参与埃莉西亚感兴趣的事情？ 说完，尼娜便带着艾莉西亚穿过了那个裂隙，然后它就消失了。 ]这或许也是件好事——尽管露米的环境很温馨，但那里确实不适合孩子们待着。 真是个早熟的孩子啊，不是吗？ “她有点喜欢独来独往，”妮娜承认道，终于重新拿起那杯被她忽视已久的麦芽酒，深深地喝了一大口。在我她那个年纪的时候，我的姐妹们并不喜欢我……嗯，她本身就不太喜欢和别人亲近，至少不是以那种过分亲密的方式。不过你……看起来和她相处得挺融洽的。这真是太好了，否则我会很难过的。 用最轻描淡写的说法来说，你也应该是这样吧。 尼娜叹了口气，勉强挤出一丝微笑，然后将手放在你的手上。“嗯……希望你能从那件事中得到你想要的东西。 [pc.name]我们的女儿有点孤僻，不过在需要的时候她也能和其他人相处得来……真不知道她这种性格是从哪里来的。那个从这里开始。” 你笑着在那只傻乎乎的鸟的额头上亲了一下。至少，这总比一直被那些幻象困扰要好。 “我完全同意。那么…… [nina.isPregnant |还需要什么吗 It's like how she brought you places on your vision quest — although time doesn't stop on this occasion, no one seems to notice anything amiss as Nina drags a fluffy harpy chick through the tear in reality. The poor little creature hasn't even grown all her adult feathers yet and is covered in a coat of fuzz, squawking indignantly as she's pulled into Nina's lap. "Mooooom." "Mmhm. Sorry about that, kid." Nina lets go of her ale and cuddles the chick close, kissing the little tyke on her forehead. "You know I wouldn't drag you out like this if it weren't really important. It's not every day that your [pc.mf |father |mother ] can drop by to see you despite owning this wayfort and all — saving the world and defeating monsters tends to keep one away." rows.original: [flags.NINA_PSI |You reach out and brush a stray lock of stormcloud-gray hair away from Nina's brow, pushing back on her forehead and forcing her to look up from the table and at you. She knows what's coming, right? "Of course I do. You're going to take me back to your bedchambers in the Wayfort, and then we're going to fuck like animals until I give out. I saw it in a dream, and to be honest, have been looking forward to it for a couple days now." So, she saw that coming, huh? Does she prefer to have the forewarning her visions provide, or would she rather have the chance to receive a pleasant surprise now and then? "Honestly, I don't really care, because it's not anything I can change anyway. What you can do, though, is finish the job all this ale started and fuck me until I finally pass out stupid." |You reach out and brush a stray lock of stormcloud-gray hair away from Nina's brow, pushing back on her forehead and forcing her to look up from the table and at you. For someone who's drunk out of her mind, she doesn't look too bad. Maybe if she cleaned up a little and grew her hair out some more... it's not as if she does much flying about these days, does she? "Ohh, that's the nicest thing that anyone except Rumie's said about me in a while." Groaning softly, the harpy hiccups and melts against your hand. "I mean, I've got no illusions about myself — give me a few more years and I won't even be able to clean up pretty. Go all sour like spoiled milk." Well then, she might as well make the best of what time she has left to have as much fun as she can, right? "Oh, gods, yes; I'm a harpy, after all. If I'm going to serve the time, I might as well do the crime. Isn't that right?" ] Up you go, then. Nina is amazingly light, even for a harpy, and you have no problem manhandling her up from her table and away from the collection of empty jugs that surrounds her spot. Sure, she's frazzled, but Nina's at that point in her life when being a little unkempt isn't wholly a bad look... It's a short walk from Rumie's to your bedchambers, and Nina squeals in delight as you toss her onto the bed and kick the door shut behind the both of you. Harpy clothes were never the most complicated, and Nina's is no exception: it's not long before you've got her laid out before you like a succulent spring chicken, wings and drumsticks all. rows.original: Nina's eye lights up the moment you mention you've searched the mine, going so far as to momentarily lose interest in her ale. Grinning triumphantly, she turns her now-burning gaze upon you, quivering in excitement. "Well? What did you find?" An entire crate of ice wine, thirty bottles in total. Thirty bottles! You can understand a smuggling operation, but this? How did she really know about all of this? You slam it down on the bar table, and Nina's expression goes from ecstatic to euphoric. "Visions, I tell you, visions; they've never led me astray. I didn't put the pitfalls there, if that's what you're implying. Now, I said I'd be pretty happy to have whatever you found... so can I have the ice wine now? This looks like the good stuff, the kind that was rare and expensive even in the druids' heyday when their vineyards were flourishing." [pc.isDK |Yeah, just wait a moment right there. You put your life on the line for all this wine; you expect some kind of compensation. Do you look like some kind of charity? "Yes?" Well, appearances are deceiving, because you want to be paid. She doesn't have any problem paying Rumie for her drink, she shouldn't have any problems paying you. "Well, you [party.som | |and your friend |and your friends ] can drink with me if you like..." Maybe if you were as much of a hopeless drunk as she is, but that's not good enough for someone who doesn't value alcohol inordinately. You'd like something more material that preferably won't wind you with a throbbing headache the next day. "Aww..." If she can pay Rumie, she can pay you. "I guess, I guess... let's see what I've got around here that'd help you adventuring types." Fumbling about for a bit, Nina draws a small scroll case from her clothes. Skin-tight as they are, they couldn't possibly have had enough space to hold something of that size without an obvious bulge, but that's what happens. "Here. Gods, your kind plays hard ball." [pc.title]s don't get rich and famous by being overly charitable. |Yeah, sure. Just take it, thirty bottles of ice wine is a heavy thing to be lugging around. Nina reaches for the ice wine, then pauses to think through the permanent alcoholic haze that surrounds her. "You know, you've gone through quite a bit to get all of this for me. You [party.som | |and your friend |and your friends ] can drink with me if you like... how does that sound?" Under normal circumstances, it might've been a pleasant suggestion, but when it comes to Nina, it's a little less so. Mostly because of the sheer volume involved, if nothing else. "Aw, don't be a spoilsport. I'll even throw this in to sweeten the deal." Fumbling about for a bit, Nina draws a small scroll case from her clothes. Skin-tight as they are, they couldn't possibly have had enough space to hold something of that size without an obvious bulge, but that's what happens. "Here, this should be more useful to you adventuring than it is to me." ] Gained 1x Tome of Mind Blast. "Got that off some academic who thought I was a fortune teller, it's a long story. Now, if you don't mind, we have to sample the quality of this beauty here. Tee-hee." Impatient to get started already, Nina waves for you to be seated on the other side of her table. "Fifteen for you, fifteen for me. This is going to be great." [party.has etheryn |[etheryn.highConfidence |"Is she sure about this?" Ryn says, lowering her voice and trying not to be heard by the inebriated harpy. "This is some of the best vintage — I don't think we even have this much left in the palace cellar! I mean, Alissa drank a lot of it over the years, but it was never very plentiful to begin with!" You're guessing from her reaction that it's also amazingly strong. "It doesn't taste like it, but it is. I remember reading that the druids were able to make all kinds of amazing wines in my great-grandmother's time — that's how they made most of their money, as opposed to the donations one would expect of them and their role in society. Just... fifteen bottles all at once, this wouldn't be a good idea even if it were plain old wine, but mirrorwine to boot..." ] ]
rows.translation: 一提到你已经搜查了那座矿井，尼娜的眼睛立刻亮了起来，甚至有那么一瞬间，她对她的麦芽酒都失去了兴趣。她得意地笑着，将那充满兴奋的目光投向你，声音颤抖着问道：“那么？你找到了什么？” 整整一箱冰酒，总共三十瓶。三十瓶！走私活动倒还能理解，但这个？她究竟是怎么做到的？真的你知道这一切吗？ 你把杯子重重地放在吧台上，尼娜的表情从欣喜若狂变成了极度兴奋。“幻觉，我告诉你们，绝对是幻觉；它们从未让我犯过错。如果你是在暗示我是故意设置了那些陷阱的话，那我可要否认了。我之前说过，无论你找到了什么，我都会非常高兴……那么现在，能给我那杯冰酒吗？这看起来真的不错那种即使在德鲁伊的全盛时期，当他们的葡萄园一片繁荣的时候，也依然十分稀有且价格昂贵的东西。 [pc.isDK |是啊，就等一下吧。你为了这些酒冒了生命危险，总该得到一些补偿吧。你看起来像什么慈善机构吗？” “是吗？” “嗯，外表有时候会骗人，因为你是想要得到报酬的。她愿意为露米的酒付款，那么她也应该没有问题为你付钱。” “嗯，你[party.som | |还有你的朋友 |还有你的朋友们 ]如果你愿意的话，可以和我一起喝酒……” 或许，如果你也像她那样是个无可救药的酒鬼，那还说得通，但对于那些并不特别热衷于饮酒的人来说，这样的邀请显然不够吸引人。他们更希望得到一些实实在在的东西，而且最好这些东西不会在第二天让你头痛欲裂。 哎呀……” 如果她能付钱给露米，那她肯定也能付钱给你。 “我想吧，我想……让我看看我这里有什么能帮助你们这些喜欢冒险的人的东西。”尼娜翻找了一会儿，最终从衣服里拿出了一个小卷轴袋。尽管这些衣物非常贴身，但如果没有明显的凸起，它们根本不可能有足够的空间来容纳那么大的东西——然而事实就是如此。“给。天啊，你们这些人可真是不留情面啊。 [pc.title]人们并不会因为过于慷慨解囊而变得富有或出名。 |嗯，当然。拿去吧，三十瓶冰酒确实太重了，带着到处跑也不方便。” 尼娜伸手去拿冰酒，然后停了一下，试图在酒精带来的迷糊中理清思绪。“你知道，你为了给我搞到这些，确实费了不少功夫[party.som | |还有你的朋友 |还有你的朋友们 ]如果你愿意的话，可以和我一起喝……你觉得怎么样？” 在正常情况下，这或许会是一个不错的提议，但说到妮娜，情况就有点不同了。主要是因为涉及的酒量实在太大，至少是这个原因吧。 哎呀，别扫大家的兴嘛。我再加这个作为额外的奖励吧。”尼娜摸索了一会儿，终于从自己的衣服里掏出了一个小小的卷轴袋。她的衣服本来就紧身贴体，如果没有明显的凸起，根本不可能有足够的空间容纳那么大的东西，但事实就是如此。这个，对你们这些喜欢冒险的人来说，应该会比对我更有用。 ] 获得了1本“心灵冲击之书”。 这个是从某个以为我是算命师的学者那里得到的，其中有一段很长很复杂的故事。现在，如果你们不介意的话我们真得先尝尝这美味的品质才行呢，嘻嘻。”妮娜迫不及待地想要开始，她示意你坐在她桌子的另一边。“你付十五，我付十五，这次可要好好享受一下了痛快。" [party.has etheryn |[etheryn.highConfidence |她是吗？当然可以。这是关于什么的？”小琳压低声音说道，尽量不让那个喝醉的哈皮听到。“这些可是最上等的陈年佳酿——我觉得宫殿的地窖里都快没有这些酒了！这些年来，艾莉莎确实喝掉了很多，但本来这类酒的数量就不多啊！从她的反应来看，这种酒也应该非常美味才对。 “虽然它的味道并不像人们想象的那样，但实际上确实如此。我记得在我曾祖母的时代，德鲁伊们能够酿造出各种美味的葡萄酒——他们主要是通过这种方式来赚取收入的，而不是依靠人们通常认为的、与他们的社会地位相符合的捐赠。就……一下子买十五瓶酒，就算这是普通的葡萄酒，这也不是个好主意啊。镜之酒更何况…… ] ]

rows.original: Nina doesn't get the chance to taste the nectar, however. Before she can even set down her brazenberry ale to reach for the ice wine, she becomes voiceless, her joyful eye goes vacant and glassy, and her smile collapses into disquieting slack-jawedness. The beginning of another vision, one presumes, confirmed by her slumping forward onto the table and burying her head in her feathered arms. Unfortunately for you, this time she doesn't even mumble, instead staring intently at the wood from a distance of an inch or two with all the fury of a thousand suns. And then slowly but surely, she lifts her head. Life settles back into Nina's eye, and her smile returns from a drooling mess; her gaze focuses, and so do her thoughts. Watching the transformation is sobering: a spark ignites Nina's features, the life in her, and once more does she look like herself again, her one good eye fixing itself on you... ...And she grins. "Oh. Hey." Hey herself — she just had another one of those crazy visions, presumably. "Oh yeah. I've been having a lot of visions involving you of late, to be honest. Like I said, it used to be two or three times a year, but in the last few months it's been you nonstop. Almost every single one of them — it was kinda fun at first, but the shine quickly wore off. I'd like to see someone else for a change." While you're sure that's very interesting, you want to know about this vision. The one she just had. Nina's reply is to reach into the crate and pull out the bottles — like she said, fifteen for her, fifteen for [party.combatNames]. She lays them out upon the table with a ear-to-ear smile, looking immensely satisfied with herself at the pretty sight. "I was getting to that. This vision... it's a bit hard to explain, but the brief version is that we're going to go on a journey together. The full story requires a prepared mind, and in order to truly understand it you'll have to see the world as I do." You're not entirely sure fifteen bottles of elven ice wine all at once[party.som | |, even with someone to help, |, even with two others to help, ] is a good idea. "Don't you chicken out on me. You asked, and now I have to answer. Are you ready?" It looks like this so-called journey Nina's about to drag you on might take some time, especially if it's not just downing all this stuff. You might want to prepare yourself for a ride before accepting her offer of a drink.
rows.translation: 然而，妮娜没能尝到那口琼浆。她还没来得及放下手里的黄铜莓麦酒去拿冰酒，就失去了声音，她那只欢快的眼睛变得空洞呆滞，笑容也垮成了一种令人不安的张口失神。又一个幻象要开始了，大概吧——她向前瘫倒在桌上，把头埋进自己那双覆满羽毛的手臂里，算是证实了这一点。对你不幸的是，这回她连嘟囔都没有，只是一两英寸的距离死死盯着木头，带着千轮烈日般的狂怒。 然后，缓慢而确定地，她抬起了头。生机重新回到妮娜的眼中，她的笑容也从那副流口水的惨状里回来了；她的目光重新聚焦，思绪也随之清晰。看着这场转变令人清醒：一点火星点燃了妮娜的容貌、她体内的生命，她再一次看起来像她自己了，她那只完好的眼睛定定地锁在你身上…… ……然后她咧嘴一笑。“哦。嘿。” 嘿她自己——她刚才大概又看到那种疯狂的幻象了。 “哦，对。说实话，最近我总在做跟你有关的幻象。就像我说的，以前一年也就两三次，可这几个月来全是你，一个接一个。几乎每一个都是——起初还挺有意思的，但那点新鲜劲很快就磨没了。我倒想换个人看看。” 虽然你确信那一定非常有趣，但你想知道的是这个幻象。她刚刚看到的那个。 妮娜的回答是伸手进箱子，把瓶子都掏了出来——正如她说的，十五瓶给她，十五瓶给[party.combatNames]。她把它们一一摆在桌上，笑得合不拢嘴，看着这漂亮的景象，一副对自己极为满意的样子。 “我正要说到这个。这个幻象……有点难解释，但简单来说，就是我们俩要一起去旅行。完整的故事需要有准备的头脑，而要想真正理解它，你得像我一样看这个世界。” 你不太确定一次性喝下十五瓶精灵冰酒[party.som | |，就算有人帮忙， |，就算另外还有两个人帮忙， ]是个好主意。 “别临阵退缩啊。是你问的，那我现在就得回答。你准备好了吗？” 看来妮娜要拖你去的这趟所谓旅程说不定要花不少时间，尤其如果它不只是把这些东西灌下去的话。在接受她请的这一杯之前，你也许该先做好准备，迎接一段旅程。

rows.original:
Nina waves you over as you seat yourself across the table from her, offering you a rare treat in the form of an unopened ceramic jug of brazenberry ale. Far from it being you to refuse that gesture of [pc.isDK
        |rightful tribute after all the shit she's put you through
        |goodwill after all the craziness you've been through together
    ] — this particular jug is lighter and waterier than most, as if she knew exactly what you needed. She probably did.
    
    "How're you hanging in there, man? You're my favorite dude and it would suck to have something happen to you."
    
    Just fine, just fine. You still have a [flags.VISION_JUICE
        |tinge of that foul, oily taste on your tongue from that horrible stuff
        |bit of a headache from your adventures
    ], but that's well on the way to recovery thanks to her. So... has she sorted out her thoughts yet?
rows.translation:
妮娜朝你招了招手，你便在她对面的桌旁坐下，她递给你一份难得的款待——一罐还没开封的黄铜莓麦酒。你当然不会拒绝这份[pc.isDK
        |她让你受了那么多罪之后应得的补偿
        |你们一起经历过那么多疯狂之后她的一片好意
    ]——这只罐子比大多数都更清淡、更掺水，就好像她清楚地知道你需要什么。她多半确实知道。
    
    “你最近还好吗，兄弟？你可是我最喜欢的家伙，你要是出了什么事，那可太糟了。”
    
    还好，还好。你还有些[flags.VISION_JUICE
        |舌头上残留着那鬼东西留下的一丝难闻的油腻味
        |因为那些冒险而有点头疼
    ]，不过多亏了她，你已经恢复得差不多了。那么……她理清自己的想法了吗？
rows.raw:
"
    Nina waves you over as you seat yourself across the table from her, offering you a rare treat in the form of an unopened ceramic jug of brazenberry ale. Far from it being you to refuse that gesture of [pc.isDK
        |rightful tribute after all the shit she's put you through
        |goodwill after all the craziness you've been through together
    ] — this particular jug is lighter and waterier than most, as if she knew exactly what you needed. She probably did.
    
    "How're you hanging in there, man? You're my favorite dude and it would suck to have something happen to you."
    
    Just fine, just fine. You still have a [flags.VISION_JUICE
        |tinge of that foul, oily taste on your tongue from that horrible stuff
        |bit of a headache from your adventures
    ], but that's well on the way to recovery thanks to her. So... has she sorted out her thoughts yet?"

rows.original: "Yeah. I'll still need to talk to Gerry about it — without actually going to him, of course — but I've put all my thoughts in a row, cleared out the cobwebs, man. You're feeling all right, aren't you? Fractured space and stopped time does funky things to the inside of your head, I had to check mine to make sure it was, like, put on right." You're fine. Come to speak of it, she looks a bit more sober and coherent. Nina nods gravely. "Yeah, sure. Like, I need to dry out a moment to be straight with you, man. Don't worry, I'll get myself smashed again once we're done, pay Rumie for the service and all. "Aanyway. Juice." That stuff that she mixed up back in the Wayfort's past? That was some experience, all right — it was unnerving, sure, but something in the back of your mind wants more, to see if there're any interesting sights to be had. Probably not a good idea, but the curiosity remains... Nina clears her throat. "Before we totally move onto that, man, I just gotta be clear: we're done going around and getting stuff, unless I have another vision and I really doubt that's happening anytime soon. Call it, like, a gut feeling, man. Even if there were a reason to continue, I think it's best to lay low and keep a muted psychic profile for a bit, and traveling with you through the Ways does not help with that. We cool?" You remember what she said about you acting like a rock on a piece of paper or something like that. Yeah, you'll stick to the waystones for a while. "So yeah. Remember what I was saying back there? The brew —" she taps one of the forlorn empties" — lets you see, the conjuror's concoction lets you enter, the winterstem keeps you alive. But at the end of it all, you've still got to leave, or else you'll be stuck in the dreamscape forever, caught in all the potential futures and unable to return. That's not possible to replicate via simple alchemy, you need a jolt of power from a bona fide dreamwalker to get it going. "That's why I guess I'm going to be here for a while, man. Be here to make Juice for you if you need it, and given that 'here' is Rumie's with plenty of drink I'm more than okay with that. You bring me the ingredients, and I'll, like, totally brew you all the Juice you want, free of charge. Simple as that, man. As for what you do with all that Juice, I'm sure you'll find it plenty useful while out and about, man. Like, there's totally a lot of stuff you can get up to when seeing things you shouldn't be." Sure there is. "You might also see some stuff here and there, but given that we're not on the edges of the Ways where time and space start to break down, there's a lot less special stuff that the Juice could reveal to you that way. I wouldn't expect to perceive any oddities unless you're up in a place where there's all kinds of crazy stuff that'd be attracting dreamwalkers. "Remember, it's one jug of brazenberry ale, one conjuror's concoction, and one winterstem for a dose that'll last a normal dude like you all day. Yeah, sure, that's like, far more ale than the recipe strictly needs, but brewing up Juice's thirsty work, man. Girl like me's gotta keep focused, if you know what I mean."
rows.translation: 是的，我还是需要和杰里谈谈这件事——当然，不需要亲自去找他——但我已经把所有的想法都整理清楚了，把那些杂乱的思绪都理顺了。你现在感觉还好吧？时空扭曲和时间停止会对人的思维产生一些奇怪的影响，我得确认一下自己的思维是否还正常。你没问题的。说起来，她看起来确实清醒多了，说话也条理清晰了。” 尼娜认真地点了点头：“是啊，确实。不过我得先冷静一会儿，才能把事情跟你说清楚。别担心，等我们谈完，我还会再喝得烂醉如泥的，然后把钱付给露米，让她帮我处理这些事情。 不管怎样，果汁吧。” 就是她在荒废驿堡过去的时候调制过的那种东西？那确实是一次特别的体验——虽然有点让人紧张，但内心深处还是想再尝试一次，看看是否还能看到一些有趣的东西。或许这不是个好主意，但好奇心还是驱使着我…… 尼娜清了清嗓子，说道：“在我们真正开始讨论这个之前，我得先把事情说清楚：我们不会再去四处搜集那些东西了，除非我再次获得某种启示，但我觉得短期内这种情况不太可能发生。就凭这种直觉吧，伙计。即使有继续下去的理由，我觉得现在最好低调行事，暂时隐藏自己的灵能能力，然后和你一起继续这段旅程吧。不是帮个忙吧。我们冷静点，好吗？” 你还记得她说过你就像一张纸上的石头一样，什么也动弹不了吧？没错，你暂时还是得遵守这些规则吧。 “所以，还记得我之前说过的话吗？这种饮品——她轻敲其中一个空瓶——能让你进入那个魔法师创造的世界，冬茎草能让你存活下去。但归根结底，你还是必须离开，否则就会永远被困在那个梦境之中，陷入无数可能的未来之中，再也无法回来。仅通过简单的炼金术是无法复制出这种效果的，你需要一位真正的梦行者赋予你力量，才能实现这一目标。 所以我想，我应该会在这里待上一段时间吧。如果你需要的话，我随时可以为你制作果汁。而且既然‘这里’是露米的地方，有各种各样的饮料，那我完全没意见。你把所需的材料带给我，我就会免费为你制作你想喝的所有果汁，就是这么简单。至于你如何使用这些果汁，我相信在外的时候，它们一定会派上很大的用场……比如，当你遇到一些不该出现的东西时，这些果汁绝对能帮你解决很多问题。 当然有。 “你可能会在这里或那里看到一些奇怪的东西，但既然我们并不处于那些时间和空间开始变得混乱的边缘地带，那么‘汁液’通过这种方式向你展示的特殊现象就会少很多。除非你身处那些会吸引那些进行梦游的人的、充满各种奇怪事物的地方，否则我并不认为你会察觉到什么异常现象。 记住，只需要一壶铜莓啤酒、一种巫师调配的秘方，再加上一根冬茎，就能制作出一份足以让你这样的普通人使用一整天的剂量。没错，这个配方所需的啤酒量确实远超实际需要，但为了制作出Juice这种令人垂涎的饮品，真是不得不这样做啊。像我这样的姑娘，可必须保持专注才行，你懂我的意思吧？

rows.original: "Yeah. First off though, just in case you're still wondering, the journey's over. We've gotten everything we need." Really? That last outing actually produced something that was worth the hassle? [var0|Well, you did get Thalia out of the Wayfort's past, but she knows what you mean.] "Seems so, man. You and I are completely and utterly done, unless I get another vision." Nina pauses with the jug halfway to her lips, then lowers it and taps her chin. "Well, when I say done, I don't mean like, done done. I can totally make Juice for you, and we can like, talk about the strangeness we're seeing in the world and fuck and do other kinds of stuff. When I say done, I mean, like, going around with me and helping me get stuff. Even if we weren't done, we'd be hoofing it via waystone at best — I think it's best to lay low and keep a muted psychic profile for a bit, and traveling with you through the Ways does not help with that." It's fine. The more time she spends here and not in her own head, the more time you have to hang out together, have a brazenberry ale, or perhaps ten. But roll that back a bit — she said something about making Juice for you. What's that? She may ramble a bit, but you've yet to hear that from her. "Oh, that. While you were gone, I finally figured out what the visions were trying to have me do, why we were going around collecting all that stuff until we were so rudely interrupted and yanked into the Wayfort's past. Remember what I was saying?" Something about seeing, entering... that kind of stuff. "The brew —" she taps one of the forlorn empties "— lets you see, the conjuror's concoction lets you enter, the winterstem keeps you alive. But at the end of it all, you've still got to leave, or else you'll be stuck in the dreamscape forever. That's not possible to replicate via simple alchemy, you need a jolt of power from a bona fide dreamwalker to get it going. Something about seeing that funny-mirror version of myself got my memory going, and now I've figured it all out, how to tie together all the reagents. That was the thing we were there to collect, the knowledge." Really. So maybe the vision wasn't wrong at all, maybe you being yanked out of the ether by an unspeakable horror was all set up from the start. "Well, man, I sure as the Seven didn't see any of that in the vision. But still, you know... everything like, happens for a reason, man. Sometimes another vision will pick up where the old one left off, seamless as a latex goo. Some call it destiny, but I call it, like... um..." Nina fumbles about in a manner that could be construed as drunken. In her current state, the likelihood of that's a coin flip. "Look, I'm not saying anything's certain save for nine portions of brazenberry ale to four of conjuror's concoction, and one portion of winterstem. That, and to make sure that last one's properly pounded into a paste with mortar and pestle to release all the good stuff in the leaves and stem. That's important." And then she mixes all that together to make this Juice thing? If it's that simple, any two-bit alchemist would've stumbled upon it long ago. Gods, even you could make it. "Well, there's just the last step, and the most important one." Nina taps her head with a clawed finger. "You've got to activate everything, make them friends so that they like, totally get along. A little mental persuasion that just putting it over a flame isn't going to do, that just makes them angry. Remembering how to do the persuading is why we ended up going to that... that place; that's what I figured out after reflecting on that whole debacle. Wouldn't have been possible otherwise, because it's the kind of thing that you can only learn by experiencing it." Like riding a horse? "Dunno, never ridden one before, man. But here, I made some Juice while you were gone." Nina shoves another ceramic jug across the table. "Give it a go and let me know what you think. I find it rather trippy, but you and I are fundamentally different up here, man; it almost certainly won't have the same effect on you it does on me. I expect the effect on a non-dreamwalker to be far more muted and hence safe, so you should be fine."
rows.translation: 是的。不过首先，为了防止你们还在疑惑，这次行动已经结束了。我们得到了所有需要的东西。” 真的吗？上次的那次行动竟然真的得到了值得我们付出努力的成果？ [var0|嗯，你确实把塔莉娅从韦弗特的过去中解救了出来，但她明白你的意思。] 看来是这样吧，伙计。你我之间真的彻底结束了，除非我再次得到某种预感。”尼娜说着，将水壶举到嘴边，却又停了下来，轻轻敲了敲下巴。“嗯，当我说‘结束了’的时候，我并不是指完成好的。我完全可以帮你制作“果汁”，我们也可以一起讨论这个世界上那些奇怪的现象，做些其他有趣的事情。当我说“好的”时，我的意思是让你陪我一起行动，帮我完成一些事情。即使我们没有完成原来的计划，最多也只能通过“路标”继续前进吧——我觉得现在最好保持低调，尽量减少自己的灵能活动，然后和你一起沿着这些道路继续前进。不是帮个忙吧。” 没关系。她在这里待的时间越长，而不是沉浸在自己的思绪中，你们就有更多时间一起出去玩，喝一杯布拉森贝里啤酒，甚至可以喝上十杯。不过，先回到刚才的话题——她说过要为你准备果汁，这是怎么回事？她虽然有时候会说话啰嗦，但你应该还没听她详细讲过吧。那个哦，那个……在你离开的时候，我终于弄明白了那些幻象究竟想让我做什么，也明白了我们为什么要收集那些东西，直到我们被突然打断，被强行带到了荒废驿堡的过去。还记得我刚才说过什么吗？” “应该是关于‘看见’、‘进入’之类的东西吧……” “那种药剂——”她敲了敲其中一个空瓶子，“那种由法师调配的药剂能让你‘看见’，能让你‘进入’那些特定的领域；而冬茎草则能让你保持生命。但归根结底，你还是必须离开，否则就会永远被困在那个梦境之中。这种效果是无法通过简单的炼金术来实现的，你需要一位真正的梦行者给予你力量，才能让这一切发生。看到那个镜像中自己的模样，似乎触发了我的记忆，现在我终于想明白了，知道该如何把所有这些炼金材料组合起来使用了。那个那正是我们前往那里所要获取的东西，那些知识。” 真的。所以也许那个愿景根本就没有错，也许你被某种难以形容的恐怖力量从虚空中拽了出来，这一切其实从一开始就已经被安排好了。 “嗯，老兄，我可以肯定的是，我根本什么都没看到。那个在那个幻象中。不过，你知道……一切事情的发生都有其原因。有时候，另一个幻象会接上上一个幻象留下的线索，衔接得天衣无缝。有些人称之为命运，但我更愿意称之为……嗯，就这样吧。妮娜的动作显得有些慌乱，看起来像是喝醉了。以她现在的状态，到底是不是真的喝醉了，其实也很难说……‘听着，我并不是说有什么事情是确定的，只不过九份大胆莓啤酒、四份巫师的调配饮料，再加上一份冬茎酒，这些倒是可以确定会有的。就是这些，而且还要确保把最后那部分材料用研钵和研杵彻底捣成糊状，这样才能让叶子和茎秆中的所有有益成分都释放出来。这一点非常重要。” 然后她把所有这些材料混合在一起，就制成了这种果汁吧？如果真的那么简单，随便哪个蹩脚的炼金术士早就发现了。天啊，连神明们恐怕也会早就想到这个办法的。你嗯，现在只剩下最后一步了，也是最重要的一步。”尼娜用带爪子的手指轻敲着自己的头。“你必须让所有东西都活跃起来，让它们成为朋友，让它们彼此喜欢、相处融洽。仅仅用火烧它们是远远不够的，那样只会让它们生气。记住如何进行这种说服才是我们最终去那里的原因地点就是在反思了那整个糟糕的经历之后，我才想明白这个道理的。否则是不可能明白的，因为这种事情只有亲身经历才能学会。” 就像骑马一样吗？ “不知道，我从来没骑过马，伙计。不过在你不在的时候，我泡了一些这种饮料。”妮娜把另一个陶瓷罐推到桌子对面，“你试试看，然后告诉我你的感受。我觉得这种饮料挺有意思的，不过我们俩的口味和喜好本来就不一样，所以它对你产生的效果，很可能和对我不一样。我认为，对于非“梦行者”角色来说，这种影响会小得多，因此应该也是安全的，所以你应该不会有问题。

And looking at the brew that Nina's produced for you, one only wonders if there's a reason for that. ] ] "Don't worry, man," Nina says, noticing your hesitation. "The visions told me it'd be totally okay. Like, I wouldn't ever knowingly hurt you. It's not poisonous or anything; like I said, I had some myself." You sigh, then tip your head back and drain the tankard in a few gulps. The taste is surprisingly rich and thick, almost addictive; like the color, there's no way it could be derived from the stated ingredients. The sensation of it sliding down your throat to settle heavily in your stomach is palpable, but the effects have already begun to take place before that; the Juice works in more dimensions than simply the physical, as your vision blurs and colors a faint violet at the edges. It's... it's like there's two of everyone: of Rumie at the bar, [party.hasCompanions |of [party.compNames], ]of the patrons at their tables, of everyone, even Nina — you can see where everyone will be a few seconds ahead in time before they actually move there. The sensation is similar, but not identical, to what you felt when confronting your other half in that other Wayfort on the edges of the Ways. It's definitely not something that people with normal senses should have to endure for too long — the way your mind's put together, it just fundamentally doesn't fit. A nice place to visit, perhaps, but not somewhere you'd want to live on a permanent basis or run the risk of being driven to madness. Is this how Nina feels most of the time? "You okay, man? Like, it hit me pretty hard when I tried it, too. Breathe, man, breathe — but don't focus. Forcing it isn't going to work, like one of those glass finger doodads they have in Tychris; the more you struggle, the deeper it sinks its teeth into you. Just relax, don't think too hard, let your mind wander. It's all good." The soothing tones of Nina's voice cut through your panic, and you find that relaxing does help: it's like looking at something out the corner of your eye in that the less you focus, the sharper the images of the near-immediate future appear. They're still not comfortable by any means and your mind instinctively rebels at the torment it's being put through, but at least the disorientation's more bearable. Is that what this Juice does? Let you see a few seconds into the future? You can think of several situations where the blink of an eye could make all the difference... And then, the precognition fades, the future and present selves of everyone in the bar flowing back into each other as normality resumes. You look down at the remaining Juice in the tankard, then carefully pour it back into the jug. "Yeah, I get you," Nina says. "First time I tried it, I needed a minute or two to lie down and take in what happened. That, and the killer headache — that was totally awful. But that jug's yours now — hygiene, man. I'm not drinking from that." ...Did you just see into the future, even if it was for the blink of an eye? "Well, I wouldn't like, call it seeing into the future. Like, if it were the future, then everything would've been highlighted like that. But it's not, only some people and things. I dunno. But it only lasted for a bit for you, right? Maybe if you drank more, it'd last longer. Can't do anything about how useful the effect might be, though." Well, seeing into the future is closest to how you can describe what happened to you, precognition of a sort, so you'll stick with that. All things being said, though, even normal people can learn to reasonably predict an opponent's moves a few seconds ahead of time, so... you're not saying that kind of thing is useless, it's certainly a leg up, but... oh gods, it's hard to put into words. Nina insinuated that Juice has a much more powerful effect on dreamwalkers than other people, so it's a miracle she's still upright now. That being said, no doubt she's had a lifetime to get used to this kind of weirdness. Nina smiles drunkenly and claps you on the shoulder, giving it a reassuring squeeze. "Don't sweat it, man. I've learned that trying to explain usually doesn't help and makes you confused as well. Let's just say that it works, and I totally, like, get it." So... this stuff is okay, then? You're not going to be having ominous visions or accidentally ripping impromptu entrances into the dreamscape — into the Ways? "You're not a dreamwalker, so unlikely." Nina's expression turns serious. "If anything, it's me who needs to worry about that, man. After everything we've been through, I'd better see to shoring up my head-space just in case something weird happens. I kinda wonder what Juice would do to the dreamless but [pc.swornGod nareva |for all that you're one of those gothmanders I don't think I can just ask you to bring the Juice to one of those punished wizards you have and ask the poor bugger to drink it or else. Like, I'm pretty sure that kind of thing is a big no-no for your kind, man. |they don't quite advertise themselves, man. ] "You might also see some stuff here and there, but given that we're not on the edges of the Ways where time and space start to break down, there's a lot less special stuff that the Juice could reveal to you that way. I wouldn't expect to perceive any oddities unless you're up in a place where there's all kinds of crazy stuff that'd be attracting dreamwalkers." So... what happens now? A shrug. "Like I said, no more running around, no more journeys for a while. You bring me the ingredients, and I'll, like, totally brew you all the Juice you want, free of charge. Simple as that, man. As for what you do with the Juice, I'm sure you'll find it plenty useful while out and about, man. Isn't my problem. "Remember, it's one jug of brazenberry ale, one conjuror's concoction, and one winterstem for a dose that'll last a normal dude like you all day. Yeah, sure, that's like, far more ale than the recipe strictly needs, but brewing up Juice's thirsty work, man. Girl like me's gotta keep focused, if you know what I mean."

|话虽如此……你对那些神秘试剂还是有所了解的。虽然人们长期以来一直在以各种方式使用冬茎，但直接将其摄入体内，其实并不是人们通常会采用的方法。确实已经有太多巫师尝试过吞食、吸食、鼻吸等各种方式来使用这些物质了，因此，如果你至今还没有听说过有人将这种用于娱乐的植物当作食物来食用，那么这个事实反而会让人感到惊讶。 |[pc.bgMulti hunter barbarian courtesan 你叹了口气，然后仰头将整杯酒一饮而尽。这种味道出奇地浓郁醇厚，几乎会让人上瘾；就像它的颜色一样，根本不可能是由所列的成分带来的。当这种液体滑入喉咙，在胃里沉淀下来时，那种感觉是显而易见的，但实际上，在那之前，它的效果就已经开始发挥了——这种“果汁”带来的影响并不仅仅局限于生理层面，因为你的视线会变得模糊，视野边缘还会浮现出淡淡的紫色。 就好像每个人都有两个分身一样：酒吧里的露米，还有另一个[party.hasCompanions |的[party.compNames]， ]那些坐在自己桌子旁的顾客们每个人就连妮娜也不例外——你也可以。看到在那个地方，每个人在实际到达之前都会提前几秒钟到达那里。这种感觉与你在另一个“韦斯福特”中与自己的灵魂伴侣相遇时所感受到的相似，但又不完全相同。 对于拥有正常感官的人来说，这种体验绝对不应该持续太久——以人类大脑的构造来看，这种感觉从根本上来说就是不符合人类感知机制的。适合也许是个不错的旅游胜地，但绝对不是适合长期居住的地方，否则人们很可能会被逼得发疯。尼娜大部分时间都是这种感受吧？ “你没事吧，兄弟？说实话，当我尝试的时候，我也觉得非常难受。深呼吸吧，伙计，深呼吸……但不要刻意去控制。强迫自己是没有用的，就像提克里斯那里那些玻璃手指装置一样；你越挣扎，它就越会紧紧抓住你。放松吧，别想得太复杂，让思绪自由地飘荡吧。没关系的。 妮娜那舒缓的声音缓解了你的恐慌，你发现放松确实有帮助：这就像是用眼角余光去看某些东西，你越是不去刻意关注，那些即将发生的情景就会显得越清晰。不过，这种状态仍然让人感到不适，你的头脑也会本能地反抗这种折磨，但至少这种迷失感已经变得可以忍受一些了。 这就是这种“果汁”的作用吗？能让人们提前几秒钟看到未来？你可以想象很多这样的场景：在那些瞬间，一个眨眼之差就能改变一切…… 然后，这种预知能力就会消失，酒吧里每个人的未来与现在的状态又会恢复到正常状态。你低头看看酒壶里剩下的“果汁”，然后小心翼翼地把它倒回罐子里。 是啊，我明白你的感受，”妮娜说，“我第一次尝试的时候，确实需要花一两分钟的时间躺下来，好好回想一下发生了什么。再加上那种剧烈的头痛……真的太难受了。不过现在那个水壶是你的了——注意卫生嘛，我可不会用那个喝水的。” ……你刚才是不是有了一瞬间的预知能力？哪怕只是那么一瞬间而已…… 嗯，我可不愿意称之为‘预知’未来比如说，如果那是未来，那么所有东西都应该被那样标记出来。但实际上并非如此，只有某些人和某些事物会被标记出来。我也不太清楚为什么。不过这种效果对你来说也只持续了一段时间，对吧？也许如果你喝得更多，这种效果会持续更久。不过，这种效果到底有多有用，我们也无能为力啊。 嗯，预见未来其实最接近于你描述自己所经历的事情的那种能力，可以说是一种预知能力。不过，话虽如此，即使是普通人也能学会在几秒钟之前合理地预测对手的下一步行动，所以……你并不是说这种能力毫无用处，它确实能带来优势，但是……天啊，这种感觉真的很难用语言表达出来。 |尽管你也是那些哥特曼德族的一员，但我还是觉得，我没法直接要求你把你手头的“果汁”拿给那些被惩罚的巫师们，让那些可怜的家伙喝下去，对吧？我敢肯定，这种行为在你的族群里绝对是绝对禁止的，伙计。 |他们自己其实并没有怎么宣传自己，真的。 ] “耸了耸肩，说道：‘就像我之前说的，暂时不能再到处跑了，也不能再去进行什么冒险了。你把需要的材料拿来，我就会免费为你制作你想要的所有果汁。就是这么简单，伙计。至于你怎么使用这种饮料，我相信你在外出时肯定会发现它非常有用，这可不是我的问题。 rows.original: Fair enough. But what if you find wrangling all the ingredients too time-consuming and annoying? Isn't there a better way to go about this? Nina thinks a moment. "Like, I don't know, man. Rumie's got all the ale I could ever need, but that costs electrum. I could probably get the concoction from [wayfort.hasFarrah |the cat lady in the shop, but again, that's gonna cost |the elf lady down in the village at the other end of the forest, but that's totally gonna cost and I gotta make the trip — on foot or wing, mind you, since I'm totally supposed to be lying low for a bit ]. And finally, there's the matter of winterstem. That stuff doesn't grow on trees, you know." You sigh. No, it doesn't. "Damn right. It grows in the ground, and messing through undergrowth for that stuff is a right pain, man. You stay bent over or on your knees for half a day or more, things start to hurt." She could just say no. "Nuh-uh. I'm not saying no because it isn't the case, man. I'll do it because I'm not going to go against the vision, but like, it's going to cost you." How much? "Enough to make you consider getting all the stuff yourself, man. Life's complicated enough without us going and making it harder for everyone. Like, I owe you a bunch, but I'm pretty sure I don't owe you free Juice for life. That's just cruel, man." All right, all right. You get it. Nina graces you with a thin smile and pushes the jug of Juice over to you. "Here, you can have this one, I think we can agree you've earned it. But like... don't forget that the Juice isn't everything, man. Folks have more than one purpose in life, and if you want to hang out and get smashed or smash, I can do that too. Come back anytime, okay? "Now if you don't mind, I've got to totally drown myself in the sweet embrace of Rumie's great ale, fill my body with divine purpose and all. Girl's gotta do what a girl's gotta do." You obtain 1x Juice.
rows.translation: 这倒也有道理。但要是你觉得四处搜罗全部材料太费时、太烦人呢？难道就没有更省事的办法吗？ 妮娜想了一会儿。“这个嘛，我也说不准，伙计。露米那儿有我用得着的所有麦酒，可那得花琥珀金币。我大概还能从[wayfort.hasFarrah |商店里的猫女那儿弄到药剂，不过还是得花钱 |森林另一头村子里的精灵女士那儿弄到药剂，不过肯定得花钱，而且我还得亲自跑一趟——走路也好，飞过去也罢。别忘了，我现在本来应该低调躲一阵子 ]。最后还缺冬茎。你知道，那玩意儿可不长在树上。” 你叹了口气。是啊，确实不长在树上。 “可不是嘛。它长在地里，而钻进灌木丛里翻找那玩意儿简直要命，伙计。弯着腰或跪上大半天，谁都会浑身疼。” 她完全可以直接拒绝。 “才不要。我不说‘不行’，是因为事实并非如此，伙计。我会照做，因为我不打算违背预见到的未来；但话说回来，你得付钱。” 多少？ “多到足够让你认真考虑自己去收集全部材料，伙计。生活本来就够复杂了，没必要再给大家添麻烦。我的确欠你不少，但我很确定自己还没欠到必须终身免费供应果汁的地步。那也太残忍了，伙计。” 好吧，好吧。你明白了。 妮娜淡淡一笑，把那壶果汁推给你。“喏，这一壶归你。我想我们都同意，这是你应得的。不过……别忘了，果汁并不是一切，伙计。每个人的人生都不止一种意义。你要是想来一起喝个烂醉，或者狠狠干一场，我也能奉陪。随时回来，好吗？ “现在，要是你不介意，我得彻底投入露米美妙麦酒的甜蜜怀抱，让神圣使命充满全身之类的。姑娘总得做自己该做的事。” 你获得了1份果汁。
rows.raw: " Fair enough. But what if you find wrangling all the ingredients too time-consuming and annoying? Isn't there a better way to go about this? Nina thinks a moment. "Like, I don't know, man. Rumie's got all the ale I could ever need, but that costs electrum. I could probably get the concoction from [wayfort.hasFarrah |the cat lady in the shop, but again, that's gonna cost |the elf lady down in the village at the other end of the forest, but that's totally gonna cost and I gotta make the trip — on foot or wing, mind you, since I'm totally supposed to be lying low for a bit ]. And finally, there's the matter of winterstem. That stuff doesn't grow on trees, you know." You sigh. No, it doesn't. "Damn right. It grows in the ground, and messing through undergrowth for that stuff is a right pain, man. You stay bent over or on your knees for half a day or more, things start to hurt." She could just say no. "Nuh-uh. I'm not saying no because it isn't the case, man. I'll do it because I'm not going to go against the vision, but like, it's going to cost you." How much? Girl's gotta do what a girl's gotta do." You obtain 1x Juice."

rows.original:
So, about some Juice...

    Nina rolls her good eye at you and shoots you a lazy grin. "Yeah, man. If you've got the ingredients, I can brew up some Juice for you right quick. That, or if you're willing to pay... I saw you coming like, in a vision a couple days ago, and made some ahead of time. Well, not like it matters, the stuff keeps well.
    
    "So, what'll it be, man?"
rows.translation:
那么，关于果汁的事……

    妮娜冲你翻了个白眼，然后懒洋洋地笑了笑：“嗯，老兄。你有材料的话，我马上就能给你调出一些果汁。或者，如果你愿意付钱……几天前我在幻象里看到你会来，就提前做了一些。不过其实也无所谓，这东西很耐放。
    
    “那么，你要哪一种，老兄？”
rows.raw:
"
    So, about some Juice...

    Nina rolls her good eye at you and shoots you a lazy grin. "Yeah, man. If you've got the ingredients, I can brew up some Juice for you right quick. That, or if you're willing to pay... I saw you coming like, in a vision a couple days ago, and made some ahead of time. Well, not like it matters, the stuff keeps well.
    
    "So, what'll it be, man?""

rows.original: Make juice with ingredients you've brought.
rows.translation: 用你带来的食材来制作果汁吧。

rows.original: You don't have the ingredients on hand. You'll need brazenberry ale, conjuror's concoction, and winterstem.
rows.translation: 你手头没有这些材料。你需要黄铜莓麦酒、术士的调配药剂和冬茎。
rows.raw: "You don't have the ingredients on hand. You'll need brazenberry ale, conjuror's concoction, and winterstem."

rows.original: So, now that she's had a little time to think on it... can she tell you more about the juice?
rows.translation: 所以，现在她有了一些时间来思考这个问题……她能再跟你详细讲讲这种果汁的事情吗？
rows.raw: "So, now that she's had a little time to think on it... can she tell you more about the juice?"

rows.original:
"Changed your mind?" Nina shrugs. "Suit yourself, man. This stuff isn't going to go off anytime within our lifetimes, so come back anytime you need the stuff. I'll be around for a little while, so don't worry about finding me. Maybe I'll even find you.

        "Now, is there like, anything else I can do for you while you're hanging around?"
rows.translation:
“改变主意了？”妮娜耸了耸肩。“随你便吧，伙计。这些东西在我们有生之年是不会自动消失的，所以什么时候需要再用，随时都可以回来找我。我还会在这里待一段时间，所以不用担心找不到我……说不定我还会去找你呢。

        “那么，你现在还有其他什么需要我帮忙的吗？”
rows.raw:
"
        "Changed your mind?" Nina shrugs. "Suit yourself, man. This stuff isn't going to go off anytime within our lifetimes, so come back anytime you need the stuff. I'll be around for a little while, so don't worry about finding me. Maybe I'll even find you.

        "Now, is there like, anything else I can do for you while you're hanging around?""

rows.original: "Sure, if I know the answers to begin with." Nina shrugs and takes a swig of Rumie's ale. "Like, this stuff is 'it was revealed to me in a dream' tier. Even I, who make the juice, don't rightly know everything about it or how it works, or where the idea came from, because I damn well didn't come up with it myself. I'm not that amazing a dreamwalker." Perhaps she could start with that last one. If she didn't come up with the idea herself, who did? Nina's brow furrows and she thinks incredibly hard, the gears turning in her head. Then, the dam breaks in her thoughts and she smiles, snapping her fingers. "We did, of course." %"We", she says. Who's %"we"? Because you certainly didn't. "Like... all of us, man. The dream... the Ways, what shields us from the void between the spheres — it's the dreams of fish, of folk like us, of gods, of everyone. That's why I meant by 'we.' All of us." Technically, she might be right, but that doesn't answer your question in any useful way. She could've just said she didn't know. "Well then, same place the visions come from, man. Maybe that's a better answer for you?" All right then, she doesn't know. And she didn't know how to put the juice together from its individual ingredients, and now she does... because she saw her other half in a broken dream of the Wayfort? "Yeah, man. Maybe I knew it all along and just needed to remember. Have it jolted loose, or perhaps it was a bit of me that needed to be restored. That kinda thing." You get that psionic stuff isn't a precise thing like arcane magic — that everything's slightly different for every dreamwalker, even if the broad strokes are similar. Usually similar, at any rate. Maybe you shouldn't pry further, because Nina's attempts to explain are just making things more confusing. "It's hard because it's one of those things which is just easier to show rather than tell, and I can't really show you an example, man." Nina takes another swig of ale straight from the jug. "The avanai — those bird-people are the only ones I know of who have some kind of system in place to prevent their young dreamwalkers from causing all kinds of havoc by teaching them. But, like, they don't do it with books and geometry and that kind of stuff which you'd expect of wizards, man. The things dreamwalkers pass on tricks to one another... not only is it a little different from everyone, but like, you can't put that down on paper, less give a lecture on it. You get me?" If what happened to you when you drank Juice is anything like what Nina does, even if a pale imitation, then you do think you glimpse some understanding of what she's getting at.[pc.isMage | For all of your arcane education, there aren't any words to fully do justice to that kind of feeling. ] "I think the saying is: 'you'd know in your bones.' There's so much feeling in it, you've either got to have someone to like, show you the ropes, or it's figuring it out for yourself, which is the hard way. Those avanai, they go into each others' dreams and heads and show the chicks how it's done, and even then the exact how is different from person to person, because that's just how people feel." So to bring it back to Juice... that whole experience with going through the shattered Wayfort of the past, confronting a distorted mirror version of herself. That's what sparked the eureka moment? You can only wish that meeting your doppelganger had done the same for you, but you're notably lacking in any startling insights from that encounter, alas. "Close enough. There was something about that thing, in its being... and after experiencing it, all the previous visions just fell into place and made sense. That's when I knew. Like, really, truly, deeply knew just how it could be done, how Juice was made, what proportions to use and how to apply my mind in just the right place to do what even electrum can't do. Not because it was too hard, but it just needed to hit the right spot. I know like, this doesn't make any logical sense, but dreams are the last place where you should expect logic, man." Now that she brings it up... about dreams. She's more coherent of late. Nina smiles weakly at you. "Yeah, well, like I said, I'm totally trying to lay low for a bit, go out into the dreamscape less until this blows over; that does mean I'm home a little more instead of letting my body just do what it wants. Can't say I don't enjoy the change of pace, man, but I think I'll start up again after a couple months. As nice as it is, man, you can't stay indoors for too long else you'll go all stir crazy, you dig me?" No long, awkward pauses, no sudden snaps as if she's seeing you for the first time ever, no losing the topic mid-conversation. It really is kinda nice. "Don't get too used to it, man. That's all I'm saying. Hopefully this mess will have blown over before too long." Hopefully. "Now, since you've been, like, talking all about it... did you want to make or buy some Juice?"
rows.translation: 当然，前提是我知道这些问题的答案。”尼娜耸了耸肩，然后喝了一口露米酿造的麦芽酒。“这种东西简直属于‘是在梦中得到的启示’这种级别吧。就连我这个负责制作这种酒的人，也并不完全了解它的制作原理、起源，因为这根本不是我自己想出来的主意。我可不是什么了不起的‘梦游者’啊。 或许她可以从最后一个想法开始。如果这个主意不是她自己想出来的，那又是谁想出来的呢？ 尼娜的眉头紧锁，她拼命地思考着，脑海中的思绪飞速旋转。突然，她灵光一闪，会心一笑，然后打了个响指：“当然是我们想出来的。 我们’，”她说。但谁才是“我们”呢？因为你显然不是。 “就是……我们所有人，伙计。那些梦想……那些守护我们、让我们免于陷入各个世界之间的虚无的东西——这些梦想属于鱼儿，属于我们这样的人，属于神明，属于每一个人。这就是我所说的‘我们’的含义。我们所有人。 从技术上讲，她可能是对的，但这并没有以任何有用的方式回答你的问题。她本可以直接说她不知道。 “那好吧，这些幻象都是从同一个地方产生的，也许这个答案对你来说更合适些？” 好吧，她确实不知道。她之前不知道如何将这些零散的成分组合起来，但现在她知道了……因为她在关于荒废驿堡的梦境中看到了自己的另一半？ 是啊，也许我一直都明白这些，只是需要重新记起来而已。可能是某种记忆被唤醒了，又或许是我内心深处某些东西需要被重新找回。就是这种感觉。” 你应该明白，这种超自然能力并不像奥术魔法那样具有固定的规则——对于每一个梦行者来说，具体的表现方式都会有一些不同，尽管大致的原理是相似的。通常情况下至少可以说是类似的。也许你不应该再追问下去了，因为妮娜试图解释这些，反而让事情变得更加混乱了。 “这很难解释，因为这类事情就是更适合用行动来展示，而不是用语言来描述。我真的没办法给你举个例子来说明。尼娜直接从罐子里又喝了一大口麦芽酒。“那些阿瓦奈人——那些鸟人，是我所知道的唯一一个拥有某种机制的种族，他们通过这种机制来防止自己的年轻成员在进行‘梦境漫步’时造成各种混乱。但是，你知道，他们并不会用书籍、几何学之类的东西来传授这些技巧，这些可不是你想象中巫师会使用的方法。那些能够“梦游”的人彼此之间传递的技巧……不仅每种技巧都略有不同，而且根本无法把它们写在纸上，更不可能通过讲座来传授。你明白我的意思吗？” 如果你在喝了那种果汁之后所经历的事情，与妮娜的行为有相似之处，哪怕只是很微弱的相似，那么你确实觉得自己能够稍微理解她的意图了。[pc.isMage | 尽管你接受了如此高深的魔法知识，但仍然没有任何词语能够完全表达那种感受。 ] 我想有句俗话是：‘你心里会明白的。’其实其中蕴含的意义实在太多了感受在这种情况下，要么得有人愿意帮助你、指导你入门，要么就得自己摸索，而后者显然更加困难。那些“阿瓦奈”会进入别人的梦境和脑海中，向那些新手们展示该怎么做，即便如此，具体的方法仍然如何因人而异，因为人们本身就是这样的。感受到所以，回到Juice的话题上来……那种穿越过去那片破碎的荒废驿堡，面对自己那面扭曲的镜像的经历，就是触发灵光一现的根源吗？你当然希望与自己的分身相遇也能带来同样的效果，但可惜的是，那次经历并没有给你带来任何惊人的启示。 差不多了。那种东西本身就有一种特殊的特质……在经历了它之后，之前所有的幻象都变得清晰起来，有了意义。就在那个时候，我知道我是说，我真的、彻底地了解该如何去做，如何制作这种“果汁”，该使用什么样的比例，以及如何恰到好处地运用自己的智慧来完成那些连“电银”都无法做到的事情。并不是因为这些事情太难，而只是因为需要找到正确的方法而已。我知道，这么说可能没什么意义合乎逻辑的感觉上确实是这样，但梦才是最不应该存在逻辑的地方，伙计。” 既然她提到了这个……关于梦的话题。最近她的表达确实清晰多了。 尼娜虚弱地对你笑了笑：“嗯，就像我说的，我现在确实打算暂时低调一点，减少进入梦境世界的次数，等这一切平息后再继续；这意味着我会多待在家里，而不是让我的身体随心所欲地行动。得说，我确实挺喜欢这种节奏变化的，不过我想过几个月后还是会继续原来的习惯。虽然这种新方式很不错，但总不能长时间待在室内，否则会让人变得烦躁不安的，你懂我的意思吧？ 没有长时间的尴尬沉默，也没有那种仿佛第一次见到你一样的突然反应，更不会在谈话过程中突然偏离主题。真的啊是还挺不错的。 “不过别太习惯这样，伙计。我就想说这点。希望这场闹剧能尽快平息。” 但愿如此吧。 “既然你一直在谈论这个……你是想自己制作果汁，还是想买现成的果汁呢？

rows.original:
"Sure thing. Like I said, it'll cost you — not just because Rumie doesn't give her drinks out for free, but also for the trouble in going out and getting all the stuff together while I could be here soaking my brain in ale. It's all bright and dirty and loud out there, man. Totally not cool."

    You don't know about that. Touching some grass seems to have done her plenty of good.
    
    Nina scowls and idly waves a hand towards the jugs she's prepared. "Saw that one coming, man. Anyway, here's what you wanted, however much you want. Pay up and it's yours."
rows.translation:
当然可以。就像我之前说的，这会让你花费一些费用——不仅仅是因为露米不会免费提供饮料，还因为你需要花时间出去采购所有这些东西，而这个时候我本可以在这里喝着麦芽酒放松休息的。外面到处都是光亮、肮脏和嘈杂的东西，真的一点也不酷。”

    “你根本不懂这些。接触一下大自然似乎对她很有好处。”
    
    尼娜皱着眉头，漫不经心地朝她准备好的那些罐子挥了挥手。我就知道你会来这一招。总之，这就是你想要的东西，你想拿多少就拿多少。付钱之后，它就是你的了。

    "Sure thing. Like I said, it'll cost you — not just because Rumie doesn't give her drinks out for free, but also for the trouble in going out and getting all the stuff together while I could be here soaking my brain in ale. It's all bright and dirty and loud out there, man. Totally not cool."

    Nina scowls and idly waves a hand towards the jugs she's prepared. "Saw that one coming, man. Anyway, here's what you wanted, however much you want. Pay up and it's yours.""

rows.original: "Pleasure doing business. Anything else you want while the both of us are home?"
rows.translation: “我很乐意做这笔生意。既然我们俩都在家，你还想要点别的什么吗？”
rows.raw: '"Pleasure doing business. Anything else you want while the both of us are home?"'

rows.original:
"Sure. Pick out the ingredients from your stuff and I'll put them together. No extra charge — consider it my rent to you or something for letting me slum about in Rumie's bar, man. Sure, I'm doing a lot for you, but on the other hand it's really comfy here, so it all evens out."

    Taking the ingredients from you, Nina pours a measure of the ale into one of her empties, then upends all of the conjuror's concoction along with it. This is followed by her walking up to the bar and borrowing a mortar and pestle from Rumie — soon, the pungent scent of winterstem sap reaches your nose, and the steady hammering draws the stares of several other patrons aghast at what by all appearances is the criminal waste of a good smoke. Eventually, Nina finishes pounding the calming herb to a paste and washes it into the rest of the mixture with some more ale, then stoppers it.
    
    Now it's time for her to work her magic.
    
    The one-eyed harpy huffs a bit, and her cheeks color. "You know full well that it's not arcane magic or anything..."
    
    Just a turn of phrase.
    
    Nina looks like she's going to protest that, then her peevishness completely evaporates as if the last few sentences of your conversation had never taken place. A completely placid expression on her face, she focuses on the ceramic jug and taps its side several times, focusing intensely. [pc.hasBoon JuicedUp
        |You're well aware of the silliness in watching Juice be made while under a previous batch's effects, but as limited as the — well, one supposes it can be called a potion — effects are, you can perceive that there's definitely something going on inside of the jug. The pre-images generated by the Juice in your vision twist and warp about Nina's hands, the certainty of probability in the next few moments completely thrown out of whack by what she's doing to it.
        
        Trippy..
        |As far as [pc.isMage
            |senses both mundane and magical
            |your senses
        ] are concerned, nothing happens, but Nina passes the jug over to you and pulls out the stopper to reveal the transformation of the jug's contents into viscous violet fluid.
    ]
    
    "Here you go, [pc.name], man, one batch of Juice fresh and ready to go. Like everything else, drink in moderation, okay? Getting sick's the least of your worries when it comes to these things.
    
    "Now, did you want me to make more, or is there something else you needed?"
rows.translation:
“当然。你从自己的东西里挑出材料，我来把它们调配好。不另外收费——就当作你准许我窝在露米酒吧里的租金之类的吧，伙计。我确实替你做了不少事，不过这里住起来真的很舒服，所以也算两清。”

    妮娜接过材料，先往一只空酒壶里倒入适量麦酒，再将术士的调配药剂全数倒进去。随后，她走到吧台前，向露米借来研钵与研杵——很快，冬茎汁液的刺鼻气味钻入你的鼻腔，稳定的捣药声也引得好几位顾客惊骇地侧目；在他们看来，这分明是在糟蹋上好的烟草。终于，妮娜把这种镇静草药捣成糊状，用更多麦酒将其冲进混合物中，然后塞紧壶口。
    
    现在，该轮到她施展魔法了。
    
    独眼哈比轻哼一声，双颊泛红。“你明明知道，这不是什么奥术魔法……”
    
    只是一种说法罢了。
    
    妮娜看起来本想反驳，可她的不悦忽然消散得一干二净，仿佛刚才的几句对话从未发生。她神情无比平静，专注地盯着陶壶，凝神在壶壁上敲了几下。[pc.hasBoon JuicedUp
        |你很清楚，身上还残留着上一批果汁的效果，却又观看新果汁的制作过程，这场面有多么滑稽。不过，尽管这种——好吧，姑且可以称为药水——的效果十分有限，你仍能察觉壶里确实发生了什么。果汁在你视野中生成的预像围绕妮娜的双手扭曲变形；她对这壶东西做的事，彻底打乱了未来几刻原本确定的概率。
        
        真迷幻……
        |依照[pc.isMage
            |你平凡与魔法的双重感官
            |你的感官
        ]，什么也没发生；可妮娜把酒壶递给你，拔开塞子时，里面的东西已经变成了黏稠的紫色液体。
    ]
    
    “给你，[pc.name]，伙计。一批新鲜果汁，拿去就能喝。跟其他东西一样，适量饮用，明白吗？对这种玩意儿来说，喝出病反倒是最不值得担心的后果。
    
    “那么，你是想让我再调几份，还是另有别的事？”

rows.original: It's okay, this will be enough.

You were intending to be the first to proposition some rough-and-tumble, but Nina cuts you off by putting her fingers together and wringing her hands. Did she see this coming in one of her visions? Whether she did or not, Nina's more than content to accept the inevitability of... well, whatever she's about to do. It must be nice to have fatalistic courage like that, but is it really a decision of it's inevitable. "So, uh, hey. You're looking for that, huh?" You reach out and brush a stray lock of stormcloud-gray hair away from Nina's brow, pushing back on her forehead and forcing her to look up from the table and at you. She knows what's coming, right? "I don't need any visions to know what's going on in that head of yours. It's not like you're trying to hide it or anything, man." Good. Then what's with all this coyness? It's not like she's any stranger to this whole business, being a harpy and all. She may not get to partake as much as her sisters do, but she's certainly no innocent. [wayfort.hasZhara|Is she feeling self-conscious with all these other harpies around?] "I... well." Nina ruffles her feathers, uncharacteristically shy; her one good eye is clearly trying to summon up the courage to behold you directly, and failing despite multiple attempts. "I've just been thinking, man." Better than opening up her mind and wandering around while her body is drunk. What's up? "Well, like... we've been through a lot together, right? And putting people in danger together is supposed to, like, draw them closer, yeah?" It's a common happenstance in tales that has some grounding in reality, but doesn't necessarily happen all the time. What about it? "It's... uh... man, this is hard." She can take all the time she needs to gather her thoughts all in a line. Nina may have faith in her visions — at least, you suspect that's what provoked this — but getting someone else involved probably messes it all up, especially someone like you. "Well, I kinda feel it. But at the same time, I thought it'd be much stronger, you know? Like, if I were to get all ditzy and flighty like some of my sisters do. Given that what we went through together was as awful as it gets, it feels like, I'm, well..." You just laugh at that and bop Nina lightly on the head. [pc.isDK |Sure, it's nice to have people feel obligated to you, but she doesn't have it in her for that kind of thing. |You're not one of her visions — she doesn't need to feel obliged to you for anything. ] "Phew, that's a load off. For a moment, I really didn't know how you were going to react, man. That's not something I can say about just anyone." New sex options with Nina are now open to you. If that's all, then you might as well get to it. Or did she foresee this as well? "Actually... no. For once, I didn't see you coming. But that's what makes you special amongst all these people, man. There're parts of you that're just not in any vision, your choices actually matter. That's the thrill of not knowing..." Well, you hope to be surprising her for a long time to come. Up you go, then — Nina is amazingly light, even for a harpy, and you have no problem manhandling her up from her table and away from the collection of empty jugs that surrounds her spot. Sure, she's frazzled, but Nina's at that point in her life when being a little unkempt isn't wholly a bad look... It's a short walk from Rumie's to your bedchambers, and Nina squeals in delight as you toss her onto the bed and kick the door shut behind the both of you. Harpy clothes were never the most complicated, and Nina's is no exception: it's not long before you've got her laid out before you like a succulent spring chicken, wings and drumsticks all. "Guess we aren't strangers any more, heh. Go on, then, blindside me. Do whatever you want, I want to be surprised..."
rows.translation: 你本来打算第一个提议来一场激烈的争斗，但尼娜却先一步双手交叠，绞着双手表示反对。难道她在某次预知中就已经看到了这一幕？不管是不是这样，尼娜都已经接受了这一不可避免的事实……好吧，不管她接下来要做什么。拥有这样的宿命论勇气确实很不错，但这种决定真的就是不可避免的吗？ “那么，呃，嘿。你是想说那个嗯？” 你伸手将尼娜额头上那一缕乌云般的灰发拨开，轻轻按压她的额头，迫使她从桌子上抬起头来看你。她应该知道接下来会发生什么吧？ 我根本不需要什么预感就能猜到你脑子里在想什么。你又不是在试图隐瞒什么，对吧？” 好吧，那为什么还要表现得这么扭扭捏捏呢？毕竟她本身就是一个女妖，对这种事情早就习以为常了啊。她可能无法像她的姐妹们那样参与那么多活动，但她也绝不是什么无辜的人。 [wayfort.hasZhara|在周围这些“恶女”们的包围下，她会不会感到很不自在呢？] 我……嗯。”妮娜有些局促不安，显得格外害羞；她那唯一的一只眼睛显然在努力鼓起勇气直接看着你，但尽管尝试了好几次，还是没能成功。“我只是在想，嗯…… 嗯，就是……我们在一起经历了很多事情，对吧？而一起让别人陷入危险，应该会让彼此的关系更加紧密吧？在故事中，这种情况其实很常见。一些基于现实，但并不一定总是如此。你觉得呢？ “这……呃……真的很难。” 她可以花任何她需要的时间来整理自己的思路。尼娜或许相信自己的那些预感——至少，你怀疑正是这些预感引发了这一切——但让别人参与进来，很可能会把事情搞砸，尤其是像你这样的人。 嗯，我也有这种感觉。但同时，我也觉得它本应该更强烈一些，你知道吗？比如说，如果我也变得像我有些姐妹那样昏昏沉沉、情绪不稳的话……考虑到我们共同经历的一切都那么糟糕，我就觉得，嗯…………” 你只是笑了笑，然后轻轻拍了拍尼娜的脑袋。 [pc.isDK |当然，让人们觉得有义务对你好是件好事，但她并不是那种会这么做的人。 |你并不是她心中所设想的那个人选——她没有任何义务为你做任何事。 ] 呼，总算松了口气。有那么一会儿，我真的不知道你会怎么反应，伙计。这种事，我可不敢对随便谁说。 现在，你可以与妮娜体验新的性爱选项了。 如果就这些的话，那你就直接说吧。还是说，她其实也预见到了这一幕？ “其实……并没有。这一次，我真的没有预料到你会出现。但正是这一点，让你在所有人当中显得与众不同。你的某些行为和选择，确实超出了任何人的预料。重要的事情那种未知带来的刺激感，就是这样的……” 嗯，你肯定希望在未来很长一段时间里，都能给她带来惊喜。那么，开始行动吧——尼娜的身体轻得惊人，即使对于一个女妖来说也是如此。你完全可以把她从桌子上抱起来，带离她周围那些空罐子的包围圈。当然，她确实显得有些疲惫，但在这个阶段，对妮娜来说，稍微有点不修边幅倒也不算什么坏事…… 从露米家到你的卧室只需要走一小段路。当你把妮娜扔到床上，然后关上门时，她高兴地尖叫起来。哈比族的服装从来都不复杂，尼娜的这套也不例外：很快你就能把她打扮得妥妥当当，就像一只鲜嫩多汁的春鸡，翅膀和腿脚都整齐地摆放好。 “看来我们不再算是陌生人了，呵呵。那就来吧，突然袭击我吧。你想做什么都行，我就想被惊喜到……

Maybe it was in one of her visions, or maybe it's a fuck-sense that every harpy innately has. She's the only harpy that you know of in all of the Marches who has these kinds of visions, and it'd be a terrible waste of talents that she has no reason to be ashamed of; you're going to fill her future with so many eggs that she can't fly. Literally, she can look forward to it, because that's the only future she'll be able to see!

    Yeah, you can see how any military leader would be hesitant to hire a pair of mercenaries that let their last leader perish. You question [asgeir.name] as to what [asgeir.heShe] did next.
    
    "From there, Refnir and I, along with many other mercenaries, were hired by a foreman to protect the miners."
    
    You ask [asgeir.name] how long [asgeir.heShe]'s been down, working in the mines.
    
    "Far too long," [asgeir.name] says. "To answer your question, it's been over two years. An unnatural, mistimed blizzard caused a cave-in, sealing all of us in. There were air pockets throughout the cavern, so there was no short supply of air, but we were limited by how many days of food we had — a supply which the foreman, that selfish coward, hoarded for himself. The old foreman failed his charge..." in a stormy tone [asgeir.name] says, "I would not. It was fortunate that I came upon Rimescore. With it, I formented a coup and dealt with the guards he bribed; I froze the old foreman's door and kicked it down before relieving him of his position. That pathetic creature you saw calling himself the jailor... that was the old foreman before Tharsus came along and performed his twisted experiments on him."

    ]我出生在这里，就在霜冻边境。当饥荒降临，毁掉了我们部落的庄稼时，我和雷夫尼尔收拾行囊，搬到了贝尔哈兰腹地，在那里四处打工，当雇佣兵。不久之后，那里的一位战lord雇佣了我们，让我们真正成为了职业战士。那位战lord名叫尤利西斯，他是个值得尊敬的领导者，后来……我们也成了他的好朋友。”

你问[asgeir.name]为什么[asgeir.heShe]如果他们在腹地能找到一份舒适的工作，雷夫尼尔也会离开的。 [pc.isCunning
        |你猜，这肯定和某件事有关。 [asgeir.name]用过去时来称呼这位贝拉兰军阀。
    ]
    
    我们的营地[asgeir.name]沉默了片刻，说道：“那是在深夜里遭到了袭击。等到有人发出警报时，营地的一半已经陷入火海了；我们毫无征兆地陷入了激烈的战斗。我和雷夫尼尔拼命冲向尤利西斯，但已经太晚了——我们发现他受了致命伤。在他去世之前，他把[corlup.imprisoned
        |他家族世代相传的战斧，他恳求我继承他的遗志。我怎么可能拒绝呢？
        |这个。 [asgeir.name]拿出一把装饰华丽、带有胡须状纹路的战斧，举在你面前。“这是他家族世代相传的武器。尤利西斯在临终前恳求我接过它，继续传承他的使命。
    ]之后，我和雷夫尼尔逃走了，回到了霜冻边境地区。

是啊，你可以想象，任何一位军事领袖都会犹豫是否应该雇佣这样一对让他们的前领导者丧命的雇佣兵。你对此感到疑惑吧？ [asgeir.name]至于……方面[asgeir.heShe]从那以后，我和雷夫尼尔，还有许多其他雇佣兵，被一位工头雇佣来保护矿工们。”

你问[asgeir.name]需要多长时间？ [asgeir.heShe]已经很久没有下矿干活了。”

rows.original:
"The Alraune has my eternal gratitude. When my men were trapped during the cave-in, it was her effigies that came to our aid: they helped move the rubble and gave us food we desperately needed. However, her gifts turned us into the beastmen we are now. Her presence caused a new form of growth to appear in the area: the lycanthorn. The men consumed this blighted flower in mass quantities, myself included."

    You ask why [asgeir.heShe] and [asgeir.hisHer] men were eating flowers.
    
    "[pc.ra corruptedlupine
        |Why did you?
        |It was served with the other fruits the effigies gave us. They said it would make us strong.
    ] Nevertheless, I'm glad that, despite everything, she still lives. Without her, we would not have survived[corlup.recruited
        |. I'm sure my men are glad to see the effigies again. If someone can help keep their urges in check, it's those girls
    ]."
rows.translation:
“阿尔劳妮让我永远心存感激。矿洞塌方时我的部下们被困在里面，是她的拟像赶来相助：它们帮我们搬开碎石，还给了我们急需的食物。然而，她的馈赠也把我们变成了如今这副兽人的模样。她的存在让这一带长出了一种新的东西：狼人荆棘。我的部下们，包括我自己，都大量食用了这种被污染的花朵。”

    你问为什么[asgeir.heShe]和[asgeir.hisHer]部下要吃花。
    
    “[pc.ra corruptedlupine
        |那你为什么要吃
        |它是和拟像给我们的其他果子一起端上来的。它们说吃了能让我们变强
    ]。尽管如此，我很高兴，不管怎样，她仍然活着。没有她，我们根本活不下来[corlup.recruited
        |。我相信我的部下们一定很高兴再见到那些拟像。如果有人能帮他们压住冲动，那就只有那些姑娘了
    ]”

rows.original: You ask how someone like Olivia found herself in a position as one of [asgeir.hisHer] captains. You can't imagine her as one of the first few people to fall to the spread of corruption. "She wasn't," [asgeir.name] says. "The young Olivia was a late addition. She was once part of an adventuring group that raided the mines, indiscriminately attacking my men. However, she and her compatriots were defeated and then taken captive. You need not imagine what happened during that brief period." That explains why she was willing to help you out, and why she wanted out. "Indeed. I had hoped the offer for a position of power would've mollified such thoughts of revenge, and that she understood my vision. I guessed wrong. No matter. What happened, happened." Why did [asgeir.heShe] offer her the position of captain, anyways? You ask [asgeir.name] as to [asgeir.hisHer] reasoning. It mustn't have been out of mercy or a semblance of guilt. [corlup.imprisoned |" |[asgeir.name] chuckles. "Do you think that poorly of me? But no, ]I brought Olivia along because of her natural charisma and profession: she is a bard. A bard's weapon is their tales and performances. If my plans of conquest were successful, I would need someone to ease the transition of cultural synthesis; I would still need to run an empire after my conquest was done. With her, the masses could've been indoctrinated with any number of narratives of my choosing. That's why I made her one of my captains."
rows.translation: 你问像奥利维亚这样的人怎么会成为[asgeir.hisHer]队长之一。你实在无法想象她会是最早倒在腐化蔓延之下的那批人之一。 “她不是，” [asgeir.name]说。“年轻的奥利维亚是后来才加入的。她曾是一个洗劫矿场的冒险队伍的一员，无差别地攻击我的人。不过她和她的同伴被击败后成了俘虏。那段短暂的时期里发生了什么，你不必去想象。” 这就解释了为什么她当初愿意帮你，以及为什么她想脱离出去。 “确实。我本希望给她一个有权力的位置能平息她那些复仇的念头，也以为她理解我的愿景。我猜错了。无所谓。发生过的事就是发生了。” 那么，[asgeir.heShe]究竟为什么要给她队长的位置呢？你向[asgeir.name]问起[asgeir.hisHer]理由。这肯定不是出于仁慈，也不像是出于愧疚。 [corlup.imprisoned |“ |[asgeir.name]轻笑道。“你这么看我吗？不过，并非如此， ]我带上奥利维亚，是因为她天生的魅力和她的职业：她是个吟游诗人。吟游诗人的武器就是他们的故事和表演。如果我的征服计划成功了，我需要有人来缓和文化融合的过渡；征服结束后我仍然要统治一个帝国。有她在，我就能用各种我挑选的叙事给大众洗脑。这就是我让她当上队长之一的原因。”

rows.original:
[first time
        |You're not sure if it's a sensitive topic for [asgeir.name], so you broach the subject of how [asgeir.heShe] acquired [asgeir.hisHer] myriad scars as tactfully as you can
        |Knowing that [asgeir.name] takes some measure of pride in [asgeir.hisHer] myriad scars, you ask [asgeir.himHer] to tell you again about how [asgeir.heShe] acquired them
    ]. Initially you're worried you've offended the older [asgeir.manWoman], as [asgeir.heShe] fixes you with a stern gaze. Just when you start to feel uncomfortable though, [asgeir.heShe] relaxes and lets out a chuff.
    
    "I'm just teasing." [asgeir.name] pats your shoulder. "I take it your imagination runs wild when I act all dodgy about my scars, no?"
    
    You breathe a sigh of relief before conceding that yes, you were worried after asking [asgeir.himHer].
    
    [asgeir.name] smirks as your response, obviously pleased with [asgeir.hisHer] bout of mischief. Noticing that you're not laughing though, [asgeir.heShe] gives you a more serious answer this time. "I'm proud of my scars; each scar built the [asgeir.manWoman] you see before you, but none were fun to earn."
    
    You ask [asgeir.name] how [asgeir.heShe] received so many scars when magic often prevents them in the first place if treated early.
    
    [asgeir.HeShe] wags a furred finger at you while smiling roguishly. "See, you've sort of answered your own question there. Magic can prevent scarring if treated early, but when I received most of these injuries all I had access to was what could be provided in the field. Since I lack arcane means of recovery, the best I can do is simple first aid." As [asgeir.heShe] speaks, [asgeir.name] exposes [asgeir.hisHer] sculpted musculature and the many exotic scars covering [asgeir.hisHer] body, showing them off to you. "I served a little more than three decades as a man-at-arms under Lord Ulysses Weyland's command, and I volunteered for all the most dangerous postings and assignments. That usually meant that I was either deep in unknown territory or behind enemy lines, two places where you cannot easily set up a hospital tent. I always figured that if I could hold a blade, I was still good for duty. It didn't matter to me if I was riddled with arrows, burned with magic, or bitten by wild animals. Anything after that is history we already know."
    
    [pc.isBimbo
        |You have a hard time focusing on a bunch of old scar tissue when there's so much [corlup.isFemale
            |well-sculpted
            |hunky
        ] muscle on display. Is [asgeir.heShe] just doing this as an excuse to flex? Not that you care either way. You fan your flushed face with your hand, trying to pay attention to your captain's story.
    ]
    
    After showing off all of his battle scars, he puts his garbs back on[pc.isBimbo
        |, much to your chagrin
    ], before taking a seat. "I hope that eased your curiosity."
    
    It did. You thank [asgeir.name] for explaining [asgeir.hisHer] scars to you.
rows.translation:
[first time
        |你不确定这对[asgeir.name]来说是不是敏感话题，于是尽量委婉地提起[asgeir.heShe]是如何得到[asgeir.hisHer]那无数伤疤的
        |知道[asgeir.name]对[asgeir.hisHer]那无数伤疤多少有些自豪，你便请[asgeir.himHer]再讲一遍[asgeir.heShe]是如何得到它们的
    ]。起初你担心自己冒犯了这位年长的[asgeir.manWoman]，因为[asgeir.heShe]用严厉的目光盯着你。可就在你开始感到不自在时，[asgeir.heShe]却放松下来，哼了一声。
    
    “我只是逗你玩。” [asgeir.name]拍了拍你的肩膀。“我猜，一提到我的伤疤我就这么躲躲闪闪，你的想象力一定就狂奔起来了，对吧？”
    
    你松了口气，随后承认：是的，问过[asgeir.himHer]之后你确实担心了。
    
    [asgeir.name]对你的反应坏笑了一下，显然对[asgeir.hisHer]这番恶作剧很满意。不过[asgeir.heShe]注意到你并没有笑，于是这次给了你一个更认真的回答。“我为自己的伤疤感到自豪；每一道伤疤都造就了你眼前这位[asgeir.manWoman]，但没有一道是轻轻松松得来的。”
    
    你问[asgeir.name]，既然魔法只要及早治疗往往就能防止留疤，那[asgeir.heShe]又是怎么落下这么多伤疤的。
    
    [asgeir.HeShe]坏笑着，用一根覆有毛发的手指朝你晃了晃。“你看，你其实自己就回答了这个问题。如果及早治疗，魔法确实能防止留疤，但我受这些伤的时候，能用的只有战地里能提供的东西。既然我没有奥术手段来恢复，我能做的最多也就是简单的急救。” [asgeir.heShe]说着，[asgeir.name]露出[asgeir.hisHer]线条分明的肌肉，以及覆盖[asgeir.hisHer]全身的许多奇特伤疤，向你展示。“我在尤利西斯·韦兰德勋爵麾下当了三十多年的兵，还主动申请了所有最危险的驻地和任务。那通常意味着我要么深入未知的领地，要么待在敌后——这两个地方都不容易搭起一座医院帐篷。我一直觉得，只要我还能握住刀刃，我就还能上阵。身上插满箭矢、被魔法烧伤、被野兽咬伤，这些我都不在乎。再往后的事，就是我们早就知道的历史了。”
    
    [pc.isBimbo
        |眼前摆着这么多[corlup.isFemale
            |匀称结实
            |魁梧英俊
        ]肌肉，你实在很难专心去注意那一堆陈年疤痕组织。[asgeir.heShe]该不会只是借这个由头炫耀肌肉吧？反正你也不在乎。你用手给自己发烫的脸扇风，努力把注意力放在队长的故事上。
    ]
    
    展示完自己所有的战斗伤疤后，他重新穿好衣服[pc.isBimbo
        |，这让你颇为懊恼
    ]，然后坐了下来。“希望这能满足你的好奇心。”
    
    确实满足了。你感谢[asgeir.name]为你解释[asgeir.hisHer]身上的伤疤。

rows.original:
You ask [asgeir.name] what [asgeir.heShe] likes to do for fun.

    [asgeir.name] shrugs lazily. "Not much. In my youth I was fascinated with survival training; I used to take Refnir on hunting and camping trips."
    
    You ask [asgeir.name] if [asgeir.heShe] still enjoys doing that stuff anymore.
    
    [corlup.imprisoned
        |Asgeir folds his arms and stares at you from his side of the cell, letting the awkward silence sink in. "I can't say I've had the opportunity to find out
        |[asgeir.name] scratches [asgeir.hisHer] chin, thinking about [asgeir.hisHer] answer before saying, "Not particularly. However, when I'm not doing exercise or [wayfort.hasKari
            |sparring with Karithea
            |martial training
        ], I've been trying something else out."
        
        You inquire as to what hobby your captain has been trying out.
        
        "Well, that would be fishing," [asgeir.name] says. "The silence does well for an old, tired mind. I only like to fish in wild waters though; unfortunately, there's only a few lakes that are safe enough for it anyway. Last I heard, imps make for poor fishing bait." Noticing that you're not laughing, though, [asgeir.heShe] dryly states, "That was a joke
    ]."

rows.original: You ask if Asgeir has visited his pups recently. Asgeir closes his eyes and lets out a long sigh from his nose before shaking his head. "No. I haven't." Since they're his kids, you ask if he doesn't at least feel a little obligated in being in their lives. "[corlup.imprisoned |I want to do right by my pups, but the best thing I can do for those younglings... is by staying far away from them, at least until I'm no longer like"— Asgeir gestures at himself —"this. I've done things I'm not proud of. I don't want them to see me as a failed warlord, and I don't want my past coming back to haunt them. What those pups need is a father... not a monster |If I'm still kicking by the time this demon war is over, I shall visit our younglings. They at least deserve to know who their father is ]."

rows.original: Figuring [asgeir.name] doesn't get treated like a proper puppy too often, you decide to spoil [asgeir.himHer] a bit with some petting. Mischievously, you begin sidling up next to the lupine warlord, careful not to give away your scheme too early. [flags.ASGEIR_SCRITCHES |Confident after [asgeir.hisHer] previous reaction that [asgeir.heShe] won't be too upset about a repeat performance, you pull [asgeir.himHer] to your level and tell [asgeir.himHer] you just think [asgeir.heShe] could use a little more tender affection in [asgeir.hisHer] life. [asgeir.HeShe] grumbles a bit, but [asgeir.heShe] doesn't stop you. "If you're so hung up on this I guess I won't stop you. Just give me a little warning next time." |[asgeir.HeShe] casts you a suspicious glance. "What are you doing, [pc.name]?" [asgeir.hisHer] ears flick before swiveling towards you like big, furry radar dishes. Those targets are just too tempting to resist. You put on an innocent facade and explain to the older lupine as you're sidling closer to [asgeir.himHer] that you'd simply like to take a closer look at his horns. [asgeir.HeShe] scoffs at your explanation. "They're just horns, [pc.name], but fine." [asgeir.name] gets to your level, giving you access to his horns. ] You take a moment to stare at [asgeir.name]'s head and formulate your plan of attack. You can see that [asgeir.heShe] has the usual two dog-like ears of most lupines atop [asgeir.hisHer] head, and [asgeir.hisHer] left ear has been nicked by a past injury. Far less typical though are the pair of horns poking out of [asgeir.hisHer] skull. You're pretty [pc.isCanine |familiar with the fact that canines |sure you heard somewhere that lupines ] enjoy having their heads scratched. You just have to hope that remains true for old dogs like [asgeir.himHer] as well. Setting your strategy in motion, you move your fingers to [asgeir.name]'s canid ears, alternating between scratching at the bases and gliding your nails up the lengths of his ears. You don't seem to elicit any reaction yet, but you're confident that will change with time. The fur of [asgeir.hisHer] ears are ridiculously soft and far finer than the hair on [asgeir.hisHer] head. It's a joy just to run your fingertips over the fluffy strands, so you begin lightly pinching the edges of [asgeir.hisHer] ears with your fingers to feel both inside and out. Whenever you linger for too long on one spot, the respective ear flicks reflexively. [asgeir.name] growls a complaint at you the third time this happens. "I see. So this is your game. Be careful with those things. You're really just itching me when you do that.[pc.isCanine | How do you not know this when your ears are the same? ]" You apologize to [asgeir.name], assuring [asgeir.himHer] that you know what you're doing. Elthara adds, glancing about the ruined fort. "To find land and titles of their own, a place in the world to belong? Well, now you have it. Do with the fort what you will. Daliza's troops have brought a throne, even. A symbol of authority and power befitting the Champion of Frost."
rows.translation: ……几小时后…… 啊，你在这儿呢。 [pc.name]请注意，荒废驿堡的北门目前仍然敞开着，也没有人看守，一队极北精灵正从那里通过。艾尔萨拉走在队伍的最前面，旁边还有一位身着黑色铠甲、身材高大的女性，她骑在一只与吉萨所骑的类似的巨兽背上。 艾尔萨拉微笑着向你走来，那位骑着狼的战士也跟在后面，与此同时，士兵们也分散开了。那些军队成员正一起扛着某个又大又重的东西，东西被厚厚的布盖着，他们没有浪费任何时间，直接将那些货物带进了城堡。 [party.has etheryn |艾尔萨拉！”小琳欢快地叫道，从你身后出现，迅速跑进了那位女祭司的怀抱中。“你终于完成了我的秘密任务吗？” “确实完成了！我敢肯定，[pc.name]会非常感激的，对吧，[pc.heShe]？" | 当那两人靠近时，你迅速皱起了眉头。“艾尔萨拉，是什么事让你们来到这里？” “是我们那位尊贵的上司直接下达的命令。 [etheryn.crowned |摄政者 |女王 ]你会喜欢的，”艾尔萨拉眨着眼睛说道。 ] 那个跟在她后面的胖女人从她的坐骑上下来，向你简短地点了点头。她是个体格健壮的女孩，比那位女祭司要高一些，当然也更加魁梧、肌肉更加结实。她穿着黑色皮甲，胸甲上雕刻着蓝色的龙纹，这些图案与她手臂上的纹身是一致的。一头乱蓬蓬的红发竖立在她的头顶上，与她浓重的眼线及唇膏形成了鲜明的对比。这位女子将一只手放在腰间那把长长的弯曲剑上，静静地站在艾尔萨拉身后，注视着你。 “咳，允许我为大家介绍达莉莎女士。”女祭司说道，同时指向她身旁那位沉默不语的女性。她刚从东部岛屿回来，错过了宫廷里发生的所有热闹事情……因此，我的王妃认为她非常适合担任这条古老商道的新的执法官。她会像一名真正的执法官一样，保护商人们的安全，征收税款等等，让我们以最好的形象出现在公众面前。至于你，冰霜勇士……” 艾尔萨拉从胸前取出一卷卷好的卷轴，递给了你。“根据王座的法令，你现在被授予里德尔河沿岸的土地，包括这座古老的堡垒，以及所有相关的权利。包括税收以及严格的司法制度，”身穿黑色铠甲的女性达莉莎补充道，“而我在这里，就是为了按照您的命令来维护这些权利。 [party.has etheryn |小琳兴奋地对你笑了。 [etheryn.lnhConfidence |我……希望没问题的吧。 [pc.name]我本来想这是个惊喜啊！想作为对你的奖励…… |希望这样没问题吧，”她害羞地说，“我想给你一个惊喜。作为对你一直以来所做一切的奖励…… |惊喜吧！”她轻笑着，把手搭在你的肩上，“我想奖励你，感谢你所做的一切，但既然国库已经空虚，城市也变得如此破败……这就是我所能做的最好的事情了。 ]" ] 这不正是所有冒险者都渴望的吗？”艾尔萨拉环顾着这座被毁的堡垒说道，“找到属于自己的土地和头衔，找到一个属于自己的归宿。现在你们已经得到了。你们想怎么处置这座堡垒都行。达莉莎的军队甚至还带来了一座王座——那是属于冰霜冠军的权威与权力的象征。
rows.raw: ' ...A few hours later... "Ah, there you are, [pc.name]!" Your attention is drawn to the Wayfort's north gates, currently still sitting open and unguarded, as a column of boreal elves march through. Elthara is at the head of the group, accompanied by a tall, muscular woman in black armor riding on the back of a warg much like Gytha's. Elthara smiles and sashays over to you, followed by the wolf-mounted warrior, as the soldiers spread out. The troops are carrying something large and heavy between them, draped under a heavy cloth, and they waste no time taking their cargo directly into the keep. [party.has etheryn |"Elthara!" Ryn chirps, appearing from behind you and quickly finding her way into the priestess's open arms. "You finally finished my secret task?" "That I did! I'm sure [pc.name] will be most appreciative, won't [pc.heShe]?" | You quick a brow as the pair draw near. "What brings you here, Elthara?" She's clad up in black leather armor, embossed with a blue dragon motif across the breastplate that matches the tattoos up her arms. A messy bun of red hair sits atop her head, contrasting her dark kohl and lip paint. The woman rests a hand on a long, curved sword belted to her hip and stands silently behind Elthara, watching you. "Ehem. May I introduce Lady Daliza," the priestess says, indicating her quiet shadow. "She's freshly returned from the eastern islands, and missed all the commotion in the palace... so my royal lady decided she would be a perfect new bailiff for the old tradeway. Elthara produces a rolled-up scroll from between her breasts and hands it to you. And high justice," the black-armored woman, Daliza, adds. "And I'm here to enforce those rights, at your order." [party.has etheryn |Ryn smiles at you excitedly.
