rows.original: You didn't ask for this, and you aren't interested in becoming a vassal of the Winter City.
rows.translation: 你并没有要求这样，而且你也没有兴趣成为冬城的附庸。
rows.raw: "You didn't ask for this, and you aren't interested in becoming a vassal of the Winter City."

rows.original:
"No," you say evenly.
    
    "N-no?" Elthara blinks.
    
    "[pc.HeShe] said no," Daliza laughs, grinning at the priestess. "Are we done here?"
    
    "No!" Elthara snaps, crossing her arms. "You can't just... not accept a lordship, that's... who does that?"
    
    [pc.dcb
        |"I don't need your permission to hold whatever land I want. If I say this fort's mine, it's mine. If I don't want it, I don't take it. I'm sure as shit not swearing fealty to your fucking city."
        |"Me," you shrug. "I refuse to swear fealty to the Winter City. Find another lord."
        |"Uhhhh.... me?" you giggle. "I do! Or don't? Uh... I don't wanna."
    ]
    
    [party.has etheryn
        |[etheryn.lnhConfidence
            |You can see Ryn's ears droop precipitously at your decision, eyes downcast in humiliation and rejection.
            |Ryn gasps, looking between you and her chancellor. "B-but [pc.name]... I-I thought... thought you would... like it..."
            |Ryn gasps, looking between you and her chancellor. "But [pc.name], after all you've done for me... I wanted to give you something back, for once... something real and important... Ah, what was I thinking..."
        ]
    ]
    
    Elthara sighs, rubbing the back of her head. "Well... we can't just leave the Wayfort undefended. More demons have been rising up all over the Marches and the Frostwood, and Etheryn wants more trade with the south, which we aren't going to see without someone to protect the merchants!"
    
    Daliza sighs. "I didn't march my men-at-arms all the way down here to turn them around because some southern twat shoved your writ back in your face. We're staying, and carrying out the [etheryn.crowned|regent|queen]'s order to protect the riverway. I'll have them start building up a barracks off the road a ways, get wood palisades built up at least."
    
    "Fine. Fine." Elthara shakes her head at you and turns to leave. "Perhaps Etheryn will name you the next lord of this place, Daliza. It's a better chance at re-landing your family than retaking the islands."
    
    The bailiff scowls and marches off towards the keep to rally her followers, while Elthara makes to leave. "Sorry for wasting your time, [pc.title]. The bailiff and her men will set about patrolling the keep and the roads around it; do try not to cause a fuss with them?"
    
    [party.has etheryn
        |Ryn watches them go, ears drooped. "W-well... if you ever do find somebody you w-want to stay with... you're welcome to use these lands. Th-the city doesn't have the resources to rebuild it on our own anyway, so... it'll just be abandoned otherwise."
        
        [var0
            |Neither do you. And you don't have any plans of putting in the effort. You sigh. "Let's go already."
            |Maybe some day, but if you do, it'll be on your terms, not with the Winter City's help. You sigh. "Let's go already."
        ]
    ]
rows.translation:
“不，”你平静地说道。
    
    “不、不接受？”艾尔萨拉眨了眨眼。
    
    “[pc.HeShe]说不接受，”达莉莎看着女祭司，咧嘴笑道。“这里的事结束了吗？”
    
    “没有！”艾尔萨拉双臂抱胸，厉声说道。“你不能就这样……拒绝领主之位，那可是……谁会做这种事？”
    
    [pc.dcb
        |“我要占哪块地，根本不需要你的准许。我说这座堡垒是我的，它就是我的；我不想要，就不会收下。老子他妈的绝不会向你那座该死的城市宣誓效忠。”
        |“我啊。”你耸了耸肩。“我拒绝向冬城宣誓效忠。另找一位领主吧。”
        |“呃……我？”你咯咯笑道。“我会呀！还是不会？呃……我不想要。”
    ]
    
    [party.has etheryn
        |[etheryn.lnhConfidence
            |你看见小琳因你的决定而猛地垂下双耳；受辱与被拒令她失落地低下眼睛。
            |小琳倒吸一口气，目光在你与她的宰相之间游移。“可、可是，[pc.name]……我、我以为……以为你会……喜欢……”
            |小琳倒吸一口气，目光在你与她的宰相之间游移。“可是，[pc.name]，你为我做了那么多……我只是想回报你一次……送你一些真实而重要的东西……啊，我到底在想什么……”
        ]
    ]
    
    艾尔萨拉叹了口气，揉着后脑勺。“好吧……我们不能就这样让驿堡无人守卫。恶魔正在边疆与霜林各处不断涌现，伊瑟琳也希望加强同南方的贸易；若是无人保护商人，那些贸易根本无从谈起！”
    
    达莉莎叹了口气。“我可没有率领披甲士兵一路赶来，只为了让某个南方蠢货把你的敕令摔回脸上后，就带着他们转身回去。我们会留下来，执行[etheryn.crowned|摄政王|女王]保护河道的命令。我会让他们在远离道路的地方着手搭建兵营，至少先修起木制栅墙。”
    
    “好吧，好吧。”艾尔萨拉朝你摇了摇头，转身离去。“也许伊瑟琳会任命你为此地下一任领主，达莉莎。相比重新夺回那些岛屿，这更有可能让你的家族再次获得封地。”
    
    执法官皱着脸，大步走向主堡，准备召集部下；艾尔萨拉则要告辞。“抱歉浪费了你的时间，[pc.title]。执法官和她的士兵会着手巡逻主堡及周围道路；请尽量别和他们闹出乱子，好吗？”
    
    [party.has etheryn
        |小琳垂着双耳，目送她们离去。“好、好吧……如果你以后真的找到了想要留在身边的人……这些土地随时可以给你使用。反、反正城里也没有资源自行重建这里，所以……不然它只会继续荒废。”
        
        [var0
            |你同样没有资源，而且也不打算付出那份心力。你叹了口气。“赶紧走吧。”
            |也许以后会吧；但就算重建，你也会按自己的条件行动，而不是依靠冬城。你叹了口气。“赶紧走吧。”
        ]
    ]

rows.original:
You look to [party.has etheryn
        |Ryn
        |Elthara
    ] and nod. "I accept."
    
    "Wonderful!" Elthara beams, pressing the scroll into your hands. "Keep this somewhere safe. It is proof of your peerage within the kingdom, should you ever need to prove it without Etheryn around. You are free to do whatever you wish on and with your lands, but please... this fort is the first step into boer'alvar lands southerners will take. Make your lands the impression you would want to give them! While the city's resources are stretched thin, we'll do what we can to aid in the fort's reconstruction. Speak with Bailiff Daliza when you're ready to begin."
    
    [party.has etheryn
        |[etheryn.highConfidence
            |Your royal companion cheers, bouncing on her heels. "I'm so glad you accepted, my new Marcher [pc.mf
                |Baron
                |Baroness
            ], my very first vassal... there's no one in all the world I'd rather have at my side than you, [pc.name]."
            
            "Careful, Etheryn," Elthara chides. "Hethia was already complaining that you can't make a foreign adventurer a [pc.mf
                |lord
                |lady
            ] just so you can marry [pc.himHer]."
            
            Ryn blushes furiously. "I-I didn't... I wouldn't... that's not..!"
            
            Elthara just laughs. "I know, dear. Just be mindful of appearances, for your sake."
            
            "... I will. I'm sorry. But you and I both know [pc.name] deserves it."
            
            "[pc.HeShe] does indeed."
            |
            Etheryn smiles, a rare treat on the elf-girl's timid face. "I'm so glad... [pc.name], thank you. I promise, I'll be a worthy queen someday. Worthy of your support..."
            
            "You will, Etheryn," the high priestess says, putting a reassuring hand on the girl's shoulder. "You're already much more so than your sister ever could be."
        ]
        
        Elthara extends a hand, and the bailiff draws her sword — a long, curved silvery-white blade, like those carried by the kitsune all over the Frostwood. Daliza surrenders it to the high priestess, who in turns presents it in both hands to Etheryn. "Since our lady is here in person, it seems only proper to grant lordship by the old custom as well. Don't you think, [etheryn.crowned|my queen|lady regent]?"
        
        Ryn nods solemnly. "O-of course. Please kneel, [pc.name]."
        
        Well, this is what you agreed to, isn't it? You take a knee, bowing your head before the petite halfsex. She rests the blade on your shoulder, and speaks evenly. "By decree of the Winter Throne, I name you, [pc.name], as [pc.mf
            |Baron
            |Baroness
        ] of the March. You shall be my spear and my shield, my eyes and my ears.[etheryn.highConfidence
            | You shall be my heart.
        ]"
        
        Elthara coughs quietly. "It's 'the realm's' everything, dear."
        
        Ryn's cheeks flush, but she moves the blade from shoulder to shoulder without correcting herself. Elthara shakes her head indulgently, smiling as the younger elf withdraws her blade and returns it to the bailiff. "Rise, then, [pc.mf
            |Baron
            |Baroness
        ] [pc.name]."
        
        You stand as Daliza is sheathing her sword. The bailiff is the first to acknowledge your new status with a slight bow. "Right then, [pc.mf
            |m'lord
            |m'lady
        ]. Once we're done installing your new throne, I'll set up patrols and get repair crews working on the palisades. We'll have this fort in fighting shape before you know it. As for living shape..."
        
        Elthara pipes up, saying, "The city will help, of course. Coordinate with Daliza, [pc.mf
            |baron
            |baroness
        ], when you're ready to get underway."
        
        "Or find a merchant or somesuch. Likely to find better, cheaper masons to the south. If not, we've got plenty of elves lookin' for work as the months turn lean. Just let me know what suits you, [pc.mf
            |m'lord
            |m'lady
        ]."
        |
        Elthara extends a hand, prompting the bailiff to draw her sword — a long, curved silvery-white blade, like those carried by the kitsune all over the Frostwood — and surrenders it to her. "Since our lady could not be here in person, I will swear you in as her vassal by my power as high priestess and royal chancellor. Please, [pc.name], kneel."
        
        Well, this is what you agreed to, isn't it? You take a knee, bowing your head before the motherly cleric. She rests the blade on your shoulder, and speaks the old words with all the gravity of the queen herself. "By decree of the Winter Throne, I name you, [pc.name], as [pc.mf
            |Baron
            |Baroness
        ] of the March. You shall be the realm's spear and its shield, its eyes and its ears, as the queen is its heart. Now rise, [pc.mf
            |Baron
            |Baroness
        ]."
        
        Elthara returns the sword to Daliza and offers you a hand. "The city will be happy to help you rebuild this fort, to turn it into a proper base of operations, though our resources are somewhat limited at the moment... just speak with Bailiff Daliza when you're ready."
        
        "Or find a merchant or somesuch on your own," the bailiff shrugs. "Likely to find better, cheaper masons to the south. If not, we've got plenty of elves lookin' for work as the months turn lean. Just let me know what suits you, [pc.mf
            |m'lord
            |m'lady
        ]."
    ]
    
    Daliza rests her hand on her sword's hilt, glancing around the fort's courtyard. "Well, lady priestess, you'd best get back to the city. [pc.mf
        |Baron

    ] [pc.name], I'll be inside the keep if you need me."
    
    Elthara curtseys and, smiling proudly, turns to go.

rows.original:
"So what's the catch?" you ask, glancing between priestess and reeve. "What's expected of me if I say yes?"
    
    "You'd be a lord," Daliza grunts. "So not much."
    
    Elthara gives the bailiff a dark look. "That's unkind, especially from a noblewoman. If you hadn't been on that expedition, you might well have... hmph! We can discuss that another time. Now, [pc.name]... what's expected of you is to maintain the old fort, protect merchants, and if necessary, respond to the elvenqueen's call to arms to defend the Winter City. So... not much different than what you've been doing. And most of the day-to-day will be executed by Lady Daliza. You'll have a stream of income and some authority over the surrounding lands, and in return, we ask that you continue to defend the Winter City from threats foreign and domestic."
    
    "That's it?"
    
    "That's it. You're free to continue your adventures and to host who and whatever you wish within these walls, so long as they pose no threat to the city proper. You may even hold court and pass sentences for crimes, as any landed lord... though you may have to answer for your judgements, should they blow back on the throne. And in return, you'll have the protection of the Winter City and its soldiers should foes encroach on you, and you will be recognized as a Marcher Baron. No doubt your fame and influence will spread even further with a noble title of your own; many doors open to those with titles, and with friends in high places!"
rows.translation:
那么，其中有什么隐情呢？”你问道，目光在女祭司和村长之间来回扫视，“如果我答应了，他们会要求我做什么呢？”
    
    “你会成为一名领主，”达丽莎哼了一声，“所以要求也不多。”
    
    艾尔萨拉向那个管家投去了一个阴沉的眼神：“这么说未免太刻薄了，尤其是出自一位贵族女士之口。如果你没有参加那次远征，你现在或许已经……哼！这个我们改天再谈吧。现在， [pc.name]…人们对你的期望就是维护那座古老的堡垒，保护商人们的安全，而在必要时，响应精灵女王的号召，共同保卫冬城。所以……其实和你一直以来所做的并没有太大区别。而日常的大部分事务，都会由达莉莎女士来处理。你将获得稳定的收入，并对周边的土地拥有一定的管辖权。作为交换，我们要求你继续保卫冬城，抵御来自内部和外部的威胁。”
    
    “就这些吗？”
    
    “就这些。你可以自由地继续你的冒险，在这些城墙之内邀请任何你想邀请的人或事物来此居住，只要他们不会对这座城市本身构成威胁。你甚至可以像任何一位领主一样，审理案件并判处刑罚。…不过，如果你所做的判断最终对王位造成负面影响，你将不得不为此负责。作为回报，当敌人侵犯你的领地时，冬城及其军队会保护你，而且你也会被正式承认为边境男爵。毫无疑问，拥有一个高贵的头衔，你的名声和影响力将会进一步扩大；对于那些拥有头衔的人来说，许多机会都会向他们敞开，而且如果你在高层有人脉，那就会更加有利了！

rows.raw: "Ask the bailiff about the former captain, now [jaelyn.isDemon|a demon and your slave|seeking redemption, or at least rehabilitation, at the Frost Hound]."

rows.original: Ask Daliza's thoughts about some of the people that she's met here at the fort.
rows.translation: 询问达莉莎对她在堡垒里遇到的一些人的看法。
rows.raw: "Ask Daliza's thoughts about some of the people that she's met here at the fort."

rows.original: That sure is a huge warg Daliza's got. That means it gives huge hugs, right?
rows.translation: 达莉莎拥有的那个东西可真大啊。那意味着它可以给予非常有力的拥抱，对吧？
rows.raw: "That sure is a huge warg Daliza's got. That means it gives huge hugs, right?"

rows.original: Inquire about the day Ryn's dad, the king dowager, died.
rows.translation: 询问小琳的父亲，也就是老国王，去世那天的情况。
rows.raw: "Inquire about the day Ryn's dad, the king dowager, died."

rows.original: Ashe is quite talkative on the subject of dragons. Perhaps she and Daliza could have a productive conversation.
rows.translation: 阿什在谈论龙的话题时相当健谈。或许她和达莉莎可以进行一次很有意义的对话。
rows.raw: "Ashe is quite talkative on the subject of dragons. Perhaps she and Daliza could have a productive conversation."

rows.original:
"Tell me, what's the job of a bailiff exactly?"
    
    Daliza puffs out her chest proudly, as if showing off the dragon wing's emblazoned on her breastplate. "It is the duty of a lord's bailiff to collect taxes and to enforce laws. I ensure that each merchant that passes across the River Ridell pays his or her fair share to you, and to the throne. If there are criminals on your lands, my men and I will see justice done by the blade or by the shackle. If the fort is attacked in your absence, I will lead its defense."
    
    So in short, she's the muscle. "How many men are under your command?"
    
    "Twenty heavy footmen, all of whom I trained myself. They're equipped with full panoplies, shields, spears, and short bows. Truncheons, too, for policing work. It's no army, but you won't find better fighters anywhere between the Winter City and Khor'minos. My men will be more than enough to handle any brigands or monsters that come crawling out of the forest."
    
    "Have they seen combat?"
    
    The bailiff nods, and a proud grin flicks across her face. "They're experienced. The Winter City hasn't seen all-out war in centuries, but I've blooded my men on frost wyverns, leothran raiders, even a jotun. Druidic rebels, too, before they came back into the fold. You needn't worry, [pc.mf
        |m'lord
        |m'lady
    ], my troops will serve you well."
    
    "Oh!" she adds, grin turning fiercer. "My warg, Narcie, is prowling the woods too. She was a gift from Queen Alissa, strong and prideful as her sire — the queen's own beast. Can sniff out criminals and malcontents from a mile away, and her snarl and snapping's let her make more than a few arrests on her own. We need her, one whistle'll bring her in for the hunt."
    
    Good to hear...
rows.translation:
“告诉我，执法官的职责究竟是什么？”
    
    达莉莎骄傲地挺起胸膛，仿佛在炫耀胸甲上印着的龙翼。“领主麾下的执法官负责征税与执行法律。我会确保每位渡过里德尔河的商人都向你和王座缴纳应付的份额。若领地上出现罪犯，我和部下会用刀剑或镣铐主持正义。你不在时若堡垒遇袭，我会率领众人防守。”
    
    简而言之，她就是武力担当。“你手下有多少人？”
    
    “二十名重装步兵，全都由我亲自训练。他们配有全套甲胄、盾牌、长矛与短弓，还有用来维持治安的警棍。这算不上军队，可从冬城到科尔米诺斯之间，你再也找不到更优秀的战士。我的部下足以应付任何从森林里爬出来的强盗或怪物。”
    
    “他们经历过实战吗？”
    
    执法官点了点头，脸上闪过自豪的笑意。“他们身经百战。冬城已有数百年未经历全面战争，但我曾带他们猎杀霜龙、狮族劫掠者，甚至还有一个约顿人。德鲁伊叛军重归正统前，我们也曾同他们交战。你无须担心，[pc.mf
        |大人
        |女士
    ]，我的士兵会好好为你效命。”
    
    “哦！”她又补充道，笑容变得更加凶悍。“我的座狼纳西也在森林里巡逻。她是艾莉莎女王送给我的礼物，像她的父亲一样强壮而骄傲——她父亲正是女王自己的座狼。她隔着一英里就能嗅出罪犯与不满分子，靠着低吼与利齿，已经独自完成过不少次逮捕。需要她时，只要一声口哨就能唤她前来狩猎。”
    
    听起来不错……

rows.original: [flags.RQ2_ALISSA |"So, your family..." Daliza stifles a proud smile. "All of the legends and stories were true, it seems. The dragons of Dracia, the Skal'norria clan as our bond-mates. Truly, it makes my heart soar to know my parents' tales were true to the last... and yet, it makes the absence of dragons from the world that much harder to bear. After our expedition, there's no longer any question in my mind that I have dragonsblood in my veins, however faint it might be. That places me in a small and shrinking club, doesn't it?" You nod. [ashe.around |It's true, the only dragon you know is living in your mace now that her body's dead and gone. |There aren't exactly a lot of — or perhaps any — dragons hiding around the world these days, are there? ] Daliza sighs and leans back against the wall, arms crossing against her dragon-etched breastplate. "Still, it makes me deeply thankful for what I have, and for what I've inherited: the legacy of Eldred, who wooed a great dragon in the heat of battle; the blessing of Nareva and her beloved servant who helped establish Estelore itself, who in turn built that great tower on our island; and of course, great Dracia Keep, the shield of the northern seas. What I've inherited from my ancestors is far greater than even I had dreamed. To say that I'm proud would be an understatement in the extreme." [flags.TODO_DALIZA_CREST |"So, Lady Daliza," you say, leaning in a little closer, "with a family so prestigious, don't you owe it to those famous ancestors to continue the bloodline?" Dal's cheeks flush. "I suppose, someday, yes. But we're in the middle of a war, my love, and I am a war-leader. I can't exactly waddle onto the battlefield gravid with child when the time comes that I'm needed. So... later. But I swear, that is a conversation we will have when there is peace in our lands." You guess that'll have to do for now. ] |"Elthara mentioned something about your family, didn't she?" "Hmm." Daliza fidgets. "She always did have a big mouth. What's she told you, exactly?" You shrug. "Nothing. She just mentioned it when we met, that's all... [pc.dcb |but now you've got me curious. What's wrong with them? |but it clearly makes you uncomfortable. Is something amiss? |but I'm just dyiiiiiing to know more about you! Why, is something wrong? ]" "Ah. Hm. Well then." Daliza sighs, scrunching her lips. "Pardon me, [pc.mf |m'lord |m'lady ], I don't much like talking about myself, much less my family. By rights, my line are lords of Dracia, an island holding on the extreme eastern edge of the kingdom. Practically part of the Sailgraves, it was. When the Godswar broke out, Dracia and the other island holdfasts were first to be attacked. Never knew what hit them — demons and monsters came crawling up out of the water in the night before my ancestors even knew there was a war going on. Dracia fell, and House Ridell never retook it. Even now, most of the old kingdom is abandoned, lying in ruins. Like this place [wayfort.renovated|was|is]. Not much cause to risk men and resources reconquering our old land when even the Winter City itself isn't half full." "Does that have something to do with the expedition Elthara mentioned?" She nods. "And why I was out of the city when Alissa's madness finally boiled over. At the start of summer, I led a ranging expedition eastward to see the state of boer'alvar fortifications and abandoned towns between the Winter City and the coast. Queen Alissa had been considering resettling a town, if we found one that was safe enough and in good enough repair. No small part of me hoped that we'd make it all the way to Dracia, and... well, it was certainly wishful thinking. We never even made it to the coast — lost five good outriders to Wraith-touched beasts, and the fiends only became more ferocious and common the further east we went. Had to turn back, or none of us would have made it home." Daliza sighs, hanging her head slightly. "Someday, though. I will find my way back to Dracia. But before that day comes, I'll train up a replacement for you, [pc.mf |m'lord |m'lady ]. No need to worry about me leaving you without warning." ]
rows.translation: [flags.RQ2_ALISSA |那么，你的家人……” 达莉莎强压下心中那股自豪的笑容。“看来，所有那些传说和故事都是真实的。达拉西亚的巨龙们，斯卡尔诺里亚家族作为我们的盟友……真的，想到我父母讲述的故事每一句都是真实的，我的心情简直激动得无法形容。然而，正因如此，这个世界上没有龙的存在才显得更加难以忍受。经过这次探险后，我再也不会怀疑自己体内流淌着龙之血脉，哪怕这份血脉极其微弱。这样一来，我就属于那个越来越小的特殊群体之中了，不是吗？你点了点头。 [ashe.around |确实，现在她的身体已经不复存在，你所知道的唯一一条龙，就住在你的权杖里了。 |如今，世界上真正隐藏着的龙，已经不多了——或者说，可能已经没有龙存在了，对吧？ ] 达莉莎叹了口气，靠在墙上，双臂交叉放在那块刻有龙纹的胸甲上。“尽管如此，我还是对自己所拥有的一切，以及继承下来的东西感到由衷的感激：埃尔德雷德留下的遗产——他在激烈的战斗中赢得了巨龙的青睐；娜瑞瓦以及她那位忠诚的仆人的恩赐，正是他们帮助建立了埃斯泰洛尔，而那些仆人后来又在我们的岛上建造了那座伟大的塔楼；当然，还有那座巍峨的达拉西亚要塞，它是北方海域的守护者。我从祖先那里继承的东西，远远超出了我的想象。如果说我感到自豪，那简直是一种轻描淡写的表达。 [flags.TODO_DALIZA_CREST |那么，达莉莎小姐，”你说道，微微靠近了一些，“拥有如此显赫的家庭背景，难道你不应该为那些著名的祖先着想，延续这个家族的血脉吗？” 达莉莎的脸颊顿时红了。“我想，总有一天，我一定会这么做的。但是，亲爱的，我们现在正处于战争之中，而我是一名战争领导者。在需要我的时候，我总不能怀着孩子摇摇晃晃地走上战场吧。所以……等战争结束后再谈。但我向你保证，等到我们的国家恢复和平，我们一定会好好谈谈这个话题的。暂时也只能这样了。 ] |艾尔萨拉提到过你的家人，对吧？” “嗯。”达莉莎坐立不安地回答，“她向来就爱多嘴。她具体说了些什么呢？” 你耸了耸肩：“没什么。我们见面时她只是顺口提了一下而已…… [pc.dcb |但现在你引起了我的好奇心。它们到底怎么了？ |但这显然让你感到不适。是不是出了什么问题？ |但我真的非常想了解更多关于你的信息！难道，有什么不对吗？ ]啊……嗯，那好吧。”达莉莎叹了口气，抿了抿嘴唇，“不好意思[pc.mf |大人 |女士 ]我不太喜欢谈论自己，更不愿意谈论我的家人。按理说，我的家族是达拉西亚岛的统治者，那个岛屿位于王国的最东端。实际上，达拉西亚岛曾经属于“航海牧师”组织的一部分。当神战爆发时，达拉西亚岛和其他一些岛屿首先遭到了攻击。我从来不知道究竟是什么力量袭击了它们——在夜幕降临之际，恶魔和怪物从水中爬了出来，而我的祖先们甚至还没有意识到发生了什么。是一场持续不断的战争。达拉西亚沦陷了，里德尔家族再也没能将其收复。直到如今，这片古老王国的绝大部分地区依然被废弃，沦为废墟。就像这个地方一样[wayfort.renovated|是|是]既然连冬城本身都远未坐满人，那就没有必要冒险派出人员和资源去重新夺回我们的故土了。” “这和艾尔萨拉提到的那次远征有什么关系吗？” 她点了点头。就在艾莉莎的疯狂终于达到顶点的时候，我正好不在城里。初夏的时候，我带领一支探险队向东进发，去考察冬城与海岸线之间那些被遗弃的城镇，以及布尔人建造的防御工事的状况。如果能够找到一个足够安全且状况良好的城镇，艾莉莎女王一直在考虑重新安置人们。我内心其实也很希望我们能够顺利抵达达拉西亚……不过，这当然只是一种美好的愿望罢了。我们甚至都没有能够到达海岸——有五名出色的侦察兵被那些被怨灵影响的野兽杀害了，而且我们越往东走，这些恶魔就越凶猛，出现得也越频繁。我们不得不折返，否则没有人能够活着回到家中。达莉莎轻轻叹了口气，低下了头。“不过，总有一天我会的。我一定会找到回到达拉西亚的路。但在那一天到来之前，我会为你培养一个替代者。 [pc.mf |大人 |女士 ]不必担心我会突然离开你们。 ]

rows.original:
"What's the status of the fort?" you ask.
    
    [wayfort.stateABC
        |"It's shit," Bailiff Daliza answers, glancing around the place. "Obviously. [pc.mf
            |M'lord.
            |M'lady.
        ]"
        |"Repairs have made good progress. The outer walls are... defensible... now. The towers are still mostly wrecked, and the inner keep looks like shit, but I wouldn't feel like we're on the back foot if we have to defend the place against an attack. At least from the south."
        |"It's starting to look halfway decent," Daliza answers, looking around with what might actually be a smile. "The smell's gone, somebody finally plugged the draft, and the outer walls have all been patched up to fighting shape. Give me a catapult in the courtyard and this place'll feel proper defensible. As it is... I guess I'll settle for it feeling like a home. [aileh.isWayfort
            |Doesn't hurt that we've got a dragon in the tower
        ]."
        
        "High praise, coming from my [pc.isBimbo
            |grumpy-pants
            |taciturn
        ] bailiff."
        
        She snorts a little laugh and shrugs. "It is what it is. I wouldn't be ashamed to show my parents where I'm serving. [daliza.fucked|Nor whom I've chosen to dedicate myself to...]" 
        
        High praise indeed...
    ]
rows.translation:
“驿堡目前情况如何？”你问道。
    
    [wayfort.stateABC
        |“一团糟。”执事达莉莎环顾四周，答道。“显而易见。[pc.mf
            |大人。
            |女士。
        ]”
        |“修缮进展不错。外墙现在已经……能够防守了。塔楼大多仍是废墟，内堡看起来也糟透了，但若要抵御进攻，我不会觉得我们处于劣势。至少面对南方来敌时不会。”
        |“已经开始有几分像样了。”达莉莎环顾四周，脸上似乎真的带着一丝笑意。“臭味没了，终于有人堵住了漏风处，外墙也全都修补到足以作战的状态。要是院子里再放一架投石机，这地方就真能算防守严密。至于现在……我想，能让它像个家也不错。[aileh.isWayfort
            |更何况塔里还住着一条龙
        ]。”
        
        “从我这位[pc.isBimbo
            |臭脾气的
            |沉默寡言的
        ]执事嘴里说出来，这评价可真高。”
        
        她轻哼着笑了一声，耸耸肩。“事实如此。我不会羞于让父母看看自己效力的地方。[daliza.fucked|也不会羞于让他们知道，我选择了为谁奉献自己……]”
        
        的确是极高的评价……
    ]

rows.original: "You want to know about that day, huh? Under [etheryn.crowned |her Majesty |the regent ]'s orders? It feels like forever that it happened, even if it was but a handful of decades back." Daliza looks thoughtful. "Alissa's rule really made that big of a splash that it sticks out in everyone's mind, didn't it, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]?" While that's no doubt very interesting, you're asking about the king dowager here, not Alissa. Call it a hunch, but you think that everyone's had just about enough of Ryn's sister for a good while now. Back to the point — does she know anything about the circumstances surrounding the death of Ryn's father? "Right, sure; I was even on duty when it happened. I was just a constable back in the day, wasn't but a year into duty at the palace. As far as I was concerned, it was just another afternoon, and then there was a big hullabaloo coming from the palace gates. I was wondering if there'd be some kind of call to arms, but when I arrived at the scene with my sergeant and everyone else they were carrying in the king dowager in on a stretcher." Were... were his daughters around? Daliza shrugs. "I don't know. There was barely enough time to get a good look at the man before we were mustered and sent out into the woods to investigate that there'd been any foul play. My sergeant, he was tasked with arresting the huntsmaster." There are so many questions her statement there raises, but you'll take them one at a time. First off, what did the king look like when he was brought in? "In a bad way. He was a big and hearty man, which was supposedly part of the reason why the queen fell for him and was where Alissa got her build from, but it was only because of that that he'd survived the trip back from the Frostwood and to the palace. They'd bound his gut wound — it was soaked through with blood, and he was clutching it and groaning. The man was pretty stoic — you'd have to be around the old queen — but the wound pained him enough that he couldn't help himself. Even with the bindings, you could see the edges of the rip the boar's tusks tore into his flesh. "Some of us worked with the Lumians, tried to figure out if there was any foul play to the wound. It was a pretty shitty one, though, excuse my language, and eventually what killed him wasn't the wound itself, but the infection he'd gotten by virtue of having the contents of his guts spill into his blood. Once that happens, even the best of healing magic's hard-pressed to save you; I suppose only a direct miracle from the goddess herself could've spared his life at that point... and that was denied. The priestess who did his autopsy was pretty ill, I'm told." And the investigation... "I went out with a couple of the palace guard — every pair of hands that could be spared was roped into the investigation. It was the king dowager, after all, and if there was foul play involved it's wasn't going to slip by for lack of searching. We combed the woods, the huntsmaster's quarters, the armory for any hint that this might have been anything but a simple accident. Not that we found anything, but I was pretty damned tired at the end of it all. "You know, looking back on it, I feel like a lot of that investigation was just pointless and it was just one big dog and pony show to reassure the crown's subjects that we were doing something. The people loved the old queen and king, and to have the two go in just a matter of a few decades apart was absolutely devastating. If they'd thought we weren't doing the investigation justice, they might have done something stupid, and they wanted results. Not that investigations actually work that way — you don't put in so much work and then get a guaranteed result. But try telling that to the average bugger who just doesn't want to hear that the king was dead, and from something as banal as a big pig. If it weren't for Alissa calming the crowd and reminding everyone of her mother, it could've gotten real ugly."
rows.translation: 你想知道那天发生的事情，是吧？在[etheryn.crowned |女王陛下 |摄政王 ]他的那些命令？虽然那只是发生在几十年前的事情，但感觉却像是很久以前的事了。”达莉莎若有所思地说道，“艾莉莎的统治确实引起了巨大的轰动，因此大家都还记得，对吧？ [pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]虽然这确实很有趣，但你现在问的是王太后，而不是艾莉莎。姑且算是一种直觉吧，我觉得大家已经受够了小琳的妹妹这个话题了。回到正题——她是否了解关于小琳父亲死亡真相的任何信息呢？ 没错，当时我确实正在值班。那时候我还只是个警员，在皇宫服役才刚满一年。对我来说，那只是平常的一个下午，突然间，皇宫大门那边传来了巨大的喧闹声。我还在想是不是发生了什么紧急情况，但当我和我的中士以及其他人赶到现场时，他们正用担架把王太后抬了进来。 他的女儿们在场吗？” 达莉莎耸了耸肩：“我不知道。我们几乎没时间好好看看那个男人，就被召集起来，派往树林去调查是否发生了什么不测。我的中士负责逮捕那个狩猎主管。 她的陈述引发了诸多问题，但我们可以逐一探讨。首先，当国王被带进来的时候，他长什么样子？ “情况很糟糕。他原本是个身材高大、体格强壮的男人，据说这也是王后被他吸引的原因之一，艾莉莎的身材特征也是由此而来。但正因为这个原因，他才能够在从冰原森林回到宫殿的途中活下来。他们已经包扎了他的腹部伤口——伤口处已经浸满了鲜血，他紧紧捂着伤口，不断地呻吟着。这个男人本来相当坚忍，只有那些曾经侍奉过老女王的人才知道他到底有多坚强……但这次伤口带来的疼痛实在让他无法忍受。即使穿着这些护具，你仍然能够看到那些被野猪的獠牙撕裂在皮肉上的伤口边缘。 我们中的一些人与卢米安人一起工作，试图查明这个伤口是否有什么不寻常的地方。不过，那个伤口确实非常严重，恕我言辞粗俗，最终导致他死亡的原因并不是伤口本身，而是由于他的内脏组织流入血液所引发的感染。一旦那种情况发生，即便是最强大的治愈魔法也无力挽救你的生命；我想，只有女神亲自降临创造奇迹，才有可能在那种时刻挽救他的性命……但这样的奇迹并没有发生。据我所知，为他的尸体进行验尸的女祭司当时也病得很重。" 而调查工作…… “我和几名宫廷卫兵一起参与了调查——凡是能抽得出来的人手都被派去参与这项工作。毕竟涉及到王太后，如果其中存在阴谋诡计，我们绝对不会放过任何线索。我们搜查了森林、猎场主管的住处以及军械库，试图找出任何能够证明这并非一起简单事故的迹象。虽然最终什么也没找到，但到最后我真的累坏了。 你知道，现在回想起来，我觉得那些调查很多都是毫无意义的，只不过是一场盛大的表演，目的是让王室的子民们相信我们确实在采取行动罢了。某个东西人们非常喜爱那位老国王和老王后，而他们仅仅相隔了几十年就相继离世，这一事实确实令人痛心不已。如果他们认为我们的调查工作没有做到位，或许会做出一些愚蠢的举动，而他们迫切地希望看到调查结果。其实，调查本来就不是这样的——你不会付出那么多努力却能确保得到结果。但试想，去跟那些根本不愿意相信国王已经去世的人讲这个道理吧，尤其是当这个消息仅仅与一头肥猪有关的时候…… 要不是阿丽莎安抚了人群，并让大家想起了她的母亲，事情可能会变得非常糟糕。

rows.original: You... see. Circling back a little, she mentioned that the huntsmaster was arrested, and that his quarters were searched for anything that might have suggested foul play. That would've been Elyon, wouldn't it? A nod. "He was still relatively new at the job given the retirement of the previous huntsmaster a handful of years back, but he and his apprentices were the ones who'd prepared the equipment and animals the hunting party were using on the day. For lack of a better suspect, he was arrested and taken into custody without charge." And he just went along with it? "It was more for his own protection than anything else, really. The people were incensed; they wanted a scapegoat to blame for the king dowager's death, and he and his apprentices were the most likely victims. If they'd stepped foot outside of the palace the mob might have torn them apart without thinking twice — that was how much they'd loved [etheryn.crowned |her Majesty |the regent ]'s parents. But yes, we searched his chambers, the kennels, and the mews; we returned empty-handed without any evidence of any kind of plot to do away with the king. We examined the broken boar spear as best as we could, brought in the best smiths from the city to look it over, and no, there weren't any notches in the wood where he'd cleverly sawn through it halfway or anything. It was just a bad hunting accident. Eventually, we had to admit that there wasn't any evidence and let him go." But that wasn't the answer the crowd wanted. "No, it wasn't. But we at least try to be a people of laws, as opposed to blatant who and whom. Even with him exonerated from the king's death, the man had to endure the ugly looks of the palace staff who still thought he'd somehow caused the king dowager's death and managed to get away with it. I don't even think he left the palace very much after that; anything he needed from the city, he sent his apprentices out for. I think things got to the point where Elyon really started believing that he was, in some way, really responsible for the king dowager's death." And he still feels that way? "Wouldn't surprise me. From what I've seen, these demons become obsessed over something in particular. If he's on the way to becoming one, it makes perfect sense. Which is why I was, and still am, going to be coming down on him like a ton of bricks at the slightest misstep, pardon my language." You sigh. Ryn wants to try and save him from that end... which is, after all, the entire point of this whole exercise. It would help if Daliza didn't already act like he was a lost cause. "Begging your pardon, [pc.title], but if I thought he was a lost cause I wouldn't have bothered dragging him back all the way after my men found him wandering the woods." Well, in any case, you appreciate her for speaking about the matter so candidly — and loudly, for that matter. You're starting to get a clearer picture of the events that happened that day. "Hmp. If [etheryn.crowned |her Majesty |the regent ]'s given a lawful order, then I can't quite say no, can I? I can guess she's trying to do this to help him, but I don't think it'll do any good. Then again, I know I'd make a shitty queen without a heart. Ha! Good luck on your investigation, [pc.title] — I know how tiresome trying to put the pieces together can be. Now, all this talking's made my mouth dry. Anything else you want to discuss before I go get myself a drink?"
rows.translation: 你……明白我的意思吧。回到刚才的话题，她提到猎头被逮捕了，人们还搜查了他的住处，想找出可能表明他有罪的证据。那个人应该就是埃利昂吧？ 点了点头。由于之前的猎场主管在几年前就已经退休了，所以他接手这份工作其实还算是比较新的。不过正是他和他的学徒们准备了当天狩猎队所使用的一切装备和动物。由于没有更合适的嫌疑人，他就被逮捕了，而且在没有被正式指控的情况下就被关押了起来。 而他只是顺从了这一安排吗？ “其实，这更多是为了保护他自己。当时人们都怒不可遏，他们想要找一个替罪羊来为王太后的死负责，而他和他的学徒们正是最有可能成为牺牲品的人选。如果他们敢走出宫殿，那些暴民可能会毫不犹豫地将他们撕成碎片——因为他们实在太受人爱戴了。 [etheryn.crowned |女王陛下 |摄政王 ]他的父母。不过，我们确实搜查了他的房间、狗舍以及那些小巷，但一无所获，没有任何证据表明有人策划过要谋杀国王。我们尽最大努力检查了那支断裂的野猪矛，甚至请来了城里最出色的铁匠来仔细研究，但结果仍然是否定的——木头上没有任何痕迹，表明有人曾经巧妙地将矛锯成两半。那只是一起不幸的狩猎事故。最终，我们不得不承认没有其他证据，因此只能放他走。” 但这个答案并不符合人群的期望。 “不，确实不是这样的。但至少我们尝试一下吧。作为一个讲法治的民族，人们应该摒弃那种明目张胆的偏袒与歧视。即使这个人被证明与国王的死亡无关，他仍然不得不忍受宫廷工作人员那些鄙夷的目光——那些人依然认为他是导致了王太后的死亡，却侥幸逃过了惩罚。我认为在那之后，他几乎再也没有离开过宫殿；他所需要的任何东西，都是让他的学徒们去城里采购的。情况逐渐发展到这样的地步：埃利昂真的开始相信，自己在某种程度上，确实要对王太后的死负有一定责任。他现在还是这么觉得吗？” “我一点也不会感到惊讶。以我的观察来看，这些恶魔都会对某样东西产生执念。如果他正在朝着那个方向发展，那么这一切就完全合情合理了。正因如此，过去是这样，现在也是这样，只要他稍有差错，我就会严厉地批评他，还请原谅我的言辞。 你叹了口气。小琳想要尽力帮他避免这样的结局……毕竟，这才是整个事情的初衷啊。如果达莉莎不要表现得好像他已经无可救药的话，会比较好。 “请原谅[pc.title]不过，如果我认为他无可救药的话，我的手下在森林里找到他时，我就不会费心把他带回来了。” 无论如何，你得感谢她如此坦率地谈论这件事——而且还是当着这么多人的面说出来的。这样，你对那天发生的事情也就逐渐有了更清晰的认识了。 “哼[etheryn.crowned |女王陛下 |摄政王 ]既然收到了合法的命令，那我也没办法拒绝，对吧？我猜她是想通过这种方式来帮助他，但我觉得这并不会有什么效果。不过话说回来，我也知道，如果一个女王没有同情心，那她肯定不是一个好女王。哈！祝你的调查顺利吧。 [pc.title] — 我知道把所有这些零碎信息拼凑起来是多么令人烦恼的事情。 现在，说得太多了，我的嘴巴都快干渴了。在我去喝点东西之前，还有什么你想讨论的吗？

rows.original: "So, [jaelyn.isBartender |you've seen what's become of the former Captain of the Guard..." [flags.DALIZA_JAE_3SUM |"Intimately, yes..." Daliza says, eyes askance. "Thank you... for the push, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. Corrupted or not, that's still the Captain Jael'yn I knew under those horns. Still strong and sassy and... well, you know. She's changed, of course, and seems quite charmed by her position as your... retainer... but more is the same than has changed." "Well, that's good to hear." You smile, leaning back on the throne. "Have you two been getting along?" Daliza nods, lips twitching into what just might be a smile. "Aye, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ], that we have... and I'll do what I can to help her while you're away adventuring. The soul doesn't make the woman, no matter what Elthara and the other priests say. That much I can see with my own two eyes. So someone needs to try and bring her back to Lumia's light. At the very least, I'll keep her out of any mischief." Good to hear. |Daliza stiffens, even moreso than usual for the taciturn elf when pressed for conversation. Her rose-painted lips press into a thin line, and you can see a vein throb on her brow. But she doesn't speak; just nods sharply. "Okay..." You sigh, trying to parse a way to get more out of her. "So did you two know each other...?" "Of course. Captain Jael'yn trained me." Oh. Daliza sighs, glancing towards the bar where your demonic maid is working, just out of earshot. "She trained me to protect the Winter City, and I wasn't there when my city needed me most. When my captain needed me most... now look at her. A slave to her own lusts... and to you." Those last words come with enough bite to [pc.isDK |make someone with Etheryn's willpower break and flee |make you wince ]. "You don't approve." "I'm not here to give my opinion on matters of personal morality," the elf growls back, clearly restraining herself. "But if you're asking me if I like working from the same building where my mentor is ringed and collared, no, I don't." "Harsh. But she seems to be having a great time of it," you tease. "Aside from the magic cockring, anyway. But that's necessary to keep her under control." Daliza frowns. "To keep her from running around the countryside forcing herself on people. I know. A grim reminder of what Alissa brought the city to, with the help of that demon-woman. Still. Jael'yn is a victim of hers as much as anyone." At least she understands that much. "So you and her won't have a problem?" "Problem? No, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. It's just... seeing her like this, all pent up and perpetually frustrated... much less in a slave's collar... it's difficult." "Well, maybe you can help take care of at least one of those problems..." "Pardon me, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]?" "Nothing, nothing." ] |have you heard of what happened to Captain Jael'yn?" "Former captain..." Daliza corrects hesitantly, stiffening. Her rose-painted lips press into a thin line, and you can see a vein throb on her brow. "Lady Etheryn has officially discharged Jael'yn from all duties." "Ah, of course. So, did you two know each other...?" "Yes. Captain Jael'yn trained me." Oh. Daliza sighs, resting a hand on her sword. "She trained me to protect the Winter City, and I wasn't there when my city needed me most. When my captain needed me most... and now look at her. A slave to her own lusts... and to you." Those last words come with enough bite to [pc.isDK |make someone with Etheryn's willpower break and flee |make you wince ]. "At least she stopped short of becoming a demon, too." The bailiff's lips purse tighter. "Aye, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. But none of that should have happened in the first place. Alissa nearly brought ruin to our city, and all of us — Jael'yn and the royal guard, my rangers, Elthara's clerics — were either helpless to stop it, or seduced into going along with madness. rows.original: "The fort's been good for the Winter City. With us here to protect them, traders have started filtering up north again. People are starting to remember that the city exists; that we boer'alvar aren't extinct. Mmm. Before we resettled this fortress, I'd never met anyone but kitsune born south of the river. Now? Now I've seen minotaurs and centaurs and marefolk and even one very lecherous-looking half-gnoll — not to mention your companions." You nod along. "Glad you're meeting new people." "I am, yes. Remarkably, most of them are relatively well behaved. Traveling merchants have a rather poor reputation in the stories from up north, but nobody's tried to cheat or poison any of my rangers. I've only had to arrest a couple of miscreants for trying to evade taxes, too. I'd have thought more would try and ford the river, but it seems that between the bridge and the safety of the fort, most peddlers are willing to accept an excise of convenience." [wayfort.hasFarrah |"Has Farrah been any trouble?" Daliza shifts her weight. "Technically? No. She does try and cheat us, and half her goods are corrupted to begin with, but if peddling creamy white drinks and overcharging for whetstones and boots is the worst a demon gets up to I'll count myself contented." ] "Good to hear."
rows.translation: 这座堡垒对冬城来说意义重大。有我们在这里保护他们，商人们又开始向北方迁徙了。人们也开始重新记起这座城市的存在；也开始意识到我们这些布尔阿尔瓦尔人并没有灭绝。嗯……在我们重新驻守这座堡垒之前，我从来没遇到过河以南出生的人，除了那些狐人之外。现在吗？现在我可是见过弥诺陶洛斯、半人马、海洋生物，甚至还遇到一个看起来极其好色的半地精——更别提你的同伴了。” 你点头表示同意：“很高兴你能结识新朋友。” “是啊，确实很高兴。说来也奇怪，他们中的大多数人都表现得相当规矩。在北方的故事中，商人的名声通常不太好，但从来没有人试图欺骗或毒害我的护林员。我也只逮捕过几个试图逃税的坏人而已。我本以为会有更多人试图渡河偷逃，但实际上，在桥梁和堡垒的庇护下，大多数小贩都愿意接受这种便利带来的“额外费用”。" [wayfort.hasFarrah |法拉有没有惹过什么麻烦？” 达莉莎挪了挪身子，说道：“严格来说？没有。她确实就算她试图欺骗我们，而且她卖的商品本来就有一半是劣质的，但只要她只是卖一些乳白色的饮料，或者对磨刀石和靴子收取过高的价格，那我也就觉得心满意足了。 ] 听到这个消息真是太好了。

rows.original:
"Well, I never thought I'd meet a real live dragon," Daliza says, stifling an uncharacteristic chuckle. "I think Aileh counts, even if she's a being born of corruption — she's still the closest thing to a dragon anyone around here has seen in centuries."

    "Anyone, anywhere," you muse. Some folk wonder if dragons ever existed at all. 
    
    Daliza nods. "She's not as bad as I would have thought for being a demonspawn. Has a certain... imperious majesty to her, despite walking around half-naked. Her presence certainly has kept the bandit numbers down. One look at the huge dragon-woman brooding on the tower and most ne'er do wells will go find easier pickings than your lands."
    
    "Seems you appreciate having her around, then."
    
    Daliza's ears twitch. "I won't deny it, m'[pc.mf
        |lord
        |lady
    ]. Dracians were kin to sea dragons, once. Perhaps I'm biased because of that, but I can't find it in myself to say a word against her even knowing whence she came. Aileh is strong, self-sufficient, regal... and keeps her corruption to herself, so far as I have seen. She'd make a good bailiff if she had a mind to work for you. And if you trust someone reared by the enemy commander."
    
    "[aileh.friendLover
        |She's good people, Daliza.
        |I do.
        |We'll have to see.
    ]"
rows.translation:
“我从没想过，自己竟会见到一条活生生的真龙。”达莉莎说道，强忍着一声与平日形象不符的轻笑。“我认为艾莱赫算得上；即使她是腐化孕育的生命，她仍是这附近几百年来任何人见过的、最接近龙的存在。”

    “不只是附近，而是任何地方。”你沉吟道。有些人甚至怀疑龙是否曾经存在。
    
    达莉莎点点头。“就恶魔后裔而言，她并没有我预想得那么糟。虽然总是半裸着走来走去，却有种……威严而傲然的气度。她的存在确实压低了强盗的数量。那些恶棍只要看见塔顶盘踞着一个巨大的龙女，大多都会另寻比你的领地更容易下手的目标。”
    
    “这么说，你很欣赏她留在这里。”
    
    达莉莎的耳朵动了动。“我不否认，[pc.mf
        |大人
        |女士
    ]。达拉西亚人曾与海龙同族。或许因此我有所偏爱，但即使知道她来自何方，我也说不出一句反对她的话。艾莱赫强大、自立、高贵……而且据我所见，她一直把自身腐化约束得很好。若她有意为你效力，会成为一名出色的执事——前提是你信任由敌军统帅抚养长大的人。”
    
    “[aileh.friendLover
        |她是个好人，达莉莎。
        |我信任她。
        |这还得再观察。
    ]”

rows.original: "That plant's trouble," Daliza answers, gesturing across the bridge. "She's positioned so that nobody from the south can get across the bridge without seeing her first. And if they see her, half the time they turn tail and run. A quarter of the time they end up forgetting the rest of us are here and playing fertilizer with the Alraune and her daughters. It's a Nareva-blessed miracle we get anybody with the wits to make it across the river at all." "Slow down. Has she actually hurt anyone?" [jaelyn.isDemon |Daliza scowls. "Aside from the Captain's soul? No. And she insists that was an accident, that they just had sex the one time and pop, out it went! Hmmph. |No. But still. ] I'm having my troops keep a close watch on her. A creature that corrupted right near our base isn't doing the realm any favors. Nor your reputation." You shrug. "As you say, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]."

rows.original:
"That creature... the behemoth of a horse-abomination," Daliza says slowly, glancing across the river. "That thing is dangerous. I don't like having it so close... it's big enough that I think it would take half my rangers to put it down, if it went wild. For now, at least, it's... it seems insensate, pacified by the flowers."

    You lean in with a grin. "Have any of your girls taken it for a ride?"
    
    The bailiff's brow furrows. "I don't know, and frankly, I don't want to. None of them have come back from patrols unable to walk, at least. Now that you mention it, though, one of my sergeants did suggest we try training the thing for war."
    
    "Oh?"
    
    "Don't get your hopes up, but if it can learn to wield a lance other than the one between its legs, the thing could be a powerful weapon. If not, I'm sure you can just point it in the enemy's direction in a siege and watch it go berserk."
    
    Fun.
rows.translation:
那种生物……简直就是一匹怪物，”达莉莎缓缓说道，目光越过河流望去。“那种东西非常危险。我可不喜欢它离我们这么近……它的体型实在太大了，如果它发狂了，我想我需要一半的游骑兵才能把它制服。至少目前来看，这……似乎有点荒谬，但那些花朵让这一切显得变得平和了一些。”

    你笑着凑近问道：“你们家那些姑娘中有谁试过骑它吗？”
    
    执达官皱起了眉头：“我不知道，说实话，我也不想知道。至少，没有一个人在巡逻后无法行走而回来。不过，你现在这么一提，我的一个中士确实建议我们尝试训练这种生物来用于战斗。”
    
    “哦？”
    
    “别抱太大希望，但如果它能学会使用除了它腿间那根长矛之外的其他武器，那么这种生物确实可以成为一种强大的战斗工具。如果不是这样的话，我相信在围攻战中，你只需要把它指向敌人的方向，然后看着它发狂就可以了。”
    
    真有趣。

rows.original:
"My rangers and I have had a few run-ins with the tanuki family just north of here," Daliza mentions awkwardly. "While the Evergreens have been known to us for, er, ever, I've never encountered them before up close. Perhaps it's just the mind playing tricks, but there's something eerie about the witch and her daughters. At least, the furry ones. The younger girls are so vacant, like there's nobody home upstairs, while their mother jiggles around casting magic that would make Estelorean archmagisters envious. At least there's a few normal-looking ones, the halfbreeds, but..."
    
    "But?"
    
    She sighs. "I don't like to speculate, m'[pc.mf
        |lord
        |lady
    ]. But something's [silly
        |rotten in Denmark
        |not right with that family
    ]. Better they be here than closer to the city, I suppose. If they were, I think half the population would be half-tanuki by now..."
rows.translation:
“我的游骑兵和我跟北边不远处的狸猫一家发生过几次小摩擦，”达莉莎尴尬地提起。“虽然我们早就知道常青女士一家，呃，可以说一直都知道，但我从没这么近距离地接触过她们。也许只是心理作用，可那个女巫和她的女儿们总让人觉得有些诡异。至少那些毛茸茸的是这样。年幼的女孩们眼神空洞，就像脑子里根本没人一样，而她们的母亲则浑身乱颤地施展着足以令埃斯特洛伦大法师嫉妒的魔法。至少还有几个看起来正常的，也就是那些混血儿，可是……”
    
    “可是？”
    
    她叹了口气。“我不喜欢胡乱猜测，[pc.mf

rows.original:
"Karithea is certainly a unique addition," Daliza muses. "I remember hearing about the Temple of Terrestrial Fire growing up, and I'd even scouted the place out once or twice, but I never ventured inside. It seemed sacrilegious. It would seem I was right to avoid it; Karithea seems like a powerful guardian indeed."
    
    "Have you two been getting along?"
    
    "Oh, of course. I love dogs." Your bailiff smirks. "Years of training on Narcie and her siblings have left me well prepared to completely disable an aggressive hell-beast like her in one fell swoop, you know."
    
    You lift a brow, until Daliza [pc.hasEmoteEars
        |reaches over and gives you a vigorous scritching all over your ears. The sudden onrush of sensation leaves your eyes rolling back, and legs twitching. Oh, gods, that feels good.
        |mimics scratching a wolf between the ears.
    ] "See? No matter how fierce the hound, she can't stand up to my secret weapon."
    
    [kari.isMom
        |"Besides," she adds, reaching down and scooping up your [kari.numKids 2
            |eldest 
        ]hell-pup up as the little wolflet trundles past with a fresh-caught river fish in her mouth. "It's nice to have puppies around. And this two-legged breed of yours is perhaps the cutest I've ever seen." 
        
        Dal wiggles the pup's nose and pets her ears. You smile, doing the same, until Daliza's warg trots over and lets her mistress plant your pup on her back. "Go see Kari, Narcie."
        
        "Woof!"
        
        The two of them bolt away towards the courtyard.
    ]
    
    Daliza plants her hands on her hips. "I'm glad to have [kari.fucked
        |your mate
        |the hellhound
    ] on our side. She's well behaved for a wildling and surprisingly conversational. We've had some lovely conversations about brushcraft, hunting techniques... even religion. Despite appearances, I think the she-wolf's got quite the sharp mind. Talented with magic, too. A good ally to have in these dark days."
rows.translation:
“卡莉西娅确实是一位独特的新成员，”达莉莎沉思道。“我小时候就听说过大地之火神殿，甚至还侦察过那里一两次，却从未踏入其中。那似乎是种亵渎。看来我避开它是正确的；卡莉西娅的确是一位强大的守护者。”
    
    “你们相处得还好吗？”
    
    “哦，当然。我喜欢狗。”你的执法官坏笑起来。“你知道，多年来训练纳西与她的兄弟姐妹，让我做好了充分准备，只消一招就能彻底制服她这种凶悍的地狱猛兽。”
    
    你扬起眉毛，达莉莎随即[pc.hasEmoteEars
        |伸手用力挠遍你的双耳。突如其来的强烈快感令你双眼上翻，双腿抽动。哦，诸神在上，实在太舒服了。
        |模仿起挠狼耳朵中间的动作。
    ]“看见了吧？无论猎犬多么凶猛，都招架不住我的秘密武器。”
    
    [kari.isMom
        |“而且，”她一边补充，一边弯腰抱起你的[kari.numKids 2
            |长女
        ]地狱犬幼崽；小狼崽嘴里叼着刚抓来的河鱼，正摇摇晃晃地经过。“有小狗在身边真不错。而你这种两条腿的品种，也许是我见过最可爱的。” 
        
        达尔揉动幼崽的鼻头，抚摸她的双耳。你笑着也照做起来，直到达莉莎的座狼小跑过来，让女主人把你的幼崽放到她背上。“带她去见卡莉吧，纳西。”
        
        “汪！”
        
        她们俩飞奔着冲向庭院。
    ]
    
    达莉莎双手叉腰。“我很高兴有[kari.fucked
        |你的伴侣
        |那头地狱犬
    ]站在我们这边。作为野生种，她十分守规矩，而且意外地健谈。我们愉快地聊过丛林技艺、狩猎技巧……甚至还有宗教。别看她外表那样，我觉得这头母狼头脑相当敏锐，魔法天赋也很出色。在这段黑暗的日子里，她会是位好盟友。”

rows.original:
"Say, where's Narcie?" you ask, glancing around the hall. "I don't see her much."

    Daliza nods. "As is proper. She's a war-warg, the biggest in the realm. A castle is no place for a beast her size."
    
    She puts two fingers to her rose-painted lips and gives a sharp whistle. A moment passes, then another... and then the front door of the keep is bashed open by a wolf the size of a warhorse barreling towards the bailiff. Narcie skids to a halt, overshooting her mistress and loping back around with her tongue out, panting and wagging her tail. 
    
    "Good girl!" Daliza says, rubbing her hound's snout in both hands. "Say hello to the [pc.mf
        |baron
        |baroness
    ]."
    
    The huge wolf turns to you and, slow and wary, extends a paw. Once Dal gives you a slight nod, you reach out and shake the huge mitt, tensing when you feel her finger-length claws wrapping around your hand. Despite your first proper meeting, the she-wolf's gentle as can be, just resting her paw in your grip and panting until you release her. 
    
    "Queen Alissa gave me Narcie when she was just a pup," Dal mentions, continuing to pat the hound. "Child of her own beast. Her mother passed just a year or so before you arrived. Now my Narcie is the largest of the northern wargs. Aren't you?"
    
    Narcie barks in agreement. 
    
    "Largest and fiercest!"
    
    Another bark. Her tail wags faster.
    
    "Largest, fiercest, and most loyal of them all."
    
    Narcie throws her head back and howls. Daliza lets herself laugh, leaning in and giving the she-wolf a full-on hug. "That's my girl. Just a sweetheart when she's not working. But don't let that fool you: she's brought in more criminals and raiders than most of my rangers. Your lands are safe under her watch, aren't they?"
    
    "I feel safer already."
rows.translation:
“话说，纳西去哪儿了？”你环顾大厅问道。“我不怎么见到她。”

    达莉莎点了点头。“本该如此。她是战争座狼，也是国内体型最大的一头。城堡不适合她这种体型的猛兽。”
    
    她将两根手指放到涂着玫瑰色唇彩的双唇间，吹响一声尖锐的口哨。片刻过去，又过了片刻……随后，一头战马大小的巨狼撞开主堡前门，朝执法官疾冲而来。纳西刹车时滑了出去，冲过了女主人，又吐着舌头绕回来，气喘吁吁地摇着尾巴。 
    
    “好姑娘！”达莉莎双手揉搓猎犬的口鼻，说道。“向[pc.mf
        |男爵
        |女男爵
    ]问好。”
    
    巨狼转向你，缓慢而警惕地伸出一只前爪。达尔微微点头后，你便伸手握住那只巨大的爪掌；感觉她足有手指长的利爪包住你的手，你顿时浑身紧绷。尽管这是你们第一次正式见面，母狼却温柔至极，只是把爪子搁在你掌中，喘着气等你松开。 
    
    “纳西还只是幼崽时，艾莉莎女王便把她送给了我，”达尔一边继续抚摸猎犬，一边说道。“她是女王座狼的孩子。她母亲在你抵达前大约一年去世了。现在，我的纳西是北方座狼中体型最大的。对吧？”
    
    纳西汪了一声表示赞同。 
    
    “最大，也最凶猛！”
    
    她又叫一声，尾巴摇得更快了。
    
    “最大、最凶猛，也是它们当中最忠诚的。”
    
    纳西仰头长嚎。达莉莎忍不住笑起来，倾身紧紧抱住母狼。“这才是我的好姑娘。不工作的时候，她就是个小甜心。不过，可别被这一面骗了：她抓获的罪犯与劫掠者，比我的大多数巡林者都多。你的领地在她的看守下很安全，对吧？”
    
    “我已经觉得安全多了。”

rows.original:
"Want to pet her?"

        "Absolutely."
        
        Dal whispers something soothing in boer'alvar while you get closer, reaching out to Narcie. The war-warg doesn't flinch as you plant your hands on her silky-soft fur, starting to scratch around the ears. You can't quite get her leg going, but the hound sits there and soaks up as much attention as you're willing to lavish on her — and insists on a little more after that, pawing at your hand when you're ready to stop until you get brow-beaten into a few extra tummy pats. 
        
        "She's starting to like you," Daliza says.
        
        [daliza.fucked
            |"Is she the only one?"
        
            The bailiff steps in and gives you a quick kiss. "Hardly."
            |"I'd rather her be on my side, yeah." 
        
            Daliza chuckles. "Don't worry. Narcie is on my side, always, and I am on yours."
        ]
        
        The bailiff barks a couple quick commands in her native tongue, and the huge wolf stalks back out the door whence she came. No luck on her closing the door behind her, though. Daliza sighs and marches off to do so, leaving you standing over a sizable puddle of wolf-slobber on your carpets.

You can't quite get her leg going, but the hound sits there and soaks up as much attention as you're willing to lavish on her — and insists on a little more after that, pawing at your hand when you're ready to stop until you get brow-beaten into a few extra tummy pats. 
        
        "She's starting to like you," Daliza says.
        
        [daliza.fucked
            |"Is she the only one?"
        
            The bailiff steps in and gives you a quick kiss. "Hardly."
            |"I'd rather her be on my side, yeah." 
        
            Daliza chuckles. "Don't worry. Narcie is on my side, always, and I am on yours."
        ]
        
        The bailiff barks a couple quick commands in her native tongue, and the huge wolf stalks back out the door whence she came. No luck on her closing the door behind her, though. Daliza sighs and marches off to do so, leaving you standing over a sizable puddle of wolf-slobber on your carpets.'

rows.original:
"Mmm, that looks too good to pass up. Let me get in on that," you say, stepping a little closer to your bailiff. 

        "Sure, go ahead. She won't bite."
        
        "No," you say. "I meant me. Pet me."
        
        Daliza blinks. "What?"
        
        "What?"
        
        The bailiff sighs, shaking her head. "[pc.isCanine
            |This is... are you sure? Aha... okay, okay. Just 
            |You're so strange. Very well, 
        ]present your head."
        
        You bite a lip and lean in, [pc.hasEmoteEars
            |ears twitching in anticipation and 
        ]giving Narcie an affectionate pat as you go. Daliza glances around as if to make sure nobody's watching before planting both of her cool, blue hands on to the top of your head. You suck in a sharp breath as she starts to slowly stroke your [pc.hair], rubbing the backs of your [pc.ears] with her thumbs and gently scratching your scalp with her nails. Her hands are every bit as strong as you remember, firm but affectionate, thoroughly petting every inch from your brow to your neck. 
        
        "Oh gods yeah," you murmur, shivering. "That's the stuff."
        
        "I'm glad... because Narcie's getting jealous," Daliza says, lifting one hand from you — or rather, having it lifted by a snout — and onto Narcie's head. The warrior-elf sighs as she's trapped between you and her war-warg, scratching both of you behind the ear for a good long minute. 
        
        When she finally can't take any more, Dal gives you both one parting pat on the cheek and folds her hands behind her back where Narcie can't get at them again. The big wolf snorts and lopes off of its own accord, heading back out into the courtyard whence it came. 
        
        "You're a pervert," Daliza mentions casually, stepping in and giving you a smooch on the cheek. You can practically feel her lipstick clinging to you. "But a cute pervert."
        
        You just grin.
rows.translation:
嗯，这个看起来太诱人了，绝对不能错过。让我也参与进来吧，”你说着，朝那位女仆走了几步。

        “当然，请便。她不会咬人的。”
        
        “不，”你说，“我是说让我摸摸你。”
        
        达莉莎眨了眨眼：“什么？”
        
        “什么？”
        
        女仆叹了口气，摇了摇头：“你到底想说什么[pc.isCanine
            |这……你确定吗？啊哈……好吧，好吧。就这样吧。 
            |你真奇怪。好吧， 
        ]把头伸出来。”
        
        你咬住嘴唇，身体向前倾了倾。 [pc.hasEmoteEars
            |耳朵因为期待而微微抽动…… 
        ]一边走，一边亲切地拍了拍纳西的肩膀。达莉莎环顾四周，确认没有人在看，然后把她那双冰凉的蓝手放在你的头上。当她开始轻轻抚摸你的头时，你不由得倒吸了一口凉气[pc.hair]，揉搓着你的后背[pc.ears]她用拇指轻轻挠你的头皮，指甲也轻轻划过你的头皮。她的手，依然如你记忆中那样有力——结实而充满关爱，从你的额头到脖子，每一寸肌肤都得到了她细致的抚摸。
        
        “哦，天啊……”你颤抖着低声说道。真是太棒了。”
        
        “我很高兴……因为纳西会吃醋的。”达莉莎说着，将一只手从你身上拿开——实际上，是让一只狼鼻将她的手拉开了——然后放在纳西的头上。这位战士精灵叹了口气，因为她被你们俩夹在中间，只好用爪子抓你们的耳朵，抓了好一会儿。 
        
        当她再也无法忍受时，达尔轻轻拍了拍他们两人的脸颊，然后把双手背在身后，这样纳西就再抓不到它们了。那只大狼哼了一声，自己走开了，重新回到了它来的那个院子里。 
        
        你是个变态，”达莉莎漫不经心地说道，走过来亲了你的脸颊一下。你能感觉到她的口红粘在了你的脸上。“不过是个可爱的变态罢了。”
        
        你只是笑了笑。

rows.original:
You heft the crate of weapons down in front of your loyal bailiff. "I found these in the Undermountain. I think they belong to you."

    Daliza peers down at the crate, brow furrowing. "The crest of Dracia. [var0
        |Yes, you mentioned you'd found a shipment of weapons from my homeland. It pains me to see our forges turned to the enemy's purpose, but I am glad you deprived the demons of these at least. I can put them to good use with my soldiers, yes.
        |Where did you get these? The deeplands of Khor'minos?"
    
        You nod. "Being smuggled in by demons."
        
        "Fuck." Daliza's knuckles whiten around the grip of her kitsune-forged sword. "To think I'm using a bartered blade while our enemies wield Dracian bronze. Disgusting. Thank you for recovering these, m'[pc.mf|lord|lady]. I will disseminate them to our soldiers at once. And you should bring word of this discovery to the court. The Winter City lost Dracia more than two centuries ago; these were not made by boreal elf hands.
    ]"
    
    Daliza's crimson lips tighten as she picks up one of the curved blades, holding it to the light. "A fine weapon despite its corrupted craftsmanship. It's hard to believe that a demon could make such a thing. I will make sure these are put to good use, [pc.name]."
    
    "Good."
rows.translation:
你把沉重的武器箱放到忠诚的执事面前。“我在山腹深域找到了这些。我想，它们属于你。”

    达莉莎低头打量箱子，皱起眉头。“达拉西亚的纹章。[var0
        |对，你提过自己找到了一批来自我故乡的武器。看到我们的锻炉被用于敌人的目的，令我十分痛苦；但至少你从恶魔手中夺走了这些，我很庆幸。我和士兵们能让它们派上用场，没错。
        |你从哪里弄到这些的？科尔米诺斯的深地？”
    
        你点点头。“恶魔正把它们偷运进来。”
        
        “操。”达莉莎握紧狐妖锻造的剑，指节因用力而发白。“一想到我用的是交易得来的剑，敌人却挥舞着达拉西亚青铜，真令人作呕。感谢你找回这些，[pc.mf|大人|女士]。我会立刻把它们分发给士兵。你也该把这项发现禀报宫廷。冬城在两个多世纪前就失去了达拉西亚；这些绝非极北精灵之手打造。
    ]”
    
    达莉莎拿起一把弯刀，对着光线观察，绯红的嘴唇紧紧抿起。“尽管工艺遭到腐化，这仍是一件好武器。很难相信恶魔竟能制造出这样的东西。我会确保它们物尽其用，[pc.name]。”
    
    “很好。”

rows.original: You take a casual step closer, ready to ask the icy bailiff if she's free, when you feel something hot and heavy heft onto your shoulder, accompanied by hot breath down your neck. Your eyes slowly turn to meet the muzzle of a tremendous war-wolf slobbering on you, lips curled up in a snarl. "Eeeeeasy girl," Daliza says, trying not to smirk. "We're just talking, Narcie." The warg huffs, breathing hard. It doesn't move. "Sorry, [pc.mf |Baron |Baroness ]," Daliza says, closing the distance between you and hefting her beast's snout off you. She gives its nose a two-handed rub down, letting you soak in just how immense these northern wargs really are. It's not hard to imagine the bailiff riding this beast to war. "She's protective. Doesn't like people getting too close uninvited." [pc.dcb |"Train your mutt better," you grumble, flicking drool off your [pc.armor]. |"Sorry," you say, trying not to stare at Narcie's enormous fangs. Yeah, protective. |"Awww, it's okay! She's a precious bean, yes she is!" What a good doggy, protecting its mommy! ] "Hmm. Good girl," Daliza says, scratching the horse-sized wolf behind the ear. It finally loosens up, sitting back and flicking its tail across the stones, but its sharp eyes never leave you. "So, what was it you wanted to say, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]?" Glancing between Daliza and Narcie, you say "I was about to ask if you had some free time." "If Narcie's back from her patrol, that means I'm about ready to call it a day. Something you need before I retire?" [pc.isBimbo |"Retire? Oh no, already? Then we deeeeefinitely gotta hurry up and go on a date and then bone before you leave forever and ever!" Daliza stifles a laugh. "I meant retire to my chambers for the [dayNight |day |night ], m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]." "... Oh!" You smile sweetly. "So, wanna go hang out? We should be friends!" |"No, but I have something I want after you're off-duty," you say. Daliza arches a brow. "Oh? A personal matter, then. What can I do for you, [pc.name]?" Actually using your name, wow. Guess she's off-duty now after all. [pc.isDK |But you're thinking more about what this rock-hard warrioress could do to you. ] You flash the elven woman a smile and say, "I was just thinking we should get to know each other better." ] "That right?" Daliza says. "You don't find it inappropriate to fraternize with your subordinates? Hmm, alright, [pc.name]." Daliza unbuckles her swordbelt and hangs it off Narcie's neck, giving the warg a slap on the flank. "Go to bed, girl. [pc.name] [pc.isDK |isn't as bad as [pc.heShe] lets on |is safe enough ]." Narcie gives you a last, wary look before loping off towards the bailiff's chambers. For her part, Daliza straightens up and folds her arms behind her back, gesturing to the little traveler's tavern that's been set up in the keep. "A drink, [pc.mf |baron |baroness ]?" That sounds like a good place to start.
rows.translation: 你随意地走近一步，正准备询问那个冷冰冰的执事她是否自由了，突然感到有什么热乎乎的东西压在了你的肩膀上，同时还有热气喷在你的脖子上。你缓缓转过头，看到了那只巨大的战狼的嘴部，它的嘴唇正扭曲着，露出凶狠的表情。 “别紧张，姑娘，”达莉莎努力忍住笑说道，“我们只是在聊天而已，纳西。” 那只战狼喘着粗气，一动不动。 “对不起[pc.mf |男爵 |女男爵 ]达莉莎说着，走到了你跟前，把那头巨兽的鼻子从你身上拿开。她用双手仔细地擦拭着它的鼻子，让你真切地感受到这些北方狼人到底有多庞大。不难想象，那个执法官一定是骑着这种巨兽去打仗的。“她很护着这头兽，不喜欢有人未经邀请就靠得太近。 [pc.dcb |把你的杂种狗训练得更好些吧，”你抱怨着，一边把它嘴边流出的口水弹掉。 [pc.armor]。 |对不起，”你说道，努力不去盯着纳西那巨大的獠牙看。嗯，这是出于保护自己的本能吧。 |哇，没关系！她可是非常珍贵的宝贝，确实是的！” 多乖的狗狗啊，竟然会保护自己的妈妈！ ] 嗯，好姑娘。”达莉莎一边说，一边挠着那只马大小的狼的耳朵。它终于放松了下来，向后一靠，尾巴在石头上扫来扫去，但它那锐利的目光始终没有离开你。“那么，你本来想说什么呢？[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]你将目光在达莉莎和纳西之间转了转，然后说道：“我正想问你们是否有空闲时间。” “如果纳西完成了她的巡逻任务，那就意味着我也差不多该结束一天的工作了。在你我离开之前，还有什么事需要我帮忙的吗？ [pc.isBimbo |退休？哦不，已经到这个地步了？那我们绝对得赶紧去约会，然后尽情享受一番，免得你一去不复返了！” 达莉莎强忍住笑意，说道：“我是说，回我的房间去[dayNight |天 |夜晚 ]，嗯[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]……哦！”你甜美地笑了，“那么，想一起出去玩吗？我们应该成为朋友吧！ |不，但我有件事想要告诉你。之后你现在下班了吧，”你说。 达莉莎挑了挑眉毛：“哦？那应该是私人事务吧。我能为你做些什么呢？ [pc.name]居然真的用了你的名字，哇。看来她现在应该已经下班了吧。 [pc.isDK |但你更在意的是，这位坚如磐石的女战士究竟能对你做些什么。 ]你向那位精灵女子露出了微笑，说道：“我在想，我们应该多了解一些关于对方的事情。 ] 是吗？”达莉莎说道，“你不觉得和下属关系太亲密有些不合适吗？嗯，好吧[pc.name]达莉莎解开剑带，把它挂在纳西的脖子上，然后轻拍了一下那头战狼的侧腹：“去睡觉吧，姑娘。 [pc.name] [pc.isDK |并没有那么糟糕[pc.heShe]泄露了秘密 |足够安全了 ]纳西在最后警惕地看了你一眼，然后便朝执达官的办公室走去。而达莉莎则挺直身子，双臂交叉在背后，指向城堡里搭建起来的小旅店，说道：“去喝一杯吧。 [pc.mf |男爵 |女男爵 ]听起来这确实是个不错的起点。

rows.original: A couple of hours later... "Another, please, Rumie," Daliza says, tapping her stein. Daliza's slowly relaxed her rigid posture over the course of a half-dozen tankards. Her icy blue cheeks are getting well and truly flushed, and that neat bun is starting to fall apart with how much her ears are wiggling. You've been regaling her with the stories of your adventure [pc.isChamp |— sans the worst of the details, anyway — |, sparing none of the lurid details, ] and she's been urging more and more of them from you with every round. Perhaps she thought you'd just fallen off a turnip cart and come to save the Winter City out of nowhere! "I think yoooou've had enough, bailiff," Rumie giggles, taking the cup. "You're too heavy for me to have to carry to your room!" Daliza scowls at the bee-girl and huffs. "I am fit to fight an army all by myself. Give that back or I'll come over this and refill it myself. From the taps." "Oh nooooo!" Rumie giggles, rolling her black eyes. "Big mean elfy's gonna come over and bully me! Hope she knows how to fly!" You set a hand on Dal's shoulder when she starts to rise, pushing her back in her chair. She goes down with a grunt of frustration, ears wobbling this way and that. "Hmph! You get off with a warning this time, bumble-butt," she drawls, swaying slightly. "Ah, perhaps I have... overindulged... a bit. Forgive me, [pc.name], I haven't taken an [dayNight |afternoon |evening ] off in... since the expedition. It's been... it's been nice, to relax a bit." [pc.isBimbo |"To make a frieeeeeend?" you pry, fluttering your lashes. "Mmm! To make a friend," she nods. |"Same here," you tell her. "I'm glad we're taking the time together." "Mmm! To new friends," Daliza says, making to grab a tankard that's no longer there. "I— damn it, Rumie!" You grin. "To new friends." ] Daliza runs a hand through her hair, finally destroying what's left of her bun and letting her crimson locks fall, all the way down to her waist. Why, she really looks the part of a noblewoman when she shows off that regal mane. She chuckles and flashes you a quite genuine smile. Between her painted lips and flowing hair, you realize Dal would cut quite the warm figure were she anything but a boreal elf.         You try not to roll your eyes at her insistence on decorum as you turn to leave — and just about jump out of your skin when she pinches your ass as you do so. A glance over your shoulder shows her at full parade rest just as you found her, though, completely nonplussed save for her still-red-tinged cheeks.
    ]

rows.original: "Aaaaah! Please, let me go! I swear it won't ever happen again!" A cry of horror and alarm has you reaching for your [pc.weapon], heart leaping into your throat. The source of their terror becomes clear in the massive form of Daliza's monstrous wolf Narcie, who appears to be wielding the small, screaming man in her teeth. Her head whips around left, and whips around right, tearing his clothing. The captured man goes abruptly silent, passing out after getting completely rattled. The wolf whines like a puppy, before padding up to you and dumping the man at your feet. "U-uuh..." You turn the man over and check him for injuries, but there's nothing but a few bruises. One of Daliza's guards walks up, stifling laugh. "She caught a thief! Go on, reward her!" "Reward?" At the word reward, the huge wolf puts her paws up and sits heavily on her haunches. She gives you another low, plaintive whine before you approach, abruptly springing to her feet and rolling over onto her back with a heavy 'whumph' while the guard drags away the thief. "Who's a good girl?" The wolf barks — or more growls, menacingly — but her tongue flops out and she wiggles against the ground, tail flicking from side-to-side. Well, if this is a ploy to steal your hands, it's a damned good one. You drop to your knees and sink your hands into her fur, scratching and rubbing at the oversized borker until she's tail-wagging and wriggling madly like a giant baby. "Yes! You're a good girl! Yes you are, who's the bestest pupper? Catching all those big mean thieves?!" [pc.dcb |The guard appears surprised to see a crack in your stoicism, and you wave them off. "Oi, fuck off, I'm busy petting pups." "Yes [pc.mf |sir! |ma'am! ]" |This must not be a new sight, judging by the familiar smile on the guard's face. You shoo them off; there is important pupper-petting to be done. |Your whole body is alive with the joy of petting an enormous toothy doggo, and this only delights Narcie more. ] She rolls onto her front again and gives you a big slurping lick across the neck and face, panting and giving you the fanged, growling equivalent of a woof until you're pinching and rubbing her ears. "Good girl."
rows.translation: “啊啊啊！求你放我走！我发誓再也不会犯了！” 惊恐的尖叫令你伸手去抓[pc.weapon]，心脏一下提到嗓子眼。 恐惧的源头很快便显而易见：达莉莎那头巨狼纳西的庞大身影出现了，牙齿间还叼着那个尖叫不止的小个子男人。她将脑袋向左、向右猛烈甩动，扯烂他的衣服。被捕的男人让她彻底晃散了架，突然安静下来，昏死过去。 巨狼像小狗般呜咽一声，随后踱到你面前，把男人扔在你脚边。“呃……”你将男人翻过来检查伤势，却只发现了几处瘀伤。 达莉莎的一名卫兵走来，强忍笑意。“她抓住了一个小偷！快，奖励她！” “奖励？” 一听见“奖励”，巨狼就抬起前爪，沉沉坐在后腿上。你走近时，她又发出低沉而哀怨的呜咽；随后，她猛地起身，以沉重的‘砰’一声仰面翻倒，而卫兵则把小偷拖走。“谁是好姑娘？” 巨狼叫了一声——更像是充满威胁的低吼——可舌头却耷拉在外，身体贴着地面扭动，尾巴左右扫个不停。好吧，如果这是诱骗你献上双手的计谋，那可真他妈高明。 你跪倒在地，双手埋进她的毛发，用力抓挠揉搓这头超大号狗狗，直到她像个巨婴般疯狂摇尾扭动。“对！你是好姑娘！没错，谁是最最棒的小狗？把那些又大又坏的贼全抓住了？！” [pc.dcb |卫兵看到你冷峻的外表露出裂缝，显得颇为惊讶；你挥手赶开他们。“喂，滚远点，老子正忙着撸狗。” “遵命，[pc.mf |先生！ |女士！ ]” |看卫兵脸上熟悉的笑容，这大概不是新鲜场面。你把他们赶走；眼下还有重要的撸狗工作要做。 |抚摸这头长满利齿的巨型狗狗，令你全身都因喜悦而活跃起来，这也让纳西更加开心。 ] 她再次翻回正面，伸出大舌头，把你的脖颈与脸庞舔得湿漉漉的；她喘着气，用獠牙间的低吼发出相当于“汪”的声音，直到你捏住她的双耳揉搓起来。“好姑娘。”

rows.original: "M'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]," Daliza says as you come her way, inclining her head to you. "Have a moment to talk?" "Of course," you tell her. That's why you were coming over anyway. A hint of a smile plays across Dal's red lips before she [daliza.fucked |closes the distance, grabs you by the collar, and kisses you on the lips |takes that nod of her head and turns it into a deep bow ]. "From the bottom of my heart, thank you. Without your efforts, I may never have seen my family's homeland with my own eyes, much less reclaimed it for House var Dracia. I may already be sworn to your banners, but if there is any way to repay you, you need but ask it." You put a hand on Dal's shoulder and give it a squeeze. [daliza.fucked |Her hand comes to rest on yours, and even in the public space of the great hall, for once Daliza allows herself to remain passionately close to you, chest to chest. |Her ears flick up and down, and color creeps onto her cheeks. ] "I mean it. Thank you, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]." "So, what are your plans now, jarlessa?" you ask her. "You're not planning on leaving me for your island, are you?" She shakes her head. "Not any time soon. There's a war to be fought, and Dracians never back down when they are called to arms. Besides, there are hardly enough people to fill the Winter City itself; I'm liable to be sat there alone on my hereditary rubble if I went back now. In a few years, perhaps, I will put together another expedition to repair the keep and resettle the lands. I may even invite some southerners, if Queen Etheryn keeps to her intentions of revitalizing trade. I hear Sartaani is overflowing with people these days — our wyld'alvar cousins, especially. But that is all a concern for another time, a more peaceful time. Until then, I am more focused than ever on seeing our lands through this crisis." [flags.RQ2_DBURROW 3 |"Speaking of your focus, Dal, how're you feeling? After we made it to the dragonbarrow, I was starting to think you'd lose it completely." "Ah, hah, yes," Dal dissembles, rubbing the back of her neck. "I don't know what came over me. I must have been just... overwhelmed, by the history bearing down on me down there. Like I could hear my ancestor's voice in the deepest recesses of my mind. Indistinct and indecipherable, but so... so potent it was almost, well, overwhelming." "Voice? As in, just one?" She nods, slowly. "One. A woman's. Some trick of the mind, I'm sure, or perhaps a lingering specter awoken by a descendant's presence. I don't know. What matters is that I was recovered by the time we reboarded the Vigil and have had no repeats of the... the sensation. You've nothing to worry about, [pc.name]." "Just... [pc.dcb |don't let it interfere with your duties, Lady Daliza," you command. She straightens. "Of course not, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. As I said, it's in the past now." |let me know if you have another incident. I'm worried about you after that." Her lips twitch, ever so slightly. "Understood, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. I will, you have my word." |take care of yourself, Dal-Dal," you pout. "That was scary, back on the island!" Her lips twitch, ever so slightly. "My apologies for worrying you, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. I'll let you know if there are any aftereffects, you have my word." ] That'll have to do, for now. ]
rows.translation: M[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]达莉莎说道，当你朝她走过来时，她微微倾下了头。“有时间聊聊吗？” “当然，”你回答道。你本来就是为此而来的。 达莉莎红润的嘴唇上浮现出一丝微笑，然后[daliza.fucked |拉近距离，抓住你的衣领，然后亲吻你的嘴唇 |看到她点了点头，便将其理解为一个深深的鞠躬。 ]发自内心地，我想对你说谢谢。如果没有你们的努力，我可能永远无法亲眼看到家人的故乡，更不可能为瓦拉·德雷西亚家族重新夺回这片土地。虽然我已经宣誓效忠于你们的旗帜，但如果有什么方式可以报答你们，你们尽管开口。” 你把手放在达尔的肩上，轻轻拍了拍他。 [daliza.fucked |她的手轻轻搭在了你的手上，即便是在这个宽敞的大厅里，这一次，达莉莎也允许自己如此亲密地与你站在一起，胸贴着胸。 |她的耳朵微微动了一下，脸颊上也浮现出了红晕。 ]我是认真的。谢谢你，我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]那么，你现在有什么打算呢，贾勒萨？”你问她，“你不会为了你的岛屿而离开我吧？” 她摇了摇头。“短期内不会。现在还有战争要打，而当德雷西亚人被召唤去战斗时，他们从不会退缩。此外，目前根本没有足够的人手来重建这座冬城；如果我现在回去，很可能会独自坐在那些废墟中。也许几年后，我会再次组织一支探险队，来修复这座城堡并重新开垦那些土地。如果伊瑟琳女王真的决心振兴贸易，我甚至可以考虑邀请一些南方人来。听说这些天萨塔尼城的人口变得非常多，尤其是我们的wild'alvar表亲们。不过，这些事情都可以等到以后、在一个更加和平的时期再讨论吧。在此之前，我比以往任何时候都更加专注于帮助我们的国家度过这场危机。 [flags.RQ2_DBURROW 3 |说到你的状态，达尔，你感觉怎么样？当我们来到龙墓之后，我还有点担心你会彻底崩溃呢。” “啊，哈哈，是啊，”达尔笑着回答，一边揉着她的后颈。“我也不知道自己当时是怎么了。我当时肯定只是……被那些压在我身上的历史所震撼了。就好像我能听到自己祖先的声音，在我心灵的深处回荡。那些声音模糊不清，难以辨认，但却如此强烈，几乎让我无法承受。声音？就是只有一个声音吗？” 她缓缓点了点头。“一个。女性的声音。我敢肯定，这一定是某种心理作用的结果，或者也许是一个后裔的出现唤醒了某个萦绕不去的幽灵。我也不清楚。重要的是，在我们重新登机的时候，我已经恢复了意识。守望者而且那种感觉再也没有出现过。你完全不需要担心。 [pc.name]只是…… [pc.dcb |不要让这件事影响到你的职责，达莉莎女士，”你命令道。 她立刻挺直了身子：“当然不会，大人。[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]正如我所说，那些事情都已经成为过去了。 |如果再发生什么事情，请一定要告诉我。在那件事之后，我真的很担心你。” 她的嘴唇微微颤动了一下。“明白了，先生。[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]我一定会的，我向你保证。 |照顾好自己，达尔-达尔，”你撅着嘴说，“在岛上发生的那些事真是太可怕了！” 她的嘴唇微微一颤：“真抱歉让你担心了，我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]如果出现任何后遗症，我一定会告诉你的，我向你保证。 ] 暂时就这样吧。 ]

rows.original: "Dal, what would you say to having a conversation with a dragon?" The bailiff blinks at you. "You don't really have to ask, do you? It'd be a dream come true, especially after what we've learned. But-" You sling Ashe off your belt with a flourish, smirking to yourself as a dizzy "Wheee!" echoes in your mind. When you present the mace to Dal, Ashe has just enough time to say, "This promises to be an interesting talk!" before Daliza takes her spirit's housing. "What does an ornamental mace have— gah! It talks! She talks, my apologies miss... Ashelander? That name does sound familiar, yes. Truly, you were...? Goddess, one of you yet lives! Er, after a fashion, I suppose. I too mourn for your kin, but to hear a dragon's words at all is a miracle!" So this is what it's like when for everyone else when you and Ashe have a chat... Daliza though shows no sign of realizing you can only hear her side of things, carrying on with animated excitement. "Still, my lady, it's an honor... yes, of the Skal'norria clan, that's right. You knew Senasthrelle? Truly!? Please, yes, I wish to know everything! Oh, Nareva's t— er, knowledge, yes!" You smile and leave them to it for a few minutes. You're liable to end up more confused than enlightened only hearing Dal [silly |fan-girling over |squealing in excitement ].
rows.translation: “达尔，要是能和一条龙交谈，你会怎么想？” 执事眨眨眼。“这还用问吗？尤其知道了那些事情以后，这简直是梦想成真。不过——” 你潇洒地从腰带上取下艾希，心中回荡着一声晕头转向的“呜呼！”，令你暗自发笑。你把钉头锤递给达尔时，艾希只来得及说一句“这次谈话肯定很有意思！”，达莉莎便接过了她灵魂的容器。 “一把装饰用钉头锤能有什——啊！它会说话！是她会说话，抱歉，小姐……阿什兰德？这个名字确实听起来很熟悉。您真的曾经是……？女神在上，你们竟还有一位活着！呃，我想，是以某种形式活着。我也为您的同族哀悼，但能听到龙的话语本身就是奇迹！” 原来在别人看来，你和艾希交谈时就是这副模样…… 不过达莉莎似乎完全没意识到你只能听见她这边的话，依然兴奋地滔滔不绝。“无论如何，女士，这是我的荣幸……是的，斯卡尔诺里亚氏族，没错。您认识塞纳斯特雷尔？真的！？求您了，我想知道一切！哦，娜瑞瓦的奶——呃，知识，对！” 你微笑着把几分钟留给她们。只听见达尔[silly |狂热崇拜 |兴奋尖叫 ]，你恐怕只会越来越困惑，而不是得到启迪。

rows.original:
When you come back from [dayNight
            |lunch
            |dinner
        ], Daliza's sitting on the arm of your throne, cradling the mace in her lap and smiling from ear to ear. It's all... very unlike her. All that normal aloof chill she likes to display in public's melted away to childlike adoration. You're almost surprised she's not petting Ashe like a new puppy. 
        
        "Ah, [pc.name], I'm sorry," the boreal bailiff laughs, pushing herself to her feet with a smile. "Ashe and I lost track of time, but our conversation has been... truly profound. Thank you for the opportunity."

rows.original: "About dragons..." Dal lets herself give a hint of a smile[pc.ra dragon |and strokes one of your horns ]. "My favorite subject. Each of them was a treasure beyond compare, a living demigod... and now, it seems, they're gone. It's hard to imagine that Nareva would allow her most beloved to die out like that, but you can imagine how happy I [pc.ra dragon |am to see |was to have seen ] you take on their guise. To have a spark of hope that even if the true dragons of yore really are gone, there may be some hope for something close enough to rise again in their stead. That alone is more than enough." "What do you know about them?" you ask her. [ashe.around |Ashe thrums. "Shouldn't you be asking me that?" You smile. "I'd love to hear a Dracian's take on them." ] Daliza sighs. "Nobody has seen a dragon at all in living memory, and the stories my mother told me made it clear that the last of Dracia's dragons, Senasthrelle, fell in battle when the demons first attacked the island at the onset of the Godswar. I believe we likely found her grave, under the castle. That room was so heavy with power that I could taste it. Feel it in every fiber of my being. And yet, it was nothing but a barrow... lifeless." [ashe.around |You hear the hum of your draconic mace in your mind, chewing over that statement a moment. "Senasthrelle Anferra Skal'noria: Sentinel of the Seas, the Unbreaking Frost Which Shields the North. I remember her! She was... huge. Powerful. Regal. To see Senasthrelle weave blade and spell was like watching a dance. A very deadly dance, as more than a few Belharans learned during the wars. But she loved mortals more than any of us, like you were all her beloved children. I don't believe she had any eggs of her own to nurture. When we heard that she'd died, it sent a wave of sorrow through all dragonkind. The best of us laid low by a single monster..." Daliza quirks a brow at you, seeing your attention wavering. ] "Your family was bonded to Senasthrelle's clan, right? I'm pretty sure you share some of her blood." "Distantly, but yes, I believe you're right. I was never wholly sure until we went to Dracia, but afterwards... I'm certain that I have the blood of dragons in my veins. I can't say that it's done anything for me — I still can't breathe fire after all!" "Would you want to? Viviane still has some of the crystals I used..." Dal chuckles and shakes her head. "No. Well, no. I'm quite happy to admire dragonhood. I don't need to live it. What is a dragon without mortals to worship it, anyway?" [var0 |"I would be lost without my frosty kobold," you tease, slapping Dal's ass with the flat of your tail. ] She [pc.ra dragon |licks her lips, drinking you in with her eyes. |gives you a hungry look. You can tell she's thinking about the next time you're going to dragon up for her. ] "What do you know about dragons more generally?" you ask, before Dal gets too distracted. "Well," she says, "Aside from being immortal and beautiful? Hmm. They were shapeshifters, of course; or at least, they could condense their immense bodies down into humanoid shapes. They were all hermaphrodites naturally, but there are legends and art depicting human-form dragons of all sexes. They could breathe fire, and fly, and their scales were so thick as to make them nearly immune to mortal weapons — at least, of normal size." "There are legends of dragons being felled by siege weapons that get lucky shots, and in prehistory, it appears they fought some kind of massive war against the jotuns of the north-beyond-north. Some of my rangers used to come across old bits of architecture up on the Rift, bits of castles and towers, burnt black and frozen after centuries of disuse. Gods only know what the dragons and giants could have fought over, but I am sure axes and bows of such stature could pierce even an ancient dragon's hide. They may have been beyond the care of age, but the Godswar proved their immortality wasn't foolproof." [ashe.around |You feel an uncomfortable shifting in Ashe's presence. ] You [ashe.saved |think back to watching Ashe die |have to ask ], "Are you really sure they're all gone?" She shrugs. "As I said, none have been seen in mortal memory. It is... possible that some endure, hiding among mortals using their shapeshifting. But I struggle to believe it. A dragon requires so much food to sustain itself that it must hunt in its true form at least, I should think, and that is hard to hide indefinitely." "I wish I could speak to their culture, but we know little of it for sure. The Skal'noria scions that bonded to my house lived on the islands with us — they wore little, fought and drunk hard, and adored gems and pearls as tribute, but there were so few that it's hard to say they had a culture different from our own at all. I've read some references to dragons living in the south that had some kind of kingdom up in the highest mountains, but no mortals were allowed to travel there. Assuming it existed, which I doubt... someone would have found it by now, and then you wouldn't need to ask me about dragon culture, you could read it in a book." [ashe.around |Ashe sighs. "That's the most depressing thing I've heard in days." ]
