]你披上了他们的外衣。这样人们才会抱有一丝希望：即便那些古老的真龙真的已经消失，或许还有某种与它们相似的存在能够再次出现，取代它们的位置。仅凭这一点，就已经足够了。” “你对它们了解多少？”你问她。 [ashe.around |阿什低声说道：“你不应该先问问别人吗？我是吗？” 你微笑着回答：“我很想听听德拉克尼亚人对于这些事情的看法。 ] 达莉莎叹了口气：“在人们的记忆中，根本没有人见过真正的龙。而我母亲告诉我的那些故事也明确指出，达拉西亚最后的龙——塞纳斯特雷尔，在神战爆发时，当恶魔首次袭击这座岛屿时，就已经在战斗中阵亡了。我认为我们很可能找到了它的坟墓，就在城堡的下面。那个房间里充满了强大的能量，我甚至能感受到它的存在，每一根神经都能体会到这种力量。然而，那里却只有一具毫无生气的尸骸 [ashe.around |你在脑海中回响着那把巨龙之锤发出的嗡嗡声，仔细思考着这句话。“塞纳斯特雷尔·安费拉·斯卡尔诺里亚：海洋的守护者，那守护北方、永不破碎的寒冰。我记得她！她……体型庞大得惊人。强大而威严。看着塞纳斯特蕾尔挥舞刀刃、施展法术，就像在观看一场舞蹈——一场极其致命的舞蹈。在那些战争中，不少贝拉尔人都体会到了这一点。然而，她对凡人的爱远超我们所有人，你们对她来说，就像她亲爱的孩子们一样。我不相信她自己有任何可以培育的东西。当我们听到她去世的消息时，整个龙族都陷入了悲痛之中。我们中最优秀的人，竟然也被一个普通的怪物给消灭了…… |她用充满渴望的眼神看着你，你能看出，她正在想着下一次你们能一起做什么有趣的事情。 ] 关于龙，你究竟了解些什么呢？”你在达尔分心之前问道。 “嗯，”她回答道，“除了它们是不朽的、美丽的生物之外……它们还能变形，至少可以将自己庞大的身躯变形成人类的形态。它们本质上都是雌雄同体的生物，但传说与艺术作品中确实描绘过各种性别的龙类。这些龙能够喷火、飞翔，它们的鳞片极其厚实，使得它们几乎能够免疫普通武器——至少是那些普通尺寸的武器。有传说称，某些幸运的攻击者曾用围攻武器击倒了龙；而在史前时期，它们似乎与北方极地地区的巨兽进行过大规模的战斗。我的一些游骑兵曾在裂谷地带发现过一些古老的建筑遗迹——那些被烧成焦黑的城堡和塔楼，在数个世纪无人使用之后，依然矗立在那里。只有神明才知道那些龙和巨人们究竟为了什么而争斗，但我敢肯定，那种威力的斧头和弓箭，甚至能够刺穿古老巨龙的皮甲。虽然它们似乎已经超越了时间的侵蚀，但“神战”证明了它们的永生并非绝对无懈可击。" [ashe.around |在艾希的面前，你会感到一种令人不适的异样感。 ] 你[ashe.saved |回想起来，当时看着艾希死去，那种心情真是难以形容…… |不得不询问 ]你真的确定它们都已经消失了吗？” 她耸了耸肩：“就像我说的，有生以来从来没有人见过它们的踪迹。也有可能有些还活着，它们利用变形能力隐藏在人类中间……但我觉得这种可能性很小。一条龙需要消耗大量的食物来维持生存，因此它至少必须以自己的真实形态进行捕猎，否则就无法长期隐藏下去。” “我希望能更深入地了解他们的文化，但实际上我们对它知之甚少。那些与我家建立了联系的斯卡尔诺里亚后裔，和我们一起生活在那些岛屿上——他们身材矮小，喜欢打架和饮酒作乐，还极其喜爱宝石和珍珠作为贡品。不过他们的数量实在太少了，因此很难说他们拥有与我们不同的文化。我读过一些资料，说南方有龙居住，它们在最高的山脉中建立了自己的王国，但没有任何凡人被允许前往那里。不过，如果这样的地方真的存在的话——我对此表示怀疑……现在应该已经有人发现了吧。那样的话，你们就不用来问我关于龙文化的事情了，直接去书里查阅不就行了。" [ashe.around |艾什叹了口气：“这是我这些天听到的最令人沮丧的事情了。 ]

你背对着那辆毁坏的商队继续前行，但附近传来的嘈杂声吸引了你的注意。你意识到，直到此刻，那些自然界中常见的声音竟然全都消失了——既没有昆虫翅膀振动的嗡嗡声，也没有头顶树冠上鸟儿的鸣叫声。在你的好奇心驱使下，你逐渐走到了这片原本寂静得令人不安的森林中，那噪音的唯一来源也渐渐出现在你的视线范围内。
    
    当你靠近一些时，你终于发现了声源。一群被腐蚀了的狼族围成了一个粗略的圆圈，将一位黑白相间的半狼族女性紧紧围在中间。她手持一根能从杖尖喷出神圣火焰的法杖，同时另一只手也施加了恢复性魔法，拼命试图抵挡那些攻击者。那些野性的狼族并没有注意到她的存在，它们的注意力全都集中在眼前这个被包抄的女祭司身上。尽管她身材娇小，但目前还是能够勉强应付，但这些粗野的野兽的数量是她的六倍，她被彻底压制只是时间问题而已。
    
    [party.has cait
        |又有一位女祭司需要被拯救了！”凯特惊呼道，双手紧握着她的法杖。“准备好再次上演这一幕了吗，英雄？
    ]
    
    你会介入吗？
rows.raw:
"
    Turning your back to the ruined caravan, you set off on your way but your attention is caught by the faint sound of heated activity nearby. You realize that, until now, the typical sounds of nature were eerily absent. There's neither the ambient humming of insectoid wings nor the singing of birds in the canopy above. With your curiosity getting the better of you, your path brings you closer to the sole locus of the noise within these otherwise ominously quiet woods.
    
    Drawn closer, you spot the source. Forming a crude circle along the perimeter, a pack of corrupted lupines close in around a dainty black and white-haired half-lupine woman. With quarterstaff in hand, which conjures out sacred flames out from the head of it, and restorative magic applied to herself from her other hand, she desperately attempts to fend off her assailants. The feral lupines haven't noticed your presence, their attention is otherwise occupied on the outflanked priestess before them. Despite her delicate figure, she sufficiently holds her own for now, but the brutish beasts easily outnumber her six to one. It's only a matter of time before she's overwhelmed.
    
    [party.has cait
        |"Another priestess in need of saving!" Cait gasps, clutching her hands around her staff. "Ready to put on a repeat performance, hero?"
    ]
    
    Will you intervene?"

rows.original: You don't even need to think about it. The answer is obvious. Drawing your [pc.weapon], you charge in[party.som | | with [companion1.name] | with your companions ] to the priestess's aid. It's a fight!
rows.translation: 你甚至不需要考虑这个问题。答案显而易见。只需画出它即可。 [pc.weapon]你冲了上去[party.som | | 与[companion1.name]一起 | 和你的朋友们一起 ]来帮助这位女祭司吧。 这是一场激烈的战斗！
rows.raw: " You don't even need to think about it. The answer is obvious. Drawing your [pc.weapon], you charge in[party.som | | with [companion1.name] | with your companions ] to the priestess's aid. It's a fight! "

rows.original: Jump in and help her fend off the feral beastmen.
rows.translation: 快过来帮她抵御那些野性的兽人吧。
rows.raw: "Jump in and help her fend off the feral beastmen."

rows.original:
[pc.isDK
            |There's no need for you to risk your own neck being a hero for some reckless woman. Instead you sit back and let your morbid curiosity take over.
            |It's too risky to leap in and help her. Maybe she can handle her own, and besides you have your own composition to factor. You feel yourself tense as you witness what unfolds.
        ]
rows.translation:
[pc.isDK
            |你没必要为了某个鲁莽的女人而冒生命危险去当英雄。相反，你大可以坐下来，让那种病态的好奇心驱使你行动吧。
            |贸然插手帮助她实在太危险了。也许她自己能够应付得来，而且你还得考虑自己的体质。看着事情的发展，你感到自己越来越紧张。
        ]
rows.raw:
"
        [pc.isDK
            |There's no need for you to risk your own neck being a hero for some reckless woman. Instead you sit back and let your morbid curiosity take over.
            |It's too risky to leap in and help her. Maybe she can handle her own, and besides you have your own composition to factor. You feel yourself tense as you witness what unfolds.
        ]"

rows.original: [pc.isDK|It's her fault she got into this situation, not yours.|Discretion is the better part of valor.] The chance of her becoming corrupt will greatly increase from your inaction!
rows.translation: [pc.isDK|她陷入这种境地是她的错，而不是你的错。|谨慎才是真正的勇敢。] 如果你不采取任何行动，她走上腐败道路的可能性将会大大增加！
rows.raw: "[pc.isDK|It's her fault she got into this situation, not yours.|Discretion is the better part of valor.] The chance of her becoming corrupt will greatly increase from your inaction!"

rows.original:
With your timely intervention breaking their attack and tipping the balance against them, the pack of tainted lupines scatter to the four winds. While you couldn't capture one of them, it nevertheless marks a decisive victory! Even now they're probably running off to lick their wounded pride.[pc.isDK
        | The outcome of this conflict was never in any doubt.
    ] Standing tall in aplomb, a meek feminine voice pipes up behind you.
    
    "I-ehumm."
    
    You turn to face the nigh-imperceptible, awkward voice.
    
    Wrapping her arms underneath her slight chest, your rescued priestess anxiously lowers her head like a wilted flower and drags a deep breath before lifting her head back up. Even after all this, she can hardly hold eye contact with you. "Thanks."
    
    You casually remark that it was no problem and you had a few run-ins with those crazed lupine men before. She just nods once solemnly. Without any sort of reply, the conversation is left in an uncomfortable silence. [pc.isDK
        |This awkwardness is fucking painful. It's not that hard woman, just talk!
        |Her anxiousness is palpable.
    ] [flags.ETHERYN_MET
        |It's like trying to hold a conversation with Ryn when you first met. 
    ]The fact isn't lost on her as her body tenses, sinking into herself as she scratches the sides of her arm. It's hard not to imagine that if she wasn't frozen in place, she would've likely scurried off by now. Let's start with simple questions such as introductions. Starting first, you introduce yourself to her before following up and asking the lady her name.
    
    "D-Drifa, I'm Drifa," she mutters, as if confirming it to herself.
    
    [pc.isDK
        |See, that wasn't so hard, was it?
        |Progress!
    ] That actually raises an interesting point, on account of her lupine features and name, one would infer she's from this area but you don't believe you have ever seen her in town before. Rather than just pondering to yourself, you put the question to Drifa directly.
    
    Drifa nods and relaxes her tense shoulders. "I'm from there, yes. I don't know if I can call it home, though."
    
    [party.has etheryn
        |Ryn's ears droop in silent sympathy.
    ]
    
    Why's that?
    
    She grimaces and casts her attention sidelong. "Too many people, I suppose." She shrugs. "It's like — it's like being stuck in a really small box that's very noisy. It's easier for me to hide from everyone."
    
    [pc.isDK
        |[silly
            |You don't know what you were expecting.
            |Why're you not surprised with that answer?
        ]
        |That's certainly an evocative way of putting it.
    ] Still, that leaves the matter of why you found her in the position she was in earlier.
    
    "About that," Drifa spends a few seconds formulating the right way of articulating her thoughts. "I noticed something was wrong when people were going missing and I maybe might've overheard some hunters gossiping about running into some of the missing residents in the woods, but they were... different. If something bad was happening, I couldn't just sit back and hide while others could be getting hurt. So... I just started looking around and that," she gestures with a hand to the clearing you're both in, "is how I ran into them. Or rather, I guess that's how they found me."
    
    [party.has cait
        |"Well that," Cait says, putting a reassuring hand on Drifa's slender shoulder, "makes you very brave indeed."
        
        The dog-priest gives a small nod, tucks her ears, and says, "[silly
            |Y-you too
            |T-thanks
        ]."
    ]
    
    Through your own travels and exposure to the demoness Kasyrra, you've become well-acquainted with the dark seedings of corruption, but the reminder is made starkly poignant that this is still a relatively new thing for most people. It doesn't look like this spread of corruption is going to be stopping any time soon. These fell beasts — not even demons themselves, but victims of this spread — are becoming a legitimate threat and you understand the necessity of pacifying these crazed wolfmen.
    
    "If you're looking for them too, maybe I can um... help... too?"
    
    [pc.isDK
        |Acting out in reckless indignation, without the proper strength to enforce your will, only spells disaster. Considering that you needed to intervene on her behalf proves as such. This girl's naivety nearly got her in over her head. Unlike her: you, however, do not cling blindly to the tiresome mask of moral posturing. There's no altruism in the charge of babbling children; what you do is at least honest and gets results
        |It's rather noble of her to have gone so far in risking her own neck to help, not many would've. Her willingness alone to have taken action, rather than sitting in complacency, exemplifies her altruistic heart
    ]. Nevertheless, the fact of the matter remains that you need to decide what should be done about Drifa; she's clearly eager enough to involve herself in this cause.
rows.translation:
多亏你及时出手，打破了他们的进攻，使局势转向了对他们不利的一方，那些被污染的狼群便四散逃跑了。虽然你没有抓住其中任何一只，但这无疑是一次决定性的胜利！此刻，它们恐怕正在四处逃窜，试图舔拭自己受挫的自尊心吧。[pc.isDK
        | 这场冲突的结局从一开始就毋庸置疑。
    ]你镇定自若地站在那里，突然背后传来一个温柔而略带羞涩的女声：
    
    “我、呃……”
    
    你转过身，看向这个几乎听不见、听起来有些尴尬的声音。
    
    那位被你救下的女祭司将双臂交叉在胸前，紧张地低下头，就像一朵枯萎的花朵，深吸一口气后，才重新抬起头。即便经历了这一切，她仍然很难与你进行眼神交流。只是简单地说了一句“谢谢”。
    
    你随意地表示这没什么，因为你之前也遇到过那些疯狂的狼族男子。她只是郑重地点了点头，没有再说出任何话，整个对话在一种尴尬的沉默中结束了。 [pc.isDK
        |这种尴尬的感觉真是他妈的难受。女人，其实没那么难相处，好好谈谈不就行了！
        |她的焦虑之情显而易见。
    ] [flags.ETHERYN_MET
        |这就好比在初次遇见小琳时，试图与她进行对话一样。 
    ]她显然注意到了这一点，她的身体变得僵硬，整个人都缩了进去，还不停地抓挠着自己的手臂。不难想象，如果她没有被固定在原地的话，现在早就跑开了。我们先从一些简单的问题开始吧，比如自我介绍。首先，你应该先向她介绍自己，然后再询问她的名字。
    
    “德……德莉法，我是德莉法，”她低声说道，仿佛是在确认自己的名字一样。
    
    [pc.isDK
        |看，其实并没有那么难，对吧？
        |进展顺利！
    ]这确实引出了一个有趣的问题：从她那狼一般的特征和名字来看，人们会认为她应该来自这个地区，但你却觉得自己从未在镇上见过她。你没有只是自己思考这个问题，而是直接把疑问问了出来。
    
    德莉法点了点头，放松了自己紧绷的肩膀：“我确实来自那里，不过……我不确定是否还能称它为家乡。
    
    [party.has etheryn
        |小琳的耳朵耷拉下来，仿佛在默默表达同情。
    ]
    
    为什么会这样呢？”
    
    她皱了皱眉头，然后将目光转向一旁。“大概是因为人太多了吧。”她耸了耸肩，“就好像被关在一个非常吵闹的小盒子里面一样。这样我就能更容易地躲开所有人了。
    
    [pc.isDK
        |[silly
            |你根本不知道自己原本期待的是什么。
            |听到这样的回答，你难道不应该感到惊讶吗？
        ]
        |这种表达方式确实很有感染力。
    ]不过，这就引出了一个问题：为什么你会在那个地方发现她处于那种状态。
    
    “关于这个，”德莉法花了几秒钟来组织语言，以便能够准确地表达自己的想法。“当人们开始失踪的时候，我就察觉到有些不对劲。也许我还无意中听到一些猎人闲聊，说他们在树林里遇到了那些失踪的居民………不一样。如果发生了不好的事情，我不可能坐视不理、躲起来，而让别人去受伤。所以……我就开始四处寻找，而就在你们现在所在的这个空地上，我遇到了他们。或者，我想他们就是通过这种方式找到我的吧。
    
    [party.has cait
        |真是了不起，”凯特说着，将一只安慰的手放在德莉法纤细的肩上，“你确实非常勇敢。”
        
        那只狗祭司轻轻点了点头，把耳朵贴在身体两侧，然后说道：[silly
            |你…你也是吗
            |谢谢
        ]。"
    ]
    
    通过你自己的经历以及与女恶魔卡希拉的接触，你已经深刻认识到了腐败这种暗影势力的存在，但这一事实依然提醒我们：对大多数人来说，腐败仍然是一件相对新鲜的事情。看来这种腐败现象短期内是不会得到遏制的了。这些堕落的野兽——其实他们甚至算不上真正的恶魔，只是这种腐败现象的受害者——已经构成了真正的威胁，你们也明白平息这些疯狂的狼族的必要性吧。
    
    如果你也在寻找他们的话，也许我也能……帮忙……吧？
    
    [pc.isDK
        |出于鲁莽的愤怒而采取行动，却没有足够的力量来坚持自己的意志，只会招致灾难。你之所以需要出面为她干预，恰恰证明了这一点。这个女孩的天真让她陷入了麻烦之中。与她不同，你并不会盲目地戴着那些虚伪的道德面具。照顾那些吵闹的孩子虽然没有什么功利可言，但你的行为至少是诚实的，而且确实能够取得成效。
        |她不惜冒着生命危险去帮助别人，这种行为实在非常高尚，很少有人能做到这一点。她主动采取行动，而不是坐视不理，这一事实本身就体现了她无私奉献的精神。
    ]然而，事实依然是，你必须决定该如何处理德莉法的问题；她显然非常愿意参与到这项事业中来。

rows.original:
It couldn't hurt to have an extra set of hands around; the halfbreed has proven herself a capable spellcaster and it couldn't hurt to recruit her services. The Wayfort belongs to you and it isn't that far. Having a reliable way of interacting with her would be more fruitful than having to track her down in town each time you want to discuss anything. This just leaves the matter of actually asking her. As skittish as this lady is, there's no telling if she'll just outright turn down the offer, but it doesn't hurt to ask. Despite it being her home, Drifa did say that she felt uncomfortable in town. Extending the invitation, you wait for her response.
        
        "The old fort? Are you sure?" Drifa asks.
        
        You insist it's fine. The fort is guarded and is not nearly as densely populated as Hawkethorne. Plus, it's an ideal place for her to conduct her search.
        
        She considers your proposal further before ultimately making her decision. Lifting her chin up, closing the social schism between you and her, the dog-girl finally makes eye contact with you and forms a slight smile on her face. It's a weak smile, but a smile nonetheless.
        
        "I'd like that. Thank you."
        
        Well then, at least that part's dealt with. It might take some time for her to pack up her things and settle in, but you're sure she'll be a pleasant addition to the fort [pc.isDK
            |as someone to mess with
            |and lend a helping hand in whatever way she can. After all, she has just as much stake in this as you do
        ].
rows.translation:
多一个人手总没有坏处；那个混血儿已经证明了自己是个能力不错的施法者，雇佣她的服务肯定没有坏处。荒废驿堡庄园本来就是你的，而且距离也不远。如果能够有一种可靠的方式与她联系，那么每次想要讨论事情时都不必去城里找她，这样会方便得多。现在剩下的就是真正去问她了。虽然这位女士性格有些古怪，但谁也说不准她会直接拒绝这个提议，不过问问总没有坏处。尽管那是她的家，但德莉法确实说过她在城里感到不太自在。你再次发出邀请，等待她的回复。
        
        那座古老的堡垒？你确定吗？”德莉法问道。
        
        你坚持认为那里没有问题。那座堡垒有守卫，而且人口密度远没有鹰棘镇那么高。更何况，那里对她来说进行搜索活动来说是个理想的地方。
        
        她仔细考虑了你的建议，最终做出了决定。抬起下巴，消除了你们之间的隔阂，这个狗女孩终于与你进行了眼神交流，脸上露出了淡淡的微笑。虽然那微笑很微弱，但终究还是微笑。
        
        我想要那个。谢谢。”
        
        那么，至少这部分问题已经解决了。她可能需要一些时间来收拾行李并安顿下来，但你可以肯定，她一定会成为这个团队的宝贵成员。 [pc.isDK
            |一个容易被捉弄的人
            |并且会尽她所能提供帮助。毕竟，她在这件事中所受的影响，和你是一样的
        ]。

        Well then, at least that part's dealt with. It might take some time for her to pack up her things and settle in, but you're sure she'll be a pleasant addition to the fort [pc.isDK
            |as someone to mess with
            |and lend a helping hand in whatever way she can. After all, she has just as much stake in this as you do
        ].
        "

rows.original: If only you had a place she could stay...

rows.raw: "If only you had a place she could stay..."

rows.original: Drifa seems eager enough to help in this cause, and you'd be remiss to dismiss it outright; she has just as much stake in this as you do. However, it might be for the best to not uproot her for now from Hawkethorne on account of how dangerous the area is. The important part is that you now know of her existence and that she lives somewhere in town. Once you return to Hawkethorne, she shouldn't be too hard to find, right?
rows.translation: 德里法似乎非常愿意为这项事业提供帮助，如果你直接拒绝她的帮助，那就太可惜了——她和你一样，也在这个事情中有着切身的利益。不过，考虑到这个地区环境危险，现在暂时不要把她从鹰棘镇带走或许才是最好的选择。重要的是，你现在已经知道她的存在了，而且知道她就住在镇上的某个地方。等你回到鹰棘镇后，应该不难找到她吧？

However, it might be for the best to not uproot her for now from Hawkethorne on account of how dangerous the area is. The important part is that you now know of her existence and that she lives somewhere in town. Once you return to Hawkethorne, she shouldn't be too hard to find, right?"

rows.original: Let Drifa get back to town and help with the marauding wolf-men.
rows.translation: 让德莉法回到城里，帮忙对付那些四处劫掠的狼人吧。
rows.raw: "Let Drifa get back to town and help with the marauding wolf-men."

rows.original: You have no desire to interact with Drifa nor do you wish for her to get involved in this. She's way in over her head; you can deal with this problem yourself. It may hurt for her to hear this from you, but it's the blunt truth and for her own safety: you don't need her. Her talents lie elsewhere, and that place is not with you. The half-lupine shakes her head. "N-no. I promised myself that I would get this done." She swallows hard and stubbornly stands her ground. "I can't let anyone else get hurt!" She's not going to do anything. Why does she think she can accomplish this task if she needed you to intervene in the first place? You don't need her, nor do you wish to babysit her. All she'd be is a hindrance to you. She's not as strong as she thinks she is, she's just an annoyance. In the end, you tell her to just beat it and go back home. You'll take care of it from here. The priestess visibly deflates and retreats back into her defensive shell. Lowering her stance, her hair obscures her face as she tightly holds herself. You can't see her face, but you know you've just hit more than a few nerves. "I," Drifa chokes back a hiccup as shuddering tremors run through her frame, "I see." The priestess barely finishes her sentence before she turns on her heel away from you and runs off. Then, just like that, she's gone. It's unlikely you'll ever see her again.

rows.translation: 考虑到你迄今为止的表现如此出色，而且也觉得自己已经为即将到来的挑战做好了充分的准备，那么现在就没有任何理由不立刻前往那里，解决那些狼族的威胁了。带上德莉法，你们便动身前往那个被污染的巢穴吧。
rows.raw: "\n        Considering how well you've fared thus far and feeling adequately stocked for the venture ahead, there doesn't seem to be a reason why you couldn't just go there and deal with the lupine threat here and now. Letting Drifa tag along, you depart for the corrupted den."

rows.original: Once you start, you won't be able to leave until the job is done!
rows.translation: 一旦开始，你就必须完成这项工作，否则就无法停止！
rows.raw: "Once you start, you won't be able to leave until the job is done!"

rows.original: You'd like to feel a bit more prepared before making that expedition. This isn't something either of you should be leaping blindly into. Once everything's stocked up and you're finally ready, then you can disembark on perilous adventures into the bellies of the beast. For now, you and Drifa should bide your time. Perhaps even getting to know each other better if you're to be fighting alongside each other. Telling the priestess this, she nods and takes her leave. When you're ready, you should go speak to her.
rows.translation: 在开始那次冒险之前，你肯定希望自己能做好更充分的准备。这件事绝对不是你们俩可以贸然行动的。等到所有物资都准备齐全，你们真正准备好之后，再踏入那些充满危险的领域去吧。目前，你和德莉法应该先耐心等待时机。如果你们将来要并肩作战的话，或许还可以多了解彼此一些。你把这句话告诉了女祭司，她点了点头便离开了。等你们准备好了，再去找她谈谈吧。
rows.raw:
"
        You'd like to feel a bit more prepared before making that expedition. This isn't something either of you should be leaping blindly into. Once everything's stocked up and you're finally ready, then you can disembark on perilous adventures into the bellies of the beast. For now, you and Drifa should bide your time. Perhaps even getting to know each other better if you're to be fighting alongside each other. Telling the priestess this, she nods and takes her leave. When you're ready, you should go speak to her.
        
        "

rows.original:
Slinging spells, summoning wards, and blocking with her staff, the dark-haired priestess fends off corrupted foe after another, but her struggles are in vain. The odds aren't in her favor; this is a losing battle and it's only getting worse. As she backsteps away from one wolfman, another sneaks around and flanks her. Then, just like that, the fight is over as the staggering blow is dealt. Losing her footing, she stumbles and falls to the ground. In a desperate bid to continue a fight that's already over, the dog-priestess scrambles around and tries to pick herself back up, but a firm hand from one of the men makes sure to keep her down. Following through, the feral wolfman then sits atop her and wraps his hands around the woman's delicate neck.
    
    "Ghhh," the dog-girl winces, clenching her teeth as his grip tightens. 
    
    Thrashing and bucking underneath him, she looks to her side and sees her staff, which lies at the edge of her grasp. As she reaches out, she manages to press her fingertips to it. She might be able to escape; however, this hope is snatched away from her as another lupine comes up and kicks her staff away. The pack watches as hope drains from her features and cackles as her only means of escape is cut off from her.
    
    "P-please!" she whimpers to the feral beastmen, but her plea falls on deaf ears.
    
    The sneering lupine keeps his pin on the priestess and leans in close to her. Sniffing his captured quarry, the robust beast revels in his victory. Rolling his tongue out from his maw, he slowly drags his tongue from her neck to her cheek, and menacingly declares, "Welcome to the pack."
    
    With no more words, the halfbreed woman is hefted onto one of their shoulders as they then run off with their prize, ignoring you. [flags.CLUPINES_DEFEAT
        |You know exactly where they're going and what they intend to do with her.
        |Disappearing into the woods, you couldn't make heads or tails where they took her, but you have a feeling that you know what they intend to do with her.
    ] Not only do you have to rescue her, but it has become painfully poignant that these fell beasts are becoming a legitimate threat and they need to be stopped.
rows.translation:
这位黑发女祭司不断抛出法术，召唤护盾，并用法杖进行防御，一次又一次地击退那些被腐蚀的敌人，但她的努力终究是徒劳的。形势对她极为不利——这场战斗注定失败，而且情况还在不断恶化。当她从一个狼族身边后退时，另一个狼族却悄悄绕到她的侧后方。紧接着，那一记沉重的打击便让战斗结束了——她失去了平衡，踉跄着跌倒在地。在这场早已结束的战斗中，这位狗祭司仍拼命挣扎着试图重新站起来，但其中一名男子用一只有力的手将她按在了地上。接着，这个野性的狼族坐到了她的身上，将双手环绕在那名女子的纤细脖子上。
    
    啊……”狗女孩痛苦地呻吟着，他的手抓得越紧，她的牙齿就越发用力地咬紧。
    
    她在他的压迫下不停地挣扎、反抗，这时她瞥见了自己的手杖——它就放在她触手可及的地方。她伸出手，终于用指尖触到了它。或许她还能逃脱……然而，这个希望很快就被打破了：另一只狼走了过来，将她的手杖踢到了远处。这群狼看着她脸上的希望一点点消失，然后发出嘲弄的笑声，因为她唯一的逃生途径就这样被切断了。
    
    求求你们了！”她向那些野蛮的兽人哀求道，但她的恳求完全被无视了。
    
    那个冷笑着的狼族紧紧盯着女祭司，慢慢靠近她。嗅着捕获到的猎物，这个强壮的野兽为自己的胜利而欢欣鼓舞。它把舌头从嘴里伸出来，缓缓地从她的脖子舔到脸颊，然后威胁地宣称：“欢迎加入我们的族群。
    
    没有多说一句话，那个混血女人就被他们扛在其中一个人的肩上，然后他们带着战利品跑掉了，完全无视了你。 [flags.CLUPINES_DEFEAT
        |你非常清楚他们要去哪里，以及他们打算对她做什么。
        |她消失在了树林中，你完全不知道他们把她带到了哪里，但你有种预感，知道他们打算对她做什么。
    ]你不仅必须救出她，而且这些凶残的野兽已经构成了真正的威胁，必须阻止它们继续危害他人。

rows.original: There's no accusation in your voice, only idle curiosity. In the general sense of the words, yes, you did invite [drifa.fucked |your girlfriend |this woman ] to stay here, but your question for Drifa is in literal relation to the word: why's she here at the tower? Sure, the notion isn't entirely outside the realm of possibility — considering she's free to roam around as she pleases in the fort — it's still a rather odd place to find her. You were under the impression she'd be focused on the moving process. You'd like to know why Drifa decided to make a stop here. [drifa.isCorrupt |"To be honest, I don't know. After I got here, I just... started walking around — and before you ask, no, I didn't have a place in mind. Your guess is as good as mine. Maybe I wanted to get away from everything, maybe I saw this tower and thought it was a good vantage point, or maybe it was just pure whim. I don't know." Drifa then turns to the window and folds her arms. "Point is," she drifts her icy gaze to the far horizon, "it doesn't matter. What matters is what we choose to do now that we're here. For me, it's tending to you and looking out this window." |"[var0 |At first... I came up here thinking that I could maybe find if there was somewhere the afflicted townsfolk were gathering at |I'm not sure to be honest ], but when I reached the top and looked out," Drifa rests her hand against the wall, "I guess I got lost in the view." ] Sidling up next to Drifa, you look out the selfsame window to understand what she's referring to. As you look out from your vantage point, you're treated to the scenic view of [dayNight |the River Ridell glistening from the sunlight above and the expansive untamed wilds of the Old Forest. Between boreal terrain and distant mountains, it's hard to get a clear view, but you know that the quaint village Hawkethorne rests on the other side of these woods |numerous torchlights glowing from the fort below and the starlight from twilight tapestry above ]. The stunning view leaves you in awe, you can see how she was so easily distracted. "Beautiful, isn't it?" Drifa sighs. "[drifa.isCorrupt |It all feels so distant from up here. When I first saw it all, I didn't know what to make of it." Then, like a wilting flower, the somber wolf-girl lowers her head and continues; this time though, when she speaks, there's only the dry tone of melancholic defeat in her voice. "I wanted to enjoy it, I just wanted to feel something!" One of her hands closes into a tight, white-knuckled fist atop her arm. "I tried to force some kind of warmth back into my heart — to spark it anew — but it is gone! As I stare out into the world, I see nothing — feel nothing! All I get from this," she gestures out toward the vista before her, "is the cold reminder of how empty I've become." Drifa lifts her chin and drags a long breath. With a scorned heart and stern gaze, she avows: "It doesn't matter... not anymore. All that matters now is what we do from here on out." The wolf-girl puts her hand on your shoulder, her expression relaxing as she looks at you now. "If the world wants me to be as ugly as it is, then I'd gladly become the monster you need me to be. You mean more than the world itself. While I'm here with you, I don't feel cold. For as long as you hold some place for me, I feel warm — happy." |Even from up here, it all seems so grand. Makes me feel small in comparison. It really- wait, is that it?" What does she see? You do a double-take and glance at [drifa.fucked |your dog-girlfriend |the priestess ] before ultimately following the direction of her outstretched finger. You try looking around, even going so far as squinting in order to focus on whatever she's pointing at, but all you just see is just a bunch of trees. [drifa.fucked |"Ah crud," Drifa blurts out, "my bad. Turns out it wasn't what I thought it was, just ignore me |Drifa slowly retracts her finger and sulks. "It's nothing... sorry about that ]." That's a relief, now you don't feel completely blind for not seeing anything. That being said, this awkward mistake must be mortifying for her; that's okay though, everyone makes mistakes. If words aren't enough to console her, you follow through with a different kind of comfort: a head pat. Placing your hand atop her head, you tousle that dark hair of hers [drifa.fucked |before concluding with a good, once-over rub on an ear. As you brush your thumb along the white inner fuzz, you |and ] ask what she thinks she saw. Drifa [drifa.fucked |nuzzles against your hand, grunting against your affectionate touch. "Nhhf... |relaxes and admits, " ]I thought I saw the village from here." Returning your hand back to your side, you inform [drifa.fucked |your lover |the girl ] that Hawkethorne is a good few miles away let alone the trees and mountains which hide it. "I knooow," she admits while tidying her hair. "When I was at the village, that was all I ever knew. So being out and up here, this is all wonderfully new to me! For the first time, I'm seeing the world for what it truly is... and it puts into perspective the need for us to [drifa.fucked |preserve its beauty. After all, we're all in this for the long haul. Let's make it be for a better tomorrow. |to protect it! ]" ] Drifa pulls her hand away and clears her throat, "Sorry about that, I must've gotten carried away there. You probably didn't come all this way to hear me ramble."

德莉法抽回自己的手，清了清嗓子说道：“抱歉，我刚才有点太激动了。你大概不是专程跑这么远来听我胡言乱语的吧。
rows.raw: ' There's no accusation in your voice, only idle curiosity. In the general sense of the words, yes, you did invite [drifa.fucked |your girlfriend |this woman ] to stay here, but your question for Drifa is in literal relation to the word: why's she here at the tower? Sure, the notion isn't entirely outside the realm of possibility — considering she's free to roam around as she pleases in the fort — it's still a rather odd place to find her. You were under the impression she'd be focused on the moving process. You'd like to know why Drifa decided to make a stop here. [drifa.isCorrupt |"To be honest, I don't know. After I got here, I just... started walking around — and before you ask, no, I didn't have a place in mind. Your guess is as good as mine. Maybe I wanted to get away from everything, maybe I saw this tower and thought it was a good vantage point, or maybe it was just pure whim. I don't know." Drifa then turns to the window and folds her arms. "Point is," she drifts her icy gaze to the far horizon, "it doesn't matter. What matters is what we choose to do now that we're here. For me, it's tending to you and looking out this window." |"[var0 |At first... I came up here thinking that I could maybe find if there was somewhere the afflicted townsfolk were gathering at |I'm not sure to be honest ], but when I reached the top and looked out," Drifa rests her hand against the wall, "I guess I got lost in the view." ] Sidling up next to Drifa, you look out the selfsame window to understand what she's referring to. As you look out from your vantage point, you're treated to the scenic view of [dayNight |the River Ridell glistening from the sunlight above and the expansive untamed wilds of the Old Forest. Between boreal terrain and distant mountains, it's hard to get a clear view, but you know that the quaint village Hawkethorne rests on the other side of these woods |numerous torchlights glowing from the fort below and the starlight from twilight tapestry above ]. The stunning view leaves you in awe, you can see how she was so easily distracted. "Beautiful, isn't it?" Drifa sighs. "[drifa.isCorrupt |It all feels so distant from up here. When I first saw it all, I didn't know what to make of it." Then, like a wilting flower, the somber wolf-girl lowers her head and continues; this time though, when she speaks, there's only the dry tone of melancholic defeat in her voice. "I wanted to enjoy it, I just wanted to feel something!" One of her hands closes into a tight, white-knuckled fist atop her arm. "I tried to force some kind of warmth back into my heart — to spark it anew — but it is gone! As I stare out into the world, I see nothing — feel nothing! All I get from this," she gestures out toward the vista before her, "is the cold reminder of how empty I've become." Drifa lifts her chin and drags a long breath. With a scorned heart and stern gaze, she avows: "It doesn't matter... not anymore. All that matters now is what we do from here on out." The wolf-girl puts her hand on your shoulder, her expression relaxing as she looks at you now. "If the world wants me to be as ugly as it is, then I'd gladly become the monster you need me to be. You mean more than the world itself. While I'm here with you, I don't feel cold. For as long as you hold some place for me, I feel warm — happy." |Even from up here, it all seems so grand. Makes me feel small in comparison. It really- wait, is that it?" What does she see? You do a double-take and glance at [drifa.fucked |your dog-girlfriend |the priestess ] before ultimately following the direction of her outstretched finger. You try looking around, even going so far as squinting in order to focus on whatever she's pointing at, but all you just see is just a bunch of trees. [drifa.fucked |"Ah crud," Drifa blurts out, "my bad. Turns out it wasn't what I thought it was, just ignore me |Drifa slowly retracts her finger and sulks. "It's nothing... sorry about that ]." That's a relief, now you don't feel completely blind for not seeing anything. That being said, this awkward mistake must be mortifying for her; that's okay though, everyone makes mistakes. If words aren't enough to console her, you follow through with a different kind of comfort: a head pat. Placing your hand atop her head, you tousle that dark hair of hers [drifa.fucked |before concluding with a good, once-over rub on an ear. As you brush your thumb along the white inner fuzz, you |and ] ask what she thinks she saw. Drifa [drifa.fucked |nuzzles against your hand, grunting against your affectionate touch. "Nhhf... |relaxes and admits, " ]I thought I saw the village from here." Returning your hand back to your side, you inform [drifa.fucked |your lover |the girl ] that Hawkethorne is a good few miles away let alone the trees and mountains which hide it. "I knooow," she admits while tidying her hair. "When I was at the village, that was all I ever knew. So being out and up here, this is all wonderfully new to me! For the first time, I'm seeing the world for what it truly is... and it puts into perspective the need for us to [drifa.fucked |preserve its beauty. After all, we're all in this for the long haul. Let's make it be for a better tomorrow. |to protect it! ]" ] Drifa pulls her hand away and clears her throat, "Sorry about that, I must've gotten carried away there. You probably didn't come all this way to hear me ramble." '

rows.original: Now that she's here, despite the fact that she probably just arrived not too long ago, you're hoping to glean first impressions from the wallflower. [wayfort.renovated |A lot of effort went into fixing up the place. It's a far cry from what it once was when it first fell into your possession |You won't lie, the fort has seen better days — many, in fact. For lack of a better word: it looks like shit. Loath to admit it, but the seat of your barony is dust and debris right now. Perhaps, one of these days, you'll find the time to give this place some much needed [silly |tlc |renovation ] ]. "I like it. This fort — it's much quieter than town[drifa.isCorrupt | and it means we'll be seeing each other more often." Drifa then wraps her arms around you and says, "If I had the choice to be anywhere in the world, I'd rather it be here — with you. We could do anything we want here!" |. Just think about it," Drifa says, walking to the center. Twirling around, with her arms outstretched, she exclaims, "There's so much possibility here! Out here, in the frontier, we have the whole world [drifa.fucked |to ourselves |ahead of us ]! We could go anywhere and do whatever we want. [wayfort.sexy |But, um..." her excitement dies down and is replaced with a strange curiosity, "is..." she clears her throat and then goes to speak; as she tries, though, the words catch in her throat and come out as a tentative croak. After a couple attempts of trying to speak, she finally finds the nerve and asks, "Is openly lewd stuff a normal, everyday, thing here?" For her to bring this up, you presume she must've had an incidental run-in with one of the fort's more [pc.isBimbo |wild and sexy friends |debaucherously-inclined occupants ]. If she's asking if this is breaking any rules, then no it is not. That kind of activity is perfectly allowed within the fort. After all, you're the one that allowed this policy. "Ah, I uh... I see. I'll... try to keep that in mind. Nevertheless, thank you |Thanks ] for letting me stay in your home." Your [drifa.fucked |dog-girlfriend |wallflower friend ] hugs you. ] If having [drifa.fucked |[pc.isDK |your [drifa.isCorrupt |personal wolf-bitch |[pc.isPoly |innocent beacon of light |one shred; one light; one bright, shining star ] ] |your [drifa.isCorrupt |personal wolf-bitch |sweetheart ] ] |Drifa ] here means you can freely check in on her, then you wouldn't have it any other way. The Wayfort will become a good home for her. Regrettably, the hug does not last forever as she detaches herself from you and takes a step back.

rows.original: You chime in and inform Drifa that she'll need to start carrying her weight and help out if she's to stay here and make use of the fort's facilities. The specifics of what that has to be doesn't matter as it's more so important that she finds something to do in order to earn her keep. Rain or shine, everyone has to do their part and contribute in some form or another. "I see," Drifa responds, pressing a knuckle to her lip in contemplation She hums and murmurs, but after a bit, she nods. "It'd only be fair for the generosity you've shown me. If[drifa.isCorrupt | you so will it, you may use me as you see fit, be it as an extension of your wrath or someone to satisfy you, I'm yours to use as you see fit |-if need be, I could offer my um... my services as a healer ]." You inquire further if [drifa.isCorrupt |these are the roles |this is the role ] she intends to designate herself with during her stay here. This means she'll be placed in a position where she'll have to reliably interact with the people of the fort — sometimes many of them throughout the course of a day, given the occasion. [drifa.isCorrupt |Drifa takes some time to mull it over in her head. She then shrugs. "I'd rather just interact with you, but I understand we have to do what's expected of us, even if we don't like it. If it comes as part and parcel of my duties, then I'll manage, one way or another." |Drifa's expression pales; however, in spite of the trepidation, she resolves herself. "If it comes as part and parcel of my duties... then... then I'll do my best. No matter what happens, it's my duty and moral obligation to provide help to those who need it. I can do this... I think." Well, at least it's a start. ]
rows.translation: 你插话告诉德莉法，如果她想继续留在这里并使用这座堡垒的设施，就必须开始承担自己的责任，帮忙做一些事情。具体需要做些什么并不重要，更重要的是她得找点事情做来换取留在这里的资格。无论晴雨，每个人都必须以某种方式尽自己的一份力。 “我明白了，”德莉法沉思着，用指关节轻按着嘴唇说道。 她低声哼唱着，过了一会儿，她点了点头。“考虑到你对我所表现出的慷慨，这样做才是公平的。如果[drifa.isCorrupt | 你希望如此，你可以随意利用我——无论是将我当作你发泄怒火的工具，还是用来满足你的某些需求，我都任由你随意处置 |有需要的话，我可以提供我的……我的治疗服务 ]。” 你进一步询问道，[drifa.isCorrupt |这些就是她打算给自己安排的职责 |这就是她打算给自己安排的角色 ]是否就是她在这里逗留期间要承担的。这意味着她将会处于一个需要与要塞里的人们进行频繁互动的位置上——根据不同的场合，有时一天之内就需要与其中很多人进行交流。 [drifa.isCorrupt |德莉法在心中仔细考虑了一番，然后耸了耸肩：“我其实更愿意和你交流互动，但我明白，我们必须去做那些别人期望我们做的事情，即使我们并不喜欢。如果这是我的职责所在，那么无论如何，我都会设法完成它。” |德莉法的神情变得黯淡下来；然而，尽管心中充满忐忑，她还是下定了决心。“如果这是我的职责所在……那么……我一定会尽我最大的努力。无论发生什么，帮助那些需要帮助的人都是我的责任，也是我的道德义务。我想，我能够做到这一点。” 好吧，至少这是一个开始。 ]

rows.original:
[drifa.isCorrupt
        |Ever since you've taken Drifa in as your ward, she's come to learn a lot about the world while in your presence. You've already accomplished the task of breaking her down and then rebuilding her from the woman she once was. As an object of your manipulative fascination, you find that it couldn't hurt to gather more insight of who your she-wolf is. Considering her implicit loyalty towards you, she seems more than willing to comply in answering any questions you might have. 
        |[drifa.fucked
            |You've already accomplished the feat of tearing down the reductive walls which separated her from the rest of the world and became her tether, but it doesn't hurt to spend time with your beloved in casual conversation every now and again. Drifa is certainly eager to answer any of your inquiries.
            |For lack of better words, you wanted to know who she was. To understand her on a fundamental level instead of being kept at arm's length from her. Friendship is built upon the mutual understanding of one another, is it not?
        ] Hopefully you find a conversation topic about her to discuss before things become awkward.
    ]
    
    [rand
        |Noting her lupine features, from the ears perched on top of her head to the tail resting behind her It isn't too far-fetched on account of the fact that most of the residents where she came are lupine. Drifa's attention follows your inspection of her body and her ears flick. No point beating around the bush, so you inquire as to which side she inherited them from. 
        
        [drifa.isCorrupt
            |In a low tone, Drifa plainly answers, "Mom. It came from my," her words peeter out mid sentence. Swallowing that lump in her throat, Drifa recollects herself and continues, "they came from my mother's side."
            
            Looks like you have her mother to thank then. Did she also inherit her dainty, feminine figure from her too?
            
            "No," she admits dryly.
            
            If Drifa's apparent crossbreed nature is anything to go by, then you need only your imagination to infer how the union between her parents went. He must've been a brave soul to attempt that charge. While the topic is still fresh, you continue and ask what her home life was like growing up[drifa.metFamily
                |.
                | and if her parents are still around. Bemusing the possibility, you humor the idea of meeting her family and reveling in their reactions as they bear witness to the fruits of your labor.
            ]
            
            "They were kind, but... perhaps too kind. My parent's protection over me was suffocating. They treated me like some kind of flower — afraid that some monster would come along and take away their precious gift to the world. In their fear, they neglected to see that I couldn't grow or spread my own wings. I can tell they tried their best and I still love them for it. [drifa.metFamily
                |No matter, you're the only family I need now."
                |If you wish to meet them, they should still be in the village taking care of my younger sister. I'd like to show you them, one day."
            ]
            |[drifa.fucked
                |Drifa titters and wraps both hands behind her back. "Curious? I got my ears and tail from my mother's side. Let's just say my father was a very brave man."
                |"M-my mother," she brings her hand up and sheepishly itches the back of her neck, "it came from my mother. My father was a," she rubs her cheek and hums to herself, "a very brave man."
            ]
            
            Props to her father for surviving such an ordeal. Following the topic, you continue and ask what her home life was like growing up[drifa.metFamily
                |.
                | and if her parents are still around. Perhaps one of these days you'd like to meet them when given the chance.
            ]
        ]
        
        [drifa.fucked
            |"I'd like to think that mom and dad did their best to raise me. I'm sure they're still in town if you'd like to meet them, but I imagine they probably have their hands full with my baby sis.
            |"I-I liked it. They're good people, really! It just... feels weird not hearing their input to help me out."
        ]
        |An underlying curiosity surfaces to the forefront of your thoughts. Was she always an antisocial person?[drifa.isCorrupt
            | Despite the fact that she has grown much since your initial encounter with her, she still has difficulty holding conversations with people other than you. Might this have been due to her metamorphosis post-expedition of the corrupted den or has she always been like this?
            
            "More or less," Drifa freely admits. "Beforehand, I wasn't what one would call a social butterfly. Talking was never really my thing, I much preferred to observe from a distance. Surmise it to my anxiety." Sighing, the halfbreed priestess rolls her head down. "Even now, I still don't talk to many people unless I have to, but my reasonings for it have become... different."
            
            How so?
            
            Her head remains angled downwards, but as she blinks, she lifts her cold blue eyes in your direction. "I don't like it."
            
            Is that any different to how it was before for her?
            
            "Very."
            
            In what way, and does this also mean she doesn't enjoy these little exchanges with you?
            
            "You, like a few others, are an exception. I would never dare defy your presence nor deny your whim. You are, and always will be, my guiding light." Resting a hand on her waist, Drifa curls a knuckle and taps it upon her lips. "Hmm, it's better to say that, in the past, I had difficulty turning my thoughts into words. Now though? I simply don't care anymore."
            |[drifa.fucked
                | Despite the fact that she has grown much since your initial encounter with her, she still has difficulty holding conversations with people other than you.
            ] Asking such a question, you don't know how she'll respond. Would she find it tactless? Perhaps this might have been a sensitive topic for her. Your concerns are dispelled when Drifa shakes her head.
            
            "It's okay," Drifa admits. [drifa.fucked
                |"It's not like there's some dark secret or past trauma. I'm just like this. Growing up, I really didn't need to talk much but in doing so I suppose I inadvertently made things harder for myself for not practicing my talking skills. I enjoy talking but, more often than not, my head forms a blank of what I should say at that moment." She then raises her hands and begins gesticulating. "Actually, I think it's more appropriate to say that there's so much stuff running around in my head that I can't decide what I want to say. When I'm with you though, what I want to say just comes naturally to me."
                |"I know you mean well. It's just that, uh... my mind, it's hard to work with. It makes things, uh, difficult to make come out right. When I try talking I guess I kinda," she sheepishly rubs her forearm and shrugs. "freeze up. I enjoy the silence, but I do wish I was good at turning my thoughts into words."
            ]
            
            Offering a perspective nugget of wisdom, you inform Drifa that communication shouldn't be something that one should force. If she wants to better apply that latent charisma of hers, she should let her responses form naturally rather than attempting to hastily pick an ideal response. To put it succinctly, she should think of it as no different than a muscle you can train.
            
            "Thanks, I'll try and keep that in mind."
        ]
        |It couldn't hurt to ask an innocuous question. Amongst the plethora of mercurial questions on your mind, you ultimately break the ice with a simple question and ask Drifa what her favorite color is.
        
        "Eh?!" Drifa cocks her head in [drifa.isCorrupt
            |muted
            |baffled
        ] confusion. "My... favorite color?"
        
        [pc.isDK
            |You don't recall stuttering. Yes, what was her favorite color. You're not expecting anything fancy here. Just a simple answer like red or black is fine.
            |You nod. Of course you idly entertain your own theories of what it could be but you wait to hear what it could be from her own lips.
        ]
        
        "Blue, probably. It's a pretty color." Absentmindedly, Drifa brushes a finger through her raven hair[drifa.hasFlower
            | and hooks underneath the blue flower you gifted her.
            |, brushing her bangs aside to a clearer view of her soft blue eyes.
        ] Blue is certainly her color. "What about you, what's your favorite color?"
        
        That's perhaps a tale for another time, you grin in jest as you avoid her question.
        
        [drifa.isCorrupt
            |"I see."
            |"Hey, that's cheating!" Drifa crosses her arms and pouts in defiance of your teasing. Resting your hand upon her head, her stubborn insistence dissipates as you rustle her hair.
        ]
        |It couldn't hurt to ask an innocuous question. Amongst the plethora of mercurial questions on your mind, you ultimately break the ice with a simple question and ask Drifa what her favorite animal is — perhaps a pet growing up?
        
        "Can't say we did. Hmm," the half-breed brings a curled finger to her lips and deliberates her own answer. [drifa.isCorrupt
            |"I'd have to say dogs or wolves."
            
            A little on the nose isn't it? Is there a reason why she likes dogs aside from the fact that she's part lupine? Perhaps [pc.ra lupine
                |that be why she's so drawn to you?
                |it might be due to a deep seated feeling of kinship with them?
            ]
            
            She shakes her head. "Not quite. My affinity for them is a recent development."
            
            There's no doubt that, by recent, she's referring to a certain self-awakening. Indulging your curiosity, you ask what it might've been beforehand.
            
            "Beforehand?" Having to think upon it, Drifa curls a finger to her lip and ponders the options in her head. Coming to a conclusion, she lets her hand fall down to her side. "Maybe foxes."
            
            That's quite an unexpected answer as opposed to her current one. Not one you'd associate from someone like her. Crossing your arms, you might as well inquire as to why she chose that option. You're more than curious to hear her reasoning. 
            
            "I apologize if my answer is ill-satisfying, but I think the reason I used to like foxes was because of how cute and full of life they were. Not much else I could go on to say about them. Recently though," she holds an open palm up and begins to gesticulate idly. "I've taken a fascination with canines because of what they represent. Dogs, and by extension wolves, are hardy and driven creatures. Their loyalty and love can just be as equally matched to their cutthroat ferocity if they're given the right push. There's a reason why their image is evocative and ever-present in the many cautionary tales.
            
            I like dogs because they're the end result of domesticating such primal creatures, but — deep down inside — there's still the undeniable reminder of what they are and can just as easily become under duress. When pushed to the brink, even the sweetest of dogs will revert to their base instincts. When the circumstances are right, just point them in the right direction and you'll see them for what they truly are."
            
            A wry grin forms on your face as you make sense of her explanation. Might this be projection from Drifa?
            
            Shrugging, Drifa settles her open palm upon her waist. "Perhaps. I won't lie and say I don't admire their driven nature and see a reflection of them in myself." A dark, sadistic smile twists on her face. "My explanation didn't unnerve you did it? Don't worry, losing you would be akin to death for me. You have nothing to fear from me. The only ones that have to fear are those whom you point me at."
            |"I'd have to say foxes."
            
            A unique or contrarian answer from the norm if you've heard one. Is there a reason why she likes foxes in particular?
            
            She nods. "There's something about their playful energy, I guess. I just think they're really cute. But um... I would never want one as a pet. I know that they can be quite noisy, destructive, and very bitey."
            
            If she's fascinated with foxes so much, does this fact also carry over to the foxen folk such as the Kitsune?
            
            [pc.ra foxmorph
                |Drifa places a hand on her hip and titters behind a closed fist. "Not quite. [drifa.fucked
                    |My love for you is unrelated to that. Strolling up to you, [pc.heightRange 60 72 84
                        |she leans in and pecks your cheek with a gentle kiss
                        |she stands up on her toes and places a gentle kiss on your cheek.
                        |she waves you down to her level and places a gentle peck on your cheek.
                        |she crouches down and pecks your cheek with a gentle kiss.
                    ] 
                    |You're my friend, regardless of that! Strolling up to you, [pc.heightRange 72 84
                        |she stands on her toes and reaches a svelte hand out to brush
                        |she waves you down to her level and reaches a svelte hand out to brush
                        |she places a svelte hand on you and brushes
                    ] your head.
                ]
                |She tenses her lip and shakes her head. "I'm sorry, but I'm not familiar with the term."
            ]
            
            [pc.ra kitsune
                |Wordlessly, you point to yourself as your vulpine tails animate behind you.
                
                "O-oh" Drifa's face burns red with embarrassed shame before hiding behind her hands and letting a long and drawn out groan.
                
                Easing her embarrassment, you offer a curt pat onto her head.
                |That comes as a genuine surprise, but upon extra consideration the fact shouldn't surprise you. From your interaction with the kitsune, they're a secluded group. Possibly even more so than Drifa with the added layer of their xenophobia, save for certain inclinations which would draw them outside their den and interact with errant travelers on the road. Not everyone is well inundated and as well traveled as you are.
            ]
        ]

                    |[pc.name]
                ]. It means a lot to me. It really does."
            ]
            
            There's no harm in wishing to learn more about her, especially in regards to something she seems passionate about.
            
            Drifa rocks on the pads of her heel while directing her attention skyward. "I'm just a simple girl. I can cast a few cantrips, but nothing like Brother Sanders. If anything... I'm just a lay priestess of the Dawn Maiden, Lumia."
            
            That solves that question — wait a minute, if she's just a lay priest then why did she pursue this path and how did she practice into her studies?
            
            Her head lowers from the sky and turns back to face you. "It's because I want to help people in a tangible way... but also so I don't feel lost when the night comes. To have a direction and purpose in life. If it's to kindle and preserve the light of hope, even through the smallest of deeds, then that shall be my lot in life."

        |[flags.DRIFA_FAITH
            |尽管这个话题对德莉法来说可能相当敏感，但你还是再次提到了她的信仰。这是她生活中另一个不可忽视的方面，你想要从中了解更多关于她的信息。她的信仰对她来说意味着什么？德莉法双臂交叉，找了个墙角靠在上面，然后才开始说话。
            
            说实话？我不知道。目前来说，我仍然只是黎明女神卢米娅的一名普通祭司。我真不明白为什么这种情况还可能发生，”她惊讶地说道，“发生了那么多事情，我本以为卢米娅早就剥夺我的力量了。
            
            然而，她不仅依然在这里，而且她的力量在得到你的指导之后更是得到了增强。

“确实如此，”德莉法茫然地回应道，“我至今仍然会回想起那个被感染者所在的巢穴。我认为那个洞穴是在考验我的决心，其中必定隐藏着某种更重要的意义。然而最终，尽管我付出了那么多努力，却什么也没有得到。只剩下那些发生过的记忆，尽管那些记忆已经变得模糊不清。我们只是赢了比赛，然后离开了那个洞穴。并没有任何神的干预。天空中没有降下任何火焰般的惩罚，也没有任何神的力量来拯救我。只有我们两个人……我在想……卢米娅是否真的在乎呢？
            
            这重要吗？无论如何，很明显德莉法内心充满了疑虑。她的内心充满了矛盾与挣扎，你一定想知道，是什么驱使她坚持走这条路吧？

德莉法举起两根手指：“有两个原因：一是为了留下自己的痕迹，二是为了你。我未能保护好属于自己的光芒。我知道自己已经无可救药，但或许——只是或许——我还能做些什么正确的事情，以此激励他人选择比我更美好的道路。当然，这一切需要一些时间，因为在我变得更强大的过程中，仍然需要你们的帮助；不过，当那一刻到来时，能够终于跻身那些优秀的行列之中，我将感到无上荣幸。作为平等的伙伴，与你们并肩站在一起。

“卢米亚人，”她干巴巴地回答道。
            
            嗯……这就回答了那个问题。从谈话中那种紧张的气氛来看，现在或许最好暂时停止这个话题的讨论了。

迪拉fa用脚跟轻轻敲打着地面，同时将目光投向天空。“我只是一个普通的女孩而已。我能够施展一些简单的法术，但远远比不上桑德斯修士。说实话……我只不过是黎明女神教会的普通女祭司罢了，名叫卢米娅。

            她的头从天空中低下，重新转向你。“因为我想要以一种切实的方式去帮助人们……同时也是为了在夜晚来临的时候不会感到迷茫。为了让自己的人生有方向、有目标。如果我的使命就是通过最微小的行动去点燃并守护希望之轻型，那么这就是我人生应有的意义。"

当你提到这个显而易见的事实时，德莉法的眼睛突然睁大了，随后她明显显得有些慌乱。“啊……对……我确实解释过了，对吧？”她低下头，开始焦虑地用食指互相敲击。“那部分内容可能有点无聊……你确定想听吗？

rows.original:
It couldn't hurt to have an extra set of hands around; the halfbreed has proven herself a capable spellcaster and it couldn't hurt to recruit her services. The Wayfort belongs to you and it isn't that far. Having a reliable way of interacting with her would be more fruitful than having to track her down in town each time you want to discuss anything. That just leaves the matter of asking her first. As skittish as she is, she could very well refuse your invitation but she did say that she had no considerable ties to Hawkethorne. Extending the invitation, you wait for her response.
    
    "The old fort? Are you sure?" Responding to her question, you insist it's fine. To which Drifa deliberates the proposal before finally making her choice. Lifting her head up and weakening the social barrier interposed between you and her, she finally makes eye contact with you and forms a slight smile on her face. It's a weak smile, but a smile nonetheless. "I'd like that. Thank you."
    
    That's dealt with, then. It might take some time for her to pack her things and settle in, but you're sure she will be a pleasant addition to the fort and lend a helping hand against the corrupted lupines. She has just as much stake in this as you do.

Whatever it is, it's something that doesn't grow here naturally. I don't know how or why they got there, but the fact is there's a correlation between these flowers and the afflicted. It was as if these flowers mark some kind of hunting ground."
        
        Drifa points to a spot on the map "I followed the river upstream until I found what I thought was just an abandoned worksite. When I got there, it was just as I thought. The area was absolutely swarming with them! I tried to get closer but it was too dangerous, but I did overhear some things."
        
        And what're they?
        
        "Aside from them talking about their... um... desires, I heard them talk about some kind of jarl — an alpha, if you will. I also heard what their leader wants to do: they intend to take Hawkethorne!"
        
        Yeah, that's bad. No matter, they won't get far if you have anything to say about it.
        
        "I'm coming with you!" Drifa chimes in.
        
        Is that a good idea though?

        德莉法点了点头，然后拿出一朵狼族角花和一张粗糙的手绘地图。“自从人们开始失踪以来，我就一直在努力查明真相。”这个狗女孩揉了揉后颈，说道：“这，嗯……你能在那个时候找到我，真是太幸运了。如果没有你的帮助，我想我根本无法逃脱那次埋伏。不过，在追踪他们的踪迹时，我注意到河岸边长着一些奇怪的花朵。乍一看，我以为它们只是普通的狼牙草而已，根本没太在意。直到我注意到它们有些……不同之处：它们是紫色的，而且长满了刺，就像这个一样。”德莉法指了指那根狼角。“这种东西我以前从未见过！不管它是什么，显然它并不是自然生长在这里的。我不知道它们是如何、为何会出现在那里的，但事实是，这些花朵与那些患病的人之间存在某种关联。就好像这些花朵在标记着某种“猎场”一样。
        
        德莉法指着地图上的一个位置说道：“我沿着河流向上游走去，最终找到了一个我以为只是被废弃的工地。当我赶到那里时，情况确实如我所想——那片区域里到处都是它们！我试图靠近一些，但实在太危险了，不过我确实听到了一些声音。

不过，这真的是个好主意吗？

rows.original:
With that out of the way, that just leaves how you should approach the problem.
    
    Bringing a hand to her own forearm, Drifa adds more. "Their leader... perhaps we can deal with him. Without their leader holding them together, their pack might fall apart."
    
    Or they might just elect a new alpha.
    
    Drifa grimaces. "Er... yeah, forgot about that possibility. Regardless, this might give us long enough to provide the afflicted with the aid they need to get back to their old selves. I leave the choice of what we should do to you."
    
    Simple enough. Deal with their leader and sort the rest from there. With a plan on hand, do you feel like you're ready for the trial ahead?

既然那件事已经解决，接下来就只剩你该如何着手处理这个问题了。

    也可能他们只会另选一个头目。
    
    德莉法苦着脸。“呃……是啊，忘了还有这种可能。不管怎样，这或许能给我们争取到足够的时间，去为那些染病的人提供他们所需的救助，让他们恢复原本的样子。我们该怎么做，这个选择我交给你。”
    
    简单得很。处理掉他们的头领，剩下的再看着办。既然计划在手，你觉得自己准备好迎接前方的试炼了吗？

You're serious? Well that's a big egg on my face, then. What's up?" With how casual she's being, it makes this whole situation much less stressful. You take one of the promise rings out, and present it to Drifa. Drifa blinks, then her slitted eyes widen as she realizes just what this is and by that extent, what you're offering. "A wedding ring?" Drifa comments, alternating her attention between it and you. You clarify that it's a promise ring. "What's the difference? Well, for starters, the actual wedding rings will be provided at the event. You tell her this ring is to proclaim that you've claimed her hand in marriage. "We're already married, as far as I'm concerned."[drifa.isCollared | She points to her collar. ] Nevertheless, she presents her hand to you, letting you slip the ring onto her finger. "It won't hurt to make it official. So... what do we do now?" You tell her the list of things that must be done: she's gotta tell her folks, the two of you will need to wear something nice for the event, and to find a venue to host the wedding. "Got it," Drifa says. "I'm sure Garth wouldn't complain if we asked him to use the inn for our wedding — more customers, and all. As for an outfit, we did make a nice chunk of change when we plundered the corrupted mine. I'm sure we can both get something nice. You better not complain if I get something risqué for the occasion, though." You hope aloud that she doesn't come to the event wearing her birthday suit. "Oh gods, no! Are you crazy? People are going to be there — people who aren't you seeing my body. I'll think of something. You'd better not get cold feet; if you leave me at the ceremony, I'm coming for your ass. You're stuck with me whether you like it or not." She holds up her hand with the promise ring on it. "This is proof of that. Now, let's go tell my parents the good news." |You look at your sweet puppy-lover, and swallow hard. Drifa tilts her head, bends her ears forward. "Is something wrong?" You're already feeling butterflies in your stomach. You clench your fists, reach into your pack, and tell Drifa that you've something to give her. "Oh? What is it?" Dammit! If you don't do it now, you'll lose your nerve and never do it. You take one of the promise rings out, and present it to Drifa. Drifa blinks, then her slitted eyes widen as she realizes just what this is and by that extent, what you're offering. "[pc.name]..." she smiles and tears well up in her eyes, "I... ah..." Will she marry you? Drifa throws herself at you, embracing you tightly. "Yes, [pc.name]! I will!" After separating, you slip the silver ring onto her finger. It looks good on her. Drifa takes a deep breath and calms herself, folding her ears forward as her tail swishes behind her. Quietly, she rolls her wrist back and forth, studying the ring on her finger, seeing how it fits her as she asks aloud, "does this mean we're married now?" Not quite. You answer back that it's just a promise ring. The actual wedding will take a few days to organize. She'll need time to tell her folks, get a proper dress, and to have a venue to host the event. Drifa holds her hand with the ring on it close to her chest, cherishing it as she says, "got it! M-maybe Nelia can help me — I mean us — with our gowns. Mom is a good friend of Garth, I'm sure he'd love to host us. Now come on, let's tell my family the good news." ]
rows.translation: [drifa.isCorrupt |你看着那位喜欢狼的女孩，艰难地咽了口唾沫；而德莉法则微微歪了歪头。 “怎么了？该不会是我身上有什么问题吧？如果没有……那肯定是有别的原因。” 此时，你的胃里已经开始翻江倒海了。你握紧拳头，从背包里拿出了东西，然后告诉德莉法你有些东西要送给她。 “哦，等等。你是认真的吗？那可真是让我尴尬极了……到底是什么事情呢？” 她表现得如此随意，让整个场面变得不那么紧张了。你取出一枚订婚戒指，递给了德莉法。 德莉法眨了眨眼，然后她那狭长的眼睛突然睁得更大，因为她立刻明白了这枚戒指的含义，以及你因此而想要表达的东西。 “一枚结婚戒指？德莉法一边看着它，一边注视着你，目光在两者之间来回切换。 你向她解释说，那其实是一个订婚戒指有什么区别呢？ 嗯，首先，真正的结婚戒指会在仪式上颁发。你可以告诉她，这枚戒指是用来正式向她表达你想要娶她为妻的意愿的。 “在我看来，我们早就结婚了。[drifa.isCollared | 她指了指自己的衣领。 ]然而，她还是伸出了手，让你把戒指戴到她的手指上。“正式确认一下也没什么坏处。那么……我们现在该怎么做呢？” 你告诉她需要完成的一些事项：她必须告诉她的家人，你们俩都需要为这场婚礼准备一些合适的服装，另外还需要找一个举办婚礼的场地。 明白了，”德莉法说道，“我相信加斯不会介意我们让他把客栈用来举办婚礼的——这样既能吸引更多顾客，也是件好事。至于礼服的话，我们确实当我们洗劫那座被破坏的矿场时，确实赚了一大笔钱。我相信我们俩都能得到一些不错的东西。不过，要是我为这个场合挑选了一些比较大胆的东西，你可别抱怨哦。 你暗自祈祷她不会穿着生日礼服来参加这个活动。 “哦，天啊，千万别这样！你疯了吗？人们会有人在那里——而那些人却不会。你看到我现在的样子，你肯定能想出办法的。千万别临阵退缩；要是你在婚礼上丢下我，我绝对会追到你身边。不管你愿不愿意，你都得陪着我。”她举起戴着订婚戒指的手，“这就是证明。现在，我们去告诉我的父母这个好消息吧。 |你看着自己那个可爱的、喜欢小狗的小家伙，不由得咽了口唾沫。德莉法歪了歪头，把耳朵向前凑了凑。 “出什么问题了吗？” 你的胃里已经开始一阵阵翻腾了。你握紧拳头，从背包里拿出了什么东西，然后告诉德莉法你有东西要给她。 “哦？是什么东西？” 该死！如果现在不这么做，你就会失去勇气，永远也不会去做了。你取出一枚承诺戒指，将其递给德莉法。 德莉法眨了眨眼，然后她那狭长的眼睛突然睁得更大，因为她立刻明白了这枚戒指的含义，以及你因此而想要表达的东西。[pc.name]……”她微笑着，泪水在眼眶中打转，“我……啊……” 她会嫁给你吗？ 德莉法扑向你，紧紧地拥抱你。“会，”她说道。 [pc.name]我一定会的！” 分开后，你将那枚银戒指戴在了她的手指上。它戴在她手上非常合适。 德莉法深吸一口气，让自己平静下来，耳朵向前耷拉，尾巴在身后摆动着。她轻轻地将手腕来回转动，仔细观察手指上的戒指，感受它戴在身上的感觉，然后大声问道：“这是不是意味着我们现在已经结婚了？” 还不完全是。你回答说，这只不过是订婚戒指实际的婚礼筹备还需要几天的时间。她需要时间告诉家人，挑选合适的礼服，还要找到举办婚礼的场地。 德莉法将戴着戒指的手紧贴在胸前，珍惜地说道：“找到了！也许内莉娅能帮我们挑选礼服……妈妈是加思的好朋友，我相信他会很乐意为我们举办婚礼的。好了，我们现在就去告诉家人这个好消息吧。 ]

rows.original: You think again — maybe there's something time-sensitive that needs doing. Drifa deserves to not have something interrupt the grand day; you'll ask again when your schedule is more open.
rows.translation: 你再想一想吧——也许有某些事情需要立即处理。德莉法不应该在这么重要的日子里遇到任何干扰；等你的日程安排更空闲一些，再再去问吧。

rows.original:
Raising your arms, you present yourself to the priestess. You would like some healing. [wayfort.hasDrifa
        |It doesn't hurt to make use of your fort's resident healer.
        |Perhaps it might've been more prudent to visit Brother Sanders at the chapel rather than scouring high and low for a reclusive healer, but it doesn't hurt to visit her and make her feel special.
    ]
    
    [var0
        |
        Drifa's eyes widen in shock when she gets a good look at you and, before you get a word in edgewise, she hurriedly rushes to your side. The dark-haired half-breed works herself into a profuse panic. Wasting no time, she places a closed fist to her chest and hastily performs the healing rites with her sacred beads clutched in hand.
        
        "[pc.Name]!" her voice strains. "H-hold on!"
        
        Isn't she overreacting just a little bit? It's not like anything you have is lethal.
        
        "N-no... well... perhaps maybe..." She glares up at you and pouts. There's no doubt Drifa is attempting to be stubbornly defiant, but coming from her it just comes across as adorable and missing its mark. The light of her healing hands draws out all the hurt and pain you're carrying as she presses her dainty healer's hands upon you before shaking her head — rustling her long raven hair. "I cannot take such risks lightly. I... I'm sorry," she exhales and composes her scrambled thoughts. "I just... don't want to lose you. You know that."
        
        [pc.isDK
            |Then she better stay on top of her game.
            |Don't worry, you're not planning to go anywhere.
        ] Thanking her, [party.hasCompanions
            |you allow Drifa to tend to the rest of your compatriots before returning to the matter at hand
            |you return to the matter at hand.
        ]
        |
        "Eh?!" Drifa tilts her head and parts her lips in confusion. "Is-do-uh... are you... asking for a hug?" she murmurs.
        
        What? You're equally as lost before looking down at your open arms. Ah right, you didn't quite clarify your intentions nor are your injuries noticeable. Without context, it's easy to see where her confusion is coming from. No harm, no foul. Holding your arms beside you again, this time you ask her to tend to your injuries.
        
        "OH!" she exclaims in burning embarrassment as it finally clicks. "Right! I got this... I think."
        
        Clutching her sacred beads in a closed palm close to her chest, Drifa graces her fingers gently upon you and works her magic. Infusing the light of her soothing holy magic into you, the half-breed priestess draws all that hurt and pain you're carrying from you. As quickly as the process began, so too does it end. Already that sublime comfort of her restoration fades in its fleeting warmth as she removes her touch.
        
        "So um, are you okay?" She inquires whilst tapping her index fingers.
        
        To be honest, you feel a tad on the mediocre to average side emotionally. Not much going on aside from the typical demonic invasion. 
        
        "Hey," Drifa pouts and taps your arm lightly with a fist in protest. "I meant physically!"
        
        Of course, you knew what she meant but how could you resist teasing her if she makes such an adorable expression. Telling her this rewards you with a buffet of thumps and pushes all while her tail brushes behind her. With how often you've seen Drifa be emotionally secluded, it's a pleasant sight to see her in such gaiety from a little playful teasing. Thanking her, [party.hasCompanions
            |you allow Drifa to tend to the rest of your compatriots before returning to the matter at hand
            |you return to the matter at hand.
        ]
    ]
rows.translation:
你举起双臂，向女祭司走去。你希望得到治愈。 [wayfort.hasDrifa
        |利用你堡垒里的治疗专家并没有坏处。
        |或许，去小教堂拜访桑德斯修士会更为明智，而不是四处寻找这位隐居的治愈者，但去拜访她、让她感受到自己的特别之处，也没什么坏处。
    ]
    
    [var0
        |
        当德莉法仔细看清你的样子时，她震惊得瞪大了眼睛。还没等你开口说话，她就急忙冲到了你身边。这个黑发混血女子陷入了极度的恐慌之中。她毫不迟疑地将紧握的拳头放在胸前，同时手中紧握着那些神圣的珠子，迅速开始了治疗仪式。[pc.Name]啊！”她的声音有些颤抖，“等、等等！”

她这样反应，会不会有点过度了？你说的那些东西又不是什么致命的东西啊。

“不、不是……也许吧……”她抬头看着你，撅起了嘴。毫无疑问，德莉法是在试图表现出固执和反抗，但对她来说，这种表现反而显得很可爱，反而没有达到预期的效果。她那充满治愈力量的双手轻轻触碰着你，将你内心深处所有的伤痛与痛苦都一一抚平。然而，她却摇了摇头，她那长长的乌黑头发随之轻轻摆动：“我不能轻易地承担这样的风险……我……对不起，”她轻声说道，努力整理自己混乱的思绪，“我只是……不想失去你。你明白的。
        
        [pc.isDK
            |那么她最好继续保持自己的高水平表现。
            |别担心，你又不是真的要去什么地方。
        ]向她道谢， [party.hasCompanions
            |你可以先让德里法去照顾你的其他同胞，然后再回来继续处理当前的事情。
            |让我们回到正在讨论的主题上来。
        ]
        |
        呃？！”德丽法歪着头，困惑地张开嘴唇，“你、你是……在邀请我拥抱你吗？”她轻声问道。

什么？当你低头看到自己张开的双臂时，你也同样感到困惑。对了，你之前并没有明确说明自己的意图，而且你的伤势也不明显。在没有更多背景信息的情况下，她的困惑完全可以理解。没关系，你把双臂重新放在身体两侧，这次你请她帮你处理伤势吧。
        
        哦！”她顿时感到无比尴尬，终于明白了是怎么回事。“对了！我想我明白了……”

德丽法将那串神圣的念珠紧紧握在胸前，轻轻用手指触碰着你，然后开始施展她的魔法。这位混血女祭司将她那治愈人心的神圣魔力注入你的体内，帮你驱散所有那些你所承受的痛苦与伤痕。这个过程开始得如此迅速，结束也同样快。当她收回自己的手时，那种由她带来的慰藉与温暖，也在转瞬即逝之中渐渐消散了。
        
        那么，你没事吧？”她一边说着，一边用食指轻轻敲打着你的手臂。

说实话，从情绪上来说，你现在的状态只能算是一般般吧。除了那些常见的“恶魔入侵”症状之外，也没有什么其他特别的感受。

“喂，”德莉法撅着嘴，用拳头轻轻敲了敲你的手臂，表示抗议。“我是说你的身体状况啊！
        
        当然，你明白她的意思，但当她露出这么可爱的表情时，你怎么可能忍得住不去逗她呢？告诉她这件事之后，你只会得到一连串的捶打和推搡，而她的尾巴也会在身后不停地摆动。考虑到你经常看到德莉法情绪上显得很孤僻，因此看到她因为一点小小的玩笑而变得如此开心，实在是一件令人愉快的事情。于是，你便向她道了谢。 [party.hasCompanions
            |你允许德里法先去照顾你的其他同胞，然后再回来继续处理当前的事情。
            |让我们回到正题上来。
        ]
    ]

For the first time, Drifa takes the initiative and approaches you. Between the abnormal nature of this encounter and the pensiveness in her feather-light stance, there's no doubt about it, something's on her mind. Question is: what does she have to say? You won't lie, the last meeting you had with her could've ended better. As she lowers her red hood, you cast your focus to the blues of her blue and study her features for any leads as to what's in store.
    
    The halfbreed priestess takes a deep breath and says, "I'm sorry."
    
    Those words break the stalemate of silence and ring like a cacophony in your ears. Why's she sorry? Fearing the worst of what she might have to say, you don't want to ask; regardless, you do it anyway. 
    
    She swallows and says, "For running away."

    "It was wrong of me to do that to you. I just... didn't know how to take it all in," Drifa admits, placing a closed palm to her chest and relaxing her shoulders. "I just hope I didn't mess everything up and hurt you. I can tell you're [pc.isDK

[rand
        |Approaching Drifa, you place an open palm firmly between her two lupine ears. Alternating between gently rubbing her soft, dark hair and scritching her head, the half-lupine woman softens beneath your touch as her bushy tail vigorously disregards the air behind her and sweeps with a mind of its own.
        
        
        Closing her eyes and clenching her teeth, Drifa makes a long whine of contentment as the hand that was stroking her long, smooth hair moves to pin one of her canine ears. As your fingers reach behind her ear to itch that recluse spot, an opportunistic thumb finds itself stroking the soft, white inner fuzz of her ear while she's distracted. Holding her tongue between her teeth, she stiffles an immodest sound and aggressively nuzzles her head against your hand. Pulling her tongue back into her mouth, Drifa swallows hard and groans. "R-right there! Nnn, keep going!"
        
        [drifa.isCollared
            |Who's a good girl?
            
            "Me, I'm a good girl," she murmurs. "I'm a good girl!" 
            
        ]
        Drifa starts breathing rapidly and heavily as you apply yourself to her ear and head with an enthusiastic ardor. Picking up the pace with both hands now, you turn her lengthy dark hair into a disheveled mess. Vigorously rubbing her head, your hands become a blur until you start to feel your hands become tired; however, you don't want to stop, the compulsion to make an even bigger mess of her velvety-soft hair only grew. Through your intense efforts, she has become like clay in your hands. Under the delightful thrall of your petting, the touch-hungry woman's shoulders fall slack as her limp head bobs with your movements. Tousling her dark hair into an untidy display, the brows above Drifa's closed eyes furrow as she chuffs in bliss behind clenched teeth.
        
        Satisfied with your performance, you ruffle the bangs of her hair one last time for good measure before you withdraw your hand from her head. Drifa murmurs in incoherent mumbling, you think she's probably trying to say something, but it's incomprehensible at the moment. Rubbing your fingers together, waiting for Drifa to gather herself, there is still the lingering tactile sensation of her hair on your hands.
        
        After some time, the half-lupine woman's eyes flutter open and then takes a deep breath to steady herself. [weightedRand 1 3
            |She then looks[pc.heightRange 67
                | up
            ] at you with a [drifa.isCorrupt
                |mischievous glint in her eye
                |winsome smile
            ] and says, "My turn."
            
            Before you have time to fully process what she had just said, the [drifa.isCorrupt
                |wolf

            ]-girl grabs a hold of you and repays the favor. Starting from your forehead, she runs her svelte fingers along your [pc.hair]. Trailing her fingers back and forth on your head, she uses her nails to gently scritch your head.             ]. You've been working yourself tirelessly." Tugging you closer to her, she gracefully wanders both her hands to both sets of your ears. Her nurturing continues as her slender fingers pinch and glide along the contours of your [pc.raceAdjective] ears. "One of these days, whenever you have the time, you should let me work on you — to get all the knots and pent-up kinks out of your body. I can only imagine how tense you must be."
            
            [pc.raMulti kitsune elf
                |The foxen ears perched atop your head swivel and flick as if to escape her grasp, but her dainty hands pin them in place. With nowhere else to escape, you brace yourself for when her thumbs sink into the sensitive [pc.hairColor] fluff of your perky ears. Feeling her thumbs stroke the insides of your ears, you involuntarily drag a sharp breath and feel a trembling in your chest. Unbeknownst to the half-lupine, she's unaware of her action's impact on you as she continues with her innocuous, yet vigorous efforts.
                
                A sigh of exquisite delight parts from your lips as the numerous mass of tails sweep behind you. The warmth of her hands caressing against your sensitive fuzz is palpable yet she impishly continues unabated. Drifa then leans in and whispers into your ear. "It's fine, just relax and let me take care of you."

All you can do is shiver in her embrace as your mind struggles to stave off the mind-numbing sensation of her invasive fingers. She's making a mess of you and you're loving every second of it. Reduced to piteous, animalistic mewls and yips, your body intrinsically yearns for more of this physical contact. With a whim of its own, your head nuzzles against her exploratory palms. [rand
        |当你靠近德莉法时，你将一只手掌平放在她那双狼耳之间。你时而轻轻揉搓她那柔软、深色的毛发，时而又轻轻挠她的头。这位半狼半人的女性在你的抚摸下变得愈发柔软，而她那茂密的尾巴则完全不受控制地摆动着，仿佛有着自己的意志一般。
        
        
        德莉法闭上眼睛，咬紧牙关，当那只轻抚着她长而顺滑头发的手移到她的犬耳旁时，她发出了一声满足的呜咽声。当你的手指伸到她耳后去挠那个容易被忽略的地方时，你的拇指便趁机开始轻轻抚摸她耳朵内部柔软、洁白的绒毛——而她此时完全没有注意到这一点。她把舌头咬在牙间，强忍住那不雅的声响，然后用力把头贴在你的手上。德莉法把舌头重新含进嘴里，用力吞了口唾沫，然后呻吟道：“就、就在这里！嗯，继续啊！"
        
        [drifa.isCollared
            |谁是好女孩呢？
            
            “我，我就是好女孩，”她轻声说道，“我真的是好女孩！ 
            
        ]
        当你满怀热情地抚摸她的耳朵和头部时，德莉法的呼吸变得急促而沉重。你双手的动作节奏逐渐加快，将她那长长的黑发弄得乱七八糟。你用力地揉搓她的头发，双手的动作变得模糊不清，直到开始感到疲惫——然而，你却丝毫不想停下来，那种想要把她那柔软如丝的头发弄得更加凌乱的冲动只会与日俱增。在你的悉心照料下，她仿佛成了你手中的黏土。在你温柔的抚摸下，这个渴望被触碰的女人放松了身体，无力的头部随着你的动作轻轻摇晃。你将她那乌黑的头发弄得乱蓬蓬的，德莉法紧闭的双眼上方，眉毛紧锁着，她咬紧牙关，脸上洋溢着幸福的表情。
        
        对你们的表现感到满意，你最后一次轻轻拨了拨她的头发，然后才把手从她的头上拿开。德莉法发出了些含糊不清的低语声，你觉得她可能在试图表达什么，但此刻那些话语确实让人无法理解。你搓着手指，等待着德莉法恢复平静，她的头发留在你手上的触感依然萦绕在心头。
        
        过了一会儿，这个有着半狼族血统的女子终于睁开了眼睛，然后深吸一口气，试图让自己平静下来。 [weightedRand 1 3
            |然后她看向了那边。[pc.heightRange 67
                | 向上
            ]来吧，开始吧[drifa.isCorrupt
                |她眼中闪烁着调皮的光芒。
                |迷人的微笑
            ]然后她说：“现在轮到我了。”

                |狼
                |狗
            ]一个女孩抓住你的手，以此来报答你之前的帮助。她从你的额头开始，用她纤细的手指沿着你的身体缓缓滑动[pc.hair]她用手指轻轻地在你的头上滑动，指甲轻轻刮过你的头皮。你的身体瞬间变得僵硬，一股刺痛感从脊椎一直传到全身，但这种感觉很快消失了，取而代之的是一种舒缓的感觉。
            
            “我觉得，最需要被宠爱的人，就是你。 [drifa.isCollared
                |[pc.master]
                |[pc.name]
            ]你一直都在不懈地努力。”她将你拉得更近一些，然后优雅地将双手分别放在你的双耳旁。她那温柔的抚摸继续着，她纤细的手指轻轻捏着、滑过你耳廓的轮廓[pc.raceAdjective]有空的时候，你一定要让我帮你放松一下——把你身体里那些紧张的情绪和积压的压力都释放出来。我完全可以想象你现在一定非常紧张。

                [drifa.fucked
