rows.original: The next stop on Drifa's cleaning tour of duty is your throne room — it's as empty as the living quarters are, given that you're not holding any audiences at the moment. There's the impulse to take a seat and observe imperiously as Drifa hurries to clean your audience chamber, but she does need to clean the throne as well, and taking in the view from but one angle is undercutting yourself, isn't it? Still, you're not wholly alone as you were. Every now and then, one of the maids or Wayfort staff scurry through the end of the room en route to somewhere else, driving home the fact that there're others around. Drifa starts with [rand |several tapestries hanging on the far wall — using a stepladder, she takes them down and brings them out into an adjoining open-roofed space to get some sunshine. Before long, your hardworking [silly |doog |dog-girl ] has them strung up on a line with a carpet beater in hand, sending up clouds of fine dust into the air with each firm smack. Goodness, you'd no idea so much dust was gathering in your hall of rulership. But what draws your eye is the way she wields the carpet beater: instead of just using her arm and shoulder which would tire her out quickly, Drifa puts her full body into each swing. Time seems to slow down as her entire body tenses from temples to thighs, winding up for the blow; [drifa.pregStage 2 |even her big pregnant belly's useful in gathering momentum as opposed to just being a burden |even with the maid outfit in the way, the flexing and tightening of poor Drifa's muscles is plain with her exertions ]. Oh, that's quite the clever way of doing it. Perhaps a little slower, but by spreading out the burden over her whole body, Drifa can keep on going for a long time without needing to rest.[drifa.pregStage 2 | Given how she's so heavily pregnant with your puppies, you imagine she needs such techniques all the more. ] "T-thank you[drifa.isCollared |, [pc.master] ]!" The jolt of praise lances straight down and burns itself into the dog-girl's psyche; she just can't surmount her nature, nor does she want to. If anything, Drifa embraces it whole-heartedly: the unadulterated joy in her big blue eyes, framed by cheeks made rosy by the blush that's creeping into her [drifa.isCollared |collar |neck ] — it's simply to die for. "It does make beating out all that dust a lot easier. Look, I haven't even broken a sweat!" Well, well, what a smart girl she is! Did she come up with it by herself? "Oh, no. Mom used to clean up around the house, but when I tried helping her I just couldn't do the things she did because... well, I just didn't have her kind of build. So instead of trying to make me achieve what I couldn't — that is, having arms like hers — she helped me use the rest of what I had to produce the same result. There's a lot less strain on my shoulder this way, and I like moving my whole body, too!" |the centrepiece of your audience chamber — your throne. Stripping off what cushioning there is, Drifa replaces it with clean padding so that you can be nice and comfortable while going about the whole ruling business, rather than having to bear with a grungy seat. But that's just the beginning. Setting aside the cushioning to be washed later, your hardworking maid-dog starts the long, laborious process of polishing your throne and making it its most presentable — you do want to look your best while passing judgement, don't you? It's a deceptively simple matter of a rag and waxy polish that smells distinctly alchemical, but the gleaming shine that her efforts leave in their wake is marvelous, and she seems to do it all so effortlessly. She's using what the maids usually use to clean up, right? No personal secret metal polish or anything? "Everything's from the maid closet, [drifa.isCollared |[pc.master] |[pc.name] ]!" Drifa replies cheerfully. "You can wind up ruining wood and the like if you mix and match different types of polish willy-nilly, and since this isn't my usual job I didn't want to take the risk!" Maid closet, huh? Given the state that your wayfort's in most days, said maids are likely using it more for funny business than its ostensible purpose. Drifa's the only maid about your home that you've actually seen doing any actual cleaning instead of accidentally spilling drinks and adding to the mess to be made. Not just a priestess, but a truly exemplary example of a maid to boot! "W-why, thank you for the praise,[drifa.isCollared | [pc.master], ]" Drifa starts moaning before she realizes what she's doing and catches herself. Thoroughly embarrassed, her doggy ears turn down and to the sides behind her frilly headband, and she hurriedly turns away from you to focus on polishing your throne. Really, she's fooling no one by doing that, but you'll let it pass. Bent over your seat of rulership and furiously working away with her rag, the work of polishing isn't just a matter for Drifa's arms and shoulders, but her entire body. She's bent so far over that [drifa.pregStage 2 |her big pregnant belly hangs under her like a heavy, ripe fruit on the bough, its weight forcing her to twist her torso with each pass of her polishing cloth over the majesty of your throne. Blissfully oblivious to the fact that she's got her rear directed straight at the entrance and hence in full view of anyone passing by or through the throne room, Drifa continues to be a diligent dog. And that derriere... short as they are, Drifa's maid skirts have already ridden halfway up her rear thanks to her constantly wagging tail, the lacy hem stretched out over each juicy buttcheek as it clenches and flexes with the dog-girl's diligent polishing. There's no better way to frame how her hips and butt have widened and swollen in eager preparation to push out the growing puppies in her round tummy |the skirts of her maid uniform have stopped just at the line where thigh ends and butt begins, the lacy hem stretched out over the crease. Sheer as the fabric is, it can't hide the clenching and flexing of each pert cheek that accompanies the dog-girl's diligent polishing ], and the occasional maid who passes by en route elsewhere can't help but stop and give poor Drifa a burning, envious stare before hurrying on. Sauntering over and approaching Drifa from the side, you make a show of inspecting her handiwork; acting completely oblivious to the dog-girl's increasingly aroused state, you run a fingertip along your throne's armrest and raise it to eye level for inspection. Hmm, not a speck of dust to be had! You repeat the motion, only this time with the armrest's underside, and your fingertip remains squeaky clean. Frankly, you're amazed that Drifa's doing such a good job... or maybe it's just that the maids don't actually do a lot of maiding that clearing said bar isn't that much of a challenge. "P-please don't say such things, [drifa.isCollared |[pc.master] |[pc.name] ]," Drifa stammers, stumbling over her words at the sudden spike of arousal. "I'm sure they're doing their best." Well, whatever the case with others, Drifa's a great example of a hardworking dog[silly |go ]. Can she tell you how she manages to get such a shine without any fancy polish? "Well, [drifa.isCollared |[pc.master] |you see ], it's all in the forearm," she replies, a big smile on her face. "My mother taught me that — since I don't have the bulk that she has, she taught me how to put the weight of my whole body behind the thrust, really get it to move! That way, you can really show those stains and tarnish who's boss!" ] Suddenly realizing that she's gushing in public and more importantly, in front of you, Drifa stifles a whine in the back of her throat and turns back to her work. Sweat beads on her forehead and dampens the base of her frilly maid headband — it's true that she's been exerting herself, just not in the physical sense. She's controlling herself reasonably well, but the first real cracks in the dam are starting to show as the poor girl contends with the aftereffects of your praise; no matter how she tries, Drifa's body betrays her. It's not just the desperately stifled panting — she can't keep her tail from swishing to and fro, beating against the frilly lace skirts, nor can the give in the outfit's top conceal the hefty rise and fall of her bosom as her pulse quickens with heat. [drifa.pregStage 2 |And of course, the firm roundness of Drifa's [silly |baby bag |puppy purse ] — seeing her so desperately trying not to cradle and stroke it on the job, as blatantly full as it is, stretching out the front of the maid dress... one can almost pity her. Almost. ] And to think, you haven't even so much as touched her yet... Feigning complete and utter ignorance, you raise an eyebrow. Something the matter? "N-no[drifa.isCollared |, [pc.master] ]!" The overenthusiastic reply simply confirms the very opposite, but you play along with [drifa.isCollared |your poor puppy |poor Drifa ] and nod. It's really not like her to zone out in public for no good reason — even if this is your throne room, there are people passing through every so often when you're not holding audiences. She needs to better control herself, because she's in public. Those last words have the effect on Drifa you'd expected: caught between her sense of shame and the needs of her [drifa.pregStage 2 |hormonal, puppy-filled |animal ] body, the dog-girl freezes solid on the spot until you give her a reassuring pat on the shoulder. Now then, it's time for her to put the finishing touches on her work in the throne room and move on.     ]腾出空间，也确保德莉法的家人拥有照料它们所需的一切。德莉法对整个过程极其认真，已经重新站起身来四处走动。说实话，德莉法的母亲对此熟悉得很，你们两个几乎无事可做；到了中午，也该离开了。
    
    “谢谢你，妈妈。”德莉法说道[drifa.isCorrupt
        |
        |，紧紧抱住高大的狼人女性
    ]。“没有你，我们真不知道该怎么办。”
    
    “哦，别说这种话！”德莉法的母亲笑道，尾巴左右摇摆。“我喜欢陪孙辈们玩。我会像保护自己的孩子一样保护它们。你们去吃点东西吧。尤其是你，亲爱的，你需要恢复体力。”
    
    她挥手送别你们；你和德莉法一起走到外面，暂且喘口气。
    
    德莉法[drifa.isCorrupt
        |长长地叹了口气
        |微微一笑，发出一声虚弱的轻笑
    ]。
    
    你用手臂环住她，把她拉近，让她默默靠在自己身上。她闭上眼睛，缓慢地深呼吸了几次，随后转向你，双臂猛然环住你，紧紧抱了一下。接着，她又把你推开，让你保持在一臂之外，同时捏住你的双肩。
    
    “好了。”她说道。“我们回去继续吧。”
rows.raw:
'
    The next day starts with a bustle of activity, setting up Drifa's room for the additional pup[var0
        |s
    ] and ensuring Drifa's family has everything they need to take care of them. Drifa takes the whole process very seriously, already back on her feet and walking around. Truth be told, Drifa's mom is so familiar with the whole process that neither of you have much to do, and by noon it's time to leave.
    
    "Thanks, Mom," Drifa says[drifa.isCorrupt
        |
        |, hugging the large lupine woman tightly
    ]. "I don't know what we'd do without you."
    
    "Oh, please!" Drifa's mom laughs, tail wagging from side to side. "I love spending time with my grandkids. I'll protect them as if they're my own. You go on and get some food. Especially you, sweetie. You need to get your strength back up."
    
    She waves the two of you off and you walk outside with Drifa for a momentary breather.
    
    Drifa [drifa.isCorrupt
        |sighs at length
        |smiles and lets out a weak chuckle
    ].
    
    You put your arm around her and pull her close, letting her lean against you in silence. She closes her eyes and takes a few long, deep breaths before turning towards you and throwing her arms around you in a tight hug. Then she pushes you away, holding you at arm's length and squeezing your shoulders. 
    
    "Okay," she says. "Let's get back to it."
    '

rows.original: [var0 |A tap at the window wakes you up; Drifa and the twins are still asleep. After pushing yourself out of bed, you walk over to the window and open it to see a [flags.EIRA_MET |familiar face: it's the valkyrie courier, Eira! Wasting no time, she reaches into her pack, pulls out a medallion by its golden chain, and hands it to you — the bronze medallion, itself, is round with eight, elongated spokes reminiscent of a sun and a topaz set in the center of it. There's symbols in a strange script engraved along the concentric circles around the sun-like design. You can't make heads or tails of what it says. Nevertheless, you accept the amulet, but not without asking what it's for and who it's from. "This medallion is a blessed gift from [pc.isValkyrie |our |the ] goddess, Lumia. She wanted me to deliver this to you as thanks for dealing with the afflicted wolfmen, but also as a gesture of good luck for [drifa.isMarried |your wife |Drifa ]'s transition into motherhood[silly |. She's been watching your career with great interest ]." You thank Eira for this delivery and then ask what this medallion actually does. "This medallion is actually meant for Drifa," Eira says with a nod toward your sleeping companion. "It's blessed with the power to ease the burden of pregnancy and ensure the well-being of all her future children." [pc.isDK |You ask the divine courier if there's anything stopping you from just keeping the blessed trinket. "Well... I suppose there's nothing really stopping you, but please don't do that. Stealing someone else's package is [silly |a federal crime |generally considered to be a rude gesture ]." You tell Eira that you're just teasing her. ]You'll give it to Drifa once she wakes up. "Thank you, and congratulations on the twins." With nothing left to add, Eira spreads her wings and takes flight, continuing with the rest of her deliveries. After closing the window, you pull up a chair, sit next to Drifa, and wait for her to wake up. After some time later, you're roused to wakefulness when Drifa begins to stir. Yawning, you stretch out and turn to look at [drifa.isMarried |your wife |the wolf-girl ]. "Good morning," Drifa mutters before wiping the sleep from her eyes and sitting up. You ask Drifa if she's feeling any better. "Never better. Hey, what's that?" Drifa asks, looking at the medallion on your lap. You pass on Eira's message. |strange amulet sitting on the window sill — the bronze medallion, itself, is round with eight, elongated spokes reminiscent of a sun and a topaz set in the center of it. Nevertheless, you pick it up and bring it to Drifa. Maybe she'll know something about this; it's got lumian written all over it. You close the window, pull up a chair to her bedside, and wait for her to wake up. Some time later, you're roused when Drifa begins to stir. "Never better. Hey, what's that?" Drifa asks, looking at the medallion on your lap. Without complaint, you hand her the sun-shaped medallion; she sets it on her lap and meditates, tracing her fingers along the shape of the trinket. After a few minutes, she opens her eyes and regards you with a nod. "This thing... it's not just Lumia's holy symbol... it's a medallion that's been blessed with powerful fertility magic! Whoever enchanted this must've been a powerful priest or priestess. Where did you find this?" You tell her that you heard a knock and found it sitting on the window sill; you don't know who dropped it off or why, but you reckon that whoever did it, did so with deliberate purpose. With everything that's happened thus far, it can't have been a coincidence. ] "I see. [drifa.isCorrupt |At the very least, we've got a trinket with a powerful enchantment on it. "I can keep it around for its blessing to ease the burden of childbirth... or..." Or what? After a pregnant pause, Drifa says, "we can take the medallion to the eldritch pool in the corrupted mine and perform some... alterations on it. I bet that, if I performed a lumian incantation and bathed the medallion in the goop, I can twist its fertility magic into something more! That said, I don't think Lumia would like us messing with her gift; what I do is your choice, though. I won't look a gift horse in the mouth." |I'm glad Lumia sees me worthy enough for such a blessed gift. Drifa reaches into a pouch and pulls out a medallion by its golden chain— the bronze medallion, itself, is round with eight, elongated spokes reminiscent of a sun and a topaz set in the center of it. There's symbols in a strange script engraved along the concentric circles around the sun-like design. "I found this at my window the day after I gave birth. It's a medallion that's been blessed with powerful fertility magic! Whoever enchanted this must've been a powerful priest or priestess. What do you think we should do with it?" ]

[pc.isValkyrie |我们的 |那个 ]女神卢米娅。她让我把这份礼物交给您，既是为了感谢您帮助那些受苦的狼人，也是为了祝您好运。 [drifa.isMarried |你的妻子 |德莉法 ]她从普通女性转变为母亲的这一过程[silly |她一直非常关注你的发展历程。 rows.original:
Drifa picks up the medallion by its golden chain and puts it on. "It's light. So... how do I look?"

        Drifa [drifa.isCorrupt

Then she pushes you away, holding you at arm's length and squeezing your shoulders. 
        
        "Okay," she says. "Let's get back to it."

rows.translation: 让德莉法留着这枚徽章，用它的力量来减轻怀孕的负担。

rows.original: You like the sound of [pc.isDK |your bitch |Drifa ] becoming much more fertile. However, you do have some questions. Drifa raises an eyebrow. "Oh?" The way she so readily came up with the idea of using the medallion this way... it feels like she's been planning something like this for a while. "Perceptive, aren't you?" Sighing, Drifa lets the medallion hang loose from her fingers and sway idly from its chain. Back and forth, back and forth... all while she cozies up to you. If it's a ploy to get your affection, it's working. "Nothing escapes your notice, huh?" She's become a lot more honest about her feelings and desires, especially when it's with you. "Hehe. But yes, I've been thinking about it for a good while now. After we left the mine, in fact." She pauses, lining up her thoughts with her words. "You remember Asgeir and Rimescore, don't you?" rows.original: All right, this makes sense; Drifa's answered your questions and is confident enough that her plan will work. Is she up for the trek, or does she want to lie in a little longer? "I'll make the energy even if I don't have it. Don't worry about me, [pc.name] — honestly, you should be worried for yourself." That's the spirit! You take Drifa by the hand and help her out of bed, then tuck in the tiny pair of half-lupines — Drifa's family will take care of them in your absence. Afterward, Drifa and you gather your gear before setting out through the northern exit of the village, entering the wilderness. As you venture closer to the mountains, the vegetation thins out, making way for high ledges of stone and compact clay. Steep escarpments divide this part of the region from the rest of the Old Forest. Without the threat of danger, you make your ascent up the sandy, foot-worn trail which snakes up the cliffside. [wayfort.hasDrifa
        |Using the Waystone, [party.hasCompanions
            |you wave goodbye to [party.compNames] before
        ] you and Drifa travel the Ways Between until you arrive in Hawkethorne. Standing before the heroic statue in the middle of town, the two of you gather your bearings before continuing forth. 
    ]Together, you and Drifa idly walk the bustling streets of Hawkethorne.
    
    "So, where to first, [pc.name]?" Drifa asks. "Do we go to Garth's, my parent's place to get their blessing, or Nelia's to get our outfits?"
    
    You recommend going to Nelia's place first. Once you've got an estimate, you can give a proper date to her parents so they can set things up. No point in letting her family find out last; if her parents say no (which [pc.isDK
        |would have no effect on your plan to marry this woman
        |is unlikely
    ]), then that complicates things since it's her mother's connection with Garret that'll open the door for the Frosthound Inn to be used for the event.
    
    "To Nelia's!"
    
    Together, you and Drifa make your way to Nelia's place.
    
    It is a strange union, perhaps; strange circumstances of meeting, a strange way in which the relationship developed. Whether by sheer coincidence or by fate, you met, fell in love, and now spend your days in something approaching marital bliss even when everything hasn't been formalized yet. While it may seem to be nothing short of a fairy tale, it is everything but; the woman walking next to you is living proof of that.
    
    Drifa laughs. "I didn't think I'd meet the love of my life while [drifa.isCorrupt
        |[drifa.captured
            |getting my ass beat
            |kicking ass
        ]
        |fighting to protect my hometown
    ]. I didn't even think I'd get married back then."
    
    You doubt she would've gotten married if she didn't meet you. After all, she's not much of a people person.
    
    "[drifa.isCorrupt
        |Always have been." Drifa pats your back.
        |Aw, you butt!" Drifa punches your arm. 
        
        Ow, ouch! You tell Drifa you're just messing with her.
        
        "Who's a shy girl now? Not me." Drifa beams in aplomb and gently rubs your arm, soothing the spot with a healing spell.
    ] "Don't worry, I'm sure we'll have more trials and tribulations we'll face together. If there's anyone who I'd want to face forever, it's you. I don't know if it's fate or not that we met, regardless, I'm glad we did."
    
    Perhaps it's better to say that it wasn't fate. You still would've been attracted to her.

    ]“别担心，我相信以后还会有更多考验与磨难等着我们一起面对。若要挑一个永远与我共同面对它们的人，那只能是你。我不知道我们的相遇是不是命运，但无论如何，我很高兴我们遇见了彼此。”
    
    也许说这不是命运才更合适。即使没有安排，你依然会被她吸引。
rows.raw:
"
    [wayfort.hasDrifa
        |Using the Waystone, [party.hasCompanions
            |you wave goodbye to [party.compNames] before
        ] you and Drifa travel the Ways Between until you arrive in Hawkethorne. Standing before the heroic statue in the middle of town, the two of you gather your bearings before continuing forth. 
    ]Together, you and Drifa idly walk the bustling streets of Hawkethorne.
    
    "So, where to first, [pc.name]?" Drifa asks. "Do we go to Garth's, my parent's place to get their blessing, or Nelia's to get our outfits?"
    
    You recommend going to Nelia's place first. Once you've got an estimate, you can give a proper date to her parents so they can set things up. No point in letting her family find out last; if her parents say no (which [pc.isDK
        |would have no effect on your plan to marry this woman
        |is unlikely
    ]), then that complicates things since it's her mother's connection with Garret that'll open the door for the Frosthound Inn to be used for the event.
    
    "To Nelia's!"
    
    Together, you and Drifa make your way to Nelia's place.
    
    It is a strange union, perhaps; strange circumstances of meeting, a strange way in which the relationship developed. Whether by sheer coincidence or by fate, you met, fell in love, and now spend your days in something approaching marital bliss even when everything hasn't been formalized yet. While it may seem to be nothing short of a fairy tale, it is everything but; the woman walking next to you is living proof of that.
    
    Drifa laughs. "I didn't think I'd meet the love of my life while [drifa.isCorrupt
        |[drifa.captured
            |getting my ass beat
            |kicking ass
        ]
        |fighting to protect my hometown
    ]. I didn't even think I'd get married back then."
    
    You doubt she would've gotten married if she didn't meet you. After all, she's not much of a people person.
    
    "[drifa.isCorrupt
        |Always have been." Drifa pats your back.
        |Aw, you butt!" Drifa punches your arm. 
        
        Ow, ouch! You tell Drifa you're just messing with her.
        
        "Who's a shy girl now? Not me." Drifa beams in aplomb and gently rubs your arm, soothing the spot with a healing spell.
    ] "Don't worry, I'm sure we'll have more trials and tribulations we'll face together. If there's anyone who I'd want to face forever, it's you. I don't know if it's fate or not that we met, regardless, I'm glad we did."
    
    Perhaps it's better to say that it wasn't fate. You still would've been attracted to her."

rows.original: You arrive at Nelia's place before long; a small, low to the ground stall with a sign saying %"Under- and Over-clothes" sits near the edge of the market. The display has a selection of various bits of clothing—mostly underclothes, but some hats and belts populate the display as well. Behind the small counter, you see Nelia, the motherly-looking stallkeep hard at work. "Oh heya, sweetie," Nelia says to Drifa with a wave before going back to sewing something behind her stall." How can I help you two to[dayNight |day |night ]?" You explain to Nelia that you're going to be having a wedding in a few days, and that the two of you need outfits for the occasion. "In a few days?" The goblin woman puts a hand over her mouth. "Oh my! Will this have to be a rush order?" "Not quite," Drifa says. You add that the date of the event itself is subjective to how long it'd take her to get the outfits made and ready. The idea, though, is that it'd be within the week. "Normally this'd be double my rate for a rush order, but since you're one of us and keeping the village safe, I can make an exception for you two. And besides, what's life without a little challenge?" You offer to pay for yours and Drifa's outfit, but your fiance refuses, insisting you pay for just your own while she pays for hers. "I've got money; we went through the corrupted mine together, didn't we? And besides, what I want should be a secret. You wouldn't want to ruin the surprise before our wedding day, would you?" "Aw, just look at you two lovebirds," Nelia says, grabbing a stick with measured notches on it before hopping off her seat and walking towards you. "I'll make sure you two are fit as a fiddle on your wedding day." As she's taking your measurements, she asks, "what color and style do you want your outfits to have?" You pick out what you want for your [pc.mascFem |suit |dress ], but Drifa gets down to a knee and whispers what she wants into Nelia's ear. As she's listening to what she has to say, the goblin eyes you, smirks, and croons, "oh my... you darlings will look lovely together." You're now curious about what Drifa told her. What did she say to elicit such a reaction from Nelia? You hope Drifa didn't ask for something gaudy; knowing her, though, it [drifa.isCorrupt |must've been something risque |can't have been anything risque. She's too reserved for that. Your fiance would self-combust before she wore anything lewd in public ]. "You can count on me being there," Nelia says before going off onto a tangent about her own past wedding. But before long, she comes back with an answer. "I'll have your outfits ready within six days at the latest. Just come on by whenever you're free." At least you've now got an answer — six days. Without further ado, you follow Drifa back to her home. Once inside, Drifa calls out to her parents. "Hey mom, dad? I'm back!" Drifa shouts. "I made some stew if you're hungry sweetie," [drifa.familyMet |Drifa's mom says |a mature woman's voice echoes ] from another part of the house. "I've got great news!" Drifa shouts back. "Can you come here? I'm helping your little sister right now." Drifa looks at you and shrugs before heading deeper You watch as [drifa.familyMet |Drifa's mom tends to a bruise on Elise's cheek |an imposing wolfwoman with a hefty bosom sitting cross-legged, tending to a bruise on a little girl's cheek — a little girl, who couldn't be more than nine years of age, who looks a lot like a miniature version of Drifa. That must be Drifa's mother and her kid sister ]. "Where's dad?" Drifa asks. "I need to tell you all something." Drifa's mom licks her thumb and brushes the little girl's cheek. "Dad left a little while ago with his friends. If their butts don't run into trouble out there, he should be back after a week or two. That just leaves poor Elise and I here. Isn't that right?" Drifa's mom turns back to Drifa's sister and pinches her cheeks. After that, she tousles Elise's hair and directs her attention to Drifa, letting the little rapscallion scamper off. "So, what's the big news, sweetie?" Your fiancee holds up her hand, showing her mother the ring on her finger. Excitedly, Drifa announces, "[pc.name] just proposed to me! I'm getting married!" The tail behind Drifa's mother starts wagging, and she picks up her daughter for a big hug. "That's great! Curse your father for not being here. When's the wedding? I'll drag that bastard here if he thinks he's missing his daughter's big day." You answer that it'll be in six or seven days. That's when your outfits are finished. You then broach the idea of postponing the wedding until Drifa's father returns. "Not happening," Drifa's mother says, setting her daughter back down. "The wedding will happen when you kids get your outfits. Can't trust Nelia to keep a secret; if she knows, then the whole village will know. The longer we make everyone wait, the rowdier they'll become. The people here are dying for an excuse to have some festive fun." "Actually..." Drifa raises a finger, "that's why I... we need your help. Can you talk to Garth so we can host the wedding at his place?" "Of course, sweetie. However..." Drifa's mom scratches her chin, "it might be best if we have the wedding at the chapel. Many of the newbloods here are from the south and don't share our way of life. They're scared of a little rough and tumble action. Their kind of celebration is a bit too stuffy for my tastes, but the people seem to prefer it that way. But, once that's out of the way, I'm sure we can carry on with the festivities at Garth's place for a tried and true lupine wedding! How does that sound?" "[drifa.isCorrupt |To be honest, mom, I don't care what everyone else wants. It's what I want that matters. But whatever. Go with that. I just want this day to go smoothly |That sounds... nice. I remember Sanders talking about lumian weddings; having both can be fun, and it appeases everyone. Let's go with that ]." Drifa's mom continues, "don't worry about the rings. I'll pay Ogrish for some wedding bands. We can even have your little sister be the ringbearer." "Why can't we just use these rings again?" Drifa asks, holding up her hand, referring to the ring already on her finger. "I don't know, sweetie, but them's the rules: you can't use your promise rings as wedding rings." "The rules are dumb!" Drifa pouts, but her mom tousles her hair, getting her to smile. [drifa.familyMet |Drifa's mom |The large lupine woman ] regards you and says, "sorry, but you'll have to avoid seeing my baby girl for a few days. Don't worry," she gives you a toothy grin and thumps her chest with a fist, "I'll make sure no one takes her from you. It breaks my heart to give my little girl away, but you've got my blessing." She then places a hand on your shoulder and gets real close as she says in a hushed tone, "by blood and ice, if I hear you laying a finger on my baby girl or you end up making her cry, I'm breaking every single bone in your body and then dumping your body into the River Ridell. Do I make myself clear?" [pc.isDK |You[pc.isStrong | remove the wolfwoman's hand from your shoulder and ] recommend that she doesn't try intimidating her daughter's fiance. You're not some spineless coward who'll run away at the first sign of trouble, and you're not going to be bullied into submission, even if it's your soon-to-be wife's mother. Drifa's mother smiles, comforted by your otherwise rude response. "You've got a strong spirit. My daughter picked a good, strong [pc.manWoman] |You tell her that no harm will come to her daughter. Drifa's mom smiles and pats your shoulder. "Good ]. I don't want what happened to Gwyn to happen to my baby girl. No [pc.manWoman] is going to skip town on my daughter."
rows.translation: 不久之后，你就来到了内莉娅的摊位前。那个摊位很小，高度很低，摊位上挂着一个牌子，上面写着“内衣与外衣”。摊位上陈列着各式各样的衣物——主要是内衣，但也有一些帽子和腰带。在小柜台后面，你可以看到看起来像位母亲般的摊主内莉娅正在埋头工作。 “哦，嗨，亲爱的，”内莉娅一边向德莉法招手致意，一边回到自己的摊位后面继续缝制什么东西。“你们两位需要帮忙吗？[dayNight |天 |夜晚 ]你向内莉娅解释说，几天后你就要结婚了，因此你们俩都需要为这个场合准备合适的服装。 “几天后？”那个哥布林女子捂住了嘴。哦天啊！这难道真的需要紧急处理吗？” “也不完全是，”德莉法说道。 她进一步解释说，活动的具体日期其实取决于她制作和准备这些服装所需的时间。不过，她保证这些工作肯定能在一周内完成。 通常情况下，加急订单的费用会是平常价格的两倍，但既然你是我们中的一员，也在为保护村庄而努力，那我就可以为你们俩破例。再说，生活中如果没有一点挑战，还有什么意义呢？” 你提出要承担自己和德莉法服装的费用，但你的未婚夫拒绝了，坚持让你只支付自己的费用，而由她来承担德莉法的服装费用。 我有钱；我们不是一起经历了那座被破坏的矿井吗？而且，我想要的东西应该秘密你总不会想在我们结婚那天破坏这个惊喜吧？” “哎呀，看看你们这两对恩爱夫妻吧，”内莉娅说着，拿了一根刻有刻度的木棍，从座位上跳下来朝你们走去。“我会确保你们在结婚那天看起来无比般配的。”在她测量你们的尺寸时，她问道：“你们想要什么颜色和风格的服装呢？” 你们选出了自己想要的服装款式[pc.mascFem |适合 |衣服 ]但是，德莉法单膝跪地，将她想要说的话轻声告诉了内莉娅。当内莉娅听着她的话语时，那个哥布林用它那双眼睛盯着你，露出狡黠的笑容，然后低声说道：“哦，我的天啊……你们这两个可爱的人看起来可爱极了一起吧。” 现在你一定很好奇德莉法对内莉娅说了什么。她究竟说了什么，才会让内莉娅有这样的反应呢？你希望德莉法没有提出什么过分的要求；不过，以她的性格来说[drifa.isCorrupt |肯定是一些比较大胆、刺激的内容吧…… |肯定不会有什么过分大胆的行为。她太内敛了，根本不会做出那种事。在你的未婚妻在公共场合穿上任何挑逗性的衣服之前，你的未婚夫早就先“自燃”了！ ]你可以放心，我一定会去的，”涅莉亚说道，然后突然转而开始谈论她自己过去的婚礼。不过没过多久，她又给出了答案：“最迟六天内，我一定会把你的礼服准备好的。有空的时候随时过来吧。” 至少你现在得到了一个答案——六天。于是，你没有再犹豫，跟着德莉法回到了她的家。一进门，德莉法就叫起了她的父母。 “妈妈，爸爸？我回来了！”德莉法喊道。 “如果你饿了，我做了些炖菜哦，亲爱的。 [drifa.familyMet |德莉法的妈妈说 |一位成熟女性的声音在空气中回荡…… ]从房子的另一个地方传来了声音。 “我有好消息！”德莉法大声回应道。 “你能过来一下吗？我现在正在帮你妹妹呢。” 德莉法看了你一眼，耸了耸肩，然后继续往里面走去。 你目送着她离开[drifa.familyMet |德莉法的妈妈正在处理艾莉丝脸颊上的淤伤。 |一位身材魁梧、胸部丰满的狼女盘腿而坐，正在照料一个小女孩脸颊上的淤伤——那个小女孩显然不超过九岁，她的模样很像德莉法的缩小版。那一定是德莉法的母亲和她的妹妹吧。 ]爸爸去哪儿了？”德莉法问道，“我有件事要告诉大家。” 德莉法的妈妈舔了舔拇指，然后轻轻抚了抚小女孩的脸颊：“爸爸刚才和朋友们一起出去了。如果他们在外面没有遇到什么麻烦，大概一两周后就会回来。这样就只剩下可怜的艾莉丝和我在这里了，对吧？”德莉法的妈妈转过身，捏了捏德莉法的妹妹的脸颊，然后又弄乱了艾莉丝的头发，将她的注意力引向德莉法，让那个小调皮鬼跑开了。那么，有什么好消息要告诉妈妈吗？” 你的未婚妻举起手，让她的母亲看到她手指上的戒指。德拉法兴奋地宣布道：[pc.name]刚刚向我求婚了！我们就要结婚了！” 德拉菲的母亲听到这个消息后，尾巴立刻开始摇动起来，她立刻抱起女儿，紧紧地拥抱了她。“太好了！真希望你父亲能在场……婚礼什么时候举行？如果那个混蛋以为自己能错过女儿的重要日子，我就把他拖到这里来。” 你回答说婚礼将在六七天后举行，因为那时你的礼服也才会准备好。然后你可以提出把婚礼推迟到德莉法的父亲回来之后再办。 不行，”德莉法的母亲说道，然后把女儿重新放回座位上。“等你们这些孩子都准备好礼服之后，婚礼才会举行。根本不能信任内莉娅，她根本守不住秘密；如果她知道了，整个村子的人都会知道的。我们让大家都等得越久，他们就会变得越吵闹。这里的人们其实非常渴望有一个借口来好好庆祝一番。” “其实……”德莉法举起一根手指，“这就是我…… 我们需要你的帮助。你能和加斯谈谈吗，这样我们就可以在他的家里举办婚礼了。” “当然可以，亲爱的。不过……”德莉法的妈妈挠了挠下巴，“在教堂里举办婚礼可能会更好。这里很多新来的人都是从南方来的，他们并不认同我们的生活方式。他们害怕一点激烈的打闹场面。他们的庆祝方式对我来说有点过于拘谨，不过大家似乎更喜欢这种方式。不过，等这些事情都解决了，我相信我们可以在加斯家里继续举行这场传统而经典的狼族婚礼庆典！这样听起来怎么样？[drifa.isCorrupt |说实话，妈妈，我不在乎别人想要什么。我只在乎自己想要什么。我重要的是你想要什么。不过不管怎样，就选那个吧。我只希望这一天能够顺利进行。 |那听起来……不错。我记得桑德斯提到过 Lumian 的婚礼仪式；两种仪式都举行的话会很有趣，也能让大家都满意。我们就这么办吧。 ]德莉法的妈妈继续说道：“别担心那些戒指的事。我会付钱给奥格里什，让他为我们准备一些结婚戒指。甚至可以让你的妹妹来担任捧戒人。” “为什么我们不能直接再使用这些戒指呢？德莉法举手问道，指的是她手指上已经戴着的戒指。 “我不知道，亲爱的，但规则就是这样的：你不能把订婚戒指当作结婚戒指来使用。” “这些规则太愚蠢了！德莉法撅起了嘴，但她的妈妈轻轻揉了揉她的头发，让她露出了笑容。 [drifa.familyMet |德莉法的妈妈 |那个高个子的狼人女性 ]她跟你说：“对不起，但在接下来的几天里，你得暂时不能见我的女儿了。别担心，”她露出灿烂的笑容，然后用拳头敲了敲自己的胸膛，“我一定会确保没人能把我的女儿从你身边带走。虽然把我的小女儿交给别人让我很伤心，但我完全支持你的决定。然后她把手放在你的肩上，凑近你的耳边，用低沉的声音说道：“以血和冰为誓，如果我听到你敢对我的女儿动一根手指头，或者让你让她哭一场，我会打断你身上的每一根骨头，然后把你的尸体扔进里德尔河。我说得够清楚了吗？ [pc.isDK |你[pc.isStrong | 把那个女狼的手从你的肩膀上拿开，然后…… ]建议她不试试吓唬她女儿的未婚夫吧。你可不是那种一遇到麻烦就逃之夭夭的懦夫，更不会被欺负得屈服，哪怕对方是你未来妻子的母亲。 德莉法的母亲看到你如此强硬的回应，不禁露出了笑容：“你真有骨气。我女儿选了个好伴侣，一个坚强的人。 [pc.manWoman] |你告诉她，她的女儿不会受到任何伤害。 德莉法的妈妈微笑着拍了拍你的肩膀：“很好。 ]我绝不想让我的女儿也遭遇格温所经历的一切。绝对不行。 [pc.manWoman]他打算带着女儿离开这个城市。

You then broach the idea of postponing the wedding until Drifa's father returns. "Not happening," Drifa's mother says, setting her daughter back down. "The wedding will happen when you kids get your outfits. Can't trust Nelia to keep a secret; if she knows, then the whole village will know. The longer we make everyone wait, the rowdier they'll become. The people here are dying for an excuse to have some festive fun." "Actually..." Drifa raises a finger, "that's why I... we need your help. Can you talk to Garth so we can host the wedding at his place?" "Of course, sweetie. However..." Drifa's mom scratches her chin, "it might be best if we have the wedding at the chapel. Many of the newbloods here are from the south and don't share our way of life. They're scared of a little rough and tumble action. Their kind of celebration is a bit too stuffy for my tastes, but the people seem to prefer it that way. But, once that's out of the way, I'm sure we can carry on with the festivities at Garth's place for a tried and true lupine wedding! How does that sound?" "[drifa.isCorrupt |To be honest, mom, I don't care what everyone else wants. It's what I want that matters. But whatever. Go with that. I just want this day to go smoothly |That sounds... nice. I remember Sanders talking about lumian weddings; having both can be fun, and it appeases everyone. Let's go with that ]." Drifa's mom continues, "don't worry about the rings. I'll pay Ogrish for some wedding bands. We can even have your little sister be the ringbearer." "Why can't we just use these rings again?" Drifa asks, holding up her hand, referring to the ring already on her finger. "I don't know, sweetie, but them's the rules: you can't use your promise rings as wedding rings." "The rules are dumb!" Drifa pouts, but her mom tousles her hair, getting her to smile. [drifa.familyMet |Drifa's mom |The large lupine woman ] regards you and says, "sorry, but you'll have to avoid seeing my baby girl for a few days. Don't worry," she gives you a toothy grin and thumps her chest with a fist, "I'll make sure no one takes her from you. It breaks my heart to give my little girl away, but you've got my blessing." She then places a hand on your shoulder and gets real close as she says in a hushed tone, "by blood and ice, if I hear you laying a finger on my baby girl or you end up making her cry, I'm breaking every single bone in your body and then dumping your body into the River Ridell. Do I make myself clear?" [pc.isDK |You[pc.isStrong | remove the wolfwoman's hand from your shoulder and ] recommend that she doesn't try intimidating her daughter's fiance. You're not some spineless coward who'll run away at the first sign of trouble, and you're not going to be bullied into submission, even if it's your soon-to-be wife's mother. Drifa's mother smiles, comforted by your otherwise rude response. "You've got a strong spirit. My daughter picked a good, strong [pc.manWoman] |You tell her that no harm will come to her daughter. Drifa's mom smiles and pats your shoulder. "Good ]. I don't want what happened to Gwyn to happen to my baby girl. No [pc.manWoman] is going to skip town on my daughter.""

rows.original:
For the next few days, you rehearse your vows and celebrate at the inn with your companions. News of the local wedding spreads fast in this bustling village, and the gregarious populace grows increasingly rowdy as the day of the ceremony gets closer and closer. You can only imagine how wild the occasion is going to be at the wedding. After you pick up your [pc.mascFem
                |suit
                |dress
            ] from Nelia, you find Brother Sanders waiting for you at the inn.
            
            "[silly
                |Hello there
                |Ah, there you are, [pc.name]
            ]. I see you have the proper attire; I'll give you time to get changed, but I wish to talk to you before the event. Once you're ready, come back and we'll talk."
            
            You go up to your room and spend a couple minutes getting changed into your fancy [pc.mascFem
                |suit
                |dress
            ]. After going over your vows one last time, you head back downstairs and regroup with Brother Sanders. 
            
            "Come. Sit with me," Sanders says, gesturing to the empty spot on the bench next to him.
            
            You oblige and sit down. Aside from the wedding, you ask Sanders what the special occasion is for this meeting.
            
            "Firstly, I'd like to congratulate you on your wedding. Tell me: are you nervous?"
            
            [pc.isChamp
                |You admit that you're a little nervous. Who wouldn't be? It's an important day and you don't want to screw up. You've been rehearsing your vows for days on end.
                
                "That's more than a few other folks I've arranged
                |Not even in the slightest.
                
                Brother Sanders laughs. "Now I know you're bluffing
            ]. Jokes aside, I'm glad you wished to celebrate the occasion. The people were looking for something to liven up their spirits, what with everything going on as of late. Now... let me ask you this: do you care about Drifa?"
            
            What is this question? Of course you do! You assure him that you love Drifa with all your heart.
            
            The good priest smiles and nods, content with your answer. "I've known Drifa since her family first moved to this village. Growing up, she's always had a strong fascination with the teachings and precepts of Lumia. Her becoming a lay priestess of Lumia was only natural. What I'm trying to say is that the idea of family means a lot to that girl. The sacrament of marriage is a holy bond between lovers — a bond which would destroy her if broken. If you're not ready, this is your chance to let her know before it's too late. There's no shame in giving it more time."
            
            You remain steadfast in your plans: [pc.isDK
                |Drifa will be yours
                |you're going to marry Drifa
            ] if it's the last thing you do!
            
            "Then you're a better [pc.manWoman] than most." He pats your back and stands up "Don't stress about the ceremony too much. I'll handle everything. With that said, I think it's time we get you married."
            
            You follow Brother Sanders back to the chapel where you find a whole crowd of people waiting. The priest isn't wrong; people are excited for this event.
            
            "Many of the families in Hawkethorne know each other, so it's only natural that they'd come and support each other during this momentous occasion," Sanders says. "Drifa might not recognize it, but people do care about her. I fear Garth is going to wrangle many rambunctious patrons this afternoon."
            
            Once the crowd spots you and Sanders, they begin taking their seats in the chapel. Upon entering, you see your companions already waiting and ready to support you. If anything goes wrong, they've got your back. Walking down the aisle, you take your place beside them and wait for your soon-to-be bride.
            
            Before long, the door is pushed open, and it's none other than Drifa walking in.
rows.translation:
在接下来的几天里，你们反复练习着要说的誓言，并与朋友们一起在客栈里庆祝。在这个热闹的村庄里，关于这场婚礼的消息传播得非常快，而随着婚礼日期的临近，那些喜欢聚众闹事的村民们也变得越来越喧闹。你可以想象，婚礼当天的场面一定会热闹非凡吧。在你们准备好一切之后[pc.mascFem
                |适合
                |衣服
            ]从内莉娅那里得知，桑德斯修士正在客栈里等你。[silly
                |你好啊
                |啊，你终于来了。 [pc.name]
            ]我看你已经穿好了合适的服装；我会给你一些时间让你换衣服，但在活动开始之前，我想先和你谈谈。等你准备好了，再回来找我，我们再继续讨论。”

你回到自己的房间，花了几分钟时间换上了那套漂亮的服装。 [pc.mascFem
                |适合
                |衣服
            ]在再次回顾了你们的誓言之后，你回到了楼下，与桑德斯修士会合。

“过来，坐我旁边吧。”桑德斯说着，指了指他旁边长椅上的空位。

你便坐了下来。除了询问婚礼的相关事宜外，你还问桑德斯，这次聚会究竟是有什么特别的缘故。

“首先，我想祝贺你们结婚了。告诉我，你现在紧张吗？”桑德斯问道。
            
            [pc.isChamp
                |你承认自己有点紧张。谁会不紧张呢？今天是重要的一天，你当然不想搞砸任何事情。这些誓词，你已经反复练习了好几天了。

“这可比我之前为其他人准备的那些誓词认真多了。
                |一点也不。  

桑德斯修士笑了起来：“现在我知道你在虚张声势了。
            ]说正经的，我很高兴你想要庆祝这个时刻。最近发生了这么多事情，大家确实都需要一些东西来振奋一下情绪。现在……我想问你一个问题：你关心德莉法吗？这个问题是什么意思？你当然爱她啊！你要向他保证，你是全心全意地爱着德莉法的。”

那位善良的牧师微笑着点了点头，对你的回答很满意。“从德莉法的家人第一次搬到这个村子的时候，我就认识她了。在成长过程中，她一直对卢米娅的教义与戒律怀有浓厚的兴趣。因此，她成为一名卢米娅的平信徒女祭司，也是理所当然的事情。我想说的是，对于那个女孩来说，“家庭”这个概念意味着非常重要的东西。婚姻这一神圣的仪式，是恋人之间彼此联系的纽带——一旦这条纽带被打破，将会给双方带来无法挽回的伤害。如果你还没有准备好，现在就是个机会，让你在为时已晚之前告诉她。给自己一些时间，并没有什么可羞愧的。
            
            你依然坚持着自己的计划不动摇： [pc.isDK
                |德莉法将会属于你。
                |你将会嫁给德莉法。
            ]就算这是你最后要做的事情也要去做！

“那么，你就更[pc.manWoman]比大多数人都更值得。”他拍了拍你的背，然后站了起来：“别太为这场仪式担心，一切有我负责。话虽如此，我觉得是时候让你结婚了。”

你跟着桑德斯修士回到了小教堂，发现那里已经有一大群人在等待了。牧师说得没错，人们确实对这一活动感到兴奋。

“在鹰棘镇，很多家庭彼此都认识，所以在这种重要的时刻，他们互相支持、前来参加活动，这也是很自然的事情，”桑德斯说道。德莉法可能没有意识到，但人们其实很关心她。我担心加斯今天下午会遇到很多调皮捣蛋的顾客。”

当人群看到你和桑德斯后，他们便开始在礼拜堂里找座位坐下。一进门，你就会看到你的同伴已经在那里等候着，准备为你提供支持。如果遇到任何问题，他们一定会站在你身边。沿着通道走下去，你在他们旁边站好位置，等待着即将成为你新娘的人出现。
            
            不久之后，门被推开了，走进来的人正是德莉法。

rows.original:
Standing before you, Drifa is adorned in an extremely beautiful white bridal gown. Belted around her waist is a black strip with embroidered gold sunbursts — the symbol of her goddess, Lumia. The long-flowing dress leaves her shoulders bare, but her arms are richly adorned with silken sleeves. Her immaculately groomed hair is decorated with a pair of blue flowers on either side of her head. One thing comes to mind when you see your soon-to-be wife: her absolute, radiant beauty. [drifa.isCorrupt
                    |If you didn't know better, you'd think she's her old self.
                ]
                [var0]
                Gentle entrance music is played by River, and the assembly stands while Drifa takes her place.
                
                Your eyes meet hers, and she instinctively lowers her gaze. That won't do. Gently, you reach out with a finger and catch her chin, forcing her to meet your eyes. You'll make her the happiest woman alive, you promise.
                
                Sanders begins. "Dearly beloved, we are gathered here today today to join [pc.mf
                    |this man and this woman
                    |these two women
                ] in holy matrimony. [pc.name] and Drifa have you come here to enter into marriage without coercion, freely and wholeheartedly?"
                
                You and Drifa consent.
                
                "Are you prepared, as you follow the path of marriage, to love and honor each other for as long
                as you both shall live?"
                
                Yes, you are.
                
                "I am," Drifa says, looking at you and smiling.
                
                Brother Sanders continues, "since it is your intention to enter the covenant of Holy Matrimony, join your right hands, and declare your consent before the gods of this church."
                
                You rest your right hand atop Drifa's and declare your consent.
                
                "I, Drifa, take you, [pc.name], to be my [pc.mf
                    |husband
                    |wife
                ]. I promise to be faithful to
                you, in good times and in bad, in sickness and in health, to love you and to honor you all the days of my life."
                
                "May Lumia in her kindness strengthen the consent you have declared before each other and graciously bring to fulfill her blessings within you. What Lumia has joined, let no one put asunder." Brother Sanders regards Drifa's sister with a nod. "Come. Bring us the rings."
                
                Elise tentatively looks around at the large crowd. Feeling intimidated, she hurriedly jogs to the altar with her tiny legs and hands the box of rings to Brother Sanders before running back to the comforting arms of her mother.
                
                Brother Sanders sprinkles the wedding bands with holy water before handing them to each of you. "[pc.name], you may place the ring on her finger and say your vows."
                
                After slipping the ring onto Drifa's delicate finger, you declare your vows to Drifa.
                
                "Drifa, you may now do the same," Sanders says, giving her a nod as he gestures to you.
                
                "In the name of Lumia, I give you this ring as a sign of my love and fidelity." Drifa takes your right hand and slips the ring onto it. Holding your hand, she says, "[pc.name], when we first met, I didn't expect it to be the face of my future [pc.mf
                    |husband
                    |wife
                ]. I thought our meeting in the woods was the providence of my goddess, but I now know that we would've found each other in the end. You're a bright and gentle soul, [pc.name]... and you're the best thing to have ever happened to me. You're a shining beacon when the night is dark and cold. What we forge here today is an inseparable bond, and there's no better person to spend eternity with than you. I love you, [pc.name]... now and forever."
                
                Brother Sanders smiles and says, "In the sight of gods and these witnesses, I now pronounce you [pc.mf
                    |husband and wife
                    |married
                ]. You may now kiss."
                
                You and Drifa kiss[drifa.isCorrupt
                    |; the wolf-girl winks and sneakily wrestles your tongue with hers, making sure you feel her tongue piercing
                ].
                
                "Rise, everyone, and go in peace to glorify the gods with your life," Sanders says, concluding the formal wedding. All that's left is the lupine-styled afterparty.
                
                With that, everyone pours out of the chapel and begins making their way to the inn; you should, too. Taking Drifa's hand, the two of you walk to the Frosthound Inn. Once you arrive, you take a seat at the largest table and pull Drifa onto your lap. There's a number of unfamiliar faces who show up to congratulate you. There's drink and merriment to be had.
                
                With a pint of ale in hand, Nelia approaches you. "Congratulations, you two! Those were lovely vows. [pc.hasRealCock
                    |So when are the kids coming?"
                    
                    Drifa [drifa.isCorrupt
                        |takes a sip from her mug and glances at you; from your position, you can see her sly smile.
                        
                        "Oh?" Nelia purrs. "Looks like your wife expects an answer, [pc.name]."
                        
                        [pc.isImpotent
                            |As it stands, it's not like you could even give her a child, what with your sterility and all.
                            
                            An amused smile forms on her lips. "[pc.HeShe]'s got you beat there, Drifa."
                            |Before you can respond, Nelia waves her hand dismissively. "Don't worry, sweetie. I'm just messing with you. Make sure to enjoy yourselves."
                        ]
                        |splutters, coughing up her drink. "Kids? B-but I'm on brown leaf![pc.isImpotent
                            |And... and [pc.name] isn't—
                        ]"
                        
                        "I'm just teasing, darlings," Nelia says with a mirthful smile on her lips. "Make sure to enjoy yourselves.
                    ]
                    |I loved the bit about your love lasting an eternity. It was really romantic."
                ]
                
                While Nelia's here, you compliment her handiwork on the outfits. They turned out really nice, especially Drifa's; you were in stunned awe when you saw her walking into the chapel.
                
                Nelia beams with aplomb before taking a swig of her drink. "[silly
                    |I never miss, sweeties
                    |I only improved what's already there, sweetie
                ]. I'm glad everything went smoothly. The amount of people that showed up was truly something."
                
                You mention that it's all thanks to her, what with her gossiping about the event to the whole village.
                
                "Gossip? Nah." Nelia bats a stray hair out of her face and crosses her heart, swearing innocence. "I did nothing of the sort."
                
                You ask what she means. Didn't she gossip about the upcoming wedding?
                
                Nelia smiles and shakes her head.
                
                Really?
                
                "Am I really that untrustworthy with a secret?" Nelia teases. "I think someone's been giving you a bad impression of me. Believe it or not, all these people came out for you two; they care about their own, and you're a respected member of the community."
                
                "Hey, fucker, you're that [pc.isDK
                    |asshole
                    |pussy
                ] running around, aren't you?" an inebriated lupine says, messily slamming his mug onto the table and pointing a finger at you. "[silly
                    |I'll show you who the real boss of this gym is
                    |You don't deserve any of this
                ]."
                
                "Dude, what the fuck?" Garret says, pushing his way through the crowd. "This is their night. Leave them alone."
                
                "You want to fucking go?" The drunk wolfman says to Garret, raising his fists. "I bet this chump is going to pump and dump this girl like that guy did to your sister."
                
                You put a hand on your weapon, expecting a fight, but Garret holds a hand up. "I'll handle this loudmouth. You go on and enjoy yourselves."
                
                "Oh, will you now? And who the fuck are you?"
                
                "I'm the [gweyr.returned
                    |man who's going to kick your ass
                    |strongest man in Savarra
                ]," Garret says before flexing his fingers, tightening his fist into a ball, and knocking the drunken lupine out with a single punch. He then hefts the unconscious man onto his shoulder and leaves.
                
                "Well... that was something," Drifa comments. She then hops off your lap, turns to you and says. "Come one, let's dance! I want to see this dress twirl."
                
                You take Drifa's hand. Her hand is small compared to yours, but still a delight to hold, and your heart skips a beat as your fingers meet the warm metal of the ring on her finger. Holding her hand, you follow Drifa and dance with her.
                
                And, just like that, the festivities stretch long into the night — Sanders wasn't wrong in that lupines love an excuse to goof off. Eventually even the lupine's boisterous energy starts to flag and, one by one, they head back to their homes. Tonight will pass, and people will settle back into normalcy... but tomorrow will be the first day of the rest of your life with Drifa.
rows.translation:
站在你面前的德莉法身着一件极其美丽的白色婚纱。她的腰间系着一条饰有金色太阳图案的黑带——这是她所崇拜的女神卢米娅的象征。这条飘逸的婚纱让她的肩膀裸露在外，但她的双臂上却装饰着华丽的丝质袖子。她那一头梳理得一丝不苟的头发两侧还插着两朵蓝色的花朵。当你看到你即将成为妻子的她时，首先映入你脑海的，一定是她那无与伦比、光彩照人的美丽。 [drifa.isCorrupt
                    |要是你不太了解内情，肯定会以为她还是以前的她。
                ]
                [var0]
                河流缓缓奏响了轻柔的入场音乐，众人纷纷站起身来，而德莉法则走到了她的位置上。

你的目光与她的相遇，她本能地低下了头。这样不行。你轻轻地伸出手指，托起了她的下巴，迫使她再次与你对视。你承诺，一定要让她成为这个世界上最幸福的女人。

桑德斯开始发言了：“亲爱的各位，我们今天聚集在这里，是为了共同[pc.mf
                    |这个男人和这个女人
                    |这两位女性
                ]在神圣的婚姻中。 [pc.name]那么，德莉法，你是自愿、毫无强迫地来到这里，准备与对方结为夫妻的吗？”

“你和德莉法都表示同意。”

“那么，在踏上婚姻的道路之后，你是否准备全心全意地爱护对方，终生彼此扶持？
                那么，你们俩都愿意这样吗？”

“是的，我们愿意。”

“我愿意，”德莉法微笑着看着你说。

桑德斯修士继续说道：“既然你们都愿意缔结神圣的婚姻契约，携手共度一生，并在这座教堂的神明面前表达自己的意愿，那么……你将右手放在德莉法的手上，表示同意。

“我，德莉法，接受你[pc.name]，成为我的[pc.mf
                    |丈夫
                    |妻子

    ]. After getting undressed, you join Drifa on the bed and pull her into your spooning embrace.
    
    "Oh... hey there. I got the bed ready for you," Drifa murmurs. "How was your day?"
    
    Cuddling with her, you discuss the events of your day.

        "Thanks," Drifa whispers. "Good night, dear."
        
        You exchange smiles and let yourself fall into a slumber.

            "You know... with each day that passes, we get closer to your child's birthday."
            
            In that case, she'd better get to work on popping out this pup so you can stuff another into her.
            
            "I couldn't have put it better myself — being pregnant suits me. Carrying your babies just makes me feel so warm and good, both inside and out. But enough talk, let's get to sleep."
            |Drifa regards you with a warm smile and guides your hand to the underside of her growing belly. "I wonder... what kind of future our kids will have; what fun memories will we make with them?"
            
            You could think of a few things.
            
            "Just imagine it: us and our little pups, playing at a creek during a nice summer's day. I want to see this more than anything. I want to make our kids laugh and put a smile on their faces."
            
            That sounds wonderful.
            
            "I wonder what our kid's first words will be? Will they call for [pc.mf

            Playing with Drifa's hair, you instead raise the idea of your kid calling for their sweet dog-momma. Additionally, you wonder which person your baby will take more after — you or your beautiful wife? Whatever the case may be, you're eager to see your child all the same.
            
            "Only way for us to find out is to go to sleep. Each day brings us closer, after all."
            
            Smiling, you nuzzle against Drifa's shoulder and let yourself fall into a slumber.
        ]

rows.original:
You wake up the next morning with a smile, happy to still feel the [drifa.hasRimescore
        |warm
        |cool
    ] weight of your half-lupine concubine snuggled into your chest. Soon after you wake up, Drifa cracks a bleary eye open up and then the other before groaning.
    
    Drifa's never been much of a morning person, has she?
    
    You sigh and tousle the barely cognizant woman's hair before detangling yourself from her with no small amount of regret and get dressed. Letting Drifa rise and shine on her own accord, you gather your things and give her a kiss for good luck. With nothing left for it, you continue on your merry way.

你的执达官沉思了一会儿，手托着下巴，眼睛半闭着，似乎在认真思考。“嗯，应该可以的。在我们用来存放军械和珍宝的地下室下面——虽然现在那里可能什么都没有——我们可以挖开石质地面，把那里改造成楼梯，再腾出一些空间来建造牢房。这得花多少功夫啊？”

达莉莎抿了抿嘴唇，无奈地耸了耸肩：“我也说不准啊；这得看那地板和天花板的结构有多结实。我们可能需要木材来搭建支撑结构，以防万一；还需要金属来制作栏杆，另外还得准备一些石头来建造楼梯和墙壁。考虑到你为荒废驿堡的初步翻新已经付出了那么多努力，以及还有那么多工作需要完成，这个建议确实相当合理。

“确实有。还有一件事……”达莉莎低声说道，似乎察觉到了你对自己能力的自信。“那些恶魔、女巫以及其他施法者，根本没有什么简单而人道的办法可以将他们束缚住。他们可能会变成老鼠或者细长的怪物，也可能会化作雾气，甚至直接传送走…… 我们需要一位法师来帮忙，而且这位法师必须具备更强的能力，才能有效应对那种情况，而不仅仅是简单地在荒废驿堡地区安装供暖设施。

你能想到的人选不多：[flags.VIVIANE_MET|薇薇安、]常青女士[flags.MIKO_MAI_MET|，或许还有米可与舞]。至少问问也没有损失。
    ]

        |Daliza frowns and adjusts her ponytail, settling her stance a little straighter. "Do we need one for somebody? Are you expecting a lot of imprisonments?"

        "[pc.dcb
            |Depends how many of them piss me off.
            |Maybe, but it's definitely better to be prepared.
            |Mmmmmaybe? Sometimes people have to sit on the time-out chair!
        ]" You smirk, looking around the Wayfort. "Is it possible?"
        
        Your bailiff ponders for a moment, hand to chin, eyes half-lidded in concentration. "After all of the renovations, we have some construction supplies leftover. And we could install stairs and excavate down under the armory and vaults."
        
        "How much work is that?"
        
        Daliza purses her lips, shrugging helplessly. "I don't know for sure; it depends on how solid the floor-slash-ceiling is, we'd need wood to put up supports — just in case, metal for bars, and some extra stone to make up the stairs and walls." 
        
        After all of the work you'd gone through to get the Wayfort in its current, glorious condition, that doesn't sound too difficult.

There is no simple, humane way to keep them restrained. They might just turn into rats or skinny things, or mist, or just teleport or something. rows.original: [wayfort.upgraded |"I was wondering when you'd get around to that, [pc.mf |Master |Mistress ]!" Jael'yn bounces on her heels, tits nearly quaking free from her barmaid dress. "Can't have a fort without a dungeon, and the rest of this building is fucking pristine." "You've put a lot of thought into this?" The demon nods and grins, pouring a drink for you. "Of course, it was kind of my speciality. We know the workforce, we have plenty of leftover materials, we really only have one particularly challenging requirement..." She waits for you to ask; 'and that is?', but you refuse to bite, instead smirking and sipping your drink. Jael'yn pouts and continues, waving a hand towards the north. "The armory and vault space is good for more than that, it's the sturdiest part of the whole fort. Unfortunately there's a serious weakness to it too. We need a real enchanter, not for just heating-runes, or self-washing windows, or whatever the cellar fridge... else any caster or demon worth their salt will just slip out and make us look like fucking idiots." Your barmaid lets out a sigh of relief, leaning on the counter. "Right, we've had a lot of workers around, and they've proven they know what they're doing. There's a spot that's... I suppose technically our armory and vaults, even though we aren't using it." Her spaded tail swishes around in the air, and her tits nearly pool out of her top. Makes sense, but it doesn't leave you quite so many options; you know of [flags.VIVIANE_MET|Viviane, ]Evergreen[flags.MIKO_MAI_MET|, and perhaps Miko and Mai]. rows.translation: [wayfort.upgraded |“我一直在想你什么时候才会提到这件事，[pc.mf |主人 |女主人 ]！”杰琳兴奋地踮脚蹦跳，乳房几乎要从酒馆女侍的裙装中震出来。“堡垒可不能没有地牢，而且这栋建筑的其他地方他妈的一尘不染。” “你已经仔细考虑过了？” 恶魔点头咧嘴一笑，为你倒上一杯。“当然，这以前勉强算是我的专长。我们熟悉这些工人，剩余材料也很充足，真正棘手的要求其实只有一个……” 她等着你追问“那是什么？”，可你偏不上钩，只是坏笑着啜饮杯中酒。 杰琳撅起嘴，挥手指向北方，继续说道。“军械库和金库区不只能储物，还是整座堡垒最坚固的部分。可惜那里也有一个严重弱点。我们需要一名真正的附魔师，不是只能刻加热符文、造自洁窗户，或者不管地窖冰柜用了什么的那种……否则，任何像样的施法者或恶魔都能溜出去，让我们看起来像群他妈的蠢货。” 这样一来，你的选择并不多；你认识[flags.VIVIANE_MET|薇薇安、]常青女士[flags.MIKO_MAI_MET|，或许还有米可与舞]。不过开口问问总没有损失。 |杰琳用那条罪恶般修长的恶魔舌头舔了舔嘴唇。“请别命令我去建它，[pc.mf |主人 |女主人 ]，不然我非得当场发作不可。” 对，你刚才差点把问题问糟了。“地牢应该怎样建造？” 你的酒馆女侍如释重负地叹息一声，倚在柜台上。“好，我们这里一直有许多工人，他们也证明了自己确实懂行。有一个地方……严格说来，我想那是我们的军械库和金库，虽然目前并未使用。”她带尖头的尾巴在空中甩动，乳房几乎要从上衣里淌出来。“我敢说，我们能让其中一些工人修一条向下的楼梯，再挖出一座地牢，关押你那些宝贝的淘气婊子。” 杰琳邪恶地笑着站直身体。“计划只有一个障碍：我们需要真正的附魔师来完成工作，否则，任何像样的恶魔或施法者都能溜出去，让我们看起来像群他妈的蠢货。我的意思是真正的附魔师，要比给水加热之类严肃得多，懂吗？” 有道理，可这样一来，你的选择并不多；你认识[flags.VIVIANE_MET|薇薇安、]常青女士[flags.MIKO_MAI_MET|，或许还有米可与舞]。不过开口问问总没有损失。 ]

[wayfort.upgraded
        |"I suppose that's one way to utilize the space," Farrah sighs. "You realize paying guards comes out of our profit margins though, don't you?"

        You nod; of course it does.
        
        "Very well! I suppose a fortress needs a dungeon... it shouldn't be anything too difficult, except for getting the magical bars."
        
        "Magical bars?" You enquire, looking the demon-cat up-and-down.
        
        Farrah nods, and the mime for emphasis has her feline ears shrinking down into slender, finned things, and her whole body loses definition as she becomes a lankier, skinner elven woman. Right before springing back down into her feline form in a way that makes her tits bounce in very interesting ways. "Otherwise any demon or shapeshifter you stick down there will figure out how to wiggle free. So we need a proper enchanter... other than that, just the usual rock, wood, metal, and a cash injection from our slender coffers."
                
        An enchanter makes sense, but it doesn't leave you quite so many options; you know of [flags.VIVIANE_MET|Viviane, ]Evergreen[flags.MIKO_MAI_MET|, and perhaps Miko and Mai]. There's nothing to be lost from asking, at least.
        |"A place to keep prisoners? I... suppose that can be arranged, though you've nobody to guard such a place." The azure demon-cat frowns and purses her lips for a few moments. "I suppose adding one on wouldn't be impossible, though this fort will make less money in order to maintain it."
    
        "Couldn't I just get magical cages and be done with it?" You sigh and scratch your neck.
        
        "...People need to eat, and see other faces, or you'll be the prisoner of a few stark-mad useless things that can't be interacted with. And if it's all the same to you, I don't want to sit around in a fortress that might just one day have some unattended murderer break out and stab me in my sleep."
        
        A... vivid picture. "Alright, how much will this set me back?"
        
        "You aren't wrong about magical cages, otherwise anyone who can shapeshift..." Farrah enunciates the point by literally flattening her hands together a few inches, before they spring back again. "Will just slip out. But in resources? No difference to what you've had to acquire before. We'll have to put some of the fort's profits back into guards though," she sighs. "Those boreals watching the roads between here and the winter city don't owe us a damned thing, so they sure won't do it."
        
        An enchanter makes sense, but it doesn't leave you quite so many options; you know of [flags.VIVIANE_MET|Viviane, ]Evergreen[flags.MIKO_MAI_MET|, and perhaps Miko and Mai]. There's nothing to be lost from asking, at least.
    ]

[wayfort.upgraded
        |“我想这也算是一种利用空间的办法，”法拉叹道。“不过你知道，支付守卫薪水会削减我们的利润，对吧？”

        你点点头；当然会。
        
        “那好吧！我想堡垒的确需要一座地牢……除了弄到附魔栅栏以外，应该没有什么太难的地方。”
        
        “附魔栅栏？”你上下打量着恶魔猫，出声询问。
        
        法拉点点头，又亲自演示以强调原因：她的猫耳缩成细长的鳍状物，全身轮廓也变得模糊，化为一名身材更高挑纤瘦的精灵女子。随后，她猛地恢复猫女形态，乳房以十分惹眼的方式弹跳起来。“否则，被你关进去的恶魔或变形者总会找到办法扭动着逃出去。所以我们需要合格的附魔师……除此之外，无非就是常规的石材、木料、金属，再从我们单薄的金库里注入一笔资金。”
                
        附魔师的要求合情合理，却也让你没剩下多少选择；你认识[flags.VIVIANE_MET|薇薇安、]常青女士[flags.MIKO_MAI_MET|，或许还有米可与舞]。不过开口问问总没有损失。
        |“关押囚犯的地方？我……想来应该可以安排，只不过你根本没有人手看守。”蔚蓝色的恶魔猫皱起眉，抿唇思考了片刻。“我想增建一座地牢并非不可能，不过为了维持它，堡垒的收益会有所降低。”
    
        “我不能直接弄些魔法牢笼，一劳永逸吗？”你叹了口气，挠着脖颈。
        
        “……人总得吃饭、见到其他面孔，否则你只会得到几个彻底发疯、毫无用处、根本无法交流的囚犯。再说，如果你觉得这都无所谓，我可不想坐在一座堡垒里，等某天无人看守的杀人犯越狱，趁我熟睡时捅我一刀。”
        
        这幅画面……可真生动。“好吧，这要花我多少钱？”
        
        “你说魔法牢笼倒也没错，否则任何能够变形的人……”法拉直接将双手压扁到仅相距几英寸，随后又令其恢复原状，以此强调自己的观点。“都会轻易溜出去。不过资源方面？和你此前必须收集的东西没有区别。只是我们得把一部分堡垒利润重新投入守卫身上，”她叹道。“那些驻守在此地与冬城之间道路上的极北精灵可不欠我们任何东西，自然更不会来干这活。”
        
        附魔师的要求合情合理，却也让你没剩下多少选择；你认识[flags.VIVIANE_MET|薇薇安、]常青女士[flags.MIKO_MAI_MET|，或许还有米可与舞]。不过开口问问总没有损失。
    ]

rows.original: The curvaceous witch trails a finger through the air, leaving motes of magic in her wake. "An enchantment for cell bars? How unpleasant." "But can you do it?" Viv scrunches her face up for a moment, before sighing and nodding. "Yes, it wouldn't be too hard, just uncomfortable; I'll have itchy fingers for a week after making something that exclusively blocks magic." She considers for a few minutes, before pulling out a tightly bound paper package of plain electrum coins. "If you'd like to stand back?" You do as requested, watching with interest as she closes her hands over the stack. It's shocking to see the witch's dainty little hands press the coinstack flat while motes of light and an almost glue-y, syrupy magical residue seeps from between her fingers and drips to the ground. She hisses and finds somewhere to dump the electrum plates she's made, hurriedly washing her hands clean. They look raw, as though she'd been scrubbing away at tiles for half an hour, and there's a lock of sweaty hair that she has to tuck back before finally regaining her composure. "There, done... I recommend picking those up in a bag; if you have the capacity for magic and touch them with your bare skin, you'll get an allergic reaction." Following her careful instructions you scoop the electrum plates; they make you deeply uncomfortable to hold, even with a bag to separate. "What do I do with them?" "Get them hot, hammer them into the ceiling or floor right by the bars." Viv frowns, washing her hands again and looking uncomfortable. "Oh, and don't worry about the charge... I'm sure you can pay it back some time." Perfect.
rows.translation: 身材曼妙的女巫以手指划过空气，沿途留下点点魔光。“给牢房栅栏附魔？真让人不舒服。” “但你能做到吗？” 薇芙皱起脸思索片刻，随后叹着气点了点头。“能，应该不会太难，只是感觉很难受；制造专门用来阻断魔法的东西后，我的手指会痒上整整一周。”她思考了几分钟，随后取出一个用纸紧紧包裹的包裹，里面装着普通的琥珀金币。“能请你退后一点吗？” 你依言照办，饶有兴趣地看着她双手合拢，将整叠硬币包在掌中。女巫娇小纤细的双手竟把硬币堆压得扁平，实在令人震惊；与此同时，点点光芒与近似胶水、糖浆般的魔力残渣从她指缝渗出，滴落地面。 她倒抽着气，找了个地方放下制成的琥珀金板，匆忙洗净双手。那双手看起来一片红肿，就像她刚刚刷了半小时瓷砖；一绺汗湿的头发垂落下来，她不得不将其拨回耳后，才终于恢复镇定。“好了，完成了……我建议用袋子装起那些金属板；如果你拥有施展魔法的能力，又用裸露皮肤触碰它们，就会出现过敏反应。” 你严格遵照她的指示，把琥珀金板铲进袋子；即使隔着袋子，拿住它们依旧让你极度不适。“我该怎么处理？” “把它们烧热，再锤进栅栏旁边的天花板或地板。”薇芙皱着眉，又洗了一遍手，看起来依旧难受。“哦，还有，不用担心费用……我相信你以后总有机会偿还。” 完美。

She considers for a few minutes, before pulling out a tightly bound paper package of plain electrum coins. "If you'd like to stand back?" You do as requested, watching with interest as she closes her hands over the stack. It's shocking to see the witch's dainty little hands press the coinstack flat while motes of light and an almost glue-y, syrupy magical residue seeps from between her fingers and drips to the ground. She hisses and finds somewhere to dump the electrum plates she's made, hurriedly washing her hands clean. They look raw, as though she'd been scrubbing away at tiles for half an hour, and there's a lock of sweaty hair that she has to tuck back before finally regaining her composure. "There, done... I recommend picking those up in a bag; if you have the capacity for magic and touch them with your bare skin, you'll get an allergic reaction." Following her careful instructions you scoop the electrum plates; they make you deeply uncomfortable to hold, even with a bag to separate. "What do I do with them?" "Get them hot, hammer them into the ceiling or floor right by the bars." Viv frowns, washing her hands again and looking uncomfortable. "Oh, and don't worry about the charge... I'm sure you can pay it back some time." Perfect.'

rows.original: Evergreen clicks her tongue, putting up a finger. "Of course I know such bindings, and I do have a surplus..." "Should I ask?" "You can! You might even get a clear answer, darling." She draws out the word 'darling' with a rueful smirk, rummaging around in her desk. "Honestly I've just been looking for a reason to get rid of them, they make accomplished witches like me feel terribly uncomfortable to have around." "You're afraid they'll be used against you?" Evergreen scoffs and waves the thought off, plucking up a bag and tossing it over to you. "No, it causes an allergic reaction to touch the plates themselves in powerful spellcasters." "How does it work?" You hold the bag up, feeling a little unsettled and uncomfortable yourself, just from being that close to them; to be fair, your soul is a little stranger than most. And your body far more transmutable. "Just stamp them into the ceiling, or floor, right by the bars, or door. My magics will stop any transient casters from escaping your gracious hospitality." The milfy witch smirks, waving you off when you reach for money. "No, I insist. May they serve you well, and be kept as far away from my fingers as possible; the itching lasts for weeks."

rows.original:
"Oh?" Meira quirks an eyebrow, but smiles and invites you to take a seat. "The dungeon, is it? Do tell."
    
    Yes, it's about the dungeon. It's solid enough, but you'd like it to be able to hold more than mundane creatures if it came to that. Hence the enchantments.
    
    "Oh, of course. I'll accept the job happily — one of the first things I did once you were out of sight was to personally visit every nook and cranny of this wayfort, so I know what you're talking about. That being said... do indulge a girl's curiosity. Why me?"
    
    Why her? What kind of question is that? You took her on as your court mage, it's only natural that you go to someone in-house rather than contract someone else. If something goes wrong with the dungeon enchantments, it'd be better to have their inner workings known by the person who's right here so the matter can get fixed immediately, wouldn't she agree?
    
    "Yes, but..." Meira cocks her head. "I think there's something more there, too."
    
    If there's anything there, it's that you want her to earn her keep and get to the "mage" part of her job description, rather than "court." Schmoozing and playing at being hopped-up fortune teller all day has its uses, but diminishing returns are a thing. Now, if she doesn't mind doing her job?
    
    The naughty 'nuki blows you a raspberry. "Pff, you're no fun. I already said I'd do it; it's not as if I'm looking for ways to get out of the job. All right, let me go and get my things. Don't wait on me — it'll take some time to get everything put together, but I expect that it shouldn't take too long."
    
    With that, Meira spins on her heel and heads off into the back of her chambers; after a couple moments, the sound of clanking and rummaging starts up from behind a screen. Looks like this conversation's over — you'll have to head down to the dungeon later to check out her handiwork, but everything seems to be in order otherwise.
rows.translation:
“哦？”梅拉挑了挑眉毛，但随即露出了微笑，邀请你坐下。“是关于地下城的事吧？快说说看。”
    
    是的，确实是与地下城有关。这个地下城本身已经相当坚固了，但如果你们遇到需要对付更强大的敌人时，它就应该能够容纳更多的怪物。因此，才需要这些魔法咒语。
    
    “哦，当然。我会很高兴地接受这份工作的——其实在你离开后，我做的第一件事就是亲自去考察了这个地方的每一个角落，所以我完全明白你在说什么。不过……也请允许一个女孩满足一下自己的好奇心吧。为什么会选择我呢？”
    
    为什么是她？这算什么问题吗？你聘请她担任你的宫廷法师，选择内部人员而不是外聘他人，这是很自然的选择。如果地下城的魔法效果出了问题，让熟悉这些内部机制的人来处理，问题才能得到及时解决，她不也是这么认为的吗？
    
    “是的，但是……”梅拉歪了歪头，“我觉得其中还有别的原因。”
    
    如果说有什么原因的话，那就是你希望她能够通过自己的努力来获得应有的回报，真正实现她职位描述中“法师”那一部分，而不是“宫廷”那一部分。整天跟别人套近乎、装作那个神通广大的占卜师固然也有它的作用，但效果总会逐渐减弱。现在，如果她不介意认真履行自己的职责的话？
    
    那个调皮的努基朝你吐了吐舌头。“哼，你真没意思。我已经说过我会去做的，我又不是在找借口逃避责任。好吧，让我去拿我的东西吧。别等我——虽然把所有东西都准备好需要一些时间，但我想应该不会太久。”
    
    说完，梅拉便转身朝自己的房间走去；过了一会儿，从屏风后面传来了翻找东西的声音。看来这次谈话到此结束了——你以后得去地牢看看她搞了些什么，不过其他方面似乎都挺正常的。

rows.original:
The matronly fox leans back, smiling beatifically. "Now why woul' you need something like that?"
    
    You sigh and plant both hands on your hips, looking her over from top, to luscious bottom. "If you were put in a prison cell for some reason, and there was no enchantment to prevent you from casting magic, how quickly would you get out?"
    
    She purses her lips, considering for only a brief moment before admitting. "I would try to get out so quickly, that when y'turned around to leave I would be stood in front of you."
    
    The shrine fox gets up with a sigh, gesturing you to make yourself comfortable while leaving to do her wicked works. It only takes a few minutes before she returns with a bamboo box that rattles when shaken. "Here, free of charge, it's mostly offcuts from other enchantments, quickly stamped in't tiles."
    
    "How do I use them?"
    
    [var0
        |Miko
        |Mai
    ] winces and gestures at her raw red finger tips. "Don't touch 'em directly, you'll break out in a rash. Just stamp them into the ceiling or floor by your entrance, they'll befuddle any transformation." She twitches her nose in time with the word 'befuddle' with a smirk.
rows.translation:
那只气质成熟的狐女向后靠去，脸上挂着幸福的微笑。“你为什么会需要这种东西呢？”
    
    你叹了口气，双手叉腰，从头到她那诱人的臀部仔细打量一番。“假如你出于某种原因被关进牢房，而且没有附魔阻止你施法，你需要多久才能逃出来？”
    
    她抿起嘴唇，只思考片刻便坦白道：“我会用最快速度出去；等你转身准备离开时，我已经站在你面前了。”
    
    神社狐女叹着气站起身，示意你随意休息，自己则离开去施展那些邪门手段。仅仅几分钟后，她便带着一个竹盒返回；摇晃时，里面会发出哗啦声。“拿去，免费。这些大多是其他附魔留下的边角料，匆忙压成了符片。”
    
    “该怎么使用？”
    
    [var0
        |米可
        |舞
    ]皱起脸，指了指自己红肿破皮的指尖。“别直接碰，否则会起疹子。只要把它们压进入口附近的天花板或地板，就能扰乱任何变形术。”说到“扰乱”时，她坏笑着抽了抽鼻子。

rows.original:
"Oh! [pc.name]," Elthara says, waving her hand. "How goes things?"
    
    You give her a nod and smile. "Well enough. Yourself?"
    
    "The same as ever," she says, smiling back at you before growing a little more serious. "By the way, I visited your new fort. [wayfort.upgraded
        |It's in admirable shape
        |[wayfort.renovated
            |It's in decent shape
            |It's in unfortunate shape
        ]
    ], but more to the point I seem to have missed you while I was there. A shame, as I was quite intent upon having... lengthy talks. Ones that might run late into the night." The elf sighs. "Unfortunately, my presence here is ever-demanded — the breaks I can take are few and far between."
    
    [elthara.fuckedAny
        |You pick up what she's putting down immediately. "Aah, of course. Yes, I would be quite willing to invite you for diplomatic talks, High Priestess," you say, lips curling upwards slightly. "No doubt there's a lot we could learn from each other. It's regrettable I missed you — we'll have to spend long hours catching up."
        
        Elthara blushes all the way up to her pointed ears, eyes darting sideways to check for the presence of any underlings. "Yes... I do hope so." She clears her throat, attempting to dispel the lingering feelings and return to business.
        |"I'd be happy to have you at the Wayfort, High Priestess," you say. "No doubt our talks will be fruitful."
        
        "Yes... indeed," she says, glancing sideways before looking back at you. "I will send a message to Hawkethorne upon my arrival — I understand that's where you are staying. Now, is there anything I might do for you while you're here?"
    ]

    "Oh! [pc.name]," Elthara says, waving her hand. "How goes things?"
    
    You give her a nod and smile. "Well enough. Yourself?"
    
    "The same as ever," she says, smiling back at you before growing a little more serious. "By the way, I visited your new fort. [wayfort.upgraded
        |It's in admirable shape
        |[wayfort.renovated
            |It's in decent shape
            |It's in unfortunate shape
        ]
    ], but more to the point I seem to have missed you while I was there. A shame, as I was quite intent upon having... lengthy talks. Ones that might run late into the night." The elf sighs. "Unfortunately, my presence here is ever-demanded — the breaks I can take are few and far between."
    
    [elthara.fuckedAny
        |You pick up what she's putting down immediately. "Aah, of course. Yes, I would be quite willing to invite you for diplomatic talks, High Priestess," you say, lips curling upwards slightly. "No doubt there's a lot we could learn from each other. It's regrettable I missed you — we'll have to spend long hours catching up."
        
        Elthara blushes all the way up to her pointed ears, eyes darting sideways to check for the presence of any underlings. "Yes... I do hope so." She clears her throat, attempting to dispel the lingering feelings and return to business.
        |"I'd be happy to have you at the Wayfort, High Priestess," you say. "No doubt our talks will be fruitful."
        
        "Yes... indeed," she says, glancing sideways before looking back at you. "I will send a message to Hawkethorne upon my arrival — I understand that's where you are staying. Now, is there anything I might do for you while you're here?"
    ]

Opening it up, you read over the fancy script — looks like Elthara's back at the Wayfort, and she's looking forward to your presence.[elthara.fucked| Yes... no doubt.] You put it away and weigh your options. |"Hey, are you [pc.name]?" someone says. You turn to see a blonde fellow, probably in his twenties or thirties. A little rough around the edges but obviously harmless. "That's me. What's up?" you ask. "'Ere. Courtesy of the old wolf," he says, handing you a letter with a grin. There's a very fancy wax seal on it. "Garth told me to go see if you were around. Didn't read it, promise." You thank the man and he goes on his merry way — right back to the inn, no doubt — before you open the letter up and read it. Dearest [pc.name], I hope this letter finds you in good health. I have undertaken a trip to your fort — the Wayfort, as I understand you call it — and intend to remain here for three days. I would very much enjoy your presence, and I plan to make this a regular occurrence every two weeks.[elthara.fucked | The lines of the letters here are a little less refined, as if the author's hand was shaking.
