rows.original:
"Ever since she was young, Alissa loved hunting, yet hated doing so alongside the adults back then, since they would often belittle her and treat her more like a child than a fellow hunter. That's why she wanted to go by herself, but Queen Alraince was scared of letting her reckless daughter alone in the wild, and that's why she made Alissa choose at least one hunting partner. Out of all the people, she chose me."
    
    "You seem pretty proud of that."
    
    "I sure am. But I still fail to understand why I was chosen, considering we had only met once before that," she recalls, and you catch a glint of nostalgia in her weak smile. "It was during one of those hunting parties that she grew tired of the adults there and escaped to face the wilderness by herself. She found me in the forest, training with Demon's Shadow for the day I could finally apply to be a city guard. I didn't know who she was, and she didn't introduce herself either; she only asked me if I wanted to go hunting, and I said I did. It took the guards a whole day to find her. The noblemen who had been with her at the hunting party were terrified of what Queen Alraince would do to them if Alissa didn't appear, and Alissa took great pleasure in that. She couldn't stop laughing when she saw the panicked faces of all those adults who had belittled her."
    
    "That sounds like Alissa..."
    
    [party.has etheryn
        |[etheryn.highConfidence
            |"And she must've been in a good mood," Ryn says. "I've seen her doing much worse for far less."
            |"It... it does," Ryn says.
        ]
    ]
    
    "She was only a disobedient rascal back then." A faint smile flashes through Gytha's face, but it's an expression full of sorrow rather than happiness. "Now that I think about it, I suspect she was just testing everyone's limits, wondering how bad she'd have to behave to call the Queen's attention. But Queen Alraince was always either too busy taking care of the kingdom or too kind to scold Alissa, which she perceived as her mother not caring enough. Then Queen Alraince died." 
    
    Gytha stops for a second, and no one dares to break the silence. She's staring at the nothingness as if she was seeing the scene play again before her eyes. Then, she takes a deep breath and resumes her story.
    
    "It was hard for Alissa. I recall that we went on a hunt not that much after. I remember how she cried her eyes out, how she wailed until she lost her voice, and her tears.... they were tears of anger; of wrath. She had done some questionable things before, but it was after the Queen's passing that she truly began to change. She was full of spite, angry at the world, and her way of retaliating was by hurting whoever she could. Yet the world itself didn't care, and she only became worse and worse, lost in her impotence and childish rage." Then her voice breaks, and she swallows. "If only I had been courageous enough back then..."
    
    "She's responsible for her own actions," you tell her.
    
    "And so am I," she answers, taking a deep breath that fills her chest and lets some pride come back to imbue her stance. "And the fact that I couldn't help my friend will remain."
rows.translation:
“她从小就热爱打猎，但那时候讨厌和成年人一起打，因为他们常常贬低她，把她当成小孩，而不是同行的猎人。所以她才想独自去打猎，可阿尔兰斯女王害怕让自己这个莽撞的女儿独自待在野外，于是逼着艾莉莎至少选一个打猎搭档。在所有人里，她选中了我。”
    
    “你听起来挺为此自豪的。”
    
    “我确实自豪。可我还是不明白自己为什么会被选中，毕竟在那之前我们只见过一面，”她回忆道，你从她那淡淡的笑容里捕捉到一丝怀念。“就是在一次狩猎聚会上，她受够了那里的成年人，独自逃出去面对荒野。她在森林里发现了我，当时我正在练习恶魔之影，为了有朝一日能去申请当城卫。我不知道她是谁，她也没有自我介绍；她只是问我愿不愿意去打猎，我说愿意。守卫们花了整整一天才找到她。当时和她一起参加狩猎聚会的贵族们吓坏了，生怕艾莉莎不出现的话阿尔兰斯女王会怎么处置他们，而艾莉莎对此乐在其中。当她看到那些曾经贬低她的成年人惊慌失措的表情时，她笑得停不下来。”
    
    “这听起来很像艾莉莎……”
    
    [party.has etheryn
        |[etheryn.highConfidence
            |“而且她当时心情肯定很好，”小琳说。“我见过她为远不如这的事做出糟糕得多的举动。”
            |“这……这确实像她，”小琳说。
        ]
    ]
    
    “那时候她只是个不听话的小捣蛋鬼。”吉莎脸上闪过一抹淡淡的微笑，但那神情里满是悲伤而非喜悦。“现在回想起来，我怀疑她只是在试探每个人的底线，想知道自己得表现得多糟糕才能引起女王的注意。可阿尔兰斯女王不是忙于治理王国，就是心太软，从不肯责备艾莉莎，而艾莉莎把这当成了母亲不够关心自己。后来阿尔兰斯女王去世了。” 
    
    吉莎停了一秒，没有人敢打破沉默。她凝视着虚空，仿佛那一幕正在她眼前重演。然后，她深吸一口气，继续讲她的故事。
    
    “那段日子对艾莉莎来说很难熬。我记得没过多久我们就去打了一次猎。我记得她哭得眼睛都肿了，嚎啕大哭直到失声，还有她的眼泪……那是愤怒的泪水，是暴怒的泪水。她以前也做过一些可疑的事，但正是在女王去世之后，她才真正开始改变。她满心怨恨，对世界充满怒火，而她报复的方式就是伤害她所能伤害的任何人。可这个世界本身并不在乎，她只是变得越来越糟，陷在自己的无力和幼稚的怒火里。”说到这里，她的声音破了，她咽了口唾沫。“要是我当时能勇敢一点就好了……”
    
    “她要为自己的行为负责，”你告诉她。
    
    “我也一样，”她答道，深吸一口气，让胸膛鼓起，也让几分骄傲回到她的姿态里。“而我没能帮到我的朋友，这个事实会一直留在我心里。”
rows.raw:
'
    "Ever since she was young, Alissa loved hunting, yet hated doing so alongside the adults back then, since they would often belittle her and treat her more like a child than a fellow hunter. That's why she wanted to go by herself, but Queen Alraince was scared of letting her reckless daughter alone in the wild, and that's why she made Alissa choose at least one hunting partner. Out of all the people, she chose me."
    
    "You seem pretty proud of that."
    
    "I sure am. But I still fail to understand why I was chosen, considering we had only met once before that," she recalls, and you catch a glint of nostalgia in her weak smile. "It was during one of those hunting parties that she grew tired of the adults there and escaped to face the wilderness by herself. She found me in the forest, training with Demon's Shadow for the day I could finally apply to be a city guard. I didn't know who she was, and she didn't introduce herself either; she only asked me if I wanted to go hunting, and I said I did. It took the guards a whole day to find her. The noblemen who had been with her at the hunting party were terrified of what Queen Alraince would do to them if Alissa didn't appear, and Alissa took great pleasure in that. She couldn't stop laughing when she saw the panicked faces of all those adults who had belittled her."
    
    "That sounds like Alissa..."
    
    [party.has etheryn
        |[etheryn.highConfidence
            |"And she must've been in a good mood," Ryn says. "I've seen her doing much worse for far less."
            |"It... it does," Ryn says.
        ]
    ]
    
    "She was only a disobedient rascal back then." A faint smile flashes through Gytha's face, but it's an expression full of sorrow rather than happiness. "Now that I think about it, I suspect she was just testing everyone's limits, wondering how bad she'd have to behave to call the Queen's attention. But Queen Alraince was always either too busy taking care of the kingdom or too kind to scold Alissa, which she perceived as her mother not caring enough. Then Queen Alraince died." 
    
    Gytha stops for a second, and no one dares to break the silence. She's staring at the nothingness as if she was seeing the scene play again before her eyes. Then, she takes a deep breath and resumes her story.
    
    "It was hard for Alissa. I recall that we went on a hunt not that much after. I remember how she cried her eyes out, how she wailed until she lost her voice, and her tears.... they were tears of anger; of wrath. She had done some questionable things before, but it was after the Queen's passing that she truly began to change. She was full of spite, angry at the world, and her way of retaliating was by hurting whoever she could. Yet the world itself didn't care, and she only became worse and worse, lost in her impotence and childish rage." Then her voice breaks, and she swallows. "If only I had been courageous enough back then..."
    
    "She's responsible for her own actions," you tell her.
    
    "And so am I," she answers, taking a deep breath that fills her chest and lets some pride come back to imbue her stance. "And the fact that I couldn't help my friend will remain."
    '

rows.original:
"You didn't seem too fond of Ryn before," you ask her. "What are your thoughts now?"
    
    "Was that the impression I gave?" she says, somewhat surprised. "I never had anything against her. It's just... It was difficult, looking at her and being reminded of how weak I was." 
    
    "What do you mean?"
    
    "Alissa isn't the only one I failed when I didn't stand up to her. And I'm not speaking about my duties as a member of the Odain family," she says, looking at the ground to hide her ashamed face. "Lady Etheryn... She seemed so lonely. She was alone in this world, being either belittled or outright ignored by everyone. I could relate to that. I wish I would've lent her a hand, been the person I needed when I was going through those same feelings. But I didn't do anything. I failed her as well. Avoiding her was an attempt to run away from my own remorse."
    
    "And has that changed?"
    
    "[etheryn.highConfidence
        |Well, thankfully, where I lacked courage, Lady Etheryn showed bravery in spades. She risked everything and escaped, and then managed to leave all that behind and become the person she's now. That's something that I can only admire. It inspires me to try to make peace with my past. You ask me what I think of her now. Well, I think she's grown into a worthy queen. One that I'm happy to serve, and one that I want to be able to look at and feel pride instead of guilt."
        |No. I've only gotten better at hiding it. Just look at her now. She's broken, and we let that happen." Her eyes become watery with tears. "I know that I can't change the past, but I can at least learn from it, make it be worth something. That's why even if I can't stand there and pretend everything is fine whenever I'm in her presence, I'll dedicate my life to protect her. I owe it to her, to Alissa, and also to myself." 
    ]
rows.translation:
“你之前似乎并不太喜欢小琳，”你问她。“那你现在是怎么想的？”
    
    “我给人的印象是那样的吗？”她有些意外地说。“我从没对她有过任何意见。只是……看着她、被提醒自己当年有多弱小，这让我很难受。” 
    
    “你是什么意思？”
    
    “我没能鼓起勇气反抗她时辜负的，并不只有艾莉莎一个。而且我说的并不是我身为奥代恩家族一员应尽的职责，”她说着，低头看着地面以掩藏羞愧的脸。“伊瑟琳女士……她看起来那么孤独。她在这世上孤身一人，不是被人轻视，就是被人干脆无视。我能体会到那种感觉。我真希望当时能拉她一把，成为我自己在经历同样感受时所需要的那个人。但我什么都没做。我也辜负了她。躲着她，其实只是想逃避我自己的悔恨。”
    
    “那现在变了吗？”
    
    “[etheryn.highConfidence
        |嗯，值得庆幸的是，在我缺乏勇气的地方，伊瑟琳女士却展现出了十足的胆量。她冒着一切风险逃了出来，之后又成功把那些都抛在身后，成为了现在的她。这一点我只能钦佩。它激励我去试着与自己的过去和解。你问我现在怎么看她。嗯，我觉得她已经成长为一位配得上王位的女王。一位我乐意效劳的女王，一位我希望能直视她、感到自豪而非愧疚的女王。”
        |没有。我只是更擅长把那种感觉藏起来了。看看她现在的样子吧。她已经被毁了，而这一切是我们放任发生的。”她的眼里泛起泪水。“我知道我改变不了过去，但至少能从中吸取教训，让它有几分价值。所以，哪怕每次在她面前我都无法站在那里装作一切都好，我也会倾尽一生去保护她。这是我欠她的，欠艾莉莎的，也是欠我自己的。” 
    ]

rows.original:
"How are you dealing with the idea of, you know... pregnancy?"
    
    "I can sense the [gytha.pregStage 1 2 3
        |life growing within me
        |bump getting bigger
        |baby moving
    ], and it makes me think of you. In a good way, I mean," she rushes to add. "As in, it makes me think of how good it is that we shared a moment of... Oh, you must be getting the idea that I think about how we made the baby, about how you fucked me and flooded my... my passage. It's not like that. Well, it's not that I don't think about it sometimes either, but it's... You... you get what I mean, do you not?"
    
    "I think you are dealing with it perfectly from what you tell me."
    
    "That is correct, yes," she looks away and scratches the back of her head. "It is... what I meant."
    
    "But what about being a mother? It sounds like a big deal."
    
    "It is. But I want to do it," she answers, full of confidence. "I barely met my parents. No matter how much I attempt to bring their faces to my mind, it is something I cannot do. However, I do remember how their absence felt. Having no one to share the good news with, no one to seek for comfort when bad news arrived. I think there is something special about receiving a mother's care and love, something a child needs. I do not know how it feels. I can tell you I craved it though."
    
    You share a moment of silence. Your eyes stare at her, hers look down to her own hands.
    
    "Please do not pity me," she finally says. "It was no one's fault. Just life. What I meant to say is, I cannot wait to give this baby all the love I could not have."
rows.translation:
“对于……你知道的，怀孕这件事，你适应得怎么样？”
    
    “我能感觉到[gytha.pregStage 1 2 3
        |生命正在体内成长
        |肚子正变得越来越大
        |宝宝正在活动
    ]，这会让我想起你。我是说，往好的方面想起你。”她急忙补充道。“也就是说，这会让我想起，我们曾共同度过那样的……哦，你一定觉得，我是在回想我们怎么造出这个孩子，回想你怎么操我、怎么把我的……我的甬道灌得满满的。不是那样的。好吧，也不是说我偶尔完全不会想起那些，可是……你……你明白我的意思，对吧？”
    
    “照你说的来看，我觉得你适应得非常好。”
    
    “没错，是的。”她转开视线，挠挠后脑。“我……就是这个意思。”
    
    “不过，成为母亲呢？听起来责任很重大。”
    
    “的确。但我想当母亲。”她满怀信心地回答。“我几乎没有见过父母。无论多么努力地试图回想起他们的面容，我都做不到。不过，我记得他们不在身边是什么感觉。遇到好消息时无人分享，坏消息来临时无人寻求安慰。我认为，得到母亲的关怀与疼爱是一种很特别的感受，也是孩子所需要的。我不知道那究竟是什么滋味。但我可以告诉你，我一直都很渴望得到它。”
    
    你们共同沉默了片刻。你的双眼注视着她，她则低头看着自己的双手。
    
    “请不要可怜我。”她终于说道。“那不是任何人的错，只是人生如此。我想说的是，我已经迫不及待要把自己没能得到的所有爱都给这个孩子了。”

rows.original:
"How is our little Lythen?" you ask, too afraid to even caress him. Those short moments where he is not crying should be cherished, and you don't want to risk it.
    
    "Strong, healthy, and more handsome each passing day," Gytha says. He has Gytha's beautiful gray eyes when he's not squinting to cry harder, and blonde hairs have started growing on his little head. "Do you want to hold him?"
    
    "Of course."
    
    "Here, be careful." With very slow and careful movements she lifts the baby into your arms.
    
    It's amazing how little he weighs, how small it is, how strong the fire burning in your heart rages when you look at him. You just want to hold him tight. 
    
    Despite your best efforts, Lythen does what he does best and starts crying. Gytha instinctively clicks her tongue to try to calm him, but it doesn't really work.
    
    "What do you think he'll be like when he grows up?" you ask, cradling him in your arms in another futile attempt to make the screams stop.
    
    "I guess that is entirely up to him," Gytha says. "We can only guide and love him along the way."
rows.translation:
“我们的小莱森怎么样？”你问道，甚至不敢去抚摸他。他不哭的那些短暂时刻应当珍惜，你不想冒险破坏。
    
    “强壮、健康，一天比一天更英俊，”吉莎说道。在他没有眯着眼睛哭得更凶的时候，他有着吉莎那双美丽的灰色眼睛，而且他那小脑袋上已经开始长出金色的毛发。“你想抱抱他吗？”
    
    “当然想。”
    
    “来，小心点。”她动作极其缓慢而小心地把婴儿抬进你的怀里。
    
    他那么轻，那么小，而每当你看着他，你心中燃烧的那团火就烧得那么旺，实在令人惊叹。你只想把他紧紧抱住。 
    
    尽管你已经尽力，莱森还是做了他最擅长的事——哭了起来。吉莎本能地啧啧咂舌，想让他安静下来，但并没什么用。
    
    “你觉得他长大后会是什么样子？”你问道，把他抱在怀里晃着，又一次徒劳地想让他停止哭喊。
    
    “我想那完全取决于他自己，”吉莎说道。“我们能做的只是一路引导他、爱他罢了。”

rows.original:
"What's on your mind?" you ask her, taking a seat right next to her. 
    
    "I was just thinking about life," she sighs.
    
    "Do you like it? Your life now?"
    
    "Oh, like you wouldn't believe." A shy smile appears on her face. "I have everything I could have ever dreamt. I am fortunate and happy."
    
    "What's the problem then?"
    
    "There is no problem. But there is also no such a thing as a worriless soul. And in the midst of nights like this I sometimes wonder If I deserve this joyful fate. I failed Lady Etheryn, I failed Alissa when I didn't scold her behaviour, and then again when I didn't go to her aid. I failed the kingdom, and its people. Yet here I am, despite my many failures, cradling in my arms what I have always desired."
    
    "People are not defined by their failures, Gytha."
    
    "By what then?"
    
    "What they learn from those failures, I guess."
    
    "Do you... do you think I have learnt from them?"
    
    "I think only you can answer that."
    
    "I try," she says. "I try to make up for my mistakes, to do better... I hoped the guilt would go away if I did, but it does not. I sometimes still wonder what would have happened if I stood up for Lady Etheryn, or what would have happened if I got to Alissa before you. Could I have changed her mind? Would I at least feel like I had done everything within my power to help her instead of having this lurking thought that I abandoned her?"
    
    "Those are things we will never know. Things we will never be able to change."
    
    "I am aware. And despite what I may think when my own happiness begins to feel scary, it is probably better that way. Speaking of which, I... I don't think I got to thank you."
    
    "What for?"
    
    "For stopping me before I got to Dracia, for this second chance. All that I said is true. I feel remorse, I sometimes wonder what could have been and I still feel deeply for my friend. But the joy I feel when I see the good we are doing alongside Lady Etheryn, or when I look at our child's face is immensely bigger. That may not have been possible without you." She averts her gaze, her cheeks turning pink. "So... I suppose this would be a good moment to say thank you."
rows.translation:
“你在想什么？”你问道，在她身边坐下。 
    
    “我只是在想人生。”她叹息道。
    
    “你喜欢吗？你现在的人生？”
    
    “哦，喜欢得超乎你的想象。”她脸上浮现腼腆的笑容。“我拥有自己曾经梦想的一切。我很幸运，也很幸福。”
    
    “那问题是什么？”
    
    “没有问题。但世上也不存在毫无忧虑的灵魂。在这样的深夜里，我有时会怀疑，自己是否配得上这份幸福的命运。我辜负了伊瑟琳女士；我没有斥责艾莉莎的行为，因而辜负了她，后来没有前去帮助她，又辜负了她一次。我辜负了王国，也辜负了这里的人民。可我如今却仍在这里，尽管有过这么多失败，怀中依然抱着自己一直渴望的事物。”
    
    “人不会由自己的失败来定义，吉莎。”
    
    “那由什么定义？”
    
    “我想，是他们从失败中学到的东西。”
    
    “你……你觉得我从中学到了吗？”
    
    “我想只有你能回答这个问题。”

    "What's on your mind?" you ask her, taking a seat right next to her. 
    
    "I was just thinking about life," she sighs.
    
    "Do you like it? Your life now?"
    
    "Oh, like you wouldn't believe." A shy smile appears on her face. "I have everything I could have ever dreamt. I am fortunate and happy."
    
    "What's the problem then?"
    
    "There is no problem. But there is also no such a thing as a worriless soul. And in the midst of nights like this I sometimes wonder If I deserve this joyful fate. I failed Lady Etheryn, I failed Alissa when I didn't scold her behaviour, and then again when I didn't go to her aid. I failed the kingdom, and its people. Yet here I am, despite my many failures, cradling in my arms what I have always desired."
    
    "People are not defined by their failures, Gytha."
    
    "By what then?"
    
    "What they learn from those failures, I guess."
    
    "Do you... do you think I have learnt from them?"
    
    "I think only you can answer that."
    
    "I try," she says. "I try to make up for my mistakes, to do better... I hoped the guilt would go away if I did, but it does not. I sometimes still wonder what would have happened if I stood up for Lady Etheryn, or what would have happened if I got to Alissa before you. Could I have changed her mind? Would I at least feel like I had done everything within my power to help her instead of having this lurking thought that I abandoned her?"
    
    "Those are things we will never know. Things we will never be able to change."
    
    "I am aware. And despite what I may think when my own happiness begins to feel scary, it is probably better that way. Speaking of which, I... I don't think I got to thank you."
    
    "What for?"
    
    "For stopping me before I got to Dracia, for this second chance. All that I said is true. I feel remorse, I sometimes wonder what could have been and I still feel deeply for my friend. But the joy I feel when I see the good we are doing alongside Lady Etheryn, or when I look at our child's face is immensely bigger. That may not have been possible without you." She averts her gaze, her cheeks turning pink. "So... I suppose this would be a good moment to say thank you."
    '

        |那个小小的、几乎看不见的凸起，她总是轻轻抚摸着它。如此微不足道的东西，竟能带来如此温暖的感觉，真是不可思议。
        |那个刚开始凸出来的小包，随着她体内孕育的生命一天天成长，也在逐渐变大。
        |她那明显已经怀孕的腹部，她不停地抚摸着。她说这样做是为了让胎儿安静下来，但显然，她这么做也是为了让自己感到安慰。
    ]只要感觉到她的肚子就在自己的手掌下，这个女孩就会感到无比开心，她的心里充满了最纯粹的幸福。
    
    “你感觉怎么样？”你问她。
    
    “有点紧张，”她笑着说。
    
    “我本以为奥丹家族的战士应该不会对怀孕有什么顾虑才对，”你开玩笑地她说。
    
    我……不会的，”她急忙回答道，“我可以毫无问题地生下你的孩子。事实上，我甚至可以生下十几个。”
    
    “好吧，那我们就这么办吧。”
    
    “我们……真的要这么做吗？”
    
    “也许吧。如果你喜欢这种体验的话。我们会一步一步来处理这些事情。”
    
    “哦，我真的很享受这段经历。虽然并不容易，但这也难怪吧？”她再次轻抚着自己的腹部，脸上不自觉地浮现出一丝微笑，“我体内正有一个新的生命在成长。有一个新的生命陪伴着我，而在我心中，没有什么感觉比保护它更重要的了。这种感觉……真的无法用言语来形容。你……”她移开了视线，“你是不是也想触摸它呢？”
    
    “那个小肿块？”
    
    她缓缓地点了点头，仿佛害怕如果动作太快，会把你吓跑一样。
    
    当然，”你伸出手，此刻反而是你变得动作迟缓、充满紧张了。她握住了你的手，将其引向自己的腹部。
    
    [gytha.bellyPregRange 0 25
        |现在还远远感觉不到任何变化，毕竟这个微小的隆起乍一看几乎难以察觉，但吉莎那充满热情的表情、她那热切的神情，以及她温柔的触碰，确实让人感到一阵温暖。这种感觉确实很特别，真的是难以用语言形容。
        
        当你轻轻抚摸她的身体，你的手被她手掌和腹部夹在中间时，你突然意识到，自己可以一整天都这样做。 
        |现在这个凸起已经非常明显了，不仅肉眼能看出来，用手触摸也能感觉到。你首先会感受到她柔软的皮肤，而当你开始轻轻抚摸她的时候，会发现下面有什么东西在移动。
        
        “你感觉到了吗？”吉莎瞪大眼睛，紧紧握住你的手，大声问道。是宝宝在动！哦，天啊，你感觉到了吗？”
        
        “我感到了，确实感到了，”你一边说，一边继续轻抚着她。如果你说没有让你的心跳加速，那你就是在撒谎。
        
        “宝宝是因为你在这里才开心的，”她抽泣着说道。她似乎快要哭出来了。
        
        “我当然会在这里，”你把头放在她的肚子上。你不仅能感觉到那里有动静，还能听到微弱的心跳声。看来这个新生命似乎很喜欢你说的话。为了宝宝，也为了你。”
        
        你闭上眼睛，专注于那微弱而代表着新生命诞生的声音——那是它第一次跳动的心跳。这些声音所传达的信息，远比任何交响乐都要深刻。吉莎又抽泣起来。
        
        “你在哭吗？你问道，此时你的双眼依然紧闭，头依然靠在她的肩上。
        
        “不，”她说道，而你知道，这些话是她在泪水中说出的。“我叫吉莎·米拉达·奥丹，我不会哭泣。”
        
        “我以为我听到有人在哭泣。那一定是宝宝了。”
        
        “一定是。”她抱住你的头，同时也轻轻抚摸着自己的肚子，你们三个人就这样静静地待在一起，沉浸在这一刻的美好之中。
    ]
    
    [silly
        |你已经想好名字了吗？”你问她。
        
        “如果是男孩，我就叫他‘无名’，和我父亲一样。”
        
        “如果是女孩呢？”
        
        “那样的话，也叫‘无名’，就像我母亲一样。”
        
        “这些真的是他们的名字吗？”
        
        “看起来应该是吧，”她耸了耸肩，“你可以去维基百科上查一下。
    ]

rows.original:
"[pc.name]!" [var2] calls out to you. "Thank the Seven you are here. It's Gytha, hurry."
    
    [var1|He|She] rushes towards the keep, leaving you no choice but to spring after them before you can even ask yourself what's going on. The path takes you to the living quarters, and before you know it, you open the door to find Gytha sitting down, her legs open and her face the most red it has ever been. 
    
    "Breathe in, breathe out, Gytha. Deep breaths," [party.has cait
        |Elthara
        |Cait
    ] says. She has taken care of the situation and kneels before the pregnant elf, right between her spread thighs.
    
    "Oh my god. You are doing great," Ryn says, holding her hand. 
    
    For Lumia's sake, she's in labor.
    
    "Everyone who is not [pc.name], out of the room," [party.has cait
        |Elthara
        |Cait
    ] orders.
    
    "No." Gytha holds Ryn tight, stopping her from moving even one step away.
    
    "Okay, she can stay. Everyone else, out."
    
    "Where is [pc.name]?" Gytha asks. A layer of sweat coats her face, gluing blonde locks to her forehead and temples. She must be in so much pain she cannot even think straight, but somehow she's still beautiful.
    
    "I'm here," you announce as you grab her free hand, which she is quick to squeeze hard.
    
    "I apologize. Forgive me, I beg you. I cannot do this. I-I can't," Gytha cries, trying to catch her breath.
    
    "What's your name?" you ask her.
    
    "Wha... what?" she asks in a daze.
    
    "Tell me who you are."
    
    "I am G-Gytha Myrrada Odain, heir of the Odain family."
    
    "And do you really think that's the name of someone who cannot do it?"
    
    "I want to," she cries. "But it hurts so much, and the baby refuses to come out. I suspect our child hates me."
    
    "The baby just wanted to wait for me," you joke. "Now that I'm here, I''ll stay with you the whole time, okay?"
    
    "O-okay," she nods between choppy breaths. 
    
    "I need you to push, Gytha," [party.has cait
        |Elthara
        |Cait
    ] says. "Breathe and push, breathe and push. You can do this."
    
    "I can, I can..." Gytha repeats under her breath. She gathers all her strength and pushes, squeezing your hand so hard you think she may break it. 
    
    It's a long night. One of the longest you recall. Gytha's screams and cries remain in your ears long after silence finally comes, but it all falls short in comparison to her titanic effort. If anything, you wish you could have done something else other than just remain by her side witnessing her pain. 
    
    However, no matter what you could have done, how much of her burden you could have carried, all the pain, hers and yours, is alleviated when you hear the newborn's first cry. 
    
    "It's a [var0|boy|girl]," [party.has cait
        |Elthara
        |Cait
    ] announces as she carries the crying baby to Gytha.
    
    "Our [var1|boy|girl]." Gytha takes [var1|him|her] into her arms and melts. If she had any tears left, she'd shed it now, but instead she smiles at your [var1|son|daughter], and it's one the warmest, most pure smiles you can ever witness.
    
    [var0
        |"He is a handsome little man. Have you thought of a name yet?" Ryn asks.
    
        "What do you think of Lythen?" Gytha says, her eyes searching for yours, expecting your approval. "I like that for his first name, but he needs a second one. Every nobleborn should have it."
        
        "What men do you miss the most right now?" you ask her.
        
        "My brother Claes," she smiles."
        
        "We should go with Lythen Claes Odain then," you confirm.
    
        "Oh, I love it."
    ]
    
    The baby looks at you, crying as if [var1|he|she] had no intention of ever stopping. Hopefully it's not because he has any issue with the name.
    
    "Isn't [var1|he|she] precious?" Gytha asks.
    
    And despite the tears and the screams coming out of the little soul in front of you, she is completely right. You could spend your whole life admiring this moment.
rows.translation:
“[pc.name]！” [var2]它在呼唤你：“感谢七神，你终于来了。我是吉莎，快过来。
    
    [var1|他|她]他们冲向了堡垒，让你根本来不及思考发生了什么，就不得不跟了上去。这条路将你引向了居住区，不知不觉间，你推开了门，发现吉莎正坐在那里，双腿分开，脸涨得通红。

“深呼吸，吉莎。慢慢地吸气，再慢慢地呼气。 [party.has cait
        |艾尔萨拉
        |凯特
    ]她说，她已经处理好了这一切，现在跪在那位怀孕的精灵面前，就站在她张开的双腿之间。

“天啊，你做得太棒了，”小琳握着她的手说道。

看在卢米娅的份上，她现在正在分娩啊……

“所有那些没有[pc.name]，走出房间。 [party.has cait
        |艾尔萨拉
        |凯特
    ]不行。”吉莎紧紧握住小琳的手，不让她迈出半步。

“好吧，她可以留下。其他人，都出去。”

“她去哪儿了[pc.name]？”吉莎问道。一层汗水覆盖在她的脸上，使金色的头发粘在额头和太阳穴上。她一定疼得无法正常思考，但即便如此，她依然显得如此美丽。

“我在这里，”你一边说，一边握住了她空着的那一只手，而她立刻紧紧地握住了你的手。
    
    我道歉，求你原谅我。我做不到，我真的做不到，”吉莎哭着，试图喘过气来。

“你叫什么名字？”你问她。

“什……什么？”她茫然地反问。

“告诉我，你到底是谁。我是吉莎·米拉达·奥丹，奥丹家族的继承人。”

“你真觉得这样的名字会让人无法完成这件事吗？”

“我想要，”她哭着说，“但是太疼了，孩子就是不肯出来。我怀疑我们的孩子讨厌我。”

“宝宝只是想等我而已，”你开玩笑地说，“现在我来了，我会一直陪在你身边的，好吗？”

“好……好吧，”她在断断续续的呼吸中点了点头。

“吉莎，你需要用力推一下。 [party.has cait
        |艾尔萨拉
        |凯特
    ]她说：“深呼吸，然后用力推，再深呼吸，再用力推。你一定能做到的。”

“我能的，我能的……”吉莎小声地重复着。她聚集起全部的力量，用力推着，握住你的手的力量大到让你觉得她的手可能会被捏断。 
    
    这是一个漫长的夜晚——也是你记忆中最漫长的夜晚之一。即使在寂静最终降临之后，吉莎的尖叫声与哭喊声依然萦绕在你的耳边，但与她所付出的巨大努力相比，这一切都显得微不足道。如果你可以的话，你真希望能做点别的，而不仅仅是陪在她身边，眼睁睁看着她承受痛苦。 
    
    然而，无论你能够做些什么，无论你能为她分担多少负担，当听到新生儿的第一声啼哭时，她所有的痛苦，以及你的痛苦，都会得到缓解。

“是个男孩！ [var0|男孩|女孩]，" [party.has cait
        |艾尔萨拉
        |凯特
    ]她一边抱着哭泣的婴儿走向吉莎，一边说道：

“我们的[var1|男孩|女孩]吉莎拿走了。 [var1|他|她]投入她的怀抱，仿佛融化般温暖。如果她还有泪水的话，此刻一定会流出来；然而，她却对你露出了微笑。 [var1|儿子|女儿]那是一种最温暖、最纯粹的微笑，是你所能见过的最美好的微笑之一。
    
    [var0
        |他是个帅气的小男孩。你们已经想好给他取什么名字了吗？”小琳问道。

“你觉得‘莱森’怎么样？”吉莎说道，她的目光紧紧地盯着你，期待着得到你的同意。“我觉得用这个作为他的名字很不错，但他还需要一个姓氏。每个贵族出身的孩子都应该有姓氏。”

“你现在最想念的是哪些人呢？”你问她。

“我的哥哥克拉斯，”她微笑着说。

“那我们就叫他‘莱森·克拉斯·奥代恩’吧，”你决定道。

“哦，我太喜欢这个名字了。”她高兴地说道。
    ]
    
    婴儿看着你，哭着，仿佛在说[var1|他|她]并没有停止的打算。希望这并不是因为他对这个名字有什么意见。

“难道不是吗？ [var1|他|她]真珍贵吗？”吉莎问道。

尽管眼前的这个小女孩正在流泪、尖叫，但她说得完全正确。你完全可以花一生的时间来欣赏这一刻。

rows.original: You're used to seeing the gravid forms of I'ava and Sif... but that's not what you're seeing today. Poor Liresh and Syrish look exhausted, while the druids are utterly radiant. It's moments like this you can see why Lumia is compared so much to the sun, but if you told these girls that you'd probably be spoiling the moment. Best keep that thought to yourself. "[pc.name]! Look!" I'ava carefully holds out a giggling, burping, wiggling baby elf. "I made this!" Sif giggles and mimics her sister's sentiment, proudly showing off her other baby. "I feel so light and sexy again, but I already miss being luscious and big," Sif groans. "We're finally mothers now, though, and that's all that matters..." Syrish grins wickedly, tip-toeing over Sif's shoulder to gently tickle her baby's nose. "Hey, we could make that happen again..." The elf tuts, but looks down, attempting to hide a blush that creeps into her ears. "Shush. Anyway, we wanted to make sure you met them; they may not have come about if not for your mercy." [pc.hasRealCock |"Or seed," I'ava adds with a soft chuckle. ] After giving you a chance to hold both kids and tickle their ears until they're giggling and burbling, the druids return the precious little snowflakes to their embrace. "We should get back home now." "So, you've[pc.isBimbo |, like, totally ] officially moved in together?" All four girls do an uncanny job of going 'pssh' and waving the whole matter off. "Nonsense, we're just hanging around!" They might be a little in denial. "If you say so, congratulations on the healthy babies though.[pc.isBimbo| They're, like, actually so adorable it hurts.]" With proud smiles on their faces, and some exhausted looking snow-cats in tow — who do at least sneak a kiss on the cheek for you — they head back out into the forest.
rows.translation: 你已经习惯伊阿瓦和西芙大腹便便的模样……但今天看到的景象截然不同。她们依旧赤着双足，身穿平日的长袍，怀中却抱着襁褓，几个小宝宝正贴在胸前享用大餐。她们低调地快步进来，每人身后都跟着一名猫咪双胞胎。可怜的莉蕾什和西瑞什看起来筋疲力尽，两名德鲁伊却完全容光焕发。 正是在这样的时刻，你才看得出为什么人们总将卢米娅比作太阳；但要是告诉这些姑娘，大概会破坏此刻的气氛。最好还是把这个念头留给自己。 “[pc.name]！快看！”伊阿瓦小心地托起一个咯咯发笑、打着饱嗝、不停扭动的精灵宝宝。“这是我生的！”西芙笑了起来，也学着姐姐的语气，骄傲地展示自己的另一个孩子。 “我又觉得自己一身轻松、性感迷人了，可我已经开始想念那种丰腴而硕大的感觉了。”西芙呻吟道。“不过我们终于成为母亲了，这才是最重要的……” 西瑞什坏坏地笑着，踮起脚从西芙肩头探过身子，轻轻挠了挠她宝宝的鼻头。“嘿，我们可以再让你变成那样……” 精灵啧了一声，却又低下头，试图藏起一路爬到耳朵上的红晕。“嘘。总之，我们想确保你见到孩子们；若不是你的仁慈，他们也许根本不会来到世上。” [pc.hasRealCock |“还有你的种子。”伊阿瓦轻笑着补充。 ] 你轮流抱过两个孩子，又挠挠他们的耳朵，逗得他们咯咯直笑、咿呀作声；随后，德鲁伊们把这两片珍贵的小雪花重新拥进怀中。“我们该回家了。” “所以，你们已经[pc.isBimbo |，就，彻彻底底地 ]正式住到一起了？” 四个姑娘竟异口同声地发出“切”的一声，挥挥手便把整件事撇开。“胡说，我们只是经常一起待着！” 她们可能多少有些自欺欺人。“既然你们这么说，那就恭喜生下健康的宝宝。[pc.isBimbo|他们真的，简直可爱得让人受不了。]” 她们脸上带着骄傲的笑容，领着两名神色疲惫的雪猫——后者倒还都偷偷亲了亲你的脸颊——一起重新走入森林。
rows.raw: ' You're used to seeing the gravid forms of I'ava and Sif... but that's not what you're seeing today. Though walking around barefoot in their usual robes, they now have bundles hugged to chests, where little babies enjoy their feast. They dive in, hushed, with a cat-twin each in tow. Poor Liresh and Syrish look exhausted, while the druids are utterly radiant. It's moments like this you can see why Lumia is compared so much to the sun, but if you told these girls that you'd probably be spoiling the moment. Best keep that thought to yourself. "[pc.name]! Look!" I'ava carefully holds out a giggling, burping, wiggling baby elf. "I made this!" Sif giggles and mimics her sister's sentiment, proudly showing off her other baby. "I feel so light and sexy again, but I already miss being luscious and big," Sif groans. "We're finally mothers now, though, and that's all that matters..." Syrish grins wickedly, tip-toeing over Sif's shoulder to gently tickle her baby's nose. "Hey, we could make that happen again..." The elf tuts, but looks down, attempting to hide a blush that creeps into her ears. "Shush. Anyway, we wanted to make sure you met them; they may not have come about if not for your mercy." "If you say so, congratulations on the healthy babies though.[pc.isBimbo| They're, like, actually so adorable it hurts.]" With proud smiles on their faces, and some exhausted looking snow-cats in tow — who do at least sneak a kiss on the cheek for you — they head back out into the forest. '

rows.original: [var0 |I'ava and Sif, the boreal, breed-hungry twins, are sitting near the bar and chatting with anybody who will give them the time of day. Unsurprisingly, [sif.pregStage 0 1 |they're attracting plenty of attention, though they don't walk off with anyone in particular. Instead their eyes light up when they spot you, waiting in the hopes that you'll come to spend a little time with them. |and despite their already-pregnant bellies, there are plenty of people to give them attention... although you're fairly sure they've only got eyes for you, especially with Liresh and Syrish absent. ] |There's quite a cluster at the bar today, thanks to the presence of the bountiful boreal twins I'ava and Sif, and the half-leothran cuddle-kitties Liresh and Syrish. The quartet attracts plenty of attention from your fort's usual wandering merchants, or eager travelers looking to cross between forests. It doesn't matter how much attention they get, however, as when the two sets of twins spot you, you're the only [pc.mf |man |woman ] they have eyes for. ]

rows.original:
[var0
        |[sif.pregStage 1
            |"Why if it isn't our favorite person, [pc.name]." I'ava smiles softly, sipping a cup of tea at the bar and gently stroking her pregnant belly. 
            
            "I'm your favorite?"
            
            Sif gives an uncharacteristic giggle — either that or the baby kicked — and waves off-handedly. "You're in the top three, in no particular order. How about that?"
            
            "More believable, at least. How are you doing?"
            
            "We're doing well, hormones aside..." I'ava mutters, sharing a glance with her twin. "But maybe you could help with that?"
            |I'ava and Sif, now without their customary pregnant bellies, are an intimidating duo. They've got full-on steins full of... what looks like cider and ale at the same time. Those steins must be a fantastic workout, because you can see some surprising muscle on their biceps. They smile and wave at you, inviting you to take a seat with them besides the bar. "Well hello there... we've got the cats looking after the babes for the day." I'ava smiles softly.
            
            "Although we'll be rushing back by nightfall," Sif adds. "Want to spend some time together before we shamble home?"
        ]
        |[sif.pregStage 1
            |Four pairs of eyes glitter at you as you approach; I'ava and Sif sit side-by-side, sipping tea, while Liresh and Syrish sup on frothy pints of something probably stocked by Pupperidge. "Hey, it's the most beautiful [pc.race] I know, heya [pc.name]!" Liresh smiles brightly, fluffy tail swishing around and gently bapping I'ava and Sif on their noses.
            
            Syrish drains her mug, leaps to her feat, and pounces you to steal a hug before anyone else gets their chance. The elves simply smile shyly and give you little finger-waves, sipping their tea with perfect synchronicity. Warmth envelopes you, and your face is dragged down into squishy, fur-collared kitty-titty. "How's it going?"
            
            Once you're able to see the light — and breathe again — you sink your hands into the coal-furred cat's hair and rub at her until she squeals. "Fine, thanks."
            
            "Want to spend a little time together?" Sif smiles, brushing her own hands across the shorn sides of her hair, while her ears do a little nervous wiggling. "We do get super hormonal, but... there's always room for a meal and some relaxation, if you're hanging around."
            |I'ava, Sif, Liresh, and Syrish are a salacious combination of slender, druidic elf, and curvaceous kitty. 
            
            They don't match in any way. If you'd not seen them make lovesick eyes at one-another when the other isn't looking, you're sure the two sets of twins wouldn't have anything in common. As it stands, the quartet have proven made for eachother... and — judging by the looks in their eyes when you're close enough — you.
            
            "Heey there..." I'ava and Sif gently clunk tankards together at your approach, each lady with a hand buried in a cat's hair and rubbing their ears. "Come for a little fun?"
            
            "Or to put more babies in Eevy and Siffle?" Syrish teases, still purring throatily while her poofy tail swishes around.
            
            "...I hate these pet-names," I'ava scowls. "We keep telling you to stop it."
            
            "You love them; makes your ears wiggle," Liresh giggles, before yelping when it earns her an ear-pinch. "Ah! Okay, okay fine."
            
            The raven-haired I'ava huffs and shakes out her hair, before giving you a faint — if shy — smile. "We don't have to have sex to have fun, though I won't... deny how enjoyable it is with you."
        ]
    ]
rows.translation:
[var0
        |[sif.pregStage 1
            |如果那个人不是我们最喜欢的人，那还为什么，[pc.name]我微微一笑，坐在酒吧里喝着茶，轻轻抚摸着她隆起的腹部。”
            
            “我是你最喜欢的吗？”
            
            西芙发出了一阵不合她性格的轻笑——要么就是宝宝在踢她——然后漫不经心地摆了摆手。你排在前三名之列，具体顺序并不重要。这样怎么样？”
            
            “至少听起来更可信一些。你最近怎么样？”
            
            “还算不错，不过激素的影响还是挺大的……”我低声说道，同时与她的双胞胎姐妹交换了一个眼神。不过也许你可以帮忙解决这个问题？
            |艾娃和希芙现在不再有着她们惯常的怀孕隆起的腹部，但这对姐妹依然显得十分威武。她们手中端着的那些大杯子里，似乎同时装着苹果酒和麦芽酒。喝这样的酒肯定能让手臂的肌肉得到很好的锻炼，因为你能看到她们的二头肌上明显出现了肌肉线条。他们微笑着向你招手，邀请你和他们一起坐在酒吧旁边。“嗨，你好……今天有猫咪在照看那些小宝贝呢。”艾娃温柔地笑了起来。
            
            “不过我们会在天黑之前赶回来。”西芙补充道。在我们各自回家之前，想一起共度一些时光吗？
        ]
        |[sif.pregStage 1
            |当你靠近时，四双目光紧紧地注视着你；I'ava和Sif并坐在一起，一边喝茶，而Liresh和Syrish则喝着可能是Pupperidge提供的泡沫状饮料。“嘿，你真是太漂亮了[pc.race]我知道，嘿。 [pc.name]哇！”李雷什开心地笑了起来，它那蓬松的尾巴摇来摇去，轻轻碰了碰伊娃和西夫的鼻子。
            
            西里什一喝完杯子里的饮料，就跳到它的伙伴身边，抢在其他人之前抱住了你。精灵们只是害羞地微笑，向你轻轻挥了挥小手指，同时无比同步地啜饮着茶。一股温暖的气息包围着你，你的脸不知不觉就变得像一只戴着毛茸茸项圈的小猫咪一样圆润可爱。“最近怎么样？
            
            一旦你能够看到光明，重新开始呼吸，你就会把双手伸进那只覆盖着煤灰的猫的毛发中，轻轻揉搓它，直到它发出吱吱的叫声。“好了，谢谢。”
            
            “想一起度过一些时光吗？西芙微笑着，用双手轻轻整理着自己剪短的头发，她的耳朵也有些紧张地微微动着。“我们的确会因为荷尔蒙的影响而情绪波动，但是……如果你在附近的话，总还是可以一起吃顿饭、放松一下的吧。"
            |艾娃、希芙、利雷什和西里什，这一组合简直是将苗条的德鲁伊精灵与曲线优美的猫娘完美地融合在了一起。
            
            她们之间没有任何相似之处。如果你没有看到她们在对方不注意的时候互相投以充满爱意的眼神，你肯定会认为这两对双胞胎之间没有任何共同点。目前来看，这四个人似乎确实天生就是为彼此而存在的……而且——当你靠近他们时，从他们眼中的神情就能看出来——他们也是为你而存在的。
            
            “嘿，你好……”当你走近时，艾娃和西芙轻轻地将手中的酒壶碰在了一起，两位女士都把手伸进猫的毛发里，轻轻揉着它们的耳朵。过来一起玩吧？”
            
            “还是想让伊薇和西芙尔再多生些小宝宝呢？”西里什调皮地问道，她的喉咙里还发出咕噜咕噜的声音，蓬松的尾巴也在不停地摆动。
            
            “……我讨厌这些昵称，”艾瓦皱着眉头说道。我们一直都在告诉你们，别这样做了。”
            
            “你们明明很喜欢它们，看到它们就会忍不住笑出声来，”莉蕾什笑着说，话音刚落就挨了一记捏耳光的惩罚，顿时尖叫起来：“啊！好吧，好吧，我再也不说了。”
            
            那个有着乌黑头发的伊娃哼了一声，甩了甩头发，然后给了你一个淡淡的——虽然带着些害羞——微笑。我们并不一定要通过性行为来获得乐趣，不过我必须承认，和你在一起的时候，性行为确实会带来很多愉悦。
        ]
    ]

rows.original: There's no space at the bar for you to feast, so at some point along the way your group transitions to crowding around the end of one of the common room's long tables. The Wayfort gets a lot of visitors, and your particularly-attractive corner of the fort is no exception. Thankfully, they leave you in peace once the meal arrives; a delicious buttery shortcrust pie, stuffed to the brim with shredded steak, caramelized onions, and a gravy so thick you could stand a knife up in it. [iava.pregStage 0 1 3 |Sif and I'ava share a look, licking their lips in a way that makes you think more of ferocious predators than hungry druids, before carving up a great big slice each. |Just the short wait has had Sif and I'ava looking ravenous, and they hold their pregnant bellies as though it were a promise to match the pending bundles of joy with fully-blown food babies instead. |The elves prior to now have been transitioning rapidly between discomfort and utter hunger, riding that narrow edge of 'help, we're eating for two' and 'I'm being constantly kicked in the tummy'. Now that the food has arrived, its siren song washes away that discomfort in real time. ] Considering you're the [pc.mf |master |mistress ] of this house, when you move up to get your own slice, there's a hand held up and an 'Ah-ah-ah' from Sif and I'ava, before they serve you[sif.orgy | and the cats your own honking big slices | your own great big slice ]. This had been intended as a social call; a chance to chat with the girls, and relax before heading out once more into that dark, dangerous world. Instead your mouths are so constantly stuffed with meaty pie and buttery potato that there's no opportunity to exchange words at all, besides the occasional [sif.orgy |purr and ]happy moan. In no time at all, the lot of you polish off the pie and mash, and as empty plates are taken away, fresh ones are settled down; lighter fare, consisting of a thin veggie soup, and some crackers. "I couldn't eat another bite..." I'ava groans, even as her sister dips a cracker in soup and feeds her yet more. You actually do tap out, unwilling to render yourself completely immobile just because the other girls are still eating. [sif.orgy |The cats too are halfway to being completely splayed out across the table, struggling to keep drooping eyes open. |Things have quieted down in general in the common room, leaving you free to enjoy the meal in peace. ].. looks like dinnertime is at its close. "I should get going again." You groan and stretch, straining yourself until there's a satisfying click in your back, and a gurgle from your stomach telling you to sit still. There's only so much sitting around you can do, however, and although this statement earns a few whines of complaint, nobody stops you from getting up. If they even can, considering the amount of pie and potato the girls have all put away with you. rows.original:
"The Terrestrial Fire... why do you serve it so faithfully?"
    
    "Why?" the hellhound echoes back. "Because I was born to it. To protect the cult's temple was my purpose, and has been since I was a pup! What I had thought [kari.isMom
        |our
        |my
    ] childrens' would be. But the last of the flame druids breathed their last years ago now. I swore an oath to the temple's master when I was a child, that I would protect the eternal flame until my dying day. Yet the days have grown long and the temple grows cold. The fire there is symbolic; what you have taken is the last ember of true power that remained to the cult I once proudly served. I served out of loyalty to that flame, and now you bear it. I would rather protect the inheritor of the Terrestrial Flame, or what little remains of it, than cold and empty stone now long abandoned." 
    
    "And you would serve me with that same loyalty?"
    
    The hellhound's tail swishes, and she raises her chin proudly. "If you would have me. I am no young spark anymore, but I am still strong, and I am loyal unto death. No foe will breach your castle's walls while I live.[kari.isMom
        | And I will birth you many strong, fierce daughters to carry on my duty!
    ]"
rows.translation:
“大地之火……你为何如此忠心地侍奉它？”
    
    “为什么？”地狱犬回声般应道。“因为我生来就属于它。守护教派的圣殿曾是我的使命，从我还是幼犬起就是如此！我本以为那会是我[kari.isMom
        |我们的
        |我的
    ]孩子们的归宿。但最后一位火焰德鲁伊早在多年前就咽了气。我还是个孩子时就向圣殿的主人立下誓言，要守护那永恒之焰直到我死的那天。可日子越拖越长，圣殿也越来越冷。那里的火只是象征；你所夺走的，是我曾引以为傲地效忠过的那个教派所剩的最后一点真力的余烬。我当初是出于对那团火焰的忠诚而侍奉，而如今承载它的是你。与其守着那些早已被遗弃的冰冷空石，我更愿意守护大地之火的继承者——或者说，守护它所剩无几的部分。” 
    
    “而你会以同样的忠诚来侍奉我吗？”
    
    地狱犬的尾巴一摆，她骄傲地抬起下巴。“如果你愿意收下我。我早已不是年轻的火花，但我依然强壮，而且我会忠诚至死。只要我还活着，就没有敌人能攻破你城堡的墙。[kari.isMom
        | 我还会为你生下许多强壮、凶悍的女儿，来延续我的职责！
    ]”

rows.original:
"You can stay," you tell her. You [kari.isMom
        |squat down, and immediately are all but barreled over by your daughter squealing in delight and running into your arms. Her mother's barely a step behind her, picking you both up and squeezing you into a hug
        |extend a hand, but the hellhound's already past your arm and grabbing you into a fierce hug
    ] that has your [pc.face] smothered into her dark cleavage. 
    
    "I swear on the Terrestrial Fire that burns in my blood, you won't regret this! I shall be your loyal hound so long as I shall live, my Champion. My liege!"
    
    With those massive arms bearhugging you, there's no escape until she's spun you around and planted you back on your feet[kari.isMom
        | with your hands full of giggling hell-pup
    ]. When the rush of excitement abates, though, the red-robed [silly
        |wan
        |woman
    ] composes herself and solemnly — or as much so as she can with a wagging tail — lowers her head. "It has been years beyond counting since I last had anyone to serve[silly
        | and protect
    ]. I am called Karithea, child of the Terrestrial Fire... though you may call me Kari[kari.fucked
        |... or mommy, if you prefer
    ]. I do hereby swear to be at your side, bearer of my flame, until the last spark of the sun burns cold."
    
    With her head bowed low, it feels like the appropriate thing to do is reach out and pat her ears. The gesture takes Kari by surprise, but sets her tail wagging that much harder all the same. "I will stand guard here at your gates. But if you wish to continue this... I am at your service, my flame!" 
    
    You feel safer... and quite a lot warmer... already.

rows.original:
You find Kari squatting down next to Daliza's warg, Narcie, giving her fellow canine a thorough brushing down with her hands. The big warg's on her back, tongue lolling out of her mouth and eyes half-closed, heedless of your approach — though her tail's already intense swishing does pick up a notch, as does Kari's.
    
    "Hello, [kari.fucked
        |my flame
        |flamebearer
    ]!" the hellhound says, glancing up at you long enough to give you a warm smile before returning her attention to Narcie. "I am communing with this proud and noble beast."
    
    A fat dollop of drool drops off the tip of Narcie's tongue.
    
    "So fierce and strong!" Kari affirms, rubbing Narcie's belly. "A fine protector and partner for Lady Daliza."
    
    The hellhound slaps Narcie's chest lightly and stands — or tries to, anyway, before the warg grabs her wrist in her jaw and drags her back down for one last belly rub.
    
    A whistle from the direction of the keep finally gets Narcie on her feet and trotting away, leaving you and Kari to your devices.
rows.translation:
你看到卡莉蹲在达丽莎的伙伴纳西旁边，正用手仔细地为这只犬类梳理毛发。那只体型庞大的犬类趴在她的背上，舌头耷拉着，眼睛半闭着，似乎完全没有注意到你的靠近——不过它的尾巴已经开始剧烈地摆动起来，卡莉的尾巴也在同一时刻开始晃动。
    
    “你好， [kari.fucked
        |我的火焰
        |火把手
    ]哼！”那头地狱犬说道，它抬头看了你一眼，露出了一个温暖的笑容，然后又将注意力转回了纳西身上。“我正在与这只高贵而骄傲的野兽交流呢。”
    
    纳西的舌头上掉下了一大滴口水。
    
    真是太凶猛、太强壮了！”卡莉一边说，一边轻轻抚摸着纳西的肚子，“真是达莉莎小姐理想的守护者和伴侣啊。”
    
    那只地狱犬轻轻拍了拍纳西的胸膛，然后试图站起来——不过在它刚抬起腿的时候，那只战争犬就用它的下颚抓住了纳西的手腕，又将她拉了回去，继续给她抚摸肚子。
    
    从堡垒方向传来的哨声终于让纳西站了起来，她小跑着离开了，留下你和卡莉继续各自做自己的事。

rows.original: Hana's made her way into the fort for once, deep in conversation with Kari, but you're treated to two bushy tails a-wagging when you head over. "Heyya, sweetheart!" Hana says, giving you a wave. "[kari.fucked |My flame |Flamebearer ]," Kari says. She lifts a paw off where it's been idly scratching Hana's ears and [party.has ryn |transplants it to Ryn's head instead |gives your shoulder a squeeze ]. "Your fiancee and I were discussing our exercise routines." Hana pokes [kari.pregStage 2 |one of Kari's big biceps |Kari's chiseled abs ] and grins. "Would that I were an orc and could build myself up just by eating! We're talking about maybe splitting the cost of some new weight-training equipment, but..." "But neither of us have any income!" Kari laughs. "And no, don't offer, I'll make some myself! I'm a fine smith, you know." "Then I'm sure I can source some more metal off the colony. Lots of spare scraps lying around here and there." Hana and Kari exchange a vigorous handshape that does some delightful things to their bosoms, before Hana slips off towards the gate, blowing you a kiss on her way out. "A fine choice of mate," Kari says with an approving nod. "You two will make many strong pups! So, what brings you to me as well?"

rows.translation: 今天，艾尔萨拉比你先到达了卡里泰亚，他们两个[var0 | 怀孕晚期 ]当你走过去时，女人们已经在愉快地交谈着了。[pc.name]，看到你后，艾尔萨拉恭敬地向你点了点头，说道：‘你好。希望你不会介意我暂时让卡丽泰亚分心一会儿。’” 那只巨大的猎犬笑了起来。[kari.eltharaFucked |亲爱的，你从来都不会分散我的注意力。毕竟，我们的感情是彼此共有的。 |至少，美女是我最喜欢的那种能让人分心的东西。 ]你们两个在聊什么？”你问道。 [var1 |我们的孩子，”艾尔萨拉承认道，脸颊瞬间泛红，“我们俩都希望能在一个更温暖、更安全的环境中抚养他们。” “你才刚成为母亲，”卡莉说道，“但你的身心都非常坚强。有你在身边保护他们，孩子们什么都不用害怕。” 艾尔萨拉把手放在肚子上，微笑着说道：“如果你能以公民的身份更直接地为这个王国做出贡献，那就再安全不过了……” 卡莉举手示意她继续说下去。[kari.eltharaFucked |亲爱的，我很感激你的好意，但是…… ]我是[pc.name]那头野兽[pc.hisHers]独自一人。我会让我的孩子们像我小时候那样自由自在、无拘无束。我们不需要任何女王式的统治来束缚我们。 |弗罗斯特伍德的安全至关重要，”艾尔萨拉说道，“这些年来，卡里泰亚在城里的护林员们中间已经成为了一个传奇人物。如今恶魔开始侵扰这片森林，她为保卫我们的领地而付出的努力也就更加多了。能知道这位传说的真面目，真是太好了，嗯？”卡莉一边说，一边展示着自己的肌肉。“告诉你的游荡者们，我是独自狩猎的，艾尔萨拉。已经很多很多年没有和其他人一起行动过了。不过，我很高兴自己的努力能够有所帮助——即使我并不是尼奥哈尔特的公民。艾尔萨拉微笑着说道：“你知道，我们是可以改变这种状况的。伊瑟琳——” 卡莉举手示意道：[kari.eltharaFucked |亲爱的，我很感激你的好意，但是…… ]我是[pc.name]那头野兽[pc.hisHers]独自一人。我既不需要，也不想要你那个小女王的祝福，就能在这片森林里狩猎。 ] [party.has ryn |小琳的耳朵微微一动。“但是你确实就生活在我们这片土地上。” 卡莉将手放在小琳的头上，轻轻抚摸着她金色的头发：“你是这些土地的主人，小琳，但你是否真的明白这个意义呢？持有他们？在过去的两百年里，Njorhaalt还有哪位女王能够做到这一点呢？她笑了，不过那是一种善意的笑。 ]也许再过几代人，恩乔哈尔特会重新恢复元气，重新夺回它的领地。但眼下，这片森林属于精灵、野人以及恶魔。也有一些勇敢的殖民者居住在这里，不过精灵的数量很少。也许我的子孙，或者他们的后代，有朝一日会登上王位……但我，将会追随我的火焰使者，继续我的道路[pc.himHer]独自一人……” 艾尔萨拉叹了口气：“也许在未来的某一天，你会改变主意的，卡丽泰亚。达莉莎女士和她的游骑兵们，真的会从你的经验和力量中受益匪浅。” “他们现在就已经从中受益了！”卡莉坚持说道，“而且只要我不被束缚，他们就会继续受益。不过……我猜，你永远都不会停止要求我帮忙吧……” 这位粉发精灵轻声笑了起来。[kari.eltharaFucked |你非得这样不可，亲爱的。” “那……确实是这样。任何能见到你的理由，我都觉得很开心，”卡莉叹了口气说道。 |你已经很了解我了。” “我了解卢米安人，”卡莉说道，“他们就像黎明一样坚韧不拔。 ][pc.name]，别用你那副可怜巴巴的眼神看着我！你来找我有什么事？” 艾尔萨拉向你们两人鞠了一躬，然后离开了。

rows.original: "Tell me about the Cult of the Terrestrial Fire?" The hellhound frowns. "I'm no priest, [kari.fucked |my flame |flamebearer ]. I was a warrior. Not a paladin, or some crusading war-cleric, but a guardian. I can't tell you the inner mysteries of the cult." "I'll settle for what you do know." "Very well," she says, running a paw through her crimson mane. "I am sure you know of the druids that were once common in these woods; what was once the realm of Njorhaalt?" You nod. "I've met [var0|several of them in the Winter City|one, Hethia]." [party.has ryn |Etheryn's ears droop. "This still is Njorhaalt!" Kari just reaches over and pats the elf's head. ]"There were many sects of the druidic faith. All animists, all worshippers of the wyld spirits of the world, but some focused on healing, or growing plants, or conjuring spirits of the forest. Some looked beyond the mantle of the earth, and saw the flame within, roiling at the heart of Savarra. This, they found, was the most powerful of all the wyld's aspects, the flaming lifesblood of the world. This sect dubbed themselves the Cult of the Terrestrial Fire, and built their temple over a seam of flame that has burned eternal ever since the days when even the Winter City was but a hillfort beneath the glacial wall!" The hellhound puffs her chest out proudly. "From the eternal flame, our faith drew great power indeed. Our priests' mastery of flames could scour our foes a mile away, sear closed grevious wounds, burn away the rot and renew the forest! We were respected far and wide, and even dragons and kings came to seek our wisdom and strength!" [ashe.around |Your mace thrums at your side. "Renewing the forest... Hmm, now that she mentions it, I very distinctly remember her little cult offering me gifts of scale salve and pretty clothes. I certainly never asked them for anything. Except directions, once, when I was very young and rather lost. Surely they wouldn't remember something that mundane so vividly though..." Now you're wondering if that salamander statue might have been their memory of a young Ashe.. ] "So you all worshiped lava, from underground?" Kari huffs. "It was more than that! The earthfire was alive with power and promise, in those days, and it sang back to us as surely as the wind howls in the forest. Spirits swam the seas of magma, [pc.name]! We drew them out, bound them to service, worshipped them! It was no mundane fire that surged through the temple. Even now, the eternal flame still burns, even centuries past the cult's prime!" "What happened to the cult, anyway?" you ask. "You seem to be all that's left." The pride burning in Karithea's eyes wanes, and her shoulders slump. "I expect you wish the whole grand story, of betrayal and death and all the horrors that would see a powerful faith scattered to the winds and left as nothing more than a memory?" You wince. "Was it that bad?" "No, worse," Kari says sadly. "There was no grand betrayal, nor some climactic battle I could have perished in to defend my faith. There was just... a slow, painless death. Flamepriests got old, and died. The youth slipped away in the night, running off to the city, or to join the forest druids. Njorhaalt scorned us, the south forgot we had ever existed, and the kitsune began to poison the Old Wyld — what little was left of it after the Godswar. I remember the last high priest, Karles, and his three grandchildren... two of them ran away after their parents died, off to join their cousins in defiance of the Lumians' new order. The third crossed a witch of the woods, and was never seen again. Karles and I were all that was left in the temple after that, and he wasted away soon enough. At least the twins came back in the end, to see him off. But they didn't stay." The hellhound's tail curls under her leg. "That was well over a decade ago now. Perhaps much longer — the march of years escaped me in my solitude. Long enough for me to have been forgotten by my own children, it seems." She gives you a faltering smile, and [party.has ryn |pats your head and Ryn's both |reaches out to pat your head ]. "But those days of loneliness are long past now, thanks to you, [kari.fucked |my flame |flamebearer ]! You awakened the last embers of the Terrestrial Fire... and stoked the flames of battle[kari.fucked | and desire ] in my heart for the first time in an age! Don't think me a sad old bitch. I have purpose again, in you and this keep[kari.isMom | — and in our new pack, my mate ]!"
rows.translation: 跟我讲讲‘大地之火崇拜’吧？” 那只地狱犬皱起了眉头：“我又不是牧师[kari.fucked |我的火焰 |火把手 ]我曾是一名战士。不是圣骑士，也不是什么投身正义战争的牧师，而只是个守护者。那些教派的秘密，我实在无法向你透露。” “那你所知道的，就足够了。” “好吧，”她说着，用爪子轻轻梳理着自己那猩红色的鬃毛，“你应该知道，曾经这些森林里遍布德鲁伊；这里也曾是Njorhaalt的领地吧？” 你点了点头：“我确实听说过。 [var0|冬城里的其中一些人|第一个，赫希娅]。" [party.has ryn |伊瑟琳的耳朵耷拉了下来。“这仍然是Njorhaalt！” 卡莉只是伸出手，轻轻拍了拍那名精灵的脑袋。 ]德鲁伊信仰中存在着许多不同的派别。他们都是万物有灵论者，都崇拜自然界中的各种精灵与力量，但有些派别专注于治疗疾病、培育植物，或是召唤森林中的精灵；而另一些派别则试图洞察大地的深处，去探寻蕴藏于萨瓦拉核心处的那股炽热能量。他们发现，这才是所有自然力量中最强大的一种，是这个世界燃烧的生命之源。这个教派将自己称为“地火教”，并在一条自古以来就持续燃烧的火焰之上建立了他们的寺庙——甚至早在冬城还只是一座位于冰川墙下的山丘堡垒的时候，这条火焰就已经存在了！那头地狱犬骄傲地挺起胸膛：“正是从永恒之火中，我们的信仰汲取了强大的力量。我们的祭司们对火焰的控制力足以消灭一英里之外的敌人，治愈严重的伤口，烧尽腐朽之物，甚至让森林重新焕发生机！我们远近闻名，就连龙和国王也都前来寻求我们的智慧与力量！ [ashe.around |你的战锤紧贴在身侧。“恢复森林……嗯，现在她提到了这个，我清楚地记得她曾经献上的那些小祭品。我规模庞大的礼物、治愈伤痛的药膏，还有漂亮的衣服……我当然从来都没有要求过这些。他们除了方向指引之外，其实没有什么别的。有一次，当我还很小的时候，有点迷路了……但他们应该不会如此清晰地记得这么平常的事情吧…… 现在你可能在想，那座蝾螈雕像，会不会就是他们对年轻时的艾希的记忆呢…… ] 所以你们所有人都是崇拜地下的岩浆吗？” 卡莉哼了一声：“远不止如此！在那些日子里，地火充满了力量与希望，它会像森林里呼啸的风一样，清晰地回应我们。各种精灵在岩浆的海洋中游荡[pc.name]我们把它们取出，供奉起来，虔诚地崇拜它们！那可不是普通的火焰——它曾在神庙中熊熊燃烧。即便过了几个世纪，那个崇拜仪式的鼎盛时期已经过去，那永恒的火焰依然在燃烧。” “那么，那个崇拜仪式最终发生了什么呢？”你问道，“看来现在只剩下你们这些人了。 卡莉西娅眼中的骄傲渐渐消退，她的肩膀也耷拉了下来。“我想你一定很想听这个关于背叛、死亡以及种种恐怖事件的故事吧？那些事件让一份强大的信仰彻底瓦解，最终只留下了一段回忆而已。” 你不禁皱起了眉头：“真的有那么糟糕吗？ 不，更糟糕，”卡莉悲伤地说道，“并没有什么惊天动地的背叛，也没有什么为了捍卫信仰而必须参加的惨烈战斗。只是……一种缓慢而无痛苦的死亡。火焰祭司们老了，然后去世了；而那些年轻人，则在夜色中悄悄离开，有的去了城市，有的加入了森林德鲁伊。尼奥尔哈尔特蔑视我们，南方的人们甚至忘记了我们的存在，而那只狐妖开始破坏那片在神战之后所剩无几的古老荒野。我还记得最后一位大祭司卡尔斯，以及他的三个孙子孙女。他们的父母去世后，有两个人违抗卢米安人的新规定，离家去投奔他们的表亲们。第三个人则遇到了森林中的女巫，从此便再也没有人见过他。从那以后，寺庙里就只剩下卡尔斯和我了，而他也很快就病倒了。至少那对双胞胎最终还是回来了，为他送行。但他们并没有留下来。 地狱犬的尾巴在她的腿下盘绕着。“那已经是十多年前的事了。或许更久……在孤独中，时间的流逝让我浑然不觉。足够长的时间，让我似乎甚至被自己的孩子们给遗忘了。”她给了你一个颤抖的微笑，然后说道[party.has ryn |轻轻拍了拍你的头，然后也拍了拍小琳的头。 |伸手来轻拍你的头 ]但是那些孤独的日子已经一去不复返了，这一切都要归功于你。 [kari.fucked |我的火焰 |火把手 ]你唤醒了大地之火最后的余烬……并点燃了战斗的烈焰。[kari.fucked | 以及渴望 ]在我心中，这是时隔多年之后第一次有这样的感觉！别以为我是个悲伤的老女人。现在，我有了新的目标，那就是你和这份感情。[kari.isMom | ——而在我们的新礼包里，还有我的好友呢 ]！"
rows.raw: ' "Tell me about the Cult of the Terrestrial Fire?" The hellhound frowns. "I'm no priest, [kari.fucked |my flame |flamebearer ]. I was a warrior. Not a paladin, or some crusading war-cleric, but a guardian. I can't tell you the inner mysteries of the cult." "I'll settle for what you do know." "Very well," she says, running a paw through her crimson mane. "I am sure you know of the druids that were once common in these woods; what was once the realm of Njorhaalt?" You nod. "I've met [var0|several of them in the Winter City|one, Hethia]." [party.has ryn |Etheryn's ears droop. "This still is Njorhaalt!" Kari just reaches over and pats the elf's head. ]"There were many sects of the druidic faith. All animists, all worshippers of the wyld spirits of the world, but some focused on healing, or growing plants, or conjuring spirits of the forest. Some looked beyond the mantle of the earth, and saw the flame within, roiling at the heart of Savarra. This, they found, was the most powerful of all the wyld's aspects, the flaming lifesblood of the world. This sect dubbed themselves the Cult of the Terrestrial Fire, and built their temple over a seam of flame that has burned eternal ever since the days when even the Winter City was but a hillfort beneath the glacial wall!" The hellhound puffs her chest out proudly. "From the eternal flame, our faith drew great power indeed. Our priests' mastery of flames could scour our foes a mile away, sear closed grevious wounds, burn away the rot and renew the forest! We were respected far and wide, and even dragons and kings came to seek our wisdom and strength!" [ashe.around |Your mace thrums at your side. "Renewing the forest... Hmm, now that she mentions it, I very distinctly remember her little cult offering me gifts of scale salve and pretty clothes. I certainly never asked them for anything. Except directions, once, when I was very young and rather lost. Surely they wouldn't remember something that mundane so vividly though..." Now you're wondering if that salamander statue might have been their memory of a young Ashe.. ] "So you all worshiped lava, from underground?" Kari huffs. "It was more than that! The earthfire was alive with power and promise, in those days, and it sang back to us as surely as the wind howls in the forest. Spirits swam the seas of magma, [pc.name]! We drew them out, bound them to service, worshipped them! It was no mundane fire that surged through the temple. Even now, the eternal flame still burns, even centuries past the cult's prime!" "What happened to the cult, anyway?" you ask. "You seem to be all that's left." The pride burning in Karithea's eyes wanes, and her shoulders slump. "I expect you wish the whole grand story, of betrayal and death and all the horrors that would see a powerful faith scattered to the winds and left as nothing more than a memory?" You wince. "Was it that bad?" "No, worse," Kari says sadly. "There was no grand betrayal, nor some climactic battle I could have perished in to defend my faith. There was just... a slow, painless death. Flamepriests got old, and died. The youth slipped away in the night, running off to the city, or to join the forest druids. Njorhaalt scorned us, the south forgot we had ever existed, and the kitsune began to poison the Old Wyld — what little was left of it after the Godswar. I remember the last high priest, Karles, and his three grandchildren... two of them ran away after their parents died, off to join their cousins in defiance of the Lumians' new order. The third crossed a witch of the woods, and was never seen again. Karles and I were all that was left in the temple after that, and he wasted away soon enough. At least the twins came back in the end, to see him off. But they didn't stay." The hellhound's tail curls under her leg. "That was well over a decade ago now. Perhaps much longer — the march of years escaped me in my solitude. Long enough for me to have been forgotten by my own children, it seems." She gives you a faltering smile, and [party.has ryn |pats your head and Ryn's both |reaches out to pat your head ]. "But those days of loneliness are long past now, thanks to you, [kari.fucked |my flame |flamebearer ]! You awakened the last embers of the Terrestrial Fire... and stoked the flames of battle[kari.fucked | and desire ] in my heart for the first time in an age! Don't think me a sad old bitch. I have purpose again, in you and this keep[kari.isMom | — and in our new pack, my mate ]!" '

rows.original:
"Can you tell me about yourself... or about what you are, really?"
    
    "I am Karithea," your hellhound answers, quirking her head. "Have you forgotten your glorious hellhound? Your [kari.isMom
        |mate? Mother of your child[kari.numKids 2
            |ren
        ]?
        |loyal guardian?
    ] Have you taken a knock to the head, [pc.name]?"
    
    You groan, and Kari smirks. "I mean about hellhounds!"
    
    "I know," she teases, tail wagging. "I'm not sure what there is to say, though. I've always been one. My mother was a boreal elf, and my father a lupine from one of the tribes out in the deep forest. The Cult of Terrestrial Flame possessed a ritual that would infuse a child in the womb with the power of the eternal flame, which created me."
    
    Kari puffs herself up, chin held high. "My masters granted me the power of elemental flame, burning in my very blood from birth! It was a great honor to be given this gift, and I have gladly passed it down to all of my children by way of the same rite. [kari.isMom
        |Our child[kari.numKids 1 2
            | howls
            |ren howl
        ] with the same roaring blaze that sings in my heart!
        |You've yet to meet them, but my daughters howled with the same roaring blaze that sings in my heart!
    ]"
    
    "So you were created by magic?" 
    
    Kari nods. "Of course, we're not nature's own gift to Man. I was told that my children would be born chimerae without the rite as well, so I was taught it before I first mated."
    
    "Could you use that ritual on someone else?"
    
    "Hmm!" Kari's ears twitch, and she cants her head. "I haven't tried, though I suppose the priests must have used it on my mother. I would never interfere with another woman's pregnancy, though, unless she were an initiate of the cult and volunteered, as my own mother did. [kari.hasCock
        |Or was carrying my children, now that I am so equipped to father them myself! 
    ]Still, I taught it to my daughters,[kari.isMom
        | and will teach our pack as well,
    ] so that if they so choose, they may propagate our kind. [kari.isMom
        |I cannot wait for our daughters to fill the forest with howling once again!
        |I would love to hear the forest echo with the howling of hellhounds again some day.
    ]"
rows.translation:
“能和我讲讲你自己吗……或者说，你究竟是什么？”
    
    “我是卡莉西娅。”你的地狱犬歪着头答道。“你忘记自己光荣的地狱犬了吗？你的[kari.isMom
        |伴侣？你孩子[kari.numKids 2
            |们
        ]的母亲？
        |忠诚的守卫？
    ]你撞到脑袋了吗，[pc.name]？”
    
    你呻吟一声，卡莉得意地坏笑。“我是问地狱犬！”
    
    “我知道。”她摇着尾巴调侃道。“不过，我不知道有什么可说的。我生来就是地狱犬。母亲是一名极北精灵，父亲则是来自森林深处某个部落的狼族。大地之火教派掌握着一种仪式，能将永恒之火的力量灌注进母腹中的孩子体内；我便由此诞生。”
    
    卡莉昂起下巴，自豪地挺起胸膛。“我的主人赐予我元素烈焰之力，使它从出生起就在我的血液中燃烧！获赐这份力量是莫大的荣誉，我也乐意通过相同的仪式，将它传给自己的每个孩子。[kari.isMom
        |我们的孩子[kari.numKids 1 2
            |发出的嚎叫
            |们发出的嚎叫
        ]中，同样燃烧着我心中高歌的熊熊烈火！
        |你还没有见过她们，但我的女儿们嚎叫时，同样燃烧着我心中高歌的熊熊烈火！
    ]”
    
    “所以，你是由魔法创造的？” 
    
    卡莉点点头。“当然，我们可不是大自然赐给人族的礼物。别人告诉我，即使不做仪式，我的孩子也会生来就是奇美拉，所以我在初次交配前就学会了它。”
    
    “你能对别人施展这种仪式吗？”
    
    “嗯！”卡莉耳朵一动，把头歪向一边。“我没有试过，不过那些祭司想必曾对我的母亲施展仪式。但我绝不会干涉另一个女人的孕育，除非她像我的母亲一样，是教派的入门信徒并且自愿接受。[kari.hasCock
        |或者，现在我自己有了孕育后代所需的装备，她正怀着我的孩子！ 
    ]不过，我已经把仪式教给女儿们，[kari.isMom
        |也会教给我们的族群，
    ]这样一来，如果她们愿意，就能繁衍我们的种族。[kari.isMom
        |我等不及要让女儿们的嚎叫再次响彻森林了！
        |我希望有朝一日，能再次听到地狱犬的嚎叫在森林里回荡。
    ]”

rows.original: "Have you had many encounters with demons?" "A few," Kari snorts. "Pathetic imp-things attempted to loot the temple before I first met you. I smashed them like insects, of course, but I have been on edge ever since they arrived." She growls deep in her throat, and her ears flatten. "Damnable things! They all reek of dark magic, but they turn aside my cleansing flames! I find myself forced into fisticuffs rather than unleashing the fury of the elements these days." You blink. "Wait, you don't normally just claw people?" Kari mocks offense, then throws her head back and laughs. "Hardly! Before these demons appeared, when I roused myself to battle I would fling fire as potent as any archmage's! And yet these new fiends brush it aside like a hedge witch's sparks. It's insulting." Perhaps that's true. Still, though, you reach over and rub Kari's ears. "You're [pc.isDK |hardly useless |still a fierce wolf ] even without your magic." "Haha! You're kind to say so, [kari.fucked |my flame |flamebearer ]! Still, to fight without the fury of the eternal flame at my side is unnerving. I am still adjusting to this new threat, but I will soon sniff out their weaknesses and adapt, as I have always done. I would be a poor guardian indeed if I let a little thing like fire resistance dissuade me!" "So aside from fighting them-" Kari puts up a hand. "What thoughts do I need about an enemy besides how to combat them? I will leave the rest to you, and happily. Bring me a foe to fight, [pc.name]. I care nothing for demons beyond that. Nuance is a thinking woman's game." The massive hellhound flexes one of her mighty arms, making the bicep bulge so thickly that you couldn't wrap your hands around it if you tried.
rows.translation: 你遇到过很多恶魔吗？” “有几次吧，”卡莉哼了一声，“在我第一次遇见你之前，那些可悲的家伙试图抢劫那座寺庙。我当然把它们打得落花流水，但从那时起，我就一直处于紧张状态。” 她从喉咙深处发出低吼，耳朵也竖了起来：“该死的家伙！它们身上都散发着暗影魔法的气息，但却能抵挡住我那净化之火！这些天，我往往不得不亲自与它们搏斗，而无法释放大自然的力量来惩罚它们。” 你眨了眨眼：“等等，你不要通常都是用爪子抓人吧？” 卡莉嘲笑道，然后仰头大笑：“才不是呢！在这些恶魔出现之前，每当我决定战斗时，我释放出的火焰威力不亚于任何大法师！可这些新出现的怪物却把我的火焰当作草丛中的火花一样轻易地忽视了。这简直太侮辱人了。” 也许确实如此。不过，你还是伸手揉了揉卡莉的耳朵：“你[pc.isDK |几乎没什么用处 |依然是一头凶猛的狼 ]即使没有你的魔法也好。” “哈哈！你这么说真是太客气了[kari.fucked |我的火焰 |火把手 ]不过，如果没有永恒之火的愤怒在我身边支持，战斗确实会让人感到不安。我还在适应这种新的威胁，但就像过去一样，我很快就会找出他们的弱点并做出相应的应对。如果连防火这样的能力都能让我退缩，那我确实算不上是一个称职的守护者！” “那么，除了与他们战斗之外……” 卡莉举手说道：“面对敌人，除了考虑如何与他们战斗之外，我还需要考虑什么呢？其余的事情就交给你们吧，我非常乐意。只要给我一个敌人让我去战斗就行了。 [pc.name]除此之外，我对恶魔根本不感兴趣。细腻的情感表达才是真正适合有思想的女性玩的游戏。”这只庞大的地狱犬展示着她那强健的手臂，她的二头肌隆得如此明显，以至于你根本无法用双手将其围住。

rows.original: "Nice outfit," you say, [var0|casually groping one of the hell-milf's tits through her bustier. Her tal flicks, and she gives you a toothy grin.|looking her up and down. "What changed?" Kari flexes, letting you admire everything that's not covered up, too.] "I'm not some feral mongrel, [pc.name]. In the sanctity of my temple, I could revel in the glory of my bare body, but I know better than to come into public wearing nothing but my fur. There could be children about!" You chuckle. rows.original:
You pass a hand over the thin hem of your hellhound's skirt. "[pc.isDK
        |Make me one of these.
        |Would you be willing to make me one of these?
    ]"
    
    "Aha! I had a feeling you might ask," Kari laughs, enveloping your hand in one of her coal-dark paws. "I've been working on a new robe since you accepted me into your service. I think I have your size about right[kari.fucked
        | — after all, I've had plenty of hands-on experience
    ]."
    
    She bids you wait a moment while she jogs back to... wherever it is Karithea keeps... whatever it is she owns other than her clothes. Honestly you aren't sure as to either of those; you never see her anywhere but here or at your side, and she arrived with nothing but the clothes on her back. Nevertheless, she disappears into the keep, and a few minutes later returns with a bundle held under her arm. She presents it to you with pride, wagging her tail while you unfold the long skirt wrapped around the chestplate and hold it up to yourself.
    
    "You made this all by yourself?" you marvel, rapping knuckles against the bronze. 
    
    The fiery wolf-woman nods. "Oh, yes. I even smelted the metal. An easy feat, when the Terrestrial Fire flows in your veins! And... when you have a lot of free years with nothing to do but practice your skills and sleep. I'm neither master smith nor tailoring queen, but this will serve you well in battle against even the full fearsomeness of a dragon's breath!" 
    
    You hold the ensemble up to yourself, which brings a smile to Kari's face. "[kari.hasCock
        |Thinking of you wearing my handiwork into battle... mm. Just the idea is getting me hard!
        |You'd do me a great honor by wearing it into battle.
    ]" When she puts it like that... you lean in and catch the scent of her on the clothes, faint but unmistakable...
rows.translation:
你的手掌抚过地狱犬裙摆纤薄的边缘。“[pc.isDK
        |给我也做一套。
        |你愿意给我也做一套吗？
    ]”
    
    “啊哈！我就知道你可能会问。”卡莉大笑着，用一只煤黑色的爪子包住你的手。“自从你接受我为你效力，我就一直在制作一件新战袍。我想，自己应该把你的尺寸估得差不多了[kari.fucked
        |——毕竟，我有过大量亲手丈量的经验
    ]。”
    
    她请你稍等片刻，随后小跑着回到……卡莉西娅存放……衣服之外的其他财物的某个地方。老实说，这两个问题你都不清楚；你从没在这里或你身边以外的地方见过她，她到来时除了身上那套衣服也一无所有。尽管如此，她依然消失在主堡中，几分钟后回来，腋下夹着一个包裹。她骄傲地将其递给你，摇着尾巴；你展开包裹住胸甲的长裙，将整套服装举在身前。
    
    “这些全是你自己做的？”你惊叹道，用指节敲敲青铜。 
    
    火红的狼女点点头。“当然。我甚至亲自熔炼了金属。大地之火流淌在血脉中，这不过是举手之劳！而且……要是有许多空闲的年头，除了练习技艺和睡觉以外无事可做，也能熟能生巧。我既不是锻造大师，也不是裁缝女王，但就算面对巨龙吐息的全部威力，它也能在战斗中好好保护你！” 
    
    你把整套服装举在身前比量，卡莉脸上顿时露出笑容。“[kari.hasCock
        |想到你穿着我的手艺上战场……嗯。光是想想，我就硬了！
        |若你能穿着它上战场，便是赐予我莫大的荣誉。
    ]”她这么一说……你便凑近衣物，嗅到了上面属于她的气味，虽然淡薄，却不会认错……

rows.original:
"So, about your family..."
    
    Karithea sighs. "Ah, long gone, [kari.isMom
        |except for our precious little pack!
        |I'm afraid.
    ] The forest's been deprived of my daughters' howls for more than a decade now. Too quiet, if you ask me!"
    
    Cautiously, you ask, "What happened to them?"
    
    Thankfully, the answer doesn't prove to be a sad one. "Time marches on, and the flames must spread lest they fade. My first pack, my daughters, were my pride and joy — and still are, though it's been so long since I've seen them. One by one, they left the temple and struck out on their own, with their own mates and ambitions, drawn off by the promise of new horizons and thriving communities. I had four children, a few years older than you are now, I would say. Four glorious daughters blessed by the flame! They came to me as a litter, fathered by one of the younger druids, a halfsex elf with such beautiful red hair and sapphire eyes..."
    
    [party.has etheryn
        |Ryn glances up at the huge wolf-woman, a good two feet taller than she is and half again as wide. "You... you mated with a half-sex? Really?"
        
        Kari flashes Ryn a grin and plants a [silly
            |pawb
            |paw
        ] atop her head, ruffling her golden hair. "Oh, yes. She looked a lot like you, little queenling, though she wore her hair shorter and carried herself like a proud lioness. Not a [etheryn.lnhConfidence
            |frightened mouse
            |young hawk
            |glorious warhawk
        ]." Kari chuckles, rubbing Ryn's ears.
    ]
    
    "Our daughters were tall and strong, and their flames burned hot," Kari continues. "But they were as wild as the winter winds, too. None of them could sit on their hands for more than a few seconds, and they were happiest running through the forest with snow in their fur. One by one, as our community shrank, they left with their own mates or comrades, heeding the call to new adventure elsewhere." 
    
    "And you really haven't heard from them since?" 
    
    "Not once," Kari laments. Her tail's habitual wag slows, just a bit. "I wouldn't expect to. They are far away now, and I am old and bound to the eternal flame. I'm sure they've all long forgotten about their mother, on their own journeys to motherhood. Oh, don't give me that look! I am happy for my girls. I wouldn't want them uprooting their lives to come and make a lonely bitch happy just for a day.[kari.isMom
        | Especially not when we have our own pack to raise, [pc.name].
    ]"
    
    "What about your parents, and your partner?"
    
    The hellhound shrugs. "Tira's axe comes for us all with time. My father, I hardly knew. My mother perished with a wasting sickness she caught exploring the ruins of another druidic temple to the west. My half-siblings by her fled to Mie Xadaron's camp after that, close to twenty years ago now."
    
    "And your mate?" you ask.
    
    "Ah, she..." Karithea pauses, and her tail finally stops entirely. "I don't know, in truth. She left with our youngest, talking about settling a new village to the northwest, beyond the reach of the Lumians' order and druids both. There were only a handful of flamepriests left by then. They both begged me to come with them, but I refused. I had my duty. There was still a spark to the eternal flame's magic that sang to my blood, still the last of the red clergy to protect. I only hope that, wherever those two and their comrades settled, they found the happiness that eluded them in our home." 
    
    You can't help but lean in and pet Kari's ears at that, trying to reignite her [silly
        |giddy-wiggler
        |bushy black tail
    ]. She sighs and permits it, though it takes a good couple of minutes to get her past that moment of melancholy.
rows.translation:
那么，关于你的家庭……”

卡莉西娅叹了口气：“啊，他们早就离开了。 [kari.isMom
        |除了我们珍贵的小背包之外！
        |恐怕不行。
    ]这个森林已经十多年没有听到我女儿们的嚎叫声了。说实话，实在太安静了！

你小心翼翼地问道：“她们发生了什么事？”

幸运的是，答案并不令人难过。时间无情地流逝，火焰必须持续燃烧才能不熄灭。我的第一批女儿们，曾是我最大的骄傲与喜悦——如今依然如此，尽管我已经很久没有见到她们了。一个接一个，她们离开了那座寺庙，开始了属于自己的生活，拥有了自己的伴侣和追求，被新机遇与繁荣社区的前景所吸引。我有四个孩子，他们的年龄应该比你现在稍大一些。四个美丽的女儿，真是上天赐予我的珍宝！她们是由一位年轻的德鲁伊所生的，那位德鲁伊是一位拥有美丽红发和蓝宝石般眼睛的半性别精灵……"
    
    [party.has etheryn
        |小琳抬头看着那个高大的狼女——她的个子比小琳高出足有两英尺，体型也是小琳的两倍宽。“你……你竟然和一个半性生物交配了？真的吗？”

卡莉朝小琳笑了笑，然后[silly
            |pawb
            |爪子
        ]她的金发被风吹得乱蓬蓬的。“哦，没错。她和你长得很像，小公主，只不过她的头发剪得短一些，举止也像一头高傲的母狮子一样。完全不是[etheryn.lnhConfidence
            |受惊的老鼠
            |年轻的鹰
            |光荣的战鹰
        ]卡莉轻笑着，揉了揉小琳的耳朵。
    ]
    
    我们的女儿们身材高挑、体格强壮，她们的‘火焰’也燃烧得格外炽热，”卡莉继续说道，“但她们也同样像冬天的狂风一样狂野。没有一个人能安静地坐着不动超过几秒钟，让她们最开心的事情就是穿着沾满雪花的毛皮在森林里奔跑。随着我们社区的规模逐渐缩小，他们一个接一个地离开了，带着自己的伙伴或战友，去追寻其他地方的新的冒险。”

“那么从那以后，你就再也没收到过他们的消息吗？”

“一次也没有，”卡莉叹息道。她那条习惯性摇动的尾巴，此刻也慢了下来，只是稍微慢了一点而已。我真没想到会这样。他们现在已经远去了，而我年纪大了，也注定要陪伴永恒之火。我相信，在他们各自走向成为母亲的道路上，早就把他们的母亲忘得一干二净了。哦，别用那种眼神看我！我为我的女儿们感到高兴。我可不想让他们为了让一个孤独的女人开心一天，而不得不放弃自己的生活、离开自己的家园。[kari.isMom
        | 尤其是当我们还有自己的团队需要培养的时候，就更不能这样做了。 [pc.name]。
    ]那你的父母和伴侣呢？”

那个恶魔般的生物耸了耸肩：“时间一到，提拉的斧头会降临到我们所有人的头上。我几乎不认识我的父亲；我的母亲则是在探索西部另一座德鲁伊神庙的废墟时，因患上了某种致命的疾病而去世的。在那之后，我和她所生的同父异母或同母异父的兄弟姐妹们便逃到了米克萨达隆的营地，那已经是将近二十年前的事了。”

“那你的伴侣呢？”你问道。

“啊，她……”卡丽泰亚停顿了一下，她的尾巴终于完全停止了摆动。“说实话，我也不知道。她带着我们的小儿子离开了，说要去西北方建立一个新村庄，那里既不在卢米安人的管辖范围内，也不在德鲁伊的势力范围之内。到那时，只剩下为数不多的火焰祭司了。他们俩都恳求我跟他们一起去，但我拒绝了。我履行了自己的职责。那永恒之火所蕴含的魔力依然在我血液中流淌，激发着我的热情；作为最后的红色神职人员，我依然坚守着自己的使命。我只希望，那两个人以及他们的同伴们，无论最终定居在哪里，都能在我们这个家园中找到他们一直渴望拥有的幸福。在这种情况下，你忍不住会凑过去轻抚卡莉的耳朵，试图重新点燃她心中的热情。 [silly
        |头晕目眩的东西
        |浓密的黑色尾巴
    ]她叹了口气，最终还是同意了，不过过了好几分钟，她才从那种忧郁的情绪中走出来。

rows.translation: 你自信地走向卡莉西娅常去的庭院，但当真正到达那里时，你却完全没准备好面对即将发生的一切。 [kari.numKids 0 1 |当你靠近时，这只体格魁梧、黑鬃毛的亚马逊犬兴奋地摇着尾巴，露出真诚的笑容。她的怀里抱着某个小小的生物，那个小东西在你靠近时不停地扭动身体，还发出了一声高亢的“哇哦！”声。 “我的小伙伴！”这只地狱犬高兴地叫道，尾巴摇得如此厉害，以至于它冲过来时差点把你撞倒。“看看我们培育出了什么！这么小，却已经那么可爱了……而且它的咬合力简直像地狱之火一样猛烈！ 这位新晋妈妈迫不及待地将她的小宝宝展示给你看。这只小幼犬的身体长度还不到一英尺，四肢上覆盖着黑红相间的绒毛，它的尾巴看起来更像一根深色的面条，而不是像它妈妈那样那条浓密茂盛的尾巴。……但她有着同样漆黑的皮肤、赤金色的眼睛，那双眼睛里燃烧着炽烈的火焰；而当你将她从她母亲身边带走时，她的獠牙会立刻咬向你。她也会立刻用爪子抓住你——那些爪子虽然很小，其实并不会造成真正的伤害，但它们能将这个无助的小幼崽牢牢地固定在你身上。然后，她会再次发出欢快的叫声，开始嗅着你、啃咬着你。 她想了解你！”她的母亲一边轻抚着女儿的头发一边解释道，“她还需要一段时间才能看得清楚……而且要过很多年才能说话、才能开始狩猎！在那之前，我会用我的生命保护她。而你……” 那只地狱犬微笑着，轻轻地将女儿从你怀里接过来，然后用自己的怀抱拥住了你。“我的伴侣，你有一项非常重要的任务要完成。她需要姐妹们。我已经渴望你的触碰了，我体内的火焰再次燃烧起来。所以，请占有我吧，亲爱的！让我再次成为母亲，一次又一次——直到整个北方都被地狱犬的嚎叫声所淹没！我绝不满足于任何其他的结局！ |你还没来得及靠近那只地狱犬，就被你的大女儿叫了起来——她一边尖叫着，一边拽着你的手，用她那小小的力气把你拉向卧室。肯定出了什么事情……而当你看到你那只体型庞大的小狗伙伴躺在床上，上半身赤裸着，还在摇着尾巴迎接你时，一切就都清楚了。她怀里抱着一只新出生的小狗。急切地吮吸着。 “看，我的[pc.mascFem |英俊的 |美丽 ]天哪！”她惊呼道，坐起身来，轻轻抚摸着那个新生婴儿的黑发，“又是一个如此美丽、强壮的宝宝贪婪的女儿！” 这只母狗温柔地将她刚出生的幼崽从自己充满乳汁的胸前抱下来，把那个还在扭动、几乎看不见东西的小家伙递给你，让你按照惯例去闻一闻，再用手指轻轻咬它一下。不过，等你的小女儿习惯了你之后，她的母亲就会把孩子交给你的长子，让她去外面晒晒太阳。 等孩子们都走后，你的伴侣——这位母狗女性——会从床上跳下来，抓住你的肩膀，把你拉到身边。“太好了[hellhound.totalKidsText]到目前为止，我的孩子……但我的身体渴望得到你更多的爱。更多！所以，请接纳我吧，亲爱的！让我再次成为母亲，一次又一次——直到整个北方都被地狱犬的嚎叫声所笼罩！我绝不满足于任何少于这个的要求！ ]
rows.raw: ' You stride confidently towards Karithea's habitual haunt in the courtyard, but find yourself utterly unprepared for what you're faced with when you arrive. [kari.numKids 0 1 |The burly black-maned amazon perks up as you approach with a wagging tail and a genuine smile. There's something tiny clutched in her arms, a tiny wiggling shape that lets out a tiny, high-pitched "Awoooo!" as you draw closer. "My mate!" the hellhound beams, wagging so fiercely that she nearly knocks you off your feet when she bounds over. "Look at what we've made! So small and precious... but she bites with a fury of hellfire already!" The newly-made mother eagerly presents her bundle of joy to you. The tiny pup's barely a foot from toe to ear-tips, with black and red fuzz on her limbs and a tail that looks more like a dusky noodle than the bushy monster her mother's sporting... but she has the same coal-dark skin and reddish-gold eyes, full of infernal fire, and fangs that snap at you the moment you take her from her mother. She sinks her claws into you immediately, too tiny to really hurt — all it does is firmly attach the defenseless pup to you, and she lets loose another little howl of delight as she starts sniffing and chewing on you. "She wants to get to know you!" her mother explains, stroking her daughter's hair. "It'll be a while before she can see clearly... and many years before she speaks or hunts! Until then, I will protect her with my life. And you..." The hellhound smiles, gently retrieving her daughter from your arms and wrapping you up in one of hers. "You have one very important job, my mate. She needs sisters! I crave your touch already, and my body's fire is burning again. So take me, mate! Make me a mother again, and again, and again — until the north is awash in the howling of hellhounds! I won't settle for anything less!" |You've barely had a chance to approach the hellhound before you're greeted by your eldest daughter yipping and tugging on your hand, dragging you towards your bedchambers with all her tiny might. There's a new puppy attached to her breast, nursing hungrily. "Look, my [pc.mascFem |handsome |beautiful ] stud!" she howls, sitting up and stroking the tiny newborn's dark hair. "Another beautiful, strong, voracious daughter!" The hellhound milf gently detaches her new pup from her milk-laden bosom, presenting the squirming, near-blind child to you for the customary sniffing and chewing on your fingers. Once your little daughter has become accustomed to you, though, her mother hands the child off to your eldest and instructs her to go and see the sun. Make me a mother again, and again, and again — until the north is awash in the howling of hellhounds! I won't settle for anything less!" ] '

There's a faint heat in the depths of your belly that just won't fade, fanning the faint embers of light lust and turning the sensitivity in your nipples ridiculously high. Just the gentle brush of your clothing against them has your body heating up. Ah... [pc.dcb |fuck! You're pregnant. |you're pregnant. You're pregnant! |you're going to be a [pc.mf |daddy |mommy ]![var0 | Again!!!! ] Oh, you're so excited!!!! ] Thinking back on who you've been with more recently, the only one that comes to mind is the fiery hellhound that's taken up residence in the Wayfort. You should probably go let her know about the little flame that's taken root in your womb.

rows.original:
As your child grows within your belly, it's no longer possible to hide your swelling baby bump.
    
    Your [pc.breasts] ache, swollen and sensitive to the touch. Your [pc.hips] ache as well, widening into proper, childbearing hips. It's undeniable that your body is changing to better accommodate your little hellhound until she's ready to be born. 
    
    The heat in your womb has only been getting steadily warmer as your child grows within you. Young as your daughter is, you can already feel her moving around, just as feisty as her sire.
    
    You pat your steadily growing baby bump, pressing just enough to feel where your baby currently rests. The faintest of flutters press against your palm, just like the butterflies you feel in your stomach when you think of who your daughter might grow up to be.
    
    What will she be like? Will she still be as energetic as she is now? Whose eyes will she have? 
    
    You can't wait to meet her!
rows.translation:
随着孩子在你腹中长大，你再也无法遮掩自己日渐隆起的小腹。
    
    你的[pc.breasts]又胀又痛，一碰就敏感。你的[pc.hips]也隐隐作痛，正在撑开成适合生育的宽胯。不可否认，你的身体正在变化，好更妥帖地容纳你的小地狱犬，直到她准备好降生。 
    
    随着孩子在你体内成长，你子宫里的热度也在一路攀升。你的女儿虽然还小，你已经能感觉到她在里面动来动去，像她父亲一样精力旺盛。
    
    你拍了拍自己不断隆起的小腹，按压的力道刚好能感觉到宝宝此刻所在的位置。最细微的一阵胎动贴上你的掌心，就像你想象女儿将来会变成什么样时，胃里泛起的那种悸动。
    
    她会是什么样子呢？还会像现在这样活泼吗？她会有一双谁的眼睛？ 
    
    你已经等不及要见到她了！
