rows.original:
It's glaringly obvious that you're pregnant.

    Your belly's already grown so big that it's impossible to see past your swollen stomach. The growing hell-pup within you grows ever hotter, pulsing steady just like a heart made of terrestrial fire.
    
    [pc.isMilky|You were already lactating, but your pregnancy has caused your [pc.milkType] production to pick up|Your aching [pc.breasts] have filled with [pc.milkType]]. Fluid leaks from your sensitive [pc.nipples], constantly leaving wet spots on your [pc.gear].
    
    The ever-present heat in your belly only gets hotter as your pregnancy continues, the little pup in your [pc.womb] already doing her best to live up to the fiery legacy her sire carries.
    
    A particularly painful little fist strikes at your insides, your baby squirming and active, almost never running out of energy. You take a few moments to rub soothingly around the spot where little feet attack, murmuring quietly to settle her down, even for just a moment.
    
    When she's finally taken mercy on your poor, bruised organs, you know that even with your daughter's never-ending energy, you'll be doing this again.
rows.translation:
你明显已经怀孕了。

    你的肚子已经胀得那么大，根本看不到隆起的肚子以外的东西。你体内那只正在成长的地狱犬幼崽越来越灼热，像一颗由凡间火焰构成的心脏，稳定地搏动着。
    
    [pc.isMilky|你本来就已经在泌乳了，但怀孕让你的[pc.milkType]产量又涨了上来|你胀痛的[pc.breasts]里已盛满了[pc.milkType]]。液体从你敏感的[pc.nipples]渗出，不断在你的[pc.gear]上留下湿痕。
    
    随着孕期继续，你腹中那股始终存在的灼热只会越来越烫，你[pc.womb]里的小家伙已经在努力不辜负她父亲所承袭的烈焰血脉。
    
    一只格外疼的小拳头捶在你的体内，你的宝宝又踢又动，精力几乎永远用不完。你花了一会儿工夫，在被小脚踢中的地方周围轻轻揉着，低声念叨着哄她安静下来，哪怕只有片刻。
    
    等她终于可怜你那副受伤器官、放过它们时，你知道，就算你女儿精力无穷无尽，你还是会再来一次的。

rows.original: You're absolutely gravid. Rubbing a palm along the side of your belly, you can't help the flush of heat you get from the feeling of your body stretched taut. With the heavy weight of your [pc.womb] stuffed full of fiery hell-pup, you know it's only a matter of time before your daughter is forcing her way into the world with all the fire that hellhounds are famed for. The heat in your belly is like a furnace now, constantly burning yet never waning. Even though you're in the Frost Marches, you're running so hot that you've had to take to sleeping with no covers, too hot and sweaty to sleep well with all the extra heat. Not that you've been sleeping well anyway, with your daughter rolling and kicking around in your [pc.womb], like she's incapable of not trampling your insides as much as possible before she's born. You can already tell that she's a fighter, refusing to settle down even when you murmur to her while you rub your stomach. Just a little bit longer until you get to hold your child in your arms for the first time.
rows.translation: 你绝对可以。怀孕。 当你用手掌轻轻抚摸自己的腹部时，会不由自主地感受到一股热流涌上心头——那是因为你的身体在这一过程中被拉得紧紧的。而这种重型的[pc.womb]你体内充满了炽热的火焰，你知道，你的女儿迟早会带着那些地狱犬所特有的狂热，闯入这个世界。 你现在肚子里的这种灼热感，就像是一座熔炉，一直在燃烧，却永远不会熄灭。尽管你身处冰霜之地，却依然热得不行，甚至不得不不盖被子睡觉——因为太热、出汗太多，根本无法安静地入睡。 其实，你本来就睡得不好，因为你的女儿一直在你身边翻来覆去、踢来踢去[pc.womb]好像她根本做不到似的。不是在她出生之前，她就已经在不断地“折腾”你的内脏了。你可以明显感觉到，她是个充满斗志的孩子——即使你在抚摸自己的肚子时轻声对她说些话，她也不愿意安静下来。 再耐心等待一会儿吧，很快你就能第一次将自己的孩子抱在怀里了。

rows.original:
A sharp, cramping pain seizes through your entire body, loudly announcing the imminent arrival of your feisty little hell-pup.
    
    You move as fast as you're able to, rushing towards Gwyn's nursery, wracked with labor pains that make you constantly have to stop and breathe. You're breathing through a particularly painful contraction roughly halfway to Hawkethorne when you hear the wonderfully familiar voice of your hellish mate call out as she runs to meet you.
    
    "[pc.name]! I sensed that something was wrong, so I came to find you. When I got close enough to smell you, I knew that our daughter was coming whether you were ready or not. I will carry you the rest of the way." She doesn't wait for you to answer, scooping you into her arms and supporting your body with strong, flexing biceps as she takes off running towards Hawkethorne's nursery.
    
    Without having to stop for each contraction and with your trusty hound carrying you the rest of the way, you arrive at the nursery in no time at all. Kari gently sets you down, keeping her arms around you to help you to the birthing table while Gwyn and Cait make last minute preparations for the birth.
    
    It's long, painful and messy. While Gwyn and Cait guide you through your delivery, your mate doesn't leave your side for even a moment. She whispers words of encouragement into your [pc.ear] as you squeeze her paw with each push.
    
    Finally, with one last push, your child slips free of your body, immediately filling the air with strong, wailing cries. Gwyn is quick to clean and swaddle your daughter while Cait moves to help you with the afterbirth. 
    
    As you begin to slip into an exhausted rest, you can just make out how Kari presses a kiss to your cheek, murmurs of how amazing you were lulling you to sleep.
rows.translation:
一阵尖锐的痉挛剧痛攫住你的全身，大声宣告着那只活泼的小地狱犬即将降生。
    
    你竭尽所能地快步赶往格温的托儿所；阵痛折磨着你，令你不得不一次次停下喘息。前往鹰棘镇的路刚走到一半，一阵格外痛苦的宫缩令你不得不停下来调整呼吸；就在这时，你听见地狱犬伴侣无比熟悉而亲切的声音。她正飞奔过来与你会合。
    
    “[pc.name]！我感觉到情况不对，所以来找你了。等我靠到足以闻见你的气味，便知道无论你有没有准备好，我们的女儿都要出生了。剩下的路由我抱你过去。”她不等你回答，便一把将你抱起；她屈起结实有力的肱二头肌托住你的身体，向鹰棘镇的托儿所飞奔。
    
    忠诚的猎犬抱着你走完余下路程，不必每次宫缩都停下来，因此你很快便抵达托儿所。卡莉轻轻放下你，仍用双臂搂着你，帮你走到产床旁；格温和凯特则在进行分娩前的最后准备。
    
    过程漫长、痛苦而狼藉。格温和凯特引导你完成分娩，伴侣则一刻都不曾离开你的身边。你每次发力时都紧握她的爪子，她则在你的[pc.ear]边低声鼓励。
    
    最后一次发力过后，你的孩子终于滑出身体，响亮有力的啼哭立刻充满空气。格温迅速清理干净女儿，把她裹进襁褓；凯特则过来帮助你排出胎衣。 
    
    你疲惫得逐渐陷入沉睡，只隐约感觉到卡莉在你脸颊印下一吻；她呢喃着你有多么了不起，哄你进入梦乡。

You watch her coo at the little hellhound, face full of pure, ecstatic joy. Kari beams at you when she notices your attention, helping you sit up and adjust before placing your daughter in your [pc.hands]. Your little hell-pup scrunches up her face in protest, squirming as well as she can while tightly swaddled. She lets out a small, quiet awooo and tries to bat at your hand with tiny little paws, managing instead to wrap one little hand around your finger. She's soft with fluffy baby fur, snuffling against your finger as she dozes off to sleep. A yawn escapes your mouth as your body urges you back to sleep, and Kari gently rubs one giant paw against your face. "Rest, my flame. We'll still be here when you wake."

rows.original: Finally, Kari puts you down and plants her paws on your shoulders. "You've made me a very happy woman, my dear, dear flame. Would that I could ease the burden you carry. Do not hesitate to ask anything of me!"
rows.translation: 最后，卡莉把你放下，把她的爪子放在你的肩膀上。“你让我成为一个非常幸福的女人，我亲爱的、亲爱的火焰。要是我能帮你减轻身上的负担该多好。有任何事情，都尽管向我提出来吧！”

rows.original:
As you're walking by, you catch sight of Karithea following behind a pair of hired laborers that've been working on the keep's walls. Kari's head and shoulders taller than the human men, and is effortlessly carrying two buckets full of stone on her shoulders where each of them is struggling to lug one each away. [kari.isMom
        |Your [kari.numKids 2
            |eldest 
        ]hell-pup daughter is following behind, laboriously dragging a smaller bucket along behind her.
    ]
    
    "[kari.fucked
        |My flame!
        |Ah, flamebearer!
    ]" Kari says, giving you a nod. "This fortress seems eternally in need of attention, as though the very wyld seeks to tear it down brick by brick!"
    
    "Th-that'd be Tira, miss," one of the villagers says. "Goddess of time, and it wearing everything down." 
    
    Kari just laughs, and flops her tail over his head. "Whatever you say, little man. Gods or wyld, it makes no difference. We're the bulwark against time tearing down my [kari.fucked
        |mate's
        |newfound
    ] home, so let's put our backs into it!"
    
    "Yes ma'am!" the laborers groan, heading towards their cart. Kari gives you a wink and lopes along with them.

你路过时，正好看见卡莉西娅跟在一对受雇修缮要塞城墙的工人身后。卡莉比那些人类男子高出一个头和一副肩膀，毫不费力地扛着两桶石头，而他们每人却连一桶都拖得吃力。[kari.isMom
        |你那[kari.numKids 2
            |最年长的 
        ]地狱犬女儿跟在后面，费力地拖着一个较小的桶。
    ]
    
    “[kari.fucked
        |我的火焰！
        |啊，火焰使者！
    ]”卡莉说着，朝你点了点头。“这座要塞好像永远都需要人手照料，仿佛荒野本身就想把它一块砖一块砖地拆掉！”
    
    “那、那是蒂拉，小姐，”一个村民说道。“时间的女神，一切都被她磨损掉。” 
    
    卡莉只是大笑，把尾巴甩到他头上。“随你怎么说，小家伙。神明也好，荒野也好，都没什么区别。我[kari.fucked
        |伴侣的
        |新得的
    ]家正被时间拆着，我们就是挡住它的壁垒，所以都给我加把劲！”
    
    “是，夫人！”工人们呻吟着，朝他们的推车走去。卡莉朝你眨了眨眼，跟着他们一起跑了。

rows.original:
You hear a shout of outrage from the audience hall, shrill enough to make you reach for your weapon... until a nearby door slams open, and you see a great dark shape zooming out in a flash of fang and fur. You duck to the side as Daliza's warg speeds past, carrying something small, dark, and squealing on her back. Is that...
    
    Daliza herself comes jogging after her beast, red-faced and panting. She glances at you with a mix of embarrassment and despair. "Your little hellion's stolen my [rand
        |hair tie
        |dragon stuffy
        |favorite mug
        |left boot
    ]!"
    
    You glance between Daliza and the rapidly-retreating shade of your daughter and Narcie. "Seems she had a getaway all planned out."
    
    "That's the worst part!" Daliza groans. "Narcie scooped her up and won't listen to my commands. Your hell-pup's... hypnotized her, or-or something!"
    
    "Maybe they're just having fun," you shrug. 
    
    Daliza jabs a finger at you furiously, only barely biting back giving you a piece of her mind, before she slumps her shoulders and resumes trotting after the pair. "Narcie! Heel! Heel, girl!"
    
    Well they certainly get along...
rows.translation:
会客厅里传来一声愤怒尖叫，尖锐得令你伸手去摸武器……直到附近一扇门砰然打开，一个巨大的黑影裹着獠牙与毛皮飞窜而出。达莉莎的座狼从身旁疾驰而过，你连忙侧身避让；它背上还驮着某个又小、又黑、吱吱乱叫的东西。那是……
    
    达莉莎亲自追着野兽小跑而来，脸色通红、气喘吁吁。她以尴尬又绝望的神情瞥了你一眼。“你家的小恶魔偷了我的[rand
        |发带
        |龙玩偶
        |最喜欢的杯子
        |左靴
    ]！”
    
    你的目光在达莉莎与迅速远去的女儿和纳西之间来回移动。“看来她早就规划好了逃跑路线。”
    
    “最糟的就是这个！”达莉莎呻吟道。“纳西把她驮走，根本不听我的命令。你家的地狱犬幼崽……把它催眠了，或、或者做了别的什么！”
    
    “也许她们只是玩得开心。”你耸耸肩。
    
    达莉莎怒气冲冲地用手指戳向你，勉强咽回满肚子训斥，随后垂下双肩，继续小跑着追赶她们。“纳西！脚边！回来，姑娘！”
    
    看来她们相处得确实很好……

rows.original: You just about trip over something warm and writhing laying out on the ground in front of you. Though you're able to stop yourself before you put your foot down in the middle of it, the sight of so much squirming gives you pause until you finally manage to figure out what it is you're looking at: Your children. Three black-and-red hellhounds are squirming around while your trio of veparii [silly |snek |snake ]lets are wrapped around them, binding them in place. The [silly |wrapscallions |slithering kiddos ] are just like their mom, attracted to the warmest thing they can get their tails around... and in this case, at least, that's a trio of hell-pups that are giggling and pawing at them, tails all a-wagging. With a grunt of effort, you lean down and pick the whole bundle of them up at once, earning several excited shrieks — and a loud "Whooo!" from the only son you have among them. "What are you three doing?" you chide the little veparii, [silly |booping Vera's nose |smooching Vera's forehead ]. She's the only one that's face-up enough to get at from this angle. "Your sisters can't move!" That may be the case, but the hellhound pups don't seem all that put out. Their tails are beating faster than your heartbeat, and your eldest has such a huge smile on her face despite all the white tail that's halfway draped over her head. "Come on. Let's get you someplace warmer," you laugh, hoisting your six kiddos and heading for the fort's hearthfire. That should lul the fluffy snakes asleep pretty quick, and allow your pups to wiggle out if they want to. Of course, it turns out they're not half as eager as they were acting to get away once you nestle the ball of fluff and scales by the fireplace. Your eldest pup manages to clamber on top, asserting her dominance over your pack of kids by sitting on Sana's chest and howling triumphantly... and then wrapping him in a great big hug. "They get along so well," Vatia herself sighs, slithering into view. "I think we all had the same idea." You're about to question her, when you notice your serpentine lover's dragging Karithea along with her... though your mighty hellhound mate's lounging on her back atop Vatia's tail, carried along with the witch's undulating slithers without a care in the world. "My flame!" Kari says, waving you over. "Join us!" They don't have to ask you twice. Vatia lays herself out in front of the fire, with you and Kari sitting against her lower body like a great big pillow, before being wrapped up just once in softly sinuous snakeskin. Vatia nestles her chin into your neck, giving you a kiss, before promptly closing her eyes. "So very, very warm..." Your pups and veparii kids come and join in one by one, extricating themselves from the baby-pile and coming to clamber over their parents. Or their step-parents, mostly: Kari's quickly wrapped in [silly |noodles |snakes ], while Vatia ends up with hell-pups climbing her like a mountain to snuggle into her fur. You end up with your eldest of each brood in your arms, with Vatia's head on one shoulder and Kari's on the other. Now this is life...
rows.translation: 你差点被地上那些温暖且正在扭动的东西绊倒。虽然你及时停住了脚步，但看到这么多东西在蠕动，还是让你犹豫了一下，直到最终你才弄清楚自己看到的是什么： 是你的孩子们。 三只黑红相间的地狱犬正在地上扭动，而你的三个维帕里[silly |蛇宝宝 |幼蛇 ]缠绕在它们身上，把它们牢牢困在原地。 [silly |葱花 |滑溜溜的小家伙们 ]它们简直和它们的妈妈一样，总是被那些最温暖的东西吸引住……至少在这次的情况下，是一群正在咯咯笑、用爪子挠你的小家伙们，它们的尾巴都摇得飞快。 你费了点力气，弯下腰把它们全都抱了起来，这一举动引来了它们几声兴奋的尖叫——还有你唯一那个儿子发出来的响亮叫声：“哇哦！” “你们三个在干什么？”你责备着这些小家伙们。 [silly |弄歪维拉的鼻子 |亲吻薇拉的额头 ]只有她正面朝上，从这个角度才能攻击她。‘你的姐妹们动弹不得！’” 虽然可能是这样，但那些地狱犬幼崽似乎一点都没有受到影响。它们的尾巴摆动得比你的心跳还要快，而你最大的那只幼犬，尽管有一半的白色尾巴搭在它的头上，脸上却依然挂着灿烂的笑容。来吧，我们找个更暖和的地方待着吧。”你笑着说，然后抱起六个孩子，朝着堡垒里的壁炉走去。这样应该能让那些毛茸茸的“小蛇”很快睡着，也让你的孩子们如果想的话，能够自由活动了。 当然，当你把那些毛茸茸的小家伙们放在壁炉旁时，它们其实并没有表现得那么渴望离开。你最大的那只小狗成功爬了上去，坐在萨娜的胸前，胜利地嚎叫着，以此来彰显它对你们这一群“小家伙”的统治地位。然后进行包装处理。他紧紧地拥抱在一起。 “他们相处得非常融洽，”瓦蒂娅自己也叹息道，一边慢慢出现在你的视线中。“我想我们所有人都有同样的想法。” 你正准备询问她时，却注意到你这位蛇一般的恋人正把卡莉泰娅也拉了过来。我的火焰！”卡莉说道，一边挥手召唤你，“过来加入我们吧！ 他们没必要问你两次。 瓦蒂娅躺在火堆前，你和卡莉像两个巨大的枕头一样靠在她的身上，然后她就被柔软而蜿蜒的蛇皮包裹了起来。瓦蒂娅将下巴靠在你的脖子上，亲了你一下，然后立刻闭上了眼睛。“真是太温暖了……” 你的小狗们和维帕里家族的孩子们也一个接一个地过来，从那一堆婴儿中爬出来，爬到他们的父母身边。或者是他们的继父母，大多数情况下都是：卡莉很快就被……所包围了。 [silly |面条 |蛇 ]而瓦蒂娅则会有那些小家伙像爬山一样爬到她身上，依偎在她的毛皮里。最后，你会把每一窝中最年长的幼崽抱在怀里，瓦蒂娅的脑袋靠在你的一个肩膀上，卡莉的脑袋则靠在另一个肩膀上。 这才是真正的生活啊……

But no, for but a brief moment of seriousness, it's just me and the bee here, and now that people are walking through the Wayfort it's going to be a shitshow. As much as I'd love to see to your every need, I physically can't... and this collar will make me feel ill the more I struggle." Jael'yn tuts at the thought, adjusting her bodice. "Not to guilt you, or anything. But having extra work — and eye candy — around would be huge." "What do I need to do then?" "You've supplied the cuties! We just need the dresses... of which I have faith in you to supply." Right, of course... '

rows.original: "Hey, excuse me!" A grinning hornet slides past you, nibbling what appears to be a sandwich. "Sor— oh! [pc.mf |Lord |Lady ] [pc.name]! My apologies..." The mess hall is looking a lot busier than you're used to, although the inhabitants make way for you when you approach the bar. Rumie waves you down with a tired smile, adjusting her hair and skirt. "H-hey, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]... anything you need?" "You're looking... [pc.isBimbo |pooped |exhausted ], are you okay?" It takes a few moments for the usually-bubbly bee to muster up some extra enthusiasm, but after she has a drink in your hands she relaxes again. "I'm alright really, it's just... I'm only one lil' bee! And there are more visitors than I'm used to. I don't think I can clean up and serve people, and make food for everyone..." That could be a problem. "Although, uh, I had a thought!" [wayfort.hasAlraune |Rumie gestures at a passing effigy and few assorted hornets |Rumie waves to a few wickedly-grinning hornets ]. "A lot of the girls here could use something to do! Heck, some of them already clean up for free if they're bored and I ask really nicely!" "What, I should employ them?" "How about..." Rumie clasps her hands together and gives you her brightest smile, to the point you'd not be surprised if she began to sparkle. "Maids!" A couple of hornets do look up at the abrupt outburst, and when you tilt your head in silent question they give you a thumbs-up. It would appear this is not the first time Rumie has voiced this opinion. "Alright, what would I need to do?" You eventually ask, sipping from the bottle she's offered you. Crisp, slightly-chilled pupperidge ale tickles your throat... good, good. "Just get maid outfits? I'm fairly sure Nelia back in Hawkethorne would do it." "Yay!" Rumie bounces hard enough to nearly free her tits, and she blushingly settles them back down — lest she trigger any nearby hornet-bully instincts. "I, uh... a-hem. But yes, [pc.mf |my lord |my lady ], if you can get a cute uniform for them, I can teach them everything they need to know!" That shouldn't be too hard...
rows.translation: 嘿，不好意思！”一只咧着嘴笑的黄蜂从你身边飞过，似乎正在啃着什么三明治。“对……哦！ [pc.mf |领主 |女士 ] [pc.name]非常抱歉……” 食堂里的人似乎比你平时看到的要多得多，不过当你走向吧台时，周围的人都会给你让路。露米带着疲惫的笑容向你招手，一边整理着自己的头发和裙子，一边说道：“嘿，我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]你需要什么吗？” “你看起来…… [pc.isBimbo |累坏了 |精疲力竭 ]你没事吧？” 这只平时总是活泼开朗的蜜蜂花了好一会儿才重新振作起来，但在喝了你递给它的东西之后，它又放松了下来。“其实我没什么事，只是……我只不过是一只小小的蜜蜂而已！而且来参观的人比我平时遇到的要多得多。我觉得我根本来不及把这里清理干净。以及服务人民，以及给大家准备食物……” “不过，这个可能会带来一些麻烦。” “不过，嗯，我有个主意！ [wayfort.hasAlraune |露米指向一个路过的假人，还有几只各种各样的黄蜂。 |露米向几只咧着邪恶笑容的大黄蜂挥了挥手。 ]这里很多女孩其实都需要找点事情做啊！说真的，有些女孩只要觉得无聊，就会主动来帮忙打扫，而且我请求的时候也总是很客气呢！” “什么，我应该雇用她们吗？” “这样怎么样……”露米双手交叠，露出最灿烂的笑容，那笑容灿烂到让你觉得她随时都会发出光芒来。“雇她们当女仆吧！” 几只大黄蜂确实看到这种突然的爆发，当你疑惑地歪着头看时，他们却向你竖起了大拇指。看来，这已经不是露米第一次表达这种观点了。 “好吧，那我需要做些什么呢？你最终还是问了出来，一边喝着她递给你的酒瓶里的酒。那种清爽、略带冰镇的Pupperidge麦芽酒刺激着你的喉咙……真不错，真好。“就买女仆装吗？我敢肯定，鹰棘镇的内莉娅也会这么做的。 耶！”露米用力蹦跳，结果她的胸部差点就露了出来，她红着脸赶紧把它们按了回去——生怕惹恼了附近那些喜欢欺负人的家伙。“我，呃……咳。不过，没错， [pc.mf |大人 |夫人 ]如果你能给他们准备一些可爱的制服，我就可以教他们所需知道的一切了！” 这应该不会太难吧……

rows.original: [var0 |The matronly goblin teases at a needle and thread, pondering at a little knot before it pops free. With that fiddly work seen to, Nelia focuses on you properly. "Dresses, you say? And how many are we talking about? What about stature?" You flounder for a few minutes when you realize that's a hard number to guess, before Nelia sighs and pulls up a piece of paper and a charcoal-marker. "...How about you just give me some vague guesses, and I'll make lots of them for you. Multiples in multiple sizes, a mixture of color and silks." She gently licks her thumb and runs it across the marker. She works for a few minutes while you watch, drawing up dress size numbers, and throwing together a vague preliminary sketch... pausing when she realizes they're not quite revealing enough. "Can't say I've designed clothing for hornet girls [wayfort.hasAlraune |— or plant girls — ]before, an interesting challenge, indeed..." By the time Nelia's finished with the sketches, half an hour has passed and there's a neat stack of papers and at least three blunted charcoals. "There, do you think these will work?" You nod an agreement, before settling on the crux of the matter. "They look great, but how much will this cost?" "It's... a lot of silk, and it doesn't grow on trees! The dye will be quite expensive, too." The goblin purses her lips before scribbling in a receipt for you; five-thousand electrum coins. Ouch.
rows.translation: [var0 |这位主妇般的哥布林拨弄着针线，对着一个小线结琢磨片刻，直到它终于松开。处理完这点细碎活计后，内莉娅才真正把注意力放到你身上。“裙子，你是说？那我们说的是多少件？身材尺寸呢？” 当你意识到这很难估出一个准确数字时，你支吾了几分钟，随后内莉娅叹了口气，拿出一张纸和一支炭笔。“……不如你就给我一些大概估计，我会给你做很多件。多个尺寸、多件备用，再混合不同颜色和丝绸。”她轻轻舔了舔拇指，在炭笔上抹过。 她工作了几分钟，你则在一旁看着她列出裙装尺寸数字，并迅速画出一张粗略的初步草图……随后她意识到这些设计还不够暴露，于是停了下来。“我以前可没给黄蜂女孩[wayfort.hasAlraune |——或者 plant girls—— ]设计过衣服，确实是个有趣的挑战……” 等内莉娅画完草图，半个小时已经过去，桌上整齐地叠着一摞纸，旁边至少有三支用钝的炭笔。“好了，你觉得这些能用吗？” 你点头表示同意，随后把话题转到核心问题上。“看起来很棒，不过这要花多少钱？” “这可是……很多丝绸，而且丝绸又不是长在树上的！染料也会很贵。”哥布林抿了抿嘴，随后给你写下一张收据：五千枚琥珀金币。哎哟。

rows.original:
"Ah! I'd been wondering when you would show up. Look, I'm finished! Aren't these dresses precious?" Nelia stops you with a wave the moment you enter, gesturing you to a desk with a number of crates resting on it.

    You lift one of the lids and stifle [pc.dcb
        |a surprised noise
        |a delighted gasp
        |a bubbly giggle
    ] at the sight of them; utterly beautiful maid dresses, of mixed colors and sizes. A testing squeeze and stroke of the fabric shows it to be a careful mixture of tougher body fabrics, and incredibly soft silks around the bodice. There's even supportive ribbing to make for an impromptu low-bust corset. "I love them."
    
    "I pulled... a few late nights on these, I have to confess. But they just came out so wonderfully! I never get to make large batches of clothing like this, it was a novel experience, and you've paid me well for my time." The goblin gives you a fond smile and helps pack up the crates for you, before handing them over. "Good luck, and do keep me in mind if you need anything else."

rows.translation: 当你探索这个世界时[wayfort.stateABC |那座古老堡垒的破败遗迹 |正在建设中的运输设施，正在检查施工进度，以及时发现可能存在的问题。 |这座堡垒中那些几乎具有皇家气派的走廊，已经得到了全面修复，现在完全可以正常使用了。 ]你来了[wayfort.stateABC |你所认为的那样 ]这是为堡垒的侍从和工作人员准备的居住区。总体来说，一切都应该都井井有条……只是其中一扇门被关上了。[wayfort.stateABC | 只不过是用一块厚厚的树皮将它固定住而已——甚至连合适的木材都没有使用——而用来固定的，似乎只是一小堆石头和人们的祈祷而已。 |这种情况本身并不罕见，只不过你能听到有人在房间里闹翻天，而你本来并不指望会有人在那里。 [dayNight |在这个时间在宿舍里工作 |在这个时候还醒着，发出一些不寻常的声音…… ] |这种情况本身并不罕见……只不过你清楚地知道每个房间应该分配给哪个人，而这个房间按理来说应该是空的。然而你却能听到里面的声音：有人在里面活动着，弄得有些动静。 ] 你[pc.isDK |推开门[wayfort.stateABC |一块树皮，完全不考虑人的隐私——反正树皮后面也没什么值得保护的吧。 |门大开着，完全不顾及那个人的隐私。 （你也没办法阻止） ]是一对庞大无比胸部在紧绷的薄纱衣物下显得格外突出，那衣物几乎无法完全贴合她们的身形；衣料如此紧绷，以至于人们甚至能清楚地看到她们的乳头。或许，那些声响正是由此产生的——她们当时正处于某种亲密的举动之中。接下来你看到的是一双深褐色的眼睛，由于缺乏睡眠，眼周的皮肤略带灰暗。这双眼睛位于一个可爱的鼻子上方，而那个鼻子又配有一对涂着哥特式黑色口红的丰润嘴唇。整个脸部被一头修剪得当但略显凌乱的棕色头发环绕着，这些头发一直垂到它们的脖颈处。 ]她根本不需要为跳上那块会爆炸的符文石之后发生的事情而担心。毕竟，你现在在这里，活得好好的——可以说，多亏了她，贝尔温也能毫发无伤地从那场爆炸中幸存下来。 玛蒂哈静静地站在那里，听着你的回答。过了一会儿，她微微转动头部，抬了抬帽子的边缘，这样至少能够朝你的方向看去……即使不能完全看到你。在……时候我可以见见他吗？”她问道，声音的音调微微上扬。“贝尔温通常应该和你在一起吧？他现在在这里吗？ [pc.isDK |Y |带着些许犹豫，y ]你可以告诉她，如果他们现在见面，可能对双方都没有好处。在经历了这一切之后，贝尔温目前正处于一种非常糟糕的情绪状态中，现在与他交谈可能会让双方的伤痛再次被揭开。或许，让时间来治愈他们的伤痛才是最好的办法。 听到你的话后，她把双臂紧紧地抱在身上，用双手抱住自己的腹部。“我明白了，”在你们之间再次陷入沉默之后，她说道。 显然，尽管她非常担心[berwyn.name] ——而且她非常担心——一提到这个就忧心忡忡。 [berwyn.himHer]这对她来说显然是一件痛苦的事情。她的姿态、她的态度，以及最明显的，她的肤色，都在说明：那个在堡垒里沉醉于权力的玛蒂哈——那个企图将萨瓦拉的世界拉入“中间之道”以实现自己扭曲目的人——此刻并不在这个房间里。此刻与你交谈的，只是一个感到困惑、充满悔恨的女性罢了。

rows.original: "There’s a gap in my memory after I had jumped on that rune stone," she continues, perking up and stiffening her back, but she continues to not look towards you. "The last thing I remember is waking up in the courtyard of this[wayfort.stateABC |... hovel. There was nobody nearby. I had no sense of direction or location. The most I have right now are the clothes on my back, and while I’m confident in my skills as a witch, I’m also not willing to take any chances by picking a direction and wandering. | waypoint fortress. I was assisted by some of the living staff here and given a room of my own, which was one emergency taken care of, but I still have no sense of location or direction | castle. I was assisted by some of the living staff here and given a room of my own, which was kind of them and one emergency situation resolved. I was hoping to use the facility’s library [dayNight |soon |tomorrow ] to at least try and pinpoint my location before planning my next move ]." You tell her that she can reach Hawkethorne by traveling south for a few hours on foot. "Hawkethorne?" she parrots, her head whipping back towards you, but careful to keep her eyes from poking out from underneath the brim of her hat. "The rural yokel village?" [pc.isDK |You laugh. Yep, that’s them! |... The rural village, yes. ] "And what are you doing here?" she demands, her arms crossing tighter around her stomach. "If I couldn’t be reunited with Berwyn, I was looking forward to putting the past behind me and starting again. I can’t very well do that if the past keeps chasing me down." You respond that you [wayfort.stateABC |own this heap of rocks. It’s not much of a fortress, you realize, but you were hoping to rebuild it once you had the time and the funds. It’s something you’re sort of looking forward to. "You’ll have your work cut out for you," she says. |own the fortress you two are in right now. It was in much worse shape when you first obtained it, but with a bit of attention, a heap of cash, and some extra help, you’ve slowly been turning it into something a bit more respectable. "It makes me long for my tower," she sighs. |own the Wayfort that she’s in right now. "You?!" she nearly shouts, agog. At first, it wasn’t much of a building at all; it was a heap of rocks, vaguely arranged in the shape of a building. But with some time, effort, some help, and a whole lot of money, you’ve managed to transform it back into the fortress that it once was, complete with the nice living quarters she’s making herself comfortable in. "An accomplished adventurer, capable of striking down power equitable to the gods themselves; a rich tradesman and accomplished negotiator; and... with you owning this fortress, I think that technically makes you a [pc.mf |lord |lady ]." She laughs once to herself. "That’s quite the list. It reminds me of someone I knew a long time ago." ] You ask her what she intends to do next. [wayfort.stateABC |"Try not to freeze to death[dayNight | tonight ]," she says sarcastically. But then, s |S |S ]he sighs in dejection. "I don’t know. When I awoke in the courtyard, I had nothing but the clothes I’m wearing now. No fortress; no enchanted stone holding thousands of years of ambient mana; no idea where I was; and nobody to rely on[wayfort.stateABC |, much less near me at all, out in the middle of nowhere ]." She lifts her head for the first time since you two first started talking, but she doesn’t look at you: she stares off into the upper edge of the room, looking at nothing in particular. You can finally see her eyes underneath the brim of her hat – they’re moist with tears that are welling in their bottoms. "On the one hand, I took it as an opportunity to start over. I’ll be the first to admit that I wasn’t the kindest woman in the world these past few years. Starting over as a nobody would have been a blessing." Matiha looks back down, hiding herself behind the brim once more. "But on the other, I have nothing. Nothing. Nobody. Not Berwyn, not even Elexis. And Hawkethorne isn’t my home. The idea of starting from absolutely nothing is...." She stutters. "It’s scary."[pc.isDK | She’s putting up a convincing act, but you’re pretty sure it’s crocodile tears to try and make you sympathetic towards her. It might not be, of course, but you’re not soft-hearted enough to assume from the start that she’s being sincere. But even still... eh. It doesn’t cost you anything for her to stay here. And besides, she’s hot. Maybe she’ll repay your generosity later. ] You tell her that she’s free to stay here, if she wants. [wayfort.stateABC |You’re aware that the accommodations are... technically better than nothing, but that’s exactly why she should accept your offer: it’s either this, or out in the cold. Unless she thinks she can make it to Hawkethorne from here[dayNight | |, especially at this hour ]. |She’ll have to mind the noise from all the continuing construction, of course, but her room is warm; the food is plentiful; and, provided she doesn’t start going crazy from overdosing on mana again, the Wayfort has laboratories and libraries she may be interested in. |Even if she were to make it all the way to Hawkethorne, she’d find that the accommodations there are less than what she’d find here. Here, she has a room, rent-free, that’d be nicer than the Frost Hound’s lodgings; there’s more than enough food for her; and, provided she doesn’t go mana-crazy again, you’ll allow her to peruse the fort’s library and laboratories as she likes. ] At first, Matiha doesn’t answer. You’d have thought an offer like that would have been met with enthusiasm, but that’s not the case. "Why are you being nice to me?" she asks, tilting her head so that you can see her chin underneath her brim. "Our entire relationship is built on Berwyn running to you to put a stop to his evil mistress. We’ve encountered each other twice before now, and both times ended in conflict." There are [pc.isDK |exactly two |plenty of ] reasons why you’d want to be charitable to her[pc.isDK | |, ranging from not wanting to see a woman that’s down on her luck being forced to walk through the cold to find a home that isn’t hers to try and start her life over from nothing, to you not believing that she’s truly evil and was only confused and corrupted from the influence of that rock, to... you just being that sort of person, where you have the means to help others and you’d like to extend that to her ]. But the easiest reason of them all is it’s because you two know Berwyn. He always thought highly of his teacher, and he’d never forgive you if you told Matiha to [pc.isDK |go fuck herself |hit the road ]. Again, she hesitates. You see her fingers clench tightly into her biceps. "Is that true?" she asks. "When I woke up, I sort of thought that... he hated me." Berwyn’s first and last priority was to get his teacher back. That’s why he came to you in the first place. The plans changed a bit when she had that stone of hers that made her crazy and powerful, but having her, having Matiha, back to the way he remembered her, was what he had wanted from the beginning. You tell her that it’ll be a while before he’s ready to speak with her again, but when he is, it’ll be an easier conversation than she thinks. If she’s not willing to accept that you’re being nice to her for her[pc.isDK | | for the sake of it ], then you ask her to accept that you’re being nice to her for Berwyn. After another moment, you see the corner of her mouth crook into a small smile. "Sure. I can accept that." She brings her hand to her nose – you think. You can’t see through the brim of her hat – to wipe away something. "And I’ll accept your offer to stay. Even without the Vodo rune stone, I’m still a witch of some repute; perhaps I can be of use here."

I was hoping to use the facility’s library [dayNight |soon |tomorrow ] to at least try and pinpoint my location before planning my next move ]." You tell her that she can reach Hawkethorne by traveling south for a few hours on foot. "Hawkethorne?" she parrots, her head whipping back towards you, but careful to keep her eyes from poking out from underneath the brim of her hat. "The rural yokel village?" [pc.isDK |You laugh. Yep, that’s them! |... The rural village, yes. ] "And what are you doing here?" she demands, her arms crossing tighter around her stomach. "If I couldn’t be reunited with Berwyn, I was looking forward to putting the past behind me and starting again. I can’t very well do that if the past keeps chasing me down." You respond that you [wayfort.stateABC |own this heap of rocks. It’s not much of a fortress, you realize, but you were hoping to rebuild it once you had the time and the funds. It’s something you’re sort of looking forward to. "You’ll have your work cut out for you," she says. |own the fortress you two are in right now. "It makes me long for my tower," she sighs. |own the Wayfort that she’s in right now. "You?!" she nearly shouts, agog. At first, it wasn’t much of a building at all; it was a heap of rocks, vaguely arranged in the shape of a building. But with some time, effort, some help, and a whole lot of money, you’ve managed to transform it back into the fortress that it once was, complete with the nice living quarters she’s making herself comfortable in. "An accomplished adventurer, capable of striking down power equitable to the gods themselves; a rich tradesman and accomplished negotiator; and... with you owning this fortress, I think that technically makes you a [pc.mf |lord |lady ]." She laughs once to herself. "That’s quite the list. It reminds me of someone I knew a long time ago." ] You ask her what she intends to do next. [wayfort.stateABC |"Try not to freeze to death[dayNight | tonight ]," she says sarcastically. But then, s |S |S ]he sighs in dejection. "I don’t know. When I awoke in the courtyard, I had nothing but the clothes I’m wearing now. No fortress; no enchanted stone holding thousands of years of ambient mana; no idea where I was; and nobody to rely on[wayfort.stateABC |, much less near me at all, out in the middle of nowhere ]." She lifts her head for the first time since you two first started talking, but she doesn’t look at you: she stares off into the upper edge of the room, looking at nothing in particular. You can finally see her eyes underneath the brim of her hat – they’re moist with tears that are welling in their bottoms. "On the one hand, I took it as an opportunity to start over. I’ll be the first to admit that I wasn’t the kindest woman in the world these past few years. Starting over as a nobody would have been a blessing." Matiha looks back down, hiding herself behind the brim once more. "But on the other, I have nothing. Nothing. Nobody. Not Berwyn, not even Elexis. And Hawkethorne isn’t my home. Unless she thinks she can make it to Hawkethorne from here[dayNight | |, especially at this hour ]. |She’ll have to mind the noise from all the continuing construction, of course, but her room is warm; the food is plentiful; and, provided she doesn’t start going crazy from overdosing on mana again, the Wayfort has laboratories and libraries she may be interested in. |Even if she were to make it all the way to Hawkethorne, she’d find that the accommodations there are less than what she’d find here. You’d have thought an offer like that would have been met with enthusiasm, but that’s not the case. "Why are you being nice to me?" she asks, tilting her head so that you can see her chin underneath her brim. "Our entire relationship is built on Berwyn running to you to put a stop to his evil mistress. We’ve encountered each other twice before now, and both times ended in conflict." There are [pc.isDK |exactly two |plenty of ] reasons why you’d want to be charitable to her[pc.isDK | |, ranging from not wanting to see a woman that’s down on her luck being forced to walk through the cold to find a home that isn’t hers to try and start her life over from nothing, to you not believing that she’s truly evil and was only confused and corrupted from the influence of that rock, to... you just being that sort of person, where you have the means to help others and you’d like to extend that to her ]. But the easiest reason of them all is it’s because you two know Berwyn. He always thought highly of his teacher, and he’d never forgive you if you told Matiha to [pc.isDK |go fuck herself |hit the road ]. Again, she hesitates. You see her fingers clench tightly into her biceps. "Is that true?" she asks. "When I woke up, I sort of thought that... he hated me." Berwyn’s first and last priority was to get his teacher back. That’s why he came to you in the first place. The plans changed a bit when she had that stone of hers that made her crazy and powerful, but having her, having Matiha, back to the way he remembered her, was what he had wanted from the beginning. You tell her that it’ll be a while before he’s ready to speak with her again, but when he is, it’ll be an easier conversation than she thinks. If she’s not willing to accept that you’re being nice to her for her[pc.isDK | | for the sake of it ], then you ask her to accept that you’re being nice to her for Berwyn. After another moment, you see the corner of her mouth crook into a small smile. "Sure. I can accept that." She brings her hand to her nose – you think. Even without the Vodo rune stone, I’m still a witch of some repute; perhaps I can be of use here." '

rows.original: There’s just one more thing, before you two make this official. Ever since you came into her room, she’s outright refused to look at you. Is it something you said? "Um," she mutters, her voice coming out quaky and nervous. Her right hand reaches for her brim and pulls it down, hiding herself behind her enormous hat. "I think I’d rather not say. And, in fact, the longer you stay, the more... problems that we... or at least I, might have." ... This is your wayfort, now. If she’s going to live here, she’s not going to be able to avoid you forever. "I can certainly try!" she barks. No, you’re putting your foot down on this. If she’s going to live in your fortress[wayfort.stateABC |, even such that it is ], she’s going to have to at least tell you why she won’t look at you. If it’s something you need to fix, you’ll fix it. "You’ll do...!" she starts, loudly, before settling down and continuing meekly. "... no such thing." She mumbles something else underneath her breath, far too quietly and garbled for you to make out. You lean on one foot, lowering yourself so that you can peek at her from underneath the brim of her hat; the skin of her neck and face have turned bright red, and although her nipples were already large enough to poke out against the fabric of her clothing, you can easily tell that they’re erect: they look like they might punch holes through her robe if she isn’t careful. Her lips are quivering and rolled inward, and when you lean down far enough that you can see her eyes and she can see yours, she makes the tiniest 'eep!’ before twisting and lowering her hat some more, almost to the point of it falling off her head. "Okay," she starts, but her voice breaks and she clears her throat to start again. "Okay. Fine. The truth is that there are... two problems. And one of them is you." Is it anything you need to work on? "No," she answers immediately. "I... it’s... I don’t know. It’s not any one thing about you. It’s you. I’m...." She tentatively, nervously, lifts the brim of her hat, just enough that your eyes meet once again. Her skin hasn’t gotten any less red. "I’m... attracted to you. I’m... wildly attracted to you. I can’t explain it. It’s not any one thing about you. The way you look; the way you talk; the way you sound; the way you walk... I’ve had attractions before, but nothing ever like this. My heart feels like it’s about to beat out of my chest. And my...." She clears her throat again, but doesn’t elaborate further. Although you notice that her eyes temporarily break from yours to glance down the ramp of her bust. You could probably hazard a guess what else of hers is going crazy for you. "I don’t know where this came from. We’ve met only twice before. I suppose I was under the Vodo rune stone’s influence both times, but even before then, I wouldn’t have supposed myself so... vulnerable to someone like you." On the one hand, you can see how that might be debilitating, especially since she’s going to start living on your property now. She’s a pretty [pc.isBimbo |smart |studious ] woman and she’d probably appreciate not having you on the mind while she’s trying to work. On the other... that’s a pretty big compliment. And, although you keep this part to yourself, you’re not seeing the issue. "The second problem is... somewhat related," she says. Her left hand goes to her leg, her palm stroking along her exposed thigh, attracting your eyes to her hips from the movement. Once she notices your gaze has shifted, she starts grinding her hips together. You can’t tell if it’s all intentional. "My libido has skyrocketed. I... I don’t know what caused it and I’m having... um...." She clears her throat again and twists her head, too embarrassed to look at you. "I’m having... trouble... 'containing’ it." [pc.isDK |Ah, that must have been the noise that you heard coming from in here earlier. She lets out an exasperated sigh, letting out all of the air in her lungs at once. "Indeed," she squeaks. |"'Containing’ it?" you ask, before immediately regretting it. What she meant became obvious the second you said it out loud. "Do you need a more detailed description?!" she hollers. "You heard the noises earlier. I was trying to 'wrangle’ my own damn body until it behaved! I don’t think I need to explain it any further!" You don’t say as much, but... it’d be kind of hot if she did, though. ] "With these two issues combined, you can see how I’d really rather appreciate it if you’d either leave me alone, or you fffffffffffuuuhhhhh...." She lowers her hat over her eyes once again with her right hand, but her left hand can’t seem to find a comfortable spot to stay on her body. It flits between hanging limp at her thigh, to resting on her breast, to, probably unintentionally, running it over the cap of her nipple before wrapping it around her stomach protectively. "Either you leave me alone, or you fffff... you haaaaaa... you...." She lowers her voice. "You help me deal with it." [pc.isDK |You can definitely do one of those things, sure. "Ugh, that snide attitude of yours," she scoffs, but stops herself before saying anything... dishonest. |What she’s asking you to do isn’t lost on you – and you’re honored, flattered, and you might be willing – but you don’t want to seem like you’re taking advantage of her. Is that really something she wants you to do? Don’t you run the risk of making it worse? "Worse than what I’m going through right now?" she replies. ]"It would likely only be a temporary fix, but... Nareva help me, I’m so frazzled and lost in my own head that getting this knot out of my loins for a few minutes could help me focus long enough to find a cure.[pc.isDK | | So yes. I’m sure. Don’t make me repeat myself and just do as I say before I grind [wayfort.stateABC |these rocks |a rock ] to dust with my thighs. ] Either fffffffhelp me out here or leave, already." Well. You heard the lady.[pc.hasKnot | Ironic choice of words about knots and loins, though. ]

rows.original: You ask Matiha to tell you a bit more about herself. Aside from what she happened to let slip in the tower during the incident, and the fact that [matiha.isLover |she’s entered into a polyamorous relationship with two people |she admitted that she, well, that she’s badly attracted to you ], there’s so little that you know about the woman Matiha. [matiha.isLover | |She clears her throat at the open-air admission for her feelings towards you. ]Matiha sets down her teacup and smiles – an insincere, closed-mouth smile that’s trying to protect something. "What more would you like to know?" she asks in turn. Thinking back, you don’t remember a lot about what Matiha had said in the tower – but you distinctly remember her saying that she knew [berwyn.name]’s grandfather, and that a massive hurricane had devastated the western coastline, which unearthed a handful of Jotun artifacts, where they had found the rune stone that had started all that mess. But she also mentioned that that raid in particular was over a century ago. Maybe starting with her age would be a good start. At the new question, Matiha’s face goes through a gamut of different expressions: from nervousness, to a wry smile, to something glossy and distant as she considers answering at all. "Don’t you know it’s rude to ask a lady her age?" she responds eventually.[berwyn.andMatiha | [berwyn.name] laughs once at that. "Cut the shit, Matiha," [berwyn.heShe] says. "Just tell us already." Matiha hesitates again, but she knows she’s cornered. She could simply not answer, based on the fact that you remembered the conversation from before, it wouldn’t be difficult to ballpark it. | Still, she knows that not answering would just make things more difficult and cause tension between you two. And the fact that you remembered what she said earlier means that you’d be able to ballpark it fairly well anyway. ] "The truth is, I don’t remember the exact number," she responds. She circles the rim of her teacup a few times as she thinks. "The Vodo rune stone had stopped my aging when I first started tapping into it. I was twenty-two when Fiodoir and I found that stone, so I would estimate my age to be roughly around ninety, give or take a few years." [pc.isBimbo |Oh, wow! She’s – wait! That means that she’s a GILF, right? Because she’s fucking killing it at her age! Matiha cocks one eyebrow, her expression stone-faced. "What’s a 'Gilf?’" she asks. You tell her that you’ll show her later. |Damn. She’s really knocking it out of the park for her age. "I appreciate that, thank you," she says, her lips curling into a smarmy, 'I’m hot and I know it’ smile. ] Has the effects of the Vodo rune stone been wearing off now that it’s, well, not a thing anymore? "Sadly, yes," she answers, looking down at her fingers and flexing them individually. "Luckily for me, all of my 'owed’ time doesn’t seem to be catching up to me all at once. But my aging has resumed all the same, I can say that for certain." She sighs wistfully as she sees her own reflection in her teacup. "It sort of makes a woman miss having an artifact that provides unlimited power and eternal youth, you know. I wonder where the nearest Narevan vault is." She’s... probably joking, but you don’t let the conversation linger there to find out for certain. You ask her about her younger years – how did she become the witch that she is today? "Oh, goodness, where to start?" she asks with a laugh. "I was displaying magical affinity before I was ten years old: by then, I was already reading magic tomes and devouring the knowledge within them for all their worth. Or, at least, the beginner-level tomes. I was setting things on fire with my fingertips before my eleventh birthday." That’s quite the alarming power for a ten-year-old girl to wield. "My affinities drew me towards black magic[pc.isMage | | – qualities that a person would normally associate with destruction, such as setting fires, or shooting lightning from my fingers. The classic imagery you’d find in popular fiction ]. But one day, I...." Her expression changes very suddenly, like a candle had been blown out. She loses all humor and energy in her body as she stares sadly into her drink. Even the hat on her head begins to sag. "I didn’t quite have my powers in check – I doubt any little girl could. Even contorting the mana into a little ember requires more discipline than a child should be capable of." She takes a long, shuddering sigh as she tries to hold back her tears. If you had to guess, she lost someone important to her because of her inability to control her own magic. "One day, I... accidentally burnt my stuffed bear, Mister Snuggles, while we were on a dinner date with my other dolls." She lifts her hand to her eyes, wiping them dry with her thumb. "By the time I got it under control... he was gone."[berwyn.andMatiha | [berwyn.name] sits there, incredulous, at the story. One eyebrow lifts high on [berwyn.hisHer] forehead while [berwyn.hisHer] mouth curls into a confused, frustrated, open-mouthed scowl. "All of that build-up was over a stuffed doll?!" [berwyn.heShe] asks. "How dare you?" Matiha snaps back, her eyes narrowing into daggers in [berwyn.name]’s direction. "Mister Snuggles was a part of my family, [berwyn.name]. He was an important part of my childhood. Who are you to say what a little girl should or shouldn’t choose to bond with?" At the tone of Matiha’s voice, [berwyn.name] immediately backs down, going back to [berwyn.hisHer] own tea. Perhaps [berwyn.heShe] meant it in jest, but Matiha clearly didn’t find it so funny. ] She goes back to regarding her tea. She grips the cup by the handle and gently swishes the liquid around, watching it dance in the bowl. "I haven’t been a black mage since then. My knowledge of black magic begins and ends with conjuring fire. And Withering Bolt, I suppose. Ever since then, I had thrown all of my effort into enchantment magic instead." You ask why enchantment magic specifically. Although she certainly has the natural beauty for it, you’d think after an event like that, she’d want to lean towards white magic or something more... outwardly beneficial. "That’s what I thought I was doing!" she responds. "My thinking at the time was that I could use enchantment to bring Mister Snuggles back to me. And if I could make Mister Snuggles good as new with enchantment magic, then maybe I could breathe some life into the rest of my doll set. Never mind the fact that the school I was after was actually transmutation, not enchantment, so my plan wouldn’t have worked anyway." ... She thought that enchanting a burnt stuffed bear would heal it of all of its burn damage? "Look, the mind of a child is its own labyrinth, [pc.name]," she huffs, taking another swig of her tea – a larger, more intent one than before. "I thought that a successfully enchanted stuffed bear doll would come back to me as good as new. I was young and heartbroken. I didn’t exactly put a lot of thought into it." She sets the teacup back onto its platter, her nostrils flaring as she thinks back to that day. "It’s for the best that it didn’t work, of course." You ask her to continue with her story from there. She had forsaken black magic for enchantment, which led her to who she is today – but how did she go from a heartbroken child with a burnt bear doll to a Narevan treasure hunter with [berwyn.name]’s grandfather? "Fiodoir and I went to the same school, Marouka, when we were young adults. As I said before, he was a gifted battlemage, unlike any that I had the pleasure of knowing before[pc.isMage|... until recently," she says, smiling as she looks your way. " |. ]He was as gifted with the sword as he was with the tome – he could cut down a foe twice his size with one hand and incinerate the remains with the other before it lost its balance."[berwyn.andMatiha | [berwyn.name] sighs wistfully, [berwyn.hisHer] eyes trailing off to nowhere as [berwyn.heShe] imagines the sort of adventures that [berwyn.hisHer] grandfather had gotten up to. And, perhaps, the fantasy of one day wielding power not unlike his. ] "Fiodoir and I graduated at the top of our respective classes. We both knew that we were exceptional at what it was we did." She stops to sip her tea, taking a long look at the teacup’s well before continuing. "As we delved deeper into our personal research, however, we came to the mutual realization that... there was something that Marouka wasn’t teaching us. Most likely because they didn’t know themselves." She takes another sip before continuing casually, as if she were talking about the weather. "So he and I started drawing up plans and theories on where we could search to find these answers. The first, and most obvious, place to look was a Narevan treasure vault. And we were prepared to make that risk – to raid one of Nareva’s personal vaults – but our scheduled plans were waylaid by a hurricane that had torn up the western coastline." She and Fiodoir had a thirst for knowledge, you understand that much, and they had the suspicion that there was more to magic than they were being taught... so their conclusion was to steal from one of the gods? Not just 'one’ of the gods, either – the god of knowledge and secrets herself? "As opposed to asking the god of secrets 'pretty please?’" she smirks in response. "Fiodoir and I knew what we were getting into. And we had considered every alternative. We didn’t exactly want Nareva, a god, to be our enemy – but we also couldn’t accept that there was knowledge that she was willingly keeping from us, and we also knew that it was better to ask forgiveness than permission." She takes another dainty sip of her tea. "It was pure chance that that hurricane not only stopped us from initiating a raid on a vault’s known location, but had also unearthed some Jotun artifacts in the process. The Vodo rune stone among them." She sets down her teacup and its platter on the table between you. "And I believe I’ve told you the rest." Not quite – you do have one more question about her history, particularly with Fiodoir. "You’re about to ask if we were ever in a relationship, correct?" Matiha interrupts, cutting you off before the words can even form in your head. You confirm – with a bit of frustration, since she took all the fun out of it.[berwyn.andMatiha | [berwyn.name] sits still, [berwyn.hisHer] teacup in [berwyn.hisHer] hand, awaiting Matiha’s response. Given the relationship you three have, you’d understand if [berwyn.heShe] would be a bit... hesitant to learn if Matiha and Fiodoir were ever physically intimate. ] "Not in a romantic or sensual way," she answers. "Fiodoir had a beautiful mind and an attractive personality... but he was also a large, stocky, gruff, hairy man[berwyn.andMatiha |." She smirks wryly, her eyes briefly flitting towards [berwyn.name] before resuming. " |. ]It should be obvious by now what sort of body type I’m attracted to, and it wasn’t him."[berwyn.andMatiha | At that, [berwyn.name] deflates in [berwyn.hisHer] chair, sighing oh-so-lightly in relief to [berwyn.himHer]self. ]
rows.translation: 你让玛蒂哈多讲一些关于她自己的事情。除了她在那次事件中在塔里不小心透露出的一些信息，还有那个事实[matiha.isLover |她与两个人建立了多角恋关系。 |她承认，嗯，她对你确实很有好感。 ]关于玛蒂哈这个女人，你所了解的其实非常少。 [matiha.isLover | |她在公开场合清了清嗓子，表达了自己对你的感情。 ]玛蒂哈放下茶杯，露出一个笑容——那是一个虚伪的、紧闭着嘴唇的笑容，似乎在试图掩饰什么。“你还想了解些什么呢？”她反问道。 回想起来，你却想不起来还有什么很多关于玛蒂哈在塔里说过的话——但你清楚地记得她说过她知道那些事情。 [berwyn.name]她的祖父曾参与那次行动，当时一场巨大的飓风摧毁了西海岸线，导致一些约顿族的文物被暴露出来，而就在那些文物中，他们发现了那块引发了这一切麻烦的符文石。但她也提到，那次行动其实已经发生了一个多世纪之前了。或许从她的年龄开始谈起会是个不错的开始。 听到这个新问题，玛蒂哈的脸上浮现出一系列复杂的表情：从紧张，到苦笑，再到在考虑是否应该回答这个问题时那种若有所思、显得有些恍惚的神情。你难道不知道，询问女士的年龄是一种不礼貌的行为吗？”她最终说道。[berwyn.andMatiha | [berwyn.name]哈哈，得了吧，玛蒂哈。 [berwyn.heShe]快告诉我们吧。” 玛蒂哈再次犹豫了，但她知道自己已经无路可走了。如果对方还记得之前的对话，那么推断出答案应该并不困难。她实在无法再拒绝回答了。 | 不过，她心里明白，如果不回答，只会让事情变得更加复杂，导致你们之间的矛盾加剧。而你能够记起她之前说过的话，这说明你其实已经能够大致理解其中的意思了。 ] 说实话，我并不记得具体的数字了，”她回答道。她一边思考，一边用手指轻轻敲打着茶杯的边缘。“当我第一次开始使用那块沃多符文石时，它的确让我的衰老过程停止了。我和菲奥多尔发现那块石头的时候，我二十二岁，所以大概现在我的年龄应该在九十岁左右吧，上下可能差个几岁。 [pc.isBimbo |哦，哇！她……等等！这意味着她是个“熟女”，对吧？因为她已经……呃，年纪不小了。表现非常出色在她这个年纪！ 玛蒂哈挑了挑眉毛，表情依然严肃。“‘Gilf’是什么意思？”她问道。 你就告诉她，稍后会给她解释。 |该死，以她的年纪来说，她的表现真的太出色了。 “我很感激，谢谢你，”她说，嘴角勾起那种“我知道自己很性感”的讨好笑容。 ] 既然那种“沃多符文石”的效果已经不复存在了，那么它的效果是不是已经逐渐消失了呢？ “遗憾的是，是的，”她低头看着自己的手指，一根一根地活动着它们，回答道，“不过幸运的是，我‘欠下的’那些时间似乎并没有一下子全部找上我。但我衰老的过程还是继续了，这一点我可以肯定。”她望着茶杯中自己的倒影，无奈地叹了口气，“你知道，这种感觉会让人真正渴望拥有一件能赋予无限力量和永葆青春的神器啊。我在想最近的纳雷万金库在哪里。” 她…… 大概吧开玩笑的，但你并没有让话题就停留在那里，没有继续追问下去以弄清楚真相。你问她关于她年轻时的故事——她究竟是如何变成如今这样的女巫的？ “哦，天哪，该从哪里说起呢？”她笑着问道。在我十岁之前，我就已经展现出了对魔法的特殊天赋：那时，我已经开始阅读魔法典籍，并全力吸收其中蕴含的知识。至少是那些初级级别的典籍吧。而在十一岁生日之前，我就已经能够用指尖点燃物品了。对于一个十岁的女孩来说，拥有这样的力量确实令人担忧。 “我的天性使我对黑魔法产生了浓厚的兴趣。[pc.isMage | | – 这些特质通常会让人联想到破坏行为，比如纵火，或者从手指中释放闪电。这些都是流行文学中常见的经典意象。 ]但是有一天，我……” 她的表情突然发生了变化，就像一支蜡烛被吹灭了一样。她整个人都失去了幽默感和活力，悲伤地望着自己的饮料。就连她头上的帽子也似乎开始下垂了。 我当时完全无法控制自己的力量——恐怕任何一个小女孩也都做不到这一点。就连将那些魔力凝聚成一小团火焰，也需要超出一个孩子所能拥有的自制力。” 她长长地叹了口气，身体不由自主地颤抖着，努力忍住泪水不流出来。如果你非得猜测的话，她是因为无法控制自己的魔法，从而失去了某个对她来说非常重要的人。 “有一天，我和我的其他玩偶一起吃晚餐时，不小心把我的毛绒熊‘Mister Snuggles’烧坏了。她把手举到眼前，用拇指擦了擦眼泪。“等我终于控制住局面……他已经不见了。[berwyn.andMatiha | [berwyn.name]坐在那里，简直无法相信这个故事。他的一条眉毛高高挑了起来。 [berwyn.hisHer]同时皱着眉头[berwyn.hisHer]嘴角扭曲成一种困惑又沮丧的表情，张大嘴巴说道：“所有这些铺垫，竟然只是为了一个毛绒玩具？！ rows.raw: ' You ask Matiha to tell you a bit more about herself. Aside from what she happened to let slip in the tower during the incident, and the fact that [matiha.isLover |she’s entered into a polyamorous relationship with two people |she admitted that she, well, that she’s badly attracted to you ], there’s so little that you know about the woman Matiha. [matiha.isLover | |She clears her throat at the open-air admission for her feelings towards you. ]Matiha sets down her teacup and smiles – an insincere, closed-mouth smile that’s trying to protect something. "What more would you like to know?" she asks in turn. Thinking back, you don’t remember a lot about what Matiha had said in the tower – but you distinctly remember her saying that she knew [berwyn.name]’s grandfather, and that a massive hurricane had devastated the western coastline, which unearthed a handful of Jotun artifacts, where they had found the rune stone that had started all that mess. But she also mentioned that that raid in particular was over a century ago. Maybe starting with her age would be a good start. At the new question, Matiha’s face goes through a gamut of different expressions: from nervousness, to a wry smile, to something glossy and distant as she considers answering at all. "Don’t you know it’s rude to ask a lady her age?" she responds eventually.[berwyn.andMatiha | [berwyn.name] laughs once at that. "Cut the shit, Matiha," [berwyn.heShe] says. "Just tell us already." Matiha hesitates again, but she knows she’s cornered. She could simply not answer, based on the fact that you remembered the conversation from before, it wouldn’t be difficult to ballpark it. | Still, she knows that not answering would just make things more difficult and cause tension between you two. And the fact that you remembered what she said earlier means that you’d be able to ballpark it fairly well anyway. ] "The truth is, I don’t remember the exact number," she responds. She circles the rim of her teacup a few times as she thinks. "The Vodo rune stone had stopped my aging when I first started tapping into it. I was twenty-two when Fiodoir and I found that stone, so I would estimate my age to be roughly around ninety, give or take a few years." [pc.isBimbo |Oh, wow! She’s – wait! That means that she’s a GILF, right? Because she’s fucking killing it at her age! Matiha cocks one eyebrow, her expression stone-faced. "What’s a 'Gilf?’" she asks. You tell her that you’ll show her later. |Damn. She’s really knocking it out of the park for her age. "I appreciate that, thank you," she says, her lips curling into a smarmy, 'I’m hot and I know it’ smile. ] Has the effects of the Vodo rune stone been wearing off now that it’s, well, not a thing anymore? "Sadly, yes," she answers, looking down at her fingers and flexing them individually. "Luckily for me, all of my 'owed’ time doesn’t seem to be catching up to me all at once. But my aging has resumed all the same, I can say that for certain." She sighs wistfully as she sees her own reflection in her teacup. "It sort of makes a woman miss having an artifact that provides unlimited power and eternal youth, you know. I wonder where the nearest Narevan vault is." She’s... probably joking, but you don’t let the conversation linger there to find out for certain. You ask her about her younger years – how did she become the witch that she is today? "Oh, goodness, where to start?" she asks with a laugh. "I was displaying magical affinity before I was ten years old: by then, I was already reading magic tomes and devouring the knowledge within them for all their worth. Or, at least, the beginner-level tomes. I was setting things on fire with my fingertips before my eleventh birthday." That’s quite the alarming power for a ten-year-old girl to wield. "My affinities drew me towards black magic[pc.isMage | | – qualities that a person would normally associate with destruction, such as setting fires, or shooting lightning from my fingers. The classic imagery you’d find in popular fiction ]. But one day, I...." Her expression changes very suddenly, like a candle had been blown out. She loses all humor and energy in her body as she stares sadly into her drink. Even the hat on her head begins to sag. "I didn’t quite have my powers in check – I doubt any little girl could. Even contorting the mana into a little ember requires more discipline than a child should be capable of." She takes a long, shuddering sigh as she tries to hold back her tears. If you had to guess, she lost someone important to her because of her inability to control her own magic. "One day, I... accidentally burnt my stuffed bear, Mister Snuggles, while we were on a dinner date with my other dolls." She lifts her hand to her eyes, wiping them dry with her thumb. "By the time I got it under control... he was gone."[berwyn.andMatiha | [berwyn.name] sits there, incredulous, at the story. One eyebrow lifts high on [berwyn.hisHer] forehead while [berwyn.hisHer] mouth curls into a confused, frustrated, open-mouthed scowl. "All of that build-up was over a stuffed doll?!" [berwyn.heShe] asks. "How dare you?" Matiha snaps back, her eyes narrowing into daggers in [berwyn.name]’s direction. "Mister Snuggles was a part of my family, [berwyn.name]. He was an important part of my childhood. Who are you to say what a little girl should or shouldn’t choose to bond with?" At the tone of Matiha’s voice, [berwyn.name] immediately backs down, going back to [berwyn.hisHer] own tea. Perhaps [berwyn.heShe] meant it in jest, but Matiha clearly didn’t find it so funny. ] She goes back to regarding her tea. She grips the cup by the handle and gently swishes the liquid around, watching it dance in the bowl. "I haven’t been a black mage since then. My knowledge of black magic begins and ends with conjuring fire. And Withering Bolt, I suppose. Ever since then, I had thrown all of my effort into enchantment magic instead." You ask why enchantment magic specifically. Although she certainly has the natural beauty for it, you’d think after an event like that, she’d want to lean towards white magic or something more... outwardly beneficial. "That’s what I thought I was doing!" she responds. "My thinking at the time was that I could use enchantment to bring Mister Snuggles back to me. And if I could make Mister Snuggles good as new with enchantment magic, then maybe I could breathe some life into the rest of my doll set. Never mind the fact that the school I was after was actually transmutation, not enchantment, so my plan wouldn’t have worked anyway." ... She thought that enchanting a burnt stuffed bear would heal it of all of its burn damage? "Look, the mind of a child is its own labyrinth, [pc.name]," she huffs, taking another swig of her tea – a larger, more intent one than before. "I thought that a successfully enchanted stuffed bear doll would come back to me as good as new. I was young and heartbroken. I didn’t exactly put a lot of thought into it." She sets the teacup back onto its platter, her nostrils flaring as she thinks back to that day. "It’s for the best that it didn’t work, of course." You ask her to continue with her story from there. She had forsaken black magic for enchantment, which led her to who she is today – but how did she go from a heartbroken child with a burnt bear doll to a Narevan treasure hunter with [berwyn.name]’s grandfather? "Fiodoir and I went to the same school, Marouka, when we were young adults. As I said before, he was a gifted battlemage, unlike any that I had the pleasure of knowing before[pc.isMage|... until recently," she says, smiling as she looks your way. " |. ]He was as gifted with the sword as he was with the tome – he could cut down a foe twice his size with one hand and incinerate the remains with the other before it lost its balance."[berwyn.andMatiha | [berwyn.name] sighs wistfully, [berwyn.hisHer] eyes trailing off to nowhere as [berwyn.heShe] imagines the sort of adventures that [berwyn.hisHer] grandfather had gotten up to. And, perhaps, the fantasy of one day wielding power not unlike his. ] "Fiodoir and I graduated at the top of our respective classes. We both knew that we were exceptional at what it was we did." She stops to sip her tea, taking a long look at the teacup’s well before continuing. "As we delved deeper into our personal research, however, we came to the mutual realization that... there was something that Marouka wasn’t teaching us. Most likely because they didn’t know themselves." She takes another sip before continuing casually, as if she were talking about the weather. "So he and I started drawing up plans and theories on where we could search to find these answers. The first, and most obvious, place to look was a Narevan treasure vault. And we were prepared to make that risk – to raid one of Nareva’s personal vaults – but our scheduled plans were waylaid by a hurricane that had torn up the western coastline." She and Fiodoir had a thirst for knowledge, you understand that much, and they had the suspicion that there was more to magic than they were being taught... so their conclusion was to steal from one of the gods? Not just 'one’ of the gods, either – the god of knowledge and secrets herself? "As opposed to asking the god of secrets 'pretty please?’" she smirks in response. "Fiodoir and I knew what we were getting into. And we had considered every alternative. We didn’t exactly want Nareva, a god, to be our enemy – but we also couldn’t accept that there was knowledge that she was willingly keeping from us, and we also knew that it was better to ask forgiveness than permission." She takes another dainty sip of her tea. "It was pure chance that that hurricane not only stopped us from initiating a raid on a vault’s known location, but had also unearthed some Jotun artifacts in the process. The Vodo rune stone among them." She sets down her teacup and its platter on the table between you. "And I believe I’ve told you the rest." Not quite – you do have one more question about her history, particularly with Fiodoir. "You’re about to ask if we were ever in a relationship, correct?" Matiha interrupts, cutting you off before the words can even form in your head. You confirm – with a bit of frustration, since she took all the fun out of it.[berwyn.andMatiha | [berwyn.name] sits still, [berwyn.hisHer] teacup in [berwyn.hisHer] hand, awaiting Matiha’s response. Given the relationship you three have, you’d understand if [berwyn.heShe] would be a bit... hesitant to learn if Matiha and Fiodoir were ever physically intimate. ] "Not in a romantic or sensual way," she answers. "Fiodoir had a beautiful mind and an attractive personality... but he was also a large, stocky, gruff, hairy man[berwyn.andMatiha |." She smirks wryly, her eyes briefly flitting towards [berwyn.name] before resuming. " |. ]It should be obvious by now what sort of body type I’m attracted to, and it wasn’t him."[berwyn.andMatiha | At that, [berwyn.name] deflates in [berwyn.hisHer] chair, sighing oh-so-lightly in relief to [berwyn.himHer]self. ] '

It’s related to her sexual health. You’re [berwyn.andMatiha |all |both ] adults; talking about something as serious and personal as that ought to be something you don’t have to shy away from, especially considering your relationship. At that last part, Matiha pauses, raises an eyebrow, and gently sets her teacup down onto her platter. "Is this a question that must be asked now?" she asks in turn. It’s not, but there’s also not really a 'good’ time to ever ask, if that’s how she wants to deflect it. Matiha hums in thought at your rebuttal. After deliberating with herself for a moment, she closes her eyes, takes a deep breath in through her nose, and exhales. "Fine, ask your deeply personal question, then," she surrenders. You were just wonder how she’s handling her increased libido. She had mentioned some time ago that, ever since the incident, it’s been more intense than usual, and you were wondering if she’s been having a difficult time coping[berwyn.andMatiha |. I’ve been devoting my every waking hour to my studies and research." I had garnered some knowledge of polymorphization from that one Narevan magehunter that attacked me during the height of the rune stone incident, but using magic to control a bodily function like my libido is still many, many years off for me, if indeed it’s possible at all." rows.original: You wake sometime later. Your mind is a groggy, blurry place, and your eyes are crusted over and unfocused when you manage to open them. But at least the light of the room is fairly dim. Your muscles are all stiff from staying in the same position for so long, but it’s a good kind of stiff: the kind that you can work out with a stretch or two. As you squirm in the bed, you feel the warm body of someone else being in there with you, although you can’t make out silhouettes in your mind’s eye. Eventually, when you manage to get them open, the first thing you see is the dark crown of Matiha’s hair, her face still buried into the crook of your neck. She was so comfortable since you two first went to sleep that she hadn’t moved the entire time. You can feel her fingers lightly play at your spine, drawing senseless shapes on the [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] of your back, and she only stops once you begin to stir. "Hey there, sleepyhead," she says once she looks up at you, her gaze meeting yours. Her eyes have narrowed into slits from her cheeks having raised into a smile – she doesn’t often smile like that. "Good morning." You ask her how long she’s been awake before you. "Not too long at all," she answers. "But... I’m not in a rush to get up. I was enjoying myself." Eventually, though, your muscles start to creak from staying in some spot for too long, and you pull yourselves out of bed. It’s a slow, languid affair; neither of you are in a hurry to get started with your days. You spend enough time sleeping in tavern beds and bedrolls on the cold ground that[wayfort.stateABC |, well, there’s no denying that this bed was a downgrade, but the comfort of the bed doesn’t matter as much as the comfort of your company |sleeping in a plush bed like this one was nice – especially with the company you had |majesty bed like that one is a treat you’re reluctant to give up, especially with the company you had ]. But, all the same, you eventually pull yourself and your effects together, and you’re made presentable to the world once more. After a sleep like that, you feel like you can take on anything! You pull yourself away from Matiha, and you make your way out of the fortress for now, ready to resume your journey after a good night’s sleep.
rows.translation: 过了一阵，你从睡梦中醒来。脑中昏沉模糊；好不容易睁开眼睛时，眼角满是硬痂，目光也无法聚焦。不过，至少房间里的光线相当昏暗。 长时间保持相同姿势，令你的肌肉全都僵硬，可这是种舒服的僵硬，只要伸展一两次便能舒解。你在床上扭动时，感觉到另一个人的温暖身体也和你躺在一起，尽管脑海中无法勾勒出她的轮廓。 最终，等你终于睁开双眼，首先看到的是玛蒂哈乌黑的头发；她的脸依旧埋在你颈窝中。从两人入睡开始，她便睡得无比舒适，始终没有移动。你能感觉到她的手指轻轻拨弄你的脊背，在你背部的[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]上画出毫无意义的形状，直到你开始动弹才停下来。 “嘿，瞌睡虫。”她抬头看向你，与你四目相对后说道。她双颊扬起笑容，双眼也眯成了细缝——她很少这样微笑。“早上好。” 你问她比自己早醒了多久。 “根本没多久。”她答道。“不过……我不急着起床。刚才一直很享受。” 不过，长时间保持某个姿势，你的肌肉终究开始嘎吱作响，你们只好从床上爬起来。整个过程缓慢慵懒；你们都不急着开始新的一天。你经常睡在酒馆床铺和寒冷地面的铺盖卷里，所以[wayfort.stateABC |，好吧，无法否认这张床档次更低，但比起床铺是否舒服，同床之人带来的舒适更加重要 |能睡在这样柔软的床上十分惬意——尤其还有她陪伴 |这样富丽堂皇的床铺让人舍不得离开，尤其还有她陪伴 ]。 但无论如何，你最终还是收拾好自己与随身物品，再一次体面地面对世界。睡过这样的一觉，你感觉自己能应付一切！ 你依依不舍地离开玛蒂哈，暂时走出堡垒；一夜好眠之后，你已准备好继续旅程。
