rows.original: The air within the old watchtower's ground floor is sullen. While [wayfort.hasAileh |[var0 |the path and stairs leading to Aileh's residence, as well as the little corner where the summoning circle, are clean |the path and stairs leading to Aileh's residence above are clear ] |[var0 |the small bit of space around the summoning circle is clear |the immediate entryway is mostly clean of dust and debris ] ], the rest of the watchtower's base has been left to lie as it is, gathering dust. Privacy is a double-edged sword — out of sight, out of mind. The very surroundings which Meira seeks to use to hide from public view have also resulted in the maids simply not bothering to clean the empty, unused space; crumbling furniture aside, smashed bookcases, moldy paper and flaking parchment form most of the mess. Meira's expression goes through several emotions, disgust and anger included, until finally settling on the realization that she might be just a little slightly in over her head. You do find it interesting that she managed to learn so much about the old watchtower on her previous visit here, yet seems so surprised at it being a dump. Presumably she'd have known that before she arrived on your doorstep. Having second thoughts about not wanting to bunk down with the hired help? Meira pouts. "I'll be fine." Good. Her first job as your court wizard, then, will be to clean up enough of this mess to make the watchtower's base livable. Since she's going to stay here, it's to her benefit; you'll just step back and watch how she handles this. "Sure, I could, but cleaning up is for m—" You hold up a finger at that. See, if she's going to be in your employ as court mage, then her job is to serve you. While she might have gotten a lot of leeway back home with her [evergreen.dealtWith |mother |sister ], she doesn't get to complain that work is beneath her. Sure, she can suggest a different method to achieve the goal you've set out, or improvements on how things are done, or suggest an alternative. What she doesn't get to do is to be a brat and complain that her skills are being wasted on a menial task — she's here to get stuff done, not tell you why she won't or can't do it. Now, if she wants to show off her prowess... she's welcome to do so by cleaning her new room. Meira looks like she's going to argue[pc.isDK | and you have to admit that you're extremely tempted to reproach her on the spot. Damn brats like her... seriously, some correction is in order! Just before the temptation gets to be too much, though, she turns her poutiness into a smile and shrug |, but the mood passes quickly — suspiciously quickly, if anything ]. "Well, if I'm going to live here..." With a quick wave of her hand, the 'nuki witch undoes the bindings holding her stuff atop the sled, then out comes a broom and dustpan. As you watch, they start cleaning up the grime and dust while a mop follows suit, followed by a bucket. "Where's the nearest well?" Meira asks with a grin. "I'm afraid I haven't gotten the enchantment on the bucket perfect just yet — last time I tried it, it simply wouldn't stop and swamped all of Mom's carpets."
rows.translation: 那座古老瞭望塔的一楼里，空气显得阴沉而闷热。 [wayfort.hasAileh |[var0 |通往艾莱住所的小路和楼梯，还有那个用于召唤仪式的小角落，都保持得非常干净。 |通往上方艾莱住宅的小路和楼梯都十分清晰可见。 ] |[var0 |召唤圈周围的那片小空地是空的。 |入口处基本上没有积灰和杂物。 ] ]瞭望塔的其余部分依然保持着原来的样子，积满了灰尘。隐私其实是一把双刃剑——看不见，就等于被忽视了。正是梅拉试图利用这些隐蔽的环境来避开公众的目光，也因此导致那些女仆们根本懒得去清理这些闲置的空荡空间；除了破旧的家具、损坏的书架、发霉的纸张和剥落的羊皮纸之外，那里几乎一片狼藉。 梅拉的表情经历了多种情绪，包括厌恶和愤怒，最终她意识到，或许自己确实有点力不从心了。有趣的是，她在上次来这里的时候竟然对那座古老的瞭望塔了解得如此之多，然而现在看到它变成了一片废墟，却显得如此惊讶。想必在她来到你家门口之前，她就应该已经知道这些了。 现在开始后悔不想和这些雇来的帮手们挤在一起住了吗？ 梅拉撅了撅嘴：“我不会有事的。” 很好。那么，她作为你的宫廷巫师的第一项任务，就是把这里弄得干净整洁，让瞭望塔的基地能够居住下去。既然她要留在这里，这对她来说是有利的；你只需要退后一步，看看她是如何处理这件事的。 “当然，我可以但是打扫卫生这种事情本来就是……” 你对此指了指。你看，如果她要成为你的宫廷法师并为你工作，那么她的职责就是为你服务。她在家乡面对[evergreen.dealtWith |母亲 |姐姐 ]时或许得到了不少宽容，但在这里可不能抱怨这种工作有失身份。当然，她可以提出不同的方法来达成你设定的目标，或者建议改进现有的工作方式，也可以提出其他替代方案。但她没有权利耍脾气，抱怨自己的能力被浪费在这样一份琐碎的任务上——她来这里是来完成工作的，而不是来告诉你为什么她不愿意或无法完成这些任务的。 现在，如果她想展示自己的能力……那就让她通过打扫自己的新房间来证明吧。 梅拉看起来像是想要反驳些什么。[pc.isDK | 你不得不承认，你真的很有冲动当场责备她。像她这样的调皮鬼……说真的，确实需要有人管教她了！不过，在这种冲动变得太过强烈之前，她突然把那副不高兴的表情变成了微笑，然后耸了耸肩。 |不过这种情绪很快就会消退——事实上，消退得快得有些反常。 ]嗯，如果我打算在这里生活的话……” 她迅速挥了挥手，那位“魔法女巫”便解开了绑在雪橇上的那些包裹，接着一把扫帚和一个簸箕出现了。你看着她们开始清理那些污垢和灰尘，随后一把拖把也加入了清理工作，最后还有一个水桶也跟了上来。 “最近的井在哪里？”梅拉笑着问道，“恐怕我还没把水桶上的魔法效果调好呢——上次我试的时候，它根本停不下来，把妈妈的所有地毯都弄湿了。
rows.raw: " The air within the old watchtower's ground floor is sullen. While [wayfort.hasAileh |[var0 |the path and stairs leading to Aileh's residence, as well as the little corner where the summoning circle, are clean |the path and stairs leading to Aileh's residence above are clear ] |[var0 |the small bit of space around the summoning circle is clear |the immediate entryway is mostly clean of dust and debris ] ], the rest of the watchtower's base has been left to lie as it is, gathering dust. Privacy is a double-edged sword — out of sight, out of mind. The very surroundings which Meira seeks to use to hide from public view have also resulted in the maids simply not bothering to clean the empty, unused space; crumbling furniture aside, smashed bookcases, moldy paper and flaking parchment form most of the mess. Meira's expression goes through several emotions, disgust and anger included, until finally settling on the realization that she might be just a little slightly in over her head. You do find it interesting that she managed to learn so much about the old watchtower on her previous visit here, yet seems so surprised at it being a dump. Presumably she'd have known that before she arrived on your doorstep. Having second thoughts about not wanting to bunk down with the hired help? Meira pouts. "I'll be fine." Good. Her first job as your court wizard, then, will be to clean up enough of this mess to make the watchtower's base livable. Since she's going to stay here, it's to her benefit; you'll just step back and watch how she handles this. "Sure, I could, but cleaning up is for m—" You hold up a finger at that. See, if she's going to be in your employ as court mage, then her job is to serve you. While she might have gotten a lot of leeway back home with her [evergreen.dealtWith |mother |sister ], she doesn't get to complain that work is beneath her. Sure, she can suggest a different method to achieve the goal you've set out, or improvements on how things are done, or suggest an alternative. What she doesn't get to do is to be a brat and complain that her skills are being wasted on a menial task — she's here to get stuff done, not tell you why she won't or can't do it. Now, if she wants to show off her prowess... she's welcome to do so by cleaning her new room. Meira looks like she's going to argue[pc.isDK | and you have to admit that you're extremely tempted to reproach her on the spot. Damn brats like her... seriously, some correction is in order! Just before the temptation gets to be too much, though, she turns her poutiness into a smile and shrug |, but the mood passes quickly — suspiciously quickly, if anything ]. "Well, if I'm going to live here..." With a quick wave of her hand, the 'nuki witch undoes the bindings holding her stuff atop the sled, then out comes a broom and dustpan. As you watch, they start cleaning up the grime and dust while a mop follows suit, followed by a bucket. "Where's the nearest well?" Meira asks with a grin. "I'm afraid I haven't gotten the enchantment on the bucket perfect just yet — last time I tried it, it simply wouldn't stop and swamped all of Mom's carpets." "

rows.original: At the end of it all, Meira's cleared out about a third of the watchtower's base, having set down her bed behind a Kitsuhon-style screen that divides that corner of her chambers from her working area. The air's still incredibly musty, and the dilapidated bookcases have been shoved aside along with their contents. "I don't want to clear them out just yet," she explains as she fetches another bucket of water for the mop. "I took a look at a couple, and while most of them are in that pale elf scribble there're some which are written in plain old Belharan. I'm not sure if they're arcane, but restoring anything of use that might be in them will keep me earning my pay if you don't have anything better for me to do in the meantime." There's no way she's going to be able to clear out everything in an hour or two, but with the help of her enchanted tools at least she isn't going to be choking on dust in her sleep. "I'll set out the rest of my stuff later,[var0 | | and get the summoning circle fixed up while I'm about it ]," Meira adds, dusting off her hands as she recalls broom and mop. "So, did I pass? I sure think I did — some of the place's cleaned up, and without me breaking a sweat to boot." Or a speck of dirt on her skin or dress, either. "I'll take that as a yes, then." Beaming, Meira plants her fists on her hips and thrusts her chest forward, all proud of herself. "See, even you can recognize how capable I am, [pc.name]. Sure, I may talk a good deal, but that's only because I'm worth it." Is she, now? Oh, you're sure that she's worth something — Meira is her mother's daughter, after all, and you wouldn't have let her come to your Wayfort if you thought she were useless. But to such a degree? Meira's smile widens into a smirk. "Of course. You know it, but if you need further demonstrations I'll be sure to astound you in the days to come. Like I said before, you won't regret taking me on, not one bit." Well. This corner of the tower has been cleaned up, if nothing else, and Meira's bed has been set out, all nice and plush. That attitude of hers... you wouldn't say it needs adjustment, because it's part of what makes Meira herself. That being said, it could use some tempering... and if you wanted to give the damned brat some correction, the tools have been laid out for the deed. All that remains, really, is for you to decide when — not if — she needs said correction. Here and now, or later...
rows.translation: 最终，梅拉清理出了瞭望塔底层约三分之一的空间，把床铺安置在一面基苏洪式屏风后；屏风将房间一角与工作区域分隔开来。空气依然霉味浓重，破败的书架连同其中内容都被推到一旁。 “我还不想清走它们。”她一边解释，一边为拖把又取来一桶水。“我翻过几本，虽然大部分都是那种苍白精灵的鬼画符，但也有些用普通的古贝尔哈兰语书写。我不确定它们是否与奥术有关，但如果你暂时没有更好的工作交给我，修复书中任何可能派上用场的内容，也足够让我对得起自己的薪水。” 她不可能在一两个小时内清理掉所有东西，但有附魔工具帮忙，至少睡觉时不至于被灰尘呛死。 “剩下的东西以后再摆出来，[var0 | |顺便把召唤法阵修好 ]。”梅拉补充道，一边拍掉手上的灰，一边召回扫帚和拖把。“那么，我通过考验了吗？我觉得自己肯定通过了——至少有些地方已经清理干净，而且我甚至没出一滴汗。” 她的皮肤和衣服上也一粒灰尘都没有。 “那我就当你回答‘是’了。”梅拉灿烂一笑，双拳抵住髋部，高高挺起胸膛，对自己无比骄傲。“你瞧，就连你也能看出我多么能干，[pc.name]。没错，我是很会夸夸其谈，但那只是因为我有这个本事。” 她果真如此吗？哦，你确信她的确有价值——毕竟梅拉是她母亲的女儿；如果觉得她一无是处，你也不会允许她来到驿堡。可真有她说的那么厉害？ 梅拉的笑容逐渐变成坏笑。“当然。你心里明白；可要是还需要更多证明，我保证会在今后的日子里让你大吃一惊。我以前说过，你绝不会后悔雇用我，一点也不会。” 好吧。至少塔楼这一角已经清理干净，梅拉的床也的确铺好了，看起来柔软又舒适。至于她那种态度……你不会说需要纠正，因为那正是梅拉之所以成为梅拉的一部分。不过，倒是可以稍微磨去一点锋芒……如果你想好好管教这个该死的小混蛋，工具都已经为此摆放妥当。 说到底，只剩下由你决定什么时候——而不是要不要——进行这场管教。现在当场动手，还是留到以后……

rows.original: The damn brat needs correction before she gets herself into trouble under your roof.
rows.translation: 这个该死的小丫头得好好管教一下，免得她在你的屋檐下惹出麻烦。
rows.raw: "The damn brat needs correction before she gets herself into trouble under your roof."

rows.original: It's better for her to save up her brattiness so you can really give it to her later.
rows.translation: 她最好先攒着这股任性劲儿，这样你回头才能好好收拾她。
rows.raw: "It's better for her to save up her brattiness so you can really give it to her later."

rows.original: Better to nip the problem in the bud — Meira needs to know what's what before she gets herself into trouble. You may not be her mother, but that doesn't mean she has free rein to get into all kinds of mischief under your roof. No sooner have you taken a step towards your new court mage that her eyebrows shoot up and her smirk widens. Slowly, she spreads her hands, palms turned upward, and feigns innocence; it is, of course, utterly unconvincing. Yes, Meira knew this was coming all along and in all likelihood provoked you into this without you even knowing it... "You beast," she half moans, half-sighs. "Not a day under your roof, and you're already seeking to —" Assert your proper authority over her? Get her in line before she upsets the running of the Wayfort? "That's just a pretext... and terribly flimsy one at that." Like deserves like; it's every bit as flimsy as her pretensions to innocence and offense. "Mmmh." Turning her ears down, Meira sashays towards you and wraps her fuzzy 'nuki tail about your leg. "First day on the new job, and a poor girl's already being ordered to do the heavy lifting? You, [pc.mf |sir |ma'am ], have absolutely no mercy. But maybe that's how these things should go if you're seeking to put me in my place, yes?" All right, that's enough out of her. You grab Meira by her shoulders, feeling the grip her tail has on you tighten in tandem; she squeals in mock shock and does the whole fainting fit schtick. No, you're not having any of that, and push her down right into the fluffy confines of her bed. No sooner has Meira hit the sheets that her demeanor melts away and her smugness returns to the fore, pulling you right down into the sheets atop her with her tail. "I take it this is where you adjust my attitude, hmm?" she whispers. "I suppose if you fuck my brains out thoroughly enough, you might even succeed for a little while." Feisty, isn't she? This isn't the first time you've fucked her, after all; you have an idea of what to expect. "Sure, sure." Meira raises a finger to her lips, framing her smile. "But it's the first time when I don't have to care what Mom or Senja think. Go on, then, do your worst. How am I supposed to respect your authority if you won't even make an adequate show of strength?" She's trying to wind you up, you know that full well. You're doing exactly what she wants you to, but maybe the biggest difference between you and Meira in the here and now is that you're not going to defy her out of sheer contrariness, especially not when this is to your benefit. Meira squeals as you shove her into the mattress — her ruffled state contrasts perfectly with the finery of her gown, inviting you to despoil her further. You don't even bother to remove her clothes — [pc.bg noblescion |well, you could, given that you're familiar enough with such finery after your time at court. Meira gown takes after stereotypical Belharan fashion, and you're pretty sure the tricks used to slip in and out of such garments with a minimum of fuss despite their complexity will work on these. But to be perfectly honest, you don't really want to go to even that much trouble. Delivering Meira's welcome fuck unto her while she's still clothed, not even bothering with that much pretense... well, there's an appeal to it, you have to admit. Drive it into her bratty head that she's the kind who isn't worth a proper undressing and all. |her brattiness demands to be corrected now, and fumbling with her courtly getup would just make her even more smug at your trouble. Besides, how are you going to despoil such finery if it's off her? No, if Meira's going to be putting on airs as she comes to live under your roof, then it's up to you to teach a brat that she's got to earn her place in this wayfort instead of expecting to be handed it for free. ] With that thought in mind, you grab at Meira's neckline and yank hard — the jewelled brooch pops off with ease, clattering away onto one of the freshly-laid rugs. Too much ease, one wonders, especially as her top flows with ease off her shoulders, all the fabric bunching up at her waist. Knowing Meira, no doubt even her best finery's been designed with this much in mind... all doubt is dispelled when you pull up the skirts of her gown to find that she's wearing no panties at all. She was really hoping for something like this to happen, wasn't she? Meira raises a hand to her cheek as she sinks further into the sheets, affecting innocence while she holds her gaze. "Why, whatever do you mean, [pc.name]? With a heavy gown like this, you'd have to check to tell the difference to begin with... are you saying that I'd go so far as to bait you into going this far?" That's exactly what you're saying! "Oh well." Meira smiles and rolls her eyes. "Guess you got me there, hehe. So, what are you going to do about it? Are you going to get undressed, or do you want more foreplay?" You're getting to it, you're getting to it. Meira's content to lie back and undress you with her eyes while you go about it for real. No sooner has your [pc.armor] fallen by the side of the plush bed that the naughty 'nuki gestures for you to come hither with both hands, a palpable aura of smug oozing from her pores. "I suppose some orientation would help if I'm going to be living under your roof," she sighs. "So why don't you do something about that, boss?"

所以，她并不是在和那些有权势的人打交道，而是在和一些有趣的人交往。这一点还是可以理解的。 “嗯，算了吧你是那个总是在那些马奇地区的重要人物背后捣乱的人……所以，我并不打算干扰你正在做的这些好事。但是，还有很多普通民众对你抱有期望[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]属于韦弗特家族的人，然而你却无法应对他们。所有人就我个人而言，我会尽力提供帮助。虽然算不上真正的管理者，但应该也算接近这个角色了吧。 |她会想家吗？ “想家？我现在就在家里，所以这根本不是一个真正的问题。” 拜托，她其实很清楚你的意思——你指的是常青女士庄园吧。 梅拉轻笑道：“嗯，好吧……其实并不想家，也不是因为那个老地方离河岸只有一步之遥。 [evergreen.dealtWith |那栋老房子……嗯，就连去参观都会让人感到疲惫。我非常乐意让森娅去收拾那堆烂摊子，而我可以住在这样一个地方，在这里，我甚至有幸能够聆听自己的思绪。 |我一直都知道，总有一天我必须以某种方式离开这座宅邸，因此我一直在为那一刻做准备。更何况，就算我请求妈妈，她也不会允许我回来，所以何必浪费时间去考虑那些根本不可能实现的事情呢？ ]所以，绝对不要错过这个机会，真的非常棒。说实话，对森娅来说，她来我这里拜访我，反而比我去她那里要好得多；那座豪宅根本不适合像她这样的好女孩待在那里。[evergreen.dealtWith |即使她现在已经是它的主人了…… ]嗯，还好梅拉对来到这里生活持积极的态度。只要她继续做好自己该做的事，不惹麻烦就好了。太你一定会不遗余力地确保她不会为自己的决定后悔。 |有时候，我还是会想起自己曾经多么想成为一名厨师呢，哈哈。想用转化术把那些普通的厨房废弃物变成美味佳肴。虽然现在我还是会偶尔向露米讨要一些剩菜剩饭来尝试制作，但我已经接受了这个事实：这终究只是一种爱好而已。如今，我对于让她来为我准备饭菜已经非常满足了；事实上，这样的伙食甚至比我在宅子里时吃到的还要好。虽然不一定更美味，但确实更加…… 真实的嗯，实在找不到更好的词来形容了。” “你——” 梅拉举起一根手指：“我知道你接下来要说什么，但不，你完全没有必要为此感到抱歉。在荒废驿堡这里遇到了那么多其他人之后，我相当确定，那样的关系根本不可能持续下去。这种过着悠闲的生活，喝着药酒，闲聊几句，也挺不错的。在这附近，你可找不到像我这样穿着时髦的女士了，对吧？” 说实话，你们俩确实都进步了很多。你还记得当时梅拉忙得不可开交，到处与人争执，为的其实是……嗯…… “回想起来那个很明显，妈妈让我做这件事只是为了不让我出门。而现在，我终于能够做一些真正有意义的事情了。工作我在这里喜欢的这个东西，比那个要好得多。事实上，我知道该在取得优势时及时停止，而不是一味地坚持下去，甚至不惜“祈求神明”的帮助。 ]
rows.raw: " [rand |"It's... fine. The place is a little old, but I remember it from when I was younger and you've spruced it up a lot ever since. There's a difference between being run-down and having history, and you should congratulate yourself on having made that difference." And this place? Is she comfortable? No leaky walls, crumbling mortar, pests or that kind of thing? "There were a few problems, but nothing I couldn't handle. I used a little of the money I brought along to hire some folks from Hawkethorne Senja knows. They filled in the cracks nicely enough." She had money? After going through Hawkethorne and getting all the stuff she needed the day she arrived, that is. "[evergreen.dealtWith |You would not believe the sheer amount of money Mom had hidden in all kinds of places — it makes sense now given that she's been milking people for the gods know how long, but even so. It's several fortunes over, honestly; Senja won't be missing what I needed to get on my own feet. |Mom quite literally paid me to get her out her door. She said I could call it an advance on my dowry to whoever I ended up clinging on to, so long as I didn't come back crawling to her for more. She was rather harsh in that last exchange... but I guess she had to be to make her words stick. ] "Anyway! You don't need to worry about me, I'm capable of making my own living arrangements. Really. If there's something I do need, the only way you'll ever be hearing about it is if neither I nor any of your people can do anything, so there's that." |"I've settled into a routine that works for me," Meira explains. "Get dressed and open for consultation in the morning, let that stretch all the way till mid-afternoon. Then it's me time: either get to my own pursuits, wander down to Farrah's, or anything else I fancy. If I'm feeling lazy that day, I can simply take off and go see Senja, or wander down to the village. Rumie bringing my meals, and coming to clear up the dishes when I'm done. No one around to tell me what to do or when to do it, so long as I come out in the black at the end of it all. "I don't know what other people think of your wayfort, [pc.name], but I've got to thank you for giving me a place where I can at least hear myself think without one of my many sisters constantly trying to get my attention. It wasn't until Mom finally ended my spate of busywork that I realized how much I missed the sound of silence, and now I have it again." She's more than welcome. So long as no one has any cause for complaint, you're more than happy to let Meira just do her own thing. "Cause for complaint? There's always one if you look hard enough. But if no one looks, well..." Meira gives you an impish smile. "Don't mind me, just thinking aloud. I like it here enough to not consciously jeopardize my chances of staying on in your wayfort, don't worry." |You've been wondering... "Yes?" She's your court mage. There's the %"court" part of her job, which boils down to schmoozing, and the %"mage" part, which is basically providing magical services. But you have to ask: who exactly does she schmooze with, anyway? Both Khor'minos and Njoorhalt are a little removed from this spot spanning the River Ridell — even Hawkethorne is reasonably distant on foot. This is supposed to be the edge of civilization, do many dignitaries pass through? You sure haven't noticed any that you didn't at least have a hand in summoning yourself. "Oh. Well, they usually come one of two ways: either as part of a consultation, or [wayfort.hasFarrah |Farrah |Rumie ] directs me to people she wants me to learn more about. I'm making something of a name for myself separate from the Evergreen line, you see, and with [wayfort.hasFarrah |Farrah |Rumie ] keeping an eye on the comings and going of people there's no shortage of opportunities to at least get to know some of them who might come in useful later on. "Let's face it, [pc.name]: I think you should know full well by now that you need to know people in order to make this wayfort even bigger and better. Not necessarily nobs and their kind, but people of the kind who can come and fix up old masonry in days if need be. You're right in that the nearest dignitaries are a good way aways... but we're not looking for them. We're looking for interesting people, and anyone all this way out here in these times has some kind of story to tell." So, she's not exactly schmoozing with established powers, but more with interesting people. You can get behind that. "Nah, you're the one getting up in the drawers of every established bigwig in the Marches, so I'm not about to muscle in on the good job you're doing. But there're a lot of smaller folk who have expectations of you as the [pc.mf |lord |lady ] of the Wayfort, and yet you can't deal with everyone on a personal basis. I try to help out with that. Not exactly a steward, but close enough I guess." |Does she get homesick? "Homesick? I'm home right now, so that isn't a real question." Come now. She knows exactly what you mean — for the Evergreens' mansion. Meira giggles. "Yeah, ok. No, not really, and it's not because the old haunt is just a stone's throw away from the riverbank. [evergreen.dealtWith |The old house is... well, even the visits are tiresome. I'm more than happy to let Senja sort out that mess while I live here in a place where I have the privilege of hearing myself think. |I've always known that I'd have to leave the mansion someday, somehow, so I've been steeling myself for that moment. That and Mom would never let me return even if I asked, so why waste time on considering impossibilities? ] So nope, don't miss it one bit, and it's great. To be perfectly honest, it does more good for Senja to come visit me here than the other way around; that mansion is no place for a nice girl like her[evergreen.dealtWith |, even if she's its mistress now ]." Well, it's good that Meira's taken a positive outlook to coming to live here. So long as she continues to do her thing and not cause too much trouble, you'll endeavor to ensure that she doesn't regret her decision. |"Sometimes, I still think of how I wanted to be a cook of sorts, haha. Using transmutation to achieve results with kitchen refuse that normal methods can't. Even though I still ask Rumie for her scraps to mess around with every now and then, I've come to accept that it'll never be really more than a hobby. These days I'm more than content to let her serve me my meals; if anything, it's better than what I used to have back at the mansion. Not necessarily more delicious, but more... real, for lack of a better word to put it." You — Meira holds up a finger. "I know what you're going to say, and no, you don't have to be sorry for it. After experiencing a bunch more people out here in the Wayfort, I'm pretty sure it wouldn't have worked out. This kind of life dispensing tinctures and making idle chatter isn't so bad, either. You don't find many ladies as sharply dressed as I am out here in this neck of the woods, eh?" To be completely honest, the both of you have come a long way. You still remember when Meira was running around doing busywork tussling with people for their... well... "Looking back on that, it was so plain Mom had me do it just to keep me out of the house. Being able to actually do useful work that I like here beats that by a mile. As things are, I know when to quit while I'm ahead and not push it asking the gods for more." ] "

rows.original: [wayfort.hasDaliza |"Well, one of the first things I did was to go to your bailiff and see if there were any actual duties and expectations. I figured if anyone would know, it'd be her given that she runs things while you're gone." And did Daliza have anything to say about that? "Nothing more than for me to not cause trouble and make myself useful. I honestly don't know what I expected, but it was certainly more than this." Well, the court of Njoorhalt was in a pretty miserable state by the time you got there, and you don't know if the pale elves had a mage living in-house. Elthara's capable of magic, but you doubt that her duties were anywhere similar even more the whole Alissa thing. So, so be sure, Daliza's given her a pretty free hand? |[wayfort.hasFarrah |"Well, one of the first things I did was to go to that cat shopkeeper of yours and check if there were any actual duties and expectations that I'd have to fill. I figured that if anyone would know, it'd be her." Farrah? "Well, that's right. Shrewd lady, nose for business, has a bead on the pulse of this wayfort. Everything's still pretty loose, but if anyone would know anything about responsibilities, it'd be her." And what did Farrah say? In hindsight, it does make sense that she'd have an unofficial hand in running the place, but for Meira to go to her for guidance... "Anything wrong with that?" Nothing. Anyways, your question? "Nope. People do what they like in this wayfort, there's no one keeping everyone else in line. Which is kinda funny, but also makes a lot of sense. Things are very free here; Farrah said that so long as I made myself profitable and stayed out of trouble, no one would care what I did." Sounds like something that Farrah would say, true. So, she's been given leave to find herself work, then. |"Well, one of the first things I did once you left was to head down to Rumie and see what she had to say on the matter, if there were any expectations I'd have to live up to that I wasn't going to make up myself from common sense." Rumie, huh? "Yeah. She keeps things together here while you're gone, in her own milksop way. It's pretty amazing how she manages it, but it works." That makes sense. For how subby bee-girls are supposed to be, Rumie did show a decent amount of initiative in setting up shop in the Wayfort all on her own. Anyway, what did she say? "That so long as I made myself useful and stayed out of trouble, no one would care what else I did. Which is why I like it here — there's a pretty free hand to do what I want, on my own time, and if I foul up it's going to be me eating the consequences." That does sound like something Rumie would say; she's already got enough on her own plate without having to micromanage a handful like Meira. So, she's on her own to find trouble, isn't she? ] ] "Yup." Playing at being hedge-witch, then? Like her mother, only scaled down? "Well, I don't ask for kids as payment, for one. Next, people feel a lot more comfortable coming to me than a spooky manor in the middle of the woods. There's something about being, um..." Meira searches for the word. "Sanctioned? Endorsed? Well, being officially a court mage and everything that eases the mind when people come up to me. I'm also a lot friendlier and classier than [evergreen.dealtWith |Senja is. Like, she was playing at being shopkeep for so long, with how much success again? With how busy she is tying up all the loose ends Mom's left behind and dealing with my remaining sisters, I think it's better for her nerves that I take care of the clientele while she finds her feet. |Mom is. She tends to intimidate, you know, and it's very deliberate. Me, I like people in a much friendlier way — I was already dealing with the riff-raff while Mom handled the serious cases, so it's not as if I'm stealing her business. ] "So... yeah. Minor ailments, rearranging faces here and there, small enchantments, generally things that keep both the locals and people passing through in good working order. And of course, I get to mess with folks whenever I get bored. Don't worry, it's just a little harmless fun." Sure it is. "When I have expenses, I have Farrah charge them to your treasury, what I do earn over costs and living expenses goes right back in there too, naturally. And of course, I'll do any of my services for you for free. Consider it my rent." It looks like she's got things all worked out, which is a bit of a surprise. Given Meira's perpetual youthful air, you were half-expecting her to flop around waiting to be told what to do. "Eeeeh. I still remember the days of Mom setting me busywork to do, roaming the fores challenging people for cock and balls. Girl's got a lot of time to think while out in the woods... anyway, isn't that just about how your Wayfort works? It's not like you're sitting on your throne all day shuffling papers, holding court and telling people what to do. Whether you admit it or not, you've been blessed with a bunch of minions who don't need you breathing down their necks all the time to keep things running, so just enjoy it, okay? It's like the best gift any bigwig like you can get."
rows.translation: [wayfort.hasDaliza |嗯，我做的第一件事就是去找你的管家，想了解一下到底有哪些实际职责和期望。我觉得，既然在你不在的时候是她在负责所有事务，那么她肯定最清楚这些情况。 那么，达莉莎对此有什么要说的吗？ “我只是想不要惹麻烦，尽自己的一份力而已。说实话，我本来也不清楚自己期望得到什么，但结果肯定没有这样。 当你到达那里时，恩乔尔哈尔特法庭已经处于相当糟糕的状态了，而且你也不知道那些苍白精灵是否在那里雇用了法师。艾尔萨拉确实会使用魔法，但你觉得她的职责与那些法师的职责根本没有任何相似之处，尤其是考虑到艾莉莎的事情之后。所以，可以肯定的是，达莉莎给了她相当大的自由度来处理这件事吧？ |[wayfort.hasFarrah |嗯，我做的第一件事就是去找你们那位猫店老板，问问是否有什么具体的职责或要求需要我履行。我觉得，如果有人会知道这些信息，那肯定就是她。 法拉？ “没错，就是她。那个精明的女士，对各种事情了如指掌，对这个行业的动态了如胸中。虽然现在一切都还比较混乱，但要是有人了解各种职责分工的话，那肯定就是她。那么，法拉是怎么说的呢？事后想来，她非正式地参与管理这件事也确实合情合理，但梅拉竟然去找她寻求建议…… “这有什么不妥吗？没什么。总之，你有什么问题吗？ “没有。在这个圈子里，人们都是做自己喜欢的事情，没有人会强迫别人遵守规矩。这有点有趣，但同时也很有道理。这里的环境非常自由；法拉说过，只要我能让自己盈利并且不惹上麻烦，没人会在意我做什么。 听起来确实是法拉会说的台词，没错。那么，她应该是被允许自己去找工作了。 |嗯，你离开后，我做的第一件事就是去找露米，想听听她对此事有什么看法。如果有什么我必须满足的要求，那我总不能凭自己的主观判断来决定吧，毕竟我需要了解实际情况。雷米，是吧？ “对。你不在的时候，她总是以自己那笨拙的方式把这里打理得井井有条。她居然能做到这一点，真是不可思议，但确实有效。” 想起来也有道理。按照那些“低调内敛”的蜜蜂女孩应有的性格，露米独自在荒废驿堡开店，确实表现出了相当大的主动性。不过，她当时是怎么说的来着？ “只要我能发挥作用，不惹麻烦，别人就不会在意我还会做些什么。这就是为什么我喜欢这里——我可以完全按照自己的意愿，在自己的时间里做我想做的事情，如果搞砸了，后果也只能由我自己承担。 这话听起来确实像是露米会说的；她自己的事情已经够多了，根本没必要去管像梅拉这样的几个人。所以，她是自找麻烦的，对吧？ ] ] 嗯。” 那么，她现在是在扮演女巫的角色吧？就像她的母亲一样，只不过规模小了一些而已？ “嗯，首先，我并不会要求人们用孩子作为报酬。其次，比起那些位于森林深处的阴森庄园，人们来找我时会觉得更加安心。毕竟，我……”梅拉努力寻找合适的词语来表达。“算是得到了官方的认可吧？或者说，我是一名正式的宫廷法师，这个身份让人们在来找我时会感到安心。而且，我也是一个很多比……更友好、更高雅[evergreen.dealtWith |森娅啊，她已经扮演店主这个角色这么久了，而且做得还相当成功呢。现在她忙着处理妈妈留下的各种琐事，还要照顾我的其他姐妹们，我觉得由我来接待顾客，让她有更多时间来适应这个新角色，反而会对她的神经有好处。 |妈妈就是这样的。她总是喜欢用威慑的方式与人打交道，而且这种做法很刻意。而我，更喜欢以一种友好、亲切的方式与人相处。当初我是负责处理那些普通案件，而妈妈则负责处理那些严重的案件，所以我的工作并不会抢她的生意。 ] 所以……嗯，就是一些小毛病，比如调整一下人们的容貌，施加一些小魔法，总之就是一些能让当地人和路过的人都能正常生活的琐事。当然，只要我感到无聊，就可以随便找人玩玩闹闹了。别担心，这只是些无伤大雅的娱乐而已。” “当然是啦。” “当我需要花钱的时候，我会让法拉从你的财政账户中支取这些钱；而我的收入在扣除开销和生活费用之后，也会自然而然地重新存回那里。当然，我愿意免费为你提供任何帮助。就当这是我的“租金”吧。 看来她把一切都安排得井井有条，这确实有点出乎我的意料。考虑到梅拉永远保持着年轻的样子，你本来还以为她会手足无措，等着别人来告诉她该做什么呢。 哎呀，我还记得妈妈以前总让我做些琐事，然后我就跑到外面去，挑战那些家伙……在森林里的时候，女孩确实有很多时间可以用来思考……不过，你们的荒废驿堡不也是这么运作的吗？又不是说你整天坐在王座上整理文件、发号施令、告诉别人该做什么。不管你承认不承认，你其实有一群下属，他们完全不需要你时刻监督他们，事情照样能够顺利进行。所以，就好好享受这份待遇吧，好吗？这简直就是像你这样的高层人士能够收到的最珍贵的礼物了。

For how subby bee-girls are supposed to be, Rumie did show a decent amount of initiative in setting up shop in the Wayfort all on her own. Anyway, what did she say? "That so long as I made myself useful and stayed out of trouble, no one would care what else I did. Which is why I like it here — there's a pretty free hand to do what I want, on my own time, and if I foul up it's going to be me eating the consequences." That does sound like something Rumie would say; she's already got enough on her own plate without having to micromanage a handful like Meira. So, she's on her own to find trouble, isn't she? ] ] "Yup." Playing at being hedge-witch, then? Like her mother, only scaled down? "Well, I don't ask for kids as payment, for one. Next, people feel a lot more comfortable coming to me than a spooky manor in the middle of the woods. There's something about being, um..." Meira searches for the word. "Sanctioned? Endorsed? Well, being officially a court mage and everything that eases the mind when people come up to me. I'm also a lot friendlier and classier than [evergreen.dealtWith |Senja is. Like, she was playing at being shopkeep for so long, with how much success again? With how busy she is tying up all the loose ends Mom's left behind and dealing with my remaining sisters, I think it's better for her nerves that I take care of the clientele while she finds her feet. |Mom is. She tends to intimidate, you know, and it's very deliberate. Me, I like people in a much friendlier way — I was already dealing with the riff-raff while Mom handled the serious cases, so it's not as if I'm stealing her business. ] "So... yeah. Minor ailments, rearranging faces here and there, small enchantments, generally things that keep both the locals and people passing through in good working order. And of course, I get to mess with folks whenever I get bored. Don't worry, it's just a little harmless fun." Sure it is. "When I have expenses, I have Farrah charge them to your treasury, what I do earn over costs and living expenses goes right back in there too, naturally. And of course, I'll do any of my services for you for free. Consider it my rent." It looks like she's got things all worked out, which is a bit of a surprise. Given Meira's perpetual youthful air, you were half-expecting her to flop around waiting to be told what to do. "Eeeeh. I still remember the days of Mom setting me busywork to do, roaming the fores challenging people for cock and balls. Girl's got a lot of time to think while out in the woods... anyway, isn't that just about how your Wayfort works? It's not like you're sitting on your throne all day shuffling papers, holding court and telling people what to do. Whether you admit it or not, you've been blessed with a bunch of minions who don't need you breathing down their necks all the time to keep things running, so just enjoy it, okay? It's like the best gift any bigwig like you can get." "

rows.original: "Oh, my neighbor?" She doesn't seem very excited about the prospect of discussing Aileh — is there something between the girls that you ought to know and nip in the bud before it turns into a catfight? "What? No! Now where would you be getting that idea?" Meira huffs. "We just keep to ourselves well enough, despite her living just above me. Good fences make for good neighbors and all, you know — I'm so glad that this watchtower has these big old thick walls. Back home, I'd be hearing my sisters getting up to no good all the time, keeping me awake at night. Now? Whatever dragon lady gets up to in her roost, I can't hear a peep, and no doubt the same applies to me and my shenanigans when it comes to her. This is a nice state of affairs, and I'd prefer to keep it that way." Yes, but... well, Meira's a socialite. Aileh's a dragon. You'd have expected her to show more interest in the dragon living above her. "Living above her, that's the important part. Like... I see dragon lady just about every day, give her a nod and smile, and move on. You get used to it, you know? It's like how I grew up thinking everyone lived like Mom did.[evergreen.dealtWith | Even with Senja running the show, nothing much has changed in that regard, all the old decorations are still up because she's just so used to them. ] "Keeping it nice and cordial, that's the thing. Besides, she doesn't strike me as the kind of lady who's into small talk or social games, so this is fine."
rows.translation: “哦，我的邻居？” 她似乎对谈论艾莱赫这件事并不太起劲——这两个女孩之间是不是有什么你该知道、并趁它演变成一场撕斗之前掐灭在萌芽里的事？ “什么？不会吧！你从哪儿得来那种想法的？”梅拉哼了一声。“尽管她就住在我楼上，我们俩倒也相安无事。俗话说得好，好篱笆造就好邻居——我太庆幸这座瞭望塔有这么厚实的老墙了。要是在老家，我总会听见姐妹们胡搞瞎闹，吵得我夜里睡不着。现在呢？不管那位龙女士在她的巢里搞什么名堂，我都听不见一点动静；同样地，我的那些胡闹对她来说大概也一样。这样的状况挺好，我希望能一直保持下去。” 是的，可是……嗯，梅拉是个交际花。艾莱赫是条龙。你本以为她会对自己楼上住着的那条龙表现出更多兴趣。 “住在楼上，这才是重点。就像……我几乎每天都见到那位龙女士，朝她点头微笑，然后就走开。你会习惯的，你懂的？就像我从小以为所有人都像妈妈那样过日子。[evergreen.dealtWith | 就算现在是森娅在管事，这方面也没多大变化，那些旧装饰还都挂着，因为她实在太习惯它们了。 ] “保持友善客气，这才是关键。再说，她给我的感觉也不是那种喜欢闲聊或社交把戏的女士，所以这样挺好。”

Besides, she doesn't strike me as the kind of lady who's into small talk or social games, so this is fine." "

rows.original: "Lady drives a hard deal, but she can source things that I can't even with the connections that Mom ha[evergreen.dealtWith |d |s ]. I don't know about her methods, but she gets the job done, and none of her deliveries are ever late even if they cost." Does that ever matter to her, though? It's not like she pays for anything out of her own pocket. As far as you understand it, all of Meira's expenses are directly drawn from your vault. Anything she makes also goes straight to your vault... but to be frank about it, a lot of what your court mage does isn't measured in coin. Meira pouts. "H-hey, what's that supposed to mean? Just because I'm not paying for it myself doesn't mean I can go ham on buying all kinds of stuff, wouldn't you agree?" You would, but it's because you're the one paying for it. "Well! Anyway, we're talking about Farrah now, not me, so! I've got to watch myself when in her little emporium — just can't shake off the feeling that she's trying to take me for everything I, or rather, you have." Heh, more than she knows. Well, she doesn't need to worry about her person when in Farrah's, only her purse. And if she finds your local merchant being a little too pushy or egregious... well, she can tell you.
rows.translation: “这位女士做生意很硬气，但她能弄到一些连妈妈的人脉都[evergreen.dealtWith |d |s ]弄不到的东西。我不清楚她用的什么手段，但她总能把事办成，而且她的货从来不迟到，哪怕代价不低。” 不过，代价对她来说真的重要吗？毕竟她花的又不是自己的钱。据你所知，梅拉的所有开销都直接从你的金库支取。她赚来的东西也直接进你的金库……但说实话，你的宫廷法师做的很多事，并不是用金币能衡量的。 梅拉撅起嘴。“嘿——这话是什么意思？就因为不是我自己掏钱，我就不能随便买各种各样的东西了吗？你不同意吗？” 你会同意，但那是因为掏钱的是你。 “好吧！总之，我们现在说的是法拉，不是我，所以！在她那小店里我得管好自己——总觉得她想把我，或者说，把你有的东西全都榨走。” 嘿，比她以为的还要多。不过她在法拉店里不必担心自己的人身安全，只需要担心钱包。而如果她发现你这位本地商人有点太咄咄逼人或者太出格……嗯，她可以告诉你。

rows.original: "Sweet girl, that one." Meira giggles. "And not just because she's a bee and all. Even I feel a little bad and wonder if I'm not taking advantage of Rumie when I ask for meals and drinks to be brought up to my chambers, but it's so convenient when I'm tending to people. I'd love to cook for myself, still do it as often as I can, but with things as they are doing so every day just isn't an option." Oh? She's not one for heading down to the bar, then? Meira gives you a wink. "When was the last time you saw a court mage heading down to the local watering hole? I've got to stay in character, remember? Can't have my mystique dashed to pieces boozing it up in public — it'd reflect poorly on you, wouldn't it?" The way she couches a privilege for herself as looking out for you... Meira truly is something else. "But yes, I do enjoy dear Rumie. In a way, she reminds me of some of my sisters — so bright-eyed and eager to please that it melts your heart. Good worker, has always produced anything I ask of her without complaint, and in return I ask as little of her as I can." Interesting that Meira considers that repayment for Rumie's kindness. "Well, it is within the purview of her job, is it not? I am lightening her load, am I not?" You sigh and shake your head. "Well, if you're concerned about Rumie's well-being, why don't you hire her more help than she already has? The bar's always doing good business with all the people coming through the Wayfort, after all."
rows.translation: “她真是个甜美的姑娘。”梅拉咯咯笑道。“而且不只是因为她是只蜜蜂。有时我让露米把饭菜和饮料送到房间里，就连自己都会有些过意不去，担心这算不算占她便宜；可我照料别人时，这样实在太方便了。我很愿意亲自做饭，也依然尽可能常做，可按现在的情况，每天自己下厨根本不现实。” 哦？所以，她不会亲自下楼去酒吧？ 梅拉朝你眨眨眼。“你上次看见宫廷法师亲自跑去当地酒馆是什么时候？我得保持形象，记得吗？可不能公然酗酒，把我的神秘感砸得粉碎——那也会让你脸上无光，对吧？” 她把为自己争取特权说成是在替你着想……梅拉的确非同一般。 “不过没错，我很喜欢亲爱的露米。在某些方面，她让我想起自己的几位姐妹——那双明亮的眼睛和讨人欢心的热切劲儿，简直能把你的心都融化。她工作勤快，每次都毫无怨言地拿来我想要的一切；作为回报，我也尽量少麻烦她。” 有意思，梅拉竟将这视为报答露米的善意。 “好吧，那本来就在她的工作范围之内，不是吗？我是在减轻她的负担，对吧？” 你叹了口气，摇摇头。 “嗯，如果你担心露米过得好不好，为什么不在现有帮手之外再为她雇些人呢？毕竟，随着这么多人经过驿堡，酒吧的生意一直很好。”

rows.original:
"Her caravan's the kind of thing that would have a place of honor in the mansion's displays," Meira muses. "No doubt if Mom knew about it, she'd [evergreen.dealtWith
        |have stopped at little to get it for herself... it might be a plan spanning years, but she'd have a good chance of getting what she wanted. Good thing that Senja's now in charge, huh?
        |want it for herself, if just to say she had it."
        
        With how Gianna's caravan has been wandering all over the Marches, you're pretty certain that the elder Evergreen knows of its existence.
        
        "Oh, Mom's the kind to get what she wants. Maybe it'll take years, maybe decades. But once she's got her heart set on something, she'll either get it or die trying. Which is why hopefully she has other things on her mind; I quite like Gianna."
    ]
    
    Is the caravan that much of a prize?
    
    "While there's some similarity to several of the pieces on display in the mansion, it's still pretty unique. I'm not sure if it dates back to old imperial Belhar, or from some other world altogether.
    
    "But come now. We're talking about Gianna, not her caravan — one's just as fascinating as the other. She certainly has a touch of youthful vigor which I can relate to; doing business with her is always a pleasure, and said business is brisk, too. While I don't care much for the purple cat that she has in tow, the junkrat's another matter despite his appearance. It's always a pleasure to meet someone as passionate about his field as you are. I don't understand half of what he's saying, but that's perfectly fine as he's more than content to listen to my natter on about my work, too."
    
    Gianna provides several valuable services both for you and the rest of the Wayfort; you're glad that she's decided to make this place a regular stop on her travels. It's also a good thing that Meira's decided to get on their good side.
    
    "Now, whoever said that I would be up to such mischief? I'm just a girl making small talk, that's all. Certainly not buttering up anyone for the sake of my [pc.mf
        |lord
        |lady
    ]; it's not as if [pc.heShe] needs such a thing with a longtime friend of [pc.hisHers], after all."
rows.translation:
“她的商队完全有资格在宅邸陈列品中占据显赫位置。”梅拉沉思道。“妈妈若是知道，肯定会[evergreen.dealtWith
        |不择手段地把它弄到手……这项计划也许会延续多年，但她很有可能得到想要的东西。幸好现在由森娅当家，对吧？
        |想把它据为己有，哪怕只是为了宣称自己拥有它。”
        
        吉安娜的商队一直在边境地区四处游荡，你很确定老常青女士知道它的存在。
        
        “哦，妈妈就是那种想要什么便一定会拿到的人。也许要花几年，也许要花几十年。可她一旦认定某样东西，不是将其弄到手，就是在尝试中送命。所以，希望她现在正忙着考虑别的事情；我很喜欢吉安娜。”
    ]
    
    那支商队真是如此珍贵的收藏品？
    
    “虽然它和宅邸里陈列的几件藏品有些相似，但依然相当独特。我不知道它是从古贝尔哈帝国流传下来，还是完全来自另一个世界。
    
    “不过，还是说回来吧。我们谈的是吉安娜，不是她的商队——两者其实同样迷人。她身上无疑带着一股年轻人的活力，我对此很有共鸣；和她做生意总是件乐事，而且生意也相当红火。我不太喜欢她带在身边的紫猫，但那只垃圾鼠虽然外表不怎么样，却另当别论。遇见一个像你一样热爱自身领域的人总是很愉快。她说的话有一半我都听不懂，不过完全没关系，因为她也很乐意听我滔滔不绝地谈论自己的工作。”
    
    吉安娜为你和驿堡的其他人提供了几项宝贵服务；你很高兴她决定把这里当成旅途中的固定一站。梅拉决定和他们搞好关系，也是一件好事。
    
    “现在，是谁说我会使这种坏心眼？我只是个和人闲聊的姑娘，仅此而已。当然不是为了我的[pc.mf
        |领主
        |女领主
    ]而刻意讨好任何人；毕竟，[pc.heShe]面对[pc.hisHers]的多年老友，根本不需要这样做。”

rows.original:
"Oh, I totally enjoy her company. She's the perfect straight man — or straight woman, if you will — to play jokes off of. I know there's a certain kind of boreal elf who is as icy as her body, a complete stick in the mud... those kinds are the best to tease.
    
    "Oh, don't worry, I never do anything serious, and she never seems to catch on, anyway. It's all in good fun."
    
    Would... would she mind telling you some of the shenanigans she's gotten up to?
    
    Meira raises a finger to her lips. "Ah, well! That would be telling, wouldn't it? Besides, you might go ahead and tell her, and that would ruin the surprise."
    
    You shake your head. Really now — if Daliza's such a stick in the mud that she never realizes she's been pranked to begin with, doesn't that make it pointless? Half the fun is in the victim realizing he or she's been pranked, after all.
    
    "Maybe she doesn't herself," Meira admits. "But those around her do, and that's enough for me."
    
    Look, you can't stop Meira from making mischief as much as you can stop fish from swimming or birds from flying; you knew as much when you let her stay under your roof. The only thing that you can ask of her in this regard is not to overdo it; dry as she may be, you need Daliza able to serve as your bailiff. Besides, without Daliza, there's no guarantee that her replacement, if any, from the Winter City would be as good a victim.
    
    "You have a point. But as I said, I'm keeping myself in check, no nothing needs to change from what I'm doing. Don't worry about your dear bailiff, oh [pc.mf
        |lord
        |lady
    ] of the Wayfort — like you said, she's too precious to let go."
rows.translation:
哦，我真的很喜欢和她在一起。她就是那种完美的‘直男’或‘直女’，可以一起开玩笑、互相调侃。我知道，有一种北境精灵，他们的性格就像他们的身体一样冰冷，完全固执己见……这类人最适合被捉弄了。
    
    哦，别担心，我从来不会做出什么严肃的事情，而且她似乎也从来没察觉到什么。这一切都只是为了好玩而已。”
    
    那么……她会不会介意告诉你一些她做过的一些淘气事呢？
    
    梅拉把手指放在嘴唇上：“啊，这个嘛……那可就等于暴露秘密了，不是吗？而且，如果你直接告诉她，那就破坏了惊喜的效果了。
    
    你摇了摇头。说真的，如果达莉莎真的那么固执，连自己被捉弄了都毫无察觉，那这种恶作剧岂不是毫无意义吗？毕竟，整个恶作剧的乐趣就在于让受害者发现自己被骗了，对吧？
    
    “也许她自己并没有意识到，”梅拉承认道，“但周围的人肯定知道，而对我来说，这就足够了。
    
    听着，你根本不可能阻止梅拉捣乱——就像你无法阻止鱼儿游泳或鸟儿飞翔一样；当你允许她住在你家里的时候，你就应该明白这一点。在这方面，你唯一能要求她的就是别做得太过火；毕竟，虽然梅拉可能有些固执，但你还是需要达莉莎来帮你处理各种事务。另外，如果没有达莉莎，也无法保证来自冬城的替代者会是一个同样合适的“替罪羊”。
    
    你说得有道理。但就像我之前说的，我在自我控制，我的行为没有任何需要改变的地方。别为你亲爱的执法官担心，哦[pc.mf
        |领主
        |女士
    ]关于韦弗特家族的人——就像你说的，她们太珍贵了，不能让她们离开。
rows.raw:
"
    "Oh, I totally enjoy her company. She's the perfect straight man — or straight woman, if you will — to play jokes off of. I know there's a certain kind of boreal elf who is as icy as her body, a complete stick in the mud... those kinds are the best to tease.
    
    "Oh, don't worry, I never do anything serious, and she never seems to catch on, anyway. It's all in good fun."
    
    Would... would she mind telling you some of the shenanigans she's gotten up to?
    
    Meira raises a finger to her lips. "Ah, well! That would be telling, wouldn't it? Besides, you might go ahead and tell her, and that would ruin the surprise."
    
    You shake your head. Really now — if Daliza's such a stick in the mud that she never realizes she's been pranked to begin with, doesn't that make it pointless? Half the fun is in the victim realizing he or she's been pranked, after all.
    
    "Maybe she doesn't herself," Meira admits. "But those around her do, and that's enough for me."
    
    Look, you can't stop Meira from making mischief as much as you can stop fish from swimming or birds from flying; you knew as much when you let her stay under your roof. The only thing that you can ask of her in this regard is not to overdo it; dry as she may be, you need Daliza able to serve as your bailiff. Besides, without Daliza, there's no guarantee that her replacement, if any, from the Winter City would be as good a victim.
    
    "You have a point. But as I said, I'm keeping myself in check, no nothing needs to change from what I'm doing. Don't worry about your dear bailiff, oh [pc.mf
        |lord
        |lady
    ] of the Wayfort — like you said, she's too precious to let go."
    "

rows.original:
"Oh, her? She's definitely more in the %"mage" side of things than anything else," Meira replies cheerfully. "Lady's devoted to her work, if a bit reckless — reminds me a little of Mom in that they do share the same kind of energy. I'm not super big on enchantments besides the basics which Mom instructed us daughters in as foundational knowledge, so there's not much to discuss. Still, it's obvious from that chicken-leg house of hers that she knows her stuff.
    
    "We don't swim in the same circles, so we don't butt heads; everything's all hunky-dory. She's a woman dedicated to her work, and I can respect that just as she gives me my space."
    
    That's all she has to say on the matter?
    
    "Hey, I like to gossip, but the lady doesn't have much to gossip about and I'm sure that it's because she prefers it that way. It's no guarantee, but the best way to avoid being the subject of gossip is to be so utterly boring that even if people make stuff up about you it'd be so blatantly wrong as to be unbelievable."
rows.translation:
“哦，她啊？她绝对更偏向%“法师”那一类，而不是别的什么，”梅拉开心地回答道，“这位女士对工作很投入，只是有点鲁莽——这让我有点想起妈妈，她们确实有同样的一股劲头。除了妈妈作为基础知识教给我们这些女儿的那些基础法术之外，我对附魔并不特别热衷，所以也没什么好聊的。不过，从她那栋鸡腿屋就能看出来，她确实很懂行。
    
    “我们不在同一个圈子里，所以不会起冲突；一切都和和美美的。她是个专心于自己工作的女人，我尊重这一点，就像她也给我留出空间一样。”
    
    关于这件事，她就只说了这些吗？
    
    “嘿，我喜欢八卦，可这位女士没什么可八卦的，我敢肯定这是她自己喜欢的方式。这不能保证什么，但避免成为八卦对象的最好办法，就是让自己无聊到即使别人编造关于你的事，也会荒谬得让人无法相信。”

rows.original:
"Nice plant lady you've got there. Shame that she's... well, a plant and rooted to the spot. I think I'm skilled enough in transmutation to be able to give her legs should she want them, but just having them doesn't mean you know how to use them, and I'm not sure she wants them in the first place. Lady seems happy enough with her daughters."
    
    Could she, though? Make the Alraune walk if it came to that?
    
    "Might be tricky, but I definitely could manage it. The possibility of a change so drastic having some kind of side effect, though, is high enough that I wouldn't recommend it."
    
    Oh.
    
    "It's fine. I've found several uses for her nectar, non-lewd ones, even. Her daughters' will work as well, but it's less potent, so I have to concentrate it as opposed to their mother's and it ends up tasting really odd.
    
    "It's odd to see this menace that Mom thought was enough of a problem to shield the mansion and block further access into the Frostwood from; looks like you've tamed the plant lady to the point of being such docility. You seem to have the knack for it."
    
    Really, now? Given how feisty the Alraune was when you first encountered her... is there a chance that given enough time and encouragement, Meira herself might be tamed, too?
    
    "Why, I never!" Meira gives you a haughty little huff and looks you dead in the eye. "For one, I have the legs to simply walk away from such shenanigans if you were to try them on me!"
    
    Sure, she does. But would she want to?
    
    "Of course I would! What kind of question is that? Don't lump me in with that plant huss — I mean, plant lady of yours! Again, she may be rooted to the spot, but I'm not!"
    
    You don't think Meira's understanding the point you're trying to make through all her huffiness, but that suits you just fine.
rows.translation:
你养的这株植物可真不错啊。可惜它……嗯，毕竟只是株植物，被固定在了原地。我想我的转化技巧应该足够娴熟，如果它想要腿的话，我完全可以帮它长出来。不过，有了腿并不意味着就能学会使用它们，而且我也不确定它是否真的需要这些腿。看样子，它对自己的‘女儿们’已经很满意了。
    
    不过，她真的能做到吗？如果真的有必要，她能让阿尔劳妮动起来吗？
    
    “可能会有点困难，但我肯定能办到。不过，这种剧烈的变化很可能会带来一些副作用，因此我并不建议这么做。”
    
    哦。
    
    没关系。我发现她的花蜜有很多用途，甚至还有一些不涉及淫秽内容的用途。她女儿们的花蜜也可以使用，不过效果没那么强，所以我必须对它们进行浓缩处理，否则味道会变得很奇怪。
    
    “真奇怪，妈妈当初认为这种植物是个大麻烦，甚至不惜用 mansion 来保护它，阻止人们进入霜木林；看来你把这种植物驯服得非常听话了。你似乎真的有这方面的天赋。
    
    真的，现在就要吗？考虑到你第一次遇到阿尔劳妮时，她可是那么好斗……那么，如果给足够的时间和鼓励，梅拉自己也有可能被驯服吧？
    
    “哼，我才不会呢！”梅拉傲慢地哼了一声，直视着你的眼睛说道，“首先，我有足够的勇气和能力，可以直接走开，远离那些无聊的把戏！
    
    当然，她愿意。但她真的会愿意吗？
    
    “我当然愿意啦！这算什么问题？别把我和你们的那位‘植物女士’混为一谈啊！虽然她可能整天待在花园里，但我可不是那样的人！”
    
    你大概觉得梅拉虽然脾气暴躁，但其实明白你想要表达的意思，不过这对你来说也正好吧。

[evergreen.dealtWith
        |No sooner have you brought up the topic of her mother that Meira grows sober. "While I know I was never a candidate for her body-hopping to begin with, it's... disquieting learning that about your own mother. She made us, raised us... and knowing what she was up to now, I don't doubt that she would've burned Senja, me, or any of her daughters if it meant her getting ahead. I guess we're lucky that by the time Senja and I came on the scene, there weren't many things in life that Mom wanted, but she didn't already have."
        
        The secret to living forever without needing to constantly replace old bodies being one of them.
        
        "Yeah..." Meira shivers. "Look, I can understand why Mom did what she did. I'm still too young to actually start aging any more than what she set us to shortly after being born, but... after everything that's happened, I've spent a lot of time thinking about growing old and my body finally giving up the ghost. It's scary, especially at a time in my life when I should just assume I'll be around forever. That kind of fear, it can really drive people to do things.
        
        "It doesn't excuse what she's been doing for hundreds of years now, but... I can understand. Empathize without sympathizing, if you get me."
        
        ...
        
        "But hey, the final pieces have fallen into place, and all the questions I'd ever wanted to ask Mom but could never bring to bear have been answered. Now that Senja is in Mom's place, I think everything's going to be all right."
        
        Meira gives you a smile, clearly looking for reassurance. You sigh and pat her on the head. There, there.
        |"Oh? Mom's a lot more friendly now that I'm out of the house. She doesn't mind when I come back to visit, but it's clear that the mansion isn't my home anymore and that I should be on my way by sundown. Not overstaying my welcome and all, heh. 'Your daughter's your daughter all your life'? Well, maaaybe... but certainly not in the same way when it comes to Mom.
        
        "I'm just glad I got out ahead of the rush. I don't remember if I told you this before, but Mom has this thing where all of us half-'nuki daughters have got to leave home by a certain time, stand on our own two feet, as Mom says. Now, I've got nothing to back this up, but I've got a feeling that said moment isn't too far away, now. She's been aggressively marrying off many of our half-blooded sisters to people she knows for the last few years now, even before you came... I'm just glad I got to leave home on my own terms instead of Mom arranging them for me. Like, sure, I did go and check out her recommendations just to be able to properly weigh my options... but all in all, I'm glad that I chose to be your court mage, for what it's worth. It's just not chilly enough down by Yvennes."
    ]
rows.translation:
[evergreen.dealtWith
        |你一提到她母亲的事情，梅拉立刻变得严肃起来。“虽然我知道自己本来就根本不可能成为她附身对象，但……听到关于你自己母亲的这种事，还是让人感到不安。是她抚养了我们，把我们养大成人的。…考虑到她现在的所作所为，我毫不怀疑，如果这能帮助她获得利益，她绝对会烧死森娅、我，或者她的任何一个女儿。我想我们还算幸运的——因为在森娅和我出现之前，妈妈已经想要了很多她还没有得到的东西，但那时她已经没有机会再得到它们了。"
        
        永远活着而不需要不断更换旧身体的秘密，就是其中之一。
        
        “是啊……”梅拉颤抖着说道，“我明白妈妈为什么会那么做。我还太年轻了，实际上还没有开始衰老——至少还没有像她在我们出生后设定的那样快速衰老。但是……在经历了这一切之后，我花了很多时间思考衰老以及我的身体最终会失去功能这件事。这真的很可怕，尤其是在我这个本应该认为自己会永远活下去的年纪。那种恐惧，确实能够驱使人们去做出某些行动。
        
        这并不能为她这些年来所做的一切开脱，但是……我能够理解。我的意思是，我能够感同身受，但并不表示同情，你明白我的意思吧。”
        
        ……
        
        “不过，现在所有的谜团都已经解开了，那些我一直想问妈妈却从未敢提出的问题也都得到了答案。既然现在森娅已经取代了妈妈的位置，我想一切都会好起来的。
        
        梅拉对你笑了笑，显然是在寻求安慰。你叹了口气，然后轻拍她的头：“好了，好了。
        |哦？原来我离开家后，妈妈变得友善多了。我回去拜访她时，她也不再反对了，但很明显，这座宅子已经不再是我的家了，我应该在日落之前离开。毕竟不能太招人嫌吧，呵呵。你的女儿永远都是你的女儿，对吧？”嗯，也许吧……但说到母亲的话，情况肯定不一样。
        
        “我只是庆幸自己能提前行动。我不记得之前有没有跟你说过，母亲有个观念，就是我们这些‘半个日本血统’的女儿们必须在某个特定的时间之前离开家，独立生活，母亲就是这么说的。现在，我没有任何证据可以支持这个想法，但我有一种感觉，那个时刻已经不远了。在你们来到这里之前，这几年来，她一直在积极地把我们那些同父异母或同母异父的姐妹们嫁给她认识的一些人。……我只是很高兴能够按照自己的意愿离开家，而不是由妈妈来为我安排一切。当然，我确实去了解了她的建议，这样才能更好地权衡各种选择……但总的来说，能够选择成为你的宫廷法师，我感到非常高兴。在伊文尼斯附近，天气还是不够寒冷啊。
    ]

rows.original: [evergreen.dealtWith |"Poor dear's worked to the bone these days," Meira tells you with a dry chuckle. "Even if she isn't actually seeing people and their requests the way Mom used to do, there's a lot of baggage that Mom's left in her wake that poor Senja has to figure out and deal with. No notes or any other kind of explanation, naturally, because Mom wouldn't have to explain her stuff to herself. "Then there's the matter of my remaining sisters. Good thing I got out from that mess as quickly as I did — I don't envy the few remaining half-blooded sisters of mine still living with Senja. Poor Senja has to feed, clean, and corral every single one of Mom's intended, uh, spares while she can find them good homes with people who at least won't mistreat them. Without Mom around to lead them, they've turned into little more than fuckpets at this point; Senja's life would be so much easier if she weren't such a do-gooder. I'm not saying she should be like Mom was, but sometimes you've got to accept that getting the best solution for everyone simply isn't going to happen and it shouldn't get in the way of any solution at all." Hmm. "You know what I think? You should go and visit her a little more, [pc.name]. I don't know what you might be able to do about any of her problems, but it can't hurt to actually ask. And in the likely case that you can't or she won't let you do something about them — these are family matters, after all — I'm sure that you can at least help her forget her woes for a little while. Take my dear sister down a peg or two by turning her into a moaning, panting hussy like what's in her blood. Trust me, it's what that goody-two-shoes really needs. "Or if you don't want to visit her, you can always wait when she comes to check in on me. Honestly, don't know why she does that, she already has enough problems of her own without trying to take on more from yours truly. But hey, it's all the better for you to ambush her and give her a good what-for, am I right?" |"Honestly, I don't know why she insists on staying on in the mansion. A good number of our half-blooded 'nuki sisters have already gotten married off at Mom's suggestion or otherwise struck out on their own, but Senja's still there, playing at being storekeeper. If she wants to run a business, Mom's more than wealthy enough to get her started ten times over, so it's not like she hasn't flown the nest for lack of opportunity. Now that I've left, there're even fewer of us half-blooded sisters hanging around." Maybe Senja is just hanging on out of inertia, or perhaps she still places sentimental value on her familiar surroundings? "Sure, whatever. It can't go on for too much longer — sooner rather than later, she's going to be the last one in the mansion, and then Mom's going to have to kick her out rather than get her to leave of her own free will. That's not going to be pleasant for anyone involved." Has Meira tried talking to Senja about it? "No, because it'd be useless. And before you say that I haven't tried, I've dropped enough hints about it over the last several months, the latest of which is me actually leaving and setting up here. rows.original: Meira's grin turns from impish to truly smug. "Show off what we made together? Tch, my only complaint is that you're not asking more often. There're plenty of rumors of your exploits when it comes to producing by-blows... so I guess I should be happy that you're asking. Let me [dayNight |make it clear I'm not open for consultation |make sure we're closed up for the night ] and I'll be right with you." Your court mage is good to her word. She steps out a moment, [dayNight |flips the sign by her door |makes sure the door's firmly barred ], then returns with a smile and takes you by the hand. Together, the both of you step towards the back of Meira's quarters where the summoning circle is; she's walled off a portion of the room to serve as a nursery for her kits. A strange choice at a first glance, but the stone here is thick and sturdy, and a sense of calmness hangs over the room as [dayNight |sun |moon ]light streams in along with just a hint of chill Marches air. It's the best place for Meira's brood, especially when it obvious that the fruit of her womb is obviously anything but mundane. The elder Evergreen didn't have a nursery in her mansion, but then again, Meira's mothing never had need of one... "One of my sisters helped me set it up," Meira explains. "She got sent down to Yvennes to be some lady's maid and girl-toy, and Senja pulled some strings to let her come back to the Marches for a bit. It's not your standard nursery, but then our kids are anything but normal, wouldn't you say?" Elbowing you, Meira laughs, then swooshes in and shuts the door; the naughty 'nuki reaches into the nearest crib and plucks out a sleepy-looking half-'nuki infant swaddled in soft fabric. Meira looks up at you, her violet eyes dancing with delight and mischief, then settles back in the embrace with a happy sigh. "Really... I don't know why Mom chose to skip over this part when it came to me and my sisters. Sure, it can get messy and loud at times, but on the other hand, I'm well aware of how fleeting these moments are." [rand |You give Meira a look, then ask if it's okay that you hold your daughter for a bit. "Heh, I'd have been upset if you didn't ask. Sure you can — just be careful, okay? [meira.numKids 2 3 |Both of our daughters are heavy |All of our daughters are heavy |She's a heavy one ]." Oof. Meira wasn't lying — the little 'nuki kit already has the makings of a low-key giantess to begin with, but what takes the cake is how dense she is. Your daughter only wriggles and squirms a little in the swaddling, but she weighs as much as if she were made out of solid stone. That's one sturdy child, all right — one can only wonder if she came out of the womb that way, or if it grew on her. You eye Meira, and she smiles; it's clear that your court mage is more than happy to keep that tidbit of information to herself. "Like I said, I do want to give our children the best possible start I can, in every way that I can think of. Careful now, you're holding a future champion in your arms right there." The kit's poofy and more than a little chubby, exactly what one might expect from a baby 'nuki. Little round ears... and it looks like she's going to be every bit the redhead that her mother is. Calm, too. "She's really well-behaved. Honestly, if I didn't know better I'd have thought that she was Senja's instead of mine. Maybe Lumia got things mixed up and put Senja's kid into my womb — [pc.isValkyrie |I guess you can ask about that the next time you see the lady, yeah |now wouldn't that be a laugh, eh ]?" You ignore Meira's teasing and continue fussing over the little 'nuki kit, wondering at just what she meant by champion. Size and weight aren't everything, after all, and you're pretty sure that they aren't the extent of what your court mage is capable of when it comes to transmutation. Maybe they'll make themselves known as your daughter grows older... but for now, what you're holding in your hands is a plump 'nuki kit who seems like nothing out of the ordinary[meira.numKids 6 9 |, despite the hugely overdue degree to which Meira grew her pregnancy |, despite the absolutely monstrous proportions to which Meira grew her pregnancy ]. You heft your daughter again, prompting her fuzzy 'nuki tail to squirm from within the swaddled bundle, and catch her little gaze. She stares back at you, perhaps expectantly, perhaps watchfully. Not going to make a move? Just content to watch? Those big, violet eyes just continue to fix themselves on you. Well then, that's fine. Just existing is enough on her part to bring you contentment. You fuss over your half-'nuki daughter for a bit, squeezing gently at her chubby little infant body, then hand her back to her mother. "Makes you want more, doesn't it?" Since her daughters are dependent on her and her alone for their needs... well, so long as Meira can handle it. She seems to be doing fine now, but eventually there's going to be a limit, isn't there? "Eventually, but we're hardly near the limit just yet. My body's own willingness to accommodate these shenanigans surprises even me; it's more enthusiastic than I am. Sometimes I wonder if it's really the one pulling the strings, and I'm merely along for the ride." |Looking to Meira, you ask her if it's all right for you to hold your daughter for a bit. "Heh, I would've been upset if you didn't show at least that much interest in your girl; besides, she's quite the heavy little thing. Here then, she's all yours." As Meira moves to hand you your daughter, though, the little 'nuki kit extends a tiny hand and thumps it against her bosom, then squirms up in the swaddled bundle to nuzzle her chest. It's clear what the kit wants, now that she's been woken up from her nap... "Heh, hungry little thing. But then again, that's partly my fault too, so I have only myself to blame for making [meira.numKids 2 |them little furnaces who need |her a little furnace who needs ] feeding all the time." [pc.isMilky |Can you have a go? You're milky yourself. Meira pauses a second, contemplating your request, then nods and hands your daughter over. "I'll have to feed her again soon after, given that you don't have the nutrient density that she requires to keep going, but this isn't about that, I know. You're not around all the time, so you need to get close to our daughter far more when there is the chance." Well... yes. Meira hands over your daughter, and you find a chair by the window to make yourself comfortable on before pulling aside your [pc.armor] to expose a breast. Sensing the change, your daughter quietly nuzzles up against you expectantly, brushing the firm flesh of your bosom before latching on and pulling at length. Gods, is the little 'nuki kit as ravenous as she's heavy — Meira wasn't kidding about needing nutrient-dense milk, given how your daughter sucks. Maybe even selkie milk wouldn't be enough to sate the bottomless pit you're holding in your hands, but that's how it is, isn't it? With the sheer intensity involved, you feel your milk begin to let down in no time at all. This goes on for a little while, the rhythmic pulling at your [pc.chest] strangely comforting and pleasant in a soothing manner... "I don't know about you, but it feels good for me, really good. I wouldn't give it up for the world," Meira says with a happy sigh as she watches you with folded arms. "Oh sure, the day will come, and I won't be milky any more. But that day? Well, it's comfortably far off." That's one way of putting it. Looks like your daughter's a picky eater, too — that, or she's come to accept that your milk isn't going to be filling for her in the way she needs. Either way, though, the little 'nuki kit is more than content with you holding her, and that's what truly matters here. You hand her back over to her mother, who wipes off and burps your daughter before settling back with a happy sigh. |You understand, watching and spending time together will be just fine for you. Meira dips her head and pulls her top aside to expose a breast; you can only wonder at how much they've grown along with the rest of her. 'Nuki daughters of the kind Meira intends to bear have intense needs, and her bosom is changing to meet said needs. Not for size, not for sensitivity, but the sheer richness of Meira's milk has packed her tits with such potential that the blissful look on the baby 'nuki's face tells you all you need to know. Even at this distance, the euphoria exuding from both mother and daughter is palpable. Heh. Meira's come a long way, hasn't she? Well, there's nothing saying that you can't be a part of this, too. While Meira continues to nurse your daughter, you pulling mother and daughter close in with a good old-fashioned cuddle. Meira is firm yet squishy, and she sighs contentedly before snuggling in. "Thanks, [pc.name]. You just perfected the picture right there." It doesn't last long — with how voracious your daughter is despite her size, she's drained Meira dry in a matter of minutes. It's a little hard to believe, but she looks satisfied enough as she snuggles back into Meira's arms, who wipes off and burps the little 'nuki kit before cradling her with a sigh of contentment. ] The kits really have a voracious appetite, don't they? Meira grins as she sets your daughter back down in the crib, then cups her bosom with both hands. "It's not just the amount they want, it's how much nutrition there's to be had, too. I suppose if something unfortunate were to happen to me, a selkie nursemaid might just be able to cut it if you could find someone willing from the glaciers. But otherwise? "There's yet another reason our girls are dependent on me, at least until they can be weaned; I wasn't kidding when I said they need care that only I can give. Oh, the things a mother does for her daughters' benefit." You see. One supposes that she wouldn't have any left over for having fun, would she? "The good thing about milk," Meira replies, lowering her voice to a husky purr and giving her still-dribbling tits a firm squeeze, "is that more can always be made. That holds doubly true for me as opposed to anyone living in this Wayfort of yours. To say that there's milk left over is to imply that there's not more where that came from. So don't worry about it, oh [pc.mf |lord |lady ] of the Wayfort: if you want it, you have but to ask, you big baby." |You extend a finger to the little 'nuki kit in Meira's arms; the youngster follows it with her wide, violet eyes but doesn't reach out or anything, content to stay snug in her swaddling. It's clear that she's noticed you, but your daughter is content to lie back and simply observe. "Lazy little creature, isn't she?" Meira chuckles. "She's got the energy, she's just very measured about using it unless it's something she really cares about. Then... well, it bears testament to my skills that she's that strong this young." As opposed to her mother who was traipsing the woods in finery? Yeah, you can see the difference. "I'd have trouble believing she's mine if it weren't for the eyes, and the fact that I was the one who pushed her out of my belly. But it is what it is — after all, Senja and I had the same mother, and we have our differences." You waggle your finger a little more, but the little 'nuki kit just pouts in her baby way and turns away from it. Guess she's not in a playful mood. "Sorry about that," Meira says a little sheepishly. "But I guess it's good that her personality is so obvious this early on, isn't it?" |"Actually, you timed this visit excellently. I was planning to give our daughter an examination today, and another pair of hands is welcome. Would you mind holding her for a moment?" Of course, this is what you're here for. "Mhm. Do be careful, she's heavy." Oof. Meira wasn't lying — the little 'nuki kit already has the makings of a low-key giantess to begin with, but what takes the cake is how dense she is. Your daughter only wriggles and squirms a little in the swaddling, but she weighs as much as if she were made out of solid stone. That's one sturdy child, all right — one can only wonder if she came out of the womb that way, or if it grew on her. You eye Meira, and she smiles; it's clear that your court mage is more than happy to keep that tidbit of information to herself as she [meira.isPregnant |waddles |steps ] over to a corner of the nursery. So, about this examination... "Just some simple measurements to see how our daughter is doing. You know full well that I've endeavored to give our daughters every advantage I could conceive of from the moment of their — well, conception. It's just a look-over to make sure that everything's proceeding as expected." Right. For a moment there, you were a little worried that something might be wrong. "Oh, that worry never goes away, even if our daughter was like any other ordinary child. How much more so, when she's anything but? I don't expect there to be anything wrong, but on the off-chance that there is, it's best to get wind of it quickly so it can be nipped in the bud." As it turns out, everything is rather mundane. Meira sets up a table by the nursery window, and you help hold your daughter still as her mother measures her with several pieces of knotted string. Then it's off to a pair of balances — thankfully, your daughter cooperates while Meira adjusts the other pan with metal weights to figure exactly how heavy the little tyke is. Huh. Seeing the small pile of weights on the other side... having held your daughter in your arms, you knew that the girl was dense, but having it laid out like this before you is another thing. She's a heavy kid, all right. "Oh, don't I know it, having carried her around inside of me for as long as I could hold her in," Meira replies with a chuckle. "She's only gotten even moreso ever since popping out of my tummy." You're not sure what you expected — more magic, perhaps, and less poking and prodding of a sort that your half-'nuki daughter endures with all the dignified sullenness that an infant can muster, even one as robust as her. Eventually, Meira finishes the examination with a smile and hands the baby back to you to hold one last time before all of this is over. A clean bill of health, you take it? "For her? Yes. If she were any other child, her vitals would give cause for concern, but our daughter is no mundane child.[meira.numKids 2 3 | Neither of them are. | None of them are. ]" The pride in Meira's voice is unmistakable as you return to your daughter's crib and set her back in. "Thanks for being around for this, [pc.name]. Usually she fusses a bit more, but having you around has calmed her quite a bit. Even if she won't admit it, I think she likes it when you hold her." Heh, that's true. Meira's the one who has to feed, change, and otherwise mind your daughter. All you have to do is come in every so often and play with her. Your court mage gets a little pouty at that. "Mmmmh. Well, I guess it is true. Absence makes the heart grow fonder and all." ] Once everything's settled down, Meira leads you out of the nursery and quietly shuts the door behind the both of you, then leans into your side with a smug snuggle. She really does enjoy this, doesn't she? Just like the elder Evergreen? "Pft, don't lump me in with Mom[evergreen.dealtWith |, especially since we know what she was doing all along ]. Two people can like the same thing for different reasons and in different ways, you know." Meira shivers a little, then relaxes against you. "Like I said, I'll never agree with why she chose to have us grow, in like a week or two. Taking it slow means there's a lot of time to build a good foundation for your kids in every sense of the word." She really is becoming a bit of a goody-two-shoes — that sounds like something Senja might've said. "Oh, please. Senja would squirm and be all indignant about what I'm doing; she wouldn't want to interfere in any way that'd make her the least bit uncomfortable. Me, I'm willing to do what it takes for our daughters' sake." Giggling, Meira [pc.heightRange 72 |stands on tiptoe |leans in ] to give you a quick kiss. "Thanks for being around today, [pc.name]; I really appreciated it. [meira.isPregnant |There'll be another addition to the nursery in good time, so you taking an interest in things is always welcome. |If you like being around the kids so much, why don't we make another one when you have the time? ] Come back anytime, you hear me?"

真的……我不明白为什么妈妈在处理我和姐妹们的事情时，会忽略这部分。当然，有时候那些场面确实会变得混乱而吵闹，但另一方面，我也非常清楚这些时刻是多么短暂。 [rand |你看了梅拉一眼，然后询问是否可以暂时抱抱自己的女儿。 “呵呵，要是你这么做了，我也会不高兴的。没有问：当然可以——不过要小心点，好吗？ [meira.numKids 2 3 |我们两个女儿都长得胖胖的。 |我们所有的女儿都长得相当丰满。 |她可是个重量级的人物啊。 ]哎哟。梅拉没有说谎——那个小小的“婴儿包裹套装”本身就已经具备成为一个“低调的巨型婴儿”的条件了，但真正令人惊叹的是她的体重。你的女儿在被包裹起来后只是稍微扭动了一下身体，但她的体重却仿佛是由坚硬的石头构成的。真是个结实的孩子啊……人们不禁会想，她是天生就是这样的，还是后来才长成这样的。当你看向梅拉时，她露出了微笑；显然，你的宫廷法师非常乐意继续照顾这个孩子。那个她暗自记下了这个信息。
