rows.original: [wayfort.hasDaliza |Just as you're about to enter the grand hall, you're stopped at the doorway by a worried Daliza. Arms folded and lips set into a straight line, your bailiff stiffens and attempts to stifle her emotions as you approach, giving you a curt nod. "Baron[pc.mf | |ness ]." She's not one for playing coy. What's the matter? "A gothmander from Tychris arrived a little while ago and has been seeking audience. I tried to tell her that you're often out about the Marches and no one knows when you'll be back, but she was certain you'd be showing up soon." And how long ago was %"a little while"? "Several hours prior, [pc.mf |sir |ma'am ]." Well, she wasn't wrong about you showing up soon, then. This should be interesting. "Well, I'm just —" Daliza clears her throat. "Permission to be direct, [pc.mf |sir |ma'am ]?" Yes? "[pc.swornGod nareva |I know that you're one of the Order now... it worries me about the things that'll be asked of you as an Astrida. For someone to come all the way here from Tychris instead of waiting for you to next visit... you aren't about to be sent on some dangerous mission, are you? Of course, you've proven yourself multiple times over, Baron[pc.mf | |ness ], but even so... |You haven't gone and accidentally done something to draw their attention, have you? This is one of those times where decades happen in days, and I worry every time you go out there. ]" There, there. Really now, sometimes Daliza has quite the overactive imagination — but that's not necessarily a bad thing if it's about the Wayfort and you. Time for you to see what this is all about, then. ] As you step into the great hall and the people gathered within, [wayfort.hasDaliza |you spy the gothmander Daliza mentioned |something interesting catches your eye: there's a gothmander at one of the low tables ], having a conversation with several frostmander merchants. Noticing you, the astrida rises from her seat and steps towards you, stopping at a respectful distance and [pc.swornGod nareva |saluting you. "Champion of our goddess." At ease, at ease; there's no need to be so stiff about titles. What's up? |giving you a small bow. "[pc.isBaron |Baron[pc.mf | |ness ] |[pc.name], I presume ]?" That'd be you. What brings one of the order to your holdings, then? ] "I'll cut to the chase. You've recently come into possession of a Tychrisian spellsinger, haven't you?" Yes, but... well, that's getting down to business pretty quick, isn't it? What's her name, at least? [silly |"To be honest[pc.swornGod nareva |[pc.mf |sir |ma'am ] ]? It doesn't matter. I'm a two-bit character in this story who was cooked up for this purpose and who you'll never see again, I don't need a name. Well, I suppose I do have my own name and history and everything in the author's mind, but when it comes to being part of your story that stuff's irrelevant, really. And the writer just took out way more words to get this all across instead of just giving me a throwaway name and leaving it at that. |[pc.swornGod nareva |A smile. "I'm just an errand girl sent out to save you the trouble of running back to Tychris, [pc.mf |sir |ma'am ]. That's all." |An enigmatic smile. "Even if I'm just an errand girl, I think it's better that I keep my name to myself for now because of this spellsinger business." ] Fine, she can keep her secrets. Even those tasked with simple fetch-and-carries have appearances to keep up, eh? ] "Anyway, spellsingers. We've been trying to find this one for a while now; they're not exactly common artifacts, after all. After the Leroux family informed us that one of their daughters had absconded with the spellsinger the order had entrusted to them, we've been hunting it down; their historical significance to the order and its affiliates aside, they could be quite troublesome if turned to more nefarious uses, like the younger Leroux no doubt intended after stealing it from her own family." Olivia? "That's her name, yes. [pc.swornGod nareva |The goddess sends her regards, and to congratulate you on a job well done clearing that mess up on your own initiative |Thanks for doing our job for us. I know it sounds rather trite, but the order can't be everywhere all at once ]. We were aware of what was going on, but as you can tell, we're also stretched pretty thin and have to figure out what's most important to triage." You've dealt with most of them, but Olivia and Tharsus managed to give you the slip. Perhaps you should've secured Olivia after beating the stuffing out of her, but you had more important things on your mind at the time, especially since the ruckus no doubt stirred up the hive. [var0 |Does the order also want the lupines? "So long as you keep a tight leash on them, we're content to let the dogs remain in your custody[pc.swornGod nareva |, [pc.mf |sir |ma'am ] ]. We understand you have a lumian on your payroll seeking to cure them, so there's no need to fill our containment chambers if they're not causing trouble. ] "Back to the point of the spellsinger..." the gothmander holds out a scaly hand. "If you would hand it over, [pc.swornGod nareva |[pc.mf |sir |ma'am ] |please ], I'll bring it back to Tychris in no time. You'll be suitably compensated for your assistance, of course." What'll happen to the artifact? A shrug. "It may go back to the Leroux family, although after this bout of negligence they may well have lost [pc.swornGod nareva |our |the ] goddess' favor and with it, the right to keep a spellsinger. If that happens, perhaps it'll be passed on to another. Before any decision can be made, though, it needs to be returned to the order." All right, you get the drift. Taking out the spellsinger from your belongings, you pass it over to the gothmander, who looks it over. Satisfied with what she sees, she puts it away and hands you a small, heavy coffer full of coin. You lose the spellsinger. You gain 2000 EC. "A token of appreciation for your help[pc.swornGod nareva |; our goddess merely asks that you don't spend it all in one place ]. While it's understandable that many want to hold keepsakes of their adventures, spellsingers are loaned out under very specific circumstances and aren't just loot." All right, all right. Is that all, then? "That's all. Thank you again[pc.swornGod nareva |, [pc.mf |sir |ma'am ]. Our goddess hopes that you'll be in Tychris again soon |[pc.isBaron |, Baron[pc.mf | |ness ]. It's good to have someone around keeping order for once | for your cooperation — the adventurer's instinct to hoard can cause some to get quite attached to finds ]." ] All right, all right. You get the point — no need to rub it in. "I'll be off, then." Throwing you a quick salute, the gothmander spins on her heels and is out the grand hall in several easy steps, disappearing around a corner and leaving you with the weight of the electrum-filled coffer in your hands. Phew. Now... what were you up to before you were so rudely interrupted?

|你看到达莉莎提到的那个哥特曼德了吗？ |你会注意到一些有趣的东西：在其中一个低矮的桌子旁，坐着一个哥特曼德。 ]正在与几位霜冻商人交谈时，阿斯特里达注意到了你，她从座位上站起来，朝你走去，然后在保持适当距离的地方停了下来。 [pc.swornGod nareva |向您致以敬意。 “我们女神的捍卫者。” 别太拘谨了，称号什么的其实没什么大不了的。最近怎么样？ |向你轻轻鞠躬。[pc.isBaron |男爵[pc.mf | |特性 ] |[pc.name]，我想应该是这样吧。 ]那就是你啊。那么，是什么事情让你来到了这片领地呢？ ] 我直接说重点吧。你最近得到了一件提克里斯咒歌者，对吧？” “是的，但是……嗯，这也太快进入正题了，不是吗？至少能告诉我她的名字吧？ [silly |说实话[pc.swornGod nareva |[pc.mf |先生 |女士 ] ]没关系。在这个故事里，我只是一个为这个目的而被创造出来的小角色，之后你也再也不会见到我，所以我并不需要一个名字。当然，在作者的想象中，我确实有自己的名字、背景故事等等，但当这些成为你故事的一部分时，那些其实都无关紧要了。作者之所以用了这么多笔墨来描述这些，只是为了更好地表达这个意思，而不是简单地给我一个临时用的名字就了事。 |[pc.swornGod nareva |一个微笑。“我只是被派来帮您省去跑回提克里斯的麻烦的小丫头罢了[pc.mf |先生 |女士 ]就这些了。 |一个神秘莫测的微笑。“就算我只是一个跑腿的丫头，但考虑到这件咒歌者的来历，我觉得现在还是最好保持匿名比较好。 ] 好吧，她可以继续保守她的秘密。就连那些只需要负责简单跑腿任务的人，也得注意自己的形象，不是吗？ ] 总之，回到咒歌者这件事上。我们其实已经花了很长时间来寻找这件物品——毕竟，这类神器并不常见。在勒鲁家族告诉我们他们的一个女儿私吞了教团委托他们保管的这件咒歌者之后，我们就开始全力追查它的下落。除了这件道具对教团及其附属组织具有重要的历史意义之外，如果被用于邪恶的目的，它可能会带来严重的麻烦。毫无疑问，年轻的勒鲁从自己家族手中偷走这件道具，就是打算将其用于不正当用途的。奥利维亚？ “没错，她的名字就是奥利维亚。 [pc.swornGod nareva |女神向您致以问候，并祝贺您主动采取措施解决了那场混乱，做得非常出色。 |感谢你们为我们分担了这些工作。我知道这话听起来有点老生常谈，但确实不是所有事情都能同时得到解决。 ]我们当时清楚发生了什么，但正如你们所见，我们的精力也已经被分散得差不多没有了，我们必须先确定哪些事情是最重要的，才能优先处理。 你们已经处理了其中大部分问题，但奥利维亚和塔尔苏斯还是成功逃脱了你们的控制。也许在把奥利维亚彻底制服之后，你们应该把她关起来才对，但当时你们有更重要的事情要处理——尤其是考虑到这场骚动肯定已经引起了其他人的注意。 [var0 |这个订单也需要这些狼犬吗？ “只要你们能好好管住它们，我们就不反对让这些狗继续由你们来照看。[pc.swornGod nareva |， [pc.mf |先生 |女士 ] ]我们了解到，你们的团队中有一名名叫卢米安的研究人员正在致力于治疗这些疾病，因此，如果他们没有造成任何麻烦的话，就没有必要将他们关进隔离室里。 ] 回到咒歌者的问题上来……”哥特曼德伸出了一只布满鳞片的手部，“如果你能把它交出来的话[pc.swornGod nareva |[pc.mf |先生 |女士 ] |请。 ]我很快就会把它交给提克里斯。当然，对于你的帮助，你会得到相应的补偿。” 那么，这件文物最终会怎么样呢？ 他耸了耸肩：“它可能会回到Leroux家族手中，不过经历了这次疏忽之后，他们很可能已经失去了它。 [pc.swornGod nareva |我们的 |那个 ]得到女神的眷顾，也就意味着你有权保留那件咒歌者。如果真的发生了这样的事，或许这份权利会传给别人。不过，在做出任何决定之前，首先必须将这件咒歌者归还给教团。 明白了吧？你从自己的物品中取出那件咒歌者，交给了那位哥特女领主。她仔细检查了一下，对结果很满意，便将其收了起来，然后递给你一个装满金币的重型小箱。 你失去了咒歌者。 你将获得2000点EC。 作为对您帮助的感谢之情[pc.swornGod nareva |我们的女神只要求你们不要把所有的钱都花在同一个地方。 ]虽然很多人想要保留自己冒险经历的纪念品，这是可以理解的，但咒歌者实际上是在非常特定的情况下被借出的，并非随意就可以被使用。战利品好吧，好吧。那么就这些吗？ “就这些。再次感谢你们。[pc.swornGod nareva |， [pc.mf |先生 |女士 ]我们的女神希望你能尽快再次回到提克里斯。 |[pc.isBaron |男爵[pc.mf | |特性 ]有个人在旁边维持秩序，确实挺好的 | 感谢您的配合——冒险者天生的囤积习性会让一些人对自己发现的物品产生很强的占有欲 ]。" ] 好吧好吧，你的意思我明白了——没必要再反复强调了。 “那我就先走了。”这位哥特风格的女士向你快速敬了个礼，然后转身几步就走出了大厅，消失在转角处，只留下你手中那个装满电铸币的箱子。 呼……现在……在你被这么粗鲁地打断之前，你到底在忙些什么呢？
rows.raw: " [wayfort.hasDaliza |Just as you're about to enter the grand hall, you're stopped at the doorway by a worried Daliza. Arms folded and lips set into a straight line, your bailiff stiffens and attempts to stifle her emotions as you approach, giving you a curt nod. "Baron[pc.mf | |ness ]." She's not one for playing coy. What's the matter? "A gothmander from Tychris arrived a little while ago and has been seeking audience. I tried to tell her that you're often out about the Marches and no one knows when you'll be back, but she was certain you'd be showing up soon." And how long ago was %"a little while"? "Several hours prior, [pc.mf |sir |ma'am ]." Well, she wasn't wrong about you showing up soon, then. This should be interesting. "Well, I'm just —" Daliza clears her throat. "Permission to be direct, [pc.mf |sir |ma'am ]?" Yes? "[pc.swornGod nareva |I know that you're one of the Order now... it worries me about the things that'll be asked of you as an Astrida. For someone to come all the way here from Tychris instead of waiting for you to next visit... you aren't about to be sent on some dangerous mission, are you? Of course, you've proven yourself multiple times over, Baron[pc.mf | |ness ], but even so... |You haven't gone and accidentally done something to draw their attention, have you? This is one of those times where decades happen in days, and I worry every time you go out there. ]" There, there. Really now, sometimes Daliza has quite the overactive imagination — but that's not necessarily a bad thing if it's about the Wayfort and you. Time for you to see what this is all about, then. ] As you step into the great hall and the people gathered within, [wayfort.hasDaliza |you spy the gothmander Daliza mentioned |something interesting catches your eye: there's a gothmander at one of the low tables ], having a conversation with several frostmander merchants. Noticing you, the astrida rises from her seat and steps towards you, stopping at a respectful distance and [pc.swornGod nareva |saluting you. "Champion of our goddess." At ease, at ease; there's no need to be so stiff about titles. What's up? |giving you a small bow. "[pc.isBaron |Baron[pc.mf | |ness ] |[pc.name], I presume ]?" That'd be you. What brings one of the order to your holdings, then? ] "I'll cut to the chase. You've recently come into possession of a Tychrisian spellsinger, haven't you?" Yes, but... well, that's getting down to business pretty quick, isn't it? What's her name, at least? [silly |"To be honest[pc.swornGod nareva |[pc.mf |sir |ma'am ] ]? It doesn't matter. I'm a two-bit character in this story who was cooked up for this purpose and who you'll never see again, I don't need a name. Well, I suppose I do have my own name and history and everything in the author's mind, but when it comes to being part of your story that stuff's irrelevant, really. And the writer just took out way more words to get this all across instead of just giving me a throwaway name and leaving it at that. |[pc.swornGod nareva |A smile. "I'm just an errand girl sent out to save you the trouble of running back to Tychris, [pc.mf |sir |ma'am ]. That's all." |An enigmatic smile. "Even if I'm just an errand girl, I think it's better that I keep my name to myself for now because of this spellsinger business." ] Fine, she can keep her secrets. Even those tasked with simple fetch-and-carries have appearances to keep up, eh? ] "Anyway, spellsingers. We've been trying to find this one for a while now; they're not exactly common artifacts, after all. After the Leroux family informed us that one of their daughters had absconded with the spellsinger the order had entrusted to them, we've been hunting it down; their historical significance to the order and its affiliates aside, they could be quite troublesome if turned to more nefarious uses, like the younger Leroux no doubt intended after stealing it from her own family." Olivia? "That's her name, yes. [pc.swornGod nareva |The goddess sends her regards, and to congratulate you on a job well done clearing that mess up on your own initiative |Thanks for doing our job for us. I know it sounds rather trite, but the order can't be everywhere all at once ]. We were aware of what was going on, but as you can tell, we're also stretched pretty thin and have to figure out what's most important to triage." You've dealt with most of them, but Olivia and Tharsus managed to give you the slip. Perhaps you should've secured Olivia after beating the stuffing out of her, but you had more important things on your mind at the time, especially since the ruckus no doubt stirred up the hive. [var0 |Does the order also want the lupines? "So long as you keep a tight leash on them, we're content to let the dogs remain in your custody[pc.swornGod nareva |, [pc.mf |sir |ma'am ] ]. We understand you have a lumian on your payroll seeking to cure them, so there's no need to fill our containment chambers if they're not causing trouble. ] "Back to the point of the spellsinger..." the gothmander holds out a scaly hand. "If you would hand it over, [pc.swornGod nareva |[pc.mf |sir |ma'am ] |please ], I'll bring it back to Tychris in no time. You'll be suitably compensated for your assistance, of course." What'll happen to the artifact? A shrug. "It may go back to the Leroux family, although after this bout of negligence they may well have lost [pc.swornGod nareva |our |the ] goddess' favor and with it, the right to keep a spellsinger. If that happens, perhaps it'll be passed on to another. Before any decision can be made, though, it needs to be returned to the order." All right, you get the drift. Taking out the spellsinger from your belongings, you pass it over to the gothmander, who looks it over. Satisfied with what she sees, she puts it away and hands you a small, heavy coffer full of coin. You lose the spellsinger. You gain 2000 EC. "A token of appreciation for your help[pc.swornGod nareva |; our goddess merely asks that you don't spend it all in one place ]. While it's understandable that many want to hold keepsakes of their adventures, spellsingers are loaned out under very specific circumstances and aren't just loot." All right, all right. Is that all, then? "That's all. Thank you again[pc.swornGod nareva |, [pc.mf |sir |ma'am ]. Our goddess hopes that you'll be in Tychris again soon |[pc.isBaron |, Baron[pc.mf | |ness ]. It's good to have someone around keeping order for once | for your cooperation — the adventurer's instinct to hoard can cause some to get quite attached to finds ]." ] All right, all right. You get the point — no need to rub it in. "I'll be off, then." Throwing you a quick salute, the gothmander spins on her heels and is out the grand hall in several easy steps, disappearing around a corner and leaving you with the weight of the electrum-filled coffer in your hands. Phew. Now... what were you up to before you were so rudely interrupted? "

rows.original: The great hall is quiet at this time of night — uncommonly so, since it's open to the public unless you're holding court, and there's usually someone or the other having an evening repast. This particular evening, though? There's little more than the crackle of the flames in the firepit, having burned down to embers at this point. It's quiet. Cold. Forbidding. Perhaps even a little melancholy, [wayfort.stateABC |which is to be expected given the state of your home in the Marches |for this is still a fortress at heart and not a palace |betraying its true nature under all the decor ]. The air is still, and the weight of the old stones presses down upon you in the dim light; the great hall looks so much vaster now that it does in the light of day. Phew. You step through the tables, passing through on your way to wherever it was that you were going, but something in the gloom tugs at the back of your mind, a sensation that something's amiss in your home. Glancing around, you spy a smudge of shadow in the distance that shouldn't be there — the silhouette that should be your throne is distinctly not throne-shaped. Instinctively, your hand goes for your [pc.weapon], but that apprehension is soon replaced by an equally pressing one of another nature: atop the throne that's rightfully yours as [pc.mf |lord |lady ] of the wayfort is Olivia Bellamon Leroux. A petite pup in a seat that's far too big for her, slouched in an appropriately villainous fashion: one hand clutches at an armrest, while the other's wrapped around the neck of a half-emptied bottle. It's more for show than anything else, of course, because she's perfectly sober, eyes widening for a fraction of a moment as she realizes you're approaching. This is a [pc.isDK |bitch |dog ] who's up on furniture she has absolutely no right being on, and she [pc.isDK |damn |full ] well knows it. "Oh, Dearest. Out this evening for pleasure? The night is still young." Cute, but you're not letting her take the initiative. What's she doing up on your throne? "It's a nice throne. Comfortable, despite its appearance. Good positioning, and I note that the hall is shaped so as to let your voice carry all the way to the end. What was the word for it? Ah yes, acoustics. You're lucky to have come across this, Dearest." You roll your eyes. No, you're not going to let yourself be led astray, especially by such a half-baked attempt concocted in panic on the spot. Once more: what's she doing up on your throne? Olivia shifts with just the tiniest bit of discomfort, wiggling her butt in your seat[pc.ra lupine | and no doubt getting her scent all over it ]. "Well... I'm just trying to see things from your perspective, that's all. If I'm going to write entire ballads about you, Dearest, then it behooves me to try and understand you better, isn't that right? And no, it's not as easy as asking you, because actions speak louder than words." Which means she needs to sit on your throne and make a big deal of it. To which, you note that despite you being right in front of her and this conversation having gone on for the last several minutes, she hasn't made any effort to vacate your throne. "You have such a comfortable seat, Dearest. High and comfortable... but it's lonely at the top, isn't it?" Yeah, sure, okay. Now you know that her entire spiel about walking a mile in your shoes was plain [pc.isDK |bullshit |nonsense ], because damned if you ever felt that way as [pc.mf |lord |lady ] of your fort. The facts still remain: Olivia Bellamon Leroux is on your throne, being a miserable brat about it, and her pretexts are in all likelihood paper-thin on purpose. That slouch reminds you of how she was carrying herself when you first met, and her very demeanor is daring you to do something about an openly defiant act of brattiness. Manhandling a kicking and screaming little dog off furniture she's not supposed to on would create quite an unnecessarily ugly scene and that's what she's likely counting on, but there are other ways of discouraging such behavior, should it come to that...
rows.translation: 在深夜时分，这座大厅显得格外寂静——这种情况实属罕见，因为除非有重要会议举行，否则这里通常是向公众开放的，而且通常总会有人在这里享用晚宴。然而，这个特别的夜晚却不同：火坑里的火焰已经熄灭，只剩下偶尔传来的噼啪声。 寂静。寒冷。令人感到压抑。或许，还带着一丝淡淡的忧郁[wayfort.stateABC |考虑到你家在马奇地区的现状，这种情况也在意料之中。 |因为这本质上仍然是一座堡垒，而非宫殿。 |在所有这些装饰之下，它依然暴露了自己的真实本质。 ]空气静止不动，昏暗的光线下，那些古老的石块仿佛压在你的身上；与白天的景象相比，这座大厅显得更加宽敞辽阔。 呼…… 你穿过那些桌子，继续朝着目的地前进，但黑暗中有什么东西在不断萦绕在你的脑海中，那种感觉就像是你家里出了什么问题一样。环顾四周，你注意到远处有一片本不该出现的阴影——那个本该是你的王座的轮廓，显然并不是王座的形状。 本能地，你的手伸向了[pc.weapon]但这种忧虑很快就被另一种同样紧迫的忧虑所取代：登上那本应属于你的王位[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]在队伍中，奥利维亚·贝拉蒙·勒鲁赫格外引人注目。她是个娇小的女孩，坐在一个对她来说显然太大的座位上，姿势显得格外“邪恶”：一只手紧紧抓住扶手，另一只手则搂着半空中的酒瓶。当然，这一切更多只是为了作秀罢了，因为她其实完全没喝酒。当你靠近时，她的目光瞬间亮了起来。 [pc.isDK |贱人 |狗 ]谁知道她会把哪些家具搬上去呢？那些家具根本就不该被她用到啊[pc.isDK |该死 |完整 ]她心里很清楚。 “哦，亲爱的。今晚出来玩吧？夜晚还长着呢。” 挺可爱的，不过你并没有让她主动采取行动啊。她现在坐在你的“王座”上干什么呢？ “这是个不错的王座啊。尽管外观普通，但使用起来非常舒适。它的布局设计得很好，而且我发现大厅的构造使得声音能够传播到最远的地方。那个词是什么来着？啊，对了，就是“声学设计”。亲爱的，你能遇到这样的地方真是太幸运了。你翻了个白眼。不，你绝对不会让自己被这种仓促拼凑出来的东西所迷惑，尤其是这种在慌乱中即兴想出来的东西。再说一次：她究竟在你的王座上干什么？ 奥利维亚微微有些不自在地挪动着身子，在你的座位上扭动着屁股。[pc.ra lupine | 毫无疑问，它的上面沾满了她的体香。 ]嗯……我只是想试着从你的角度来理解事情而已。如果我真的要为你写一首长篇的情歌，亲爱的，那么我就更有必要努力去更深入地了解你，对吧？不过，这并不像直接问你那么简单，因为行动比言语更有说服力。这意味着她必须坐上你的王位，把这件事搞得轰轰烈烈。而你注意到，尽管你就坐在她面前，而且这场对话已经持续了好几分钟，她却丝毫没有打算离开你的王位。 亲爱的，你的座位真是太舒服了——既高又舒适……不过坐在最上面的话，应该会感到有点孤单吧？” “嗯，确实是这样。现在你知道她那套“设身处地为你着想”的说辞，其实根本就是一派胡言。 [pc.isDK |胡说八道 |胡说八道 ]因为，如果你真的有过那样的感受，那可真是太糟糕了[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]这正是你的弱点。 事实依然如此：奥利维亚·贝拉蒙·勒鲁正在你的王位上，表现得像个十足的任性鬼，而她那些借口很可能是故意编造得漏洞百出。她那懒散的姿态让你想起你们初次见面时她的样子，而她的整个举止都在挑衅你，让你对这种公然的任性行为采取行动。如果强行把一只又踢又叫的小狗从它不该待的地方弄下来，肯定会引发一场不必要的闹剧，而她很可能正是指望这种情况发生的。不过，如果真的到了那一步，其实还有其他方法可以阻止这种行为……

Once more: what's she doing up on your throne? Olivia shifts with just the tiniest bit of discomfort, wiggling her butt in your seat[pc.ra lupine | and no doubt getting her scent all over it ]. "Well... I'm just trying to see things from your perspective, that's all. If I'm going to write entire ballads about you, Dearest, then it behooves me to try and understand you better, isn't that right? And no, it's not as easy as asking you, because actions speak louder than words." Which means she needs to sit on your throne and make a big deal of it. To which, you note that despite you being right in front of her and this conversation having gone on for the last several minutes, she hasn't made any effort to vacate your throne. "You have such a comfortable seat, Dearest. High and comfortable... but it's lonely at the top, isn't it?" Yeah, sure, okay. Now you know that her entire spiel about walking a mile in your shoes was plain [pc.isDK |bullshit |nonsense ], because damned if you ever felt that way as [pc.mf |lord |lady ] of your fort. The facts still remain: Olivia Bellamon Leroux is on your throne, being a miserable brat about it, and her pretexts are in all likelihood paper-thin on purpose. That slouch reminds you of how she was carrying herself when you first met, and her very demeanor is daring you to do something about an openly defiant act of brattiness. Manhandling a kicking and screaming little dog off furniture she's not supposed to on would create quite an unnecessarily ugly scene and that's what she's likely counting on, but there are other ways of discouraging such behavior, should it come to that... "

rows.original: No, this won't do at all. Enough is enough — if Olivia's not getting down by herself, you'll just have the make the alternative sufficiently unpalatable.
rows.translation: 不对，这样绝对不行。够了——如果奥利维亚不肯自己动手，那你就只能让另一种选择变得足够难以接受。
rows.raw: "No, this won't do at all. Enough is enough — if Olivia's not getting down by herself, you'll just have the make the alternative sufficiently unpalatable."

rows.original: Know what, this isn't worth the fuss that Olivia's no doubt going to cause if you force the issue.
rows.translation: 你知道吗，如果你强行推进这件事，奥利维亚肯定会大吵大闹的，根本不值得为此麻烦。
rows.raw: "Know what, this isn't worth the fuss that Olivia's no doubt going to cause if you force the issue."

rows.original: So, Olivia likes sitting on thrones, doesn't she? You have a throne for her that she'd be much more suited to.
rows.translation: 所以，奥利维亚喜欢坐在王座上，对吧？你有一座更适合她的王座。
rows.raw: "So, Olivia likes sitting on thrones, doesn't she? You have a throne for her that she'd be much more suited to."

rows.original: So, one last time: you have a [pc.isDK |bitch |dog ] who's up on furniture she knows full well she's not supposed to be on, and completely unrepentant about it. Is she going to remove herself? "With all respect, Dearest, it's for research. I did just say that it's important to get a feel for what it's like to be you up here — you can spare a few more minutes to let me absorb the atmosphere you get all the time brooding on your throne, right?" That's a lot of words to say no. Okay, you can deal with that. Spinning on your heel, you turn your back on the yappy little dog and make a beeline for the courtyard, Olivia's gaze trained on the back of your neck every step of the way. For all that she's trying to appear nonchalant, she can't hold back the giggle that sounds from behind you as you slip out the south entrance. That's fine, it'll be fine. You do have a plan... the courtyard well is pretty deep, and the aquifers of the Marches are plenty cold. Olivia's mirth is short lived: her eyes widen as she sees you step back into the great hall, filled bucket in hand. "Oh no, Dearest. Don't you dare. Don't you dare in the slightest. You're not going to actually do what I think you're about to do." You ignore her and weave your way through the tables and towards your throne. "You don't want to do that. You'll ruin the wood! You'll ruin the upholstery! Is it really worth having wet dog smell ingrained into the seat for all eternity just to deny a girl a moment's curiosity so that she can serve you better?" Pft. You know it's more than curiosity that drove Olivia to get up on furniture she has no right being on. "Come on. You really aren't so petty, are you? If you hadn't happened to come along this evening, I'd have just planted my butt in your throne and taken in the view from there for about fifteen minutes, and then I'd have gotten off with no one the wiser. At this point, what does it really matter? Can't you —" For all of Olivia's words, she may have been an annoying little dog barking away. No sooner are you within range that you heave, putting your back and shoulders into the swing; the bucket's icy contents hurtle out directly at her, arcing beautifully through the air lit by the dim firelight.
rows.translation: 所以，最后再说一次：你有一只[pc.isDK |贱人 |狗 ]明明完全清楚自己不该待在家具上，却还毫无悔意地赖在上面。她打算自己下来吗？ “亲爱的，恕我直言，这是为了研究。我刚才就说了，了解待在你这个位置上是什么感觉很重要——你总能多花几分钟，让我感受一下你整天坐在王座上苦思冥想时沐浴的那份氛围吧，对吧？” 说这么多话，意思就是不行。好吧，你能应付。你脚跟一转，背对着那只聒噪的小狗，径直朝院子走去，奥利维亚的目光一路跟着你的后颈。尽管她努力装出若无其事的样子，可当你从南门溜出去时，她还是没忍住从你身后传来的那声轻笑。 没关系，会没事的。你确实有个计划……院子里的那口井相当深，而边境地区的地下水又冷得很。奥利维亚的得意没能持续多久：当她看见你提着满满一桶水重新走进大厅时，眼睛一下子睁大了。 “哦不，亲爱的。你敢。你绝对不许这么做。你不会真的要做出我以为你要做的那种事吧。” 你没有理她，穿过那些桌子，朝你的王座走去。 “你不会想这么做的。你会把木头弄坏的！还会毁掉椅面的衬垫！难道为了让一个姑娘满足片刻的好奇心——好让她能更好地伺候你——就值得让王座永远烙上湿狗的味道吗？” 嗤。你心里清楚，驱使奥利维亚爬上那些她根本没资格待的家具的，绝不只是好奇心。 “拜托。你不会真的这么小气吧？要是今晚你没有碰巧过来，我早就一屁股坐到你的王座上，在那儿看大约十五分钟的风景，然后若无其事地下来，谁也不会知道。事到如今，这又有什么要紧呢？你就不能——” 不管奥利维亚说了多少话，她终究只是只汪汪乱叫的烦人小狗。你刚一进入射程就猛地发力，用后背和肩膀带动这一甩；桶里冰冷的水直直朝她飞去，在昏暗的火光中划出一道漂亮的弧线。

rows.original: It's a moment of beauty. Clear well water, Olivia's pale cheeks and horrified expression — it's plain that she never expected you to follow through with your threat, for you to give in at the last moment when it was clear she wasn't about to budge. But with the water already mid-air, it's far too late for her to even attempt to dodge, not with the villainous slouch that she's oh-so-confidently assumed. The splash as the bucketful of water hits Olivia right in the chest is wonderful, as is the shriek that follows seconds later — one entire bucket from base to brim in a single go, all over an annoying little creature. Drenched from head to toe and shivering miserably, the little yappy dog scrambles to right herself; her fur, her hair and that slinky red dress of hers all cling to her curves, refusing to allow her any respite from the bone-piercing chill. Gods, she really is clingy when wet. It's only to be expected that a bard's bark is much worse than her bite, but seeing her flop around at the foot of your throne, her soaked clothing causing her no end of misery yet disrobing in public is out of the question even if the great hall is empty — Hey, you gave her every chance to back down. You'd like to think you're quite the magnanimous [pc.isBaron |baron[pc.mf | |ness ] |[pc.mf |lord |lady ] ], but this is your home and while Olivia's here there are lines she's not to cross. Seriously, she's still not satisfied with a seat at the head of the largest table? It's what was coming to her. "Whyyyyy..." Dear gods, the whinging when she's all bedraggled and soaked. Oh, now she's turning on the waterworks. "You'd cut off your nose to spite your face? Ruin your throne so it won't be fit to sit on for weeks?" Sighing, you crouch down by Olivia rolling about on the drenched rug at the foot of your throne, and impassively watch the tantrum play out. [pc.bg noblescion |Look, you're blue-blooded yourself, and you were forced to learn enough of what etiquette that's descended from old Belhar and is still extant in what remains of the shattered imperium to... actually, anyone knows to not get on the boss' seat. For any reason. At all. Getting on your throne was bad enough, but making up bullshit and expecting you to swallow it was just a slap in the face. But hey, you won't pursue the matter any further. Just seeing her in a wet dress and making a fool out of herself like the whiny little dog she is... it does feel deeply satisfying to see her brought down a peg. Shouldn't get too used to it, though; wouldn't want to end up like her. Olivia replies with several whiny animal noises that you choose to ignore. Seriously. Maybe her problem is that she's been away from home and stuck in a hole for too long and hasn't had to deal with any peers to the point where she thinks she can get away with anything. Well, lest she forget it: you're as noble as she is, maybe even more given you're landed to boot. By her own standards, it'll take more than the little sass and obfuscation that she uses to keep her [silly |simps |adoring fans ] in line, so maybe she should quickly remember how to act in a more civilized setting. |Hey, you may not have had the same privilege of birth that she had, but that just means you had to earn this wayfort with your own two hands. By that measure, you damn well think you're far more fit to sit upon your throne than she is — perhaps she should consider how her own ancestors came to power, heh. [pc.bgMulti courtesan minstrel |What etiquette that's descended from old Belhar and is still extant in what remains of the shattered imperium may not have applied to you, but you still spent enough time around those which it did to understand some of it |You may be a little rough around the edges for being a [pc.isBaron |baron[pc.mf | |ness ] |local warlord ], but that just means you're not tolerating this nonsense ]. Getting on your throne was bad enough, but making up bullshit and expecting you to swallow it was just a slap in the face. But hey, you won't pursue the matter any further. Just seeing her in a wet dress and making a fool out of herself like the whiny little dog she is... it does feel deeply satisfying to see her brought down a peg. Shouldn't get too used to it, though; wouldn't want to end up like her. Olivia replies with several whiny animal noises that you choose to ignore. ] Now then. The throne is a small matter — even if you had to replace it entirely, which you strongly doubt, it'd still be your seat in essence. The same can't be said of Olivia, and you'd rather not let her get insufferable to the point where you have to evict her; Asgeir may have allowed her to do as she pleased — he clearly wasn't the type to have the patience to deal with feminine wiles — but she'll find you a more exacting [pc.master]. While she lives under your roof, you're not going to stand for her getting up on furniture that she's not supposed to and putting on airs about it; that's a line that she's not to cross and your word is final. Now shoo. Olivia continues snivelling a little longer on all fours[pc.isDK | like the bitch that she is ], then glares daggers at you as she scrambles to her feet and hightails it out of the great hall. One can only wonder how many times someone in her life has pushed back when she started to shove... judging by her reaction, not very much. But hey. Your throne is soaked through and through, as is the rug; the bottle Olivia was holding lies smashed on the ground, its former contents bleeding into the puddle. And of course, as Olivia promised, the smell of wet dog is already starting to ingrain itself into the upholstery and wood. You'd call for [wayfort.hasMaids |the maids |Rumie ], but it's the middle of the night and everyone's in bed; at the same time, you've got to get this cleaned up now before it really does ruin everything. But seeing Olivia not just drenched from head to toe, but also the shock of having someone actually go through with a threat? It might just have been worth the long night ahead of you.
rows.translation: 这一幕真是美得令人窒息。清澈的井水、奥利维亚苍白的面颊以及她那惊恐的表情——显然，她完全没料到你会兑现自己的威胁，在她显然已经不肯让步的那一刻，你还是选择了屈服。但当那一桶水已经高高抛向空中时，她根本来不及尝试躲避，尤其是她还那么自信地保持着那个讨厌的驼背姿势。 当那一桶水狠狠砸在奥利维亚的胸口时，溅起的水花听起来真是美妙极了，而几秒钟后她发出的尖叫声也同样令人印象深刻——整整一桶水，从底部到顶部，全部倾泻在了那个讨厌的小生物身上。全身被淋得湿透，瑟瑟发抖的小狗拼命挣扎着想要站稳；它的毛发、皮毛，还有那条紧身的红色连衣裙，全都贴在它的身上，让它无法摆脱那刺骨的寒冷。天啊，她湿漉漉的时候真的特别黏人。 其实，一个吟游诗人的“吠声”比他的“咬伤”要可怕得多，这也是意料之中的事。但看到她在你的王座脚下乱扑腾，湿透的衣服让她痛苦不堪，却还是不肯在公共场合脱衣服，就算大厅里空无一人，这也是不可能发生的…… 嘿，你给了她足够的机会让步。你愿意相信自己是位相当宽宏大量的[pc.isBaron |男爵[pc.mf | |夫人 ] |[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ] ]，但这是你的家，既然奥利维亚来了，有些底线她是绝对不能越过的。说真的，她连最大那张桌子最显眼的位置都不满意吗？这本就是她应得的位置啊。 “为什么……”天啊，看看她现在这副狼狈不堪的样子，还在这儿抱怨个不停。哦，真是的现在她开始哭闹起来：“你竟然不惜毁掉自己的鼻子来报复别人？甚至毁掉自己的王位，让它在好几周内都无法使用？” 你叹了口气，蹲在奥利维亚身边，看着她在你王座脚下的湿漉漉的地毯上打滚，冷眼旁观着这场发脾气的行为。 [pc.bg noblescion |听着，你自己也是贵族出身，所以你不得不学习那些源自古老贝拉尔、至今仍存在于这个已经分裂的帝国残余部分中的礼仪规范……其实，就是这些。有人吗？知道不能随便坐上老板的位子。无论出于什么原因，都绝对不能。坐上你的位子已经够糟糕的了，而再编造一些胡话还指望你相信，那简直就是打你的脸。 不过，嘿，你也不会再追究这件事了。只要看到她穿着湿裙子，像个爱哭闹的小狗一样出洋相……看着她被挫败，确实会让人感到非常解气。不过，也不应该太习惯这种感觉；否则，自己最终也会变成和她一样吧。 奥利维亚用几声抱怨般的动物叫声回应，但你选择忽略这些声音。 说真的，也许她的问题在于她离开家太久了，被困在某个地方太久，一直没有机会与同龄人交往，因此她觉得自己可以为所欲为而不会受到任何惩罚。嗯，免得她忘了：你和她一样高贵，甚至可能更高贵，因为你还拥有自己的地产。按照她自己的标准，仅仅依靠那些俏皮话和含糊其辞的手段是远远不够的[silly |傻瓜们 |忠实的粉丝们 ]她应该尽快学会如何在更文明的环境中表现自己。 |嘿，你可能没有她那样的出身优越条件，但这只是意味着你不得不通过自己的努力去争取而已。赚取这一切都是你亲力亲为的结果。按照这种标准来看，你肯定认为自己比她更适合坐上王位——或许她应该好好想想自己的祖先们是如何获得权力的，呵呵。 [pc.bgMulti courtesan minstrel |那些源自古老贝拉尔、至今仍存在于这个支离破碎的帝国残余地区的礼仪，或许并不适用于你，但你在这些遵循这些礼仪的人群中待了足够长的时间，因此也了解其中的一部分。 |身为[pc.isBaron |男爵[pc.mf | |夫人 ] |地方军阀 ]，你或许还显得有些粗野，但这只意味着你不会容忍这种荒唐事。 ]登上王位已经够糟糕的了，但编造一些荒谬的谎言还指望你相信，这简直就是一种侮辱。 不过，算了，你应该不会再追究这件事了。只要看到她穿着湿漉漉的裙子，像个爱抱怨的小狗一样出丑，就足够了。看到她受到挫折，确实让人感到很有成就感。不过，也不应该太习惯这种感觉，否则自己最终也会变成她那样。 奥利维亚用几声抱怨的动物叫声作为回应，但你选择忽略这些声音。 ] 那么，王位其实是个小问题——即便你必须彻底更换它，而你也很怀疑是否真的有必要这么做，但它本质上仍然是你的位置。但奥利维亚就不一样了，你绝对不想让她变得难以忍受，以至于你不得不将她赶走。虽然阿斯盖尔可能允许她为所欲为——显然他不是那种有耐心应对女性诡计的人——但最终她还是会找到更棘手的方式来对付你。 [pc.master]既然她住在你家里，你就不能容忍她去碰那些她不该碰的家具，还摆出一副高人一等的样子；这是她绝对不能越过的界限，你的决定就是最终决定。 现在，快走开。 奥利维亚还继续趴在地上抽抽搭搭地哭了一会儿。[pc.isDK | 像个十足的贱人一样 ]然后她怒视着你，慌忙站起身来，匆匆跑出了大厅。人们不禁会想，在她的人生中，当她开始强行推进某事时，究竟有多少次被人制止过……从她的反应来看，似乎并没有几次。 不过，说实话，你的王座已经完全浸湿了，地毯也是；奥利维亚拿着的那个瓶子也摔得粉碎，里面的液体洒了一地，形成了一滩水。当然，正如奥利维亚所承诺的，那种狗尿的味道已经开始渗透进座椅的布料和木头里了。 你会要求[wayfort.hasMaids |那些女仆们 |露米 ]可是现在已经是深夜了，所有人都已经上床睡觉；同时，你也必须马上把这一切清理干净，否则真的会毁了一切。 不过，看到奥利维亚不仅全身湿透，更因为有人真的把威胁付诸行动而感到震惊，或许这一整晚的等待都是值得的。

rows.original:
Know what, it's not worth the scene Olivia's going to cause if she forces the issue. If she wants to take your seat for a bit to see things from your perspective... as much [pc.isDK
        |bullshit
        |of a fig leaf
    ] as that might be, it's not worth the trouble.
    
    "Thanks for seeing things my way, Dearest." Olivia blows you a kiss. "You really do have a nice seat here. Keeps the posterior warm on a cold day, which is every day in this miserable corner of the world."
    
    Just get off before anyone sees her.
    
    "Like I said, I need but only a few minutes. Don't worry, no one else's going to see me up here and start doubting you or anything, haha. Why do you think I'm here in the dead of night?"
    
    Olivia really looks like she's enjoying herself, taking a swig directly from the bottle and lounging about — one would imagine that this is a bad caricature of what someone might imagine rulership involves, but the yappy little dog is clearly going out of her way to tweak your nose and rub it in, wearing thin the veneer of plausible deniability.
    
    You should go before she does something stupid enough to change your mind.
    
    "Thanks again, Dearest," Olivia's voice sounds from behind you as you slink out of the great hall. "You won't regret it."
    
    Who knows? You already might be, for not standing up to her...

你知道吗，要是奥利维亚硬要较真，她闹出的场面可不值得。如果她想坐一会儿你的位子，从你的角度看看事情……不管那有多[pc.isDK
        |胡说八道
        |一块遮羞布
    ]，也都不值得去惹这个麻烦。
    
    “谢谢你顺着我的意思，亲爱的。”奥利维亚朝你飞了个吻。“你这儿的位子确实不错。冷天里还能让屁股暖和暖和——而在这个世界的这个破角落里，天天都是冷天。”
    
    赶紧下来，别让人看见她。
    
    “就像我说的，我只要几分钟而已。别担心，不会有别人看见我坐在这儿，然后开始怀疑你什么的，哈哈。你觉得我为什么要在深更半夜来这儿？”
    
    奥利维亚看起来确实很享受，她直接对着瓶口灌了一口，懒洋洋地瘫着——人们大概会以为，这是对统治权所包含之物的拙劣漫画式想象，但这条爱叫的小狗显然是在刻意戳你的痛处、往伤口上撒盐，把可以推说不知情的那层薄纱越磨越薄。
    
    你最好在她做出什么蠢到能让你改变主意的事之前离开。
    
    “再次谢谢你，亲爱的，”当你溜出大厅时，奥利维亚的声音从你身后传来。“你不会后悔的。”
    
    谁知道呢？也许你已经后悔了，因为你没有当面顶撞她……

Secondly, the standard set by fairy tales is marriage and living happily ever after. Neither are you interested in using her situation to pressure her into anything she doesn't want to do — plenty of fish in the Marches. If she's interested, she's interested. If she's not, she's not. rows.translation: 奥利维亚眼睛闪烁着光芒，将一根手指放在嘴唇边，与你的目光对视了几秒钟，让这个问题在空气中慢慢沉淀。了解她的人都知道，她其实早已做出了决定，只是故意拖长回答的时间来增添戏剧性效果——毕竟，吟游诗人嘛，总是喜欢这样的表现方式的。 所以，现在她已经被救出来了，按照惯例，公主应该会赐予一些性恩作为奖励，对吧？” 不。首先，她根本不是公主；其次，童话故事里所描绘的结局总是结婚然后幸福地生活在一起。最后， [pc.isDK |如果你真有这么卑鄙的心，直接拿你想要的东西不就行了，何必搞那些她想象中你正在表演的哀怨把戏呢？ |她这种极度愤世嫉俗的态度，其实并没有给自己带来任何好处。 ]这并不是一种交易或义务——如果她同意了，你也不会因此降低她的生活费用，也不会允许她放松对自己的要求。你更不会利用她的处境来强迫她做她不愿意做的事情……边境地区的人才多得很。 如果她感兴趣，那就是感兴趣；如果她不感兴趣，那就是不感兴趣。 “嗯，听你这么一说……嗯，这确实让人耳目一新，毕竟这些天来，有些人一直在用那些糟糕的方式试图说服我。 [silly |简单易懂的东西。 |野蛮人 ]或者是另一个人来跟我搭讪，以此赢得一位女士的青睐。”奥利维亚的嘴角浮现出一丝微笑，“你说你并不打算因此而回报我什么，亲爱的，但我还是想知道，是否有可能说服你改变主意。当然，不是以任何形式的交换——你对此太过坚持了——但也许在未来的某个时候，你会因为一些完全无关的原因，想要对一个远在家乡之外的女孩好一些。作为一种消磨时间的方式吧……我相信你对此应该很熟悉。” “哦，得了吧。 [wayfort.stateABC |她已经充分利用了你在荒废驿堡这里提供的一切资源。 “那么获得再多给点吧，”奥利维亚愤恨地说道，“亲爱的，不要为了我这么做，而是为了你的尊严。修补好那破旧的床架，雇些人来帮忙。如果你真的需要我，那就给我一些实质性的东西，而不是一张早已腐烂的床架，让我不得不自己去买床垫和床单。至少这也是为了你自己在做这件事时的舒适吧。” 她的话里充满了怨恨，但她说得也没错…… “如果你能认真考虑我的建议，这些努力确实是值得的。言归正传…… |她现在只是在逗你玩吧？ 奥利维亚哼了一声：“也不能这么说。我明白的，亲爱的——这次的情况不是‘还有其他办法可以付房租吗？’这种类型，虽然我也不会沦落到那种地步。但如果你能因此生气的话……嗯，没错。挑衅 — 成为更好的自己[pc.mf |男人 |女性 ]如果通过其他无关的方式获得这些信息，那么我并不介意满足自己的好奇心。 “这是真的。 |你的妻子虽然确实占据了一个相当有利的防御位置，但她同时也过着极其奢华的生活；在除了科尔米诺斯之外的所有边境地区，恐怕都找不到这样的舒适条件。她就算每晚都为你服务，所赚的钱也远远不够支付她的生活开销——毕竟，她作为宫廷吟游诗人为你所做的贡献，远比她那些所谓的“技巧”要宝贵得多。 “哼！好吧…… ]我必须承认，我确实感到很感兴趣。你在短短几小时内就击败了那个可怕的塔尔苏斯、那个野蛮的雷夫尼尔，甚至还打败了阿斯盖尔本人。这样的体力肯定也适用于你的其他事情，对吧，亲爱的？ “所以，没错。如果我要赞美你的话，多了解一些关于你的信息也没坏处，哪怕只是些外在的了解。我们开始吧，哦[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]在去荒废驿堡的路上吗？
rows.raw: " Eyes twinkling, Olivia raises a finger to her lips and holds your gaze for several seconds, letting the question sink in. Knowing her, she's already made her decision and is just dragging out her answer for the theatrics — bards will be bards, you suppose. "So. Now that she's been saved, this is where the princess is expected to dispense sexual favors as a reward, then?" No. Firstly, she's not a princess. Secondly, the standard set by fairy tales is marriage and living happily ever after. And finally, [pc.isDK |if you'd been in the mind to be this scummy, you'd just have taken what you wanted instead of doing the wheedling song and dance that she imagines you're performing |she isn't doing herself any favors by being this miserably cynical ]. This isn't some kind of transaction or obligation — if she does agree to this, you're not going to lower the cost of her room and board, let her slack off in her duties. Neither are you interested in using her situation to pressure her into anything she doesn't want to do — plenty of fish in the Marches. If she's interested, she's interested. If she's not, she's not. "Huh. Hearing you lay it out like that... well, it's a breath of fresh air from weeks upon weeks of miserable attempts by some [silly |simp |brute ] or the other to chat me up and earn a lady's favor." A small smile creeps over Olivia's lips. "You say that you don't intend to grant me any favors in return, Dearest, but I do wonder if I can't convince you otherwise. Not as any kind of exchange, as you're so adamant about, but perhaps sometime down the line you might be inspired by completely unrelated reasons to be kind to a girl far away from home. A challenge to pass the time; I'm sure you're familiar with those." Oh, come on. [wayfort.stateABC |Shes already making use of most of what you have to offer here at the wayfort. "Then get more," Olivia spits. "Don't do it for me, Dearest, do it for your dignity. Patch up the old mortar, hire some help around these parts. If you want to use me, then give me more than an ancient dry-rotted bedframe I have to buy my own mattress and sheets for. It's for your own comfort during the deed, if nothing else." She says it with such venom, but she's not wrong, either... "Worth the effort if you'll take my words to heart. Back to the point |She's just teasing you now, isn't she? Olivia chuffs. "Yes and no. I get it, Dearest — this isn't a 'is there any other way I can pay my rent?' situation, not that I would ever stoop to such a thing. But if I can provoke you — yes, provoke — into being a better [pc.mf |man |woman ] by other unrelated means, then I don't mind satisfying my curiosity. "It's true |Your wayfort may be a bona fide defensive position, but she's also living in the lap of luxury; there isn't such comfort to be had in all of the Marches outside of maybe Khor'minos. She could sell her body to you every night and not come even close to a fraction of her living expenses — the work she does for you as court bard is far more valuable than any tricks she might turn. "Hmph! Well ], I do confess that I'm intrigued. You beat that creep Tharsus, the brute Refnir, and Asgeir himself in the span of a few hours at most. Surely that kind of stamina also applies to your other endeavors, doesn't it, Dearest? "So yes. If I'm to sing your praises, a little more knowledge of you couldn't hurt, even the carnal kind. Shall we, oh [pc.mf |lord |lady ] of the wayfort?" "

[pc.isVirile
        |Before that, though... there's the matter of... well, she knows, yes?
        
        Olivia raises an eyebrow. "Oh, preventatives? You don't have to worry about that, I've brought enough with me from home to last a long, long time. One of the few things the brutes didn't take from me when I was captured along with my colleagues. A small mercy and privilege in exchange for submitting to their terms. Asgeir was smart enough to know that I would be of much less use to him stuck waddling around with a big belly."
        
        That being said... now that she's no longer stuck in a hole, just about any local apothecary has brown leaf. Getting some would be a simple run down to Hawkethorne at most, assuming one of the traders passing through the fort doesn't have any.
        
        "Thanks, but no thanks. I've been taking this ever since I reached my majority as a woman, and it's what I know and am familiar with; it's worked for me all these years and served me pretty well. I don't know the local preventatives, and don't want to foul up. I'm sure you understand why I'm cagey, given the risks involved."
    ]
    
    So long as she's got herself covered, you're fine with it.
    
    Olivia drains her [olivia.isPregnant
        |juice-filled 
    ]wine glass with a gulp, then hands it to [var0
        |one of her many orbiting maids who steps up to both receive it and clear the half-empty bottle in its ice bucket.
        
        "You dears are dismissed for several hours," she purrs. "Take the time to freshen yourselves up, because there'll be lots of work to do once Momma's through with [pc.name]."
        
        A giggle ripples its way through the maids, but they scatter swiftly from the great hall in all directions; with her retinue gone, Olivia stands from her seat and stretches, rolling her shoulders languidly before giving you a smile.
        
        "Shall we, Dearest?"
        |one of her lupine sycophants — it's a small surprise how they manage to just appear out of nowhere when she needs them. Some kind of bratty bardic power than Olivia possesses, no doubt.
        
        "All right, dismissed. Go back and do... whatever it is [pc.name] has you doing around these parts, I don't know. Bask in how fortunate you are to be able to serve me, instead of whatever drudgery it is my dearest has you doing. No need to rush, come back when you're ready and not one moment before."
        
        Olivia's [silly
            |simps
            |adoring fans
        ] slink away from the great hall with considerable speed; she doesn't even wait for them to depart before standing with a sigh.
        
        "Dealing with that lot is tiresome, even if they can be useful at times. Help me take my mind off such troubles, Dearest?"
        |Rumie. It's a small wonder your bee-tender manages to do everything from cleaning the wayfort to waiting on Olivia hand and foot, in addition to running the bar — someday, you'll have to ask Rumie how she manages being such a busy little bee. Having a kink for it no doubt helps, but there's the matter of not being able to be in multiple places at the same time...
        
        "Thank you, Rumie. You're dismissed for the next several hours," Olivia purrs. "Do get some rest, because I foresee a lot of cleaning up in your immediate future. Wouldn't want my favorite little bee to overwork herself and fall ill."
        
        Rumie giggles nervously, but gets the hint and buzzes off. With just the both of you at the table, Olivia turns her smile to you and rises from her seat.
        
        "Dearest, I beg of you to kill me should I ever fall to such pathetic lows; I shudder to think how close I came to being in something akin to Rumie's position. Please help me forget, if but for a little while."
    ]

rows.original: As you approach the vault, you're greeted by the sight of [var0 |Daliza and several of her garrisoned outriders by the open vault door: your bailiff herself is going over several ledgers at a table that's been dragged in for this purpose, her underlings alternating between your money in and out under her supervision. As you approach, Daliza stands to attention and throws you a salute. "M'[pc.mf |lord |lady ], what a surprise. Don't usually see you at the bookkeeping." Circumstances usually contrive to keep you away while the cake's being baked; besides, it's better on the nerves to turn up for the eating afterwards rather than see how it's made. How's your money? "We're bringing in the most recent tolls and taxes, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. Mostly from the bridge and commerce that happens here as a matter of course... minus whatever goes to maintaining the staff and other expenses. The rest, of course..." Daliza gestures to the vault, and you nod. Looks like everything's in order, then. "Actually, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ], there is one thing which requires your personal attention and I'm glad you've shown up." Hm? "It's regarding the dog bard you adopted as a pet. Olivia, was it? She's been withdrawing money from the vault without asking either you or me beforehand." |Farrah and several of her workers by the open vault door. The demoness sits at a folding table, alternating her gaze between the ledgers laid out before her and watching her underlings handle the money like a housewife watching the scales at market. As you draw near, she breaks out into a self-satisfied smile and stands to greet you, cracking her knuckles. "Well, if it isn't [pc.name]. Welcome to the best part of my job." It's more money than Farrah's ever had the chance to personally handle, is it? "I've had business concerns before." Farrah nonchalantly waggles a hand at the lupines moving in bags amidst the clink of coin. "But taxation and stewardship are a new endeavor to me. Still, wealth is wealth, however one comes across it." And today's wealth happens to be... "Tolls from the bridge, taxes from commerce in and around the wayfort, that kind of thing. Including me, of course — I pay all my taxes." A grin. "Income from your concerns in general, minus expanses and pay for the wayfort staff. The money may not all be mine, but just having the privilege of handling it is downright orgasmic. Such a pity that you're not usually around when the money comes in, but making the Marches safe for business is more important, isn't it?" Of course she'd say that, she wouldn't be Farrah otherwise. In any case, since everything's in order under Farrah's watchful eye, you'll just — "Mmmh." The smile vanishes from Farrah's lips, and she holds up a finger. "There is one thing." Yes? "It's the little bitch you took pity on and dragged into the wayfort. Olivia, was it? She's been filching money from the vault without asking." |Rumie by the vault door, several burly lupines moving your money in and out. Your bee-tender's got a bunch of ledgers tucked under one arm, and gives you a shy wave with the other as she notices your approach. "Oh! Hi, [pc.name]! Don't usually see you when the money's being sorted. Something happen?" No, you just happened to be passing by and thought you'd drop in to check on the vault. Looks like things are pretty busy today — what's going on? "Oh! I'm putting in the profits from the bar. That and paying these fine gentlemen for the latest shipment of booze." Rumie grins sheepishly, and blushes when you give her the nod of approval she'd been seeking. "There's a little more to everything, of course, but this is what I'm handling today at any rate." She really does everything around the wayfort, doesn't she? You're always worried about Rumie overworking herself — while beefolk are predisposed to such, uh, proclivities, overdoing it is still a possibility. Hope the other wayfort residents haven't been running her ragged — her bar and duties to you come first before anything else. "Hee hee. I do my best. Although, now that you bring it up..." Yes? "There's something about the tasks Miss Olivia wanted me to do for her while you were away — she asked me to make several purchases down in Hawkethorne that she obviously couldn't have afforded by herself. I looked into things, and the money undoubtedly came from the wayfort." ]
rows.translation: 当你接近金库时，首先映入眼帘的是[var0 |达莉莎和她的几名驻守在敞开的金库门旁的护卫们看到了你：你的管家亲自坐在一张专门为此准备的桌子前，仔细核对着几本账本，她的下属们在她的监督下，负责记录你的资金往来情况。 当你走近时，达莉莎立刻站直身子向你敬礼：“大人。[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]真是太意外了。平时可不太常见你在做记账工作呢。” 通常情况下，各种情况都会让人在“蛋糕还在烤制的过程中”远离现场；更何况，等到蛋糕做好后再去品尝，反而会让人更加紧张。你的财务状况怎么样？ “我们最近收取的各类费用和税款都挺可观的，嗯[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]主要来源于这里进行的各种贸易活动……当然，还要扣除用于维持员工生计及其他开支的费用。其余的，应该都没问题吧……” 达莉莎指向那个金库，你点了点头。看来一切都很正常。 “其实，先生[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]在那里是有一件事需要你亲自处理，我很高兴你终于出现了。” “嗯？” “就是关于你收养的那只宠物狗吟游诗人……奥利维亚，对吧？她一直在未经你或我同意的情况下从保险库里取钱。 |法拉和她的几名手下站在敞开的金库门前。那个女恶魔坐在一张折叠桌旁，她的目光在眼前的账本和手下们处理金钱的场景之间来回切换，就如同一位家庭主妇在市场上观察商贩称量货物一样。当你靠近时，她露出了一个自鸣得意的笑容，站起身来迎接你，同时还打了个响指。 “哟，原来是你啊[pc.name]欢迎来到我工作中最精彩的部分。” 这笔钱的数量，恐怕连法拉也从未有机会亲自经手过吧？ “我以前也处理过一些商业事务。”法拉漫不经心地挥了挥手，看着那些装在袋子里、在硬币的叮当声中被搬运过来的狼族。但税收与管理对我来说还是一项全新的工作。不过，无论通过什么方式获得财富，财富本身就是财富。” 而今天的财富，恰好就是…… “桥梁通行费、在商站周边进行的商业活动中产生的税收，诸如此类的东西。当然，也包括我在内。我缴纳了所有的税款。”他咧嘴一笑，“这些钱主要是来自你们为我提供的各种帮助，当然也用来支付路途中的各种开销以及路途帮派成员的薪酬。不过，这些钱可能还不够所有归我所有吧，但仅仅是拥有处理这件事的权限，就已经让人感到无比愉悦了。真可惜，每当有钱进账的时候，你却不在身边……不过，确保那些地区能够正常开展商业活动，毕竟更为重要，不是吗？” 她当然会这么说，否则她也不可能成为法拉这样的一个人了。无论如何，既然在法拉的监督下一切都在顺利进行，那你只需要…… “嗯……”法拉的笑容消失了，她举起一根手指，“还有是有件事。” “什么事？” “就是那个你出于同情而带进避难所的小贱人。奥利维亚，对吧？她一直在未经允许的情况下从金库里偷钱。 |露米站在金库门前，几个身材魁梧的狼族正在把你的钱搬进搬出。你的出纳员一只胳膊下夹着一堆账本，看到你走过来时，另一只胳膊朝你羞涩地挥了挥。 “哦！嗨， [pc.name]平时可没见过你在整理钱款的时候出现，发生什么事情了吗？” “没有，只是刚好路过，就想着进去看看金库的情况。看来今天这里挺忙的……到底发生了什么？ 哦！我正在把酒吧赚到的利润用来支付这些绅士们，也是用来购买最新一批酒品。”露米害羞地笑了笑，当你给予她期待中的肯定答复时，她的脸立刻红了。“当然，其实还有其他一些事情需要处理，但至少今天我负责的就是这些事情。她确实总是把所有事情都安排得井井有条，不是吗？你总是担心露米会过度工作——毕竟人类本来就容易有这种倾向，过度劳累确实是有可能发生的。希望其他福尔特地区的居民没有让她过于忙碌吧——她的酒吧生意以及对你们的责任才是最重要的。 “嘻嘻，我已经尽力了。不过，既然你提到了这个……” 是吗？ 在你不在的时候，奥利维亚小姐让我为她做一些事情——她让我去鹰棘镇买一些她显然自己买不起的东西。我仔细调查了一下，那些钱无疑都是来自荒废驿堡的。" ]
rows.raw: " As you approach the vault, you're greeted by the sight of [var0 |Daliza and several of her garrisoned outriders by the open vault door: your bailiff herself is going over several ledgers at a table that's been dragged in for this purpose, her underlings alternating between your money in and out under her supervision. As you approach, Daliza stands to attention and throws you a salute. "M'[pc.mf |lord |lady ], what a surprise. Don't usually see you at the bookkeeping." Circumstances usually contrive to keep you away while the cake's being baked; besides, it's better on the nerves to turn up for the eating afterwards rather than see how it's made. How's your money? "We're bringing in the most recent tolls and taxes, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. Mostly from the bridge and commerce that happens here as a matter of course... minus whatever goes to maintaining the staff and other expenses. The rest, of course..." Daliza gestures to the vault, and you nod. Looks like everything's in order, then. "Actually, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ], there is one thing which requires your personal attention and I'm glad you've shown up." Hm? "It's regarding the dog bard you adopted as a pet. Olivia, was it? She's been withdrawing money from the vault without asking either you or me beforehand." |Farrah and several of her workers by the open vault door. The demoness sits at a folding table, alternating her gaze between the ledgers laid out before her and watching her underlings handle the money like a housewife watching the scales at market. As you draw near, she breaks out into a self-satisfied smile and stands to greet you, cracking her knuckles. "Well, if it isn't [pc.name]. Welcome to the best part of my job." It's more money than Farrah's ever had the chance to personally handle, is it? "I've had business concerns before." Farrah nonchalantly waggles a hand at the lupines moving in bags amidst the clink of coin. "But taxation and stewardship are a new endeavor to me. Still, wealth is wealth, however one comes across it." And today's wealth happens to be... "Tolls from the bridge, taxes from commerce in and around the wayfort, that kind of thing. Including me, of course — I pay all my taxes." A grin. "Income from your concerns in general, minus expanses and pay for the wayfort staff. The money may not all be mine, but just having the privilege of handling it is downright orgasmic. Such a pity that you're not usually around when the money comes in, but making the Marches safe for business is more important, isn't it?" Of course she'd say that, she wouldn't be Farrah otherwise. In any case, since everything's in order under Farrah's watchful eye, you'll just — "Mmmh." The smile vanishes from Farrah's lips, and she holds up a finger. "There is one thing." Yes? "It's the little bitch you took pity on and dragged into the wayfort. Olivia, was it? She's been filching money from the vault without asking." |Rumie by the vault door, several burly lupines moving your money in and out. Your bee-tender's got a bunch of ledgers tucked under one arm, and gives you a shy wave with the other as she notices your approach. "Oh! Hi, [pc.name]! Don't usually see you when the money's being sorted. Something happen?" No, you just happened to be passing by and thought you'd drop in to check on the vault. Looks like things are pretty busy today — what's going on? "Oh! I'm putting in the profits from the bar. That and paying these fine gentlemen for the latest shipment of booze." Rumie grins sheepishly, and blushes when you give her the nod of approval she'd been seeking. "There's a little more to everything, of course, but this is what I'm handling today at any rate." She really does everything around the wayfort, doesn't she? You're always worried about Rumie overworking herself — while beefolk are predisposed to such, uh, proclivities, overdoing it is still a possibility. Hope the other wayfort residents haven't been running her ragged — her bar and duties to you come first before anything else. "Hee hee. I do my best. Although, now that you bring it up..." Yes? "There's something about the tasks Miss Olivia wanted me to do for her while you were away — she asked me to make several purchases down in Hawkethorne that she obviously couldn't have afforded by herself. I looked into things, and the money undoubtedly came from the wayfort." ] "

rows.original: So, before you go any further, what is the problem here, exactly? Is she accusing Olivia of embezzlement? [var0 |Daliza purses her lips and looks thoughtful. "No, m'l[pc.mf |ord |ady ]. That would mean she was misappropriating the wayfort's funds for her personal gain. I wanted to be thorough before coming to you, so I went over the books personally to trace where the money went, and..." And? "...As far as the purchases go, she's in the clear. All of the things the money Olivia took from the treasury went to were legitimately and plausibly necessary expenses for her duties as court bard. Entertainments for guests, a modest addition to her wardrobe, goodwill gifts, that sort of thing. There were a few discrepancies where I'd to ask some discreet questions to trace, but they turned out to be benign like ordering catering from the Frost Hound down in the village. It's true that your little pet bard benefited from the purchases, but as things go it's hard to separate work and pleasure in her line of business, m'l[pc.mf |ord |ady ]. "So no. I'm not accusing her of embezzling the wayfort's coffers." Then what exactly is she accusing Olivia of? Daliza clears her throat. "The charges I'm bringing against her are that of overstepping her authority, m'l[pc.mf |ord |ady ]." Explain? "As your bailiff under royal authority, I'm responsible for your finances when you're not around. This isn't just about collecting taxes and the like — what's going in — but also what goes out. Your little pet bard may have had legitimate expenses, but didn't bother going through either you or me when getting the money. This causes problems: she was kind enough to leave something of a paper trail this time so I could make sure everything added up, but there's no guarantee that will happen again. Nor do we want to set the precedent that anyone can just walk into the treasury and take anything they like, m'l[pc.mf |ord |ady ]. That way lies trouble, to put it lightly." So the problem is that Olivia didn't go through the proper channels? "Yes, m'l[pc.mf |ord |ady ]. They exist for a reason, and she wasn't granted an exemption.[pc.bgMulti noblescion soldier | Spare or not, you were born into a household — you should understand how these things work. | You served in the old imperial heartlands — a soldier like you should understand full well how a chain of command is expected to work. ]" You're starting to see the picture here, but one more question: weren't there any guards posted at the vault when this happened? Wasn't Olivia stopped? "That..." Daliza grimaces. "There were, m'l[pc.mf |ord |ady ]. Both of them have been properly reprimanded for allowing themselves to be browbeat into submission. Fact of the matter is, if you act as if you've every right to be where you are, others won't question it." Even vault guards? "She's a bard. She's very good at browbeating and playing on emotions against better sense." Daliza sighs. "Like I said, they've been reprimanded; it won't happen again. "Now, m'l[pc.mf |ord |ady ], if you could please make a decision so we can get on with our lives?" |Farrah smiles and shakes her head. "Oh no, dearie. If I'd discovered a thieving little snit under my nose, I'd be a lot madder than I am now. That, and disappointed in myself for not discovering her sooner. That being said, I did imagine that Olivia would be embezzling, because that was what I'd have done in her shoes... but that didn't turn out to be the case." You nod for Farrah to go on. "No, I wanted to be sure everything was ironclad so she wouldn't be able to wriggle out of it, so I asked around and followed the money that she claimed from the treasury. As it turned out, the expenses were legit: entertainments for guests, a modest addition to her wardrobe, goodwill gifts to visitors, that sort of thing. She's not the kind to leave a paper trail, but making an impression on people cuts both ways, if you know what I mean. There were a few discrepancies here and there, but they turned out to be fine in the end. I don't know exactly what she paid Garth off for, but I can imagine given how I pay the man discreetly as well for certain jobs. "It's true that there're some grey areas — the little bitch does like to splurge at Nelia's — but I can understand it being hard for some people to separate work and pleasure. I'm one of them, after all. So no. I'm not accusing her of embezzling the wayfort's coffers." Then what exactly is she accusing Olivia of? Farrah's eyes flash, and her voice lowers to a catlike hiss. In that moment, the demoness looks a lot like a dragon defending her hoard. "See, sweetie, when you're gone, I mind your money — for an honest cut of the dues, of course, as with everyone else who works here. If the books don't add up at the end of the day, I'm the one responsible, and I absolutely can't stand it. Your little pet bitch caused me three sleepless nights wondering where I'd gone wrong in the bookkeeping until I put together what was going on. "When it comes to my money — our money — all she had to do was ask. I'm no miser, I'm smart enough to know that you need to spend money to make money. But see, she couldn't even be fucking bothered to throw a by-your-leave either my way or yours, and that caused me no end of grief because I thought it was my fault the hawks were gone, that I'd made a mistake somewhere." You're starting to see the picture here: it's really not a good precedent to set that someone can just walk into the vault and help themselves to its contents, so long as it's justified. There are a lot of justifications one can come up with for expenses if it comes to that. "Yes, yes! You know what I'm getting at, [pc.name]!" That being said... doesn't Farrah have someone watching your vault? "I... it's my fault. My people had it open for a bit that day to pay off one of my suppliers, and your little bitch knows how people tick. If you act as if you've every right to be where you are, others won't question it. Well, I've put a stop to that. No more carelessness." |Rumie looks down and grinds the balls of her feet against the floor. "W-well, not exactly." Well, she'll have to speak up and be clear about what her complaint is. She came all the way up to bother you about it, so you know it's important. "Um, embezzlement would be stealing from you, right? But Miss Olivia wasn't stealing, not actually. The money she took, some of the things she had me order for her were really stuff that she might need for her job. Food and drink for the guests, the kind only Garth can get... oh, new clothes from Nelia's, and some kind of wax for that flute of hers. That kind of thing. It's kind of on the edge, since Miss Olivia likes that kind of thing too, but with her job it's not possible to separate work and pleasure, I think? "So, um... no, I'm not saying that she's embezzling your money, because she's not stealing it for herself. That's a lot more bad than what Miss Olivia's done, and I don't want to put her on the spot for something she didn't do." Then what exactly is she accusing Olivia of? "You can't just take peoples' money without letting them know, even if they'd have given it to you anyway had you asked! When the hornets come to beefolk for honey and the like, they don't sneak in the back to do it and leave without telling anyone! It's one thing to give something out, and another to just have the honey disappear; that's what would've happened if I didn't realize where Miss Olivia was getting the money for all the things she was instructing me to buy for her!" Olivia mustn't think very highly of Rumie, given that your bee-tender is the one who handles your money; it's like trying to sell stolen goods to the proprietor of the very store you stole them from. Slights aside, the issue at the end of the day is that Olivia didn't bother asking either Rumie or you for the money from your coffers. "It's... it's..." Rumie sighs and slumps her shoulders; asserting herself has taken more out of your beetender than even she herself knows. "It's not hers to take, is what I mean. She's probably used to it back home, but she's not in Yvennes any more." You get it. This isn't Olivia's household to muck about with as she pleases. "If she hadn't involved me, I would've discovered the missing money sooner or later, and it would've worried me sick. She didn't take it for selfish reasons or personal gain, but..." You're getting a clear picture of the situation here — with the wayfort being in the state that it is and Rumie only being one bee, it's hard to keep the vault secure. By and large, its main defense is its dilapidated state leading would-be thieves to assume that there's nothing worth stealing in there. But for someone who knows otherwise... "I-I'm sorry, [pc.name]." She shouldn't be — Rumie already has to juggle too many things when it comes to running the wayfort, and she can't be in two places at once. ] You consider everything that's been said so far. On one hand, it sounds like Olivia's need was genuine and that she showed initiative in not bothering you with what would have been a formality in asking you for the money, refusing her for legitimate expenses would've been unreasonable. On the other hand, it should bother you that she feels entitled to take what she needs from your vault without so much as asking first — even if you'd have reasonably given her the money her job needed, it's not something you want to set as precedent. That, and you remember the sight of Olivia sitting in your throne without so much as a by-your-leave. Call it a hunch, but it's quite possible there's more to this than meets the eye. Is she testing her boundaries again? [var0 |You turn back to Daliza. What's the traditional boreal elf way of dealing with such infractions? Embezzlement would be straightforward, but this... "Insubordination comes closest, in my assessment. The circumstances do lend themselves to granting her considerable leniency, so my recommendation would shy away from anything that would mar the pretty face and body she needs to do her job. Some light-handed public humiliation should do, preferably in front of those she's familiar with. A bitch like her would be most susceptible to social pressure from those whose opinions she cares for — scars on the heart, rather than on the skin, as the local lupines might say." [wayfort.stateABC |Hmm. The wayfort did use to have a stockade, but you still haven't gotten around to clearing out the place... Daliza sighs. "We can throw together something somewhere more private if you wish, m'l[pc.mf |ord |ady ]. It shouldn't take much to hold a tiny brat like Olivia in place." |Hmm. The wayfort did use to have a stockade, but you while the courtyard's been cleared out you still haven't gotten around to refurbishing it... Daliza sighs. "We can throw together something somewhere more private if you wish, m'l[pc.mf |ord |ady ]. It shouldn't take much to hold a tiny brat like Olivia in place." |That's a thought. There is that fine new stockade-pillory you've put in... "We can have the essentials moved somewhere more private if you wish, m'l[pc.mf |ord |ady ]. Like I said, it'd be more effective if the reproach were in the eyes of those who actually know her, as opposed to the riff-raff." ] |You turn back to Farrah. In light of all this, what does she think would be an appropriate way of correcting Olivia's behaviour? "You're asking me?[pc.isDK | Honestly, I'm a little surprised you're not lumping me in with your pet bard when it comes to your so-called correction. ]" Given her particular obsession, Farrah's been the one most distraught by this episode, so she should have some say in it. You can then be more or less lenient as you please. "Hmph." Farrah folds her arms. "She didn't embezzle anything, so I'm not as mad as I could be — as I said, the little bitch's real crime is not minding either of us in the slightest. I would've given her the money if she'd only asked, but clearly her highness isn't about to lower herself to what she deems as begging. "Well, since she's too high and mighty to ask a nobody like me for money, I think taking her down a peg would be best. Nothing too harsh — she does need that pretty face and body of hers to do her job — but the currency her kind deals in isn't gold or silver, it's favors and influence. If I had my druthers, I'd humiliate her a bit; pauper her where it really counts." Humiliation, huh? Come to think of it, [wayfort.stateABC |the wayfort did use to have a stockade, but you still haven't gotten around to clearing out the place... "Oh, that's not a problem; I can have something suitable quickly rigged up in the great hall in no time at all. Olivia's a small creature, it won't take much to hold her in place, especially from someone who knows a thing or two about knots and lashings." Farrah sounds quite enthusiastic about the prospect, which you can't blame her for. Why the great hall, though? A devilish smile creeps over Farrah's face. "Because I'd rather her not even so much as think of daring something like this again, [pc.name]. Just set her up in the very spot where she entertains your guests; w |the wayfort did use to have a stockade, but you while the courtyard's been cleared out you still haven't gotten around to refurbishing it... "Oh, that's not a problem; I can have something suitable quickly rigged up in the great hall in no time at all. Olivia's a small creature, it won't take much to hold her in place, especially from someone who knows a thing or two about knots and lashings." Farrah sounds quite enthusiastic about the prospect, which you can't blame her for. Why the great hall, though? A devilish smile creeps over Farrah's face. "Because I'd rather her not even so much as think of daring something like this again, [pc.name], and so I intend to beggar her where it hurts. Just set her up in the very spot where she entertains your guests; w |there is that fine new stockade-pillory you've put in... A devilish smile creeps over Farrah's face. "I like the way you think, [pc.name]. That being said... as satisfying as it'd be to have that haughty little bitch subjected to public use by the lowest of the low like a Jassirite initiate, I'm worried that it may not drive the point home. The goal is to make sure that this doesn't happen again, yes?" You raise an eyebrow. "We can move the stocks into the great hall for a bit," Farrah continues, rubbing her hands together, demonic glee oozing off her. "Right where Olivia usually entertains her guests. W ]hen they come to peddle influence and the like... well, they'll still get entertainment, just of a different sort. These are the people who your pet bard has been leading on by flashing her tits and ass at all this time. Give them a payoff, right?" |You turn back to Rumie. Given that she's the one who thought to tell you this was happening... were you to take Olivia in hand, what would she suggest you do? Rumie blushes, wide-eyed. "M-me, [pc.name]?" Yes, her. Olivia didn't commit actual thievery and had her job and your interests in mind[pc.isDK | — ostensibly, anyway — |, ] so there's no need to be too harsh. At the same time, there's the possibility you'd like to drive home the message: overreaching her authority under your roof isn't going to be tolerated. And since beefolk like Rumie are really into being bullied without any real harm being done... well, she can draw from previous encounters with vesperans for ideas. "Oh! Um..." your bee-tender furrows her brows, then her expression brightens and she giggles. "I think... I think if I were in her place, I'd certainly want to be clapped in irons and punished a little. Made out to be a bit of a laughingstock in front of people I knew, right? That'd be kind of fun! Maybe a little light spanking for trying to hide the honey, while I'm pinned down all the while... "Miss Olivia has a fair handful of people who she wants to keep in good graces with, so you could do it in the great hall! She certainly doesn't care for the opinions of those she considers beneath her, I know as much. It's really hot, she nails the demeanor just right!" All right, you understand where Rumie's coming from. "Mm-hm!" ] Now that you've a grasp of the situation, how're you going to deal with it? Or, taking a step back, does it need dealing with? The facts could be interpreted as Olivia pushing back against you, simple thoughtlessness on the little bard dog's part — or since she by all appearances does have the wayfort's welfare and your interests in mind, do you think she can be trusted to have a hand in managing your money?
rows.translation: 所以，在你继续之前，先想清楚……什么？是这里的问题究竟是什么呢？她是在指控奥利维亚贪污吗？ [var0 |达莉莎抿着嘴唇，若有所思地说道：“不，先生[pc.mf |命令 |阿迪 ]那意味着她正在挪用路标的资金来谋取私利。在来找你之前，我想先彻底调查一番，所以我亲自查看了所有的账目，试图追踪那些钱到底去了哪里……然后呢？ 就购物方面而言，她没有任何问题。奥利维亚从国库中取出的那些钱，全都用在了她作为宫廷吟游诗人的职责所必需的、合理且正当的开销上——招待宾客、稍微添置一些衣物、赠送礼物之类的东西。确实存在一些需要我谨慎调查的差异，但最终发现这些差异都并无恶意——比如从村里的“寒霜猎犬”餐厅订购餐饮服务之类的。你的小宠物吟游诗人确实从这些购物中受益了，不过在她的职业领域里，很难区分工作与娱乐之间的界限，先生。[pc.mf Wasn't Olivia stopped? "That..." Daliza grimaces. "There were, m'l[pc.mf |ord |ady ]. Both of them have been properly reprimanded for allowing themselves to be browbeat into submission. Fact of the matter is, if you act as if you've every right to be where you are, others won't question it." Even vault guards? "She's a bard. She's very good at browbeating and playing on emotions against better sense." Daliza sighs. "Like I said, they've been reprimanded; it won't happen again. "Now, m'l[pc.mf |ord |ady ], if you could please make a decision so we can get on with our lives?" |Farrah smiles and shakes her head. "Oh no, dearie. That being said, I did imagine that Olivia would be embezzling, because that was what I'd have done in her shoes... but that didn't turn out to be the case." You nod for Farrah to go on. "No, I wanted to be sure everything was ironclad so she wouldn't be able to wriggle out of it, so I asked around and followed the money that she claimed from the treasury. She's not the kind to leave a paper trail, but making an impression on people cuts both ways, if you know what I mean. There were a few discrepancies here and there, but they turned out to be fine in the end. I don't know exactly what she paid Garth off for, but I can imagine given how I pay the man discreetly as well for certain jobs. "It's true that there're some grey areas — the little bitch does like to splurge at Nelia's — but I can understand it being hard for some people to separate work and pleasure. I'm one of them, after all. So no. I'm not accusing her of embezzling the wayfort's coffers." Then what exactly is she accusing Olivia of? Farrah's eyes flash, and her voice lowers to a catlike hiss. In that moment, the demoness looks a lot like a dragon defending her hoard. "See, sweetie, when you're gone, I mind your money — for an honest cut of the dues, of course, as with everyone else who works here. Your little pet bitch caused me three sleepless nights wondering where I'd gone wrong in the bookkeeping until I put together what was going on. "When it comes to my money — our money — all she had to do was ask. I'm no miser, I'm smart enough to know that you need to spend money to make money. Food and drink for the guests, the kind only Garth can get... oh, new clothes from Nelia's, and some kind of wax for that flute of hers. That kind of thing. It's kind of on the edge, since Miss Olivia likes that kind of thing too, but with her job it's not possible to separate work and pleasure, I think? "So, um... no, I'm not saying that she's embezzling your money, because she's not stealing it for herself. That's a lot more bad than what Miss Olivia's done, and I don't want to put her on the spot for something she didn't do." Then what exactly is she accusing Olivia of? "You can't just take peoples' money without letting them know, even if they'd have given it to you anyway had you asked! When the hornets come to beefolk for honey and the like, they don't sneak in the back to do it and leave without telling anyone! Olivia mustn't think very highly of Rumie, given that your bee-tender is the one who handles your money; it's like trying to sell stolen goods to the proprietor of the very store you stole them from. "If she hadn't involved me, I would've discovered the missing money sooner or later, and it would've worried me sick. She didn't take it for selfish reasons or personal gain, but..." You're getting a clear picture of the situation here — with the wayfort being in the state that it is and Rumie only being one bee, it's hard to keep the vault secure. By and large, its main defense is its dilapidated state leading would-be thieves to assume that there's nothing worth stealing in there. But for someone who knows otherwise... "I-I'm sorry, [pc.name]." She shouldn't be — Rumie already has to juggle too many things when it comes to running the wayfort, and she can't be in two places at once. ] You consider everything that's been said so far. On one hand, it sounds like Olivia's need was genuine and that she showed initiative in not bothering you with what would have been a formality in asking you for the money, refusing her for legitimate expenses would've been unreasonable. On the other hand, it should bother you that she feels entitled to take what she needs from your vault without so much as asking first — even if you'd have reasonably given her the money her job needed, it's not something you want to set as precedent. That, and you remember the sight of Olivia sitting in your throne without so much as a by-your-leave. Call it a hunch, but it's quite possible there's more to this than meets the eye. "Insubordination comes closest, in my assessment.
