rows.original: Actually, this is fine. You're okay with how things have turned out. [var0 |Daliza frowns. "I beg your pardon, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]?" |Farrah scowls. "Excuse me? I didn't just hear that, did I?" |"Oh. Um." Rumie lowers her gaze and puts her fingers together. "Okay." ] As she mentioned, Olivia's real crime here — if one can call it that — is not asking for permission. The expenses are reasonable for what she does as your court bard, and you'd have approved them were you here. If the only issue is one of getting your go-ahead, then you'll grant it here and now: you give Olivia permission to draw all her future business expenses right from the wayfort's coffers. [var0 |"Permission to speak bluntly, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]? I don't like this, and I'm not saying it as your bailiff. This feels like one of those rules-bending situations where you know someone's guilty, you've caught that someone red-handed, and there's a loophole in the wording of the law that makes the case all come apart." Yes, but this isn't a technicality Olivia's getting off on. You know there're concerns, but on the whole it's okay to let your court bard make her own decisions. "It rubs me the wrong way." |"The money —" Your money, you should add. Farrah may have access to the wayfort's finances in order to grow her business for its benefit, but ultimately the stake in her business is yours. Neither do you remember her being formally appointed to manage your money — she just fell into the role due to her aptitude for business, and you've accepted this turn of events. Given how Farrah's benefited greatly from having a free hand with your money, surely she can extend the same courtesy to Olivia? Or is this really about a feline jealously guarding her territory from a rival? "There's no reason it can't be both. Olivia overstepped her authority, and even if you're giving her permission now she didn't have it then." |"O-oh. In that case, I don't think I've got any further complaints, then. I'll go tell Miss Olivia, shall I?" Rumie may be saying the words, but you can tell from her demanor that she still has misgivings about the entire thing, doesn't she? They must be pretty strong for someone as meek as your bee-tender to hold them to begin with. She can speak freely — out with it, then. Rumie lowers her gaze. "I just don't like it. It feels like it's giving her too much, too soon. There's no reasonable explanation for it, it's just a feeling I have." ] [pc.isDK |Well that's too fucking bad, then |You get her concerns, but on the other hand you don't want to run your wayfort in a manner where everyone has to seek permission for every little thing just to be able to do what's right by everyone ]. If you didn't trust Olivia, then you wouldn't have offered her a position in your court to begin with. The little yappy dog may be haughty and insufferable, but she's smart enough to not threaten a good arrangement even in the face of temptation. [var0 |"The problem with appealing to self-interest, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ], is that there'll always be someone who can make a better, more irresistible deal." Daliza thins her lips. "On principle, I quite thoroughly dislike those of a mercenary bent, and I understand her home was quite well-known for producing such." |Farrah hisses in a distinctly feline manner. "Oh, please. Now she's here of her own accord, and the wayfort's much better than a hole in the ground. Also, you're sure that Olivia's going to be watched quite carefully from here on out, right? [var0 |"My garrison and I have more important tasks than to play nursemaid to an entitled brat who doesn't realize her position, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. If there's nothing else, she can inform Olivia of her new privileges, and you can get back to doing what it was you were at before this interruption.
rows.translation: 其实，这样也挺好的。你对目前的发展结果感到满意吧。 [var0 |达莉莎皱起了眉头。“请问您能再说一遍吗，先生/女士？[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]？" |法拉皱起了眉头。“你说什么？我刚才确实听到了，对吧？ |哦，嗯。”露米低下头，把手指交叉在一起。“好吧。 ] 正如她所说，奥利维亚在这里真正的“过错”——如果可以这样称呼的话——就是没有征求你的同意。考虑到她作为宫廷吟游诗人的工作性质，这些开支其实是合理的，如果你在这里的话，肯定也会批准这些申请的。如果唯一的问题就是是否得到你的许可，那么我现在就批准你：允许奥利维亚将她未来所有的业务开支都从旅途中获得的资金中支出。 [var0 |恕我直言，先生。[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]？我不喜欢这样，但我这么说并不是在以执行者的身份强迫你。这种情况似乎属于那种需要灵活运用规则的特殊情形知道肯定有人有罪，你当场抓住了那个人，但法律条文的某些漏洞导致整个案件出现了问题。” “是的，但奥利维亚这次并不是在钻技术上的空子。虽然大家确实有些担忧，但总体来说，让法庭上的辩手自己做出决定也是可以的。” “这真的让我很不舒服。 |那些钱—— 你的钱的问题，你确实应该考虑一下。法拉虽然可以掌管荒废驿堡的财务，以便为自己的事业发展谋利，但归根结底，她事业的成败与你息息相关。你难道不记得她其实是被正式任命来管理你的钱的吗？她之所以能担任这个角色，只是因为她在商业方面很有天赋，而你也接受了这种安排。既然法拉能够自由支配你的钱并因此获得了巨大的利益，那么她难道不能同样体谅奥利维亚吗？或者，这其中究竟隐藏着什么原因呢？真的是关于一只猫为了保护自己的领地而嫉妒地对抗竞争对手吗？ “其实两者完全可以同时存在。奥利维亚越权了，而且即使现在你允许她这么做了，但在当时她并没有这个权利。 |哦，那样的话，我想我没有什么其他意见了。那我去告诉奥利维亚小姐吧？” 虽然鲁米这么说，但从她的态度来看，她对整件事仍然有些疑虑，对吧？对于像你这样温顺的人来说，能够坚持持有这些东西，说明它们一定非常珍贵。那么，她就应该毫无顾忌地说出来吧。 鲁米低下头：“我只是不喜欢这样。我觉得这样做太早了，也给了她太多东西。对此并没有合理的解释，这只是一种我的感觉而已。 ] [pc.isDK |那可真是太他妈糟糕了。 |你理解她的担忧，但另一方面，你也不希望自己的行事方式导致每个人都必须为每一件小事征求许可，才能去做那些对大家都有益的事情。 ]如果你不信任奥利维亚，当初就不会给她提供在你们宫廷中任职的机会。那个爱吠叫的小狗虽然傲慢又难以忍受，但她足够聪明，不会在诱惑面前破坏现有的良好安排。 [var0 |诉诸个人利益这种做法，其实[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]也就是说，总会有人能够提出更优惠、更具有吸引力的条件。”达莉莎撇了撇嘴，“从原则上来说，我非常反感那些唯利是图的人，而且我也知道她的家族向来以这类人闻名。 |法拉用一种典型的猫科动物般的腔调嘶声道：“哦，求你了。你真的觉得那种一有机会就会背叛前主人的贱人值得信任吗？一旦变成了叛徒，那就永远都是叛徒。 |好吧，好吧。你不需要说服我[pc.name]……" ] 她是在违背自己意愿的情况下被安排到那里去的，生活在极其恶劣的环境中。现在她是自愿来到这里的，而且这个住处确实比那种简陋的住所要好得多。另外，你确定从现在开始，奥利维亚会受到密切的监视吧？ [var0 |我和我的驻军有更重要的事情要做，而不是去照顾一个不懂得自己身份、自以为是的小屁孩。[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]然而，我认为在未来的日子里，你的宠物吟游诗人惹麻烦的机会将会越来越少。 |法拉双臂交叉，懒得回答。但看她那怒火中烧的样子，你完全可以猜到，这个恶女人一定会找各种借口，把奥利维亚牵扯进几乎任何事情里。不过，这样也罢了吧。 |奥利维亚小姐根本就不把我当回事，甚至几乎不会想起我。我想，这样反而是件好事吧？”鲁米露出一丝无奈的微笑，“既然她经常让我伺候她，我想我也只能密切关注她的动向了。 ] 好吧，那就这样吧。如果没有其他事情了，她可以把新的权限告知奥利维亚，而你们也可以继续做之前被中断的事情了。

rows.original: After thinking about it, you've come to a decision. Although Olivia did overstep her authority in the wayfort's pecking order by helping herself from the vault, she didn't do it for personal gain. While you agree that there needs to be some kind of reproach here, you don't think you're going to go as far as clapping the little dog in irons publicly. [var0 |Laws and customs may be one thing, but as baron[pc.mf | |ess ] you need to tailor the punishment to the circumstances of the crime instead of just following precedent. "As you wish, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]." |There's just a little animosity between Farrah and Olivia, is there? They don't work in the same line, so you can only assume that it's a clash of personalities. Farrah scowls. "It's as plain as day that she's way too uppity for her own good and needs to be brought down a peg or two." |Rumie may be into being bullied, but you get the feeling that Olivia would consider it a far harsher punishment than what your bee-tender intended to suggest. "O-oh." ] There's no need to act like that, she's done nothing wrong here. Now, if she wouldn't mind, would she please go get Olivia so the two of you can talk this through? Several moments later, a slightly ruffled and very cross Olivia's been brought up to the vault. She eyes you, [var0 |Daliza |Farrah |Rumie ], and the open vault door, then shrugs. "So, Dearest, what's the matter? I had a good audience going." You briefly relay what you've been told about Olivia's spending, and how she's been making withdrawals from the vault without seeking permission from the relevant people. "Okay?" Olivia says, dismissively checking her nails. Would she care to explain herself? "Not really, no. To be honest, Dearest, I don't think you should worry about this either. There were legitimate expenses I needed to do my job — the job you hired me for — that my pay doesn't cover, not that it should have to. I took what I needed, no more, no less. The way I see it, this whole situation is a complete [silly |nothing-burger |non-issue ]." And that would be perfectly fine if she was being accused of embezzlement, but that's not the case. The problem here is that she's overstepping herself. "And? It was unavoidable. You're gone all the time with your [pc.isDK |conquests |daring do adventures ] across the Marches, so it's not like I can reliably get ahold of you and ask. [var0 |And as for your bailiff, she's patrolling with her outriders all the time. I hardly have any chance to catch her when she's in the wayfort itself." Daliza thumbs her nose down at the little dog. "The patrols are on a timetable. Please don't make excuses. As for any other occasion, I'll make time if the matter is pressing enough — such as money leaving the treasury." "Your outriders are so easily browbeaten into submission. I guess I should thank you for softening them up for me." Ladies, ladies. If they're going to have a catfight, they can do it in the great hall later; at least they'd have an audience. For now, though, you want to get to the bottom of things. |And as for that miser you have handling your money for you, Dearest, I know that she'd just deny me the expenses just to make me squirm and suffer." "Excuse me, you little bitch," Farrah says with a feline hiss, "I'm right here, if you haven't already realized it." "So you don't deny it? You're not calling me a liar, only that you don't like it said to your face?" Ladies, ladies. If they're going to have a catfight, they can do it in the great hall later; at least they'd have an audience. For now, though, you want to get to the bottom of things. |There's no one else in this gods-forsaken ruin to ask, and I'm not going to wait for you to come back when some matters have to be cinched in half a day! There's Rumie. Rumie's always around, even if you aren't. "What? Rumie? That bee's a servant! What kind of standing does she have that I don't, that I should be seeking permission from her for anything? I'm the one who ordered her to make several of the purchases to begin with!" Yes, but Rumie has been with you longer than Olivia has, and had more opportunity to prove her trustworthiness. ] "Whatever. My point is that there's not always someone around to ask, and because of how finicky people can be sometimes I need the money now; I can't just wait for you to come back, gods knows how long that'd take. I don't see what all the fuss is about — as I understand it, Dearest, I should be able to just claim what I need to do my job. Think of it as an occupational investment." Seems like Olivia genuinely doesn't understand the issue here. Even if she couldn't find you or [var0 |Daliza |Farrah |Rumie ], she should've at least left a note, or written a line in the ledgers, something to let others know what she'd done. Instead, her expenses had only come to light when [var0 |Daliza |Farrah |Rumie ] noticed the discrepancies and looked into the matter. Instead, she'd given neither of you so much as a by-your-leave — given that this has happened multiple times, she could've asked you for permission sometime — "Most of those times, you were too busy [pc.hasCock |using me to get your dick wet |putting me in my place, to use a euphemism ]. Mixing business and pleasure really spoils the mood, wouldn't you say, Dearest?" [pc.isDK |Whatever. This is unacceptable — so long as she's under your roof, she lives by your rules, and one of them is having the common courtesy to not leave other people hanging |You roll your eyes. Enough dragging this out — no doubt Olivia felt entitled to take whatever she wanted from her family coffers, but she's not in Yvennes any more and she's not so high that she doesn't have to answer for thoughtless actions ]. You don't care if Olivia has expenses that need to be addressed to make her job easier, she's not to make other peoples' jobs unnecessarily harder while at it. Understood? Now, you'll give her permission to withdraw what she needs from your vault in the future, so long as it's for her job. That being said, after this little incident, Olivia should know that her spending habits will be watched to ensure she doesn't overstep her authority once more. And if something similar should arise in the future, she doesn't have this excuse to fall back on again. Is that understood? A huff. "Fiiine. This is your home[wayfort.stateABC |, ruin that it may be ]." Good, that should settle matters for now. Once again, she's not in Yvennes any more, and unlike the corrupted lupines you actually care about the running of the wayfort and the well-being of its inhabitants. All right, the both of them are dismissed — you need to get back to what you were doing before you were interrupted by domestic affairs...
rows.translation: 经过深思熟虑，你终于做出了决定。虽然奥利维亚确实在韦尔福的等级体系中越权了，擅自从金库中取出了东西，但她这么做并非出于个人利益。虽然你认为她确实应该受到某种责备，但你不认为有必要公开将这只小狗关进铁笼里惩罚它。 [var0 |法律和习俗固然重要，但作为男爵来说[pc.mf | |ess ]你需要根据犯罪的具体情况来决定惩罚措施，而不仅仅是遵循以往的惯例。 “如您所愿，大人。[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]。" |法拉和奥利维亚之间似乎有点敌意，对吧？她们的工作领域不同，所以这种矛盾很可能只是性格不合造成的。 法拉皱起了眉头：“很明显，她太自命不凡了，必须让她收敛一点才行。 |虽然露米似乎乐于被欺负，但你会觉得，对奥利维亚来说，这种行为其实是一种比你的“护花使者”所设想的更为严厉的惩罚。 “哦…… ] 没必要那样做，她在这里并没有做错任何事。现在，如果她不介意的话，能不能去把奥利维亚叫过来，你们俩好好谈谈这件事？ 几分钟后，情绪有些激动、显得非常生气的奥利维亚被带到了那个房间。她看着你[var0 |达莉莎 |法拉 |露米 ]他看着敞开的金库门，然后耸了耸肩。 “那么，亲爱的，怎么了？我刚才还有不少人在听呢。” 你简要地向他讲述了关于奥利维亚的消费情况，以及她是如何在未经相关人员许可的情况下从金库中取款的。 好吧？”奥利维亚漫不经心地说着，同时检查着自己的指甲。 她会不会愿意解释一下自己的行为呢？ “其实并不需要。说实话，亲爱的，我觉得你也不必为此担心。我确实有一些合理的开支，这些开支是完成我的工作所必需的——毕竟，这就是我的工作。你他们雇佣我，只是因为我的薪水不足以覆盖所有的开销，并非因为我的薪水本来就应该足够。我拿了我所需要的，不多也不少。在我看来，整个情况简直是一团糟。 [silly |没什么大不了的 |不是问题 ]如果她被指控贪污的话，那倒也没什么，但事实并非如此。问题在于，她这次确实越界了。 “那又怎样？这种事情本来就不可避免。你总是整天[pc.isDK |征服 |勇于追求冒险 ]在那些边远地区，我根本无法可靠地联系到你来询问这件事。 [var0 |至于你的法警，她一直都带着她的护卫们在周围巡逻。只要她在要塞里，我就几乎没有机会抓住她。 达莉莎用鼻子轻蔑地哼了哼那只小狗：“那些巡逻是必须按照时间表来办事。请不要找借口。至于其他情况，如果事情确实非常紧急——比如国库的资金出现问题——我肯定会抽时间处理的。” “你的那些手下太容易就被吓倒、屈服了。我想，我应该感谢你把他们‘软化’了，让我更容易对付他们。” 女士们，女士们。如果她们非得吵个架的话，大可以晚些时候在大厅里去吵；至少那里会有很多人围观。不过现在，我们还是应该把事情弄清楚才对。 |至于那个为你管理钱财的吝啬鬼，亲爱的，我知道她就是故意不批准我的开支要求，就是为了让我难受、让我煎熬。” “不好意思，你这个小贱人，”法拉用一种猫一样的嘶声说道，“我就在这儿，如果你还没注意到的话。” “所以你并不否认这件事？你并不是在说我在撒谎，只是你不喜欢别人当面这么说而已吧？” 女士们，女士们。如果她们非得吵上一架的话，大可以晚些时候在大厅里去吵；至少那样会有很多人在场围观。不过，目前你还是需要弄清楚事情的真相。 |在这片被神明抛弃的废墟里，已经没有其他人可以求助了。而有些事情必须在半天内解决，我可不会等你回来！ 还有露米啊。即使你不在，露米也总是在那里。 “什么？露米？那只蜜蜂不过是个仆从而已！它到底有什么地位她难道就因为我没有这样做，就意味着我在做任何事情之前都应该先征求她的同意吗？其实最初就是我吩咐她去进行那些购买的！” “没错，但露米在你身边工作的时间比奥利维亚长，她也有更多的机会来证明自己的可靠性。 ] 随便吧。我的意思是，有时候并没有人会在身边询问这些事情，而且由于有些人的要求可能非常苛刻，所以我确实需要这笔钱。现在我可不能一直等着你回来，天知道那要花多长时间。我不明白大家为什么这么大惊小怪的——据我理解，亲爱的，我应该只需要去做完成工作所需的事情而已。就把这看作是一种职业投资吧。 看来奥利维亚真的不明白这里的问题所在。即使她找不到你，或者[var0 |达莉莎 |法拉 |露米 ]她至少应该留张便条，或者在账本上写句话吧。某个东西她本想让别人知道自己做了什么。然而，直到后来，她的开支问题才被曝轻型出来。 [var0 |达莉莎 |法拉 |露米 ]她注意到了这些矛盾之处，于是开始调查这件事。然而，她甚至没有征求过你们的意见——考虑到这种事情已经发生过好几次了，她本应该提前征求你们的同意的…… “大多数情况下，你们都太忙了，根本无暇顾及这些事情。 [pc.hasCock |利用我来满足你的欲望罢了 |用委婉的说法来说，就是让我明白了自己的位置。 ]把工作和娱乐混在一起，真的会破坏心情，你不觉得吗，亲爱的？ [pc.isDK |算了。这种行为是不可接受的——只要她住在你家里，就必须遵守你的规矩，而其中一条规矩就是要有最基本的礼貌，不要让别人陷入困境。 |你翻了个白眼。别再拖下去了——毫无疑问，奥利维亚觉得自己有权从家里的钱袋里拿走任何她想要的东西，但她现在已经不在伊薇恩身边了，而且她的地位也不再那么高了，她总得为自己的轻率行为负责吧。 ]你并不关心奥利维亚是否有一些需要解决的开支，这些开支是为了让她的工作更顺利一些；但你不能允许她因此而让其他人的工作变得更加困难。明白了吗？ 现在，你可以允许她以后从你的保险库中取出她工作所需的东西，只要这些开支确实是用于她的工作的。话虽如此，经过这次小插曲，奥利维亚应该明白，她的消费习惯将会受到监督，以确保她不会再越权行事。如果将来再发生类似的事情，她就再也没有这个借口可以用了。明白了吗？ “哼。好的。这里是你的家。[wayfort.stateABC |哪怕会因此毁掉一切也好 ]好了，这样应该可以暂时解决问题了。她已经不在伊文尼斯了，而且与那些被腐蚀的狼族不同，你确实关心这个中转站的运作以及那里居民的安危。好吧，他们俩的事情都先放到一边吧——你得继续做你之前被家庭琐事打断的事情了……

rows.original: After some consideration, this won't do. No, this won't do at all — first Olivia sits on your throne with a flimsy excuse, and now she treats the contents of your vault as some kind of public fund one can withdraw from without so much as a by-your-leave. At least the little yappy dog wasn't as blatant about it as she was the first time, but it's clear that the lesson about overstepping her boundaries under your roof didn't sink in. [pc.isDK |To be frank, you were hoping for something like this: |As regrettable as it may be, ] a healthy dose of correction needs to be sent her way. [var0 |Daliza? "M'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]?" Would she mind getting a couple of her outriders together and bringing Olivia over? Nothing too harsh just yet — you want to hear your court bard's side of the story first. "At once, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]." Daliza salutes, spins on her heel, and she's gone. You don't have long to wait — about five minutes later, your bailiff returns with two of her garrison and Olivia in tow, the latter being frogmarched in with a scowl on her face. "You don't have to be so curt about it, you brutes," she snaps. "I'm coming along just fine — after all, I've done nothing wrong." |Farrah? "Hmm?" Would she mind getting a couple of her people and bringing Olivia over? They seem pretty capable, so they shouldn't have any problems corralling your court bard. Nothing too rough, though — not until Olivia's had the chance to tell her side of the story. "Oh, don't worry." If Farrah's smile was nasty before, it's now turned downright vicious. "I'm not going to spoil a good thing by moving too quickly. All right, boys, you heard [pc.himHer]! Two of you follow me — we're going to get this sorted!" You don't have long to wait: about five minutes later, a very smug Farrah returns with Olivia in tow, the latter hoisted by the workmen from under her shoulders. At a gesture from the demoness, they dump her on the floor; grumbling, Olivia clambers to her feet and dusts herself off. "No need to treat me like that, I haven't done anything wrong." "That's for [pc.name] to decide, sweetie." |Actually... Rumie? "Yes?" Is she up for a bit of role reversal? While you know that these people are just here to deliver the booze and get paid, does she think they'd mind helping her bring Olivia here? Your court bard's quite the petite creature, so they shouldn't have any problem manhandling her if they ignore the noise she's bound to make. "O-oh! I think that shouldn't be a problem, we're always willing to do each other favors." Nothing too harsh, though, not until you've heard Olivia's side of the story. "Of course! I just..." taking a deep breath, Rumie squares her shoulders and puffs her chest out. "If two of you boys could help me pick up another shipment, I'd appreciate it." You don't have long to wait. Five minutes later, your bee-tender's back at the vault, this time with Olivia hoisted between two burly lupines. While your court bard has the temerity to not outright resort to kicking and screaming, she's plainly extremely sour about the method of her summons. rows.original:
A quarter of an hour later, you step into the great hall to find [wayfort.stateABC
            |makeshift restraints jury-rigged together from wood, rope and chains
            |makeshift restraints jury-rigged together from wood, rope and chains
            |the essential bits of the stockade moved in from the courtyard
        ], just a little ways ahead of Olivia's usual seat at the head of the high table. [var0
            |Daliza's underlings
            |Farrah's hirelings
            |Rumie's workmen
        ] have made quick work of the job, and it doesn't take much to restrain someone as slight and petite as Olivia; with her head and wrists clapped securely in place, the enormity of what's about to happen to her is finally beginning to sink in. 
        
        Your court bard is trying to put a brave face on it all, especially knowing that this could have been worse, but one gets the feeling that she would've borne a private lashing better than being made a social pauper. The pressure only intensifies as she sees you approach, and though Olivia doesn't start begging, you see her swallow hard as the gaze of every single reveler in the hall is drawn to the both of you.
        
        "Happy now?"
        
        [pc.isDK
            |Satisfying as it may be, t
            |T
        ]his isn't about your personal pleasure or petty vindictiveness. While you may have been comparatively more lenient after catching her sitting on your throne, you can't just let it go when Olivia's pushing threatens to have actual repercussions for the wayfort's smooth running. If it'd stayed between the two of you, maybe, but now that others have been dragged into this little spat as well...
        
        Anyway, the point of all this is to drive the lesson home.
        
        "And if it doesn't stick?"
        
        Then you'll just have to hammer in said lesson harder. If anything, Olivia should be glad that you're choosing to take her in hand — it would be so much easier for you to banish her from the wayfort and be done with it.
        
        Silence ripples out over the great hall, everyone waiting to see if you'll follow through on your implied threat. There's a tense, hushed moment, and then eventually the tension fades as Olivia sags and skulks in her restraints. Unwilling to accept her situation, but having no further retort — well, that's about as good as it'll get for now, you suppose.

A frown crosses his face as he takes in Olivia in her restraints, then looks between the two of you. "Oh-ho. Now what do we have here?" You briefly fill in Refnir on Olivia's indiscretions up to this point, and what you'd like him to do in order to correct the little dog's attitude towards others. "Hmph. So she's betrayed you, as much as she's betrayed Asgeir; unsurprising when she's always only ever had her own interests in mind. Once a traitor, always a traitor." Olivia snarls and shakes at her restraints. "You allowed Tharsus to transform me into a bimbo, then turned a blind eye to that old creep's plans to make me a puppy mill once you'd had your stupid moot! Did you seriously think I wouldn't find out? How do you expect loyalty after that? "Either you plotted against me, or are so incompetent and naive a leader as to be taken in by that scheming old man! Maybe you are that much of a musclehead, because he was stringing you along with promises of a cure he would never provide!" Good, good. Looks like there's still plenty of animosity festering between the two; this should be quite the show for everyone in the hall. Your only request to Refnir is that he doesn't break Olivia too hard: her transgressions aren't that severe. She hasn't actually betrayed you, just been quite insubordinate. Still serious in the eyes of a man like him, but not as grievous a sin. All you get from the ex-captain is a snort. Slowly and with great deliberation, he steps behind Olivia and grabs the hem of her little red dress, pulling it up and over her butt and fluffy tail; you feel the collective intake of breath by everyone in the hall. The show's about to begin. "Noooo...! You can't do this...!" Refnir doesn't deign that with a response. Olivia wriggles in her restraints, but the stockade does its job; she can't see what's going on behind her, but most certainly feels it when the ex-jarl shreds her smallclothes with his claws and rams his throbbing red rocket right into Olivia without so much as allowing her to adjust. Refnir clearly intends to take out his corrupted frustrations on the little bratty dog, and it promises to be quite the show given how much he still particularly loathes her. Once he's done, he can release Olivia, maybe have her cleaned up if he's feeling charitable. Refnir slows down his thrusts just enough to give you a nod and grunt, then turns his undivided attention to making an example out of Olivia. The stockade rattles and shakes as he throws your court bard against it over and over again, letting go of himself in a fit of bestial fury; despite the wood rattling and chains jangling precariously as they pin Olivia in place, the stockade holds. The increasingly wet smacks of meat against meat, of Olivia's oversized tits slapping against the boards, how her yelps turn to whines as the air is crushed from her lungs over and over again — whether he means to or not, Refnir puts on a show for everyone in the great hall. As for Olivia... it's instructive to see her expression melt from shock, to pleading, then to whimpering resignation as the ex-jarl continues to pound her from behind, her ears turning down as sweat pours from her brow. Given the inclinations of the corrupted lupines and how Refnir's working himself into ever more of a bestial fury with each moment, you can imagine that the show will be going on for quite a while. It's going to be more of the same, just ever more intense by the moment... and you probably want to get back to whatever it was you were at before you were interrupted.
rows.translation: 是的，雷夫尼尔在这方面应该能发挥很好的作用。你只需发出通知，要求他前来帮忙，不久之后，那位前队长就会赶到。 [corlup.recruited |他从自己的办公室走出来，看上去一副威严十足的样子，还有几名下属跟在身后。 |在狱中度过那些岁月后，他如今只能拖着步子行走，同时努力活动那些僵硬的肌肉。 ]他皱起眉头，看着被束缚着的奥利维亚，然后又将目光转向你们两人。 “哦，原来如此。现在我们面对的是什么情况呢？” 你简要地向雷夫尼尔说明了奥利维亚到目前为止所犯下的错误，以及你希望他能够采取什么措施来纠正她这种对待他人的态度。 哼，原来她背叛了你，就像她背叛了阿斯盖尔一样；这种人从来只考虑自己的利益，这也难怪。一次背叛，永远都是背叛。” 奥利维亚愤怒地咆哮着，拼命挣扎着想要挣脱束缚。你让塔苏斯把我变成一个花瓶，而在你那愚蠢的会议结束后，却对那个老变态想把我变成繁殖犬场的计划视而不见。你真以为我会不知道吗？在这种情况下，你还怎么指望我对你保持忠诚呢？ 要么是你密谋对付我，要么就是你太无能、太天真，才会被那个阴险的老头给骗了！也许你真是个十足的肌肉笨蛋，因为他一直用永远无法实现的治愈承诺来哄骗你！” 很好，很好。看来这两个人之间仍然积压着许多怨恨；这场冲突肯定会让在场的所有人都大开眼界。你唯一的要求就是希望雷夫尼尔别把奥利维亚折腾得太狠：她的过错并没有那么严重。她并没有真正背叛你，只是相当不服管教。不过，在他这样的男人眼里，这也算不上什么严重的过错。 前队长对你所做的，只不过是冷哼了一声。他慢慢地、似乎经过深思熟虑之后，走到奥利维亚身后，抓住了她那条红色小裙子的下摆，将裙子拉了起来，盖过了她的屁股和那蓬松的尾巴……你感受到大厅里的所有人都同时屏住了呼吸——演出即将开始了。 “不……！你们不能这样……！” 然而，雷夫尼尔并没有给予任何回应。奥利维亚在束缚中挣扎着，但那些束缚确实起到了作用；她无法看到自己身后发生了什么，但当那位前酋长用爪子撕碎她的衣物，然后将自己那坚硬如火箭般的阴茎强行插入她的身体时，她无疑感受到了这一切。雷夫尼尔显然打算把那些积压在心中的怨恨发泄在这只调皮的小狗身上，考虑到他至今仍然对它怀有深深的厌恶，这场“表演”肯定会相当精彩。 等他做完这些，就可以释放奥利维亚了——如果他心情好一点，或许还会让她洗个澡。 雷夫尼尔略微放慢了自己的动作，只是轻轻点了点头，发出一声低吼，然后便全神贯注地开始惩罚奥利维亚。他将你的宫廷吟游诗人反复扔向栅栏，彻底释放了自己野性的愤怒；尽管木栅栏在震动，链条也在危险地叮当作响，但它们依然牢牢地固定着奥利维亚的位置。 肉与肉碰撞发出的湿漉漉的声音，奥利维亚那过大的胸部不断撞击木板发出的声响，还有她一次次被挤压得喘不过气来时发出的哀嚎——无论雷夫尼尔是否有意，他都在大厅里为所有人上演了一场戏。至于奥利维亚……看着她的表情从震惊、恳求，最终变成无奈的呜咽，实在很有意思。当那位前酋长继续从背后猛烈攻击她时，她的耳朵都耷拉了下来，汗水也从她的额头不断流淌下来。 考虑到那些被腐蚀的狼族们的倾向，以及雷夫尼尔每时每刻都在逐渐陷入更加狂暴的状态，你可以想象这场冲突还会持续相当长一段时间。接下来发生的都会是同样的事情，只不过会变得越来越激烈……而你大概也想要回到被中断之前正在做的事情上去了吧。

rows.original: You may not want to personally correct Olivia's behavior, but given how your court bard's gathering all kinds of stares in her current vulnerable position, you've got an entire hall of the willing on hand. That'll do just fine — you step behind Olivia, smack her on the rear firmly enough for her to yelp, and let the revelers know your court bard's up for grabs. Anyone who wants to can take her down a peg or two, so long as they don't mind it being in full view of the great hall. Olivia whimpers and shakes at her restraints. [dayNight |There must be at least several dozen people in the hall at this moment, all minding their own business up until now; just about every single demographic in the Marches is represented here |Even at this hour in the evening, there're a couple dozen people in the hall, mostly gathered about the fire for its warmth up until now ]. Foremost amongst them, though, is Olivia's audience — no doubt she'd been playing her usual tricks on the before you had her summoned to the vault. "You can't be serious. You can't really be putting me up to be used just as anyone pleases." No, you're quite serious about her punishment. You let her off easy the first time when you caught her sitting on your throne, so a simple reprimand clearly didn't take. What is she expecting you to do, lash her? No, you're above that — a little public humiliation will hit Olivia where it really hurts. Given how she's been playing the same tricks she did with the corrupted lupines and leading on her clientele with veiled suggestions regardling the possibility of sex in the unspecified future, having her actually come up with the goods for everyone she's been stringing along thus far is quite fitting, you'd say. "Noooo...! You can't do this...!" It's that attitude which got her stuck with the corrupted lupines to begin with; it's that attitude which keeps on imperiling the second chance she's been given. Perhaps once this lesson sinks in, she'll drop the haughty noblewoman act as being anything but a stage persona, and work with the rest of the wayfort. Besides, she'll be watched to ensure that the crowd doesn't go too far; she won't be of any use to you as a court bard if she's broken. Isn't that right, [var0 |Daliza? Your bailiff grimaces. She's clearly not too enthused at the whole affair, but salutes. "I have other duties, but I'll have a couple of my outriders make sure things don't get out of hand, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]." That'll do. That being said, she doesn't look too happy about it. "Don't get me wrong, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ] — your pet bard absolutely deserves this, it's effective for someone spoiled rotten like her, and I don't regret exposing her indiscretions in the least. It's just... all of this is a little too close to the way Alissa would've handled things for my comfort." |Farrah? The demoness grins wickedly. "You have my word on that, sweetie. Given the massive annoyance she's been to the smooth running of my business, breaking the noisy little bitch after a single bout of correction would be letting her off too lightly. I'll personally participate — actually, if you don't mind, I'll lead the effort in setting her straight." No doubt that's to ensure that nothing gets out of hand, and not because she wants first dibs on correcting a brat through lady love? "No reason it can't be both." |Rumie? "Me? But... um... okay, I guess." Your bee-tender blushes."The barrels should be in place by now, so I was hoping to get back to the bar —" Call it a hunch, but you think that most of Rumie's clientele will be occupied for a little while. That, and she deserves a bit of a sit-down after working so hard of late, doesn't she? That, and she's a bartender — despite her meek exterior, Rumie does know how to handle a rowdy crowd. "Well, I guess I can't say no. It'll be a change of pace." ] All right, then. Reaching down, you grab the hem of Olivia's little red dress, pulling it up and over her butt and fluffy tail to a collective intake of breath by everyone in the hall. Being in a position like this only underlines how much of a bimbo the corrupted lupines made her... and how vulnerable her desperate wriggling makes her look. Your job's done here. Ignoring Olivia's pleas for mercy, you turn your back on the high table and make to leave the great hall — the first of your court bard's squealing whines reach your ears as you turn the corner, rising to desperate, impassioned cries punctuated by the clink of chains as the commotion in the great hall grows. The increasingly wet smacks of meat against meat, of Olivia's oversized tits being suckled on, how her yelps turn to whines as the air is crushed from her lungs over and over again — all of that fades to blessed silence as you return to the vault and get back to what you were doing before you had to set domestic matters straight. Hopefully the lesson will sink in and your court bard will be less trouble for everyone here on out...
rows.translation: 你或许并不想亲自去纠正奥利维亚的行为，但考虑到你的宫廷吟游诗人在她目前这种脆弱的情况下吸引了众多目光，其实你手边有一大群愿意帮忙的人。这样就可以了——你走到奥利维亚身后，用力拍她的屁股，让她发出一声尖叫，然后让在场的所有人都知道，你的宫廷吟游诗人现在可以被“抢走”了。任何想要这么做的人都可以让她难堪一下，只要他们不介意这种事情发生在大厅里，让所有人都能看到就行。 奥利维亚在束缚中呜咽着，不停地挣扎。 [dayNight |此刻，大厅里至少有几十个人，他们之前都在各自做着自己的事；这里几乎汇聚了边境地区所有不同年龄段、不同背景的人。 |即使是在傍晚的这个时间，大厅里仍然有二三十个人，他们大多聚集在火堆旁，享受着它的温暖。 ]然而，其中最为重要的是奥利维亚的听众们——毫无疑问，在你将她召唤到地窖之前，她肯定已经在使用她那些惯用的伎俩来吸引他们的注意了。 “你不会是认真的吧？不可能真的你是在故意让我被人随意利用吧。” 不，你对她的惩罚确实是认真的。第一次抓到她坐在你的王座上时，你并没有严厉惩罚她，所以仅仅一次简单的斥责显然没有起到效果。她到底指望你做什么？揍她吗？不，你不会那么做的——让奥利维亚受到一些公开的羞辱，才会真正让她感到痛心。考虑到她一直以来都在使用那些和那些被腐蚀的狼族时用过的同样的手段，用一些含糊其辞的暗示来吸引她的客户，让他们期待未来可能会发生性关系，那么现在让她自己为那些她一直在欺骗的人承担后果，其实也是理所应当的，你说呢？ 不……！你不能这样……！” 正是这种态度，让她最初陷入了那些被污染的狼族之中；也正是这种态度，不断威胁着她所获得的第二次机会。或许，当她真正明白这个道理时，就会不再装作那种高傲的贵族女性，而真正与其他人一起合作，共同面对挑战。 此外，还会有人监视她，以确保人群不会行为过激；如果她出了问题，她就无法再为你担任宫廷吟游诗人了，对吧？ [var0 |达莉莎？ 你的执达员露出了不悦的表情。显然，她对这件事并不太感兴趣，但还是敬了个礼：“我还有其他事务要处理，但我会派几名手下去确保事情不会失控，大人。[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]就这样吧。不过，看她的样子，她似乎并不太高兴。” “别误会，我的意思是[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ] — 你的宠物吟游诗人绝对值得这样的对待，对于像她这样被宠坏的人来说，这种惩罚确实很有效，而且我一点也不后悔公开了她那些不当的行为。只是……这一切的处理方式，有点太接近艾莉莎会采取的方式了，让我感觉不太舒服。 |法拉？ 那个女恶魔邪恶地笑了。“我向你保证，亲爱的。考虑到她对我的生意造成的种种麻烦，仅仅在教训她一次之后就放她走，未免太轻饶她了。我会亲自参与其中——其实，如果你不介意的话，让我来负责引导这个过程，帮助她把事情处理好吧。 毫无疑问，这样做的目的是为了确保一切不会失控，而不是因为你想通过“女性特有的温柔”来优先纠正那个调皮的孩子吧？ 完全没有理由不能两者兼得。 |露米？ “我吗？但是……嗯……好吧，应该吧。”她的脸颊顿时泛起了红晕。“那些酒桶应该已经安置好了，所以我本来打算回到酒馆去……” 或许只是直觉，但你认为露米的大部分顾客在短时间内应该都会被占用吧。没错，而且她最近工作得太辛苦了，确实应该休息一下，不是吗？更何况她本来就是一名调酒师——尽管外表看起来很文静，但露米其实很擅长应付那些吵闹的人群。 “嗯，我想我也没理由拒绝吧。这会让人感到节奏有所变化。 ] 好吧，那么。他低下手，抓住了奥利维亚那条小红裙的裙摆，将裙子拉起来，盖过了她的屁股和蓬松的尾巴，这一幕让大厅里的所有人都倒吸了一口凉气。这样的场景更加凸显出那些被腐蚀的狼族把她变成了一个多么愚蠢、轻浮的女孩。…以及她那种拼命挣扎的样子，究竟让她显得多么脆弱。 你的任务到此为止了。 无视奥利维亚的恳求与哀求，你转身离开了大厅——就在你转过拐角的时候，宫廷吟游诗人的尖叫声首先传入了你的耳中，随后那些绝望而激昂的呼喊声也越来越激烈，其间还不时传来链条碰撞的声音，整个大厅里一片混乱。 肉与肉相互碰撞时发出的湿漉漉的声音，奥利维亚那巨大的乳房被吮吸时的感觉，以及她的尖叫声如何逐渐变成呜咽声——当你回到地窖，继续做那些在处理家庭琐事之前一直在做的事情时，所有这些声音都渐渐消失了，取而代之的，是令人耳目一新的寂静。希望大家能从中吸取教训，这样你们的宫廷吟游诗人以后就不会再给大家带来麻烦了……

Given the massive annoyance she's been to the smooth running of my business, breaking the noisy little bitch after a single bout of correction would be letting her off too lightly. I'll personally participate — actually, if you don't mind, I'll lead the effort in setting her straight." No doubt that's to ensure that nothing gets out of hand, and not because she wants first dibs on correcting a brat through lady love? "No reason it can't be both." |Rumie? "Me? But... um... okay, I guess." Your bee-tender blushes."The barrels should be in place by now, so I was hoping to get back to the bar —" Call it a hunch, but you think that most of Rumie's clientele will be occupied for a little while. That, and she deserves a bit of a sit-down after working so hard of late, doesn't she? That, and she's a bartender — despite her meek exterior, Rumie does know how to handle a rowdy crowd. "Well, I guess I can't say no. It'll be a change of pace." ] All right, then. Reaching down, you grab the hem of Olivia's little red dress, pulling it up and over her butt and fluffy tail to a collective intake of breath by everyone in the hall. Being in a position like this only underlines how much of a bimbo the corrupted lupines made her... and how vulnerable her desperate wriggling makes her look. Your job's done here. Ignoring Olivia's pleas for mercy, you turn your back on the high table and make to leave the great hall — the first of your court bard's squealing whines reach your ears as you turn the corner, rising to desperate, impassioned cries punctuated by the clink of chains as the commotion in the great hall grows. The increasingly wet smacks of meat against meat, of Olivia's oversized tits being suckled on, how her yelps turn to whines as the air is crushed from her lungs over and over again — all of that fades to blessed silence as you return to the vault and get back to what you were doing before you had to set domestic matters straight. Hopefully the lesson will sink in and your court bard will be less trouble for everyone here on out... "

rows.original: This is fine — the burden of shame is weighty enough on Olivia that you don't need to be more forceful in correcting her. Letting her stew in the stocks for several hours, in full view of the great hall... she won't be living this down for a good while. "You can't be doing this to me," Olivia groans. "All I did was —" You've already explained to her what the problem with her actions was, and aren't inclined to repeat yourself. If she'd actually been pilfering money from the treasury, you would've been well without your rights to throw her out of your home, at the very least. There's a whole gamut of rather embarrassing things that could be done to her while she's clapped tight in the stocks — you're being quite lenient in sparing her them. Olivia growls — or rather, tries to, as it comes out as far more of a whine than anything. Now then, [var0 |Daliza will make sure that no one tries anything funny with your court bard while she's in the stocks, yes? Your bailiff grimaces. She's clearly not too enthused at the whole affair, but salutes. "I have other duties that preclude me from babysitting a brat, but I'll have a couple of my outriders make sure things don't get out of hand, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. Look and not touch, so to speak." That'll do. That being said, she doesn't look too happy about it. "Don't get me wrong, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ] — your pet bard absolutely deserves this, it's effective for someone to whom influence is everything, and I don't regret exposing her indiscretions in the least. It's just... I need to remember that despite the outward similarities, this isn't how Alissa ran things, that your pet warrants a stint in the stocks." |Farrah will ensure that no one tries to touch the goods, won't she? The demoness smirks at you and arches an eyebrow. "I still say she should be on sale for the right price... although I won't overstep myself. Besides, finishing this right now would be letting her off far too lightly. You have my word as a merchant that no one will lay a finger on your pet, [pc.name]." That'll do. So long as she doesn't get bored. "Trust me, I won't. I think I'm going to enjoy this very much, dear." |Rumie will keep Olivia safe and ensure that she isn't punished any more than she ought to be, right? Your bee-tender scratches her head and buzzes in place. "We-ll, [pc.name], there's the matter of the bar..." Move it up here for a bit — there's going to be an audience for the show Olivia's putting on, and they'll be getting thirsty. She'll be getting lots of patrons that way, far more than if she remained at her post. "I-I guess you're right!" ] All right, then, your job's done here. If Olivia doesn't make a fuss, she might be able to come out the other end of this with some of her dignity intact — She tries to kick you and snarls in a most undignified and unladylike manner. — Or maybe not. Turning your back on the high table, you make to leave the great hall, ignoring all the noise Olivia's making every step of the way. Hopefully she'll have rethought her position after several hours...
rows.translation: 这样也挺好——奥利维亚已经背负了足够的羞耻感，你没必要再强行纠正她了。让她在大厅里羞愧地待上几个小时……她这一辈子都忘不了这件事的。 你不能这样对我，”奥利维亚呻吟道，“我只不过是……” 你已经向她解释过她的行为到底有什么问题，也不想再重复一遍了。如果她真的从家里偷钱的话，至少你也有权利把她赶出去。当她被牢牢地绑在枷锁中时，有各种各样相当尴尬的事情都可能发生在她身上——你对她还算比较宽容，没有让她遭受那些事情。 奥利维亚试图发出低吼，但实际上发出的声音更像是一声哀怨。 那么， [var0 |当你的宫廷吟游诗人在枷锁中时，达莉莎会确保没有人敢对他做出什么不当举动，对吧？ 你的法警面露不悦之色——显然他对这件事并不太感兴趣，但还是敬了个礼：“我还有其他职责要处理，实在没时间照看这个调皮鬼，不过我会派几名护卫去确保事情不会失控。[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]可以说，就是看看而已，不要动手。” 这样就行了。不过，看她那样子，似乎并不太高兴。 “别误会我的意思，先生[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ] — 你的宠物吟游诗人确实值得这样的惩罚，对于那些将影响力视为一切的人来说，这种惩罚确实有效，而且我一点也不后悔公开了她那些不当的行为。只是……我需要记住，尽管表面上看两者有些相似，但阿丽莎并不是这样处理事情的，你的宠物确实应该被“关进笼子里”一段时间。 |法拉一定会确保没有人敢动那些货，对吧？ 那个女恶魔对你露出讥笑的表情，挑了挑眉毛：“我还是觉得，只要价格合适，这些货就应该被卖出去……不过我也不会越界。再说，现在就把它们处理掉，未免太便宜她了。作为商人，我向你保证，绝对不会有人敢动你的宠物一根毫毛。 [pc.name]这样就可以了。只要她不会感到无聊就行。” “相信我，她不会无聊的。我觉得我会非常享受这个过程的，亲爱的。 |露米会保护奥利维亚的安全，确保她不会受到超出应得范围的惩罚，对吧？ 你的小蜜蜂挠了挠头，然后在原地嗡嗡叫着：“嗯[pc.name]，还有酒吧那件事……” “把它移到这里来吧——奥利维亚要举办的这场表演肯定会有很多人来看，他们肯定会口渴的。这样她就能吸引很多顾客，比她继续待在原来的位置上要多得多。” “我……我想你是对的！ ] 好的，那么你的任务到这里就结束了。如果奥利维亚不闹事的话，她应该能够顺利度过这个难关。一些她的尊严丝毫未受损害—— 她试图踢你，还用极其不体面、不符合淑女身份的方式咆哮着。 —— 或者也未必如此。你转身离开高桌，径直走向大厅出口，完全无视奥利维亚一路上发出的那些吵闹声。希望几个小时后，她能重新考虑自己的行为……

rows.original: Odd. Olivia isn't in her usual seat at the high table [dayNight |today |this evening ]. While she may be an aggravating little dog at times, you've yet to know her for the sin of sloth; she enjoys being the centre of attention too much for that. A quick look around the great hall turns up no sign of your court bard, either — wherever Olivia's entertaining whatever company she has, it isn't in here, to be sure. You're just about to call it quits when a faint but unmistakable screech comes to you through the wayfort's ancient walls: that of a very small, angry dog. Right, the chambers Olivia's claimed for herself are close to the great hall to reduce the distance between her and her work; your court bard's one to mix business and pleasure. What you didn't expect, though, as you step out of the great hall and into the corridors, is that of Drifa's voice raised in opposition to Olivia's, [drifa.isCorrupted |just a smidge less menacing even if it's not for lack of trying |as uncharacteristic of [drifa.isMarried |your wife |her ] as it may be ]. Indeed, as you hurry on, the argument only grows more heated — you catch some snippets here and there, but it's clear that this catfight has been going on long before you even caught wind of it. This wing of the wayfort is less-traveled to the point where the [drifa.isCorrupt |wolf |dog ]-girls haven't bothered closing the door to Olivia's chambers, allowing you to catch snippets of their screaming match as you draw close. Or maybe it's simply gotten heated to the point where neither of them care... [drifa.isCorrupt |"Olivia, Olivia. If you'd just let yourself think before running your mouth, perhaps none of this would be necessary —" "I know this game, bitch. I've played it myself, far longer than you have, so you can drop the cool, unruffled demeanor. You gods-damn well know that this was inevitable because you planned it that way." "Oh, no doubt. But I do have a lot of things going on, especially when it comes to [pc.name], so you'll excuse me if I don't remember exactly what's gotten you so aggrieved. No doubt it's really important to someone as shameless as you, but it looks like our priorities don't match up." |"Olivia, I'm trying to understand where you're coming from, but you're making it hard for me. I'm trying to be reasonable here, so if you could just explain —" "I've explained it well enough, you're just too much of a goody-two-shoes. From anyone else, I'd have dismissed it as an act, but you might just be genuine about it. And actually, that makes me even more mad than if you were faking it!" A sigh. "Explain it to me like I'm an idiot, then." ] "Just look at you!" Olivia snaps. "[drifa.isCorrupt |I know you have some spine and self-dignity — so that makes it all the more disgusting that you'd debase yourself so utterly and completely before [pc.name]. Like, why? It's one thing to not have it to begin with, but to have it and deliberately set it aside? At this point, is there anything you'd deny [pc.name]?" Drifa thinks a moment, [drifa.isCollared |unthinkingly tugging at the collar about her throat as she genuinely processes |genuinely processing ] Olivia's pointed question. Then, a wolfish yet dreamy smile spreads over her lips. "Oh. I'd definitely deny [pc.name] if [pc.heShe] ever thought of abandoning me. [drifa.isMarried |We're married now, and I fully intend to take the whole %'till death do us part' thing extremely seriously |Well, I'd do far more than simply deny [pc.himHer], but you get my point ]." "That's not what I meant, and you know it!" "Why, whatever else would you mean, Olivia? Don't project yourself onto me — then again, the best the likes of you could get were Asgeir and Tharsus. Hardly the most trustworthy of characters. "Maybe the problem isn't with me, have you considered that? Maybe the problem's with you, that you've got to see two people thinking alike as one of them being not thinking at all. And if it's the right person... then why should that be a problem to begin with?" "Of course it's a problem! If you don't control your own decisions and make your own choices, what do you have?" "Oh, I don't know." At this point, both women have drawn ever closer by some strange magnetism, one wolf against another in unspoken challenge. "To be perfectly honest, I think you're protesting this a little too deeply — odd, for someone who should've been raised to be aware of the responsibilities expected of her in exchange for her privileges. Somehow, I don't think you'd have taken my simple life in exchange for the relative freedom, would you? No, you love the trappings of comfort too much. "So, Olivia... what's so terrible about believing in [pc.name]? It's better in believing in sweet cakes and dry wines like you do, and considerably more satisfying than trying to keep on top of everything all the time." [drifa.isCollared |"And you don't mind having a collar put on you?" "Why should I? Collars are for animals. I am an animal." Drifa shows the other wolfess her teeth. "It's not just fitting, it's perfectly right. Oh, I was a little apprehensive about wearing such a thing at first, but now I don't think I could live without it. After all, it's from [pc.name]." "It also makes you [pc.hisHer] pet!" "So?" The sheer blitheness with which Drifa replies is enough to shock Olivia to snarling. "Nothing wrong with that; if it's [pc.name]'s pet that I'm to be, it's more than I could ever have hoped for. This token of affection I wear and which you seek to deride — it doesn't disgust you. No, it makes you envious, doesn't it? |"And you're just content to leave your fate to [pc.name]?!" "Why not? [pc.HeShe] has a far clearer vision for the future for me — for you — and [pc.heShe]'s possessed of the will and power to see it through. I realized... power is something that you are, Olivia. You can't beg, borrow, steal, or bargain for it. Not for long. [pc.name] is power. "And in that case, why shouldn't I leave my fate to someone who can handle it better than I could?" "Because you should make your own decisions for yourself!" "Is that so?" The sheer blitheness with which Drifa replies is enough to shock Olivia to snarling. "Have you ever trusted anyone, Olivia? Has anyone ever willingly trusted you? Given where and what station you come from... you've always had to watch your back for fear of finding a knife in it, haven't you? Even in idyllic Clairemont? I loved and trusted my family, one of the benefits of being lowborn. But you've never had that, have you? Is that why you can't feel comfortable letting go? ] "Perhaps you should spend less time plotting how to get people to like you, and more time simply accepting the love that others are willing to lavish upon your undeserving butt just because you don't like the form it takes." |There's being a goody-two-shoes, and there's utterly debasing yourself before someone else — the first is already annoying enough, but the other just takes the cake. At this point, is there even any dignity left in you? Is there anything that you'd conceivably say no to [pc.name]?" Drifa thinks a moment, [drifa.isCollared |unthinkingly tugging at the collar about her throat as she genuinely processes |genuinely processing ] Olivia's pointed question. Then, she shakes her head. "Why would I?" "That's what I mean! Are you a dog, or a wolf? Don't you have a single independent thought in that head of yours, or is it all mush?" "I do, but it's not hard to come to the same conclusions as [pc.name] does on a lot of things. And honestly, Olivia —" Drifa steps forward and pinches the other woman on the cheek — "I think you do protest a little too much. [drifa.isCollared |At first, I was a little apprehensive about this collar, but I don't think I could live without it any more. There's something so romantic about being able to trust someone that deeply that [drifa.isMarried |you don't just marry that person, but also take things to the point where ]you'd leave the important decisions to them, right? What would be the point in trusting [pc.name] if I didn't feel comfortable letting [pc.himHer] make the decisions [pc.heShe]'s better positioned to make |Is it really that bad to leave the heavy decisions to someone else who's better positioned to make them? I trust my dear [pc.name], after all[drifa.isMarried |, enough to marry [pc.himHer] ]. What would be the point in that if I didn't feel at ease leaving some of my decisions to [pc.himHer], and the other way around, too? ]? All I have to do is focus on my tasks around the wayfort and anything [pc.name] asks of me — the rest is beyond my pay grade." ]
rows.translation: 奇怪，奥利维亚并没有坐在高桌上她惯常的位置上。 [dayNight |今天 |今晚 ]虽然她有时候会表现得像个惹人烦的小狗，但你也从未见过她有懒惰的毛病；她太喜欢成为众人关注的焦点了，根本不可能犯这种错误。在大厅里快速扫视一圈，也没有发现你的宫廷吟游诗人的踪迹——不管奥利维亚现在正在和谁一起消遣，肯定不在这里。 就在你准备放弃的时候，一阵微弱却清晰刺耳的叫声从传送门的古老墙壁中传了过来——那是一只非常小、而且显得非常愤怒的狗发出的声音。没错，奥利维亚选定的那些房间就位于大厅附近，这样她就可以减少往返工作地点所需的距离；而你的宫廷吟游诗人选择的房间，则正好能让他在工作与娱乐之间找到平衡。然而，当你走出大厅走进走廊时，你并没有预料到会听到德莉法的声音与奥利维亚的声音激烈地对峙起来。 [drifa.isCorrupted |虽然已经尽力让它看起来不那么具有威胁性了，但还是稍微差那么一点而已。 |这与的风格完全不符。 [drifa.isMarried |你的妻子 |她 ]无论如何 ]的确，随着你继续深入调查，争论变得越来越激烈了——你偶尔能听到一些零星的言论，但很明显，这场激烈的争执在你得知之前就已经持续了很长时间。这个方向通道的这一段路很少有人经过，以至于[drifa.isCorrupt |狼 |狗 ]那些女孩们甚至都懒得关上奥利维亚的房间门，因此当你靠近时，就能听到她们激烈争吵的声音。又或许，争吵已经变得如此激烈，以至于她们根本不再在意别人是否听到…… [drifa.isCorrupt |奥利维亚，奥利维亚。如果你能在说话之前先好好思考一下，也许这一切都不必发生——” “我太了解这个游戏了，贱人。我自己玩过，玩的时间比你长多了，所以你别再装出一副冷静沉着的样子了。你们心里很清楚，这种事情本来就是不可避免的你是这样安排好的。哦，毫无疑问。不过我现在确实有很多事情要处理，尤其是在这方面[pc.name]，所以，如果我不太记得是什么事情让您如此恼火，还请见谅。对于像您这样厚颜无耻的人来说，这件事肯定非常重要，但看来我们的优先事项并不一致。 |奥利维亚，我尝试中我理解你的立场，但你现在让我的处境变得很困难。我一直在努力尝试合理的在这里，所以如果你能解释一下的话——” “我已经解释得很清楚了，只是你太过于循规蹈矩、过于正直了。换作别人，我可能会认为这只是装样子，但对你来说，或许你真的是这么想的。其实，这一点反而让我更加更多简直比你装傻还要生气！” “唉，那就像给我讲给白痴听一样，详细解释给我听吧。 ] 看看你现在的样子！”奥利维亚厉声说道。[drifa.isCorrupt |我知道你还有些骨气与尊严——因此，你竟会如此彻底地贬低自己，这一点反而更加令人作呕。 [pc.name]比如说，为什么呢？一开始就没有这个东西是一回事，但明明有了却故意把它搁置一旁？到了这个地步，还有什么是你愿意否认的吗？ [pc.name]迪拉法思考了一会儿， [drifa.isCollared |她不由自主地拉了拉脖子上的衣领，同时仍在认真地思考着这件事。 |真正地进行处理 ]奥利维亚提出了那个尖锐的问题。随后，她嘴角浮现出一丝既狼吞虎咽又充满幻想的微笑。 “哦，我明白了。当然拒绝[pc.name]如果[pc.heShe]有没有想过抛弃我。 [drifa.isMarried |我们现在结婚了，我真心打算把“至死不离”这句话当作一句严肃的承诺来遵守。 |嗯，我做的可远远不止是简单地予以否认。 [pc.himHer]你明白我的意思吧。 ]我不是这个意思，你心里明白的！” “哦，那你到底想说什么呢，奥利维亚？别把你的想法强加给我——话说回来，像你这样的人，能得到的最好的选择也只有阿斯盖尔和塔尔斯斯了。他们根本不是最值得信任的人选。 ]…你从不放弃帮助别人，这正是你最优秀的品质。我并不指望奥利维亚会很快改变态度，但至少我们已经开始尝试了，不是吗？当然，她内心仍然充满了怨恨，正是这样的经历让我庆幸自己并非出身于一个高高在上的家庭。但是……我觉得她不可能否认那种真挚的同情与关爱确实存在，毕竟她已经体验过了。这种感觉简直会上瘾……我深有体会，因为我也忍不住一再想要体验它。 “我们能不能稍后再继续这个话题呢？ [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ]？ 请。我应该不会花太长时间就能让奥利维亚安顿下来，然后……嗯……虽然这次相处很愉快，但我真的希望接下来能只我们两个人在一起，暂时远离其他人。”德莉法用她那最可爱的眼神看着你，她的情绪似乎已经完全恢复了。你微笑着回应她[drifa.isMarried |你的“狗老婆 |狗女孩 ] [drifa.isPregnant |她将手放在自己凸出的小肚子上，轻轻抚摸着那里，确保你在看着她，然后才完全沉浸在这个动作中。“嗯，就是这个三我们当中啊。感觉已经有很久没有好好拥抱过了，而因为我现在这么大了，这意味着我有更多的身体可以让你依偎在身边，对吧？ |[drifa.hasKids |她心不在焉地用手指轻轻划过自己的身体，然后摇了摇头。“哼，奥利维亚说我变胖了……不过，如果这是为了你和我们的家庭，我一点也不介意。她真的不明白那些真正关心他人的人是怎么想的。 我只是想和你单独在一起而已。 [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ]即使只是短暂的时间也好。这个世界很残酷，但你的存在让我感到安心。 |她看起来随时都可能像一只真正的狗一样开始乞讨，她明亮的眼睛和充满爱意的笑容中流露出一股迫切的心情。“如果你真的愿意的话，我并不介意把你分享给别人。 [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ]但是……我真的很珍惜我们在一起的那些时光。难道我们就不能再有一次这样的机会吗？尤其是在经历了那些之后这个求你了？ ] ] ] rows.raw: " It's no use fighting it — Olivia's pride is no match for both Drifa's [drifa.isCorrupt |lewd encouragement |eager guidance ] and your firm patting all at once. With her haughty facade crumbled in the face of loving pleasure, the little yappy dog can't help but follow her instincts and push her head into your palm while Drifa looks on with [drifa.isCorrupt |perverse glee at having snagged a new toy for you |delight at having someone to share her joy with ]. "Noooo..." the little [pc.isDK |bitch |yappy dog ] whines in between gasps. "This can't be happening to meeee..." Disbelief that she's been caught in such a neatly-laid trap, or disbelief that the affections her cynical self always dismissed as fairy tales turned out to exist after all? Her words say the former, her expression and demeanor say the latter. You finish up your headpatting by pushing your fingertips against Drifa and Olivia's heads, eliciting yet another whining orgasm from the latter while the former shivers and feeds her salacious prurience into the littler dog with [drifa.isCorrupt |firm kisses |gentle caresses ], then step back to admire your handiwork. The two [drifa.isCorrupt |wolf |dog ]-girls may have forgotten the argument that sparked all this to begin with, but you haven't... and to be honest, you'd say that Drifa won handily. [drifa.isCorrupt |"I didn't ask you for your help, [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master], ]but thanks for setting things right." Smirking, Drifa squeezes Olivia against her side, the littler canine still trembling with orgasmic aftershocks. "You were very persuasive — I couldn't have made that argument on my own." And you couldn't have been as effective as you were without her helping. Hopefully this will get Olivia to come around to her way of thinking. "Oh, I wouldn't expect a complete about-face, not from a frigid bitch like her; there's a lot of guarded bitterness in that bratty body of hers, and not all of it is unwarranted. But... it's a start. Like me, once she's tasted the truth, she won't be able to help herself but keep coming back for more. "And speaking of more, [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master], ]why don't you come by my place when I've finished putting away this minx? Headpats are nice and all, but what I really want is your undivided attention." Flattening her ears, Drifa [drifa.isPregnant |arches her back and pushes out her tummy, cradling her puppy pudge in both hands. "Carrying your puppies in my belly all day gets me all hot and bothered, and butting heads with this bitch has made it even worse. If you want to thank me for helping you make your point... surely you can reward the mother of your pups by having a little alone time with her?" |[drifa.hasKids |looks down at herself and runs her hands over her sides, realization on her face as if it's only now that she's noticed she's nude. A small, cold smile works its way onto Drifa's lips as she regards you, affection without warmth, as it were. "I want to relive some private memories with you, if get my drift." |shakes her head slowly, a small cold smile playing on her lips. "I guess I can be selfish at times, can't I? Although I don't mind getting you another bitch to play and fuck with if that's what makes you happy, I also want you all to myself, [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ]. We have history, after all." ] ] |"Thanks, [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ]," Drifa says, heaving a sigh of relief as the tension in the air starts unwinding. "I got pretty mad back there — if you hadn't stepped in and straightened out the both of us, it'd have turned into a screaming match." A little more than a screaming match, but yes. While you're glad that Drifa's so passionate about defending you to others, she wouldn't have gotten anywhere just butting her head against that wall. It's far more effective to quickly find and exploit chinks in an opponent's armor. "Yeah. I just... well, I kind of feel sorry for Olivia." Drifa looks a little sheepish, flattening her ears. "If I'd lost hope to everyone and everything to the extent that she had, I'm not sure there'd be any reason for me to keep on going. Spite simply won't do it for me." She's a good girl,[drifa.isMarried | which is why you married her; a good girl is ] something that Olivia is most certainly not. "Hee hee. Yeah. [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ]... you don't give up on people, which is the best thing about you. I don't expect Olivia to come around anytime soon, but we've made a start, haven't we? Sure, there's a lot of guarded bitterness in her, and it's stuff like this that makes me thank Lumia that I wasn't born all high and mighty. But... I don't think she can deny that genuine compassion and affection exists, not after having tasted it. It's horribly addictive... I'd know, because I can't help but keep coming back for more. "Can we please continue this later, [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ]? Please? It won't take me too long to get Olivia settled, and then... well... sure, this was fun, but I really want it to just be the both of us for a little while." Drifa makes her best puppy-dog eyes at you, her good spirits restored. Grinning, [drifa.isMarried |your dog-wife |the dog-girl ] [drifa.isPregnant |lays a hand atop her protruding tummy and caresses the top of her puppy pudge, making sure you're watching before really losing herself in it. "Well, just the three of us. It feels like forever since we've had a good cuddle, and since I'm so big that just means there's more of me to snuggle up against, right?" |[drifa.hasKids |absent-mindedly trails her fingers down her sides, then shakes her head. "Hmph. Olivia said I was getting fatter... well, if it's for you and our family, I don't mind in the least. She really doesn't understand how those who genuinely care for others think. "I just want to be alone with you, [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ], even if for a little while. It's an ugly world out there, but you make me feel safe." |looks fit to start begging like an actual dog any time, eagerness radiating from her bright eyes and loving smile. "I don't mind sharing you with others if that's what you want, [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ], but... I do treasure the moments we have together. Can't we please have another, especially after this? Please?" ] ] ] Perhaps later, once she's dealt with a very dazed Olivia. For now, your job here is done — you've put the annoying little dog in her place, hopefully with a lesson she won't be forgetting in a hurry. If it improves Olivia's attitude towards others, it'll have been worth it. "

rows.original: The great hall's unusually empty [dayNight |for this time of day, when all kinds of people would be out and about. Normally, you'd have expected to hear the clink of mugs amidst the hubbub of voices |even for the evening, the fire dying low in the pit and conversation muted. You'd have figured that most still awake at this hour would've gathered together against the chill of the Marches air ], but there's a tension lingering in the atmosphere. The reason for that soon becomes clear: the great hall's occupants are very pointedly ignoring a pair of gothmanders, keeping clear from the duo who've claimed a table for their own. Noticing you, the astrida set aside their drinks, rise from their seats and step towards you, stopping at a respectful distance and [pc.swornGod nareva |saluting you. "Champion of our goddess." At ease, at ease; there's no need to be so stiff about titles. What's up? |giving you a small bow. "[pc.isBaron |Baron[pc.mf | |ness ] |[pc.name], I presume ]?" That'd be you. What brings the order to your holdings, then? ] "Official business. No need to be tense, [pc.swornGod nareva |our goddess doesn't have need of your services just yet |we aren't 'out to get you', as some might put it ]. I'm Lydia, and this is Amalthea." You haven't kept them waiting long, have you? "An hour or two. We haven't been bored, this place has historical merit." How did they know you'd be in the wayfort? Your schedule is irregular, to say the least. Given how you take off over the Marches as you please, the two of them could've been waiting for an age. [pc.swornGod nareva |"As you know, Champion, the goddess reveals fair few of her secrets," Lydia says, "but she did mention that you'd be in at this time. You must mean quite a lot to her for her to pay such attention to your comings and goings." Well, that only makes sense. You're her personally anointed champion, after all. "Legend in Tychris has it that the goddess is able to see out of every astrida's eyes, but she has never deemed fit to confirm or deny such rumors," Amalthea adds. "Nevertheless, here we are." |"The goddess said that you'd be in at this time, [pc.title]," Lydia says with a nod. "As for how she knew that, it's not our place to question. Few are the secrets which she reveals unnecessarily." Oh, there's no need for all that. [var0 |You are married into the en Tychris line, after all; it's only natural that the patron goddess of the royal family would keep an eye on you. Why, you're even a little flattered. |[pc.isDK |You've been tramping all around the Marches, kicking ass and taking names. Of course gods, let alone the nosiest of them all, would be interested in your doings. |In the relatively short time that you've been in the Marches, all sorts of things have been happening at a frightening pace. That the goddess who's well-known for keeping tabs on these things would be following your actions is hardly surprising. ] ] Amalthea coughs. "Whatever the goddess' reasons for knowing your whereabouts at any time, here we are." ] Yes, here they are. Now... what brings the two of them all the way from Tychris?
rows.translation: 大厅里空得出奇[dayNight |照这个时间段来说，本该有各式各样的人在外面走动。平时你还能在嘈杂的人声中听见酒杯相碰的叮当声 |可即便到了傍晚，火坑里的火也快熄了，谈话声也压得很低。你本以为这个点还没睡的人会聚在一起，好抵挡边境地区的寒气 ]，可空气里却萦绕着一股紧张感。原因很快就清楚了：大厅里的其他人都在刻意无视那两个哥特曼德，远远避开了这对独占了一张桌子的搭档。 注意到你之后，这些阿斯特里达教团成员放下酒杯，从座位上起身朝你走来，在保持礼貌距离的地方停下，[pc.swornGod nareva |向你敬礼。 “我们女神的冠军。” 放松，放松；不必对头衔这么拘谨。有什么事吗？ |向你微微鞠了一躬。 “[pc.isBaron |男爵[pc.mf | |夫人 ] |[pc.name]，我猜 ]？” 那就是你了。那么，是什么风把教团吹到你的领地上来的？ ] “公事。不必紧张，[pc.swornGod nareva |我们的女神暂时还用不上你的效力 |我们并不是有些人说的那种要来找你麻烦的人 ]。我叫莉迪亚，这位是阿玛尔西娅。” 你应该没让他们等太久吧？ “一两个小时吧。我们倒没觉得无聊，这地方挺有历史价值的。” 她们怎么知道你会来驿堡？你的行程至少可以说是毫无规律。考虑到你在边境地区想飞就飞，这两位本可能等上很久很久。 [pc.swornGod nareva |“如你所知，冠军，女神很少透露她的秘密，”莉迪亚说，“但她确实提到过你会在这时候回来。她如此关注你的来去行踪，你对她来说一定意义非凡。” 嗯，这倒也说得通。毕竟你可是她亲自册封的冠军。 “提克里斯有传说称，女神能透过每一位阿斯特里达的眼睛看世界，但她从未表态证实或否认过这种传言，”阿玛尔西娅补充道。“不管怎样，我们来了。” |“女神说过你会在这个时候回来，[pc.title]，”莉迪亚点头说道。“至于她怎么知道的，就不是我们该追问的了。她无缘无故透露的秘密少之又少。” 哦，用不着这么拘礼。[var0 |你确实是嫁进了恩·提克里斯家族的人；王室的女神自然会照看你。说真的，你还有点受宠若惊呢。 |[pc.isDK |你一直在边境地区四处闯荡，揍人立威，扬名立万。当然会有神——更别提最爱管闲事的那个——对你的所作所为感兴趣。 |你来到边境地区的时间相对不长，各种事情却以惊人的速度接连发生。那位以密切关注这类事情而闻名遐迩的女神会追踪你的行动，一点也不奇怪。 ] ] 阿玛尔西娅咳了一声。“无论女神出于什么理由随时知道你的行踪，反正我们来了。” ] 是啊，他们来了。那么……这两位为什么会从提克里斯一路赶来呢？

rows.original: "Well, [pc.swornGod nareva |Champion, ]it's less to do with you, and more someone currently under your roof. And it's less that the person in question has actually committed any offense under the order's jurisdiction, but has raised cause for concern." "Olivia Bellamon Leroux is currently in residence here, isn't she?" Yes, Olivia's your court bard, yes, she's living in the wayfort, and yes, she's probably not too far away at the moment. What's the little [pc.isDK |bitch |dog ] done this time that's got the order worried? "It's less of what she has done, and more of what she has on her. A Tychrisian spellsinger — several of which have been entrusted to various houses for centuries now." "House Leroux has been rather concerned that its heir withdrew it from the family vault without asking and has gone 'on a romantic escapade', to use their words." So Olivia stole the spellsinger from her own family and slipped all the way up north — after the business with your own finances, you're not surprised that she was more than willing to help herself to things she felt entitled to. Well then, you suppose that the order will be wanting their artifact back? Lydia coughs. "Actually, that's what we're here to determine[pc.swornGod nareva |, [pc.mf |sir |ma'am ] ]." Could she explain? "Our investigations so far have been quite favorable to the young lady Leroux. After questioning those who survived the corrupted lupines, not only was she coerced into her circumstances, but throughout the entire ordeal did not use the spellsinger to further their plans, something which by all accounts she came under considerable pressure to do from her captors. Neither did she participate in the perpetration of many of the atrocities which were committed, although it's arguable that she was being held back for her role later on. "Since no abuse of magical power was involved on her part, the order is inclined to weigh in on the spellsinger's theft as an internal matter of House Leroux, and hence beyond our jurisdiction. While our detractors enjoy tarring us as fanatical witch-hunters, we do our best to be reasonable in our inquisitorial efforts.[pc.swornGod nareva | Now that you're one of us, [pc.mf |sir |ma'am ], I fully expect plenty of mud-slinging to come your way, especially as our goddess' anointed champion. ]" There's a catch, though. They wouldn't be here otherwise. Amalthea nods. "Yes. As things stand, Olivia is... unstable, to use a euphemism. Despite her behavior up to this point, we understand that she shares in the affliction of the lupines; thus, it may become necessary to reclaim her spellsinger as a precautionary measure." But Olivia hasn't done anything, has she? "Not yet. The possibility she might do so — that is what we're here to assess, to hear her side of the story and see if the risk in allowing her to keep the spellsinger is acceptable." You look between Lydia and Amalthea, the gothmanders' expressions as stiff as boards, and sigh. Would they like you to call Olivia in, then? "Please."
rows.translation: 嗯， [pc.swornGod nareva |冠军， ]这其实与你关系不大，而是与目前住在你这里的那个人有关。问题并不在于这个人是否真的违反了该法令的管辖范围，而在于他/她确实引发了一些令人担忧的行为或情况。 “奥利维亚·贝拉蒙·勒鲁目前住在这里，对吧？” 是的，奥利维亚是你们法庭的吟游诗人，她确实住在韦弗特，而且现在她应该就在附近吧……到底是什么事情呢？ [pc.isDK |贱人 |狗 ]这次的事情让那些贵族们感到担忧，其实并不是因为她做了什么，而是因为她身上拥有什么。她带着一件提克里斯咒歌者——几个世纪以来，她掌握的这些法术一直被委托给不同的家族来保管。勒鲁家族一直很担心他们的继承人未经允许就从家族金库中取出了那些物品，然后‘去进行一场浪漫的冒险’了，用他们的话来说就是。” 所以，奥利维亚从自己家族手中带走了那件咒歌者，然后一路向北逃去了——在经历了那些财务纠纷之后，你也不会感到惊讶，她竟然会毫不犹豫地拿走那些她认为自己有权得到的东西。那么，你认为他们会要求取回自己的神器吧？ 莉迪亚轻咳了一声：“其实，我们正是来确认这个问题的。[pc.swornGod nareva |， [pc.mf |先生 |女士 ] ]她能解释一下吗？” “我们目前的调查结果对勒鲁小姐来说相当有利。在询问了那些从那些被腐蚀的狼族手中幸存下来的人之后，我们发现她并非是被迫陷入这种境地的，而且在整个过程中，她也没有利用那件咒歌者来帮助他们实现他们的计划——尽管据所有人说，她的俘虏们对她施加了很大的压力，要求她这么做。她也没有参与那些暴行的实施，尽管有人认为，正是由于她日后要扮演的角色，她才被限制了行动自由。 “由于她没有滥用魔法力量，因此法庭倾向于将这件咒歌者失窃视为勒鲁家族内部的矛盾，因此不属于我们的管辖范围。虽然那些批评我们的人喜欢将我们描绘成狂热的迫害者，但我们在进行调查时确实会尽力保持理性。[pc.swornGod nareva | 现在你已经成为我们的一员了， [pc.mf |先生 |女士 ]我完全预料到，你会面临大量的诋毁和攻击，尤其是作为我们女神指定的冠军之后。 ]不过，这其中有一个隐含的条件——如果不是因为这个原因，他们也不会出现在这里。 阿玛尔西娅点了点头：“没错。目前的情况是，奥利维亚……可以用‘情绪不稳定’这个委婉的说法来形容她。尽管她到目前为止的表现还算正常，但我们知道，她同样受到了那种‘狼族症候群’的影响；因此，为了预防万一，我们可能有必要将她重新收归我们的管理之下。” 但是，奥利维亚并没有完成没有吧？然而她有可能这么做——这就是我们今天要来评估的事情。我们需要听听她的解释，看看允许她继续保留这件咒歌者所带来的风险是否可以接受。” 你将目光在莉迪亚和阿玛尔西娅之间转来转去，看到这两位哥特女巫的表情僵硬得像木板一样，于是叹了口气。那么，她们是希望你把奥利维亚叫进来吗？ “请吧。
rows.raw: " "Well, [pc.swornGod nareva |Champion, ]it's less to do with you, and more someone currently under your roof. And it's less that the person in question has actually committed any offense under the order's jurisdiction, but has raised cause for concern." "Olivia Bellamon Leroux is currently in residence here, isn't she?" Yes, Olivia's your court bard, yes, she's living in the wayfort, and yes, she's probably not too far away at the moment. What's the little [pc.isDK |bitch |dog ] done this time that's got the order worried? "It's less of what she has done, and more of what she has on her. A Tychrisian spellsinger — several of which have been entrusted to various houses for centuries now." "House Leroux has been rather concerned that its heir withdrew it from the family vault without asking and has gone 'on a romantic escapade', to use their words." So Olivia stole the spellsinger from her own family and slipped all the way up north — after the business with your own finances, you're not surprised that she was more than willing to help herself to things she felt entitled to. Well then, you suppose that the order will be wanting their artifact back? Lydia coughs. "Actually, that's what we're here to determine[pc.swornGod nareva |, [pc.mf |sir |ma'am ] ]." Could she explain? "Our investigations so far have been quite favorable to the young lady Leroux. After questioning those who survived the corrupted lupines, not only was she coerced into her circumstances, but throughout the entire ordeal did not use the spellsinger to further their plans, something which by all accounts she came under considerable pressure to do from her captors. Neither did she participate in the perpetration of many of the atrocities which were committed, although it's arguable that she was being held back for her role later on. "Since no abuse of magical power was involved on her part, the order is inclined to weigh in on the spellsinger's theft as an internal matter of House Leroux, and hence beyond our jurisdiction. While our detractors enjoy tarring us as fanatical witch-hunters, we do our best to be reasonable in our inquisitorial efforts.[pc.swornGod nareva | Now that you're one of us, [pc.mf |sir |ma'am ], I fully expect plenty of mud-slinging to come your way, especially as our goddess' anointed champion. ]" There's a catch, though. They wouldn't be here otherwise. Amalthea nods. "Yes. As things stand, Olivia is... unstable, to use a euphemism. Despite her behavior up to this point, we understand that she shares in the affliction of the lupines; thus, it may become necessary to reclaim her spellsinger as a precautionary measure." But Olivia hasn't done anything, has she? "Not yet. The possibility she might do so — that is what we're here to assess, to hear her side of the story and see if the risk in allowing her to keep the spellsinger is acceptable." You look between Lydia and Amalthea, the gothmanders' expressions as stiff as boards, and sigh. Would they like you to call Olivia in, then? "Please." "

rows.original: Several minutes later, everyone's gathered before your throne — while you aren't exactly holding court right now, this nevertheless feels like a weighty enough occasion that it's warranted. Even the usually pouty Olivia's turned pensive in the presence of both gothmanders, despite Lydia and Amalthea doing their best to be friendly — a demeanor that only grows once the three of you inform her just why the astrida are here. "As you understand, Lady Leroux, the spellsinger would be a manner of concern were it to fall into the wrong hands." "And you're here to take it from me." "No, Lydia and I are here to determine if that's necessary." With all respect... you understand that [pc.swornGod nareva |your fellow gothmanders are trying to be friendly, but how they're going about it is turning things confrontational. |the duo are trying to be nice, but the order's reputation, deserved or not, is setting Olivia's teeth on edge ]. And as for Olivia... she needs to get a grip on herself and stop acting as if she's being persecuted here, because she's not. Lydia and Amalthea are already predisposed to taking her side, and you're not going to stand for any witch-hunting under your roof, [pc.swornGod nareva |especially as Nareva's personally anointed champion |not that any is happening right now ]. Now, if she would speak — clearly, this time? Olivia draws herself together, squares her shoulders, and looks up at the gothmanders towering over her. "I've done nothing wrong." "Not that falls under the jurisdiction of the order, no." "Good, because Mother can go fuck herself. The spellsinger was entrusted by your order to our family, and I have just as much right to it as anyone else." "Your internal matters are beyond our purview. Sort your family feud on your own time, Lady Leroux." "Yeah, sure, okay." Olivia's ears droop at the tips, and she sighs. "All right, let's cut to the chase. Since the both of you talk a big deal about being reasonable, there's got to be something that'll leave you both satisfied that I'm not going to freak out without warning and cause you trouble. What is it? Come on, what are your conditions? Surely you've thought this through before coming all the way from Tychris, right?" Amalthea clears her throat. "Indeed we have, but you may not find them to your liking. Regardless of the form it takes, the essence of what we're looking for is some kind of assurance of your continued good behavior in spite of... hmm, urges that you may experience as a result of what was done to you. If you have any better ideas, we're all ears." To be honest, this is going better than you expected — it sounds like Olivia and the gothmanders are coming to some kind of accord, although you expect it to hurt on Olivia's part. You've dispensed with your duty in bringing the two together and could leave them to it with a clear conscience, but on the other hand after hearing what Lydia and Amalthea want from your court bard, you could resolve this by sticking your neck out for Olivia. Decisions, decisions...
rows.translation: 几分钟后，所有人都聚集在你的王座前——而你却不在那里。正好虽然现在大家只是在进行日常交谈，但这个场合显然足够重要，因此这样的表现也是情有可原的。就连平时总是闷闷不乐的奥利维亚，在这两位哥特风格的女性的面前也变得若有所思起来——尽管莉迪亚和阿玛尔西娅一直在尽力表现得友好。而只有当你们三个人向她解释阿斯特里达家族为何会来到这里时，她的态度才真正发生了变化。 如您所理解的，勒鲁夫人，如果那件咒歌者落入坏人之手，那将会带来严重的麻烦。” “而您来这里，就是为了从我这里接过它。” “不，莉迪亚和我来这里，是为了确定是否真的有必要这么做。充满敬意地说……您应该明白这一点。 [pc.swornGod nareva |你的那些哥特曼德同伴其实是想表现得友好，但他们的方式却让事情变得充满了对立和冲突。 |这两人虽然试图表现得友善，但无论这个机构是否当之无愧，它的声誉确实让奥利维亚感到非常不安。 ]至于奥利维亚……她得控制好自己的情绪，别再表现得好像自己在这里受到了迫害，因为事实并非如此。莉迪亚和阿玛尔西娅本来就倾向于站在她那一边，而你也不会允许自己的家里发生任何迫害他人的事情。 [pc.swornGod nareva |尤其是作为娜瑞瓦亲自指定的冠军而言。 |目前还没有什么事情发生。 ]现在，如果她愿意开口说话的话显然这次又是这样吗？” 奥利维亚振作起来，挺直肩膀，抬头望着那些高耸在她面前的哥特式怪物。“我没有做任何错事。” “不过，这确实不属于我们这个组织的管辖范围。 很好，因为那个女巫根本不值得我们理会。那件咒歌者是奉你的命令托付给我们家族的，我和其他人一样，都有权利处理这件事。” “你们家族的内部矛盾与我们无关。勒鲁夫人，你们还是自己解决家族纷争吧。好吧，没问题。”奥利维亚的耳朵耷拉了下来，她叹了口气说道：“那我们就直入主题吧。既然你们俩总强调要讲道理，那肯定某个东西这样就能让你们俩都放心了——我肯定不会毫无征兆地慌慌张张，给你们带来麻烦。到底是什么事情？快说吧，你的条件是什么？你从提克里斯大老远赶过来，肯定已经考虑得很周到了吧？阿玛尔西娅清了清嗓子，说道：“确实我们有这样的东西，但你们可能不会觉得它们符合自己的口味。无论这些东西以何种形式呈现，我们真正追求的，其实是某种能够保证你们在面对各种情况时依然会保持良好行为的机制。嗯，这些做法可能会给你带来一些负面影响。如果你有什么更好的建议，我们都愿意倾听。 说实话，事情的发展比你预想的要好——听起来奥利维亚和那些哥特风格的人似乎正在达成某种共识，不过你认为这对奥利维亚来说应该会是一件痛苦的事。你本可以履行自己的职责，将这两个人牵在一起，然后心安理得地离开，但另一方面，既然知道了莉迪亚和阿玛尔西娅对你这位宫廷吟游诗人的期望，你也可以为奥利维亚挺身而出，从而解决这个问题。 决策啊，决策……
