rows.original: Let Olivia sort this out. She's her own woman and can speak for herself.
rows.translation: 让奥利维亚自己来解决这个问题吧。她已经是个独立的女性了，完全有能力为自己发声。
rows.raw: "Let Olivia sort this out. She's her own woman and can speak for herself."

rows.original: Vouch for Olivia's good behavior. You'll keep her under control.
rows.translation: 为奥利维亚的良好表现作担保。你会把她管好的。
rows.raw: "Vouch for Olivia's good behavior. You'll keep her under control."

rows.original: Vouch for Olivia's good behavior, and offer the gothmanders a hands-on demonstration of just how you keep her in line. This will extend an invitation to the gothmanders to partake as well, so skip this if you'd rather keep Olivia to yourself.
rows.translation: 为奥利维亚的良好表现做担保，并亲自向那些哥特曼德演示你是如何让她乖乖听话的。这也会顺便邀请那些哥特曼德一同参与，所以如果你更想把奥利维亚独占，就跳过这个选项吧。
rows.raw: "Vouch for Olivia's good behavior, and offer the gothmanders a hands-on demonstration of just how you keep her in line. This will extend an invitation to the gothmanders to partake as well, so skip this if you'd rather keep Olivia to yourself."

rows.original: Everything's going just fine with Olivia and the gothmanders — with your presence in this discussion more perfunctory than anything, you lean back in your throne and tune out their voices. Olivia's being whiny as usual, but Lydia and Amalthea don't seem inclined to lay down any inquisitorial smackdown on the little yappy dog, so you're content to sit back and let your mind wander until this entire affair is over. Which it does. You're not sure exactly how long the negotiations took, but eventually the drone of their voices fades, the hubbub of the great hall flowing back in; you turn your attention back to Olivia and the gothmanders, the latter staring down at her with folded arms. "I think that'll be sufficient, Lady Leroux." Lydia snaps, wagging a finger in your court bard's direction as if she were a particularly pouty child. "It's no ironclad guarantee of your future behavior, but we're willing to consider your actions under considerable coercive pressure, as well as your house's history of cooperation with the order, and give you a chance." "So, you'll finally get off my back?" It's Amalthea's turn to sigh. "Once more... you haven't done anything wrong that falls under our jurisdiction, regardless of how insufferable a person you may be. You can keep the spellsinger, but remember that our eye is always on you. Consider this a warning, and an exhortation to conduct yourself responsibly regardless of any impulsive desires." Olivia looks like she's got a clever comeback for that, but thinks better of it at the last moment, instead clutching the spellsinger ever closer to herself. With a note of finality, the gothmanders [pc.swornGod nareva |throw you a salute. "We'll be taking our leave, Champion. Is there anything you wish to convey back to Tychris?" Not at the moment. Hope it wasn't too much trouble coming all the way out here for a short conversation. "Oh, it's nothing, [pc.mf |sir |ma'am ]." Amalthea waves off the question. "Things are getting pretty hectic under the palace these days, so it's nice to have a little break, have some fresh air." |give you a nod. Their business is concluded? "That depends on whether your court bard behaves herself. We don't think it's necessary... but at the same time, hope that our assessment hasn't been in error. Good [dayNight |day |night ], [pc.title]." ] With that, Lydia and Amalthea turn tail and leave your throne's presence, melding back into the crowd in the great hall. For an encounter with the astrida, that went pretty well. Olivia scowls. "You think so, Dearest? I thought I was going to die back there." Come now. You thought they were being quite reasonable, which is why you didn't butt in on the discussion. "[pc.swornGod nareva |Dearest... of course you'd say that, wouldn't you? You're one of them, after all. I guess I should be glad that you didn't take their side in the bargain, but... |Ever the even-handed one, aren't you, Dearest? Well, maybe it's for the best that you stayed out of it instead of messing things up even more. ]" You shrug. All's well that ends well — Lydia and Amalthea didn't see fit to confiscate the spellsinger. If Olivia's going to hold to that view of the order, then at the very least she should admit that they've been mighty lenient in letting her off with a mere warning instead of clapping her in irons and shipping her back to Tychris, or whatever she imagined the duo was going to do. "Fine, Dearest. Be that way." Without further explanation, Olivia spins on her heel and stomps off in the direction of the high table. A bit high-strung, but anyone would be after an encounter with the Order Astrida, you suppose. She'll calm down in a little while...
rows.translation: 奥利维亚和那些哥特曼德人相处得还不错——你在这场讨论中的存在多半只是走个形式，于是你靠回王座上，不去听她们的声音。奥利维亚像往常一样哼哼唧唧，但莉迪亚和阿玛尔西娅似乎并不打算对这只爱叫唤的小狗来一场审判式的痛打，所以你也乐得往后一靠，任思绪飘荡，直到整件事结束。 事情确实结束了。你不确定谈判到底花了多久，但最终她们声音的嗡鸣淡了下去，大厅的喧闹又涌了回来；你把注意力转回奥利维亚和那些哥特曼德人身上，后者正抱着手臂俯视着她。 “我想这样就够了，勒鲁女士。”莉迪亚厉声说道，朝你那位宫廷吟游诗人的方向摇着一根手指，仿佛她是个特别爱闹别扭的小孩。“这不能算是你未来行为的铁证保证，但我们愿意考虑你是在相当大的胁迫压力下做的那些事，再加上你的家族一向与教团合作，就给你一次机会。” “这么说，你们终于肯放过我了？” 轮到阿玛尔西娅叹气了。“再说一次……你并没有做过任何落在我们管辖范围内的错事，无论你这人有多让人受不了。你可以留着那件咒歌者，但记住我们始终盯着你。把这当作一个警告，也是一个劝诫：不管有什么冲动的欲望，都请约束好自己的行为。” 奥利维亚似乎想出了一个机灵的反驳，但最后一刻还是打消了念头，只是把那件咒歌者抱得更紧。带着一种尘埃落定的意味，那些哥特曼德人[pc.swornGod nareva |向你敬了个礼。 “我们这就告辞了，冠军。你有什么话想带回提克里斯吗？” 暂时没有。希望你们大老远跑来只为一席短谈，没给你们添太多麻烦。 “哦，没什么，[pc.mf |先生 |女士 ]。”阿玛尔西娅摆摆手，对这个问题不以为意。“这些天宫殿底下乱得很，所以能稍微歇一歇、透透新鲜空气，挺好的。” |向你点了点头。 她们的事办完了？ “那得看你的宫廷吟游诗人表现如何。我们觉得没这个必要……但同时也希望我们的判断没有出错。祝你有美好的一[dayNight |天 |夜 ]，[pc.title]。” ] 说完，莉迪亚和阿玛尔西娅转身离开了你的王座前，重新融进大厅的人群里。就与阿斯特里达的一次碰面而言，这算是相当顺利了。 奥利维亚皱起眉头。“你真这么觉得吗，亲爱的？我还以为我要死在那儿了。” 得了吧。你觉得她们已经相当讲理了，所以才没有插嘴那场讨论。 “[pc.swornGod nareva |亲爱的……你当然会这么说，不是吗？毕竟你也是她们中的一员。我想我该庆幸你没有在交易里站到她们那一边，不过…… |你总是这么不偏不倚，不是吗，亲爱的？好吧，也许你没有插手反而是最好的，免得把事情弄得更糟。 ]” 你耸了耸肩。结果好就一切都好——莉迪亚和阿玛尔西娅没有打算没收那件咒歌者。如果奥利维亚要坚持对教团的这种看法，那至少她该承认，她们已经非常宽大了，只给了她一个警告，而不是把她铐起来送回提克里斯，或者她想象中这对搭档会做的任何事。 “行吧，亲爱的。随你。” 没有再解释什么，奥利维亚转身踩着重步朝高桌的方向走去。是有点神经紧张，不过在与阿斯特里达教团碰过面之后，换谁都会这样，你想。她过一会儿就会平静下来的……
rows.raw: " Everything's going just fine with Olivia and the gothmanders — with your presence in this discussion more perfunctory than anything, you lean back in your throne and tune out their voices. Olivia's being whiny as usual, but Lydia and Amalthea don't seem inclined to lay down any inquisitorial smackdown on the little yappy dog, so you're content to sit back and let your mind wander until this entire affair is over. Which it does. You're not sure exactly how long the negotiations took, but eventually the drone of their voices fades, the hubbub of the great hall flowing back in; you turn your attention back to Olivia and the gothmanders, the latter staring down at her with folded arms. "I think that'll be sufficient, Lady Leroux." Lydia snaps, wagging a finger in your court bard's direction as if she were a particularly pouty child. "It's no ironclad guarantee of your future behavior, but we're willing to consider your actions under considerable coercive pressure, as well as your house's history of cooperation with the order, and give you a chance." "So, you'll finally get off my back?" It's Amalthea's turn to sigh. "Once more... you haven't done anything wrong that falls under our jurisdiction, regardless of how insufferable a person you may be. You can keep the spellsinger, but remember that our eye is always on you. Consider this a warning, and an exhortation to conduct yourself responsibly regardless of any impulsive desires." Olivia looks like she's got a clever comeback for that, but thinks better of it at the last moment, instead clutching the spellsinger ever closer to herself. With a note of finality, the gothmanders [pc.swornGod nareva |throw you a salute. "We'll be taking our leave, Champion. Is there anything you wish to convey back to Tychris?" Not at the moment. Hope it wasn't too much trouble coming all the way out here for a short conversation. "Oh, it's nothing, [pc.mf |sir |ma'am ]." Amalthea waves off the question. "Things are getting pretty hectic under the palace these days, so it's nice to have a little break, have some fresh air." |give you a nod. Their business is concluded? "That depends on whether your court bard behaves herself. We don't think it's necessary... but at the same time, hope that our assessment hasn't been in error. Good [dayNight |day |night ], [pc.title]." ] With that, Lydia and Amalthea turn tail and leave your throne's presence, melding back into the crowd in the great hall. For an encounter with the astrida, that went pretty well. Olivia scowls. "You think so, Dearest? I thought I was going to die back there." Come now. You thought they were being quite reasonable, which is why you didn't butt in on the discussion. "[pc.swornGod nareva |Dearest... of course you'd say that, wouldn't you? You're one of them, after all. I guess I should be glad that you didn't take their side in the bargain, but... |Ever the even-handed one, aren't you, Dearest? Well, maybe it's for the best that you stayed out of it instead of messing things up even more. ]" You shrug. All's well that ends well — Lydia and Amalthea didn't see fit to confiscate the spellsinger. If Olivia's going to hold to that view of the order, then at the very least she should admit that they've been mighty lenient in letting her off with a mere warning instead of clapping her in irons and shipping her back to Tychris, or whatever she imagined the duo was going to do. "Fine, Dearest. Be that way." Without further explanation, Olivia spins on her heel and stomps off in the direction of the high table. A bit high-strung, but anyone would be after an encounter with the Order Astrida, you suppose. She'll calm down in a little while... "

rows.original: At your words, all three women turn to you, their gazes pressing intently against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. Just like that, you've seized the ball — it's clear that none of them were expecting this. "That'd be... acceptable," Lydia says with a slow nod. "[pc.swornGod nareva |Not just one of our own, but the goddess' champion [pc.himHer]self vouching for someone... one would be hard-pressed to find another whose words carry more weight. |Your efforts in the Marches have not gone unnoticed, and the order does appreciate you making our lives easier — your candidacy for such a role is valid, [pc.name]. ] "That being said, if you do vouch for Lady Leroux in this matter and she does fall afoul of the order, you'll share equally in her fate." [pc.swornGod nareva |Did she think that the champion of her goddess would be unaware such rules existed? |You expected something like this, so it doesn't come as a surprise. ] "Just to make things clear." Olivia gives you a sidelong glance. "[pc.name], you don't have to —" But you do. Olivia's your [pc.isDK |property, and you'd like to imagine you're a responsible enough [pc.title] to mind your playthings. Here under your roof, even a fucktoy is well-cared for. "Dearest, I..." Olivia begins, then sweeps her gaze over to the gothmanders, who are trying with all their might to stifle giggles |court bard, and if you saw fit to take her on then it's only natural that you should see fit to take responsibility for those who're part of your court. Isn't that right? "Dearest, I..." Olivia begins, then lowers her gaze ]. "I appreciate it, I guess." "We'll need this in writing, of course. Vouching for another is a serious matter — when we say you would share equally in Lady Leroux's fate should she cause any transgression, we mean it.[pc.swornGod nareva | There're no exceptions, not even for the goddess' own champion [pc.himHer]self. ]" Yes, you get the point; you'll keep Olivia on a tight leash. While Amalthea continues to go over the matter with you and Olivia — mostly the latter — Lydia produces ink and parchment from her things, quickly penning the note. You give it a quick read-through: it's but a few sentences, acknowledging that you're taking on the role of guarantor when it comes to Olivia's good behavior, and any offense she commits that falls within the Order Astrida's jurisdiction will be assumed to have been perpetrated with your knowledge. That sounds about right. You put your name at the bottom, and then it's Olivia's turn to do so; she bites her lip, pauses to glance at you, then hastily scrawls hers next to yours. Everything's in order, then? Lydia gives the document a look-over, its ink still wet. "This will suffice. Lady Leroux, [pc.swornGod nareva |Our own goddess' champion has seen fit to be magnanimous and personally vouch for your good behavior; you've been given a chance most in your position wouldn't have, and I wouldn't squander it if I were you |I'd like to impress upon you the fact that very, very few are willing to vouch for another when it comes to dealings with the Order Astrida. Since [pc.name] was willing to do so, I wouldn't betray the trust [pc.heShe] has in you ]. So long as you stay in our good graces, you may keep the spellsinger and use it as you see fit." "And —" "And as we said, whatever's going on between you and your kin is your own business." Stowing away the document, Lydia gives her partner a nod before turning to you. "Our business here is concluded, [pc.swornGod nareva |champion. Hopefully we'll be seeing you in Tychris soon, there's always work to be done |[pc.title] ]. We'll be taking our leave now, it's a long way back."
rows.translation: 听到你的话，三个女人全都转向了你，她们的目光紧紧地压在你[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]上。就这样，你抢到了主动权——显然，她们谁都没有预料到这一点。 “那……可以接受，”莉迪亚缓缓点头说道。“[pc.swornGod nareva |不光是我们自己人，还有女神本人的冠军[pc.himHer]亲自为某人担保……很难再找出一个话更有分量的人了。 |你在边境地区的努力并没有被忽视，教团也确实感激你让我们的日子好过了一些——你就任这一职务的资格是完全成立的，[pc.name]。 ] “话虽如此，如果你在这件事上确实为勒鲁夫人担保，而她又真的违逆了教团，你就会和她共同承担同等的命运。” [pc.swornGod nareva |她难道以为，她那位女神的冠军会不知道有这样的规矩？ |你本来就料到会有这种事，所以并不感到意外。 ] “只是先把话说清楚。” 奥利维亚侧眼瞥了你一眼。“[pc.name]，你其实不必——” 但你确实要这么做。奥利维亚是你的[pc.isDK |财产，而你也愿意相信自己是位足够负责任的[pc.title]，会照看好自己的玩物。在你的屋檐下，即便是个性爱玩具也会被照料得妥妥当当。 “亲爱的，我……”奥利维亚刚开口，就把目光投向那几位哥特曼德——她们正拼命忍着笑 |宫廷吟游诗人，如果你认为接纳她是合适的，那么你自然也该认为，为自己宫廷中的人承担责任是合适的。不是吗？ “亲爱的，我……”奥利维亚刚开口，就垂下了目光 ]。“我想，我还是感激的。” “当然，这件事我们需要立字为据。为他人担保是件严肃的事——当我们说，如果勒鲁夫人犯下任何过错，你会与她共同承担同等的命运时，我们是认真的。[pc.swornGod nareva | 没有例外，即便是女神本人的冠军[pc.himHer]也不例外。 ]” 没错，你明白这个意思；你会把奥利维亚管得紧紧的。当阿玛尔西娅继续与你、还有奥利维亚——主要是后者——梳理这件事时，莉迪亚从随身物品里取出墨水和羊皮纸，迅速写下了那份字据。你快速通读了一遍：上面不过几句话，确认你在奥利维亚的良好品行方面担任担保人，而她所犯下的任何属于阿斯特里达教团管辖范围内的过错，都将被视为是在你知情的情况下犯下的。 听起来差不多就是这样。你在最下方签上自己的名字，接着轮到奥利维亚；她咬着嘴唇，顿了顿，瞥了你一眼，然后匆匆在你的名字旁边签下自己的。 那么，一切都妥当了？ 莉迪亚把文件通览了一遍，上面的墨迹还没干。“这样就够了。勒鲁夫人，[pc.swornGod nareva |我们自家女神的冠军宽宏大量，亲自为你的良好品行担保；你得到了大多数处于你这个位置的人得不到的机会，换成我可不会浪费它 |我想让你明白一个事实：在与阿斯特里达教团打交道时，愿意为他人担保的人少之又少，少得可怜。既然[pc.name]愿意这么做，我可不会辜负[pc.heShe]对你的这份信任 ]。只要你继续待在我们的眷顾之中，你就可以留着那把咒歌者，随你怎么用。” “还有——” “而且就像我们说过的，你和你的族人之间发生什么，那是你自己的事。”莉迪亚收起文件，朝她的同伴点了点头，然后转向你。“我们在这里的事已经了结了，[pc.swornGod nareva |冠军。希望很快能在提克里斯见到你，总有活儿要做 |[pc.title] ]。我们现在要告辞了，回程路还很长。”

rows.original:
With that, both gothmanders [pc.swornGod nareva
        |throw you a salute before turning to
        |turn tail and
    ] depart, leaving just you and a very tense Olivia at the head of the great hall. Minutes pass in silence, the murmur of voices slowly returning once Lydia and Amalthea have departed, and then Olivia slowly raises her eyes and wrings her hands.
    
    "Um... thanks."
    
    [pc.isDK
        |Hmph
        |She's welcome
    ].
    
    "I thought you wouldn't have done such a thing after that entire business with your throne and the money. So, uh..."
    
    [pc.isDK
        |It's clear that she's never been properly owned before.
        
        "What?"
        
        She doesn't think you just said that to get rid of Lydia and Amalthea, did she?
        
        "Dearest, if I wasn't owned by someone, being kept in a hole in the ground, what was I?"
        
        Jailors don't take possession of their prisoners. No... what the two of you have is something more. Unlike her situation under Asgeir, there's nothing stopping Olivia from simply walking out over the bridge and never turning back... but she hasn't despite what's happened, has she?
        
        "I'm here because I want to be!"
        
        Exactly. And that's why you went and vouched for her good behavior — once more, you take good care of your property, and she's been quite the splendid fucktoy. Enough that you'd be concerned if you lost her, anyway.
        |Whatever she might have done, she's still part of your court and living under your roof. Even if you'd distanced yourself from this business, you wouldn't have been able to avoid being tarred by association.
        
        "That's worlds apart from vouching for me to the Order Astrida."
        
        Is it, now? Responsibility flows upward. Just because Olivia didn't mind her underlings as a so-called captain, nor Asgeir pay too much attention to the details of what she and Tharsus got up to under his nose — that doesn't mean the responsibility didn't exist, it just means they were awful at it. Is this the first time anyone in her life has ever minded what his or her subordinates were doing?
        
        "Hmm..."
        
        Without standing to gain from the matter, you might add.
    ]
    
    "I... I..." Olivia raises a finger, as if to jab it in your direction accusatorially, then sighs and drops her objection. "I'll admit it's better than what anyone would've done for me." 
    
    Then she doesn't have to question it too much. If Olivia wants to learn gratitude, she can start by doing her job consistently and well, without making trouble for the other residents.
    
    "Implying that I... well, you have a point. I'll be off, then. And well... thanks again, Dearest. I'm not sure what I would've done with those two without you."
rows.translation:
说罢，两名哥特曼德[pc.swornGod nareva
        |向你敬礼，随后转身
        |转身便
    ]离开，只留下你和无比紧张的奥利维亚站在大厅首席。几分钟在沉默中度过；莉迪亚与阿玛尔西娅离开后，低沉的人声逐渐重新响起。奥利维亚慢慢抬眼，紧张地绞着双手。
    
    “呃……谢谢。”
    
    [pc.isDK
        |哼
        |不用客气
    ]。
    
    “我以为，经历了王座和钱的整场风波，你不会再为我做这种事。所以，呃……”
    
    [pc.isDK
        |显然，以前从来没有人真正拥有过她。
        
        “什么？”
        
        她该不会以为，你刚才只是为了摆脱莉迪亚和阿玛尔西娅才那么说吧？
        
        “亲爱的，如果被人关在地洞里不算遭人拥有，那我又算什么？”
        
        狱卒不会拥有囚犯。不……你们两个拥有的是更加深刻的关系。不同于在阿斯盖尔手下的处境，没有任何东西能阻止奥利维亚走过桥梁，一去不回……可经历这么多以后，她依然没有离开，对吧？
        
        “我留在这里，是因为自己想留下！”
        
        没错。所以你才为她的良好行为担保——再说一次，你会妥善照料自己的财产，而她一直是个相当出色的泄欲玩具。无论如何，出色到你会担心失去她。
        |不管她做过什么，她依旧是你宫廷的一员，生活在你的屋檐下。哪怕你试图远离这桩事务，也无法避免因关系密切而遭到牵连。
        
        “这和向阿斯特里达教团为我担保有天壤之别。”
        
        真的吗？责任会向上追究。奥利维亚担任所谓队长时不管束手下，阿斯盖尔也不太关心她和塔尔苏斯在眼皮底下做了什么——但这不代表责任不存在，只说明他们履行得糟糕。难道这是她有生以来，第一次有人在意自己下属的所作所为？
        
        “嗯……”
        
        而且你还没有从中获得什么好处。
    ]
    
    “我……我……”奥利维亚抬起手指，仿佛要满怀责怪地戳向你，随后又叹息着放弃异议。“我承认，这比任何人曾为我做过的事都好。” 
    
    那么她不必质疑太多。奥利维亚如果想学会感恩，可以先从始终如一地做好工作开始，不要给其他住民惹麻烦。
    
    “说得好像我……好吧，你有道理。那我先走了。还有……再次谢谢你，亲爱的。没有你在，我真不知道该拿她们两个怎么办。”

            |Whatever she might have done, she's still part of your court and living under your roof. Even if you'd distanced yourself from this business, you wouldn't have been able to avoid being tarred by association.
            
            "That's worlds apart from vouching for me to the Order Astrida."
            
            Is it, now? Responsibility flows upward. Just because Olivia didn't mind her underlings as a so-called captain, nor Asgeir pay too much attention to the details of what she and Tharsus got up to under his nose — that doesn't mean the responsibility didn't exist, it just means they were awful at it. Is this the first time anyone in her life has ever minded what his or her subordinates were doing?
            
            "Hmm..."
            
            Without standing to gain from the matter, you might add.
        ]
        
        "I... I'll admit it's better than what anyone would've done for me." She sighs.
        
        Then she doesn't have to question it too much. If Olivia wants to learn gratitude, she can start by doing her job consistently and well, without making trouble for the other residents.
        
        "Implying that I... well, you have a point. Leave me to make myself presentable, then. It'll take all day to get out the smell..."
        "

rows.original: As you approach Olivia, your court bard's ears perk up — she seems genuinely pleased to see you, as opposed to a perfunctory politeness. Wait, how can you be so sure of that? Olivia's a bard and actress foremost; she knows well enough to wear emotions like masks. And yet... you don't think your gut feeling is off. Maybe the little dog acts differently in your presence, maybe she's been in your employ long enough for you to get familiar with what's underneath, maybe you have other ways of knowing. It's not as if the corrupted lupines cared very much for her beyond Asgeir's grand plan to force a moot. But having noticed your approach, Olivia beckons you forward with a faint smile. "[dayNight |Good day |Evening ], Dearest. You're looking for me?" Convenient timing — she doesn't seem to have much of an audience today. Something up? "I know, right? It's as if the gods knew you were coming and sent me a slow day, which is perfect for what I had in mind. Care to have [dayNight |brunch |supper ]? Just the two of us." Whoa, that's a bit sudden. [pc.bg courtesan |You were in the courtesan business before all this began, you know how this works — simple meals are never just that. |Don't these things get planned out in advance in the circles she moves in? ] Olivia chuckles. "Come now, Dearest. You sought me out, so clearly you have some time to spare, don't you? It's not as if any meeting with yours truly is short or forgettable; if you've the [dayNight |daylight |time ] to burn making small talk with me, you can join me for [dayNight |brunch |supper ] while about it." If she's being that adamant about it. What's the occasion, though? "Does there need to be an occasion for good food? That being said... I've been living under your roof for a while, and I think I've finally got the stink of that old mine out of my fur and skin. That's cause enough for celebration for a girl like me who needs those to do her job, wouldn't you say? Whatever the state of this wayfort, it's a step up from that hole in the ground. "The food keeps pretty well, so I had Rumie put it in the bar cellar several days ago. After that, it was a matter of waiting for you to show up." Well. Olivia isn't wrong — you were intending to spend a little time with her, and this invitation is relatively inoffensive as Olivia goes. All right, you'll see what's up. "Splendid. Rumie? Rumie!" Your bee-tender buzzes over[wayfort.hasMaids |, maid outfit and all ]. "Mistress Leroux?" "Bring out the food and set the table for us, won't you? [pc.name] has finally shown up."
rows.translation: 你走向奥利维亚时，宫廷吟游诗人的耳朵竖了起来——她似乎真心为见到你感到高兴，而非例行公事地礼貌应对。 等等，你为什么能如此确定？奥利维亚首先是一名吟游诗人和演员；她很懂得将情绪作为面具佩戴。可是……你不觉得自己的直觉出错。也许小狗在你面前表现不同，也许她受雇于你太久，让你熟悉了伪装下面的东西，也许你还有其他判断方式。除了阿斯盖尔强行召开大会的宏伟计划，腐化狼族并没有多么关心她。 不过，注意到你走近以后，奥利维亚依然带着淡淡的微笑招手让你过来。“[dayNight |日安 |晚上好 ]，亲爱的。你在找我？” 时机方便——她今天似乎没有多少听众。发生什么事了？ “就是说呀！仿佛诸神知道你会来，特地给了我一个清闲日子，正好适合心中的计划。愿意一起吃[dayNight |早午餐 |晚餐 ]吗？就我们两个。” 嚯，有些突然。[pc.bg courtesan |这一切开始前，你曾从事娼妓生意，很清楚其中门道——简单的一餐从来不只是吃饭。 |她活动的社交圈里，这种事情不是应该提前安排吗？ ] 奥利维亚轻笑。“来吧，亲爱的。是你主动来找我，显然有些空闲时间，对吧？与本人的任何会面都不会短暂或容易遗忘；既然你有[dayNight |白昼 |时间 ]可以浪费在与我闲谈上，何不顺便和我一起吃[dayNight |早午餐 |晚餐 ]？” 既然她如此坚持。不过，这是为了庆祝什么？ “享用美食一定需要特别的理由吗？不过话说回来……我住在你的屋檐下已经有一段时间，想必终于洗掉了那座老矿井留在毛发与皮肤上的恶臭。对于像我这样要靠这副皮囊工作的人而言，这已经足够值得庆祝，对吧？不管这座驿堡情况如何，都比那个地洞强。 “食物很耐存放，所以几天前便让露米把它放进酒吧地窖。接下来，只需等你出现。” 好吧。奥利维亚说得没错——你的确打算陪她一阵，而且按她的标准，这次邀请相对无害。好吧，你会看看究竟有什么名堂。 “太好了。露米？露米！” 你的蜂女酒保嗡嗡飞来[wayfort.hasMaids |，还穿着全套女仆装 ]。“勒鲁夫人？” “把食物拿出来，替我们摆好桌子，可以吗？[pc.name]终于到了。”

rows.original:
Rumie works fast — by the time you've reached Olivia's chambers, your beetender has pulled out a small side table and seating for two, followed by opening several wrapped packages. Cold meat cuts, salted greens, the works — more palatable than hardtack and biscuits, but still the kind of food that keeps on a cool shelf for months. Even the wine's already poured by the time you arrive, and from separate bottles to boot.
        
        "Not the most romantic, but it's hard to order something fresh from Hawkethorne when your schedule is so erratic, Dearest," Olivia says as she ushers you to your seat. "But it'll do — the point of such little meetings is to be with someone else, isn't it?"
        
        Hope she didn't spend too much.
        
        "I paid for it out of pocket. Garth's a pretty good cook — says he spent more time making meals as a mercenary than actually fighting, although I think he wasn't serious when he said it. Still, he gave me a discount after learning it was for you, so the least I could do was sit through his jokes.
        
        "And I have to agree with him. For you... it's worth it."
        
        [pc.isDK
            |She'd better, after that whole business with the wayfort's money.
            |You're glad that she's not taking chances after the whole business with the wayfort's money. This falls quite firmly on the side of personal expenses.
        ]
        
        "Yes, yes. Hmm..." Olivia looks down at the spread on the table between the both of you and frowns. "There's something off, but..."
        
        But?
        
        She snaps her fingers. "That's it! I forgot to get the cheese platter — Dearest, do you mind biding a minute while I go get it from Rumie's?"
        
        It'll take more than a minute with those short legs of hers, but good things are worth the wait.
        
        "Well-spoken, Dearest. I'll be back before you know it."
        
        Olivia rises from her seat, blows you a kiss, and sashays off, leaving you alone in her chambers with the food. There's something about her today, she's laying it on really thickly[pc.isBimbo
            |, and that's, like, super-duper good. You're really glad that Olivia's gotten a lot cheerier and happier ever since getting out of that hole, so much so that she's remembered how to be cheery instead of being a sourpuss all the time!
            
            Maybe if she keeps on being happy like this, she'll actually be able to beat the corruption Tharsus put in her and be a normal girl again! Like, chasing off all the nasty thoughts so that she can smile genuinely once more!
            
            Yeah, that makes, like, total sense! Why wouldn't Olivia be a little flattering in that kind of mood? You'd be, too!
            | that even the most oblivious idiot can see something's up... or is it? The little dog's changed a lot ever since coming to the wayfort, especially since you've been personally taking her in hand.
            
            Something itches at the back of your mind, a sense that Olivia's up to some kind of mischief, but what, if anything? All the dishes on the table are shared...
            
            ...Except the wine in your glasses. Come to think of it, didn't she come in with those? And you didn't see her pour them out...
            
            You eye your wineglass, then Olivia's by her forlorn, empty seat. There doesn't seem to be anything off about either at a glance, but the uneasy feeling in the pit of your stomach refuses to leave. It's the only part of the meal that's exclusive to either of you, which means if Olivia were to get up to some mischief, it'd be through the drink.
            
            It is too obvious, though? Are you second-guessing yourself? Either way, the glasses are identical, so it wouldn't be too hard to make the switch. Rumie's isn't that far away, so you'll have to do it now before Olivia returns...
            
            Do you want to swap Olivia's wineglass with yours?
        ]
rows.translation:
露米动作很快——当你来到奥利维亚的房间时，她已经搬来了一张小茶几和两张椅子，同时还打开了几个包装好的食物。有冷切肉、腌制的蔬菜，各种美食一应俱全——这些食物确实比硬饼干和干粮更可口，但依然属于那种可以放在阴凉处保存数月的食品。当你到达的时候，酒已经倒好了，而且还是用不同的酒瓶装的。

“虽然不是最浪漫的方式，但考虑到你的日程安排总是那么不规律，亲爱的，要从鹰棘镇那里订购新鲜的东西确实挺困难的。”奥利维亚一边说，一边带你坐到座位上。不过也还可以吧——这种小型聚会的意义就在于能和别人在一起，不是吗？”

希望她没有花太多钱。

“这些费用都是我自掏腰包支付的。加斯的厨艺相当不错，他说他当雇佣兵的时候，花在做饭上的时间比实际战斗的时间还要多，不过我觉得他这么说的时候并不是认真的。不过，当他知道这是给你的之后，还是给了我折扣，所以至少我应该陪他一起听那些笑话。

“而且我必须同意他的看法。为了你……这一切都是值得的。
        
        [pc.isDK
            |在发生了那件与驿堡的钱有关的事情之后，她最好还是这么做。
            |你很高兴，在那次与荒废驿堡公司的资金有关的事件之后，她没有再冒险去做任何事情。这笔开支显然属于个人开销范畴。
        ]
        
        是的，是的。嗯……”奥利维亚低头看着你们两人面前的食物，皱起了眉头。“有点不对劲，但是……”

“但是什么呢？”

她打了个响指：“就是这个！我忘了去拿奶酪拼盘——亲爱的，你能稍等一会儿吗？我马上去露米家取回来。以她那短小的腿脚，肯定需要超过一分钟的时间，但值得等待的总是美好的事情。”

“说得真好，亲爱的。我很快就会回来。”

奥利维亚从座位上站起来，向你飞了一个吻，然后摇摇晃晃地走开了，留下你独自一人在她的房间里，面对那些食物。她今天有点不一样，表现得格外热情主动。[pc.isBimbo
            |真的太好了！你肯定也为奥利维亚感到高兴——自从摆脱了那些困境之后，她变得开朗多了，也快乐多了，甚至重新学会了如何开心地生活，而不再总是闷闷不乐的！
            
            也许如果她能一直保持这样的快乐状态，她真的能够战胜塔苏斯在她心中种下的腐败思想，重新成为一个普通的女孩！也就是说，把那些糟糕的想法都赶走，这样她就能再次露出真正的笑容了！
            
            是啊，这样想确实很有道理！在这种心情下，奥利维亚怎么可能不说些奉承话呢？你也会这么做的吧！
            | 就连最迟钝的人也能看出有些不对劲……真的吗？自从这只小狗来到这个地方，它已经发生了很大的变化，尤其是自从你开始亲自照顾它之后。

你的脑海中总有一种模糊的感觉，觉得奥利维亚肯定在搞什么鬼，但具体在搞什么呢？桌上的所有菜肴都是大家共享的……

……除了你们杯中的酒。仔细想想，她不就是带着那些酒进来的吗？而且你们也没看到她把酒倒进去的……

你盯着自己的酒杯，然后看向奥利维亚那边——她那空荡荡的座位旁，酒杯也还放在那里。乍一看，这两样东西似乎都没有什么问题，但那种让人不安的感觉却始终挥之不去。这是这顿饭中唯一属于你们其中任何一人的东西，这意味着如果奥利维亚想耍什么花招，她肯定会通过这种饮料来达到目的。
            
            但这也太明显了吧？你是在怀疑自己的判断吗？不管怎样，这两副眼镜看起来一模一样，所以进行替换应该不会太难。露米的家离这里也不远，所以在奥利维亚回来之前，你得赶紧把这件事办掉。你想把奥利维亚的酒杯和你的换一下吗？
        ]

rows.original: You look between Olivia's wineglass and yours. Maybe you're just being paranoid, but being paranoid doesn't necessarily mean they're not out to get you. Besides, if Olivia's not up to mischief, then swapping your glasses won't do any harm either, right? You have only moments to act — it's but mere moments after the deed's done that the little dog herself sweeps back into the doorway, a tray of cheese in her hands. "Thanks for waiting, Dearest. We can finally have a lovely time, just the both of us." The little dog sets down the tray, then gathers her skirts and takes a seat. "Now, we've got the wine, we've got the cheese — shall we begin with a toast to your health?" Sounds lovely. You clink your glasses and drain their contents, then start with the meal. Olivia regales you with tales of her youth over the food, but it's clear that something's distracting her: her eyes wander, her fingers get all fidgety, and she seems to be waiting for something to happen... after half an hour or so of watching the little dog suffer, it seems prudent to ask. Is something the matter? "No, just some intrusive thoughts, that's all. Being here with you is bringing back memories of home, or rather, memories I should've had but didn't, Dearest. It's... complicated, to say the least." [pc.bg noblescion |She can be frank with you: it's not like you weren't born without the proverbial silver spoon in your mouth, either. |Heh. You can tell when she's being evasive at this point. ] Several moments pass over small talk, during which Olivia grows more agitated; whatever's troubling her is coming to a boil, and you wonder if it isn't the result of whatever mischief she intended to play on you. What happens next, though, is a small surprise: without warning, the little dog reaches across the table for your half-full wineglass. "Excuse me, Dearest." Before you can react, she's drained the remainder of the glass, her eyes starting to moisten; several seconds pass in awkward silence as you stare at each other. Eventually, Olivia thumps her chest and sighs, a sudden melancholy creeping into her demeanor as the tips of her doggy ears droop. "Nothing." It feels about time to broach the question directly, but Olivia surprises you by taking the initiative and finally bursting into tears before you can ask. "I'm s-sorry, [pc.name]. Dearest. After this, you'd be perfectly within your rights to throw me out, or worse." Oh, you had the feeling that Olivia was up to some mischief... but at the end of the day, you do trust her, as she says. And sometimes, if it's just between the both of you... a little harmless mischief does keep things interesting. "It's hardly harmless!" You hand Olivia your napkin, and watch as she blows her nose messily. Well, she can start by telling you what's going on, then. "There... well, you know how there's the witch of the woods who lives across the river, right? I went and got a love potion from her, because... you... I..." Uh-huh. You see where this is going. "I wanted to do it, but I also didn't want to." Olivia sniffles. "It's... I don't know half of how I feel nowadays, Dearest. How you make me feel, whether you also feel... well, not the same way, but the other half of what I do, if that makes sense. "If I acted suspiciously enough, you'd figure something was up and swap the glasses, which you did. But you drank the potion, and nothing happened. Then I drank what was left of the potion, and nothing happened. You weren't just being mean all this time, I just... "I didn't deserve myself, nor you. That and maybe... maybe it'd finally clear up just what and how you think of me, Dearest, and the same goes the other way around. I don't know myself, and it's gotten so bad of late that it's started to hurt. Like, physically hurt." So, to sum up everything she's said: Olivia went and got a love potion from [evergreen.dealtWith |Senja |Evergreen ], spiked her own drink and acted suspiciously to get you to swap your drinks. However, nothing happened when you took the love potion, and in a guilty fit she drank the rest herself and is now distraught because everything still feels the same. "...Yes. But there's no point in it, Dearest. The witch told me the potion would be instant, but it's been so long now and I don't feel any different! There must've been a mistake, or she cheated me, or..." Olivia's voice trails off as she sighs and shakes her head. You don't think Olivia's lying — not while in this emotional state, at any rate. The love potion didn't take, but was it really because Olivia was cheated, or is there something more here? Well, first things first, then you can reason things out from there. Was the love potion a dud?
rows.translation: 你将奥利维亚的酒杯和自己的酒杯相互对调了一下。也许你只是多虑了，但多虑并不一定意味着别人真的在算计你。更何况，如果奥利维亚没有恶意，那么交换你们的酒杯也不会造成任何不良后果，对吧？ 你只有短短的几秒钟来采取行动——就在事情发生后的那几秒钟里，那只小狗就拿着一个装满奶酪的盘子走回了门口。 “谢谢你等待，亲爱的。我们终于可以单独一起享受美好的时光了。小狗把托盘放下，然后整理好裙摆坐了下来。‘现在，酒和奶酪都已经准备好了——我们是不是应该先为你的健康干杯呢？’” 听起来真不错。 你们碰杯后将杯中的酒一饮而尽，然后开始用餐。奥利维亚一边吃饭，一边向大家讲述她年轻时的故事，但很明显，有些事情正在分散她的注意力：她的目光不时游离，手指也不停地摆弄着，似乎在等待着什么事情发生……在看着那只小狗痛苦挣扎了半个小时之后，我觉得还是有必要问一问的。 有什么不对吗？” “没有，只是有些烦人的念头罢了。和你在一起，让我想起了家乡，或者更确切地说，是一些我本应该拥有但却没有的记忆，亲爱的。这么说吧，情况有点复杂。" [pc.bg noblescion |她可以对你坦诚相告：毕竟你也不是那种一出生就含着银汤匙长大的孩子吧。 |呵呵，现在就能看出她在故意回避话题了。 ] 闲聊持续了一会儿，期间奥利维亚的情绪变得越来越焦躁不安；显然，困扰她的某件事即将爆发出来，你不禁怀疑，这是否与她之前打算对你耍的那些小把戏有关。然而，接下来发生的事情却有点出乎意料：毫无征兆地，那只小狗穿过桌子，抢走了你那半满的酒杯。 对不起，亲爱的。” 你还没来得及反应，她就已经喝光了杯中的酒，眼睛也开始湿润起来；接下来几秒钟，你们彼此对视，空气中弥漫着尴尬的沉默。最终，奥利维亚拍了拍自己的胸膛，叹了口气，她的眼神中突然浮现出一丝忧郁，她的耳朵也耷拉了下来。 没什么。” 感觉是时候直接问这个问题了，但奥利维亚却主动先开了口，甚至在你还没来得及提问之前，她就突然哭了起来。 “我……我很抱歉[pc.name]亲爱的，经历了这一切之后，你完全有权利把我赶出去，甚至采取更严厉的措施。” 哦，你早就觉得奥利维亚在暗中捣鬼……但归根结底，你确实相信她的话吧。有时候，如果只是你们两个人之间的事情……一些无伤大雅的恶作剧确实能让关系更加有趣。 “那可一点也不无伤大雅！” 你把餐巾纸递给奥利维亚，然后看着她把鼻子弄得一团糟地擤鼻涕。嗯，她可以先告诉你发生了什么。 “那个……你知道河对岸住着那位森林女巫吧？我去她那里弄来了一瓶爱情魔药，因为……你……我……嗯……你明白我的意思吧。” “我本来想这么做的，但同时又不想这么做。”奥利维亚抽泣着说道，“现在我自己的感受都搞不清楚了，亲爱的。你让我有了什么样的感受，而你自己又是不是也有同样的感觉……嗯，虽然方式不同，但我所做的另一部分事情，大概你能理解我的意思吧。” “如果我的行为足够可疑，你们就会察觉到不对劲，然后交换那些眼镜，而你们确实这么做了。但是你们喝了那种药水，却什么事情也没有发生。然后我她喝掉了剩下的那瓶爱情药水，但什么事情也没有发生。原来你一直以来都不是在故意刁难我，我只是…… “我不配拥有自己，也不配拥有你。也许……也许这样就能彻底弄清楚你到底是如何看待我的，亲爱的。同样的，我也无法了解自己。最近的情况变得太糟糕了，甚至开始让我感到身体上的痛苦。” 总之，奥利维亚去弄来了那瓶爱情药水，但最终什么效果也没有[evergreen.dealtWith |森娅 |常青女士 ]她自己在饮料里下了药，然后表现得可疑，就是为了让你交换饮料。然而，当你喝了那杯“爱情药水”之后，什么事情也没有发生。于是她心虚地把剩下的饮料都喝掉了，现在她非常沮丧，因为一切依然如故。 ……是的。但是这样做毫无意义，亲爱的。女巫告诉我这种药水会立刻见效，可现在已经过了这么长时间，我仍然没有任何变化！肯定有什么误会，或者她是骗了我，又或者……”奥利维亚叹息着，摇了摇头，话音渐渐低了下去。 你不会认为奥利维亚在撒谎——至少在她现在这种情绪状态下，是不可能的。那杯爱情魔药并没有起作用，但真的是因为奥利维亚被欺骗了，还是其中另有隐情呢？ 嗯，先处理眼前的问题，然后再慢慢分析其中的原因吧。那瓶爱情魔药其实是无效的吗？
rows.raw: " You look between Olivia's wineglass and yours. Maybe you're just being paranoid, but being paranoid doesn't necessarily mean they're not out to get you. Besides, if Olivia's not up to mischief, then swapping your glasses won't do any harm either, right? You have only moments to act — it's but mere moments after the deed's done that the little dog herself sweeps back into the doorway, a tray of cheese in her hands. "Thanks for waiting, Dearest. We can finally have a lovely time, just the both of us." The little dog sets down the tray, then gathers her skirts and takes a seat. "Now, we've got the wine, we've got the cheese — shall we begin with a toast to your health?" Sounds lovely. You clink your glasses and drain their contents, then start with the meal. Olivia regales you with tales of her youth over the food, but it's clear that something's distracting her: her eyes wander, her fingers get all fidgety, and she seems to be waiting for something to happen... after half an hour or so of watching the little dog suffer, it seems prudent to ask. Is something the matter? "No, just some intrusive thoughts, that's all. Being here with you is bringing back memories of home, or rather, memories I should've had but didn't, Dearest. It's... complicated, to say the least." [pc.bg noblescion |She can be frank with you: it's not like you weren't born without the proverbial silver spoon in your mouth, either. |Heh. You can tell when she's being evasive at this point. ] Several moments pass over small talk, during which Olivia grows more agitated; whatever's troubling her is coming to a boil, and you wonder if it isn't the result of whatever mischief she intended to play on you. What happens next, though, is a small surprise: without warning, the little dog reaches across the table for your half-full wineglass. "Excuse me, Dearest." Before you can react, she's drained the remainder of the glass, her eyes starting to moisten; several seconds pass in awkward silence as you stare at each other. Eventually, Olivia thumps her chest and sighs, a sudden melancholy creeping into her demeanor as the tips of her doggy ears droop. "Nothing." It feels about time to broach the question directly, but Olivia surprises you by taking the initiative and finally bursting into tears before you can ask. "I'm s-sorry, [pc.name]. Dearest. After this, you'd be perfectly within your rights to throw me out, or worse." Oh, you had the feeling that Olivia was up to some mischief... but at the end of the day, you do trust her, as she says. And sometimes, if it's just between the both of you... a little harmless mischief does keep things interesting. "It's hardly harmless!" You hand Olivia your napkin, and watch as she blows her nose messily. Well, she can start by telling you what's going on, then. "There... well, you know how there's the witch of the woods who lives across the river, right? I went and got a love potion from her, because... you... I..." Uh-huh. You see where this is going. "I wanted to do it, but I also didn't want to." Olivia sniffles. "It's... I don't know half of how I feel nowadays, Dearest. How you make me feel, whether you also feel... well, not the same way, but the other half of what I do, if that makes sense. "If I acted suspiciously enough, you'd figure something was up and swap the glasses, which you did. But you drank the potion, and nothing happened. Then I drank what was left of the potion, and nothing happened. You weren't just being mean all this time, I just... "I didn't deserve myself, nor you. That and maybe... maybe it'd finally clear up just what and how you think of me, Dearest, and the same goes the other way around. I don't know myself, and it's gotten so bad of late that it's started to hurt. Like, physically hurt." So, to sum up everything she's said: Olivia went and got a love potion from [evergreen.dealtWith |Senja |Evergreen ], spiked her own drink and acted suspiciously to get you to swap your drinks. However, nothing happened when you took the love potion, and in a guilty fit she drank the rest herself and is now distraught because everything still feels the same. "...Yes. But there's no point in it, Dearest. The witch told me the potion would be instant, but it's been so long now and I don't feel any different! There must've been a mistake, or she cheated me, or..." Olivia's voice trails off as she sighs and shakes her head. You don't think Olivia's lying — not while in this emotional state, at any rate. The love potion didn't take, but was it really because Olivia was cheated, or is there something more here? Well, first things first, then you can reason things out from there. Was the love potion a dud? "

Was the love potion a dud? "

rows.original: It must've been a dud, since you don't feel any different.
rows.translation: 那东西肯定没什么效果，因为你并没有感觉到任何变化。
rows.raw: "It must've been a dud, since you don't feel any different."

rows.original: No, it wasn't. There's something else going on here.
rows.translation: 不，并非如此。这里肯定还有别的原因在起作用。
rows.raw: "No, it wasn't. There's something else going on here."

rows.original: It must've been — you focus inwards, examining yourself as best as you can, but to all of your knowledge you don't think or feel any different towards Olivia that you otherwise would've been inclined to anyway. If the so-called potion did nothing to you or Olivia, then the only reasonable conclusion is that it didn't take. Olivia sniffles and looks up at you. "Y-you really think so, Dearest?" Well, there are other possibilities, such as the both of you being so amazingly special and unique that [evergreen.dealtWith |Senja's love potion recipe, which is no doubt her mother's before it became hers |Evergreen's love potion, the mainstay of an infamous witch of the woods like her ], has absolutely no effect on either of you in the exact same way. That, and does she really want to go back and pay Evergreen Manor a visit, demand her money back? [evergreen.dealtWith | |Wait. She did pay with money, right? Not the usual way in which Evergreen demands payment? "I... I wouldn't have done such a thing! But even if I had, the witch said she didn't want that anyway. That I've... I've had things done to me, very deliberately so, and while what's skin deep was absolutely delightful that which lay beneath was concerning enough that she didn't want any daughters from me. It was money or nothing. "I don't know, Dearest. Up till then, I wanted Tharsus dead. Now, I'm wondering if him being alive might not be such a bad thing, given what I want to do to that perverted old creep." Oh dear. Knowing Evergreen, the problem must be quite serious for the 'nuki witch to say such a thing. The entire experience must've been quite the ordeal for Olivia. ] Olivia sighs. "I... I suppose you're right, Dearest. I don't ever want to go back there again." She still isn't feeling any different, is she? "Do I look like I'm bubbling over with burning lust or mindless affection?" Shaking her head, Olivia looks over the half-eaten meal, then swoons over to her bed and tosses herself into the plush sheets. Hugging her fluffy tail like a big bolster, the little dog stares morosely up into the ceiling. "I'm feeling a lot all right, but it's certainly not love." Who knows? Love doesn't have to be titillating all the time — it can be sour and bitter as much as sweet. "I'm not in the mood for jokes right now, Dearest." It wasn't meant to be, but she doesn't have to act so offended. There is one small matter at the heart of all this...
rows.translation: 肯定就是如此——你向内审视自己，尽你所能地检视自身，但就你所知，你对奥利维亚的感觉与原本会有的倾向并无二致。如果那种所谓的药水对你和奥利维亚都没有产生任何效果，那么唯一合理的结论就是它没有生效。 奥利维亚抽了抽鼻子，抬头看着你：“你、你真的这么认为吗，亲爱的？” 嗯，还有其他可能性，比如你们俩就是如此特别、如此独一无二，以至于[evergreen.dealtWith |森娅的爱情魔药配方——毫无疑问，在她之前，这配方是她母亲的 |常青女士的爱情魔药——像她这样声名狼藉的林中女巫的看家本领 ]，对你们两人以完全相同的方式完全不起作用。再说，她真的想回去拜访常青女士庄园，要求退钱吗？ [evergreen.dealtWith | |等等。她确实是用钱付的账，对吧？而不是常青女士通常要求的那种支付方式？ “我……我本来是不会做出这种事来的！但就算我真的做了，那女巫也说了她反正不想要那个。说我……我被人故意做过一些手脚，虽然表面上的那部分确实令人愉悦，但底下的情况却严重到让她不想从我这里得到任何女儿。要么付钱，要么什么都得不到。 “我不知道，亲爱的。在那之前，我一直希望塔尔苏斯死掉。可现在，想到我想对那个变态的老色鬼做的事，我在琢磨让他活着也许不算什么坏事。” 哦天哪。以常青女士的性子，能让这位努基女巫说出这种话，问题肯定相当严重。对奥利维亚来说，这整段经历一定非常煎熬。 ] 奥利维亚叹了口气：“我……我想你是对的，亲爱的。我再也不想回到那里去了。” 她还是没有任何不同的感觉，对吧？ “我看起来像是满身沸腾的欲火或者无脑的爱慕吗？”奥利维亚摇了摇头，看了一眼那顿吃了一半的饭，然后摇摇晃晃地走到床边，一头扑进柔软的床单里。那只小狗似的姑娘像抱大靠枕一样抱住自己毛茸茸的尾巴，闷闷不乐地盯着天花板。“我确实感觉到了很多情绪，但那肯定不是爱情。” 谁知道呢？爱情未必时时刻刻都令人心动——它既可以甜蜜，也可以酸涩苦楚。 “我现在没心情开玩笑，亲爱的。” 这话本意并非如此，但她也不必表现得这么生气。这一切的核心还有一个小问题……

rows.original: [var0 |Meira looks up as you burst into the watchtower's ground floor, wineglass in one hand, Olivia in the other. Your court mage eyes the both of you, a small smile playing on her lips, then sits back in her chair. "Well, Olivia. Have you finally gotten yourself into trouble with something that you can't squirm out of?" That would depend on how this goes. If she wouldn't mind having a look at this? Meira raises an eyebrow at the wineglass and takes it from you. "I suppose, but you've got to tell me what — oh. Huh. Eugh." Is there something? Your court mage wrinkles her nose. "Oh yes, it's a love potion, Mom's recipe[evergreen.dealtWith | — well, I guess it's Senja's now ]. There's no mistaking that pungence, even at arm's length." You don't smell anything. "It's only something that Mom and us daughters can sense." Sighing, Meira hands you back the wineglass. "Mom's recipe is so potent, she was never able to devise an antidote for it, so she did this instead just in case someone had the clever idea to use her own concoctions against her and her daughters. It absolutely reeks, so there's no disguising the scent." There's absolutely no chance the love potion might have been a dud? "Not in a chance. People came from as far as the heartlands to get their hands on Mom's stuff. If Olivia put it in someone's drink... well, the poor bastard's already completely infatuated with her, that's all I'll say." |Senja looks up as you burst into Evergreen Manor, wineglass in one hand, Olivia in the other. Her smile vanishes, though, as soon as the little dog draws into her sight. "Oh, [pc.name]! I, um..." Senja's gaze darts between you and Olivia, and she quickly figures that dissembling isn't going to do her much good. "Olivia, you didn't tell me [pc.name] was the one you intended the potion for!" So the love potion's hers, right? "I wouldn't have sold it to her if I'd known you were the recipient!" That doesn't matter, and you don't mind; she's not in trouble. All you want out of Senja is to know if she cooked up a dud. Senja takes the wineglass from you; even at arm's length, she makes a face and wrinkles her nose. "Eugh. Yes, it's still stinky, which means it's good." You don't smell anything. Senja sighs and hands you back the wineglass. "It's something that only Mom and us daughters can smell, [pc.name]. Her recipe's so potent she was never able to devise an antidote for it, so she did this instead just in case someone had the clever idea to use her own concoctions on herself. "The reagents that make the potion work absolutely reek to us, so there's no disguising it. If it's still stinky, it's still good." There's absolutely no chance the love potion might have been a dud? A shrug. "It never failed for any of Mom's customers, and it's been the same for me. She built a good chunk of her reputation on this." |Evergreen looks up as you burst into Evergreen Manor, wineglass in one hand, Olivia in the other. It wasn't [pc.name] you dosed my love potion with, was it?. You can't say I didn't warn you against such silliness." Evergreen needn't worry — you're not really mad, and she just admitted that Olivia got the love potion from her. All you want to know is if she cooked up a dud, because you don't feel any different from before. "[pc.name], a good chunk of my reputation stems from this very concoction; people come up all the way from the heartlands to get their hands on a love potion that actually works without side effects. Anyone can cook up an aphrodisiac, but genuine love's a lot harder to come by. A sip's enough of a dose: if you don't feel any different after, you should really think why nothing seems to have changed." Olivia clears her throat. "Sounds like someone who doesn't want to give me my money back." "On the contrary, my dear, you can have a full refund. I've little use for coin — watching [pc.name] drag you in my door has been payment enough in amusement. No doubt I'll be hearing plenty of interesting news coming up from the wayfort in the next few weeks." Oxana snaps her fingers, and one of her full-blooded daughters comes up with a coinpurse, which the witch tosses to Olivia. "There. Your money back, in full — now do I have reason to lie to you about my potion's efficacy?" "Plenty." "Children these days, so mistrusting." Oxana sighs, and turns to you. "You've more sense in your head, [pc.name]. Think on it, and it'll make sense before long. Any other questions?" You're surprised that Evergreen didn't insist on her usual payment. Evergreen's jovial demeanor dries up like thin spit on a hot stove, a frown creasing her features. "Your court bard has had things done to her, very deliberately so, and while what's skin deep is absolutely delightful that which lies beneath is less so." Does she mean that Olivia's frigid or something? "No, quite the opposite. Very much the opposite, in fact — what's taken root in her body would be worth studying, perhaps even get me excited in my younger days. But now, I wouldn't want to put one of my daughters in that womb of hers. Not worth the risk." Just as well. Olivia's on her own contraceptives. Evergreen rolls her eyes and waves off the notion. "Anyway. My love potion, it worked; the reagents still stink in that wineglass you're holding, so they haven't gone off. You're a clever one, [pc.name], you'll figure out what happened before too long." ] Thanks, she's been very helpful. "Any time now!"
rows.translation: [var0 |当你手持酒杯、抱着奥利维亚冲进瞭望塔的底层时，梅拉抬起了头。这位宫廷法师注视着你们两人，唇边浮现出一丝微笑，然后又靠回椅子里。 嗯，奥利维亚，这次你是不是又陷入了自己无法摆脱的麻烦之中？” 这还得看事情会如何发展。如果她不介意的话，让我看看这个吧？ 梅拉挑了挑眉毛，接过你手中的酒杯。“我想是的，但你得告诉我具体是什么……哦，呃，真难喝。” 是不是有什么问题？ 你的宫廷法师皱了皱鼻子。哦，对，这是爱情魔药，是妈妈亲自配制的配方呢。[evergreen.dealtWith | — 嗯，我想现在这个东西应该是森娅的了。 ]那种刺鼻的气味，即使站在几步之外也绝对不会弄错。” “你却什么味道都闻不到。” “只有妈妈和我们这些女儿才能察觉到这种气味。”梅拉叹了口气，把酒杯递还给了你。妈妈的配方效果太强烈了，她根本没办法研制出解药，所以她就采取了这个办法——毕竟总有人可能会想出用她自己配制的药剂来对付她和她的女儿们。这种药的味道实在难闻极了，根本无法掩盖它的气味。那种爱情魔药绝对不可能是假的吧？” “绝对不可能。人们甚至从内陆地区专门赶来，就是为了得到妈妈制作的东西。如果奥利维亚真的把那种魔药加到了别人的饮料里……嗯，那个可怜的家伙已经完全迷上她了，我只能说这么多了。 |当你手持酒杯、带着奥利维亚冲进常青女士庄园时，塞尼娅抬起头来看你。然而，当那只小狗出现在她视线中时，她的笑容立刻消失了。 “哦， 耸了耸肩：“妈妈给她的顾客们用的时候，从来都没有失败过，我用的时候也是一样。她正是凭借这一成就建立了自己良好的声誉。 |当你手持酒杯、牵着奥利维亚冲进常青女士庄园时，常青女士夫人抬起了头。看到你们俩的样子，她的笑容从顽皮变成了彻头彻尾的邪恶，然后她懒洋洋地靠在扶手椅上说道： “我就说吧，你这家伙精力太过充沛，根本不懂分寸[pc.name]你肯定在我的爱情药水里加了什么吧？我早就警告过你，别干这种傻事。 常青女士不必担心——你其实并没有生气，她只是承认奥利维亚是从她那里得到了那瓶爱情药水。你现在只是想知道，她是不是配了一瓶没效果的药水，因为你自己并没有感觉到任何变化啊。[pc.name]，我的声誉在很大程度上正是源于这种神奇的药剂；人们甚至从不远处赶来，就是为了获得这种真正有效的爱情魔药。可以运行。没有任何副作用。任何人都可以制作出催情剂，但真正的爱情却难得寻觅。只需喝一小口就足够了：如果之后你没有感觉到任何变化，那你真的应该好好想想，为什么什么都没有改变。” 奥利维亚清了清嗓子：“听起来像是有人不想把我的钱退给我。” “恰恰相反，亲爱的，你可以得到全额退款。我对这些硬币没什么用处——看[pc.name]让你走进我的家门，就已经算是给了我足够的乐趣了。毫无疑问，在接下来的几周里，我一定会听到很多来自荒废驿堡的有趣消息。”奥克萨娜打了个响指，她的一个纯种女儿立刻拿来了一个钱袋，女巫将钱袋扔给了奥利维亚。给你，你的钱全额退还了——现在我还有理由对你的药水效果撒谎吗？” “当然有。” “现在的孩子们，真是太不信任别人了。”奥克萨娜叹了口气，然后转向你说道。你脑子里的智商总归是比那些人高的[pc.name]仔细想想，不久之后你就会明白其中的道理的。还有其他问题吗？” 你很惊讶，常青女士并没有像往常一样坚持要求支付费用。 常青女士原本欢快的神情，就像热锅上的薄痰一样瞬间消失了，她的脸上浮现出一丝愁容。你的宫廷吟游诗人遭遇了一些刻意为之的伤害，虽然表面上看上去很糟糕，但实际上内在的情况却没那么糟。” 她是想说奥利维亚性格冷漠之类的吗？ 不，恰恰相反。事实上，完全相反——她体内所发生的变化确实值得研究，甚至可能会让我回想起自己年轻时的那些经历。但如今，我绝对不愿意让自己的女儿进入她的子宫。不值得冒这个风险。” “也好吧。奥利维亚自己会采取避孕措施的。” 常青女士翻了个白眼，对这种想法不屑一顾：“总之，我的爱情魔药确实有效；你手里那个酒杯里剩下的炼金材料仍然有味道，说明它们还没有失效。你真是个聪明人啊。 [pc.name]，不久之后，你就会弄清楚发生了什么。 ] 谢谢，她真的帮了大忙。 “随时都可以！

All you want out of Senja is to know if she cooked up a dud. Senja takes the wineglass from you; even at arm's length, she makes a face and wrinkles her nose. "Eugh. Yes, it's still stinky, which means it's good." You don't smell anything. Senja sighs and hands you back the wineglass. "It's something that only Mom and us daughters can smell, [pc.name]. Her recipe's so potent she was never able to devise an antidote for it, so she did this instead just in case someone had the clever idea to use her own concoctions on herself. "The reagents that make the potion work absolutely reek to us, so there's no disguising it. If it's still stinky, it's still good." There's absolutely no chance the love potion might have been a dud? A shrug. "It never failed for any of Mom's customers, and it's been the same for me. She built a good chunk of her reputation on this." |Evergreen looks up as you burst into Evergreen Manor, wineglass in one hand, Olivia in the other. Her smile widens from mischievous to outright devilish as she takes in the both of you, all smug as she slouches in her armchair. "I told you, you've more energy than sense, child. It wasn't [pc.name] you dosed my love potion with, was it?. You can't say I didn't warn you against such silliness." Evergreen needn't worry — you're not really mad, and she just admitted that Olivia got the love potion from her. All you want to know is if she cooked up a dud, because you don't feel any different from before. "[pc.name], a good chunk of my reputation stems from this very concoction; people come up all the way from the heartlands to get their hands on a love potion that actually works without side effects. Anyone can cook up an aphrodisiac, but genuine love's a lot harder to come by. A sip's enough of a dose: if you don't feel any different after, you should really think why nothing seems to have changed." Olivia clears her throat. "Sounds like someone who doesn't want to give me my money back." "On the contrary, my dear, you can have a full refund. I've little use for coin — watching [pc.name] drag you in my door has been payment enough in amusement. No doubt I'll be hearing plenty of interesting news coming up from the wayfort in the next few weeks." Oxana snaps her fingers, and one of her full-blooded daughters comes up with a coinpurse, which the witch tosses to Olivia. "There. Your money back, in full — now do I have reason to lie to you about my potion's efficacy?" "Plenty." "Children these days, so mistrusting." Oxana sighs, and turns to you. "You've more sense in your head, [pc.name]. Think on it, and it'll make sense before long. Any other questions?" You're surprised that Evergreen didn't insist on her usual payment. Evergreen's jovial demeanor dries up like thin spit on a hot stove, a frown creasing her features. "Your court bard has had things done to her, very deliberately so, and while what's skin deep is absolutely delightful that which lies beneath is less so." Does she mean that Olivia's frigid or something? "No, quite the opposite. Very much the opposite, in fact — what's taken root in her body would be worth studying, perhaps even get me excited in my younger days. But now, I wouldn't want to put one of my daughters in that womb of hers. Not worth the risk." Just as well. Olivia's on her own contraceptives. Evergreen rolls her eyes and waves off the notion. "Anyway. My love potion, it worked; the reagents still stink in that wineglass you're holding, so they haven't gone off. You're a clever one, [pc.name], you'll figure out what happened before too long." ] Thanks, she's been very helpful. "Any time now!" "

rows.original: Olivia's silent on the walk back, still sniffling and trembling from time to time. You can sense the question roiling inside of her with each step until you're almost back in her chambers; she can't take it any more, and it spills out of her unbidden. "Why?" Why what? "Why didn't it work? The witch said it should have, by all means! But neither you nor I..." Olivia. "...?!" She's still hysterical, so you give her a light smack on the cheek to get her attention. It's obvious: the love potion absolutely worked, [evergreen.dealtWith |Senja |Evergreen ] didn't make a mistake. The reason she didn't feel any change after having drugged herself was because she already loves you. How does it feel to love? How does it feel to be loved? "I... is that it? Is this how it feels?" Olivia looks down at her hands. "It can't be, this isn't what love is supposed to feel like!" How does she know that? She said she's been feeling out of sorts — when did it start? "I don't know when it started. It kind of happened over time, if that's what it is to begin with..." She does feel different from when she was living in a hole bossing around her sycophants, right? "I... I do, Dearest. But I thought it'd be different, more sudden, more obvious... it's hardly what I expected." Love isn't always sudden; sometimes it takes weeks, months, years. Nor is it always titillating — it can be sour and bitter as much as sweet. And given what was done to Olivia by Tharsus and who she's become at this point, physically and mentally... maybe this isn't so bad an outcome. No fairytale romances for the likes of Olivia, not when one considers how she was brought up and what happened to her in the mine, but there're plenty of other kinds of workable relationships. "I need a lie-down, think about this for a while." Which is fine, as you've just returned to her chambers. The half-eaten meal still sits on the table, cold by now; Olivia ignores all of it and flops onto the plush sheets of her bed, hugging her fluffy dog tail like a bolster and staring up at the ceiling. Before you leave, there's one last thing that needs to be dealt with... "Yes?"
rows.translation: 返回途中，奥利维亚始终沉默不语，仍会不时抽泣颤抖。每走一步，你都能感觉到那个问题在她体内翻腾，直到快要返回房间时，她终于再也无法忍受，问题不由自主地脱口而出。 “为什么？” 什么为什么？ “为什么没有用？女巫说过，按理它一定会奏效！可你和我都没有……” 奥利维亚。 “……？！” 她依然歇斯底里，于是你轻轻拍了拍她的脸颊，引起她的注意。答案显而易见：爱情药水绝对生效了，[evergreen.dealtWith |森娅 |常青女士 ]没有犯错。她给自己下药后没有感觉到任何变化，是因为她已经爱上你。爱一个人是什么感觉？被人爱又是什么感觉？ “我……就因为这样？这就是爱人的感觉？”奥利维亚低头看向自己的双手。“不可能，爱情不应该是这种感觉！” 她怎么知道那一点？她说自己一直心绪不宁——这是从什么时候开始的？ “我不知道什么时候开始。它就这样逐渐发生了，假如这真的就是爱……” 比起住在地洞里对马屁精发号施令时，她的确感觉有所不同，对吧？ “我……的确不同，亲爱的。但我以为它会是另一种感觉，更加突然、更加明显……这完全不是我的预期。” 爱并非总是突如其来；有时需要几星期、几个月、几年。它也不总让人心醉神迷——可以酸涩苦楚，也可以甜美。考虑到塔尔苏斯曾对奥利维亚做过的事，以及她如今在肉体与心智上变成的模样……也许这不算太坏的结果。以奥利维亚的成长方式和矿井中的遭遇，她这样的人不会拥有童话般的爱情；但世上还有许多其他能够维系的关系。 “我要躺一会儿，好好想想。” 当然可以，你们正好已经回到她的房间。吃了一半的饭菜依旧放在桌上，如今已经凉了；奥利维亚看都不看一眼，扑到床铺柔软的床单上，把毛茸茸的狗尾巴当作长枕拥在怀里，仰望天花板。你离开之前，还有最后一件事必须解决…… “什么事？”

rows.original: You haven't forgotten that she tried to drug you. "Oh." Olivia curls up on her bed; this entire episode's clearly taken all the fight out of her to the point where she can't even muster the will to defend herself. "I don't have any excuses, Dearest; do with me as you will. You'd be in your rights to throw me out of the wayfort or worse — I know neither Asgeir, Refnir or Tharsus would show me mercy at this point." What to do? On one hand, it would be satisfying to drive home Olivia's lesson while she's vulnerable. On the other, it's clear that the little dog's own maelstrom of emotions is tormenting her far more than what you could ever inflict on her right now. To be blunt about it, any so-called discipline you impose upon your court bard in this moment would be purely for your gratification, even if she did plot to drug you with [evergreen.dealtWith |Senja's |Evergreen's ] love potion. As the saying goes: don't [pc.hasCock |stick your dick |get all tangled up ] in crazy. Olivia's job may involve plenty of acting, but here and now, it's quite obvious that she's genuinely distraught. There'll be time for plenty of sexual fun later, and getting up to hanky-panky with the little dog in this vulnerable emotional state feels slimy, for lack of a better word to put it. Quietly, you step out of Olivia's chambers and shut the door behind you, only to find Rumie pacing about just outside: your beetender buzzes over in short order, wringing her hands. "[pc.name]. Is Mistress Leroux —" Give her half an hour to cry it off, then she can go in. Olivia's likely to still be sore even after, so you'd appreciate it if Rumie would treat her kindly. "Of course! I-I'll go prepare some things immediately!" As you walk away from the scene, you can't help but think back to the circumstances under which you first met Olivia. Asgeir left her to her own devices, which was more or less neglecting her; Tharsus favored brute force in his approach. Maybe you didn't intend things to turn out this way, but in the end getting the little dog to come around on her own and willingly stop being such a bitch — some might consider it a lot more satisfying that the corrupted lupines' meatheaded methods. For all of Olivia's mischief about the wayfort, it's come to naught. Attempting to dose you with love potion was an ultimatum of sorts — one that fell through just like everything else. Perhaps, finally, Olivia will behave and make it stick.

rows.original: Odd. Olivia isn't in her usual seat at the high table [dayNight |today |this evening ]. While she may be an aggravating little dog at times, you've yet to know her for the sin of sloth; she enjoys being the centre of attention too much for that. A quick look around the great hall turns up no sign of your court bard, either — wherever Olivia's entertaining whatever company she has, it isn't in here, to be sure. In fact, this entire scene has a sense of you having gone through this before — that of you walking in on both your dog-girls while having an argument. A sinking sensation of familiarity worming its way into the pit of your stomach, you hurry out of the great hall and to Olivia's chambers. The girls are indeed there, but they aren't arguing: instead, Drifa and Olivia are huddled on the bed[drifa.isCorrupt | in a state of half-undress ]. They're not whispering, so you can eavesdrop on them from the doorway, but the voices coming from within are even and hushed. It's not an argument that they're having like last time, at any rate. [drifa.isCorrupt |"Nothing shameful about wearing a collar, Olivia," Drifa's voice comes to you from within. "That is, if you or I had any shame left." |"There's nothing inherently wrong with wearing a collar, Olivia," Drifa's voice comes to you from within. "I [drifa.isCollared | |would gladly ]wear one, and nobody thinks worse of me for it." ] "That's because everyone in this wayfort and in Hawkethorne already know you're [pc.name]'s pet. I will say that this place has a way of easing you into accepting even the most eyebrow-raising oddities. Having to deal with a motley assortment of faces every day does that to you." "[drifa.isCorrupt |Exactly. So why worry about wearing a collar[drifa.isCollared | like I do ]? |If it helps you out, you can think of it like an accessory! ]" Olivia shakes her head. "It just feels wrong, on a level that I can't put into words. I just don't like it, even I know there shouldn't be anything wrong with it — that [pc.name]'s done only right by me and given me more chances than I deserve." [drifa.isCorrupt |Drifa tilts her head at Olivia's words. "Oh, there's nothing wrong with it, Olivia. I belong to [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ]. You've accepted that you belong to [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ]. If you're certain of it in your heart, why would there be any problem with wearing it outwardly? I'm certainly not ashamed of letting others know I'm owned, collar or not." "There are many reasons, but..." Olivia sighs and folds her arms. "Most importantly, it goes against everything I've been raised to know, you understand? It's not a rational thing." "Then don't be rational about it." Drifa presses herself up against Olivia, rubbing herself all over the smaller half-lupine while lacing her fingers about Olivia's neck. "Think of how happy you'll be [drifa.isCollared |with a matching collar, just like mine; we can belong to [pc.Master], be [pc.hisHer] pets together. |with a formal mark of [pc.name]'s approval, it'll be just as good as a ring. ] "Who cares what other people think? You've been through as much with [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ] as I have — you know full well that [pc.heShe] didn't trick us into this or do anything underhanded. All that happened was that we realized the inevitability of our place." |"It's only weird if you think it is. If you don't want to wear one, that's perfectly fine. Far be it from me to tell anyone what to do. All I'm saying is that you shouldn't knock it until you try it. Who knows, you might like it![drifa.isCollared | I know I did." Drifa casually tugs at her collar. "Wearing this thing has helped me grow much more confident, and I also wear it because it represents something special to me. I [drifa.dated |love |deeply respect ] [pc.name], and we should be proud to have such a good [pc.Master] as [pc.himHer] | I know I would." Drifa smiles dreamily. "Maybe if you do get one, [pc.name] will see fit to collar me, too ]." "It's undeniable that [pc.name] has taken a heavy responsibility for me and my actions, especially considering the whole business with the order wanting my spellsinger back." Olivia sighs and folds her arms. "And there's a difference between this and what those mutts had planned for me." "The choice is yours. I do think we'd look cute if we had [drifa.isCollared |matching ] collars, though. If you don't end up liking it, you can just take it off. Drifa [drifa.isCollared |reaches up and tugs at her own collar |gives the littler dog a small, cold smile ]. "You of all people should know that publicly admitting a fact has meaning in and of itself, Olivia. Not merely that you've accepted your fate... but that you're not ashamed of it." Olivia swallows hard. "Do it," Drifa whispers,her voice dripping with honeyed poison. "Become like me, free of these silly rules which everyone else tries to impose on you, and focus on the only words that matter — [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ]'s. "[drifa.isPregnant |We don't just need to have matching collars, we can get matching bellies as well." Sighing wistfully, Drifa pats her protruding tummy with no small satisfaction. I got out of that hole to avoid being some godsforsaken puppy mill!" Olivia sputters, staring at Drifa's pregnant bump. "You can't be serious in suggesting that I willingly turn myself into one after all that!" "Why not? I know where you're coming from — being used by those ugly brutes who didn't care for you is abhorrent. But this... this is a different matter, Olivia." Reaching in from the little wolf's sides, Drifa snickers and forms a heart with her fingers over Olivia's lower belly, pushing in with her thumbs just under the little wolf's navel. "[drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ] cares for you, has taken responsibility for you, possibly at the cost of [pc.hisHer] freedom and life where the meddling 'manders are concerned. It's the least we bitches can do for [pc.himHer]. Doing this because we desire it is worlds apart from being forced into it by the unworthy and uncaring." "Clinging to false hope is weakness, Olivia; there's no cure for what I've become, and the same goes for you.         |dog

rows.original: Both [drifa.isCorrupt |wolf |dog ]-girls notice you the moment you step in, ears perking up and tails starting to wag. While [drifa.isMarried |your [drifa.isCorrupt |wolf |d[silly |o ]og ]-wife |Drifa ] greets you enthusiastically, straightening up on the bed, Olivia shies away and tries to hide behind Drifa — not surprising, given what they were just discussing. "[drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ]! We were just —" You heard. "O-oh." Both [drifa.isCorrupt |wolf |dog ]-girls huddle a little closer against each other. "Okay, then." Not all of it, but enough to get the gist of what's going on. Stepping up to the bed, you sit on its edge, making sure that Olivia doesn't have anywhere to hide before reaching out and patting the smaller [drifa.isCorrupt |wolf |dog ]-girl on the head. Now then, you want Olivia to be honest: this is your wayfort, and she has your word no one will judge her answer either way. Does she want a collar[drifa.isCollared | to match Drifa's ]? The little red dog's ears swivel this way and that, and she swallows hard; Drifa's gaze is boring into her with all the intensity of a minoan augur. But then again, it's so much easier to go along with what she really wants deep down inside now that she has the approval of the two most important people in her life here and now. "Y-yes!" "It's not fair, [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ]," Drifa huffs, [drifa.isPregnant |resting her hands on her pup-swollen middle |folding her arms ]. "I spend half the day trying to [drifa.isCorrupt |talk her into it |get her to be more open-minded ], and you tease it out of her just like that!" [drifa.isCollared |And that's why Drifa's your pet. She may be the first, but she's still a pet. |What can you say? You just have a way with words — that's why Drifa's with you, isn't she? ] "Mmmh... I can't argue." See? It's that simple. All that remains is to go out and get that collar for Olivia, and [wayfort.hasFarrah |you're pretty sure Farrah has |no doubt at least one of the merchants Olivia's been working so hard to draw to the wayfort should have ] these kinds of things in stock.

rows.original: As it turns out, [wayfort.hasFarrah |Farrah's emporium is rather empty at this time of day, enough that the demoness is able to focus her undivided attention upon the three of you as you step in. Lounging on the counter, Farrash swishes her tail and turns her eyes up to you as you approach, a smile spreading on her lips. "Well! Customers, and quite emotional ones, too. In the mood to buy something to salve those hurts?" You need a collar — preferably one that [drifa.isCollared |matches Drifa's and ]will fit snugly over Olivia's throat. She has these kinds of kinky things hanging around, doesn't she? Now that gets Farrah's attention, the demoness sitting up with a start; a flicker of annoyance passes over her features as she studies Olivia's bedraggled form, but that quickly gives way to smug excitement as she connects the dots. "Oh ho. Let's see what I have in the back, then. You're in luck — I picked up a couple of bargains several days ago. Let's see if we've got anything that suits your little doggy, shan't we?" The demoness is good to her word — she disappears around the back and re-emerges shortly with several collars about her arm. Some of them are leather, some felt; all of them are studded with semi-precious stones and incredibly gaudy and eye-catching. [drifa.isCollared |Compared to Drifa's collar, the choices are certainly ostentatious — matching doesn't need to mean the same, after all. |Certainly a choice for a little classy toy dog like Olivia is, and very suitable for her role in your wayfort. ] "Take your pick," Farrah purrs. "I have more if none of these strike your fancy." |Gianna's mechanical caravan is sitting in the courtyard when you step out, doing a brisk business — the telltale chirp that accompanies it is unmistakable. The proprietress herself waves the three of you over as she sends off the last of her customers, a smile under that hood of hers. "'Lo there, [pc.name]! Looking to be the next customer?" Depends on what she's selling — Gianna has the knack for turning up when you need a merchant. Not that there should be any trouble finding one in the wayfort with all the work Olivia's been doing of late, but... she gets the point. "Had a feeling we'd be needed, and so I turned the caravan around. Looks like we got here just in time — you're wanting something to soothe the hearts of those girls behind you, is that right? They look like they've been in a scrap." One could put it that way. Does Gianna have anything to make [pc.isDK |your bitches |the girls ] feel better? More specifically, you need a collar — preferably one that [drifa.isCollared |matches Drifa's and ]will fit snugly over Olivia's throat. That'll cheer them right up and solve what they were having a back-and-forth over. "Sure do. That's more Tamarind's thing, she loves picking up those knicknacks when we're back in Jassira, but I reckon I know the merchandise well enough. A moment, please." Gianna swings herself out of the driver's seat, landing with a heavy thump before circling around to the wagon's back. After some rummaging, she returns with several collars about her arm. Some of them are leather, some felt; all of them are studded with semi-precious stones and incredibly gaudy and eye-catching. [drifa.isCollared |Compared to Drifa's collar, the choices are certainly ostentatious — matching doesn't need to mean the same, after all. |Certainly a choice for a little classy toy dog like Olivia is, and very suitable for her role in your wayfort. ] "That's all we've got, plenty of catfolk around these parts feeling mighty homesick. Any of them catch your fancy?" ] Hmm. Olivia? "Y-yes?" Which one does she like most? "Aren't you supposed to pick one out for me, Dearest?" You could, but you want Olivia to do it for herself. That way, she knows that she did this freely. "Oh. I should've guessed as much." Sighing, the little [drifa.isCorrupt |wolf |dog ] runs her fingers over each of the collars on display until she finds one to her liking — black felt studded with jet. Ha... the Olivia that you met in the mine would certainly have gone for the most expensive option regardless of what it actually looked like or whether it complemented her. Now? Well, there's no doubt that Olivia's still herself, but she's a lot wiser about it. Maybe, like Drifa said, she just needed to be honest with herself. Putting on an act might have been necessary to survive amidst a pack of half-crazed wolfmen, but there's no need for that now.
rows.translation: 原来如此， [wayfort.hasFarrah |在这个时间段，法拉的商店里几乎没有什么顾客，因此当你走进去时，这位女恶魔能够将全部的注意力都集中在你们三个身上。法拉懒洋洋地靠在柜台上，当你靠近时，她摇动着尾巴，抬起眼睛看着你们，嘴角露出了微笑。 “哇！顾客啊，而且还是情绪相当激动的顾客呢。是不是想买点东西来缓解那些伤痛呢？” 你们需要一条项圈——最好是那种[drifa.isCollared |与德莉法的相匹配，并且…… ]这个东西会紧紧地套在奥利维亚的脖子上。她身上不是总挂着这类奇怪的东西吗？ 这一下引起了法拉的注意，那个女恶魔猛地坐了起来；当她看到奥利维亚那狼狈不堪的样子时，脸上闪过一丝恼怒，但很快，当她弄清楚事情的来龙去脉后，她的脸上又露出了得意的笑容。 “哦嗬那我们来看看我后面有什么吧。你真走运——几天前我买到了几件便宜货。看看有没有适合你家小狗的东西吧，好吗？” 这个女恶魔确实说到做到了——她走到后面去了，不一会儿就拿着几条项圈回来了，她的手臂上挂满了这些项圈。有些是皮革制的，有些是毛毡做的；所有这些项圈上都镶嵌着半宝石，看起来极其华丽、十分显眼。 [drifa.isCollared |与德莉法的项圈相比，这些选择确实显得更加夸张——毕竟，搭配并不一定意味着两者必须完全一致。 |对于像奥利维亚这样一只优雅的小玩具狗来说，这确实是个不错的选择，也非常适合她在你的游戏中扮演的角色。 ] 随便选吧，”法拉轻声说道，“如果这些都没有让你中意的话，我还有很多其他的。 |当你走出门时，吉安娜的机械商队正停在院子里，生意十分红火——那种特有的嗡嗡声再清楚不过了。店主本人正在送走最后一位顾客，看到你们三个人后，她微笑着朝你们招手。 “嘿，过来[pc.name]想成为下一个顾客吗？” 这得看她卖什么东西——吉安娜总能在你需要的时候出现。不过，考虑到奥利维亚最近一直在忙于各种事务，在韦弗特这个地方找商人应该也不会有什么困难吧……不过，还是不确定呢。我就觉得我们会需要帮忙的，所以才让商队掉头赶来的。看来我们来得正是时候——你是想找些什么办法来安抚你们身后那些女孩的情绪，对吧？它们看起来就像经历了一场激烈的战斗。 也可以这么说吧。吉安娜有什么要说的吗？ [pc.isDK |你那些女人 |那些女孩们 ]感觉好些了吗？更具体地说，你需要一条项圈——最好是那种[drifa.isCollared |与德莉法的相匹配，并且…… ]肯定合适。这种小玩意儿其实是塔玛琳喜欢的，每次我们回到贾西拉，她总会捡那些小饰物来玩，不过我觉得我对这些商品还是挺了解的。请稍等片刻。” 吉安娜从驾驶座上跳下来，重重地落在地上，然后绕到马车的后面。经过一番翻找，她手里拿了几条项圈，回到了车上。有些是由皮革制成的，有些则是用毛毡制作的；所有这些饰品上都镶嵌着半宝石，看起来极其华丽、十分抢眼。 [drifa.isCollared |与德莉法的项圈相比，这些选择确实显得更加炫耀性——毕竟，搭配并不一定意味着两者必须完全一致。 |对于像奥利维亚这样一只优雅的小玩具狗来说，这确实是一个非常合适的选择，也完全符合她在你的游戏中的角色设定。 ] 我们就这些选择了，这一带有很多猫族，他们都非常思念家乡。有没有哪位让你感兴趣呢？ ] 嗯，奥利维亚？ “是、是吗？” 她最喜欢哪一个呢？ “亲爱的，不是你应该帮我选一个吗？” 你可以但是你希望奥利维亚自己去做这件事。这样，她就会知道这是她自己的决定，是自愿做的。 “哦，我早该猜到的。” 小女孩叹了口气，说道[drifa.isCorrupt |狼 |狗 ]她仔细地抚摸着展架上每一件项圈，直到找到一件令她满意的——那是一件黑色毛毡材质的项圈，上面点缀着黑宝石。哈……你在矿场遇到的那个奥利维亚，肯定会选择最昂贵的那件，而不管它实际看起来如何，也不管它是否适合她。现在呢？毫无疑问，奥利维亚依然是她自己，只不过她对此已经有了更深刻的认识。 也许，就像德莉法说的那样，她只需要对自己坦诚而已。在那些半疯狂的狼人中间生存，装作另一个人或许是一种必要的手段，但现在再也没有这个必要了。

Well, there's no doubt that Olivia's still herself, but she's a lot wiser about it. Maybe, like Drifa said, she just needed to be honest with herself. Putting on an act might have been necessary to survive amidst a pack of half-crazed wolfmen, but there's no need for that now."

rows.original: Olivia turns the collar over in her hands; she pinches the band, tugs at the clasp, runs the material between thumb and forefinger to test its comfort. Perhaps some part of her is looking for an excuse to reject it, but if so, she's finding none. "There's nothing off about the collar, is there?" Why would there be? "Because... well, because —" You haven't forgotten that she tried to drug you with a love potion, only to fail because it couldn't have any further effect on either of you. If Olivia's genuine about being your pet, perhaps she should start with being less cynical about everyone and everything, and stop assuming everyone thinks and acts like her. Olivia hugs herself defensively and turns her ears down. "I just, well, it's a habit — it always paid off to be careful, a girl traveling so far from home all by herself —" The entire point of all of this from the outset is to have Olivia correct her behavior and come to you of her own free will. If she's going to do this, she has to want it, to desire it — affecting her mind with drugs or enchantments would completely defeat the purpose. It's a very pretty collar, to be sure, but also entirely mundane. Any so-called magic that might result isn't going to come from a fashion accessory, but rather from within Olivia's heart. [wayfort.hasFarrah |"Listen to [pc.name], [pc.heShe]'s right," Farrah purrs. "I know my merchandise — it's a very pretty trinket, but that's all it is." |"Just saying, I don't keep such things in stock," Gianna says curtly. "Bad for business in the long term when you get that kind of reputation." ] "All right, I get the point." A sigh, and then Olivia looks [pc.heightRange 60 |up ]at you imploringly. "You wouldn't mind helping me, would you, Dearest?"
rows.translation: 奥利维亚把项圈在手中翻来覆去；她捏捏颈带，拉扯搭扣，又用拇指与食指摩挲材质，测试是否舒适。也许她内心某处正在寻找拒绝的借口，可就算如此，她也一无所获。 “这条项圈没有什么不对劲吧？” 为什么会有？ “因为……好吧，因为——” 你没有忘记，她曾试图用爱情药水给你下药，结果却失败了，因为药水无法再对你们两个产生更多影响。如果奥利维亚真心想做你的宠物，也许应该先别再愤世嫉俗地怀疑所有人、所有事，也别再假定每个人都像她一样思考行事。 奥利维亚防备地抱住自己，垂下双耳。“我只是，好吧，这已经成了习惯——一个姑娘独自远离家乡旅行，小心谨慎总会得到回报——” 从一开始，这一切的重点便是让奥利维亚纠正行为，出于自由意志来到你身边。她若要这样做，就必须想要它、渴望它——用药物或魔法影响心智，会彻底违背目的。这的确是条非常漂亮的项圈，但也完全普通。任何可能产生的所谓魔法都不会来自时尚饰品，而会来自奥利维亚内心。 [wayfort.hasFarrah |“听[pc.name]的，[pc.heShe]说得没错。”法拉发出呼噜。“我了解自己的商品——它是件非常漂亮的小饰物，但仅此而已。” |“说明一下，我不库存这种东西。”吉安娜简短地说道。“从长远来看，沾上这种名声不利于生意。” ] “好吧，我明白了。”奥利维亚叹息一声，随后满怀恳求地[pc.heightRange 60 |抬头 ]望向你。“你不介意帮帮我吧，亲爱的？”
