rows.original: Actually, you would. "What?" Like you just said, you wouldn't hesitate to mind your pet's needs, but this is different. You need Olivia to do this on her own, to come to terms with what she wants. It won't do for her to be double-guessing her decision at the earliest opportunity — you want it to be clear that she's coming to you of her own accord, as you just pointed out. Olivia gives you a slight nod, then raises the collar. When she finally does it, time seems to slow — her pulling the collar about her neck, adjusting its strap, fumbling with the little golden buckle. The little [drifa.isCorrupt |wolf |dog ] breathes so heavily throughout it all you wonder if she's going to start outright panting, or perhaps she's just worried about choking herself by accident — —Yeah, right. But when the collar's finally fastened and she lets her hands fall, Olivia looks immensely relieved, as if she's just taken a great burden off her shoulders. And she has. "That wasn't as bad as I thought it'd be. It's quite liberating, in fact; the weight's reassuring in a way that I can't quite put into words." [drifa.isCorrupt |"You mean, you don't want to put into words, because it'd out you as a shameless pet." Tail wagging, Drifa rounds on Olivia, gently tugging on the littler wolf's new collar. "Nothing wrong with that — shame is what they use to control you. If you're going to be at someone's beck and call, there are better ways to be leashed than shame. "But I know what you're feeling, and can damn well put it into words. It feels so good to accept that you're better suited as [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ]'s pet, doesn't it? Whatever personal feelings I may have towards you, Olivia... I'm looking forward to having you join me at [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ]'s side |"Hee hee, we do match. There, Olivia — didn't I tell you it'd only be weird if you made it weird? It looks great on you." Tail wagging furiously, Drifa gives the smaller dog-girl a big grin. "Wait till you get to the good part — I can only hope that it'll be as good for you as it was for me ].[drifa.isCollared | | That, and I hope [pc.name] gets me one like yours soon, so we can match. ]" Girls, girls. That'll be enough — plenty of time for that sort of thing soon. For now, though, you turn back to [wayfort.hasFarrah |Farrah, who's been watching this entire scene play out with a lazy smile on her face and looking very smug in the way only felines can. How much do you owe her? "For this spectacle? I'll give it to you for free." You raise an eyebrow at the lounging Farrah. Really, now? She's feeling okay, isn't she? Not running a fever or anything? "Psh." Farrah flicks her tail and drums her fingers on the counter. "Seeing that little bitch finally get her comeuppance after all the grief she's given me is almost as good as a big score — almost. You've never known pain until you've had Olivia try to haggle you down. "But if you're so insistent on paying me, I don't mind. No reason to spoil your mood right now, I'll just take it out of the wayfort's income and leave it at that." |Gianna, who's been putting away the remaining collars while the scene's been playing out. How much do you owe her? "Nah, I don't need paying. You can think of it as a levy for letting us do business at your wayfort, or a gift for being such a good customer all this while. Business has never been better in the Marches ever since you started solving everyone's problems, so good on you." You raise an eyebrow, but nod. All right, you'll accept the gift. "Honestly, I should be the one paying you to get rid of it. Tamarind always picks up way too many of these knickknacks, way faster than we can move them. Congratulations on your missus on finding one that she likes, I get the feeling she'll be wearing it for a long time." ] Well then, if she insists. Turning back to Drifa and Olivia, you take in the sight of your [drifa.isCollared |old pet juxtaposed against your new one: big and small, black and red, [drifa.bigTitty |curvaceous |slender ] and voluptuous, the comparisons stretch on... ...Oh well, two pets aren't going to be much more trouble than one, right |new pet, and you're not the only one eyeing Olivia. Drifa is looking pretty envious herself, perhaps you should get her one too sometime before she explodes ]? On the other hand, there's fun that you can now get up to, playing one [drifa.isCorrupt |wolf |dog ] off against the other. Do you feel up to breaking Olivia into her new station?
rows.translation: 其实，你会的。 “什么？” 就像你刚才说的，你会毫不犹豫地照顾好你的宠物的需求，对吧？这个这不一样。你需要让奥利维亚自己来做这件事，让她自己弄清楚自己真正想要什么。如果她一有机会就开始怀疑自己的决定，那肯定是行不通的——你希望她能明确地、主动地来找你，就像你刚才指出的那样。 奥利维亚微微点了点头，然后抬起了衣领。当她终于开始动手的时候，时间似乎变得缓慢起来——她将衣领拉到脖子上，调整着背带，笨拙地摆弄着那个小小的金色扣子[drifa.isCorrupt |狼 |狗 ]在整个过程中，她的呼吸都如此急促，让人不禁怀疑她是不是马上就要开始喘不过气来了，又或者她只是担心自己会不小心被呛到…… ——是啊，当然了。 但当领子终于被系好，她放下双手时，奥利维亚看起来如释重负，仿佛刚刚从肩上卸下了沉重的负担。而事实上，她确实如此。 “并没有我想象中那么糟糕。事实上，这种感觉相当令人解脱；那种沉重的负担在某种程度上给人一种安心的感觉，而我却很难用语言来形容这种感受。 [drifa.isCorrupt |你是说，你并不这么认为？想要用语言表达出来吧，因为那样做只会让你显得像个无耻的宠物。”德莉法摇着尾巴，走到奥利维亚身边，轻轻拉了拉那只小狼的新项圈。“这样做并没有什么错——羞耻感正是他们用来控制你的工具。如果你注定要听从别人的摆布，那么除了用羞耻感来束缚自己，还有更好的方式。 “但我明白你的感受，也能够用语言准确表达出来。当你意识到自己更适合成为[drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ]的宠物时，就不必再受羞耻束缚，对吧？无论我个人对你有什么看法，奥利维亚……我都很期待你加入我，与[drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ]并肩 |嘻嘻，我们确实太合适了，奥利维亚——我不是说过，如果你自己把它弄得复杂起来，才会显得奇怪吗？你穿上它看起来简直太棒了。”德莉法兴奋地摇着尾巴，对着这个年纪较小的女孩露出了灿烂的笑容。“等你看到后面的部分就知道了……我只希望它对你来说，也能像对我一样有意义 ]。[drifa.isCollared | | 还有，我也希望如此。 [pc.name]我也会尽快买一个和你一样的，这样我们就一样了。 ]姑娘们，好了好了。这种事情以后有的是时间做。现在，你们还是回去吧[wayfort.hasFarrah |法拉一直带着懒洋洋的微笑注视着这一幕的发展，她的神情非常以只有猫科动物才有的那种得意姿态……你到底欠她多少钱？ “就为了看这一幕？我免费送给你吧。” 你看着那懒洋洋地躺着的法拉，挑了挑眉毛。真的，现在就这么做？她现在应该感觉好多了吧？也没有发烧什么的吧？” “哼。”法拉甩了甩尾巴，用手指在柜台上敲打着：“看着那个小贱人终于得到了她应得的报应，想想她给我带来的那些麻烦，这种感觉简直和赚了一大笔钱一样棒——差不多吧。直到奥利维亚试图跟你讨价还价，你才会真正体会到什么是痛苦。 “不过如果你非要坚持付钱给我，我也没意见。现在也没必要破坏你的好心情，我就把这笔钱算作福特的收入吧，就这样吧。" |吉安娜一直在一边观看这一幕的发展，一边把剩下的项圈收起来。你欠她多少钱呢？ “不，我不需要你付钱。你可以把这笔钱看作是我们能在你的集市上做生意而应缴纳的税费，或者看作是感谢她一直以来一直是我们这么好的顾客而送的一份礼物吧。自从你开始帮助大家解决各种问题以来，马奇地区的生意从未如此红火过，真是太棒了。 你挑了挑眉毛，但还是点了点头。好吧，你接受了这份礼物。 说实话，应该是我付钱让你把这些东西处理掉才对。塔玛琳德总是买太多这类小饰品，速度快得让我们根本来不及处理。恭喜你老婆找到了她喜欢的那个，我觉得她会经常戴着它吧。" ] 那么，如果她坚持的话……再回头看看德莉法和奥利维亚，你会看到这样的景象： [drifa.isCollared |旧宠物与新宠物形成对比：一个庞大，一个小巧；一个黑色，一个红色。 [drifa.bigTitty |曲线优美 |纤细的 ]而且它们还非常迷人，这样的比喻简直数不胜数…… ……唉，反正养两只宠物也不会比养一只麻烦多少，对吧？ |新宠物啊，而且关注奥利维亚的并不只有你一个人。德莉法看起来也相当羡慕呢，或许你也应该在她发火之前，也给她买一只吧。 ]另一方面，现在你也能够享受到另一种乐趣了，那就是去玩这个游戏。 [drifa.isCorrupt |狼 |狗 ]你觉得自己有能力帮助奥利维亚适应她的新工作环境吗？

rows.original: As fun as it'd be to get Drifa in on the act, Olivia's looking overwhelmed by what she's done. Sure, she's been working up to this point for a good while now, but even having been eased into it over time, taking the last step and collaring herself has taken a toll on the little [drifa.isCorrupt |wolf |dog ]'s mental fortitude. "[drifa.isCorrupt |Aww," Drifa whines. "Are you sure about this, [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ]? I was looking forward to introducing Olivia to the kind of delights only we can enjoy." Patience, patience. She'll get to have her fun soon enough — and no teasing Olivia behind your back, either. Your court bard needs some time alone to come to grips with her new station in life; you'll send for both your pets when the time is right and not one moment sooner or later. "As you wish, [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ]. I'll make sure she's all freshened up and knows how to be a good pet by the time you need us." |You don't have to worry, [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ]." Drifa says cheerily — perhaps a bit too much so. "I'll take good care of Olivia until you have need of us both. She'll be as right as rain in no time, or I'm not a priestess." That's fine, but she's not to let Olivia order her around like she does Rumie or everyone else, for that matter. [drifa.isCollared |As far as you're concerned, both dog-girls are your pets, and they're equal in your eyes. The same goes for the other way around; Drifa doesn't have any seniority just because she was collared first. It's much more fun that way. |You'll trust Drifa to ease Olivia into things, and not overstep her newfound authority even if she's the senior. ] "I'd never do such a thing, [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ], it just isn't me. Now, if I may have your leave to put Drifa to sleep — I mean, bed..." ] But of course. Giving you her [drifa.isCorrupt |nastiest |sweetest ] smile, Drifa grabs Olivia by under the littler [drifa.isCorrupt |wolf |dog ]'s arms and leads the both of them away. Asking around, you wrangle some information out of the locals — what they tell you is that Lady Leroux complained she wasn't feeling well and retired to her chambers, but no one can agree exactly when that was. Fine, it doesn't matter. It's not like she left the premises. You can just go to her room and see if you can get her side of things. Olivia's chambers aren't that far from the great hall. Hopefully it's not barred when you get there. To your relief, her door's not locked. You creak the door open and are greeted with an uncharacteristic sight: [olivia.isCollared |your little pet |Olivia ]'s curled up in the sumptuous embrace of her bed, face half-buried in her pillow. Dressed in a pink nightie, Olivia's nestled into the sheets and made herself comfortable, although judging by how mussed they are there's been a lot of tossing and turning in the bargain. A small stack of dishes sits on the bedside table, about two or three meals' worth of cleaned crockery; whatever Olivia's come down with, it hasn't dulled her appetite any. This isn't some sudden fainting spell and quick lie-down: for your court bard to still be in her sleepwear, it's plain that Olivia's been in bed for the entire day and hasn't gotten out, even for meals. She's not one inclined to sloth — vanity, yes, but not laziness — and one can only wonder what malady's torn [olivia.isCollared |your little pet |the diligent bard ] away from her attention-seeking routine. "Rumie?" Olivia mumbles, squirming about in bed. "Rumie, is that you? Can you be a dear and get me more of that fruitcake from the kitchen? I'd appreciate it if you could — hmm —" [olivia.isCollared |Your little pet |Olivia ] stops, sniffs the air, then one of her ears turns towards you. With great effort, she opens one eye, then rolls over in the sheets to take you in. "Oh. Forgive me, Dearest[olivia.isCollared | [pc.Master] ]. I thought you were Rumie." Olivia glances over at a crumb-littered plate by her bedside and lets out a sheepish chuckle. "Can I still have some of that fruitcake in the kitchen?" You should be the one asking that question — the Olivia you know should be out there basking in the adoration of others, not cooped up in bed! She's not feeling under the weather, is she? "I... I guess." Olivia makes an effort to sit up, fails, and melts back down into a fuzzy puddle on the mattress. "I'm not coming down with a fever or anything. I'm just... kind of tired, really. Tired and cold — I could understand chills if I were running a fever, but I'm not." No nausea, either — judging by the small pile of dishes on the bedside table, her appetite's been excellent for someone as petite as her. Well, petite by Marches standards, anyway. When did this all start? "It started a while ago — a few hours, I think. Actually, now that you mention it, I recall feeling this way when I got out of bed this morning. Rumie was nice enough to check in on me and bring me a bite to eat, which I'm grateful for." Any idea what's wrong with her? rows.translation: 你本来打算去看看奥利维亚的，但结果发现，今天她并没有坐在高桌旁的座位上。桌首那个空荡荡的位置，以及周围根本没有人陪伴她，这一幕反而比她平时表演时吸引的人群还要引人注目。 [dayNight |有趣的是，你现在已经如此习惯她的存在，以至于她不在身边时，这种变化才会显得如此明显。 |其中一个原因是[olivia.isCollared |你的小宠物 |那只小狗 ]她总得睡觉吧，但每次你找她的时候，无论白天还是夜晚，她几乎总是在大厅里。 ]经过打听，你从当地人那里获得了一些信息——他们告诉你，勒鲁夫人称自己身体不适，便回了自己的房间休息，但没人能确定她到底发生了什么。当……的时候就是那样。没关系，其实也没什么大不了的。又不是她离开了那个地方，你直接去她的房间，看看能不能了解她的想法吧。奥利维亚的房间离大厅并不远，希望你去的时候门没有上锁。 令你欣慰的是，她的门确实没有锁。你推开门，却看到了一个不同寻常的场景： [olivia.isCollared |你的小宠物 |奥利维亚 ]奥利维亚蜷缩在豪华的床上，脸半埋在枕头里。她穿着粉红色的睡衣，舒适地躺在被子里，不过从被子的凌乱程度来看，她应该翻来覆去地折腾了好一会儿。床头柜上放着一小叠餐具，大概够吃两三顿饭的干净碗碟；不管奥利维亚生了什么病，她的食欲似乎丝毫没有受到影响。 这显然不是一次突然晕倒然后简单躺下休息的事情——既然这位宫廷吟游诗人仍然穿着睡衣，那就说明奥利维亚一整天都躺在床上，甚至没有起来吃过饭。她绝不是那种会懒惰的人——当然，她可能有虚荣心，但绝不会懒散——人们不禁会想，究竟是什么病痛在折磨着她。 [olivia.isCollared |你的小宠物 |那位勤奋的吟游诗人 ]不再陷入她那种寻求关注的惯常行为中。 “露米？”奥利维亚嘟囔着，在床上翻来覆去。“露米，是你吗？你能帮我去厨房拿些水果蛋糕来吗？如果你能这么做的话，我会很感激的——嗯 [olivia.isCollared |你的小宠物 |奥利维亚 ]她停下来，嗅了嗅空气，然后其中一只耳朵转向了你。她费了很大劲才睁开一只眼睛，接着在床单上翻了个身，将你纳入视线范围。 “哦，原谅我，亲爱的[olivia.isCollared | [pc.Master] ]我还以为你是露米呢。”奥利维亚瞥了一眼床边那盘布满碎屑的盘子，不好意思地笑了笑，“厨房里还有那种果酱蛋糕吗？我能再吃点吗？” 这个问题其实应该由你来说才对——你认识的奥利维亚现在应该正在外面享受别人的赞美，而不是躲在床上吧！她应该没有生病吧？ 我……我想应该是吧。”奥利维亚试图坐起来，但没能成功，又软软地倒在床垫上。“我并没有发烧之类的症状，只是……真的很累。既累又冷——如果我在发烧的话，感到发冷也是可以理解的，但我并没有。 也没有感到恶心——从床头柜上那小堆餐具来看，对于她这样身材娇小的人来说，她的食欲确实很好。嗯，至少按照Marches的标准来看是如此。这一切到底是从什么时候开始的呢？ “应该是在几小时前开始的吧。其实，现在你这么一说，我突然想起来今天早上起床的时候也有这种感觉。我本来想试着走一走让这种感觉消失，但发现它并没有好转，于是我就请了个假。后来，当我意识到自己还要在这里待一段时间时，我就换上了更舒服的衣服。……露米还特意来看我，还给我带了些吃的，我真的很感激她。 知道她到底怎么了么？ “不知道，但我想先试着睡一觉，如果明天还是没有好转，再再去担心也不迟。
rows.raw: " You've been meaning to drop in on Olivia, but as it turns out, she's not in her seat at the high table today. The empty space at the table's head, along with the utter lack of her audience, is more eye-catching than the crowd she usually draws for entertainments — [dayNight |it's interesting that you've gotten so used to her presence at this point that her not being around stands out this much |one reasons that [olivia.isCollared |your little pet |the little dog ] has to sleep sometime, but she's almost always been in the great hall every time you've sought her out, day or night ]. Asking around, you wrangle some information out of the locals — what they tell you is that Lady Leroux complained she wasn't feeling well and retired to her chambers, but no one can agree exactly when that was. Fine, it doesn't matter. It's not like she left the premises. You can just go to her room and see if you can get her side of things. Olivia's chambers aren't that far from the great hall. Hopefully it's not barred when you get there. To your relief, her door's not locked. You creak the door open and are greeted with an uncharacteristic sight: [olivia.isCollared |your little pet |Olivia ]'s curled up in the sumptuous embrace of her bed, face half-buried in her pillow. Dressed in a pink nightie, Olivia's nestled into the sheets and made herself comfortable, although judging by how mussed they are there's been a lot of tossing and turning in the bargain. A small stack of dishes sits on the bedside table, about two or three meals' worth of cleaned crockery; whatever Olivia's come down with, it hasn't dulled her appetite any. This isn't some sudden fainting spell and quick lie-down: for your court bard to still be in her sleepwear, it's plain that Olivia's been in bed for the entire day and hasn't gotten out, even for meals. She's not one inclined to sloth — vanity, yes, but not laziness — and one can only wonder what malady's torn [olivia.isCollared |your little pet |the diligent bard ] away from her attention-seeking routine. "Rumie?" Olivia mumbles, squirming about in bed. "Rumie, is that you? Can you be a dear and get me more of that fruitcake from the kitchen? I'd appreciate it if you could — hmm —" [olivia.isCollared |Your little pet |Olivia ] stops, sniffs the air, then one of her ears turns towards you. With great effort, she opens one eye, then rolls over in the sheets to take you in. "Oh. Forgive me, Dearest[olivia.isCollared | [pc.Master] ]. I thought you were Rumie." Olivia glances over at a crumb-littered plate by her bedside and lets out a sheepish chuckle. "Can I still have some of that fruitcake in the kitchen?" You should be the one asking that question — the Olivia you know should be out there basking in the adoration of others, not cooped up in bed! She's not feeling under the weather, is she? "I... I guess." Olivia makes an effort to sit up, fails, and melts back down into a fuzzy puddle on the mattress. "I'm not coming down with a fever or anything. I'm just... kind of tired, really. Tired and cold — I could understand chills if I were running a fever, but I'm not." No nausea, either — judging by the small pile of dishes on the bedside table, her appetite's been excellent for someone as petite as her. Well, petite by Marches standards, anyway. When did this all start? "It started a while ago — a few hours, I think. Actually, now that you mention it, I recall feeling this way when I got out of bed this morning. I tried to walking it off, but when it became clear it wasn't going away I excused myself. Then, when I figured I was going to be here for a while, I changed into something more comfortable... Rumie was nice enough to check in on me and bring me a bite to eat, which I'm grateful for." Any idea what's wrong with her? "No, but I figured I'd try to sleep it off and worry about it if I didn't feel any different by tomorrow." "

rows.original: All right, if she's feeling this unwell, then perhaps a visit from Drifa is warranted. Olivia's eyes snap open as if you'd slapped her, [olivia.isCollared |your little pet ]instinctively recoiling at the very notion. "W-what?" Drifa's a priestess. [drifa.isCorrupt |Technically. ]She knows something about these things. "B-but don't you know someone who's more — well — experienced? Competent? You get around a lot to scourge up all the material I'm supposed to embellish into song and verse, surely you know people. Like... like that old fart down in the village, what's his name —" You get the feeling it's not Drifa's medical competency that has Olivia all in a tizzy. Isn't that right? Olivia skulks. Now, you do know some more colorful characters — there's no doubt that [evergreen.dealtWith |Senja |Evergreen ] could easily figure out what's wrong with her quickly. She's just across the river, after all. That said, Drifa's been in on this whole corrupted lupine business from the beginning[wayfort.hasCorlups |, and she's been working on Asgeir and his people to try and find a cure. Your [olivia.isCollared |little pet |court bard ] sighs and sinks back into her bed. "Any luck?" More than Tharsus had, at any rate. "That's not saying much since he was making them worse." There doesn't seem to be much hope of a cure, but Drifa's been able to suppress the symptoms enough that they're [corlup.recruited |able to do their jobs about the wayfort without lapsing back into being sex-crazed beasts |quiet enough in their cells. This isn't a permanent cure... yet, but it does give everyone involved some hope even if it means their corruption will have to be managed for the rest of their lives. Enough progress, and they might even get to the point where you can release them in good conscience ]. |, and she's got the most experience with all of this. [wayfort.hasDrifa |Sure, there might be better-practiced healers out there, but they're not currently here, now are they? While Drifa is here, she's got a job to do, and that's to take care of the fort's infirm — that includes Olivia |Others might be more skilled than Drifa is, but she has the best knowledge of Olivia's particular circumstances ]. ] A reluctant sigh. "Very well, Dearest[olivia.isCollared | [pc.Master] ], I see where you're coming from. I don't like it, but it's what it is." If her corruption's starting to act up, Drifa's the best person to see to her. You'd ask why Olivia isn't already being treated, but you already have a good guess at the answer. "Okay, okay. I don't want to hear it any more!" Olivia's turned all grumpy and sour but at least the petulant anger's brought with it a good dose of energy as she extends a hand and lets you pull her out of bed. "Let's just get this over with so I can go back to sleep."
rows.translation: 好吧，如果她感觉这么不舒服，那么或许让德莉法来看看是必要的。 奥利维亚的眼睛猛地睁开了，就好像你打了她一下一样。 [olivia.isCollared |你的小宠物 ]一想到这个念头，他就本能地感到一阵抗拒。“什、什么？” 德莉法可是一位女祭司啊。 [drifa.isCorrupt |严格来说。 ]她对这些事情应该有所了解。 “但是，你难道不认识一些经验更丰富、能力更强的人吗？你经常四处打听，搜集那些我需要用来创作歌曲和诗句的材料，肯定认识很多人吧。比如……比如村里那个老家伙，他叫什么来着……” 你大概能感觉到，让奥利维亚如此慌乱的原因，并不是德莉法的医疗能力，对吧？ 奥利维亚低着头，一言不发。 现在，你确实认识一些更加丰富多彩的角色吧——毫无疑问，这些角色会为故事增添许多趣味。 [evergreen.dealtWith |森娅 |常青女士 ]我很快就能弄清楚她到底出了什么问题。毕竟，她就在河对岸啊。话虽如此，但从一开始，德莉法就已经参与了这整个与腐化狼族有关的事件。[wayfort.hasCorlups |她一直在致力于研究阿斯盖尔和他的族人，试图找到治愈方法。 [olivia.isCollared |小宠物 |宫廷吟游诗人 ]她叹了口气，又躺回了床上。“有进展吗？” 至少，比萨鲁斯要顺利一些。 “不过这也说明不了什么，因为他本来就在努力尝试嘛。更糟的是看来治愈这种病的可能性不大，但德莉法已经设法将症状控制在了可以忍受的范围之内。 [corlup.recruited |能够以恰当的方式完成自己的工作，而不会重新变回那些被性欲冲昏头脑的野兽 |在他们的牢房里，环境已经足够安静了。这虽然还不是永久性的解决办法……但至少为所有相关人员带来了一些希望，即便这意味着他们余生都不得不应对自身的腐败问题。如果进展顺利，或许有朝一日我们真的可以心安理得地将他们释放出来 ]。 |而且，在这些方面，她拥有最丰富的经验。 [wayfort.hasDrifa |当然，可能还有其他经验更丰富的治疗者，但他们现在并不在这里，对吧？只要德莉法还在这里，她就有自己的职责要完成，那就是照顾堡垒里的伤员——这其中当然也包括奥利维亚 |虽然其他人可能比德莉法更熟练，但对她来说，了解奥利维亚的具体情况才是最重要的 ]。 ] 一声无奈的叹息。“好吧，亲爱的[olivia.isCollared | [pc.Master] ]我明白你的意思了。虽然我不喜欢这样，但事实就是如此。” 如果她的腐败症状开始恶化，德莉法才是最适合处理这个问题的人。你可能会问为什么奥利维亚还没有接受治疗，但你对这个答案应该已经有了一个大概的猜想。 好吧好吧，我再也不想听了！”奥利维亚变得脾气暴躁、满脸不悦，但至少这种任性带来的愤怒还让她充满了活力。她伸出手，让你把她从床上拉起来。“我们赶紧把这件事解决掉，这样我就能继续睡觉了。"

rows.original: It's a short walk over to [wayfort.hasDrifa |Drifa's chambers |the chambers Drifa usually occupies when she makes the trek up from the village ] — ever since the whole corrupted lupine incident, she's warranted one, and the wayfort still has plenty of empty room. [drifa.isMarried |Your [drifa.isCorrupt |wolf |dog ]-wife |The [drifa.isCorrupt |wolf |dog ]-girl ] perks up when she sees you enter, but her enthusiasm dampens slightly when she sees who you've got in tow. "Oh, it's you." The two [drifa.isCorrupt |wolves |dogs ]' eyes meet, and Drifa's ears flick. "Is something the matter?" You inform Drifa about Olivia's condition — that she came down with something serious enough to drive her to bed instead of her usual attention-seeking routine. Additionally, you tell her about Olivia's reluctance to come, and insist upon the importance that she needs to get a check-up. "I see." The two [drifa.isCorrupt |wolves |dogs ] eye each other, but a sharp glance at [olivia.isCollared |your pets |them ] stops that tension cold before it can grow into something worse. "Why don't you lie down, and we'll figure what's going on?" Olivia looks between you and Drifa, clearly hesitant to put herself at the mercy of another [drifa.isCorrupt |wolf |dog ] she considers her rival. You give her a firm nod, and she acquiesces, clambering onto the bed and laying herself out. "There's no need to be so tense," Drifa says[drifa.isCorrupt |, although the way she's showing her teeth is clearly intended to do anything but put Olivia at ease. "Just because I'm wearing a different coat, it doesn't mean I'm any less good at my job." | with a smile. "I am a priestess, after all." ] "It's not your competence I'm worried about." Drifa [drifa.isCorrupt |smirks. "Oh, don't worry about that. You're [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ]'s [olivia.isCollared |pet |property ] — I wouldn't dream of trying anything funny when [pc.heShe] clearly cares so much for you. That'd make [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |my darling ] most upset, and I'd prefer to avoid that." |lets her smile fall. "Olivia... please... I know we don't see eye to eye at times, and that makes it hard for you to trust me. But, please, I need you to set whatever feelings of rivalry you have for me aside and let me help you. This is about your health. If you won't do it for that, then do it for [drifa.isCollared |our [pc.master] |[pc.name] ]. [pc.HeShe] wouldn't have brought you here if [pc.heShe] didn't care about you." ] "Hmph..." [drifa.isCorrupt |Ladies, ladies. While this spat may have brought back some of Olivia's usual self, you've brought her to Drifa to be examined. If she wouldn't mind? Drifa dips her head. "Of course, [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |Darling ]." ]
rows.translation: 步行过去很近。 [wayfort.hasDrifa |德莉法的密室 |德莉法从村庄出发前往那里时通常会待在那些房间里。 ]自从那起狼族被腐蚀的事件之后，她确实应该得到这样一个机会，而且路标站里还有许多空位。 [drifa.isMarried |你的[drifa.isCorrupt |狼 |狗 ]妻子 |那个[drifa.isCorrupt |狼 |狗 ]-女孩 ]当她看到你走进来时，她的情绪立刻高涨起来，但当她看到你带着谁一起来时，她的热情又稍微减弱了一些。 “哦，原来是你啊。”两人说道。 [drifa.isCorrupt |狼群 |狗 ]他们的目光相遇，德莉法的耳朵微微一动。“出了什么问题吗？” 你向德莉法说明了奥利维亚的情况——她患上了某种严重的疾病，因此卧床不起，不再像往常那样到处惹人注意。你还告诉她，奥利维亚本来并不愿意来医院，但你坚决认为她必须接受检查。 “我明白了。”两人[drifa.isCorrupt |狼群 |狗 ]互相对视，但突然交换了一个锐利的目光。 [olivia.isCollared |你的宠物们 |他们 ]在那种紧张局势恶化之前，它就被及时制止了。“你为什么不躺下休息，我们再想办法弄清楚到底发生了什么？” 奥利维亚在你和德莉法之间来回看了看，显然很犹豫，不知道是否应该将自己的安危交到别人手中。 [drifa.isCorrupt |狼 |狗 ]她看着自己的竞争对手。你坚定地点了点头，她便同意了，爬上床躺了下来。 “没必要这么紧张，”德莉法说道。[drifa.isCorrupt |虽然她露出牙齿的方式显然是在试图表达某种意思但是让奥利维亚放心吧。“我只是换了件外套，并不意味着我的工作能力有所下降。 | 微笑着说道：“我是毕竟，她是一位女祭司。 ] 我担心的并不是你的能力问题。” 德莉法[drifa.isCorrupt |他咧嘴一笑：“哦，别担心那个。你[drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |[pc.name] ]的[olivia.isCollared |宠物 |财产 ] — 我才不会呢。梦想在尝试任何奇怪的事情时[pc.heShe]显然非常关心你。这样的举动说明[drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |亲爱的 ]我非常不高兴，因此我更愿意避免这种情况发生。 |让她露出微笑吧。“奥利维亚……求你了……我知道我们有时候意见不合，这也让你很难信任我。但是，求你，把我对你怀有的那些敌意放在一边，让我帮助这是关于你的健康的。如果不能为了你的健康而去做这件事，那么就为了别的原因去做吧。 [drifa.isCollared |我们的[pc.master] |[pc.name] ]。 [pc.HeShe]如果我不是这样做的，就不会带你来到这里了。 [pc.heShe]根本不在乎你。 ] 哼 [drifa.isCorrupt |女士们，女士们。虽然这场争执让奥利维亚恢复了一些往日的活力，但你们还是把她带到了德莉法这里接受检查。她应该不会介意吧？ 德莉法点了点头：“当然不会。 [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |亲爱的 ]。" ]

rows.original: You'd been intending to check in on Olivia given that you haven't spoken to your [olivia.isCollared |little pet |court bard ] in some time now, but her usual spot at the head of the high table is conspicuously empty and her audience missing. [dayNight |It's interesting that she's rooted herself so firmly as a fixture in the great hall that her disappearance is instantly noticed — at the very least, you know she's doing her job |One reasons that Olivia has to sleep sometime and it shouldn't be odd at this hour, but that hasn't been an issue when you previously sought her out, day or night ]. Another spat? You can't help but quicken your pace as you leave the hall and pass through the wayfort's corridors. Not that you needed to worry about your [olivia.isCollared |pets |dogs ] fighting each other, though. It's calm, almost too calm as you approach Drifa's chambers, one sense of unease replaced by another; you knock, push open the door, and are greeted by quite the sight. Now, out with it. ] "Now, Darling, you know how the corrupted lupines — well, mostly Tharsus and maybe Refnir — were planning to turn [drifa.isCorrupt |this bitch into a breeding slut |Olivia into a —" she wrinkles her nose distastefully at the phrase — "puppy mill ] when they were done with her?" Suffice to say that [olivia.isCollared |it's not just the powdered stuff that she brought up from home, her corruption's rooted itself so deeply that I think there isn't a contraceptive I know of that'll work on her at this point. Such a deep-seated change wouldn't have happened all at once — it probably worked itself through her over the time she was in that hole, and she herself had no idea because none of Asgeir's people touched her." You turn to Olivia, [olivia.isCollared |your little pet |the little dog ] still unable to meet your gaze. "I... guess that's another possible reason why they didn't take away my powder when I got press-ganged into being a so-called captain." Of course someone as easily flattered as Olivia was would've assumed it was simple rank privileges and not something more sinister. Anyways... Drifa? Drifa [drifa.isCorrupt |smirks |sighs ]. "Dutiful midwife as I am, I've been keeping a close eye on Olivia since we discovered she was with child. As the pup's grown, the changes have only become increasingly deep-rooted: even if I were to somehow devise a cure for what ails the corrupted lupines, I don't think this is something that can be reversed. "Well, there is a silver lining. The corruption's given [drifa.isCorrupt |this bitch |Olivia ] an uncanny control over her fertility — apparently, catching a litter in her belly doesn't happen unless she really wants it to, which... honestly, if it were me, I'd prefer something like this over taking brown leaves. [drifa.isCorrupt |[drifa.empowered |Well, you can't get them all, can you? "I still can't believe you really want this for yourself." "Not having to fiddle with brown leaves would be a weight off my mind." ] Olivia looks resigned at all this — no doubt she's had these last several months to rethink the direction her life's taking. rows.original: "I'll be as brief as possible, but you ought to take a seat regardless. Now, you remember how the corrupted lupines — well, mostly Tharsus and maybe Refnir — were planning to turn [drifa.isCorrupt |this bitch into a breeding slut |Olivia into a —" she wrinkles her nose distastefully at the phrase — "puppy mill ] when they were done with her?" Yes. "It seems like her corruption's affected how the powder she was using worked on her. That is, it didn't. Which makes sense, if she was going to be a packmother." Seems like? Drifa shrugs. "I've been back to that hole a few times to try and figure out more about Tharsus' work, but a lot of it is beyond me. To make things worse, Olivia tried to hide the fact that she was pregnant until her belly became too huge to conceal — which thankfully, didn't take long[drifa.isCorrupt |, the dumb bitch ]. Hence, I only got to examine her after that. "I still don't have a perfect understanding of this [drifa.isCorrupt |so-called ]corruption — may never will. [drifa.isCorrupted |There're only two corrupted lupine women, and I don't consider myself anything like your little side-bitch, thank you very much |There's only one corrupted lupine woman, and one's a painful number from which to draw generalizations ]. Suffice to say that for all that Olivia was dutifully taking the powder she brought up all the way from home, she may as well have been drinking flour in water." You turn to Olivia, [olivia.isCollared |your little pet |the little dog ] still unable to meet your gaze. "I... guess that's another possible reason why they didn't take away my powder when I got press-ganged into being a so-called captain. Not that any of them touched me while Asgeir still had plans for me, so..." Of course someone as easily flattered as Olivia would assume it was simple rank privileges and not something more sinister. Olivia harrumphs. "Well, there's no doubt he's yours. The last time I was with anyone else was ages ago, long since before I got dragged into that hole, so that rules out any other possibility." "Why she didn't instantly get knocked up after moving in under this roof... well, that's the silver lining. While her old powder doesn't work any more, she has to genuinely want to conceive in order for it to happen — which a fit of screaming, begging breeding appears to fit said bill. We all heard you through the walls months ago." "Look, if I'd known it'd turn out to be more than just play-acting —" You wave off Olivia's words. She wasn't the most emotionally continent of all people; it'd have happened sooner or later. Turning back to Drifa, you give her a nod — so, what happens now? [olivia.isCollared |[drifa.isCorrupt |"Should anything be done?" Drifa echoes, all but trembling with excitement herself. "If you ask me, Darling? This is fine — no, this is more than fine." "I'm not sure I feel that way," Olivia mutters, shooting you a glance. "Not about my son, of course, but about what's happening to me. If there isn't a single contraceptive that's going to work on [drifa.isCorrupt |this little cunt |Olivia ] thanks to her corruption, you just need to be careful about how worked up you get while [drifa.isCorrupt |fucking her stupid. That means, um, not getting to the point where I can hear you through the walls like what happened to cause this in the first place ] — so long as you don't get her to that point, she should be fine." Oh. If nothing else, it's an incentive for Olivia to learn to control her emotions even in the heat of the moment. "But it feels so good to just lose it," Olivia pouts. |"[drifa.isCorrupt |This little bitch |Olivia ] may be accustomed to the contraceptive she brought from home, but I've had her change to brown leaf now that her son's out of her." That'll work? Drifa sighs. "For now. It's not a lasting solution — in fact, the brown leaf's already showing signs of weakening — but it'll buy her enough time to [drifa.isCorrupt |scream and beg for a pup in her belly every time she gets railed. For something as small as her, she can make a lot of noise |learn to be a little more stoic, control her emotions better ]. My guess is that Tharsus banked on her not keeping herself in check." rows.raw: " "I'll be as brief as possible, but you ought to take a seat regardless. Yes. "It seems like her corruption's affected how the powder she was using worked on her. That is, it didn't. Which makes sense, if she was going to be a packmother." Seems like? Drifa shrugs. "I've been back to that hole a few times to try and figure out more about Tharsus' work, but a lot of it is beyond me. To make things worse, Olivia tried to hide the fact that she was pregnant until her belly became too huge to conceal — which thankfully, didn't take long[drifa.isCorrupt |, the dumb bitch ]. Hence, I only got to examine her after that. "I still don't have a perfect understanding of this [drifa.isCorrupt |so-called ]corruption — may never will. [drifa.isCorrupted |There're only two corrupted lupine women, and I don't consider myself anything like your little side-bitch, thank you very much |There's only one corrupted lupine woman, and one's a painful number from which to draw generalizations ]. Suffice to say that for all that Olivia was dutifully taking the powder she brought up all the way from home, she may as well have been drinking flour in water." You turn to Olivia, [olivia.isCollared |your little pet |the little dog ] still unable to meet your gaze. "I... guess that's another possible reason why they didn't take away my powder when I got press-ganged into being a so-called captain. Not that any of them touched me while Asgeir still had plans for me, so..." Of course someone as easily flattered as Olivia would assume it was simple rank privileges and not something more sinister. Olivia harrumphs. "Well, there's no doubt he's yours. The last time I was with anyone else was ages ago, long since before I got dragged into that hole, so that rules out any other possibility." "Why she didn't instantly get knocked up after moving in under this roof... well, that's the silver lining. While her old powder doesn't work any more, she has to genuinely want to conceive in order for it to happen — which a fit of screaming, begging breeding appears to fit said bill. We all heard you through the walls months ago." "Look, if I'd known it'd turn out to be more than just play-acting —" You wave off Olivia's words. She wasn't the most emotionally continent of all people; it'd have happened sooner or later. Turning back to Drifa, you give her a nod — so, what happens now? [olivia.isCollared |[drifa.isCorrupt |"Should anything be done?" Drifa echoes, all but trembling with excitement herself. "If you ask me, Darling? This is fine — no, this is more than fine." "I'm not sure I feel that way," Olivia mutters, shooting you a glance. "Not about my son, of course, but about what's happening to me. The thought of things happening under my skin that I don't have any control over... it feels gross." "Listen here you little [silly |shit |reprobate ] — I'd love to figure out what Tharsus did to you so I can replicate it for myself. This is a good thing that's happened to you — having that kind of control over yourself without needing to take teas or powders or whatnot — ooh, I'm getting all worked up just thinking about it." |"To be honest? I know Tharsus meant this to be a curse, but I think if you look at it from another perspective, it could be a blessing instead." Olivia shrinks in upon herself. "I don't feel very blessed. Not about my son, of course, but about what's happening to me. The thought of things happening under my skin that I don't have any control over... I know you're trying to make me feel better, Drifa, but it's still gross." "Well, it's not. To be honest, I'm a little envious. Being able to not have to bother with brown leaves and only have pups when you truly, genuinely want it to happen — it's the sort of thing a lumian priestess should be blessed with, isn't it? Olivia, I get how you feel, but since I can't do anything about this at the moment, approaching it from a different angle might make you feel better about the matter." "You... you'd really rather have it for yourself?" "Not having to fiddle with brown leaves would be a weight off my mind." ] So, her answer is to do nothing? "Not to do nothing, [drifa.isCollared |[pc.Master] |Darling ]. Just admitting what the situation is. If there isn't a single contraceptive that's going to work on [drifa.isCorrupt |this little cunt |Olivia ] thanks to her corruption, you just need to be careful about how worked up you get while [drifa.isCorrupt |fucking her stupid. That means not pushing her to the point where she's clawing the sheets and begging you to fuck a pup into her |doing it. That means, um, not getting to the point where I can hear you through the walls like what happened to cause this in the first place ] — so long as you don't get her to that point, she should be fine." Oh. If nothing else, it's an incentive for Olivia to learn to control her emotions even in the heat of the moment. "But it feels so good to just lose it," Olivia pouts. |"[drifa.isCorrupt |This little bitch |Olivia ] may be accustomed to the contraceptive she brought from home, but I've had her change to brown leaf now that her son's out of her." That'll work? Drifa sighs. "For now. It's not a lasting solution — in fact, the brown leaf's already showing signs of weakening — but it'll buy her enough time to [drifa.isCorrupt |scream and beg for a pup in her belly every time she gets railed. "Not enough to [drifa.isCorrupt |stop her from squeezing a brat out from between her legs |prevent this from happening ]." Drifa shakes her head. "The corruption was already thick to begin with, but months of having a pup in her belly has made it truly deep-rooted, given what it was intended to do. [drifa.isCorrupt |I |I'm not about to give up hope just yet, but i ]t's likely that Olivia will just have to live with this for the rest of her life." "Constantly needy and crying, wanting my attention, demanding food at ungodly hours... at least our son has an excuse, but I had none. Feels like I'm getting a taste of my own medicine." ] Case in point. Well... one last thing. Can you hold your son? "Yes, but later." Olivia sighs. "He gets really cranky after feeding — stop biting, you little shit!" Heh, he takes after his mother, then. You know better than to disturb Olivia after she's just eaten. "Hmph!" Is she still mad? "Not as much as before, but yes." Look... you're sorry for not being home all this time, but you expected the wayfort to keep running while you were away. She... is she serious? "A little. I don't mind either way — all in all, the experience wasn't as scary as I'd thought it would be. ]" You'll consider it. Drifa? [drifa.isCollared |Us girls have to watch out for each other, after all. |It's nice to have someone special to look after, isn't it? ]" Having a half-lupine son wasn't on your list of things to come home to, but you're glad it turned out as best as could be hoped for. All's well ends well, you suppose... "

Olivia chuckles, then jabs a finger at her lower belly. "You and I, we very definitely wanted this to happen. It's not something that I ever thought I'd enjoy doing, but now that I've tried it? With the right person... well, this is better than what my fate would likely be had I stayed home." With Drifa minding her, you're sure she's in good hands. With enough investigation into how the pool's affected her, maybe Drifa will be able to concoct a cure someday. A sigh. "No hope, no fear, as the chaplain back home used to say. Now that you're aware I'm with child... what did you come for to begin with?

|别太勉强自己了，奥利维亚，”德莉法一边说，一边给奥利维亚端来一杯热汤。“虽然这种愉悦感会让人忽略一个事实：每次生产都会对你的身体造成负担。即便那种‘腐蚀’力量在增强你的体质，我还是建议你适度休息，不要过度劳累。……而且，每次看到这种情绪在你心中越来越根深蒂固，真的让我很担心。到目前为止，还没有出现任何不良后果，但是……” |奥利维亚，你的能力总是让我感到惊讶，”德莉法一边说着，一边将一杯汤递给她的宠物伙伴。“我只希望，当我遇到同样的情况时，也能拥有这样的毅力。” 奥利维亚仔细观察德莉法的语气，试图找出任何奉承的意味，但并没有发现，于是她叹了口气，开始喝起汤来。别这样。我为了变成现在这个样子所经历的一切，是你这种善良的人根本不应该承受的。你拥有纯真，这种品质如此珍贵而又如此短暂——真的不值得为此付出如此大的代价。 “现在回想起来，一切都清晰地呈现在我的眼前。他们的意图就是利用我，直到我彻底崩溃为止，我对此非常确定。这和我现在所处的处境完全一样。所以，别想跟我一起陷入这种困境了，你这个伪善的人。我敢肯定。 [pc.Master]我可不想让你为此付出代价。 ] ] ] 面对这个问题，奥利维亚重新躺回床上，闭上眼睛，脸上洋溢着幸福的笑容。而德莉法则最后再看了一眼自己的职责对象，确认母子俩都安然无恙后，才向他们点了点头便离开了。现在只剩下你和奥利维亚以及你刚出生的小狗在一起，你轻声地对着它们说着什么，直到它们因为刚刚经历的这一切而渐渐进入沉睡状态。 尽管奥利维亚为了获得他人的喜爱尝试了各种各样的方法……但看来，她终于找到了自己一直在追求的东西。
rows.raw: " Now that all the fuss is over, the both of you are able to sit and take stock of everything that's happened while Drifa busies herself with the rest of the clean-up: [olivia.pregStage 2 3 4 |while your pet continues to nurse the newborn, you ply her with praise and pats, congratulating her for doing so well even as you dry her off. Bashful contentment really does fit what was once a haughty heiress, especially with a collar about her neck and a pup at her breast — the old Olivia would've held her nose and dispensed with this as a duty expected of someone in her position, but seeing her this pleased with herself at what she's achieved is much better. |clutching the newborn pup to herself, Olivia struggles to sit up in bed, her movement still awkward from the occasional spasm of pleasure emanating from her lower belly. You help her up and prop her against a firm pillow, at which your pet nods in thanks and focuses on the feeding. One has to admit, Olivia looks regal despite what she's just gone through, arguably even dignified and portrait-worthy, with a jewelled collar about her neck and pup at her breast. Ears folded and eyes half-lidded, your recently-pregnant pet appears entirely pleased with what she's managed to achieve. Good, good. At least she's no longer fretting over what her pup might turn out like — Olivia's time spent stuck amongst the corrupted lupines will never leave her, but at least she's taken everything in stride. |you praise and pet Olivia with all your might while she gathers herself and nurses the newborn, keeping her mind focused throughout the constant spasms of pleasure emanating from her lower belly in the wake of the high of the actual birth. Given that your recently-pregnant pet's achieved quite the feat, she deserves it. Well, as focused as she can be — while Olivia's not outright insensate, she isn't forming any coherent words for the new few hours. No matter how her corruption prepares her your pet's body for the ordeal, she just takes it as an excuse to enjoy the act of whelping all the more. And frankly? She wouldn't be Olivia if she didn't. Some things change, as the jewelled collar about her neck and silly smile on her face prove... and others don't. ] By and large, Olivia slowly comes to herself again, light flickering in her eyes as she processes through her exhaustion and pleasure the enormity of what she's achieved yet again. With one hand in yours and her other arm cradling the newborn pup to her breast, she looks [pc.heightRange 54 |up |over ] at you and gives you a sheepish smile. "Looks like I managed it yet again, Dearest [pc.Master]." And so she has. Now that it isn't anything new to her, she looked like she was really enjoying herself, which suits you just fine. Having your pups should be pleasurable from start to end, and you're proud of her for handling herself well up till the last. Olivia bows her head and nuzzles the pup, then turns to you with a sheepish smile. [olivia.pregStage 2 3 4 |"I suppose it's better than pain, even if it's no less exhausting in its own way. But if it weren't for you, Dearest [pc.Master], I still wouldn't have put up with any of this in the slightest." Come now, there's no need to keep up appearances, not when you've just seen her heart laid bare in the throes of — well, she knows. |"I've talked it over with Drifa before. There's no reason it should feel that good, and yet it does. As tempting as it might be, though... I wouldn't put up with any of this if it weren't for you, Dearest [pc.Master]. For you... I'll keep on having, so long as you're willing to keep on giving." |"Of course it's going to feel good, it's coming from you. Being with child for so long does get inconvenient at times, and it's a little something for waddling around like a ball on legs for twice as long as I should've been." And if it weren't you who put the pup in her, she wouldn't have deigned to endure it in the slightest? "Dearest [pc.Master], that's not really a meaningful question, is it? There's no one else in the Marches who can put a pup in this body of mine, let alone one the size of this brat." ] [drifa.isCorrupt |[drifa.isPregnant |Smirking, Drifa leans in over the bed and gives Olivia a kiss on the side of her brow. "Well done, well done. Our pack just got a little bigger... and soon, it'll be my turn to do my part." "Not going to ask me to pace myself?" "Why should I? You're seem to know what you're doing. So long as it's all for [pc.Master], I don't care." "So long as it's all for [pc.Master]," Olivia agrees with a sigh. "Don't worry about biting off more than you can chew — after seeing you pop brats like nothing this many times, I'm actually quite envious. Sure, I get off on birthing too, but it's nowhere as intense as what you enjoy. Still, we fill different roles in this endeavor, so I guess I'm just being a bitch." "And you'll fill us up as often as we need to be, right, Dearest [pc.Master]?" Squeezing your fingers, Olivia smiles up at you. "Your pets are quite literally laboring in your name and for your glory..." |[drifa.hasKids |Holding out a mug of warm broth to the littler wolf-girl, Drifa sidles up by the bedside and smirks down at Olivia. By how smug she's being, you'd imagine she was the one who'd just whelped instead of her fellow pet. "Take some time to recover after this one," she chuckles as Olivia accepts the mug and sips quietly. "It's my turn next. Besides, you're the one suited to slow, large loads; I'm better at popping them out quickly." Olivia rolls her eyes, but keeps her smile. "Come on, bitch. Here and now, in front of [pc.Master]? You're shameless." "I left all of my shame back in that hole. Figured I wasn't going to have need of it where I'm going. And as for [pc.Master]... we're putting together a pack in [pc.hisHer] name, growing it from [pc.hisHer] seed. Of course [pc.heShe] should be hearing this, probably turns [pc.himHer] on. Aren't I right, [pc.Master]?" You carefully hold your tongue and give Olivia's arm a firm squeeze. Drifa just laughs and retrieves the mug once Olivia's drained it. "We literally labor for your glory, [pc.Master]. We'll put together something far greater and more worthy than the idiot Asgeir could ever, and have fun while doing it to boot. Rest while you can, Olivia — I don't take as long as you do to grow a pup." |"You looked like you were having fun," Drifa says as she hands Olivia a mug of warm broth, then leans in to give the littler wolf-girl a kiss on the brow. "Most unlike every other time I've attended to someone in childbed, but that's old news to you at this point, isn't it?" "I can't say I'd prefer pain," Olivia muses as she sips from the mug. "But that moment when everything just felt right and it came..." Drifa takes a deep breath. "I could feel it coming from you." "You want it for yourself, don't you? Sure, it's fun, and there were times during the birth when I wasn't sure if I'd be coming back. But... what makes it all worthwhile is that I'm bringing [pc.Master]'s pups into this world." ] ] |[drifa.isPregnant |At length, Drifa brings Olivia a mug of warm broth, which the latter accepts and sips gracefully. Now that Olivia's belly is much flatter without a pup in it, just the squishy leftovers until she returns to shape, Drifa looks positively fit to pop by comparison. "Your turn next, goody-two-shoes," Olivia sighs as she leans back in bed. "I'd wish you good luck, but you don't need it to do well anyway." "You could always learn a bit of midwifery," Drifa replies. "Help me when it's my time." "Tempting, but I don't have the bedside manner for it. That, and you have plenty of people around to help, being a local with roots and all. Me... I just have [pc.name] and you. Not being a bitch or anything, but... I'd just be a klutz at that kind of work." A smile as Drifa retrieves the mug. "Sounds like an excuse to me." "Don't get ahead of yourself, goody-two-shoes. I have the feeling that I'll be fat and waddling again by the time you've whelped." |[drifa.hasKids |"Don't push yourself too hard, Olivia," Drifa adds as she brings Olivia a mug of warm broth. "The pleasure does mask the fact that each pup you bear does take a toll on your body. Even with the corruption fortifying you, I'd gently urge you to pace yourself... that, and seeing it ingrain itself further in you each time is worrying. There've been no adverse effects so far, but..." "I get it, I get it," Olivia sighs. "Thanks for worrying about me, Drifa. I'm too tired to get mad at you, so I'll just lie here and let you lecture me." "I've had [pc.Master]'s pups too, Olivia. Without the kind of help you have. It's worth doing, and doing lots, but all I'm saying is that you don't want to burn yourself out." |"You never cease to amaze me at what you're capable of, Olivia," Drifa says as she hands her fellow pet a mug of broth. "I can only hope I'll have this kind of fortitude when it's my turn." Olivia eyes Drifa for any trace of flattery, and failing to find it, sinks back with a sigh before sipping at the mug. "Don't be. You're left alone with Olivia and your newborn pup, quietly murmuring nothings to them as they drift off from the effort of the ordeal. For all the things she's tried in her need to be liked by others... it seems that Olivia's finally found what she was seeking. "

"Champion."]

rows.translation: 去和那位堕落的圣骑士谈谈吧。

rows.original: There's a commotion coming from the fort's south gate when you arrive. A group of lupine loggers from town are gathered around an armored woman who's just a few inches shorter than they are, all wagging their tails and talking excitedly. You've barely closed the distance to the crowd when a voice booms over the wolfmen: "So the rumors were true! This [wayfort.renovated |place is your domain |trash heap does draw all kinds ]." It's damn familiar, but you can't quite place it until the loggers make way for the woman in their midst. You've... never seen her before in your life, a pale redhead with a broad-set amazonian physique and a pair of horse ears poking through holes in a white and green cowl wrapped around her. But you'd recognize that armor anywhere, bronze burned black by dragonfire and gouged out with mighty claws. That damned demon knight. The real Calise. She's wearing a human disguise — or half-human, anyway. There's a horse tail flicking behind her, and those ears; her legs have a thick coat of fur on them too, though they're still shaped like a human's. The demoness returns your appraising look, leaning on a two-handed war axe. She waves the loggers off. "Give us some space, would you? I need to talk to [pc.isBaron |the [pc.mf |baron |baroness ] of this place |the Champion here ]." The pack of wolf-men bow their heads respectfully — to Calise as much as to you — and head back towards their camp in the forest. The demoness's lips draw taut a moment, and then she sighs once the last of them are past the gates. "Fucking hell. Those idiots saw a Velunite cowl and came running for my blessings. Was close to suffocating around all that fur and slobber..." "What're you doing here, anyway?" you ask. "I thought you'd be long gone by now." Calise snorts. Somehow it sounds more equine now, in her disguise. "Gone where? My god forsook me, my soul's gone, nobody's heard a peep out of Tollus or any of the cult... I'm fucking adrift. Ever since the battle I've just been wandering around wondering, what the fuck do I do now?" She shrugs. "Guess you could say my feet carried me here. You know I'd been working on a plan to take this place over, after Khor'minos... use it as a stepping stone to take over the boreal elf kingdom.[wayfort.renovated| Plus it'd be a kick right in your nuts if you escaped the siege!] Must have still had it on the mind." How reassuring. The towering warrior leans against the stone wall. "Fuck off with that look. All that goes through my god-damned mind is ways to fight. Sitting still like this has my blood fuckin' boiling. But I'm trying, anyway. I'm not here to pick a fight." "Then why are you here?" Calise's ears flatten against her scalp, but she gives you a scowl that could kill. "What do you think? I've got nowhere to go. My people back home would kill me for what I've become. So it's either this or I go throw myself off a cliff... but you made the effort to keep me alive when I'd have been happy to do a whole lot worse to you. So maybe you could use somebody like me around to kill whatever comes to fuck this place up? Cult, demons, monsters, whatever... I don't care as long as there's something to fight. And out here in the wilderness there ought to be plenty of shit you'll want dead."
rows.translation: 当你到达堡垒的南门时，那里正传来一阵喧闹声。一群来自镇上的狼族伐木工聚集在一位身材只比他们矮几英寸的装甲女子周围，他们全都兴奋地摇着尾巴，交谈着。 你刚走到人群附近，一个声音突然在那些狼族中间响起：“原来那些传言都是真的！这个[wayfort.renovated |地点是你的领域 |垃圾堆确实会吸引各种各样的东西。 ]这种感觉真是太熟悉了，但直到那些伐木工让出道路，让一位女人出现在他们中间时，你才终于想起来在哪里见过她。你……这辈子从来没见过她，她是一个皮肤苍白、红发的女性，拥有结实如亚马逊女战士般的体格，一头马尾辫从她围在身上的白绿相间的头巾中露出来。但你在任何地方都能认出那套盔甲：被龙火烧得通黑，上面还留有凶猛爪子留下的痕迹。 那个该死的恶魔骑士……真正的卡莉丝。 她现在伪装成了人类——或者说，至少是半人类形态。她的背后有一条马尾在摆动，那对耳朵也是；她的双腿上也覆盖着一层厚厚的毛发，不过它们的形状仍然像人类的腿。 这位女恶魔回望着你那充满赞赏的目光，同时倚靠着一柄双手战斧。她挥手让那些伐木工们退开。“请给我们一点空间，好吗？我得和[pc.isBaron |此地的[pc.mf |男爵 |女男爵 ] |这里的勇士 ]谈谈。”那群狼族恭敬地低下了头——既向卡莉丝致敬，也向你表示敬意——然后便朝着森林中的营地方向走去。恶魔女子的嘴唇紧绷了片刻，直到最后一名狼族离开大门后，她才长叹一声。该死，那些蠢货一看到维伦信徒兜帽就跑过来求我赐福……被那些毛皮和口水弄得差点窒息……” “你到底在这里干什么？”你问道，“我本来以为你早就走了呢。卡莉丝哼了一声。在这种伪装下，她的声音听起来倒更像马了。“走了在哪里我的天啊，我的灵魂都快崩溃了……从来没有人听到过托勒斯或者那个邪教组织有任何动静……我现在真的感觉自己像个无家可归的人。自从那场战斗之后，我就一直在四处游荡，不知道自己现在到底该做什么。”她耸了耸肩，“大概可以说，是命运的安排让我来到了这里。你知道的，在科尔米诺斯的事情之后，我就一直在策划如何夺取这个地方的控制权……打算把它作为跳板，进而掌控整个极北精灵王国。[wayfort.renovated| 更何况，如果你成功突破了包围，那可真是太棒了！]肯定还是没把那件事忘掉。” 真是让人安心啊。 那个高大的战士靠在石墙上：“别用那种眼神看我。我满脑子想的都是怎么战斗。像现在这样坐着，简直让我怒火中烧。不过我还是在努力控制自己，我可不是来惹事的。” “那为什么是你在这里干什么？” 卡莉丝的耳朵贴在头皮上，但她瞪着你的眼神简直能杀人。“你以为呢？我无处可去。如果我回到家乡，我的族人会因为我现在的样子而杀了我。所以，要么留在这里，要么就跳下悬崖自杀。…但是当你让我活下来的时候，我其实完全有可能对你做出更过分的事情。所以，或许你可以让我这样的人来帮忙对付那些想要毁掉这个地方的东西吧？无论是邪教、恶魔还是怪物，什么都行。……只要有敌人可以战斗，我根本不在乎。而在这片荒野里，肯定有很多你恨不得杀死的家伙吧。

真的没有其他地方了吗？

rows.original: Does she really have nowhere else to go?
rows.translation: 她真的没有其他地方可去了吗？
rows.raw: "Does she really have nowhere else to go?"

rows.original: So that's what her demonic obsession is: battle?
rows.translation: 原来她那近乎魔一般的执着就是为了战斗吗？
rows.raw: "So that's what her demonic obsession is: battle?"

rows.original: She doesn't quite look like you remember, but at least she's gotten rid of that perpetual snarl.
rows.translation: 她看起来确实和你记忆中的不太一样了，但至少她不再总是皱着眉头了。
rows.raw: "She doesn't quite look like you remember, but at least she's gotten rid of that perpetual snarl."

rows.original:
Calise throws her hands up. "No, I don't have anywhere else! I know the cult's got some base out in the Sailgraves, but fuck that shit. I can't go home... and even if I could, I know I'd just spread this damn corruption there, too. I can't do that to the people I swore to protect... even I've got enough of my senses left to feel my heart tearing apart at the thought! So where else but here? Who the fuck else'd take me in... and who else is strong enough to keep me from doing more things I'll regret?"

    Her shoulders slump. "I didn't ask to be a gods-damned monster, [pc.name]. The bitch-queen turned me into this. I'm not so far fucking gone that I don't see what I am. I wanted to die the whole time I was with the cult, just looking for somebody strong enough that wouldn't pussy out of it like she did. Instead I got you, but you're... at least you're [pc.isDK|a monster with a goal I can get behind|not a monster, too. Inside or out]. Whatever I've become, you can stop me if I go too far. You've proven that. I don't trust myself, but I trust your strength."
rows.translation:
卡莉丝举起双手。“不，我没有别的地方可去！我知道邪教在帆葬海岸某处设有基地，但去他妈的。我不能回家……即使能够回去，我也知道自己只会把这该死的腐化传播到那里。我不能这样对待那些自己发誓保护的人……就连我也还保有足够的理智，光是想到这点便觉得心都要撕裂了！所以除了这里还能去哪儿？他妈的还有谁愿意收留我……又有谁足够强大，能阻止我再做出后悔的事？”

    她垂下双肩。“我没要求自己变成一个诸神诅咒的怪物，[pc.name]。那个贱人女王把我变成了这样。我还没有他妈的堕落到看不清自己是什么。和邪教待在一起时，我无时无刻不想死，只是在寻找一个足够强大、不会像她一样临阵退缩的人。结果我遇见了你，可你……至少你[pc.isDK|是个目标令我愿意支持的怪物|同样不是怪物，无论内在还是外表]。无论我变成了什么，只要我做得太过火，你都能阻止我。你已经证明过这一点。我不相信自己，但相信你的力量。”

rows.translation: 真的没有其他地方了吗？

rows.original:
"I guess it is," Calise growls. "It's hard to think about anything else. I see somebody, anybody, and I size them up. Gauge if they'll be strong enough to actually challenge me... or if they're so disgusting it's worth smearing the floor with them even if they aren't. You'll never understand how much I'm pulling myself back from lunging at you right now. The idea of crossing blades with you again makes me drench my fucking thighs!"

    She's breathing a little heavier now, cheeks flushing. Her tail whips back and forth against the fort's outer wall, kicking up dust. 
    
    "Easy, now."
    
    "I know! I'm in control. For now. But that's the point. I need something to fight. Something worthwhile. I figure, a place like this, you've got to have monsters and brigands crawling all over the place looking to take advantage. I know the cult was eyeing this place up real good. Other powers will be, now that Tollus is licking his wounds. You could use somebody with my... talents. And I need an outlet that doesn't make me want to kill myself. We both win."
    
    "Can I trust you not to fight the people here, if I let you stay?"
    
    Calise's knuckles crack around the haft of her axe. "No. Maybe? I'm fucking trying here." She snorts again. "If it gets bad, I'll fly to Khor'minos and enter the arena. Beat somebody that wanted to get their ass whooped! Or sortie out and find some bear to beat to death with my bare hands! I'm not... I didn't come here to fuck with you, damn it. This isn't some ploy to come in and wreck [wayfort.renovated|your home|the merchant caravans] while you're away. I don't exactly have a god to swear on now, but I would."
rows.translation:
我想是的，”卡莉丝低吼道，“真的很难去想其他事情。每当看到有人出现，我就会立刻评估他们——判断他们是否有足够的实力来挑战我……或者，他们是否糟糕到就算没有实力也值得我与他们交手。你永远无法理解，我现在究竟在多大程度上克制着自己，才没有直接冲向你。一想到要再次与你刀锋相对，我就觉得自己的大腿都在发抖！

    她的呼吸变得有些急促，脸颊也涨得通红。她的尾巴在堡垒的外墙上不停地来回抽打，扬起了阵阵尘土。
    
    “放松一点，好吗。”
    
    “我知道！我现在是可以控制的。至少现在是这样。但问题就在这里——我需要一些东西来发泄我的情绪，需要一些敌人来与我战斗。确实很有意思。我想，像这样的地方，肯定会有怪物和强盗四处出没，企图占为己有。我知道那个邪教组织早就盯上了这个地方。现在托勒斯正在恢复元气，其他势力也会纷纷前来抢夺的。你可以找一个拥有我这种才能的人来帮忙。而我，也需要一个不会让我想要自杀的工作环境。这样我们双方都能得到好处。
    
    如果我让你留在这里，你能保证不会和这里的人发生冲突吗？”
    
    卡莉丝紧握着斧头的把手，指关节都快咯咯作响了。“不能保证……也许吧？我确实在尽力保持冷静。”她又哼了一声，“但如果情况变糟，我就飞去科尔米诺斯，参加竞技场比赛，打败那些想找我麻烦的人！或者干脆走出去，找头熊用拳头把它打死！我可不是……我他妈不是来这儿跟你闹着玩的，明白吗？这根本不是什么诡计，更不是来这儿捣乱的。 [wayfort.renovated|你的家|商队]趁你不在的时候。我现在确实没有什么可以用来发誓的东西，但我确实是这么想的。

rows.original:
"Hah, I'd get lynched if I walked around in my true skin now. But seeing the bitch-queen wearing her old body, I thought, why not do that myself?" Calise spreads her arms, showing off her muscular, half-equine physique. "This is me, before the red whore changed me. It's not easy to keep this skin on, I'm no witch, but... weirdly, it kind of helps keep my mind focused. Gives me something to concentrate on other than how much I want to slam you against this wall and choke the life out of you." 
    
    Calise gives you a half-hearted little snarl. "Or maybe something else. You asking about this look for a reason, Champion? Hah. I never thought I was pretty, even as a little girl I was tall and gangly. Now I'm a fucking mountain. Or, well, I was. Am? Fuck knows. I pack on muscle like an orc and I've got stamina to go six rounds with one in the ring, or in bed, or both.[party.has arona
        |"
        
        Arona licks one of her tusks. "I'd take you up on that. Bet I'd win against your soul-suckin' powers."
        
        "Get in line," Calise laughs. "
    ] I know I'm not some slim, beautiful princess like the bitch-queen... but I know I could handle you going all out on me. And I bet you could take me, too."
    
    She rolls her shoulders and flexes a bicep, showing off just how meaty her arms are. "Give me leave to stay here and you can see what this old body of mine was capable of any way you want it. In battle, in bed, fuck if I care. You can have your way with me. I'm not too proud to trade sex for shelter anymore."
    
    [party.has arona
        |Arona gives you an almost pleading look. "C'mooooon. Let her stay."
    ]
rows.translation:
“哈，我现在要是以真实皮囊四处走动，非被私刑打死不可。可看到那婊子女王还穿着她原来的身体，我就想，为什么不自己也这么干呢？”卡莉丝张开双臂，展示着自己肌肉发达、半马形的体格。“这就是我，在那个红发婊子改变我之前的样子。维持这副皮囊可不容易，我可不是女巫，不过……奇怪的是，这反而有助于让我保持专注。让我有别的事可以集中精神，而不用总想着有多想把你摔到墙上掐死你。” 
    
    卡莉丝有气无力地朝你低吼了一声。“或者也许是别的东西。你问起我这副模样，总有原因吧，冠军？哈。我从没觉得自己漂亮过，就算还是个小姑娘的时候，我也是又高又瘦长。现在我是座该死的山。或者说，嗯，我曾经是。现在还是吗？鬼知道。我像兽人一样长肌肉，体力也够跟一个在擂台上打六个回合，或者在床上，或者两样都来。[party.has arona
        |”
        
        阿罗娜舔了舔自己的一颗獠牙。“我接受你的挑战。我打赌我能赢过你那套吸人灵魂的本事。”
        
        “排队等着吧，”卡莉丝笑道。“
    ]我知道自己不是什么苗条美丽的公主，不像那个婊子女王……但我知道我扛得住你对我全力施为。而且我打赌你也受得住我。”
    
    她转了转肩膀，绷起一块二头肌，展示自己的手臂有多结实。“只要准我留在这里，你想怎么检验我这具老身体的能耐都行。在战场上，在床上，我他妈才不在乎。你可以随意摆布我。我已经不再高傲到不肯用性来换一个容身之处了。”
    
    [party.has arona
        |阿罗娜用近乎恳求的眼神看着你。“来嘛——。让她留下吧。”
    ]

rows.original: "Alright. You can stay." "Fuck yeah!" Calise says, pumping her fist. "I know you've got no reason to trust me, [pc.name], but I'll try not to fuck this up. Don't have a great track record of that in my life, but... I'll try. If nothing else you don't have to worry about anybody attacking this place while I'm here. I'll die before I let a single foe take one step past these gates, you have my word!" She hefts her axe onto her shoulder and looks towards the keep. "So this is... home now, huh? Feels weird to say." You glance between her and the old stones. "Been traveling for that long?" "No. I just... never really had one," Calise shrugs. "I had a people, the Tilamac tribe. But they weren't a home. It... fuck, nag my ear off about it later. I want to explore this place. See where I can lay my head." She clasps your shoulder. You brace for impact, ready for the demon knight to really hammer you, but her touch is surprisingly gentle. Despite yourself, you flinch a little. "Hey. I'm not... I'm in control. I'm not going to hurt you. Not unless you want me to." Calise flashes you a hint of a smirk. "I was just going to say..." She takes a deep breath, and closes her eyes. "Thanks. You should have fucking killed me. You're an idiot for not, and maybe you'll regret it. But gods damn if I'm not going to at least try and make sure you don't. It's not easy keeping my shit together, but I was a paladin once. I'm not so weak-willed that I'll turn on you just because my blood rises at the thought. It's just another kind of fight, just against myself. And I plan on winning." Now she sounds like she just enjoys tormenting herself! But if it keeps her from lashing out at you and the rest of the fort's denizens, well, that's something anyway. Calise squeezes your shoulder, again much gentler than you expected. "Unless you wanna fight sometime. Or... figure out some other way to help me work this aggression out. Until then, I'll be around. Just grab me whenever you want me." "I'll do that..."
rows.translation: “好吧。你可以留下。” “他妈的好极了！”卡莉丝挥着拳头说道。“我知道你没理由信任我，[pc.name]，但我会尽量不把这件事搞砸。我这辈子在这方面的记录可不怎么样，不过……我会努力。别的且不说，只要我在这儿，你就不用担心有人来攻打这个地方。我宁可死，也不会让任何一个敌人跨过这些大门一步，我向你保证！” 她把斧头扛到肩上，望向城堡。“所以这里现在就是……家了，是吧？说出来感觉怪怪的。” 你在她和那些古老的石墙之间来回看了看。“你旅行了那么久吗？” “不。我只是……从来就没有过真正的家，”卡莉丝耸了耸肩。“我有过我的族人，蒂拉马克部落。但那不算家。那……操，这事以后你再拿它来烦我吧。我想逛逛这个地方，看看哪儿能让我躺下睡觉。” 她抓住你的肩膀。你绷紧身子准备承受冲击，等着这位恶魔骑士狠狠来一下，可她的触碰却出奇地轻柔。你不由自主地微微一缩。“嘿。我不是……我能控制住。我不会伤害你。除非你想让我这么做。”卡莉丝露出一丝若有若无的坏笑。“我只是想说……” 她深吸一口气，闭上了眼睛。“谢谢。你当初就该他妈的杀了我。你没杀，就是个白痴，也许你以后会后悔。但老天作证，我至少会努力确保你不会后悔。保持理智并不容易，可我曾经是一名圣骑士。我还没软弱到因为一想到这个就热血上涌便背叛你。这只是另一种战斗，对手是我自己。而我打算赢。” 现在她听起来倒像是挺享受折磨自己的！但如果这能让她不对你和堡垒里其他人发作，那好歹也算是件好事。 卡莉丝捏了捏你的肩膀，又比你预想的轻柔得多。“除非你什么时候想打架。或者……想出别的办法帮我发泄这股冲动。在那之前，我都会在这儿。想要我的时候随时来找我。” “我会的……”

rows.original:
"No way you're staying here," you say. "I let you go, so go. Surely you'll find somewhere that'll take you in."
    
    "Yeah back in the fucking cult. Fuck!" Calise groans. Maybe I'll try west of here. The Greyvales. I hear there's all sorts of nasty creatures in those mountains. Maybe one of 'em will be worth dying to."
    
    The demoness pulls her shawl around herself and hefts up her axe. "Just put your foot up that bitch-queen's ass for me if she ever shows herself again. Shame I won't be there to see it."
    
    You're only a little surprised she leaves without forcing the issue. Maybe she has learned something, at least...
rows.translation:
“你绝对不能留在这里，”你说。“我放你走了，那就走吧。你肯定能找到愿意收留你的地方。”
    
    “是啊，回到那该死的邪教里去。操！”卡莉丝呻吟道。也许我该往西边试试。灰谷。我听说那些山里什么样的凶恶生物都有。也许其中有一个值得我为它去死。”
    
    女恶魔把披肩裹紧自己，举起了斧头。“要是那个婊子女王再露面，替我狠狠踹她的屁股。可惜我看不到了。”
    
    她没再纠缠就走了，你只是稍微有点意外。也许她至少学到了点什么……

rows.original: Maybe Calise could show you a thing or two?
rows.translation: 也许卡莉丝可以给你指点一两招？
rows.raw: "Maybe Calise could show you a thing or two?"

rows.original: Take Calise for a roll in the hay.
rows.translation: 带卡莉丝去干草堆里滚上一回吧。
rows.raw: "Take Calise for a roll in the hay."

rows.original: "Just want to talk? Not exactly my strong suit," Calise grumbles. "But fine. I'm yours to do with as you please, even if it's just... talking. So, speak your piece. I'm listening."
rows.translation: “就只想聊聊而已？这确实不是我的强项，”卡莉丝抱怨道，“不过好吧，你想怎么利用我都行，哪怕只是……聊天而已。那么，你说吧，我在听。”
rows.raw: '\n    "Just want to talk? Not exactly my strong suit," Calise grumbles. "But fine. I\'m yours to do with as you please, even if it\'s just... talking. So, speak your piece. I\'m listening."\n    '

rows.original: Calise mentioned her people, the Tilamac, but also said they were never a home for her...
rows.translation: 卡莉丝提到了她的族人——蒂拉马克人，但也表示他们从来都不是她的归宿……
rows.raw: "Calise mentioned her people, the Tilamac, but also said they were never a home for her..."

rows.original: Ask about the actual place she's from. What's it like?
rows.translation: 问问她到底来自哪个地方，那里是怎样的一个地方。
rows.raw: "Ask about the actual place she's from. What's it like?"

rows.original: So who's this mysterious lady Calise was mumbling about?
rows.translation: 那么，卡莉丝一直在喃喃自语的这位神秘女士到底是谁呢？
rows.raw: "So who's this mysterious lady Calise was mumbling about?"

rows.original: So how did Calise actually become the Champion of Velun, rather than just another of his armed followers?
rows.translation: 那么，卡莉丝究竟是如何成为维伦的冠军的，而不是仅仅成为他的一个武装追随者而已呢？
rows.raw: "So how did Calise actually become the Champion of Velun, rather than just another of his armed followers?"

rows.original: How's she coping with living as a demon, free from the cult?
rows.translation: 她现在作为一只恶魔生活，摆脱了那个邪教的束缚，她是怎么应对这种生活的呢？
rows.raw: "How's she coping with living as a demon, free from the cult?"

rows.original:
"Oh, that..." Calise grunts, planting her hands on the haft of her axe, jutting up between her legs. "Yeah, shit, I did say that. Fuck you for remembering."
    
    You give her a look, and she sighs. "What do you want to know?"
    
    "Who are the Tilamac, for starters."
    
    "They're Valgars," Calise says. Her hands gesture vaguely south. "I don't know if that means anything to you. Hillfolk from near the coast, other side of Old Belhar from here. Pretty much can't be further away unless you're in Jassira. We don't live that differently from people up here, small villages scattered around, though we followed game animals rather than farming the land. There's no fucking farmland down there worth a damn. It's hard living, and makes hard people. Like me." Calise slaps one of her mammoth biceps. 
    
    She chuckles gruffly[party.has atugia
        | and points to Atugia
    ]. "Although... most of the Tilamac are about five foot and change." 
    
    "[pc.isBimbo
        |Soooo they're not all pretty ponies like you?
        |They're not all marefolk, I take it?
    ]"
    
    "[pc.isBimbo
        |Shut it. And no, t
        |T
    ]hey're humans. But there were other tribes all around us. Marefolk, elves, orcs. I'm the product of an... unwanted mixing of tribes. The marefolk exile any man that won't agree to be gelded, same as they do here, and just let 'em run wild when the rut takes their minds." Calise growls under her breath, scarred knuckles whitening around the haft of her axe. "You [pc.isBimbo
        |aren't so stupid that you need me to spell out the rest, right
        |get the idea, right
    ]?" 
    
    "Yeah..."
    
    "So I was worse than the red-headed stepchild among my people. Growing bigger than any of 'em just made me stand out, gave 'em more excuses to stare at me or make the evil eye when I walked by. So fuck 'em, soon as I could manage on my own, I left. Nobody shed a tear to see the big brute go."
    
    Calise always looks like she's one dark thought away from losing it completely, and you can see a storm brewing in her mind now that's liable to boil over into something violent. 
    
    "So where did you go after leaving?" you ask, trying to coax her past that memory.
    
    "The forest," she says. The tension in her shoulders stops building, at least for now. "The Valgar lands are surrounded by a forest thicker [cali.fucked
        |than my bush
        |than the princess of Khor'minos
    ]. You can live your whole life in there, lose yourself between trees older than time itself. That was my plan. That's... how I found Velun."
rows.translation:
“哦，那件事……”卡莉丝哼了一声，双手按在斧柄上；斧柄从她两腿之间竖起。“是啊，操，我确实说过。你居然还记得，去你的。”
    
    你看了她一眼，她叹了口气。“你想知道什么？”
    
    “先说蒂拉马克是什么人。”
    
    “他们是瓦尔加尔人。”卡莉丝说道，双手含糊地朝南方比了比。“我不知道这对你有没有意义。他们是住在海岸附近的山民，就在旧贝尔哈的另一边。除非你人在贾西拉，否则几乎不可能离这里更远。我们的生活和这里的人没太大不同，也是散居在一座座小村庄里，不过我们追逐猎物而生，不靠耕种土地。那里根本没有一块像样的耕地。日子苦，养出来的人也硬。就像我。”卡莉丝拍了拍一条巨大的肱二头肌。 
    
    她粗声笑了笑[party.has atugia
        |，又指向阿图吉娅
    ]。“不过……大多数蒂拉马克人也就五英尺出头。” 
    
    “[pc.isBimbo
        |所以他们不全是像你一样漂亮的小马驹喽？
        |这么说来，他们并不全是马人？
    ]”
    
    “[pc.isBimbo
        |闭嘴。没错，他们
        |他们
    ]是人类。不过我们周围还有其他部族，马人、精灵、兽人。我是……部族之间一次不受欢迎的混血产物。马人会放逐任何不肯接受阉割的男人，和这里一样；等发情期夺走他们的理智，就任他们四处撒野。”卡莉丝压低声音咆哮，握住斧柄的伤疤累累的指节泛起白色。“你[pc.isBimbo
        |总不至于蠢得还要我把剩下的事说清楚吧
        |懂我的意思吧
    ]？” 
    
    “懂……”
    
    “所以我在族人眼里，比不受待见的继子还糟。长得比他们每一个人都高，只会令我更加扎眼，让他们在我经过时更有理由盯着我，或是投来恶毒的目光。去他们的吧；我一能独自生活，就离开了。没有人为那个大块头的离去掉一滴眼泪。”
    
    卡莉丝总像只差一个阴暗念头就会彻底失控；此刻，你能看见她心中酝酿的风暴，仿佛随时会沸腾成暴力。 
    
    “那你离开后去了哪里？”你问道，试图引导她跨过那段回忆。
    
    “森林。”她说道。至少眼下，她肩头不断积聚的紧张停止了。“瓦尔加尔的土地被一片浓密得[cali.fucked
        |胜过我那丛毛
        |胜过科尔米诺斯公主
    ]的森林包围。你可以在那里度过一生，迷失在比时间本身还古老的树木之间。那就是我的计划。也正是……我找到维伦的方式。”

rows.original:
"My homeland? Hah, we don't really even have a name for it. The Valgar lands. The Shadow of Zhenna. Rocky shithole." She snorts, almost a laugh. "That's what it is. Horribly broken rocky marshes leading into horrible rocky hills under Zhenna Mountain in the north. Then there's a great big forest that wraps around the mountains, so deep I doubt anybody's explored a tenth of it, and full of all sorts of echoes of the Old Wyld. Druid clans are hidden all over the place in there, and little villages of orcs and elves. Lot of mixing there, not like with the hill tribes." 
    
    She bristles a moment, then sighs. 
    
    [party.has atugia
        |Atugia peers at the towering warrior. "I thought that accent was familiar. I think we were born pretty close to the same place."
        
        Calise's ears flick. "You're a Valgar too, huh? Yeah, I hear it. You sound like the old elders from the villages up north." She pauses. "South, from here. North from where I was born. Other side of the mountain?"
        
        Atugia nods. "We didn't call ourselves that, but yeah, I guess our people might have been neighbors. I never thought I'd meet somebody from home all the way up here."
        
        The huge horse-woman considers the much smaller girl for a moment before sighing and planting a hand atop Atugia's head, mussing her mop of bright red hair. She's strong enough to make Tui wobble on the spot — you're almost worried her head'll pop right off before Calise finishes with her. "Yeah. You know... you kind of look like my cousin. Little shorter. Same apple-colored hair. She was cute. I guess it's not bad, hearing a little slice of the old country."
        
        [party.has kiyoko
            |Kiyoko perks up a moment, then quickly shakes her head and returns to examining the river.
        ]
        
        Calise turns her gaze back to you. 
    ]"I spent most of my life in the shadow forests, all around the big mountain. I learned to live off the land, and gods damned was there a bounty in there. The trees'd feed you most of the year, and there's so many deer in the brush that I'd trip over the bastards. I never went hungry, which is more than I could say for my kinfolk in the hills. Just had to fight for my life all the time."
    
    "The forest was that dangerous?"
    
    "Oh, yeah," Calise says, patting her axe. "Wraith-touched weren't a problem like in Old Belhar, but you'd see other monsters all over. Chimeras, dire serpents and boars, like everything in the forest wanted to grow twice as big as it should've. Or grow extra heads!" She laughs. "I got damn good with a bow and my axes, and even better at running the fuck away. If I wasn't gonna eat it, couldn't afford to get hurt fighting it. The forest gave plenty, but it made sure you didn't get complacent. One wrong step and you're something else's meal."
    
    She pauses to run her fingers over several of the scars marring her pale, freckled skin. "On my way up here from the Valgar lands, people were terrified of me. Must have thought I was some kind of barbarian warlord who'd conquered a thousand tribes and used their chieftains' skulls as pisspots. Fuckers. These scars are from wild beasts, not blades. I'd only killed two-legged beasts a handful of times by then, and not one that didn't deserve it!"
    
    "Were people much of a problem in the forest?"
    
    "Nah, barely ever saw anybody else. Almost forgot how to talk, I'd go so long without seeing another mortal. The only fuckin' person I could count on seeing was her..."
    
    You quirk a brow. "Her?"
    
    Calise just makes a non-commital noise in her throat.
rows.translation:
我的旧国？哈，我们甚至都没有给它起个名字。瓦尔加尔之地？珍娜的阴影？还是那个布满岩石的荒芜之地吧。”她哼了一声，几乎要笑出来，“就是这么个地方——一片遍布岩石的沼泽地，一直延伸到北方珍娜山脚下那些崎岖的丘陵地带。那里有一片广阔的森林，环绕着群山，面积如此之大，恐怕没有人能够探索到它的十分之一。这片森林里充满了古老荒野的各种遗迹与痕迹。德鲁伊部落隐匿在森林的各个角落，而兽人和小精灵们也建立了自己的小村落。那里的情况太复杂了，和那些山区的部落完全不一样。”

她愣了一下，然后叹了口气。 
    
    [party.has atugia
        |阿图吉娅注视着那位高大的战士，说道：“我觉得那个口音听起来很熟悉……我想我们应该是出生在差不多同一个地方吧。”

卡莉塞的耳朵微微一动，说道：“你也是瓦尔加人吧？没错，我听出来了。你的说话方式就像北方那些村庄里的老人们一样。她停顿了一下，说道：“往南，从这里开始；往北，就是我出生的地方……山的那边吗？”

阿图吉娅点了点头：“我们并没有用那个称呼来指代自己，但没错，我想我们的族人应该算是邻居吧。我从没想过会在这里遇到一个来自家乡的人。那位高大的女骑手凝视着那个体型小得多的女孩，沉吟片刻后，叹了口气，将手放在阿图吉娅的头上，弄乱了她那一头亮红色的头发。她的力气大得足以让图伊在原地摇晃起来——你甚至会担心，在卡莉丝完成动作之前，她的头就会直接掉下来。是啊。你知道……你有点像我的表妹。只是个子矮一些，头发也是同样的苹果色。她很可爱。听你讲一些故乡的事情，还挺有意思的。
        
        [party.has kiyoko
            |清子暂时精神一振，但很快又摇了摇头，继续观察那条河流。
        ]
        
        卡莉丝将目光重新转向你。 
    ]我大半生都在那片大山周围的幽暗森林里度过。我学会了如何依靠大自然生存，那里真的有取之不尽的食物。一年中的大部分时间，树木都能提供足够的食物；灌木丛里也有大量的鹿，多到我经常会被它们撞倒。我从来不饿过，而这在山里的同胞们那里却是难以实现的——他们总是不得不为生存而战。
    
    这片森林真的有那么危险吗？”

“哦，确实如此，”卡莉丝一边说，一边轻拍着她的斧头。“那些被怨灵影响的怪物并不像在老贝拉尔时那么麻烦，但其他各种怪物也到处都是——奇美拉、凶猛的蛇类和野猪，总之，森林里的所有生物似乎都变得比正常情况下大了一倍。或者长出多余的脑袋来！”她笑着说，“我使用弓和斧头的技术已经相当娴熟了，而逃跑的本事更是无人能及。如果我不打算吃掉那些动物，就绝不能在与之搏斗时受伤。森林提供了丰富的食物，但它也会确保你不会因此而变得懈怠。一步踏错，就会变成别人的盘中餐。
    
    她停顿了一下，用手指轻轻抚过那些遍布在她苍白、布满雀斑皮肤上的疤痕。“从瓦尔加尔地区来到这里的过程中，人们都对我充满了恐惧。他们肯定以为我是什么野蛮的军阀，征服了成千上万的部落，还用那些部落首领的头骨来当尿壶……那些混蛋。这些疤痕其实是野兽留下的，而不是刀刃造成的。到那时候，我只有过几次杀死两足动物的经历，而且每一次，那些动物都确实罪有应得！
    
    在森林里，人类会带来很多麻烦吗？”

“不，几乎从来没见过其他人。我都快忘了怎么说话了，有那么长时间都没有见到任何人类。唯一能确定会遇到的那个人，就是她……”

你挑了挑眉毛：“她？
    
    卡莉丝只是用喉咙发出了一声含糊不清的声音。

rows.original:
[cali.fucked
        |"Oh, yeah... you would be curious about her, wouldn't you? My Ethlyn." Calise's tail flicks behind her, and she makes a fond little snort. "She's a dryad, a trueborn daughter of Velun — a princess of the Wyld. I met her when I was barely more than a child, freshly shorn from my tribe and half dead from an elk hunt gone wrong. I killed the fuck but I... wasn't as strong as I thought. Fucking running theme in my life, huh?" 
        
        Calise grunts and leans back against the wall, staring into the river. "But Ethlyn didn't care, even if I was weak and delirious. Hours from dropping from infection by the time I wandered into her grove. I had nothing to give her, but she still sheltered me. Brought me food and medicine. Nursed me back from the edge of death. Never asked for a thing in return. She just... talked to me. Nobody else had for years by then, even in my tribe. They'd already decided I was a lost cause. But Ethlyn was different. She didn't see me for what I was, she didn't see a big stupid brute that was only good for carving monsters apart. She treated me like a teenage girl. And I fucking hated it!"
        
        "You... what?"
        
        "I hated her. I felt like she was talking down to me, treating me like a child. Compared to her, I was, but that didn't make it easier to bear. But I was half crippled, and couldn't get away. So she was free to just... talk at me. To tell me about her god, and the forest, things I'd never heard before. My people had been druidic, they spurned the gods, but Ethlyn was beloved by Velun, and wanted to share him with me. I'd never..." She shakes her head and runs a scarred hand through her hair. "I'd [silly
            |never known such love.
            |grown up rough, [pc.name]. Fucking awful.
        ] I was a little monster even back then, but she took the time to teach me, and eventually, some of her god-bothering got through my thick, stupid skull. I started praying. Velun started answering."
        
        "Is that how you became a paladin?"
        
        Calise shrugs. "Sort of. I guess. Nobody ever made me swear an oath, and I never went to some big cathedral. I just started listening to the trees, and to Ethlyn, and they pointed me to things that needed killing. Or protecting. And I got stronger. Even killed a mountain wyrm that'd gone mad with poison in its veins. I'd never seen someone so proud when I dragged its corpse to Ethlyn's grove. We ate well that night, and she gave me her blessing..."
        
        "So you two were... close?"
        
        "Hah, nothing like that. She's not my lover, more like a... a mother. A mother that'd kill me without hesitation if I showed myself to her now." 她的脸色在好几秒钟内都保持着僵硬的表情。看来你得换个话题来聊了……

Ethlyn will find someone else to raise up as her knight. She's practically immortal. She never needed me."
