rows.original: So, she's living in Nareva's Dream now?
rows.translation: 所以，她现在住在娜瑞瓦的梦境里吗？
rows.raw: "So, she's living in Nareva's Dream now?"

rows.original: Thalia looks around her, then gives you an easy shrug and smile. "I'd need to see more of it to form a proper opinion, wouldn't I?" Is she asking you to take her around? "The goddess did say that I wouldn't be able to leave the Wayfort's confines as part of whatever agreement she came to with Tira, so that wouldn't be out of the question." All in good time, all in good time. All right, let's rephrase — what are her first impressions, then? "It's familiar, yet different. You've remade it to your liking, but it nevertheless has roots that run deep before either of us. That sense of history blends quite well with what you've done with the place, or at least the interior of the old watchtower. Can't help but notice none of the old archives are around, more's the pity." Yeah. Either someone had gotten to them before you came on the scene, or they'd all rotted away over the years. By the time you first set foot in the Wayfort, there was nothing left in the watchtower, which itself had fallen into ruin. "A pity. How easy it is for all that work to be reduced to dust... but that's all in the distant past, isn't it? Neither of us could have done anything about it. "That about sums up my first impressions — is there anything else you'd like to clear up?"
rows.translation: 塔莉娅环顾四周，然后轻松地耸了耸肩，微笑着对你说：“我需要多看看才行，才能形成一个合理的看法，不是吗？” 她是想让你带她去看看吗？ “这位女神确实可以说，根据她与蒂拉达成的某种协议，我根本不可能离开荒废驿堡家族的管辖范围，所以这个可能性根本就不存在。” 好吧，慢慢来，慢慢来。那么，她最初的印象是什么呢？ 这种感觉既熟悉又有所不同。你根据自己的喜好对它进行了改造，但它所蕴含的历史底蕴，在我们两人之前就已经存在了。这种历史感与你对这片地方所做的改动——至少是对那座旧瞭望塔内部的改造——结合得相当融洽。忍不住会注意到，那些古老的档案全都不见了，真是太遗憾了。” “是啊。要么是在你来到这里之前，就已经有人把它们拿走了，要么就是这些档案在这些年里全都腐烂掉了。当你第一次踏入荒废驿堡的时候，瞭望塔里已经什么也没有了，那座塔本身也早已变成了一片废墟。 真遗憾。所有那些努力竟然就这样化为乌有……但那都已经是很久以前的事了，对吧？我们当时谁也无能为力。 “大致上，我的第一印象就是这样的。还有其他什么需要说明的地方吗？"

rows.original: What does she think of what you've done with the Wayfort?
rows.translation: 她对你对荒废驿堡家族所做的一切有什么看法？
rows.raw: "What does she think of what you've done with the Wayfort?"

rows.original: You'd like to know what happened afterwards — Nareva seemed quite concerned when you told her about it. Did she follow up on the matter like she implied she would? [pc.isAstrida |A chuckle. "You could go to Tychris and inquire, you know." Yes, but you'd rather not deal with the bureaucracy involved. Oddly enough, being Nareva's personal champion doesn't exempt you from red tape, but one supposes the privileges must end somewhere. Also, you want to hear it from her, and not some desk job flunky. "Oh. Um." Careful now, she might choke trying to stifle those giggles. "I don't know that much more myself, only what I heard before the goddess got me out of that urn. Anyway, [flags.VISION_SERPENT 2 |thanks to us defeating that serpent, the rest of the matter was simply clean-up. Not the most glorious of jobs, but certainly a safer one; the goddess deemed the matter important enough to send not one, but two teams into the Ways." From what you understand, perturbations in the Ways are important for the same reason portals are: the Ways keep what exist in the beyond, well, beyond. "Exactly. Even though we — sorry, you — had swept the area and cleared it out, she wanted to be sure they were prepared for anything." Everything turned out well, you suppose? "As well as can be, so I heard. The garrison, or what was left of their minds, was... uh, dispersed. Granting them peace was all that could be done for them at that point. rows.translation: 达莉莎从一张羊皮纸上抬起头；她刚才一直在沉思，独自啜饮着茶水[wayfort.hasMaids |，此时一名大黄蜂女仆嗡嗡飞过。她高兴地朝你挥挥手指，扭了扭屁股，随后离开，让你与执法官安静相处。 |。 ]她连忙寻找地方放下茶杯，好向你敬礼；你挥手制止，她却显得局促不安，仿佛还在完成饮茶和坚持敬礼之间纠结。 最后她让步了，重新恢复稍息的姿势。“有什么吩咐，我的[pc.mf |男爵 |女男爵 ]？” [pc.dcb |“我的驿堡依然不够完美，怎样才能真正变得出色？我不该只配得到冰冷的石头、空荡的大厅和一个破烂庭院。” |“驿堡仍有可以改进的地方；我们需要什么，才能尽可能让它做到最好？” |“嗯，我在想；驿堡是挺不错啦，可——是，为了这里所有的可爱姑娘，我想把所有东西都弄得好得多。我们能怎么办？” ] 执法官抿住涂画精致的漂亮嘴唇，片刻后用脚踢开一只塞满文件的信使包，取出一本厚重的书。“后勤方案，已经检查并复查。” “这些你已经全部做完了？” “遗憾的是……还有若干空缺；我们没有所需大部分物资的联系人，也不知道在哪里能找到原材料。除了冬城本身，可是……”达莉莎声音渐弱，话语出口前仿佛细细品味其滋味。“让我们直接欠下城市的人情，或除少数当地美食外还依赖他们供应任何物资，都不是明智之举。” “美食？” 精灵双耳抽动，表情依旧不动声色。“例如腌鱼。”
rows.raw: ' Daliza looks up from a piece of parchment, having been lost in thought and sipping tea [wayfort.hasMaids |as a hornet maid buzzes past. She gives you a pleased finger-wave and wiggles her bum before departing, leaving you in peace with the bailiff. |by herself. ] She hurriedly looks for somewhere to put the teacup down in order to salute before you wave her off, and she looks uncomfortably torn between finishing her drink, or saluting you anyway. In the end she relents, settling at-ease once more. "Yes, my [pc.mf |baron |baroness ]?" [pc.dcb |"My Wayfort still isn't perfect, how do we make it actually good? I deserve better than cold stone, an empty hall, and a shit courtyard." |There are still improvements that could be made to the Wayfort, what do we need to make it the best it can be?" |"Well, like, I was thinkin'; the Wayfort's nice and all, buuuut, I could like... use a way nicer everything for all the cuties. What can we do for that?" ] The bailiff purses her pretty painted lips for a few seconds, before kicking open a messenger bag full of files and pulling out a weighty book. "Logistics, all checked and double-checked." "You've completed all of this already?" "There are... a number of gaps, unfortunately; we don't have any contacts for the majority of what would be required, nor where raw resources could be found. Apart from the Winter City itself, but..." Daliza trails off, practically tasting the words before she forms them. "It would be ill-advised to place ourselves directly in the city's debt or rely upon them for any supplies outside of a few regional delicacies." "Delicacies?" The elf's ears twitch, even though her expression remains impassive. "Pickled fish, for instance."'

rows.original: "Well done on getting everything you have gotten together so far, I'm sure we can budget a few little extras sent down for you and your soldiers every month." There's a proud little glitter behind the bailiff's eyes, but she gives you a stoic nod. "This is appreciated, [pc.mf |my baron |my baroness ]. I'll let everyone know about your decision once preparations are underway." "It's all on you, [pc.isBimbo |you're supposed to be thanked for me buying the thing, otherwise I wouldn't know to buy it! |don't hide behind me on that account ]." [pc.dcb |You frown and wave the matter off, unwilling to be fawned over for the sake of a few fish. |Your hands go up in feigned surrender; it would probably be a lot better if Daliza were properly thanked by her soldiers. |P'shaw, what a silly. ] "Now, what do we need?"
rows.translation: 你把所有事情都处理得非常好。拥有根据我们目前的情况来看，我相信我们每个月都能拨出一些额外的资金，专门用来照顾您和您的士兵们。” 法警的眼中闪烁着自豪的光芒，但她还是坚定地点了点头：“非常感谢您。 [pc.mf |我的男爵 |我的女男爵 ]等准备工作开始后，我会把你的决定告诉大家的。” “这一切都取决于你。 [pc.isBimbo |我买这个东西本来就应该感谢你，否则我根本就不会想到要买它 |别因为那个原因而躲在我身后 ]。" [pc.dcb |你皱了皱眉头，摆了摆手，不愿为了几条鱼就被人讨好。 |你假装投降，举起了双手；如果达莉莎能得到她的士兵们应有的感谢，情况可能会好很多。 |哎呀，真是个傻瓜。 ]那么，我们现在需要什么呢？

rows.raw: "Getting a little ahead of herself, isn't she?"

rows.original: You begin leafing through the report Daliza has put together, [pc.isBimbo |[silly |doing everything in your power to focus those few unflattened wrinkles in your brain |trying to keep the information from swimming in your vision ] |tracking down the pages with a [pc.nail] ]. "Stone, Wood, Metal... though I'm unsure as to where so much can be gotten." Daliza sighs, recounting from memory with eyes half-closed while you read. "A blacksmith, obviously; we lack the means for something as simple as doorknobs and hinges. Not forgetting fire-grates, sconces, the portcullises..." She opens her eyes again and frowns at the thought, continuing. "We'll need a lot of help moving that thing in the first place, the northern gate still has a twisted wreck trapped inside of it." Resources and a smith, that makes sense... "A tailor for rugs, curtains, tabards, a flag, beds and linens... perhaps a cushion for the stockades, since the idea apparently has merit amongst my girls, too." Her ears begin to burn purple at that, but before you can tease her she barrels right on. "Now, I do not know what you might be used to from the south, but there are simple enchantments that would make the Wayfort truly spectacular, if that would be your wish; runes to keep water clean, to keep storage chilled, to warm up water in bathtubs, add additional resistance to structures..." Daliza opens her eyes again and looks up at you, clicking her tongue. "I understand that may sound like a lot, but autonomy and comfort is useful for yourself, and for my soldiers. The only matter is finding an enchanter and funding them with electrum, so far as I understand." The list continues to go as you flip over to the next page, sighing. Daliza carries on, unperturbed at your growing frustration. "Food." "This whole page is food?" Dal nods, reaching out a hand to accept the logistics report back. "Meat, vegetables, fruit, fish. All staples both for some finer eating — which I understand Rumie [wayfort.hasJaelyn|and even Jaelyn are|is] interested in providing — and just meeting our day-to-day requirements without using up our rations immediately." You roll your shoulders and consider the options; you're probably going to have to find these people yourself and build up a considerable amount of capital. The Harvest Valley supplies plenty for the village, perhaps Pupperidge has production to spare, or the marefolk... "Anything else?" [flags.HIVE_CLEARED |Daliza smiles — a genuine smile, at that — and shakes her head. [wayfort.hasMaids |"No, especially with all of those hornets around playing maid for us. It's easy to forget that the majority of them are rather tall, strong examples of the species. They should be plenty of help." |"No, there have even been some hornets interested in assisting [flags.HIVE_PURIFIED |their Queen's favorite hero |their Queen's super-bestest friend ] with matters here, so they should prove to be useful extra weight for that northern portcullis, at least." ] |Daliza still appears concerned, rolling her shoulders and pulling up an extra report. "My soldiers keep coming back with information about Hornets attempting to accost both them, and travelers. With your leave to be frank? With a bunch of dumb horny bitches attacking everyone, any hope of the Wayfort becoming civilized is a pipedream." Well, shit. You're going to have to get to the bottom of that, then. ] Daliza flips back to the beginning of the report, rolling her shoulders and pulling out a quill and listing off a copy for you. "Forty units of wood, I've got reports of a lumberjack to the north who might be able to assist. "Sixty units of stone; we're just about out. It's a lot, and I'm not sure who would quarry a lot of rock who might be capable of providing this. "Twenty-weight of metal... I know that there are plenty of spurious mercenary outfits who could be relieved of their belongings. If not? I'm not sure who might sell metal scrap or ingots. As for the others; a blacksmith, an enchanter, and someone who would be willing to meet our food requirements... that's everything." Your bailiff blows over the parchment, making sure the ink is dry before folding it and handing it off to you.
rows.translation: 你开始翻阅达莉莎整理好的那份报告。 [pc.isBimbo |[silly |竭尽全力去消除你大脑中那些尚未被抚平的“皱纹”。 |努力不让这些信息在你的视线中泛滥成灾。 ] |逐一查找那些相关页面。 [pc.nail] ]石头、木材、金属……不过我不确定这些材料该从哪里获取。”达莉莎叹息着，半闭着眼睛回忆着往事，而你则在一旁静静地听着。“显然，我们需要铁匠；我们连制作门把手和铰链这样的简单物品所需的工具都没有。更不用说火炉架和壁炉台了城门闸门……”她再次睁开眼睛，想到这里不禁皱起了眉头，继续说道：“首先，我们需要很多帮助才能把那个东西搬进去——北门里还卡着一堆扭曲变形的残骸呢。” 资源和一个铁匠，这倒确实是有必要…… 一个专门制作地毯、窗帘、短袍、旗帜以及床铺和床上用品的工匠……或许还可以制作一些用于栅栏上的靠垫，因为我的女孩子们似乎也都觉得这个主意不错。”听到这里，她的耳朵立刻变得通红起来，但还没等别人取笑她，她就继续说了下去。 现在，我不知道你们在南方可能已经习惯了什么，但有一些简单的魔法咒语，可以让荒废驿堡变得真正令人惊叹，如果这是你们的愿望的话；比如那些能让水保持清洁的符文、让储藏室保持低温的符文、让浴缸中的水变暖的符文，以及那些能增强建筑物抗力的符文。……”达莉莎再次睁开眼睛，抬头看着你，轻轻吐了吐舌头。“我知道这听起来可能要求很高，但自主权和舒适度对你自己来说很重要，对我的士兵们也同样重要。目前我所知道的是，关键在于找到一位法师，并用电银为他们提供资金支持。" 当你翻到下一页时，清单似乎还在继续……你不禁叹了口气。达莉莎却依旧若无其事地继续说着：“食物。” “这一整页都是关于食物的吗？” 达莉莎点了点头，伸手接过那份物流报告。“肉类、蔬菜、水果、鱼类……这些都是人们日常所需的基本食物。当然，也有一些更高级的食物——我想露米应该也明白这一点吧。 [wayfort.hasJaelyn|就连杰琳也在其中。|是]我们有兴趣提供这些资源——同时也只需要满足我们日常的需求，而不必立即耗尽所有的储备。” 你耸了耸肩，开始考虑各种选择；很可能你得自己去找这些人，并筹集相当数量的资金。丰收谷为村庄提供了充足的资源，也许帕珀里奇还有多余的产量，或者那些马人……“还有其他办法吗？ [flags.HIVE_CLEARED |达莉莎笑了，那是一个真诚的微笑，然后她摇了摇头。 [wayfort.hasMaids |不，尤其是有那么多黄蜂群在为我们帮忙的时候。很容易忘记，它们中的大多数其实都是体型高大、力量强大的个体。它们应该能提供很大的帮助。 |不，甚至还有一些人愿意提供帮助。 [flags.HIVE_PURIFIED |他们女王最喜爱的英雄 |他们女王最最要好的朋友 ]考虑到这里的种种情况，这些因素至少应该能为那个北方的防御门户增添一些额外的力量和帮助。 ] |达莉莎依然显得很担忧，她耸了耸肩，然后拿出了另一份报告。“我的士兵们不断带回消息，说那些‘黄蜂群’一直在试图袭击他们以及其他旅行者。说实话，如果让那些愚蠢又好色的女人到处攻击别人，那么‘荒废驿堡’地区还能保持文明状态，那简直就是天方夜谭。” 好吧，这下麻烦了。你得彻底调查清楚这件事才行。 ] 达莉莎将报告翻回到开头，耸了耸肩，然后拿出一支羽毛笔，开始为你列出所需材料： “需要四十单位木材，据报道北方有位伐木工可能会帮忙。 六十单位的石头；我们的库存差不多用完了。这个数量确实很大，我不确定究竟是谁有能力开采这么多石头来满足这个需求。 “二十单位的金属……我知道有很多冒充佣兵的人，他们的财物完全可能被没收。否则呢？我不确定还有谁会出售金属废料或锭块。 至于其他的人选：一个铁匠、一个法师，还有那个愿意满足我们食物需求的人……就这些了。”你的执达官将羊皮纸吹干，确保墨水完全干透后，才将其折叠起来交给你。

rows.original: [daliza.trustRange 0 3 |"Being asked is terribly novel, if... appreciated." |"You're asking my opinion again? I... appreciate the trust you're placing in me, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]. I certainly wouldn't want to disappoint, you..." ] Daliza has a small — tiny, if anything — smile as she once more digs into her bags. "My soldiers haven't ranged much further than the northern and southern woods, unfortunately. But we do hear things. The kitsune in the northern forest have proven adept spellcasters, if... infuriating.[party.comp kiyoko |" Kiyoko smirks beside you at that, tails wriggling around. "They would prove useful in the art of enchanting, and there is a capable smith no less." | Do you know of any who might help?" ] The foxes are certainly a possibility... "What about Evergreen?" The bailiff frowns and plants a hand on her hip. "I'm not sure I trust the tanuki witch, whatever your arrangement with them. But it is your prerogative, [pc.mf |Baron |Baroness ]." "Besides that," Daliza continues. "There's the tailor down in Hawkethorne [wayfort.hasMaids |who made all of the maid costumes |I've heard tell could produce what we need ]... perhaps the blacksmith too? Although I imagine in your journeys you've met plenty by this point who would jump at the chance to have their works utilized by yourself and my forces. Ah, and I believe Rumie has mentioned farmland south-and-west of here, assuming they've not all been chased away into Hawkethorne by corrupt aggressors, they should be a simple enough task." Simple enough, not to mention the rough estimate for hiring them all of... stars above. Ten thousand electrum? Hopefully some of your associates will do you a deal.

rows.original: You know who to go to.

"Improvements? Why yes! There is a lot that could be done, and my ears have kept to the ground and pressed to the lips of travelers in an attempt to discover how best this can be done!" The azure demon reaches beneath her impromptu counter and pulls out a stack of papers, covered in numbers and names — some of which have had little hearts drawn next to them. "Let's see here... stars and sand, this is going to be a lot!" Her eyes scan up and down before she pulls out an extra parchment and begins to recount, copying the details over. "Forty weight of lumber — I heard there's some lumberjack fox up north? Might be worth buying off of her..." She licks her thumb and continues. "Sixty units of stone, which could be a challenge, it's a lot of stone. There hasn't been a quarry since Khor' though. Perhaps you can trade with them for stone? Otherwise it's the old fashioned way..." "Twenty weight of metal for hinges, doorknobs, frames, portcullis, chains..." Farrah pauses and rolls her neck. "Then comes people to work with all of this; blacksmiths — of which I've no doubt a strapping, sexy young adventurer like yourself has encountered — tailors... [wayfort.hasMaids |I suppose the same little green strumpet who made all those just adorable little maid outfits? |Might be there's someone who tailors working in the Winter City you could squeeze a deal out of, if you don't want to go through Hawkethorne. ]" This list is definitely starting to sound expensive, but it should be worth it. "Anything else?" Farrah winks and continues, blowing on the parchment to dry it before adding further notes. "An enchanter! Someone who will work us a number of runes for things such as clean well water, heated bathtubs, reinforcements for the portcullis... things like that. You don't think that luscious curvy raccoon-witch would be willing to do that, would you? Else there are... hmmn, plenty of [silly |foxxos |kitsune ] who seem capable." The azure demon finally scribes off one last line, looking pleased. "Besides that? We need meat, veg, fruit, and delicious, delicious [silly |feesh |fish ]. So far as I'm aware, there's a farm owned by some wolf girls who might be able to assist with that." She slides over the parchment after double-checking it one last time, licking her lips. "My best estimate? Ten-thousand electrum." [pc.dcb |"Fuck." |"Wow..." |"[silly |That's a big ooph from me kitty! |Oh ding-dang... ]" ] [flags.HIVE_CLEARED |Farrah purrs, wiggling her hips. "I'll see if I can't ask some of your lovely flying honey-hornets to help with some of the other heavy-lifting once you're done with the acquisitions, otherwise I'll be at it for months. That's all I can think of though!" Her eyes are still glazed over at the thought of so much money changing hands, and you suspect that the moment you leave she's going to fist herself into a frothy frenzy. "Good luck!" |Farrah's tail swishes from side-to-side, eyes glazed over at the thought of so much money changing hands. "Oh!" She shakes herself off after a moment. "Before I forget; those hornets! Deal with them, I don't know how you intend to do it, but you've got to. They're nothing but pests as they are now, when they could instead be employees. Catch my drift?" ]
rows.translation: 改进？当然啦！确实有很多这是完全可以做到的。为了找到最好的实现方法，我一直在仔细倾听旅行者们的话，努力从中获取线索！” 那头蔚蓝色的恶魔从她临时搭建的柜台下面拿出一叠文件，文件上密密麻麻地写满了数字和名字，其中一些名字旁边还画着小爱心。让我想想……星星和沙子，这个数量肯定不少！” 她的目光上下扫视了一番，然后拿出一张额外的纸稿，开始重新记录这些细节。 “四十担木材——我听说北方有只伐木狐妖，对吧？也许从她那里买下来会是个不错的选择……”她舔了舔拇指，继续说道。 “六十块石头，这可能有点困难，因为数量确实很大。不过自从科尔之后，就已经没有采石场了。或许你可以试着和他们交易来获取这些石头？否则就只能用老办法了……” “制作铰链、门把手、框架以及栅栏等部件需要使用二十磅重的金属……”法拉停顿了一下，然后活动了一下脖子，“接下来还需要有人来把这些部件加工成成品——比如铁匠，我相信像你这样年轻、健壮又充满冒险精神的家伙肯定遇到过铁匠吧？还有裁缝也是必不可少的…… [wayfort.hasMaids |我想，就是那个调皮的小绿丫头干的吧可爱极了少女装吗？ |如果你不想通过鹰棘镇来办理这件事，或许可以在冬城找到某个能帮你达成交易的裁缝。 ]这份清单上的东西听起来确实挺贵的，但应该都是值得的吧。还有别的什么吗？” 法拉眨了眨眼，继续说道，同时用嘴吹了吹羊皮纸，让它变干，然后又补充了一些注意事项：“还需要一个法师！找一个能为我们制作一些符文的人，比如用来制造清洁的泉水、加热的浴缸、加固城门的装置之类的。你不会认为那个身材火辣、曲线优美的浣熊女巫会愿意帮忙吧？要不然……嗯，也有不少[silly |狐狐 |狐妖 ]看起来能胜任。”” 那头蔚蓝色的恶魔终于写下了最后一行，看起来非常满意。“除此之外？我们还需要肉类、蔬菜、水果，还有那些美味可口的东西[silly |鱼儿 |鱼 ]据我所知，有一些狼人女孩拥有一座农场，她们或许能够帮助解决这个问题。” 她再次仔细检查了那份文件，然后舔了舔嘴唇，将文件推到了对方面前。“我粗略估计一下，需要一万枚电银。 [pc.dcb |“该死。” |哇…… |"[silly |我真是太粗心了，小猫咪！ |哦不…… ]" ] [flags.HIVE_CLEARED |法拉发出呼噜声，扭动着臀部说道：“等你们完成这些收购任务后，我看看能不能请你们那些可爱的飞行大黄蜂来帮忙搬运那些沉重的东西。不然的话，我得花上好几个月的时间才能搞定这些工作呢……不过，这也是我目前能想到的办法了！”一想到有这么多钱会在手里流转，她的双眼依然充满了兴奋与憧憬。你敢打赌，等你一离开，她肯定会兴奋得手舞足蹈起来。“祝你好运！ |法拉的尾巴左右摇摆着，一想到有这么多钱要易主，她的双眼都亮了起来。“哦！”过了一会儿，她回过神来：“差点忘了，那些黄蜂！你们得想办法处理掉它们，我不知道你们打算怎么做，但必须得解决掉。现在它们只不过是些害虫罢了，而其实它们本可以员工你明白我的意思吧？ ]

rows.original:
"You want what?" Jael'yn frowns and stands up straight, planting a hand on Rumie's head and toying with her ears. "I'd certainly love to be back in the lap of luxury, [pc.mf
        |master
        |mistress
    ], but that's an expensive endeavour."
    
    "I just need to know how expensive, and what we need."
    
    The demonic barmaid blinks, releasing the squirming bumblebee once she's appropriately shivering before adjusting her collar. "That's... a challenging order to fulfill, you're killing me here." Her tail whips about and her demonic tongue extends to the limits of its lurid length, but she works her mind toward the task. "Alright, I'm going to need some paper or something..."
    
    She dips below the bar counter, leaving with you with nothing but her upturned ass and waving tail for half a minute before she returns upright, adjusting her tits when they spill free from her outfit. "Okay, we're gonna need... stone, lumber, metal, craftspeople, food, someone who can magic up some damned hot water, and a big fat stack of coin. [flags.HIVE_CLEARED
        |I can make all those honey-brained hornets help with the rest if you can get that.
        |Not to mention we'll need a workforce, perhaps if you could wrangle all of those honey-brained hornets, we could get something done without it taking an eternity?
    ]"
    
    Jael'yn gulps and tugs on her collar again, looking you up and down before pressing her tits together with her arms and leaning on the counter. "Did I do good?"
    
    "Yes, good job. I'll... figure out the rest." 
    
    The demonic barmaid shudders and stifles a whimper at the rush of pleasure, soaking in the relief of fulfilling an order. 
    
    Rumie lets out a surprised gasp beside her at the accompanying sounds of cum splashing to the floor at her feet, turning beet red. "I-I'll get that."
    
    You know plenty of craftspeople you could shake down for the materials and enchanting services... as for foodstuffs, perhaps Harvest Valley has production to spare for your growing fort. She's set you on your task, now it's time to get to it.
rows.translation:
“你想要什么？”杰琳皱眉站直，一手按在露米头上拨弄她的双耳。“我当然很想重回锦衣玉食的生活，[pc.mf
        |主人
        |女主人
    ]，可那是一项昂贵的工程。”
    
    “我只需要知道有多昂贵，以及需要哪些东西。”
    
    恶魔酒保眨眨眼，直到不断扭动的蜜蜂姑娘颤抖得恰到好处，才放开她，整理起自己的项圈。“那……这要求很难满足，你真要了我的命。”她尾巴来回鞭打，恶魔长舌伸至淫靡长度的极限，却依旧开动脑筋思索任务。“好吧，我需要纸或者类似的东西……”
    
    她钻到吧台下方，足足半分钟里，只留下向上翘起的屁股和摇晃的尾巴供你观赏，随后才重新直起身体，又调整从衣服里掉出来的双乳。“好，我们需要……石料、木材、金属、工匠、食物、一个能用魔法弄出该死热水的人，还有一大堆钱币。[flags.HIVE_CLEARED
        |只要你能弄到这些，我可以让那些满脑子蜂蜜的大黄蜂帮忙完成其余工作。
        |更不用说我们还需要劳动力；也许你能管住那些满脑子蜂蜜的大黄蜂，让我们不必耗费整整一个世纪就能完成工作？
    ]”
    
    杰琳吞咽一口，又扯了扯项圈，上下打量你，接着双臂夹紧乳房，俯身靠在吧台上。“我做得好吗？”
    
    “做得很好。我会……想办法解决剩下的事。” 
    
    恶魔酒保浑身一颤，压住一声呜咽，沉浸在完成命令的宽慰与快感中。 
    
    伴着精液泼溅到脚边地板上的声响，旁边的露米惊讶地倒吸一口气，整张脸涨得通红。“我——我来清理。”
    
    你认识很多工匠，可以逼他们提供材料和附魔服务……至于粮食，也许丰收谷还有剩余产量可供你不断发展的驿堡使用。她已经给你安排了任务，现在该着手行动了。

rows.original: "Alright [pc.name], what is it you need? A new blade? Armor fix-up? Jewelry for your partners?" Ogrish stands up a little straighter and smiles good-naturedly, resting down the blade he'd been honing. "[pc.isBimbo |Nuh-uh! Not this time! But I super might soon. |For once? No. ] I need construction work done for my fort to the north." "That old thing? So what, hinges, bolts, frames, rivets?" You show him the list written up by [wayfort.hasDaliza |Daliza |[wayfort.hasFarrah |Farrah |Jael'yn ] ], watching as his eyes widen and he lets out a surprisingly sharp whistle despite his tusks. "That's quite the sum, I'll need the metals reimbursed, but for the whole lot?" The blacksmith sighs and considers for a few moments longer, handing over the sheet. "Two-thousand, five-hundred." This time you let out the low whistle; that's no small sum. "Hey, it's the smithing for an entire fortress, and I know I'll give you my best work. You don't like it, feel free to shop around."
rows.translation: “好吧，[pc.name]，你需要什么？新刀？修理护甲？送给伴侣的首饰？”奥格里什站得稍直了一些，露出和善的笑容，放下刚才一直打磨的刀刃。 “[pc.isBimbo |才不是！这次不需要！不过我可能很快就会超级需要啦。 |难得一次，不需要。 ]我需要人替北边的堡垒做些建筑工程。” “那个老地方？所以要做什么，铰链、螺栓、框架、铆钉？” 你把[wayfort.hasDaliza |达莉莎 |[wayfort.hasFarrah |法拉 |杰琳 ] ]列好的清单递给他。奥格里什双眼越睁越大；尽管长着獠牙，他仍吹出一声意外尖锐的口哨。“这可是一大批东西。我得收回金属成本，不过要把全部东西都做完？” 铁匠叹了口气，又考虑片刻，把纸张递回来。“两千五百。” 这次轮到你压低声音吹了声口哨；那可不是一笔小钱。 “嘿，这是为一整座堡垒锻造铁器，而且我知道自己会拿出最好的手艺。你若不满意，尽管去货比三家。”

rows.original:
As much as it hurts, you'd been warned of the costs implied in working on the fort. Ogrish still looks surprised when you foist over so much cold, hard coin however.

        "Guess you're really serious about that place. Don't worry, it'll all be my finest work. That thing'll be standing even when we're all old and gone."
rows.translation:
尽管这很令人痛心，但你们之前就已经被告知过，在这座堡垒上工作会带来哪些代价。然而，当你拿出这么多沉甸甸的硬币时，奥格瑞什依然显得很惊讶。

        “看来你们是真的对那个地方很重视啊。别担心，我会把最好的精力都投入到这项工作中去。等我们所有人都老去离开这个世界的时候，那座堡垒依然会屹立不倒。”

"

        "Guess you're really serious about that place. Don't worry, it'll all be my finest work. That thing'll be standing even when we're all old and gone.""

rows.original: Rags looks surprised when you broach the topic, folding her arms beneath her [rags.pregStage 0 3 |fur-bound chest |prodigious, milky tits ]. "And you want me to be the one to do all the smithing work?" "[pc.dcb |Exciting right? Hinges... and stuff. |If it's okay with you, I mean, I know you basically only ever do weapons and armor. |Yeah! Although, like... I guess I don't need any stabbystuff. ]" Ragnild snorts softly, running her tongue across her tusks and indicating the shoreline. "I confess, there's a certain novelty to working on something I've not done before. The most I get to do when it's not arms is... I guess nails for ships, a few bolts here and there. Piercings, I guess?" She squints at you after a moment's more consideration. "I'm not constructing a throne to go under your ass, am I?" "[pc.isBimbo |Nope! Already got me one'a those! |Ha, no. I've already got one. ]" The deep-green blacksmith smirks and shakes her head and holds her hand out, "got a list of what you need?" You fork over the parchment, watching her appraise the list from top-to-bottom before she finally folds it and hands it back. "Twenty-five hundred, although we don't have that much hanging around." "I can supply extra metal... but surely we can bring the price down?" "Well, [arona.isDom |you are our warchief's bitch |you have made Arona into your bitch ]. I figure we can kick that down to half its worth and you can just pay me the hours I'm putting in. Deal?"
rows.translation: 你提起这个话题时，拉格斯面露惊讶，双臂交叉在[rags.pregStage 0 3 |裹着毛皮的胸膛 |硕大而充盈乳汁的双乳 ]下。“你想让我负责所有锻造工作？” “[pc.dcb |很刺激，对吧？铰链……之类的东西。 |我是说，如果你不介意的话；我知道你基本只打造武器和护甲。 |对啊！不过……我想自己不需要任何捅人的东西。 ]” 拉格妮尔德轻声喷鼻，用舌头舔过獠牙，指向海岸。“我承认，打造从未做过的东西，的确有种新鲜感。不制作武器时，我最多就是……大概替船造钉子，偶尔造些螺栓。或者穿孔饰品？”又思考片刻后，她眯眼看你。“我不会要造一把垫在你屁股下面的王座吧？” “[pc.isBimbo |不会！我已经有一把啦！ |哈，不会。我已经有了。 ]” 深绿色皮肤的铁匠咧嘴一笑，摇着头伸出手。“有你需要的东西的清单吗？” 你交出羊皮纸，看她从头到尾估量清单，最后将其折起还给你。“两千五百枚，不过我们手边没有那么多材料。” “我可以额外提供金属……但我们肯定可以压低价格吧？” “嗯，[arona.isDom |你是我们战酋的母狗 |你确实把阿罗娜变成了自己的母狗 ]。我想可以砍到一半价值，你只需支付我投入的工时。成交？”

rows.original: [var0 |Zuzaan lets out what might be called a delighted whinny, 'fwipping' her tail from side-to-side. "Here I thought you would be coming to me for my smithing talents, you want me to make a bunch of enchantments for you?" You nod, holding out a parchment covered in notes taken by [wayfort.hasDaliza |your bailiff |[wayfort.hasFarrah |Farrah |Jael'yn ] ]. The mare sniffs and looks the page over, tutting softly after a point. "A shame you don't want me for smithing too! Could've done the whole lot... don't get me wrong! I'd love an excuse to steal a few stallions for a week and pound out—" Zuzaan pauses for effect. "A bunch of rune plates that can just be stamped onto whatever they're needed for. Sound good?" "How much would this cost me then?" She grins and hands your paper back, tail swishing once more and kicking up the scent of a horny mare with enough potency to make your mouth unconsciously water. "Two-thousand, five-hundred electrum, and not a 'leccy less. I'll need to use at least half of it as material alone... let alone any money left over for me. You've done us a good turn though, and I'm happy to take a smaller slice. Sound good?" |The muscular mare's eyes immediately light up at the prospect, and she has to bite a sooty knuckle in order to keep the smile from showing on her face. "What's this, an opportunity to craft something mundane? I— I'm actually a little bit surprised! I've spent so long crafting for warfare..." Zuzaan grins, sighs and tucks back her braid, giving you ample opportunity to soak in the contours of her muscular form. "Okay, I'm in. What exactly am I going to have to craft in that case?" You hand over a folded parchment with the list of requirements, the reading of which makes the mare's brows slowly rise. "That's not a small list; how much do you expect this to cost you? Not to mention we've nowhere near so much metal hanging around." "It's for an entire fortress — my fortress, actually." "Sure looks it. Tell you what, I'm looking at over two-thousand electrum's worth of work and materials here, probably closer to two-thousand, five-hundred. Buuut... I'd be willing to work this all at-cost if you paid me to do the enchanting on top of that." She hands the sheet back, smiling again and cupping one of her weighty tits. "I can see you're looking for one'a them too, unless I'm too late and you've already gotten some 'chanter before coming to me for the smithing..." "How much would that cost, out of curiosity?" "Smithing and enchanting together? Three-thousand, seven-hundred-and-fifty. Fair deal, no?" ]
rows.translation: [var0 |祖赞发出一声堪称欢喜的嘶鸣，尾巴“嗖嗖”左右摆动。“我还以为你会看中我的锻造技艺才来找我；你想让我替你制作一堆附魔物？” 你点点头，拿出一张写满[wayfort.hasDaliza |你的执法官 |[wayfort.hasFarrah |法拉 |杰琳 ] ]所作笔记的羊皮纸。母马嗅了嗅，低头读过纸页，片刻后轻轻咂舌。“真遗憾，你不想同时让我负责锻造！我本来可以全包……别误会！我很想找借口偷来几匹种马用上一周，狠狠干出——”祖赞故意停顿。“一堆可以直接压到所需之处的符文板。听起来怎么样？” “那么，这要花我多少钱？” 她咧嘴笑着把纸还给你，尾巴再次摇摆，扬起一股发情母马的气息，浓烈得让你无意识地口舌生津。“两千五百枚琥珀金币，一枚也不能少。光是材料，我至少要用掉其中一半……更别说最后留给自己的钱了。不过你帮了我们大忙，我愿意少赚一点。怎么样？” |强壮母马的双眼立即因这个提议亮了起来，她不得不咬住沾有煤灰的指节，才没有让笑容显露在脸上。“这是什么，制作普通物件的机会？我——我其实有点吃惊！我为战争打造东西太久了……” 祖赞咧嘴一笑，叹着气把辫子拨回身后，让你能尽情欣赏她壮硕身躯的轮廓。“好吧，我加入。那么，我究竟要打造什么？” 你递出一张折起的羊皮纸，上面列有需求；母马越读，双眉抬得越高。“这清单可不短；你预计要花多少钱？更别提我们手边根本没有这么多金属。” “这是为了整座要塞——其实就是我的要塞。” “看起来的确如此。这样吧，这里的工作和材料价值超过两千枚琥珀金币，可能更接近两千五百枚。可——是……如果你付钱让我再负责附魔，我愿意让所有锻造工作都按成本收费。” 她把纸张还给你，再次微笑，一手托着沉甸甸的乳房。“我看你也在寻找一个附魔师，除非我已经来迟了，你在找我锻造以前就找到了别的附魔师……” “只是出于好奇，那要花多少钱？” “锻造和附魔一起？三千七百五十枚。很公平，对吧？” ]

"Gods, I'm going to need to lay claim to one of the studs around here for a long week of work. Who to pick?" She's already distractedly scanning the horizon, tail swishing and kicking up the scent of a horny breeder. "Oh! And, uh, yeah. Thanks for the cash, [pc.name]. I'll get started straight away."

rows.original:
Nelia's perfectly-sculpted eyebrows raise in surprise, and you could swear there's already money glittering in her eyes. [wayfort.hasMaids
        |"Well, you've already made me a very wealthy woman after putting together all of those precious maid outfits, how could I deny the opportunity to put my skills to furnishings too?"
        |"Well now, that's a little bit outside of my wheelhouse, at best i've done cushions before... but I'd be willing to put my skills to task."
    ] 
    
    "[pc.isBimbo
        |Yay! That's super! I've got, like, a list of stuff!
        |Excellent, here's the list.
    ]"
    
    The goblin laughs as her eyes scroll the list, and she looks up at you again as though to check. "This really is a lot, and you're not asking for cheap works either!"
    
    "Do you have the stock for it?"
    
    "No, luckily cloth is one of the few things we have in an undeniable abundance! Not to mention with such good customers like yourself, I'm able to order some really quite wonderful linens, wools, and silks." Nelia hands the parchment back, tenting her fingers and smiling at you. "How much do you think I'm going to charge you?"
    
    [pc.isCunning
        |"Two-thousand, five-hundred electrum, and not a coin less?"
        
        Nelia purses her lips, before bursting out into a laugh. "Fine, ha, I see you've done this before. Yes, that what I'll charge."
        |"...A lot?"
        
        Nelia snorts a rather unladylike-snort, nodding slowly. "Pretty much; about, say... Two-thousand, five-hundred coins?"
    ]
    
    Urgh. You expected it, but it still hurts to hear it.
    
    "Hey, you could end up finding someone who will do the work cheaper, but you know that I produce quality in a timely fashion, and I won't scrimp a bit on it."
rows.translation:
内莉娅雕琢得完美无瑕的双眉惊讶地扬起，你几乎敢发誓，她眼中已经闪烁着金钱的光芒。[wayfort.hasMaids
        |“嗯，你让我制作那些珍贵的女仆装，已经令我成了相当富有的女人；我又怎么会拒绝把技艺运用到家具上的机会？”
        |“哎呀，这多少超出了我的专业领域；我以前最多只做过软垫……不过我愿意发挥技艺，接受挑战。”
    ] 
    
    “[pc.isBimbo
        |好耶！太棒了！我有一张……差不多是东西的清单！
        |很好，清单在这里。
    ]”
    
    地精双眼扫过清单，笑了起来，随后再次抬头看你，仿佛要加以确认。“这可真不少，而且你要的也不是什么廉价货色！”
    
    “你有足够的库存吗？”
    
    “没有——幸好布料是我们少数无可置疑地存量充足的东西之一！更何况，有你这样出色的顾客，我能订购到真正精美的亚麻布、羊毛和丝绸。”内莉娅把羊皮纸递回来，十指指尖相抵，朝你微笑。“你猜我会收多少钱？”
    
    [pc.isCunning
        |“两千五百枚琥珀金币，一枚也不能少？”
        
        内莉娅抿起嘴唇，随即放声大笑。“好吧，哈，看来你以前做过这种事。没错，我就是这个价。”
        |“……很多？”
        
        内莉娅发出一声颇不淑女的嗤笑，缓缓点头。“差不多；比如说……两千五百枚钱币？”
    ]
    
    呃。你早有预料，可亲耳听见仍然肉痛。
    
    “嘿，你最后也许能找到收费更便宜的人，不过你知道我能及时交出上等成品，而且绝不会偷工减料。”

rows.original: The goblin's eyes actually shine when you fork over the cash, and she bites her lip pointedly. "Okay, this is going to be just a delight. It may be money to pay for a service, but I can't help but thank you for your custom. You're keeping these old bones alive, you know. Always new, interesting things to craft." [pc.dcb |"Don't call yourself old, you daft green tart." You tease, and the smaller goblin scoffs, waving you off. |"You? Old? Nonsense." |"N'awwh, you're still super-young!" ] "Fine, fine! Now scoot, I'm going to get started right away."
rows.translation: 那个哥布林的眼睛，实际上闪耀当你把钱付给她的时候，她故意咬了咬嘴唇，说道：“好了，这次肯定会让你们非常满意的。虽然这只是用来支付一项服务的费用，但我还是忍不住要感谢你们的支持。你们让这些老家伙继续有了存在的意义，知道吗？总有一些新鲜有趣的东西可以让它们继续被制作出来。 [pc.dcb |别自称老家伙，你这个愚蠢的绿色小妖精。”你开玩笑地说道，那个较小的地精则嗤之以鼻，挥了挥手让你走开。 |你？老了？胡说八道。 |哎呀，你还这么年轻呢！ ] 好吧好吧！现在快走，我马上就要开始工作了。

rows.original:
Telfir, the man responsible for such lovely works when you were exploring the marketplace with Ryn, looks surprised to see you once more. "Greetings, friend! [party.som
        |Touring the markets alone this fair [dayNight
            |day
            |eve
        ]?
        |Enjoying another waltz through the market with a lovely companion?
        |What brings you and your lovely companions to my humble store once more?
    ]" He courts a perfectly gentile bow and flashes you a simple smile, making sure to spare a glance for his goods— ensuring that they're presented properly.
    
    "It's a pretty big job," you begin, handing over a sheet of parchment.
    
    [wayfort.hasDaliza
        |"Whoever wrote this, they have a beautiful script. So neat and orderly..."
        
        "Daliza, my bailiff."
        
        "Bailiff? Oh! Goodness, that's right, I had heard someone had been landed by our lady, and landed to the south... would that be yourself?"
        
        [pc.isBimbo
            |"Yuppers!"
            |"That's right."
        ]
        
    ]"Excellent, let me just take a look at this..." Telfir scans the list, finally letting out a whistle. "I'm honored you'd think my humble shop capable of such a task!"
    
    "And is it?"
    
    The elf's eyes glitter for a moment, before he clears his throat and double checks. "Certainly, I could... it's not a quick job, to be sure, but I have the means, and a few contacts who would be delighted to assist me with the tapestries."
    
    "You do?"
    
    "But of course! They've not had call to utilize their skills in a winter's age, but they helped produce some of the castle's finest works."
    
    "And how much would this cost me?"
    
    "[wayfort.hasDaliza
        |Well..." Telfir trails off and sighs, before giving you his warmest smile. "Tell not a soul, and I'll knock five-hundred electrum off, for a total of two-thousand. Consider it my gift for opening southern lands for what will undoubtedly be more trade in my future."
        
        Although far from chump change still, that's a huge deal he's offering you.
        |Goodness, quite a lot, if I'm quite honest [pc.mf
            |my lord
            |my lady
        ]." He gives you his warmest smile regardless, "I've got the cloth required, it will be labor and sale only. Two-thousand, five-hundred electrum. How does that sound?"
        
        It sounds expensive, but fairer than you could expect sometimes.
    ]
rows.translation:
你之前与小琳逛市场时，泰尔菲尔正是那些精美作品的制作者；如今再次见你，他面露惊讶。“问候你，朋友！[party.som
        |这样美好的[dayNight
            |白昼
            |夜晚
        ]，独自逛市场吗？
        |又在与一名可爱同伴漫步市场吗？
        |是什么让你和可爱的同伴再次光临鄙店？
    ]”他极其文雅地鞠了一躬，向你露出朴实的微笑，又不忘瞥一眼商品——确保它们陈列得当。
    
    “这工作相当庞大。”你递出一页羊皮纸，开口说道。
    
    [wayfort.hasDaliza
        |“写这张纸的人字迹很美。如此工整有序……”
        
        “达莉莎，我的执法官。”
        
        “执法官？哦！天哪，对了，我听说我们的女领主赐予某人南方的封地……那会是你吗？”
        
        [pc.isBimbo
            |“没错哟！”
            |“没错。”
        ]
        
    ]“很好，让我看一看……”泰尔菲尔扫过清单，最后吹了声口哨。“你认为鄙店有能力完成如此任务，真令我深感荣幸！”
    
    “那有吗？”
    
    精灵眼中闪过一丝光彩，随后清清嗓子，再次检查。“当然，我能……这肯定不是一件很快完成的工作，但我有办法，还有几位熟人很乐意协助制作挂毯。”
    
    “你真有？”
    
    “当然！他们已经多年没有机会施展技艺，却曾协助制作城堡中最精美的一批作品。”
    
    “这会花我多少钱？”
    
    “[wayfort.hasDaliza
        |嗯……”泰尔菲尔声音渐弱，叹了口气，随后向你露出最温暖的笑容。“不要告诉任何人，我会减去五百枚琥珀金币，总价两千。就把这视作我的礼物，感谢你开放南方土地；这无疑会为我带来更多生意。”
        
        即使仍远非一笔小钱，他给出的优惠也相当可观。
        |天哪，老实说，的确不少，[pc.mf
            |大人
            |女士
        ]。”即便如此，他仍向你露出最温暖的笑容。“我有所需的布料，只会收取人工与销售费用。两千五百枚琥珀金币。听起来如何？”
        
        听起来很昂贵，不过有时已经比你所能期待的更加公平。
    ]

rows.original:
As much as it pains you — and your wallet — you count out a fat stack of coins and deposit them into the tailor's bag. 

        "My thanks for your custom. Send a runner when you're prepared for me to begin— preferably with some measurements."
        
        "Will do."
rows.translation:
尽管这会让您感到痛苦，也会让您的钱包受挫，但您还是数出了一大堆硬币，把它们放进了裁缝的袋子里。 

        “非常感谢您的定制服务。等您准备好让我开始工作的时候，请派人通知我——最好能带上一些尺寸数据。”
        
        “好的，我会照做的。”

rows.original: Pay for Telfir's tailoring services, just
rows.translation: 只需支付泰尔菲尔的裁缝服务费用即可。
也许等以后再说吧，那实在太贵了。

rows.original:
Viv nibbles gently on a perfectly-manicured and painted nail, considering your request for a few moments before giving you an easy smile. "For you, dear? It would be my pleasure... let's see what I can do, shall we?"
    
    After handing over a list of requirements, her brows raise for the briefest of moments before settling down again. "You're going to keep me busy with more than just your company, it would seem! I hope you realize there's nothing cheap about this request, right?"
    
    "...How much are we talking about here?" You sigh, already feeling that sinking sensation deep down in your wallet.
    
    "Oh don't look like that, [pc.mf
        |hun
        |sweetie
    ]. Every rune I stamp will get my personal attention; every hot bath or delicious cup of tea, or every storm kept out by shielded windows, and you can think fond thoughts of your favorite witch." Her painted lips form a sultry smile, and she pointedly brings her arms together in order to push up her chest. "Twenty-five hundred."
    
    Two-thousand, five-hundred electrum? You knew to expect exactly that but it still stings just how on-the-dot such a large sum is.
rows.translation:
薇芙轻轻咬着一枚修剪完美、涂有甲油的指甲，思索你的请求片刻，随后轻松地笑了笑。“为了你吗，亲爱的？我很乐意……来看看我能做些什么，好吗？”
    
    你递过需求清单后，她的眉毛极其短暂地扬了一下，随即又恢复原样。“看来除了陪伴你，我还会因为别的事情忙个不停！希望你明白，这份请求一点也不便宜，对吧？”
    
    “……究竟要多少钱？”你叹了口气，已经感觉自己的钱包深处猛地一沉。
    
    “哦，别摆出那种表情，[pc.mf
        |亲爱的
        |甜心
    ]。我刻下的每一道符文都会得到亲自照料；以后每泡一次热水澡、每喝一杯好茶，或每当受护窗户挡住一场暴风雨，你都可以深情地想起自己最喜欢的女巫。”她涂过唇彩的嘴唇勾起妩媚笑容，又故意并拢双臂托高胸部。“两千五百。”
    
    两千五百枚琥珀金币？你早就料到恰好是这个数字，可如此巨额而分毫不差，依然令人肉痛。

rows.original:
To Viv's credit, she gives you an appropriately sultry purr when you start pulling out stacks of money. Shivers trail down your spine [pc.hasTail
            |to the tip of your [pc.tail]
            |until you're fidgeting to shake the sensation off
        ], and her eyes glitter with wicked promise for the next time you return to her. "When you have everything ready for me, just say the word, I'll begin getting these stamped out for you. It might be the work of a few weeks, if that's alright?"
        
        [pc.isBimbo
            |"Totes!"
            |"Yes, that's fine."
        ]
rows.translation:
值得称赞的是，当你开始一叠叠往外掏钱时，薇芙给了你一声恰到好处的撩人呼噜。一阵战栗顺着你的脊背往下窜[pc.hasTail
            |一直窜到你[pc.tail]的尖端
            |让你坐立不安，只能抖着身子把那感觉甩掉
        ]，而她的眼睛里闪着邪恶的期许，盼着你下次再来找她。“等你把我要的东西都备齐了，说一声就行，我就开始替你把它们印出来。可能要花上几个星期，这样可以吗？”
        
        [pc.isBimbo
            |“超级可以！”
            |“可以，没问题。”
        ]

rows.translation: 你的钱可不够啊！2,500枚琥珀金币。

rows.original: "I've been wondering if you'd ever require my services for matters more mundane! Finally, you're making that dreadful old lump of miserable stone into something respectable!" There's a delighted glitter in her eyes, and she sinks a few hands into her ever-giving bosom before continuing. "Even better; I don't have to worry about a lord or lady that's going to try and remove me from their doorstep![evergreen.kidsRange 1 | Especially considering they're such a wonderful [pc.mf |father |mother ]. ]" She gives you her most alluring smile, squeezing her chest until milk beads before releasing and holding out one of her still-warm hands. "Do you have a list of what you'd require?" Feeling the heat creeping up to your [pc.ears] already, you're quick to hand over the parchment. "I hope you won't mind a few of my babies stopping by from time-to-time? The novelty of having a bar in easy reach won't soon wear thin for them, I'm sure." You'd be insulted if they didn't, most likely. "When I've got the place looking respectable, at least." "With my help, that shouldn't take long!" Evergreen chuckles and hands the parchment back, steepling her fingers and thinking for a few moments. [wayfort.hasDaliza |"You really must introduce me to whoever does your numbers, they're spot-on." You're not sure Daliza would get along particularly well with the fluffy idol of fertility and virility, but oh well. ] "Two-thousand, five-hundred on the dot for all of the runes you'll need written and stamped...[evergreen.kidsRange 1 | although for a [pc.mf |mother |father ] known to my embrace? At-cost, a gift, from mommy." "How much is that?" "Exactly half; one-thousand, two-hundred and fifty electrum coins." [pc.isBimbo |She confirms, for your wonderfully [silly |smooth bwain |empty head ]. |She confirms with a smile. ] | I do hope you can afford it." ] "I can't just give you a kid?" Evergreen snorts, shaking her head. "Not only would you need to keep me pregnant for a few dozen-children for the scope of the service — as tempting as that part is — I actually do need electrum to perform all of that alchemy."
rows.translation: 我一直在想，你是否也会需要我在一些平凡的事情上帮忙呢！终于，你把那块原本毫无价值的石头变成了值得尊敬的东西！”她的眼中闪烁着喜悦的光芒，然后把手伸进自己那永远宽大的胸脯里，继续说道。 “更棒的是，我再也不用担心会有什么贵族老爷或夫人试图把我从他们家门口赶走啦！[evergreen.kidsRange 1 | 尤其是考虑到他们真是太棒了[pc.mf |父亲 |母亲 ]。 ]她向你露出最迷人的微笑，将胸部紧紧挤压，直到乳汁开始溢出，然后松开手，伸出仍然温暖的一只手：“你有没有列出自己需要哪些东西呢？” 感受到热量正在逐渐蔓延到你的身上[pc.ears]哎呀，你可真是个办事利落的人，这么快就把羊皮纸递过来了。‘希望你们不会介意我的孩子们偶尔来这儿玩吧？对他们来说，能随时吃到这些小点心，这种新鲜感肯定不会很快消失的。’” “如果他们不介意的话，你反倒会觉得被冒犯才是吧……至少在我把这个地方收拾得体面一些之后，他们是不会介意的。” “有我的帮忙，这应该不会花太长时间吧！”常青女士轻笑着，把羊皮纸递了回去，然后双手交叠，思考了一会儿。 [wayfort.hasDaliza |你真的应该把我介绍给负责你们数据统计的人，他们的数据简直太准确了。” 你不确定达莉莎是否会与这个象征生育与阳刚之气的偶像相处得来，但算了，反正也没办法改变什么。 ] 两千五百元，正好够支付所有那些需要书写并盖章的符文了……[evergreen.kidsRange 1 | 尽管如此为了[pc.mf |母亲 |父亲 ]被我紧紧拥在怀中……这是妈妈送给你的礼物，不收取任何费用。” “这个礼物值多少钱呢？” “正好是一半的钱——一千二百五十枚琥珀金币。 [pc.isBimbo |她确认了，真是太好了。 [silly |头脑冷静 |空脑壳 ]。 |她微笑着确认道。 ] | 我真心希望你能够负担得起。 ] 我总不能就这么把一个孩子给你吧？” 常青女士哼了一声，摇了摇头。“首先，为了完成这项任务，你得让我怀孕几十次才能生出足够多的孩子来——虽然这个想法很吸引人，但实际上确实需要进行这些炼金术操作，就必须拥有电银。

rows.original: "Well I'll be righ' damned, ya could'a gone to any old lad or lass but you've come f'me and my sister?" The curvaceous Kitsune runs a few finger through her own thick foxy tails, sizing you up for a few moments. "If'n it's that Kerosite magic touch ya after, no brighter folk'n us." There's a glitter to her eyes that's a little more reminiscent of a predator with her pray, but the shrine maiden settles back with a surprisingly bright laugh. "Am I right in assumin' you're not after th'usual trickery though? It'd be righ' disappointin', but... not unexpected." "Aaah, or perhaps y'lookin' for a lil' discount, that right? [pc.ra kitsune |S'true, we look after our own, for a foxy fox like y'self, it'd be a right un-neighbourly act fer us t'leave ya penniless on our borders. |Y'know it's only fellow kitsune who're able t'take advantage'a that, right? Woul' be downright shameful'a us otherwise. ]" [var0|Miko|Mai] smiles and dips a hand under her robe, shuffling to resettle her bosom after leaning in so deeply to tease you. "Well, how much will it cost then?" You hand over the parchment [wayfort.hasDaliza |Daliza |[wayfort.hasFarrah |Farrah |Jael'yn ] ] drew up, biting your lip and waiting. For the briefest of moments, the oft-teasing fox is the picture of seriousness — you suspect they'd be pretty merciless if you tried to scam either of them — before she hands back the parchment... which now smells almost immediately of sweet flowers, neat trick. "[pc.ra kitsune |F'you? I'll tell it to ya' straight; fifteen hundred — or one-thousand, five-hundred — of ya shiniest 'leccys. |Well, for ya' lovely self, this is lookin' like... two thousand an' five hundred 'leccy coins, assumin' we'd like t'take any profit outta the endeavour. An' we do. ]" Phew, that price is [pc.ra kitsune |still ]no small amount. The shrine maiden gives you a flutter of her eyelashes that hints at an innocence you know is far from present.
rows.translation: “嘿，真他妈没想到；你大可去找随便哪个男人或女人，却来找我和妹妹？”身材丰腴的狐妖将几根手指穿过自己浓密的狐尾，打量你片刻。“如果你想要凯罗斯信徒的魔法手艺，就没有比我们更聪明的人。” 她双眼闪着微光，更像一名捕食者看见了猎物；可神社巫女往后一靠，笑声却意外爽朗。“我猜，你不是来寻求平常那些戏法的，对吧？那会相当令人失望，不过……并不意外。” “啊——，又或者你想要一点折扣，是吗？[pc.ra kitsune |没错，我们会照顾同族；对你这样迷人的狐狸，任你在我们的边境一贫如洗，实在太不睦邻了。 |你知道，只有同为狐妖的人才能享受优惠，对吧？不然我们可要颜面扫地。 ]”[var0|米可|舞]微笑着将一只手探入长袍；她方才为了调戏你而深深俯身，现在挪动身体，重新安置自己的胸脯。 “那么，究竟要花多少？”你交出[wayfort.hasDaliza |达莉莎 |[wayfort.hasFarrah |法拉 |杰琳 ] ]拟定的羊皮纸，咬住嘴唇等待。 这只总爱调戏人的狐狸有极其短暂的一刻变得无比严肃——你怀疑自己若想欺骗她们中的任何一个，她们都会相当无情——接着，她把羊皮纸还给你……纸张几乎立即散发出甜美花香；真是巧妙的戏法。“[pc.ra kitsune |对你？我就直说吧；一千五百——没错，就是一千五百——枚你最闪亮的琥珀金币。 |嗯，看在可爱的你份上，这大概要……两千五百枚琥珀金币，前提是我们想从这项工程赚到一点利润。而我们当然想。 ]” 呼，这个价格[pc.ra kitsune |依然 ]不是小数目。神社巫女睫毛轻颤，暗示着一种你很清楚根本不存在的纯真。

rows.original:
[pc.dcb
            |"You're bleeding me dry," you curse.
            |"Damn, still feels like a steep, steep charge..."
            |"Heck! That's a lotta pennies!"
        ]
        
        "Innit jus'?"
        
        [var0|Miko|Mai] grins and accepts your patronage with open palms, tails swishing before she pours the entire lot into her own cleavage. Somehow the waterfall of silver-gold coin doesn't fall right back out again, and she giggles at the way your gaze drifts forward. "I know, such delightful lil' tricks'a the eyes, aint they?" 
        
        Now that you're lighter of pocket, you've got to find the joy where you can. "When ya ready f'us, jus' send a lil' runner or stop by ya'self, y'hear?" 
        
        Her bouquet of tails swish invitingly, but apparently the matter is closed... for now.
rows.translation:
[pc.dcb
            |“你简直要把我榨干了，”你骂道。
            |“靠，这收费还是感觉贵得离谱……”
            |“我去！这可得一大把便士！”
        ]
        
        “可不是嘛？”
        
        [var0|米可|舞]咧嘴一笑，摊开双手收下你的惠顾，尾巴先甩了甩，然后才把那一整堆钱倒进自己的乳沟里。那些金银币汇成的瀑布不知怎么竟没有立刻掉出来，看到你的目光不自觉往前飘，她咯咯笑了起来。“我知道，这种讨喜的小把戏很勾人，对吧？” 
        
        既然钱包轻了，你就得在能找乐子的地方找乐子。“等你准备好招待我们了，就派个小跑腿的来，或者自己过来一趟，听见没？” 
        
        她那一束尾巴诱人地摆动着，但看来这件事已经谈完了……暂时。

rows.original: The shark-shaman sits up, looking confused. "Wait, why in Seastone's name would you come to me to go enchanting a bunch of stuff above water." "Because I know you're good, and I bet there's nobody better for a lot of these runes." She doesn't appear convinced until you hand over a piece of parchment, tossing back her lengthy hair and squinting at the [wayfort.hasDaliza |carefully-recalled list from Daliza |hurried scrawl from [wayfort.hasFarrah |Farrah |Jael'yn ] ]. "I— oh. Yeah, no, actually I can do that incredibly easy. Most of this is just... make water hot, or make rooms warm. I can make these into electrum stamps no problem, then any [silly |dumb stinky |idiot ] can slap them on." "How much would that cost?" You sigh a moment later, realizing the crux of the matter. By this point Imora has a grin on her face to show off the neat row of her siorc teeth, large tail slapping on the ground as though to enunciate her point. "Pretty sure Seastone would be delighted to know my works are on the walls and tubs of well-adjusted, noble surfacers [pc.ra siorc |representing us so wonderfully as you do |like yourself ]..." "And?" "Weeeeell, we have a special policy for [pc.ra siorc |fellow ]siorcs, to help them feel comfortable and happy even away from home. [pc.ra siorc |Even though you're alchemized through-and-through, you're still family so far as I or anyone else from Starhome gives a shit. For you? One-thousand, two-hundred and fifty electrum. |Alas, you don't... fit into that particular demographic, [pc.mf |handsome |cutie ]. I'm going to need full price; two-thousand, five-hundred electrum. ]" Her eyes glitter until they're a match to the field of stars that makes up her tough siorc flesh. Gods, it's a lot of money.
rows.translation: 鲨人萨满坐起身来，满脸困惑。“等等，以海石之名，你为什么会来找我给一堆水面以上的东西附魔？” “因为我知道你很擅长，而且我敢说，其中许多符文没人比你更合适。” 她似乎仍不信服，直到你递出一页羊皮纸；她将长发甩到身后，眯眼阅读[wayfort.hasDaliza |仔细回忆达莉莎所列出的清单 |[wayfort.hasFarrah |法拉 |杰琳 ]匆匆写下的字迹 ]。“我——哦。对，不，实际上这对我简直轻而易举。大部分只是……加热水，或者温暖房间。我能毫无问题地把符文制成琥珀金印记，到时候随便哪个[silly |又蠢又臭的家伙 |白痴 ]都能把它们拍上去。” “这要花多少钱？”片刻后，你意识到问题的关键，不由叹气。 此时伊莫拉已经咧嘴微笑，露出整齐的一排鲨人牙齿；粗大的尾巴拍打地面，仿佛用来强调自己的话。“我很确定，海石若知道自己的作品出现在那些适应良好、高贵的地表鲨人[pc.ra siorc |——你把我们代表得如此出色—— |——例如你—— ]的墙壁和浴池上，一定会很高兴……” “然后呢？” “嗯——，我们对[pc.ra siorc |同为 ]鲨人的人有特别政策，帮助他们即使远离家乡也能感到舒适快乐。[pc.ra siorc |虽然你从里到外都是炼金术的产物，但只要我或星之家任何人在意，你仍然是家人。给你？一千二百五十枚琥珀金币。 |可惜，你不……属于特定群体，[pc.mf |帅哥 |可爱鬼 ]。我必须收取全价；两千五百枚琥珀金币。 ]” 她的双眼闪闪发光，直至与构成坚韧鲨人肌肤的星野相称。 诸神啊，这可是一大笔钱。

rows.original:
Her tail slaps the ground a few more times before she starts bursting out into bright giggles. "Oh wow, I'm sorry, no, this isn't anything about you. I'm just excited to do something like this; I've never just worked a job for a few weeks."
        
        "Never?"
        
        "At best it's a day on, a day off. At this rate I'll even be able to get Seastone to help me, we can even work at the same desk." There's a pleased smile on her face once she calms down, carefully portioning the coin out into a coupleof smaller bags before tying them to her hips. "I'd best get this home... thank you, [pc.name]. If you can get a message to me when it's time to begin, I'll dig right in."
rows.translation:
她的尾巴又在地上拍了几下，随后她忽然爆发出一阵清脆的咯咯笑声。“哦哇，对不起，不，这跟你没关系。我只是很兴奋能做这样的事；我还从来没有安安稳稳地做一份工作做个几星期呢。”
        
        “从来没有？”
        
        “最多也就是上一天班、休一天。照这个势头，我甚至能让海石来帮我，我们还能在同一张桌子上干活。”她平静下来后，脸上挂着满意的笑容，仔细地把那些硬币分装进几个小袋子里，系在腰上。“我最好把这笔钱送回家去……谢谢你，[pc.name]。到了该开工的时候，你要是能捎个信给我，我马上就动手。”

rows.original: Anna's tail begins wagging furiously, and the ginger pup all but drags you down into a hug. "Oh! Oh yes we'd love to! Love-love-love to!" When she releases you, you stagger back with the scent of horny pup and hard work beginning to fog up your brain. "Didn't expect that." "Really? I'd think it obvious you know? We're farmers, and you're giving us a chance to farm more! The initial cost is going to obviously be high, but after that we'll have the infrastructure to supply for you all monthly on the cheap." "Infrastructure?" "Mhm, once things originally went... uh, poorly, in the general area? For a lot of people they abandoned their fields. Our own orchard is like two thirds the size of what it used to be, and goodness knows we need an excuse to restore the farm to its full Pupperidge potential." "What can you supply, then?" "Meat, vegetables, fruit, milk, beer, and the occasional snackythings. Oh! If you're after fish though, the mares do lots of fishing. We were gonna, but they're just better at it and have more people fishing. Instead they come to us for stuff and it's a trade." "How much would it cost then for some supplies?" The ginger pup's eyes are bright enough to practically sparkle, and she takes your hand before pressing it into her chest. "Two-thousand for our hero!" "Two thousand?" Anna smiles and nods, squeezing your hand. "Yep! We should probably charge a liiiittle bit more, but we've got stocks in reserve that would only go to waste otherwise. You have, like, a whole fortress that I'm betting gets filled with cuties all the time. So we'll just sell you all the surplus now, and use the money to make sure we can keep you supplied without strain, for years to come." That seems like a big decision to just make out of nowhere... The red-headed pupperidge pup smiles and releases you, twiddling her fingers and doing some mental mathematics before continuing. "Trust me! Morwen was sure all of our extra stuff was just taking up storage space, and she misses having a full-sized orchard — her mom loved those trees — so don't worry. I will check with her later just to be double-super sure, but I wouldn't worry about it. Money is my concern." [pc.dcb |"Surprisingly good of you." |"Aw thanks, that's incredibly good of you." |"Gosh you're just the super-sweetiest!" ] Anna's tail wags hard enough to slap at you a little, and she visibly bites down the urge to bark. "Okay, I need to calm down. I'm sorry, we've just been waiting for an opportunity to re-expand for ages, and I bet this'll encourage the other farmers to return to their fields too. We miss having neighbours! There was the couple a few miles down who had the most precious guard doggos, and their missus would bring over the creamiest pies." Heh. Two-thousand electrum is a lot, but at least they have the supply for your initial demand to hand.
rows.translation: 安娜的尾巴开始疯狂地摇动，那只姜黄色的小狗几乎要把你拉进它的怀抱里。“哦！太好了，我们非常愿意！真的非常愿意！” 当它放开你时，你踉跄着后退，那小狗身上散发出的气味，以及一连串的忙碌工作，已经开始让你的大脑变得昏昏沉沉了。真没想到。” “是吗？我觉得这应该很明显才对吧？我们都是农民，而你们正在给我们提供机会，让我们能够种植更多的作物！虽然初期投入肯定会很高，但之后我们就能拥有相应的基础设施，从而能够以较低的成本每月为你们提供所需的物资。基础设施？” “嗯，当初在那个地区，情况一开始变得……呃，不太顺利，很多人都放弃了他们的农田。我们自己的果园面积也只剩下原来的三分之二了，说实话，我们真的需要一个理由来让农场恢复到它原本应该有的状态，发挥出它应有的潜力。什么？可以那么这些食材都是由你提供的吗？” “肉类、蔬菜、水果、牛奶、啤酒，还有偶尔的一些零食。哦！如果你想要鱼的话，那些母马们很擅长捕鱼。我们本来也打算去捕的，但她们在这方面确实更在行，而且负责捕鱼的人也更多。相反，他们是来找我们购买这些东西的，这就是一种交易。” “那么，购买一些物资需要花费多少钱呢？” 那只姜黄色的小狗的眼睛亮得几乎像是在闪烁，它握住你的手，然后把你的手按在自己的胸口。两千块就能买到我们的英雄了！” “两千块？” 安娜微笑着点了点头，然后握了握你的手：“没错！其实我们应该收多一点钱才对，但我们现在还有一些库存，如果不卖掉的话就会浪费掉。你好像有整个要塞我敢打赌，那个地方肯定会一直堆满各种可爱的小东西。所以我们现在就把多余的那些都卖给你们，用这些钱来确保在未来的几年里，我们能够持续为你们提供这些东西，而不会遇到任何麻烦。” 这样的决定，似乎是突然间就做出的。那只红头的小狗咧嘴笑了，然后松开了你，一边捻着手指，一边在心里算着什么，接着继续说道：“相信我吧！莫文觉得我们那些多余的物品只是占用了储存空间，而且她真的很怀念拥有一个像样的果园——她的妈妈也是这么想的。非常喜欢那些树……所以别担心，我会稍后再和她确认一下，以确保万无一失，不过我觉得你不必太担心这个。钱的事情我来处理就好。 [pc.dcb |你真是太好了，真让人意外。 |啊，谢谢你，你真是太好了。 |天啊，你真是太甜了！ ] 安娜的尾巴摇得特别厉害，几乎都要打到你了，而她显然也在强忍着吠叫的冲动。“好吧，我得冷静下来。对不起，我们其实已经等了很久，就等着有机会再次扩张了，我相信这件事也会鼓励其他农民回到他们的田地里去。我们真的很怀念有邻居的日子！就在几英里外，有那么一对夫妇，他们养了那些非常珍贵的看门狗，而他们的妻子还会经常送来最美味的派来。 呵呵。 两千枚琥珀金币确实是一笔不小的数目，但至少他们有足够的库存来满足你最初的需求。

rows.original:
You take a deep breath and look the tail-wagging half-wolf dead in the eyes, pulling out a bulging pack of coin. Anna's mouth becomes a perfect 'O.' "That's still so much money!"
        
        Your own smile is a little smug, it can't be denied; she gets stock-still when you plant the sack in her hands. "Wow... thank you, [pc.name]. Seriously, this means so much!"
        
        Anna [pc.heightSNV
            |sinks down and gives you a dainty little smooch on the cheek
            |leans in and kisses you softly on the cheek
            |tiptoes and kisses you on the cheek
        ], still a mixture of delighted and shocked. "Just say the moment you're ready! Send a runner, stop by yourself, we'll carriage it all up and deliver it as soon as we can!"
        
        Anna pauses and snaps her fingers, tail still wagging even when the rest of her body goes still. "Oh, by the way! I've heard the mares are having an absolute bumper crop for fish stuff, perhaps they'd be willing to trade?[atani.married| Especially since I heard, uh, you got married." The perky pupper fidgets and twiddles her fingers... but you dare not tease about any jealousy.|"]
        
        You thank Anna again with a skritch behind the ears that has her leaning in and smiling. "Until next time." 
        
        "See you soon, hero."

        你脸上露出了一丝得意的笑容，这是无可否认的；当你把那袋钱放在她手里时，她整个人都愣住了：“哇……谢谢你！ [pc.name]说真的，这对我来说意义太大了！”
        
        安娜[pc.heightSNV

        ]她依然既高兴又震惊。“只要你准备好就告诉我吧！派个人过来，你自己过去一趟，我们会尽快把所有东西都运过去并送到的！”

        你又用一种让安娜耳朵发麻的轻声感谢了她，这让她忍不住倾身过来，微笑着对你说：“下次见。”
        
        “很快就会再见的，英雄。

rows.original: You don't have that much! 2,000 EC.
rows.translation: 你的钱可不够啊！2,000枚琥珀金币。

rows.original:
[atani.married
        |Your
        |The
    ] gold-and-sunshine mare smiles and swishes her tail around — which only serves to wash you with the scent of her waiting sex — while she considers. "We produce plenty of fish, sure. A lot of it gets preserved for travel, but honestly we're quite comfortable where we are right now."
    
    Her smile turns shy and she twiddles her fingers together, tail still swishing. "Plus I get to be closer to [atani.married
        |my [pc.mf
            |husband
            |wife
        ]
        |you
    ]."
    
    [atani.married
        |She opens up her arms after that, in silent request to you.
        
        When you sink into her arms she lets out a deeply satisfied sigh, hugging you closely and suffusing you with warmth. "Anything you need, and we have it for you. Although if you're willing to pay a little initially for the fishy, my people will be happy to have some extra money at the end of the month."
        
        It's actually a little odd to imagine the marefolk being industrious and salary-ing their fishermen, but a girl's got to live, you suppose.
        
        Atani sneaks a few kisses before you part again, brushing back her hair. "How abooout... I'm not sure. I'd say five-hundred, but for you my love? Consider it a gift; Hundred-twenty-five?"
        |After clearing her throat, the sun-dappled mare-chieftain takes a few moments to consider the requirements, before resting hands on her tummy. "Five-hundred electrum. That should be enough for us."
    ]

rows.original: When you've got the cash and time, you'll be back for her.
rows.translation: 当你有了足够的金钱和时间，你就会回到她身边。

rows.original: Daliza gives you a [daliza.trustRange 3 |faint smile |stoic salute ] when you recount your progress, pulling out her journal of tabulations in order to double check. "That certainly sounds like everything... I've checked and double-checked, but there's little I can do to make myself completely sure." A [wayfort.hasMaids |couple of maids |visiting hornet ] saunters up with a little basket of goodies, handing out what appear to be thin crackers glazed with honey. "Ooo, I know what you need to make it perfect, [flags.HIVE_PURIFIED |lady Daliza |pretty elfy ]." At that, the bailiff quirks a brow looking to you for confirmation. You wave the hornet on with a [pc.dcb |smirk |smile |bubbly grin ], and the curvaceous caramel cutie continues. "That statue looks like butts, and I have a sister who knows how to make stuff with stone [flags.HIVE_PURIFIED |that's just beautiful |and she's super-duper great ]!" Daliza lets out a soft 'hunh', flipping pages back and forth. "I believe you're right, miss..." "Myzzy!" "Of course, miss Myzzy. Yes, honestly the old collapsed statue would steal away from the majesty of the place... especially now that I realize it's the second thing anyone traveling through from the north will see, besides the Wayfort itself." The redheaded elf purses her lips, turning her attention to you. "Well, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]? What would you want such a statue to be?" That is a good question...
rows.translation: 你讲述进展时，达莉莎向你露出[daliza.trustRange 3 |淡淡的笑容 |沉稳的敬礼 ]，取出记录统计结果的日志加以复核。“这些听起来确实就是全部……我已经检查并复查，却还是没什么办法令自己完全确定。” 一[wayfort.hasMaids |对女仆 |名来访的大黄蜂 ]提着一小篮好东西走来，将看似抹有蜂蜜的薄脆饼分发给众人。“哦——，我知道还需要什么才能让这里完美，[flags.HIVE_PURIFIED |达莉莎女士 |漂亮的精灵姑娘 ]。” 执法官挑起眉毛，看向你寻求确认。你带着[pc.dcb |坏笑 |微笑 |灿烂的笑容 ]挥手示意大黄蜂继续说，身材丰腴的焦糖色美人便说道。“那座雕像丑得像屁股，我有个姐姐知道怎么用石头做东西，[flags.HIVE_PURIFIED |成品美极了 |而且她超级无敌厉害 ]！” 达莉莎轻轻“嗯”了一声，前后翻动书页。“我相信你是对的，小姐……” “米兹！” “当然，米兹小姐。没错，老旧坍塌的雕像确实会有损这里的庄严……尤其是我现在才意识到，从北方途经此地的人首先看见驿堡本身，第二眼就会看见它。”红发精灵抿起嘴唇，将注意力转向你。“那么，我的[pc.mf |领主 |女主人 ]？你想要一座什么样的雕像？” 这的确是个好问题……

rows.original: The azure demon's eyes brighten up, and with a sultry purr she throws her head back and runs fingers through her hair. "Wonderful! I'm looking so forward to a little of the good life... and we didn't even have to do any embezzling!" She trails off and stares at you for a moment. "I assume?" [pc.dcb |"Not a chance, earned it all the hard way." |"Nope." |"What's embezzling?" ] "Good!" She continues, clapping her hands until her little bells are jingling. "There's just one more thing and for the longest time I couldn't put my whisker on it... until this lovely lady came by!" At a sharp whistle, a smiling [wayfort.hasMaids |hornet maid |hornet — no doubt visiting from her hive — ] buzzes into view, with a basket of what appears to be crackers glazed in honey and sprinkled with winter berries in hand. "Greetings, and yes! I noticed your statue sucks, you know, the headless... wolf man? I think? I can't even tell who it was meant to be." You accept a cracker and quietly munch, inviting her to continue with a little wave. "Right, well, I have a sister who knows how to make stuff with stone [flags.HIVE_PURIFIED |that's just beautiful |and she's super-duper great ]!" Farrah speaks up now, pausing to swallow her own tasty honey-cracker. "How much would this cost, miss...?" "Oh, Myzzy! Call me Myzzy, please. And [flags.HIVE_PURIFIED |we wouldn't dream of charging you, we're allies 'til the end. |totes nothing, as long as you have the rock and stuff. We're like, super besties afterall. ]" "What should the statue actually be then, [pc.name]?" That's a good question...
rows.translation: 蔚蓝色恶魔双眼一亮，发出魅惑的呼噜声，仰起头，将手指穿过自己的长发。“太棒了！我无比期待再次享受一点美好生活……而且我们甚至不必挪用公款！”她声音渐弱，盯着你看了一刻。“应该没有吧？” [pc.dcb |“想都别想，这些全是我千辛万苦赚来的。” |“没有。” |“什么是挪用公款？” ] “很好！”她继续说道，不断拍手，令身上的小铃铛叮当作响。“只剩下最后一件事；很长时间里，我始终想不出那是什么……直到这位可爱的女士到来！” 一声尖锐口哨响起，一名面带微笑的[wayfort.hasMaids |大黄蜂女仆 |大黄蜂——无疑是从蜂巢来访—— ]嗡嗡飞进视野，手中提着一篮似乎涂满蜂蜜、洒有冬莓的脆饼。“你们好，没错！我注意到你们的雕像糟透了，就是那个无头的……狼人？大概吧？我根本分辨不出本来雕的是谁。” 你接过一块脆饼默默咀嚼，轻轻挥手，请她继续。 “好吧，是这样，我有个姐姐会用石头做东西，[flags.HIVE_PURIFIED |成品美极了 |而且她超级无敌厉害 ]！” 法拉此刻开口，先停下来咽下自己的美味蜂蜜脆饼。“这要花多少钱，小姐……？” “哦，米兹！请叫我米兹。而且[flags.HIVE_PURIFIED |我们做梦都不会收费，我们可是永远的盟友。 |完全不要钱，只要你们有石头之类的材料。毕竟我们是超级好朋友嘛。 ]” “那么，雕像实际上应该是什么，[pc.name]？” 这是个好问题……
rows.raw: ' The azure demon's eyes brighten up, and with a sultry purr she throws her head back and runs fingers through her hair. "Wonderful! I'm looking so forward to a little of the good life... and we didn't even have to do any embezzling!" She trails off and stares at you for a moment. "I assume?" [pc.dcb |"Not a chance, earned it all the hard way." |"Nope." |"What's embezzling?" ] "Good!" She continues, clapping her hands until her little bells are jingling. "There's just one more thing and for the longest time I couldn't put my whisker on it... until this lovely lady came by!" At a sharp whistle, a smiling [wayfort.hasMaids |hornet maid |hornet — no doubt visiting from her hive — ] buzzes into view, with a basket of what appears to be crackers glazed in honey and sprinkled with winter berries in hand. "Greetings, and yes! I noticed your statue sucks, you know, the headless... wolf man? I think? I can't even tell who it was meant to be." You accept a cracker and quietly munch, inviting her to continue with a little wave. "Right, well, I have a sister who knows how to make stuff with stone [flags.HIVE_PURIFIED |that's just beautiful |and she's super-duper great ]!" Farrah speaks up now, pausing to swallow her own tasty honey-cracker. "How much would this cost, miss...?" "Oh, Myzzy! Call me Myzzy, please. And [flags.HIVE_PURIFIED |we wouldn't dream of charging you, we're allies 'til the end. |totes nothing, as long as you have the rock and stuff. We're like, super besties afterall. ]" "What should the statue actually be then, [pc.name]?" That's a good question... '

rows.original: Jael'yn bounces on the spot, hugging her chest before planting a hand on Rumie's head and giving her pointed ears a little rub. "Excellent, I have waited far too long without the good life once more. I shall shake down a group of [wayfort.hasMaids |my lovely little pet maids |those delicious hornets ] and send them off to everyone. There is just one last thing..." Before the sinking sensation in your wallet has time to develop, the curvaceous and muscular demon-barmaid puts up her hands disarmingly. "Oh, it's a free service, [pc.mf |master |mistress ], don't fret." "Go on..." Jael lets out a sharp whistle, and a hornet shoots up to her feet, buzzing over with a pause to hand you a delicious-smelling honey-glazed cracker. "Hi! I'm Myzzy, and one of my sisters has been learning to do [flags.HIVE_PURIFIED |sculpting! |stone stuff! ]" "[flags.HIVE_PURIFIED |sculpting? |stone stuff? ] "Mhm!" The hornet watches as you take a bite from the cracker, handing one over to Jael'yn too when the demon holds out a hand. "I noticed that your statue is a headless old wolf man, and when I asked who it was nobody knew." Fair, you don't have any idea yourself. "Go on..." "We were wondering if you'd like a nice statue, so when people travel through, they can see something that doesn't look like an old headless guy. Especially if the rest of the Wayfort's going to be really pretty." Jael'yn continues the hornet's thought, pausing only to finish swallowing her cracker. "The only question would be what to have the statue be, and as much as I'd like to surprise you, I think it would be better that you choose."
rows.translation: 杰琳站在原地蹦跳，双臂抱住胸口，随后一手按在露米头顶，轻轻揉弄她的尖耳朵。“太好了，我已经太久没能再次享受美好生活。我会逼一群[wayfort.hasMaids |我可爱的小宠物女仆 |那些美味的大黄蜂 ]去把消息送给每个人。只剩下一件事……” 还不等钱包下沉的感觉成形，身材丰腴而强壮的恶魔酒保便摆出安抚的姿态，举起双手。“哦，这是免费服务，[pc.mf |主人 |女主人 ]，别担心。” “继续……” 杰琳吹响尖锐的口哨，一名大黄蜂猛然站起身来，嗡嗡飞到这里，途中停下递给你一块香气诱人的蜂蜜脆饼。“嗨！我是米兹，我的一位姐姐一直在学习[flags.HIVE_PURIFIED |雕塑！ |石头相关的活儿！ ]” “[flags.HIVE_PURIFIED |雕塑？ |石头相关的活儿？ ]” “嗯哼！”大黄蜂看着你咬下一口脆饼；恶魔伸出手时，她也递给杰琳一块。“我注意到你们的雕像是个无头的老狼人；我问过他是谁，可没人知道。” 很合理，连你自己也不知道。“继续……” “我们在想，你们想不想要一座漂亮的雕像；这样人们经过时，就能看见某个不像无头老头的东西。尤其是驿堡其他地方要变得非常漂亮。” 杰琳接过大黄蜂的话，只停下来咽完脆饼。“唯一的问题是该把雕像做成什么模样。我很想给你一个惊喜，不过还是让你选择更好。”

rows.original:
"A dragon," you blurt out. "I'd like a great big regal dragon. The only thing you have to be careful of is the medallion on the current statue; if it's damaged, the magic will be ruined."

        [wayfort.hasDaliza
            |Daliza looks ecstatic, pressing her hands together and smiling quite genuinely. "I think it's a wonderful choice, something regal and powerful." 
            
            "Just a little biased, aren't you, Daliza?" 
            
            The bailiff's ears burn purple and she clears her throat, looking for some way to occupy her hands before settling for threading her fingers. Although you'd expected your bailiff to be pleased, there is some legitimate wonderment to her expression when she turns to face the hornet. "I have some old designs in one of my journals, if your sister would appreciate the reference material?"
            
            "Probably!" Myzzy confirms, adjusting her skirt. "I can't wait! I bet she'll make it incredible..."
            |[wayfort.hasFarrah
                |"Mmmm, not a bad choice, I can certainly see the appeal. Traders ride on through, and see something sinuous and towering." 
                
                Myzzy looks similarly enthused by the idea, smiling and nodding. "I'll let her know right away, I bet it'll be great!"
                |Jael'yn quirks a brow, smiling after a few moments. "Not what I was expecting, but that's a pretty neat choice. I'm sure we can rustle up some art of the long-gone beasts, and have something to impress passing traders."
                
                Myzzy smiles and claps her hands together, hornet-abdomen twitching in time with the buzz of her wings. "Wonderful, I'll let her know right away to get started!"
            ]
        ]
rows.translation:
一条龙，”你脱口而出，“我想要一条威武庄严的巨龙。唯一需要注意的是现在那座雕像上的徽章，如果它受到了损坏，魔法就会失效。

        [wayfort.hasDaliza
            |达莉莎看起来欣喜若狂，双手合十，脸上洋溢着真诚的微笑。“我觉得这是个非常棒的选择，既高贵又充满力量。”
            
            “你有点偏心了吧，达莉莎？ 
            
            法警的耳朵都快被烫成紫色的了，她清了清嗓子，试图找些事情来做，最后只好把手指交叉在一起。虽然你本以为法警会很高兴，但当她转过身面对那只大黄蜂时，她脸上的表情确实让人感到有些意外。我的某个笔记本里有一些旧设计图，如果你妹妹需要这些参考资料的话，应该会很高兴的。”
            
            “应该会吧！”迈兹确认道，一边调整着自己的裙子。“我等不及了！我敢打赌，她一定能做出非常棒的东西来……"
            |[wayfort.hasFarrah
                |嗯，这个选择还不错，我确实能看出它的吸引力。商人们会继续前行，然后看到那些蜿蜒曲折、高耸入云的景象。”
                
                Myzzy也似乎对这个想法很感兴趣，她微笑着点了点头：“我马上就会告诉她，我敢打赌，一定会很棒的！
                |杰尔林挑了挑眉，过了一会儿才露出笑容：“虽然不是我预想的，但这个选择确实挺不错的。我相信我们一定能找到一些关于那些早已消失的野兽的图案，用来给路过的商人留下深刻印象。”
                
                米兹微笑着拍手，她那像黄蜂一样的腹部随着翅膀的振动而轻轻颤动：“太好了，我马上让她开始准备吧！
            ]
        ]

rows.original: "An elf," you proudly announce. "A really big, pretty elf, greeting people as they ride, drive, or walk through." [wayfort.hasDaliza |Daliza looks pleased, threading her fingers together and nodding. "You might not be surprised, but I am obviously biased, and a big fan." Her eyes are bright as she turns to face the hornet. "It would paint a great image of us, I suspect. Goodness knows recent events in the Winter City we could use a more welcoming face." Myzzy looks similarly happy with the choice, clapping her chitinous hands together and smiling. "Oh! Can we borrow one of your soldiers for modelling then, miss Daliza?" "Um... sure. I just ask that the statue has clothing on it, then." |[wayfort.hasFarrah |"Huh, a surprisingly tame choice. Alright, makes sense though considering it's us and the route to Winter City. A big ol' friendly elf lady should look good for us." Myzzy looks similarly happy with the choice, clapping her chitinous hands together and smiling. "Excellent! We can totally borrow an elf for a reference I'm sure. We'll get started right away!" |Jael'yn grins wickedly, cupping her tits together. "I know just the model..." "You're—" "Oh, gods no, not me; Ryn. Just... you know, sex it up a little extra. I'm sure she'll love it." There's a wicked look in her eyes that puts a shiver down the spines of yourself, Myzzy, and poor Rumie who continues to observe. "That can be arranged, definitely..." Myzzy mumbles. "Okay! I'll go get my sister for that straight away." ] ]

I would love to have a sexy, terrifying demon for a statue." "It is your decision, though I do not think it's a particularly good one." "Aileh would like it," is the only answer you have to hand. We all saw her when she strode through the hive, and you just don't forget a woman like that. We can probably make one that's very similar!" "Easy, no? Did I do good, [pc.name]?" rows.original:
"Is it possible to restore the current statue?" you murmur thoughtfully. "As damaged as it is, could it be mended?"
        
        [wayfort.hasDaliza
            |Myzzy frowns, unsure of what to say. Daliza sighs, thinking for a moment before answering for her. "Probably not, but the statue can be carved anew. The plans for the original statue are likely in the city's archives. I'll send a messenger to request them. If we also hire one of Hawkethorne's workers to model, we should be able to reconstruct the design." She brusquely crosses her arms. "My girls aren't fond of that statue, but the Hawkethorne crew you hired seemed to like it. It should make a good impression on traders."
            
            Myzzy perks up, a sultry grin growing as she considers your bailiff's words.
            |[wayfort.hasFarrah
                |Farrah chuckles."Buttering up our southern neighbors, are we? A sensible choice, if a tad boring." The azure demoness flicks her gaze at Myzzy, who seems unsure of how to respond. An awkward moment later, Farrah answers for the hornet. The statue is too far gone. However, we've already been offered a free new statue. All they need is a model, and I just so happen to have some old-fashioned tribal gear in stock. It'll be easy to tempt a passing trader to dress up and pose. 
                
                Myzzy perks up, her mood lifting as she puzzles out the kitty-demon's words.
                |This clearly catches both Myzzy and Jael'yn off guard. A few moments pass in tense silence, before Myzzy cautiously answers. "I... I don't think so? I've never seen my sister fix stones, just carve them..." 
                
                Jael'yn tugs her collar nervously. "That statue is trash, [pc.mf
                    |master
                    |mistress
                ]. If you want something like that, they'd need to start from scratch. Hire a lupine, maybe someone from the crew that was here a while back, and dress them up. Would that work?" 
                
                "That'll work. Good girl."
                
                Jael shudders at your words, the barest hint of a moan answering your praise. 
                
                Myzzy perks up, a sultry grin growing as she considers Jael'yn's proposal. 
            ]
        ] "We'll get to have one of those hunks pose for us? I- my sister would love that!"
rows.translation:
是否有可能修复这座现在的雕像呢？”你若有所思地低声问道，“尽管它已经损坏得如此严重，但还是有可能修复吗？
        
        [wayfort.hasDaliza
            |米兹皱起了眉头，不知道该说些什么。达莉莎叹了口气，思考了一会儿后替她回答道：“大概不行，但那座雕像可以重新雕刻。关于原雕像的设计图应该存放在城市的档案馆里。我会派人去取那些资料。如果我们也能聘请鹰棘镇的手下中的一位来参与建模工作，我们应该就能重新还原那个设计。”她粗鲁地交叉双臂说道，“我的女儿们并不喜欢那座雕像，但你们聘请的鹰棘镇团队似乎挺喜欢它的。这肯定会给商人们留下良好的印象。”
            
            米兹ィ听后精神为之一振，当她仔细思考你那位执达官的话时，脸上浮现出一丝妩媚的笑容。
            |[wayfort.hasFarrah
                |法拉轻笑起来：“在讨好我们的南方邻居啊？这个选择挺明智的，不过有点无聊吧。”这位蔚蓝色的女恶魔瞥了瞥米兹，后者似乎不知道该如何回应。过了片刻的尴尬沉默，法拉替米兹说了话。那座雕像已经损坏得太严重了。不过，我们已经得到了一座全新的免费雕像。他们所需要的只是一个模特，而我正好手头有一些老式的部落服饰。用这些服饰来吸引路过的商人让他们穿上并摆好姿势，应该很容易吧。 
                
                当Myzzy弄明白那只猫妖的话时，她的情绪立刻好转了，变得欢快起来。
                |这显然让米兹和杰琳都措手不及。几秒钟的紧张沉默之后，米兹小心翼翼地回答道：“我……我不这么认为。我从来没见过我姐姐修理石头，她只是会把石头雕刻出来而已……”
                
                杰琳紧张地拉了拉她的衣领：“那座雕像简直是一团糟。 [pc.mf
                    |掌握
                    |女主人；情妇
                ]如果你想要那样的东西，他们就得从头开始。雇一个人吧，比如之前在这里工作过的某个人，然后给他们配备合适的服装。这样行得通吗？”
                
                “这个办法可行。好姑娘。”
                
                听到你的话，杰尔不禁颤抖起来，轻微的呻吟声表达了她的感激之情。
                
                米兹则显得兴致勃勃，当她考虑杰琳的这个建议时，脸上浮现出一丝妩媚的笑容。 
            ]
        ]我们能请那位肌肉男为我们摆个姿势吗？我……我妹妹一定会非常喜欢的！

rows.original: There's a flurry of motion as hornets are called on and handed off sheets of paper with instructions and calculations, before dressing up warmly for travel and zipping off in all directions. [wayfort.hasDaliza |"We're going to be very busy for a few weeks, but I look forward to it." Daliza turns her attention to you, [daliza.trustRange 3 |giving you a tired smile |giving you a stoic salute ]. "What are your plans, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]?" "I could stay and help, or get out from under your feet." [daliza.trustRange 3 |Daliza's expression softens, and the bailiff folds her arms to think. "I believe your assistance would be welcome, though I know not what craftsmanship skills you have compared to the hive-building hornets who have promised aid." The redheaded elf goes quiet after that, soaking in the peace of a few minutes before the storm. "I have something of a confession." "[pc.dcb |Out with it, then." |Tell me what's on your mind." |Aww, something up?" ] Dal nods and lets her arms down once more— you suspect by now, that if her hair weren't so neatly tied up she would be constantly fiddling with it. "When first we met, I assumed the ladies Elthara and Etheryn to have lost their minds. After a truly challenging time abroad, we returned to find that our city had fallen to corruption from the inside, as opposed to the out. A foreigner had seen us at our most despicable, and the cost for my absence was to be leal bondage with you." "Your opinion has changed then?" She snorts and nods, saluting you. "Aye, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]. I and my soldiers trust you to do the right thing, and we will always stand beside you." [pc.dcb |You grunt and shuffle from foot-to-foot, surprised by her earnest salute. "Uh, thanks." If the bailiff is bothered by your curt response, it doesn't show. |"I appreciate that, truly." |"Awww, Dal, you're such a sweetie really!" At least at that, the bailiff scowls, but there's a little deeper color to her lengthy ears that might hint at a blush. ] |Daliza stares long and hard at you before exhaling, gesturing to the Wayfort at large. "I would rather you stayed out from underfoot, but I can hardly stop you from being involved. This is your land, as I feel constantly reminded. There is much we're bound to disagree on in the future, like as not. We will always endeavour to make the best of such situations." "Are we not getting along, then?" She licks her painted lips and considers you for a moment longer, but soon gives up and looks away. "I am unconvinced, still. Time will tell." ] |[wayfort.hasFarrah |"Going to hang around and help? Or get out from underfoot and go tend to whatever?" |Jael'yn smirks and licks her lips, looking to be every part of the predator in wait before becoming a bubbly puddle once more at your attention. "Will you be staying to work, or heading off while the grunt-stuff gets done?" ] ]
rows.translation: 一阵忙碌的活动随之展开：人们纷纷叫来黄蜂，将写有说明和计算数据的纸张交给它们，然后自己穿上保暖的衣服，朝各个方向飞去了。 [wayfort.hasDaliza |在接下来的几周里，我们会非常忙碌，但我对此感到很期待。”达莉莎将注意力转向了你。 [daliza.trustRange 3 |露出一个疲惫的微笑 |向你致以庄严的敬礼 ]你有什么打算，我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]我可以留下来帮忙，也可以离开，不再打扰你。 [daliza.trustRange 3 |达莉莎的表情变得柔和起来，执达官双臂交叉，陷入沉思。“我相信你的帮助会很有用，不过我不太清楚，与那些承诺会提供援助的筑巢黄蜂相比，你究竟拥有哪些技艺。” 红发精灵在说完这些后陷入了沉默，静静地享受着暴风雨来临前的这几分钟宁静。“我有些事情想要坦白。[pc.dcb |那就直说吧。 |告诉我你在想什么。 |哎呀，怎么了？ ] 达尔点了点头，再次放下了她的手臂——此刻你大概已经猜到了：如果她的头发没有被整理得那么整齐，她肯定会不停地摆弄它。“我们初次见面时，我以为艾尔萨拉和伊瑟琳两位女士一定是疯了。在国外度过了真正充满挑战的时光后，我们回到家乡，却发现我们的城市已经从内部开始腐朽堕落。有一个外国人亲眼目睹了我们最卑鄙的一面，而我离开的代价，就是与你结下永恒的羁绊。那么，你的想法改变了吗？” 她哼了一声，然后点了点头，向你表示认同。“是啊，我的想法确实改变了。 [pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]我和我的士兵们信任你会做出正确的决定，我们也会永远站在你的一边。 [pc.dcb |你哼了一声，拖着脚步走来走去，对她这种认真的致意感到有些意外。“呃，谢谢。” 不过，如果执行官对你的简短回应感到不满，他也没有表现出来。 |我真的很感激这一点。 |哇，达尔，你真的太贴心了！” 至少在某些时候是这样。那个法警皱起了眉头，但她那长长的耳朵上浮现出了一丝淡淡的红色，或许是在暗示她脸红了。 ] |达莉莎久久地凝视着你，然后缓缓呼了口气，同时指向那片广袤的荒废驿堡地区。“我其实希望你能够远离这里，但我也很难阻止你参与其中。毕竟，这是你的土地——这一点我总是忍不住想起。未来，我们肯定会在很多事情上产生分歧。不过，我们总会努力尽力应对这样的局面。 “那么，我们之间的关系是不是不太融洽呢？” 她舔了舔涂了口红的嘴唇，又多看了你一会儿，但很快便放弃了，把目光移开了。我还是不太相信，不过时间会证明一切的。 ] |[wayfort.hasFarrah |是打算留下来帮忙呢？还是先走开去处理自己的事情？ |杰琳露出一丝狡黠的笑容，舔了舔嘴唇，完全展现出那种潜伏在暗处的捕食者的姿态，但转眼间，她又恢复了那副活泼开朗的样子，重新吸引你的注意。“你是打算留下来继续工作，还是等那些繁琐的事情处理完后再离开呢？ ] ]
