rows.raw: ' "So," you say. Vatia regards you neutrally, eyes roving over your face. "You want children?" Vatia nods. "I know that doesn't mesh very well with the idea of traveling the world, but I don't think that was my teacher's point. What he actually wanted was for me to experience life... everything it has to offer." She smiles. "And I think children are a part of that. I don't want to study magic forever, even though it's been a big part – maybe all – of my life up until now." You decide to let her in on a secret. "There is still a way to travel with children. The waystones of old are still active. I don't know how far they truly extend, but at minimum they cover a significant amount of the Marches." Vatia looks surprised. "I had thought them lost to time. How interesting. Can you use them?" "I was imbued with the power by happenstance, but yes," you say. "I don't know that my quest would be possible without them." "So we could still travel were you to give me children, then," she says, smiling. "That's good to know." "I don't mean to question your motivations, but are you sure you want children, Vatia?" you say. "Up until now you've been one of the most free-spirited people I've encountered.[pc.hasKids |" You cup her cheek. "Not that I'd ever turn you down, I just want to make sure this is what you really want." |" ] She smiles at you. "I understand. Your exposure to me has mostly been exchange of warmth, rather than thoughts. It's something I've considered for a long time, actually. My mentor, he – I got the feeling he... regretted some of his choices. He loved all of us children as his own, of course. I don't think he ever regretted that. But perhaps there was a tinge of wishing he had done it sooner... of not single-mindedly pursuing one thing to the detriment of all others." You nod. "You don't want regrets." "That, and I don't know if anything ever made him as happy as teaching the children did," Vatia says. "I'm sure had you asked him what he took more pride in, his accomplishments in the field of magic or his teaching of children, he would have easily answered the second. Maybe one day I'll be a teacher too." She smiles. "But for now, I'd be happy just being a parent. I don't even know if my children would be interested in magic." "We'd be teaching them either way," you say with a smile. She laughs. "That is true." You regard her in comfortable silence for several seconds, finally nodding. "You've thought about this." "There's a lot of time to think when you're lying around by yourself," Vatia says. "My thoughts often turned to the past and eventually, the future." She looks you in the eye. "You featured quite prominently. I'd... like to have your children, [pc.name]." You lean down and give the soft snakewoman a kiss, her tongue gently meeting yours as she embraces you. "I suppose we'd better work on that, then," you say, smiling at her. She gives you a luscious grin. [flags.VATIA_WF_TALK_CHILDREN | |Vatia's pregnancy content is now enabled. ] '

rows.original: "How are you?" you ask. "Feeling okay with the pregnancy?" [vatia.pregStage 1 2 3 |"I'm okay," Vatia says, nodding as she pets her tummy. "The kids are healthy." She smiles at you. "Though I really am eating for four, now." "Guess I'd better look into our larder stock," you muse. "As long as there's meat!" she says. "Can't do without it." "So you can tell the kids are fine, then?" you say. "Mhm," she says. "It's kind of an abstract feeling... like making something out behind a curtain. But they're okay." You gently brush her hair back, tucking some long black strands behind her ear. "What about everything else? Are you warm enough?" Vatia giggles. "I'm not going to break, [pc.name]. I'm not even showing yet. But I appreciate you checking." You smile. "As long as everything's alright." "I could do with some fun," she says, eyeing you. "Fun's always in the cards," you say. |"It's a bit harder to get around, but it's not that bad," Vatia says, rubbing her swelling tummy. "I do have to leave a space in my coils if I want to lie on my front, and beds are side-only now. So there's that for changes." "Want a massage?" you offer. "That would be nice," she says, smiling. "My shoulders, if you don't mind." She hums in contentment as you rub her down, working the tension out of her upper body. Closing her eyes, she leans back into you and eventually the massage becomes you stroking her hair as she makes sighs of happiness. "Our children are growing," she murmurs, breaking the silence. "I can't wait to meet them." You smile. "Me either. I wonder what they'll be like." "Me too," she says. "I've thought about it so much that at this point I'll be happy just to have them no matter what. Quiet, loud, excitable, calm, whatever they are... I'll be happy with them." You nod. "Seeing them healthy will be nice." "They're healthy as can be right now," Vatia assures you. "So, we've just got to wait." Waiting it is, then. |"How's everything?" you say, gesturing at her. Given how big her tummy is, it's obvious there could only be one thing you're referring to. Vatia smiles, a hand on her pregnant belly. "Good. It's been very... lazy. There's not much of an incentive to do anything when you're this pregnant." She flutters her eyelashes at you. "Except perhaps spend some time in bed." You grin. "I think an extended massage could be arranged." "Gooood," she purrs, pressing herself against you from the side. You find yourself naturally being drawn into putting an arm around her swelling waist, holding her. "I am finding myself more excitable these days..." "Thinking of more children already?" you murmur. Vatia kisses you. "After everything's calmed down a bit. Let's see how everything goes with these ones, first... I don't want to be out of my depth and then add in even more problems." "Very forward-thinking," you say, rubbing her side. "Let's go with that, then." "You say forward-thinking, but there's just as good of a chance I think our kids are such miracles we should have more immediately," she sighs. "But we'll worry about that later... you know, a few months, at least." "So from 'after everything is over' to 'a few months' in the space of two sentences," you note. "Should I continue negotiating you down, or?" Vatia laughs in your arms. "Stop! At this rate we'll have so many kids I won't know what to do!" You give her another kiss. "That doesn't sound so bad." rows.original:
"Everything going okay with the kids?" you say.
    
    "As okay as three kids can be," Vatia says, glancing down at them. "When they're not climbing the curtains, they're in my hair."
    
    "That does sound like our kids," you admit.
    
    "At least they're very cute," she says. "It's hard to be annoyed when they're so adorable... and honestly, they're very well-behaved."
    
    "That's true," you say, bending down to pick Sana off the floor. He doesn't seem to mind. "You certainly aren't what I expected out of a newborn. Are you?"
    
    The snakeboy giggles and grabs your [pc.hasMuzzle
        |muzzle, tickling your snout
        |nose
    ]. This is positive feedback, you think.
    
    "I feel blessed that our children are so unique and interesting," Vatia says with a smile. "I don't think it's going to take them long to start doing amazing things."
    
    "Well, we have to raise them first," you remind her. "Then they can do amazing things. Though, really, they're already pretty amazing."
    
    Ina and Vera are pawing at your legs, no doubt in the hopes of getting up. You bend down and they cling onto your arms, climbing into them to join Sana before you straighten up again.
    
    "Alright," you say as they snuggle into you. "Now we've got everyone onboard."
    
    "I hope you didn't have plans," Vatia says. "They're going to go right to sleep in your arms."
    
    Sure enough – they're already closing their eyes, snuggled up against each other. You carefully take a seat next to Vatia, arms supporting the children, and look down at them. Vatia gives you a kiss on the cheek.
    
    "What a wonderful sight," she says, giggling. "Now you're trapped."
    
    "Could be worse than being trapped with our kids," you say. "Do you want to nap?"
    
    "Hmmm, I might as well, I suppose," she says, coiling herself up next to you. "Wake me if you or the children need anything, okay?"
    
    "Sure. Good night, Vatia," you say.
    
    "G'night," she murmurs.
    
    The firepit crackles as you sit there with your kids and lover, the former silently sleeping in your protective arms and the latter resting against your side. You're not sure how long you're sitting there before they begin to stir to wakefulness once more, but it seems like you could tolerate spending more time like this. Maybe a lot more time.
rows.translation:
孩子们都还好吧？”你问道。
    
    “三个孩子能有多好呢？”瓦蒂娅一边说，一边低头看着他们，“他们要么在爬窗帘，要么就在我的头发里。”
    
    “听起来确实像我们的孩子啊，”你承认道。
    
    至少它们非常可爱，”她说，“当它们这么惹人喜欢的时候，真的很难生气……而且说实话，它们的行为举止也非常乖巧。”
    
    “确实如此，”你说道，然后弯下腰把萨娜从地上抱起来。它似乎并不介意这样。你绝对不是我想象中新生儿该有的样子，对吧？”
    
    蛇人男孩咯咯笑着抓住你的[pc.hasMuzzle
        |口鼻，还挠了挠你的鼻尖
        |鼻子
    ]。你觉得这算是积极反馈。”
    
    “我们的孩子如此独特、如此有趣，我觉得自己真的很幸运，”瓦蒂娅微笑着说道，“我想他们很快就能开始做出一些了不起的事情来。”
    
    “嗯，首先我们得把他们养大才行，”你提醒她，“然后他们才能去做那些了不起的事情。不过说实话，他们现在就已经相当了不起了。
    
    伊娜和薇拉正在用爪子抓你的腿，显然它们是想站起来。你弯下腰，它们便抓住你的手臂，爬到你身上，和萨娜一起待在你怀里，然后你才直起身来。
    
    “好了，”你说着，它们依偎在你身边，“现在大家都到齐了。
    
    希望你没有别的安排，”瓦蒂娅说，“它们会直接在你怀里睡着呢。”
    
    果然，它们已经闭上了眼睛，依偎在了一起。你小心翼翼地坐在瓦蒂娅旁边，用双臂托着孩子们，低头看着他们。瓦蒂娅在你脸上亲了一下。
    
    真是太棒了，”她笑着说，“现在你们被困住了。”
    
    “其实，比起和我们的孩子一起被困，情况还可能更糟呢，”你说，“你想小睡一会儿吗？”
    
    “嗯，我想还是睡一会儿吧，”她说着，依偎在你身边，“如果你或孩子们需要什么，记得叫醒我，好吗？
    
    好的，晚安，瓦蒂娅。”你说。
    
    “晚安。”她轻声回应。
    
    你们围坐在火堆旁，孩子们和你的爱人都在你身边：其中一个安静地沉睡在你的怀中，另一个则靠在你的身旁。你不知道自己坐了多久，直到他们开始慢慢苏醒过来。不过，你觉得这样的时光再长一些也没关系……也许，甚至需要更长的时间。

    You smile a little guiltily. "Sorry, Vatia."
    
    She's silent for a long time. Then her voice rises in a husky whisper. "It's okay."
    
    You lean over to check if she's awake, but she's pretty clearly still deep in the throes of sleep. Well, the last thing you want to do is disturb your pregnant lover's rest. You rise to leave only to find a hand around your wrist, glancing down.
    
    Vatia's head is turned just enough to have one bright blue eye cracked slightly open, watching you from the pillow. She says nothing, but as you sit down it closes once more and the grip on your hand loosens.
    
    Looks like you'll be here until she falls deep asleep again. It could be a lot worse, you suppose. You rest with her for a while, stroking her hair and comforting her until her breaths are long and slow before gently extricating yourself and leaving her to rest. All coiled up in your blankets, she's quite the cute sight.
    
    It takes some time for her to emerge, yawning and gently rubbing her eyes before looking around.
    
    "Hey, sleepyhead," you say. "Did you get some good rest?"
    
    Vatia slithers over to you and wraps her arms around your back, planting her head on your shoulder. "Mmhm. Nice dreams. Mostly about you and the kids, I think."
    
    You smile. "That's good. Want something to eat?"
    
    "I could go for an entire pig," she sighs.
    
    "I'll get working on it," you promise. "You make yourself comfortable by the fire."
    
    A pregnant snakewoman is hard to appease, you suppose. The food is good, though – evidenced by the shared relish with which she chows down on your offerings. At least she has simple desires.
rows.translation:
你走近时，瓦蒂娅并不在火坑旁。显然她不会走远——可她在哪里？
    
    你先检查她的房间，想知道她过得如何。她不在这里；不过说实话，你几乎从未见她待在房里。也许十分合适的是，她几乎所有时间都在火坑旁度过。
    
    接下来，你寻找自己的房间——瞧啊——她就在你的床上。她裹着你所有毯子，连备用毯也没放过；你走近时，看见她依偎着枕头，脸深深埋入其中一个，完全看不见。
    
    你走到床边，悄悄坐在她身旁，将一根手指穿过她光亮的乌黑长发。她呼吸缓慢，俨然一幅宁静安详的画面。你的手肘不小心碰到一个枕头
    
    “嗯嗯不——要。”瓦蒂娅在睡梦中哭诉，把它抱得更紧。“[pc.name]……”
    
    你有些内疚地微笑。“抱歉，瓦蒂娅。”
    
    她沉默了很长时间。随后，低沉沙哑的耳语响起。“没关系。”
    
    你俯身检查她是否清醒，可她显然依旧深深沉浸在睡眠中。好吧，你最不想做的便是打扰怀孕爱人的休息。你起身准备离开，却发现一只手握住手腕，于是低头看去。
    
    瓦蒂娅头颅稍稍转动，一只明亮的蓝眼微微睁开，从枕头上注视你。她一言不发；可你重新坐下时，眼睛便再次闭合，握住你手腕的力道也放松下来。
    
    看来，你得留在这里，直到她再次沉沉睡去。我想，情况本可以糟糕得多。你陪她休息片刻，抚摸长发，不断安慰；等她的呼吸变得悠长缓慢，才轻轻挣脱出来，留下她休息。她盘起身体裹在你的毯子里，着实可爱。
    
    过了一阵，她才终于出现，一边打呵欠，一边轻轻揉眼睛，随后环顾四周。
    
    “嘿，小懒虫。”你说道。“休息得好吗？”
    
    瓦蒂娅蜿蜒到你身旁，双臂环绕你的后背，将头靠在肩膀上。“嗯哼。做了些美梦。我想，主要是梦见你和孩子。”
    
    你微笑起来。“那就好。想吃点什么吗？”
    
    “我可以吃下一整头猪。”她叹息道。
    
    “我这就准备。”你保证道。“去火边坐舒服些。”
    
    你想，怀孕的蛇女很难满足。不过食物很不错——她充满享受地大吃你端来的东西，便是证明。至少她的欲望十分简单。

rows.original:
[wayfort.hasDaliza
        |One of the elven guards snaps to attention the moment you enter the Wayfort. "Commander! The snakewoman sent for you. She says you should see her immediately."
        
        Vatia! Thanking the guard, you hurry inside and
        |You note upon entering that you can't see Vatia. She's not by the firepit – where is she? You hurry inside and
    ] find her in your room, one hand on her tummy and panting.
    
    "Vatia!" you exclaim, drawing closer.
    
    She waves her hand. "I'm okay," she huffs. "I- I'm fine, just... hold my hand..."
    
    Though labor is long and arduous, leaving Vatia exhausted, everything goes well. She delivers three adorable little children – a boy and two girls – you immediately wash swaddle in towels and blankets, leaving them looking a lot like their mother. [wayfort.hasDaliza
        |With the help of a few of the guards
        |Working hard by yourself
    ], you carefully wash everything and everyone so you can deposit your lover and your kids into a fresh, warm bed, leaving Vatia to sleep a bit after everything she's been through. The children themselves are blessedly quiet, looking up at you with their big, inquisitive eyes until they drift off to join their mother.
    
    You opt to join them, just for a quick nap. With Vatia on one side and you on the other, the kids are as safe as can be.
rows.translation:
[wayfort.hasDaliza
        |你一走进荒废驿堡，其中一名精灵卫兵立刻立正站好。“指挥官！那个蛇女派人来找您了，她说您必须马上见她。”
        
        瓦蒂娅！你向卫兵道了谢，然后迅速走了进去。
        |你一进去就发现看不到瓦蒂娅。她不在火堆旁边——那她去哪里了？你急忙走进屋内，寻找她的踪迹。
    ]你在她的房间里找到了她，她一手放在肚子上，气喘吁吁的。
    
    “瓦蒂娅！”你惊呼着，快步走过去。
    
    她挥了挥手：“我没事，”她喘着气说，“我只是……请握住我的手……”
    
    虽然分娩的过程漫长而艰辛，让瓦蒂娅筋疲力尽，但一切还是顺利地结束了。她生下了三个可爱的孩子——一个男孩和两个女孩。你立刻用毛巾和毯子把他们包起来，他们看起来和他们的母亲非常相像。 [wayfort.hasDaliza
        |在几名守卫的帮助下
        |独自努力奋斗
    ]你仔细地清洗好一切，然后把你的爱人和孩子们放到干净温暖的床上，让经历了这一切的瓦蒂娅也能好好地睡一会儿。孩子们也非常安静，他们用那双充满好奇的大眼睛望着你，直到最终进入梦乡，与他们的母亲一起入睡。
    
    你也决定陪他们一起小睡一会儿。瓦蒂娅在一边，你在另一边，孩子们在这里再安全不过了。

rows.original: "Oops- no touching [pc.mf |daddy |mommy ] while [pc.hesShes] sleeping," you hear, the first thing greeting you upon waking. You open your eyes to the sight of Vatia removing a small giggling child from your face, her tail wiggling as she stretches her arms out for you. You sit up with a smile, careful not to put your arms anywhere there might be a tiny naga. "Good morning," you say. "I see we've started on the festivities." "They're very curious!" Vatia says, resting the girl in her arms. You can see she's got a little dress on – Vatia must have been prepared. "No crying, lots of looking around. Isn't that right?" You see the other two are on her shoulders, peering at you from their perch. "They seem very talented, don't they?" "They're very precocious," she says, nuzzling her head against one of them. "I wouldn't have thought they'd be up and about... and yet, here we are." The two of you watch your three kids crawling all over her. "They haven't used their magic yet, though..." "They might have learned to control it," you say. "No doubt they still have the underlying talent to use it... or maybe they know it'd be dangerous." The two of you watch your three children as they watch you back. No answers are forthcoming. The girl in Vatia's hands wriggles around, gaze fixed on you, until her mother looks down at her. "Do you want to visit [pc.mf |daddy |your other mommy ]?" "I'll take her," you say. "Have you decided on names, Vatia?" "The girl on my shoulder is Ina," she says, smiling wide. "The boy is Sana. And this one... is Vera." [var0] "Hello, Vera," you say, smiling down at her. You take her from Vatia with one arm and gently shake her tiny hands with the other, sending her into fits of giggles as she coils around your forearm. At least she's easy to hold up. "Now you're really a [pc.mf |father |mother ] to veparii," Vatia says. "She's going to want that all the time." "I guess I can still make a bed with children wrapped around my arms," you say, watching your daughter clutch your arm. Her snake half is soft and smooth, and having her slightly colder form against your [pc.skinFurScales] is a nice feeling. "Though I don't imagine I'll be getting much done with them asleep." "Truly," Vatia says. "Oh, now these two are curious." Ina and Sana have been watching, and now each of them are raised up in wonder. They lean forward, uncognizant of the weight of their heads, and just about flop onto the bed before Vatia rescues them. "Careful," she murmurs as they withdraw to a safer, more sensible distance. "Here, you can take a look." She holds her arms out to you and Ina is the first to move, slithering down from her perch on her mother's shoulders to sit in Vatia's open hand instead. The young snakegirl takes a moment to consider it before reaching out for what she wants, falling onto your other arm and latching on with a smile. It only takes her a couple of seconds to coil around you. "Now you have two bracelets," Vatia notes. "Very fluffy for bracelets," you say. "Veparus babies do tend to be very fluffy when they're young," she says, looking down at Sana. He's still considering his options. "They grow out of it over time. And they grow quite fast, so you probably won't be able to wear our kids for long." "Get the wearing in while the wearing is good, you mean," you say. Vatia laughs. "Exactly." She strokes a finger across Sana's cheek. "Do you want to go too?" Sana points at you, ushering Vatia's hand closer, and as you bend down he clings onto you in order to get his tail up and around the back of your neck. Supporting him with your upper arm, you let him get ahold of you until he settles up there against the back of your head with his tail looped around your neck. "Now I've got a matching necklace," you say as Vatia stifles a snort. "You have the full ensemble," she says. "Look at you." "Well, I can't go anywhere like this," you say. The kids are already falling asleep against you. "Guess I'll spend some more time in bed." "Perfect," Vatia says. "Here." The snakewoman coils up in such a fashion you can lean against her with a space for Sana, the two of you lying there in the company of your sleeping children. Your arms resting against your front, you regard them with curiosity. "I really expected more crying," you say. "I'm told I was a very quiet child," Vatia says, leaning over your shoulder to look at the girls. "Not much crying, not much talking, lots of reading. Maybe ours are the same way." You nod. "We'll have our hands full entertaining them." "It looks to me as though you already have your hands full," Vatia points out. You roll your eyes as she giggles. "I guess it's better than them throwing the furniture around." "Well, they could still do that," she says, resting against you. "Hopefully when they're old enough to explain that it's bad... but you never know." "We'll find out sooner or later," you say. Vatia smiles. "We will." The children slowly lose their grip on you as they drift into deeper sleep, and Vatia takes the opportunity to put them back in bed under the blankets with their heads on a pillow. "I'm sure they'll be hungry when they wake up," she says. "I'll stay here and keep an eye on them." You kiss her. "I'll be back soon." You leave the snakewoman coiled up with the kids, stepping outside for a moment to get things done – and find some food for Vatia. No doubt mom is hungry as well as the children...
rows.translation: 哎呀——不能碰哦！ [pc.mf |爸爸 |妈妈 ]当[pc.hesShes]时睡着了……”当你醒来时，首先听到的是这句话。 你睁开眼睛，看到瓦蒂娅正把一个正在咯咯笑的小孩从你的脸上拿开，她的尾巴摇来摇去，同时伸出手来想要触碰你。你微笑着坐起来，小心翼翼地避免将手臂放在可能有小娜迦的地方。 “早上好，”你说，“看来大家已经开始庆祝活动了。” “它们可好奇了！”瓦蒂娅一边说，一边把小女孩抱在怀里。你可以看到她穿着一条小裙子——瓦蒂娅肯定事先做足了准备。“不要哭，很多四处张望的样子，对吧？” “你看，另外两只正趴在她的肩膀上，从那个位置盯着你看呢。‘它们看起来挺有天赋的，不是吗？’” “它们确实很早熟，”她说着，把头靠在其中一只身上。我真没想到他们已经能到处活动了……没想到真的发生了。”你们俩看着自己的三个孩子在她身边爬来爬去。“不过他们还没有使用过他们的魔法呢……” “也许他们已经学会了如何控制它了，”你说。毫无疑问，他们仍然具备运用这种能力的潜质……或许他们只是知道这样做会很危险。” 你们两个人一起看着自己的三个孩子，而那些孩子也在注视着你们。然而，没有任何答案出现。 瓦蒂娅手中的那个女孩不停地扭动身体，目光紧紧地盯着你，直到她的母亲低头看了她一眼。你想去参观吗？ [pc.mf |爸爸 |你的另一个妈妈 ]我来照顾她吧，”你说。“你们已经为她们取好名字了吗，瓦蒂娅？” “我肩膀上的那个女孩叫伊娜，”她笑着说，“那个男孩叫萨纳，而这个……叫维拉。 [var0] 你好，薇拉，”你微笑着对她说。 你用一只手抱起她，另一只手轻轻握住她的小手，她的笑声不断，紧紧缠着你的前臂。至少她很容易被抱起来。 “现在你才真正算是[pc.mf |父亲 |母亲 ]去维帕里吧，”瓦蒂娅说，“她会一直想要那个的。” “我想，就算孩子们缠在我的怀里，我依然可以铺一张床吧，”你一边说，一边看着你的女儿紧紧抓住你的手臂。她那半条蛇身的部分柔软而光滑，当她那稍微凉一些的身体贴在你的手臂上时[pc.skinFurScales]这种感觉真好。不过我想，当他们睡着的时候，我应该也做不了什么事情吧。” “确实如此，”瓦蒂娅说，“哦，现在这两个孩子变得好奇起来啦。” 伊娜和萨娜一直在观看这一幕，此刻她们都惊讶地站了起来。她们向前倾身，完全没注意到自己头部的重量，差点就摔倒在床上，幸而瓦蒂娅及时扶住了她们。 小心点，”她轻声说道，同时他们退到了一个更安全、更合适的距离。“来，你可以看看。” 她伸开双臂，伊娜第一个走了过来，从母亲肩上滑下来，坐到了瓦蒂娅张开的手中。这位年轻的蛇女犹豫了一会儿，然后伸手拿走了她想要的东西，爬到了你的另一只手臂上，脸上带着笑容紧紧地缠住了你。仅仅几秒钟，她就完全缠在了你的身上。 现在你有了两条手部链了，”瓦蒂娅说道。 “这些手部链真是太柔软了，”你评论道。 “维帕鲁斯幼崽在幼年时期确实会显得非常柔软，”她一边说，一边低头看着萨纳。他仍在考虑自己的选择。“不过随着时间的推移，它们的柔软度会逐渐减弱。而且生长速度也很快，所以你可能没办法长时间戴着我们的孩子们的‘手部链’吧。 趁现在还方便，赶紧利用这个机会吧，你是这个意思吧？”你说道。 瓦蒂娅笑了：“没错。”她用手指轻轻触了触萨娜的脸颊：“你也要一起去吗？” 萨娜指了指你，把瓦蒂娅的手部拉得更近了一些。当你弯下腰时，那只小动物紧紧抓住你，把它的小尾巴绕到你的脖子上。你用上臂托住它，让它稳定地待在你的脖子上，直到它的尾巴完全绕在你的后脑勺处。 现在我也有了一条配套的项链了，”你说道，而瓦蒂娅则强忍着笑意。 “你这套装扮已经齐全了，”她说，“看看你自己吧。” “嗯，穿着这样的装扮我哪儿也去不了，”你说道，“孩子们都已经靠在我身上睡着了……看来我得再在床上躺一会儿了。 太好了，”瓦蒂娅说，“给你。” 那个蛇女以这样一种方式盘绕着自己，让你可以靠在她身上，同时还能给萨娜留出空间，你们俩就可以一起躺在那里，孩子们也在旁边安静地睡着。你将手臂放在身前，好奇地注视着他们。 我本来以为会看到更多的哭闹场面呢，”你说。 “别人告诉我，我小时候是个非常安静的孩子，”瓦蒂娅说着，凑到你肩旁去看那些女孩们。“不怎么哭闹，也不怎么说话，大部分时间都在读书。也许我们的孩子也是这样的。” 你点了点头：“要哄这些孩子开心，我们可真是要费一番功夫了。 在我看来，你现在已经忙得不可开交了，”瓦蒂娅指出。 你翻了个白眼，而她则咯咯笑了起来。“至少这样总比他们把家具扔得到处都是要好吧。” “嗯，他们还是有可能那么做的，”她靠在你身上说道，“希望等他们长大到能够明白这种行为是错误的时候……不过谁也说不准。 我们迟早会弄清楚的，”你说。 瓦蒂娅微笑着：“我们一定会弄清楚的。” 孩子们渐渐失去了对你的依恋，渐渐进入了更深的睡眠状态，瓦蒂娅便趁这个机会把他们重新放到床上，给他们盖上被子，让他们把头放在枕头上。 我敢肯定，他们醒来后会觉得饿的，”她说，“我会留在这里照看他们。” 你吻了她一下，然后说道：“我很快就会回来。” 你留下那个蛇女和孩子们在一起，自己则出去办点事情——顺便为瓦蒂娅找些食物。毫无疑问妈妈孩子们都饿了……
rows.raw: ' "Oops- no touching [pc.mf |daddy |mommy ] while [pc.hesShes] sleeping," you hear, the first thing greeting you upon waking. You open your eyes to the sight of Vatia removing a small giggling child from your face, her tail wiggling as she stretches her arms out for you. You sit up with a smile, careful not to put your arms anywhere there might be a tiny naga. "Good morning," you say. "I see we've started on the festivities." "They're very curious!" Vatia says, resting the girl in her arms. You can see she's got a little dress on – Vatia must have been prepared. "No crying, lots of looking around. Isn't that right?" You see the other two are on her shoulders, peering at you from their perch. "They seem very talented, don't they?" "They're very precocious," she says, nuzzling her head against one of them. "I wouldn't have thought they'd be up and about... and yet, here we are." The two of you watch your three kids crawling all over her. "They haven't used their magic yet, though..." "They might have learned to control it," you say. "No doubt they still have the underlying talent to use it... or maybe they know it'd be dangerous." The two of you watch your three children as they watch you back. No answers are forthcoming. The girl in Vatia's hands wriggles around, gaze fixed on you, until her mother looks down at her. "Do you want to visit [pc.mf |daddy |your other mommy ]?" "I'll take her," you say. "Have you decided on names, Vatia?" "The girl on my shoulder is Ina," she says, smiling wide. "The boy is Sana. And this one... is Vera." [var0] "Hello, Vera," you say, smiling down at her. You take her from Vatia with one arm and gently shake her tiny hands with the other, sending her into fits of giggles as she coils around your forearm. At least she's easy to hold up. "Now you're really a [pc.mf |father |mother ] to veparii," Vatia says. "She's going to want that all the time." "I guess I can still make a bed with children wrapped around my arms," you say, watching your daughter clutch your arm. Her snake half is soft and smooth, and having her slightly colder form against your [pc.skinFurScales] is a nice feeling. "Though I don't imagine I'll be getting much done with them asleep." "Truly," Vatia says. "Oh, now these two are curious." Ina and Sana have been watching, and now each of them are raised up in wonder. They lean forward, uncognizant of the weight of their heads, and just about flop onto the bed before Vatia rescues them. "Careful," she murmurs as they withdraw to a safer, more sensible distance. "Here, you can take a look." She holds her arms out to you and Ina is the first to move, slithering down from her perch on her mother's shoulders to sit in Vatia's open hand instead. The young snakegirl takes a moment to consider it before reaching out for what she wants, falling onto your other arm and latching on with a smile. It only takes her a couple of seconds to coil around you. "Now you have two bracelets," Vatia notes. "Very fluffy for bracelets," you say. "Veparus babies do tend to be very fluffy when they're young," she says, looking down at Sana. He's still considering his options. "They grow out of it over time. And they grow quite fast, so you probably won't be able to wear our kids for long." "Get the wearing in while the wearing is good, you mean," you say. Vatia laughs. "Exactly." She strokes a finger across Sana's cheek. "Do you want to go too?" Sana points at you, ushering Vatia's hand closer, and as you bend down he clings onto you in order to get his tail up and around the back of your neck. Supporting him with your upper arm, you let him get ahold of you until he settles up there against the back of your head with his tail looped around your neck. "Now I've got a matching necklace," you say as Vatia stifles a snort. "You have the full ensemble," she says. "Look at you." "Well, I can't go anywhere like this," you say. The kids are already falling asleep against you. "Guess I'll spend some more time in bed." "Perfect," Vatia says. "Here." The snakewoman coils up in such a fashion you can lean against her with a space for Sana, the two of you lying there in the company of your sleeping children. Your arms resting against your front, you regard them with curiosity. "I really expected more crying," you say. "I'm told I was a very quiet child," Vatia says, leaning over your shoulder to look at the girls. "Not much crying, not much talking, lots of reading. Maybe ours are the same way." You nod. "We'll have our hands full entertaining them." "It looks to me as though you already have your hands full," Vatia points out. You roll your eyes as she giggles. "I guess it's better than them throwing the furniture around." "Well, they could still do that," she says, resting against you. "Hopefully when they're old enough to explain that it's bad... but you never know." "We'll find out sooner or later," you say. Vatia smiles. "We will." The children slowly lose their grip on you as they drift into deeper sleep, and Vatia takes the opportunity to put them back in bed under the blankets with their heads on a pillow. "I'm sure they'll be hungry when they wake up," she says. "I'll stay here and keep an eye on them." You kiss her. "I'll be back soon." You leave the snakewoman coiled up with the kids, stepping outside for a moment to get things done – and find some food for Vatia. No doubt mom is hungry as well as the children... '

rows.original:
Things are a bit of a mess when you find Vatia. Vera is enjoying hanging from her mommy's hair, giggling as she swings around behind her, Vatia has a wriggling Sana tucked under her arm, and Ina is doing her best to make a great escape across the floor. You swoop in and rescue your child before she does anything silly, a mumble of dissent in your ear as you put her over your shoulder.
    
    "Thanks, [pc.name]," Vatia sighs, reaching back and extricating Vera from her hair. "Turns out they don't need magic to be a handful. And you! Stop wiggling."
    
    Sana wiggles harder for a moment, then gives up when it's clear there'll be no escaping his mother's grasp.
    
    "That's better," you say, jiggling Ina a bit in your arms until she's smiling. "Stop causing trouble."
    
    She giggles. You're not sure the message really got through, but oh well.
    
    "They're very adventurous and curious about the world around them," Vatia says. "I guess a combination of our traits is a bit of a disaster when it comes to keeping control of children."
    
    "Do we need someone to watch them?" you say.
    
    "Oh, no," she says. "I track them with magic. Very easy to do when they're of my own blood. So, no escapades into the wilderness without me knowing. Just, you know, fishing them out of cupboards and whatnot..."
    
    You smile. "A cupboard doesn't seem so bad, all things considered." You look down at Ina, who's been watching you speak very interestedly. "Are you sleeping in cupboards?"
    
    "Last time it was all three of them in one cupboard," Vatia sighs. "At least they're looking out for each other."
    
    "I wonder what they'll do in later life," you muse.
    
    "It'd be nice if they stuck together," she says, hugging Vera and Sana to her chest. "But life's a long road."
    
    The two of you tire the kids out for a while before putting them to bed together, leaving them to curl up and fall asleep under the blankets.
    
    "It's hard to believe they can be so serene after causing so much mayhem," you say.
    
    "If babies didn't have to sleep, I'd already be crazy," Vatia sighs. "But they are wonderful."
    
    You spend some time with Vatia, watching your wonderful children snooze away without a worry in the world before you give her and the kids a kiss each and look around the Wayfort to make sure everything's in order.
rows.translation:
当你找到瓦蒂娅时，场面有点混乱：维拉正开心地挂在妈妈的头发上，跟着妈妈晃来晃去，咯咯笑着；瓦蒂娅的胳膊下夹着扭动个不停的萨娜，而伊娜则拼命地试图从地板上爬走逃跑。你迅速冲过去，在你的孩子做出什么傻事之前把他们救了出来。当你把他们扛在肩上时，耳边传来了一些不满的嘟囔声……
    
    “谢谢[pc.name]，”唉，”瓦蒂娅叹了口气，伸手将维拉从自己的头发中拨了出来，“原来他们根本不需要魔法就能惹麻烦。还有你！别再乱动了。”
    
    萨娜又挣扎了一会儿，但显然无法摆脱她母亲的掌控，于是只好放弃了。
    
    这样就好多了，”你说道，轻轻摇晃着怀中的伊娜，直到她露出笑容。“别再惹麻烦了。”
    
    她咯咯笑了起来。你不确定她是否真正理解了你的话，但也没关系吧。
    
    “他们非常喜欢冒险，对周围的世界充满了好奇心，”瓦蒂娅说，“我想，我们这些性格特点加在一起，在管教孩子的时候确实会带来一些麻烦。
    
    我们需要派人看着他们吗？”你问道。
    
    “哦，不用。”她回答，“我用魔法来监视他们。既然他们是我的亲生孩子，监视起来就非常容易。所以，他们不可能在我不知情的情况下跑到野外去。顶多就是他们会躲到橱柜里之类的地方，我们只需要把他们找出来而已……
    
    你微笑着说道：“仔细想想，储藏柜其实也没那么糟糕嘛。”你低头看着伊娜，她一直饶有兴致地听着你说话。“你们也会在储藏柜里睡觉吗？”
    
    “上次有三只小动物一起待在一个储藏柜里呢，”瓦蒂娅叹了口气，“至少它们还能互相照顾。
    
    我想知道他们长大后会做什么呢，”你沉思道。
    
    “如果他们能一直在一起就好了，”她说着，把薇拉和萨娜搂在怀里，“但人生之路还很长啊。”
    
    你们俩陪孩子们玩了一会儿，然后一起把他们哄上床，让他们盖着被子安静地睡着了。
    
    真难以相信，它们在造成了这么多麻烦之后，还能如此安静地睡觉，”你说。
    
    “如果婴儿们不需要睡觉的话，我早就疯掉了，”瓦蒂娅叹了口气，“但它们确实太可爱了。”
    
    你和瓦蒂娅一起度过了这段时光，看着你们那些可爱的孩子们无忧无虑地熟睡着，然后你亲了她们每个人一下，又环顾了一下荒废驿堡，确保一切都在正常进行中。

rows.original:
There's a conspicuous lack of veparii children around when you approach Vatia, giving her a smile. "Hey, you. How's everything going?"
    
    "Great," Vatia says, stretching out. "I managed to get the kids to take a nap. Want to go spy on them?"
    
    That sounds fun. You join her in the bedroom, looking over the pile of long-tailed children jumbled up atop the sheets. Sana has his little mitt in Ina's face, and Vera is wrapped around his tail.
    
    "If they were any smaller they'd tie themselves in knots," you sigh.
    
    Vatia giggles. "Pretty hard to do with a thick tail, but when it gets long enough..." She flicks the tip of her lengthy tail for emphasis. "You do have to look out for it."
    
    You tug the blankets up a bit to keep the warmth in for the trio of your children, watching them calmly snooze. Vatia reaches out for your hand with a smile, the two of you standing guard over the little lives you've created.
    
    "I hope they grow up safely," Vatia murmurs.
    
    "Me too," you say, squeezing her hand. "I'll do my best to see that they do."
    
    Her expression softens. "I know."
    
    You shift your hand to her side, pulling her against you and letting the naga lean her head against your shoulder. The two of you stay like that for what feels like days but is probably minutes, gazing down at your childrens' peaceful faces and hoping the future they grow up in is as bright as can be. Eventually you head back out to the Wayfort proper, getting some food from the stockpiles and sitting down to eat with her.
    
    "Oh," Vatia says, rising from the meal. "They're up. I'm gonna go keep an eye on them."
    
    "Take some food with you," you say, offering a piece of meat.
    
    Vatia leans over and takes a bite. "Fhanks."
    
    You smile as you watch the concerned mother slither away and into the room with your children, finishing your food before standing up.
rows.translation:
当你走向瓦蒂娅并对她微笑时，你会发现周围明显没有维帕里族的孩子们。“嘿，你好，最近怎么样？”
    
    “挺好的，”瓦蒂娅伸了个懒腰说，“我终于让孩子们去小睡了一会儿。想一起去看看他们吗？”
    
    听起来挺有趣的。你跟着她走进卧室，看到一堆长尾巴的孩子们乱七八糟地躺在床单上。萨纳把他的小手套放在伊娜的脸上，而薇拉则缠在他的尾巴上。
    
    如果它们的尾巴再短一点，估计就会把自己缠成一团了，”你叹道。
    
    瓦蒂娅咯咯笑了起来：“不过带着一条这么粗的尾巴，确实很难做到这一点……不过当尾巴长得足够长时……”她甩了甩自己那条长长的尾巴，以强调自己的观点，“那时候就真的得小心点了。
    
    你把毯子拉高一些，好为你的三个孩子保留那份温暖，看着他们安静地打着盹。瓦蒂娅微笑着伸出手来，你们俩一起守护着这些你们亲手创造的小生命。
    
    “希望他们能平安地长大吧，”瓦蒂娅轻声说道。
    
    我也是，”你说道，握住了她的手。“我会尽我所能确保他们能够做到。”
    
    她的表情变得柔和起来。“我知道。”
    
    你将手移到她的身体一侧，将她拉向自己，让那条娜迦将头靠在你的肩膀上。你们俩就这样静静地待着，感觉像是过了好几天，但实际上可能只是几分钟而已。你们凝视着孩子们宁静的面孔，心中期盼着他们未来的生活能够充满光明与希望。最终，你们回到了荒废驿堡的主区域，从储备的食物中取了一些，然后坐下来一起吃饭。
    
    哦，”瓦蒂娅说着，从餐桌旁站了起来，“他们已经醒了。我去看看他们吧。”
    
    “带上一些食物吧，”你说道，递给她一块肉。
    
    瓦蒂娅接过肉咬了一口：“谢谢。”
    
    你微笑着，看着这位充满关爱的母亲带着孩子们走进房间，自己则继续吃完饭才站起身来。

rows.original:
You note Vatia is all coiled up as you approach, curiosity getting the better of you and drawing you closer. It looks like she's gone to sleep atop her coils... and the kids are with her. Snuggled up tightly, all four of them are snoozing away by the fire. You can't help but smile – looks like they're learning from mom pretty quickly.
    
    Quietly sitting down next to her, you lean against Vatia's cool scaled body and rest for a while. It's nice and uneventful without the little trio making trouble and getting up to shenanigans. They've certainly livened up Vatia's days, to say the least.
    
    You rest there for a while before standing, running your fingers through the snakewoman's onyx-black hair. They'll all be up soon enough, no doubt, but for now you'll let her rest a bit longer. She could use the time off.
rows.translation:
当你靠近时，你注意到瓦蒂娅正蜷缩着休息，好奇心驱使你走了过去。看起来她是在自己的蜷缩姿势中睡着了……而那些孩子们也在她身边。他们四个人紧紧依偎在一起，在火堆旁安静地睡着了。你不禁会露出微笑——看来他们学妈妈的样子还挺快的。
    
    你悄悄地坐在她旁边，靠在瓦蒂娅那凉爽、布满鳞片的身体上休息了一会儿。没有那三个小家伙惹麻烦、搞恶作剧，真是太安静、太惬意了。至少可以说，他们确实让瓦蒂娅的日子变得有趣多了。
    
    你在那里休息了一会儿，然后站起身来，用手指轻轻抚摸着那个蛇发女郎那乌黑如玉的头发。毫无疑问，他们很快就会都起床了，但现在，你就让她再休息一会儿吧。她完全可以利用这段休息时间。

rows.original: The fort's great hall is much busier than usual, with a mix of [wayfort.hasDaliza|Daliza's rangers|servants] and passing boreal merchants gathered around with all their heads all craned upwards. You inevitably follow the crowd's gaze as you enter the room, looking to the ceiling just in time for a forearm-sized yellow feather to land on your face. You sputter, blowing it away, in time to see its owner — one of several possible candidates nesting in the hall's rafters — giving you a sheepish grin. Harpies. Dozens of them. "Oh, there's the [pc.mf|man|woman] of the hour!" a familiar lilting voice croons, drawing your attention to your throne. A familiar red-headed thief is sat sideways across the chair, her clawed legs dangling over the armrest while her feathered headdress hangs off the seatback. She's got a froth-topped mug cradled between her boobs, and [zhara.isPregnant|one hand rests on her gravid egg-filled tummy|gives you a two-handed wave]. "Hope you don't mind me and the girls making ourselves at home while your valet went and fetched you." [wayfort.hasDaliza|"I am nobody's valet, cretin," Daliza barks, fingers tightening around her sword.|Rumie squeaks, cheeks flushing and wings buzzing behind you. "Oh. I've been had, haven't I?"] "What are you and your friends doing here?" you ask, looking between the wingleader and her gaggle of compadres roosting in your rafters. "And why are you bullying my [wayfort.hasDaliza|bailiff|bee]?" "The latter, because it's fun!" she says, grinning wide. "The former, well, you know it's getting kinda dangerous out there these days. Little demon bastards crawling out of the very stone, seems like, either attacking me and the girls, or jumping the people I'm tryin' to lift coin off. Marks are getting scarce all around the ol' mountains... and so are safe places to live. Even mom's fortress all the way up on the peaks is getting hammered by monsters. So! When I heard you of all people were putting down roots and fixing up this ol' place, I figured, why not bunker down with [pc.name]! If you can whip my girls around and apparently take down some kinda demon-elf-queen lady, surely you can keep a handful of very, very grateful harpies safe and sound." There's a great deal of whooping and chirping from the rafters, and several hundred feathers fall languidly onto your floor. Oh that's going to take some cleaning up. Poor [wayfort.hasMaids|maids|Rumie]. "And what's this business about being 'lady of the keep', then?" The thief laughs. "Well! A [pc.mf|lord|lady] needs a[pc.mf| lady|... you know, uh, another lady! Yeah]! And I am clearly the leading contender for the position. Look at these qualifications!" [zhara.isPregnant |The wingleader runs her feathery hand across her egg-bump, pulling up her tunic to show off the taut flesh surrounding the life you planted within her. |She bounces her tits in her hands, spreading her legs to show off her meaty thighs and a fleeting glimpse of feathery bush. ] [wayfort.hasFreja |[wayfort.hasDaliza |Daliza glances at you, cheeks coloring.         "Never thought I'd see the day the mountaintops were so dangerous. I mean, what's the point of a hidden nest if it's just gonna be surrounded by demons and pissed-off [silly
            |furries
            |frost-cats
        ] anyway? So yeah, I for one want to raise my kids somewhere with sturdy walls and a badass [pc.title] to protect 'em. And that's here. With you. If that wasn't obvious.""

rows.original: What about your daughter[zhara.numKids 2|s] with the wingleader? Will [zhara.numKids 2|they|she] be moving in with her?
rows.translation: 你和那个翼队长生的女儿[zhara.numKids 2|们]怎么样了？[zhara.numKids 2|她们|她]会搬去和她一起住吗？
rows.raw: "What about your daughter[zhara.numKids 2|s] with the wingleader? Will [zhara.numKids 2|they|she] be moving in with her?"

rows.original: The fort's great hall is much busier than usual, with a mix of [wayfort.hasDaliza|Daliza's rangers|servants] and passing boreal merchants gathered around with all their heads all craned upwards. You inevitably follow the crowd's gaze as you enter the room, looking to the ceiling just in time for a forearm-sized yellow feather to land on your face. You sputter, blowing it away, in time to see its owner — one of several possible candidates nesting in the hall's rafters — giving you a sheepish grin. Harpies. Dozens of them. Agnimitra strides beside you, her eyes focused forward; she has a disapproving scowl on her face like she had just gotten someone else’s feathers in her soup after having a particularly bad day. "Oh, there's the [pc.mf|man|woman] of the hour!" a familiar lilting voice croons, drawing your attention to your throne. A familiar red-headed thief is sat sideways across the chair, her clawed legs dangling over the armrest while her feathered headdress hangs off the seatback. She's got a froth-topped mug cradled between her boobs, and [zhara.isPregnant |one hand rests on her gravid egg-filled tummy |gives you a two-handed wave ]. "[flags.AGNI_ZHARA |And you brought Great-Grandma Agni with you!" She sets down the ale and hops to her feet, walking – more like bounding with excitement, particularly at the sight of Agnimitra – towards you both. "Honestly, you couldn’t have made this into a more perfect day, m’[pc.mf|lord|lady]!" |Who’s the broad?" she asks, motioning to Agnimitra. She sets down the mug of ale and sits properly on the throne, leaning far forward in an attempt to get a better look at your partner. "She has great taste in feather colors!" Without changing her expression, Agnimitra raises her right hand and presses her middle finger to her thumb. With a snap, her thumb instantly alights, a thin ember settling on the thumb’s tip. Just as quickly, the thief’s eyes widen, and all the energy evaporates from her body. All of the loud whooping and warbling of the harpies in the rafters stop as well. All it took was one snap of Agnimitra’s fingers, and every single harpy in the throne room is brought to heel. "Great-Grandma Agni?" the harpy wingleader asks, her voice so low and awed that you barely hear it in the new silence of the room. "Nobody else," Agnimitra answers, flicking her wrist to snuff the flame. The silence hangs in the room for a moment longer as the harpies all process what it is they’re seeing. "Well, that makes things even better!" the thief exclaims jubilantly, hopping to her feet and spreading her arms as she walks – or, rather, bounds with excitement – towards you both. The harpies in the rafters restart their own excitement at a much higher volume. "Holy shit, Great-Grandma, we were all worried sick about you! But if you’re here, and you’re young... that means that m[pc.mf|lord|lady] here is the one that brought you back!" ] "What are you and your friends doing here?" you ask, looking between [flags.AGNI_ZHARA|Zhara|the wingleader] and her gaggle of compadres roosting in your rafters. "And why are you bullying my [wayfort.hasDaliza|bailiff|bee]?" "The latter, because it's fun!" she says, grinning wide. "The former, well, you know it's getting kinda dangerous out there these days. Little demon bastards crawling out of the very stone, seems like, either attacking me and the girls, or jumping the people I'm tryin' to lift coin[flags.AGNI_ZHARA | – I mean... jumping the people we were paid handsomely to try and protect on the road. Caravans in need of protection | off. Marks ] are getting scarce all around the ol' mountains... and so are safe places to live. Even mom's fortress all the way up on the peaks is getting hammered by monsters. So! When I heard you of all people were putting down roots and fixing up this ol' place, I figured, why not bunker down with [pc.name]! If you can whip my girls around and apparently take down some kinda demon-elf-queen lady, surely you can keep a handful of very, very grateful harpies safe and sound." Agnimitra remains unimpressed. "And, as a bonus, I get to hang around my newly-rejuvenated Great-Grandma!" she continues, wrapping her left arm around Agnimitra’s shoulders and giving her a few playful nudges. "There’s so much we gotta talk about now that you’re young again, Agni. Gods, I’m still beside myself, here! You look like you could fold a log in half by doing some stomach crunches!" [flags.AGNI_ZHARA | |"You’ve been stealing from people?" Agnimitra asks with a low tone and a furrowed brow. You’re not totally up to speed on what Agnimitra’s relationship is with this harpy thief, but her presence alone is enough to shake the resolve of every harpy in the room at once, and her lowered tone and ice-cold gaze has the thief withdrawing her arm and taking a step back. Even if there’s no blood relation, and ‘Great-Grandma’ is just an honorific, it’s apparent that Agnimitra wasn’t kidding when she said she was a legend among her kind. "No – I mean, nah, Grandma," the thief sputters, her smile quickly waning into a nervous grin. She paces her feet somewhat and her hands can’t find a comfortable place to stay. "The girls and I, we scout out each of our, uh... we keep an eye on the roads, right, and we watch for other thieves on the roads, and we wait for them to steal money from someone else, and then we steal the money from the thieves. That’s what I meant!" "And you give the money back to the ones it belongs to, right?" "Ye – uh, yeah!" Agnimitra stares the girl down – and eventually lets out a long sigh through her nose, lowering her head into her right hand and massaging her wrinkled forehead in frustration. She was only recently reborn and this thief girl is taking away years of her life already. ] "And what's this business about being 'lady of the keep', then?" you ask. The thief laughs[flags.AGNI_ZHARA | |, glad for the opportunity to change the subject ]. "Well! A [pc.mf|lord|lady] needs a[pc.mf| lady|... you know, uh, another lady! Yeah]! And I am clearly the leading contender for the position. Look at these qualifications!" [zhara.isPregnant |The wingleader runs her feathery hand across her egg-bump, pulling up her tunic to show off the taut flesh surrounding the life you planted within her. |She bounces her tits in her hands, spreading her legs to show off her meaty thighs and a fleeting glimpse of feathery bush. [wayfort.hasFreja |[wayfort.hasDaliza |Daliza glances at you, cheeks coloring. "If I introduce her to Aileh and your daughter, do you think she'll fuck off?" |You have a sneaking suspicion Aileh is going to have strong words for the both of you if she finds out there are beautiful-pregnant-lover qualifications for being 'Lady of the Wayfort'. ] ] ] Her friends cat-call the both of you, almost deafening when their captain shows a little extra skin. When the cacophony finally ends, the wingleader heaves herself up into a proper sit upon your throne and fixes you with a smirk. "So? What do you say, [pc.title]?"
rows.translation: 这座堡垒的大厅里熙熙攘攘，来来往往的人络绎不绝。 [wayfort.hasDaliza|达莉莎的游骑兵队|仆从们]那些路过的北方商人也都聚集了过来，全都把头仰得高高的。当你走进房间时，不由自主地顺着人群的目光望向天花板，就在这时，一根有前臂那么长的黄色羽毛落在了你的脸上。你赶紧咳了几声，把它吹走，这时才看到了它的主人——其中一位几个可能藏在大厅屋檐下的那些家伙——会让你不禁露出尴尬的笑容。 ……鹰身女妖。有几十只呢。 阿格尼米特拉走在你身旁，目光直视前方；她的脸上带着不赞成的表情，就好像在经历了糟糕的一天之后，突然有人把别人的羽毛掺进了她的汤里一样。 “哦，原来是在这里[pc.mf|男人|女性]正是时候！”一个熟悉而轻快的声音响起，将你的注意力引向王座。一个你熟悉的红发小偷正侧坐在椅子上，她那带爪子的双腿悬在扶手上，而她那装饰着羽毛的头饰则挂在椅背上。她把一个装满泡沫的杯子抱在胸前[zhara.isPregnant |一只手轻轻放在她那因怀孕而隆起的腹部上 |向你挥了挥双手 ]。 "[flags.AGNI_ZHARA |你们还把阿格尼奶奶也带来了！”她放下手中的麦芽酒，兴奋地站起身来，快步走向你们俩——尤其是看到阿格尼米特拉的时候，她的步伐更是显得无比激动。“说真的，你们真的把这一天安排得再完美不过了。[pc.mf|领主|女士]！" |那个身材丰满的女子是谁？”她问道，同时指向阿格尼米特拉。她放下手中的麦酒杯，坐到王座上，身体前倾以便能更清楚地看到你的伴侣。“她的羽毛颜色选择真是很有品味啊！” 阿格尼米特拉面无表情地抬起右手，将中指抵在拇指上。随着一声轻响，她的拇指上立刻出现了一颗细小的火苗。 转眼间，小偷的眼睛瞪得大大的，体内的所有力气仿佛都被抽走了。屋梁上那些鹰身女妖发出的喧闹叫声也瞬间消失了。仅仅是因为阿格尼米特拉弹了一下手指，王座厅里的每一只鹰身女妖都立刻安静了下来。 伟大的阿格尼祖母？”那位女妖首领用极其低沉而充满敬畏的声音问道，在房间里重新降临的寂静中，这声音几乎听不见。 “没有其他人了，”阿格尼米特拉回答道，同时甩了甩手腕，熄灭了火焰。 房间里的气氛再次陷入沉默，因为那些女妖们都在消化她们所看到的一切。“好吧，这样事情反而更好了！”小偷兴奋地叫道，她跳了起来，双臂张开，兴奋地朝你们俩跑去。屋檐上的那些女妖们又开始以更高的音量喧闹起来。“天啊，曾祖母，我们可都是为您担心死了！但如果您还在这里，而且还是那么年轻……那就意味着[pc.mf|领主|女士]这就是那个让你们重返游戏世界的东西！ ] 你和你的朋友们在这里干什么？”你边问边四处张望。 [flags.AGNI_ZHARA|扎拉|队伍的领导者]还有那一群依附在你的庇护下的家伙们。“那你为什么还要欺负我呢？ [wayfort.hasDaliza|法警|蜜蜂]后者，因为玩起来很有趣！”她笑着说，笑容灿烂。“至于前者嘛，你知道，这些天外面变得有点危险了。那些小恶魔似乎从石头里钻出来，要么攻击我和那些女孩，要么扑向那些我正在试图帮助的人[flags.AGNI_ZHARA | – 我是说……那些我们受雇来保护的人，我们却在路上抛弃了他们。那些需要保护的商队啊…… | 关闭。标记已关闭。 ]这些资源在整座山脉里都越来越稀缺了……安全的居住地也同样不多。就连妈妈位于山顶上的堡垒，也不断遭到怪物的侵袭。所以，当我听说你们这些人正在这个地方安家落户、建设家园时，我便想：为什么不来投奔[pc.name]呢！既然你能把我的姑娘们收拾得服服帖帖，还能打倒那位恶魔精灵女王，那么，保护好那些感激不尽的鹰身女妖们应该不是什么难事吧。” 然而，阿格尼米特拉依然没有表现出任何兴趣。而且作为额外的好处，我还可以经常和我的那位重新焕发青春的曾祖母待在一起！”她继续说道，左手搭在阿格尼米特拉的肩上，调皮地轻轻推了她几下。“真是太棒了太多了阿格尼，现在你又年轻了，我们真的得谈谈了。天啊，我到现在还简直不敢相信！你看你现在的体型，做几个仰卧起坐就能把一根原木折成两半了吧！ [flags.AGNI_ZHARA | |你一直在偷别人的东西？”阿格尼米特拉压低声音问道，眉头紧锁。 你可能还不太清楚阿格尼米特拉与这个女妖小偷之间的关系，但仅仅她的出现，就足以让房间里的所有女妖们立刻动摇决心。而她那压低的声音与冰冷的目光，更是让那个小偷立刻缩回了手，后退了一步。即使没有血缘关系，而且“曾祖母”这个称呼也只是出于礼貌，但很明显，阿格尼米特拉说自己是同族中的传奇人物时，并不是在开玩笑。 “不……我是说，算了，奶奶，”小偷结结巴巴地说道，她的笑容很快便变成了紧张的苦笑。她来回踱步，双手不知该放在哪里才舒服。“我和那些女孩们，我们会负责监视道路情况，对吧？我们会留意周围的一切。其他路上到处都是小偷，我们只能等待时机了他们从别人那里偷钱，然后我们再从这些小偷手里把钱夺回来。我就是这个意思！” “然后你会把钱还给它真正的主人，对吧？” “嗯……是的！” 阿格尼米特拉凝视着这个女孩，最终长叹一声，低下头，用右手揉着自己布满皱纹的额头，显得十分沮丧。她才刚刚重生，而这个偷钱的女孩就已经让她失去了好几年的光阴。 ] 那么，这个‘城堡女主人’的身份又是怎么回事呢？”你问道。 小偷笑了起来。[flags.AGNI_ZHARA | |很高兴有机会改变这个话题。 ]嗯！啊[pc.mf|领主|女士]需要[pc.mf| 女士|…你知道的，呃，又有一位女士！没错。]显然，我是这个职位的最有力竞争者。看看我的这些资历吧！ [zhara.isPregnant |那只翅膀领头的鸟用它那羽毛般柔软的手抚摸着自己肚子上的凸起，然后撩起自己的外衣，展示出那因孕育着新生命而变得紧实、富有弹性的皮肤。 |她将双乳在手中轻轻晃动，双腿分开以展示自己结实的大腿，同时让人短暂地看到她那如羽毛般柔软的私密部位。 [wayfort.hasFreja |[wayfort.hasDaliza |达莉莎瞥了你一眼，脸颊顿时泛起了红晕。“如果我把她介绍给艾莱和你的女儿，你觉得她会离开吗？ |你隐隐觉得，如果艾莉赫发现“荒废驿堡女士”这个头衔其实还附带“怀孕的美丽恋人”这样的附加条件，她肯定会对你们俩说些严厉的话。 ] ] ] 她的朋友们对你们俩大声起哄，当他们的队长稍微露出一点肌肤时，那喧闹声简直震耳欲聋。当这一切终于结束时，那个带头的女子坐到了你的王座上，带着一丝讥笑看着你：“那么？你有什么想法，[pc.title]？"

rows.original: "Alright, but you and the girls are going to have to earn your keep," you say. The wingleader looks affronted. "What, the pleasure of my company isn't enough to sate all of the desires you might have, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]?" Agnimitra scoffs in frustration. "Zhara, I say this as your Great-Grandma: you know I love you and your mother and your sisters dearly. You know there’s nothing I wouldn’t do for you. You know that I’d die for you – whatever that’s worth, coming from me." She steps into the harpy girl’s space; the harpy, her bravado shaken, takes a step back. "You came into [pc.name]’s home; you started abusing [pc.name]’s staff; you started using [pc.name]’s resources; and you’ve been acting like you’re entitled to it all from the start. If [pc.heShe] went to Shaedra’s nest and started acting the way you’re acting, you’d have sliced [pc.himHer] open without a second thought. So if [pc.heShe] is willing to let you stay conditionally, you can either put up with it, or you can go back to the Peaks." Not only does Agnimitra’s commanding tone shut the harpy down completely, but it also silences the squawking from the other girls coming from the rafters. Agnimitra is a legend among the harpies, but the respect she commands from them is something else[wayfort.hasDaliza |. Even your normally stiff, stern bailiff can’t help but be impressed with how quickly Agnimitra’s gotten the braying birds to shut up ].[zhara.isPregnant | "And for Sorra’s sake," she continues, motioning with an open palm towards the mug of ale that the harpy had left sitting at the foot of your throne, "contain yourself when you’re pregnant, woman! That’s my great, great-granddaughter in there!" ] The red-feathered harpy wingleader stands up straight, looking as though she’d just been commanded to stand at attention from a ghost. Her eyes, while wide from nervousness, remain unblinking and focused on Agnimitra, then onto you, showing you that you have her undivided attention, now that she’s been sufficiently cowed. You put your hands on your hips as you regard the woman. [flags.AGNI_ZHARA |You’ve gathered her name from overhearing her conversation with Agnimitra before, but n |N ]ow that you think about it, you don’t believe you’ve ever been formally introduced. "Oh!" the harpy says, breaking her stiff posture and relaxing her limbs. You can tell that she wants to go back to her normal, carefree, flippant attitude, but ‘Great-Grandma Agni’ is watching, and judging, her every move. "Uh, right! I am Zhara, daughter of Matron Shaedra: the Great Mother of the Northern Peaks, She Who is Beloved of Sorra[silly |, the Storm That is Approaching ]. It is a pleasure to formally make your acquaintance, [pc.isBaron |Baron |[pc.bg noblescion |Lord |my dear ] ] [pc.name]." She’s acting particularly formal, given the... relationship you two have now. Maybe it’s for Agnimitra’s benefit. Maybe she’s just trying to put on airs. She stands back upright – and quickly adjusts her top, ensuring that she’s still presentable. Knowing her, that was because Agnimitra is standing beside you. "Great-Grandma Agni is right: if our positions were reversed, I wouldn’t have stood for it. So it’s only right that me and the girls repay you for the housing. We’re good to work! Just point us in a direction and tell us to do a thing, and we’ll make sure we’re good for it." She runs a talon through her headdress. "Oh, uh, m’[pc.mf |lord |lady ]." [wayfort.hasDaliza |[wayfort.upgraded |"Can we just put them in the stockades? Nice and safe up there," Daliza suggests. Zhara blows her a raspberry. ] ]
rows.translation: 好吧，但你们这些女孩得自己想办法谋生才行。”你说道。 那位翼族首领显得非常不满：“什么？和我在一起这种乐趣还不够满足你的所有欲望吗？ [pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]阿格尼米特拉沮丧地嗤笑道：“扎拉，我是以你曾祖母的身份跟你说这些的：你知道我非常爱你、你的母亲以及你的姐妹们。你也知道，为了你们，我什么事情都愿意做。你知道，为了你们，我甚至愿意付出生命的代价——对我来说，这样的承诺可是无比沉重的。”她走进了那个女妖的面前；那个女妖原本充满的傲慢立刻消失了，退后了一步。“你当初来到这里[pc.name]这是你的家；你却开始滥用它。 [pc.name]你的团队；你们开始使用了[pc.name]这些资源本来就是属于他们的；而你从一开始就表现得好像自己有权拥有这一切一样。如果[pc.heShe]要是你去沙德拉的巢穴，然后开始做出你现在这样的举动，你早就被撕成碎片了。 [pc.himHer]会毫不犹豫地打开它。所以，如果[pc.heShe]们愿意有条件地让你留下，要么你忍受这种状况，要么你就回到山峰上去。” 阿格尼米特拉这种命令式的口吻不仅让那个女妖彻底闭上了嘴，也让从屋檐上传来的其他女孩们的吵闹声都安静了下来。在女妖们中间，阿格尼米特拉确实是个传奇人物尊重她指挥他们的方式实在与众不同。[wayfort.hasDaliza |就连你平时那严厉、冷酷的执达员，也会对阿格尼米特拉如此迅速地让那些吵闹的鸟儿安静下来感到惊讶 ]。[zhara.isPregnant | 看在索拉的份上，”她继续说道，同时用掌心朝那个女妖放在你王座脚边的麦酒杯示意，“女人，怀孕的时候可要控制好自己的情绪啊！那样才我的太好了，里面还有曾孙女呢！ ] 那只长着红色羽毛的鹰身女妖猛地挺直身体，看上去就像是被某个幽灵命令立刻立正站好一样。她的眼睛因为紧张而睁得大大的，但却始终没有眨动，目光紧紧地盯着阿格尼米特拉，然后又转向了你，这表明在她被吓得足够害怕之后，你的注意力已经完全吸引了她。 你双手叉腰，凝视着这个女人。 [flags.AGNI_ZHARA |你之前是通过偷听她与阿格尼米特拉的谈话才得知她的名字的，对吧？ |N ]哦，仔细想来，你竟然觉得自己从来没被正式介绍过呢。” “啊！”女妖哈皮说着，放松了自己僵硬的姿势，四肢也变得柔软起来。你能看出，她很想恢复自己平时那种轻松、随意、不拘小节的态度，但“伟大的阿格尼祖母”正在注视着她，也在评判着她的一举一动。“嗯，对了！我是扎拉，主母沙德拉的女儿——北方山峰的女主人，也是索拉所钟爱的人。[silly |那场即将到来的风暴 ]非常高兴能正式与您相识。 [pc.isBaron |男爵 |[pc.bg noblescion |领主 |亲爱的 ] ] [pc.name]考虑到你们现在的……关系，她的举止显得格外正式。也许这是为了阿格尼米特拉的利益，又或许她只是想装出一副高人一等的样子。 她挺直身子，迅速整理了一下上衣，确保自己看起来仍然得体。以她的性格，肯定是这样的。那个那是因为阿格尼米特拉站在你身边。“阿格尼奶奶说得对：如果我们的位置互换，我也不会容忍这种事情发生的。所以，由我和这些女孩来报答你提供的住处，实在是天经地义。我们一定能够把事情做好！只要您给我们指明方向，告诉我们该做什么，我们一定会全力以赴的。”她用爪子轻轻抚过自己的头饰，说道：“哦，嗯，我的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]。" [wayfort.hasDaliza |[wayfort.upgraded |我们把它们放在栅栏里面不就行了吗？那样既安全又方便，”达莉莎建议道。扎拉则对她翻了个白眼。 ] ]

"What, the pleasure of my company isn't enough to sate all of the desires you might have, my [pc.mf |lord |lady ]?" Agnimitra scoffs in frustration. "Zhara, I say this as your Great-Grandma: you know I love you and your mother and your sisters dearly. You know there’s nothing I wouldn’t do for you. You know that I’d die for you – whatever that’s worth, coming from me." She steps into the harpy girl’s space; the harpy, her bravado shaken, takes a step back. "You came into [pc.name]’s home; you started abusing [pc.name]’s staff; you started using [pc.name]’s resources; and you’ve been acting like you’re entitled to it all from the start. If [pc.heShe] went to Shaedra’s nest and started acting the way you’re acting, you’d have sliced [pc.himHer] open without a second thought. So if [pc.heShe] is willing to let you stay conditionally, you can either put up with it, or you can go back to the Peaks." Not only does Agnimitra’s commanding tone shut the harpy down completely, but it also silences the squawking from the other girls coming from the rafters. Agnimitra is a legend among the harpies, but the respect she commands from them is something else[wayfort.hasDaliza |. Even your normally stiff, stern bailiff can’t help but be impressed with how quickly Agnimitra’s gotten the braying birds to shut up ].[zhara.isPregnant | "And for Sorra’s sake," she continues, motioning with an open palm towards the mug of ale that the harpy had left sitting at the foot of your throne, "contain yourself when you’re pregnant, woman! rows.original: There’s one obvious way that the harpies – a roaming gang of thieves, bandits, and highwaywomen – could earn their keep. [pc.isDK |So you go ahead and say it: you want them to bring in coin. Lots and lots of coin. Enough to fund the fortress, provide their housing, and bring in their food, several times over. |You hesitate to say it because you doubt Agnimitra would approve... but, eventually, there’s just no other way around the fact that Zhara has assembled herself a... system that brings in money, and is apparently half decent at it. You tell her to bring in money. You don’t care how she does it, but you want enough money so they can feed themselves and provide enough for the fortress a few times over. ] "I can’t condone that," Agnimitra says, huffing through her nose as the words leave your mouth. "So I’m going to pretend I didn’t hear it." The air hangs stale between you three for a moment. "Does that mean you’re okay with it?" Zhara asks haltingly. Agnimitra crosses her arms. "Okay with what?" "Right, my mistake," Zhara says with a laugh. "Now we'll have a shorter [silly |commute |flight ] to our hunting grounds, too. Alright, boss, you got it. Me and the girls are gonna make you rich. Just don't complain to me if everyone around here gets mad at you for housing us." You smirk. "I'll worry about that." "Badass like you? Nothing to worry about 'cept rotten eggs on your wall!" The gaggle of birds above you roar with laughter, and Zhara smirks from ear to ear. "And hey, there'll be plenty of eggs around here for you, too. [zhara.isPregnant |Some of them are definitely going to be yours. Maybe a lot of them! |And if you want to make sure all of them are yours, well, I bet the girls will line up and present if you ask! ]" Some of the girls overhead laugh at the joke, but it’s much more muted than before. You look up towards the gaggle of them, noting their positions, how some of them eye you with anything from indifference to respect to lust. Most of them aren’t wearing much. It’s an unusual atmosphere: you feel like you’re a nun that’s walked into a bordello. The girls want to act more illicit and scandalous, but they’re not sure if they should – because Agnimitra is right there. Zhara, however, is far less concerned with Agnimitra’s approval. She comes over and hooks her winged arms around your middle, nuzzling her face into your neck while your gaze is so upturned. When you look down, you're brought into a full lip kiss that only serves to redouble the raucous cheers from overhead. "You've made a good choice, [pc.name]. We won't let you down. And when me and the girls aren't working, you can find me in the hall for whatever kinds of fun you want to get up to. I'm at your service!" She reaches down and gives your [pc.ass] a squeeze, which causes a bit more noise up in the rafters. Hell, if she’s not worried about appearances, you don’t see why you should walk on eggshells either: you reciprocate, rolling your hands down Zhara’s side and giving her own hefty ass a double-handed heft. To your mild surprise, Agnimitra doesn’t make a sound. She’s standing right there, she’s watching it all unfold in front of you, but it’s with the same intensity as watching food cook on a spit. She’s completely nonplussed by such an obvious display of affection with someone that continually refers to her as ‘Great-Grandma’. "I’ll make sure I’m easy to find when I’m not out on the job," Zhara tells you, nuzzling into your neck once more, before pulling away with an exaggerated swagger, knowing exactly where your eyes are drawn.
rows.translation: 对于那些由盗贼、强盗和女匪组成的游荡团伙来说，有一种显而易见的方式可以谋生。 [pc.isDK |那么你就直说吧：你希望他们能带来大量的金币。足够用来建造这座堡垒、为他们提供住所，还能多次满足他们的食物需求。 |你迟迟不敢说出口，因为你怀疑阿格尼米特拉不会同意……但最终，你不得不承认：扎拉确实建立了一个能够赚钱的系统，而且显然她在这方面还挺在行的。你告诉她，一定要赚到足够的钱。你并不关心她具体会用什么方法，只要你们的生活有保障，而且堡垒的开支也能得到足够的资金支持就行。 ] 我无法容忍这种行为，”阿格尼米特拉边说边通过鼻子哼着气，“所以我就当没听见吧。” 你们三个人之间的气氛顿时变得僵硬起来。“那么，这是意味着你同意这种做法吗？”扎拉结结巴巴地问道。 阿格尼米特拉双臂交叉：“同意什么？” “哦，是我的错，”扎拉笑着说，“现在我们的讨论可以简短一些了[silly |通勤 |飞行 ]也会把我们的‘狩猎场’也牵涉进来。好吧，老板，你放心吧。我和姐妹们一定会让你发大财的。不过要是因为让我们住在这里，这里的人都生你的气，你可别来找我抱怨哦。” 你咧嘴一笑：“这点我倒不担心。” “像你这么厉害的人，除了墙上可能会掉些臭鸡蛋之外，根本没什么好担心的！”你头顶上那一群鸟儿哄堂大笑，扎拉也笑得合不拢嘴：“而且，这里肯定也有很多‘鸡蛋’等着你哦。 [zhara.isPregnant |其中一些肯定会属于你。也许会很多呢！ |如果你想确保它们全都属于你，那么我敢打赌，只要你开口要求，那些女孩们一定会排好队把它们送给你！ ]几个女孩在上面听着这个笑话，纷纷发笑，但笑声比之前要轻柔了许多。你抬头看向那群女孩，注意观察她们的位置，以及她们看你的眼神——有的只是漠不关心，有的则带着尊敬，还有的眼神中透露出欲望。她们中的大多数几乎都没有穿什么衣服。这种氛围实在很不寻常：你感觉自己就像是一个走进了妓院的修女。那些女孩想要他们本想做出更加不正当、更加引人注目的举动，但却不确定是否应该这么做——因为阿格尼米特拉就在旁边。 然而，扎拉却完全不在乎阿格尼米特拉的看法。她走过来，用她那带翅膀的手臂环住你的腰，把脸贴在你的脖子上，而你的目光此时正紧紧地望着她。当你低头时，她突然吻住了你的嘴唇，这一举动使得头顶上那些人的欢呼声更加热烈了。“你做出了一个正确的选择[pc.name]我们一定不会让你们失望的。而且当我和姐妹们没有工作的时候，你们可以在大厅里找到我，想做什么有趣的事情都可以，我随时为您服务！” 她低下身子，伸出了手。 [pc.ass]轻轻一捏，结果屋梁上又传来一阵嘈杂声。哎呀，如果她都不在乎别人的看法，那你也没必要小心翼翼、如履薄冰了：你也回敬她一下吧，顺着扎拉的身体往下抚摸，然后用手轻轻捏了捏她那圆润的臀部。 令你略感惊讶的是，阿格尼米特拉竟然没有发出任何反应。她就站在那里，眼睁睁地看着这一切发生在你面前，但她的反应，就如同在看烤肉架上烤着的食物一样，毫无波澜。对于这样一种明显的示爱行为，尤其是来自一个总是称她为“曾祖母”的人，她显然完全感到困惑不已。 当我不在执行任务的时候，我会确保自己很容易被找到。”扎拉一边说着，又一次依偎在你的脖颈旁，然后又故作夸张地退开，她很清楚你的目光会被吸引到哪里去。

rows.original: Zhara and her girls are thieves. They like money, you like money; having them continue to shake down anybody that isn't under your protection seems like a natural course of action.
rows.translation: 扎拉和她的那些手下都是小偷。她们喜欢钱，你也是喜欢钱；让她们继续去敲诈那些不在你保护范围内的人，似乎是理所应当的做法。
rows.raw: "Zhara and her girls are thieves. They like money, you like money; having them continue to shake down anybody that isn't under your protection seems like a natural course of action."

rows.original: "If you want to stay," you tell her, looking between Zhara and the gaggle up in your rafters, "there'll be no banditry on my lands. In fact, I want you to help me stop [pc.isBimbo |jerks from stealing all my stuff |others from doing so ]." Zhara blinks. "You... want us to be your new guards?" [wayfort.hasDaliza |"You want them to be your new guards!?" Daliza echoes. ] It seems like the perfect job for them. One, there’s a ton of them: having a small army of harpies under your employ just sounds like a good thing to have in general. Two, they’re bandits: they know how other ne’er-do-wells work and what their goals are, where and when to expect them, and so on. And three... Agnimitra would probably prefer that they be guards rather than back to being bandits. "They’re all adults, [pc.name]," Agnimitra answers, looking up at the gaggle of harpies in the rafters and scratching at her chin in thought. "They’re old enough to make their own mistakes. That said, though, as someone they all look up to, I couldn’t condone them being highwaywomen, so... yeah, I’d prefer it if they did something a little less nefarious." Zhara mimics Agnimitra’s posture almost perfectly, looking up and scratching at her chin. You can’t tell if she’s doing it on purpose. "Can we rob any bandits we intercept?" she asks earnestly. "If any of them happen to make off with anything from your vault, you’ll get it back. But the girls are gonna want their own, you know, pocket change." That’s kind of a slippery slope. You’re trusting each of the harpies to be self-governing while they’re out – who’s to say that they won’t just decide that a legitimate caravan was actually a roaming pack of evildoers? Still, this conversation can’t go anywhere without someone giving at least a little. You tell her to swear that she, nor any of the harpies living in your fort, will knowingly rob an innocent bystander. Your concession causes a small ruckus among the harpies in the rafters. When you look up, you see at least one of them has a shit-eating grin on her face. "I swear," Zhara answers, a little too quickly for your liking. "[silly |SWEAR TO ME!" Agnimitra shouts, her voice unusually low, gravelly, and masculine. |"Swear on my name," Agnimitra interjects. ] Every harpy in the rafters immediately shuts up. Zhara looks at Agnimitra, caught off-guard by the demand; Agnimitra narrows her eyes and furrows her brow, daring Zhara to try and deflect. You’ve always known Agnimitra to be a fairly easy-going woman – but she can demand respect from the harpies when she wants to. "Uh," Zhara stutters, her eyes darting between yours and Agnimitra’s. She eventually relents, her shoulders slumping. "Fine. I swear on Great-Grandma Agnimitra’s name, we won’t rob anyone we’re not supposed to." Agnimitra holds her pose for a long moment – and, like blowing out a candle, she changes her demeanour. "Good!" she says, clapping you on the shoulder once. "I’m satisfied. The girls will behave themselves." Now that the pressure’s been defused, the thief — now former thief, you suppose — claps her hands together and, after a moment's consideration, gives you a lazy salute. "Fads come and go, [pc.name], but the one thing that’ll stick with me forever is my family tree." She taps on her head with her index claw. "My memory isn’t great, but I take the time and effort to remember everyone in my lineage. It’s not like I don’t have the time." rows.original:
"What about our daughter[zhara.numKids 2
            |s
        ]? Will [pc.isBimbo
            |our cutie patootie[zhara.numKids 2
                |s
            ]
            |[zhara.numKids 2
                |they
                |she
            ]
        ] be coming to live with us, if I let you move in?"
        
        As soon as you say ‘our daughter[zhara.numKids 2|s]’, Agnimitra visibly fidgets. Her face turns slightly towards you, then back to the wingleader’s. She’s doing her best to maintain her stern, disapproving vigilance in light of this news.
        
        A faint but genuine smile plays across the wingleader's lips. "Yeah, of course. All the girls want to bring their youngins around — that's most of the point of us wanting to be here: to have somewhere actually safe to raise the kiddos. And I'll admit, having [zhara.numKids 2|their|her] [pc.mf
            |dad
            |other mom
        ] around growing up's a big plus for me. Maybe for some of the other girls, too, I dunno how much you get around."
        
        Some of the other harpies giggle up in the rafters. A couple of them thrust forward large, egg-laden bellies of their own.
        
        "The whole point to moving in was to try and get away from, you know, the realities of the world that we live in now. Mom has a bigass fortress up in the Peaks, but it’s surrounded by demons on one side and pissed off [silly
            |furries
            |cat-people
        ] on the other. Living on the road is no place to raise some chicklets, either. Look, I may be a rough-and-tumble party gal, [pc.name], but my mom didn’t raise an idiot. And my Great-Grandma didn’t, either."
        
        Again, Agnimitra’s body posture changes, her shoulders visibly relaxing. You can hear her exhale through her nose as well. But she fights to stay stern and ready – if you told this harpy to get out, she would, against her own wishes, stand by your decision. And she knows that the wingleader is trying to appeal to her more motherly senses by bringing up the kid[zhara.numKids 2|s] the way she is.
rows.translation:
“我们的女儿[zhara.numKids 2
            |
        ]呢？如果我让你搬进来，[pc.isBimbo
            |我们的小可爱[zhara.numKids 2
                |
            ]
            |[zhara.numKids 2
                |他们
                |她
            ]
        ]会来和我们一起住吗？”
        
        你刚说出我们的女儿[zhara.numKids 2|]，阿格尼米特拉就明显地坐立不安起来。她的脸微微转向你，随即又转回那位翼领者身上。面对这样的消息，她仍在努力维持着那副严肃而不赞成的警惕神情。
        
        然而，那位翼领者的嘴角浮现出一丝淡淡的、却发自内心的微笑。“是啊，当然。所有的姑娘都想把自己的孩子带在身边——这正是我们想住进来的主要原因：找个真正安全的地方把孩子们养大。而且我得承认，能有[zhara.numKids 2|他们的|她的] [pc.mf
            |爸爸
            |另一位妈妈
        ]在身边一起长大，对我来说是很大的加分项。也许其他几个姑娘也这么想，不过我也不知道你在外面有多吃得开。”
        
        其他一些鹰身女妖在屋梁上咯咯地笑了起来，其中有几个还挺起自己同样胀满蛋的大肚子。
        
        “我们搬过来住的初衷，就是想远离——你们也知道——我们现在所生活的这个世界的种种现实。妈妈在高地山峰上有一座巨大的堡垒，但它一边被恶魔包围着，另一边则是被激怒的[silly
            |兽人爱好者
            |猫人
        ]。而且，漂泊在外的日子也不适合抚养孩子。听着，我虽然是个性格豪放、喜欢热闹的派对女孩， [pc.name]，但我妈可没养出一个白痴来。我的曾祖母也一样。”
        
        再一次，阿格尼米特拉的姿势发生了变化，她的肩膀明显放松了下来。你甚至能听到她从鼻子里呼出的气息。但她仍在努力保持严肃和戒备——如果你叫这个鹰身女妖离开，她还是会违背自己的意愿，遵从你的决定。而且她也很清楚，那位翼领者这样提起孩子[zhara.numKids 2|]，是想触动她身为母亲的那一面。

rows.original:
[wayfort.harpiesTGN
        |Zhara is roosting up in the rafters with several of her fellow thieves, planning their next heists. Seeing you down below, the girls wave and call out, sending a small shower of feathers floating down to collect around you. There's a few eggs visible up in their nests, and a whole lot of electrum coins, gems, and other jewelry adorn them, catching the light in splendid ways.
        |Zhara is sitting up in the rafters with some of her guards, watching over their drills. It's quite the graceful performance: harpies swoop this way and that in coordinated strikes, flanking a mock opponent from above and below with acrobatic lunges. Several eggs are up in their nests nearby, along with a collection of their haphazard armor and weapons.
        |
    ]
    
    [wayfort.hasDaliza
        |A few of Daliza's off-duty lads have been dragged up there as well. Given their state of dishevelment, you have to wonder if some of those eggs are going to be quite frosty for harpies... [wayfort.hasSettlers
            |Some of Lyria's settlers are up there as well, both men and half-sexed elves.
            |
        ]
        |[wayfort.hasSettlers
            |Several of Lyria's settlers have been dragged up there as well. Given their state of dishevelment, you reckon there's going to be a whole new generation of harpies being born and raised in your humble fortress.
            |
        ]
    ]
    
    [zhara.numKids 0 1 2 10
        |
        |Your daughter is sitting with her mom and aunts, watching the goings-on with wide-eyed interest.
        |Your daughters are hanging around the rafters as well, mostly sticking to the largest of the nests up there, but occasionally venturing out to snatch shiny things from other harpies or winging down clumsily to grab food from Rumie.
        |Your absolute horde of harpy chicks are squabbling around up there, kicking up a massive racket. The sheer number of shed feathers falling down around their nest [wayfort.hasMaids
            |will leave your poor maids busy non-stop
            |is enough to make your back ache already with the dread of having to clean all that up
        ].
    ]
rows.translation:
[wayfort.harpiesTGN
        |扎拉正和她的几个同伙躲在屋檐下，策划着下一次的盗窃行动。看到你站在下面，那些女孩们挥了挥手，还大声呼喊着，顿时有一阵羽毛飘了下来，落在了你周围。在它们的巢穴里，可以看到一些鸡蛋，还有大量的琥珀金币、宝石以及其他珠宝，它们在光线的照射下闪烁着绚丽的光芒。
        |扎拉和她的几名护卫一起坐在屋檐下，观察着他们的训练。那场面真是精彩绝伦：那些女妖们协同行动，从四面八方同时发起攻击，用娴熟的技巧从上下两侧包抄假想中的对手。在附近的巢穴里，还放着几颗蛋，以及它们那些杂乱无章的盔甲和武器。
        |
    ]
    
    [wayfort.hasDaliza
        |达莉莎的一些下班后的朋友们也被拉到了那里。看他们那狼狈的样子，真让人怀疑……那些鸡蛋会不会对那些“女妖”们来说太冷了些…… [wayfort.hasSettlers
            |莉莉亚的一些定居者也在那里，其中包括人类和半性别的精灵。
            |
        ]
        |[wayfort.hasSettlers
            |莉莉亚的一些定居者也被带到了那里。看他们那狼狈的样子，你大概可以猜到，在你这座小小的堡垒里，将会有一整代新的女妖诞生并成长起来。
            |
        ]
    ]
    
    [zhara.numKids 0 1 2 10
        |
        |你的女儿正和她的妈妈以及阿姨们坐在一起，睁大眼睛饶有兴致地观察着发生的一切。
        |你的女儿们也躲在屋檐下，大多聚集在最上面的那个鸟巢里，但偶尔也会冒险出来，从其他鹰身女妖那里抢夺闪亮的东西，或者笨拙地飞下来从露米那里获取食物。
        |你们那些该死的雌性鹰身女妖在上面吵得不可开交，弄得一片鸡飞狗跳。有大量的羽毛掉落在它们的巢穴周围[wayfort.hasMaids
            |会让你们那些可怜的女仆们忙个不停呢
            |光是想到之后还得把那些东西都清理干净，就已经让人觉得腰酸背痛了
        ]。
    ]

rows.original: Call Zhara down to talk — or to have a little fun.
rows.translation: 把扎拉叫下来聊聊吧——或者一起玩点乐子。
rows.raw: "Call Zhara down to talk — or to have a little fun."

rows.original: [zhara.isMom |You wave Zhara down from her roost in the rafters — and she doesn't come alone. The proud red-maned [wayfort.harpiesTGN |bandit captain |guard-commander | ] scoops Mitra up onto her shoulders and drifts down, both their wings spread out to control their fall. "Hey, babe — er, boss!" Zhara says, swooping in for a kiss. "Hi, [pc.mf |dad |mom ]!" Mitra chirps, extending her arms in a soft-spoken request for a hug, which you're happy to grant. Her mother smiles proudly as you bounce your little daughter in your arms, rubbing noses with her until she's a giggling mess. When you finally set her down, she's beaming. [var0 |"What a cute one," Agni says, patting Mitra's head. "She's got my hair. What's her name, kid?" Zhara smiles wide. "Mitra here was named after you, Great Grandmama. Once she started to hatch and I saw the red feathers, I couldn't think of another name I'd rather give her." Agnimitra pauses at first, her eyes going from Zhara's, to yours, to Mitra's, back to Zhara's, then stopping on Mitra's. A wide smile slowly spreads across her face, and a faint, high-pitched squeal, coming out more as a whiny exhale at first, reverberates from her throat. As it gets louder, Agnimitra becomes more animated: she reaches down and hooks her hands under Mitra's wings, lifting her up into the air, spinning in circles with her knees lifting as high as her stomach with each step, and she 'eeeeeeeeee!'s with happiness all the while. Agnimitra tries to always find something in life to enjoy, but you haven't seen her quite this excited in a little while. And her joy is infectious: the sound of Mitra's childish giggling undercuts Agnimitra's excited squealing. Her wings spread and her feathers ripple underneath them as Agnimitra twirls her about in the air; Mitra's she's far too young to start flying, but her instincts are kicking in already. Eventually, Agnimitra's arms start to give out, and she slowly lowers Mitra down to the ground, setting her down. Before Mitra leaves, she wraps her feathered arms around Agnimitra's legs, giving her great great grandmama a tight hug. "This is a huge compliment," Agnimitra says to Zhara, spreading her arms to hug her great great granddaughter. Zhara all-too-happily reciprocates. "You know, I know I'm a legend among the harpies and everything, but having something as precious as a child named after you – that's worth more than all of the legendary things I've done over the course of my existence. It makes me feel like my life's started over from the beginning." "Glad I could give you that sort of closure, Great Grandmama," Zhara says with a smile. Agnimitra pauses. "I'd offer to return the favor with my next baby, but... maybe you'd prefer not to have a great great grand-half-sister named after you." Zhara laughs. "I'm sure we'll think of something better." |"So," Zhara says, leaning into your shoulder and tousling Mitra's hair-feathers. "What's brought you our way, boss?" ] |You wave Zhara down from her roost in the rafters, and she comes swooping down with a smile. She plants a kiss on your lips once she's grounded, using the momentum of her descent to spin the both of you around in each others' arms. [zhara.pregStage 3 |One of her feathered hands grasps yours, guiding it down to her gravid egg-belly, letting you feel the undeniable effect your virility's had on her. ] "Hey there, babe — er, boss," Zhara grins. "What's brought you my way?" ]
rows.translation: [zhara.isMom |你把扎拉从屋檐上的栖木上叫下来——她不是一个人来的。那位骄傲的红鬃鹰身女妖[wayfort.harpiesTGN |bandit captain |guard-commander | ]把米特拉扛到自己肩上，然后飘落下来，两人都展开翅膀控制下坠的冲势。 “嘿，宝贝——呃，老板！”扎拉说着，俯身凑过来亲了一口。 “嗨，[pc.mf |dad |mom ]！”米特拉尖声叫道，伸出双臂，轻声请求你抱抱她，你乐于满足。你把小女儿抱在怀里颠着，和她蹭鼻子，直到她笑成一团，她的母亲骄傲地微笑着。等你终于把她放下时，她满脸放光。 [var0 |“真是个可爱的小家伙，”阿格尼说着，拍了拍米特拉的脑袋。“她的头发随我。她叫什么名字，小家伙？” 扎拉咧嘴一笑。“米特拉这名字就是随你起的，曾祖母。她开始破壳、我看到那些红色羽毛的时候，我实在想不出更想给她的名字了。” 阿格尼米特拉先是顿住了，目光从扎拉的眼睛移到你，再到米特拉，又回到扎拉，最后停在米特拉身上。一个灿烂的笑容慢慢在她脸上绽开，一声微弱而尖细的欢叫从她喉咙里震出来，起初更像是一声带着鼻音的呼气。随着声音越来越响，阿格尼米特拉也越来越活跃：她俯身用双手钩住米特拉的翅膀，把她举到空中，一边转圈一边迈步，每迈一步膝盖都抬到与腹部齐平，同时一直开心地咿咿咿咿咿咿咿咿咿地叫着。 阿格尼米特拉总想在生活中找到值得享受的东西，但你已经有一阵子没见她这么兴奋过了。而她的喜悦是有感染力的：米特拉孩子气的咯咯笑声，衬着阿格尼米特拉兴奋的欢叫。阿格尼米特拉在空中转着她，翅膀张开，羽毛在翅下泛起波纹；米特拉还太小，不能开始学飞，但她的本能已经在起作用了。 终于，阿格尼米特拉的胳膊开始撑不住了，她慢慢把米特拉降向地面，放下她。米特拉离开前，用长满羽毛的手臂抱住阿格尼米特拉的腿，给了她的曾曾祖母一个紧紧的拥抱。 “这可是莫大的赞美，”阿格尼米特拉对扎拉说着，张开双臂去抱她的曾曾孙女。扎拉乐不可支地回抱她。“你知道，我知道自己在鹰身女妖里算是个传奇，但能有个像孩子这么珍贵的存在以你命名——那比我这一生做过的所有传奇事迹都更有价值。这让我觉得我的人生又从头开始了。” “很高兴我能给你这样的了结，曾祖母，”扎拉笑着说。 阿格尼米特拉顿了一下。“我本想用我下一个孩子来报答你，不过……也许你并不想要一个以你命名的曾曾半血姐妹吧。” 扎拉笑了。“我相信我们会有更好的办法。” |“那么，”扎拉说着，靠在你肩上，揉乱米特拉的毛羽。“是什么风把你吹到我们这儿来的，老板？” ] |你把扎拉从屋檐上的栖木上叫下来，她微笑着俯冲而下。落地后她在你唇上印下一个吻，借着下落的势头让你们俩在彼此的怀里转了一圈。[zhara.pregStage 3 |她一只长满羽毛的手握住你的手，引着它贴上她那孕育着蛋的腹部，让你感受你的授孕力在她身上确凿无疑的效果。 ] “嘿，宝贝——呃，老板，”扎拉咧嘴笑道。“是什么风把你吹到我这儿来的？” ]

rows.original:
You give a sharp whistle to catch Zhara's attention — and that of several other harpies, all of whom wing down together. They give you just enough time to brace for it before you're bird-piled, wrapped up in wing-hugs and smooched all over by giggling thieves. Zhara sits triumphantly atop the squawking snuggle pile, grinning down at you while her sisters shower you in affection.

    "They just want to say thanks for letting us all stay," she says. You spit out a feather, rubbing harpy cheeks petting wings until their captain finally clicks her tongue, scattering her followers back to your rafters. Zhara saunters up, pulling you back to your feet and into a fierce kiss. Her own wings wrap around your back, and her tongue caresses your lips. "And so do I..." 
    
    She grins, letting you take back the initiative and hug her back. You squeeze the red-headed harpy against your chest, giving her a kiss back. 
    
    "So!" Zhara says when you finally let her go. "You need something, boss? Maybe me?"
rows.translation:
你吹了一声尖锐的口哨，想引起扎拉的注意——同时也引来另外几只鹰身女妖，她们一起俯冲下来。她们只给了你刚好足够的时间做好准备，接着你就被一群鸟儿扑倒，被羽翼的拥抱裹住，被咯咯笑着的小偷们亲了个遍。扎拉得意洋洋地坐在那堆叽叽喳喳、挤作一团的鸟群上，冲你咧嘴笑着，而她的姐妹们则纷纷向你表达亲昵。

    “她们只是想感谢你让我们大家都能留下来，”她说。你吐出一根羽毛，揉着鹰身女妖们的脸颊、抚摸着她们的翅膀，直到她们的首领终于啧了一声，把她的追随者们打发回你头顶的屋梁。扎拉款款走来，把你拉起来，给了你一个热烈的吻。她自己的翅膀环住你的背，舌尖轻抚着你的嘴唇。“我也是……” 
    
    她咧嘴一笑，让你重新掌握主动，回抱了她。你把这位红发鹰身女妖紧紧搂在胸前，回吻了她。 
    
    “所以！”当你终于放开她时，扎拉说道，“你需要什么吗，老板？也许需要我？”

Several of her underlings follow her, flapping and squawking until their leader has to reach back and bap them on the heads. "Quiet down. The rest of the flock coos at you both, giggling about how cute you and your daughter are and how she has your eyes. "I'm glad she's gonna get to see you more, now," Zhara says, ruffling the chick's hair-feathers. "She doesn't talk all that much yet, but when she does, she says she wants to see you." "All the time!" your daughter confirms. "Our new house is sooooo big. I love it!" Zhara grins. "Now you've finally got somewhere safe to grow up, Mitra. I love it too. And maybe a couple other people around here," she adds with a wink in your direction. Agnimitra perks her head up, twisting it towards you and Zhara. "Yeah?" she asks. You tell her that nobody was talking to her. "Really? I thought I just heard my name." "Actually," Zhara says, her hand resting on Mitra's head and giving her feathers a ruffle, "Mitra was named after you, Great Grandmama. Once she started to hatch and I saw the red feathers, I couldn't think of another name I'd rather give her."
