rows.raw: ' As soon as Zhara catches you looking her way, she scoops up one of the handful of young harpies roosting up there with the rest of the thieves, a girl with sun-kissed skin, a shock of red feathery hair, and big gold eyes. You recognize her immediately — how could you not? She's yours. Zhara wings down with the young girl in her arms, presenting her to you like a prize once she's landed. Several of her underlings follow her, flapping and squawking until their leader has to reach back and bap them on the heads. "Quiet down. I know you all wanna thank [pc.name], but right now, [pc.heShe] needs to say hi to [pc.hisHer] daughter." [agni.around |She's the first to speak, though: "Hi, [pc.mf |dad |mom ]!" Your heart melts instantly, and you scoop the little harpy into your arms and shower her with kisses, hugging her tight. The rest of the flock coos at you both, giggling about how cute you and your daughter are and how she has your eyes. "I'm glad she's gonna get to see you more, now," Zhara says, ruffling the chick's hair-feathers. "She doesn't talk all that much yet, but when she does, she says she wants to see you." "All the time!" your daughter confirms. "Our new house is sooooo big. I love it!" Zhara grins. "Now you've finally got somewhere safe to grow up, Mitra. I love it too. And maybe a couple other people around here," she adds with a wink in your direction. Agnimitra perks her head up, twisting it towards you and Zhara. "Yeah?" she asks. You tell her that nobody was talking to her. "Really? I thought I just heard my name." "Actually," Zhara says, her hand resting on Mitra's head and giving her feathers a ruffle, "Mitra was named after you, Great Grandmama. Once she started to hatch and I saw the red feathers, I couldn't think of another name I'd rather give her." Agnimitra pauses at first, her eyes going from Zhara's, to yours, to Mitra's, back to Zhara's, then stopping on Mitra's. A wide smile slowly spreads across her face, and a faint, high-pitched squeal, coming out more as a whiny exhale at first, reverberates from her throat. As it gets louder, Agnimitra becomes more animated: she reaches down and hooks her hands under Mitra's wings, lifting her up into the air, spinning in circles with her knees lifting as high as her stomach with each step, and she 'eeeeeeeeee!'s with happiness all the while. Agnimitra tries to always find something in life to enjoy, but you haven't seen her quite this excited in a little while. And her joy is infectious: the sound of Mitra's childish giggling undercuts Agnimitra's excited squealing. Her wings spread and her feathers ripple underneath them as Agnimitra twirls her about in the air; Mitra's far too young to start flying, but her instincts are kicking in already. Eventually, Agnimitra's arms start to give out, and she slowly lowers Mitra down to the ground, setting her down. Before Mitra leaves, she wraps her feathered arms around Agnimitra's legs, giving her great great grandmama a tight hug. "This is a huge compliment," Agnimitra says to Zhara, spreading her arms to hug her great great granddaughter. Zhara all-too-happily reciprocates. "You know, I know I'm a legend among the harpies and everything, but having something as precious as a child named after you – that's worth more than all of the legendary things I've done over the course of my existence. It makes me feel like my life's started over from the beginning." "Glad I could give you that sort of closure, Great Grandmama," Zhara says with a smile. Agnimitra pauses. "I'd offer to return the favor with my next baby, but... maybe you'd prefer not to have a great great grand-half-sister named after you." Zhara laughs. "I'm sure we'll think of something better." |She's the first to speak, though: "Hi, [pc.mf |dad |mom ]!"                 |Zhara covers Mitra's ears for a moment. 
            ]"Well, most of the girls are more interested in plying the world's oldest trade than bein' craftsmen, but I have thought about doin' a little alchemy brewing on the side. Not a cheapskate's profession, considering alchemy literally chews up 'leccy hawks, but if you start having people come through here more, I might be convinced. rows.translation: 扎拉的故事究竟是怎样的呢？

rows.original: "So, about your mother..." "Was wonderin' when you'd bring her up," Zhara says easily, leaning back against the fortress's wall. "I hear she was the first thing you saw when you went to the hills. Must have left an impression, huh?" [pc.isCunning |You nod. "Mostly I'm just wondering how she flies. I mean, the woman's enormous." Zhara cackles. "Yeah? Sorra's blessing runs strong in her, what can you say! She flies cuz she wants to, not 'cause she ought to." [party.comp azyrran |Azzy coughs awkwardly behind you. ] |That's one way to put it. "Had never seen a woman with those proportions before." Zhara chuckles. "You're just wondering how she flies, yeah? Who can say, other than Sorra? The goddess's blessing runs strong in my mother, that's for sure." ] "Clearly! So, can you tell me how she got Sorra's blessing?" The red-feathered harpy shrugs. "Not... really? I mean, we harpies are all Sorra's chosen people, that much is obvious. We're all her daughters, flying free through her skies! But some of us, like mom, they get more from the Chainbreaker than just gentle winds and easy birthing. Apparently there was this huge war around here a long time ago. One of mom's moms fought in it, I think, and caught Sorra's eye. There's nothing the goddess approves of more than layin' your life on the line to keep others free, and I guess my ancestor did that in the big war, so before the last big battle Sorra came down directly and embraced her. Filled her with the power of the stormwinds. At least, that's the story mom tells." "Surely there's more details?" "Aha, well, maybe if I paid more attention to bedtime stories I'd remember. That was always Shar's thing — mom always spoiled that little mutant with the longest stories, staying up all night sometimes with her till the moon's full in the heavens. Me, I barely remember the basics, sorry. I just know my ancestors fought against some horrible monsters a long time ago, and Sorra loves us more than usual because of it. You ever go up mountain-side and you'll probably find that out for yourself. A lot of my sisters become Sorran paladins and priests, but they don't tend to leave the mountaintops much. Closer to their goddess up there, I guess." "But anyway," Zhara continues after a moment spent shaking her head. "You were asking about my mom, huh? So, Matron Shaedra — Great Mother of the Northern Peaks, She Who is Beloved of Sorra[silly |, the Storm That is Approaching ], better known by hundreds of harpies as just 'mom' — leads our tribe up on the top of the mountain. She's made her nest up in this old Khor'minoan bath house up there, built on top of a hotspring. Been there since before I was born. I guess the bulls forgot about it after the war. They forgot a lot of their stuff up there[silly |. Free real estate! |, but we aren't complaining. ] My mother's a real heir to the old ways, so that suits her. She's got loads of books, and she knows all sorts of magic. She said there used to be a time when she was my size, all lithe and nimble, and was good with a sword and at thieving. I'm not sure I really believe it — she's been Lumia's own image for generations of sisters before me." "You make it sound like she's [pc.isBimbo |suuuuuper duper old |ancient ]," you say. Zhara shrugs. "We harpies breed quick, [mitra.met |as you well know! |you know. ] We can go through six generations before one human babe goes from the cradle to her first pregnancy. She's long lost count of how many generations she's raised up there in the mountains, but I know I've got at least ten generations of older sisters up there. All kinds of dads, too, from minotaurs to lupines to a vulperine lady all the way from the south coast. Mom ain't picky, that's for sure. And it means we've got girls that're huge and buff, lithe and clever, and everything in between." "Do you know who yours was?" you ask. "Yeah! Mom said he was one of her favorites, too, this salamander guy from way down south. He's where I get my feather-color from!" Zhara preens, smoothing out the feathers of her hair. "I was their first, matter of fact! He was this adventurer that came to see if the Great Mother of the Northern Peaks really was so beloved of Sorra. Turned out she was, and I guess he liked that so much that he stayed with her. I even knew him, for a while. He stayed with the tribe for a couple years, head buried in mom's library — when it wasn't buried in her chest, giving me sisters. Lotta sisters." She chuckles, smiling fondly. "He's the one that taught me how to use a blade, how to rake in hawks at any kind of card or dice game, even how to hunt. Sharpened the whole tribe's thieving skills while he was with us, too, showed us things from all around the old empire. Lockbreaking, shadowing, filching from pockets. He could do it all." "Sounds like a talented man. Where is he now, do you know?" "Nah," Zhara shrugs. "He packed up about five years back, a bit after the last of his kids with mom hatched. Said that 'wayfarers don't put down roots. Adventure calls, always,' and he was 'getting restless.' It's... why I'm glad you're here, with this whole fort of yours, y'know? Proved him wrong about all of your kind, at least. [mitra.met |I'm glad lil' Mitra's gonna get to grow up with both parents around, all her life. |Your kids are gonna be thankful, trust me. ] But enough about that..."
rows.translation: 那么，关于你母亲的事……” “我一直在想你什么时候会提起她，”扎拉轻松地说道，背靠着堡垒的墙壁。“听说当你第一次去那片山丘的时候，第一个看到的就是她。那一定给你留下了深刻的印象吧？ [pc.isCunning |你点了点头，说道：“主要是我想知道她是怎么飞行的。毕竟，那个女人体型实在太大了。” 扎拉哈哈大笑起来：“是吗？索拉的祝福在她身上发挥了巨大的作用，你怎么能这么说呢！她飞行是因为她自己想飞，而不是因为‘应该’这样做。 [party.comp azyrran |阿齐在你身后尴尬地咳嗽了一声。 ] |也可以这么说吧。“我以前从来没见过身材如此完美的女性。” 扎拉轻笑了一声：“你只是想知道她是怎么飞行的吧？除了索拉，还有谁知道呢？我母亲身上确实流淌着女神的恩赐，这一点是肯定的。 ] 显然！那么，你能告诉我她是怎么得到索拉的祝福的吗？” 红羽毛的哈比耸了耸肩：“嗯……其实不太清楚。我的意思是，我们哈比都是索拉选中的人，这一点很明显。我们都是她的女儿们，在她的天空下自由飞翔！但像妈妈这样的一些人，从“碎链者”中获得的东西，远不止是和风与顺利的分娩。显然，很久以前这里发生过一场大规模的战争。我想，妈妈的母亲曾经参加过那场战争，而正是她吸引了索拉的注意。没有什么比为了保护他人而甘愿冒生命危险更能让这位女神感到欣慰的了。我想我的祖先在那场大战中就是这么做的，所以在最后那场决定性的战役之前，索拉亲自降临，拥抱了她。赋予了她风暴之风的力量。至少，妈妈是这么说的。 肯定还有更多的细节吧？” “啊，也许如果我多花些时间听睡前故事，就能记起来了。这一直都是莎尔的爱好——妈妈总是用最长的故事来宠溺那个小变种人，有时候甚至会陪她熬到月亮高悬在夜空中的时候。我呢，对这些基本的事情几乎没什么印象，实在抱歉。我只知道很久以前，我的祖先们曾与一些可怕的怪物进行过战斗，而正因为如此，索拉才会比平时更加关心我们。如果你有机会去山边看看，或许就能亲自了解到这些事情了。我的很多姐妹都成为了索拉圣骑士和祭司，但她们通常不会离开那些山顶。我想，这样就能更接近她们那里的女神了吧。 不过，”扎拉摇摇头后继续说道，“你之前是问起我妈妈的，对吧？那么，主母沙德拉——北峰伟大的母亲，那位深受索拉眷恋的女性[silly |那场即将到来的风暴 ]那位被数百只女妖们亲切地称为“妈妈”的女性，带领着我们的部落登上了山顶。她在那里的一座古老的科尔米诺亚浴场里筑起了自己的巢穴，那座浴场正是建在温泉之上。在我出生之前，那里就已经存在了。我想，战争过后，那些雄性首领们应该把那里给忘了吧……他们把很多东西都忘在了那里。[silly |免费的房地产！ |不过我们并没有抱怨。 ]我母亲真的是那种坚守传统的人，所以这种生活方式很适合她。她拥有大量的书籍，也掌握着各种各样的魔法。她说，在她还是我这个年纪的时候，身体非常灵活敏捷，既擅长使用剑术，也擅长偷窃。不过我不太确定是否该相信她的话——在我之前的几代姐妹中，她一直都是卢米娅的翻版啊。 你把她说得好像她真的是那样的人一样[pc.isBimbo |老得离谱 |古老的 ]是吗？”你说道。 扎拉耸了耸肩：“我们这些女妖繁殖能力很强，很快就能够增加数量了。 [mitra.met |如你们所知！ |你知道的。 ]我们可以开始吧。六在一个人类婴儿从出生到首次怀孕之前，已经经历了许多代人。她早已记不清自己在山上养育了多少代人，但我知道，我的那些姐姐们至少属于十代之前的人了。也有各种各样的父亲，从弥诺陶洛斯到狼族，再到那位来自南海岸的狐狸女郎。妈妈肯定不会挑剔，这一点毫无疑问。这意味着我们的女儿们有的身材高大强壮，有的敏捷聪慧，还有各种类型的女孩子。你知道你的那个是谁吗？”你问道。 “知道啊！妈妈说他也是她最喜欢的人之一，就是那个来自南方的小蝾螈。我的羽毛颜色就是从他那里得到的！”扎拉一边说，一边整理着自己头上的羽毛。事实上，我是他们的第一个孩子！他是一个冒险者，前来验证北方山脉的伟大母亲是否真的是深受索拉的喜爱。后来我发现，他确实非常喜欢她，因此才选择留在她身边。有段时间，我甚至还与他相识。他在部落里待了几年，大部分时间都埋头研究妈妈收藏的书籍——当然，也有时候会依偎在妈妈的怀里，而正是这样，他才让我有了姐妹们。好多姐妹啊。” 她轻笑着，脸上洋溢着温柔的笑容：“就是他教会了我如何使用刀刃，如何在任何纸牌或骰子游戏中赢取胜利，甚至是如何狩猎的。在他和我们在一起的日子里，他还提升了整个部落的偷窃技巧，还向我们介绍了关于古老帝国的各种知识。撬锁、跟踪、从口袋里偷东西，这些他全都擅长。” “听起来真是个有能力的人。你现在知道他在哪里吗？” “不知道，”扎拉耸了耸肩，“大概五年前吧，就在他的孩子们都离开妈妈之后，他就离开了。他说：“流浪者从不会安定下来。冒险总是在召唤他们，”而他显然“变得坐立不安”。正因为如此，我才会很高兴你来到了这里，带着你那整个堡垒，你知道的吧？至少，这证明了你这样的人并非他所说的那样。 [mitra.met |我很高兴小米特拉能够在这种环境中成长。两者都她的一生，身边始终有父母陪伴。 |相信我，你的孩子们会为此感到庆幸的。 ]但关于这个话题，我们就说到这里吧……

rows.original: Ask Zhara about her enormous mother...
rows.translation: 去问问扎拉关于她那位体型庞大的母亲的事吧……

rows.original: "I take it you follow Sorra, yourself?" you venture. Zhara nods proudly. "I do, of course — the whole tribe does, [flags.TODO_HARPY_MATRON_DEFEATED||from mother, who's got the goddess's own favor, ]all the way down to the youngest firebrands among us. Our whole race is close to her, you know? That's why Sorra looks like us, 'cept for her wings being on her back; or maybe we look like her? You'd have to ask one of the priestesses that." The harpy chuckles. "But yeah, I'm a believer. Why wouldn't I be? I give her my prayers, and a tenth of the coin I take in goes tithed to the priestesses like it ought to, and in return... look where I am! Here, with you, lady of our very own keep! [mitra.met |I've got [zhara.numKids 1 2 |our beautiful daughter |our growing flock ], too! ]And don't forget that even if there's some kinda demon war goin' on, you and I are safe and healthy, can't argue with that." "You think Sorra did all that for you?" "Sure. Certainly helped," Zhara says. "Look, my goddess, she's the lady that sends clear skies to fly in, and storms to wrack your foes. Every day I can soar towards the clouds and come back unstruck by lightning, that's Sorra's hand protecting me. Every day that my sisters and I dodge Minoan slavers coming up to hunt for pleasure-girls they can sell to the nobles, that's Sorra's inspiration to our dodging around, or her sending distractions to keep the bastards at bay. You can't look at me, where I am, where my sisters are, and tell me we don't live a blessed life!" "Aside from a tithe, what does your goddess ask of you in return?" Zhara runs a hand through her feather-hair. "Should ask a priestess that, not a thief. I'm halfway to Keros' hands whether I like it or not," she laughs. "But I can tell you what I know. What I do. Sorra tells us to oppose slavery and other forms of bondage, so me and the girls will always target slavers. Free their 'goods' when we can. She tells us to sing to the heavens, to fill the world with song, so when we go to temple at night, we sing hymns for the goddess. Even when there's no priestess around, the girls and I like to sing at sunset; it's our way of wishing Sorra goodnight." "[pc.dcb |Just don't keep me up with that racket," you groan. |I'll look forward to hearing you before I sleep, then," you tell her. You know Zhara's got a good voice for moaning; it'll surely be even more beautiful for singing. |Awww, that's so sweet!" you giggle. "You've got such a pretty voice, too!" ] "So yeah, that's my faith. Give the goddess her due, and she keeps the skies clear for me and mine. I'm sure one of my paladin sisters could tell you all about the deeper mysteries of the cult, but that's all I need to know."
rows.translation: “我猜，你自己也信奉索拉？”你试探道。 扎拉骄傲地点头。“当然——整个部族都信奉，[flags.TODO_HARPY_MATRON_DEFEATED||从得到女神亲自眷顾的母亲，]一直到我们最年轻的热血姑娘。我们整个种族都和她很亲近，知道吧？所以索拉和我们长得一样，只不过翅膀位于后背；或者是我们长得像她？这得问女祭司。”鹰身女妖轻笑。“总之，我是信徒。为什么不信？我向她祈祷，把收入的十分之一照规矩献给女祭司；作为回报……看看我在哪里！就在这里，和你在一起，成了我们自己要塞的女主人！[mitra.met |我还有[zhara.numKids 1 2 |我们美丽的女儿 |我们不断壮大的鸟群 ]！ ]别忘了，即使外面正在打什么恶魔战争，你和我依旧安全健康。没人能反驳。” “你认为索拉替你做了这一切？” “当然。肯定有所帮助。”扎拉说道。“听着，我的女神会送来适合飞行的晴空，也会降下风暴折磨敌人。每一天，我能飞向云端，又不被闪电击中，都是索拉之手在保护我。每一天，我和姐妹们躲开上山狩猎、想把我们当玩乐姑娘卖给贵族的米诺斯奴隶贩子，都是索拉启发我们躲避，或派出干扰挡住那些混蛋。你不能看着我、看着我现在的位置、看着我的姐妹，然后说我们没有过上受祝福的生活！” “除了什一税，你的女神要求什么回报？” 扎拉一手梳过羽毛般的长发。“这种事该问女祭司，不该问小偷。不管喜欢与否，我已经半只脚落进凯罗斯手里。”她笑道。“不过可以告诉你我知道什么，告诉你我会做什么。索拉命令我们反抗奴隶制和其他形式的束缚，所以我和姑娘们始终会把奴隶贩子当作目标，尽可能解放他们的‘货物’。她命令我们向天空歌唱，让世界充满歌声；所以夜里去神殿时，我们会为女神唱赞歌。即使没有女祭司在场，我和姑娘们也喜欢在日落时歌唱；这是我们向索拉道晚安的方式。” “[pc.dcb |只要别用那噪声吵得我睡不着。”你呻吟道。 |那我会期待睡前听见你的歌声。”你告诉她。你知道扎拉呻吟时嗓音动听；唱歌一定更美。 |哇，太甜蜜了！”你咯咯笑道。“而且你的声音这么好听！” ] “所以没错，这就是我的信仰。给予女神应得的敬意，她便会为我与族人维持晴朗天空。我相信自己的某位圣骑士姐妹能告诉你教团更深层的一切奥秘，不过知道这些就够了。”

[mitra.met |I've got [zhara.numKids 1 2 |our beautiful daughter |our growing flock ], too! ]And don't forget that even if there's some kinda demon war goin' on, you and I are safe and healthy, can't argue with that." Every day that my sisters and I dodge Minoan slavers coming up to hunt for pleasure-girls they can sell to the nobles, that's Sorra's inspiration to our dodging around, or her sending distractions to keep the bastards at bay. You can't look at me, where I am, where my sisters are, and tell me we don't live a blessed life!" "Aside from a tithe, what does your goddess ask of you in return?" Zhara runs a hand through her feather-hair. "Should ask a priestess that, not a thief. I'm halfway to Keros' hands whether I like it or not," she laughs. "But I can tell you what I know. What I do. Sorra tells us to oppose slavery and other forms of bondage, so me and the girls will always target slavers. Free their 'goods' when we can. She tells us to sing to the heavens, to fill the world with song, so when we go to temple at night, we sing hymns for the goddess. Even when there's no priestess around, the girls and I like to sing at sunset; it's our way of wishing Sorra goodnight." "[pc.dcb |Just don't keep me up with that racket," you groan. |I'll look forward to hearing you before I sleep, then," you tell her. "You've got such a pretty voice, too!" ] "So yeah, that's my faith. Give the goddess her due, and she keeps the skies clear for me and mine. I'm sure one of my paladin sisters could tell you all about the deeper mysteries of the cult, but that's all I need to know.""

rows.original: How're Zhara and the gang enjoying the fort so far?
rows.translation: 扎拉和她的伙伴们现在对这座堡垒感觉怎么样呢？
rows.raw: "How're Zhara and the gang enjoying the fort so far?"

rows.original: "How's your family been dealing with the demons?" Zhara just shrugs. "They haven't really made it up to the mountaintops. We've seen a couple of small expeditions poking around, grabbing a few of my sisters, but it's nothing compared to what's going on down here. The girls and I see whole hordes of imps rampaging around in the fjord, or deeper in the forest. We tear 'em up when we can, of course, but it doesn't seem to make a dent in their numbers. And then there's the real demons. Not as many of them, but they're much more dangerous. Unless they're threatening us or the fort directly, we try to give them a wide berth." You scratch your chin. "So it's a lot safer on the peaks?" "For now." Zhara thumbs her dagger on her belt. "But the bath house we all live in up there, it's not a fortress. We have powerful storm-witches and Sorran godspeakers, but that'd only do so much if the hordes come bubbling up from Undermountain and attack us instead. That's part of why the girls and I left. Sure, there're more demons around here in the woods now, but you've got walls. Battlements. [wayfort.hasGuards |Troops! |Someday it'll have troops. I hope. ] I'd rather take my chances with you, here, than up in a centuries-old ruin that was built to be open and welcoming to start with." "But you said some of your sisters have been taken?" Zhara's scaled fingers close around the pommel. "Yes. When the first demons came up-mountain, my sisters just thought they were any other travelers. Bird-brained idiots. They got grabbed and taken back down to Undermountain, and we never saw hide or feather of them again. If some of the young chicks hadn't been watching from a higher peak, we'd never even have known they were taken rather than just... saw somebody hot enough to go off with 'em. That happens all the time. But this was different. To us Sorrans, taking captives against their will is the worst sin. And I think the demons knew." "So yeah, I hate them. We all hate them." Zhara snarls. "And I'm happy to help you tear these fiends a new one if they come calling at our home."
rows.translation: “你的家人怎样应对恶魔？” 扎拉只是耸肩。“它们没有真正登上山顶。我们见过几支小型队伍四处探查、抓走几名姐妹，不过和这里的状况相比根本不算什么。我和姑娘们见过整群小恶魔在峡湾里横行，或是在更深的森林肆虐。有机会时，我们当然会把它们撕碎，可数量似乎根本没少。还有真正的恶魔。数量不多，却危险得多。除非它们直接威胁我们或驿堡，否则我们尽量远远避开。” 你挠挠下巴。“所以山顶安全得多？” “暂时如此。”扎拉用拇指拨弄腰带上的匕首。“可我们大家住在上面的浴场，那不是要塞。我们有强大的风暴女巫和索拉神谕者；不过，若大军从山腹深域涌出，转而袭击我们，这些力量的作用终究有限。这就是我和姑娘们离开的部分原因。当然，森林里现在有更多恶魔，可你有城墙、城垛，[wayfort.hasGuards |还有部队！ |总有一天也会有部队，我希望如此。 ]我宁愿在这里与你一起冒险，也不想留在那座数百年前建造、从一开始就追求开放好客的废墟里。” “但你说过，一些姐妹被抓走了？” 扎拉覆有鳞片的手指扣紧刀柄。“没错。最初的恶魔登山时，我的姐妹只当它们是普通旅客。满脑羽毛的白痴。她们被抓住，带回山腹深域；此后，我们连一片皮肤或羽毛都没见过。如果不是几只年轻小鸟在更高的山峰看着，我们甚至永远不会知道她们是遭到绑架，而不是……看见某个性感到值得跟随的人。这种事时常发生。但那一次不同。对我们索拉信徒而言，违背他人意愿将其俘虏，是最严重的罪孽。而且我认为恶魔知道。” “所以没错，我憎恨它们。我们全都憎恨它们。”扎拉咆哮道。“那些恶魔若找上我们的家门，我很乐意帮你把它们撕出新洞。”

She'll hatch in a month or so, but right now I'm gonna have my hands full keeping her warm and loved... but I can spare a few moments for you still, I 'spose!" "That's great," you say with a relieved sigh, which turns into an excited smile. You kiss Zhara over and over, congratulating her on delivering that big ol' egg safely. She giggles and nuzzles into your chest, wings wrapping around your back. "Another girl for your growing flock. You're a lucky [pc.mf |man |lady ], you know that?" "Don't I know it." |A pair of harpies wing down from the rafters as you're walking by, grabbing you by the arms and hauling you airborne with gusto. You have just enough time to yelp before you're pulled up to the flock's nesting ground and presented to a sweat-sheened, gasping Zhara. The wingleader's on her back with her legs spread wide, shamelessly showing off her feathery bush and glistening thighs. But that's not what catches your eye — it's the big, round egg between her legs, still covered in goo, that consumes all of your adoration. "H-hey, tiger," Zhara groans, pushing herself up onto her elbows. "Look what I just made you..." "That's a big egg," you tell her, leaning down to gently caress it. "Are you okay?" She chuckles. "Oh, yeah. Sorra's gift to us harpies — laying eggs' the best feeling in the world. Surprised you didn't hear the moanin' from across the river. You're right though, that is a big'n." With some effort, the wingleader sits herself up and wraps her thighs around the egg, caressing it in both her feathery arms. "Yours and mine, lover. Our firstborn daughter. She's gonna be such a treasure, I can tell already." "I can't wait to meet her," you say. "How long until she hatches?" "'Bout a month, give or take, but it'll be closer to three or four before she can leave the nest. When she's ready, I'll make sure you get to meet. Until then, she needs peace and quiet and mommy's warmth. Now, I love you and all, but I gotta rest some." The wingleader clicks her tongue at her sisters, who quickly grab you and pull you back down to the ground floor. One of them giggles once you're away, whispering to you, "Harpy moms get real jealous when they're nesting! Even of their mates sometimes. Don't worry, she'll come around when the time's right, and you've got a pretty new daughter to meet!" You guess you'll be biding your time, then... ]"

rows.original: When you call Zhara down from her perch in the rafters, she doesn't come alone. The red-feathered wingleader leaps down to greet you with her arms wrapped around a bundle of young harpy, which she presents to you with a smile. Like her, the younger harpy has shockingly red hair-feathers, and big eyes full of intense curiosity that drink you in. "She's finally ready to leave the nest!" Zhara says with a smile. "Our firstborn — our little Mitra! Sweetie, say hi to [pc.mf |papa |mommy number two ]." "H-hi..." Mitra murmurs, staring at you with those big gold eyes of hers. "Ain't she a beaut?" Zhara kisses the top of your daughter's head. "Takes after me, huh." You smile and take the offered bundle of young harpy. By human standards she looks three years old or so, but you know she can't be more than a few months. Harpies grow up quick, you guess. The small bird-girl wiggles her winged arms until you scoop her up under her tail and hold her like a proper princess close to your chest, which earns you a little chirping coo and a giggle. "She doesn't talk much yet, and she's kinda shy," Zhara says, "but she's getting bigger and stronger all the time. Our beautiful baby girl..." The pride in her voice is infectious. Soon you're staring down at the harpy chick in your arms, booping her nose and tickling her feathers, smiling ear to ear — just like she is. "Thank you again for letting us move in, tiger," Zhara says, reaching in to caress some ginger feathers. "I'm real glad our little'n is going to get to grow up around her [pc.mf |dad and mom |moms ]. Most harpies only get the one — but not our little Mitra." [party.has agni | Agnimitra perks her head up, twisting it towards you and Zhara. "Yeah?" she asks. You tell her that nobody was talking to her. "Really? I thought I just heard my name." "Actually," Zhara says, her hand resting on Mitra's head and giving her feathers a ruffle, "Mitra was named after you, Great Grandmama. Once she started to hatch and I saw the red feathers, I couldn't think of another name I'd rather give her." Agnimitra pauses at first, her eyes going from Zhara's, to yours, to Mitra's, back to Zhara's, then stopping on Mitra's. A wide smile slowly spreads across her face, and a faint, high-pitched squeal, coming out more as a whiny exhale at first, reverberates from her throat. As it gets louder, Agnimitra becomes more animated: she reaches down and hooks her hands under Mitra's wings, lifting her up into the air, spinning in circles with her knees lifting as high as her stomach with each step, and she 'eeeeeeeeee!'s with happiness all the while. Agnimitra tries to always find something in life to enjoy, but you haven't seen her quite this excited in a little while. And her joy is infectious: the sound of Mitra's childish giggling undercuts Agnimitra's excited squealing. Her wings spread and her feathers ripple underneath them as Agnimitra twirls her about in the air; Mitra's she's far too young to start flying, but her instincts are kicking in already. Eventually, Agnimitra's arms start to give out, and she slowly lowers Mitra down to the ground, setting her down. Before Mitra leaves, she wraps her feathered arms around Agnimitra's legs, giving her great great grandmama a tight hug. "This is a huge compliment," Agnimitra says to Zhara, spreading her arms to hug her great great granddaughter. Zhara all-too-happily reciprocates. "You know, I know I'm a legend among the harpies and everything, but having something as precious as a child named after you – that's worth more than all of the legendary things I've done over the course of my existence. It makes me feel like my life's started over from the beginning." "Glad I could give you that sort of closure, Great Grandmama," Zhara says with a smile. Agnimitra pauses. "I'd offer to return the favor with my next baby, but... maybe you'd prefer not to have a great great grand-half-sister named after you." Zhara laughs. "I'm sure we'll think of something better. ] You hand the little harpy back to her mom, and give both of them a kiss. "I hope she's not going to be spending all her time up there in the nest." Zhara smirks. "Nah, don't you worry, she'll be running around the whole fort before too long. And flying, too. I hope you're ready for all the mischief a flying kiddo can get up to." "I'm looking forward to it."
rows.translation: 当你把扎拉从屋檐上的栖息处叫下来时，她并没有独自前来。这位红羽毛的领头鸟跳下来迎接你，怀里还抱着一群小女妖，她微笑着把这些小家伙递给你。和扎拉一样，这些小女妖也拥有令人惊叹的红色羽毛，以及充满强烈好奇心的大眼睛，它们的目光仿佛能穿透你的内心。 “她终于准备好离开巢穴了！”扎拉笑着说，“我们的第一个孩子——我们的小米特拉！亲爱的，跟它们打个招呼吧[pc.mf |爸爸 |第二个妈妈 ]嗨……”米特拉用她那双金色的大眼睛盯着你，轻声说道。 “她真漂亮，不是吗？”扎拉亲了亲你女儿的头顶，“长得跟我像，对吧？” 你微笑着，接过了她递过来的那捆小女妖。按照人类的标准来看，她看起来大概只有三岁左右，但实际上她的年龄应该不超过几个月。想必，这些鹰身女妖的成长速度确实很快吧。这个小小的鸟儿女孩会不停地摆动她那有翅膀的胳膊，直到你把她抱在尾巴下面，像抱着一位真正的公主一样把她紧紧贴在胸口，这时她就会发出轻柔的鸣叫声，还会开心地笑起来。 她现在还不太爱说话，而且有点害羞，”扎拉说道，“但她一直在慢慢长大，也越来越强壮了。我们美丽的小女儿……” 她语气中流露出的自豪之情极具感染力。很快，你就会捧着怀中的小女妖，轻轻捏她的鼻子、挠她的羽毛，然后也会像她一样，笑得合不拢嘴。 再次感谢你允许我们搬进来，老虎，”扎拉说着，伸手抚摸着那些姜黄色的羽毛，“我真的很高兴我们的孩子能够在她身边长大。 [pc.mf |爸爸以及妈妈 |妈妈们 ]大多数女妖都只能得到一个——但我们的小米特拉除外。 [party.has agni | 阿格尼米特拉抬起头，将头转向你和扎拉。“嗯？”她问道。 你告诉她，其实并没有人在和她说话。 “真的吗？我还以为自己听到有人叫我的名字呢。” “其实，”扎拉说着，把手放在米特拉的头上，轻轻拨了拨它的羽毛，“米特拉这个名字就是以你命名的，伟大的祖母。当它开始孵化，我看到它那红色的羽毛时，我就想不出还有哪个名字更适合它了。 阿格尼米特拉先是停住了动作，她的目光在扎拉、你，然后是米特拉之间来回移动，最终停在了米特拉身上。她的脸上渐渐浮现出一丝灿烂的笑容，接着，从她喉咙里发出了一声微弱而尖锐的叫声——起初那声音更像是一声抱怨般的呼气，但随后逐渐变成了连续的声响。随着声音越来越大，阿格尼米特拉的动作也变得越发激烈：她俯身将双手搭在米特拉的翅膀下，将其举到空中，然后开始旋转起来，每走一步，她的膝盖都会抬得几乎与腹部持平，同时她还会开心地“咿————！”个不停。 阿格尼米特拉总是努力在生活中找到让自己开心的东西，但你已经有一段时间没有看到她如此兴奋过了。她的喜悦具有感染力：米特拉那孩子气的咯咯笑声，让阿格尼米特拉兴奋的尖叫声听起来更加欢快。阿格尼米特拉在空中旋转着，她的翅膀展开，羽毛在空气中飘动；而米特拉虽然还太小，还不能开始飞行，但她的天性已经开始发挥作用了。 最终，阿格尼米特拉的双臂开始无力，她缓缓地将米特拉放倒在地上。在米特拉离开之前，她用自己那布满羽毛的双臂紧紧抱住了阿格尼米特拉的腿，给了这位曾祖母一个深情的拥抱。 这真是莫大的赞美，”阿格尼米特拉对扎拉说道，她张开双臂想要拥抱自己的曾孙女。扎拉也非常高兴地回应了她的拥抱。“你知道，我在女妖一族中确实是个传奇人物，但有一个以你的名字命名的孩子，这种荣誉对我来说，比我在这一生中所做过的所有传奇事迹都要重要得多。这让我感觉自己的生活仿佛重新开始了一般。 很高兴能给您这样的一个了结，曾祖母，”扎拉微笑着说。 阿格尼米特拉停顿了一下。“我本想用我的下一个孩子来回报您，但是……也许您并不希望有一个以您的名字命名的曾曾孙女吧。 扎拉笑了起来：“我相信我们一定能想出更好的办法来。 ] 你把那只小女妖送回她妈妈身边，然后亲了她们母女俩一下。“希望她不会把所有时间都花在那个鸟巢里吧。” 扎拉咧嘴笑了：“放心吧，用不了多久她就会在整个堡垒里到处跑来跑去，还会开始飞呢。希望你能做好应对一个会飞的小家伙可能会惹的麻烦的准备。” “我倒很期待呢。

rows.original: "[pc.name]!" You pause in your tracks, unaccustomed to hearing your given name on Daliza's lips so forcefully[daliza.fucked | anywhere outside of the bedroom ]. The bailiff is closing on your flank, lips drawn tight and fingers locked around her swordbelt... while Mitra is clinging to her back, wings wrapped around Daliza's neck. [zhara.numKids 1 2 3 | |Her sister is clutching Daliza's leg, hanging on and giggling while the bailiff walks. |Two of her sisters are clinging onto the bailiff's legs, giggling as they're sent up and down with every step. ] "What seems to be the problem, Daliza?" you ask, trying your damnedest to keep a straight face. "The problem," she grumbles, "is that your daughter is treating me [silly |like her unit's IFV. |like her personal warhorse. ]" "Hi, [pc.mf |dad |mom ]!" Mitra chirps, waving at you. The fact that flapping a winged arm at you drags her feathers all over Dal's face only adds to her amusement. You reach over and ruffle her hair-feathers. "Hi sweetie. [pc.dcb |Good job putting Daliza in her place." Your bailiff huffs, even as Mitra's hugging her from behind. |Are you giving your Aunt Dal a hard time?" The little harpy glances askance. "Nooooooo." "Are you sure?" "Nooooooo." |That looks like fun! Are you sure Auntie Dal-Dal is having fun too, though?" The little harpy pauses. "Uhmm....?" ] You gently pluck [zhara.numKids 1 2 3 |Mitra |the two harpies |Mitra and her sisters ] off of Daliza, slinging [zhara.numKids 1 2 |her |them ] under your arms. Mitra flaps her wings and squirms, making happy noises as you give her a couple of playful bounces. She's so light and soft, you can't help but smile at her. Dal sighs and leans down, resting a gauntleted hand on the chick's head. "Next time you want up, just ask." "Sorry Aunt Dal." Daliza rubs her feathers before standing, giving you a crisp salute, and returning to her duties — and leaving you to play with your offspring for a while, you suppose.
rows.translation: “[pc.name]！” 你停下脚步，不习惯听见达莉莎如此用力地喊出自己的名字[daliza.fucked |——至少在卧室之外不习惯 ]。执法官正从侧面逼近，嘴唇紧抿，手指紧扣剑带……米特拉却趴在她背上，双翼环住达莉莎的脖子。[zhara.numKids 1 2 3 | |她的妹妹抱住达莉莎的腿，吊在上面；执法官行走时，她一路咯咯笑个不停。 |她的两名妹妹分别抱住执法官的一条腿，每一步都令她们随之上下起伏、咯咯欢笑。 ] “看来出了什么问题，达莉莎？”你问道，拼尽全力保持严肃。 “问题，”她抱怨道，“就是你女儿把我当成了[silly |她那支部队的步兵战车。 |她的私人战马。 ]” “你好，[pc.mf |爸爸 |妈妈 ]！”米特拉欢快地喊道，向你挥手。长有羽翼的手臂一拍，羽毛便扫过达莉莎整张脸，只令她愈发开心。 你伸手揉弄她头顶的羽毛。“你好，甜心。[pc.dcb |干得漂亮，让达莉莎明白自己的地位。” 米特拉从身后抱着你的执法官，后者却气得喷鼻。 |你是不是在为难达尔阿姨？” 小鹰身女妖心虚地瞥向一旁。“没——有。” “确定吗？” “没——有。” |看起来很有趣！不过你确定达尔达尔阿姨也觉得有趣吗？” 小鹰身女妖停顿下来。“呃……？” ] 你轻轻将[zhara.numKids 1 2 3 |米特拉 |两名鹰身女妖 |米特拉和妹妹们 ]从达莉莎身上摘下来，把[zhara.numKids 1 2 |她 |她们 ]夹在腋下。你开玩笑般上下颠了几次，米特拉拍打翅膀，不断扭动，发出欢快的声音。她如此轻盈柔软，令你忍不住微笑。 达莉莎叹了口气，俯下身，将佩戴护手的一只手放在雏鸟头顶。“下次想上来，只要开口。” “对不起，达尔阿姨。” 达莉莎揉了揉她的羽毛，随后起身，干脆利落地敬礼，又回去履行职责——而你想，自己会留下陪孩子们玩一阵。

rows.original:
Your attention is caught by a scream coming from the fort's kitchen. You glance towards the offending sound just in time to see a gaggle of half a dozen harpies falling all over themselves trying to get out. One of them has a wicker basket clutched in both arms, and has clearly made herself the target of the screaming woman's ire — Rumie, it turns out, as she follows the scarpering harpies out with a raised wooden spoon.
    
    "You jerks!" she yells, menacing the retreating harpies with it. "Those cookies were for the hornets!" 
    
    [mitra.met
        |"They're for Mitra and the little ones now!" one of the harpies cackles, taking wing towards your rafters.
        
        "I made her cookies yesterdaaaaaay!" Rumie whines, buzzing her little wings angrily. "She's gonna get fat!"
        |"Ours now!" one of the harpies cackles, taking wing towards your rafters. Rumie buzzes her wings angrily, but knows better than to pursue them, you suppose.
    ] The busty bee-girl gives you a forlorn look and slumps her shoulders. "I guess I'll just make more cookies..."
    
    [pc.dcb
        |"Better be some for me too!" you say.
        |"Sorry, Rumie," you shrug. "Gonna make some for me?"
        |"Awww, sorry bumblebutt!" you say. "Can you make some for me this time too?"
    ]
    
    "At least my cooking never goes unappreciated around here," she sighs.
rows.translation:
你的注意力被从堡垒厨房里传来的尖叫声吸引了。你朝那个声音的方向望去，正好看到有六七只女妖互相挤来挤去，拼命想要逃出去。其中有一只女妖双手紧抱着一个柳条编成的篮子，显然，她成了那个尖叫的女人的目标——原来那个女人是露米，她手持一把木勺，追着那些惊慌逃窜的女妖追了出去。
    
    你们这些混蛋！”她大声吼道，用这句话威胁那些正在逃走的恶女。“那些饼干是给黄蜂吃的！

"She’s immortal; she can control fire; she has multiple legends surrounding her and her deeds; she’s on a first name basis with our harpy god[mitra.born |. Hell, I named my firstborn after great-grandma ]. And now that she’s been reborn, goddamn, [pc.name], have you seen her body? Yes, I ‘think highly’ of her." She must think she’s lucky that she has red feathers. And, hell, if she thinks Agnimitra is sexy, then she must be happy that their body type is pretty similar, too. You could have a hard time picking out their silhouettes if you were pressed. "Well, let’s not get carried away," she answers with a laugh. "I love my great-grandma, but I’m also my own woman, [pc.name]. The red feathers, and the sleek bod," she says, interrupting herself to run her hands over her curves sensually, knowing that you’d naturally draw your eyes to the motion of her body as she slides them down her sides, "sure, they’re great-grandma’s genes. But I just lucked into them, is all. It’s kind of surprising, actually, since Mom doesn’t look anything at all like great-grandma." This might be a bit of a forward, personal question, but did she ever, well... not believe Agnimitra when she said she was immortal? "You’re asking me if I believed she’d come back from the dead?" Zhara reiterates, and you confirm. "Well, I mean..." She hesitates, playing with the words on her tongue for a moment, trying to rationalize the best way to answer the question. "It came and went in waves, I guess," she says eventually. "She and Mom both told me she was immortal, and I was all, ‘whoaaaaa’. I once asked her if she could die on the spot to prove it to me." She laughs sheepishly as she recounts the innocent, naïve antics of her younger self. "A dumb, shithead question to ask, I realize now, but I was a dumb, shithead kid." "Then, as I got older, I started to believe it less. Like, there was a lot of evidence that Agni was telling the truth. She could trace our family tree with such accuracy, it could only have been if she was really there, and she really knew everyone. And there’s, like, oral history and stuff, and there are old relics and heirlooms from past families to tell us that our ancestors were there and did this thing, but great-grandma, she spoke about it all with such clarity and confidence that you couldn’t help but believe her, you know?" Agnimitra is a bard. She might have just been really good at storytelling. "That’s what I started telling myself, too," Zhara affirms. "Like, pfft, nobody’s immortal. Great-grandma Agni was just really good at bullshitting. But even if she wasn’t, I... I wanted to believe it, that she really was immortal, and that her control over fire wasn’t magic that just anyone could learn. I wanted to believe that she was special." Is that because that would mean that she was special? Being directly blood-related to the legendary immortal phoenix? "Bitch, I’m the most special harpy there is, I don’t need great-grandma’s help proving that." She laughs and gives you a playful shove in the shoulder. "When I was just a chick, and I knew great-grandma at her youngest, she was still older than she is now, physically. She’s practically a completely different woman from what I knew." You aren’t sure if you’re going to get a better opening, so you take the chance and ask her if she would like to know Agnimitra as a woman, and not as her great-grandma. She just said that Agnimitra isn’t the same woman she grew up with, after all. Zhara’s expression freezes, her brow fidgeting as she tries to put together what it is you just asked her. "Are you asking me if I want to fuck my great-grandma?" she asks, tilting her head and raising her cheeks, although you wouldn’t rightly call the expression a smile. She’s bewildered and trying to put your roundabout question to clearer words. Well, she keeps saying it herself: Agnimitra is ‘young, sexy, nubile,’ with ‘curves like bam,’ she’s a ‘prime piece of meat’, with skin as smooth as Zhara’s own, and she’s not even the same great-grandma she grew up with. If the opportunity came up, and there was no stigma attached... You don’t finish the sentence, instead letting it sit in the air between you. For her part, Zhara seems stunned by the question, like you had asked her something totally nonsensical. But she’s also not saying no. In fact, she seems to be considering it rather deeply. "On the one hand," she says slowly, trying to explain it more to herself than to you. "Agni isn’t actually my great-grandma. It’s something like eighteen or nineteen generations between us, not just four. But even still, no, I do not want to have sex with my mom’s mom’s mom. And now that she’s young again, the resemblance between us is pretty surreal, even I have to admit." She shrugs her shoulders and tilts her head to the other side. "But on the other, I could fuck the legendary phoenix. Go to somewhere else in the world, where nobody knows me or Agni, and say ‘the mythical undying fire-throwing harpy? Yeah, I fucked her.’ And yeah, I’ll say it: she’s hot as sin. I know that because I’m hot as sin," she laughs. "It’s narcissistic as hell, but, shit," she continues, slapping her own left thigh, "I wouldn’t mind having thighs like these wrapped around my face from time to time." She remains silent for a moment longer. You keep your mouth shut: anything you say could make her lose her nerve. Besides, she’s doing a perfectly fine job convincing herself. "Fuck it," she says eventually. "Great – or, Agni, she’s a legend among our people. How often would I have the chance to have a piece of that?" So, if the opportunity arose...? "Yeah, I would," she answers without hesitation, having finally convinced herself. "Although it’d be easier if I got a bit of beer into me, first. And it’s not going to be as simple as going up to her and making a pass. But if, oh, I dunno," she smirks, nudging you in the shoulder again, "if a mutual third party that we both happen to be interested in happened to broach the subject with her, well... like I said, mating between harpies can get competitive. If we both liked that ‘third party,’" she continues, winking and nudging you some more, "that’d take some of the edge off the issue, I’d think." Now it’s just a matter of inviting them both somewhere private. |Well, at least your objective is clear. If you want to have Zhara and Agnimitra at the same time, you should speak to Agnimitra next. ]'

rows.original: But seriously... all this talk of Agnimitra being young and sexy again. It’s... somewhat relieving to see that her opinion of Agnimitra hasn’t changed since they, you know. "What, got into a steamy threesome with you?" Zhara asks. She sounds so casual about it. Most people would treat what happened with a little more gravity. "Well, then I guess harpies aren’t like ‘most people’," she retorts. "Look – yes, I’ll be real, the fact that great-grandma Agni and I are related makes things a little unusual, sure. But harpies are an all-girl race, one. Two, we often stick with family units well into maturity. Hell, I sometimes go back to Mom’s nest in the Peaks for a visit. And three, harpies aren’t exactly, you know, against sharing – things can get mean and aggressive when it comes to mates, but if, say, great-grandma Agni and I have our eyes on the same [pc.race], then that makes things easier." That’s a relief to hear. Although they, well, did some things that went beyond just ‘mating’ for the sake of eggs[pc.hasCock | |, something you’re not even capable of giving them ]. "Yeah, well, she’s hot, and I had an opportunity," she says with a nasally laugh. "After having done it, [pc.name], let’s just say I’m not against doing it again. All of that experience has really given great-grandma some techniques that I wouldn’t mind learning. Or having used on me again." ... Now you’re curious. Would she ever have Agnimitra on her own? Or do you have to be involved every time? The question gives Zhara pause as she considers it. She furrows her brow and rubs at her chin. "I’d guess that... it depends on where we are," she says, chewing through the words as she puts thoughts to them. "Out in the middle of the desert? Deep in some jungle? Or, at the very least, somewhere where nobody knows that she and I are related? Yeah, I could see myself diving face-first between those thighs just for my own satisfaction. I don’t care, and I doubt she cares – she acted as though it wasn’t the first, or even the second, time she had done something like that with a ‘great-granddaughter’. But we don’t need people talking shit behind our backs for it. At least this way, this is more about you getting really lucky than us being weird." Well, uh, glad you could help by being a warm body between them. She laughs and nudges your shoulder. "That’s the spirit!"
rows.translation: 但说真的……这些关于阿格尼米特拉又变年轻、又变性感的讨论。自从她们，你知道的，那之后，她对阿格尼米特拉的看法一点没变，这倒……让人有点松了口气。 “什么，跟你们搞了一场火辣辣的三人行？”扎拉问道。 她说得如此随意。大多数人遇到这种事，都会稍微严肃一点对待。 “嗯，那我想鹰身女妖跟大多数人可不一样，”她反驳道。“听着——对，我说实话，曾祖母阿格尼和我有亲属关系，这确实让事情有点不寻常，没错。但第一，鹰身女妖是纯女性的种族。第二，我们成年之后往往还长期保持家庭聚居。见鬼，我有时还会回母亲在山峰间的巢里探望。第三，鹰身女妖其实并不反对分享——在争夺伴侣时确实可能变得凶狠又充满攻击性，但比如说，如果曾祖母阿格尼和我看上了同一个[pc.race]，那事情反而会更容易。” 听到这话让人松了口气。尽管她们，呃，做的那些事已经超出了单纯为了卵子而交配的范畴[pc.hasCock | |，一些你甚至根本给不了她们的东西 ]。 “是啊，不过，她很性感，而我有机会，”她带着鼻音笑了笑，“做过之后，[pc.name]，这么说吧，我并不反对再来一次。那些经验确实让曾祖母学会了一些我很想学的技巧。或者，让这些技巧再用在我身上。” ……现在你好奇起来了。她有没有可能自己独享阿格尼米特拉？还是每次都必须有你在场？ 这个问题让扎拉顿了顿，认真考虑起来。她皱起眉头，揉了揉下巴。“我猜……那得看我们在哪儿，”她一边斟酌着措辞、一边组织思路说道。“在沙漠正中央？在某处丛林深处？或者，至少是在一个没人知道她和我有亲属关系的地方？对，为了满足我自己，我能想象自己一头扎进那双大腿之间。我不在乎，我怀疑她也不在乎——她的表现就好像这种事她已经不是第一次做，甚至不是第二次了，而且还是跟自己的曾孙女。但我们不需要别人在背后说我们的闲话。至少这样，这件事更多是你运气好，而不是我们太古怪。” 嗯，呃，很高兴你能作为一具温热的身体夹在她们中间帮上忙。 她笑着用胳膊肘轻推你的肩膀。“这才对嘛！”

rows.original: [flags.AGNI_ZHARA_3SUM |Zhara likes to boast about how she doesn’t back down from challenges, no matter how weird or sexy or familial. But you don’t think she really meant it the last time that she got into bed with Agnimitra. "You know, you can just say you want to fuck two sexy red-headed harpies without having to try and insult my dignity," she says. Despite her words, her tone is light-hearted: she knows you didn’t mean anything by it and you’re just trying to lead into getting her and Agnimitra in bed together again. "But fine. You really want me to ‘prove’ how serious I am about this?" Well, now she makes it seem like– "No chickening out now!" she says with a firm tug on your wrist, pushing you towards the nearest exit. "Now you’ve gone and made this about me. And making this about me is making this about great-grandma Agni. And I doubt she’s going to appreciate you trying to talk shit about either of us!" You aren’t sure how the conversation turned out this way, but Zhara seems just as excited about getting a chance to ‘prove her dignity’ a second time. Her hands are on your shoulders, pushing you towards the door rather insistently. You ask her if you should get naked ahead of time this time – you know, save a few seconds. "Why is time an issue?" she asks seriously. "Is there something else you need to do? Or someone?" She doesn’t let you answer; with another heavy push, you’re shoved into the hallway of the fort while Zhara goes off to fetch Agnimitra. There’s nothing else for you to do other than to make your way to your quarters... |You ask Zhara if she was serious about ‘sharing’ you with Agnimitra. She seemed pretty convinced at the time, but you want to know if it wasn’t just bluster and bluffing. "When’s the last time I backed down from anything?" Zhara asks boastfully. She places her hands on her hips as she puffs out her chest and ruffles her feathers, making herself appear larger. "There’s no challenge – none! – that I’m willing to back down from, [pc.name]!" Good. Because you spoke with Agnimitra. The bluster evaporates quickly. Her feathers relax and her chest deflates, although her hands remain on her hips. "And?" Well, you wouldn’t be bringing it up if Agnimitra wasn’t also game. It turns out that she had many of the same opinions about her ‘great-granddaughter’s’ body as Zhara has about hers. But there’s no need for her to take your word for it. Zhara remains still and silent for a moment. Her eyes remain fixated on yours, although she’s not truly looking at you: she’s processing the information in her head. If she was really bluffing, it’s been called. "Honestly?" she says after a moment. She can’t help but let a weak, defeated smile cross her lips. "I should have figured you’d be the one bold enough to try it." So, she’s still– "Yes, I’m still gonna. Gre – Agni is a legend, [pc.name]. I won’t pass up the opportunity to get into bed with a living legend." She places her hands on your shoulders and spin you around. "You go to your room in the living quarters. I’ll go get great-grandma Agni and bring her there with me." Is she sure that she wouldn’t rather you go get Agnimitra? It might help with her nerves. "I think the opposite, personally," she says. "No, I’d better do it." You start making your way down the halls towards the living quarters when you hear Zhara call after you: "And keep your clothes on until I tell you!" ]

rows.original: Dressed like a cute barkeep with deep open cleavage, this incredibly bright gold-and-yellow bug is reminiscent of the hornets you're more familiar with... but for the part where she's incredibly pale, outrageously fuzzy, with a bimbo-bright expression, and cute little wings that seem to challenge the sheer concept of flight. Her hands deftly work a mug and a washcloth[silly |, as all bartenders are legally required to do... ] but her eyes are all on you[party.has azyrran | and your caramel cuddlebug's |r ] various curves and muscles. "H-hi!" Once you've managed to pull your gaze up from her cleavage, [party.has azyrran |and Azyrran has stopped making self-muffled hungry-noises, ]you introduce yourself. "Uh, hi? I'm [pc.name]." The bee girl — for this could only be the bee-variety of bug-folk — brightens up and stands straighter. "Th-this is your bar, right?" [pc.dcb |"The whole fort belongs to me, although you seem to have made yourself comfortable." |"Indeed it is, welcome to my fort." |"Yup! Although I wasn't using it properly yet! Welcome!" ] She clears her throat and puts down the mug she was cleaning, offering a fuzzy-cuffed hand. Unlike [party.comp azyrran |your knightly companion's smooth, chitinous forelimbs |the average hornet-girl's smooth, chitinous forelimbs ] these are delicate, soft little things. "I'm Rumie! Sorry for just moving in like this... but I was grabbed by that interesting looking cat-girl. Y-you see, I was worried!" "Worried?" "Yeah! About the hornets, it's just, they uh... they haven't come to our hives recently! You know, to like... attack us, and take our honey..." she trails off and mumbles something about eggs before snapping out of it. "A-and I wanted to be sure that they were okay! It's not like I missed the uh, the bullying and stuff... I just wanted to see if they were okay." Rumie sighs a moment later, head hanging after you finish shaking her hand. "And then I found out they can all make their own honey and stuff... so, like... I guess they aren't coming around anymore?" rows.original:
[wayfort.hasJaelyn
        |Jael
        |Rumie
    ] checks a bottle of rich red wine in her hands, turning it over and checking the label before seeming satisfied. "Here you go, [pc.mf
        |master
        |mistress
    ]." 
    
    A nice tall glass is poured for you, capturing your reflection in its warped surface. [wayfort.hasJaelyn
        |Your demonic bartender waits patiently, tail swishing around in anticipation for your reaction.
        |The bully-able buzz waits patiently to see if you like it, little gossamer wings flickering in anticipation.
    ]
    
    You're treated to a faint warmth, and subtle fruits wash over your tongue. Oaky notes ride on soft acid, and leave you salivating by the time you swallow your first mouthful; it's a good wine to sip.
    
    "Excellent! Well then, you just sit and enjoy that in peace." 
    
    You while away a good twenty or so minutes, watching as [wayfort.hasJaelyn
        |Jael confidently shoo's off anyone who might disturb you
        |Rumie nervously asks any passers-by to leave you to your break
    ]. 
    
    It's nice to catch your breath and savor, at least.

        |杰琳
        |露米
    ]拿着一瓶醇厚的红酒翻来覆去，检查标签，似乎满意以后才说道：“给您，[pc.mf
        |主人
        |主人
    ]。”
    
    她为你倒了一只修长漂亮的高脚杯，弯曲的杯面映出你的倒影。[wayfort.hasJaelyn
        |恶魔酒保耐心等待，尾巴因期待你的反应而来回摆动。
        |那只可以随意欺负的小蜂女耐心等待着，看你是否喜欢；薄纱般的小翅膀因期待而不断轻颤。
    ]
    
    淡淡暖意包裹着你，细腻果香拂过舌尖。橡木风味浮在柔和酸味之上；第一口咽下时，你已经口舌生津。这是一款适合慢慢啜饮的好酒。
    
    “太好了！那么，你就坐在这里安静享用吧。”
    
    你悠然度过了足足二十分钟左右，看着[wayfort.hasJaelyn
        |杰琳自信地赶走任何可能打扰你的人
        |露米紧张地请求每个路人别打扰你休息
    ]。
    
    至少，能喘口气、慢慢品味一番，感觉很不错。

rows.original:
Ah, now this is a taste that brings you back to the farm; you'd swear as that deliciously chill pale ale trickles down your throat, that Anna and Morwen are sat either side of you tails wagging and faces proud.

    You open your eyes, dispelling the image. Instead you can see Rumie giving you a bright smile of her own, sipping from a half-pint mug of her own. "It's good, right? I love the fizz of it!"
    
    Your head tips back and you all but drain your glass, finding it refilled a moment later. "It really is."
    
    "I hope they come visit again! The girls were super nice."
    
    "I'm sure they will," you promise. "How could they stay away?"
rows.translation:
啊，这种味道真的会让你仿佛重新回到了农场里；当那美味的冰镇淡色啤酒顺着你的喉咙流下去时，你甚至会忍不住想象，安娜和莫文正坐在你身旁，摇着尾巴，脸上洋溢着自豪的神情。

    你睁开眼睛，将这些想象从脑海中驱散开来。相反，你会看到露米也向你露出了灿烂的笑容，她正用自己那半品脱的杯子小口品尝着饮料。“很好喝吧？我就喜欢这种气泡感！”
    
    你仰起头，几乎把杯子里的饮料一饮而尽，不一会儿，杯子里又重新被倒满了饮料。确实是这样。”
    
    “希望他们能再来看我们！那些女孩们都非常友善。”
    
    “我肯定他们会再来的，”你说道，“他们怎么可能不来呢？

rows.original:
[wayfort.hasJaelyn
        |"Here, it'll put ice in your gut, and fire in your heart." Jael'yn pulls out a four-fingered line of shotglasses and tops each of them up from a clear bottle of similarly-clear liquid.
        |"Oh! You like boreal booze?" Rumie smiles and buzzes, laying out four shotglasses and filling them from a clear bottle of similarly-clear liquid.
    ]
    
    [wayfort.hasDaliza
        |A couple of Daliza's guards approach the counter, laying out coins. "Some for us too, please! We're off-duty!"
        
        No kidding the guards are off-duty; they're wearing nothing but simple linen tanktops and underwear, faces flushed from previous drinking. They let out cheers when [wayfort.hasJaelyn
            |the surprisingly-adept demon leans over Rumie's shoulders and — with a finger halfway into the bottle to measure her pours — fills the whole line.
            |Rumie acquiesces and fills a whole line of glasses up.
        ] You all clink glasses together, and knock back your shots with a reckless abandon that has the group cheering... and scattering, lest your Bailiff catch them being a bad influence.
    ]
    
    Fire scorches you down to the depths, turning to vapor in your nostrils and making your eyes water. When you exhale the curious not-taste of filtered alcohol ride son your breath, making you shiver pleasantly as it settles down.
    
    "Not bad..." You mutter, plucking up the next glass and knocking that back too.
    
    Once you finish the four shots laid out, there's a comfortable swimming in your vision that warms you right down to your [pc.toes].

[wayfort.hasJaelyn
        |来，这东西会让你肠胃感到刺痛，但同时让你的内心充满激情。”杰琳拿出一排四指长的shotglass，然后从一瓶清澈的液体中为每个杯子倒满了酒。
        |哦！你喜欢北方地区的酒啊？”露米微笑着一边说，一边拿出四个shotglass，然后从一个透明瓶子里倒出同样透明的液体，将它们都倒满。
    ]
    
    [wayfort.hasDaliza
        |达莉莎的几名卫兵走到柜台前，掏出硬币说道：“也给我们来一些吧！我们现在正在休息时间！”
        
        说真的，这些卫兵确实是在休息——他们只穿着简单的亚麻T恤和内衣，脸上还带着喝酒后留下的红晕。当[wayfort.hasJaelyn
            |这个出奇地熟练的恶魔凑到露米的肩旁，手指伸进酒瓶中测量着倒酒的量，然后将整杯酒都倒满了。
            |瑞美点了点头，然后给一整排杯子都倒满了酒。
        ]你们一起举杯，毫无顾忌地一饮而尽，这一幕让在场的所有人都欢呼起来……然后纷纷散开，生怕你们的“执法官”发现他们在坏榜样。
    ]
    
    火焰将你灼烧至深处，烟雾从你的鼻孔中逸出，令你的双眼流泪。当你呼气时，那种带着特殊气味的过滤后的酒精会随着气息飘出，当你感受到它在你体内消散时，会让你不由自主地打了个寒颤——不过这种寒颤却让人感到无比愉悦。
    
    “还不错……”你低声说道，然后拿起下一杯酒，一饮而尽。
    
    当你喝完这四杯酒之后，你的视线变得模糊起来，全身也仿佛被一股温暖的力量包裹住了[pc.toes]。

rows.translation: 一位让人联想到远古巨龙的女性坐在瞭望塔上，她倚靠在破损的城垛上，身姿在背光中显得格外闪耀。 [dayNight|太阳|黄昏]在某个时刻，她似乎把所有的东西都扔到了瞭望塔的顶层……包括她的衣服。她的身上还带着刚刚运动后留下的汗水，浓密的红色头发在风中乱蓬蓬地飘动着。强健的肌肉与丰满的胸部、以及那张充满女性魅力的脸庞形成了鲜明的对比。 [var0] 如果没有人注意到她那巨大的红色鳞片与粉色网状物构成的翅膀，她脸上的鳞片斑块，以及从肘部到膝盖、从手指到脚趾都覆盖着的厚厚鳞片和爪子，那简直就是一种罪过。她那长长的、苍白的耳朵让人联想到精灵，而她那如同爬行动物般的眼睛，则呈现出炽热的红色，眼裂也显得格外狭长。 然而，你的目光依然在她身上游移，每次从上到下打量她时，都能发现新的细节。她不耐烦地扇了几下翅膀，等待着你开口说话，却发现自己……其实有些心不在焉。相反，她露出了得意的笑容，然后将手沿着自己的腹部向下移动，分开阴唇，露出了那双乌黑发亮的阴唇。这一动作足以让人清楚地看到：她的阴唇根本没有涂任何化妆品，它们本身就是那种与乳头和阴部颜色相配的天然黑色。 最后但同样重要的是，她额头上生长的那些巨大而狰狞的角——那些角看起来简直可以用来顶撞那些大型动物，迫使它们屈服。 [party.som |你慢慢地把武器收了起来；看来你并不打算和他的女人发生冲突，至少不会是那种以暴力告终的冲突。 |[companion1.name]看起来有些困惑，与你对视了一眼，随后你们俩都把武器收了起来。 |你的同伴慢慢收起了武器，因为他们感觉没有危险。你也不觉得有什么不妥，于是也把自己的武器收了起来；至少，如果真的发生冲突，也不会是那种以暴力结束的冲突。 ]她穿着的袜子正在被撕裂，因为她那结实有力的大腿正在不断用力，汗水开始从她的手指间滴落下来。“嗯……现在我终于能够看清你下面的样子了，我妈妈冠军她称你为冠军，但那语气就像是在说些难听的话一样，她还把头歪到一边，仿佛在吐出什么令人作呕的东西。不过至少，她在选择称呼上还是有点品味的。 [pc.mascFem |英俊的 |美丽 ]小小的生物。” 你不由自主地咽了口唾沫，环顾四周，看看有没有其他人也在看。 [party.som |否则别人会看到的 |还有其他人也在看着呢。 [companion1.name] |除了你的同伴之外，还有其他人正在注视着。 ]打算好好欣赏这场表演吗？这一切都是为你准备的。 [pc.name]她的眼睛里闪烁着邪恶的光芒，脚趾上的爪子也在空气中微微弯曲着。
rows.raw: " A woman reminiscent of the dragons of old sits atop the watchtower, resting on a broken crenellation and glistening, backlit by [dayNight|the sun|twilight]. At some point she seems to have dumped her belongings into the top floor of the watchtower... including her clothing. Her body glistens with the sweat of recent exertion, and her thick red hair has become a tousled mess in the wind. Impressive muscle fights at odds with weighty tits and a beautifully feminine face. [var0] It would be a crime not to notice the massive wings of red scale and pink webbing, the scale-patches on her face, the thick scales and claws from elbows-and-knees down to fingers-and-toes. She has long, pale ears reminiscent of an elf, and burning red eyes slit like a reptile. Still yet your eyes roam over her, finding new details to pick out every time you track from bottom-to-top. Her wings flap a few times impatiently while she waits for you to speak, before realizing you're rather... distracted. Instead she smirks and runs a hand down her abdomen, parting her pussy-lips and showing off ebony pussy-lips. That also happens to be enough to make it clear that her dark black lips aren't even painted, instead they're a natural black to match her nipples and twat. Lastly — but certainly not least — are the massive, draconic horns that crest from her brow. They look like they can be used to headbutt some large animal into submission. [party.som |You slowly put your weapon away; it's unlikely you're about to get in a fight with his woman, or at the very least the kind that ends in violence. |[companion1.name] appears somewhat confused, sharing a look with you before you both put your weapons away. |Your companions slowly put their weapons away, sensing no danger. You're inclined to agree as you stow your own; at the very least if there's a fight, it's not going to be the kind that ends in violence. ] The stocking she's wearing tears as her skull-crushing thighs tense up, and juices begin to drip and dribble around questing digits. "Mmmn... now I get a look at you down there, my mother's champion." She calls you a champion in the same way one might slur, tilting her head to the side and spitting as though tasting something foul. "At least she has taste in a [pc.mascFem |handsome |beautiful ] little creature." You find yourself gulping unconsciously, looking around to see if anybody [party.som |else is watching |else is watching besides [companion1.name] |else is watching apart from your companions ]. "Going to enjoy the show? This is all for you, [pc.name]." Her eyes are burning with wicked intent, and her toe-claws flex at the air. "

rows.original:
You grimace reflexively and wave her off, "Not interested."
            
            The draconic woman's mouth drops, and she squirms where she sits before shutting her legs. "You are just no fuc— darned fun at all."
            
            Darned?
            
            She grumbles and clambers down from the broken crenelation, hopping into the broken roof of the watchtower. "Whatever, we should talk then. I owe you one, and I hate debts." 
            
            [party.som
                |It's probably not an ambush, at least.
                |[companion1.name] doesn't look so sure, but [companion1.mf
                    |he
                    |she
                ] eventually shrugs. "It's probably not an ambush. I'll wait out here if you need me."
                |"It's probably not an ambush," [companion2.name] mutters, still off-guard from the impromptu show. [companion1.name] nods an agreement, "we'll be out here if you need us."
            ] With a sigh you flip aside the curtain and head into the watchtower proper, ascending the stone stairs into what constitutes the main room. 
            
            There's a subtle change in temperature as you ascend; instead of getting colder, it grows warmer. If there was anything resembling weather-proofing in this tower, perhaps that warmth would be a little better contained. Still, the source of that heat reveals itself in the fiery redheaded form of the dragon-woman.
rows.translation:
你条件反射地皱起脸，挥手把她赶开：“没兴趣。”
            
            那个龙女张大了嘴，坐在那里扭来扭去，然后并拢了双腿。“你真是他——真是一点都不好玩。”
            
            真是？
            
            她嘟囔着从那截断裂的城垛上爬下来，跳进瞭望塔破掉的屋顶。“算了，那我们就谈谈吧。我欠你一次，而我讨厌欠债。” 
            
            [party.som
                |至少这大概不是埋伏。
                |[companion1.name]看起来不太确定，但[companion1.mf
                    |他
                    |她
                ]最终还是耸了耸肩。“这大概不是埋伏。需要我的话，我就在外面等着。”
                |“这大概不是埋伏，” [companion2.name]低声说，还没从这场即兴表演中缓过神来。 [companion1.name]点头表示同意：“需要的话，我们就在外面。”
            ]你叹了口气，掀开帘子走进瞭望塔内部，顺着石阶上去，来到算是主厅的地方。 
            
            随着你往上走，温度有一丝微妙的变化；不是越来越冷，反而越来越暖。不过，这份热量的来源很快就现身了——一个火红色头发的龙女。

rows.original: She's thrown on some clothing rather in a hurry, and is busy brushing her hair straight after a fly-around. "There you are..." The muscular monster sighs and crosses her arms beneath a prodigious chest. "A little disappointed that you weren't up for a show, but such is life." "What's this about you owing me?" Her eyes flash, and her tail whips around at her feet before thudding into the floor hard enough to kick up dust. "Yes. [flags.WC_SAW_DOTTIRS |If not for your timely intervention I'd be dead as a doornail, or have had my brain scrubbed clean out by some dark inky tentacle from beyond. |This is the most excited I've seen my mother about anything... ever. ]" She trails a long tongue over her upper teeth, showing off some impressive incisors to go with the rest of her neat, white, humanoid set. "So, first of all; thank you. My name is Aileh... Aileh Kasyrradottir." [pc.dcb |"Oh, uh. You're welcome, I guess." |"Oh? Well, you're certainly welcome." |"Aww, that's oki-doki cutie." ] Her cheeks are dark enough to show off some freckles, and she clears her throat before continuing. "And since I owe you, I have decided to do you the great favor of not fu— ruining any of your plans, or getting in the way." "That's[pc.isBimbo |, like, ] the second time you've interrupted yourself. Something wrong?" Aileh scowls and clears her throat, putting away her hairbrush. "Nothing is wrong, I just don't like cursing. Now, if I could continue?" "Go ahead[pc.isBimbo |! |. ]" "I'm moving in here." "Pardon?!" Her scowl becomes an utterly-delighted grin at your expression and her wings unconsciously burst forth from her back, flapping a few times. The grin doesn't last long when it kicks up enough dust to make you cough, rather ruining the moment. "And— urgh. I'll be sweeping this place up." "Okay, and why are you moving in?" You blink your eyes against the dust, watching as her wings retract and disappear once more. "I don't want to live in mother's basement like a [silly |NEET |helpless infant ], I don't want to be pestered by vapid, air-headed servants, and I thought it would be interesting." "And if I don't want you here?" To her credit, Aileh looks offended, placing a hand on her chest. "Well, I would be terribly hurt. And all bets would be off on me staying out of the conflict. Don't be a jerk, I'll be here, out of the way." She thumps a fist on her palm, gesturing out of the broken hole in the wall-slash-roof. "Tell you what, I'll even fight off threats to the fort— just don't expect me to go directly against mom though, she will spank me." It sounds like a good deal, at least. "Aren't you a demon?" Her expression darkens truly, and she bites a black bottom lip. "No. I'm not, don't want to be, and never will be. I don't care if you want demons, or not. I'm me, and always will be. I've had my fill." There's probably a story there, but the dragon seems disinclined to share it. Instead she lets the tension bleed away before offering a hand. "How about it then?"
rows.translation: 她匆匆穿上了衣服，忙完这些事后就开始梳理自己的头发。“给你……”那个肌肉发达的怪物叹了口气，双臂交叉在宽大的胸前。“有点失望你没有陪我表演，不过人生就是如此吧。” “你到底欠我什么？” 她的眼睛闪着光芒，尾巴在脚边甩动了一下，然后重重地砸在地板上，扬起了阵阵灰尘。“是的，我确实欠你一些东西。 [flags.WC_SAW_DOTTIRS |要不是你及时出手相救，我现在早就死了，或者被那些来自黑暗中的触手彻底夺走了大脑。 |这是我见过我母亲对任何事情如此兴奋的一次……真的是有史以来第一次。 ]她将长舌头伸到上齿旁，那整齐洁白的门牙显得格外引人注目，与她整个人类般的容貌相得益彰。“首先，非常感谢你们。我叫艾莉……艾莉·卡西拉多蒂尔。 [pc.dcb |哦，呃，应该不客气吧。 |哦？嗯，当然不客气。 |哇，好可爱啊。 ] 她的脸颊颜色较深，因此能隐约看到一些雀斑。她清了清嗓子，然后继续说道：“既然我欠你一个人情，我就决定帮你这个大忙——不会破坏你的任何计划，也不会妨碍你的事情。” “那真是太好了[pc.isBimbo |就像，比如说…… ]这是你第二次打断自己说话了。出什么问题了吗？” 艾莉皱了皱眉头，清了清嗓子，然后把发刷收了起来。“没什么问题，我只是不喜欢说脏话。现在，可以让我继续说吗？” “请继续吧。[pc.isBimbo |！ |。 ]我要搬到这里来住。” “什么？！” 看到你这样的反应，她原本紧绷的表情立刻变成了欣喜若狂的微笑，她的翅膀也不由自主地从背后展开，扑腾了几下。当扬起的灰尘多到让你忍不住咳嗽时，那笑容很快就消失了，反而破坏了当时的气氛。“还有——呃，我得把这里打扫干净。” “好吧，那你为什么要搬进来住呢？”你眨着眼睛，试图抵挡那些灰尘，同时看着她的翅膀再次收起来，消失不见了。 我可不想像某些人一样，整天待在妈妈的地下室里[silly |NEET |无助的婴儿 ]我可不想被那些空洞无物、愚蠢至极的仆从烦扰，我觉得这样会有趣得多。” “那要是我不希望你在这里呢？” 值得称赞的是，艾莉显得很生气，她把手放在胸口，表示不满。嗯，那样我会受到非常严重的伤害。而且我也再无法保证自己能置身事外、不卷入这场冲突了。别犯傻了，我会留在这里的，只是不会妨碍你们罢了。”她用拳头敲打自己的手掌，同时指向墙上被砍出的那个洞——也就是屋顶上的那个缺口。告诉你吧，我甚至会挺身而出，抵御任何对这座堡垒的威胁——不过别指望我会直接与妈妈作对，她会打我吧。” 至少听起来像是个不错的交易。“你难道不是恶魔吗？” 她的表情顿时变得阴沉起来，她咬住了下唇：“不，我不是恶魔，也不想成为恶魔，永远都不会。我不在乎你想要无论是恶魔还是别的什么，我始终都是我自己，永远都会是这样。我已经受够了。 其中或许藏着一些故事，但这条龙似乎并不愿意分享。相反，它让那种紧张的气氛慢慢消散，然后才伸出了援手。“那么，你觉得怎么样呢？

rows.original:
You take the draconic general's — or, it would seem, part-time-general's — hand and give her [pc.strengthRange 85
                        |an appropriately tough handshake. Aileh rises to the occasion, stepping in and tightening her grip in turn. Soon your handshake shifts into a warrior's grasp, and your biceps are pulsing with the effort of proving yourself the superior. "What's wrong?" Aileh finally grunts between her teeth. "Mother got you wasting your time fingering too many whores?"
                        
                        Your 'handshake' eventually ends with no clear winner, merely a cramp in both of your arms that you've got to flex away. But she looks pleased enough with the effort. "I don't have many things to move in, come on back... you know, whenever you need to pester me over whatever. Otherwise I'm staying mostly out of the way."
                        |a firm handshake. She rather overpowers you, flinching when she nearly crushes your fingers. "Oh dangit, uh, I didn't— I expected you to be stronger. I guess you're not the... muscular type, apologies."
                        
                        You wince and stretch your hand out, looking her up and down again. She's definitely a force to be reckoned with, and at least she's not your enemy. "It's... fine."
                        
                        "Aaaanyway," Aileh awkwardly laughs and rubs the back of her head. "I don't have many things to move in, come on back... you know, whenever you need to pester me over whatever. Otherwise I'm staying mostly out of the way."
                    ]
                    
                    It looks like the Wayfort now has a dragon in the tower... or at least something close to one.
rows.translation:
你握住那位龙族将军的手——或者说，这位兼职将军的手——然后将她[pc.strengthRange 85
                        |一次力度适中的握手。艾莱赫也顺应了这个场合，反过来握紧了你的手。很快，你们的握手就变成了战士之间的紧握，你的二头肌因为努力证明自己的优势而不停地跳动着。怎么了？”艾莉终于咬牙说道，“是你妈妈让你把时间浪费在和太多女人厮混上吗？”
                        
                        你们的“握手”最终并没有分出胜负，只会导致你们的手臂抽筋，之后还得用力活动才能缓解这种疼痛。不过她看起来对大家的努力感到很满意。“我需要搬运的东西并不多，你们随时都可以回来……总之，只要你们需要我帮忙处理什么事情，随时都可以找我。否则的话，我基本上会不插手这些事情的。
                        |她握住你的手，力度相当大，几乎把你的手指捏得发疼，自己却显得有些慌乱：“哦，天哪，我不是故意的……我以为你会更强壮一些呢。看来你并不是那种肌肉发达的人吧，实在抱歉。
                        
                        你皱了皱眉头，伸出手，又上下打量了她一番。她确实是个不容小觑的人物，不过至少她不是你的敌人。“没……没什么问题。”
                        
                        “总之，”艾莉尴尬地笑了笑，揉了揉后脑勺。我没什么东西需要搬，你随时都可以回来……总之，只要你需要我帮忙处理什么事情，随时都可以找我。否则的话，我基本上会不插手你的任何事情。
                    ]

rows.original: She's thrown on some clothing rather in a hurry, and is busy brushing her hair straight and wiping some of the sweat from her body. "There you are..." The muscular monster grins and licks her deep black lips. "Did you enjoy the show?" "What was this about owing me?" Her eyes flash, and her tail whips around at her feet before thudding into the floor hard enough to kick up dust. "Yes. [flags.WC_SAW_DOTTIRS |If not for your timely intervention I'd be dead as a doornail, or have had my brain scrubbed clean out by some dark inky tentacle from beyond. |This is the most excited I've seen my mother about anything... ever. ]" She trails a long tongue over her upper teeth, showing off some impressive incisors to go with the rest of her neat, white, humanoid set. "So, first of all; thank you. The name is Aileh... Aileh Kasyrradottir." [pc.dcb |"Oh, uh. You're welcome, I guess." |"Oh? Well, you're certainly welcome." |"Aww, that's oki-doki cutie." ] Her cheeks are dark enough to show off some freckles, and she clears her throat before continuing. "And since I owe you, I have decided to do you the great favor of not fu— ruining any of your plans, or getting in the way." "That's[pc.isBimbo |, like, ] a weird way to interrupt yourself. Something wrong?" Aileh scowls and clears her throat, putting away her hairbrush. "Nothing is wrong, I just don't like cursing. Now, if I could continue?" "Go ahead[pc.isBimbo |! |. ]" "I'm moving in here." "Pardon?!" Her scowl becomes an utterly-delighted grin at your expression and her wings unconsciously burst forth from her back, flapping a few times. The grin doesn't last long when it kicks up enough dust to make you cough, rather ruining the moment. "And— urgh. I'll be sweeping this place up." "Okay, and why are you moving in?" You blink your eyes against the dust, watching as her wings retract and disappear once more. "I don't want to be homeless, mother is busy, I don't want to be pestered by vapid, air-headed servants, and I thought it would be interesting." "And if I don't want you here?" To her credit, Aileh looks offended, placing a hand on her chest. "Well, I would be terribly hurt. And all bets would be off on me staying out of the conflict. Don't be a jerk, I'll be here, out of the way." She thumps a fist on her palm, gesturing out of the broken hole in the wall-slash-roof. "Tell you what, I'll even fight off threats to the fort— don't expect me to go directly against mom though, she will spank me." It sounds like a good deal, at least. "Aren't you a demon?" Her expression darkens truly, and she bites a black bottom lip. "No. I'm not, don't want to be, and never will be. I don't care if you want demons, or not. I'm me, and always will be. I've had my fill." There's probably a story there, but the dragon seems disinclined to share it. Instead she lets the tension bleed away before offering a hand. "How about it then?"
rows.translation: 她匆匆穿上了衣服，正忙着把头发弄直，同时擦去身上的汗水。“给你……”那个肌肉发达的怪物咧嘴一笑，舔了舔她那深黑色的嘴唇，“你觉得这场表演怎么样？” “你为什么觉得欠我什么？” 她的眼睛闪着光芒，尾巴在脚边猛地一甩，重重砸在地板上，扬起了阵阵灰尘。“是的，我确实觉得欠你什么。 [flags.WC_SAW_DOTTIRS |要不是你及时出手相救，我现在早就死了，或者被那些来自黑暗中的触手彻底夺走了大脑。 |这是我见过我母亲对任何事情如此兴奋的一次……真的是有史以来第一次。 ]她将长舌头伸到上齿旁，那整齐洁白的门牙显得格外引人注目，与她整个人类般的容貌相得益彰。“首先，非常感谢你们。我叫艾莉……艾莉·卡西拉多蒂尔。 [pc.dcb |哦，呃，应该不客气吧。 |哦？嗯，当然不客气。 |哇，好可爱啊。 ] 她的脸颊颜色较深，因此能隐约看到一些雀斑。她清了清嗓子，然后继续说道：“既然我欠你一个人情，我就决定帮你这个大忙——不会破坏你的任何计划，也不会妨碍你的事情。” “那真是太好了[pc.isBimbo |就像，比如说…… ]这种打断自己的方式也太奇怪了吧……是不是出了什么问题？” 艾莉皱了皱眉头，清了清嗓子，然后把梳子收了起来。“没什么问题，我只是不喜欢说脏话而已。现在，能让我继续说吗？” “请继续吧。[pc.isBimbo |！ |。 ]我要搬到这里来住。” “什么？！” 看到你这样的反应，她原本紧绷的表情立刻变成了欣喜若狂的微笑，她的翅膀也不由自主地从背后展开，扑腾了几下。当灰尘飞扬到让人忍不住咳嗽的程度时，那笑容很快就消失了，反而破坏了当时的气氛。“还有——呃，我得把这里打扫干净。” “好吧，那你为什么要搬进来住呢？”你眯着眼睛，试图抵挡飞扬的灰尘，同时看着她的翅膀再次收拢，消失不见了。 我不想无家可归，妈妈也很忙，我更不想被那些空洞无物的仆人烦扰，所以我觉得这样会挺有意思的。” “那要是我不希望你在这里呢？ 值得称赞的是，艾莱赫显得非常生气，她把手放在胸口说道：“哼，如果你们这样对我，我会感到非常受伤的。而且，我是否会置身事外也就很难说了。别这么混蛋，我会留在这里，只是不会妨碍你们的。”她用拳头敲了敲自己的手掌，然后指了指墙上那个被砍出的洞和破损的屋顶，表示自己会待在那里。告诉你吧，我甚至会挺身而出抵抗任何对这座堡垒的威胁——不过别指望我会直接与妈妈作对，她会打我吧。” 至少听起来像是个不错的交易。“你不是恶魔吗？” 她的表情顿时变得阴沉起来，她咬住了下唇：“不，我不是恶魔，也不想成为恶魔，永远都不会。我不在乎你想要无论是恶魔还是别的什么，我始终都是我，永远都会是这样。我已经受够了。 其中或许藏着一些故事，但这条龙似乎并不愿意分享。相反，它让那种紧张的气氛慢慢消散，然后才伸出了援手。“那么，你觉得怎么样呢？

You take the draconic general's — or, it would seem, part-time-general's — hand and give her [pc.strengthRange 85
                        |an appropriately tough handshake. Aileh rises to the occasion, stepping in and tightening her grip in turn. Soon your handshake shifts into a warrior's grasp, and your biceps are pulsing with the effort of proving yourself the superior. "What's wrong?" Aileh finally grunts between her teeth.                         Your 'handshake' eventually ends with no clear winner, merely a cramp in both of your arms that you've got to flex away. But she looks pleased enough with the effort. "I don't have many things to move in, come on back... you know, whenever you need to pester me over whatever. Otherwise I'm staying mostly out of the way."

rows.original: Aileh sighs and scratches the back of her neck, fluffing out her luscious red locks. "Ah, mother, mom... I'm not sure how much I could, or should, tell you." "Why do all of this?" you ask, confirming when the dragoness gives you a blank stare. "Why the corruption, changing people, the fucking literally everyone?" She bites a dark black lip and thinks for a few moments, tail lashing about irritably. "Because mom needs to. Not like anyone's forcing her, but she needs to so badly that she might as well be forced by some power outside of her control." Aileh clears her throat and avoids looking at you. "Look, I am a biased observer here." "So you love your mother?" Aileh growls softly and folds her arms, looking away from you for a moment. "Of course! She raised me, her blood runs through me — albeit not a large amount. She, on the other hand, uh...." When she looks back towards you, there's a little hurt on her face. "Mom doesn't quite understand love. She tries, and it's this compulsion that eats her up. It's like jealousy, and need, and lust, and caring all tied up into one mess." [aileh.friendLover |You wrap your arms around her, giving the dragon a hug until her tail is thrashing. |You wrap your arms around her, giving your lover a hug and stroking one of her ears until her tail is twitching nervously. |"I... didn't mean to hit a sensitive spot." Aileh scowls and takes a deep breath, shifting her stance on the wall she leans against. "How did you not expect my demonic mother to be a sensitive spot! What you mean to say is 'oops, I didn't know you had feelings', which burns a little." ] Silence extends in the room before she clears her throat and continues, tail swishing more gently now. "Look, mom wants... to do something about her own fate, but I don't trust the skeevy little cult trying to chase her tail to be of any help in that regard. I'm not about to go telling you her darkest secrets, but I do know she's interested in you, a lot." Huh, that's something to be concerned about, but that's a problem for future-[pc.name]. ] |"Can't understand why, yet." ]
rows.translation: 艾莱赫叹了口气，挠了挠后颈，把一头浓密的红发拨松。“啊，母亲，妈妈……我不确定自己能告诉你多少，或者该不该告诉你。” “为什么要做这些？”你问道；见这位龙女茫然地瞪着你，你便继续说下去。“为什么要腐化、要改变人们，还要操遍每一个人？” 她咬着一片乌黑的嘴唇，想了片刻，尾巴烦躁地甩来甩去。“因为妈妈必须这么做。并不是有谁在逼她，但她太需要这么做了，简直就像被某种她无法控制的力量逼着一样。”艾莱赫清了清嗓子，避开你的目光。“听着，我在这件事上是有偏见的。” “所以你爱你的母亲？” 艾莱赫低声咆哮，抱起双臂，把视线移开了一会儿。“当然爱！是她把我养大的，她的血在我体内流淌——虽然不是很多。而她，另一方面，呃……”当她再把目光转回你身上时，脸上带着一点受伤的神色。“妈妈并不真正懂爱。她在努力，而这种冲动把她自己吞噬了。那就像嫉妒、需求、欲望和关心全都缠成一团乱麻。” [aileh.friendLover |你伸手环住她，把这条龙抱了个满怀，直到她的尾巴剧烈甩动。 |你伸手环住她，抱住你的爱人，抚摸着她的耳朵，直到她的尾巴紧张地抽动。 |“我……不是故意戳到你的痛处的。” 艾莱赫皱起脸，深吸一口气，换了个姿势靠在墙上。“你怎么会不觉得我那个恶魔母亲是个痛处！你想说的其实是：哎呀，我原本不知道你还有感情——这话有点扎人。” ] 房间里沉默了一阵，她才清了清嗓子继续说下去，尾巴此时摆得轻柔了些。“听着，妈妈想要……对自己的命运做点什么，可我不信那个想追着她尾巴跑的鬼祟小教团在这件事上能帮上什么忙。我不会把她的秘密告诉你，但我确实知道她对你很感兴趣，非常感兴趣。” [aileh.friendLover |“总有一天，我们得好好谈谈她想对我朋友施压这件事。” |“她最好学会怎么分享，”艾莱赫气哼哼地说。“要是她把你从我身边彻底抢走，我想我受不了。” [aileh.pregStage 1 |不过她脸上随即绽开一个坏笑，轻轻抚摸着自己怀孕的肚子。“虽然是我赢了这场怀孕竞赛。你知道她发现之后会黏人得让人受不了吧？” 嗯，这倒确实值得担心，不过那是未来-[pc.name]要操心的问题。 ] |“还是不明白为什么。” ]

rows.original:
The red-scaled monster ponders and waits, as though to taste the question. Her tongue rolls around in her mouth, and she mulls and waits before finally speaking up. "Sure, only if you tell me about your childhood first."

    Huh. That's only fair, you suppose. 
    
    It's difficult to say, your own history blurs into a string of highs and lows— you left a lot of people behind, when you traveled.
rows.translation:
那只红鳞怪物若有所思地等待着，仿佛在仔细斟酌这个问题的答案。它的舌头在口中转动着，沉思片刻后终于开口说道：“好吧，但前提是你得先告诉我你的童年故事。”

    嗯，这样似乎也挺公平的。 
    
    不过，这确实很难说。自己的过去往往只是一系列起伏不断的经历罢了——在旅行的过程中，你确实留下了很多人在身后。
rows.raw:
"
    The red-scaled monster ponders and waits, as though to taste the question. Her tongue rolls around in her mouth, and she mulls and waits before finally speaking up. "Sure, only if you tell me about your childhood first."

    Huh. That's only fair, you suppose. 
    
    It's difficult to say, your own history blurs into a string of highs and lows— you left a lot of people behind, when you traveled."

rows.original: [pc.dcb |"It's a bit of a shitty tale," |"It's a somewhat sad tale," |"It's a super-duper bummer though," ] you confess. "I didn't make a lot of friends when I was a child, and that didn't transition into many friends when I was an adult." You begin to tell your tale, with Aileh hanging off of your every word. Her bottom lip actually begins to quiver as you reach the crux of the story. "And so you just... left it all behind?" "It wasn't much to leave behind by the end of the tale." You sigh and lean back, feeling... honestly terrible. You've been so preoccupied with your new life that it's easy to leave the past back there, and it takes you a few minutes to shake the sensation that's weighing your shoulders down. To the dragoness's credit she actually looks a little awkward about recounting her own childhood, twiddling her fingers and cracking her neck. "Alright, well... uh." Aileh flounders, trying to start up again. "I come from a clutch of eggs, alchemically altered by momma Kasy, instead of... the traditional way. Otherwise we'd be gross imps. She babied us, and cared for us, and did the things mothers are supposed to do. She cared — cares — for us all, but more in the way that we belong to her, than actually maternally. Mom just can't help it." "Can't help what?" "Feeling unfinished, is how she put it. Like having a family would complete her, except we were never entirely a family. She threw herself into her work, sparing us only fleeting moments of parenthood when she could, and produced some incredible feats for a frankly undeserving bi— woman. But mom did learn a bunch about souls and portals from her, which is why I think you got scrambled like a basket full of harpy eggs." "You did it again." You interrupt Aileh. "You interrupted yourself, do you hate the word bitch?" Aileh's pale cheeks brighten to match her scales, and her tail cracks noisily on the floor. "No! I just— I don't like cursing, alright? The mommest thing mom ever did was teach us to speak properly, and although I get... slang-y sometimes, I at least manage that." "It matters that much?" "...She washed my mouth out with soap. I can still remember that taste every time I'm about to say the f-word, or c-word, or even call someone a... that." She makes a soft 'bleh' and waves the matter off. "My upbringing was honestly simple; mother tried her best, I got all big and curvy and strong like her, and when we were of age we got these piercings to protect us." Aileh reveals her plump, pierced nipple with a wicked smile. "Protects me from ever squirting out my soul if I lose myself to luscious depravity, bullying weaklings for being weak, and leading demons in glorious battle." "Are you actually that corrupt?" That gives the dragon pause, before she shrugs helplessly. "By default of my mother's contribution to my blood? I imagine so. That and being a dominant violence-monger with deeply unresolved mommy-issues probably doesn't help. Are we done with this topic now? I'm still bummed out from your story." "Sure."
rows.translation: [pc.dcb |“这故事有点糟糕啊，” |“这是一个有些悲伤的故事，” |“不过，这真的太让人失望了，” ]你坦白道。“我小时候没交到多少朋友，成年后也没能因此多出几个朋友。” 你开始讲述自己的故事，艾莱赫全神贯注地听着你说的每一个字。当你讲到故事的关键处时，她的下唇甚至开始微微发抖。 “所以你就……把这一切都抛在了身后？” “到故事结尾的时候，其实也没什么值得留下的了。”你叹了口气，向后靠在椅背上，心里……说实话，感觉糟透了。你一直忙着投入新生活，很容易就把过去留在原地；过了好几分钟，你才终于甩掉那种压在肩头的沉重感。 值得称道的是，这位龙女在回忆自己的童年时确实显得有些局促，她摆弄着手指，还扭了扭脖子。“好吧，嗯……”艾莱赫支支吾吾，想重新开口，“我是从一窝蛋里孵化出来的，被卡希拉妈妈用炼金术改造过，而不是……传统的方式。不然我们就是恶心的小恶魔了。她像母亲一样呵护我们、照料我们，做母亲该做的一切。她在乎——一直都很在乎——我们所有人，但更像是把我们当成她的所有物，而不是真正的母爱。妈妈就是控制不住自己。” “控制不住什么？” “她说，就是觉得自己还没完成。就好像有了家庭她才会完整，可我们从来都不算一个完整的家庭。她一头扎进工作里，只在抽得出空的时候给我们片刻的母爱，还为一位说实话根本不配的女性创造出了不少惊人的成果。不过妈妈确实从她那里学到了很多关于灵魂与传送门的知识，所以我觉得你才会被搅得像一篮子鹰身女妖蛋一样乱七八糟。” “你又来了。”你打断艾莱赫，“你打断了自己，你是不是讨厌贱人这个词？” 艾莱赫苍白的脸颊涨得和她的鳞片一样红，尾巴在地板上噼啪作响。“不！我只是——我不喜欢说脏话，行吗？妈妈做过最有妈妈样的事，就是教我们好好说话；虽然我有时候会……冒出些俚语，但至少这一点我做到了。” “这有那么重要吗？” “……她用肥皂洗过我的嘴。每次我快要说出那句脏话、那个脏字，甚至想叫谁……那个的时候，我都还记得那股味道。”她轻轻呃了一声，摆手把这事带过去。“我的成长经历其实很简单；母亲尽了全力，我像她一样长得高大、丰满又强壮，等我们成年后，就打了这些穿孔来保护我们。” 艾莱赫露出一个邪恶的微笑，亮出自己那对饱满、打了穿孔的乳头。“它能保护我，让我在沉溺于甜美的堕落、欺负弱小、率领恶魔投入光荣的战斗时，永远不会把灵魂漏出去。” “你真的有那么堕落吗？” 这话让那头龙顿了一下，随后她无奈地耸了耸肩。“大概是继承了我母亲留在我血液里的那部分吧？我想是的。再加上我本来就是个崇尚暴力的主儿，还带着一堆没解决的恋母情结，恐怕也帮不上什么忙。这个话题我们能到此为止了吗？你的故事还是让我挺郁闷的。” “当然。”

rows.original: Tell her how you were driven to these frozen lands.
rows.translation: 告诉她，是什么驱使你来到了这片冰封之地。
rows.raw: "Tell her how you were driven to these frozen lands."

She follows along the ebb and flow of your story, actually smiling by the end. "And you packed it all up, just like that?"
