rows.original: Tell her about the promises you've made to carve out your own future.
rows.translation: 告诉她你为创造属于自己的未来所做出的那些承诺。
rows.raw: "Tell her about the promises you've made to carve out your own future."

rows.original: "Uuuh, funny story, that." "What, do you have no past?" "No I mean it's literally a funny story!" You grin and crack your knuckles, settling in for the telling. "I had my share of opportunities as a youth, and most of them were spent too drunk to recall. I would tumble from one drinking hole, trip down the stairs, and practically land in a brand new opportunity." Aileh looks on and listens in utter disbelief as you begin to recount your tales, bursting out laughing when you describe the antics of you and your friends. "And then they bought him a horse!" You add, slapping your knee and rocking back while the dragon fights down the desperately un-intimidating need to giggle-snort. When your laughter finally comes to an end, there's a quiet, bittersweet tang to the air. "I don't have memories like that, it's nearly impossible to imagine." "Well, it's your turn now..." rows.translation: “呃呃，这事说来还挺好笑的。” “怎么，你难道没有过去吗？” “不是，我是说这真的就是个好笑的故事！”你咧嘴一笑，掰了掰指关节，摆开讲故事的架势。“我年轻时也有过不少机会，但大多数时候都醉得记不清了。我会从一个酒馆里跌出来，在楼梯上摔一跤，然后几乎正好跌进一个全新的机会里。” 艾莱赫满脸难以置信地看着你、听着你开始讲述自己的故事，当你描述你和朋友们的那些荒唐事时，她更是笑得前仰后合。“然后他们还给他买了一匹马！”你补充道，一边拍着膝盖、向后仰去，而那头龙正努力压下那股一点也不吓人的、想咯咯喷笑的冲动。 当你的笑声终于停下时，空气里残留着一丝淡淡的、苦乐参半的味道。“我没有那样的回忆，几乎无法想象。” “好吧，现在轮到你了……”你示意艾莱赫继续，让自己的嗓子歇一歇。 “我是一窝蛋孵化出来的，由卡希拉妈妈用炼金术孕育，而不是……传统的方式。所以我们才不是恶心的小恶魔。她像母亲一样呵护我们、照料我们，做母亲该做的一切。她在乎——一直都很在乎——我们所有人，但更像是把我们当成她的所有物，而不是真正的母爱。妈妈就是控制不住自己。” “控制不住什么？” “她说，就是觉得自己还没完成。就好像有了家庭她才会完整，可我们从来都不算一个完整的家庭。她一头扎进工作里，只在抽得出空的时候给我们片刻的母爱，还为一位说实话根本不配的女性创造出了不少惊人的成果。不过妈妈确实从她那里学到了很多关于灵魂与传送门的知识，所以我觉得你才会被搅得像一篮子鹰身女妖蛋一样乱七八糟。” “你又来了。”你打断艾莱赫，“你打断了自己，你是不是讨厌贱人这个词？” 艾莱赫苍白的脸颊涨得和她的鳞片一样红，尾巴在地板上噼啪作响。“不！我只是——我不喜欢说脏话，行吗？妈妈做过最有妈妈样的事，就是教我们好好说话；虽然我有时候会……冒出些俚语，但至少这一点我做到了。” “这有那么重要吗？” “……她用肥皂洗过我的嘴。每次我快要说出那句脏话、那个脏字，甚至想叫谁……那个的时候，我都还记得那股味道。”她轻轻呃了一声，摆手把这事带过去。“我的成长经历其实很简单；母亲尽了全力，我像她一样长得高大、丰满又强壮，等我们成年后，就打了这些穿孔来保护我们。” 艾莱赫露出一个邪恶的微笑，亮出自己那对饱满、打了穿孔的乳头。“它能保护我，让我在沉溺于甜美的堕落、欺负弱小、率领恶魔投入光荣的战斗时，永远不会把灵魂漏出去。” “你真的有那么堕落吗？” 这话让那头龙顿了一下，随后她无奈地耸了耸肩。“大概是继承了我母亲留在我血液里的那部分吧？我想是的。再加上我本来就是个崇尚暴力的主儿，还带着一堆没解决的恋母情结，恐怕也帮不上什么忙。这个话题我们能到此为止了吗？我永远也比不上你的故事。” “当然。”
rows.raw: ' "Uuuh, funny story, that." "What, do you have no past?" "No I mean it's literally a funny story!" You grin and crack your knuckles, settling in for the telling. "I had my share of opportunities as a youth, and most of them were spent too drunk to recall. I would tumble from one drinking hole, trip down the stairs, and practically land in a brand new opportunity." Aileh looks on and listens in utter disbelief as you begin to recount your tales, bursting out laughing when you describe the antics of you and your friends. "And then they bought him a horse!" You add, slapping your knee and rocking back while the dragon fights down the desperately un-intimidating need to giggle-snort. When your laughter finally comes to an end, there's a quiet, bittersweet tang to the air. "I don't have memories like that, it's nearly impossible to imagine." "Well, it's your turn now..." You wave Aileh on and give your voice a rest. "I come from a clutch of eggs, alchemically birthed by momma Kasy, instead of... the traditional way. It's why we're not gross imps. She babied us, and cared for us, and did the things mothers are supposed to do. She cared — cares — for us all, but more in the way that we belong to her, than actually maternally. Mom just can't help it." "Can't help what?" "Feeling unfinished, is how she put it. Like having a family would complete her, except we were never entirely a family. She threw herself into her work, sparing us only fleeting moments of parenthood when she could, and produced some incredible feats for a frankly undeserving bi— woman. But mom did learn a bunch about souls and portals from her, which is why I think you got scrambled like a basket full of harpy eggs." "You did it again." You interrupt Aileh. "You interrupted yourself, do you hate the word bitch?" Aileh's pale cheeks brighten to match her scales, and her tail cracks noisily on the floor. "No! I just— I don't like cursing, alright? The mommest thing mom ever did was teach us to speak properly, and although I get... slang-y sometimes, I at least manage that." "It matters that much?" "...She washed my mouth out with soap. I can still remember that taste every time I'm about to say the f-word, or c-word, or even call someone a... that." She makes a soft 'bleh' and waves the matter off. "My upbringing was honestly simple; mother tried her best, I got all big and curvy and strong like her, and when we were of age we got these piercings to protect us." Aileh reveals her plump, pierced nipple with a wicked smile. "Protects me from ever squirting out my soul if I lose myself to luscious depravity, bullying weaklings for being weak, and leading demons in glorious battle." "Are you actually that corrupt?" That gives the dragon pause, before she shrugs helplessly. "By default of my mother's contribution to my blood? I imagine so. That and being a dominant violence-monger with deeply unresolved mommy-issues probably doesn't help. Are we done with this topic now? I'm never going to be a match for your story." "Sure."'

rows.original:
"Hm." Aileh's tail twitches, and she rubs at her arm. [aileh.friendLover
        |"I still struggle to consider if I have some kind of dream; I'm going to outlive most of the people I know, and it probably sounds quite mercenary but I'm waiting to see who wins out of you and mom."
        
        The red dragon gives you a gentle thump on the arm. "I may still be running the occasional errand for her, but I'm betting on you. It's hard to have a dream in an uncertain future, but I'm sure you'll feature in that dream somehow."
        |"Aren't you a forward little thing, love? Surely— okay, I was going to just flirt... But really? It's hard to have a dream in an uncertain future; I adore you, but I'm never going to go directly against my mother. The world will be a different place depending on how things between the two of you shake out, I just know that no matter what happens I'll lay claim to you. Deal?"
        
        You pinch her air and she laughs, biting your shoulder and cuddling up a little closer. "Deal."
        |"Dreams are stupid; for all I know the world's just going to be vapid airheads from dusk 'til dawn, or it'll be so filled to the brim with goody-gumdrops that I'm going to feel like an outcast. I don't know whether my mother wants to lay you, or slay you, I just know I'm staying out of it."
    ]
rows.translation:
“嗯。”艾莱赫的尾巴抽动了一下，她揉着自己的手臂。 [aileh.friendLover
        |“我还是很难想清楚自己有没有什么梦想；我会比我认识的大多数人活得都久，这听起来可能很功利，但我确实在等着看你和我妈妈最后谁能赢。”
        
        红龙在你手臂上轻轻捶了一下。“我可能还会偶尔替她跑跑腿，但我押的是你。在不确定的未来里，很难拥有什么梦想，不过我相信你总会以某种方式出现在那个梦里。”
        |“你这个小家伙还挺大胆的，亲爱的？当然——好吧，我本来只是想调情……但说真的？在不确定的未来里，很难拥有什么梦想；我很爱你，但我绝不会直接跟我母亲作对。你们俩之间的事会怎么收场，世界就会变成什么样子。我只知道，无论发生什么，我都会把你据为己有。成交？”
        
        你捏了捏她的鼻子，她笑了起来，咬了一口你的肩膀，又往你身边凑近了些。“成交。”
        |“梦想是蠢东西；说不定这世界从黄昏到黎明都只剩下一堆空洞无脑的家伙，或者被那些甜得发腻的好好先生塞得满满当当，让我觉得自己像个异类。我不知道我母亲是想上你，还是想杀你，我只知道我要置身事外。”
    ]

rows.original: Aileh looks a little insulted when you bring the matter up, folding her arms and sighing. "What do you mean, 'what do I think about corruption', [aileh.friendLover |[pc.name] |love |doofus ]? Do you know what corruption actually is?" [pc.isCunning |"I figure[pc.isBimbo |, like, ] corruption is bottoming out the needle on a moral compass. And when your compassion is all gone you become a demon." |"Just... becoming or being evil, maybe?" ] "Not... wrong, but not nearly a deep enough description. See, you don't just start super-corrupt, most of the time. I've seen corruption take hold of people. Their lives change little by little. They become wicked, stop caring about things... or start caring far too much about their obsessions to the exclusion of everything else. Eventually, when you grow too corrupt, and give up too many aspects of yourself, you spunk out your soul and then you're a demon." Aileh wrings her hands and thinks for a moment, tail lashing around. "I'm not exactly the sharpest tool, I'm not educated in the magic part of it like mom, but if I were to let corruption take me fully, and just give into my desires, I'd likely not be a demon of— like mother, but a demon of domination; I love being powerful, and being in control." She clicks her tongue, having gotten herself all riled up before she deflates. "That, though, would also probably twist me up into some messy echo of myself that loves all forms of domination. I'd be flapping around with a hundred-strong harem of juicy boys and girls, and I'd never stop. It'd eat away at me to be anything less than in total control, and I'd not be doing it just because I love it." "Being corrupt sounds sad, like that." "Eeeh..." The dragon general's hand wavers from side-to-side. "Not sad, being corrupt is great. I don't let anyone stop me, I'm strong, I'm confident, I'm happy." [aileh.friendLover |She averts her gaze with you and clears her throat. "Well, okay, I do let my bestie stop me, a little bit." |She licks her lips and leans into you. "Alright, well, I let someone stop me, my dear heart. But that only makes everything else I do better." ] You give her a few seconds to muddle over her words, once you notice her brows furrowing a little. "I do think being a demon fuc— really sucks, though, it wouldn't be the same. I'm pro-corruption, just... not pro-demon. I'm one of the lucky ones; I can't fall all the way off of that cliff." "Can anyone get those piercings of yours?" Aileh shakes her head and frowns. "Doubt it, not in this place, at least. Maybe after mother's given a few centuries to work her magic, but that's not time this world has for whatever you or mom are planning."
rows.translation: 你提起这个问题时，艾莱赫似乎有些受辱；她双臂抱胸，叹了口气。“什么叫‘我怎么看待腐化’，[aileh.friendLover |[pc.name] |爱人 |笨蛋 ]？你知道腐化实际上是什么吗？” [pc.isCunning |“我觉得[pc.isBimbo |，比如说， ]腐化就是把道德罗盘的指针压到最底。等同情心完全消失，你就会变成恶魔。” |“大概就是……变成坏人，或者本来就很坏？” ] “不算……错，但远远不够深入。你看，大多数时候，一个人不是突然开始极度腐化。我亲眼见过腐化控制别人。他们的生活一点一点改变。他们变得邪恶，不再在乎事物……或者对自身执念在乎得过了头，排斥其他一切。最后，你变得过于腐化，又舍弃自身太多面向，便会把灵魂喷出去，随后变成恶魔。” 艾莱赫绞着双手思考片刻，尾巴四处鞭打。“我不算最聪明的人，也不像妈妈那样接受过魔法方面的教育；不过，如果自己任腐化彻底吞没，只知屈服于欲望，我大概不会成为与母亲相同类型的恶魔，而会成为支配恶魔；我喜欢强大，也喜欢掌控一切。” 她咂了咂舌，刚才把自己说得无比激动，随后又泄了气。“可是，那大概也会将我扭曲成自身混乱的残影，热爱所有形式的支配。我会拍着翅膀四处行动，带着由上百名多汁男女组成的后宫，永不停止。不能完全掌控一切会不断侵蚀我；而且我这样做，不再只因为自己喜欢。” “照你这样说，遭到腐化听起来很悲伤。” “呃——……”龙将的手左右摇晃。“并不悲伤，腐化很棒。我不让任何人阻止自己；我强大、自信又快乐。”[aileh.friendLover |她避开你的视线，清清嗓子。“好吧，我的确会让好朋友稍微阻止一下。” |她舔舔嘴唇，贴近你。“好吧，我会让某个人阻止我，心肝。不过，这只会令我做的其他一切更加美好。” ] 你发现她稍稍皱起眉毛，便留出几秒让她梳理言辞。“不过，我的确认为变成恶魔他妈——真的很糟；那不会一样。我赞成腐化，只是……不赞成变成恶魔。我是幸运者之一；我不会彻底跌下那道悬崖。” “任何人都能得到你这样的穿孔饰品吗？” 艾莱赫摇头皱眉。“恐怕不能，至少这里没有。也许等母亲得到几个世纪施展魔法；可是无论你或妈妈在计划什么，这个世界都没有那么多时间。”

rows.translation: 你们俩静静地等待着，这段等待时间有些漫长，也让人感到些许紧张，但更多的是充满了温馨与陪伴。 [wayfort.hasMaids |你的女仆们表现得非常称职，她们会在每顿饭的时间来提醒你们，如果你们不出去至少做些晨练，就会责备你们。为了防止你们担心，她们还会承诺在你们外出期间帮忙照看你们的鸡蛋。 ]露米，你这个谦逊的助手，一定会定期来访的。[wayfort.hasMaids | 也 ]有炖菜、汤品和三明治。 不久之后，另一个装着礼物的篮子送到了艾莱手中，篮子上系着漂亮的粉色丝带，还散发着丁香花的香气。龙看到这个礼物后，高兴得直喘气，它解开丝带，里面是一系列看起来非常美味的新鲜出炉的派饼。然而，当你伸手去拿其中一个时，却只听到一声轻拍手腕的声音：“哦，怎么啦，亲爱的？妈妈准备的礼物，你居然还想偷偷拿一个给自己吗？” 虽然她的声音里带着戏弄的意味，但你可以从那条龙的眼睛里看到一丝伤感；毕竟，正是因为你的缘故，卡希拉才无法在她女儿孵化的时刻陪在她身边。好吧，好吧。”你凑过去亲了亲龙的额头，然后用手指轻轻触碰它那只精灵般的耳朵。“好好保护你的宝贝们哦。” 艾莱又开心地笑了起来，吐出舌头，然后咬了一口派。“你知道的，我爱你。我很高兴有你在我身边，你真是太棒了。 [pc.mf | |同性恋者 ]笨蛋。” 经过将近两整天的亲热拥抱、接吻以及各种亲密举动，你们的注意力突然被蛋壳内部发生的动静吸引了。艾莱紧紧抓住你的手臂，力度大到让你感到有些疼痛，她的眼睛瞪得大大的，尾巴也竖了起来。“开始了！啊！”她摇晃着你，同时凑近过来，仿佛你还没有注意到似的。“[pc.name]！时候到了！我们该帮她吗？”你可以看到有某种东西在液体中移动，那是一个胖乎乎的、正在伸展的身体，它不断地挤压着蛋壳的内壁。 “不……还不行……只有在她真正遇到困难的时候才帮忙。”尽管如此，艾莉还是咬住了自己的指关节，努力克制自己不去去救你的女儿。 时间仿佛以一种令人痛苦的速度缓缓流逝。你的女儿不断地挣扎、碰撞、摇晃，最终，蛋壳表面终于出现一道细微的裂痕。你的[pc.isDK |冰冷、阴暗的小小心脏 |心脏 ]猛地跳到了嗓子眼，你屏住呼吸，满心期待地等待着——直到那个小角终于穿透了蛋壳，一股浓稠的液体涌了出来。 这套被褥就这样被彻底毁掉了，但这些都已经不重要了。现在蛋壳上已经有了一个洞，你的小龙女儿继续在蛋壳里扭动、挣扎，朝着光的方向移动……而艾莉也兴奋地发出咯咯的笑声——最终，蛋壳彻底破裂了。 我、我的宝贝……”艾莉赫惊呼着，毫不犹豫地伸手进入那一团混乱中，将那只长满鳞片的小婴儿抱了出来。它那淡棕色的肌肤上沾满了类似蛋液般的黏液，等到它接触到阳光后，皮肤上肯定会出现雀斑般的斑点；它的四肢上还分布着一些鲜红色的鳞片。那只是一小撮柔软的黑发，上面长着两颗小小的角状突起。艾莱赫难以置信地望着这个婴儿，她通红的双眼里开始闪烁着泪光。“我们的宝宝，她……她没事的！”她张开双翼将你拥入怀中，轻轻拍着婴儿的背，直到它打出一口黏稠的奶液。 她的手把那些乱七八糟的东西拢起来，扔到了那些破碎的、像皮革一样的蛋壳残渣里，然后发出一声痛苦的叫声——你的女儿发现了一只小虫子，她用尽全力，还有那些显然很锋利的小牙齿，紧紧抓住了它。“哈……真没料到会这样。”艾莱赫脸红了，看着你，用一只翅膀尽可能地把你拉得更近一些。“看吧，亲爱的……我们自己珍贵的小宝贝。 婴儿安静地吃着东西，最后把头靠在艾莱的怀里，打了个哈欠。“啊啊啊，我要死了，她太可爱了……”你的龙族女友抱怨道，眼睛里噙满了泪水。“抱着她的感觉真是太棒了……
rows.raw: ' The two of you settle in for a long, somewhat-nervous, but mostly-cuddly wait. [wayfort.hasMaids |Your maids prove to be perfect, ensuring they stop by every meal time, and tell the two of you off if you don't go outside and at least do some morning exercises — with a promise to watch your egg while you're gone, for paranoia's sake. ]Rumie, your humble beetender, makes sure to regularly visit[wayfort.hasMaids | as well ], with stews, soups, and sandwiches. At some point another basket arrives for Aileh, wrapped in beautiful pink ribbons and smelling of lilacs. The dragon gasps with utter delight and unties it, revealing a delicious-looking assortment of freshly baked pies. When you reach for one, however, you get a gentle slap on the wrist. "Oh, what's this dear heart? Treats from mom and you're looking to sneak one for yourself?" Although there's a tone of teasing to her voice, you can see at least a sliver of hurt in the dragon's eyes; it's your fault Kasyrra can't be here with her for the hatching of her daughter. "Fine, fine." You lean in and kiss your dragon on the brow, trailing a finger along an elfin ear. "Keep your sweeties." Aileh brightens up again and pokes her tongue out before nibbling a slice of pie. "Love you, you know. I'm glad I have you with me, you tremendous, [pc.mf | |gay ]dork." It takes nearly two entire days of salacious cuddling, kissing, and egg-holding, before your joint attention is abruptly stolen by motion from within the egg. Aileh squeezes your arm so hard it actually hurts, eyes going wide and tail shooting up on end. "It's time! Ah!" She shakes you and leans in, as though you weren't already enraptured. "[pc.name]! It's time!" "Do we help her?" You can see the shadow of a form moving within liquid, a chubby, stretching thing that presses against the inside. "N-no, not yet... only if she struggles." Aileh bites her knuckles regardless, leaning in and visibly forcing herself not to dive to your daughter's aid. Time begins to drag itself out at an agonizing pace, as your daughter pushes, and bumps, rocking and shaking before finally there's a little rip in the egg's textured surface. Your [pc.isDK |cold, dark little |heart ] leaps up into your throat, and you hold your breath in open anticipation before a little horn finally punches through the membrane and a gush of thick fluids follow. That is a set of bedding officially ruined, but such concerns are secondary. Now that there's a hole in the egg, your little draconic daughter continues to poke, thrash, and squirm in the direction of light — and Aileh's excited, delighted little squeals — before the egg gives way entirely. "M-my baby..." Aileh gasps, reaching into the mess without a second's thought and scooping out the little scaled infant. Pale caramel flesh glistens with egg...slime, that will no doubt be patterned in freckles when it comes to know the sun, and little bright red scales dot her limbs . There's only a tiny little mop of soft black hair, from which sprouts two tiny horn nubs. Aileh looks the infant over in abject disbelief, burning red eyes beginning to glisten with tears. "Our baby, sh-she's okay!" Her wings steal you into a hug, pulling you close as she pats the babe until it burps up a gobful of gunk. Her hand scoops up the mess and flicks it into the broken, leathery egg-remnants before letting out a pained yelp; your daughter has found a tit, and she latches onto it with full force and some apparently-sharp mini-teeth. "H-hah... didn't expect that." Aileh blushes and looks at you, holding you as close with one wing as she can. "Look, dear heart... our own precious little ember." The baby eats quietly, before finally leaning her head back into Aileh's cradling arm and letting out a hissing yawn. "Aaaaah, I'm going to die, she's too precious." Your draconic girlfriend whines, eyes huge and tear-filled. "It feels so right to hold her..." '

She gently, carefully adjusts, cradling [freja.name] into your arms with a smile. Her little wingies twitch against your arm, her adorable little dragon-tail wiggles, and a loud burp erupts from a tiny-tooth'd maw. You give her still-sticky mop a stroke anyway and snuggle up, enjoying the feeling of unbelievable warmth boiling off of the baby.
            
            [pc.isMilky
                |You raise your new daughter up, guiding her to one of your own milky nipples. She takes one deep drink before settling into soft suckles, although her hunger doesn't last for long. "She's probably full from eating egg... stuff." Aileh mumbles, reaching in and brushing Freja's hair. "The hunger will come later I'm sure." Her tail hugs you. "Oooh you make for a very sexy mommy, dear heart."
                
            ]Once you've lain together long enough to lose all of the sensation in your arm, Aileh lets you up with a soft sigh. "I've managed to hold onto you for days to myself, and it's been wonderful. But I think you have some big dumb hero stuff to get up to, right?"

She continues to gently cradle the sleepy little scale-potato, utterly radiating jubilance. "Dear heart, have you thought of a name for her? I had an idea, but... I already got to create a surname for her."
    
        "And you were thinking?"
        
        "Freja. Something strong, beautiful, and native to this land. But... I'd be delighted if you chose."

她继续轻轻抱着那只昏昏欲睡的小鳞片土豆，脸上洋溢着无比的喜悦。“亲爱的，你为她想好名字了吗？我有个主意，但是……我已经为她取好了姓氏。”
    
        “那你想的是什么名字？”

rows.original:
The first, and most noticeable facet, is that the demon queen is actually... clothed. It's a shocking difference to her usual attire-less attire, and she takes a few moments after landing to make sure she's properly dressed. She carries a basket under one arm, and an easy smile on her face. "I know you're probably already getting the royal treatment here in this fortress... but I couldn't resist adding to the selection available to you. And — before you ask — the ingredients are made from wholly uncorrupt sources, I'm evil, not a monster." Her eyes glitter with faint amusement as she places the wicker basket down and pulls out metal dishes with steam creeping up from their lids.

        Aileh sits bolt upright, bum unconsciously wiggling in the bed. "Mommy, you didn't..."
        
        Kasyrra proudly lifts the dish, revealing a combination of folded pasta sheets, meat, and a couple of different cheese. "Made with the finest Kay-Em ingredients, and a recipe perfected back in... uh, the 'old plane', behold; Lasagne." She unleashes upon your nostrils some crunchy, garlic-y bread, sharp powdered cheese, and some buttery, pan-fried potato dumplings. "Any alchemist worth their salt should be a legend in the kitchen, and I daresay I am painfully proud of these recipes. I would have brought a matching wine, but responsible mommies stick to juice."
        
        The three of you tuck into a soberingly-strange family meal; Aileh's tail remains wrapped around [pc.hasTail
            |yours
            |your hips
        ], Kasyrra quietly eats and allows the two of you to talk about nonsense entirely unrelated to your belated quest for [pc.dcb
            |conquest
            |freedom
            |hugs
        ]. There is a visible effort on the demon's part not to flirt with you, as much as it strains her... obviously seeing you being a responsible[pc.isDK
            |, surprisingly-considerate
        ] family-[pc.mf
            |man
            |woman
        ] is enough to turn the aspiring broodmother's legs to jelly.
        
        Eventually, your meal comes to a close, and your respective tummies are full to bursting. Kasyrra reaches into her basket again... sinking into it right up to the shoulder despite its shallow depth, before pulling out a blanket, and a book covered in eldritch symbols. Catching you looking, the demon queen laughs and waves her hand, wrapping up in the blanket, crossing one cloven foot over the other, and spreading the book in her lap. "Your daughter won't hatch for a few more hours yet, by my best approximations. This is just a little light reading, my [kasyrra.hlr
            |
            |
            |dear 
        ]champion."
rows.translation:
首先，也是最显而易见的一点是，这位恶魔女王实际上……穿着衣服。与她平时不穿衣服的装扮相比，这一变化实在令人震惊。她在落地后花了几秒钟时间，确认自己确实穿好了衣服。她一只手臂挎着篮子，脸上带着温暖的微笑。“我知道你们在这座堡垒里肯定已经享受到了最好的待遇……但我还是忍不住想为你们增添一些选择。而且——在你们问之前我就先说明——这些食材都是从完全可靠的渠道采购来的，我虽然有点坏心，但绝不是什么怪物。她将柳条篮子放在地上，从里面取出了那些盖子上冒着热气的金属餐具，她的眼睛里闪烁着一丝淡淡的笑意。

        艾莱赫坐得笔直，屁股在床上不自觉地扭来扭去。“妈妈，你没有……”
        
        卡希拉骄傲地端起了那道菜，里面是折叠好的意大利面、肉类，还有几种不同的奶酪。采用最上等的材料制作，配方更是早在……呃，‘老飞机时代’就定型了，看吧：千层面。”她让那些酥脆的大蒜味面包、浓郁的奶酪粉以及黄油煎过的土豆团块扑入你的鼻孔。任何称得上是真正炼金术士的人，都应该在厨房里成为传奇人物。而我，对自己这些食谱感到无比自豪。我本来想准备搭配的葡萄酒，但作为一个负责任的妈妈，我还是选择了果汁。
        
        你们三个人一起吃了一顿奇怪至极的家庭晚餐；艾莱的尾巴依然缠在[pc.hasTail
            |你的
            |你的臀部
        ]卡希拉安静地吃着，任由你们俩谈论那些与你们迟迟未能完成的任务毫无关系的废话。 [pc.dcb
            |征服
            |自由
            |拥抱
        ]那个恶魔显然在努力克制自己，不去招惹你，尽管这对她来说非常困难……显然，她看出你是一个负责任的人。[pc.isDK
            |令人惊讶的是，他们还非常体贴。
        ]家庭-[pc.mf
            |男人
            |女性
        ]这足以让那些渴望成为“族长母亲”的人吓得腿软。
        
        最终，你的用餐时间结束了，你们的肚子也都吃得胀鼓鼓的。卡希拉再次把手伸进她的篮子……尽管篮子并不深，但她还是把手臂伸了进去，直到肩膀都浸在篮子里，然后她拿出了一条毯子和一本布满神秘符号的书。看到你在看，恶魔女王笑着挥了挥手，然后裹上毯子，把一只分叉的脚搭在另一只脚上，把书摊在腿上。“据我粗略估计，你的女儿还要再过几个小时才会孵化出来。这只是些轻松的读物而已，我的。 [kasyrra.hlr
            |
            |
            |亲爱的 
        ]冠军。
rows.raw:
"
        The first, and most noticeable facet, is that the demon queen is actually... clothed. It's a shocking difference to her usual attire-less attire, and she takes a few moments after landing to make sure she's properly dressed. She carries a basket under one arm, and an easy smile on her face. "I know you're probably already getting the royal treatment here in this fortress... but I couldn't resist adding to the selection available to you. And — before you ask — the ingredients are made from wholly uncorrupt sources, I'm evil, not a monster." Her eyes glitter with faint amusement as she places the wicker basket down and pulls out metal dishes with steam creeping up from their lids.

        Aileh sits bolt upright, bum unconsciously wiggling in the bed. "Mommy, you didn't..."
        
        Kasyrra proudly lifts the dish, revealing a combination of folded pasta sheets, meat, and a couple of different cheese. "Made with the finest Kay-Em ingredients, and a recipe perfected back in... uh, the 'old plane', behold; Lasagne." She unleashes upon your nostrils some crunchy, garlic-y bread, sharp powdered cheese, and some buttery, pan-fried potato dumplings. "Any alchemist worth their salt should be a legend in the kitchen, and I daresay I am painfully proud of these recipes. I would have brought a matching wine, but responsible mommies stick to juice."
        
        The three of you tuck into a soberingly-strange family meal; Aileh's tail remains wrapped around [pc.hasTail
            |yours
            |your hips
        ], Kasyrra quietly eats and allows the two of you to talk about nonsense entirely unrelated to your belated quest for [pc.dcb
            |conquest
            |freedom
            |hugs
        ]. There is a visible effort on the demon's part not to flirt with you, as much as it strains her... obviously seeing you being a responsible[pc.isDK
            |, surprisingly-considerate
        ] family-[pc.mf
            |man
            |woman
        ] is enough to turn the aspiring broodmother's legs to jelly.
        
        Eventually, your meal comes to a close, and your respective tummies are full to bursting. Kasyrra reaches into her basket again... sinking into it right up to the shoulder despite its shallow depth, before pulling out a blanket, and a book covered in eldritch symbols. Catching you looking, the demon queen laughs and waves her hand, wrapping up in the blanket, crossing one cloven foot over the other, and spreading the book in her lap. "Your daughter won't hatch for a few more hours yet, by my best approximations. This is just a little light reading, my [kasyrra.hlr
            |
            |
            |dear 
        ]champion.""

rows.original: Two hours pass in peaceful quiet; Aileh dozes, snuggling up against your shoulder and hugging one of your arms, while you relax and let your mind wander in the silence... and try not to fall asleep with a stomach full of lasagne. Any sleepiness is completely arrested at a jerk from the egg in Aileh's lap. It's a singular, simple motion... but compared to the only slow, almost idle sensation of a heartbeat from the egg before, it might as well be a tremendous, skyward leap. Aileh squeezes your arm so hard it actually hurts, eyes going wide and tail shooting up on end. "It's time! Ah!" She shakes you and leans in, as though you weren't already enraptured. "[pc.name]! It's time!" "Do we help her?" You can see the shadow of a form moving within liquid, a chubby, stretching thing that presses against the inside. "N-no, not yet... only if she struggles." Aileh bites her knuckles regardless, leaning in and visibly forcing herself not to dive to your daughter's aid. Kasyrra is quick to put down her book and clamber out of her maternal blanket nest, instead running some hot water into Aileh's bath and dropping a towel in. Time begins to drag itself out at an agonizing pace, as your daughter pushes, and bumps, rocking and shaking before finally there's a little rip in the egg's textured surface. Your [pc.isDK |cold, dark little |heart ] leaps up into your throat, and you hold your breath in open anticipation before a little horn finally punches through the membrane and a gush of thick fluids follow. That is a set of bedding officially ruined, but such concerns are secondary. Now that there's a hole in the egg, your little draconic daughter continues to poke, thrash, and squirm in the direction of light — and Aileh's excited, delighted little squeals — before the egg gives way entirely. "M-my baby..." Aileh gasps, reaching into the mess without a second's thought and scooping out the little scaled infant. Pale caramel flesh glistens with egg...slime, that will no doubt be patterned in freckles when it comes to know the sun, and little bright red scales dot her limbs . There's only a tiny little mop of soft black hair, from which sprouts two tiny horn nubs. Aileh looks the infant over in abject disbelief, burning red eyes beginning to glisten with tears. "Our baby, sh-she's okay!" Her wings steal you into a hug, pulling you close as she pats the babe until it burps up a gobful of gunk. Her hand scoops up the mess and flicks it into the broken, leathery egg-remnants before letting out a pained yelp; your daughter has found a tit, and she latches onto it with full force and some apparently-sharp mini-teeth. "H-hah... didn't expect that." Aileh blushes and looks at you, holding you as close with one wing as she can. "Look, dear heart... our own precious little ember." The baby eats quietly, before finally leaning her head back into Aileh's cradling arm and letting out a hissing yawn. "Aaaaah, I'm going to die, she's too precious." Your draconic girlfriend whines, eyes huge and tear-filled. "It feels so right to hold her..."
rows.translation: 两个小时在宁静中悄然流逝：艾莱依依偎在你的肩旁，抱着你的手臂小睡了一会儿，而你也放松下来，让思绪在寂静中自由驰骋……同时，你还得努力克制自己，以免在肚子还装着拉扎尼面的情况下睡着。 当艾莱赫将鸡蛋从自己腿上猛地拿开时，所有的困意立刻消失了。这个动作简单而干脆……但与之前鸡蛋那缓慢、几乎静止的心跳相比，这个动作简直就像是一次向天空的猛烈跳跃。 艾莉紧紧抓住你的手臂，力度大到让你感到有些疼痛，她的眼睛瞪得大大的，尾巴也竖得笔直。“开始了！啊！”她摇晃着你，同时凑近过来，仿佛你还没有注意到似的。“[pc.name]！时候到了！我们该帮她吗？”你可以看到有某种形态的影子在液体中移动，那是一个圆胖而柔软的东西，正在不断地挤压着液体的内部。 “不……还不行……只有在她遇到困难的时候才去帮助她。尽管如此，艾莉还是咬住了自己的手指，她努力克制自己，没有冲去帮助你的女儿。卡希拉迅速放下书，从她那温暖的被窝里爬出来，然后往艾莉的浴缸里放了些热水，还放了一条毛巾进去。 时间仿佛以一种令人痛苦的速度缓缓流逝，直到你的女儿不断地推、撞、摇晃，最终在那层有纹理的蛋壳表面划出了一道小小的裂痕。 [pc.isDK |寒冷、黑暗又狭小的地方 |心脏 ]那东西猛地钻进了你的喉咙，你屏住呼吸，满心期待地等待着——直到那个小角终于穿透了蛋壳，一股浓稠的液体涌了出来。 这套被褥算是彻底报废了，但这些都已经不重要了。现在蛋壳上已经有了一个洞，你的小龙女继续在蛋壳里扭动、挣扎，朝着轻型的方向移动……而艾莱也兴奋地尖叫着……最终，蛋壳彻底破裂了。 我、我的宝贝……”艾莉赫惊呼着，毫不犹豫地伸手进入那一团混乱中，将那个长满小鳞片的婴儿抱了出来。她那淡棕色的肌肤上沾满了类似蛋液般的黏液，等到阳光照射到她身上时，那些黏液上肯定会出现雀斑般的痕迹；而她的小肢上还分布着一些鲜红色的小鳞片。那只是一小撮柔软的黑发，上面长着两颗小小的角状突起。艾莱赫难以置信地望着这个婴儿，她通红的双眼里开始闪烁着泪轻型。“我们的宝宝，她……她没事的！”她张开双翼将你拥入怀中，轻轻拍着婴儿的背，直到它打出一口黏稠的口水来。 她的手把那些乱七八糟的东西拢起来，扔到了那些破碎的、像皮革一样的蛋壳残渣里，然后发出一声痛苦的叫声——你的女儿发现了一只小虫子，她用尽全力，还有那些显然很锋利的小牙齿，紧紧地抓住了它。“哈……真没料到会这样。”艾莱赫脸红了，看着你，用一只翅膀尽可能地把你拉得更近一些。“看吧，亲爱的……我们自己珍贵的小宝贝。 婴儿安静地吃着东西，最后把头靠在艾莱的怀里，打了个哈欠。“啊啊啊，我要死了，她太可爱了……”你的龙族女友哭诉道，眼睛里噙满了泪水，“抱着她的感觉真是太棒了……

rows.original:
She continues to gently cradle the sleepy little scale-potato, utterly radiating jubilance. "Dear heart, have you thought of a name for her? I had an idea, but... I already got to create a surname for her."
                
                "And you were thinking?"
                
                "Freja. Something strong, beautiful, and native to this land. But... I'd be delighted if you chose."
rows.translation:
她继续轻轻抱着那只昏昏欲睡的小鳞片土豆，脸上洋溢着无比的喜悦。“亲爱的，你为她想好名字了吗？我有个主意，但是……我已经为她取好姓氏了。”
                
                “那你考虑的是哪个名字呢？”
                
                “弗蕾雅。一个既强大又美丽，而且与这片土地息息相关的名字。不过……如果你能亲自挑选的话，我会更加高兴的。”

rows.original: Aileh's brow scrunches up, and she tilts her head to the side. "Uh... can we, I— that is... can we not name our baby after one of your friends? That's going to get so confusing, as touched as they might be, and as glad I am they're keeping your big dork head on your shoulders."
rows.translation: 艾莱赫皱起了眉头，把头偏向了一边。“呃……我们能不能不要用你朋友的名字来给我们的宝宝取名呢？那样肯定会让人搞混的。虽然他们人很好，我也很高兴他们能让你这个傻瓜的脑袋还好好地长在脖子上。”

That's going to get so confusing, as touched as they might be, and as glad I am they're keeping your big dork head on your shoulders.\""

rows.original:
Aileh nearly chokes when you recommend her mother's name. "What? No, sweetie no... I love my mom, but that would be the most unbelievably awkward thing for me ever."

                Kasyrra too, speaks up, having been uncharacteristically quiet while watching. Her cheeks visibly burn with second-hand embarrassment. "I must insist too, my champion. That is just not a fair thing to do to a sweet maiden's heart like that."
rows.translation:
当你提到她母亲的名字时，艾莉差点被呛到。“什么？不，亲爱的，千万别……我非常爱我的妈妈，但那样做对我来说未免太尴尬了。”

                卡希拉也开口了，她在观看过程中一直保持着异常的沉默，此刻她的脸颊明显因为尴尬而泛红。“我也必须坚决反对，我的勇士。那样对待一位纯洁的少女未免太不公平了。

rows.original: She gently, carefully adjusts, cradling [freja.name] into your arms with a smile. Her little wingies twitch against your arm, her adorable little tail wiggles, and a loud burp erupts from a tiny-tooth'd maw. rows.original: When you enter Aileh's room in the tower, your draconic lover is sat on the bed, a look of sedate joy on her face. She trails her nails with the utmost gentleness through [freja.name]s little mop of hair, watching the little dragon-baby coo and burble softly to herself. "Ah, I missed you. A gift just arrived and I was wondering if you could help me, uhm... assemble it." Aileh grins and nods towards the other side of her room, where a thin wooden crate waits for your attention. A slip of paper has been tacked to it, reading "The importance of private time". [pc.dcb |"And what the f—hell is it meant to be?" You bite back on your own cursing; sure [freja.name] can't really understand words yet, but you won't be blamed for being a shitty parent. |"And what is it? Do you know?" |"Ooooh, what is this?" ] Your girlfriend smiles and bounces [freja.name] in her lap. "There's only one way to find out, doofus." With a roll of your eyes [pc.hasTail |— and a wag of your [pc.tail] — ]you settle down by the thin wooden box, pulling out a knife and jimmying the lid open. The scent of freshly oiled pine rises to your nostrils, and the phrase 'assemble' makes a lot of sense suddenly. "[freja.name]'s crib?" Aileh grins, tickling the baby's nose until she burbles. "Yes, a gift from mom... uh, it comes with a party favor." "A party favor from Kasyrra?" It's impossible to keep the incredulity from your tone, and Aileh chucks a pillow at your head. "Don't make it weird, it's actually for us. There should be some... rune-something in there that you hammer onto the crib, and when it's activated it should dampen incoming sound, so that... you know, we can. Uh..." The dragon trails off; she must be getting rather pent up by now, now that you think about it. When she notices you staring back at her, she gives you a toothy grin, tossing back her hair with her free hand and hefting a milky tit. "Well? Better get building, dear heart." The assembly itself doesn't take long, and the freshly-lacquered, dried wood slides snugly into place with only a little glue to lock it together. The cradle has a rocking base with fold-out feet, plenty of support, and at the bottom of the box is a collection of soft white blankets and an incredibly squishy baby-sized mattress. Under the blankets and attached to the mattress is a latex covering of Khor-Minos' best... what a godsend that must be. You settle back on your [pc.ass] and let out a sigh of relief once the work is complete, tapping a shiny copper plate of intricate runes to the side that should function as little [freja.name]'s sound-proofing. The last thing you want is to wake the poor girl up while you're busy. "What're those screws for?" Aileh queries from her perch on the bed. "They... uh, they must be extras?" [silly |They always leave extras. ] Aileh scoops [freja.name] up and saunters over, tail-tip stroking your cheek fondly as she lays the baby out in her new crib. The little scaly potate's face wrinkles up as though she's about to cry before another blanket is settled over her, and she clings to it hard before relaxing again. All at once the dragon's shoulders sag, and she takes in a deep, shuddering breath. "She's such a darling, but I didn't get to sleep... at all last night." As though mocking the prospect of a sleep-filled night, [freja.name] yawns widely — showing off an adorable set of fangs — and curls up to sleep. Her little stubbin of a tail wiggles, and her wingies flap flat. "Looks like it's you and me, now, dear heart." Aileh smiles at you.
rows.translation: 当你走进塔楼中艾蕾的房间时，会发现你的这位龙族恋人正坐在床上，脸上带着一种平静而愉悦的神情。她正极其轻柔地用指甲轻轻划过[freja.name]那一小撮头发，她低头看着那只小龙宝宝，轻轻地发出呜呜声，似乎在自言自语。 “啊，我想你啦。刚收到一份礼物，我在想能不能请你帮个忙……把它组装起来。”艾莉笑着，指向房间另一边——那里有一个薄木箱正等待着她的注意。箱子上贴着一张纸条，上面写着“私人时间的重要性”。 [pc.dcb |这他妈到底是干什么用的？”你强忍住自己想要说出的脏话；当然了[freja.name]其实还听不懂他们在说什么，但如果你被认为是个不称职的家长，那也情有可原吧。 |那是什么？你知道吗？ |哦哦哦，这是什么啊？ ] 你的女朋友微笑着，蹦蹦跳跳地走来。 [freja.name]只有一种方法才能弄清楚，笨蛋。” 然后翻了个白眼。 [pc.hasTail |— 然后轻轻摇一摇你的[pc.tail] — ]你坐在那个薄木箱旁边，掏出一把刀，撬开了盖子。新鲜涂过油的松木散发出的气味扑鼻而来，这时“组装”这个词突然变得意味深长了。[freja.name]这是谁的婴儿床啊？” 艾莱笑着挠了挠婴儿的鼻子，直到她咯咯地笑了起来。“是的，这是妈妈送的礼物……嗯，里面还附带了一份小礼物哦。” “一份小礼物？来自卡希拉？你的语气里明显带着难以置信，于是艾莉赫朝你的头上扔了一个枕头。 “别搞得这么奇怪，其实这是给我们用的。里面应该有一些……什么符文之类的东西，你需要把它们固定在婴儿床上面，等激活之后应该减弱传入的声音，这样……你知道的，我们就能……呃……”龙少女的话渐渐停了下来；仔细想想，她现在肯定已经憋得有些难受了。 当她注意到你在注视着她时，她露出了灿烂的笑容，用空闲的手把头发甩到背后，同时轻轻托了托自己那乳白色的胸部。嗯？还是赶紧动手吧，亲爱的。” 组装过程其实并不耗时，那些刚刚上过漆、已经完全干透的木块只需用一点胶水就能牢牢固定在一起。这个婴儿床的底座是可以摇动的，同时还配有可折叠的足部垫，因此提供了足够的稳定性；而在箱子的下装，还准备了一些柔软的白色毯子和一张非常柔软的婴儿床垫。在毯子下面，紧贴着床垫，有一层由Khor-Minos提供的乳胶材料……这简直就是天赐之物啊。 你躺回床上， [pc.ass]当工作完成后，他松了一口气，然后轻敲了一下那块刻着复杂符文的闪亮铜板——这块铜板应该起着某种作用吧[freja.name]这些隔音材料真是太棒了。当你忙得不可开交的时候，最不希望发生的事情就是把那个可怜的女孩吵醒。” “那些螺丝是用来做什么的？”艾莉从床上坐下来问道。 “它们……呃，应该只是多余的配件吧？ [silly |他们总是会留一些多余的物品。 ] 艾莉赫大获成功[freja.name]走过来，用尾巴轻轻拂你的脸颊，然后把婴儿放在新做的婴儿床里。小家伙的脸皱了起来，好像快要哭出来一样，但很快又有一条毯子盖在她身上，她紧紧抓住毯子，这才又放松下来。突然，龙的肩膀耷了下来，她深深地吸了一口气，身体微微颤抖着：“她真是太可爱了，但我却一点都没睡着所有昨晚。” 仿佛在嘲笑一个应该充满睡眠的夜晚会降临一样， [freja.name]张大嘴巴打了个哈欠，露出那一口可爱的獠牙，然后蜷缩起来准备睡觉。她那短短的小尾巴轻轻摇晃着，翅膀也平展着休息着。“看来现在就只有我们俩了，亲爱的。”艾莉对你微笑着说道。
rows.raw: ' When you enter Aileh's room in the tower, your draconic lover is sat on the bed, a look of sedate joy on her face. She trails her nails with the utmost gentleness through [freja.name]s little mop of hair, watching the little dragon-baby coo and burble softly to herself. "Ah, I missed you. A gift just arrived and I was wondering if you could help me, uhm... assemble it." Aileh grins and nods towards the other side of her room, where a thin wooden crate waits for your attention. A slip of paper has been tacked to it, reading "The importance of private time". [pc.dcb |"And what the f—hell is it meant to be?" You bite back on your own cursing; sure [freja.name] can't really understand words yet, but you won't be blamed for being a shitty parent. |"And what is it? Do you know?" |"Ooooh, what is this?" ] Your girlfriend smiles and bounces [freja.name] in her lap. "There's only one way to find out, doofus." With a roll of your eyes [pc.hasTail |— and a wag of your [pc.tail] — ]you settle down by the thin wooden box, pulling out a knife and jimmying the lid open. The scent of freshly oiled pine rises to your nostrils, and the phrase 'assemble' makes a lot of sense suddenly. "[freja.name]'s crib?" Aileh grins, tickling the baby's nose until she burbles. "Yes, a gift from mom... uh, it comes with a party favor." "A party favor from Kasyrra?" It's impossible to keep the incredulity from your tone, and Aileh chucks a pillow at your head. "Don't make it weird, it's actually for us. There should be some... rune-something in there that you hammer onto the crib, and when it's activated it should dampen incoming sound, so that... you know, we can. Uh..." The dragon trails off; she must be getting rather pent up by now, now that you think about it. When she notices you staring back at her, she gives you a toothy grin, tossing back her hair with her free hand and hefting a milky tit. "Well? Better get building, dear heart." The assembly itself doesn't take long, and the freshly-lacquered, dried wood slides snugly into place with only a little glue to lock it together. The cradle has a rocking base with fold-out feet, plenty of support, and at the bottom of the box is a collection of soft white blankets and an incredibly squishy baby-sized mattress. Under the blankets and attached to the mattress is a latex covering of Khor-Minos' best... what a godsend that must be. You settle back on your [pc.ass] and let out a sigh of relief once the work is complete, tapping a shiny copper plate of intricate runes to the side that should function as little [freja.name]'s sound-proofing. The last thing you want is to wake the poor girl up while you're busy. "What're those screws for?" Aileh queries from her perch on the bed. "They... uh, they must be extras?" [silly |They always leave extras. ] Aileh scoops [freja.name] up and saunters over, tail-tip stroking your cheek fondly as she lays the baby out in her new crib. The little scaly potate's face wrinkles up as though she's about to cry before another blanket is settled over her, and she clings to it hard before relaxing again. All at once the dragon's shoulders sag, and she takes in a deep, shuddering breath. "She's such a darling, but I didn't get to sleep... at all last night." As though mocking the prospect of a sleep-filled night, [freja.name] yawns widely — showing off an adorable set of fangs — and curls up to sleep. Her little stubbin of a tail wiggles, and her wingies flap flat. "Looks like it's you and me, now, dear heart." Aileh smiles at you.'

rows.original:
Aileh gasps when you pounce on her, burying your face into her boobs and kissing at the soft flesh. Your hands trail down her sides, finding a staggering lack of pregnancy-squish on the dragon's hips. She lets out the hissing equivalent of a purr and drops back onto the bed with you, stretching out sinuously so that your lips and tongue can explore and taste. "I know, I'm a goddess." Aileh mumbles to herself, hands wrapping around the back of your head as you nuzzle your way into her tummy. 

        Her tail wraps around your waist and gives it a squeeze, signaling her fondness even before her fingers get a chance to [pc.hasHair
            |play with your [pc.hair]
            |trail their way along your scalp
        ]. "Are you going to just kiss my abs, dear heart? Or get yourself up here and snuggle this dragon?" 
        
        Both tempting options, in your mind... but the needy, sleepy look in your lover's burning eyes tilt the scales in her favor. You kiss a trail back up to her tits, giving each soft, sensitive, pierced nipple a little nibble and a suck, before finally arriving at her lips for a soft, tongue-laden makeout.
        
        Aileh rolls you over so that she's on top for once, straddling you with a leg and burying her face in your neck... eventually yawning and deflating further into a lovey-dovey puddle. "Mmmine..."
rows.translation:
当你扑向她，将脸埋进她的胸脯，轻吻那柔软的肌肤时，艾莉赫不禁倒抽了一口气。你的手顺着她的身体向下移动，却发现她的臀部完全没有任何怀孕带来的变化。她发出类似猫咪呼噜声的低吟，然后与你一起躺回床上，身体蜿蜒地伸展开来，让你能够尽情地探索和品尝她的身体。我知道，我可是女神呢。”艾蕾轻声自语道，当你把脸贴在她肚子上时，她双手环住了你的后脑勺。

        她的尾巴绕住了你的腰，轻轻一拧，这一动作便足以表达她的喜爱之情——甚至在她用手指触碰到你之前，就已经如此了。 [pc.hasHair
            |随便玩玩吧[pc.hair]
            |沿着你的头皮慢慢移动
        ]亲爱的，你是打算只是亲亲我的腹肌，还是过来抱抱这条‘龙’呢？”
        
        这两个选择在你看来都很有吸引力……但是，看到恋人眼中那充满渴望、略带困倦的神情，天平就倾斜到她的这一边了。你的嘴唇沿着她的身体向上移动，轻轻咬住每一个柔软、敏感、戴着穿孔环的乳头，然后轻轻吮吸它们，最后终于到达她的嘴唇，开始了一场充满柔情与舌尖触碰的亲吻。
        
        艾莱赫将你翻过来，让自己处于上方的位置，用一条腿跨坐在你身上，然后将脸埋在你的脖子里。最终，这一切都变得乏味无聊，彻底失去了原有的意义，变成了一堆甜言蜜语的空洞废话。“妈妈……

rows.original:
You're jolted awake by a sound familiar and alien at the same time; the crying of a baby, but this time the babe is your own. Aileh groans and squeezes you, climbing off and rubbing her eyes. "Well... it was a nice nap while it lasted. Good to know that rune doesn't block out [freja.name]'s cries though."

            You prop yourself up on your elbows, watching blearily as Aileh shambles over to feed the baby. Her tail still remains wrapped around one of your ankles, hugging it comfortingly while [freja.name] latches onto a tit and begins to feed. "Tsss... lucky I'm a tough woman, she has the sharpest little teeth in the world." She relaxes after a few moments, sighing and cradling her before returning to bed. 
            
            Sitting up properly, you watch as Aileh hums and feeds the babe, not stopping until there are tiny happy hisses and burbles from your daughter. "Now-now, don't want you over eating or you'll get sick..." Aileh tuts, tapping [freja.name] on the nose and smiling when she begins to giggle and hiccup. "Much better. Sorry naptime is over so soon, dear heart."
            
            "Nonsense." You make sure to get a chance to hold [freja.name] yourself before the inexorable creep of time catches up with you. Eventually you hand [freja.name] back with a kiss — for both of them — and shuck your equipment back on again.
            
            "Honey, I hate seeing you leave, but gods do you ever look good in your gear. Stay safe and come back to us, okay?" Aileh smiles at you and turns [freja.name] around in her lap, so that the baby's little hands can be made to wave goodbye to you as well.
            
            However could Aileh have been a terrifying adversarial prospect all that time ago? She's just too adorable.
rows.translation:
一种既熟悉又陌生的声音将你惊醒——那是婴儿的哭声，而这次，那个婴儿就是你自己。艾莉赫呻吟着，紧紧抱住你，然后爬起来揉了揉眼睛：“嗯……能小睡一会儿确实很不错。幸好那个符文并没有阻挡住[freja.name]不过，她的叫声依然清晰可闻。”

            你用手肘支撑身体，模糊地注视着艾莱蹒跚地走过去喂婴儿。她的尾巴仍然缠在你的脚踝上，紧紧地搂着它，仿佛在给予安慰一般[freja.name]紧紧抓住婴儿的乳头开始喂奶。“啧……还好我是个坚强的女人，她的牙齿可是世界上最锋利的了。”过了一会儿，她放松下来，叹了口气，把婴儿抱在怀里，然后才回到床上。
            
            你坐直身子，看着艾莉一边轻声哼唱，一边喂宝宝，直到听到女儿发出开心地“嘶嘶”声和“咕噜”声，她才停下来。“好了好了，别吃太多了，否则会生病的……”艾莉轻声说着，还不时轻拍着婴儿的背。 [freja.name]刚开始咯咯笑起来，还打起了嗝，脸上却带着笑容。“好多了。真抱歉，亲爱的，小睡时间这么快就结束了。”
            
            “胡说。”你一定要抓紧机会抱抱她。 [freja.name]在时间无情的侵蚀到来之前，先好好照顾好自己。最终，你会把……交给别人。 [freja.name]然后亲吻对方，再重新穿上你的装备。
            
            “亲爱的，我真不想看到你离开，但是天啊，你穿上那套装备真的看起来太帅了。一定要注意安全，一定要回来找我们，好吗？”艾莉微笑着对你说，然后转身离开了。 [freja.name]把宝宝放在自己的腿上，这样宝宝的小手也可以向你挥动，道别呢。
            
            然而，在那么早的时候，艾莉怎么会成为一个如此令人畏惧的对手呢？她实在是太可爱了。

rows.original: You can hear crying even before the door is open, and you grit your teeth to steady yourself before opening. Aileh looks up, bouncing [freja.name] on her hip. "Ah! [pc.name], you've come at a good time..." She shushes the babe gently, bouncing her again. "Perhaps you could hold her for a little while? I'd swear she's starting to miss you already." You accept your daughter willingly, making sure to toss some of your gear aside first. "What started it?" Aileh sighs and strokes at [freja.name]'s hair, her crying already begins to settle, and you gently bury her in your chest. "She just woke up crying, and even after I went through the usual baby-problems she was still upset." The relief that spreads across her tired face is palpable, and she leans in to give you a kiss. "Having you here seems to have helped, aren't you just the perfect little [pc.mf |daddy |mommy ]?" Her words bring heat to the tips of your [pc.ears], but you look down into [freja.name]'s eyes. They're a little dark and ruddy from having spent the last while bawling, but already her bright little expression is softening into sleepiness. "Ba," she proudly announces, tiny hands squeezing you. You tickle her nose with a finger and she giggles, attempting to chew on it before you withdraw — those teeth are sharp — and give her a kiss on the head instead. The soft mop of her hair is easy to tease, and you stroke at it in a way that makes her pointy little ears wiggle. "Ma, ba." [freja.name] doesn't have a way to form any useable words, yet, but the way she babbles is a lot closer to speech than before... any day now you'll hear her first words. Aileh grins and leans in, giving you a nice, slow kiss while her tail hugs your leg. "I missed you too, dear heart." [freja.name]'s stirring settles down further, and her eyes drift closed again. "Back to nap time..." "Considering the fact that her baby-age is probably just a month or so, it's not a surprise that she spends most of her time as a sleepy little potato." Aileh grins, watching you lay your daughter gently into her cradle. "Now if only I could get some sleep too. Think you can keep watch on her while I steal a few winks?" The two of you share a tongue-laden kiss that has the horny dragon moaning happily, but she struggles to fight down a yawn that follows on the heels of a pleased hiss. You watch Aileh take her time shrugging off her clothes, and she gives you a wink and softly spanks her bouncing bum. "What do you think, have I got the baby weight off?" [pc.dcb |"You sure don't look like a fat fuck," you agree. "Go to sleep, I'll hang out for a few hours and wake you before I go." |"You look perfect, I don't know how you managed it." Your response results in a bright smile on the dragon's part. "Go to sleep, I'll be right here and wake you up in a few hours before I leave." |"Yup! I could bounce coins off of that cutie-bootie!" You confirm. Aileh scoffs softly and wiggles her hips. "Go to sleep, I'll stay here and get comfy-comf, and wake you before I leave. Oki?" ] Aileh blows you a kiss and dives under the duvet, curling up on herself and hugging her tail. "Mmmmuch better. I love you, you doofus." "I know." You settle on the bed's edge and yoink one of the dragon's books; it appears to be one of Kasyrra's, actually, considering it's a treatise on soul-magic... unfortunately there's nothing especially telling about her plans. A whole lot of scrapped experiments, and a rather lurid account of harnessing a wide spectrum of emotions. It actually looks like [kasyrra.hlr |the demon-bitch |Kasy |your demonic beau ] has the nature of a teacher about her, considering the well-drawn diagrams and sensible writing. [pc.isBimbo |Even your smoothness understands the basics. |It's enough for you to easily understand the basics. ] Sadly, the basics aren't going to get you anywhere.
rows.translation: 在门还未打开之前，你就已经听到了哭声。你咬紧牙关，稳住自己才推开门。艾莱赫抬起头，眼睛里充满了泪水。 [freja.name]啊！”她惊叫道。 [pc.name]，你来得正是时候……”她轻轻安抚着婴儿，又把她抱起来晃了晃。“或许你可以抱她一会儿？我敢肯定，她已经开始想你了。” 你欣然接过了女儿，顺便把一些装备放在了一边。“这是怎么发生的？” 艾莱叹了口气，轻轻抚摸着[freja.name]她的哭声渐渐平息了，你轻轻地将她抱在怀里。“她刚醒来就开始哭，尽管我按照常规方法处理了那些婴儿常遇到的问题，她还是很难安静下来。”她疲惫的脸上流露出的如释重负之情显而易见，她凑过来亲了你一下：“有你在身边，似乎真的起到了作用，你真是太完美了[pc.mf |爸爸 |妈妈 ]她的话语让你全身都感到一阵燥热。 [pc.ears]但是，当你向下看时[freja.name]她的眼睛因为刚才一直在哭而显得有些发红，但那双明亮的小眼睛里已经浮现出睡意。“爸爸，”她骄傲地说道，那双小手紧紧地握着你的手。 你用手指轻轻挠她的鼻子，她咯咯地笑了起来，还试图去咬你的手指——不过你的手指很快就缩了回来，因为她的牙齿确实很尖——于是你只好在她的头上亲了一下。她那柔软的头发很容易被逗弄，你轻轻抚摸着她的头发，她的尖耳朵也因此动了起来。“妈妈，爸爸。 [freja.name]虽然她还不能组成任何可以理解的词语，但她现在的咿呀声已经比以前更接近真正的语言了……随时都可能说出她的第一个词来。 艾莉微笑着凑过来，轻轻地吻了你一下，她的尾巴还缠在了你的腿上。“我也想你呢，亲爱的。 [freja.name]她的身体逐渐平静下来，眼睛又一次闭上了。“又该小睡一会儿了……” “考虑到她现在还只有一个月左右大，所以她大部分时间都处于昏昏欲睡的状态，这也并不奇怪。”艾莱笑着看着你轻轻地将女儿放回婴儿床里，“真希望我也该睡一会儿了。你觉得你能照看一下她，让我小睡一会儿吗？” 你们俩拥吻起来，那亲吻如此热烈，以至于那只好色的龙都会高兴地发出呻吟声；不过她还是在满意地“嘶”了一声之后，忍不住打了个哈欠。你看着艾莱慢慢脱掉衣服，她冲你眨了眨眼，然后轻轻拍了一下自己那弹跳着的屁股：“你觉得呢？我是不是已经把生孩子后长出来的肉减掉了？ [pc.dcb |你看起来可一点都不像个胖子啊，”你说道。“去睡觉吧，我会再待几个小时，等你醒来后再走。 |你看起来太完美了，真不知道你是怎么做到的。”你的话让那条龙露出了灿烂的笑容。“去睡觉吧，几小时后我就会在这里叫你起床，然后离开。 |没错！我肯定能把硬币弹到那双可爱的小靴子上！”你这样说道。艾莉轻蔑地笑了笑，扭动着臀部说：“你去睡觉吧，我就留在这里，好好放松一下，等我要离开的时候再叫你起床，好吗？ ] 艾莉赫向你飞了一个吻，然后钻进被窝，蜷缩起来，把尾巴抱在怀里。“好多了……我爱你，你这个傻瓜。” “我知道。”你坐在床边，拿起了其中一本龙的书；实际上，这本书应该是卡希拉写的，因为里面是一篇关于灵魂魔法的论文……可惜，里面并没有提到她有什么特别的计划。里面全是些被废弃的实验记录，还有些关于如何操控各种情绪的描述。 这本书看起来还真挺有意思的[kasyrra.hlr |那个恶魔般的女人 |卡西 |你那个恶魔般的男友 ]从那些绘制精良的图表以及条理清晰的文字来看，她确实具备教师的素养。 [pc.isBimbo |甚至你的流畅性意味着要掌握基础知识。 |这样你就能够轻松掌握这些基础知识了。 ]遗憾的是，仅仅掌握基础知识是远远不够的。
rows.raw: ' You can hear crying even before the door is open, and you grit your teeth to steady yourself before opening. Aileh looks up, bouncing [freja.name] on her hip. "Ah! [pc.name], you've come at a good time..." She shushes the babe gently, bouncing her again. "Perhaps you could hold her for a little while? I'd swear she's starting to miss you already." You accept your daughter willingly, making sure to toss some of your gear aside first. "What started it?" Aileh sighs and strokes at [freja.name]'s hair, her crying already begins to settle, and you gently bury her in your chest. "She just woke up crying, and even after I went through the usual baby-problems she was still upset." The relief that spreads across her tired face is palpable, and she leans in to give you a kiss. "Having you here seems to have helped, aren't you just the perfect little [pc.mf |daddy |mommy ]?" Her words bring heat to the tips of your [pc.ears], but you look down into [freja.name]'s eyes. They're a little dark and ruddy from having spent the last while bawling, but already her bright little expression is softening into sleepiness. "Ba," she proudly announces, tiny hands squeezing you. You tickle her nose with a finger and she giggles, attempting to chew on it before you withdraw — those teeth are sharp — and give her a kiss on the head instead. The soft mop of her hair is easy to tease, and you stroke at it in a way that makes her pointy little ears wiggle. "Ma, ba." [freja.name] doesn't have a way to form any useable words, yet, but the way she babbles is a lot closer to speech than before... any day now you'll hear her first words. Aileh grins and leans in, giving you a nice, slow kiss while her tail hugs your leg. "I missed you too, dear heart." [freja.name]'s stirring settles down further, and her eyes drift closed again. "Back to nap time..." "Considering the fact that her baby-age is probably just a month or so, it's not a surprise that she spends most of her time as a sleepy little potato." Aileh grins, watching you lay your daughter gently into her cradle. "Now if only I could get some sleep too. Think you can keep watch on her while I steal a few winks?" The two of you share a tongue-laden kiss that has the horny dragon moaning happily, but she struggles to fight down a yawn that follows on the heels of a pleased hiss. You watch Aileh take her time shrugging off her clothes, and she gives you a wink and softly spanks her bouncing bum. "What do you think, have I got the baby weight off?" [pc.dcb |"You sure don't look like a fat fuck," you agree. "Go to sleep, I'll hang out for a few hours and wake you before I go." |"You look perfect, I don't know how you managed it." Your response results in a bright smile on the dragon's part. "Go to sleep, I'll be right here and wake you up in a few hours before I leave." |"Yup! I could bounce coins off of that cutie-bootie!" You confirm. Aileh scoffs softly and wiggles her hips. "Go to sleep, I'll stay here and get comfy-comf, and wake you before I leave. Oki?" ] Aileh blows you a kiss and dives under the duvet, curling up on herself and hugging her tail. "Mmmmuch better. I love you, you doofus." "I know." You settle on the bed's edge and yoink one of the dragon's books; it appears to be one of Kasyrra's, actually, considering it's a treatise on soul-magic... unfortunately there's nothing especially telling about her plans. A whole lot of scrapped experiments, and a rather lurid account of harnessing a wide spectrum of emotions. It actually looks like [kasyrra.hlr |the demon-bitch |Kasy |your demonic beau ] has the nature of a teacher about her, considering the well-drawn diagrams and sensible writing. [pc.isBimbo |Even your smoothness understands the basics. |It's enough for you to easily understand the basics. ] Sadly, the basics aren't going to get you anywhere.'

        "Mmm, next time I'm pinning you down between my thighs and trapping you here for some full-frontal snuggling." Aileh grins and sleepily drags herself out of bed.
        
        "Don't you threaten me with a good time."

        “嗯，下次我一定要把你夹在大腿之间，让你在这里好好享受一番亲密的拥抱。”艾莱赫笑着，困倦地从床上爬起来。

rows.original: The delighted squeals of your baby daughter are piercing as you enter the room, but they soon quiet down to satisfied giggling; Aileh is tucking her wings and gently landing in the middle of the room, babe held close to her chest while her tail whips around for extra balance. "Ah! You just caught us getting some fresh air and visiting mom." The dragon smiles brightly, tickling [freja.name]'s nose. "Hold her, would you?" There's another happy squeal out of your daughter as you cradle her, and her little hands try to grab your nose when you go in to nuzzle the fluffy-tuft of her hair. Your draconic girlfriend uses the moment to fly back up and put her skylight on its latch, gliding back down again. "It's wonderful out there, and mom was very excited to spoil little [freja.name]." "Did you have a nice time with your grandma?" [kasyrra.hlr |You do your best not to sigh at [freja.name]; it's not her fault her grandmother is the demon queen |She giggles at your teasing nose-taps. |Your own smile is warm and pleased; the idea of Kasyrra in a familial position is an endearing one. ] "She tried to thumb some of my cake into her mouth, but should be on milk still a little longer, isn't that right my little wanderer?" Aileh proudly strokes fingers through the babe's hair, smiling at you. "She's been crawling around quite a bit. I'm so excited for her words and steps, I hope you'll be here for them." "So do I," you agree. "She's so bright and smiley." Aileh utterly beams motherly pride, stretching herself out before letting her wings retract. "Ah, much better. How about I put our babe to bed dear heart? I want you to myself."
rows.translation: 你走进房间时，小女儿欢喜的尖叫声无比刺耳，不过很快便安静成满足的咯咯笑声；艾莱赫正收拢双翼，轻柔落在房间正中，婴儿紧贴胸口，尾巴则四处鞭打以维持额外平衡。“啊！你正好赶上我们出去呼吸新鲜空气、看望妈妈。”巨龙露出灿烂微笑，挠了挠[freja.name]的鼻子。“抱她一下，好吗？” 你将女儿搂入怀中，她又发出一声幸福尖叫；你凑近磨蹭那一小簇蓬松头发时，她的小手试图抓住你的鼻子。你的巨龙女友借此飞回上方，把天窗扣上门闩，随后又滑翔下来。“外面美极了，妈妈也无比兴奋地宠爱小[freja.name]。” “和外婆玩得开心吗？”[kasyrra.hlr |你竭力不对[freja.name]叹气；外婆是恶魔女王，并不是她的错 |她因你调皮轻点鼻子的动作咯咯欢笑。 |你的笑容也温暖而愉快；卡希拉承担家庭角色的想法令人喜爱。 ] “她想用拇指把一些蛋糕塞进孩子嘴里，不过小家伙应该再喝一阵奶，对吧，我的小漫游者？”艾莱赫骄傲地以手指梳理婴儿的头发，向你微笑。“她已经经常爬来爬去。我无比期待她开口说话、迈出第一步；希望你也能在场。” “我也希望。”你赞同道。“她真聪明，真爱笑。” 艾莱赫因母性的骄傲而容光焕发；她伸展身体，随后任双翼缩回。“啊，好多了。心肝，不如让我把孩子哄睡？我想独占你。”

rows.original: "Come on my little ember, you can do it..." Aileh's voice is soft and hushed, squatting down as you enter. Both arms are held out, fingers extended, and it's from those fingers that [freja.name] holds on with trembling little baby arms. She's grown by leaps and bounds since being a tiny little potato, and when she bounces forward on her bum it's with the effort of a chubby wiggly tail, and tiny flapping wings. Your heart leaps its way into your throat, riding a wash of pride when you can see the effort in your baby's nearly-narrowed eyes. She gasps and giggles, dropping onto her rear again. "So close..." Aileh looks up at you with a smile, burying her face in [freja.name]'s hair. "I swear she was toddling about a moment ago, and the second I looked she sat down again. I can't believe we missed it." You glance around shiftily and grin. "We can pretend she's about to do it for the first time again right now, right?" Aileh sagely nods, the same conspiratory look in her own eyes. "Deal." You take off the weightier of your gear, crouching down in front of [freja.name] and opening your arms. "Come to [pc.mf |daddy |mommy ], sweetie." "Ba!" [freja.name] squeals and giggles again, little feet kicking before she grips Aileh's fingers again. She propels herself forward with a push from her bum that has her swooping up onto her feet. Her tiny wings flap in an unconscious effort to keep her upright, and a gasp of utter delight escapes Aileh's throat. With a soft, shocked little hiss that both Aileh and [freja.name] share, she begins to guide the babe towards you. "She's doing it!" Aileh looks nothing like the dragon general you first met, smugly toying with herself atop the Wayfort's shattered tower. Instead she's every image of the sweet, loving mother. The tension goes out of her, leaving behind nervous giddiness as she proudly helps walk your daughter towards you. "Mmmblr..." Your daughter proves to be ever the talented conversationalist, babbling happily while she waddle-walks into your waiting arms. Aileh meets you with a kiss once she's close enough, her own tail lashing around while your daughter buries herself in your chest. The two — well, three — of you rise together, sharing [freja.name] in a double-cradle so that you can look down at her between kisses. "Well done, our precious little ember." You agree... turning Aileh's nethers into a flood of motherly bliss in the process. "Mnf, you're going to get me giddy you tease!" The dragon eventually sighs wistfully. "It won't be long now, she'll have a growth spurt and all of the information she's been picking up will start just... doing the brain thing." Her vocabulary fails her, eventually ending in a shrug. "Any chance you can explain that further?" "I asked mom about it, since [freja.name] was getting all... extra-plump. Basically she's going to shoot up like a whip, and all of the listening she's been doing is going to... express itself?" "Is that why you've been reading all those books?" "Sssorta..." Aileh blushes. "I also just get bored when you're not about, I can hardly leave for as long as I used to in order to run errands for mom and help train some of her goons. You can see it in [freja.name]'s eyes though; she listens, even if she's not internalizing the information." "Ma!" The two of you jolt in surprise, and another hushed whisper slips from Aileh's lips. "Did you say mom?" "Maaaa...uhm." It's drawn out, barely different from the scaly dragon-potato's usual babbling, but it's something you know instinctively as an attempt at speech. [pc.mf |"Bbbb... da!" |She places her little hand on your own lips and mumbles out a similarly-definitive "Ma!" ] [pc.isDK |It comes as a surprise to your otherwise cold, stony heart when there's moisture welling up in the corners of your eyes. Obviously when you flip this world on its rear and carve your corner out of it, you're just going to have to get used to being a softy for your kids. |Moisture wells up in the corners of your eyes, a mirror to the shimmering in Aileh's own burning orbs. ] "Steps and words in one day... you are a genius, [freja.name]." Your precious little babe only manages a succinct raspberry in response, but you're both too busy fawning over her much to care. "I'll miss this, soon. Just you watch and wait, it's going to be a week of growing pains, and then suddenly a rambunctious infant constantly trying to fly around." "She'll be fine, I'm sure." You give Aileh a kiss on the forehead. "The Wayfort will benefit from having her kicking up a fuss." [wayfort.sexy |"They're going to have to be a little better behaved then," Aileh grumbles, kissing you back. "They're hornier idiots than me." |"Hah, I'm sure it will. [wayfort.hasDaliza |Daliza is ecstatic about having more dragons in the Wayfort." |A little extra life in our home would be nice." ] ] The two of you look down at [freja.name] again, and she gives you a soft 'rar', flashing the neat row of tiny sharp teeth. "Are those still her baby teeth?" "Yyyup..." Aileh winces. "Having milk is amazing, and I fully intend to just... keep being milky somehow, but I won't miss having my tits bitten." "You're actually staying milky?" You lick your lips slowly. Aileh blushes and glances away and bites her lip. "Mmmmaybe, I might have asked for some alchemical assistance. Milk is awesome."
rows.translation: 来吧，我的小宝贝，你一定可以的……”艾莱的声音轻柔而低沉，当你走进来时，她蹲了下来，伸出双臂，手指也完全伸展开来，正是从那些手指中[freja.name]用那双颤抖的小手紧紧抓住东西。自从还是个小小的婴儿时起，她就已经成长了许多；当她用屁股向前跳跃时，那动作就像是一条胖乎乎、扭来扭去的尾巴在移动，同时也像是一对小小的翅膀在扑动。 当你看到宝宝那几乎眯成一条缝的眼睛里流露出的那份努力时，你的心会激动得跳到喉咙里去，同时也会感到无比的自豪。她喘着气，咯咯地笑着，又重新坐回了原地，说道：“就差一点了……” 艾莱赫微笑着抬头看着你，然后将脸埋了下去[freja.name]她的头发……我发誓刚才她还摇摇晃晃地走着，可我一回头，她就又坐下了。真不敢相信我们居然错过了这一幕。” 你环顾四周，然后咧嘴一笑：“我们可以假装现在她又要第一次做那个动作了，对吧？” 艾莱也明智地点了点头，她的眼中同样带着一丝默契的神情：“成交。” 你脱下那些较重的装备，然后蹲在[freja.name]张开双臂，说道：“过来吧[pc.mf |爸爸 |妈妈 ]亲爱的。” “吧！ [freja.name]又是一阵尖叫声和咯咯的笑声，那小脚丫不停地踢动着，直到她再次抓住了艾莱的手指。她用屁股一用力，让自己向前移动，很快就站了起来。她那小小的翅膀无意识地扑动着，试图保持身体平衡，而艾莱则忍不住发出一声欣喜若狂的感叹。与此同时，那个小家伙也发出了轻柔而惊讶的“嘶”声[freja.name]伸出手，开始将婴儿引向你。 “她做到了！”此刻的艾莉丝完全不同于你最初遇到的那位龙族将军——她并没有像在荒废驿堡那座残破的塔楼上那样得意地玩弄着自己，而是展现出了一个温柔、充满爱意的母亲该有的样子。她的紧张情绪一扫而空，只剩下一种兴奋与喜悦，她骄傲地牵着你的女儿走向你。 “嗯嗯……”你的女儿果然是个天生的健谈者，一边欢快地咿咿呀呀，一边摇摇晃晃地走进你张开的双臂中。 当艾莱距离你足够近时，她会用一个吻来迎接你，而她的尾巴也会不停地摆动；与此同时，你的女儿则会紧紧地依偎在你的怀里。你们三个一起站了起来，共享着这一刻[freja.name]你把她放在双臂之间，这样在亲吻她的同时，你就可以看着她了。“做得好，我们珍贵的小宝贝。”你这样说着，不知不觉中，让艾莱的内心充满了母性的幸福与喜悦。 “哼，你这样逗我，真的会让我头晕的！龙最终无奈地叹了口气。‘不用等太久了，她很快就会进入生长高峰期，那时她所吸收的所有信息都会开始在她的脑子里发挥作用……’”它的词汇量实在不够用，最终只能耸了耸肩表示无能为力。 有没有可能再详细解释一下呢？” “我本来问过妈妈的，因为[freja.name]变得越来越……丰满了呢。基本上，她很快就会像鞭子一样变得灵活起来，而她一直以来所积累的那些知识，最终也会……得到释放吧？” “这就是你最近一直在读那么多书的原因吗？” “嗯……”艾莉赫脸红了。“当你不在身边的时候，我会觉得很无聊。现在我几乎不能再像以前那样离开太久，去为妈妈跑腿，或者帮忙训练她那些手下了。你应该能看出来吧[freja.name]不过她的确在听；她在倾听，即使她并没有真正理解那些信息。” “妈妈！” 你们俩都惊讶地愣住了，而艾莱赫的嘴唇又轻声说道：“你刚才说‘妈妈’吗？” “妈……嗯。”这个发音拖得很长，几乎和那只长满鳞片的龙形土豆平时发出的声音没什么两样，但你们凭直觉就能知道，这其实是她在尝试说话。 [pc.mf |布布布……哒！ |她把小手放在你的嘴唇上，轻声喊出了那个同样充满决断意味的“妈！ ] [pc.isDK |当你原本冰冷坚硬的心中突然涌现出泪水时，你会感到十分惊讶。显然，当你彻底改变这个世界，为自己争取属于自己的一片天地时，你就不得不学会在对待自己的孩子时变得温柔一些。 |你的眼角涌出了泪水，这些泪水仿佛镜子一般，映照出了艾莱眼中那闪烁的光芒。 ]一天之内就完成了这些步骤和文字工作……你真是个天才。 |他们这次可得表现得乖一点才行，”艾莉赫边说边回吻你，“他们可比我还要愚蠢、好色。 |哈，我敢肯定一定会这样。 [wayfort.hasDaliza |达莉莎对于在荒废驿堡一带有更多的龙出现感到非常兴奋。 |让我们的家多一些活力与乐趣吧会请友善一点。 ] ] 你们两个一起看着下面。 rows.raw: ' "Come on my little ember, you can do it..." Aileh's voice is soft and hushed, squatting down as you enter. Both arms are held out, fingers extended, and it's from those fingers that [freja.name] holds on with trembling little baby arms. She's grown by leaps and bounds since being a tiny little potato, and when she bounces forward on her bum it's with the effort of a chubby wiggly tail, and tiny flapping wings. Your heart leaps its way into your throat, riding a wash of pride when you can see the effort in your baby's nearly-narrowed eyes. She gasps and giggles, dropping onto her rear again. "So close..." Aileh looks up at you with a smile, burying her face in [freja.name]'s hair. "I swear she was toddling about a moment ago, and the second I looked she sat down again. I can't believe we missed it." You glance around shiftily and grin. "We can pretend she's about to do it for the first time again right now, right?" Aileh sagely nods, the same conspiratory look in her own eyes. "Deal." You take off the weightier of your gear, crouching down in front of [freja.name] and opening your arms. "Come to [pc.mf |daddy |mommy ], sweetie." "Ba!" [freja.name] squeals and giggles again, little feet kicking before she grips Aileh's fingers again. She propels herself forward with a push from her bum that has her swooping up onto her feet. Her tiny wings flap in an unconscious effort to keep her upright, and a gasp of utter delight escapes Aileh's throat. With a soft, shocked little hiss that both Aileh and [freja.name] share, she begins to guide the babe towards you. "She's doing it!" Aileh looks nothing like the dragon general you first met, smugly toying with herself atop the Wayfort's shattered tower. Instead she's every image of the sweet, loving mother. The tension goes out of her, leaving behind nervous giddiness as she proudly helps walk your daughter towards you. "Mmmblr..." Your daughter proves to be ever the talented conversationalist, babbling happily while she waddle-walks into your waiting arms. Aileh meets you with a kiss once she's close enough, her own tail lashing around while your daughter buries herself in your chest. The two — well, three — of you rise together, sharing [freja.name] in a double-cradle so that you can look down at her between kisses. "Well done, our precious little ember." You agree... turning Aileh's nethers into a flood of motherly bliss in the process. "Mnf, you're going to get me giddy you tease!" The dragon eventually sighs wistfully. "It won't be long now, she'll have a growth spurt and all of the information she's been picking up will start just... doing the brain thing." Her vocabulary fails her, eventually ending in a shrug. "Any chance you can explain that further?" "I asked mom about it, since [freja.name] was getting all... extra-plump. Basically she's going to shoot up like a whip, and all of the listening she's been doing is going to... express itself?" "Is that why you've been reading all those books?" "Sssorta..." Aileh blushes. "I also just get bored when you're not about, I can hardly leave for as long as I used to in order to run errands for mom and help train some of her goons. You can see it in [freja.name]'s eyes though; she listens, even if she's not internalizing the information." "Ma!" The two of you jolt in surprise, and another hushed whisper slips from Aileh's lips. "Did you say mom?" "Maaaa...uhm." It's drawn out, barely different from the scaly dragon-potato's usual babbling, but it's something you know instinctively as an attempt at speech. [pc.mf |"Bbbb... da!" |She places her little hand on your own lips and mumbles out a similarly-definitive "Ma!" ] [pc.isDK |It comes as a surprise to your otherwise cold, stony heart when there's moisture welling up in the corners of your eyes. Obviously when you flip this world on its rear and carve your corner out of it, you're just going to have to get used to being a softy for your kids. |Moisture wells up in the corners of your eyes, a mirror to the shimmering in Aileh's own burning orbs. ] "Steps and words in one day... you are a genius, [freja.name]." Your precious little babe only manages a succinct raspberry in response, but you're both too busy fawning over her much to care. "I'll miss this, soon. Just you watch and wait, it's going to be a week of growing pains, and then suddenly a rambunctious infant constantly trying to fly around." "She'll be fine, I'm sure." You give Aileh a kiss on the forehead. "The Wayfort will benefit from having her kicking up a fuss." [wayfort.sexy |"They're going to have to be a little better behaved then," Aileh grumbles, kissing you back. "They're hornier idiots than me." |"Hah, I'm sure it will. [wayfort.hasDaliza |Daliza is ecstatic about having more dragons in the Wayfort." |A little extra life in our home would be nice." ] ] The two of you look down at [freja.name] again, and she gives you a soft 'rar', flashing the neat row of tiny sharp teeth. "Are those still her baby teeth?" "Yyyup..." Aileh winces. "Having milk is amazing, and I fully intend to just... keep being milky somehow, but I won't miss having my tits bitten." "You're actually staying milky?" You lick your lips slowly. Aileh blushes and glances away and bites her lip. "Mmmmaybe, I might have asked for some alchemical assistance. Milk is awesome."'

rows.original:
"Eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee!" 

    "W-wait! Slow down!" 
    
    A crash, and thump — followed by squeals of surprise and alarm — are enough to have you rushing to the door. You throw it open in alarm, and there's yet another squeal of genuine surprise, with a pitch of clarity you're unused to yet from [freja.name].
rows.translation:
“啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！” 

    “等、等等！慢点！” 
    
    一阵撞击声和闷响之后，紧接着是一连串惊恐的尖叫声——这些声音足以让你冲向门口。你惊慌地推开门，却再次听到一声真切的惊叫，那音调之清晰，是你还没从[freja.name]身上听惯的。

rows.original: "[pc.mf |Daddy! |Mommy! ] Aaaaaah!" [freja.name] throws her arms wide and sprints at you, little wings flapping, tail lashing, and clawed feet scrabbling on the wood before you're tackled dead-on in the shins. Aileh's right on her heels, dashing forward and catching you before your daughter can send you both tumbling down the stairs. Her hands grab your shoulders, and you can see that your draconic girlfriend looks a combination and delighted and frazzled. "Our little ember just... she just sprouted this morning. Literally tumbled out of the cradle giggling!" "Hiii..." [freja.name] sings again, hugging your legs and wiggling uncontrollably. You look down [pc.hasBoobs |past your tits ]at her, awe beginning to sink in at the bright, sunshine-y face. Her deep green eyes have become clear, light-drinking orbs of innocence, and none of her mother's inky blackness is present... Your daughter's surprisingly deep natural tan has sunk in, [calise.isKasyrra |true evidence of Kasyrra-slash-Calise's bloodline, perhaps? |maybe evidence of Kasyrra's original skin-tone? ] There are plenty of other changes too; [freja.name]'s chubby little tater-body has become something healthy, and a little bit lanky. Her soft, tufty black hair has taken on the thick, shaggy texture of Aileh's own, with deep tips of red. "I already had a sweater ready for her, [kasyrra.hlr |and I'll probably wait until you're gone to ask mom to give her a health checkup... as long as that's okay?" Your defensive instincts momentarily war with your wariness when it comes to the demon queen... but she may well be the only woman in the world who knows what she's doing with a dragon infant whose lineage lies in another world entirely. "It's okay," you murmur, running your hands through the incredible mop of hair. |but I was going to call mom and see if she could come check up on her?" "Of course, when it comes to special magical dragons from another realm, Kasyrra is the only one who knows." You brush your hands through your daughter's incredible mop of hair, feeling a confusing mish-mash of emotions bundle up in your heart. You settle on awe and love. |but there's no way I could keep this from mom long. Can I invite her over?" "Of course! I can't wait to see the look on her face." You grin wickedly, sinking your fingers into the incredible mop of [freja.name]'s hair. ] When you finally get back into the room, Aileh proudly scoops the squealing infant up, laughing when her wings begin to unconsciously flap from the act of being airborne. "C'mere you... you rapscallion!" "Rapscallion?" You query, quirking a brow. [freja.name] simply giggles and wiggles, flashing her biggest, most innocent heart-melting eyes in your direction. "Rapscaddon!" Her voice hits you in such a way as to settle a pang of deep, [pc.mf |paternal |maternal ] yearning— going far beyond first-words. Your daughter just heard a word... possibly for the first time, before she internalized it, and proudly shouted it back. You must never [silly |fucking ]swear in earshot of her. "I'm sorry but can you think of a more fitting word?" Aileh smiles brightly and hugs the squirmy bundle of energy before releasing her again. "We're going to need toys, and... oh gosh, to build a bed, and-and—" You smile and wave her down, sensing pending panic in your girlfriend's voice. "It's fine, I'll help." [wayfort.hasMaids |Your maids can probably round up some spare construction supplies. |Surely someone can round up some construction supplies, and if not? You certainly will. ]
rows.translation: “[pc.mf |爸爸！ |妈妈！ ]啊啊啊啊啊！”[freja.name]张开双臂朝你飞奔过来，小羽翼扑扇着，尾巴甩动，带爪的小脚在木地板上乱刨，下一秒就正正撞在你小腿上。 艾莱赫紧跟在她身后，冲上前来扶住你，免得你女儿把你们俩一起撞下楼梯。她双手抓住你的肩膀，你能看出你这位龙族女友的表情又欣喜又狼狈。“我们的小火苗刚才……她今天早上蹿个儿了。真的是咯咯笑着从摇篮里滚了出来！” “嗨咦……”[freja.name]又唱了一声，抱着你的腿扭个不停。 你低头[pc.hasBoobs |越过自己的奶子 ]看着她，那张阳光般明亮的小脸让你渐渐生出敬畏。她深绿色的眼睛变成了清澈、仿佛能吸走光线的天真圆眸，她母亲身上那种墨黑丝毫不见……你女儿那深得出奇的天然肤色已经定型了，[calise.isKasyrra |也许这就是卡希拉即卡莉丝血脉的确凿证据？ |也许能证明卡希拉原本的肤色？ ]还有不少其他变化；[freja.name]那胖乎乎的小土豆身子变得健康了些，还有点瘦长。她柔软蓬松的黑色头发变得像艾莱赫自己那样厚实而蓬乱，发梢是深深的红色。 “我已经给她准备好了一件毛衣，[kasyrra.hlr |我大概会等你走后再请妈妈来给她做个体检……只要你同意的话？” 一涉及这位恶魔女王，你护崽的本能便暂时与你对她的戒心交战……但她很可能就是世上唯一知道该如何照料一个血脉来自异世界的龙裔婴儿的女性。“没关系，”你低声说，双手抚过那一头惊人的乱发。 |但我本来就要打电话给妈妈，看她能不能过来给她检查一下？” “当然，说到来自另一个界域的特殊魔法龙，只有卡希拉才懂。”你的双手抚过女儿那一头惊人的乱发，心里涌起一团混乱交杂的情绪。你最终选择了敬畏与爱。 |但这种事我不可能瞒妈妈太久。我能请她过来吗？” “当然！我迫不及待想看看她脸上的表情。”你坏笑着，手指埋进[freja.name]那头惊人的乱发里。 ] 等你们终于回到房间里，艾莱赫得意地把尖声叫嚷的婴儿抱起来，看到她因为被举到空中而开始无意识地扇动羽翼，不禁笑了出来。“到这儿来，你……你这个小淘气！” “小淘气？”你挑起一边眉毛问道。 [freja.name]只是咯咯笑着扭来扭去，朝你亮出她那双最大、最天真、能把人心都融化的大眼睛。“小蛋捣鬼！” 她的声音以一种奇妙的方式击中你，让你心头一阵深沉的、[pc.mf |为人父 |为人母 ]的渴望安定了下来——远不止是第一次说话那么简单。你女儿刚刚听到一个词……也许是第一次听到，还没完全弄懂，就骄傲地喊了回来。 你绝对不能在[silly |该死的 ]她能听见的地方说脏话。 “抱歉，可你能想出更贴切的词吗？”艾莱赫灿烂地笑着，把这团扭动不休的活力抱了抱，又放开她。“我们需要玩具，还有……天哪，还得搭张床，还、还有——” 你微笑着摆手让她放轻松，听出女友声音里即将爆发的慌乱。“没事，我来帮忙。”[wayfort.hasMaids |你的女仆们大概能凑出一些多余的建材。 |总有人能凑出些建材，要是没有呢？那你肯定会想办法。 ]
