rows.original: Having a precocious, incredibly mobile daughter running around the room, makes it difficult to concentrate on anything productive... but you manage to pull together enough supplies to begin making a bedroom annex for [freja.name]. Aileh, admittedly, does the majority of the work. Instead you get to keep your brand new bundle of energy occupied for a while, holding her hands and bouncing her on the spot. Now that she has the mind for it, you're asked an impressive number of questions... some of which prove a little hard to answer. "Where do you go?" [freja.name] eventually asks you, big green eyes shining. "What do you mean?" Your draconic daughter gives you a look as though it should be obvious, speaking with the kind of precious authority only a child can muster. "Mmm, when you aren't here [pc.mf |daddy |mommy ]!" "Ah, that..." You hum and ponder, hefting [freja.name] onto your knee where you bounce her gently. "[pc.dcb |I go out and bash a lot of skulls, so that one day all things belong to me and my family. Family like you! |I go out and help people, rescue them when they're in danger, and improve the world for me and my family. Family like yourself. |I travel the lands and spread love and hugs for everyone, but especially for you! ]" There's a bright peal of laughter from the dragonling, and she hugs you tightly. "I wanna be big and, and... strong! So that I can help!" "You are just too precious!" Aileh interrupts, scooping [freja.name] into her arms and giving her a smooch. "Now, how about you free your [pc.mf |daddy |other mommy ] up so that [pc.mf |he |she ] can help me build your bed?" As though triggered by the word 'bed', your daughter begins to flag. She yawns, widely, moisture dampening the corners of her eyes with the intensity of it. "But I'm not sleepy!" [freja.name] lies, lyingly. "Uh huh, can you sit on the bed for a few moments though, my dear little ember?" "Ooookay..." Your daughter smiles and flaps unconsciously when she's lifted up from Aileh's hip, before clambering onto the bed. ...She lasts maybe half a minute before she's out cold. "Knew it." Aileh grins smugly, snuggling up and kissing you slowly on the lips. "As much as I desperately want to lay you down and ride you into the ground, how about we build our daughter's bed, huh?" "We'll need blankets and mattress though, right?" "I'll ask mom to bring some." Aileh smiles. You get one more kiss before digging into some modest home construction, which also gives you a chance to watch your muscular girlfriend punch a red-hot nail into a solid lacquered wooden board with her thumb. [silly |Mnf. ] It doesn't take long, and the two of you are careful not to wake [freja.name] up. "I think that's that. I'm impressed, dear heart. We're a couple of regular carpenters." Aileh hugs your side and smiles, nearly dragging your head down into her tits. "I'll call mom when you leave, and get our baby's blankets set up... and figure out how to get that privacy rune off of [freja.name]'s crib and onto her annex. Sound good?" Although thoughts of Kasyrra slinking around still make you fidget uncomfortably, you manage to keep your expression carefree for Aileh's sake. "Sounds good."
rows.translation: 天资聪颖而且格外好动的女儿在房间里跑来跑去，让人根本无法专心做任何有意义的事情……不过你还是设法凑齐了足够的材料，开始为[freja.name]修建一间附属卧室。不得不承认，大部分工作都是艾莱赫完成的。而你呢，就可以利用自己那充满活力的状态，握着她的手，让她在原地跳来跳去，让她的注意力暂时被你吸引住。 现在，当她开始有兴致与你交流时，你会被问到许多问题……其中有些问题确实有点难以回答。“你平时都去哪里呢？ [freja.name]最终，它用那双闪着亮光的大绿眼睛问你： “你是什么意思？” 你的龙裔女儿看着你，仿佛在说显而易见的用只有孩子才拥有的那种天真而坚定的语气说道：“嗯，当你不在身边的时候[pc.mf |爸爸 |妈妈 ]啊，那个……”你沉吟着，若有所思地摸了摸那个东西。 [freja.name]将她轻轻放在你的膝盖上，然后轻轻摇晃她。[pc.dcb |我走出去，打碎了许多人的头骨，这样有一天，所有的一切都会属于我和我的家人——就像你们这样的家人！ |我走出去帮助别人，在他们处于危险之中时拯救他们，从而为自己和家人改善这个世界。就像你这样的家人一样。 |我游历各地，为每一个人送上爱与拥抱，尤其是为你！ ]小龙发出一阵清脆的笑声，然后紧紧地抱住了你。“我想变得高大一些，还有……更强壮！这样我就能帮忙了！” “你实在太珍贵了！”艾莉突然插话道，一边将你抱得更紧了一些。 [freja.name]把她拥入怀中，然后亲了她一下。“现在，你能不能放开[pc.mf |爸爸 |其他妈妈们 ]向上移动，以便[pc.mf |他 |她 ]能帮我搭你的床吗？” 仿佛一听到“床”这个词，你的女儿就开始表现出兴趣来了。她打了个大大的哈欠，哈欠打得如此厉害，以至于眼泪都快掉出来了。“可我并不困啊！ [freja.name]谎言，满口谎言…… “嗯嗯，不过亲爱的小 Ember，你能坐在床上一会儿吗？” “好吧……”你的女儿微笑着，被从艾莱赫的腿上抱起来时，她还不自觉地扑腾着小翅膀，然后爬上了床。 ……她大概坚持半分钟左右，就昏了过去。“我就知道。”艾莱得意地笑着，依偎过来，轻轻吻了吻你的嘴唇。“虽然我真的很想把你压在身下，直到你筋疲力尽……但咱们还是先为女儿准备床吧，怎么样？不过，我们还是需要毯子和床垫吧？” “我会让妈妈带一些来的。”艾莉笑着说道。在开始一些简单的家庭装修工作之前，你们又享受了一次亲吻。同时，你也有机会看到你那位肌肉结实的女朋友用她的拇指将一颗烧红的钉子钉进一块涂了漆的木板上。 [silly |嗯哼。 ] 没过多久，你们俩就都非常小心，生怕吵醒对方。 [freja.name]我想就这样吧。真的，我太佩服你了……我们不过是一对普通的木匠而已。”艾莱依搂着你的腰，微笑着，几乎要把你的头拉到她的胸前。“等你离开后，我会打电话告诉妈妈，让她把我们宝宝的毯子准备好……然后再想办法去掉[freja.name]身上的隐私符文。从她的卧室走到她的附属房间，听起来不错吧？” 虽然一想到卡希拉可能在暗中活动，你就会感到不安，但为了艾莱，你还是努力保持着轻松的表情。“听起来不错。
rows.raw: ' Having a precocious, incredibly mobile daughter running around the room, makes it difficult to concentrate on anything productive... but you manage to pull together enough supplies to begin making a bedroom annex for [freja.name]. Aileh, admittedly, does the majority of the work. Instead you get to keep your brand new bundle of energy occupied for a while, holding her hands and bouncing her on the spot. Now that she has the mind for it, you're asked an impressive number of questions... some of which prove a little hard to answer. "Where do you go?" [freja.name] eventually asks you, big green eyes shining. "What do you mean?" Your draconic daughter gives you a look as though it should be obvious, speaking with the kind of precious authority only a child can muster. "Mmm, when you aren't here [pc.mf |daddy |mommy ]!" "Ah, that..." You hum and ponder, hefting [freja.name] onto your knee where you bounce her gently. "[pc.dcb |I go out and bash a lot of skulls, so that one day all things belong to me and my family. Family like you! |I go out and help people, rescue them when they're in danger, and improve the world for me and my family. Family like yourself. |I travel the lands and spread love and hugs for everyone, but especially for you! ]" There's a bright peal of laughter from the dragonling, and she hugs you tightly. "I wanna be big and, and... strong! So that I can help!" "You are just too precious!" Aileh interrupts, scooping [freja.name] into her arms and giving her a smooch. "Now, how about you free your [pc.mf |daddy |other mommy ] up so that [pc.mf |he |she ] can help me build your bed?" As though triggered by the word 'bed', your daughter begins to flag. She yawns, widely, moisture dampening the corners of her eyes with the intensity of it. "But I'm not sleepy!" [freja.name] lies, lyingly. "Uh huh, can you sit on the bed for a few moments though, my dear little ember?" "Ooookay..." Your daughter smiles and flaps unconsciously when she's lifted up from Aileh's hip, before clambering onto the bed. ...She lasts maybe half a minute before she's out cold. "Knew it." Aileh grins smugly, snuggling up and kissing you slowly on the lips. "As much as I desperately want to lay you down and ride you into the ground, how about we build our daughter's bed, huh?" "We'll need blankets and mattress though, right?" "I'll ask mom to bring some." Aileh smiles. You get one more kiss before digging into some modest home construction, which also gives you a chance to watch your muscular girlfriend punch a red-hot nail into a solid lacquered wooden board with her thumb. [silly |Mnf. ] It doesn't take long, and the two of you are careful not to wake [freja.name] up. "I think that's that. I'm impressed, dear heart. We're a couple of regular carpenters." Aileh hugs your side and smiles, nearly dragging your head down into her tits. "I'll call mom when you leave, and get our baby's blankets set up... and figure out how to get that privacy rune off of [freja.name]'s crib and onto her annex. Sound good?" Although thoughts of Kasyrra slinking around still make you fidget uncomfortably, you manage to keep your expression carefree for Aileh's sake. "Sounds good."'

rows.original: When you return with a double-armload of planks and a box of nails, Aileh and [freja.name] are staring up at the skylight with grins on their faces. "Mom's about to turn up, how do we look?" Your draconic girlfriend murmurs. "Does... it matter? She's seen [kasyrra.hlr | |you at your worst. |us at our worst. ]" You place the stack of goodies against the wall, hefting a hammer. [wayfort.hasFarrah |Thankfully Farrah had a bunch of leftover renovation supplies stowed under her counter. |Thankfully there were plenty of supplies left in the room near your throne. ] "Mmmatters." [freja.name] splays herself out in Aileh's arms, wiggling and kicking. Before you can indulge in trying to figure out why from your fidgeting daughter feels it matters, a familiar — if sinful — figure lowers herself down from the skylight. "Hello my dear— ah! Precious baby!" She's brought a large sack of goodies with her, but she's not even given time to place the bag down before she's hit by a bolt of squealing tan lightning. "Hi gamma I love you!" She cries out loudly and squeezes Kasy so hard she nearly disappears into the demon's cleavage. Her tail wiggles and her little wings flap, not stopping until she's cradled up in her arms like a princess. Kasyrra gulps, eyes immediately turning to pools of evil silver with unshed tears. "I-I love you too." Aileh sidles over and hugs your arm, looking unbelievably delighted at the look on Kasyrra's face. [calise.isKasyrra |Kasyrra's awed expression only continues to brighten, and she looks between the miniature alchemical dragon and you. She looks over and over again, her tail slowly lashing from side to side before looking up again. "[freja.name]; she looks like me..." her lip quivers. "W-why does she look like me?" Kasyrra gulps, burying her face in your daughter's hair and doing a valiant job of hiding her tears. "I didn't know there was so much of me in Aileh..." |Kasyrra nearly bawls on the spot, burying her face in [freja.name]'s hair and hiding any errant tears before they can fall. ] Kasyrra manages to pull herself together, teasing the mop of her granddaughter's soft, colorful hair. "You're beautiful, so beautiful... like a precious princess." [freja.name] gasps. "A princess?" Her own eyes grow huge, little claws grabby-handsing at Kasyrra. "Love princess!" She giggles again when Kasy kisses her hands. Aileh nods sagely. "You must make sure to find one and keep her in a tower." "Like I've done with you?" You tease, squeezing the dragon's rear and earning a blush for your effort. "Mommy princess tooo..." [freja.name] enunciate's the point, splaying herself out in Kasy's arms until she's nearly tumbling back out again. Kasyrra snorts and allows the dragonling to crawl from her grasp — after a few more delighted smooches that have her giggling and squealing again — and looks proudly at the two of you. "You have no idea how unbelievably giddy I'm feeling right now, I am just..." The demon shivers and looks you up and down for a moment, but she manages to pull herself together before [kasyrra.hlr | |it comes down to saying something she might regret. |Aileh's forced to tug you free from her baby-crazy grasp. ] "[freja.name] dear," The demon queen smiles softly, hooves clip-clopping as she squats down. "Yes gamma?" "Grandma." Kasy corrects. "Grandma." Your daughter repeats, tasting the split syllables and the full, rolling 'r.' Aileh beams with pride at the surprised raise of Kasyrra's brows, wiggling and hugging your side. "Well..." Kasyrra mumbles, tickling [freja.name]'s chin. "We can clear your enhanced cognition." At a confused look from your daughter she goes into a little more detail, speaking slowly and decisively. "You got very big, very fast, because you're special and magical. I wanted to be sure you had a nice big brain to go with it." Kasyrra takes her time giving your daughter a checkup, most of which results in delighted bright giggling, and flapping arms. While you and Aileh use the precocious child's distraction as an opportunity to start hammering together a wooden annex. There's plenty of height to Aileh's room, more than enough for you to build a huge raised platform and a ladder with which to reach it. Strong, lacquered wood resists any attempts at breaking, even when Aileh clambers up into it and bounces a few times on her bum. "I'm confident our child won't go falling through this..." Of course, [freja.name] sees this and immediately attempts to spring into the newfound construction, but she's brought short by hands scooping her from under the armpits. "Ah-ah-ah..." Kasyrra tuts, "I thought you were about to help get all of your blankets ready first, then it will actually be comfortable up there." "B-but—" She kicks her feet in the air a few times before going limp. "Aww." The demon queen laughs softly and lowers [freja.name] to the ground. "You've earned some candy for being a good girl during your checkup, too." [freja.name]'s gasp is almost comically loud, eyes big as she's handed a neatly-wrapped sweet. Aileh plants her hands on her hips, frowning. "What?" Kasyrra asks. "She can eat the occasional sweet, I've literally just given her a clean bill of health." "No, where are ours, huh?"
rows.translation: 当你抱着一堆木板和一箱钉子回来时，艾莱和[freja.name]脸上带着笑容，抬头望着天窗。“妈妈马上就要来了，我们这个样子……合适吗？”你的龙裔女友低声问道。 “有……关系吗？她已经见过我们这个样子了。”你回答道。 [kasyrra.hlr | |这就是你最糟糕的样子。 |展现我们最糟糕的一面。 ]你把那一堆好东西靠在墙上，然后拿起了锤子。 [wayfort.hasFarrah |幸运的是，法拉在她的柜台下面存放着许多剩余的装修材料。 |幸运的是，你的王座附近的房间里还有大量的物资。 ] 这很重要。 [freja.name]扭动身体，踢来踢去，最终躺在了艾勒的怀里。 还没等你来得及仔细思考为什么从你坐立不安的女儿那里得知这件事很重要，一个熟悉而又……有点“不讨人喜欢”的身影从天窗处走了下来。“嗨，亲爱的——啊！亲爱的宝贝！她带着一大袋零食来到这里，但还没等她把袋子放下，一阵刺耳的、棕色的闪电就击中了她。嗨，伽马，我爱你！她大声哭喊着，紧紧抱住卡西，用力程度之大，几乎让卡西完全消失在恶魔的胸腔里。她的尾巴不停地摆动，小翅膀也拼命扑动，直到最终被卡西像抱公主一样紧紧搂在怀里。 卡希拉咽了咽口水，眼中立刻涌出了未流出的泪水，那些泪水呈现出邪恶的银色。“我也……爱你。” 艾莱走到她身边，搂住了她的手臂，看到卡希拉脸上的表情，她显得无比开心。 [calise.isKasyrra |卡希拉那敬畏的表情愈发明亮，她将目光在那只微型炼金术巨龙和你之间来回移动。她反复地注视着它们，尾巴也缓缓地从一侧摆动到另一侧，然后再次抬起头来看。[freja.name]她长得和我一样……”她的嘴唇开始颤抖，“为、为什么她会和我长得这么像？”卡希拉咽了口唾沫，把脸埋在你女儿的头发里，努力忍住泪水。“我之前根本不知道，艾莉身上有这么多我的影子…… |卡希拉差点当场哭出来，她把脸埋了进去[freja.name]她赶紧整理好自己的头发，试图在那些泪水落下之前将它们藏起来。 ] 卡希拉努力让自己平静下来，轻轻拨弄着孙女那柔软而五彩斑斓的头发。“你真漂亮，太漂亮了……就像一位珍贵的公主。 [freja.name]倒抽了一口气：“公主？”她自己的眼睛也瞪得大大的，小手像爪子一样紧紧抓住卡希拉。“我要拥有一位公主！”当卡西吻她的手时，她又开心地笑了起来。 艾莱赫沉吟着点了点头：“你必须找到一位公主，并把她关在塔里。” “就像我把你关在塔里一样吗？”你开玩笑地说道，同时捏了捏那条龙的屁股，结果让它脸红了。 “妈妈也是公主啊[freja.name]把要点说得很清楚，然后整个人扑进卡西的怀里，直到差点又被甩出去为止。 卡希拉哼了一声，让这只小龙从她怀里爬出来——在又亲了几下之后，她忍不住又咯咯笑了起来——然后骄傲地看着你们两个：“你们根本无法想象我现在有多开心，我真的……”这个恶魔颤抖着，上下打量了你们一会儿，但最终还是勉强控制住了自己。 [kasyrra.hlr | |归根结底，就是可能会说出一些让她日后后悔的话。 |艾莉不得不用力将你从她那对婴儿极为痴迷的怀抱中拉出来。 ] "[freja.name]亲爱的，”恶魔女王温柔地笑着，蹄声“哒哒”地响起，她蹲了下来。 “是的，伽玛？” “奶奶。”卡西纠正道。 “奶奶。”你的女儿重复着这个词，仔细品味着每个音节，尤其是那个饱满、圆润的“r”音。 艾莱看到卡希拉惊讶地挑起了眉毛，脸上露出了自豪的笑容，她扭动着身体，紧紧抱住了你的腰。“嗯……”卡希拉喃喃道，同时继续挠着你的痒痒。 [freja.name]我们可以帮助你提升认知能力。”看到你女儿一脸困惑，她便进一步详细解释起来，语速缓慢而坚定：“你之所以能变得如此强大、如此迅速，是因为你与众不同，拥有神奇的力量。而我，就是想确保你拥有与之相匹配的、发达的大脑。卡希拉花了不少时间为你的女儿进行检查，检查过程中，你的女儿总是开心地咯咯笑个不停，还挥动着小手。而你和艾莱则趁这个孩子注意力被吸引的时候，开始一起动手搭建木制的附属建筑。艾莉的房间空间足够大，完全可以建造一个高大的平台，再配上一段梯子以便人们能够进入其中。这种坚固且经过上漆处理的木材能够有效抵抗任何破坏尝试，即使艾莉在平台上蹦跳玩耍，也不会对木材造成任何损伤。我相信我们的孩子不会因此而出事……” 当然， [freja.name]看到这个后立即她试图跳进那新建好的结构里，但有人从她腋下将她拉了回来。“啊——啊——啊……”卡希拉轻声笑道，“我还以为你会先帮忙把所有的毯子准备好呢，这样上去才会真正舒服些。” “可、可是……”她把脚踢了几下，然后就软软地瘫了下来。“哎呀。” 恶魔女王轻声笑了起来，然后把她放了下来。 [freja.name]你表现得很好，所以在检查结束后也得到了些糖果作为奖励。 [freja.name]她的喘息声大得几乎有些滑稽，眼睛瞪得圆圆的，因为有人递给她一块包装得整整齐齐的甜点。艾莱赫双手叉腰，皱起了眉头：“什么？”卡希拉问道。“她偶尔吃点甜点没什么问题，我刚才才确认她的身体状况完全正常。” “不，我的意思是……那些甜点到底放在哪里了？我们的哈？

rows.original:
Once you've finished building [freja.name]'s bedroom, the happy little dragon immediately clambers up into the raised annex, giggling as the curtains are drawn closed and she's hidden from view. Kasyrra saunters past you and Aileh, firmly tapping the copper rune salvaged from your daughter's crib into place on the annex's floor. "There, now you two can f— canoodle without disturbing her." 

                Even Kasy keeps her language clean around kids, it seems. [kasyrra.hlr
                    |
                    |
                    |"Or maybe all three of us?"
                ]
                
                Aileh blushes and elbows her mother, tip-toeing to look into [freja.name]'s bedroom... which treats you to the most soothing sound of all; a happy child softly snoring. "Out like a lantern."
                
                The demon queen sighs, tension bleeding out of her body. "And now, I must be off. This has been wonderful; a moment of free, familial peace. But the world won't conquer itself." Kasyrra winks at you, gives her daughter a smooch on the brow, and takes off through the skylight.
                
                Aileh slumps with relief, hugging you a moment later and burying you into the bed. "I love you."
                
                "Love you too, doofus." 
                
                The dragon snorts, tail flicking around before she buries her face in your neck. "[freja.name] had me awake early and all day, so I'm going to just pass out now. I won't keep you any longer." She kisses your neck a few times, leaving some nice lipstick prints on you before rolling off of you again and sprawling out the full breadth of her bed. "Mmmm..."
                
                A sweltering heat begins to radiate off of Aileh unconsciously, and you begin to peel yourself free. True; there's a lot to be done. You tiptoe over to your daughter's bed and climb up to give her a kiss on her heart-scale forehead.
rows.translation:
一旦你完成了建造工作。 [freja.name]走进卧室后，那只快乐的小龙立刻爬上了那个凸出的小隔间，当窗帘被拉上，它被藏了起来，这时它还在咯咯笑着。卡希拉从你和艾莱身边走过，然后将从你女儿的婴儿床里找到的铜质符文牢牢地固定在小隔间的地板上。“好了，现在你们俩可以……做些该做的事，而不会打扰到她了。”

                看来，就连卡西在孩子面前也会注意自己的言辞。 [kasyrra.hlr
                    |
                    |
                    |或者我们三个人都一起去？
                ]
                
                艾莉赫脸红了，轻轻用肘子推了推母亲，然后踮起脚尖往里面看去。 [freja.name]他的卧室……那里有最能让人心境宁静的声音：一个快乐的孩子正在轻轻打着鼾。真是‘像灯笼一样熄灭了’。”
                
                恶魔女王叹了口气，全身仿佛都松懈了下来。“现在，我必须离开了。真是太棒了——这一刻，我们终于享受到了宁静与家庭的温暖。不过，这个世界终究还是无法自我拯救的。”卡希拉朝你眨了眨眼，然后在女儿的额头上亲了一下，便从天窗处离开了。
                
                艾莱赫松了一口气，片刻之后抱住了你，将你紧紧压在床上。我爱你。”
                
                “我也爱你，傻瓜。”
                
                龙哼了一声，尾巴甩来甩去，然后把脸埋在了你的脖子里。[freja.name]这事儿让我早早地就醒了，一整天都忙个不停，现在我真的要睡着了。不会再耽误你们了。”她在你脖子上轻吻了几下，留下了一道道漂亮的口红印，然后从你身上翻下来，整个人躺在了床上。嗯……”
                
                不知不觉中，艾莉开始散发出炽热的气息，你赶紧挣脱了束缚。确实，还有许多事情需要处理。你踮着脚走到女儿的床边，爬上去，在她那心形图案般的额头上吻了一下。

rows.original:
"Weeeee!" [freja.name] cheers uproariously, riding on the back of Daliza's massive warg, Narcie. Her wings flap like an aerial brake, bringing the mighty beast up short... although this only encourages her into a massive leap that has your dragonling daughter crying out with joy. Daliza, stood on the other side of the courtyard, whistles sharply and the weighty lupine spins around before calmly trotting over for some slobbery licks.

    You head over to join them, digging your fingers into the fur of Narcie's back and scratching right above her tail until she's kicking a back leg. "Ah, [pc.mf
        |baron
        |baroness
    ]... hope you don't mind, she came out to run around and... well." She gestures at your daughter, a blush creeping up her ears... It's only now that you realize she's covered head to toe in mud... most of which Narcie has already shed herself, through some kind of dog-magic.
    
    "You need a bath." You insist to [freja.name], who only seems extra delighted at this prospect.
    
    "Hi [pc.mf
        |daddy
        |mommy
    ]! I love you!"
    
    "I love you too," you answer, peeling her off of the warg's back. "You definitely need the bath though."
    
    "Lotsa hot an' extra bubblies?" Her tail wiggles around and she hisses softly. 
    
    Daliza appears utterly delighted at the scene, doing her very best to keep her face mostly passive. "I have a little something for [freja.name], afterwards... uh. I had one as a child and I adored it to pieces. We wouldn't want it to get muddy though."
rows.translation:
“好耶——！”[freja.name]欢呼雀跃，骑在达莉莎的巨大战狼纳西背上。她的翅膀像空中刹车一样拍打，令强大的野兽骤然停住……不过，这只鼓励纳西猛然跃起，令你的小龙女儿欢喜尖叫。达莉莎站在庭院另一边，尖锐地吹响口哨；沉重的狼兽转身，平静地小跑过来，用满是口水的舌头舔她。

    你走过去加入她们，手指陷入纳西背部的毛发，在尾巴正上方挠动，直到她踢起一条后腿。“啊，[pc.mf
        |男爵
        |女男爵
    ]……希望你别介意。她出来四处跑动，然后……嗯。”她指向你的女儿，双耳逐渐泛红……直到这时你才发现，女儿从头到脚都沾满泥泞……纳西却已通过某种狗狗魔法，把自己身上的泥大多抖掉。
    
    “你得洗澡。”你坚持对[freja.name]说道；这主意却只令她愈发开心。
    
    “你好，[pc.mf
        |爸爸
        |妈妈
    ]！我爱你！”
    
    “我也爱你。”你一边回答，一边把她从战狼背上剥下来。“不过，你绝对需要洗澡。”
    
    “好多热水，还有特别多泡泡？”她的尾巴来回摇摆，轻声嘶叫。 
    
    达莉莎看起来无比喜悦，只是竭尽全力让脸上依旧几乎不动声色。“之后，我有个小东西要送给[freja.name]……呃。我小时候也有一个，简直爱得不得了。不过，我们可不想把它弄脏。”

rows.original: Half an hour of getting hot and bubbly and soaked in the bath with your daughter, and you perch her up on your knee in order to dry her soft, thick, shaggy hair. Aileh herself is absent for the moment and it's strange to be in the room without her around. [freja.name]'s tail hugs your leg, wings flapping a couple of times in order to keep balance when you bounce her gently on a knee. Daliza eventually knocks at the door, smiling at the [pc.dcb |uncharacteristic sight of you being a warm softy |sight of you being familial |way you beam good bimbo energy ]. She turns around and waits patiently while you re-dress your daughter, ears wiggling. "All done?" "Am dressed!" [freja.name] bounces from your knee, and her clean, straight hair already beginning to poof up again thanks to the natural warmth that radiates off of her body. Daliza smiles and crouches down, giving the little dragon a fond hug. "Oooh, you're warm!" "Youuuu're chilly!" [freja.name] smiles, fangy teeth on display. Daliza winks, reaching behind her back and withdrawing... a big fluffy warg doll. [freja.name]'s eyes grow wide, and her little clawed hands make little grabby motions. To your own incredible pride, she doesn't try to snatch the cuddly toy from your bailiff's hands immediately. "You have a Narcie!" She squeals instead, tail wiggling and wings flapping. "Correction... you have a Narcie, sweetie. She will protect your dreams at night..." Aww. Happy tears well up in [freja.name]'s eyes and she hugs the stuffed toy tightly "I love her I love her! I love you!" She adds Daliza to that hug too, and the elf's ears wiggle. "I want to keep her." Daliza looks at you, hugging the dragon back protectively. Your smirk only encourages her, and she stands, spinning [freja.name] through the air and lowering her down again. Once your daughter has dashed off to introduce her new doll to its bed, Daliza turns her attention to you. There's a wry smile on her face, and she toys with her cranberry hair. "So that thing is technically a chew toy; it's really strong leather under the softer fabric. She has fangs to match Narcie's own, so it seemed appropriate... Replacing the fur is something I would be happy to do for her if she ever damages it too much." "You put a lot of thought into that then, and she loves it." [daliza.fucked |You make sure the bailiff gets a big smooch, and she gives you a warm smile. "Keep that up and I'll be after one of my own one day." |Daliza blushes and gives you a warm smile, looking up at [freja.name]'s annex. "Have I mentioned I'm utterly weak to dragons?" You'd noticed. ] The bailiff hangs around with the two of you for a few more minutes before saluting and departing, allowing you some [pc.mf |daddy |mommy ]-daughter time before Aileh returns.
rows.translation: 和女儿一起泡了半个小时的热水澡，她的头发变得柔软、浓密且蓬松起来。这时你把她抱到膝盖上，帮她擦干那头柔软的头发。此刻，艾莱赫本人并不在身边，没有她在房间里，感觉确实有点奇怪。 [freja.name]当你轻轻地把她放在膝盖上时，它的尾巴会紧贴着你的腿，翅膀也会扇动几下以保持平衡。 最终，达莉莎微笑着敲响了门。 [pc.dcb |真不像是你平时的作风，你平时可是个温柔体贴的人啊…… |一看到你，就觉得你和家人一样亲切。 |你散发出的那种充满魅力的活力，真是让人无法抗拒啊…… ]她转过身，耐心地等待着你为女儿重新穿好衣服，耳朵还不停地动着。“都穿好了吗？” “已经穿好了！ [freja.name]小球从你的膝盖上弹跳起来，而她那干净笔直的头发，也因为她身体散发出的自然温暖而开始重新蓬松起来。达莉莎微笑着蹲下来，温柔地抱住了这只小龙。 “哦，你真暖和啊！” “你……你才冷呢！ [freja.name]露出了笑容，那露出的牙齿显得格外锋利。 达莉莎眨了眨眼，然后从背后拿出了一个……一个毛茸茸的大玩偶。 [freja.name]她的眼睛亮了起来。宽广的她的那双带着小爪子的手部不停地抓挠着。令你感到无比自豪的是，她并没有立刻试图从你的保镖手中抢走那个毛绒玩具。“你有一只纳西！”她尖叫道，同时摇着尾巴、拍动着翅膀。 “纠正一下…… 你亲爱的，找个像纳西这样的人吧，她会在夜晚守护你的梦想……” 啊…… 幸福的泪水在眼眶中打转[freja.name]她紧紧抱住那个毛绒玩具，眼中充满爱意：“我爱她，我真的爱她！我也爱你！”她还将达莉莎也抱了进去，那个小精灵的耳朵立刻动了起来。 “我想把她留下来。”达莉莎这样说着，保护性地抱着那条龙。 你露出的微笑反而鼓励了她，于是她站了起来，开始旋转起来。 [freja.name]飞快地穿过空中，又将女儿放下。等你的女儿跑去把她的新玩偶安放到“床”上后，达莉莎才把注意力转向你。她脸上带着一丝苦笑，一边摆弄着自己那头蔓越莓色的头发。从技术上来说，那个东西其实就是一种咬嚼玩具；在柔软的布料下面，其实是非常结实的皮革。她的獠牙和纳西的獠牙一样，所以用这样的东西似乎很合适……如果她的獠牙被弄坏了，我非常乐意帮她更换这些毛皮。你肯定花了很多心思才做出这样的东西，而她也非常喜欢它。 [daliza.fucked |你确保那个法警能得到一个热情的吻，而她也会对你露出温暖的微笑。“如果你能一直这样，总有一天我也会尝试的。 |达莉莎脸红了，抬起头，向你露出了一个温暖的微笑。 [freja.name]附录。我有没有说过，我对龙类完全毫无抵抗力？” 你早就注意到了。 ] 法警又和你们俩待了几分钟，然后敬了个礼离开了，让你们有了一些独处的时间。 [pc.mf |爸爸 |妈妈 ]在艾莱回归之前，母女俩应该共度一些时光。

rows.original:
[wayfort.hasJaelyn
        |You spot your demonic barmaid first, standing head and shoulders above the rest of the Wayfort's girls and boys. She's wearing a lazy workout top and a knee-length skirt that seems made to keep her incredibly... proportionate, proportions, from spilling out or hitting herself and someone accidentally. Beside her — and trying not to stare — is Daliza.
        |It takes a few moments to do so, but you quickly spot the deep red bob of Daliza's hair as she does a jump before dropping down into a push-up.
    ] Nearly all of your guards are present too, exercising in a group or splitting off into pairs to spar.
    
    [pc.mf
        |"Daddy!
        |"Mommy!
    ] Can I join them?" [freja.name] dashes over, leaping up into your arms. When you hoist her over your head she bursts into giggling, wings flapping as you fake-fly her over to the exercising soldiers. "Eeee!"
    
    Your arrival heralds a momentary break in the elves' exercising, [wayfort.hasMaids
        |and a few of your maids — those that weren't exercising or sparring with them — dive in with fresh drinks and a chance to swoon over luscious, sweaty bodies.
        |and they quickly pass around drinks.
    ] Daliza smiles at you both and sketches a deep, professional bow. "Lady Wayfarer, [pc.mf
        |Baron
        |Baroness
    ]." [freja.name] giggles at her title and does her best, princess-y curtsy. 
    
    [ashe.saved
        |It looks like Ashe has been teaching your daughter etiquette. [ashe.around
            |The wordless query is answered by the sensation of pride from her place at your belt, and you give the hilt an idle rub.
            |Who knew she'd been receiving lessons in etiquette?
        ]
    ] "I want to join in! Can I?"
    
    Daliza looks to you, brow raised, and you shrug. "Sure. But if they tell you something's dangerous and that you should stop, then stop." 
    
    "Yay! Does that mean I getta sword?" [freja.name] continues, eyes wide and tail lashing around excitedly.
    
    [ashe.around
        |Ashe, in a moment of rare cognisance, hums with warmth on your belt. Well... if the dragoness has taken an interest in your daughter's upbringing, who are you to discourage an ancient, trained warrior woman? "How about a big wooden mace like Ashe?"
        
        "Yessss..." [freja.name] trails off into a happy hiss that visibly melts the bailiff's already dragon-soft heart.
        |"A wooden one, yes. Your mother will actually roast me if I let you get hurt with a sharp blade."
        
        "Mmmmm..." Your daughter doesn't appear entirely convinced, at least until Daliza continues.
        
        "Plus, I'm sure you wouldn't want to accidentally cut me, either."
        
        Your daughter looks down at her feet, hugging her tail a moment later. "N-no..."
    ] You give [freja.name]'s head a fond rub, teasing her ears until she's hissing and wiggling. "So... what do I do?" She asks, bouncing on her heels when she's granted a weapon.
    
    "Well, until your mother returns, we'll drill you on how to stand, and swing in a way that won't hurt you. Nothing complicated, but we all need to do the basics — and stay refreshed on them." 
    
    You have the chance to sit back and watch your daughter play, relaxing a chair brought out for you by [wayfort.hasMaids
        |one of the maids
        |[wayfort.hasJaelyn
            |Jael
            |one of Daliza's soldiers
        ]
    ]. You could probably join in... but frankly you get more than enough exercising while you're adventuring. There is little surprise that [freja.name] takes to the task with glee, although she trips over her own limbs as much as she does one of Daliza's guards. 
    
    By the time your little daughter has exhausted herself, Aileh returns. She wings down towards the courtyard in a lazy, circular glide. When she touches down, she first splays herself out across your body and lets you hold her up by hands on the bum. Her lips trace kisses along your neck, before eventually she rests her head on your shoulder. "Having a nice time?"
    
    "Mhm..." Your brain takes a few moments to re-engage itself, but once it does, [freja.name] charges over, leaping into your arms to share in a big family hug.
    
    Aileh smatters the dragonling's brow with kisses, before wrinkling her nose. "Okay, it's bath time for you."
    
    "An' you!" [freja.name] beams, wiggling in your arms. 
    
    She isn't wrong, after Aileh's been flying around for who-knows-how-long. Her hair is looking as poofy as her daughter's now, too. "Deal. Give [pc.mf
        |your daddy
        |mommy-two
    ] some kisses, we'll go get washed up and let [pc.mf
        |him
        |her
    ] go back to being a big hero."
    
    "Muahmuahmuah!" [freja.name] gives you a big sloppy kiss before giggling and sprinting away into the tower. Aileh winks and wiggles her bum in your hands, giving you a much more salacious, tongue-entwining kiss. 
    
    "Muahmuahmuah indeed..." Aileh teases, following in her daughter's wake and waving at the soldiers as she passes.
rows.translation:
[wayfort.hasJaelyn
        |你首先注意到了那位恶魔般的酒保——她的身高在荒废驿堡酒馆的所有男女员工中显得格外突出。她穿着一件宽松的运动上衣和一条及膝的裙子，这种装束似乎特意设计用来保持她那令人惊叹的身材比例，防止她的身体部位意外暴露或撞到别人。站在她旁边的是达莉莎，她努力克制着自己不去直视她。
        |这个过程需要花费一些时间，但当你看到达莉莎在跳跃后迅速做出俯卧撑的动作时，你立刻就能注意到她那深红色的头发。
    ]你们的几乎所有守卫也都都在场，有的在集体训练，有的则分成两人一组进行切磋。
    
    [pc.mf
        |爸爸！
        |妈妈！
    ]我能加入他们吗？ [freja.name]飞快地跑过来，跳进你的怀里。当你把它举到头顶时，它突然咯咯地笑了起来，翅膀扑腾着，而你则假装带着它飞向那些正在锻炼的士兵们。“咿呀！”
    
你的到来让精灵们的锻炼暂时中断了[wayfort.hasMaids
        |还有你们的一些女仆——那些没有在锻炼或与他们切磋的女仆们——也会拿着新鲜的饮料过来，同时也有机会欣赏那些充满活力、汗流浃背的美丽身躯。
        |他们迅速将饮料分发给大家。
    ]达莉莎对你们两人笑了笑，然后做了一个深沉而专业的鞠躬。“旅人女士，”她说。 [pc.mf
        |男爵
        |女男爵
    ]。" [freja.name]听到自己的头衔，她咯咯笑了起来，然后尽力做出符合公主身份的鞠躬动作。 
    
    [ashe.saved
        |看来艾什一直在教你女儿礼仪规范呢。 [ashe.around
            |这个无声的疑问，被她佩戴在你腰带上的那一刻所带来的自豪感所解答了，于是你随意地揉了揉剑柄。
            |谁会想到她一直在接受礼仪方面的教导呢？
        ]
    ]我也想参加！可以吗？”

达莉莎抬头看着你，你耸了耸肩说：“当然可以。但如果他们告诉你某件事很危险，让你停下来，那你就必须停下来。”

“太好了！这意味着我可以得到一把剑吗？ [freja.name]继续前进，眼睛瞪得大大的，尾巴兴奋地不停地摆动。
    
    [ashe.around
        |阿什，在那难得的清醒时刻，温柔地轻哼着，声音传到了你的耳边。嗯……既然这位龙女对培养你女儿表现出兴趣，你又有什么资格去阻止一位经验丰富、训练有素的战斗女性呢？“不如给她买一把像阿什那样的大型木制战锤怎么样？”

“好啊[freja.name]声音渐渐减弱，变成了一阵欢快的嘶嘶声，这一声显然让那位执行官本就已柔软得像龙一般的心更加柔软了。
        |木制的，没错。如果让我让你被锋利的刀刃划伤，你妈妈肯定会生我的气的。”

“嗯……”你的女儿似乎并不完全信服，至少在达莉莎继续说下去之前是这样。

“而且，我敢肯定你也不想不小心划伤我吧。”

你的女儿低头看着自己的足部，过了一会儿才抱住自己的尾巴说：“不……
    ]你给吧。 [freja.name]他轻轻揉了揉她的头，逗弄着她的耳朵，直到她发出嘶嘶声并开始扭动身体。“那么……我该怎么做呢？”当她得到武器时，她兴奋地用脚后跟跳来跳去地问道。

“嗯，在你妈妈回来之前，我们会教你如何站立，以及如何挥动武器而不受伤。没有什么复杂的，但我们都必须掌握这些基本动作——并且要经常复习它们。”

你现在可以坐下来，看着你的女儿玩耍，旁边还有一把有人为你拿来的椅子，让你可以放松休息。 [wayfort.hasMaids
        |其中一名女仆
        |[wayfort.hasJaelyn
            |雅艾尔
            |达莉莎的手下之一
        ]
    ]你或许也可以加入其中……但说实话，在冒险的过程中，你已经得到了足够的锻炼了。因此，这也并不奇怪[freja.name]兴高采烈地投入到这项任务中，不过她自己经常会绊倒，就像经常被达莉莎的卫兵们绊倒一样。

等到你的女儿累得精疲力尽的时候，艾莱才会回来。她会懒洋洋地绕着圈子飞向庭院。当她轻轻落下的时候，她会先散开身体，覆盖在你的身上，让你用手托住她的臀部。她的嘴唇会轻轻吻过你的脖子，最后把头靠在你的肩上。“玩得开心吗？嗯……”你的大脑需要几分钟的时间才能重新进入工作状态，但一旦恢复过来[freja.name]充电完毕，它立刻跳进你的怀里，和大家一起享受这个温馨的家庭拥抱。

艾莱轻吻着小龙的额头，然后皱了皱鼻子：“好了，该给你洗澡了。”

“你也是！ [freja.name]那些头发在你的怀里晃来晃去……

她说得没错，毕竟艾莱已经飞行了不知道多久。她的头发现在也变得和女儿的一样蓬松了。“好吧，成交。把头发给我吧。 [pc.mf
        |你爸爸
        |妈咪二号
    ]来些亲吻，然后我们去洗个澡，再继续吧。 [pc.mf
        |他
        |她
    ]重新成为伟大的英雄吧。”

“哇哈哈！ [freja.name]先是一个大大的、有些粗鲁的吻，然后咯咯笑着跑进了塔楼。而艾莉则眨了眨眼，在你手中扭动着自己的屁股，给了你一个更加热烈、充满亲昵感的吻。

“真是太甜蜜了……”艾莉调皮地笑着，跟在女儿的后面，经过士兵们身边时还向他们挥了挥手。
rows.raw:
'
    [wayfort.hasJaelyn
        |You spot your demonic barmaid first, standing head and shoulders above the rest of the Wayfort's girls and boys. She's wearing a lazy workout top and a knee-length skirt that seems made to keep her incredibly... proportionate, proportions, from spilling out or hitting herself and someone accidentally. Beside her — and trying not to stare — is Daliza.
        |It takes a few moments to do so, but you quickly spot the deep red bob of Daliza's hair as she does a jump before dropping down into a push-up.
    ] Nearly all of your guards are present too, exercising in a group or splitting off into pairs to spar.
    
    [pc.mf
        |"Daddy!
        |"Mommy!
    ] Can I join them?" [freja.name] dashes over, leaping up into your arms. When you hoist her over your head she bursts into giggling, wings flapping as you fake-fly her over to the exercising soldiers. "Eeee!"
    
    Your arrival heralds a momentary break in the elves' exercising, [wayfort.hasMaids
        |and a few of your maids — those that weren't exercising or sparring with them — dive in with fresh drinks and a chance to swoon over luscious, sweaty bodies.
        |and they quickly pass around drinks.
    ] Daliza smiles at you both and sketches a deep, professional bow. "Lady Wayfarer, [pc.mf
        |Baron
        |Baroness
    ]." [freja.name] giggles at her title and does her best, princess-y curtsy. 
    
    [ashe.saved
        |It looks like Ashe has been teaching your daughter etiquette. [ashe.around
            |The wordless query is answered by the sensation of pride from her place at your belt, and you give the hilt an idle rub.
            |Who knew she'd been receiving lessons in etiquette?
        ]
    ] "I want to join in! Can I?"
    
    Daliza looks to you, brow raised, and you shrug. "Sure. But if they tell you something's dangerous and that you should stop, then stop." 
    
    "Yay! Does that mean I getta sword?" [freja.name] continues, eyes wide and tail lashing around excitedly.
    
    [ashe.around
        |Ashe, in a moment of rare cognisance, hums with warmth on your belt. Well... if the dragoness has taken an interest in your daughter's upbringing, who are you to discourage an ancient, trained warrior woman? "How about a big wooden mace like Ashe?"
        
        "Yessss..." [freja.name] trails off into a happy hiss that visibly melts the bailiff's already dragon-soft heart.
        |"A wooden one, yes. Your mother will actually roast me if I let you get hurt with a sharp blade."
        
        "Mmmmm..." Your daughter doesn't appear entirely convinced, at least until Daliza continues.
        
        "Plus, I'm sure you wouldn't want to accidentally cut me, either."
        
        Your daughter looks down at her feet, hugging her tail a moment later. "N-no..."
    ] You give [freja.name]'s head a fond rub, teasing her ears until she's hissing and wiggling. "So... what do I do?" She asks, bouncing on her heels when she's granted a weapon.
    
    "Well, until your mother returns, we'll drill you on how to stand, and swing in a way that won't hurt you. Nothing complicated, but we all need to do the basics — and stay refreshed on them." 
    
    You have the chance to sit back and watch your daughter play, relaxing a chair brought out for you by [wayfort.hasMaids
        |one of the maids
        |[wayfort.hasJaelyn
            |Jael
            |one of Daliza's soldiers
        ]
    ]. You could probably join in... but frankly you get more than enough exercising while you're adventuring. There is little surprise that [freja.name] takes to the task with glee, although she trips over her own limbs as much as she does one of Daliza's guards. 
    
    By the time your little daughter has exhausted herself, Aileh returns. She wings down towards the courtyard in a lazy, circular glide. When she touches down, she first splays herself out across your body and lets you hold her up by hands on the bum. Her lips trace kisses along your neck, before eventually she rests her head on your shoulder. "Having a nice time?"
    
    "Mhm..." Your brain takes a few moments to re-engage itself, but once it does, [freja.name] charges over, leaping into your arms to share in a big family hug.
    
    Aileh smatters the dragonling's brow with kisses, before wrinkling her nose. "Okay, it's bath time for you."
    
    "An' you!" [freja.name] beams, wiggling in your arms. 
    
    She isn't wrong, after Aileh's been flying around for who-knows-how-long. Her hair is looking as poofy as her daughter's now, too. "Deal. Give [pc.mf
        |your daddy
        |mommy-two
    ] some kisses, we'll go get washed up and let [pc.mf
        |him
        |her
    ] go back to being a big hero."
    
    "Muahmuahmuah!" [freja.name] gives you a big sloppy kiss before giggling and sprinting away into the tower. Aileh winks and wiggles her bum in your hands, giving you a much more salacious, tongue-entwining kiss. 
    
    "Muahmuahmuah indeed..." Aileh teases, following in her daughter's wake and waving at the soldiers as she passes.'

rows.original:
Aileh looks up from the bath which she's busy cleaning, a faint smile on her face. While up in the annex, [freja.name] is curled up with a book she's silently mouthing the words for to herself. Your draconic girlfriend follows your gaze, grinning at the sight of an enraptured child. "Those books you got her have really done the trick, she's just devouring them." 

    "That..." You trail off.
    
    That you got? You frown and look around, spotting a singular thick, black scale on the sill of Aileh's open window. When you lean out, you can see a faint trail leading towards the Wayfort's[wayfort.statueDrEDL| draconic| elven| demonic| lupine] statue. Huh.
    
    "Something wrong?" Aileh wipes her hands clean and slinks over to run her hands along your back. 
    
    "No, nothing." 
    
    It seems the gods are trying to win your daughter over... netting your child, and the grandchild of Kasyrra in one swoop is probably quite a boon.
rows.translation:
艾莉从正在清洗的浴缸中抬起头，脸上带着一丝淡淡的微笑。当时她正在附属建筑里[freja.name]蜷缩着，手里拿着一本书，默默地跟着书中的文字念着。你的那位龙族女友顺着你的视线看去，看到这个全神贯注的孩子，不禁笑了起来：“你给她的那些书确实很有效，她简直爱不释手部。”

    “那……”你支支吾吾地回应道。
    
    “是你给她的吗？”你皱起眉头，环顾四周，然后在艾莉赫打开的窗户窗台上发现了一片厚厚的黑色鳞片。当你探出头去时，看到了一条通往荒废驿堡家的模糊痕迹。[wayfort.statueDrEDL| 严厉的、苛刻的| 精灵| 恶魔般的| 狼人]雕像。嗯……
    
    “怎么了？”艾莱擦了擦手，走过来轻轻抚摸着你的后背。
    
    “没什么，没什么。”
    
    看来众神是在试图赢得你女儿的青睐……一下子就得到了你的孩子，还有卡希拉的孙子，这无疑是一件好事。

rows.original: [freja.name] giggles as you enter, hunched over a table. She looks up and gives you a happy wave, while Aileh's laid back in bed enjoying some time to doze while your daughter plays. "Hi [pc.mf |daddy |mommy ]! Look, look what I got!" Aileh snaps up into wakefulness at [freja.name]'s shout, blinking blearily at you. "Some kitsune boy stopped by with a basket of goodies for [freja.name]." "Mhm!" She bounces out of her chair, takes your hand, and guides you over. "There were, uh..." She pauses and pulls out a neatly-handwritten card. "Mochi. They were super tasty! This pretty straw fox!" [freja.name] holds up a fox made of straw, sat like an attentive puppy and wearing a little red ribbon around its neck like a scarf. "And a bunch of straw sticks and string to try and make my own." Your daughter's nose scrunches up, and she points at her handwork. "Uuuh, it's a fishy?" The blob is at least almost a fish, and you give your daughter a proud hug and play with her hair a little. "There was tea for mom and you too! I wanted some but she said it would keep me up all night." Aileh winks at you, propping herself up on the bed on her elbows. "Want to try and help make straw things with her? I tried, but..." [freja.name] stage-whispers, hand to the side of her mouth. "Mommy's not very good at making foxes." "...It was meant to be a dragon," Aileh pouts.
rows.translation: [freja.name]咯咯笑着；你走进来时，她正伏在桌边忙活。她抬头开心地朝你挥手，而艾莱赫正躺在床上，趁女儿玩耍时打个盹儿。“嗨，[pc.mf |爸爸 |妈妈 ]！快看，快看我拿到了什么！” 听见[freja.name]的喊声，艾莱赫猛然惊醒，睡眼惺忪地朝你眨了眨眼。“有个狐族男孩来过，给[freja.name]送了一篮好东西。” “嗯哼！”她从椅子上蹦下来，牵着你的手把你领过去。“里面有，呃……”她停下来，拿出一张字迹工整的卡片。“麻薯。特别好吃！还有这只漂亮的稻草狐狸！”[freja.name]举起一只稻草扎成的狐狸；它像只专心听话的小狗般端坐着，颈间还围着一条小红丝带，仿佛围巾。“还有好多稻草棍和细绳，可以让我自己试着做。” 你女儿皱起鼻子，指向自己的手工作品。“呃——这是条小鱼？”那团东西至少差不多像条鱼；你骄傲地抱了抱女儿，又轻轻揉了揉她的头发。“还有给妈妈和你的茶！我也想喝，可妈妈说喝了会让我整晚睡不着。” 艾莱赫朝你眨眨眼，以双肘撑着身体从床上坐起。“想陪她一起做点稻草玩意儿吗？我试过，可是……” [freja.name]用手挡在嘴边，故意低声说道：“妈妈不太会做狐狸。” “……我做的明明是条龙。”艾莱赫撅起嘴。

rows.original: You enter Aileh's chamber to the usual lovely greeting of "[pc.MommyDaddy]!" and "dear heart," but it seems like it's quiet time for the moment. Aileh, freshly bathed, is brushing her long, lustrous curtain of red hair, and [freja.name] is cuddled up on the bed with a book and her stuffed warg doll. For a few moments, you simply sit quietly with Aileh and watch your daughter page through her book, and enjoy the restful feeling of being at peace with your little family. It's calming, almost suffuses the whole room with a sort of golden glow... Then comes a gentle rap at the windowsill and you realize that the glow is coming from outside the tower. [freja.name] is the first to look up and gasp at the woman floating in the air there. "Hello! Mommy, [pc.MommyDaddy], look! It's a lady!" It is a lady, one you already know: a certain[annika.kissed | very smoochable ] Lumian seneschal. The blue-skinned valkyrie flashes a smile and nod at her, then at you and Aileh, before turning back to [freja.name]. "Hello there. Am I speaking to Miss [freja.name] Wayfarer?" Your daughter closes the book, leaps out of bed, curtseys beautifully, and strikes a proud pose. "Yes, ma'am! That's me! Can...um, may I know what your name is?" "I'm Annika, but you can call me Anni if you like. It's a pleasure to meet you." Oh, of course [freja.name] gets Anni privileges as soon as they meet. You had to work for those. Grinning, you stage-whisper to your daughter: "It's okay, she[annika.numKids 1 |... she's like your aunt | knows me ]. Ask her if she wants to sit down." "Oh! Okay." She swivels back to Anni. "It's nice to meet you too, [annika.numKids 1 |Aunt |Miss ] Anni! Would you like to sit down?" "Thank you very much. I won't take much of your time." She slides one leg over the windowsill, then the other "I like your wings," [freja.name] says hesitantly. "[pc.swornGod lumia |They remind me of Mommy's. Are you a balkry, too? |They're kind of like mine, but magic? ]" [pc.swornGod lumia |Aileh smiles. "Valkyrie, dear." ] "That's very sweet of you to say. Yes, [pc.swornGod lumia |I am a valkyrie, just like your mama. All of our sisters get them as a gift from our goddess, Lumia, so we can be a little bit more like dragons — like you! |they are magic, a gift from my goddess, Lumia. All of her valkyries get them so we can be a little more like dragons like you! ]" "Oooooh." Proudly, [freja.name] flaps her wings and grins. "[pc.swornGod lumia |Valkyries |Balkrys ] are pretty cool." [pc.swornGod lumia | |Aileh corrects her gently: "Valkyries, sweetie." ] "And since you don't need wings like [pc.swornGod lumia |ours |these ], Lumia thought that you could have some other presents instead. Here you go: this one to open first, and this one second." A wordless draconic squeal fills the chamber as [freja.name] excitedly unwraps the first gift to reveal a large, wonderfully plush pillow — embroidered with the winged-sun icon of Lumia, of course. "Yaaaay! Thank you, [annika.numKids 1 |Aunt |Miss ] Anni! We can rest on this when it's reading time!" She hugs it very tightly, finding out just how soft and comfy it is (by the looks of things, it is extremely soft and comfy), before reverently tucking it under her stuffed warg. "Perfect! I'm glad you like it, sweetie. Everyone needs more comfy-comf in their lives." "And..." This time, [freja.name] opens the bag to find it stuffed full of sword-shaped candies. "Are these...?" "I'm told you're a brave princess and a dragon and a warrior, all at once," Annika chuckles. "All of those kinds of people need swords, right?" "Yessss! Are they tasty?" "Well, if your [pc.mf |parent |mama ]s say it's okay, maybe you could find out yourself!" Ah, the classic trap. Ruefully, you and Aileh nod in unison. "Only a few for now, okay?" Even before you've finished speaking, [freja.name] downs one whole. "Mmmm! [pc.MommyDaddy], Mommy, these are so good! Do you want some of the valkyrie candy?" Aileh smiles. "They're yours to have or give away, but if you want..." For many minutes after that, your daughter bounces around the room, dueling a laughing Annika with candy swords and devouring the sweets when they've outlived their usefulness. Lumia's seneschal has plenty experience handling kids; thanks to all the battles she puts [freja.name] through and the relatively small number of sweets you let her eat, your little dragon's seemingly inexhaustible energy slowly runs down. Eventually, she starts to look genuinely tuckered out. And good thing, too; [dayNight |it's about time for a nap anyway |she really ought to be getting to sleep soon anyway ]. "[freja.name]? Do you think you're ready for a little rest?" "Noooo..." There's no mistaking those droopy eyelids, though. "Really?" "Mhm..." Anni grins. "It's okay, sweetie. I'm getting a little bit tired, too! [annika.numKids 1 |Maybe you can visit me later, if you like. There's some[annika.numKids 2 | people |body ] I'd like you to meet. Or I can come see you again here! |I can visit you again later, if you like. ]" "Okay," she says drowsily. "Mmm! Wait!" She summons up a last burst of energy and a little flap-flap from her wings and leaps up into the valkyrie's arms. "Thank you for the gifts and for playing with me today. Could you say thank you to Lumia for me, too?" "I will," the older woman promises. She brings [freja.name] over to the bed. "Mmm, you're nice and warm. A hug from you is an absolute treasure. But there's no better place for a sweet warm cuddly lady than her brand new pillow..." Once your daughter's safely ensconced on her pillow, already dozing gently, Annika straightens up, turns toward you and Aileh, and offers a smiling head-nod. "Thank you for letting me stop by; [freja.name] is a wonderful little girl. By the way, [dayNight |nap |bed ]time —" and here she gestures toward your sleeping daughter "— is your present. Have a good rest of your [dayNight |day |evening ]."
rows.translation: 你走进艾莱赫的寝居，迎面照例是那声可爱的问候：“[pc.MommyDaddy]！”和“亲爱的，”不过眼下似乎是安静的时间。刚洗过澡的艾莱赫正在梳理她那头长长的、亮丽的红发，[freja.name]则蜷在床上，手里拿着一本书，身边是她那只座狼玩偶。有那么一会儿，你只是安静地坐在艾莱赫身边，看着女儿一页页翻书，享受着与这个小家在一起的安宁。这很抚慰人心，几乎让整个房间都蒙上了一层金色的光晕…… 然后窗台上传来轻轻的叩击声，你这才意识到，那光晕是从塔外面来的。 [freja.name]是第一个抬头看到那个悬浮在窗外的女人并惊呼出声的。“你好！妈妈，[pc.MommyDaddy]，快看！是一位女士！” 确实是一位女士，而且你已经认识她：某位[annika.kissed | 非常值得亲一口的 ]卢米娅总管。这位蓝皮肤的女武神朝她笑了笑、点了点头，又朝你和艾莱赫点了点头，然后转回[freja.name]。“你好。我是在和[freja.name]·旅人小姐说话吗？” 你的女儿合上书，从床上跳下来，优雅地行了个屈膝礼，摆出一个骄傲的姿势。“是的，夫人！就是我！我能……嗯，可以知道您的名字吗？” “我叫安妮卡，不过你愿意的话可以叫我安妮。很高兴认识你。” 哦，当然，[freja.name]一见面就得到了安妮的专属待遇。你当初可是费了功夫才换来的。你咧嘴一笑，对女儿装模作样地耳语道：“没关系，她[annika.numKids 1 |……她就像你的阿姨 | 认识我 ]。问问她想不想坐下。” “哦！好的。”她转回安妮那边。“我也很高兴认识你，[annika.numKids 1 |阿姨 |小姐 ]安妮！你想坐下吗？” “非常感谢。我不会占用你们太多时间。”她先把一条腿跨过窗台，然后是另一条 “我喜欢你的翅膀，”[freja.name]迟疑地说道。“[pc.swornGod lumia |它们让我想起妈妈的。你也是巴尔克莉吗？ |它们有点像我的，不过是魔法的？ ]” [pc.swornGod lumia |艾莱赫微笑着说：“是女武神，亲爱的。” ] “你这么说真贴心。没错，[pc.swornGod lumia |我是女武神，就像你妈妈一样。我们所有的姐妹都从我们的女神卢米娅那里得到它们作为礼物，这样我们就能更像龙一点——就像你！ |它们是魔法，是我的女神卢米娅赐予的礼物。她所有的女武神都有，这样我们就能更像龙一点，像你一样！ ]” “哦哦哦哦。”[freja.name]骄傲地扑扇着翅膀，咧嘴一笑。“[pc.swornGod lumia |女武神们 |巴尔克莉们 ]挺酷的。” [pc.swornGod lumia | |艾莱赫温柔地纠正她：“是女武神们，小宝贝。” ] “既然你不需要像[pc.swornGod lumia |我们 |这些 ]那样的翅膀，卢米娅觉得你可以收下别的礼物。给你：这个先拆，这个第二个拆。” 一声无声的龙鸣般的尖叫充满了整个房间，[freja.name]兴奋地拆开第一件礼物，里面是一只又大又柔软的绒毛枕头——上面当然绣着卢米娅那只带翼太阳的徽记。“耶——！谢谢你，[annika.numKids 1 |阿姨 |小姐 ]安妮！读书时间我们可以靠在这个上面休息！”她把它抱得紧紧的，发现它居然这么柔软舒服（看样子，它确实极其柔软舒服），然后才虔诚地把它塞到自己的座狼玩偶底下。 “太好了！你喜欢它我就高兴了，小宝贝。每个人的生活里都需要多一点软乎乎的舒服。” “还有……”这一次，[freja.name]打开袋子，发现里面塞满了剑形的糖果。“这些是……？” “我听说你是一位勇敢的公主又是一条龙又是一名战士，三者兼备，”安妮卡轻笑道。“这几种人都需要剑，对吧？” “是——的！它们好吃吗？” “嗯，要是你的[pc.mf |家长 |妈妈 ]们说可以，也许你可以自己试试看！” 啊，经典的圈套。你和艾莱赫无奈地一齐点头。“现在只能吃几个，好吗？” 你话还没说完，[freja.name]就已经吞下了一整颗。“嗯嗯！[pc.MommyDaddy]，妈妈，这些太好吃了！你想来点女武神糖果吗？” 艾莱赫笑了。“这些是给你自己吃或者送人的，不过你要是想……” 在那之后的许多分钟里，你的女儿在房间里蹦来跳去，用糖果剑和笑个不停的安妮卡对打，等糖果没用了就吃掉。卢米娅的总管对付孩子很有经验；多亏了她让[freja.name]经历的一场场战斗，再加上你允许她吃的糖数量不多，你家小龙那看似无穷无尽的精力慢慢耗尽了。最后，她看起来是真的累坏了。这也是好事；[dayNight |反正也该小睡一会儿了 |她确实也该早点去睡了 ]。 “[freja.name]？你觉得你准备好休息一会儿了吗？” “不要嘛……”不过那下垂的眼皮是怎么也藏不住的。 “真的吗？” “嗯……” 安妮咧嘴一笑。“没关系的，小宝贝。我也有点累了！[annika.numKids 1 |如果你愿意，以后可以来我这儿看我。有一些[annika.numKids 2 | 人 |身体 ]我想让你见见。或者我也可以再来这里看你！ |如果你愿意，我以后可以再来看你。 ]” “好吧，”她昏昏欲睡地说。“嗯！等等！”她鼓起最后一点力气，翅膀小小地扑扇了两下，一跃跳进女武神的怀里。“谢谢你送的礼物，还有今天陪我玩。你能也替我谢谢卢米娅吗？” “我会的，”那位年长的女士答应道。她把[freja.name]抱到床边。“嗯，你又暖又舒服。你的拥抱是绝对的珍宝。不过，对一位甜美又温暖的抱抱小姐来说，再没有比她的新枕头更好的地方了……” 等你的女儿安安稳稳地窝在枕头上、已经轻轻打起瞌睡，安妮卡直起身，转向你和艾莱赫，微笑着点头致意。“谢谢你让我过来坐坐；[freja.name]是个很棒的小女孩。顺便说一下，[dayNight |午睡 |就寝 ]时间——”她朝你睡着的女儿比了个手势“——就是你的礼物。祝你剩下的[dayNight |白天 |晚上 ]过得愉快。”
rows.raw: ' You enter Aileh's chamber to the usual lovely greeting of "[pc.MommyDaddy]!" and "dear heart," but it seems like it's quiet time for the moment. Aileh, freshly bathed, is brushing her long, lustrous curtain of red hair, and [freja.name] is cuddled up on the bed with a book and her stuffed warg doll. For a few moments, you simply sit quietly with Aileh and watch your daughter page through her book, and enjoy the restful feeling of being at peace with your little family. It's calming, almost suffuses the whole room with a sort of golden glow... Then comes a gentle rap at the windowsill and you realize that the glow is coming from outside the tower. [freja.name] is the first to look up and gasp at the woman floating in the air there. "Hello! Mommy, [pc.MommyDaddy], look! It's a lady!" It is a lady, one you already know: a certain[annika.kissed | very smoochable ] Lumian seneschal. The blue-skinned valkyrie flashes a smile and nod at her, then at you and Aileh, before turning back to [freja.name]. "Hello there. Am I speaking to Miss [freja.name] Wayfarer?" Your daughter closes the book, leaps out of bed, curtseys beautifully, and strikes a proud pose. "Yes, ma'am! That's me! Can...um, may I know what your name is?" "I'm Annika, but you can call me Anni if you like. It's a pleasure to meet you." Oh, of course [freja.name] gets Anni privileges as soon as they meet. You had to work for those. Grinning, you stage-whisper to your daughter: "It's okay, she[annika.numKids 1 |... she's like your aunt | knows me ]. Ask her if she wants to sit down." "Oh! Okay." She swivels back to Anni. "It's nice to meet you too, [annika.numKids 1 |Aunt |Miss ] Anni! Would you like to sit down?" "Thank you very much. I won't take much of your time." She slides one leg over the windowsill, then the other "I like your wings," [freja.name] says hesitantly. "[pc.swornGod lumia |They remind me of Mommy's. Are you a balkry, too? |They're kind of like mine, but magic? ]" [pc.swornGod lumia |Aileh smiles. "Valkyrie, dear." ] "That's very sweet of you to say. Yes, [pc.swornGod lumia |I am a valkyrie, just like your mama. All of our sisters get them as a gift from our goddess, Lumia, so we can be a little bit more like dragons — like you! |they are magic, a gift from my goddess, Lumia. All of her valkyries get them so we can be a little more like dragons like you! ]" "Oooooh." Proudly, [freja.name] flaps her wings and grins. "[pc.swornGod lumia |Valkyries |Balkrys ] are pretty cool." [pc.swornGod lumia | |Aileh corrects her gently: "Valkyries, sweetie." ] "And since you don't need wings like [pc.swornGod lumia |ours |these ], Lumia thought that you could have some other presents instead. Here you go: this one to open first, and this one second." A wordless draconic squeal fills the chamber as [freja.name] excitedly unwraps the first gift to reveal a large, wonderfully plush pillow — embroidered with the winged-sun icon of Lumia, of course. "Yaaaay! Thank you, [annika.numKids 1 |Aunt |Miss ] Anni! We can rest on this when it's reading time!" She hugs it very tightly, finding out just how soft and comfy it is (by the looks of things, it is extremely soft and comfy), before reverently tucking it under her stuffed warg. "Perfect! I'm glad you like it, sweetie. Everyone needs more comfy-comf in their lives." "And..." This time, [freja.name] opens the bag to find it stuffed full of sword-shaped candies. "Are these...?" "I'm told you're a brave princess and a dragon and a warrior, all at once," Annika chuckles. "All of those kinds of people need swords, right?" "Yessss! Are they tasty?" "Well, if your [pc.mf |parent |mama ]s say it's okay, maybe you could find out yourself!" Ah, the classic trap. Ruefully, you and Aileh nod in unison. "Only a few for now, okay?" Even before you've finished speaking, [freja.name] downs one whole. "Mmmm! [pc.MommyDaddy], Mommy, these are so good! Do you want some of the valkyrie candy?" Aileh smiles. "They're yours to have or give away, but if you want..." For many minutes after that, your daughter bounces around the room, dueling a laughing Annika with candy swords and devouring the sweets when they've outlived their usefulness. Lumia's seneschal has plenty experience handling kids; thanks to all the battles she puts [freja.name] through and the relatively small number of sweets you let her eat, your little dragon's seemingly inexhaustible energy slowly runs down. Eventually, she starts to look genuinely tuckered out. And good thing, too; [dayNight |it's about time for a nap anyway |she really ought to be getting to sleep soon anyway ]. "[freja.name]? Do you think you're ready for a little rest?" "Noooo..." There's no mistaking those droopy eyelids, though. "Really?" "Mhm..." Anni grins. "It's okay, sweetie. I'm getting a little bit tired, too! [annika.numKids 1 |Maybe you can visit me later, if you like. There's some[annika.numKids 2 | people |body ] I'd like you to meet. Or I can come see you again here! |I can visit you again later, if you like. ]" "Okay," she says drowsily. "Mmm! Wait!" She summons up a last burst of energy and a little flap-flap from her wings and leaps up into the valkyrie's arms. "Thank you for the gifts and for playing with me today. Could you say thank you to Lumia for me, too?" "I will," the older woman promises. She brings [freja.name] over to the bed. "Mmm, you're nice and warm. A hug from you is an absolute treasure. But there's no better place for a sweet warm cuddly lady than her brand new pillow..." Once your daughter's safely ensconced on her pillow, already dozing gently, Annika straightens up, turns toward you and Aileh, and offers a smiling head-nod. "Thank you for letting me stop by; [freja.name] is a wonderful little girl. By the way, [dayNight |nap |bed ]time —" and here she gestures toward your sleeping daughter "— is your present. Have a good rest of your [dayNight |day |evening ]."'

rows.original: For once, [party.comp cait |Cait follows on your heels instead of making a beeline for your beetender. There's a wide grin on her face, and a box in her arms. "Where'd you get that?" You ask, brow slowly rising. "And what is it?" |Cait is leant on the tower wall, where she's apparently been waiting for you to turn up. There's a wide grin on her face, and a box in her arms. "Hey Cait... what's up? And what's in the box?" ] The pretty pink kitty looks down at the box in her arms, smiling sweetly. "Don't know, but it has a familiar smell— not like that!" Cait scolds when your nose immediately scrunches up. "You'll just have to see, it arrived for me back in town, but it also has [freja.name]'s name on it." She tilts the box towards you to show its label off, where your daughter has been inscribed in flowing, artful penmanship. "Didn't want to hand it over without you around though, so... lead on?" She flutters her eyebrows innocently, tail wiggling with barely-restrained joy. When you enter Aileh and [freja.name]'s room, the duo are surprisingly quiet; [freja.name] is perched in your draconic girlfriend's lap, nibbling a sandwich. Aileh herself is chewing on a slice of jerky with one hand, while the other pumps a solid looking weight. Both girls give you a surprised, muffled 'mfnff?' "Hey girls." [freja.name] hurriedly chows down on the rest of her sandwich, audibly 'nyam nyam nyam'ing. "Hi [pc.mf |daddy |mommy! ]" She leap-flaps up into your arms, nuzzling into your neck and hugging you tightly. "I love you!" "Love you too." You spin her and put her down, and then she notices Cait standing with her box. "Hello kitty!" [freja.name] chimes brightly, before giving her an etiquette-worthy curtsy. Cait's sunny smile could turn an iceberg into a puddle, and she lowers the crate down and opens her arms for a hug. "Hello dragon, want a hug?" "Yess!" [freja.name] trails off into a happy hiss, burying herself in the catgirl's chest and hugging until they're both satisfied. "Uh..." Aileh looks between the two of you, brow raised. "What brings you up here?" Cait hops to her feet, letting your daughter go in the same motion. "Right! Good question, shall we find out?" Her vague response is enough to wrangle Aileh's interest, and she saunters over... which makes for a sight that you'd swear you can hear Cait's womanhood prepare for entry. Luckily for Aileh, she doesn't notice that particular fact. Instead your girlfriend sprawls herself across your shoulders and gives you a smooch on the cheek. The priestess smiles, and, while [freja.name] is looking, lifts the lid off the box, making sure it's facing the dragonling. You understand now what Cait meant by a recognizable smell; it's a box full of paints, brushes, a washable painting board, a few blackboards, and a box of brightly-colored sticks of chalk. [freja.name]'s high-pitched squeal of childlike glee is enough to make you wince, and the two of you have to hold your daughter back before she can just dive right in and make an immediate mess... before Aileh plucks up the blackboards and chalks for her first, ensuring that she'll start with the objectively less-messy toys first. Cait is similarly the picture of glee, receiving a smattering of thankyou kisses and another big hug from [freja.name] before she bolts off to the table where she can draw with her mother. You give your pretty pink kitty a thankful smile, helping her tuck the rest of the art goodies away for now. "Who did you say sent this?" "Don't know... but I recognize these as all the kinds of art supplies we had in the temple when I was a wee kitten." She gestures at the ground, very low. "...It brings back some wonderful memories. If I ever find out, I'll let you know." "Thanks."
rows.translation: 难得有一次，[party.comp cait |凯特跟在你脚后，而不是直奔你的甜菜侍者。她脸上挂着大大的笑容，怀里抱着一个盒子。“你从哪儿弄来的？”你问道，眉头慢慢挑了起来。“里面是什么？” |凯特倚在塔墙上，看样子一直在等你出现。她脸上挂着大大的笑容，怀里抱着一个盒子。“嘿，凯特……最近怎么样？那个盒子里是什么？” ] 那只漂亮的粉色小猫低头看着怀里的盒子，甜甜地笑着。“不知道，但它有种熟悉的气味——不是那种！”你鼻子立刻皱起来时，凯特训斥道。“你只能自己看了，它是我回城时送到我手上的，不过上面还写着[freja.name]的名字。”她把盒子侧过来给你看标签，你女儿的名字用流畅而精美的笔迹写在上面。 “不过我不想在没你在场的时候把它交出去，所以……你先请？”她无辜地眨了眨眼睛，尾巴几乎按捺不住地欢快摆动着。 当你走进艾莱赫和[freja.name]的房间时，这两个人出奇地安静；[freja.name]正窝在你那位龙族女友的腿上，小口啃着三明治。艾莱赫自己正用一只手嚼着一块肉干，另一只手举着一个看起来很沉的铁块上下锻炼。两个女孩都用惊讶而含混的声音“唔唔？”了一声。 “嘿，姑娘们。” [freja.name]匆匆把剩下的三明治吃完，嘴里发出清晰可闻的“咩姆咩姆咩姆”声。“嗨，[pc.mf |爸爸 |妈妈！ ]”她一跃扑腾进你怀里，把脸埋进你的脖颈，紧紧抱着你。“我爱你！” “我也爱你。”你把她转了一圈放下，这时她注意到凯特抱着盒子站在那里。 “你好呀，小猫咪！”[freja.name]欢快地喊道，随后朝她行了一个合乎礼仪的屈膝礼。 凯特那阳光般的笑容足以把冰山化成水洼，她放下箱子，张开双臂准备拥抱。“你好呀，小龙，想要抱抱吗？” “想！”[freja.name]拖出一声欢快的嘶鸣，把自己埋进猫娘的胸口，一直抱到两人都满足为止。 “呃……”艾莱赫看看你们俩，眉头一挑。“你怎么会上来这儿？” 凯特一跃起身，同一动作里放开了你的女儿。“对！问得好，我们要不要去看看？” 她那含糊的回答足以勾起艾莱赫的兴趣，于是她慢悠悠地走了过来……那景象让你发誓自己听得见凯特的女性部位正在为进入做准备。对艾莱赫来说幸运的是，她没注意到这个细节。你的女友反而一把趴到你的肩膀上，在你脸颊上亲了一口。 女祭司微笑着，趁[freja.name]正看着的时候，把盒盖掀了起来，确保它朝向那条小龙。你现在明白凯特说的熟悉气味是什么意思了；那是个装满颜料、画笔、一块可水洗的画板、几块黑板，还有一盒颜色鲜艳的粉笔的盒子。 [freja.name]那声孩童般欢乐的高音尖叫足以让你皱眉，你们俩不得不把女儿拉住，免得她直接一头扎进去，弄出个立刻就见效的烂摊子……直到艾莱赫先把黑板和粉笔拿给她，确保她会先从客观上不那么容易弄脏东西的玩具开始。 凯特也同样一脸欢喜，从[freja.name]那里收到一阵道谢的吻和又一个紧紧的拥抱，然后她就跑去可以和母亲一起画画的桌前。你朝你那漂亮的粉色小猫咪露出一个感激的微笑，帮她把剩下的美术用品先收起来。“你说这是谁送来的？” “不知道……但我认得出来，这些全是我们还在神庙里、我还是只小猫的时候用的那种美术用品。”她朝地面比了比，很低的姿势。“……它让我想起了一些美好的回忆。要是我查出来是谁，我会告诉你的。” “谢谢。”

You spin her and put her down, and then she notices Cait standing with her box. "Hello kitty!" [freja.name] chimes brightly, before giving her an etiquette-worthy curtsy. Cait's sunny smile could turn an iceberg into a puddle, and she lowers the crate down and opens her arms for a hug. "Hello dragon, want a hug?" "Yess!" [freja.name] trails off into a happy hiss, burying herself in the catgirl's chest and hugging until they're both satisfied. "Uh..." Aileh looks between the two of you, brow raised. "What brings you up here?" Cait hops to her feet, letting your daughter go in the same motion. "Right! Good question, shall we find out?" Her vague response is enough to wrangle Aileh's interest, and she saunters over... which makes for a sight that you'd swear you can hear Cait's womanhood prepare for entry. Luckily for Aileh, she doesn't notice that particular fact. Instead your girlfriend sprawls herself across your shoulders and gives you a smooch on the cheek. The priestess smiles, and, while [freja.name] is looking, lifts the lid off the box, making sure it's facing the dragonling. You understand now what Cait meant by a recognizable smell; it's a box full of paints, brushes, a washable painting board, a few blackboards, and a box of brightly-colored sticks of chalk. [freja.name]'s high-pitched squeal of childlike glee is enough to make you wince, and the two of you have to hold your daughter back before she can just dive right in and make an immediate mess... before Aileh plucks up the blackboards and chalks for her first, ensuring that she'll start with the objectively less-messy toys first. Cait is similarly the picture of glee, receiving a smattering of thankyou kisses and another big hug from [freja.name] before she bolts off to the table where she can draw with her mother. You give your pretty pink kitty a thankful smile, helping her tuck the rest of the art goodies away for now. "Who did you say sent this?" "Don't know... but I recognize these as all the kinds of art supplies we had in the temple when I was a wee kitten." She gestures at the ground, very low. "...It brings back some wonderful memories. If I ever find out, I'll let you know." "Thanks."'

        |steely
        |already-warm
        |sof lovely
    ] heart.

        "[pc.dcb
            |Yup.

            |Yipyuppers!

rows.original:
[dayNight
            |You scoop your daughter up into your arms, earning a delighted little hiss, and a long wiggly tail that wraps itself comfortably around your hips. "Let's go get some fresh air."
            
            For a moment it looks as though [freja.name] might take off and get airborne on her own steam, instead she simply clambers up onto your shoulder and hugs your [pc.hasHorns
                |horns
                |head
            ]. "Yesss..."
            
            Playing around proves to be a surprisingly difficult game of chase, followed by throwing your daughter up into the air so that she can glide back down again in a wiggly, delighted circle. It's not until Aileh flies down to join you, and Rumie the bee-tender arrives with food, that you can catch your breath. Aileh leans into you and kisses you, sharing the warmth from her body and nibbling one of your [pc.ears]. "She's going to be out like a light all night, I appreciate it, dear heart."
            |Your daughter giggles softly, scooped up into your arms like a princess. "What're we doing [pc.mf
                |daddy
                |mommy
            ]?"
            
            "Let's go see some stars, and I bet I have a cup of hot milk I can get you too."
            
            Her gasp of delight is sugar right to the veins, and she's happily cradled out onto the courtyard. Aileh is the one to go and fetch a drink for her daughter, and when she settles down with your precious bean of a daughter sandwiched between you. Both women are delightfully warm, and their tails coil together before wrapping around you. [freja.name] giggles and wiggles, taking a sip from a steamy cup of warm milk. You glance sidelong at your girlfriend and she winks at you; it's pretty obvious where that milk came from, perhaps you should've asked for a mug too.
            
            Or an excuse to score a drink from the tap.
            
            The stars in the sky are beautiful, but you find yourself most enraptured by the way they're reflected in your daughter's bright, shimmering, skyward gaze. Her mouth hangs open a little, observant mind making a decent attempt at memorizing the brightest and most colorful. Aileh smiles and leans over her, giving you a slow kiss before returning to stargazing herself. 
            
            [freja.name] spends an astounding amount of time watching with you, eyes bright, attentive, and inquisitive, before sleepiness takes full hold. Her fanged maw opens with a wide yawn, and she snuggles up into your side, wrapping her arms around you... which just about turns Aileh into a puddle, judging by the look on her face. "Let's get our little ember up to bed, shall we?" 
        ]
rows.translation:
[dayNight
            |你一把将女儿抱进怀里，惹得她欢喜地轻嘶一声，细长灵活的尾巴也舒舒服服地缠上你的腰胯。“我们出去呼吸点新鲜空气吧。”
            
            有那么一瞬间，[freja.name]看起来都快凭自己的本事飞起来了，可她只是爬到你的肩膀上，抱住你的[pc.hasHorns
                |角
                |脑袋
            ]。“好耶……”
            
            玩耍变成了一场难度出乎意料的追逐游戏，接着你又把女儿抛向空中，让她欢快地扭着身子盘旋滑落。直到艾莱赫飞下来加入你们，养蜂人露米也带着食物赶来，你才终于有机会喘口气。艾莱赫倚进你怀里吻了吻你，把身上的暖意传给你，又轻咬了一下你的[pc.ears]。“她今晚肯定会一觉睡到天亮。谢谢你，心肝。”
            |你的女儿轻声咯咯笑着，像个小公主般被你抱进怀里。“我们要做什么呀，[pc.mf
                |爸爸
                |妈妈
            ]？”
            
            “我们去看星星吧。我敢说，我还能给你弄一杯热牛奶来。”
            
            她欣喜的抽气声甜得直沁心脾，随后便心满意足地被你抱到庭院里。去给女儿拿饮料的是艾莱赫；她回来坐下时，你们珍宝般的女儿正夹在你俩中间。母女俩的身体都暖得令人愉悦，她们的尾巴先缠在一起，继而一同绕住你。[freja.name]咯咯笑着扭来扭去，小口啜饮杯中冒着热气的温牛奶。你侧眼看向女友，她冲你眨了眨眼；这牛奶来自哪里显而易见，或许你也该要上一杯。
            
            或者找个借口，直接从源头喝上一口。
            
            夜空中的群星美不胜收，可真正令你着迷的，是它们映在女儿那双明亮闪烁、仰望天空的眼眸中的模样。她的小嘴微微张着，敏锐的头脑努力记住其中最明亮、最多彩的星星。艾莱赫微笑着俯身越过她，缓缓吻了你一下，而后自己也重新仰头观星。
            
            [freja.name]陪你看了久得惊人，眼神明亮、专注而充满好奇，直到睡意彻底占据上风。她张开长有尖牙的小嘴，打了个大大的哈欠，又依偎到你身旁，伸出双臂抱住你……从艾莱赫脸上的神情判断，这一幕简直要把她融化成一摊水。“我们把小火苗送上床睡觉，好吗？”
        ]

rows.original:
You prepare yourself for being covered in paint; Aileh gives you a look that tells the tale of much cleaning, and she smartly fetches a few washcloths. 
    
    Your draconic daughter dives into her Mallachian crafts box, pulling out parchments, paints, and brushes. "I'ma paint the bestest things," [freja.name] insists. "S'gonna look great!"
    
    Aileh herself settles for simply watching, already certain of artistic failings. Instead she makes you a drink while you attempt to keep up with your daughter's manic pace; you have no idea what to actually paint or draw, however, and you soon find yourself roped into coloring in the background of your daughter's drawing. 
    
    By the time you finally finish, there's pride beaming off of your daughter and she flaps and leaps into the air. She's drawn the Wayfort's statue with surprising deftness, while you have... well, you've managed to paint the ground and sky for her without ruining the dragonling's work. "What do you think mommy? [pc.mf
        |Daddy
        |Mommy
    ] helped!" [freja.name] shows off your collaborative work with a smile, and Aileh scoops her up in a proud hug the moment she puts the parchment down again.
    
    "You're already a better artist than me!" Aileh pouts teasingly, perching your daughter on her hip and booping her gently on the heart-scale. "What else do you say though?"
    
    "Ah! Thanks for me helping [pc.mf
        |daddy
        |mommy
    ]!"
    
    "My pleasure, [freja.name]." You crouch down and give her a kiss while Aileh's holding her, tickling the tips of her ears. Alas, duty calls once more.
rows.translation:
你做好了浑身沾满颜料的准备；艾莱赫看了你一眼，那眼神诉说着她经历过多少次清理工作，随后明智地取来几块毛巾。
    
    你的龙女儿一头扎进自己的马拉克手工箱，拿出羊皮纸、颜料和画笔。“我要画最最棒的东西，”[freja.name]坚持说道。“肯定会特别好看！”
    
    艾莱赫本人则满足于在旁观看，她早已确信自己没有艺术天分。你努力跟上女儿狂热的节奏时，她转而给你调了一杯饮料；可你根本不知道该画些什么，不久便被拉去替女儿的画涂背景。
    
    等你们终于完成，女儿浑身都洋溢着自豪；她拍动翅膀，纵身跃到空中。她笔下的荒废驿堡雕像娴熟得出人意料，而你则……嗯，你成功替她画好了地面和天空，又没毁掉小龙崽的作品。“妈妈，你觉得怎么样？[pc.mf
        |爸爸
        |妈妈
    ]也帮忙了！”[freja.name]笑着展示你们的合作成果；她刚把羊皮纸重新放下，艾莱赫便骄傲地将她一把抱起。
    
    “你已经比我更像个艺术家啦！”艾莱赫故意噘起嘴，把女儿架在胯边，又轻点了一下她的心口鳞片。“不过，你还该说什么？”
    
    “啊！谢谢你帮我，[pc.mf
        |爸爸
        |妈妈
    ]！”
    
    “不用谢，[freja.name]。”趁艾莱赫抱着她，你蹲下来亲了她一口，又挠挠她的耳尖。可惜，职责再度发出了召唤。

rows.original:
Before the two of you can get properly into the matter of sleep, Aileh takes your hand and guides you to [freja.name]'s cradle. "As much as I want to collapse with you, dear heart... we have to say goodnight properly." 

        The dragon's tail wraps protectively around your waist, and she gently scoops the burbling babe up into her warm embrace. The little scale potato yawns and shows off a neat selection of fangs, hands grabbing at Aileh's hair before she can dip in for a kiss on her heart-scale. "She's such a precious little thing..." Aileh trails off, eventually grinning back over at you. "Well, when she's asleep."
        
        You grin and brush the tuft of your daughter's hair, leaning in to give her a kiss as well. She stirs, a little, stubby tail wiggling. "And how long will that last?" You tease.
        
        Aileh smirks and gently returns [freja.name] to her cradle, stroking a finger across the privacy runes to protect her from any noise you might be making. "A couple of hours, so let's get our own sleep while we still can." 
        
        With her tail still wrapped around your waist, she walks you back towards bed, slipping off gear and tossing up blankets until they form something more akin to a nest than a bed itself. She falls over onto her side, cupping milky tits and gesturing you closer. "Come here, dear heart."
        
        As if you needed an invitation; you settle down, [pc.hasTail|[pc.tail] wagging|wiggling giddily for a moment] before she buries you into the sultry warmth of her cleavage. Fingers trail your scalp and rub their way down your shoulders, and her entire body tries to wrap you up while you squeeze her ass and hold the dragon close. Her heartbeat is loud in your ears, a sonorous drum that turns your brain to cotton. 
        
        She kisses your head and entwines legs with yours, waiting for your eyes to drift closed before she does the same. "Love you. Love you both."
        
        "Mmmn, you too..." You kiss the inside of her cleavage, tongue trailing out to lick and slurp until she's writhing against you... The scent of a horny dragon washes over your senses from between her milky tits, and you prepare yourself to be laid into while you're completely wrapped up.
        
        Only to be interrupted by soft, exhausted snoring, and your partner going limp. With a smirk, you crawl halfway out of her grasp and adjust yourself so that Aileh can sleep on top; she sprawls out across your [pc.chest] and snoozes into you.
rows.translation:
就在你们俩准备好好入睡的时候，艾莱赫牵住了你的手，带你走了。 [freja.name]亲爱的，我多么希望能和你一起沉沉睡去……但我们还是得好好道晚安。” 

        龙的尾巴温柔地环绕在你的腰间，她轻轻地将那个还在咿呀学语的婴儿抱进自己温暖的怀抱中。那只小小的鳞片土豆打了个哈欠，露出一口整齐的獠牙，它的手立刻抓住了艾莱的头发。在艾莱还没来得及亲吻它的心脏鳞片之前，它就已经这样做了。“它真是太可爱了……”艾莱轻声说道，最终也露出了笑容。嗯，等她睡着的时候。”
        
        你微笑着轻轻梳理女儿的头发，然后凑过去吻了她一下。她微微动了动，短小的尾巴也开始晃动起来。“那会持续多久呢？”你调皮地问道。
        
        艾莉轻笑着，温柔地回应道。 [freja.name]回到自己的“摇篮”旁，用手指轻轻触碰那些保护符文，以此阻挡你可能发出的任何噪音。“还有几个小时呢，所以我们还是趁现在好好睡一觉吧。”
        
        她的尾巴依然缠在你的腰上，她带着你走向床边，脱掉身上的装备，然后铺上毯子，把床铺弄得更像一个鸟巢，而不是普通的床铺。她侧身倒下，将那对乳白色的乳房拢在怀里，示意你靠近一些。“过来吧，亲爱的。”
        
        你仿佛根本不需要邀请似的，便坐了下来。 [pc.hasTail|[pc.tail]摇摆|兴奋地扭来扭去了一会儿]在她将你拥入她那温暖而迷人的胸膛之前，她的手指轻轻抚过你的头皮，然后顺着你的肩膀向下滑动。她的整个身体仿佛都在努力将你紧紧拥入怀中，而你则紧紧抓住她的臀部，将那条“龙”紧紧抱在怀里。她的心跳声在你耳边回响，那如同鼓声般有力的声音让你的头脑仿佛变得一片空白。 
        
        她轻吻你的头发，将自己的双腿缠绕在你的腿上，等到你的眼睛渐渐闭上时，她才跟着闭上了眼睛。“我爱你。爱你们俩。”
        
        “嗯，你也一样……”你吻着她胸前的肌肤，用舌头轻轻舔弄，直到她开始在你身上扭动、挣扎。她那乳白色的双峰散发出的诱人气息充斥着你的感官，你准备好了，准备在她完全包裹住你的那一刻与她结合……
        
        然而，一阵轻柔而疲惫的鼾声打断了这一切，你的伴侣也变得软弱无力，失去了反应。你露出一丝 smirk，从她的怀抱中爬出一半身体，调整好自己的姿势，让艾莱能够趴在你身上睡觉；她则整个人躺在了你身上[pc.chest]然后慢慢融入你的内心。

        With the sleep shaken off, Aileh's expression melts, and she gently accepts the platter with a smile that could bring an army home. "Oh sweetie, what a wonderful surprise!"
        
        [freja.name] beams, leaning in so that you can both give her cheeks a smooch before she clambers into the bed to join you both. You nestle your daughter up in your lap and wait to be served a meal, stomach already rumbling. "Miss Rumie helped me make bacon-eggies, and [wayfort.hasJaelyn

        Instead of scooping up some of said bacon and eggs herself, however, [freja.name] is mischievously licking crumbs from her lips.

rows.translation: “哎呀，你怎么这么贴心？”艾莱赫咧嘴一笑，舌头发出那种你再熟悉不过的轻柔嘶嘶声。 [freja.name]咯咯笑着，拍了拍她的小翅膀，从你的肩上滑下来，钻进你怀里要抱抱。片刻之后，你和你的女儿就被艾莱赫那对宽大得多的龙翼裹住了，围成一个温暖的茧，而她的双臂也环住了你的肩膀。 灯光暂时被遮住，你只能靠她的热度似乎越靠越近来判断艾莱赫正凑过来亲吻你。你女儿被挤到时发出一声又亮又乐的“咪！”，你也笑着收下了女友欢快的亲吻。 当艾莱赫再次退开时，她已经把[freja.name]从拥抱里捞了过去。她[flags.AILEH_FAM_HUG|总是]是怎么做到的？[freja.name]被这出其不意的抱抱魔术弄得又尖叫又喘气，一边挣扎着想脱身，一边让她那心形的头部鳞片接连挨了那位熟女龙一串响亮的“啾啾啾！”。“我确实喜欢好好抱一抱，”这头龙承认道，把[freja.name]放下来，好继续她的恶作剧。 “或者，你想来点别的？”
rows.raw: " "D'awwh, aren't you the sweetest?" Aileh grins, tongue letting out that soft, hissing purr you're oh-so-familiar with. [freja.name] giggles and flaps her little wings, sliding off of your shoulder so that she can bury into your chest for a hug. A moment later, you and your daughter are enveloped by Aileh's far larger dragon-wings, forming a tight cocoon of warmth while her arms wrap around your shoulders. With the lights temporarily out, you can only tell Aileh's dipping in for a kiss by the way her heat just seems to grow closer. There's a bright, amused 'meep!' from your daughter as she's squished, and you claim your girlfriend's gleeful kisses with a grin. When Aileh steps back again she's managed to snatch [freja.name] mid-hug. How does she[flags.AILEH_FAM_HUG| always] do that? [freja.name] squeals and gasps at the unexpected cuddle-based magic trick, trying to wriggle free as her heart-shaped head-scale receives a series of noisy 'muah muah muah!'s from the milfy dragon. "I do love a good hug," the dragon admits, letting [freja.name] down in order to return to her mischief. "Interested in something else, perhaps?" "

rows.original:
"How about a picnic?" You offer, which earns a warm smile from Aileh, and a cheer from your shoulder-mounted daughter.
    
    "I'd certainly like that. [dayNight
        |The sun is out, we can eat and have tea."
        |It's dark, and a little chilly, how about hot chocolate? One of the traders came through and delivered a bag of chocolate shavings when they saw [freja.name]."
        
        The dragonling proudly puffs out her chest, fists on hips. "I'm adorable, it is my special secret power."
        
        "It's no secret, my precious gem." Aileh hefts her up off of your shoulder and nuzzles her while she giggles.
    ]
rows.translation:
“去野餐怎么样？”你提议道，这换来艾莱赫温暖的一笑，以及你肩上女儿的一声欢呼。
    
    “我当然乐意。[dayNight
        |太阳出来了，我们可以边吃边喝茶。”
        |天黑了，还有点儿凉，来点热巧克力怎么样？有位商人路过时看见[freja.name]，就送了一袋巧克力碎屑。”
        
        小龙骄傲地挺起胸，双拳叉腰。“我很可爱，这是我的特殊秘密力量。”
        
        “这可不是什么秘密，我珍贵的宝石。”艾莱赫把你肩上的她抱起来，蹭着她，她咯咯直笑。
    ]
