rows.original: After stopping by at the bar and fetching some food from your local bee-tender[dayNight |— including a dash of honey-syrup for [freja.name]'s tea. |along with a copper cup of warm milk and chocolate shavings. ] Aileh smiles as you hoist the basket, tucking a rug under one arm, while the two of you hold [freja.name] between you like any normal family in the world. "Hehehe..." your daughter swings and flaps her wings, tail lashing around like a hunting cat. It's not a long walk that takes you to a lovely clearing; you only need to go a little ways south to find a space clear of overhanging branches, where you and your family can get some [dayNight |sunlight |starlight ]. Once the rug's been laid out, Aileh sprawls across it on her back, lets her wings out and spreads them as wide as she can. "Aaah, it's lovely out..." she pauses and somehow stretches herself out even further, sighing with satisfaction at the clicks and pops. [dayNight | |"A little chilly though." ] [freja.name] is already scamper-flapping around, picking out a tree to make an ascent, so you follow along with her while the busy mother gets some much-needed rest. Your little dragonling scampers up the nearest tree with the ease of a skinny little flapper's claw-tipped-digits. She reaches the highest branch she can, perches at its end, extends her wings, and leaps towards you, tucking her legs like she's bombing into a pool. There's not enough power or size in her wings to even glide for especially long, but it's enough to coast for a few seconds, and certainly enough to eat up her momentum until her drop into your arms is barely an issue. You're just there for fun, or at the very least to make sure your precious babe doesn't turn an ankle. There's plenty of happy squealing and wiggling as she works her way free from your grasp, giving you a squeezey hug on the leg before repeating the process. Aileh, on the other hand, has dragged herself upright and begun preparing your [dayNight |lunch |dinner ], watching with a grin as the dragonling's seemingly-boundless exuberance has a chance to get out of her system. It only takes a couple of glide-catches to have the scruffy scaled rapscallion doubled over, breathing hard, and tightly tucking in doubtlessly-aching wings. Still; it's excellent exercise for those muscles, and you're certain your little girl's going to be unstoppable one day. Aileh gives the two of you a sharp whistle like she's calling for the dogs, and [freja.name] jogs over with a flushed-face huff-and-puff[pc.isCanine |, and with a particularly loud 'awoo!' from you for good measure ]. Before your daughter gets a chance to dive into the plate of little meat pies, Aileh wraps her hands in damp towels and makes sure to scrub her claws clean. "Perfect, dig in." [freja.name] consumes every pastry daring or foolish enough to get close to her claws or fangies, making sure to give you both enthusiastic 'nyam nyam nyam!'s as she does so. You yourself have a bit of an appetite, coupled with the eternally-unfilled furnace that is your girlfriend, there's not a scrap of food left by the time Aileh's pouring drinks. [dayNight |There's very little that can possibly overheat your draconic family, but a freezing cold glass of sweet tea hits the spot any time the sun dares beat down on you. To your surprise, [freja.name] does everything in her power to take her time with the drink, sipping and savoring each mouthful — she even finishes before you and Aileh — and beams you both with a wonderful smile when you pour your leftover ice into her cup. |Your daughter's not the only one brimming with delight; Aileh too seems excited to have herself a mug of [silly |hot choccymilk |hot chocolate ], but she forces herself to remain calm while she pours— even as her tail lashes around behind her. It is rich and creamy, and a drizzle of honey chases the bitterness away, which makes for all three of you consuming the milky, chocolate-y beverage in record time. ] With a couple of final slurp, and a finished meal, your now very groggy, happy-tummy'd, mucky rapscallion curls herself up into a ball in Aileh's lap for a nap. Aileh grins toothily at you, reaching out to give your hand a squeeze. "Well, that's scored us some peace and quiet time, hmm?" You shuffle over to your girlfriend's side of the rug, smiling when she lifts a wing to wrap around your back while you snuggle up against one-another. "I think it has."
rows.translation: 在酒吧稍作停留，然后从你家附近的餐馆买了一些食物之后[dayNight |— 其中还加入了一点蜂蜜糖浆[freja.name]她的茶。 |还有一杯热牛奶和一些巧克力碎。 ]当你把篮子抬起来，一只手臂下夹着一块毯子时，艾莱笑了起来，你们俩一起抱着它。 [freja.name]就像世界上任何普通家庭一样，你们之间的关系也是如此。 “嘿嘿嘿……”你的女儿欢快地摆动着翅膀，尾巴像一只猎猫一样来回甩动。 走不多远，你就会来到一片美丽的空地上；只需向南走一小段距离，就能找到一个没有悬垂树枝的地方，在那里，你和你的家人可以[dayNight |阳光 |星光 ]一旦地毯铺好，艾莉就会仰面躺在上面，展开双翼，尽量将它们伸得最开。“啊，外面真是太舒服了……”她停顿了一下，然后又设法让自己身体伸展得更加彻底，听到关节发出的咔嚓声，她满意地叹了口气。 [dayNight | |不过还是有点凉吧。 ] [freja.name]已经蹦蹦跳跳地四处跑了，正在挑选一棵树准备开始攀爬，于是你跟着它一起行动，而这位忙碌的母亲则可以好好休息一下了。你的小龙崽以一只瘦小的爪子轻松地爬上了最近的那一棵树。 它爬到能够到达的最高树枝上，在枝端停歇下来，展开翅膀，然后朝你扑了过来，双腿弯曲得就像是在跳进水池一样。它的翅膀并没有足够的力量或面积让它能够长时间滑翔，但这样的飞行方式至少可以让它滑行几秒钟，而且肯定足以让它失去足够的冲力，这样当它落入你的怀抱时，就不会造成太大的冲击了。你参加这些活动，只是为了开心，或者至少是为了确保你那珍贵的宝贝不会扭伤脚踝。 当她努力从你的手中挣脱出来时，会发出许多开心的尖叫和扭动，然后会紧紧地抱住你的腿，然后再重复这个过程。另一方面，艾莉已经挣扎着站了起来，开始为你做准备。 [dayNight |午餐 |晚餐 ]她笑着看着这只小龙那似乎无穷无尽的活力得以发泄出来。 只需要几次巧妙的捕捉动作，那个浑身是鳞、活蹦乱跳的小家伙就立刻弯下腰来，喘着粗气，把那些肯定已经疼痛不堪的翅膀紧紧地收了起来。不过，这对锻炼它的肌肉来说确实是非常好的方式，而且你可以肯定，你的小女儿总有一天会变得无比强大。 艾莱赫像召唤狗一样，对着你们俩吹了一声响亮的口哨。 [freja.name]脸涨得通红，气喘吁吁地跑过来。[pc.isCanine |而且，它的声音格外大。哇哦！为了更加保险起见，还是从你这里获取吧。 ]在你的女儿有机会吃到那些小肉饼之前，艾莱赫先用湿毛巾帮她擦干净手，确保她的手指也彻底清洗干净。“好了，现在可以开始吃了。 [freja.name]任何敢于或愚蠢到靠近她爪子或獠牙的点心，都会被她吞噬掉，而且她一定会让你和那些点心都享受到极致的乐趣。喵呜喵呜！就在她这么做的时候，你自己也挺饿的吧？再加上你女朋友那个永远填不饱的“肚子”，等到艾莱开始倒酒的时候，早就一点食物都没有了。 [dayNight |几乎没有什么事情能真正让你的“龙裔家族”感到烦躁不安，但每当烈日当空时，一杯冰凉的甜茶总能缓解这种不适。令你惊讶的是[freja.name]竭尽全力地慢慢品尝那杯饮品，细嚼慢咽，享受每一口的美味——甚至比你和艾莱先喝完。当你把剩下的冰块倒入她的杯中时，她还会用灿烂的笑容看着你们俩。 |你的女儿并不是唯一一个满心欢喜的人；艾莱似乎也因为能喝上一杯[silly |热巧克力奶 |热巧克力 ]而兴奋不已，不过在倒饮料时，她强迫自己保持冷静——尽管她的尾巴在身后不停地摆动。是这种饮品口感浓郁、质地丝滑，再加上一点点蜂蜜，就能有效缓解其中的苦味，因此你们三个人肯定会在极短的时间内喝完这种香浓的巧克力饮品。 ] 喝了几口最后剩下的汤，吃完饭后，你现在感到有些昏昏沉沉的，但肚子却很满足。那个调皮的小家伙在艾莱的怀里蜷缩成一团，准备小睡一会儿。艾莱冲你咧嘴一笑，伸手握了握你的手：“嗯，这样我们终于可以享受一段安静的时光了，对吧？” 你挪到女朋友所在的那半块地毯上，当她把翅膀搭在你的背上，你们依偎在一起时，你露出了微笑：“我想是的。

rows.original: None of you planned to sleep for two hours, but it's not until [freja.name] snores and accidentally kicks you both as she tumbles out of Aileh's lap that you're both brought to wakefulness. There's a grumble and a groan from you, with a happy little hiss from Aileh who clings onto your side for a few kisses before finally peeling herself free. "We must do that again... right?" Aileh flutters her lashes at you. "Yesss..." [freja.name] hisses along in agreement.
rows.translation: 你们谁都没打算睡上两个小时，但当[freja.name]打着呼噜、从艾莱赫的腿上翻滚下来，还顺带踢了你们俩一脚时，你们才双双醒了过来。你嘟囔着呻吟了一声，而艾莱赫则开心地轻轻嘶了一声，贴在你身侧讨了几个吻，才终于把自己抽开。 “我们一定要再来一次……对吧？”艾莱赫朝你眨着睫毛。 “嗯……”[freja.name]也嘶声附和道。

rows.original:
"How about another lesson with Ivris?"
    
    "Oh! Miss Ivris is super-nice! Yes." [freja.name] bounces on the spot excitedly, before squealing as you scoop her entirely on your shoulders. "Bye mommy!" [freja.name] waves at the curvy dragon with a giggle.
rows.translation:
“再和艾薇莉丝上一次课怎么样？”
    
    “哦！艾薇莉丝老师人超级温柔！好啊。” [freja.name]兴奋地在原地蹦跳着，当你把她整个抱到肩上时，她发出了一声尖叫。“再见，妈妈！” [freja.name]咯咯笑着向那条曲线玲珑的龙挥了挥手。
rows.raw:
'
    "How about another lesson with Ivris?"
    
    "Oh! Miss Ivris is super-nice! Yes." [freja.name] bounces on the spot excitedly, before squealing as you scoop her entirely on your shoulders. "Bye mommy!" [freja.name] waves at the curvy dragon with a giggle.
    '

rows.original: This time when you enter Ivris' shop, the horned elf is turning to face the door, ears twitching. "Hello again [freja.name], [pc.name]," Your child apparently has a very distinct scamper; fair, you recognize her by sound too, but it's impressive how many different gaits Ivris can remember. "Hiii Miss Ivris!" The alchemist beams at her, stepping aside so that [freja.name] can give her legs a hug, and go fetch their chairs. "How are you both doing?" "Very well, thanks." You find somewhere to lean and watch the show... only to find that the elf is thoroughly prepared for your presence; a small cauldron has been set aside, with a small stack of ingredients. "No, [pc.name]..." Ivris' grin is a truly mischievous thing as [freja.name] gets set up for lesson-time. "Thank you, I get so bored making the same potion over and over." Well... it seems only fair, plus it's a delight to hear [freja.name] studiously going over her math again. There's even a break midway through so that Ivris can explain what you are making; potions for mothers' milk. Together, Ivris and your sweetie pie-dragonling make another motion, counting each measure carefully between them, and checking each amount with divisions and small multiplications. Any time she struggles or gets caught up, the elven alchemist patiently escorts her to the abacus to count it all out slowly and carefully; the woman is a natural. A very patient natural. By the time you've finished the repeat potion-crafting, [freja.name]'s lesson is at its end, and chairs are being returned to the back room where they belong. "That was good! Thank you Miss Ivris!" "My pleasure as always; and what's six times six?" "Thirty-six!" [freja.name] proudly shouts. It's incredibly difficult to tell, but with the shift in Ivris' mask, and the movement of her brows, you're fairly sure the elven alchemist is winking at you. Her hands form a little V and a Three, making a big heart while she mouths 'precious baby'. Yeah. She is. [freja.name] flap-leaps into your arms with a giggle; you nuzzle her nose, and she snuggles in. "Home time, my little princess?" "Home!"
rows.translation: 这次走进艾薇莉丝的商店时，那名有角精灵正转身面对门口，双耳轻轻颤动。“又见面了，[freja.name]、[pc.name]。” 你的孩子跑起来显然有种极其独特的声音；这也很正常，你同样能听声认出她，但艾薇莉丝能记住这么多不同的步态仍令人赞叹。“嗨——艾薇莉丝小姐！” 炼金术士冲她灿烂一笑，让到一旁，方便[freja.name]抱住自己的双腿，再去取来她们的椅子。“你们两个过得怎么样？” “很好，谢谢。”你找了个地方倚靠，准备观看这场表演……却发现精灵已经为你的到来做足准备；一个小坩埚被单独摆在一旁，旁边还有一小摞原料。 “不，[pc.name]……”[freja.name]准备开始上课时，艾薇莉丝露出了十足顽皮的笑容。“该由我谢谢你。一遍又一遍地调制同种药水，我都快无聊死了。” 嗯……这似乎也很公平；而且，再次听[freja.name]认真复习算术也令人愉快。中途甚至还休息了一阵，好让艾薇莉丝解释你正在制作什么——促进母乳分泌的药剂。 艾薇莉丝和你的龙崽甜心一起调制了另一份药水，两人仔细计算每种材料的分量，又以除法和简单乘法核对每个数值。每当她遇到困难或卡住时，精灵炼金术士都会耐心地将她领到算盘前，慢慢仔细地把数字全部算清；这女人天生就会教导别人，而且天生有着惊人的耐心。 等你完成又一次药剂调制，[freja.name]的课程也到了尾声，椅子正被放回原本所属的后屋。“这堂课真棒！谢谢艾薇莉丝小姐！” “一如既往，不用客气；那么六乘六是多少？” “三十六！”[freja.name]骄傲地喊道。 这实在很难看清，但从艾薇莉丝面具的移动和眉毛的动作判断，你颇为确信精灵炼金术士正在向你眨眼。她双手比出一个小小的 V 和一个 3，拼成一颗大心，同时以口型说道：“宝贝真可爱。” 没错，她确实可爱。[freja.name]拍翼一跃，咯咯笑着扑进你怀里；你用鼻尖蹭蹭她，她也依偎进来。“该回家了，我的小公主？” “回家！”
rows.raw: ' This time when you enter Ivris' shop, the horned elf is turning to face the door, ears twitching. "Hello again [freja.name], [pc.name]," Your child apparently has a very distinct scamper; fair, you recognize her by sound too, but it's impressive how many different gaits Ivris can remember. "Hiii Miss Ivris!" The alchemist beams at her, stepping aside so that [freja.name] can give her legs a hug, and go fetch their chairs. "How are you both doing?" "Very well, thanks." You find somewhere to lean and watch the show... only to find that the elf is thoroughly prepared for your presence; a small cauldron has been set aside, with a small stack of ingredients. "No, [pc.name]..." Ivris' grin is a truly mischievous thing as [freja.name] gets set up for lesson-time. "Thank you, I get so bored making the same potion over and over." Well... it seems only fair, plus it's a delight to hear [freja.name] studiously going over her math again. There's even a break midway through so that Ivris can explain what you are making; potions for mothers' milk. Together, Ivris and your sweetie pie-dragonling make another motion, counting each measure carefully between them, and checking each amount with divisions and small multiplications. Any time she struggles or gets caught up, the elven alchemist patiently escorts her to the abacus to count it all out slowly and carefully; the woman is a natural. A very patient natural. By the time you've finished the repeat potion-crafting, [freja.name]'s lesson is at its end, and chairs are being returned to the back room where they belong. "That was good! Thank you Miss Ivris!" "My pleasure as always; and what's six times six?" "Thirty-six!" [freja.name] proudly shouts. It's incredibly difficult to tell, but with the shift in Ivris' mask, and the movement of her brows, you're fairly sure the elven alchemist is winking at you. Her hands form a little V and a Three, making a big heart while she mouths 'precious baby'. Yeah. She is. [freja.name] flap-leaps into your arms with a giggle; you nuzzle her nose, and she snuggles in. "Home time, my little princess?" "Home!" '

rows.original:
"I think it's time for a lesson," you offer. "Learning maths and reading is boring alone, we could visit Ivris at Hawkethorne; she can teach alchemy, and maybe she has something to help me teach you basic math."
    
    [freja.name]'s expression looked close to faltering at the concept of being schooled, at least until you mentioned visiting a brand new place. "Who's Ivis?"
    
    "Ivris, she's a lovely alchemist; she even taught me. She's an elf with pretty horns."
    
    "Like mine?!" [freja.name] gasps again.
    
    You give her head a gentle scratch, grinning at the poofy mess of her hair while she happy-hisses. "Nobody's are cuter than yours, but they're cute."
    
    Aileh smiles at the two of you, folding her arms. "I appreciate it, I was never, uh, much of a teacher. You sure this Ivris won't mind, dear heart?"
    
    "Only one way to find out!" You scoop your daughter onto your shoulders and make for the Wayfort's statue. "Wave bye, sweetie."
    
    "Bye mommy!" [freja.name] waves at the curvy dragon with a giggle.
rows.translation:
我觉得是时候上堂课了，”你提议道，“光是学习数学和阅读确实很无聊。我们可以去鹰棘镇找艾薇莉丝，她可以教我们炼金术，也许她还能帮我想出办法来教你基础数学。
    
    [freja.name]听到要接受教育的这个想法时，她的表情似乎有些动摇，直到你提到要去一个全新的地方。“艾维斯是谁？”
    
    “艾夫莉丝，她是个很可爱的炼金术士，她还教过我呢。她是个长着漂亮角角的精灵。”
    
    “和我的一样吗？！ [freja.name]又倒抽了一口凉气。
    
    你轻轻挠了挠她的头发，看着她那蓬松乱乱的头发，忍不住笑了起来，而她也开心地“嘶嘶”叫着。你说：“没有谁的头发比你更可爱了，真的。”
    
    艾莉赫看着你们俩，双臂交叉抱在胸前，笑着说：“我很感激你，说实话，我以前从来都不太会当老师……你确定艾薇莉丝不会介意吧，亲爱的？”
    
    “只有试过才能知道！”你把女儿抱到肩上，朝着荒废驿堡的雕像走去，说道：“再跟妈妈招手告别一下吧，宝贝。”
    
    “再见妈妈！”她开心地喊道。 [freja.name]笑着向那条弯曲的龙挥了挥手。

rows.original: [freja.name] is like a queen in the country from her perch on your shoulders, waving at everyone who waves back with clear delight. She's an exotic individual, and a precious beacon of delight that draws the eyes. Those eyes follow you all into Ivris' shop; although you have to let your daughter down to the ground, lest you bonk her noggin on the doorframe. She tucks her wings tight as she enters ahead of you, calling out a greeting as she goes. The special flickering light of the alchemist's home and shop have your child momentarily enraptured, until the alchemist herself steps out. "Hello? That's a new voice, welcome customer!" [freja.name] screeches to a halt, blinking in confusion. "Can you see with that on?" Ivris chuckles and shakes her head, "no, dear." "Then why put them on?" You wince at [freja.name]'s bluntness; you probably should've warned her first. Thankfully Ivris seems not to mind, shrugging her shoulders and spreading ink-stained hands. "Unfortunately, dear, I can't see with the blindfold off, either." "O-oh..." [freja.name] looks to you, confused. When you nod she turns around again to face the elf, doing a surprisingly adept curtsey despite its inability to be seen. "Sorry miss." "It's fine, how were you to know?" Ivris smiles softly, turning her head to vaguely face you. "How can I help?" You could swear the woman isn't really blind; she's so capable. "It's an odd request, but do you have anything I could use to teach [freja.name] — my daughter here — some maths and alchemy?" "If I can teach you alchemy in under an hour, I'm sure a bright, impressionable child like [freja.name] will be able to manage in no time! Mathematics, though?" "I'm learning to read good already!" [freja.name] proudly announces. "Well..." you correct her. "Read well good." [freja.name] giggles. Ivris beams down at the dragonling, rubbing her slender hands together. "Then you will have no problems at all! Let me see here..." The elven alchemist crouches down behind her counter, deftly trailing a finger along it as she goes, before pulling out an abacus, which she plants on the top. "Do you know what this is?" "Mhm! It's an abby— abacus." The elf sighs with relief, lips curling up into a grin. "Good, the children usually just call it a toy. I think I'll find teaching you to be a genuine pleasure, dear." "You'll do it then?" You blink with surprise; Ivris actually teaching [freja.name] maths aswell as alchemy wasn't expected. It takes a couple of seconds to realize by the shifting of her brows, that the elf is winking at you. "It'll pass the time, and you've helped me out... plus I love an inquisitive mind." "I'm super-inquisitive!" [freja.name] proudly announces. "Shall we find out just how much?" The alchemist taps her desk gently, before gesturing over her shoulder. "I've got an hour free, if you'd like to go and bring us some chairs." The dragonling stifles her desire to squeal, and — with staggering degrees of etiquette — heads into the backroom.
rows.translation: [freja.name]就像一位女王一样，坐在你的肩膀上，向所有向她挥手的人回以欢快的回应。她是一个与众不同的人，是一道带来欢乐的珍贵光芒，吸引了所有人的目光。那些目光会跟随你一起走进艾薇莉丝的商店；不过，在此之前，你得先把女儿放下来，否则她的头可能会撞到门框上。 她紧收双翼，走在你前面，边走边打着招呼。 炼金术士的住所和店铺里那种特殊的闪烁光芒，瞬间吸引了你的孩子，直到炼金术士本人走出来。喂？这是新的接线员，欢迎您的来电！ [freja.name]发出尖锐的停顿声，困惑地眨着眼睛。“戴着那个东西，你还能看得清吗？” 艾薇莉丝轻笑一声，摇了摇头：“不能，亲爱的。” “那为什么还要戴上它呢？” 你不禁皱起了眉头[freja.name]你说话太直白了，或许应该先警告她才对。不过幸好，艾薇莉丝似乎并不在意，她只是耸了耸肩，摊开了那些被墨水弄脏的手部说道：‘可惜啊，亲爱的，就算不戴眼罩，我也看不见。’” “哦[freja.name]你看着她，感到有些困惑。当你点头表示同意时，她又转过身去面对那个精灵，尽管看不见，但她却做了一个出奇地娴熟的鞠躬。“对不起，小姐。” “没关系，你怎么会知道呢？”艾薇莉丝温柔地笑了笑，微微转过头来，朝你的方向说道：“我能帮上什么忙吗？” 你简直敢打赌，这个女人其实并不是真的失明；她的动作如此熟练，显然视力并没有问题。“这个请求有点奇怪，不过你有没有什么东西可以让我用来教学呢？ [freja.name]这是我女儿——她对数学和炼金术很感兴趣，对吧？” “如果我能在不到一小时内教会你炼金术，我相信像她这样聪明、容易接受新知识的孩子[freja.name]肯定能很快掌握的！不过数学……” “我已经在学习如何读懂数学了！ [freja.name]自豪地宣布。 “嗯……”你纠正她。 “读得好，很好。 [freja.name]咯咯地笑了起来。 艾夫里斯微笑着看着那条小龙，双手轻轻搓着。“那么你就不会遇到任何问题了！让我想想……”这位精灵炼金术士蹲在她的柜台后面，手指熟练地沿着柜台边缘滑动，然后拿出一把算盘放在桌上。你知道这是什么吗？” “嗯！这是算盘。” 精灵松了一口气，嘴角露出笑容：“太好了，孩子们通常都把它当成玩具来玩。我想教你使用它一定会是一件很有趣的事情，亲爱的。那么你就愿意去做吗？”你惊讶地眨了眨眼——艾薇莉丝竟然真的愿意教导别人。 [freja.name]数学也因为这完全超出了预料。 通过她眉毛的变化，你需要几秒钟才能意识到，那个精灵正在向你眨眼。“这样也能打发时间，而且你确实帮了我大忙……再加上，我就喜欢那些充满好奇心的人。” “我可是个十足的好奇宝宝！ [freja.name]自豪地宣布。 “我们不妨去看看到底有多少吧？”炼金术士轻轻敲了敲桌面，然后侧身示意道：“我有一个小时的空闲时间，如果你愿意的话，可以去拿些椅子过来吧。” 小龙强忍住想要尖叫的冲动，以极其得体的举止走向了后面的房间。

rows.original: [freja.name] is yawning by the time Ivris is finished with her, but you'd assume it's exhaustion rather than boredom; her eyes are still shining, and she's doing her best to commit as much as possible to memory; while the alchemist has been explaining how mixtures work together, she uses the abacus, and measurements as an explanation. Of course, your daughter was delighted by the phrase "[freja.name], with this it's three times as explosive!" But you thankfully don't have to pry her away from any dangerous chemicals. Instead, with her lesson concluded, [freja.name] proudly holds a little glass bottle aloft, tail swishing. "I did an alchemy!" Before a pause, sheepishly wiggling in her chair. "But what does it do?" Ivris smugly steeples her fingers. "Taste three times as delicious when mixed into tea." [silly |":D" |"Yay!" ] To you, Ivris smiles softly and rests her hands on the table. "If you'd like, I'm more than happy to go over this again with her any week." "Really?" The horned elf nods, patting [freja.name] on the head as she climbs out of her chair. "Of course; repetition is important to make sure it sticks, and the younger, the better." To you she gives a cheeky grin. "Plus your daughter is precious." "Heee..." [freja.name] gives her leg a hug before scampering over to join you. "Thank you Miss Ivris! I love you bye-bye!" Abruptly she skids to a halt, whipping around. "Ohwait... uh!" Both you and her impromptu teacher look confused, until she carefully slides her chair into the backroom again. Ivris mouths at you 'so precious' once more.
rows.translation: [freja.name]当艾薇莉丝讲解完毕时，那个人已经哈欠连天了，但你会认为这是因为疲惫而不是无聊——她的眼睛依然闪烁着光芒，也在竭力将尽可能多的内容记在心里；当那位炼金术士解释各种混合物是如何相互作用的时，她就会用算盘和各种测量数据来辅助理解。 当然，你的女儿肯定对这句话感到非常感兴趣[freja.name]就这样，一切就绪了。三次简直就像爆炸一样！”不过幸运的是，你并不需要把她从任何危险的化学物质旁边拉开。相反，在她的课程结束后[freja.name]骄傲地举着一个小玻璃瓶，尾巴摇来摇去：“我成功完成了一项炼金术！”稍作停顿后，她又有些害羞地在椅子上扭动身体：“不过这个东西到底有什么作用呢？” 艾薇莉丝则得意地叉着手指说：“把它加入茶中，味道会变得美味三倍呢。 [silly |:D |耶！ ] 对你说，艾薇莉丝温柔地笑了笑，然后将双手放在桌上：“如果你愿意，我随时都可以再和她讨论这件事。” “真的吗？” 这个长角的精灵点了点头，轻拍着[freja.name]从椅子上爬起来时，脑袋还撞到了桌子。“当然；重复练习很重要，这样才能确保孩子们真正记住这些内容，而且年龄越小越好。”她调皮地对你笑了笑，“再说，你的女儿可是非常珍贵的。” “呵呵[freja.name]在你的腿上蹭了蹭，然后欢快地跑过来加入你。“谢谢艾薇莉丝小姐！我爱你，再见！”突然，它停了下来，转过身来：“哦，等等……呃！” 你和它这位临时“老师”都一脸困惑，直到它小心翼翼地把椅子推回后台。艾薇莉丝对着你嘟囔了几句如此珍贵再一次。

rows.original:
"How about swimming?" you offer, "The river here is a bit cold, but there's the Lake Tarahugan, in Harvest Valley by the mares."
    
    Aileh tilts her head and grins, hands on hips. [atani.married
        |"You're not going to get abducted by the horse-wife, are you?"
        |"Just swimming? You're not going to get distracted by anyone in horsey-town, are you?"
    ]
    
    You put your hands up in feigned surrender, which has [freja.name] giggling. "No, this trip is about our little girl."
    
    "I know really, dear heart. I'll make sure to have a dry sweater ready for [freja.name] when you both get home." She leans in to sneak a kiss off of the both of you, rubs her daughter's cheeks, and watches the two of you make for the Wayfort's statue.
rows.translation:
去游泳怎么样？”你提议道，“这里的河水有点凉，不过在丰收谷的马群旁边，还有塔拉胡甘湖呢。”
    
    艾莱歪着头，双手叉腰，笑了起来。 [atani.married
        |你该不会真的被那个马娘子绑架了吧？
        |就只是游泳而已？在马镇上，应该不会有人打扰你吧？
    ]
    
    你举手假装投降，其实是在[freja.name]咯咯笑起来，”她说，“不，这次旅行是为了我们的小女儿。”
    
    “我真的明白的，亲爱的。我会确保准备一件干毛衣带上的[freja.name]等你们俩都回到家再说吧。”她凑上前去，偷偷地亲了你们俩一下，然后揉了揉女儿的脸颊，接着看着你们朝着荒废驿堡的雕像走去。
rows.raw:
'
    "How about swimming?" you offer, "The river here is a bit cold, but there's the Lake Tarahugan, in Harvest Valley by the mares."
    
    Aileh tilts her head and grins, hands on hips. [atani.married
        |"You're not going to get abducted by the horse-wife, are you?"
        |"Just swimming? You're not going to get distracted by anyone in horsey-town, are you?"
    ]
    
    You put your hands up in feigned surrender, which has [freja.name] giggling. "No, this trip is about our little girl."
    
    "I know really, dear heart. I'll make sure to have a dry sweater ready for [freja.name] when you both get home." She leans in to sneak a kiss off of the both of you, rubs her daughter's cheeks, and watches the two of you make for the Wayfort's statue.
    '

rows.original: It's difficult once you arrive in the marefolk's tent-based village, not for any serious reason, but for the fact that [freja.name] catches so much adoring attention that you're fending off mares with a stick by the time you make it to the lakeside. [atani.married |Your mare-wife |The chieftess ] grins and gives you a wave, guiding you both over. [atani.numKids 1 |In her arms is the little fluffy horse-potato that is your other daughter, [piyari.name], squeezing her hand in something akin to a wave while her mother smiles. ] [flags.AILEH_SWIMMING_TS |[atani.numKids 1 |[freja.name] waves at them and scampers over, trilling and hissing happily. "Hello Miss Atani! Hello little sister!" By now, Atani has no fear about your draconic daughter's ability to hold a baby without dropping it; if anything she giggles at the overdramatic 'ooph!' [freja.name] lets out at the babe's always-unexpected weight. "Heee..." [freja.name]'s tail wriggles as she makes cooing noises at [piyari.name] until the baby's making curious, confused, happy little burbles. |"Hello Miss Atani!" Atani smiles, tossing her hair back and watching as the dragonling scampers up to her at extreme speed. When your daughter skids to a halt, she gently ruffles her ever-curly and shaggy hair. ] "Have you two come for more swimming and shortbread-cookies?" "Well, the plan is swimming, but if you insist on cookies," you tease. "I'm sure we could be tempted." [atani.numKids 1 |Once the chieftess has scooped your wiggling potato back up, and snuck a smooch off of you, she heads into her tent. "I'll see you two later then, have fun my lovely dears!" |"It's always a pleasure, so I'll see you two later then, have fun dears." ] |[atani.numKids 1 |[freja.name] gasps with delight, tippy-toeing with great big eyes where she waves. "Hello baby! Is she a sister?" "Yep, this is [piyari.name], and Atani here is her [pc.mf | |other ]mom, say hello sweetie." "Hello sweetie!" [freja.name] giggles. "I'm [freja.name]! It's nice to meet you." Atani settles down lower so that your dragonling can get a look — at least after making sure she and [piyari.name] get a smooch from you — and appears just delighted at the way the little baby holds onto [freja.name]'s little claw. [freja.name] whispers a soft 'hewwo pweshush' that makes [piyari.name] giggle and blow a little raspberry; [freja.name] steps away again after [piyari.name] yawns sleepily. |"This is Atani, say hello sweetie." "Hello sweetie!" [freja.name] giggles. "I'm [freja.name]! It's nice to meet you." ] "So," Atani begins with a smile, tail swishing. "What brings you two here?" "Swimming lessons!" [freja.name] cheers, "It's too cold at home!" The chieftess nods sagely and cuddles [piyari.name] to her chest. "How about I make snacks for when you're finished?" Your dragonlet bunches her hands into fists, bracing them against her own mouth in an effort to tamp down any squeals that might spook the baby. "Yesss..." Her tongue peeks out, accompanied by a soft hiss. "Thanks [atani.married |love |Atani ], appreciated." ]
rows.translation: 一旦你来到了那些以帐篷为居所的海洋民族村庄，就会发现有些地方让人感到不太方便，不过这并没有什么严重的原因，只是因为[freja.name]吸引了太多人的喜爱与关注，以至于当你终于来到湖边时，竟然还得用棍子来驱赶那些围上来的人群。 [atani.married |你的妻子 |女酋长 ]他咧嘴一笑，向你挥了挥手，然后带着你们一起走了过去。 [atani.numKids 1 |她怀里抱着那只毛茸茸的小马铃薯，那就是你的另一个女儿。 [piyari.name]她的母亲微笑着，同时轻轻握了握她的手，仿佛在向她致意。 ] [flags.AILEH_SWIMMING_TS |[atani.numKids 1 |[freja.name]朝他们挥了挥手，然后欢快地跑过去，一边发出吱吱的叫声。“嗨，阿塔妮小姐！嗨，小妹妹！” 此时，阿塔妮已经完全不担心你那条龙的女儿会把婴儿抱掉；相反，她看到这种夸张的反应，反而觉得好笑。哎哟！ [freja.name]哇……”她忍不住叫出了婴儿那出乎意料的体重。 [freja.name]它扭动着尾巴，同时发出呜呜的叫声。 [piyari.name]直到宝宝发出那些充满好奇、困惑又开心的小声哼哼声。 |你好，阿塔妮小姐！” 阿塔妮微笑着，将头发甩到背后，看着那只小龙以极快的速度跑向她。当你的女儿跑得停下来的时候，她轻轻地拨了拨那头卷曲而蓬松的头发。 ] 你们俩是来继续游泳、吃短饼和饼干的吗？” “嗯，原本的计划确实是去游泳，不过如果你坚持要求靠吃饼干啊，”你开玩笑地说，“我敢肯定我们肯定会忍不住的。 [atani.numKids 1 |等女首领把你那扭来扭去的土豆重新挖起来，还偷偷亲了你一下后，她就走进了自己的帐篷。“那晚见啦，你们两个好好玩吧，我亲爱的宝贝们！ |总是很高兴见到你们，那么晚点见吧，祝你们玩得开心，亲爱的们。 ] |[atani.numKids 1 |[freja.name]高兴得直喘气，踮着脚，睁大眼睛看着她挥手的方向。“嗨，宝贝！她是你的姐姐吗？” “是的，这就是[piyari.name]还有，这里的阿塔妮就是她。 [pc.mf | |其他 ]妈妈，跟宝宝打个招呼吧。” “宝宝，你好！ [freja.name]咯咯笑了起来。“我[freja.name]很高兴见到你。” 阿塔妮坐得更低了一些，这样你的小龙就能看看了——当然，在确保自己和……之后才行。 [piyari.name]得到你的一个吻——而且看到小宝宝紧紧抱着自己的样子，它看起来开心极了。 [freja.name]它那小小的爪子。 [freja.name]轻声低语hewwo pweshush这样就好了。 [piyari.name]咯咯笑，还吹着小 raspberry 声； [freja.name]又走开了几步[piyari.name]打着哈欠，昏昏欲睡。 |这是阿塔妮，跟她说声你好吧，亲爱的。” “你好，亲爱的！ [freja.name]咯咯笑了起来。“我[freja.name]很高兴见到你。 ] 那么，”阿塔妮微笑着开口，尾巴摇来摇去，“你们两个来这里是为了什么呢？” “来上游泳课啊！ [freja.name]家里太冷了，真难受！”大家纷纷说道。 女首领若有所思地点了点头，然后紧紧地抱住了大家。 [piyari.name]把小宝宝抱在胸前，说道：“等你吃完饭，我给你做一些零食怎么样？” 小龙宝宝把双手握成拳头，放在自己的嘴边，试图抑制任何可能会吓到宝宝的叫声。“好啊……”它的舌头微微探出，同时发出轻柔的嘶嘶声。 “谢谢。 [atani.married |爱 |阿塔妮 ]非常感谢。 ]

rows.original: [flags.AILEH_SWIMMING_TS |She's already out of her sweater and parading around in her adorable egg-design onesie underwear before you've even had chance to reach the water's edge, and there's no need to teach her to tread water judging by the way she takes a flying leap into the refreshing waters of the lake. "Heee! C'mon [pc.mf |daddy |mommy ]!" You shake yourself down to your own smallclothes and saunter in, scooping her up into a nice warm hug even as cool water rises to your waist. "Ready to swim?" Once let down, [freja.name] kicks her feet tucks her wings, and lets her weight go forwards while her little claws are tightly gripping your fingers. Guiding [freja.name] around through the water is a slow-and-steady process, making sure that she's kicking her feet evenly, not fanning her wings, or moving her tail too much. There is a lot of muscle memory the poor thing has to try and tamp down on, but after you've warmed her up to swimming again, there's some heart-welling pride at the sight of her swimming unaided. It's the slowest you've ever really seen her move before, and it's not a leisurely effort by any means judging by the look of concentration on her face, but if does get easier with time. "Practice makes perfect," you catch your laughing dragonlet and scoop her up for a squeeze. "[pc.isBimbo |Or, like, close enough for stuff! |Or near enough to it, at least; sometimes you just have to do well enough. ]" |With your daughter in tow — now holding your hand as she goes, a skip in her step — you arrive at the lake. You strip down to nothing, which results in [freja.name] bursting into giggles; force of habit. "It's not bath time!" [freja.name] giggles, and you hurriedly pull your underwear back on. Wet clothes aren't that bad, but maybe you'll have to invest in some specific swimwear for next time. [freja.name] follows suit, throwing off her cozy, baggy sweater to reveal tiny cloth underclothes... with adorable little designs that look just like her egg. "Aren't they pretty and cool?!" The little dragon puffs out her chest proudly, little wings flapping, and tail whipping around. "They're very cool," you agree. "How about we get started?" Your daughter watches as you climb into the water... with a pause to make sure the ground is safe beneath; it wouldn't do to step on a broken branch or thorn and spook her. Once properly settled, you kick back and spread yourself out like a star, breathing carefully while you soak in the refreshing, temperate water. "Is it safe?" [freja.name] eventually asks. "Of course." You flip over, getting yourself thoroughly soaked before treading water back towards her, before offering both hands. "Step in slowly and carefully, and take my hands. I'll show you what to do." The little dragon gulps, staring into the lake with trepidation. "I won't go out, will I?" "You're my fiery little angel, but I don't think you're literally a fire. You have baths all the time and you don't go out then, do you?" "Yeah but those are hot water!" You quirk a brow at her, still smiling. "Come on already, it's not getting any warmer, trust me." [freja.name] huffs and puffs herself up again, dipping a toe into the water and squealing, before throwing herself fully into the lake, arms outstretched for you to catch her. "Bleph!" You make a similar noise when this earns you a mouthful of lake water, but you manage to get a hold of your daughter before she's dunked. She bursts out into laughter, kicking her feet and splashing you even more, before either of you manage to find a moment of calm. The dragonling gasps, waving her arms. "I'm swimming!" "I'm holding you up, sweetie." "O-oh..." Her face grows flushed, and she kicks her feet a couple of times before you lower her down to the armpits. "Okay! So... how do I swim?" "Well... first let's figure out treading water. It's what I'm doing, so that I can stay up and not sink." There's a complete lack of fear from your daughter as she begins the arduous process of finding her 'sea legs.' She listens patiently, and takes to treading like a fish; it doesn't take long to realize how, thanks to the fact that with her little wingies she's got some extra water-brakes. Actually swimming proves another matter; your daughter has been so confident thus far that it's easy to forget just how young she is, and that awkward middle-stage of a youthful body is causing her some difficulties now that she has to involve every extremity at once. Still... it's hard to discourage her. Despite any difficulties, there's no giving up until she's absolutely puffed out, and your biceps are aching from holding her out at max extension. "Home time?" "Yes! Oh — wait!" She squirms in your grasp and hiss-purrs with that lengthy tongue of hers, eyes big. "Snacks first?" "Sure, snacks first." You help [freja.name] paddle back to shore, and shiver a little in your smallclothes. Of course, hugging your little dragon does plenty to help warm you up, considering she's of the same living-furnace ilk as her similarly-scaled mother. Both of you make similar grumblings of complaint at pulling dry clothing on top of wet underwear — which does its own wonders for your already-high mood, seeing your daughter be so much like you when it comes to the little things. As though able to sense your thoughts, she beams at you, gently taking your hand while you both walk back into the middle of the village. ]
rows.translation: [flags.AILEH_SWIMMING_TS |你还没来得及走到水边，她就已经脱掉了毛衣，穿着那件可爱的蛋形图案连体内衣在周围蹦来跳去。看她那样纵身跳进清凉的湖水里，显然根本不需要教她如何踩水。“嘿！快来吧！ [pc.mf |爸爸 |妈妈 ]你抖了抖身上的水，穿上自己的衣服走了进去，将她紧紧抱在怀里，此时凉水已经没到了你的腰部。“准备去游泳了吗？” 被放下来的那一刻[freja.name]踢动双脚，收起翅膀，将身体重心向前移，而她的小爪子则紧紧抓住你的手指。 引导着[freja.name]在水中游动是一个需要缓慢而持续努力的过程，必须确保她能够均匀地蹬动双腿，既不要像鸟儿一样扑腾翅膀，也不要过度摆动尾巴。这只可怜的小动物需要努力抑制许多与肌肉运动相关的本能反应，但当你帮助她重新适应游泳后，看到她能够独立地在水中游动时，你会感到由衷的欣慰和自豪。 这是你见过的她移动得最慢的一次了。从她脸上那专注的神情来看，她绝对不是在悠闲地活动，而是确实随着时间的推移，会变得越来越容易的。 “熟能生巧，”你笑着抓起那只小龙，把它抱在怀里轻轻捏了捏。[pc.isBimbo |或者说，已经足够接近了，可以用来进行相关操作了！ |或者至少要接近这个标准；有时候，你只需要做到足够好就行了。足够了。 ]" |带着你的女儿——此刻她正牵着你的手，蹦蹦跳跳地走在你身边——你们来到了湖边。你脱得精光，结果就是[freja.name]突然笑出声来；出于习惯而已。 “现在还不是洗澡时间啊！ [freja.name]你忍不住笑了起来，然后急忙把内裤重新穿好。湿衣服可不行啊那个虽然不太理想，但也许下次你得专门购买一些适合游泳的服装了。 [freja.name]其他人也纷纷效仿，脱下了他们那舒适宽松的毛衣，露出了里面穿着的细小衣物可爱极了那些看起来和她的小蛋一模一样的小玩意儿。“它们是不是既漂亮又酷呢？！”小龙骄傲地挺起胸膛，小翅膀扑腾着，尾巴也甩来甩去。 “确实非常酷，”你赞同道。我们开始吧？” 你的女儿注视着你慢慢走进水中……你还会停下来确认水下的地面是否安全；可不能踩到断裂的树枝或刺棘，以免吓到她。待你稳稳地坐在水中后，你便会仰躺下来，四肢伸展，像一颗星星一样漂浮在水面上，小心翼翼地呼吸着，尽情享受这清凉而适中的水温。这安全吗？ [freja.name]最终，她问道：“当然可以。”你转过身去，让自己彻底浸湿在水里，然后开始朝她游去，同时伸出了双手。“慢慢来，小心一点，抓住我的手，我会告诉你该怎么做。小龙咽了咽口水，忐忑不安地望着湖面：“我不会出去吧？” “你可是我那火辣的小天使，不过我觉得你其实并不是真正的火。你总是要洗澡，洗澡的时候也不会出去，对吧？是啊，但那些都是热水啊！” 你微微挑了挑眉毛，依然面带微笑：“拜托，天气已经不会再变暖和了，相信我吧。 [freja.name]又气呼呼地鼓起胸膛，先试探性地把脚趾伸进水中，发出尖叫，然后整个人扑进了湖里，双臂伸开等着你来接她。“扑通！” 你也发出了类似的叫声，结果也被湖水溅了一口，不过你还是及时抓住了女儿，防止她再次被淹没。她突然大笑起来，脚不停地踢来踢去，把水溅得到处都是，直到你们俩终于恢复了一丝平静。 小龙喘着气，挥动着小手说：“我在游泳呢！” “是我在托着你呢，亲爱的。哦……”她的脸一下子红了，你把她托到腋下之前，她还踢了几下脚。“好吧！那么……我该怎么游泳呢？” “嗯……首先我们得学会如何让身体浮在水面上。这就是我正在做的事情，这样我就能保持清醒，不会沉下去。” 你的女儿在开始这段艰难的‘寻找平衡感’的过程时，完全没有表现出任何恐惧。她耐心地聆听指导，尝试着像鱼一样游动；不久之后，她就明白了——因为那些小鳍帮她提供了额外的‘水阻力’，让她更容易保持平衡。 其实游泳不过，这又是另一回事了；你的女儿到目前为止一直表现得非常自信，因此人们很容易忘记她其实也曾有过这样的经历。年轻她确实是这样，而那种处于青春中期、身体还处于发育中的尴尬状态，现在让她遇到了一些麻烦——因为她每次都需要同时使用身体的所有部位。 不过……还是很难让她放弃。无论遇到什么困难，她都不会放弃，直到她的肌肉完全发育成熟，直到你的二头肌因为长时间保持最大伸展状态而感到疼痛为止。回家时间了吗？” “是的！哦——等等！”她在你的怀里扭来扭去，那条长长的舌头不停地吐出“嘶嘶”声，眼睛也睁得大大的。“先吃点心吧？” “当然，先吃点心。”你说道，然后开始帮助她准备点心。 [freja.name]划着桨回到岸边，然后穿着薄衣服微微发抖。当然，抱着你的小龙肯定能帮助你暖和起来，毕竟她和她那同样有着鳞片的妈妈一样，都属于同一个“发热家族”。 你们俩在把干衣服穿在湿内衣外面时，都会发出类似的抱怨声——不过，当你看到女儿在这些小事上和你如此相像时，这种抱怨反而会让你的心情变得更好。仿佛能够读懂你的心思，她微笑着向你伸出手，两人一起走回了村庄的中心。 ]
rows.raw: ' [flags.AILEH_SWIMMING_TS |She's already out of her sweater and parading around in her adorable egg-design onesie underwear before you've even had chance to reach the water's edge, and there's no need to teach her to tread water judging by the way she takes a flying leap into the refreshing waters of the lake. "Heee! C'mon [pc.mf |daddy |mommy ]!" You shake yourself down to your own smallclothes and saunter in, scooping her up into a nice warm hug even as cool water rises to your waist. "Ready to swim?" Once let down, [freja.name] kicks her feet tucks her wings, and lets her weight go forwards while her little claws are tightly gripping your fingers. Guiding [freja.name] around through the water is a slow-and-steady process, making sure that she's kicking her feet evenly, not fanning her wings, or moving her tail too much. There is a lot of muscle memory the poor thing has to try and tamp down on, but after you've warmed her up to swimming again, there's some heart-welling pride at the sight of her swimming unaided. It's the slowest you've ever really seen her move before, and it's not a leisurely effort by any means judging by the look of concentration on her face, but if does get easier with time. "Practice makes perfect," you catch your laughing dragonlet and scoop her up for a squeeze. "[pc.isBimbo |Or, like, close enough for stuff! |Or near enough to it, at least; sometimes you just have to do well enough. ]" |With your daughter in tow — now holding your hand as she goes, a skip in her step — you arrive at the lake. You strip down to nothing, which results in [freja.name] bursting into giggles; force of habit. "It's not bath time!" [freja.name] giggles, and you hurriedly pull your underwear back on. Wet clothes aren't that bad, but maybe you'll have to invest in some specific swimwear for next time. [freja.name] follows suit, throwing off her cozy, baggy sweater to reveal tiny cloth underclothes... with adorable little designs that look just like her egg. "Aren't they pretty and cool?!" The little dragon puffs out her chest proudly, little wings flapping, and tail whipping around. "They're very cool," you agree. "How about we get started?" Your daughter watches as you climb into the water... with a pause to make sure the ground is safe beneath; it wouldn't do to step on a broken branch or thorn and spook her. Once properly settled, you kick back and spread yourself out like a star, breathing carefully while you soak in the refreshing, temperate water. "Is it safe?" [freja.name] eventually asks. "Of course." You flip over, getting yourself thoroughly soaked before treading water back towards her, before offering both hands. "Step in slowly and carefully, and take my hands. I'll show you what to do." The little dragon gulps, staring into the lake with trepidation. "I won't go out, will I?" "You're my fiery little angel, but I don't think you're literally a fire. You have baths all the time and you don't go out then, do you?" "Yeah but those are hot water!" You quirk a brow at her, still smiling. "Come on already, it's not getting any warmer, trust me." [freja.name] huffs and puffs herself up again, dipping a toe into the water and squealing, before throwing herself fully into the lake, arms outstretched for you to catch her. "Bleph!" You make a similar noise when this earns you a mouthful of lake water, but you manage to get a hold of your daughter before she's dunked. She bursts out into laughter, kicking her feet and splashing you even more, before either of you manage to find a moment of calm. The dragonling gasps, waving her arms. "I'm swimming!" "I'm holding you up, sweetie." "O-oh..." Her face grows flushed, and she kicks her feet a couple of times before you lower her down to the armpits. "Okay! So... how do I swim?" "Well... first let's figure out treading water. It's what I'm doing, so that I can stay up and not sink." There's a complete lack of fear from your daughter as she begins the arduous process of finding her 'sea legs.' She listens patiently, and takes to treading like a fish; it doesn't take long to realize how, thanks to the fact that with her little wingies she's got some extra water-brakes. Actually swimming proves another matter; your daughter has been so confident thus far that it's easy to forget just how young she is, and that awkward middle-stage of a youthful body is causing her some difficulties now that she has to involve every extremity at once. Still... it's hard to discourage her. Despite any difficulties, there's no giving up until she's absolutely puffed out, and your biceps are aching from holding her out at max extension. "Home time?" "Yes! Oh — wait!" She squirms in your grasp and hiss-purrs with that lengthy tongue of hers, eyes big. "Snacks first?" "Sure, snacks first." You help [freja.name] paddle back to shore, and shiver a little in your smallclothes. Of course, hugging your little dragon does plenty to help warm you up, considering she's of the same living-furnace ilk as her similarly-scaled mother. Both of you make similar grumblings of complaint at pulling dry clothing on top of wet underwear — which does its own wonders for your already-high mood, seeing your daughter be so much like you when it comes to the little things. As though able to sense your thoughts, she beams at you, gently taking your hand while you both walk back into the middle of the village. ] '

rows.original: [flags.AILEH_SWIMMING_TS |Freshly puffed out, [freja.name] is sprawled across your shoulders like an elderly cat, blinding you with wet, shaggy black hair. "Fun?" You ask, lifting her up while she squeals sleepily, and waiting for her to shake herself out like a puppy. "Hehehehe..." Your daughter giggles and wriggles, casting off as much water as possible before pointing to the sky. You brush her hair a little, and pull her sweater back on so that you can get dressed too. "Thaaankyou [pc.mf |daddy |mommy ]!" Atani comes out of her tent as the two of you leave the lake, a fresh tray of still-steaming, oven-baked, buttery, sugar-dusted shortbread cookies in hand. Though still sleepy, the moment delicious baked treats are on offer, [freja.name] opens wide and lets her lengthy dragon tongue roll out. "Aaaah..." "What do you say?" The mare chieftess proves unflappable however, glancing at you and winking before turning her attention to your daughter once more. "Oh! Uh- sorry, please can I have one thankyou?" She flashes her big shiny eyes for good measure, weaponing a trembling bottom lip with such careless ferocity that you're both clutching your hearts with your free hands. Atani almost gives [freja.name] the whole tray, pausing instead to make sure you get some of the cookies too, with a few to-go for later. "Hehehe yay," [freja.name] all but radiates smugness. Your girl can be dangerously smart sometimes. |True to her word, Atani is waiting for you both, and she's got a slim metal tray that's been loaded up with buttery fingers of stone-oven-baked shortbread. "Have a lovely time?" "Yes!" [freja.name] cheers, though it's hard to say if she heard the question, or was just responding to noises coming from the source of cookies. Regardless, [atani.married |your lovely horse-wife is more than happy to feed the precious bundle snacks — and one for you, as long as you give her a smooch on the snoot. |the lovely mare-chieftess is more than happy to feed your precious bundle some snacks. ] After making sure you've got a few to-go cookies for later tea-time-feasting, the two of you head back home, a [silly |very eepy |particularly sleepy ] [freja.name] clinging to your chest. "Think you'll come swimming again?" "Yes!" Your dragonling gives you a big squeezey hug and a 'muah!' on the cheek.. ]
rows.translation: [flags.AILEH_SWIMMING_TS |刚刚把毛发抖得蓬松起来，[freja.name]像只老猫一样趴在你肩头，湿漉漉、乱蓬蓬的黑发遮住了你的视线。“好玩吗？”你问道，将她举起；她睡意朦胧地尖叫着，你则等她像小狗一样甩干身体。 “嘿嘿嘿……”你的女儿咯咯笑着扭来扭去，尽量甩掉身上的水，又伸手指向天空。你稍稍梳理她的头发，替她重新穿上毛衣，随后自己也开始穿衣。“谢——谢你，[pc.mf |爸爸 |妈妈 ]！” 你们俩离开湖边时，阿塔妮走出帐篷，手里端着一盘刚出炉、仍冒着热气的黄油酥饼，上面还撒了糖。尽管困意未消，可美味的烘焙点心一出现，[freja.name]便张大嘴巴，让长长的龙舌滚了出来。“啊——……” “你该说什么？”这位母马酋长却丝毫不为所动；她看向你眨了眨眼，随后重新把注意力放到你女儿身上。 “哦！呃——对不起，请问可以给我一块吗，谢谢？”为了加强效果，她亮出水汪汪的大眼睛，又把颤抖的下唇化作武器，使出如此随意而凶猛的攻势，害得你和阿塔妮都用空着的手捂住心口。阿塔妮差点把整盘都交给[freja.name]，却及时停下，确保你也能分到一些饼干，还另外留了几块让你们带走。“嘿嘿嘿，好耶。”[freja.name]几乎浑身都散发着得意。 你家姑娘有时聪明得很危险。 |阿塔妮果然信守承诺，正在等着你们俩；她备好了一只窄窄的金属托盘，上面盛满以石炉烘烤、带着浓郁黄油香气的条状酥饼。“玩得开心吗？” “开心！”[freja.name]欢呼道，不过很难说她是真听到了问题，还是只在回应饼干来源处发出的声音。无论如何，[atani.married |你可爱的马儿妻子十分乐意给这个宝贝团子喂些点心——也给你一块，只要你亲亲她的鼻尖。 |可爱的母马酋长十分乐意喂你的宝贝团子吃些点心。 ] 确保带上几块饼干留待之后配茶大吃一番后，你们俩踏上归途；一个[silly |困困得不得了 |格外困倦 ]的[freja.name]紧紧贴在你胸前。“你觉得以后还会再来游泳吗？” “会！”你的小龙崽用力抱紧你，又在你脸颊上响亮地“啵！”了一口。 ]

rows.original:
[flags.AILEH_HIVE_TS
        |"How about another trip to the Hornet hive?" You offer, satisfied to see that your dragonling's delighted little hisses kick off one from Aileh too.
        
        "I won't say no to having myself pampered again," the older dragon adds. "Plus it's always nice having an excuse to spend some time together."
        
        "Uh-huh!" [freja.name] flaps her arms and wings at the same time, nearly toppling from your shoulder and forcing you to catch her where she giggles. "I wanna play with the lil' buzzles again!"
        |"I had a thought," you gently bounce [freja.name] on your shoulder while you ponder. "How about a trip to the hive?"
        
        Aileh's eyes glitter, and she folds her arms, tail lashing around. "It's been nice watching them buzz around, and they always invite me down. Apparently I'd be 'very popular', and they've promised a thorough pampering."
        
        "What do you think, sweetiebean?" You reach up and gently tap [freja.name] on the nose, and she giggles before kissing your finger.
        
        "Yesss!"
    ]
rows.translation:
[flags.AILEH_HIVE_TS
        |“再去黄蜂巢穴走一趟怎么样？”你提议道，看到你的小龙欣喜地发出细细的嘶声，还引得艾莱也跟着嘶了一声，你很满意。
        
        “我不会拒绝再被人好好伺候一次，”年长的龙补充道。“再说，能有个借口一起待上一阵子，总是很不错的。”
        
        “嗯哼！”[freja.name]同时拍打着双臂和翅膀，差点从你肩上翻下去，逼得你赶紧接住她，她就在你手里咯咯直笑。“我还想跟那些小嗡嗡玩！”
        |“我有个想法，”你一边琢磨，一边让[freja.name]在你肩上轻轻颠着。“去蜂巢走一趟怎么样？”
        
        艾莱赫的眼睛亮了起来，她抱起双臂，尾巴甩来甩去。“看着它们嗡嗡地飞来飞去真不错，而且它们总是邀请我下去。据说我会“非常受欢迎”，它们还答应要好好伺候我一番。”
        
        “你觉得呢，小甜豆？”你伸手轻轻点了点[freja.name]的鼻子，她咯咯笑着，然后亲了亲你的手指。
        
        “太——好了！”
    ]

rows.original: [flags.AILEH_HIVE_TS |Your short walk up to the hive is free of interruptions as usual, with you and Aileh swinging your daughter gently between your hands while she flaps her wings. Once you're at the entrance, a couple of knights buzz down with clear delight. "Hello again! It's always a pleasure to see the three of you." One of the girls crouches down, opening her arms for [freja.name] to flop into, squeezing her in a hug. "Coming up to play, princess?" "Yuh-huh!" [freja.name] giggles and nuzzles into the hornet girl's fluffy neck-collar, turning around in her arms so that she can see you and Aileh. "Right?" "Mhm, see you at the top, my treasure." With a laugh the knight takes to the air with [pc.hasWings |you and Aileh in tow— along with plenty of [silly |gay as heck |adorable ] hand-holding |Aileh in tow— carrying you with arms under your pits and a chuckle at the back of her throat ]. Touching down immediately earns you all a series of bright greetings, including a call of greeting from Azzy, who's using your family time as an opportunity for some of her own. [freja.name] waves at your honey-hornet companion and giggles, before you're all immediately rushed by a hornet horde, who all look incredibly excited about the chance to pamper some new faces. |Your short walk up to the hive is free of interruptions, with you and Aileh swinging your daughter gently between your hands while she flaps her wings. Once you're at the entrance, a couple of knights buzz down with clear delight. "Hello again!" One of the girls crouches down and beams at a wide-eyed [freja.name], opening her arms. "And a fresh hello to you! What's your name, princess?" "[freja.name]... hello it's nice to meet you!" The dragonling beams up at her, before realizing the still-open arms are on offer. She dives into the hug and giggles at the hornet's fluffy mantle tickling her face. "Your daughter is precious! And lady Aileh, our thanks for your help keeping the forest clean of ne'er-do-wells. Are you three coming up?" Aileh grins and shrugs, looking to her daughter. "A good question, what do you think [freja.name]?" "Yes, definitely! Can we have honey?" "More than you could possibly eat, if you're willing to play with the others! Our own daughters and sons could use a playmate; and we need an extra mouth to feed all of our honey-biscuits!" If your child nods her head any faster into this hornet's fluffy collar she's going to give herself a fit, and with a laugh the knight takes to the air with [pc.hasWings |you and Aileh in tow— along with plenty of [silly |gay as heck |adorable ] hand-holding |Aileh in tow— carrying you with arms under your pits and a chuckle at the back of her throat ]. Touching down immediately earns you all a series of bright greetings, including a call of greeting from Azzy, who's using your family time as an opportunity for some of her own. [freja.name] waves at your honey-hornet companion and giggles, before you're all immediately rushed by a hornet horde, who all look incredibly excited about the chance to pamper some new faces. ]
rows.translation: [flags.AILEH_HIVE_TS |你像往常一样，安静地走到了蜂巢前。你和艾莱一起，轻轻地将女儿抱在手中，而她则不断地扑动着翅膀。当你们来到入口处时，几名骑士兴奋地飞了过来。“又见到你们了！每次见到你们三个人总是让人感到很高兴。”其中一名女孩蹲了下来，张开双臂[freja.name]一把抱住她，将她紧紧搂在怀里。“过来玩吧，公主？” “好呀！ [freja.name]咯咯笑着，把脸埋进那个戴着蜂尾帽的女孩柔软的领圈里，然后在她的怀里转过身来，这样就能看到你和艾蕾了。“对吧？” “嗯，我们在山顶见吧，我的宝贝。” 骑士笑着，然后飞向了空中。 [pc.hasWings |你和艾莱一起，再加上许多其他的人或物[silly |极其同性恋倾向明显 |可爱极了 ]全程指导 |艾莱带着你——用双臂托着你的腰，同时喉咙里还带着轻声的笑声。 ]一落地，你们就会收到一系列热情的问候，其中还包括阿齐打来的电话——她正好利用这个家庭团聚的时刻，也想和大家聊聊天。 [freja.name]向你那位可爱的同伴挥了挥手，然后咯咯笑了起来，紧接着你们所有人立刻匆忙完成一群热情高涨的人围了上来，他们都非常期待有机会照顾这些新来的成员。 |你们沿着小路走向蜂巢的过程中没有遇到任何干扰，你和艾莱一起轻轻地将女儿抱在手中，而她则不断地扑动着翅膀。当你们来到入口处时，几名骑士兴奋地飞了过来。“又见到你们了！”其中一名女孩蹲下来，满脸笑容地望着那个睁大眼睛的小女孩。 [freja.name]她张开双臂，说道：“也向你们致以崭新的问候！你们叫什么名字呢，公主们？[freja.name]……你好，很高兴见到你！”小龙兴奋地对她说道，直到这时才注意到她仍然张开的双臂。它立刻扑了上去，被大黄蜂那柔软的毛茸茸的外皮挠得脸上痒痒的，不禁咯咯笑了起来。 “你的女儿真是太可爱了！还有艾莉女士，非常感谢您帮助我们清理森林，让那些坏人无法为非作歹。你们三个人是要上来吗？” 艾莉微笑着耸了耸肩，然后看向自己的女儿：“这是个好问题，你觉得呢？ [freja.name]嗯，当然可以！我们可以要一些蜂蜜吗？” “如果你愿意和其他孩子一起玩的话，我们会有足够多的蜂蜜让你吃个够的！我们的孩子们也需要一个玩伴；而且我们还需要多一个人来品尝我们做的蜂蜜饼干呢！” 如果你的孩子听到这里连连点头，她肯定会高兴得跳起来。骑士笑着，带着孩子飞向了空中[pc.hasWings |你和艾莉一起——再加上许多其他的人或物。 [silly |极其同性恋倾向明显 |可爱极了 ]全程指导 |艾莱带着你——用双臂托着你的腰，嘴角还挂着轻笑。 ]一落地，你们就会收到一系列热情的问候，其中还包括阿齐打来的电话——她正好利用这个家庭团聚的时刻，也想和大家聊聊天。 [freja.name]向你那位可爱的同伴挥了挥手，然后咯咯笑了起来，紧接着你们所有人立刻匆忙完成一群热情高涨的人围了上来，他们都非常期待有机会照顾这些新来的成员。 ]

rows.original: [freja.name] is soon introduced to a huge number of hornet children, and they buzz around her happily while she does her best to keep up while she's flapping. It soon becomes a game of trying to get your daughter airborne with nothing but buzz-assisted flight, but their light frames don't make for much leeway. It does result in a great big group hug that's latched itself onto your dragonling, however, and she seems to delight in being their mobile battle-fortress as they play Knights and Bandits with cloth-wrapped wooden sticks. The moment one of the buzzlets refers to her as Commander [freja.name], there's no stopping her from turning them into a well-ordered — mostly — buzzing military. [freja.name] isn't the only one getting tons of attention, either; you and Aileh have been brought some comfy chairs by order of the queen, while hive attendants, workers, and knights have all turned up with files, brushes, scale scrubs, fluff-puffers, [pc.hasBeard |beard oils, ]and moisturizers. When the queen herself saunters down, she looks a little confused at Aileh, before her expression warms up. You spare your ginger girlfriend a glance, clearing your throat. "Ah... sorry about my mom," Aileh explains. "I'm glad it all worked out okay in the end, though." Nyzerrah chuckles in a fashion similar to the dragon's own sultry tones, boobs quaking while her muscles do plenty of work showing off just how lovely they are. "Oh I don't mind; it only happened in the first place thanks to my own weakness. I was just thinking how jealous I am of you! And your partner at the same time..." She taps a chitinous digit and hums softly, glimmering wing-cape fluttering gently. "Perhaps I could persuade both of you into joining my harem?" Aileh laughs and shakes her head, though she doesn't need to do any explaining aloud; Nyzerrah's teasing is immediately interrupted by Azzy, the hornet knight looking abashed with a blush on her face as she tiptoes and pinches one of her mother's ears. "Moooom..." "Okay, okay! Fine. You can have them dear." The queen grins wickedly, as that statement has Azzy blushing near as hard as the flush creeping its way into Aileh's ears. "But you must share the juicy details, or let me watch." "We're going back upstairs now!" Azyrran huffs, pushing her mother and pouting. One of the attendants down between Aileh's legs is just finishing filing her toe-claws, a pleasant smile on her face, when [freja.name] comes charging up, covered in buzzlets. "Hi mommy, hi [pc.mf |daddy |mommy ]!" "Commander [freja.name]," Aileh and you give her a salute, smirking. "Gotten hungry?" "Uh-huh! I was just gonna say that, how'd you know?" Your daughter smiles, gently disentangling hornet children from her so that they can return to their families for [dayNight |an afternoon nap |bedtime ]. You slide out of your chair, feeling all manner of relaxed after having the knots worked out of your shoulders, your [pc.hasHair |hair brushed |head waxed ], and your face moisturized. "Because I can hear your tummy grumbling from here!" A lie, of course; it's just the way she's staring intently at the empty plate you and your girlfriend had been snacking from during pamper-time. [freja.name] gasps, scandalized, and hugs her tummy. "Weell..." Aileh giggles; a bright, girlish giggle that catches you both off-guard. At least until it settles into her customary, chocolate-silk chuckle. "Do you happen to have a kitchen?" She asks one of the hornets, which results in similar bubbly laughter. "We do, but also I don't think you have to worry about food... assuming you like honey, that is." Her smile is soft and motherly, and judging by how she towers a head higher than other hive knights, you're fairly sure you recognize her as one of queen Nyzzy's hive maidens. "I've been cooking and baking since you arrived, with a few of my helpers. We have a lot of mouths to feed, so it's a... robust facility? That, and I'm especially proud of my cooking; mother requested we spare no expense in making you feel satisfied any time you visit." [freja.name] audibly swallows, giving the massive milf her shiniest puppy-dragon eyes. "I do like honey. Please can I have some candy?" [silly |HRK! |Wow... ] Your daughter remains constantly impressive, perfectly timing that... just weaponizable look. The maiden clutches her chest, caving almost immediately. "Of course you may! I'll begin getting everyone's food, if you'd like to pick a chair to sit in, we'll bring it all out to you." Your daughter squeals happily and dashes off towards one of the benches by the honey-pool, dragging it over with an 'oooomph!' and insisting she has it all under control when you try getting up to help. Aileh grins and wraps her tail possessively around your ankle, winking at you. "All mine right now, no moving during pamper-time." [freja.name] finishes pulling over her chair with a huff and a puff, hopping up onto it and giggling when a hornet begins brushing out her tangled hair. "Ooooo I'm excited! Thankyou miss hornet!" The knight smiles and gives her a gentle ruffle, now having restored your daughter to something resembling neatness in preparation for her meal. While the three of you make some casual small talk, a series of trays are carried out, bringing with them the delicious scents of honey, roasted vegetables, and meat. The magnificent maiden's balancing all three platters, and she places two on yours and Aileh's laps, and the other she rests on hers while she sits next to [freja.name], so that your daughter isn't crushed by the feast on display. As expected, just about everything is honey-roasted; carrots, shallots, potatoes loaded with cream, cheese, and honey, and a great big haunch of ham each. To say the meal doesn't last long is an understatement; the four of you work together to demolish the feast with surgical precision, leaving nothing behind but a few ham-bones. [freja.name] in particular puts away a surprisingly vast amount of roasted carrots, to the point of tapping out, flopping on her back, and entering the beginning stages of a food coma after only a few minutes. Once the three of you have eaten your fill, the hive maiden studiously collects and stacks the plates, gives [freja.name] another fond ruffle, and heads out. "Did you have fun, my precious little treasure?" Aileh clambers up to sit next to [freja.name], who is now alternating between 'sleepy full tummy' and 'blood mostly sugar' thanks to all of the honey she's eaten. "Yesyesyes... so full, the little buzzles are so cute!" The older dragon gently lifts [freja.name] and hugs her close, resting chin on head. "Ready to go home so that you can get some sleep?" "But I'm not tired..." [freja.name] visibly fights down a yawn, face scrunching up. "Really? Your mom and [pc.mf |dad |mom ] are definitely tired," Aileh continues. "So..." "Aww, well, if you're both sleeeby..." [freja.name] grins, snuggling into her mom's chest. "Okay!"
rows.translation: [freja.name]很快，大量的黄蜂幼虫就被引入了她的生活中。当她努力扑动翅膀试图跟上它们的速度时，这些小黄蜂们开心地在她周围飞来飞去。很快，这就变成了一场游戏——仅仅依靠黄蜂们的帮助，试图让女儿飞起来，不过它们那轻巧的身体结构并没有提供太多活动空间。确实结果就是，大家抱作一团，而你的小龙似乎也特别喜欢成为他们玩耍“骑士与强盗”游戏时的移动堡垒——他们就是用包裹着布的木棍来模拟战斗的。当其中一个小家伙称她为“指挥官”时，她看起来开心极了。 [freja.name]没有什么能够阻止她将它们打造成一支秩序井然、充满活力的军队。 [freja.name]你们也不是唯一受到大量关注的人；应女王的命令，你和艾莉赫被安排了舒适的椅子坐，而蜂群的侍从、工蜂以及骑士们也都带来了文件、刷子、清洁工具和吹毛器。 [pc.hasBeard |胡须护理油 ]还有各种保湿产品。 当女王本人走下来时，她看着艾莉显得有些困惑，但很快她的表情就变得温暖起来。你瞥了眼你那位红发的女朋友，清了清嗓子。 “啊……关于我妈妈的事，真的很抱歉，”艾莉解释道，“不过我很高兴最后一切都解决了。” 尼泽拉发出了类似那条龙那般性感低沉的笑声，她的胸部随着笑声微微颤动，而她的肌肉也在不停地运动，展示着她那可爱极了他们确实是。“哦，我并不介意；这件事发生最初其实也是因为我的疏忽。我只是在想，我有多羡慕你啊！还有你的搭档……”她用那根覆满甲壳的指头轻轻敲击着，轻声哼唱着，那闪烁着微光的翼袍也轻轻摆动着。“也许我可以试着说服他们两者都难道你想让我把你纳入我的后宫吗？” 艾莉笑着摇了摇头，其实她根本不需要开口解释；尼泽拉的调侃话音刚落，阿齐这个 hornet knight 就立刻插话了。她满脸通红，显得有些尴尬，然后踮着脚尖捏了捏她母亲的耳朵。妈妈……” “好吧好吧！行啦，你可以得到它们，亲爱的。”女王坏笑着说道，这句话让阿齐的脸颊涨得通红，而艾莱耳的耳朵也仿佛被热气烫得发烫。“不过你得跟我分享那些有趣的细节，不然我就不让你得到了。我们现在要回楼上去了！”阿兹兰气呼呼地说，一边推着母亲，一边撅着嘴。 在艾莱赫脚边工作的其中一位侍者刚刚完成给她修剪脚趾甲的工作，脸上还带着愉快的笑容，就在这时[freja.name]飞快地冲了过来，身上覆盖着小绒毛。“嗨，妈妈，嗨[pc.mf |爸爸 |妈妈 ]！" "指挥官 [freja.name]艾莱和你向她敬礼，同时露出笑容。‘饿了吗？’” “嗯！我正想说这个呢，你怎么猜到的？”你的女儿笑着，轻轻地把那些“黄蜂小孩”从自己身上解下来，让他们能够回到各自的家人身边去。 [dayNight |午后的小憩 |就寝时间 ]你从椅子上滑下来，感到肩上的紧张情绪终于得到了缓解，整个人都放松了下来。 [pc.hasHair |头发已经梳理整齐了。 |头发打理得干净整齐 ]这样你的皮肤就能得到滋润了。”“因为我在这里都能听到你肚子在‘咕咕’叫呢！”当然，这只是个谎言；其实她只是紧紧地盯着你和你的女朋友在享受护理时候时用来吃零食的那个空盘子罢了。 [freja.name]倒抽着气，满脸震惊，然后抱住了自己的肚子，说道：“嗯……” 艾莱赫突然笑了起来，那是一种明亮、充满少女活力的笑声，让你们俩都有些措手不及。至少在她的笑声逐渐转变为那惯常的、柔和而低沉的笑声之前是这样。“你家里有厨房吗？她问其中一只黄蜂，结果引来了大家一阵类似的欢笑。 “我们确实需要食物，但我觉得你不必担心这个问题……当然，前提是你是喜欢蜂蜜的。”她的笑容温柔而充满母性，而从她比其他蜂群骑士高出许多的身高来看，你很确定她就是尼兹女王的蜂巢侍女之一。自从你来到这里，我就和我的一些帮手一起做饭、烘焙。我们有很多人需要喂养，所以我们的烹饪设施相当……齐全。而且，我对自己做的菜特别自豪；母亲特意要求我们不惜任何代价，确保你每次来访都能吃到令你满意的食物。" [freja.name]明显是故意咽了口口水，然后用那双充满魅力的大眼睛望着对方，说道：“我确实很喜欢糖果。请问能给我一些吗？ [silly |HRK！ |哇…… ]你的女儿确实总是让人印象深刻，她总能恰到好处地把握那个时机……真是太棒了。可被用作武器看…… 少女紧紧抓住自己的胸口，几乎立刻就崩溃了。“当然可以！我会去准备大家的饭菜，如果您想挑选一把椅子坐的话，我们会把椅子也拿过来给您。” 您的女儿高兴地尖叫一声，冲向蜂蜜池旁的一张长凳，嘿咻！一声把它拖了过来；你想起身帮忙时，她却坚称自己完全应付得来。艾莱赫咧嘴一笑，占有欲十足地用尾巴缠住你的脚踝，又冲你眨了眨眼：“现在你归我，享受宠爱时不许乱动哦。” [freja.name]气呼呼地拉过椅子，跳了上去，正当一只大黄蜂开始梳理她那乱蓬蓬的头发时，她忍不住咯咯笑了起来。“哦哦哦，太开心了！谢谢你，大黄蜂小姐！”骑士微笑着轻轻拍了拍她的头发，现在你的女儿已经重新整理得干干净净，可以准备吃饭了。 当你们三个人闲聊着时，一连串托盘被端了上来，空气中弥漫着蜂蜜、烤蔬菜和肉类的诱人香气。那位优雅的少女熟练地平衡着这三个托盘，将其中两个放在你和艾莱的腿上，而自己则拿着另一个托盘坐在旁边。 [freja.name]这样，你的女儿就不会因此而受到伤害。盛宴正在展出中。 正如预期的那样，几乎所有菜肴都采用了蜜烤的烹饪方法：胡萝卜、青葱、土豆都加入了奶油、奶酪和蜂蜜；每人都得到了一大块火腿。说这顿饭吃得很快，简直是一种轻描淡写的说法——你们四个人齐心协力，以极其高效的方式吃光了所有食物，最后只剩下几根火腿骨头。 [freja.name]尤其是，她会吃下数量惊人的烤胡萝卜，以至于仅仅几分钟之后，她就再也吃不下去了，直接仰面躺下，开始进入食物昏迷的状态。 等你们三个人吃饱之后，那位负责收拾餐具的少女就会认真地把盘子收起来并堆放好。 [freja.name]又是一阵轻柔的抚摸，然后它便离开了。 “玩得开心吗，我亲爱的小宝贝？”艾莱爬过来，坐在它旁边。 [freja.name]现在，他正在交替进行这两项工作。睡意袭来的饱腹感以及血液中的糖分含量多亏了她吃下了那么多甜食，才会这样啊。 “对对对……太饱了，这些小蜜蜂都太可爱了那条年长的龙轻轻地抬起了[freja.name]然后紧紧地将她抱在怀里，下巴搁在她的头上。“准备回家睡觉了吗？” “但我并不累[freja.name]明显强忍着哈欠，脸上挤出了痛苦的表情。 “真的吗？你妈妈和[pc.mf |爸爸 |妈妈 ]肯定都累坏了，”艾莱继续说道，“所以……” “哎呀，既然你们俩都这么累[freja.name]咧嘴笑了，依偎在妈妈的怀里：“好的！

rows.original: [flags.AILEH_DINNER_TS |Aileh grins, tail swishing around. "Mom still has an open invitation for dinner every week, how about it?" [freja.name] gasps from your shoulder, little wings flapping. "More maccacheese, and fruity pie?" Well, that certainly makes the decision easy for you, plus it's... nice, to see Kasyrra in the role of happy mother, instead of potential-[silly |endgame-boss |enemy ]. "Yeah, let's head on down. rows.original: [flags.AILEH_DINNER_TS |Demons dressed up as maids open the doors as the three of you approach, smiling sweetly with the unsettlingly-observant calm you'd expect from some kind of predator. It's honestly impressive how the boys and girls keep their respective natures tamped down, and the modest additions to their outfits look perfect. Of course, if you were to grab a dress and pull, most of the fabric would give up at the slightest bit of hesitation and reveal salacious lingerie... but the thought is nice. Bereft of lewdness, you're free to enter properly, where the massive, curvacious, muscular form of the demon Kasyrra waits. ...Wearing a fluffy jumper with depictions of little cows knitted into it. "Hi gramma!" [freja.name] cheers and flaps her wings, barreling into Kasy with a laugh, squealing with delight as she's lifted skyward, before being pulled right down into a squishy boob-hug, accompanied by plenty of noisy fake-smooches that have her flailing around in attempted escape. "Eee!" "Hello sweetie, have you been behaving?" "Uuh..." Your daughter glances side to side, twiddling her little claws before grinning toothily. "Yes! Probably!" "Eh, good enough," Kasyrra shrugs. "Let's get you all settled in for dinner, hmn?" While you're all making for the dining table, Aileh takes the opportunity to link arms with you and sneak a couple of kisses of her own before dinner. |You don't know how Kasyrra knew you were all coming so quickly, but entering her little dream palace is bereft of lewdness. A couple of demons are sauntering around, but they're fully dressed, cleaning the place, and otherwise smiling and waving at the three of you. Kasyrra puts their respective saunters to shame, even dressed modestly as she is. It turns out the crimson milf is impossible to stop sexualizing, even when she's wearing a casual dress, with a scarf around her neck, and her wings currently completely absent. "Ah! My darlings, it's so good to see you all..." She tosses back her shaggy black locks, grinning when [freja.name] mimics the motion with her own similarly shaggy hair. "And you are just a beautiful little girl! I swear you get bigger every time I see you!" "Hi Gramma!" [freja.name] gives her grandma — a statement that damned-near turns the demonic dragon-cow into a puddle — a leaping hug, snuggling in and wriggling until she's clambered atop her shoulders, holding onto horns for balance. "Hello indeed, how about we have ourselves a delicious meal? I'd love to hear what you've been learning recently." ]
rows.translation: [flags.AILEH_DINNER_TS |你们三人走近时，一群打扮成女仆的恶魔为你们打开大门，甜美地微笑着，神态却带着某种捕食者特有、令人不安的沉着与敏锐。说实话，无论男孩还是女孩，能把各自的天性压制得这么好都令人赞叹，他们服装上为保持端庄而增添的布料也显得无可挑剔。当然，如果你抓住一条裙子用力一扯，大部分布料稍受拉扯就会屈服，暴露出淫荡的内衣……不过心意是好的。 这里没有任何淫乱场面，你得以正经走入其中；身形庞大、曲线丰腴而肌肉结实的恶魔卡希拉正在里面等候。 ……身上还穿着一件织有小奶牛图案的蓬松毛衣。 “嗨，外婆！”[freja.name]欢呼着拍动双翼，大笑着猛冲进卡希怀中；她被举向高空时欣喜尖叫，随后又被拉下来，埋进柔软的乳房接受拥抱。卡希还伴以一连串响亮的假亲亲，惹得她手舞足蹈，试图逃脱。“咿——！” “你好呀，甜心，最近有没有乖乖的？” “呃……”你的女儿左看右看，摆弄着小爪子，随后咧嘴露出尖牙。“有！大概有！” “唔，够好了。”卡希拉耸耸肩。“让大家都坐好吃晚饭，嗯？” 众人走向餐桌时，艾莱赫趁机挽住你的手臂，在晚餐前偷亲了你好几下。 |你不知道卡希拉怎么会这么快就知道你们都要来，但她的小小梦之宫殿里全无淫乱场面。几个恶魔迈着招摇的步子四处走动，不过全都穿戴整齐，正忙着清洁宫殿，还会向你们三人微笑挥手。 即使穿着端庄，卡希拉的步态也令他们全都相形见绌。事实证明，这名绯红色的辣妈根本不可能不被人以色情眼光看待，哪怕她穿着休闲连衣裙，颈间围着围巾，双翼此刻也完全不见踪影。“啊！我的宝贝们，见到你们真是太好了……” 她将乱蓬蓬的黑发甩向身后；看到[freja.name]用同样蓬乱的头发模仿这个动作，她不禁咧嘴一笑。“而你真是个漂亮的小姑娘！我发誓，每次见到你，你都会长大一些！” “嗨，外婆！”[freja.name]飞扑着抱住外婆——这个称呼差点令恶魔龙牛融化成一摊水——她依偎着来回扭动，直到爬上卡希拉肩头，抓住双角保持平衡。 “确实该说你好。不如我们一起享用一顿美餐？我很想听听你最近学了些什么。” ]
