rows.original: [flags.AILEH_DINNER_TS |As before, and despite the unannounced nature of your arrival, the table is set with a magnificent amount of food; cheese and bacon pasta, fresh-baked crusty bread, a random assortment of compound butters and confit garlic. Bottles of wine and juice, with glasses already filled to the brim in anticipation of a long [dayNight |lunch |dinner ], and you're sure there will be dessert waiting yet again in the wings for you all to take home. With Kasyrra sat next to [freja.name], while you and Aileh sit side-by-side, you all enjoy the wholesome family moment. Your daughter does her best to eat slowly and sensibly, but it takes only a few moments for all resistance to break down so that she can get more cheese in her maw at a greater pace. Kasyrra and Aileh, as usual, enjoy their unspoken contest to see who can pack away the most food... Of course, you do plenty of eating yourself, but most of your attention is on the people you're eating with; a happy daughter, a loving girlfriend, and... whatever you can call the strange relationship between you and Kasyrra. How much would you have missed out, if you'd never had [freja.name]? Never opened your heart to Aileh? Before those thoughts have a chance to turn melancholy, you stuff them down with another bread-loaded handful of melted, creamy cheese. And you could swear Kasy winks at you between forkfuls of her own food. By the time you've all finished, you've broken out in a sweat, and your stomach is filled to absolute capacity... any more than this, and you'll officially step into the realm of 'internal discomfort'. "Did you enjoy yourselves?" Kasyrra sighs, stretching— once again the unspoken victor of her mommy-daughter eating competition. She gets wordless groans of agreement from the three of you, patting full bellies and trying not to hiccup or burp. Particularly when [freja.name] or Aileh might set fire to the tablecloth with such an action. "Hah, I'll go pack up the pie for you to take home. After 'Gramma' gets her smooch, of course!" Kasyrra gives her giggling grandaughter a peck on the forehead, which the dragonling returns with a quick hug around her shoulders and a noisy 'muah!' across the cheek. "Wish I could cook like that," Aileh sighs. "Then again, we'd not have as good an excuse to come visit if I did." "An' I'd get all fat!" [freja.name] snickers, rubbing her tummy enthusiastically. You can't stay for too long, and so Kasy makes sure you all leave with a basket loaded up with leftover cheesy bread, and an entire pie. Aileh and [freja.name] head off first, hand-in-hand, while the demon pats you gently on the arm. "How about one day you give me another daughter, hmm?" Her tone of voice is teasing, but the look she's giving you is anything but. You need to be careful around this woman. |Where did this dining room table even come from? Regardless, it's richly appointed, with a dish that would barely fit in most ovens merrily bubbling and steaming at its center. The rich gooey smell of melted cheese is a siren call, and the whole thing is loaded through-and-through with crispy chunks of bacon. Each of you has a plate, a bowl of buttery, crusty bread to scoop the 'maccy-cheese' onto your plates, you, Aileh, and Kasyrra have a glass of wine, and [freja.name] has some blueberry and cherry juice in a wine glass so that she doesn't feel left out. Kasyrra sits next to [freja.name], while you and Aileh sit opposite, [pc.hasTail |tails entwined |giving one-another the occasional leg-squeeze ]. "No need to worry or think about anything; I expect empty plates, empty heads, and full tummies." [pc.isBimbo |PFFT. Like an empty head is ever an issue for you. ]Digging into the feast sets your senses on fire; rich cheeses, salty meat, juicy, plump pasta noodles... Despite how overwhelming the size of the meal looked, the four of you devour it before your stomach has a chance to realize how stuffed it is. [freja.name] is first to tap out, rubbing a plump tummy with one hand and stifling burps with the other— a feat which makes smoke trickle from her nose, making Kasyrra burst out into rich laughter. You're actually sweating by the time you finish, stomach pleasantly at the limits of 'too full for comfort', while Aileh appears to be in some kind of determined challenge to match her mother mouthful for mouthful. Your redheaded girlfriend has to cave eventually, though, sighing and letting her head droop back. "Are you cheating with magic somehow?" "One day you'll match me for capacity; but today is not that day." Kasy smiles softly, looking over the three of you. "All satisfied?" You all groan something similar to assent, and she smirks. "That's a shame, and I had a hot apple pie coated in custard and sugar ready." [freja.name] valiantly [silly |sploots |sprawls ] herself out across the table, blinking a few times. "I-I want pie..." "How about taking that to go, mom?" Aileh asks, grinning bashfully at you. "I'm stuffed, even though that sounds wonderful." Kasyrra smiles and gets up from the table, rolling her shoulders and slowly picking up plates before any of the nearby maid demons get a chance to take on whatever it is that she sees as motherly duties. "Of course." While she's gone, humming a tune as she goes, Aileh lets out the most unwomanly burp she can, snickering when it makes [freja.name] hiccup and giggle. "This was nice, it's always easy to forget what she's capable of when the rest of the world moves so fast. Definitely a full tummy and an empty head today, right dear heart?" You nod an agreement, leaning in to give her a kiss, at which [freja.name] makes a soft 'eeeewww...'. You can't stay for too long, but Kasy makes sure you all leave with a basket loaded up with leftover cheesy bread, and an entire pie. Aileh and [freja.name] head off first, hand-in-hand, while the demon pats you gently on the arm. "How about one day you give me another daughter, hmm?" Her tone of voice is teasing, but the look she's giving you is anything but. You need to be careful around this woman. ]
rows.translation: [flags.AILEH_DINNER_TS |和以往一样，尽管你的到来并没有事先通知，餐桌上还是摆满了丰富的食物：奶酪和培根意面、新鲜出炉的脆面包、各式各样的黄油和腌蒜。还有装满葡萄酒和果汁的瓶子，玻璃杯里都已经倒满了酒，仿佛在期待一场漫长的聚会。 [dayNight |午餐 |晚餐 ]而且，你们可以肯定，还会有甜点等着你们带回家去。 卡希拉就坐在旁边[freja.name]当你和艾莱并坐在一起时，全家人都沉浸在这温馨的家庭时光中。你的女儿也尽力地慢慢吃饭、有节制地进食，但仅仅过了几分钟，她的所有克制就都被打破了，于是她开始以更快的速度往嘴里塞奶酪。卡希拉和艾莱，像往常一样，正在展开一场无声的竞赛，看谁能够吃掉最多的食物…… 当然，你自己也会吃很多，但你的注意力主要集中在与你一起吃饭的人身上——一个快乐的女儿，一个充满爱意的女友…………无论你如何定义你与卡希拉之间那种奇怪的关系。如果你从未经历过它，你会错过多少东西啊，[freja.name]？ 你从未向艾莱敞开心扉吗？ 就在这些念头开始变得忧郁之前，你又用一大把涂满融化奶酪的面包将它们压了下去。 而你，其实是可以的发誓卡西在吃着自己盘中的食物时，还不时朝你眨眨眼。 等到你们所有人都吃完饭，早已满头大汗，肚子也塞得再也装不下任何东西了……再多吃一点的话，那就真的会进入“肠胃不适”的状态了。 你们玩得开心吗？”卡希拉叹了口气，伸了个懒腰——又一次，在这场母女间的“进食比赛”中，她成为了那个无声的赢家。 你们三个都默默地点了点头，表示同意，同时拍着鼓起的肚子，努力不让自己打嗝或放屁。尤其是当[freja.name]时否则，艾莉赫可能会因为这样的举动而点燃桌布。 “哈哈，我去把派打包好让你带回家吧。当然要等‘奶奶’亲完之后才行！”卡希拉笑着轻吻了一下她那咯咯笑的孙女，而小龙女孩则回以一个紧紧的拥抱，还发出一阵欢快的叫声。呜哇！真希望自己也能那样做饭啊，”艾莉叹道，“不过那样的话，我们就没什么借口再来拜访了。” “而且我肯定会变胖的！ [freja.name]咯咯笑着，兴奋地揉着自己的肚子。 “你不能留下来太时间很长，因此卡西会确保大家都能带走装满剩余的奶酪面包和一整个派的食物。艾莱和[freja.name]一边并肩前行，一边有恶魔轻轻拍着你的手臂：“怎么样，有空的时候一起去我又一个女儿啊，嗯？” 她的语气带着调侃，但看你的眼神绝对不是你得小心这个女人。 |这张餐厅餐桌到底是从哪里来的呢？不管怎样，它的装饰非常豪华，上面的餐具也相当精致勉强合适在大多数烤箱里，食物都在中心部位欢快地沸腾着、冒着蒸汽。融化的奶酪散发出的浓郁香气简直像是一种诱惑，而整个食物里还嵌满了酥脆的培根块。每个人面前都有一盘碗、一碗碗涂了黄油的面包，用来将那些“奶酪通心粉”舀到自己的盘子里。而你、艾莱和卡希拉，还各自拿着一杯葡萄酒。 [freja.name]在酒杯里加入了一些蓝莓汁和樱桃汁，这样就不会觉得被冷落了。 卡希拉坐在她旁边。 [freja.name]而你和艾莱则相对而坐[pc.hasTail |彼此交织在一起 |偶尔互相捏捏腿脚 ]无需担心或考虑任何事情；我只需要空盘子、空脑袋，以及吃饱的肚子。 [pc.isBimbo |哎呀，真是的。空脑壳对你来说，这从来都不是什么问题。 ]品尝这些美食简直让人的感官为之疯狂：浓郁的奶酪、咸香的肉类、多汁饱满的意大利面……尽管这些食物的分量看起来相当庞大，但你们四个人还是在胃部还没来得及感到饱腹之前就把它们全部吃光了。 [freja.name]是第一个停下来的，一只手揉着圆鼓鼓的肚子，另一只手则努力抑制着打嗝的声音——这一举动甚至让她的鼻子里冒出了烟，惹得卡希拉放声大笑起来。 等到你终于完成这个动作时，其实已经满头大汗了，而你的肚子也已经被锻炼得达到了极限状态。太满足于现状而无法寻求进步而艾莉似乎也在决心要与她母亲一较高下，一言不发地回应着对方的每一句话。不过，你的红发女友最终还是不得不屈服了，她叹了口气，把头靠了回去。“你该不会是在用什么魔法作弊吧？总有一天，你们的能力会赶上我；但今天还不是那天。”卡西温柔地笑着，目光扫过你们三人，“大家都满意了吗？” 你们都发出了类似赞同的呻吟声，她便得意地笑了起来。真遗憾，我本来准备了一份热腾腾的苹果派，上面还涂了蛋奶糖浆和糖呢。 [freja.name]英勇地[silly |大量涌现 |四处蔓延 ]她自己走到了桌子对面，眨了几下眼睛：“我……我想吃派……” “妈妈，要不我们把派带走吧？”艾莱羞涩地笑着对你说，“我已经吃饱了，不过听起来还是很好吃的。 卡希拉微笑着从桌边站起身，耸了耸肩，然后开始慢慢地收拾盘子——在周围的那些女仆恶魔有机会来承担她认为属于“母亲职责”的这些事情之前。“当然。 在她离开的时候，一边哼着小曲，艾莉赫突然打了一个极其不女性化的嗝，听到自己发出的声音后，她不禁暗自笑了起来。 [freja.name]嘿嘿，真有趣。当周围的一切都变化得如此迅速时，人们很容易忘记她其实拥有什么样的能力。今天，肯定是吃得太饱，脑子反而变空了，对吧，亲爱的？” 你点了点头表示同意，然后凑过去吻了她一下。 [freja.name]发出轻柔的声音呃……你不能留下来。太虽然过程有些漫长，但卡西一定会确保每个人都能带走装满剩余奶酪面包的篮子，以及整整一个派。艾莱和[freja.name]一边并肩前行，一边有恶魔轻轻拍着你的手臂：“怎么样，有空的时候你也可以我又一个女儿啊，嗯？” 她的语气带着调侃，但看你的眼神完全不是那样你得小心这个女人。 ]
rows.raw: " [flags.AILEH_DINNER_TS |As before, and despite the unannounced nature of your arrival, the table is set with a magnificent amount of food; cheese and bacon pasta, fresh-baked crusty bread, a random assortment of compound butters and confit garlic. Bottles of wine and juice, with glasses already filled to the brim in anticipation of a long [dayNight |lunch |dinner ], and you're sure there will be dessert waiting yet again in the wings for you all to take home. With Kasyrra sat next to [freja.name], while you and Aileh sit side-by-side, you all enjoy the wholesome family moment. Your daughter does her best to eat slowly and sensibly, but it takes only a few moments for all resistance to break down so that she can get more cheese in her maw at a greater pace. Kasyrra and Aileh, as usual, enjoy their unspoken contest to see who can pack away the most food... Of course, you do plenty of eating yourself, but most of your attention is on the people you're eating with; a happy daughter, a loving girlfriend, and... whatever you can call the strange relationship between you and Kasyrra. How much would you have missed out, if you'd never had [freja.name]? Never opened your heart to Aileh? Before those thoughts have a chance to turn melancholy, you stuff them down with another bread-loaded handful of melted, creamy cheese. And you could swear Kasy winks at you between forkfuls of her own food. By the time you've all finished, you've broken out in a sweat, and your stomach is filled to absolute capacity... any more than this, and you'll officially step into the realm of 'internal discomfort'. "Did you enjoy yourselves?" Kasyrra sighs, stretching— once again the unspoken victor of her mommy-daughter eating competition. She gets wordless groans of agreement from the three of you, patting full bellies and trying not to hiccup or burp. Particularly when [freja.name] or Aileh might set fire to the tablecloth with such an action. "Hah, I'll go pack up the pie for you to take home. After 'Gramma' gets her smooch, of course!" Kasyrra gives her giggling grandaughter a peck on the forehead, which the dragonling returns with a quick hug around her shoulders and a noisy 'muah!' across the cheek. "Wish I could cook like that," Aileh sighs. "Then again, we'd not have as good an excuse to come visit if I did." "An' I'd get all fat!" [freja.name] snickers, rubbing her tummy enthusiastically. You can't stay for too long, and so Kasy makes sure you all leave with a basket loaded up with leftover cheesy bread, and an entire pie. Aileh and [freja.name] head off first, hand-in-hand, while the demon pats you gently on the arm. "How about one day you give me another daughter, hmm?" Her tone of voice is teasing, but the look she's giving you is anything but. You need to be careful around this woman. |Where did this dining room table even come from? Regardless, it's richly appointed, with a dish that would barely fit in most ovens merrily bubbling and steaming at its center. The rich gooey smell of melted cheese is a siren call, and the whole thing is loaded through-and-through with crispy chunks of bacon. Each of you has a plate, a bowl of buttery, crusty bread to scoop the 'maccy-cheese' onto your plates, you, Aileh, and Kasyrra have a glass of wine, and [freja.name] has some blueberry and cherry juice in a wine glass so that she doesn't feel left out. Kasyrra sits next to [freja.name], while you and Aileh sit opposite, [pc.hasTail |tails entwined |giving one-another the occasional leg-squeeze ]. "No need to worry or think about anything; I expect empty plates, empty heads, and full tummies." [pc.isBimbo |PFFT. Like an empty head is ever an issue for you. ]Digging into the feast sets your senses on fire; rich cheeses, salty meat, juicy, plump pasta noodles... Despite how overwhelming the size of the meal looked, the four of you devour it before your stomach has a chance to realize how stuffed it is. [freja.name] is first to tap out, rubbing a plump tummy with one hand and stifling burps with the other— a feat which makes smoke trickle from her nose, making Kasyrra burst out into rich laughter. You're actually sweating by the time you finish, stomach pleasantly at the limits of 'too full for comfort', while Aileh appears to be in some kind of determined challenge to match her mother mouthful for mouthful. Your redheaded girlfriend has to cave eventually, though, sighing and letting her head droop back. "Are you cheating with magic somehow?" "One day you'll match me for capacity; but today is not that day." Kasy smiles softly, looking over the three of you. "All satisfied?" You all groan something similar to assent, and she smirks. "That's a shame, and I had a hot apple pie coated in custard and sugar ready." [freja.name] valiantly [silly |sploots |sprawls ] herself out across the table, blinking a few times. "I-I want pie..." "How about taking that to go, mom?" Aileh asks, grinning bashfully at you. "I'm stuffed, even though that sounds wonderful." Kasyrra smiles and gets up from the table, rolling her shoulders and slowly picking up plates before any of the nearby maid demons get a chance to take on whatever it is that she sees as motherly duties. "Of course." While she's gone, humming a tune as she goes, Aileh lets out the most unwomanly burp she can, snickering when it makes [freja.name] hiccup and giggle. "This was nice, it's always easy to forget what she's capable of when the rest of the world moves so fast. Definitely a full tummy and an empty head today, right dear heart?" You nod an agreement, leaning in to give her a kiss, at which [freja.name] makes a soft 'eeeewww...'. You can't stay for too long, but Kasy makes sure you all leave with a basket loaded up with leftover cheesy bread, and an entire pie. Aileh and [freja.name] head off first, hand-in-hand, while the demon pats you gently on the arm. "How about one day you give me another daughter, hmm?" Her tone of voice is teasing, but the look she's giving you is anything but. You need to be careful around this woman. ] "

rows.original: You take a brief moment to go through your finances, [wayfort.hasDaliza |receiving a few figures from the vault guard Daliza's posted |taking stock of the filthy lucre that you've gathered over the course of your adventures and stashed away ]. When you're done, the current status of your finances is as such: [var2 0 1 6000 30000 60000 120000 250000 450000 700000 | There's absolutely nothing in your vault, not so much as a single copper coin, let alone an electrum. No, the only thing that you've got behind that heavy secure portcullis is dust and cobwebs, which [wayfort.hasDaliza |makes the existence of the poor guard Daliza's posted by the vault even more dreary and miserable as the make-work is blatantly obvious |just makes it look all the sadder, an emptiness that gnaws at your pride if you've got any to begin with ]. Either you really like keeping all your money on your person, or you really don't have a single coin to your name. All the more power to you, then. | You've got a small pile of electrum arrayed on one of the large wooden pallets. Certainly nothing to sneeze at by the standards of most people, but a little underwhelming for [pc.isBaron |a marcher-baron[pc.mf | |ess ] |someone who's laid claim to this fine piece of real estate ]. It certainly isn't doing you any favors, [wayfort.hasDaliza |given that the treasury guard Daliza's posted doesn't look any less bored for it |nor is it very assuaging to your pride in your station ]. Well, if nothing else, it's encouragement for you to do better, be it at earning money or letting go of the compulsion to keep it all on your person, whichever is more relevant to your situation. You do intend to put more away, right? | The amount of coin that you've amassed in the treasury has just about filled one of the pallets and is starting to spill over onto the next. While still not quite a fabled hoard of legend, this is starting to look more respectable for a [pc.isBaron |marcher-baron[pc.mf | |ess ] |local land[pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]; someone's gone to the trouble of compulsively counting each and every coin and stacking them up neatly. [wayfort.hasDaliza |The prime suspect is probably Daliza's treasury guard, who certainly has the motive and opportunity for such villainy. |Maybe someone else did it, but you certainly don't remember sitting down and devoting the awful amount of time arranging the money like that would have taken. Does cash naturally arrange itself into such forms when left alone for a while? ] Whatever the case, there's enough here for whatever emergency funding the Wayfort might need while you're out there about your business. Presumably your tenants aren't going to be utilizing it frivolously, and more importantly, if they do, it'd better damn well be back by the time you next check your finances. | Now this is starting to look more respectable. Sequestered away in neat stacks, the filthy lucre that you've amassed since your arrival in the Frost Marches has filled the entirety of one pallet and is spilling over into the next two; [wayfort.hasDaliza |even the treasury guard Daliza's posted is starting to look a little less bored and is paying somewhat more attention to the job at hand |there's a distinct sense of satisfaction that comes with a job well done like this ]. The dim light just causes the piles of electrum to glint and glisten all the more seductively — while there might not be enough here to tempt a full-blown heist, it's certainly enough to warrant more than the average petty thief. You briefly estimate that there might be enough here for a fortnight's worth of operating expenses for the Wayfort if all income were to be suddenly cut off, maybe a whole month if you tried to stretch it out. | This is starting to look more like it. The stacked coinage in your vault fills three whole pallets, ancient wood and mortar stoically bearing the weight of wealth as they did in the past. If you wanted to, you could lie down in the piles and make a bed of your wealth — not that it would be seemly to do so, of course, but it's a privilege that few people possess. Why not enjoy the little things in life while you can? Come to think of it, you've never actually stacked the coins, and even if you wanted to, doing so would take an inordinate amount of time... so why do they look so neat? Do they simply arrange themselves like that over time, or is someone playing a prank on you? Maybe it's one of the greatest magical mysteries of the world... | The amount of electrum in your treasury has gotten to the point where it's starting to overflow the pallets — not that there's no more space for them, but the stacks and piles certainly appear more aesthetically pleasing if they're allowed to spill a little, like a cup running over. An entire corner of the vault is covered in cold, hard cash, but it was clearly designed for more — leading to questions about who occupied the Wayfort before you did. At this point, it could be possible to give out small loans to petitioners in need, but given the ability of the average marcher to repay them in coin rather than in kind maybe that's not such a great idea. Or maybe it is — news of the wealth you're amassing has got to be spreading, right?[wayfort.hasDaliza | You personally suspect the boredom Daliza's posted guard is affecting is a facade at this point, but there's no way to prove it... ] | The pile of coinage you've amassed over the course of your adventure has grown to the point where if you were to stand in it, the side of lucre would reach your waist. Filling about half to two-thirds of the floor space in the vault proper, it's gotten to the point where all pretense of fitting the lot on the pallets has been dropped and the stacks simply do as they please, like grain in a silo. With so much money in one place, the real concern isn't kobolds, thieves or raiders; it's the risk of attracting treasure bugs. At least you can see the former coming; with the latter you just wake up one day to discover that all your lovely coinage is now a mass of shiny beetles. Facing down a bunch of Sailgraves raiders is probably preferable to that mess... sure, treasure bugs are edible and taste great, but that kind of silver lining would be really thin if your hoard were to be devoured... | All the money you've put away in the vault neatly and evenly covers the entirety of the old masonry floor, to the point where you could be buried up to your chest in your own wealth. Several different kinds of coinage are present in this hoard you've amassed, which represents about a year's operating expenses for the Wayfort as a whole, maybe a little less if you were a bit more generous with the luxuries. Taking this much currency out of circulation for no other purpose than to be admired is admittedly a bit concerning, but everyone's still finding old imperial caches and the like in addition to what's being minted by every two bit-warlord staking a claim down in the heartlands and more... surely you hoarding all this money wouldn't make any significant dent in the amount in circulation, right? Right? Maybe this is what it feels like to be a dragon out of legend... | Okay, you've done it. If someone had told you there was all this electrum in the entirety of the Marches, you wouldn't have believed them, but there is and it's all here in your vault. There's enough here to cover the entire floor to a depth that'd rise above your head, and it wouldn't be wrong to call this a [silly |money bin |dragon's hoard ] at this point. How the people of the Marches haven't already been reduced to barter thanks to you hoarding all the liquid currency in one place is beyond you, but the glittering trove that you've amassed in your treasury is enough to inspire awe and envy at the same time.[wayfort.hasDaliza | Even the guard Daliza's posted can't keep up the sullen act all the time now, not in the face of such wonder. ] Rich beyond compare and [pc.isBaron |even your newly-minted station as baron[pc.mf | |ess ] |station ], the only worry you'll ever have is losing it. Hope you can sleep well at night. ] In addition to your current hoard, your investments, taxes, tribute and other sources of income are generating [var0] electrum every ten days, with [var1] awaiting collection; [wayfort.hasDaliza |Daliza |Rumie ]'s making sure that it'll be delivered straight to your vault without fuss and added to your total.
rows.translation: 你花了一点时间来查看自己的财务状况。 [wayfort.hasDaliza |从金库守卫达尔扎那里得到了一些数字。 |盘点一下你在这些冒险经历中积攒起来并藏起来的那些巨额财富吧。 ]当你完成这些操作后，你的当前财务状况将会是如下所示： [var2 0 1 6000 30000 60000 120000 250000 450000 700000 | 你的金库里什么都没有，连一枚铜币都没有，更别提什么琥珀金币了。不，那扇沉重的、坚固的栅门后面，只有灰尘和蜘蛛网而已[wayfort.hasDaliza |这使得那些被安排在金库附近工作的穷苦守卫们的生活变得更加凄惨和压抑，因为这些工作根本就是徒劳无益的，这一点显而易见。 |这只会让一切看起来更加令人难过，那种空虚感会侵蚀你的自尊心——如果你还有一丝自尊心的话。 ]要么你是真的喜欢把所有的钱都带在身上，要么就是你真的一分钱都没有。那么，不管你是属于哪种情况，都说明你很有魄力啊。 | 你在一块大木托盘上放了一小堆电银。按照大多数人的标准来看，这确实不算什么值得炫耀的东西，但相对来说还是有点让人失望吧[pc.isBaron |一位领有封地的骑士[pc.mf | |ess ] |某个声称拥有这块绝佳土地的人 ]这显然没有给你带来任何好处。 [wayfort.hasDaliza |鉴于国库卫队成员达莉莎发布的内容看起来也丝毫没有减少她的无聊感…… |这也不会让你对自己目前的地位感到多么自豪。 ]嗯，至少这也是一种鼓励，激励你去做得更好——无论是赚更多的钱，还是放下那种把所有东西都据为己有的强迫心理，无论哪一点更符合你的实际情况。总之，这是一种激励。你确实是想存下更多的钱，对吧？ | 你储存在金库中的金币数量已经差不多填满了一个托盘，而且开始往另一个托盘上溢出来了。虽然还远远称不上是传说中那种庞大的财宝，但这样的数量也已经相当可观了。 [pc.isBaron |领主骑士[pc.mf | |ess ] |本地土地[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ] ]有人竟然费心地把每一枚硬币都仔细地数一遍，然后把它们整齐地堆放起来。 [wayfort.hasDaliza |主要嫌疑犯很可能是达莉莎的财务主管，他确实有动机也有机会犯下这样的罪行。 |也许是别人做的，但你肯定不记得自己曾经花那么多的时间来把那些钱整理成那样的样子。难道把现金放在那里不管，它就会自动整理成那种形状吗？ ] 无论如何，这些资金足以满足荒废驿堡在您外出处理事务期间可能出现的任何紧急资金需求。想必您的租户们也不会滥用这些钱，更重要的是，如果他们真的需要使用这些资金的话确实最好在你下次查看财务状况时，它已经回来了。 | 现在，这一切看起来确实显得体面多了。那些你自来到霜冻边境以来积攒下来的肮脏财富，被整齐地堆放在一起，一个托盘已经装满了，还溢出了，蔓延到了另外两个托盘上。 [wayfort.hasDaliza |就连国库护卫达莉莎，看起来也不再那么无聊了，她也开始更加认真地对待手头的工作。 |当一项工作完成得如此出色时，人们确实会感受到一种难以言喻的满足感。 ]昏暗的光线使得那些堆放着的电金闪烁着更加诱人的光芒——虽然这里的电金数量可能不足以引发一场大规模的盗窃案，但至少足以吸引那些不择手段的小偷们。 你粗略地估算了一下：如果荒废驿堡的组织突然失去了所有收入来源，这些电金或许足以维持两周的运营开支；而如果设法节省开支，甚至可能够用整整一个月。 | 现在看起来确实越来越像了。你金库里的那些硬币堆满了整整三个托盘，那些古老的木头和灰泥依旧像过去一样，坚毅地承载着这些财富的重量。如果你愿意的话，甚至可以躺在这些财富堆上面，把它们当作床铺来使用——当然，这样做其实并不合适，但这种特权确实只有少数人才能拥有。为什么不在有时间的时候享受生活中的这些小乐趣呢？ 仔细想想，你其实从来都没有真正把那些硬币整齐地堆放起来过，而且即使你想这么做，也会花费大量的时间……那么，为什么那些硬币看起来总是那么整齐呢？它们是随着时间的推移自然而然地排列成那样的，还是有人在捉弄你呢？也许这就是世界上最神奇的谜团之一了…… | 你仓库中的电银数量已经多到开始溢出托盘了——并不是说托盘没有足够的空间，只是如果让这些电银稍微溢出来一些，看起来会更有美感，就像杯子里的液体稍微溢出来一样。金库的整整一个角落都堆满了冰冷的现金，但显然，这个空间原本是为存放更多东西而设计的——这就让人不禁怀疑，在你之前，究竟是谁居住在荒废驿堡这里。 在这种情况下，或许可以为那些有需要的请愿者提供小额贷款，但考虑到普通游行者更倾向于用现金而非实物来偿还这些贷款，这个想法或许并不那么可行。或者，也许正是这样——你正在积累的财富肯定已经传开了，对吧？[wayfort.hasDaliza | 你现在个人怀疑，达莉莎所声称的那些无聊事情其实只是表面现象，但根本没有任何办法能够证明这一点…… ] | 在你漫长的冒险过程中，你积累的那些硬币已经多到这样的程度：如果你站在其中，那些金钱堆的边缘就会达到你的腰部。这些硬币占据了金库内大约一半到三分之二的地面空间，以至于根本不可能再将它们整齐地堆放在托盘上了，它们就那么随意地堆放着，就像仓库里的粮食一样。 当这么多钱聚集在同一个地方时，真正需要担心的并不是狗头人、小偷或强盗，而是那些会吸引宝藏虫的风险。至少前几种威胁你还能看得见；而对于宝藏虫来说，你可能某天一觉醒来，就会发现自己所有那些珍贵的硬币全都变成了一群闪闪发光的甲虫。面对一群“航海死者”劫掠者，总比陷入那种混乱要好……当然，那些宝藏虫是可以吃的，而且味道也不错，但如果你积攒的财宝真的被他们抢走了，这种“积极的方面”也就没什么意义了…… | 你把所有钱整齐地存放在金库里，这些钱足以覆盖整个旧石砌地面，事实上，如果你躺下去，你的胸部可能会被自己的财富埋住。这些积攒起来的钱里包含了多种不同的硬币，这些钱大概相当于整个荒废驿堡机构一年运营所需的费用，当然，如果你在奢侈品上的开销再大一些，这个数字可能会稍微少一些。 将如此大量的货币从流通中撤出，仅仅只是为了让人对其产生赞赏，这确实有点令人担忧。不过，除了那些在内地宣称拥有统治权的军阀们所铸造的货币之外，人们仍然在不断发现那些古老的帝国藏匿的货币等等。……你把这么多钱都囤起来，总不会对流通中的货币总量产生什么显著影响吧？对吧？ 也许，这就是传说中龙的感觉吧…… | 好了，你做到了。如果有人告诉你，在整个边境地区竟然有这么多电银，你肯定不会相信的，但事实就是如此，而这些电银全都存放在你的金库里。这里的电银数量多到足以让整个地面被覆盖，覆盖的深度甚至会超过你的头部——说这里是一座“电银矿场”也毫不为过。 [silly |钱箱 |龙的宝藏 ]在这种情况下，那些边境地区的居民居然还没有因为你们把所有流通货币都集中在一处而被迫进行物物交换，这确实让人无法理解。不过，你们在国库中积攒的那些闪闪发光的财富，确实足以同时引发人们的敬畏与嫉妒。[wayfort.hasDaliza | 就连达莉莎这样的守卫，面对如此惊人的景象，也难以一直保持那种阴沉的表情了。 ] 富可敌国，而且[pc.isBaron |就连你新获得的男爵头衔也无法改变这一事实。[pc.mf | |ess ] |车站 ]你唯一需要担心的，就是可能会弄丢它。希望你晚上能睡个好觉。 ] 除了你现有的财富之外，你的投资、税收、贡品以及其他收入来源也是你的财富来源。生成中[var0]每十天提取一次电银。 [var1]待领取; [wayfort.hasDaliza |达莉莎 |露米 ]系统会确保这些物品直接被送到你的仓库中，不会产生任何麻烦，并且会自动计入你的总数中。
rows.raw: " You take a brief moment to go through your finances, [wayfort.hasDaliza |receiving a few figures from the vault guard Daliza's posted |taking stock of the filthy lucre that you've gathered over the course of your adventures and stashed away ]. When you're done, the current status of your finances is as such: [var2 0 1 6000 30000 60000 120000 250000 450000 700000 | There's absolutely nothing in your vault, not so much as a single copper coin, let alone an electrum. No, the only thing that you've got behind that heavy secure portcullis is dust and cobwebs, which [wayfort.hasDaliza |makes the existence of the poor guard Daliza's posted by the vault even more dreary and miserable as the make-work is blatantly obvious |just makes it look all the sadder, an emptiness that gnaws at your pride if you've got any to begin with ]. Either you really like keeping all your money on your person, or you really don't have a single coin to your name. All the more power to you, then. | You've got a small pile of electrum arrayed on one of the large wooden pallets. Certainly nothing to sneeze at by the standards of most people, but a little underwhelming for [pc.isBaron |a marcher-baron[pc.mf | |ess ] |someone who's laid claim to this fine piece of real estate ]. It certainly isn't doing you any favors, [wayfort.hasDaliza |given that the treasury guard Daliza's posted doesn't look any less bored for it |nor is it very assuaging to your pride in your station ]. Well, if nothing else, it's encouragement for you to do better, be it at earning money or letting go of the compulsion to keep it all on your person, whichever is more relevant to your situation. You do intend to put more away, right? | The amount of coin that you've amassed in the treasury has just about filled one of the pallets and is starting to spill over onto the next. While still not quite a fabled hoard of legend, this is starting to look more respectable for a [pc.isBaron |marcher-baron[pc.mf | |ess ] |local land[pc.mf |lord |lady ] ]; someone's gone to the trouble of compulsively counting each and every coin and stacking them up neatly. [wayfort.hasDaliza |The prime suspect is probably Daliza's treasury guard, who certainly has the motive and opportunity for such villainy. |Maybe someone else did it, but you certainly don't remember sitting down and devoting the awful amount of time arranging the money like that would have taken. Does cash naturally arrange itself into such forms when left alone for a while? ] Whatever the case, there's enough here for whatever emergency funding the Wayfort might need while you're out there about your business. Presumably your tenants aren't going to be utilizing it frivolously, and more importantly, if they do, it'd better damn well be back by the time you next check your finances. | Now this is starting to look more respectable. Sequestered away in neat stacks, the filthy lucre that you've amassed since your arrival in the Frost Marches has filled the entirety of one pallet and is spilling over into the next two; [wayfort.hasDaliza |even the treasury guard Daliza's posted is starting to look a little less bored and is paying somewhat more attention to the job at hand |there's a distinct sense of satisfaction that comes with a job well done like this ]. The dim light just causes the piles of electrum to glint and glisten all the more seductively — while there might not be enough here to tempt a full-blown heist, it's certainly enough to warrant more than the average petty thief. You briefly estimate that there might be enough here for a fortnight's worth of operating expenses for the Wayfort if all income were to be suddenly cut off, maybe a whole month if you tried to stretch it out. | This is starting to look more like it. The stacked coinage in your vault fills three whole pallets, ancient wood and mortar stoically bearing the weight of wealth as they did in the past. If you wanted to, you could lie down in the piles and make a bed of your wealth — not that it would be seemly to do so, of course, but it's a privilege that few people possess. Why not enjoy the little things in life while you can? Come to think of it, you've never actually stacked the coins, and even if you wanted to, doing so would take an inordinate amount of time... so why do they look so neat? Do they simply arrange themselves like that over time, or is someone playing a prank on you? Maybe it's one of the greatest magical mysteries of the world... | The amount of electrum in your treasury has gotten to the point where it's starting to overflow the pallets — not that there's no more space for them, but the stacks and piles certainly appear more aesthetically pleasing if they're allowed to spill a little, like a cup running over. An entire corner of the vault is covered in cold, hard cash, but it was clearly designed for more — leading to questions about who occupied the Wayfort before you did. At this point, it could be possible to give out small loans to petitioners in need, but given the ability of the average marcher to repay them in coin rather than in kind maybe that's not such a great idea. Or maybe it is — news of the wealth you're amassing has got to be spreading, right?[wayfort.hasDaliza | You personally suspect the boredom Daliza's posted guard is affecting is a facade at this point, but there's no way to prove it... ] | The pile of coinage you've amassed over the course of your adventure has grown to the point where if you were to stand in it, the side of lucre would reach your waist. Filling about half to two-thirds of the floor space in the vault proper, it's gotten to the point where all pretense of fitting the lot on the pallets has been dropped and the stacks simply do as they please, like grain in a silo. With so much money in one place, the real concern isn't kobolds, thieves or raiders; it's the risk of attracting treasure bugs. At least you can see the former coming; with the latter you just wake up one day to discover that all your lovely coinage is now a mass of shiny beetles. Facing down a bunch of Sailgraves raiders is probably preferable to that mess... sure, treasure bugs are edible and taste great, but that kind of silver lining would be really thin if your hoard were to be devoured... | All the money you've put away in the vault neatly and evenly covers the entirety of the old masonry floor, to the point where you could be buried up to your chest in your own wealth. Several different kinds of coinage are present in this hoard you've amassed, which represents about a year's operating expenses for the Wayfort as a whole, maybe a little less if you were a bit more generous with the luxuries. Taking this much currency out of circulation for no other purpose than to be admired is admittedly a bit concerning, but everyone's still finding old imperial caches and the like in addition to what's being minted by every two bit-warlord staking a claim down in the heartlands and more... surely you hoarding all this money wouldn't make any significant dent in the amount in circulation, right? Right? Maybe this is what it feels like to be a dragon out of legend... | Okay, you've done it. If someone had told you there was all this electrum in the entirety of the Marches, you wouldn't have believed them, but there is and it's all here in your vault. There's enough here to cover the entire floor to a depth that'd rise above your head, and it wouldn't be wrong to call this a [silly |money bin |dragon's hoard ] at this point. How the people of the Marches haven't already been reduced to barter thanks to you hoarding all the liquid currency in one place is beyond you, but the glittering trove that you've amassed in your treasury is enough to inspire awe and envy at the same time.[wayfort.hasDaliza | Even the guard Daliza's posted can't keep up the sullen act all the time now, not in the face of such wonder. ] Rich beyond compare and [pc.isBaron |even your newly-minted station as baron[pc.mf | |ess ] |station ], the only worry you'll ever have is losing it. Hope you can sleep well at night. ] In addition to your current hoard, your investments, taxes, tribute and other sources of income are generating [var0] electrum every ten days, with [var1] awaiting collection; [wayfort.hasDaliza |Daliza |Rumie ]'s making sure that it'll be delivered straight to your vault without fuss and added to your total."

rows.original: Well, you made it this far. There's not much point in having such a ridiculous amount of money in one place save that you can swim in it, so you might as well take pleasure in your inordinate wealth.
rows.translation: 嗯，你终于做到了这一点。把这么多钱集中在一处，除了可以随心所欲地挥霍之外，其实并没有什么意义。所以，你大可以好好享受这份巨额财富带来的乐趣吧。
rows.raw: "Well, you made it this far. There's not much point in having such a ridiculous amount of money in one place save that you can swim in it, so you might as well take pleasure in your inordinate wealth."

rows.original:
You step [wayfort.hasDaliza
        |past the guard
        |towards the treasury
    ] and winch up the little portcullis to access your hoard, as it is. The coins feel very satisfactory in the palm of your hand as you pilfer the stacks on their pallets, firm and weighty like their value. Whatever you need this money for, it's going to be put to good use.
rows.translation:
你迈出了第一步。 [wayfort.hasDaliza
        |趁守卫不注意时行动
        |朝向金库方向
    ]然后拉动那个小翻板，就能取到你的财宝了。当你把那些堆放在托盘上的硬币一把把拿在手里时，会感觉到它们非常沉实，手感也很不错，完全符合它们的价值。无论你需要这些钱来做什么，它们肯定都能派上好用的场子。

rows.original: You step over to the corner where your spare furniture's being kept and consider your options. How would you like to decorate the Wayfort today?
rows.translation: 你走到存放备用家具的角落，开始思考该怎么做。今天，你打算如何装饰荒废驿堡呢？
rows.raw: "\n    You step over to the corner where your spare furniture's being kept and consider your options. How would you like to decorate the Wayfort today?"

rows.original: You spend a little while unpacking your chosen decor from storage and setting the pieces up about your personal spaces across the Wayfort. It takes a few tries to get it all just how you like it, but the fact that you're doing the bulk of the moving yourself curtails any impulses to excessive pickiness. Eventually, you have to admit you're done. This looks good!
rows.translation: 你花了一些时间从储藏处取出自己挑选的装饰品，然后将它们摆放在荒废驿堡各地的个人空间里。虽然尝试了好几次才让一切达到你满意的效果，但既然大部分搬运工作都是你自己完成的，也就不会再那么挑剔了。最终，你不得不承认：这样就很好看了！
rows.raw: "\n            You spend a little while unpacking your chosen decor from storage and setting the pieces up about your personal spaces across the Wayfort. It takes a few tries to get it all just how you like it, but the fact that you're doing the bulk of the moving yourself curtails any impulses to excessive pickiness. Eventually, you have to admit you're done. This looks good!"

rows.original: Change the current furniture set for your wayfort.
rows.translation: 更改你驿堡当前的家具套装。
rows.raw: "Change the current furniture set for your wayfort."

rows.original: You decide that you'd prefer a clean and spacious look for your Wayfort interior, and spend a little while gathering up all the extra furniture in your personal spaces and stowing it under hides in your vault. The end result might be a bit bare, but that also means there's no clutter to be had. After all, you can always bring the furniture back out should you change your mind.
rows.translation: 你决定让自己的荒废驿堡内部空间看起来更加整洁宽敞，于是花了一些时间把个人区域里多余的家具都收起来，把它们存放在地窖里的皮革储物箱里。虽然最终的效果可能看起来有点空荡荡的，但这也意味着房间里不会再有任何杂物了。毕竟，如果你以后改变了主意，随时都可以把那些家具重新搬出来使用。
rows.raw: "\n        You decide that you'd prefer a clean and spacious look for your Wayfort interior, and spend a little while gathering up all the extra furniture in your personal spaces and stowing it under hides in your vault. The end result might be a bit bare, but that also means there's no clutter to be had. After all, you can always bring the furniture back out should you change your mind."

rows.original: Pack up the current furniture set without replacing it with something.
rows.translation: 把目前这套家具收起来，不用替换成别的东西。

rows.translation: 目前，荒废驿堡区域内并没有任何已部署的家具。

rows.original: This is it. For all the other uses of electrum, this has got to be the most ridiculous and ostentatious use of it all. And yet... if not now, then when? If not here, then where? And if not you, then who? You spent the time and effort in order to accumulate all this coin in one place, and now it's time to feel filthy rich. Stripping off your [pc.armor], you hang it up by the vault entrance and look down into the glimmering sea of wealth below, beckoning to you with the lustre of all your hard work in earning it. You can't help yourself, not with the memories of what you did to accumulate such largesse — taking a deep breath, you dive forward off the stone and straight into the ocean of electrum. It feels amazing. The coins part about you and make way for your presence, accepting you as one of their own; you slip and wiggle through them like a fish through water, their cool touch resplendent upon your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. You wriggle deep beneath the surface in a low arc, the clinking of coin all about your person; do you really have that much money for you to be able to dive so deep into the contents of your money bin? Several sparkling gemstones bob by in your wake — you've only put hawks in here, so they must be income from the Wayfort or another one of your properties... Coins pour off your head as you break the surface with the sound of pouring metal, wealth cascading off your brow as you gasp and sigh in orgiastic delight from being immersed from head to toe in so much sheer wealth. Spitting several hawks into the air in a comical arc, you wallow in the feel of cool, heavy, precious metal on skin before arcing back for another dive. [party.randComp arona cait brint brienne etheryn kiyoko azyrran quintillus agnimitra viviane atugia |Seeing you take an absolute perverse delight in your riches, Arona can't hold herself back any longer. Tossing aside her [arona.weapon] with a gleeful bellow, she bursts into a running start, leaps, and poises to dive into the treasure hoard as if leaping from the prow of a longship into the waves... ...Only the be soundly rebuffed by the sea of electrum. Hawks fly out in every direction as her failure to penetrate the depths of wealth results in a belly flop and mighty crash; while Arona's imposing figure has resulted in a good-sized crater, she isn't able to actually swim in your money like you are. Looking a lit sheepish, the orcish amazon rubs her smarting chin, scowls, then pretends to affect that this was what she intended to do all along. "You didn't see none of that," she mutters as she settles for lying on her back and waving her limbs to the sound of money in action. "Ah shit. I bet Argoth would never be able to see this much riches in one place. This is amazing!" You just laugh at Arona's clumsy attempt to change the subject and prepare to go under once more. |"Oooo," Cait says appreciatively as she steps out onto the rolling waves of silvery coin, electrum clinking under her feet as she skips out to your side. "That has got to be pretty good. I don't think they have this even at the grand temple in the capital, so that's a first." Really? Jassira's patron deity is the prince of passion, after all; you'd have expected that such a fetish would be catered to in a place the wealthy would frequent, if nothing else. "Well, it's not that we couldn't put together something like this if need be; the temple certainly has the resources for it. But part of the point is that, well, the money's yours. If it were just coin belonging to someone else, it wouldn't feel the same, would it?" Thinking about it... yeah, she's right. It wouldn't feel the same if all this money in the vault wasn't earned by you in some fashion. It'd feel... dirty, in a way. Used. Like you were stealing someone else's private possessions and using them in an intimate fashion — something that's just not done in polite society, and unhygienic to boot. That being said, it can't hurt if it's a friend's money, right? "Funny you should bring that up," Cait says with a smile, her ears wiggling. "I was just wondering, since you were going swimming, could you...?" Could you what? "Bury me up to my neck in money. I have relatives on my father's side in the treasury department of the sultanate, you see, and — " Oh, she doesn't need to explain herself. You're friends, and isn't that what friends are for? Sighing happily, Cait just pipes down and lies on her back spread-eagled as you cover her with handful after handful of hawks. The clink and clatter as coins jostle against each other, the soft pouring sound as you gather handful after handful of your hard-earned money and let it flow onto Cait until she's buried in a little mound of pure purchasing power. "Wow." How does she feel? "A little chilly. [wayfort.hasFarrah |I don't quite get what Farrah sees in this, but I suppose I can't judge her on this particular one, can I? ]Like I was saying earlier, it's nice because it's your money, [pc.name], but it wouldn't be the same if it belonged to anyone else. "And before I forget... how do you actually manage to swim in all that?" |"Wow." Seeing you swim delightfully through your store of accumulated wealth, Brint scratches his chin and slowly shakes his head. "How do you manage to do that, [pc.name]? I — " he demurs a moment, then makes his point by balling up a beefy fist and bringing it to bear against the nearest pile of coin. Hawks scatter in all directions, but the pile nevertheless proves to be quite solid for him, whereas for you... To be perfectly honest, you don't know. It's just something that comes to you naturally — maybe if he went through the process of earning as much money by himself, he'd be able to swim in his own cash, too? Brint just laughs and claps. "Khaak, no. While I'll admit to being curious at how it might feel to swim in all that money, I'm not that curious as to go to all that trouble. I'll just sit here and be happy that you're enjoying yourself, [pc.name]. That'll do." Is he sure about that? Now you're feeling a little bad for him... "Think about it. I left home to see the world — just being able to see so much money in one place is something in and of itself. Sure, Khor'minos may be worth more, but it's all in buildings, roads, fountains, people... not in coin." Your minotaur companion rubs the back of his neck and smiles sheepishly. "Mom and sis would never believe me if I told them you had a kingdom's ransom stashed away here; being able to not just see this kind of thing, but personally know the person who it belongs to and have a hand in making it happen? That's a big one, and I thank you for that." Sheesh, now he's starting to sound all formal and most unlike himself. Well, if he can't swim in your sea of filthy lucre, he's more than welcome to... you don't know, stomp around and have some fun, unwind a bit. He's worth it, after all. |"Wow." Seeing you swim delightfully through your store of accumulated wealth, Brienne scratches her chin and slowly shakes her head. "How do you manage to do that, [pc.name]? I — " she demurs a moment, then makes her point by balling up a fist and bringing it to bear against the nearest pile of coin. Hawks scatter in all directions, but the pile nevertheless proves to be quite solid for her, whereas for you... To be perfectly honest, you don't know. It's just something that comes to you naturally — maybe if she went through the process of earning as much money by herself, he'd be able to swim in her own cash, too? [brienne.isPregnant |Brienne just laughs and claps. "Oh, no. While I'll admit to being curious at how it might feel to swim in all that money, I'm not that curious as to go to all that trouble. I'll just sit here and be happy that you're enjoying yourself, [pc.name]. That'll do." Is she sure about that? Now you're feeling a little bad for her... "Think about it. I left home to see the world — just being able to see so much money in one place is something in and of itself. Sure, Khor'minos may be worth more, but it's all in buildings, roads, fountains, people... not in coin." Your cowgirl companion rubs the back of her neck and smiles sheepishly. "Mom and sis would never believe me if I told them you had a kingdom's ransom stashed away here; being able to not just see this kind of thing, but personally know the person who it belongs to and have a hand in making it happen? That's a big one, and I thank you for that." Sheesh, now she's starting to sound all formal and most unlike herself. Well, if she can't swim in your sea of filthy lucre, she's more than welcome to... you don't know, stomp around and have some fun, unwind a bit. She's worth it, after all. |"I know you mean well, but I'm after wealth of a different kind." Finding a small heap of electrum to sit down on, Brienne lovingly pats you on the head while her other hand her rounded belly, the gleam of light upon its taut surface not too different from that of the sea of hawks. "There's money, and then there's having something — or even better, someone to spend it on, don't you agree?" You try to think of an answer for that on the spot, but all that comes is a lump in your throat. "Money's nice and all, but there's something to be said for having something to spend it on," she continues. "And what better way to leave a legacy that'll last long after our passing than some wise investments? "Oh, look at your face, [pc.name]. I'm just teasing you for a bit... or am I?" ] |Sitting down on a small heap of coin, Ryn scoops up a handful of cold, hard wealth and lets it run through her fingers while she watches you swim about in your vault. [wayfort.hasDaliza |"You know, [pc.name]... if we could have some of this money, then it would go a long way towards filling the coffers that Alissa drained during her reign." Hmm? Isn't that something that's already happening? As you understand it, accepting the title from her means that you're obliged to send a portion of whatever the Wayfort makes up to the Winter City — or is that something that has not been happening? Should you speak to Daliza about funds earmarked for the crown disappearing en route? "N-no, that's not what I meant!" Getting all flustered and red-faced, Ryn takes a moment to compose herself. "I was hoping that there could be a little more in addition to what's already coming out of the Wayfort's income." You see. Is everything all right back at the Winter City? Is Elthara facing some sort of crisis for which she doesn't have the money? "No..." Then, as unseemingly as it may be for a vassal to decline [pc.hisHer] monarch, you'll have to say no. "Oh." She needs to understand that this isn't out of any kind of selfishness or spite — if there were an imminent and existential crisis facing the crown, your answer would likely be different. But there isn't and while there's stress on her reign right now, that's not necessarily a bad thing. Part of her problems stems from the fact that just about everyone with an iota of competence or conscience has been driven away in the past decades, and good people are a lot harder to replace than money, in that regard. Having this kind of pressure that a constant low-grade lack of funds will help separate the wheat from the chaff when it comes to filling in ministerial positions in her future court. Or does it sound like an excuse to not dole out something to her, especially when she's out and about with you building up her reputation for martial pursuits? "No, no, what you're saying makes perfect sense, and you did promise to send along something if the crown met with a crisis. Many of my subjects are running along on inertia — I don't know that it's a good thing that they're so capable of taking care of themselves, or a bad thing in that the crown was so absolutely irrelevant that Alissa's ruination was barely felt in the wider city." |"You know, [pc.name]... seeing how much money you've managed to amass by doing this adventuring thing, I'm wondering if I shouldn't try and get some of the outriders to take it up as well. Knight-errants of a sort. The last time Elthara showed me our accounts I couldn't help but feel depressed. They were in the black, but barely... and I don't dare to do anything as of yet that might raise revenues even further for fear of upsetting the people. They've been through a lot." Hmm? With the Wayfort and the path over the River Ridell clear, you'd have imagined that there'd be more traffic, if nothing else. "That's the reason we're in the black," Ryn sighs. "Maybe it's just because I'm with you, but we always seem to run into suspiciously wealthy individuals, ruins overflowing with treasure, and the like, some of which is still in boer'alvar lands. I mean, sure, Daliza was out, but she was looking for suitable re-colonization sites and not money. Just look at all this — you make it look so easy. If I could put together a couple of teams of brave outriders and have them look into some of the Godswar-era legends..." It is an idea to be sure, but on the other hand Ryn needs to remember the both of you make it look easy. Other people might have a harder time of it, otherwise all the remains in the Marches would have been picked clean long ago. It's not a bad idea by any means, only that Daliza turned up empty-handed from her search for Dracia. She just shouldn't overcommit to this idea, or consider it sustainable or reliable; every ruin picked clean means one less in the pot. Another sigh. "I understand what you're getting at, [pc.name]. Thanks." ] Well, no need to worry so much about all that. Here and now in your vault, she ought to take a load off and bask in the simple presence of a ransom fit for royalty, as it were. Turn that frown upside-down! |"Well, Beloved. You look like you are enjoying yourself quite thoroughly," your fox-wife says as she seats herself on one of the larger piles of coin, wrapping a couple of tails under herself to use as a cushion while she watches you. Every so often, she scoops up some electrum in her cupped hands and tosses it after you, creating a silvery cascade that tinkles back down into the sea of wealth. "Seeing you happy like this makes me feel fine as well, so it is a boon to the both of us." You remember... you remember that she was supposed to be someone pretty high up in the hierarchy of foxes back in the day. Was she as wealthy as this? "Ehehe, there's no need to compare. But no, I certainly did not possess as much raw, material, liquid wealth in one place, is that is what you are asking." And by those words she implies that she possessed other forms of wealth? Kiyoko nods as she scoops up another handful of coin and tosses it after you, pursing her lips. "To be sure, wealth is necessary in some measure if one wishes to get things done. On the other hand, too much can be counterproductive. And money will certainly buy you influence, but power... power requires more than that. Yes, I suppose what you said is correct, Beloved, but to say that they were other forms of wealth would not be strictly correct, given that they were not wealth to begin with. "But come now. You look happy with your accomplishment, so I should not get in the way of you savoring your achievement, is that not right? Swim around and bask in all that you have earned and let not thoughts of how you might eventually lose it all trouble you." |"Ooooh, neat." Seeing you swim around in the sea of coin, Azyrran carefully lowers herself onto her knees and paddles experimentally for a bit, seeing if the money will part for her the same way it does you. When it fails to give, she sighs and shakes her head with a smile. "Well, it was too much to hope that it would accept me the same way it does you. I don't think you'd be able to swim in honey the same way my sisters and I could, so fair's fair." You pause mid-stroke to bob about before your cuddlebug. She used to swim in the honey pool? That honey pool? Azzy laughs at that. "That was when I was younger, a lot younger. The honey pool wasn't like the one you saw next to Mother — it was much smaller, for one. We'd sneak in and dunk ourselves in it, enjoy its feel embracing us from head to toe much like you're doing right now." Ooh. She does make sense. For you, being immersed in honey would indeed probably be all clingy and uncomfortable, but for a natural like Azzy and her sisters? Yeah, fair's fair. "It wasn't all fun and games. Mother would always be downright livid if she caught us swimming in the honey — 'this is something we're going to be eating later, and you're getting all of your dirt into it!' she'd say. And... yeah, she wasn't wrong, now that I think back on it after everything that's happened and all these years. But as a kid, I thought it was the greatest injustice ever. Time really does change your perspective a bunch, doesn't it?" |"Hot damn," Quin sighs appreciatively as he steps out into the vault, coins clinking under his bare feet. The bunny-man flexes his toes several times, clearly enjoying the sensation of cold, hard cash beneath his soles; even with this tactile confirmation he still seems unsure about whether what he's feeling is really there. "If we weren't caught up in this whole business with Tollus, we could just live off this like kings for the rest of our lives." Well, there's his motivation to see this whole business to its end, then. Quin laughs dryly. "Oh, don't you worry about that. I don't intend to give the bald fucker the pleasure of killing me, even if it's him reaching from the grave to drag me into it with him. No, I intend to live plenty long after he's a corpse. But seeing you like this, it really makes me think of the importance of having something nice to come back to when it's all said and done, right? Like, I'm probably never going to admit it in front of anyone else, but while disgust for that bald fucker is plenty strong as a motivator, having something nice to come back to only sweetens the deal. Really cuts down on the 'what do I do now?' questions that arise when everything's all said and done." Mm, you don't know about that. He's a working man, a bunny of action. You have your own doubts that Quin would be content to rest on his laurels once this adventure is over; he'd probably get restless before too long. "Could be, couldn't be. It all depends on the incentive, and I have to say something like this is a pretty big one." |While you've been enjoying yourself swimming laps in the sea of your amassed wealth, Agni's been sitting all the way up at the vault entrance, looking positively bored and unimpressed by the display. It's a small yet pressing point on the mood of the event, so you eventually paddle up to her and ask if something's the matter. "Well, I guess all this money's good for something, if it's only just to make you happy. I don't remember right now if I ever told you what I think of the idea and how barter is superior, but seeing you taking this much delight in just having it... well, that's one more use for this stuff than just an alchemy reagent." She sighs. "I'm not going to put on a fake smile and gush about how much I love your overflowing hoard, [pc.name], I can't. But you put a lot of effort into getting it all into one place and it clearly brings you joy, so I can live with it." Ah. "Sorry to be a downer, but if you'd spoken with me about the subject you'd have known about my distaste for currency. And maybe you did, but then you must've forgotten if so, because otherwise you wouldn't have subjected me to this, right? It's okay, I forget a lot of things, too." |While you've been enjoying yourself, Viviane has seated herself by the vault entrance, looking down contemplatively while you paddle around in the ocean of coin. She's not so much interested in the money — it probably represents nothing more than research funding to her, and you've never known her to be lacking in that by her own means — but you as you paddle in circles through the amassed hawks. Eventually, she clears her throat and beckons you over. "How do you do that?" Do what? "Please don't play coy with me, [pc.name], I haven't had enough drinks today for that. How do you swim through all those hawks as if they were liquid? By all known laws of physics, you shouldn't be doing anything more than a miserable belly-flop onto your pile of wealth accompanied by a handful of bruises, and yet here you are defying all good sense without even being aware of it. How?" You consider that a moment as you continue treading — well, it's not water, but she gets the point — in front of Viv, drawing out the moment as she awaits a reply. Eventually, you shrug. None of this really makes sense at all: you had an impulse, you followed it against all common sense, and now you're here swimming through your hoard like a fish in water. That's all there is to it, really. If there's something more involved here or which needs your attention or effort beyond the obvious, it's as much of a mystery to you as it is to her. Viv sighs. "So you believed it hard enough, and the laws of reality bent in order to realize that belief. Well, there's only one explanation for this given that we're not traveling the cosmos on the back of a giant turtle and four elephants: we're in silly mode." Silly mode? "You were content to not question your reality up to this point, dear. Let's not get started now. I don't want to have to dig you out when you realize how silly you're being and stop being able to swim in your own wealth." |Seeing you swim laps in your glittering hoard, Tui carefully lowers herself to her knees and makes a few experimental attempts at breaking the treasure's surface. Said attempts are largely unsuccessful: coins clink and a couple scatter about, but she's unable to mimic you in freely enjoying the ludicrous amount of wealth that you've built up here. "I don't get it," she grumbles, folding her arms and sitting cross-legged on a small mound of cash. "How come you get to play around in the money like that, huh?" You swim to a stop just before Tui and consider her — well, look. She's clearly overthinking things, trying to figure out how to take the plunge here. Maybe she should just let go, not worry about the hows too much and just let what comes naturally happen. At least, that's how it works for you. Birds don't really think about how they fly, after all, they just do. "Yeah, well, that's easier said than — oh. Maybe this will work." As you watch, Tui stands, retreats to the vault entrance, and removes her head, pulling it off her shoulders and carefully setting it down by the door. Dusting off her hands, her now-decapitated body breaks into a running start, does a somersault through the air, and plunges straight into the sea of wealth without even so much as a splash, the coins parting to admit her as easily as they've done for you. There, she's done it! All it took was losing her head, but she did it! Obviously, Tui's body is unable to reply directly, but she's perfectly capable of showing her pleasure at these developments by swimming circles around you. It's nice to have someone else around who really gets it, right? ] Eventually, though, it's time to pack it in. Pulling yourself out of your money bin, you shake a few loose coins off your body and prepare to get dressed and on the road again. Sure, it's an unorthodox pleasure, but it feels so satisfying and everyone knows that the difference between being crazy and eccentric is how much money you have. Let's face it, you have a lot of money.
rows.translation: 就是现在了。在电银的所有用途中，这种用法无疑是最荒谬、最炫耀性的。然而……如果不在现在，那还能什么时候？如果不在这里，那还能在哪里？如果不是你，那还能是谁呢？你花费了时间和精力，将这些电银聚集到了一起，现在正该体验一把富得流油的滋味。你脱下[pc.armor]，将它挂在金库入口处，向下望去，下方那闪烁着光芒的财富海洋正吸引着你，那片光辉承载着你辛苦赚取这一切的全部努力。你再也按捺不住，毕竟那些你曾经做过的事情，以及因此而获得的一切，都深深地烙印在你的脑海中。你深吸一口气，从那块石头上跳了下去，直接坠入了那片由琥珀金币组成的海洋之中。 这种感觉……真是难以形容。太棒了那些硬币仿佛在诉说关于你的故事，为你让出道路，接纳你成为它们中的一员；你像鱼儿在水中游动般穿梭其中，它们那冰凉的触感令你感到无比舒适。 [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]你以低低的弧线潜入水底，周围到处都是硬币碰撞发出的声响；你真的拥有那些硬币吗？那个有这么多钱，让你能够如此深入地研究自己财富的来源吧？几颗闪闪发光的宝石在你身后漂浮——你之前只放了鹰在这里，所以这些肯定是从荒废驿堡庄园或其他财产中获得的收入…… 当你从水中浮出水面时，硬币像金属流水般从你头上倾泻而下，财富如瀑布般从你额头上流淌下来。你喘着粗气，发出兴奋的叹息，因为自己竟然拥有如此巨额的财富。财富将几只鹰以滑稽的弧线抛向空中，你尽情享受着那种清凉而重型的感觉珍贵的金属在皮肤上划过，随后又弹回，准备再次俯冲。 [party.randComp arona cait brint brienne etheryn kiyoko azyrran quintillus agnimitra viviane atugia |看到你对自己的财富表现出如此病态的满足感，阿罗娜再也无法忍耐下去了。她将[arona.weapon]扔到一旁。 她发出一声欢快的吼叫，突然加速奔跑，纵身跃起，然后稳稳地跳进了那堆财宝之中，就像是从一艘长船的船头跳进海浪中一样……然而，她却被那堆积如山的财宝狠狠地拒绝了。她试图突破那些财宝的屏障，但却失败了，结果重重地摔在地上，发出巨大的声响；而阿罗娜那庞大的身躯在坠落的过程中，竟然在地面砸出了一个不小的坑洞，但她却依然无法成功获取那些财宝。游泳你根本没看到那些，”她嘟囔着，然后仰躺下来，随着金钱流动的声音，她挥动着四肢。 她的脸上带着一丝尴尬，但很快又装作这一切都是她本来就打算做的样子。啊，见鬼……我敢打赌，阿戈斯绝对不可能在一个地方看到这么多财富，真是太惊人了！” 你只是笑了笑，对阿罗娜试图转移话题的笨拙举动不以为意，然后准备再次潜入水中。 |哦哦哦，”凯特赞叹道，当她踏入那些由银色硬币铺成的起伏波浪中时，琥珀金币在她的脚下叮当作响，她蹦跳着走到你身边。“那肯定非常棒吧……我觉得他们应该没有这样的东西吧。这个就连在首都的那座宏伟寺庙里也是如此，这确实是个第一次。” “真的吗？毕竟贾西拉的信奉神明可是激情之神啊；你本应该预料到，在这样一个富人们经常光顾的地方，这样的需求肯定会被满足的。” “嗯，其实如果需要的话，我们完全有能力组织这样的活动；寺庙当然也有相应的资源。但问题在于要点也就是说，这笔钱其实是你的。如果这些钱只是属于别人的，感觉就会不一样了，对吧？” 仔细想想……没错，她说的对。如果金库里的这些钱并不属于我，感觉确实会不一样。获得的以某种方式被你使用。这种感觉……有点肮脏，某种程度上来说。就像是在使用别人的私人物品，而且是以一种亲密的方式——这种行为在礼貌的社会中是绝对不被接受的，而且也显得很不卫生。 话虽如此，如果是朋友的钱，那也没关系吧？ “真巧你提到了这个，”凯特笑着说，耳朵还动来动去。“我刚才还在想呢，既然你打算去游泳，能不能…………？” “你能给我很多钱吗？我父亲那一边的亲戚在苏丹国的财政部门工作，你知道的，所以……” 哦，她根本不需要解释。你们是朋友，朋友不就是用来互相帮助的吗？ rows.raw: " This is it. For all the other uses of electrum, this has got to be the most ridiculous and ostentatious use of it all. And yet... if not now, then when? If not here, then where? And if not you, then who? You spent the time and effort in order to accumulate all this coin in one place, and now it's time to feel filthy rich. Stripping off your [pc.armor], you hang it up by the vault entrance and look down into the glimmering sea of wealth below, beckoning to you with the lustre of all your hard work in earning it. You can't help yourself, not with the memories of what you did to accumulate such largesse — taking a deep breath, you dive forward off the stone and straight into the ocean of electrum. It feels amazing. The coins part about you and make way for your presence, accepting you as one of their own; you slip and wiggle through them like a fish through water, their cool touch resplendent upon your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. You wriggle deep beneath the surface in a low arc, the clinking of coin all about your person; do you really have that much money for you to be able to dive so deep into the contents of your money bin? Several sparkling gemstones bob by in your wake — you've only put hawks in here, so they must be income from the Wayfort or another one of your properties... Coins pour off your head as you break the surface with the sound of pouring metal, wealth cascading off your brow as you gasp and sigh in orgiastic delight from being immersed from head to toe in so much sheer wealth. Spitting several hawks into the air in a comical arc, you wallow in the feel of cool, heavy, precious metal on skin before arcing back for another dive. [party.randComp arona cait brint brienne etheryn kiyoko azyrran quintillus agnimitra viviane atugia |Seeing you take an absolute perverse delight in your riches, Arona can't hold herself back any longer. Hawks fly out in every direction as her failure to penetrate the depths of wealth results in a belly flop and mighty crash; while Arona's imposing figure has resulted in a good-sized crater, she isn't able to actually swim in your money like you are. Looking a lit sheepish, the orcish amazon rubs her smarting chin, scowls, then pretends to affect that this was what she intended to do all along. "You didn't see none of that," she mutters as she settles for lying on her back and waving her limbs to the sound of money in action. "Ah shit. I bet Argoth would never be able to see this much riches in one place. This is amazing!" You just laugh at Arona's clumsy attempt to change the subject and prepare to go under once more. |"Oooo," Cait says appreciatively as she steps out onto the rolling waves of silvery coin, electrum clinking under her feet as she skips out to your side. Jassira's patron deity is the prince of passion, after all; you'd have expected that such a fetish would be catered to in a place the wealthy would frequent, if nothing else. "Well, it's not that we couldn't put together something like this if need be; the temple certainly has the resources for it. But part of the point is that, well, the money's yours. It wouldn't feel the same if all this money in the vault wasn't earned by you in some fashion. It'd feel... dirty, in a way. Used. Like you were stealing someone else's private possessions and using them in an intimate fashion — something that's just not done in polite society, and unhygienic to boot. That being said, it can't hurt if it's a friend's money, right? "Funny you should bring that up," Cait says with a smile, her ears wiggling. "I was just wondering, since you were going swimming, could you...?" Could you what? "Bury me up to my neck in money. Sighing happily, Cait just pipes down and lies on her back spread-eagled as you cover her with handful after handful of hawks. The clink and clatter as coins jostle against each other, the soft pouring sound as you gather handful after handful of your hard-earned money and let it flow onto Cait until she's buried in a little mound of pure purchasing power. "Wow." How does she feel? "A little chilly. I — " he demurs a moment, then makes his point by balling up a beefy fist and bringing it to bear against the nearest pile of coin. Hawks scatter in all directions, but the pile nevertheless proves to be quite solid for him, whereas for you... To be perfectly honest, you don't know. It's just something that comes to you naturally — maybe if he went through the process of earning as much money by himself, he'd be able to swim in his own cash, too? Brint just laughs and claps. "Khaak, no. While I'll admit to being curious at how it might feel to swim in all that money, I'm not that curious as to go to all that trouble. I'll just sit here and be happy that you're enjoying yourself, [pc.name]. That'll do." Is he sure about that? Now you're feeling a little bad for him... "Think about it. I left home to see the world — just being able to see so much money in one place is something in and of itself. Sure, Khor'minos may be worth more, but it's all in buildings, roads, fountains, people... not in coin." Your minotaur companion rubs the back of his neck and smiles sheepishly. "Mom and sis would never believe me if I told them you had a kingdom's ransom stashed away here; being able to not just see this kind of thing, but personally know the person who it belongs to and have a hand in making it happen? That's a big one, and I thank you for that." Sheesh, now he's starting to sound all formal and most unlike himself. Well, if he can't swim in your sea of filthy lucre, he's more than welcome to... you don't know, stomp around and have some fun, unwind a bit. He's worth it, after all. |"Wow." Seeing you swim delightfully through your store of accumulated wealth, Brienne scratches her chin and slowly shakes her head. "How do you manage to do that, [pc.name]? I — " she demurs a moment, then makes her point by balling up a fist and bringing it to bear against the nearest pile of coin. Hawks scatter in all directions, but the pile nevertheless proves to be quite solid for her, whereas for you... To be perfectly honest, you don't know. It's just something that comes to you naturally — maybe if she went through the process of earning as much money by herself, he'd be able to swim in her own cash, too? Sure, Khor'minos may be worth more, but it's all in buildings, roads, fountains, people... not in coin." Your cowgirl companion rubs the back of her neck and smiles sheepishly.
