Well, if she can't swim in your sea of filthy lucre, she's more than welcome to... you don't know, stomp around and have some fun, unwind a bit. She's worth it, after all. |"I know you mean well, but I'm after wealth of a different kind." Finding a small heap of electrum to sit down on, Brienne lovingly pats you on the head while her other hand her rounded belly, the gleam of light upon its taut surface not too different from that of the sea of hawks. "There's money, and then there's having something — or even better, someone to spend it on, don't you agree?" You try to think of an answer for that on the spot, but all that comes is a lump in your throat. "Money's nice and all, but there's something to be said for having something to spend it on," she continues. "And what better way to leave a legacy that'll last long after our passing than some wise investments? "Oh, look at your face, [pc.name]. I'm just teasing you for a bit... or am I?" ] |Sitting down on a small heap of coin, Ryn scoops up a handful of cold, hard wealth and lets it run through her fingers while she watches you swim about in your vault. [wayfort.hasDaliza |"You know, [pc.name]... if we could have some of this money, then it would go a long way towards filling the coffers that Alissa drained during her reign." Hmm? Isn't that something that's already happening? As you understand it, accepting the title from her means that you're obliged to send a portion of whatever the Wayfort makes up to the Winter City — or is that something that has not been happening? Should you speak to Daliza about funds earmarked for the crown disappearing en route? "N-no, that's not what I meant!" Getting all flustered and red-faced, Ryn takes a moment to compose herself. "I was hoping that there could be a little more in addition to what's already coming out of the Wayfort's income." You see. Is everything all right back at the Winter City? Is Elthara facing some sort of crisis for which she doesn't have the money? "No..." Then, as unseemingly as it may be for a vassal to decline [pc.hisHer] monarch, you'll have to say no. "Oh." She needs to understand that this isn't out of any kind of selfishness or spite — if there were an imminent and existential crisis facing the crown, your answer would likely be different. But there isn't and while there's stress on her reign right now, that's not necessarily a bad thing. Part of her problems stems from the fact that just about everyone with an iota of competence or conscience has been driven away in the past decades, and good people are a lot harder to replace than money, in that regard. Having this kind of pressure that a constant low-grade lack of funds will help separate the wheat from the chaff when it comes to filling in ministerial positions in her future court. Or does it sound like an excuse to not dole out something to her, especially when she's out and about with you building up her reputation for martial pursuits? "No, no, what you're saying makes perfect sense, and you did promise to send along something if the crown met with a crisis. Many of my subjects are running along on inertia — I don't know that it's a good thing that they're so capable of taking care of themselves, or a bad thing in that the crown was so absolutely irrelevant that Alissa's ruination was barely felt in the wider city." |"You know, [pc.name]... seeing how much money you've managed to amass by doing this adventuring thing, I'm wondering if I shouldn't try and get some of the outriders to take it up as well. Knight-errants of a sort. The last time Elthara showed me our accounts I couldn't help but feel depressed. They were in the black, but barely... and I don't dare to do anything as of yet that might raise revenues even further for fear of upsetting the people. They've been through a lot." Hmm? With the Wayfort and the path over the River Ridell clear, you'd have imagined that there'd be more traffic, if nothing else. "That's the reason we're in the black," Ryn sighs. "Maybe it's just because I'm with you, but we always seem to run into suspiciously wealthy individuals, ruins overflowing with treasure, and the like, some of which is still in boer'alvar lands. I mean, sure, Daliza was out, but she was looking for suitable re-colonization sites and not money. Just look at all this — you make it look so easy. If I could put together a couple of teams of brave outriders and have them look into some of the Godswar-era legends..." It is an idea to be sure, but on the other hand Ryn needs to remember the both of you make it look easy. Other people might have a harder time of it, otherwise all the remains in the Marches would have been picked clean long ago. It's not a bad idea by any means, only that Daliza turned up empty-handed from her search for Dracia. She just shouldn't overcommit to this idea, or consider it sustainable or reliable; every ruin picked clean means one less in the pot. Another sigh. "I understand what you're getting at, [pc.name]. Thanks." ] Well, no need to worry so much about all that. Here and now in your vault, she ought to take a load off and bask in the simple presence of a ransom fit for royalty, as it were. Turn that frown upside-down! |"Well, Beloved. You look like you are enjoying yourself quite thoroughly," your fox-wife says as she seats herself on one of the larger piles of coin, wrapping a couple of tails under herself to use as a cushion while she watches you. Every so often, she scoops up some electrum in her cupped hands and tosses it after you, creating a silvery cascade that tinkles back down into the sea of wealth. "Seeing you happy like this makes me feel fine as well, so it is a boon to the both of us." You remember... you remember that she was supposed to be someone pretty high up in the hierarchy of foxes back in the day. Was she as wealthy as this? "Ehehe, there's no need to compare. But no, I certainly did not possess as much raw, material, liquid wealth in one place, is that is what you are asking." And by those words she implies that she possessed other forms of wealth? Kiyoko nods as she scoops up another handful of coin and tosses it after you, pursing her lips. "To be sure, wealth is necessary in some measure if one wishes to get things done. On the other hand, too much can be counterproductive. And money will certainly buy you influence, but power... power requires more than that. Yes, I suppose what you said is correct, Beloved, but to say that they were other forms of wealth would not be strictly correct, given that they were not wealth to begin with. "But come now. You look happy with your accomplishment, so I should not get in the way of you savoring your achievement, is that not right? Swim around and bask in all that you have earned and let not thoughts of how you might eventually lose it all trouble you." |"Ooooh, neat." Seeing you swim around in the sea of coin, Azyrran carefully lowers herself onto her knees and paddles experimentally for a bit, seeing if the money will part for her the same way it does you. When it fails to give, she sighs and shakes her head with a smile. "Well, it was too much to hope that it would accept me the same way it does you. I don't think you'd be able to swim in honey the same way my sisters and I could, so fair's fair." You pause mid-stroke to bob about before your cuddlebug. She used to swim in the honey pool? That honey pool? Azzy laughs at that. "That was when I was younger, a lot younger. The honey pool wasn't like the one you saw next to Mother — it was much smaller, for one. We'd sneak in and dunk ourselves in it, enjoy its feel embracing us from head to toe much like you're doing right now." Ooh. She does make sense. For you, being immersed in honey would indeed probably be all clingy and uncomfortable, but for a natural like Azzy and her sisters? Yeah, fair's fair. "It wasn't all fun and games. Mother would always be downright livid if she caught us swimming in the honey — 'this is something we're going to be eating later, and you're getting all of your dirt into it!' she'd say. And... yeah, she wasn't wrong, now that I think back on it after everything that's happened and all these years. But as a kid, I thought it was the greatest injustice ever. Time really does change your perspective a bunch, doesn't it?" |"Hot damn," Quin sighs appreciatively as he steps out into the vault, coins clinking under his bare feet. The bunny-man flexes his toes several times, clearly enjoying the sensation of cold, hard cash beneath his soles; even with this tactile confirmation he still seems unsure about whether what he's feeling is really there. "If we weren't caught up in this whole business with Tollus, we could just live off this like kings for the rest of our lives." Well, there's his motivation to see this whole business to its end, then. Quin laughs dryly. "Oh, don't you worry about that. I don't intend to give the bald fucker the pleasure of killing me, even if it's him reaching from the grave to drag me into it with him. No, I intend to live plenty long after he's a corpse. But seeing you like this, it really makes me think of the importance of having something nice to come back to when it's all said and done, right? Like, I'm probably never going to admit it in front of anyone else, but while disgust for that bald fucker is plenty strong as a motivator, having something nice to come back to only sweetens the deal. Really cuts down on the 'what do I do now?' questions that arise when everything's all said and done." Mm, you don't know about that. He's a working man, a bunny of action. You have your own doubts that Quin would be content to rest on his laurels once this adventure is over; he'd probably get restless before too long. "Could be, couldn't be. It all depends on the incentive, and I have to say something like this is a pretty big one." |While you've been enjoying yourself swimming laps in the sea of your amassed wealth, Agni's been sitting all the way up at the vault entrance, looking positively bored and unimpressed by the display. It's a small yet pressing point on the mood of the event, so you eventually paddle up to her and ask if something's the matter. "Well, I guess all this money's good for something, if it's only just to make you happy. I don't remember right now if I ever told you what I think of the idea and how barter is superior, but seeing you taking this much delight in just having it... well, that's one more use for this stuff than just an alchemy reagent." She sighs. "I'm not going to put on a fake smile and gush about how much I love your overflowing hoard, [pc.name], I can't. But you put a lot of effort into getting it all into one place and it clearly brings you joy, so I can live with it." Ah. "Sorry to be a downer, but if you'd spoken with me about the subject you'd have known about my distaste for currency. And maybe you did, but then you must've forgotten if so, because otherwise you wouldn't have subjected me to this, right? It's okay, I forget a lot of things, too." |While you've been enjoying yourself, Viviane has seated herself by the vault entrance, looking down contemplatively while you paddle around in the ocean of coin. She's not so much interested in the money — it probably represents nothing more than research funding to her, and you've never known her to be lacking in that by her own means — but you as you paddle in circles through the amassed hawks. Eventually, she clears her throat and beckons you over. "How do you do that?" Do what? "Please don't play coy with me, [pc.name], I haven't had enough drinks today for that. How do you swim through all those hawks as if they were liquid? By all known laws of physics, you shouldn't be doing anything more than a miserable belly-flop onto your pile of wealth accompanied by a handful of bruises, and yet here you are defying all good sense without even being aware of it. How?" You consider that a moment as you continue treading — well, it's not water, but she gets the point — in front of Viv, drawing out the moment as she awaits a reply. Eventually, you shrug. None of this really makes sense at all: you had an impulse, you followed it against all common sense, and now you're here swimming through your hoard like a fish in water. That's all there is to it, really. If there's something more involved here or which needs your attention or effort beyond the obvious, it's as much of a mystery to you as it is to her. Viv sighs. "So you believed it hard enough, and the laws of reality bent in order to realize that belief. Well, there's only one explanation for this given that we're not traveling the cosmos on the back of a giant turtle and four elephants: we're in silly mode." Silly mode? "You were content to not question your reality up to this point, dear. Let's not get started now. I don't want to have to dig you out when you realize how silly you're being and stop being able to swim in your own wealth." |Seeing you swim laps in your glittering hoard, Tui carefully lowers herself to her knees and makes a few experimental attempts at breaking the treasure's surface. Said attempts are largely unsuccessful: coins clink and a couple scatter about, but she's unable to mimic you in freely enjoying the ludicrous amount of wealth that you've built up here. "I don't get it," she grumbles, folding her arms and sitting cross-legged on a small mound of cash. "How come you get to play around in the money like that, huh?" You swim to a stop just before Tui and consider her — well, look. She's clearly overthinking things, trying to figure out how to take the plunge here. Maybe she should just let go, not worry about the hows too much and just let what comes naturally happen. At least, that's how it works for you. Birds don't really think about how they fly, after all, they just do. "Yeah, well, that's easier said than — oh. Maybe this will work." As you watch, Tui stands, retreats to the vault entrance, and removes her head, pulling it off her shoulders and carefully setting it down by the door. Dusting off her hands, her now-decapitated body breaks into a running start, does a somersault through the air, and plunges straight into the sea of wealth without even so much as a splash, the coins parting to admit her as easily as they've done for you. There, she's done it! All it took was losing her head, but she did it! Obviously, Tui's body is unable to reply directly, but she's perfectly capable of showing her pleasure at these developments by swimming circles around you. It's nice to have someone else around who really gets it, right? ] Eventually, though, it's time to pack it in. Pulling yourself out of your money bin, you shake a few loose coins off your body and prepare to get dressed and on the road again. Sure, it's an unorthodox pleasure, but it feels so satisfying and everyone knows that the difference between being crazy and eccentric is how much money you have. Let's face it, you have a lot of money."

rows.original: You notice that there's a new addition to Farrah's emporium — a corner stacked full of all kinds of furniture. Has she decided to get into that particular trade as well? Farrah grins toothily and rubs her thumb and forefinger together. "Might be hard to believe, but there's something of a market for this kind of stuff around these parts. Spending every day with a rickety bed and chairs that you put together isn't any way to live, and I tailor the goods to the people I intend to sell them to. Now, not to impugn the good folks of the Marches — most can throw together passable carpentry on their own, but for quality stuff there's no better to be had for reasonable prices." Hmm... reasonable prices isn't what usually comes to mind when it comes to Farrah, but you have to admit that even as a demoness, she has the sense to understand that extracting more reasonable amounts of wealth from her customers over a longer period of time leads to a larger total gain. "Hey, it's a pretty good place you have here; building up the place wasn't easy on anyone involved. It's pretty enough all right, but you know what would make it even better?" Some furniture, such as the pieces she has right there? "Now you're getting it! No, seriously — while the Wayfort's come a long way since its miserable state, it's missing a little something or the other, that personal touch that really makes it feel like home. Let's face it, up until now the place has mostly been built according to how other people envisioned it instead of you putting your mark on the construction, right? Mostly?" That is... well, you gave the orders, paid the money, and things happened. "Well, you need something to make your personal quarters more you, and by the gods do I have several lovely sets of themed furnishings that'll make them feel a lot more lived-in!" Farrah bounds over to the newly-opened furniture section with a flourish. "Why don't you take a look?"
rows.translation: 你注意到，法拉的商店里新增了一处货架——那里堆满了各式各样的家具。她是决定也涉足这个行业了吗？ 法拉咧开嘴笑了起来，同时用拇指和食指互相摩擦着。可能很难相信，但在这一带，这类商品确实有一定的市场需求。每天使用那些自己拼凑起来的破旧床椅来生活，实在不是什么好的生活方式。因此，我会根据目标消费者的需求来定制这些商品。当然，我并不是要贬低那些住在边境地区的善良人们——他们中的大多数确实能够自己做出还算不错的木制品，但要想获得质量上乘的产品，以合理的价格来说，没有比他们更好的选择了。 嗯……提到法拉，合理的价格通常并不是人们首先想到的，但不得不承认，即使她是个女恶魔，她也明白：长期从顾客那里获取更合理的收益，才能获得更多的总利润。 嘿，你这里的环境确实相当不错；打造这样一个地方，对所有参与其中的人来说都不容易。已经很不错了，但你知道什么会让它变得更好吗？” 一些家具，比如她现在摆在那里那些家具吧？ 现在你终于明白我的意思了！说真的，虽然荒废驿堡这个地方已经有了很大的改善，但它还是缺少一些东西——那种能让人们真正感受到家的温暖和亲切感。事实上，到目前为止，这个地方的建造主要是按照别人的设想来进行的，而不是你根据自己的想法来设计的，对吧？主要是吗？ 那就是……嗯，是你下了命令，支付了费用，然后事情才发生了。 “嗯，你确实需要一些东西来让你的私人住所更加你真的，天啊，我还有几套非常漂亮的主题家具，用了它们之后，这些地方就会显得更有生活气息了！”法拉兴奋地跑向新开的家具区。“你为什么不来看看呢？

rows.original: Badgered by Farrah, you figure that taking a quick look can't hurt. The feline demoness takes great pride in introducing each of the furniture ensembles on display, filling you with details that you frankly can't or won't remember and are pretty sure don't matter anyway. "...And so you see, I haven't left out a single detail. Each furniture set will cover all the personal space you have in this wayfort — the hallway, foyer, grand hall, mess hall and bar, throne room and living quarters, to be precise. A very fair deal, wouldn't you agree?" Sets? So, you can't like, just buy one here and there, mix and match as you please? "Oh, gods, oh gods no." Farrah claps her hands over her mouth in theatrical shock. "That would be terrible — these pieces come in as a set, and separating them from each other would absolutely ruin the effect. The whole is greater than the sum of the parts, don't you know? I'm sorry, but no can do. You either buy the whole set, or you don't buy anything at all. It would be absolutely heartless to tear them apart; they need to be together. I spent so much time picking out pieces that would work in harmony." All right, she doesn't need to be so melodramatic. It's all or nothing when it comes to buying these from her, then. "No rush to make any kind of decision here." Farrah gives you a saucy wink. "Wouldn't want to gain a reputation for being pushy, would I? Just talk to me about the furnishings when you're ready to make a purchase. Now, what were you actually here for before I interrupted you?"
rows.translation: 在法拉的不断催促下，你心想随便看一眼应该没什么坏处。这个猫妖对介绍展出的每一套家具都显得格外自豪，她详细地介绍了各种细节，但这些信息说实话你根本记不住，也不觉得它们有什么重要性。 ……由此可见，我没有遗漏任何细节。每一套家具都能满足您在这个城堡中的所有个人空间需求——具体来说，包括走廊、门厅、大厅、餐厅和酒吧、王座室以及生活区。这真是非常公平的交易，你不会同意吧？” “套装吗？也就是说，不能随便在这里买一件，在那里买一件，然后随意搭配使用吗？” “哦，天啊，哦，天啊不行。法拉戏剧性地用手捂住嘴巴，表现出极度的震惊：‘那可不行。糟糕透了 — 这些部件是作为一套出售的，如果把它们分开，效果就会完全毁掉。你知道的，整体总是大于部分之和的。很抱歉，但这是不可能的。要么你买下整套，要么就什么都别买。否则的话，效果肯定会大打折扣。无情的要把它们拆开；它们需要就是要在一起。我花了很多时间挑选那些能够和谐搭配的家具。” 好吧，她没必要这么夸张。既然要从她这里购买这些家具，那就只能全买或者一个都不买。 “现在还不急着做任何决定。”法拉调皮地眨了眨眼，“总不想给自己留下一个咄咄逼人的印象吧？等你决定要购买的时候，再跟我聊聊关于家具的事情吧。那么，在我打断你之前，你其实是来这里做什么的呢？

rows.original: The only piece of furniture in this catalogue to be sold on its own, this wooden display is made to occupy a place of prominence above your throne and can accommodate one weapon. Unfortunately not big or sturdy enough to display armor, but you'd want a stand for that anyway.
rows.translation: 在这份目录中，唯一可以单独出售的家具就是这个木质展示架。它被设计用来放置在你的王座上方显眼的位置，并且能够用来展示一件武器。遗憾的是，它的尺寸和结构并不适合用来展示盔甲，不过对于展示武器来说已经足够使用了。当然，如果你想要展示盔甲的话，还是需要另外准备一个专门的展示架。
rows.raw: "The only piece of furniture in this catalogue to be sold on its own, this wooden display is made to occupy a place of prominence above your throne and can accommodate one weapon. Unfortunately not big or sturdy enough to display armor, but you'd want a stand for that anyway."

rows.translation: [var1 |[wayfort.hasFreja |“你要把我留在这里吗？”当你踮起脚尖，把她那华丽的带棱纹的身躯固定到位时，艾希在你脑海中轻柔地哼道，[var0 |取代原先的陈列品 |填补那个一直空得令人遗憾的位置 ]。 “你还好吧？” [pc.dcb |倒不是说你特别在意；反正这件事无论如何都会发生。 |但愿她的感情不会因此受到伤害。 |哎呀，不要啊，你希望她不会为这件事难过。 ] “哦，我想是这样，这总比被丢在什么箱子里好多了；更不用说，我还能有更多时间陪着你那宝贝小龙了！” “[freja.name]？” “没错！你知道的，她长大后一定会成为最出色的圣骑士。聪明、好奇、充满爱心，对英雄事迹的故事毫无抵抗力，还喜欢从邪恶公主手里拯救美丽的龙。”她的声音里满是满足，当她被小心地安放到木制陈列架上时，声音又变成了低语。“这几乎……几乎就像我自己当了母亲一样。亲爱的火焰，你不在的时候，我也一定会替你看好你的领地。” |“哦，我的意思是……比起被丢在储藏箱里慢慢烂掉，这样确实好多了，可要是不能陪着你一起旅行，那就太遗憾了。”当你踮起脚尖，把她那华丽的带棱纹的身躯固定到位时，这条龙的声音里带着一丝撒娇的意味，[var0 |取代原先的陈列品 |填补那个一直空得令人遗憾的位置 ]。“不过我能理解，一位荣耀的、金光闪闪的龙族圣骑士，并不是你总想带在身边的人。” “你还好吧？” [pc.dcb |倒不是说你特别在意；反正这件事无论如何都会发生。 |但愿她的感情不会因此受到伤害。 |哎呀，不要啊，你希望她不会为这件事难过。 ] “说实话，这确实让我有点伤心，但你也想象得到，我是个很有耐心的女人。比起我此前熬过的所有等待，能待在这里、待在你领地王座上方最尊贵的位置上，已经算是一种享受了。亲爱的火焰，我会替你看好这个家的。只是别让我等太久。” ] |[var2 |[var3 |当你把艾希从木制展示柜里摘下来、准备换上[wayfort.dispWeapon]时，她其实正在轻轻打着呼噜。“嗯？”从那柄钉头锤的声音里，你几乎能听出一头掠食者睡眼惺忪、慵懒舒展身子的感觉，那声音在你脑海中缓缓回荡。“啊，又见面了，亲爱的火焰。我只是趁这机会享受一下没有痛楚的睡眠。” “要我把你放回去吗？”你打趣道。“我完全可以就——” “不用！我是说，咳，不，那样挺好的。我很想继续在你这趟光荣的冒险中照看你。让我好好看看你……” 你感觉到这柄钉头锤粗略地打量了你一番，随后意味深长地哼了一声。“你的实力增长速度快得惊人！干得好。” 那种审视的感觉接着延伸成一只手抚摸你[pc.ears]的触感。[wayfort.hasFreja |“我跟你说，[freja.name]一直是个难得的宝贝，我特别喜欢教导她。你一定是个非常骄傲的[pc.mf |父亲 |母亲 ]。” 她又继续滔滔不绝地夸赞了你家那只小飞龙的冒险倾向好几分钟，最后才终于安静下来。 ] “我们继续你这趟光荣的冒险吧，亲爱的火焰？” |当你把艾希从她的木制展示柜里取下来、准备换上[wayfort.dispWeapon]时，她的声音变成了悦耳的轻笑。“你一点都没让我等太久，让我好好看看你……” 你感觉到这柄钉头锤粗略地打量了你一番，随后意味深长地哼了一声。“你的实力增长速度快得惊人！干得好。”那种审视的感觉接着延伸成一只手抚摸你[pc.ears]的触感。“我们继续你这趟光荣的冒险吧，亲爱的火焰？” ] |[var0 |你踮起脚尖，取下陈列架上原先摆着的东西，再把[wayfort.dispWeapon]安放到位，然后确认了好几次它不会松脱、掉下来砸到你的头，这才放下脚跟。这下，这才更像你！ |你踮起脚尖，把[wayfort.dispWeapon]固定在木制陈列架上，反复检查了几遍，确认它没有歪，才满意地放下脚跟。好了，这下看起来好多了！ ] ] ]

rows.original: "Oh, thank the tree-father," Rose says when you get close enough to talk. "Oh? What's up?" you ask. "This lout named Hirrud keeps getting into fights with the legionnaires and getting kicked out. It wouldn't be so bad if he didn't keep smoking the place up when he runs with his tail between his legs." "Want me to help with him?" "If you could, that would be wonderful. The soldiers say he's holed up somewhere in the outskirts, but they don't have time to investigate with the siege ongoing. I figured you might have time." "I'll take care of it. I've got an idea for how to deal with him already," you say. You could always just beat the spoiled bully up again. He's hardly a challenge now, but it will still give the locals some relief. Alternatively, if you had a domain of your own to keep him in, you could teach him a more permanent lesson with some bimbo brew.
rows.translation: “哦，感谢树父，”你走到足以交谈的距离时，罗斯说道。 “哦？怎么了？”你问道。 “有个叫希鲁德的蠢货总和军团士兵打架，然后被人赶出去。要不是他夹着尾巴逃跑时总把这里弄得乌烟瘴气，倒也没那么糟。” “要我帮忙对付他吗？” “如果可以，那就太好了。士兵们说他躲在郊区某处，可围城仍在继续，他们抽不出时间调查。我想你或许有空。” “我会处理。我已经想到该怎么对付他了，”你说道。 你当然可以再把这个被宠坏的恶霸揍一顿。他如今几乎构不成挑战，不过至少能让当地人得到片刻安宁。或者，如果你拥有一块可以关住他的领地，也可以用些痴女酒给他一个更长久的教训。

rows.original: "Well, if it isn't one of my favorite sweetie-pies, right when I need [pc.himHer] most!" "Oh? What do you need me for? Is someone causing trouble?" "Exactly that, I'm afraid. I don't know if you know a man by the name of Hirrud Grune. Somewhat of a fixture around here. He was gone for a while but he's recently returned. He's banned from the pasture, but he just loves to come hurl insults at my girls and at any one else coming and going. Most know to pay him no mind, but it's still dreadful that they have to deal with it." "Want me to deal with him if I see him?" "Please. I've told the guards, and they're ready to string him up by his undergarments if they catch him, but he's managed to evade them every time. I asked around, and they think he's hiding out in one of the abandoned houses in the outskirts. They don't have time for a search with the siege going on, but you might. It'd mean the world to me, hun." "I'll take care of it. I've got an idea for how to deal with him already," you say. You could always just beat the spoiled bully up again. He's hardly a challenge now, but it will still give the locals some relief. Alternatively, if you had a domain of your own to keep him in, you could teach him a more permanent lesson with some bimbo brew.
rows.translation: 哎呀，这不是我最喜欢的角色之一吗？正好在我需要的时候出现[pc.himHer]大多数情况下都是这样！” “哦？你需要我帮忙做什么？是不是有人惹麻烦了？” “正是这样，恐怕是的。我不知道你是否认识一个叫希鲁德·格鲁恩的人？他在这一带算是比较有名气的人物。他之前离开了一段时间，但最近又回来了。他被禁止进入这片牧场，但他还是喜爱他总是对我的女儿们，以及任何进出这里的人辱骂不已。大多数人都知道应该无视他，但让他们不得不忍受这种行为，还是让人非常难受。” “如果我看到他，你要我帮他处理吗？” “拜托了。我已经告诉了守卫们，如果他们抓到那个人，就打算把他吊起来剥了他的内裤，但他每次都成功躲过了他们。我打听了一下，他们认为他应该躲在郊外的一些废弃房屋里。在围攻正在进行的情况下，他们根本没有时间去寻找，但你或许可以。这对我来说意义重大，亲爱的。 “我会处理的。我已经想出了对付他的办法。”你说。 其实，你完全可以直接把那个被宠坏的恶霸揍一顿就行了。现在他已经算不上什么挑战了，但这对当地人来说仍然是一种安慰。另外，如果你有自己的领域可以让他待在里面，你就可以教他一些更永久的用一些廉价啤酒来“上课”吧。
rows.raw: " "Well, if it isn't one of my favorite sweetie-pies, right when I need [pc.himHer] most!" "Oh? What do you need me for? Is someone causing trouble?" "Exactly that, I'm afraid. I don't know if you know a man by the name of Hirrud Grune. Somewhat of a fixture around here. He was gone for a while but he's recently returned. He's banned from the pasture, but he just loves to come hurl insults at my girls and at any one else coming and going. Most know to pay him no mind, but it's still dreadful that they have to deal with it." "Want me to deal with him if I see him?" "Please. I've told the guards, and they're ready to string him up by his undergarments if they catch him, but he's managed to evade them every time. I asked around, and they think he's hiding out in one of the abandoned houses in the outskirts. They don't have time for a search with the siege going on, but you might. It'd mean the world to me, hun." "I'll take care of it. I've got an idea for how to deal with him already," you say. You could always just beat the spoiled bully up again. He's hardly a challenge now, but it will still give the locals some relief. Alternatively, if you had a domain of your own to keep him in, you could teach him a more permanent lesson with some bimbo brew. "

Oh yeah, 'red-scaled beer-harlot'". "I know the guy. If I see him, I'll clock him for you," you say, furrowing your brow. "Thanks. He was telling the lady customers something about a place he was staying in the outskirts. I'm guessing his father kicked him out of the house. Figures he can't do anything but squat in someone else's." "I'll take care of it. I've got an idea for how to deal with him already," you say. You could always just beat the spoiled bully up again. He's hardly a challenge now, but it will still give the locals some relief. Alternatively, if you had a domain of your own to keep him in, you could teach him a more permanent lesson with some bimbo brew.
rows.translation: 嘿， [pc.name]正是我想见的人。这个叫希鲁德的自作聪明之徒在这里骚扰我的顾客。他虽然走了，但走之前还骂了我……他当时说了什么来着？对了，他说我是‘红鳞啤酒妓女’。” “我认识这个人。如果我看到他，一定会帮你教训他一顿的，”你皱着眉头说道。 “谢谢。他当时正在跟那些女顾客谈论他在郊区住的那个地方。我猜是他父亲把他赶出了家。看来他除了躲在别人背后逞强之外，什么也做不了。” “我来处理这个。我已经想出办法对付他了，”你说。 你完全可以直接再揍那个被宠坏的霸凌者一顿。现在他根本算不上什么挑战，但这样至少能让当地人松口气。或者，如果你有自己的域名可以让他使用，那么你可以教他更多相关知识。永久的用一些廉价啤酒来“上课”吧。

rows.original: You spend a while looking through the mostly abandoned homes that make up the outskirts' residential areas. It's not exactly a difficult search, but it is time consuming. There are so many buildings that it makes you worry about whether you'll be able to find your mark. It feels like you could search any number of these homes before running into even your first clue. Luckily, you hear your mark before you have any hope of seeing him. "Oi! I recognize you, [pc.mf |bastard |bitch ]!" he says, and you look up to see him lounging on the terrace of a vine-encrusted house. "Come to hunt me down after stealing my women? I should warn you, you may have bested me once, but I'll fight twice as hard to defend my home!" "This isn't your home, Hirrud! Will you really fight again for something you've stolen? Leave this place, and stop harassing your countrywomen!" you reply. "Leave?" he asks. "You've got some nerve. I've [silly |honed my blade while you were whoring your body. |been training while you were traipsing around the Marches doing nothing worthwhile. ]" The burly minotaur hefts his axe, holding it high. "I'll leave, alright." he says, bracing himself in preparation. "Leave my axe in your slut-stealing skull!" You narrowly manage to step out of the way before his axe cleaves the air in the space you once stood. Hirrud doesn't give you any more time to talk, lunging at you with his weapon bared. It's a fight!
rows.translation: 你花了好一阵子搜索构成郊区住宅地带的那些房屋，其中大多已经荒废。搜寻本身并不困难，却相当耗时。建筑实在太多，令你担心自己能否找到目标。你感觉可能得搜遍不知多少栋房屋，才能碰上第一条线索。幸运的是，远在有望看到目标以前，你便听见了他的声音。 “喂！我认得你，[pc.mf |混蛋 |婊子 ]！”他说道。你抬头望去，只见他正懒洋洋地坐在一栋爬满藤蔓的房屋露台上。“偷走我的女人以后，又来追杀我了？我可得警告你，你也许赢过我一次，但这回我会拿出双倍力气保卫自己的家！” “这里不是你的家，希鲁德！你真要再次为了偷来的东西战斗？离开这里，别再骚扰你的同乡女人！”你回答道。 “离开？”他反问道。“你真有胆子。我一直在[silly |你出卖身体的时候磨砺刀锋。 |你游荡在边境地区、无所事事的时候努力训练。 ]” 魁梧的弥诺陶洛斯抄起斧头，高高举起。 “我当然会让东西离开。”他一边说道，一边站稳身体做好准备。“让我的斧头留在你这偷婊子的脑袋里！” 他的斧头劈开空气、掠过你刚才站立的位置，你才堪堪躲开。希鲁德没再给你开口的时间，亮出武器向你猛扑而来。 战斗开始！

rows.original: You're fighting Hirrud Grune, an infamous minotaur mercenary. He bears an impressive mantle of horns and a king's ransom of armor: mail and hard leather cover his muscular body, along with a traveling cloak colored blood-red and pinned at the shoulder with a bronze star — a holy symbol of Lumia, goddess of the dawn. Hirrud bears a tower shield and Minothan war-sword, ready to fight.
rows.translation: 你正在与臭名昭著的弥诺陶洛斯雇佣兵希鲁德·格鲁恩交战。他那令人印象深刻的角状头饰，以及那些价值连城的盔甲，无不彰显着他的强大实力：金属锁子甲和坚硬的皮革覆盖着他强健的身体，而他身上还披着一件血红色的旅行斗篷，斗篷的肩部用一颗青铜星星固定着——那可是黎明女神卢米娅的神圣象征。希鲁德手持巨型盾牌和米诺坦战剑，随时准备投入战斗。
rows.raw: "\n    You're fighting Hirrud Grune, an infamous minotaur mercenary. He bears an impressive mantle of horns and a king's ransom of armor: mail and hard leather cover his muscular body, along with a traveling cloak colored blood-red and pinned at the shoulder with a bronze star — a holy symbol of Lumia, goddess of the dawn. Hirrud bears a tower shield and Minothan war-sword, ready to fight."

rows.original:
Hirrud drops to one knee from the force of your efforts, huffing and puffing with rage. He looks as if he wants to keep fighting, but he just can't find the strength any longer. Unable to even meet your gaze, he snorts.
    
    "Fine, I'll go! But don't think you've seen the last of me. I'll find a way to teach you a lesson somehow or another," he says, spitting in the dirt at your feet.
    
    "And I'll beat you again whenever that is. If that's what it takes to get the message into your thick skull, then I'll keep doing it."
    
    Scowling, Hirrud hefts his axe and shuffles off down the street. He doesn't even look back once as he approaches the edges of the outskirts and disappears behind the further buildings. There's no real guarantee he won't return, but you weren't kidding about beating him again if he does decide to return. However many times it takes.
rows.translation:
在你的强力攻势下，希鲁德单膝跪地，愤怒地喘着粗气。他看起来还想继续战斗，却再也挤不出一丝力气。连你的目光都无力面对，他哼了一声。
    
    “好，我走！但别以为这是你最后一次见到我。我早晚会想办法给你一个教训，”他说着，朝你脚边的泥地吐了口唾沫。
    
    “不管你什么时候回来，我都会再次击败你。要让这句话钻进你那颗榆木脑袋必须这么做，那我就一直打下去。”
    
    希鲁德阴沉着脸扛起斧头，拖着脚步沿街离去。他走近外围地区的边缘，消失在更远处的建筑后方时，一次也没有回头。你无法保证他不会回来，但你说若他回归便会再次击败他，可不是在开玩笑。无论需要多少次。

rows.original: Despite your best efforts, the lumbering minotaur manages to overwhelm you[party.som|| and [companion1.name]| and your allies]. You're the first to suffer his wrath, and the last thing you see is him raising that giant axe above his head and bringing it down atop you.
rows.translation: 尽管你竭尽全力，但这个行动迟缓的弥诺陶洛斯还是成功地把你制服了。[party.som|| 以及[companion1.name]| 以及你的盟友们]你是第一个遭到他怒火攻击的人，而你最后看到的，就是他将那把巨大的斧头举过头顶，然后朝你砍下来。
rows.raw: "\n    Despite your best efforts, the lumbering minotaur manages to overwhelm you[party.som|| and [companion1.name]| and your allies]. You're the first to suffer his wrath, and the last thing you see is him raising that giant axe above his head and bringing it down atop you.\n    "

rows.original: You spend a while looking through the mostly abandoned homes that make up the outskirts' residential areas. It's not exactly a difficult search, but it is time consuming. There are so many buildings that it makes you worry about whether you'll be able to find your mark. It feels like you could search any number of these homes before running into even your first clue. Luckily, you hear your mark before you have any hope of seeing him. "Oi! I recognize you, [pc.mf |bastard |bitch ]!" he says, and you look up to see him lounging on the terrace of a vine-encrusted house. "Come to hunt me down after stealing my women? I should warn you, you may have bested me once, but I'll fight twice as hard to defend my home!" He stands, hefting his axe and tensing in preparation. It's plain that this probably isn't his home, but this is neither the time nor place for that, and you have better plans. "Settle down, you lout. I've come with a peace offering. Honey mead!" you say, holding the bottle above your head. "I... Huh? Mead?" the lumbering brute replies, momentarily perplexed. "H-hold on a moment, let me come to the door." You wait a while, hearing him bump and crash inside before pulling the first floor door open. He eyes you with suspicion as you enter, but lets you enter unmolested. "Those three left me, too. Stole something precious on top of it," you lie through your teeth. "Aha! I was wondering why you would come to me. I suppose I can forgive your transgression if you've suffered as I have!" he says, taking the horn of mead and scrutinizing it with narrowed eyes. "Ha! these brewers know the place of a woman. Empty headed and waiting for direction." The longer he talks, the less guilty you feel about tricking him, so you simply pull out a less 'potent' horn of regular mead from your pack and take a long drink. After seeing you drink what he probably assumes is the same stuff, Hirrud unseals and drains the entire horn in several slow gulps. "Gods, that's good, Where did you say you got... What..." he says, dropping the horn and reaching for his belt-bag. "What was in that? What have you..." As he speaks, he pulls a smoke bomb and drops it before you can stop him. Thick, oily smoke fills the enclosed space, and you hear Hirrud crash against the table and then hit the ground with a thud. When the smoke finally filters out through the open door, he's sat huddled near the cupboards, breathing heavily and holding his knees. You watch as a series of rapid changes overtake him. The first thing to go is his muscle mass. You watch him flex, and see the strength bleed away in real time. The broadness remains, but the power is replaced by plump softness. All the bicep and core strength goes into a tummy that looks like it's begging to be squeezed and a pair of tits that rival it in softness. With his outfit leaving his chest exposed, said tits are left to rest completely bare and in the open. He lets out a whine, and you hear his voice turn from gravel to honey as the whine becomes a plaintive 'moo!'. His muzzle smoothens and then shortens, settling into a broad button nose and a pair of plump dark lips. His hair remains messy, completely shrouding his eyes and most of his ears. The horns atop his head also remain very much the same, sticking out the front like handlebars. You can also see all the fur above his waist smooth out into similarly colored skin, looking much smoother than his former rough body. Below the hips, the fur remains, along with the hooves, and the swishing tail, but everything rounds out to look plush and breedable. It's as if every part of his (or her, you suppose) indomitable bulk has been concatenated into a plush bimbo package. She looks up at you with a fearful tremble in her lower lip, and hugs her knees against her chest.
rows.translation: 你花了一些时间浏览那些大多已被废弃的房屋，这些房屋构成了郊区的住宅区。虽然搜索起来并不困难，但确实耗费了不少时间。有太多的建筑物，让你开始担心是否能够找到目标。感觉你可能需要搜查很多这样的房屋，才能找到第一个线索。幸运的是，在你几乎失去希望之前，你就听到了目标的声音。 “喂！我认识你[pc.mf |混蛋 |贱人 ]就是他！”他说着，你抬头望去，只见他正懒洋洋地躺在一座被葡萄藤覆盖的房子的露台上。“敢偷走我的女人，还来追捕我吗？我得提醒你——虽然你曾经打败过我一次，但这一次，我会加倍努力来保卫我的家园！他站了起来，握紧手中的斧头，全身紧绷，做好准备。很明显，这里很可能不是他的家，但现在也不是考虑这个的时候，而且你肯定还有其他的计划。 “冷静点，你这个粗人。我是带着和平的意图来的。蜂蜜酒啊！”你一边说着，一边将瓶子举过头顶。 “我……哈？蜂蜜酒？”那个行动迟缓的粗汉愣了一下，显得有些困惑，“等一下，让我先走到门口来。” 你耐心地等待着，听到他在屋里忙乱地走动了一会儿，这才推开了一楼的门。你走进去时，他用怀疑的目光看着你，但最终还是让你毫无阻碍地进来了。 “那三个人也离开了我，而且还偷走了我一些珍贵的东西，”你满口谎言地说道。 “啊哈！我还在想你为什么会来找我呢。我想，如果你也经历了和我一样的痛苦，我应该能够原谅你的过错！”他说着，拿起那杯蜂蜜酒，眯着眼睛仔细端详着。“哈！这些酿酒师们很清楚女性的作用——她们头脑简单，只需要有人给她们指明方向罢了。 他说得越久，你就越不会因为欺骗他而感到内疚，于是你干脆从背包里拿出一瓶普通的蜂蜜酒，大口喝了起来。看到你喝的正是他以为的那种酒，希鲁德也解开了包装，几大口就把整瓶酒喝光了。 天啊，太好了……你刚才说你从哪里弄到那个……什么……”他边说边扔掉喇叭，伸手去摸腰间的包。“里面装的是什么？你到底拿了什么……” 他话还没说完，就已经掏出一颗烟雾弹，在你还没来得及阻止他的时候扔了出去。浓重的油状烟雾充满了这个封闭的空间，你听到希鲁德撞在桌子上，然后重重地摔在了地上。当烟雾终于从敞开的门中散去时，你看到他蜷缩在橱柜附近，呼吸急促，双手紧抱双膝。你眼睁睁地看着一系列迅速的变化在他身上发生。 首先发生变化的是他的肌肉量。当你看到他展示肌肉时，会清楚地看到他的力量正在实时减弱。虽然肌肉的宽度依然存在，但力量已经被柔软的脂肪所取代。他所有的二头肌力量以及核心肌群的力量，都集中在那仿佛在邀请人们去捏的腹部，以及一对同样柔软的胸部上。由于他的服装设计让胸部完全暴露在外，这两处部位就彻底暴露在了人们的视线中。 它发出一声哀鸣，你的耳边听到它的声音从粗哑变得柔和，那哀鸣最终变成了凄厉的“哞！”。它的口鼻部逐渐变得圆润，最后形成了一条宽宽的鼻子和一对饱满的黑色嘴唇。它的毛发依然杂乱无章，完全遮住了它的眼睛和大部分耳朵。他头上的角也几乎没有发生变化，仍然像车把一样向前伸出。你可以看到，他腰部以上的毛发都变成了颜色相同的皮肤，看起来比他之前那粗糙的身体要光滑得多。 在臀部以下，它的毛发依然存在，蹄子也还在，尾巴摆动时也会发出声响，但整个身体看起来都变得柔软而可爱，似乎完全适合被抚摸和拥抱。它那看似坚硬的身体部位，仿佛都被精心组合成了一个柔软、惹人怜爱的小家伙。它抬起头看着你，下唇微微颤抖着，然后将双膝紧紧抱在胸前。

All the bicep and core strength goes into a tummy that looks like it's begging to be squeezed and a pair of tits that rival it in softness. The horns atop his head also remain very much the same, sticking out the front like handlebars. You can also see all the fur above his waist smooth out into similarly colored skin, looking much smoother than his former rough body. Below the hips, the fur remains, along with the hooves, and the swishing tail, but everything rounds out to look plush and breedable. It's as if every part of his (or her, you suppose) indomitable bulk has been concatenated into a plush bimbo package. She looks up at you with a fearful tremble in her lower lip, and hugs her knees against her chest. '

You lead Haddi all the way to the fort, finding an empty bedspace for her to use in the common area. Sitting her on the beds edge, you give her a comforting [pc.dcb|honk on the boob.|squeeze on the shoulder.|honk on the boob.]

    "Ok Haddi, think you're gonna be ok here?" you ask.
    
    "Y-you mean I just get to live here?" she asks right back, staring around with wide eyes and an open mouth.
    
    "I'm sure you'll be expected to help out around the place, but yeah! I'll have some of the maids come around and help you get situated."
    
    "Thank you, like, big bunches. I don't even know what to say other than thanks."
    
    "That's all I need for now. I'll be back to check on you later."
    
    "Ok! See you later, [pc.name]!"

rows.original: Before you arrive, you turn to the bimbo bumbling curiously behind you. She bumps boob-first into you, looking expectantly as she waits. "Ok sweetie. I'm going to hand you over to some friends. I want you to treat them nice, and they'll treat you nice." "O-ok! Thank you!" she says, nodding. You visit one of the barracks, finding the highest ranking boreal elf guard and presenting the shy minotaur. "This is Haddi. She's new here. Can you guys help her learn the ropes? She's really eager to learn." "Yeah! I can learn and stuff! I was, like, a really cool mercenary!" The elf gives her an incredulous look, but smiles. "Sure you were, sweetie. Can you handle a mop?" "Nope! But I'm sure I can, like, learn it! I can help with other stuff too, I'm sure!" The elf wraps an arm around her shoulder, walking with her deeper into the barracks as she prattles on about the handful of things she can do. "Thanks boss," one of the other elves says with a giggle. You leave them alone to train their new maid/relief officer, returning to your adventure knowing there's one less potential threat for you and the women of Khor'minos to worry about.
